text.body:
<5.1.1>
|| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrījagadaṃbāyai namaḥ || || athāvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate || || vyāsa uvāca || || sraṣṭāro'pi prajānāṃ prabalabhavabhayādyaṃ namasyaṃti devā yo hyavyakte praviṣṭaḥ pravihitamanasāṃ dhyānayuktātmanāṃ ca || lokānāmādidevaḥ sa jayatu bhagavāñchrīmahā kālanāmā bibhrāṇaḥ somalekhāmahivalayayutaṃ vyaktaliṃgaṃ kapālam || 1 || || umovāca || || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāśca saritastathā|| kathyaṃtāṃ tāni yatnena śraddhā yeṣu prajāyate || 2 || īśvara uvāca || || asti lokeṣu vikhyātā gaṃgā tripathagā nadī || sevitā devagandharvairmunibhiśca niṣevitā || 3 || tapanasya sutā devī yamunā lokapāvanī || pitṝṇāṃ vallabhā devī mahāpātakanāśinī || 4 || candrabhāgā vitastā ca narmadā'marakaṇṭake || kurukṣetraṃ gayā devi prabhāsaṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā || 5 || kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva tathā kāyāvarohaṇam || tathā puṇyatamaṃ devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 6 || yatrāste śrīmahākālaḥ pāpendhanahutāśanaḥ || kṣetraṃ yojanaparyaṃtaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam || 7 || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ kṣetraṃ kalika lmaṣanāśanam || pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ devi duṣprāpaṃ tridaśairapi || 8 || || umovāca || || prabhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ deva kṣetrasyāsya maheśvara || yāni tīrthāni vidyante yāni liṃgāni saṃti vai|| 9 || tānyahaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 5.1.1.10 || || mahādeva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi prayatnena prabhāvaṃ pāpanāśanam || kṣetramādyaṃ mahādevi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 11 || śrīmeroḥ saṃnidhāne ca śikharaṃ ratnacihnitam || anekāścaryanilayaṃ bahupādapasaṃkulam || 12 || vicitradhātubhiścitraṃ svacchasphaṭikavedikam || vicitravarṇaśobhāḍhyamṛṣisaṃghanināditam || 13 || mṛganāgendrasaṃyuktaṃ gajayūthasamākulam || nirjharāṃbuprapātotthaśīkarākarasaṃkulam || 14 || vātāhatataruvrātaprasūnāsthānacitritam || mṛganābhivarāmodavāsitā śeṣakānanam || 15 || latāgṛharatisthānaṃ siddhavidyādharāśrayam || pravīṇakinnaravrātamadhuradhvanināditam || 16 || tasminvane mahāramye śobhitāśeṣa bhūmikam || vairājaṃ nāma bhavanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 17 || tatra divyāṃganāgītamadhuradhvanināditā || pārijātatarucchannamaṃjarīdāmaśobhitā || || 18 || bahuvādyasamunnaddhamahāsvananināditā || layatālayutānekagītavāditranāditā || 19 || vinyastā koṭibhiḥ staṃbhairnirmalādarśaśobhitā || layatālayutānekamahākautukasaṃyutā || 5.1.1.20 || apsaronṛtyavinyāsavilāsollāsaśobhitā || sabhā kāṃtimatīnāma devānāṃ harṣadāyikā || 21 || ṛṣisaṃghasamākīrṇā munivṛndaniṣevitā || dvijātivedaśabdena nāditā''naṃdadāyikā || 22 || tasyāṃ niviṣṭaṃ vāgīśaṃ śaṃkarārādhane ratam || sanatkumāraṃ brahmarṣiṃ brahmaṇo mānasaṃ sutam || 23 || munimadhyātsamutthāya kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ || parāśarasuto vyāsaḥ praṇipatya yathāvidhi || 24 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhavabhaktyānubhāvitaḥ || papraccha parayā tuṣṭyā harṣitāṃgaruhānanaḥ || 25 || mahākālasya māhātmyaṃ prāṇināṃ mohanāśanam || || || vyāsa uvāca || || mahākālavanaṃ kasmātprocyate sarvato varam || 26 || bhagavankṣetramāhātmyaṃ mahākālasya kathyatām || kathaṃ guhyavanaṃ proktaṃ pīṭhatvamūṣaraṃ tathā || 27 || phalaṃ yathātra vasatāṃ mṛtānāṃ ca gatiryathā || snānena yadbhavetpuṇyaṃ dānenāpi ca yatphalam || 28 || kathametatsmaśānaṃ ca kṣetraṃ proktaṃ yathā tathā || pṛṣṭaṃ me śaṃkare bhaktyā brūhi tvaṃ śāstrakovida || 29 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || kṣīyate pātakaṃ yatra tenedaṃ kṣetramucyate || yasmātsthānaṃ ca mātṝṇāṃ pīṭhaṃ tenaiva kathyate || 5.1.1.30 || mṛtāḥ punarna jāyaṃte tenedamūṣaraṃ smṛtam || guhyametatpriyaṃ nityaṃ kṣetraṃ śaṃbhormahā tmanaḥ ||31|| yasmādiṣṭaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ smaśānamativallabham || mahākālavanaṃ yacca tathā caivāvimuktikam || 32 || ekāmrakaṃ bhadrakālaṃ karavīravanameva ca || kolāgiristathā kāśī prayāgamamareśvaram || 33 || bharathaṃ caiva kedāraṃ divyaṃ rudramahālayam || divyasmaśānānyetāni rudrasyeṣṭāni nityaśaḥ || || 34 || ramate bhagavāneṣu siddhakṣetreṣu sarvadā || pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamaṃ tīrthapuṣkaram || 35 || trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ kurukṣetraṃ praśasyate || kurukṣetrāddaśaguṇā puṇyā vārāṇasī matā || 36 || tasyā daśaguṇaṃ vyāsa mahākālavanottamam || prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāmiha yāni tu || 37 || prabhāsamuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetramādyaṃ pinākinaḥ || śrīśailamuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ devadāruvanaṃ tathā || 38 || tasmādapyuttamaṃ vyāsa puṇyā vārāṇasī matā|| tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthottamaṃ yataḥ||39|| mahākālavanaṃ guhyaṃ siddhakṣetraṃ tathoṣaram || kiṃcidguhyānyathānyāni smaśānānyūṣarāṇi ca ||5.1.1.40|| sarvatastu samākhyātaṃ mahākālavanaṃ mune || smaśānamūṣarakṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ tu vanameva ca ||41|| paṃcaikatra na labhyaṃte mahākālapurādṛte ||42|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye mahākālavanapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<5.1.2>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā tvekārṇave prāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || nāgnirna vāyurādityo na bhūmirna diśo nabhaḥ ||1|| na nakṣatrāṇi na jyotirna dyaurneṃdurgrahā stathā || na devāsuragaṃdharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ || 2 || sarāṃsi naiva girayo nāpagā nābdhayastathā || sarvamevatamobhūtaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 3 || tadaiko hi mahākālo lokānugrahakāraṇāt || tasthau sthānānyaśeṣāṇi kāṣṭhāsvālokayanprabhuḥ || 4 || sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sa mahākālaḥ kare kāmaṃ pratiṣṭhitam|| dakṣiṇasya tu tarjanyāṃ sa mamaṃthāviśoṣitam ||5|| kalalaṃ budbudaṃ bhūtvā tavivegavivarddhitam || jajñe tadaṃḍaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ suṣṭhu vṛttaṃ hiraṇmayam ||6|| kareṇa tāḍitaṃ taddhi babhūva dvidalaṃ mahat || adhaḥkhaṃḍaṃ smṛtā bhūmirūrdhvaṃ dyaustārakānvitam || 7 || madhye'bhavattadā brahmā paṃcavaktraścaturbhujaḥ || maheśvaro'numānyaiva tamayojadanaṃtaram || 8 || kuru sṛṣṭiṃ mahābāho vicitrāṃ madanugrahāt || ityuktvāṃtarhitaḥ kvāpi devo brahmā na jagmivān || 9 || preryamāṇo'pi vai sraṣṭuṃ brahmā devamaciṃtayat || brahmaṇā dhyāyamānaśca jñānārthaṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ || 5.1.2.10 || brahmaṇastapasā dṛṣṭaḥ prādādvedaṃ ṣaḍaṃgakam || labdhe vede'pi na cirātsaṣṭiṃ kartuṃ śaśāka saḥ ||11|| tapasā'tiṣṭhadā bhūyaḥ samārādhayituṃ bhavam || nāpaśyatsa yadā devaṃ tadā tuṣṭāva bhāvitaḥ || 12 ||| || brahmovāca || || namaḥ śivāyāmalasattvacetase guṇatrayātītavisāritejase || ṣaḍaṃgavedasya mamāpi vedhase parasvarūpānubhavāya cakṣuṣe || 13 || namo' stu te sṛṣṭividhau rajojuṣe jagatsthitau sattvamadhiṣṭhitāya te || vināśahetau tamasā mahīyase śivāya nirvāṇasukhapradāyine ||14|| aśeṣabhūtaprakṛteḥ parā ya vai parātmarūpāya namaḥ śivāya vai || nṛbuddhyahaṃkāramanovidhāyine bhartre ca ṣaḍviṃśakarūpakāya vai || 15 || bhūtoyavahnyambaravāyucaṃdrasūryātmarūpābhiridaṃ tanūbhiḥ || vyāptaṃ jagadyasya namo'stu tasmai bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyamatha vartamānam || 16 || yānīha tejāṃsi jagaṃti yāni bhūtāni bhavyānyatha kāraṇāni || bhavaṃti sṛṣṭau vilayaṃ vināśe vrajaṃti yasyātmani taṃ namāmi || 17 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || evaṃ saṃstuvato vyāsa brahmaṇo bhagavānparaḥ || antarhita uvācedaṃ brahmansaṃyācyatāṃ varaḥ || 18 || sa vavre manasā putraṃ bhavaṃ gauravakāraṇāt || vijñāyāṃtargataṃ tasya parameśa uvāca tam || 19 || yasmānmāṃ manasā putraṃ caturmukha samīhase || kasmiṃścitkāraṇe tasmādahaṃ chetsyāmi te śiraḥ || 5.1.2.20 || ayācyaṃ yācitaṃ yasmānmamāṃśo nīlalohitaḥ || rudro bhaviṣyati sutaḥ sa ca te hiṃsyati prabhām || 21 || anyadyasmātsmṛto bhaktyā tvayāhaṃ pitṛbhāvataḥ || parabrahmasvarūpeṇa jijñāsā mama yā kṛtā || || 22 || tasmādbrahmeti loke'tra nāma khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || pitāmahatvaṃ tenāpi pitāmahastato hyasi || 23 || labdhvā śāpavarāvevaṃ putrasṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ || svatejojanitaṃ vahniṃ juhvataḥ svedamāvahat ||24|| samidyuktena hastena lalāṭaṃ mārjato'bhavat || svinnabhraṣṭastato raktabiṃdureko vibhāvasau ||25||| sa nīlalohito'bhūdvai sa ca rudro bhavājñayā || tadanantaramāsādya uttatāra sutoṃ'tikāt || 26 || paṃcavaktro daśabhujaḥ śūlacāpāsiśaktimān || tripaṃca nayano raudro vyālayajñopavītakaḥ || 27 || senduḥ kapardaṃ bibhrāṇaḥ siṃhacarmāṃbaraṃdharaḥ || jātamevaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā tu brahmā nāmākarottadā || 28 || nīlalohitanāmeti bhava rudra pinākadhṛk || tataḥ pravavṛte sṛṣṭiḥ sraṣṭurlokapitāmahāt || 29 || saptādau mānasāñjajñe sanakādīṃstato'parān || marīci dakṣaprabhṛtīnmanvādīṃśca prajāsṛjaḥ || 5.1.2.30 || aṣṭabhedānsurānkṛtvā tiryagyoniṃ ca paṃcadhā || manuṣyānekabhedāṃśca sṛṣṭimevaṃ sasarja ha || 31 || sṛṣṭiḥ surādikā jātā kṛtvā brahmāṇamapyadhaḥ || praṇamyātha siṣevuste kevalaṃ nīlalohitam || 32 || tato brahmā'vadadrudramapūjyo hi tvayā kṛtaḥ || svatejasā bhavānpūjyo yato yāhi himālayam ||33|| taṃ nīlalohitaḥ proce bhavatā nārcito hyaham || tato jagāma rudro'sau sa yatra bhagavānbhavaḥ ||34|| tato brahmā'bhavanmūḍho rajasā copabṛṃhitaḥ || tatāpa tejasā sṛṣṭiṃ manyamāno mayā kṛtām || 35|| mattulyo nāsti vai devo yena sṛṣṭiḥ pravarddhitā || sadevāsuragandharvā paśu pakṣimṛgākulā || 36 | evaṃ mūḍhaḥ sa paṃcāsyo viraṃcyo'bhavaddarpitaḥ || prāgvaktraṃ susvaraṃ tasya sāmavedapravartakam || 37 || dvitīyaṃ vadanaṃ tasya ṛgve dasya pravartakam|| yajurvedadharaṃ cānyadatharvākhyaṃ caturthakam || 38 || sāṃgopāṃgetihāsāṃśca sarahasyānsasaṃgrahān || vedānadhīte vaktreṇa paṃcamenopacakṣuṣā || || 39 || tasyā'surāḥ surāḥ sarve vaktrasyādbhutatejasaḥ || tejasā na prakāśaṃte dīpaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 5.1.2.40 || saputrā api sodvegā babhūvurnaṣṭa cetasaḥ || nābhigantuṃ na ca draṣṭuṃ ciraṃ tejo'pasarpitum || 41 || abhibhūtamivātmānaṃ manyamānā avidviṣaḥ || sarve te mantrayāmāsurdevā vai hitamā tmanaḥ || 42 || gacchāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ nistejā brahmatejasā || kiṃ tu tasya na jānīmaḥ sthānaṃ yatra vyavasthitaḥ || 43 || taṃ bhīmamatra dakṣyāmo bhaktyā nānyena kenacit || evaṃ saṃmantrya te devāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāstadā || cakruḥ stotraṃ maheśasya parayā svarasaṃpadā || 44 || || devā ūcuḥ ||| namaste devadeveśa maheśvara namonamaḥ || 45 || na vidmaḥ paramaṃ mūḍhā mahimānaṃ tavātulam || yadyogena paraṃ brahma bhūtānāṃ tvaṃ sanātanaḥ || 46 || pratiṣṭhā sarvabhūtānāṃ hetuḥ sarvasya sarjane || bibharṣi caiva netrasthānsomasūryavibhāvasūn || 47 || nāmasaṃkīrtanādeva mucyante jaṃtavo'śubhāt || pṛthivyabagnicandrārkavyomavāyūpalakṣaṇāḥ || 48 || mūrtayaste mahādeva vyāptamābhiraśeṣataḥ || rajaḥsattvatamobhāvairbhrāmyamāṇaṃ tvayā jagat || 49 || nāvabudhyati sarveśa sarvamūrtidharo yataḥ || brahmādīnāṃ sureśānāṃ saṃmohanavimohanam || tvaṃ karoṣi yugāvartakāle kāle ca duḥsaham || 5.1.2.50 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā devānāmanukaṃpayā || prasannavadano bhūtvā devaiścāpi namaskṛtaḥ || 51 || vāsayanmohanāmnā tu saha devairmaheśvaraḥ ||52|| evaṃ saṃstūyamāno'sau devarṣipitṛmānavaiḥ || antarhita uvācedaṃ devā brūta yathepsitam || 53 || || devā ūcuḥ || || pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ sthāṇo prārthayāma sadā tava || tvayā kāruṇyato'smākaṃ varaścāpi pradīyatām || 54 || yadasmākaṃ mahadvīryaṃ tejaścaiva parākramam || tatsarvaṃ brahmaṇā grastaṃ paṃcamāsyasya tejasā || 55 || vineśuḥ sarvatejāṃsi tvatprasādātpunaḥ prabho || jāyate tadyathāpūrvaṃ tathā kuru maheśvara || 56 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || pratyakṣametya vai paścāccalitaḥ śarva eva hi || jagāma tatra yatrāsau rajo'haṃkāramūrttimān|| devāḥ stuvaṃto deveśaṃ parivārya upāviśan || || 57 || brahmā tamāgataṃ devaṃ nājānāttamasā vṛtaḥ || sūryakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ tejasā raṃjayañjagat || 58 || tadā'dṛśyata viśvātmā viśvasṛgviśvabhāva naḥ || sa pitāmahamāsīnaṃ sakale devamaṇḍale || 59 || tejasābhibhavanrudrastena matto'grataḥ sthitaḥ || rudratejobhibhūtaṃ ca brahmavaktraṃ na rājate || 5.1.2.60 || rātrau prakāśakiraṇaścaṃdraḥ sūryodaye yathā || sagarvothātmajaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudradevaṃ sanātanam || 61 || avandata kareṇaiva prāha vai sasmitaṃ vacaḥ || pratyuvāca virūpākṣo brahmāṇaṃ taṃ hasanniva || 62 || yato na veda paramaṃ devaṃ tattejasāvṛtaḥ || tato'ṭṭahāsaṃ bhagavānmumoca śaśiśekharaḥ || 63 || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vācamuktavān || tenādṛhāsaśabdena mohayitvā pitāmaham || 64 || tejorāśiśaśāṃkābhaḥ śaśāṃkārkāgnilocanaḥ || vāmāṃguṣṭhanakhāgreṇa brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ || 65 || cakarta kadalīgarbhaṃ naraḥ kararuhairiva || chidyamānaṃ ca tadvaktraṃ bubudhe na pitāmahaḥ || 66 || rudrasya tejasā tasmānmo hito na natiṃ gataḥ || chinnaṃ tasya śiraḥ paścādrudrahaste sthitaṃ tadā || 67 || apaśyaddaivataiḥ sārdhaṃ raudramatibhayājjvalat || maheśvarakarāṃtasthanakhai rvaktraṃ virājate || 68 || grahamaṇḍalamadhyastho dvitīya iva candramāḥ || utkṣipya tatkapālena nanarta śaśiśekharaḥ || 69 || śikharasthena sūryeṇa kailāsa iva parvataḥ || chinne vaktre tato devā hṛṣṭapuṣṭā vṛṣadhvajam || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairdevadevaṃ kapālinam || 5.1.2.70 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaḥ kapāline nityaṃ mahākālāya śaṃkhine || 71 || aiśvaryajñānayuktāya sarvabhogapradāyine || namo darpavināśāya sarvadevamayāya ca || 72 || kālasaṃhārakartā tvaṃ mahākālastato hyasi || bhaktānāṃ duḥkhaśamano duḥkhāṃtastena rocase || 73 || śaṃkaropyāśu bhaktānāṃ tena tvaṃ śaṃkaraḥ smṛtaḥ || chittvā brahmaśiro yasmātkapālaṃ ca bibharṣi ca ||74|| tena deva kapālī tvaṃ stuto hyasi prasīda naḥ || evaṃ stutaḥ prasannātmā devānutthāpya śaṃkaraḥ ||75|| kṛpānidhiḥ sa bhagavāṃstatraivāṃtaradhīyata || śaśiśakalamayūkhairbhāsita yatkapardaṃ dravati gaganagaṃgātoyavīcīviceyam|| sitavidhṛtakapālo mālayā rudrapārśve sa jayati jitavedhā ūrjitaḥ prājyatejāḥ ||76|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaāvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye brahmaśiraścheda varṇanaṃ nāmadvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 |||cha|||
<5.1.3>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || chinne vaktre tato brahmā krodhena tamasā vṛtaḥ || lalāṭe svadamutpannaṃ gṛhītvā'tāḍayadbhuvi || 1 || tatsvedātkuṃḍalī jajñe sadhanuḥ samaheṣudhiḥ || sahasrakavaco vīraḥ kiṃ karomītyuvāca ha || 2 || tamuvāca viraṃcistu darśayanrudramojasā || vadhyatāmeṣa durbuddhirjāyate na yathā punaḥ || 3 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā dhanurudyamya pṛṣṭhataḥ || sa pratasthe maheśasya bāṇahasto'tiroṣabhṛt || 4 || sa dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ cogramagamadvismito bhavaḥ || divyabāṇadhanurhastaṃ vegavikrāṃtagāminam || 5 || mayā na vadhyo'tibalaḥ sakhā viṣṇorbhaviṣyati || anugrāhyo hyahaṃ tena sakhyārthaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ || 6 || ciṃtayannitthamīśo'pi viṣṇorāśramamabhyagāt || huṃkāradhvaninā brahmanmohayitvā tato naram || 7 || prapātya ca tadā hṛṣṭaḥ krīḍāṃ kurvañjagatsthitau || yatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmāṃstapastepe pratāpavān || 8 || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ viśvātmā viśvasṛgvibhuḥ || tatra prāpto virūpākṣo dadarśa madhusūdanam || 9 || ekāṃguṣṭhasthitaṃ bhūmau tapo'tyaṃtamanāturam || yugāṃtārkasahasrasya tejasā vṛtamadbhutam || 5.1.3.10 || puṇyā dhārasamāyuktaṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ bhikṣāṃ dehītyuvāca ha || 11 || kapālaṃ darśayitvāgre jvalajjvalanasotkaṭam || kapālapāṇiṃ saṃprekṣya rudraṃ viṣṇuraciṃtayat || 12 || ko'nyo yogyo bhavedbhikṣurbhikṣādānasya sāṃpratam || yogyo'yamiti saṃkalpya dakṣiṇaṃ bhujamarpayat || 13 || taṃ bibhedāṃtargatajñaḥ śūlena śaśiśekharaḥ || tataḥ pravāha utpannaḥ śoṇitasya vibhorbhujāt || 14 || jāṃbūnadarasākārā vahnijvāleva nirmalā || niṣpapāta kapālāṃte śaṃbhunā saṃpratīcchitā || 15 || ṛjvī vegavatī śiprā dīdhitīvāṃbare raveḥ || paṃcāśadyojanā dīrghā vistāre daśayojanā || 16 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sā samuvāha harerbhujāt || kiyaṃtaṃ kālamīśo hi bhikṣāṃ jagrāha bhāvitaḥ || 17 || dattāṃ nārāyaṇenātha satpātre pātra uttame || tato nārāyaṇaḥ prāha haraṃ paramidaṃ vacaḥ || 18 || saṃpūrṇaṃ tava pātraṃ hi tato vai parameśvaraḥ || satoyāṃbudanirghoṣaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ harerharaḥ || 19 || śaśisūryāgni nayanaḥ śaśiśekharaśobhitaḥ || kapāle dṛṣṭimāveśya trinetraiśca janārdanam || 5.1.3.20 || aṃgulyā ghaṭayanprāha kapālaṃ cātipūritam || śrutvā hariridaṃ vākyaṃ raktadhārāṃ samāharat || 21 || pārśvatotha harerīśaḥ svāṃgulyā rudhiraṃ tadā || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca dṛṣṭipātaṃ mamaṃtha vai || 22 || mathyamāne tato rakte kalalaṃ budbudaṃ kramāt || babhūva ca tataḥ paścātkirīṭī saśarāsanaḥ || 23 || sahasrabāhū raktākṣo dhanurjyāṃ saṃspṛśanmuhuḥ || babhūva tūṇīragalo vṛṣaskaṃdhoṃ'gulitravān || 24 || puruṣo'rjunasaṃkāśaḥ kapāle saṃprakāśayan || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prāha rudramidaṃ vacaḥ || 25 || kapāle bhagavanko'yaṃ prādurbhūto'bhavannaraḥ || uktiṃ śrutvā harerīśastamuvāca hare śṛṇu || 26 || naro nāmeti puruṣaḥ paramāstravidāṃvaraḥ || yastvayokto nara iti narastasmādbha viṣyati || 27 || naranārāyaṇau cobhau yuge khyātau bhaviṣyataḥ || saṃgrāme devakāryeṣu lokānāṃ paripālane || 28 || eṣa nārāyaṇa sakhā narastava bhaviṣyati || tava ekākinaḥ saṃkhye tapasaśca mahāmuniḥ || 29 || vijñānasya parīkṣāyai tejo loke bhaviṣyati || tejodhikamidaṃ divyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || 5.1.3.30 || tejasā brahmaṇo dīpto bhujasya tava śoṇitāt || mama dṛṣṭinipātācca trīṇi tejāṃsi yānyataḥ || 31 || tatsaṃyogātsamutpannaḥ śatrūnudvejayiṣyati || avadhyā ye bhaviṣyaṃti durjayāstava cāpare || 32 || śakrasya cāmarārīṇāṃ teṣāmeva bhayaṃkaraḥ || evamuktavataḥ śaṃbhorvismitastasya tejasā || 33 || harirapi sa tatraiva tuṣṭāva harakeśavau || namo hara hare tubhyaṃ namaḥ śaṃkara viṣṇave || 34 || namaste śūlahastāya namaste khaṅgapā ṇaye || namonamaste medhyāya hṛṣīkeśa namo'stu te || 35 || namo'stu vācāṃ pataye śrīdharāya namonamaḥ || evaṃ stuvantaṃ taṃ bhaktyā kṛtāṃjali puṭaṃ naram|| 36 || tathaivāṃjalisaṃbaddhaṃ gṛhītvāśu karadvayam|| uddhṛtyātha kapālāttu punarvacanamabravīt || 37 || ya eva puruṣo raudro brahmaṇaḥ svedasaṃ bhavaḥ || mama huṃkāraśabdena mohanidrāmupāgataḥ || 38 || nibodha taṃ ca tvaritamityuktvāṃtarhito haraḥ || nārāyaṇasya pratyakṣaṃ bodhayitvā drutaṃ hi tam|| 39 || vāmapādena hatvā ca samuttasthau naro ruṣā || tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavatsvedaraktajayormahat || 5.1.3.40 || visphāritadhanuḥśabdairnāditāśeṣabhūta lam|| kavacaṃ svedajasyaikaṃ raktajasya tathā bhujau ||41|| evaṃ samena vai yuddhaṃ divyaṃ jātaṃ tu bhūtale || trivarṣonāni varṣāṇāṃ śatāni daśa sudvija||42|| yudhyato samatītāni svedaraktajayormune || raktajo dvibhujo dṛṣṭvā kavacaikena svedajam || 43 || bibheda bāṇavegena brahmaṇastaṃ naraṃ param || sasaṃbhramamu vācedaṃ brahmāṇaṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 44 || mannareṇocchrito brahmaṃstvadīyo vinipātitaḥ || śrutvā tadākulo brahmā babhāṣe madhusūdanam || 45 || hare'nyajanmani naro madīyo yadi hīyate || tena tuṣṭena saṃproktaṃ hariṇaivaṃ bhaviṣyati || 46 || kṛtvā tayo raṇamapi nivārya tāvuvāca ha || athānyajanmani naro madīyo bhavitā kalau || 47 || tato mahāraṇe jāte tatrāhaṃ yojayāmi tam || viṣṇunātha samāhūya maheśvarasureśvarau || 48 || uktāvimau narau rudrau pālanīyau svaśaktitaḥ || svedajātāsṛgjātau tu svakīyāṃśau dharātale || svāṃśabhūtau dvāparāṃte niyojyau bhūtale tvayā || 49 || tato'bravīttadā viṣṇuṃ sureśo duḥkhitaṃ vacaḥ || 5.1.3.50 || asminmanvaṃtare deva tretāyugaṃ tadā yadā || tvadrūpeṇeha mahatā sūryaputrahitārthinā || vālīnāma mahābāhuḥ sugrīvārthe nipātitaḥ || 51 || tena duḥkhena tapto'haṃ nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi te naram || agṛhṇamānaṃ deveśaṃ kāraṇāṃtaravādinam || 52 || viṣṇuḥ provāca maghavanbhuvo bhārāvatāraṇe|| avatāraṃ kariṣyāmi martyaloke'pyahaṃ vibho||53|| tato hṛṣṭo'bhavacchakro viṣṇuvākyena tena vai|| pratigṛhya naraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ satyamastu vacastava || 54 || ityuktvā tu ravīndrau sa preṣayitvā ca tau punaḥ || gatvā ca puṇḍarīkākṣo brahmāṇaṃ brahmaveśmani || 55 || kṛtaṃ jugupsitaṃ karma brahmannīśaṃ jighāṃsatā || yattvayā devadeveśa pumānkopena bhāṣitaḥ || 56 || śuddhyarthamasya pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ paraṃ kuru || gṛhṇanvahnitrayaṃ brahmannagni hotramupāsva ha || 57 || eko vai gārhapatyo'stu dvitīyāhavanīyakaḥ || dakṣiṇāgnistṛtīyastu trikuṇḍeṣu prakalpaya || 58 || vartule tarpayātmānaṃ māmatho dhanuṣākṛtau || catuṣkoṇe haraṃ devamṛgyajuḥsāmanāmabhiḥ || 59 || hutvā tvagniṃ ca tapasā haramevārcya tatkṣaṇāt || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu hutvāgniṃ siddhimāpsyasi || 5.1.3.60 || prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā pratipadya maheśvaram|| tato niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā viṣādaste gamiṣyati || 61 || ityevamuktvā harirugratejā gataḥ svakīyaṃ nilayaṃ mahātmā || brahmāpi cittaṃ tapase nidhāya samādadhe sarvamathācyutoktam ||62|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāha sryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vaṃtīkṣetramāhātmye brahmaṇaḥ prāyaścittavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||cha|||
<5.1.4>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || yo'sau kapāla utpanno naronāma dhanurdharaḥ|| kimevaṃ so'dhunā jāta utpattau viśvakarmaṇaḥ||1|| kathaṃ rudreṇa janitaḥ prabhuṇā buddhipūrvakam|| viṣṇunā vā bhagavatā brahmaṇā bhāva bhedataḥ ||2|| kena kasmātsamutpannaḥ śaṃkarācyutabrahmaṇām || brahmā hiraṇyagarbho yo yo jātaśca caturmukhaḥ || 3 || adbhutaṃ paṃcamaṃ vaktraṃ kathaṃ tasyāpyupasthi tam || sa tasthau bhagavānbrahmā kathaṃ rudre mano'dadhat || 4 || mūḍhātmanā naro yena haṃtuṃ sa prahito haram || 5 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || maheśvaraharī etau dvāveva sati tiṣṭhataḥ || tayoraviditaṃ nāsti siddhāsiddhaṃ mahātmanoḥ || 6 || brahmaṇaḥ paṃcamaṃ vaktraṃ yattadāsīnmahātmanaḥ || tasyaiva mānasaḥ sogniḥ śirasā tena vai dhṛtaḥ || 7 || yo naro brahmaṇaḥ proktaḥ so'pyagnistasya mānasaḥ || dadhāra taṃ mahādevaḥ kṛtvāṃgulyaṃtarāṃtare || 8 || pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭvā samutpatti mevaṃ tasya mahānnaraḥ || tasmātkapālamaṃgulyāṃ ghaṭṭamānamajāyata || 9 || sa taṃ hatvā śareṇājau brahmaṇo nihitaṃ rajaḥ || mumoha rajasā sattvaṃ yadṛcchā kṛtprabhuryataḥ || 5.1.4.10 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathamagniḥ samutpanno yoniḥ sarveṇa dhāritaḥ || vistareṇa tadācakṣva bhagavanmunivaṃdita || 11 || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || avyaktādīnyasasarjādāvaṃḍaṃ hi tadajāyata || jajñe sauvarṇavarṇābho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 12 || svayaṃbhūḥ sa tapastaptvā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ mahat || sa tapaḥstho vyājahāra bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti śrutīḥ || 13 || śrutiyogāttu manasaḥ paścādagnirajāyata || adhomukhaḥ papātāgniḥ pṛthivīṃ nirdahanyadā || 14 || pāṇibhyāṃ brahmaṇā sognirbhūmerūrdhvaṃ niveśitaḥ || tato dakṣiṇahastena vedyāmagniḥ praṇīyate || 15 || purāpatannadhojvā la ūrdhvajvālo yadā dhṛtaḥ || uttānaśca kṛto yasmādbrahmaṇā nirmito mithaḥ || 16 || jvālābhiḥ prajvalannūrdhvaṃ sarvaśabdasphuliṃgavān || hiraṇyavarṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tadovācānirutkaṭaḥ || 17 || kimarthaṃ tu tvayā deva bhūmibhakṣaṃ nivāritam || bubhukṣayāhamāviṣṭa āhāro me pradīyatām || 18 || eva mukto'gnaye brahmā svaromāṇi juhāva saḥ || kṛśaścakhāda agnistu sarvaromāṇi brahmaṇaḥ || 19 || abravīcca na me tṛptirna ca me dehanirvṛtiḥ || tvacaṃ juhāva brahmā ca cakhādāgnistvacaṃ tadā || 5.1.4.20 || abravīttaṃ tadā vahnistṛptirnāsti mameti hi || juhāva svāni māṃsāni tvacotkṛtya prajāpatiḥ || 21 || abravīcca na me tṛptirna ca me dehanirvṛtiḥ|| juhāva brahmā cāsthīni tānyaśnātsa bubhukṣitaḥ || 22 || tato dhātrā hutāśāya kṛto deho vidhātukaḥ | tamadehamatho dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇamavadacca saḥ || 23 || aho brahmanna me tṛptirna ca me dehanirvṛtiḥ| kuddheṇa brahmaṇā so'gnirhuṃkāreṇa dvidhā kṛtaḥ || 24 || āhatū rudatāvagnī āhārārthaṃ prajāpatim || huṃkāreṇa punarbrahmā dvidhaikaikaṃ cakāra vai || 25 || trayasteṣāṃ rudaṃti sma rudanhyako hyasaṃvṛtaḥ || kruddhena brahmaṇā vyāsa huṃkāreṇaiva tāḍitaḥ || 26 || rorūyamāṇe cāgnau tu punarbrahmā kṛpānvitaḥ || prāha kāmābhibhūtānāṃ bhuṃkṣva tvaṃ dehadhātukam || 27 || sa kālastasya kāmasya sā vṛttiḥ saṃprakalpitā || akārāgniṃ sanniviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā manasi mānasaḥ || 28 || huṃkārāgniḥ prajajvāla kimetaditi cābravīt || brahmā tamāha tvamapi yatheṣṭāṃ vṛttimāśraya || 29 || devamadhye bahirvāpi munīnā māśrameṣu ca || ityevamuktastenāśu vṛttimetāmarocayat || 5.1.4.30 || ahamevaṃ pradāsyāmi punaḥ punaruvāca ha || yasmādeṣa dvitīyognirhuṃkārātsama jāyata || 31 || sābhimāno'pamāno vā huṃkāro yatra kathyate || sā ca vṛttirmamādeśādbubhukṣāśāṃtaye tava || 32 || ikārāgniṃ samāhūya brahmā vacanama bravīt|| bhavatogne tviyaṃ vṛttirannaṃ bhuktaṃ daheriti ||33|| ukārāgniṃ samāhūya brahmā vacanamabravīt || yatpṛthivyāṃ gurudhyānaṃ bhagavaṃstatsamāśraya||34|| ahaṃ ca te vidhāsyāmi sthānamāhārameva ca || ityuktaḥ sa tu tenāgniryatpṛthivyāṃ śilācayaḥ || 35 || yato'gnirvyāsa tenokto girau durge mahā mune || ukārāgniḥ sa cāpyeṣa samudre vaḍavāmukhaḥ || 36 || so'pi bhinnaḥ samāhūto brahmaṇā sthānalipsayā || tvaṃ cakṣuḥ sarvalokasya brahmā vacanama bravīt || 37 || tasmāttvaṃ saṃskṛtāṃ vāṇīṃ dvijātīnāṃ prakāśaya || daivī puṇyā hi pāpāṃśca āyuṣyaṃ haṃtyasaṃskṛtā || 38 || tasmāddvijātervijñeyā vāṇī puṇyā prakāśitā || vākca mātā dvijātīnāṃ mukhe sā saṃpratiṣṭhitā || 39 || anṛtākṣaravinyāsādamaṃgalyā hyasaṃskṛtā || vaktāraṃ haṃtyato hyagniḥ sadā saṃskṛtakṛddvijaḥ || 5.1.4.40 || āhūya bhūyo'kārāgniṃ prajāpatiracakṣuṣam || vāgvedavāṇīmavadatsopi saṃmīlitekṣaṇaḥ || 41|| brahmāṇamāha vahnistu vācohaṃ mukhamasmi he || sthānaṃ mama prayacchasva sarvatejovaraṃ param || 42 || brahmā tamāha yasmāttvaṃ tejaḥsthānaṃ samīhase || tasmāttejomayaṃ yatte ravisthānaṃ bhaviṣyati ||43|| yasmāttejaḥ prapaśyaṃti cakṣurbhavati durbalam || tasmāttattejasā yuktaṃ paśyedanimiṣaṃ kvacit || 44 || ikāramatha saṃbhinnamagnimāha pitāmahaḥ || saumyadṛṣṭyā tu brahmāṇaṃ samudīkṣamupāgatam|| 45 || yasmācchīghraṃ mahāsattva saumyadṛṣṭirihāgataḥ || tasmāddāsyāmyahaṃ sthānaṃ sarvabhūtamanoramam || 46 || saṃśītātmā śītaraśmiścaṃdramāstvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || sarvatejodhiko divyaḥ saumyaḥ paramabhāsuraḥ || 47 || tarusthaḥ sarvatejāṃsi tejasā'bhibhaviṣyasi || ityuktvā taṃ visṛjyātha ukārāgnimathāhvayata || 48 || ihaihītīti śirasi samādāya nyaveśayat || tatrasthaṃ paṃcamaṃ vaktraṃ ūrdhva metatprajāyate || 49 || sa evaṃ rūpavānagnirukārāgniḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || tasmādagniśca sūryaśca ekametau vinirdiśet || 5.1.4.50 || bhavāgnirūpaṃ paramaṃ brahmāṇa midamabravīt || mamāpi ruciraṃ sthānaṃ prayacchasva yathā svayam || 51 || brahmā tamāha katamaṃ sthānaṃ te rocate'nala || agnistaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ sthānaṃ kathaya me param||52|| sthānaṃ naivāsti te bhavyaṃ tato hyevaṃ bhaviṣyati|| atra te sthātumicchāsti yadi saṃsthāsyate tviha||53|| loke nityaṃ samācāra lokasaṃsthitihetukaḥ|| saṃbhavārthamihāsa tvaṃ nijasattvaparākramaḥ||54|| yadiha tvaṃ mahājvālābhābhiḥ kalitaśobhanaḥ|| prāpsyase sarva jaṃtūnāṃ bhāsuratvamanuttamam|| na hyeṣa dharmaścaivādyo māyāmohitakāmyayā ||55|| ityukte brahmaṇā so'gniḥ prajajvāla sahasraśaḥ || anaṃtajvālābhi tato nānāvarṇādibhiḥ śritaḥ || 56 || akārekāra ūkāro brahmā tamatha dṛṣṭavān || naivāsau śāmyatāṃ yāti vahnirbhūyo vyavardhata || 57 || vyāptaṃ bhavāgninā sarvaṃ tiryagūrdhvamadhastathā || jvālābhirupari kṣiptaṃ dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 58 || ciṃtayaṃtaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ bhītaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ || śirasyaṃjalimādhāya tuṣṭāvātha praṇamya tam || 59 | tejonidhiṃ ca sarveśaṃ jñātumicchanprajāpatiḥ || niruktasūktarāhasyairṛgyajuḥsāmabhāṣitaiḥ || 5.1.4.60 || || brahmovāca || || saptatejo namaste'stu parasya paramātmane || adbhutānāṃ pratiśrotre tejasā nidhaye namaḥ || 61 || bījaṃ yo viśvabhāvānāṃ saṃmohanavimohanam || aṃdhakāro yugāvartakāle kāle ca duḥsaha || 62 || ūrdhvavaktra namastestu sattvātmaka dharātmaka || jvalajjavālotpannajala jalajeśa jalecara || 63 || jalajotphullapatrākṣa jaladeva hutāśana || kṛṣṇakāṃte kṛṣṇamārga svargamārgapradāyaka || 64 || yajñāhutisamācāra yajñarūpa namonamaḥ|| svarṇagarbha śamīgarbha jaya deva sanātana||65|| tamohāra mahāhāra svāpriya tamohara|| pradīptarocirdeveśa citrabhāno namostu te||66|| vaiśvānarānalodagra ūrdhvapāvaka sarva?? vibhāvaso mahābhāga kṛṣṇavartmannamonamaḥ || 67 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || evaṃ stutastadā sognirviraṃcimabravīdvacaḥ|| tuṣṭo'haṃ bhavato brahmanbhāvakarma prasidhyati || 68 || evamuktastadā brahmā namaskṛtyābravītpunaḥ|| jñātumicchāmyahaṃ deva ko hi tvaṃ bhagavāniti || 69 || abravītso'tha brahmāṇaṃ puruṣa stvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || ajñeyaṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ tena yogyena paśya me || 5.1.4.70 || athāpaśyatsa divyena bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam || sarvajñaṃ vidhikartāramīśvaraṃ sadasatpa ram || 71 || jvalanaṃ gaganaṃ bhūmiṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ paraṃ padam || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || sadaiva kurute devo bhuṃkte sarvaṃ yataḥ prabhuḥ || || 72 || atisaṃbhūtibhavyena stotreṇātha prajāpatiḥ || tuṣṭāva devaṃ prakṛtaṃ purāṇamajamavyayam || 73 || tato'tiraktavarṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ || viśvatobāhucaraṇaṃ viśvato'gniśiromukham ||74|| vyaktāvyaktapraṇetāraṃ praṇamañchirasā svayam|| paśyate'tha namaste'stu tubhyaṃ viśvabhavātmane || 75 || pṛthivī vāyurākāśaṃ yaccānyadbhuvanatrayam || lokālokeśvaraṃ caiva jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 76 || tattvasargaṃ bhūtasargaṃ bhāvasargaṃ tathaiva ca || brahmatejomayātmānaṃ saṃpaśyaṃścakṣuṣā svataḥ || 77 || yatkiṃcidvastujātaṃ hi tatsarvamacaraṃ caram || evaṃ stutaḥ sa tu tadā anādirbhagavānprabhuḥ|| 78 || atheśaḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathātatham || sṛjedānīṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ sa ca tvaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 79 || kartāhamanukartā tvaṃ lokānāṃ sthitikāraṇe || kuruṣvaitattathā bhāvyaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ vinirmitam || 5.1.4.80 || ityukto devadevena brahmā vacanamabravīt || namaste'stu mahādeva bhava śarva namo'stu te || 81 || tvatprasādātprajāsargaṃ kurvato me maheśvara || sakhāyaṃ prāptumicchāmi tvayā dattaṃ jagatpate ||82|| || mahe3vara uvāca || || dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya sraṣṭu kāmasya te yataḥ || kalpitaṃ bhavitā deva madutpattiṃ yadīpsyasi || 83 || putratvaṃ prāpya hīśaste chetsyāmi paṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || tatra cotpādayiṣyāmi naranārāyaṇāvubhau || 84 || || brahmovāca || || kathaṃ nārāyaṇo devastapasā manyate sa naḥ || kīrtayasva sakhā dhanyaḥ sa naḥ pūjyo bhaviṣyati || || 85 || athāpaśyattato brahmā tejasā harimacyutam || taṃ sarvagamanaṃ gamyaṃ śivaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam || 86 || maheśvarasya tejordhvaṃ saṃtaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || cakāra vyāharannārtaṃ śrīrūpaṃ śaktisāmyataḥ || 87 || aṃgulyā saṃspṛśandevo brahmāṇamabravīdvacaḥ || brahmaṃste paramaṃ dhāma ṛṣirnārāyaṇānugaḥ || || 88 || bhavitā lokarakṣārthaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām || nārāyaṇa mahāvīrya śaktireṣā madīyikā || 89 || ityuktvā bhagavāndevastamagniṃ pāṇinā' grahīt || dakṣahastāṃgulinakhamadhyasthaṃ samacīkarat || 5.1.4.90 || iti satkṛtya satataṃ naraṃ caiva maheśvaraḥ || brahmaṇo darśayitvātha tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 91 || athābravīttato brahmā agniṃ taṃ tu yugakṣaye || spṛśandakṣiṇavāmābhyāṃ sāṃtvayanniva taṃ girā || 92 || bhṛguścaivāṃgirāḥ putrau bhavitārau na saṃśayaḥ || atraiva mama bhavatāṃ vaṃśe vikhyātakarmaṇau || 93 || dvidhā saṃbhajya tenāgniṃ sṛṣṭeryajño bhaviṣyati || bhavaṃtau tiṣṭhatastatra pṛthivyāṃ dānamāśritau || 94 || brahmaṇā'gnī sametau tu brahmāṇamanunoditau || tasmādevaṃ vidhātavyau nirmathya vidhipūrvakam || 95 || ato'śvatthe śamīgarbhe saṃyogastatra paṭhyate || bhārgavāṃgirasaścaiva dvividho daiva ucyate || 96 || tasmātsutahitaḥ śreṣṭhaścaturtha iti kathyate || evaṃ vyāsa samutpanno naro'sau pūrvajanmani || 97 || evaṃ tu brahmaṇo vaktraṃ pañcamaṃ samapadyata || 98 || etadyo budhyate deva tejaḥsargamanuttamam || brahmaṇo yāti sālokyaṃ śāṃto dāṃto jitendriyaḥ || 99 || etadyognisamudbhavaṃ paśupatermāhātmyasaṃsūcakaṃ vahneḥ sādhumatiḥ śṛṇoti satataṃ yaḥ śraddhayā bhāvitam| yo vyāsa dvijadevatāpramukhataḥ saṃśrāvayedbhaktitaḥ so'tyarthaṃ bhavabhāvitaḥ śivapure saṃpūjyate daivataiḥ || 5.1.4.100 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye vaiśvānarotpatti varṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || cha ||
<5.1.5>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || yuddhe nivārite tatra raktasvedajayoḥ purā || kiṃ kṛtaṃ brahmaṇā tatra prāyaścittaṃ ca karmaṇām || 1 || janārdanena kiṃ karma śaṃkareṇa ca yanmune || etatsarvaṃ samākhyāhi prasīda vadatāṃvara || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || brahmā juhvannagnihotraṃ vanauṣadhiphalacchadaiḥ || śastaiḥ kuśasamidbhiśca yathoktaṃ hariṇā purā || 3 || badaryāśramamāsādya naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || tepatustau tapaścograṃ hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām || 4 || kapālapāṇirdeveśaḥ paryaṭanvasudhāmimām || kuśasthalīṃ samāsādya praviṣṭastadvanottamam || 5 || nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam || nānāpakṣiravākīrṇaṃ nānāmṛgasamākulam || 6 || drumapuṣpabharāmodavāsitaṃ yatsuvāyunā || buddhipūrvamiva nyastaiḥ phalapuṣpaiḥ supūjitam|| 7 || nānāgaṃdharasāḍhyaiśca pakvāpakvaphalodbhavaiḥ || phalaiḥ suvarṇarūpāḍhyairāsamantānmanoramaiḥ || 8 || jīrṇapatratṛṇādīni śuṣka kāṣṭhaphalāni ca || bahiḥ kṣipaṃti jātāni marutonugrahāṇi ca || 9 || nānāpuṣpasamūhānāṃ gandhamādāya mārutaḥ || śītalo vāti taṃ bhūmideśaṃ yatra viveśa saḥ || 5.1.5.10 || haritasnigdhanicchidraiḥ parṇairañchidrakoṭaraiḥ || vṛkṣairanekasaṃkhyaiśca bhūṣitaṃ śirasānvitaiḥ || 11 || arogidarśanīyaiśca suvṛttaiḥ kvaci duddhataiḥ || kuṭumbairiva viprāṇāṃ siddhirvai bhāti sarvataḥ || 12 || śobhanairvāyusaṃkīrṇairaṃkuraiḥ prāvṛtā drumāḥ || kulīnairiva nicchidraiḥ svagaṇaiḥ prāvṛtā narāḥ || 13 || pavanoddhūtaśikharaiḥ sparśayaṃti parasparam || ārātpavanato'nyonyaspṛṣṭaśākhāvataṃsakāḥ || 14 || nāgavṛkṣāḥ kvacitpuṣpairbhramarālīnakesa raiḥ || nayanairiva śobhaṃte dhavalaiḥ kṛṣṇatārakaiḥ || 15 || puṣpasannaddhaśikharāḥ karṇikāradrumāḥ kvacit || yugmayugmavivāhe ca śobhaṃte sādhu daṃpatīḥ||16|| supuṣpavibhavāṭopaiḥ sinduvārasya paṃktayaḥ || mūrtimatya ivābhāṃti pūjitā vanadevatāḥ || 17 || kvacitkvacitkundalatāḥ supuṣpābharaṇojjvalāḥ || dikṣudikṣu praśobhante bālacandrā ivodyatāḥ || 18 || atividrumaśobhāḍhyā kāsaṃtyo yūthikālatāḥ || puṣpitāḥ puṣpaviṭapānvīja yaṃtya ivotthitāḥ || 19 || śālārjunāḥ kvacidbhāṃti vanoddeśeṣu puṣpitāḥ || dhautakauśeyavāsobhiḥ prāvṛtāḥ puruṣottamāḥ || 5.1.5.20 || avimuktaṃ tu vallībhiḥ puṣpitāstu drumāstathā || upagūḍhā virājante nārībhiriva supriyā || 21 || cūtāśca tilakāścaiva mañjarībhiḥ karairiva || vāyuprattābhiranyonyaṃ ḍhaukantīva hi sajjanān || 22 || parasparaṃ ca saṃyuktaistilakāśokapallavaiḥ || hastairhastānspṛśaṃtīva suhṛdaścittasaṃgatāḥ || 23 || phalapuṣpanagā namrāḥ peśaleneva sajjanāḥ || anyonyamarpayaṃtīva sapuṣpāṇi phalāni ca || 24 || mārutāśliṣṭasaṃtuṣṭaiḥ pādapāḥ śālivāribhiḥ || āryāḥ samāgatā loke prītidāya iva sthitāḥ || 25 || puṣpāṇāmiva vegena svaśobhārthaṃ vrajaṃti vai || samasannāhamāsādya puruṣāḥ spardhayeva hi || 26 || puṣpaśobhābharanataiḥ śikharaiḥ kaṃpasaṃyutaiḥ || nṛtyanti pakṣiṇo mattā yuktāḥ śobhanaśekharaiḥ || 27 || bhṛṃgāḥ pavanavikṣiptāmṛtavallīlatāśritāḥ || savallikāḥ pranṛtyanti mānavā iva sapriyāḥ || 28 || puṣpābhiḥ kundavallībhiḥ pādapāḥ kvacidāvṛtāḥ || bhāti tārāgaṇaiścitraiḥ śaradīva nabhastalam || 29 || drumā ṇāmapyathāgreṣu puṣpitā mādhavī latā || śikharā iva śobhante racitā buddhipūrvakam ||5.1.5.30|| haritāḥ kāṃcanacchāyāḥ phalitāḥ puṣpitā drumāḥ|| sauhṛdaṃ darśayantīva narāḥ sādhusamāgame || 31 || puṣpakiṃjalkabahulāḥ kiṃjalkabahulodarāḥ || kiṃjalkamattamadhupā viśadā iva śārikā || 32 || śirīṣa puṣpasaṃkāśāḥ śukā mithunataḥ kvacit|| kīrtayaṃti giraścitrāḥ pūjitā brāhmaṇā yathā || 33 || saṃyuktāḥ sahacāriṇyā mayūrāścitrabarhiṇaḥ || vanāṃtare vyatiṣṭhaṃta ekāṃta iva saṃsthitāḥ || 34 || kūjaṃti patrisaṃghātā nānādbhutavirāviṇaḥ || kurvaṃti ramaṇīyaṃ hi ramaṇīyataraṃ vanam || 35 || nānā mṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ nityaṃ samuditāṃḍajam || tadvanaṃ naṃdanasamaṃ manodṛṣṭivivardhanam || 36 || kapālapāṇirbhagavāṃstathārūpaṃ vanottamam || dadarśa śaṃkaro dṛṣṭyā saumyayā naṃdanopamam || 37 || tā vṛkṣapaṃktayaḥ sarvā dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ samāgatam || nivedya śaṃbhave bhaktyā mumucuḥ puṣpasaṃpadam || 38 || puṣpapratigrahaṃ kṛtvā pādapānāṃ maheśvaraḥ || varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ bhadraṃ vaḥ pādapānityuvāca saḥ || 39 || evamukte bhagavatā taravo niravagrahāḥ || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve namaskṛtya maheśvaram || 5.1.5.40 || varaṃ dadāsi deveśa prasanna janavatsala || ihaiva bhagavannitya vane sannihito bhava || 41 || eṣa naḥ paramaḥ kāmo devadeva namo'stu te || tvaṃ cedvasasi deveśa vane'sminviśvabhāvana || 42 || sarvātmanā prapannā vai yācāmahe varottamam || kimanyavarakoṭībhireṣa no dīyatāṃ varaḥ || 43 || ityuktaḥ pādapaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ || varaṃ dadau pādapebhyaḥ procyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu || 44 || || maheśvara uvāca || || bāḍhaṃ me manasā vāso nityamatra vanottame || varaṃ dadāmi bhūyo vo na vṛthā darśanaṃ mama || 45 || nāgnirna vāyurna jalaṃ na sūryakiraṇātapaḥ || na vidyudaśaniḥ śītaṃ rujaṃ vo janayiṣyati || 46 || nityaṃ puṣpavaropetā nityaṃ susthirayauvanāḥ || kāmagāḥ kāmarūpāśca kāmarūpaphalapradāḥ || 47 || kāmasaṃdarśanāḥ puṃsāṃ tapaḥsaṃdhyājvaladṛśām || śriyā paramayā yuktā matprasādādbhaviṣyatha || 48 || evaṃ sa varadaḥ śaṃbhuranujagrāha pādapān || sthitvā varṣasahasraṃ tu kapālaṃ cākṣipadbhuvi || 49 || kṣitiṃ nipatatā tena kaṃpate sma rasātalam || vivaśāstatyajurvelāṃ sāgarāḥ kṣubhitormayaḥ || 5.1.5.50 || śakrāśanihatānīva vyāghravyālānvitāni ca || śikharāṇi vyaśīryaṃta parvatānāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 51 || devasiddhavimānāni gaṃdharvanagarāṇi ca || prasphuranti viniṣpeturvinineśurdharātale || 52 || kapotameṣāścātyaṃtaṃ punaḥ saṃghātadarśanāḥ || jyotirgrahāśchādayaṃto babhūvustīrṇabhāskarāḥ || 53 || mahatā tasya śabdena jaḍāṃdhabadhiraṃ kṛtam || babhūva vyākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 54 || surāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śarīrāṇi manāṃsi ca || avase duścakaṃpuśca kimetaditi jajñire || 55 || dhairyamālaṃbya sarve'pi samāgamyeṃdrapūrvakāḥ || brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmāṇamidamūcire || 56 || kiṃ nimittaṃ tu bhagavannetadutpātadarśane || trailokyaṃ kaṃpitaṃ yena saṃyuktaṃ kālakarmaṇā || 57 || jātaṃ kalpāvasānaṃ ca bhinnamaryādasāgaram || catvāro diggajāḥ kiṃ nu babhūvuracalāścalāḥ || 58 || dharā samādhṛtā kasmātsaptasāgaravāriṇā || utpattirnāsti sarvasya bhagavanna prayojanam || 59 || yādṛśo'yaṃ śrutaḥ śabdo na bhūto nāpi viśrutaḥ || trailokyamākulaṃ yena cakre raudreṇa bhūyasā || 5.1.5.60 || evamukto'bravīdbrahmā parameśānubhāvitaḥ || tatprasādātprati jñānī jñātvā rudramupasthitam || 61 || yatpṛṣṭaṃ marutaḥ sarve śṛṇudhvaṃ tatra kāraṇam || niścayenātra vijñeyaṃ śraddadhānairyathāvidhi || 62 || mukhaṃ chittvā nakhāgreṇa maddehātpaṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || kapālapāṇirbhagavānviṣṇorāśramamabhyagāt || 63 || yayāce pātramādāya bhikṣāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || utpapāta munistatra naronāma dhanurdharaḥ || 64 || tataḥ kuśasthalīmetya bhagavāṃstadvanottamam || viveśa tarumārgeṇa puṣpāmodābhinaṃditaḥ || 65 || anugṛhyātha bhagavānvanaṃ tatsarvagāṃḍajam || jagato'nugrahārthāya tatra vāsamarocayat || 66 || tatkapālaṃ karasthaṃ yannyastaṃ bhagavatā kṣitau || tenaiṣā kampitā bhūmiḥ kṛtaṃ trailokyamākulam || 67 || taddrakṣyatha virūpākṣaṃ prapadyata mayā saha || ārādhyamāno bhaga vānpradāsyati varaṃ hi vaḥ || 68 || ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā saha tairdevadānavaiḥ || jagāma tadvanoddeśaṃ yatrāste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 69 || prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve kokilālāpalāpitām || puṣpoccayokṣitāṃ sīmāṃ viviśuḥ śaṃkarepsavaḥ || 5.1.5.70 || saṃprāptaṃ sarvametaistadvanaṃ naṃdanasaṃmitam || suvallīgṛhaśobhāḍhyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ śuśubhe tadā || 71 || dṛṣṭvā tadvanamuttamaṃ tanubhṛtāmāhrādakaṃ cetasāṃ nānāsatphalapuṣpapādapavanairāsevitaṃ sarvataḥ || tasminbarhiṇahaṃsasārasakulai rmaṃḍūkamatsyairyute drakṣyāmo haramatra cetasi surāḥ prāpurmudaṃ te tadā || 72 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye devāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
<5.1.6>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || praviśyātha vanaṃ devāḥ sarvapuṣpopaśobhitam || iha devo 'tra devo'tra viviśuste didṛkṣavaḥ || 1 || adbhutasya vanasyāṃte na te dadṛśire surāḥ || vicinvaṃto mahādevaṃ devairbahuvilokitaḥ ||2|| tamuvāca sa bhadraṃ vai drakṣyadhvaṃ na tapo vinā || vicinvanto virūpākṣaṃ nainaṃ paśyata śaṃkaram || 3 || sa yuktaṃ hṛdaye smṛtvā brahmā devāṃstato'bravīt || trividho darśanopāyastasya devasya sarvadā || 4 || śraddhājñānena tapasā yogenaiva nigadyate || sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ cāpi devāḥ paśyaṃti yoginaḥ || 5 || tapasvinastu sakalaṃ jñānino niṣkalaṃ param || samutpanne'pi vijñāne maṃdaśraddho na paśyati || 6 || bhaktyā paramayopetāḥ paraṃ paśyaṃti yoginaḥ || draṣṭavyo nirvikāro'sau pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ || 7 || nādīkṣitairato devāḥ śaivīṃ dīkṣāṃ prapadyata || karmaṇā manasā vācā nityayuktā maheśvare || 8 || tapaścarata bhadraṃ vo rudrārādha natatparāḥ || śivadīkṣāṃ prapannānāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca tapasvinām || 9 || sarvakālaṃ vijānāti dātavyaṃ darśanaṃ mayā || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā hitameva yadu ktavān || 5.1.6.10 || śivekṣāviṣṭamatayo brahmāṇamidamabuvan || mārgeṇa vidhinā caiva śivadīkṣāsu tatparāḥ || 11. || prayaccha brahmansarveṣāṃ dīkṣāṃ naḥ śivatoṣadām|| śrutveti vacanaṃ brahmā pratyuvāca vicāritam || 12 || saṃdidīkṣayiṣuḥ kṣipramamarāñchivadīkṣayā || śivayajñārthasaṃbhārānānayadhvamalaṃ surāḥ || 13 || vedī prakalpyatāmatra yaṣṭavyo'ṣṭatanuḥ śivaḥ || padmayonervacaḥ śrutvā cakruḥ sarvamataḥ surāḥ || 14 || vinītaveṣāḥ praṇatā anena sastamanvaguḥ || śivaprasādasaṃprāptyai puṣkarajñānamīritam || 15 || yajñaṃ cakāra vidhinā vedhāścandrārdhadhāriṇaḥ || padmayoniḥ puraskṛtya tadā dīkṣāṃ pra yogataḥ ||16|| anugraheṇa devāṃstānakārayata bhāvataḥ || tato vratānāṃ pravaraṃ vrataṃ divyaṃ mahāprabhuḥ ||17|| tebhyo dadau devatābhyaḥ sa tadapyavirodhavit || paṭhyate śivaśālāyāṃ mahāpāśupataṃ vratam||18|| śaivaṃ yathoditaṃ yacca āgamācāraceṣṭitam || śivārādhanamukhyānāṃ munīnāṃ tīvratejasām ||19|| sarvānugrāhakaḥ śaṃbhuḥ sarvadevaiḥ prakalpitam || tadevaṃ prārthitaṃ buddhyā vrataṃ raudraṃ śivaṃ samam || 5.1.6.20 || tattebhyo vismayaṃ tyaktvā prāyacchatkanakāṃḍajaḥ || kāmikaṃ bhasmanāmāḍhyaṃ sarvadā kīrtitaṃ śubham|| 21 || pāpaghraṃ duḥkhaśamanaṃ puṣṭiśrībalavardhanam|| siddhidaṃ kīrtikṛtkāṃtaṃ kalikalmaṣamokṣaṇam||22|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhasmasnānaṃ samāhitāḥ || kurvaṃto mānavā dāṃtā dīkṣitāḥ saṃyateṃdriyāḥ || 23 || sarve kamaṃḍaludharāḥ sarve rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ || aniṣṭadarśanālāpa saṃgatyā parivarjitāḥ || 24 || evaṃ vratadharāḥ sarve vane tasminmaheśvaram || ārādhayaṃstamīśānaṃ vratenaiva umādhavam || 25 || bhaktyā paramayā yuktā vidhinā parameṇa ca || kālena mahatā dhyānādevaṃ jñātvā manogatam || 26 || rudradhyānāgninirdagdhakalmaṣāśca śriyānvitāḥ || tadā hatvā'suraṃ śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣo bhagavānabhūt || 27 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || brahmadattaṃ varaṃ devāḥ sarve śarvānubhāvitāḥ || samacīkaranpratyuktā brahmāpīśānabhāvitaḥ || 28 || gate varṣasahasre sa divye deveśvareśvaraḥ || jātānukaṃpo devānāṃ dīpo darśanameyivān || 29 || gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ sārdhaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ|| sudarpodbhūtadarpaghraighorairghoravighātibhiḥ || 5.1.6.30 || kāmarūpairakāmaiśca sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ || karīṃdrakaraṭāṭopapāṭanaiḥ siṃhadehibhiḥ || 31 || aṇimādi guṇairdivyairyogaiśvaryādināmabhiḥ || vyālolakeśaraśanādaṃṣṭrākaṭakaṭodbhavaiḥ || 32 || vyāghravyālānanai raudraiḥ kākakaṃkavaṭaistathā || 33 || arūpaiḥ samarūpaiśca surūpairbahurūpakaiḥ || ekadvitriśirobhiśca bahuśīrṣairaśīrṣakaiḥ || 34 || ekadvitriśikhaiścaiva nānārūpavirājitaiḥ || bahunetrairanetraiśca ekadvitrivilo canaiḥ || 35 || ekakarṇairdvikarṇaiśca bahukarṇairvikarṇakaiḥ || ekadvitrisunāsaiśca bahunāsairanāsikaiḥ || 36 || ekajaṃghairdvijaṃghaiśca bahujaṃghairajaṃghakaiḥ || eka pādairdvipādaiśca bahupādairapādakaiḥ || 37 || gauraśyāmaiḥ śyāmagaurairasitaiḥ karburaistathā || bhujaṃgahāravalayaiḥ kṛtayajñopavītakaiḥ || 38 || śūlāsipaṭṭiśa dharairbhuśuṃḍīpīraghāyudhaiḥ || cakrakrakacakodaṃḍakāṃḍadaṃḍāstrapāṇibhiḥ || 39 || gadāmudgarapāṣāṇamuśalāyudhahastakaiḥ || vajraśaktyaśaniprāsakuṃtakartṛka dhāribhiḥ || 5.1.6.40 || bhaṃbhābherīrvādayadbhirvīṇāpaṇavaveṇukān || mṛdaṃgavimalāḍhakkākāhalānakaduṃdubhīn || 41 || huḍaṃkāśṛṃgikādyāni nānāvādyāni vādakaiḥ || evaṃ nānāvidhai raudrairbhīmairbhīmaparākramaiḥ ||42|| gaṇeśvaraiḥ sudurddharṣairvṛtaḥ sūryo grahairiva || āvirbhūto mahādevaḥ svagaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ || taṃ paśya tāṃ tadā vyāsa brahmādīnāṃ divaukasām || 43 || atha brahmādayo devā dṛṣṭvāgre gaṇanāyakam || tejasādhyāsitāstasya babhūvurbhrāṃtacetasaḥ || 44 || tato 'valaṃbya te dhairyaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ yathāvidhi || ṣaḍaṃgavedayogena hṛṣṭacittavapurdharāḥ || 45 || śirogatairaṃjalibhiḥ pādebhyaśca mahīṃ gataiḥ || tuṣṭuvuḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāra sthitikartāramīśvaram || 46 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaḥ śivāya śāṃtāya sagaṇāya sanaṃdine || vṛṣāsanāya saumyāya śūlaśaktidharāya te ||47|| namo dikcarmavastrāya śucaye tīvratejase || brahmaṇe brahmadehāya brahmaṇā yojitāya ca || 48 || namoṃdhakavināśāya pareśāya namonamaḥ || rudrāya paṃca vaktrāya sarvarogāpahāriṇe || 49 || giriśāya sureśāya īśānāya namonamaḥ || bhīmogrādisvarūpāya vijayāya namonamaḥ || 5.1.6.50 || surāsurādhipataye yatīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || caṃḍāya caṃḍadaṃḍāya varakhaṭvāṃgadaṃḍine || 51 || virūpākṣaśubhākhyāya viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ || śāṃtāya ca manojñāya trinetrāya namonamaḥ || 52 || vedhase viśvarūpāya daityasaṃhāriṇe namaḥ || bhaktānukaṃpine'tyarthaṃ rudrajñānaparāya ca || 53 || virūpāya surūpāya rūpāṇāṃ śatadhāriṇe || paṃcāsyāya śubhāsyāya candrāsyāya namonamaḥ || 54 || varadāya varāhāya sukūrmāya namonamaḥ || 55 || trinetra trāṇamasmākaṃ tripuraghna vidhīyatām || vāṅmanaḥkāyabhāvaistvāṃ prapannānāṃ maheśvara || 56 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || evaṃ stutastadā devairviriṃcyādyaistathā haraḥ || śarīrāṇi vilokyeśaḥ kṛśānyatha divaukasām || 57 || divyapratāpadhāreṇa trivedhenāṃtarātmanā || 58 || ārādhanaṃ samīkṣyāha brahmādīnāṃ sureśvaraḥ || sādhusādhu mahābhāgāḥ śaśvadvratamupāsitam || 59 || divyenānena vidhinā bhṛśamārādhito hyaham || bhavadbhiḥ śra ddhayātyarthaṃ mama darśanakāṃkṣayā || 5.1.6.60 || vratasthā māṃ hi paśyaṃti mānuṣā devatā api || yadi yacca prayacchāmi kāṃścidvo hi varāñchubhān || 61 || ekaikaśo dvitriśo vā samastebhyaḥ samena vaḥ || sarvakāmaprasiddhyarthaṃ dāsyāmyenaṃ varaṃ hi vaḥ || 62 || hitāya bhavatāṃ cāhamāgāmujjayinīṃ prati || kṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ ca mayā kiṃ punarbhadramastu vaḥ || 63 || || devā ūcuḥ || || kiṃ kṛtaṃ hitamasmākaṃ kapālaṃ kṣipatā tvayā || 64 || kimarthaṃ kaṃpitā bhūmistrailokyaṃ vyākulīkṛtam || naitannirarthakaṃ deva kathyatāmatra kāraṇam || 65 || || mahādeva uvāca || || yuṣmaddhitārthametadvai bhayaṃ vinihitaṃ kṛtam || devatānāṃ tu rakṣārthaṃ śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam || 66 || asuro drohaṇonāma balavānyogamāyikaḥ || avasthitastvavaṣṭabhya rasātalatalā śrayam || 67 || tasya daityasya balino daityāḥ parapuraṃjayāḥ || yuṣmāñjñātvā tapasthāṃścāpyabhyagurbahavo hi te || 68 || seṃdrānnihaṃtumicchaṃto māyā pracchannacārakāḥ || purīṃ kanakaśṛṃgāḍhyāmenāmadhi kuśasthalīm|| samudyayuḥ surānhaṃtumudyatā udyatāyudhāḥ || 69 || teṣāṃ kapālapātena bhūminiṣkaṃ panena ca || śabdena cātighoreṇa dehātprāṇā viniryayuḥ || 5.1.6.70 || lokasthitivināśātha teṣāmāsītsamudyamaḥ || rājyaiśvaryeṇa darpiṣṭhāstena te nihatā mayā || 71 || || devā ūcuḥ || || viśvastānāṃ punaścaivameva cānugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ || devānugrahakartā tvaṃ guṇasmṛtiniṣevitaḥ || 72 || divyadṛṣṭibhiratyarthaṃ yaśo'rthaṃ bhīma naṃditāḥ || ityuktvā praṇatāndevānutthāpyoce punarbhavaḥ || 73 || || śiva uvāca || || paricaryābhisaṃyuktaṃ nityamugraniṣevitam|| dhyānasādhananiṣpannaṃ yadanyeṣāṃ na vidyate || 74 || manovākkāyabhāvena duṣkaraṃ duścaraṃ tapaḥ || anena tapasā yuktāḥ kaṣṭena duḥsahena ca || 75 || mahatā tanusādhyena bahukālārjitena vaḥ || samaṃtādabhivardhetāṃ yuṣmattejastapo'pi ca || 76 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || ityuktā devadevena devā brahmapurogamāḥ || ūcurunnāmya vaktrāṇi sthitā jānubhirīśvaram || 77 || || devā ūcuḥ || || prāṇadastvaṃ kāraṇastvaṃ tapasāṃ deva dṛśyase || tadasmākaṃ pravṛttānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ varaprada || 78 || rakṣāṃ kuruṣva deveśa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara || 79 || || īśvara uvāca || || yatnena vidhinā dattaṃ suvyaktaṃ darśanaṃ hi vaḥ || sudurlabhānyapi punardāsyāmi vo varānbahūn || 5.1.6.80 || evamukte bhagavatā brahmā vacanamabravīt || devānāmagrataḥ sthitvā śrutaśabdodbhavaṃ bhavam || 81 || prāptā vayaṃ ca bhagavansuparyāpto mahāvaraḥ || jāyatāṃ naḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ vāsasthānamathākṣayam || 82 || || || śiva uvāca || || loke'sminmama ye bhaktā mayā vinihatāśca ye || naivaṃ te durgatiṃ yāṃti labhaṃte sumatiṃ parām || 83 || sārdhaṃ tatra jaṭājūṭaiḥ śirobhiḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ || bhāṃti madvāmapārśvasthā ime te dāruṇā gaṇāḥ || 84 || yeṣāṃ vinigrahārthāya yuṣmatsaṃbodhanāya ca || savikāraṃ mayā kṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ dharaṇītale ||85|| kṛto me'nugrahasteṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktimicchatām || vane'sminnityavāso me vṛkṣairabhyarthitasya ca || 86 || mahākālavane devā āgatasya mamānaghāḥ || tapasyatāṃ ca bhavatāṃ mahākālavanaṃ tataḥ || 87 || nāmadvayayutaṃ guhyaṃ loke khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || guhyaṃ vanaṃ śmaśānaṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ mahat ||88|| kapālavratacaryā ca mayā hyeṣā prakīrtitā || kapālapātre bhuṃjānaḥ kapālavratabhūṣaṇaḥ ||89|| kapālapāṇiḥ saṃtuṣṭo bhikṣā vratasamanvitaḥ || śmaśānanilayo raudro vratonmattavimūḍhadhīḥ||5.1.6.90|| naṃditaḥ sarvabhūteṣu priyāpriyasamaḥ sadā || bhasmabhūṣitasarvāṃgo jñānī caiva viśeṣataḥ ||91|| jiteṃdriyo'sarvasaṃgo mṛdbhasmodakasaṃgrahī || nityayuktaḥ sadāvyāpī jāpī jitavarāsanaḥ || 92 || puṇyatīrthāśramopetaḥ svare deve samāhitaḥ || lokātītaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ mahāpāśupataṃ vratam || 93 || kapālavratamāsthāya purā cīrṇaṃ mayā svayam || kapālaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || 94 || kapālavratametaddhi durdharaṃ paramādbhutam || atyaṃtamutkaṭaṃ raudramaghoraṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 95 || mahāvrataṃ dviṣanmohātpāpenaiva sthito naraḥ || na mucyate sa pāpena janmakoṭiśatairapi || 96 || mahāpāśupataṃ tasmānna hanyānna ca dūṣayet || etasminnihate tasmātkoṭirbhavati ghātitā || 97 || evaṃ mahāvrataṃ yastu bhojayecchraddhayānvitaḥ || tasya bhuktā bhavetkoṭirviprāṇāṃ vedapāṭhinām || 98 || kapālapūraṇīṃ bhikṣāṃ yatīnāṃ yaḥ prayacchati || vimuktaḥ sarva pāpebhyo nāsau durgatimāpnuyāt || 99 || kapāle bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārgo'yaṃ brahmasaṃbhavaḥ || vadaṃti loke vedeṣu pūjitaṃ devadānavaiḥ || 5.1.6.100 || dhārayiṣyaṃti ye viprāḥ kapālaṃ bhūtamohanam || mama tulyāstu te brahmanvicaraṃti mahītale || 101 || japaikaniratā dhīrāḥ kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇāḥ || mahāpāśupatā loke rudrāḥ saṃsāratārakāḥ || 102 || dharmādharmavimuktāśca kṛtyākṛtyavivarjitāḥ || dīkṣayā jñānayogena prāṇinastārayaṃti te || 103 || yāni tīrthāni loke'sminyajñakoṭiśatāni ca || viśuddhasya vijñānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 104 || yathāhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ saṃpūjyo vai pitāmaha || tathaiva sarvayogebhyaḥ saṃpūjyo'yaṃ mahāvratī || 105 || saṃsārabandhamokṣārthaṃ śivaguhyamidaṃ vratam || yadetatsarvadharmeṇa apunarbhavakāraṇam|| 106 || kapālavratamādāya yastyajedajite ndriyaḥ || rauravaṃ sa prayātyāśu praṇīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 107 || ālāpayati bhāvena na tu karma karoti yaḥ || sarāgacittaḥ śṛṃgārī na ca dharmapriyaṃkaraḥ || 108 || ekatra bhojī miṣṭāśī kaitavena priyastathā || kugrāmanagare vāsī kṛṣivāṇijyasevakaḥ || 109 || ityādiduṣṭadoṣaśca tasya saṃbhāṣaṇādapi || naro narakagāmī syādyato madvratadūṣakaḥ || 5.1.6.110 || dṛṣṭvā ca śiṣṭamatha 3 mahāvratadharo naraḥ || na spṛśedaṃgamaṃgena spṛṣṭvā snāyāttu cāṃbubhiḥ || 111 || evaṃ ca sarvamākhyātaṃ kapālasya ca mokṣaṇam || yathā mayātra nikṣiptamajñānena hataṃ svayam || 112 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || evamuktvā sa bhagavānbrahmādyairamaraiḥ saha || kṣetraṃ nivāsayāmāsa yathāvatkathayāmi te ||113|| ādyametatatsmaśānaṃ ca paṭhyate munisattamaiḥ || mahākālavanaṃ vyāsa yatra sanni hito haraḥ ||114|| anugrahasya bhuvanaṃ bhūmibhāgo na saṃśayaḥ || anugrahārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ kṣetrāṃtarmṛtyudharmiṇām ||115|| suvarṇavajraparyaṃkavedikā ca mahīkṛtā || vicitrakusumāratnaiḥ kāritā sarvaśobhanā ||116|| svarṇavajrāṃkitatalā śreṣṭhā haritaśādvalā || triṃśaccatvāriṃśapūrṇāḥ kalaśāḥ koṇasaṃsthitāḥ || 117 || dvārāṇi tatra catvāri pravarṇāni tapaṃti ca || kumbhāḥ śobhaṃti tatrasthāḥ uditā bhāskarā iva ||118|| ramate tatra bhagavānvanānāmuttame vane || sanaṃdidevagaṇapaḥ kāladaṃḍādisaṃyutaḥ ||119|| etatkṛtayuge sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate vane || tretāyāṃ dharmaniratāstāpasā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||5.1.6.120|| dvāpare dharmaśīlā ye śrutavi jñānaśālinaḥ || kalau tu śuddhavijñānaśālinaḥ śaṃkaraṃ haram||121|| tapodhikāḥ prapaśyaṃti devadevaṃ maheśvaram || mahākālavane nityaṃ śūlapaṭṭiśadhāriṇam || 122 || etatte tathyamākhyātaṃ lokānugrahakārakam || sahitānukrameṇātra mantraiśca vidhipūrvakam || 123 || samarcayaṃti ye viprā bhaktyā śaṃbhumahāpadam ||| vasaṃtīha samīpaṃ te mahākālānubhāvitāḥ || 124 || paṭhati ya iha loke tasya saṃsthānametatprathitaguṇagaṇaughairarcitaṃ doṣahaṃ tat || śubhamatirabhiṣiktaḥ so'marairarcyamāno vrajati harapuraṃ yaḥ saṃśṛṇotyekacittaḥ ||125|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantī kṣetramāhātmyaṃ kapālamokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || cha ||
<5.1.7>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavankena vidhinā mahākālavane naraiḥ || rudralokamabhīpsadbhirvastavyaṃ kṣetravāsibhiḥ ||1 || kiṃ manuṣyairuta strībhiḥ siddhyarthaṃ hyāśramānvitaiḥ|| vasadbhiḥ kimanuṣṭheyametatsarvaṃ bravīhi naḥ || 2 || naraiḥ strībhiśca vastavyaṃ varṇaiścāśramavāsibhiḥ || svadharmācāraniratairdaṃbhamohavivarjitaiḥ || 3 || karmaṇā manasā vācā rudrabhaktairyatendriyaiḥ || anuśrutibhirakṣudraiḥ sarvabhūta hite rataiḥ || kiṃ kurvāṇairnaraiḥ karma rudrabhaktiṃ bravīhi naḥ || 4 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || trividhā kathitā hyatra manovākkāyasaṃbhavā || laukikī vaidikī cānyā bhavedādhyātmikī tathā || 5 || dhyānadhāraṇayā buddhyā rudrāṇāṃ smaraṇaṃ hi tat || rudrabhaktikarī caiṣā mānasī bhaktiru cyate || 6 || vratopavāsaniyamairyatedriyanirodhibhiḥ || kāyikā bhaktī rudrasya jñānadhyānasya dharmiṇām || 7 || goghṛtakṣīradadhibhirgaṃdharaktakuśo dakaiḥ || gandhamālyaiśca vividhairdhātubhiścopapāditā || 8 || ghṛtagugguladhūpaiśca kṛṣṇāgarusugaṃdhibhiḥ || bhūṣaṇairhemaratnānāṃ citrābhiḥ sragbhireva ca || 9 || vāsapravisarāstotraiḥ patākāvyajanocchritaiḥ || nṛtyavāditragītaiśca sarvapratyupahārakaiḥ || 5.1.7.10 || bhakṣyabhojyānupānaiśca yāvatpūjākṣatairnaraiḥ || maheśvaraṃ puraskṛtya bhaktiḥ sā laukikī matā || 11 || vedamantrahaviryāgairyā kriyā vaidikī matā || 12 || darśe ca pūrṇamāsyāṃ vā kartavyaṃ cāgnihotrakam ||| prāśanaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ puroḍāśaśca satkriyā || 13 || iṣṭavṛttiḥ somapānaṃ yājñikaṃ sarvakarma ca|| ṛgyajuḥsāmajāpyāni saṃhitādhyayanāni ca ||14||| kriyate rudramuddiśya sā bhaktirvaidikī smṛtā || agnibhūmyanilākāśaniśākaradivākarān || 15 || samuddiśya kṛtaṃ karma tatsarvaṃ daivikaṃ bhavet ||| ādhyātmikī tu dvividhā rudrabhaktiḥ sthitā mune || 16 || sāṃkhyākhyā yaugikī cānyā vibhāgaṃ tatra me śṛṇu || caturviṃśatitattvāni pradhānādīni saṃkhyayā || 17 || acetanāni yojyāni puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ || cetanaḥ puruṣo bhoktā na kāryaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ || 18 || rudraḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaḥ kartā sarvajñaścetanaḥ prabhuḥ || ajanmā nityamavyaktamadhiṣṭhātā prayojakaḥ || 19 || puruṣo nityavyaktaḥ syātkāraṇaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ || tattvasargaṃ bhavetsargaṃ bhūtasargaṃ ca tattvataḥ || 5.1.7.20 || saṃkhyayā parisargāya pradhānaṃ ca guṇātmakam || sādharmyamātmanaiśvaryaṃ pradhānaṃ vai vidharmi ca ||21 || kāraṇaṃ tacca rudrasya kāmya tvamidamucyate || sarvatra kartṛtā rudre puruṣe cāpyakartṛtā || 22 || acaitanyaṃ pradhāne ca tacca tattvamidaṃ smṛtam || tattvāṃtareṇa mucyaṃte kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca || 23 || prayojane ca vaijātyaṃ jñātvā tattvamasaṃkhyayā || saṃkhyāstītyucyate prājñai rudratattvārthaciṃtakaiḥ || 24 || iti tasya tattvabhāvaṃ tattvasaṃkhyā ca tattvataḥ || rudratattvādhikaṃ cāpi jñānatattvaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 25 || sāṃkhye kṛtā bhaktireṣā sadbhirādhyātmikī matā || yogināmapi me bhaktyā śṛṇu bhaktiṃ mahāsura || 26 || prāṇāyāmaparo nityaṃ dhyāyate niyateṃdriyaḥ || dhāraṇāṃ hṛdaye dhṛtvā dhyāyate yo maheśvaram || 27 || hṛtkañjakarṇikāsīnaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam || śaśāṃkajyotijaṭharaṃ vyālavṛttakaṭītaṭam || 28 || śvetaṃ daśabhujaṃ bhadraṃ varadābhayahastakam || yogajā mānasī vyāsa rudrabhaktiḥ parā smṛtā || 29 || ya eva bhaktimānrudre rudrabhaktaḥ sa ucyate || vidhiṃ tu śṛṇu me vyāsa yaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣetravāsinām || 5.1.7.30 || svayaṃ rudreṇa vihito brahmādīnāṃ samāgame || kathito vistarātpūrvaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra sannidhau ||31|| nirmamā nirahaṃkārā niḥsaṃgā niṣparigrahāḥ || baṃdhuvargeṇa niḥ snehāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ || 32 || bhūtānāṃ karmabhirnityaṃ trividhairabhayapradāḥ || sāṃkhyayogavidhijñāśca dharmajñāśchinnasaṃśayāḥ || 33 || yajaṃto vivi dhairyajñairye viprāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ || mahākālavane teṣāṃ mṛtānāṃ yatphalaṃ śṛṇu || 34 || vrajaṃtyeva suduṣprāpyaṃ brahmasāyujyamakṣayam || saṃprāpya na puna rjanma labhaṃte mokṣamavyayam || 35 || punarāvartanaṃ hitvā vidhiṃ māheśvaraṃ sthitāḥ || punarāvṛttiranyeṣāṃ prapaṃcāśramavāsinām || 36 || gārhasthyaṃ vidhimāsādya ṣaṭkarmaniratāḥ sadā || juhvate vidhinā samyaṅmaṃtrastotrairniyaṃtritāḥ || 37 || adhikaṃ phalamāyāṃti sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || sarva lokeṣu cānyatra gatistasya na hanyate || 38 || divyenaiśvaryayogena svārūḍhaḥ svaparigrahaḥ || bahusūryaprakāśena vimānena suvarcasā || 39 || vṛtaḥ strīṇāṃ sahasraiśca svacchaṃdagamanālayaḥ || vicaratyavicāryaiva sarvalokāndivaukasām || 5.1.7.40 || spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ puṃsāṃ sarvavarṇottamo dhanī || svargāccyutaḥ prajāyeta kule mahati rūpavān || 41 || dharmajño rudrabhaktaśca sarvavidyārthapāragaḥ || tathaiva brahmacaryeṇa guruśuśrūṣaṇena ca || 42 || vedādhyayanasaṃyukto ca bhaikṣavṛttirjiteṃdriyaḥ || nityaṃ satyavrate yuktaḥ svadharme ca pramodavān || 43 || mṛtaḥ kāle samṛddhena sarvabhogāvalaṃbinā || sūryeṇeva dvitīyena vimānena vicāritaḥ || 44 || guhyakonāma rudrasya gaṇaḥ paramasaṃmataḥ || aprameyabalaiśvaryo devadānavapūjitaḥ || 45 || teṣāṃ ca samatāṃ yāti tulyaiśvaryasama nvitaḥ || devadānavamartyeṣu sa ca pūjyatamo bhaveta| || 46 || varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca || aivamaiśvaryasaṃyukto rudraloke mahīyate || 47 || vasitvāsau vibhūtyā vai yadā ca cyavate naraḥ || rudralokāccyuto bhūmau vasate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || mahākālavane kṣetre brahmacaryāśrame sthitaḥ ||| maheśvaraparo nityaṃ vasedvā'tha mriyeta vā || 49 || mṛto'sau yāti divye vai vimāne sūryavarcasi || pūrṇacaṃdraprakāśo vai śaśivatpriyadarśanaḥ || 5.1.7.50 || rudralokaṃ samāsādya guhyakaiḥ saha modate || aiśvaryaṃ ca mahadbhuṃkte sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 51 || bhuktvā yugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || pracyutastu punastasmādrudralokātkrameṇa tu || 52 || nityaṃ pramuditastatra bhuktvā lokamanāmayam || dvijānāṃ sādhane nityaṃ kule mahati jāyate || 53 ||| mānaveṣu ca dharmeṣu vasedbhūyāṃśca rūpavān || spṛhaṇīyavapuḥ strīṇāṃ mahābhogapatirbhavet || 54 || vānaprasthasamācāro vanauṣadhivivarjitaḥ || śīrṇaparṇa samāhāraḥ phalapuṣpāṃbubhojanaḥ || 55 || kaṇāśano'śmakuṭṭo vā daṃtolūkhalako'tha vā || yena kenāpyupāyena jīrṇavalkaladhārakaḥ || 56 || jaṭī triṣavaṇasnāyī muktakeśaḥ sudaṃḍavān || jalaśāyī paṃcatapā varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ || 57 || kīṭakaṃṭakapāṣāṇabhūmyāṃ tu śayanaṃ tathā || sthānaṃ vīrāsanarataḥ saṃvibhāgī dṛḍhabataḥ || 58 || araṇyauṣadhibhoktā ca sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || nityaṃ dharmaparo maunī jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || 59 || rudrabhaktaḥ kṣetravāsī mahākālavane muniḥ || sarvasaṃgaparityāgī svārāmo vigataspṛhaḥ || 5.1.7.60 || yaścātra vasate vyāsa śṛṇu tasya hi yā gatiḥ || taruṇārkapradīptena vedikāstaṃbhaśobhinā || 61 || rudrabhakto vimānena yāti kāmapracāriṇā || virājamāno nabhasi dvitīya iva caṃdramāḥ || 62 || gītavāditraśabdena saṃvṛto'psarasāṃ gaṇai || varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate || 63 || rudralokāccyutaścāpi viṣṇuloke mahīyate || viṣṇulokātparibhraṣṭo brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 64 || tasmādapi cyutaḥ sthānāddvīpeṣu sa hi jāyate || svargaṣu ca tathānyeṣu bhogānbhuṃkte yathecchayā || 65 || bhuktaiśvaryo narasteṣu martyāmartyeṣu jāyate || rājā vā rājatulyo vā jāyate dhanavānsukhī || surūpaḥ subhagaḥ kāṃtaḥ kīrtimānrudrabhāvitaḥ || 66 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vā kṣetravāsinaḥ || svadharmaniratā vyāsa svabhṛtyā cārajīvinaḥ || 67 || sarvātmanā rudrabhaktā bhūtānugrahakāriṇaḥ || mahākālavane kṣetre ye vasaṃti mumukṣavaḥ || 68 || mṛtāste rudrabhavane vimānairyāṃti śobhanaiḥ || apsarogaṇasaṃyuktaiḥ kāmagaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ || 69 || athavā saṃvidagnau ca śarīraṃ vijuhoti yaḥ || rudradhyāyī mahāsattvaḥ sa rudra bhavane vaset|| 5.1.7.70 || rudraloko'kṣayasteṣāṃ śāśvato guhyakaiḥ saha || sarvalokottamo ramyo bhavatīṣṭārthasādhakaḥ || 71 || ye tyajaṃti mahākāle prāṇāna naśanairnarāḥ || teṣāmapyakṣayo vyāsa rudraloko mahātmanām || 72 || sāṃkhyāḥ stuvaṃti te rudraṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || sarvāmarayutaṃ devaṃ naṃdidevagaṇai ryutam|| anāśakamṛtāḥ śūdrā mahākālavane narāḥ || 73 || siṃhayuktaistu te yāṃti vimānairarkasannibhaiḥ || 74 || nānāvarṇasuvarṇāḍhyairhṛṣṭagaṃdhādhivā sitaiḥ | anaupamyaguṇai ramyairapsarogītavādibhiḥ || 75 || patākādhvajavinyastairnānāghaṃṭānināditaiḥ|| suprabhairguṇasaṃpannairmayūravaracāribhiḥ || 76 || rudraloke narā dhīrāḥ sarve cānaśanairmṛtāḥ || tatroṣitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān || dhanī viprakule bhogī jāyate martyamāgataḥ || 77 || karīṣaṃ sādhayedyastu mahākālavane naraḥ || sarvabhogavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 78 || rudraloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpakṣayo bhavet || 79 || tatra bhuktvā mahābhogāniha jāto mahīpatiḥ || pṛthivyāḥ sakalāyāśca rūpavānsubhago bhavet || 5.1.7.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye mahākālavanavāsavidhivarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || cha ||
<5.1.8>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || ācāraḥ paramo dharmaḥ sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || svadharmaniratāścaiva jitakrodhā jiteṃdriyāḥ || 1 || rudralokaṃ vrajaṃtīha nātra citrā matirmama || asaṃśayaṃ ca gacchaṃti lokānanyāñchaśiprabhaiḥ || 2 || vināpi kṣetravāsena tathaiva niyamena ca || striyo mlecchāśca śūdrāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || 3 || mūkā jaḍāṃdhabadhi rāstaponiyamavarjitāḥ || eṣāṃ tu kā gatiścette mahākālavane mṛtāḥ || 4 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || striyo mlecchāśca mūḍhāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || kālenaiva mṛtā vyāsa rudralokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 5 || śarīrairdivyarūpaiśca sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ || ramaṃte śaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ smaśāne pretasaṃkule || 6 || nirbhatsitā purā devī kālīti pārvatīti ca || tadā sā kupitā devī kaṭake śaṃkaraṃ prati ||7|| evaṃ hi kalaho jātaḥ śivagauryorhi yatra tu || devastatra samudbhūto nāmnā kalakaleśvaraḥ || 8 || kṛtamagre tadā kuṃḍaṃ nāmnā kalahanāśanam || snāne tatra kṛte vyāsa jātā'kalahinī priyā || 9 || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram || upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam ||5.1.8.10|| tatra yacchati yo dānaṃ truṭimātraṃ ca caṃdanam || ātmanā tāri tāstena daśa pūrve daśāpare || 11 || bhūmidānaṃ ca yastatra pradāsyati naro mune || api gocarmamātreṇa sarvabhūmyadhipo bhavet || 12 || gāmekāṃ rakti kāmekāṃ bhūmerapyekamaṃgulam || yaḥ pradāsyati bhaktyā hi sa vai rājā bhaviṣyati || 13 || dhenumaśvāṃstilānvastraṃ bhājanaṃ tāmradohanam || upānahaśca cchatraṃ ca tathā ca śreṣṭhapāduke || 14 || ye pradāsyaṃti viprebhyasteṣāṃ lokāḥ sadā'kṣayāḥ || tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu pṛṣṭhe mātrākhya devatāḥ || 15 || sā tatra sarvalokānāṃ devī duritahāriṇī || sarvatīrthaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ maṇikarṇikamuttamam || 16 || tasminsnātvā tu yaḥ paśyetpṛṣṭhamātara ādarāt|| sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ siddhimāpnoti vāṃchitām || 17 || tāsāṃ tu darśanaṃ kṛtvā mārge gamanamācaret|| na bhayaṃ tasya corebhyo rakṣobhūtabhayaṃ tathā || 18 || svadeśe paradeśe vā parvateṣvaṭavīṣu ca || na samudre bhayaṃ tasya tathā vai duṣṭabhāvanā || 19 || grahapīḍāsu sarvāsu tathā rājabhayādikam || bastaṃ vā yadi vā meṣaṃ mahiṣaṃ cāpi ghātayet || 5.1.8.20 || devīmuddiśya yo vipra so'bhīṣṭaphalamaśnute || āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmardharātrigate naraḥ || || 21 || yaḥ snāti purato devyāḥ sa siddhi labhate parām || mṛtaputrā ca yā nārī kuṇḍe snātvā sabhartṛkā || 22 || snāti vai phalakumbhena agre devyā vidhānataḥ || snātvā nānyamukhaṃ paśyetkumbhasnānena vai mune || 23 || tasya saṃjāyate putro yathā devaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ || pṛṣṭhe mātuḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthamapsarasāṃ śubham || 24 || rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpannastatra snāto bhavennaraḥ || urvaśyā vai purā vyāsa tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 25 || bhartā purūravā labdhaṃ aileyoṃ'sau mahīpatiḥ || iti kautūhalaṃ śrutvā vyāso vacanamabravīt || 26 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathamapsarasāṃ tīrthaṃ tatra jātaṃ mahāmune || kāraṇena yathā tena yasminkāle pratiṣṭhitam || tathā tanme savistāraṃ sarahasyaṃ prakīrtaya || 27 || kathaṃ purūravāścāsau bhāryāstasya varāpsarāḥ || urvaśīnāma kā sā tu kena jātā varāṃganā || sarvametadyathāvṛttaṃ vada kautūhalaṃ hi me || 28 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || naranārāyaṇau pūrvaṃ yatra vai tepatustapaḥ || 29 || badarikāśramasthau tau tenendro bhayamāgataḥ || sarvāścāpsaraso hṛdyā rūpayauvanadarpitāḥ || 5.1.8.30 || ādiṣṭā yā maghavatā vighnārthaṃ ca samāgatāḥ || tau dṛṣṭvāpsarasastatra ramantīrmadavihvalāḥ || 31 || vighnārthamiha āyātāstadā devau jajalpatuḥ || asmākaṃ na striyaḥ saṃti tena vai vighnakāraṇam || 32 || evaṃ saṃjalpya ca naro nārāyaṇamuvāca ha || kariṣyāmyahamekāṃ vai āsāṃ tu rūpato'dhikām||33|| maṃjaryā sahakārasya strīmūrubhyāṃ cakāra ha || rūpeṇāpratimāṃ loke sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 34 || utthitāṃ pramadāṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalanābhāṃ varāṃganām || gatvā śaśaṃsustāḥ śakraṃ na rtau lobhayituṃ kṣamāḥ || 35 || śakrastāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā gatvā devāvuvāca ha || praṇāmāvanato bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāṃjalim || 36 || ahamarthī striyāścāsyāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || tatastāṃ dadaturdevāviṃdrāya parameśvarau || 37 || asmadvacanasāmarthyādgṛhāṇemāṃ tvamurvaśīm || ūrubhyāṃ janitā yasmānnareṇeyaṃ varāṃganā || 38 || maṃjaryā sahakārasya teneyamurvaśī smṛtā || puraṃdaro gṛhītvā tāmurvaśīṃ paramāṃganām || 39 || gatvā svargamathāhūya citrāṃgadamuvāca ha || śikṣā'syāḥ kriyatāṃ citra yathā nṛtye vicakṣaṇā || 5.1.8.40 || kriyatāmacirādeṣā yatnamāsthāya śobhanam || evamukte tu śakreṇa kṛtā tena vicakṣaṇā || varaṃ pravīṇā sā jātā nṛtye gīte ca kovidā || 41 || evaṃ sā nyavasattatra surasadmani sundarī || gate bahutithe kāle tatrā gātsa nareśvaraḥ || 42 || ilasyaputro dharmātmā nāmnā caiva purūravāḥ || indrasyārddhāsanagato nṛtyaṃ paśyati tatra ha || 43 || nṛtyantīṃ vāsavasyāgre urvaśīṃ vīkṣya kāmukaḥ || hṛtacittastayā rājā na kiṃcitpratyapadyata || 44 || dhairyaṃ citte samāveśya muhūrtaṃ paryavasthitaḥ || urvaśī ca tadā tena darśanāhatamānasā || 45 || tatpradeśādviniṣkramya kāmārtā cātivihvalā || bhūmau sā patitā bālā ucchritādraṃgamaṇḍalāt || 46 || athātmānaṃ ca saṃvedya utthitā bhūmimaṇḍalāt || dṛṣṭā sā rājasiṃhena manmathena prapīḍitā || 47 || gataḥ purūravā bhūmiṃ tāmeva manasā smaran || smarantī rājaśārdūlaṃ gatā sāpyurvaśī gṛham || 48 || citrāṃgadagṛhe gatvā dūtaṃ sātha cakāra ha || citrāṃgadena sā nītā rātrau yatra purūravāḥ || 49 || urvaśyā rahitaḥ svargaḥ śūnyo'pyāsīddivaukasām || rātrāveva ca sā tena ānītā tridivaṃ punaḥ || 5.1.8.50 || tayā virahitaḥ so'pi śūnyacittaḥ paribhraman || unmattatāṃ gato vyāsa ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi pārthivaḥ ||51|| paribhramansa tīrthāni mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || gaṃdha veṃṇorvaśī svarge nītā sā paramāpsarāḥ || 52 || nāpi śete na vā snāti he rājanniti jalpati || tāvadapsarasaḥ sarvāstāḥ prāptā yatra corvaśī || 53 || raṃbhā ca menakā caiva pramlocā puṃjikasthalī || jalapūrṇāśrupūrṇā ca vasaṃtā caṃdrikā tathā || 54 || sūryadattā viśālākṣī caṃdrā candraprabhā tathā || āgatya tāstu sahitā urvaśīṃ vākyamabruvan || 55 || kiṃ rodiṣi varārohe martyahetoḥ sulocane || tadvākyamurvaśī tāsāṃ śrutvā vacanama bravīt || 56 || saukhyaṃ ṣaṇḍho na jānāti saṃgātstrīpuṃsayorhi yat || anayopamayā jñeyaṃ tasyārthe kṛtaniścayā || 57 || śrutvā ceti vacastasyāstāḥ saṃmaṃtrya samāhitāḥ || avidite ca devānāṃ mahākālavane gatāḥ || 58 || nṛpaṃ ca dadṛśustatra vṛkṣacchāyāniṣevitam || dṛṣṭvā cātha nṛpaṃ sarvā bhṛśaṃ jātāḥ suvihvalāḥ || 59 || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhāḥ sarvāḥ kāmārtā surayoṣitaḥ || mūḍhacittāḥ prahasyaivamurvaśī vākyamabravīt ||5.1.8.60|| || urvaśyuvāca || || ayaṃ sa puruṣavyāghro vinā yenāhamīdṛśī || ailaḥ purūravā nāma vikhyāto jagatīpatiḥ || 61 || evaṃ bruvantyāṃ vai tasyāmurvaśyāmapsarogaṇaḥ || maunībhūtaściraṃ tasthau lajjayānatakandharaḥ || 62 || etasminnantare prāyādbhagavāṃstatra nāradaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tathāgatāḥ sarvā urvaśyā sahitaṃ nṛpam || 63 || saṃprekṣya ca tataḥ prāha ki yūyamiha nisvanāḥ || tyaktvā tathāvidhaṃ ramyamindrasyālayamuttamam || 64 || varaṃ ca vriyatāṃ śīghraṃ viyogo na bhavi ṣyati || māhātmyaṃ cāsya tīrthasya kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ || 65 || asminhi durbhagā tīrthe snātvā strī puruṣo'pi vā || saubhāgyaṃ labhate samyaksarvabhogāṃstathottamān || 66 || ātmānaṃ tolayedyastu tilairvā lavaṇena vā || śarkarābhiśca bahvībhirvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || 67 || guḍena madhunā vāpi devīmuddisya pārvatīm || lavaṇena svarūpāḍhyastilaiḥ sarvāṃgaśobhanaḥ || 68 || dravyavṛddhiḥ śarkarayā guḍenāṃgeṣu pūrṇatā || madhunā caiva saubhāgyaṃ tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 69 || dvādaśaiva tu yugmāni devyā devasya bhojayet || kūpīṃ nakhariṇīṃ dadyāttāṭaṃkaṃ katakāṃjanam || 5.1.8.70 || vetrajāṃ kaṃcukīṃ caiva vastre kausuṃbhake tathā || śvetānulepanaṃ puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ dadyācca kuṃkumam || 71 || āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe vāpi māsi bhādrapade tathā || śuklāśvinatṛtīyāyā muttamaṃ vratamācaret || 72 || uttamā jāyate nārī yathā devī umā tathā || umāmaheśvarau kāryau sauvarṇau ca svaśaktitaḥ || 73 || dhāryau nāryā hi tau devau svayaṃ tulāvarohaṇe || phalāni caiva deyāni śākāni vividhāni ca || 74 || tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || evaṃ yā kurute tatra tīrthe nārī samāhitā || 75 || gandharvāpsarasāṃ loke mṛtā yāti na saṃśayaḥ || atra tīrthe ca dve liṃge pūjite devadānavaiḥ || 76 || dṛṣṭvā te paramāṃ siddhiṃ prāpnuto daṃpatī tadā || kārtikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā tatra prajāgaram || saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca rudralokamavāpnuyāt || 77 || yathā devyāḥ svarūpeṇa viyogo naiva dṛśyate || tathā tayorviyogaśca dṛśyate na kadācana || 78 || evaṃ kṛtvātha tāṃ vipra sarvāśca tridivaṃ gatāḥ || uktamapsarasāṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthāṃtaramathocyate || 79 || dakṣiṇe pṛṣṭhadevyā vai māhiṣaṃ kuṇḍamucyate || mahiṣo dānavaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato gaṇanāyakaiḥ || 5.1.8.80 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mātṝḥ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || pretarakṣaḥ piśācānāṃ pīḍayā sa vimucyate ||81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'psaraḥkuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāḥ|| 8 || || cha ||
<5.1.9>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || kathaṃ tanmāhiṣaṃ kuṇḍaṃ mātṝṇāmākṛtiḥ katham|| rudrasyaiva kathaṃ kṣetre mahiṣo dānavo hataḥ ||1|| || sanatkumāra uvāca || || kapālakhaṃḍamādāyaṃ mahādevo'pyatiprabham | brahmatejo mayaṃ divyaṃ jvalaṃtamiva cārciṣā ||2|| krīḍamāno jagannātho mohayāmāsa vai surān|| nimeṣātsa imaṃ lokaṃ yogātmā yogalīlayā||3|| prāpya puṇyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ yatrātiṣṭhanmahāprabhuḥ || tatratatra mahaddivyaṃ kapālaṃ devatādhipaḥ || 4 || sthāpayāmāsa dīptārcirgaṇānāmagrataḥ prabhuḥ || tvatsthāpitamatho dṛṣṭvā gatāḥ sarve mahaujasaḥ || 5 || vinadatsamahānādaṃ nādayaṃta diśo daśa || kṣobhārṇavāśaniprakhyaṃ nabho yena vidīryate || 6 || tena śabdena ghoreṇa dānavo devakaṃṭakaḥ || hālāhala iti khyāto deśaṃ tamabhidhāvitaḥ || 7 || amṛṣyamāṇaḥ krodhārto durātmā durjayaḥ suraiḥ || brahmadattavaraścaiva māhiṣaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ || 8 || daityaiḥ parivṛto ghorai koṭibhiścodyatāyudhaiḥ || tamāyāṃtaṃ tu sakrodhaṃ mahiṣaṃ devakaṃṭakam || 9 || samāvekṣyāha vai devo gaṇānsarvā npinākadhṛk || māyāvī gaṇapā daityastrailokyasyāpi kaṃṭakaḥ || 5.1.9.10 || āyāti tvarito yūyaṃ tasmādenaṃ vinighnatha || kapālasya gatiṃ sarva āśritā gaṇanāyakāḥ || 11 || tato devagaṇā dṛṣṭvā tamāyāṃtaṃ mahāsuram || garjamānaṃ mahānādaṃ bhramamāṇaṃ mahābhujam || 12 || bibhiduḥ śalasaṃghātairasibhi rmusalaistathā || saṃmuhya śarajālena tato bhūmau nyapātayan || 13 || hate tasminmahādevo devānprovāca vai tadā || aho darpātimūḍhaḥ sa darpeṇa nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 14 || etasminnaṃtare vyāsa tatkapālātsubhairavāḥ || dīptāsyā mātaraḥ sarvāḥ pracaṃḍāstrā mahābalāḥ || 15 || abhyadhāvaṃstamuddeśaṃ mahādevaṃ nivedya vai || daityaṃ tā bhakṣayaṃti sma bhittvā bhittvā mahābalāḥ || 16 || kapālamātarastasmātkhyātāḥ kṣetre mahābalāḥ || mahākapālastasmādvai tādṛśaḥ pari kīrtitaḥ || 17 || sthāpitasya kapālasya bhittvā samabhavatpurā || khyātaṃ śivataḍāgaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 18 || tadadyāpi mahaddivyaṃ sarastatra prakāśate || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ gaṇagaṃdharvasevitam || 19 || pātrasthamuddhutaṃ vāpi śītoṣṇaṃ kvathitaṃ jalam || raudraṃ saraḥ punātīhāśvamedhāvabhṛtho yathā || 5.1.9.20 || prāgādbrahmāpi taṃ deśaṃ devatānāṃ śatairvṛtaḥ || svargalokasya niḥśreṇī kīrtitā brahmaṇā svayam || 21 || atra tyajaṃti ye prāṇānrudra lokaṃ vrajaṃti te || dhanyā vyāsa narā martye mahākālavane sthitāḥ || 22 || raudre sarasi ye snāṃti jalaṃ vāpi pibaṃti ye || svadharmācāraniratāḥ paśyaṃtīśānamīśvaram || 23 || iti svargagatā devāḥ spṛhāṃ kurvaṃti nityaśaḥ || 24 || idaṃ śubhaṃ divyamadharmanāśanaṃ mahākapālaṃ suradaityapūjitam || mahāprabhaṃ pāpaharaṃ sanātanaṃ sureśalokādapi durlabhaṃ sadā || 25 || taporataiḥ siddhagaṇairabhiṣṭutaṃ yathā nabhaḥsthaṃ dinanāthamaṃḍalam || ya ekacittaḥ śṛṇuyātprasādatastriviṣṭapaṃ gacchati so'bhinaṃditaḥ ||26|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ paṃcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetra māhātmye mahiṣakuṇḍarudrasaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<5.1.10>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrtha trailokya viśrutam|| svayaṃbhūtaṃ maheśasya vikhyātaṃ kuṭuṃbikeśvaram|| 1 || mucyate sarvapāpaistu saptajanmakṛtairapi || śuciḥ paśyati yo devaṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathā vidhi || 2 || sarvām̐llokānatikramya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || yastu sarvāṇi śākāni kandāni vividhāni ca || 3 || tīre tasya prayaccheta sa prāpnoti parāṃ gatim || pauṣe pratipadi site aṣṭamyāṃ vā samāhitaḥ || 4 || ekenaivopavāsena aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || āśvinyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca śuciḥ paśyati mānavaḥ || 5 || paṭṭabaṃdhaṃ maheśasya sa vipāpmā divaṃ vrajet || caitre māsi site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ || 6 || karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva mṛganābhi sacandanam|| nivedayati devāya naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam || 7 || svarūpaṃ caiva viprendra sabhāryaṃ bhojayeddvijam || rudralokamavāpnoti yāvadiṃdrāścatu rdaśa || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye kuṭumbikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha || ||
<5.1.11>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ vidyādharasya tu || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā vidyādharapatirbhavet || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathaṃ tīrthamidaṃ kṣetre jātamatra mahāmune || prasādādbrūhi me brahmañchrotumicchāmi sāṃpratam || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || vidyādharapatiḥ kaścidāsīdrūpadharaḥ purā || grathitā pārijātasya mālā tena manoramā || 3 || gṛhītvā ca sa tāṃ mālāṃ gato vāsavaveśmani || nṛtyaṃtī vāsavasyāgre dṛṣṭā tena ca menakā || 4 || dattā tasyai tadā tena sā mālā nṛtyamāśritaḥ || sā menakāstutā'sthāne mālayā mohitā bhavat| 5 || kopāviṣṭena śakreṇa śapto vidyādharastadā || pṛthivyāṃ gaccha pāpiṣṭha nṛtyabhaṃgastvayā kṛtaḥ || 6 || vidyādharapadaṃ tyaktvā mama śāpācca sāṃpratam|| evamuktastu śakreṇa vākyaṃ vidyādharo'bravīta|| 7 || ajānatā mayā nātha aparādhaḥ kṛto'dhunā || anugrahamato deva kuru me tvaṃ prasā dataḥ || 8|| evamuktaḥ sa śakro vai vidyādharamuvāca ha || gacchāvaṃtīṃ tvamadyaiva yatrāste gāṃgaṭī guhā ||9|| tasyāścottarabhāge tu vidyate tīrthamuttamam || khyātaṃ tattriṣu lokeṣu nāmnā vidyādharaṃ śubham || 5.1.11.10 || bhaktyā tatra kṛte snāne vidyādharapatirbhavet || atastvamapi tatraiva kuru snānaṃ prayatnataḥ ||11|| evamuktaḥ sa śakreṇa āgato'vaṃtimaṃḍale || snānaṃ kṛtvā ca tenaiva tīrthe tasminmanorame || 12 || prabhāvāttasya tīrthasya punaḥ prāptaṃ padaṃ svakam || evaṃ vyāsa samākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vidyādharaṃ śubham||13|| tatra puṣpāṇi yo dadyāccaṃdanaṃ ca vilepanam || labhetsamastabhogānsa ihaloke paratra ca ||14|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe 'vantīkṣetramāhātmye vidyādharatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
<5.1.12>
sanatkumāra uvāca|| uttare tu pravakṣyāmi markaṭeśvaramuttamam|| tatra tīrthaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam || 1 || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā gośatasya phalaṃ labhet|| visphoṭānāṃ praśāṃtyarthaṃ bālānāṃ caiva kāraṇe ||2 || māpena māpitānkṛtvā masūrāṃstatra kuṭṭayet || śītalāyāḥ prabhāvena bālāḥ saṃtu nirāmayāḥ || 3 || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā śītalāṃ duritāpahām || na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcinna dāridryaṃ dvijottama || 4 || na ca rogabhayaṃ teṣāṃ grahapīḍā tathaiva ca ||5|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye śītalā māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<5.1.13>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ca bhairavam || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kurvīta pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || 1 || pitṝṃśca sa naro vyāsa tārayedātmanā saha || svargadvāreṇa yo'bhyeti rudrasya paramaṃ padam || 2 || bhairavasyāgrato devī pūrve tiṣṭhati cāṃbikā || tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā naraḥ strī vā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 3 || mahānavamyāṃ puruṣaḥ kṛtvā bastamayaṃ balim || mahiṣaṃ vā surāṃ māṃsaṃ mālāṃ bilvamayīṃ śubhām || bhaktyā nivedya devyai tu sarvāsiddhimavāpnuyāt || 4 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā pūjāṃ kṛtvā maheśvare || svargadvāreṇa so'bhyeti rudrasya bhavanaṃ dvija || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye svargadvāramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma trayodaśodhyāyaḥ || 13 || ||cha||
<5.1.14>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || snātvā catuḥsamudre tu paśyedrājasthalaṃ śivam || yasya darśanamātreṇa putravāñjāyate naraḥ || 1 || samudrāḥ saṃti catvāraḥ kṣārakṣīradadhīkṣavaḥ || samīpe tasya devasya sudyumnena pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || rājasthala samīpe tu samudrāḥ kena hetunā || kathaya tvaṃ muniśreṣṭha sudyumnena pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 3 || lakṣayojanaparyaṃtaṃ jaṃbudvīpaṃ suśobhanam || maryādāyāṃ sthāpito'yaṃ samudraḥ kṣārasaṃjñitaḥ ||4|| śākadvīpe dvilakṣe tu kṣīrābdhiḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || dadhyabdhistu kuśadvīpe caturlakṣaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ|| śālmale tvikṣujaladhirhyaṣṭalakṣaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 5 || catvāraste samākhyātāḥ samudrā bhūmimaṃḍale || rājasthalasamīpe tu kathamekatra saṃgatāḥ || 6 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || sudyumno nāma rājāsītpurā kalpe sudhārmikaḥ || tasya patnī varārohā nāmnā khyātā sudarśanā || 7 || muniṃ dālbhyaṃ ca sā dṛṣṭvā papraccha sutakāmyayā || bhagavankena dānena snānena vidhinā'thavā || 8 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ putro labhyo mayā katham || etadākhyāhi viprarṣe yāthātathyaṃ savistaram || || 9 || || dālbhya uvāca || || vihitāste purā putryabdhayaḥ putrepsayottamāḥ || svayaṃbhuvena devena brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || 5.1.14.10 || teṣu rājñā kṛte snāne tava putro bhaviṣyati || śaṃkarārādhane putri tasmātpreraya vallabham || 11 || dālbhyasyaiva tu vākyena vicitrākhyānakena ca || prasthāpayāmāsa patiṃ śaṃkarārādhane drutam|| 12 || sa gatvā toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaraṃ gaṃdhamādane || saṃtuṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraḥ prāha śaśisūryāgnilocanaḥ ||13|| avaṃtīṃ gaccha rājedra putraṃ prāpsyasi śobhanam|| macchāsanājjaladhayo gamiṣyaṃti kuśasthalīm || 14 || merurūpe sthale rājansamīpe śaṃkarasya ca || drakṣyasi tvaṃ naraśreṣṭha jaladhīṃstatra saṃgatān|| abhyarthitāstvayā tatra sthāsyaṃti kalayā sadā || 15 || evamuktvā mahādevo jagāmādarśanaṃ vibhuḥ || sudyumno bhāryayā sārdhamājagāma kuśasthalīm || 16 || āgatastu kuśasthalyāṃ samudrāṃśca dadarśa ha || tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā namaścakre rājasthalasamīpataḥ || 17 || te vai dṛṣṭvā ca sudyumnaṃ praṇataṃ bhaktavatsalam || procurvāridhayaḥ sarve varaṃ varaya suvrata ||16|| sa vavre manasā putraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || uvāca ca punā rājā yāvatti ṣṭhati medinī || tāvadatraiva sthātavyaṃ rājasthalasamīpataḥ || 19 || || samudrā ūcuḥ || || tāvatsthāsyāmahe'traiva yāvatkalpāvasānakam || 5.1.14.20 || bhaviṣyati ca te putraḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || atra te snānamātreṇa tasmātsnānaṃ samācara || 21 || sthale cātra śubhe rājansthāsyāmaḥ kalayā saha ||| evaṃ vyāsa samudrāstu sudyumnenāvatāritāḥ || 22 || kurute teṣu yo yātrāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || snānaṃ kṛtvā mahāpuṇye samudre kṣārasaṃjñake ||| || 23 || kuryācchāddhaṃ tato vyāsa pitṝṇāṃ bhaktitatparaḥ || pūjayecca mahādevaṃ sthalasthaṃ pārvatīpatim || 24 || maṃḍakāṃśca tato dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage ||| pātraṃ tāmramayaṃ kāryaṃ lavaṇena prapūritam || 25 || sahiraṇyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || saptadhānyasamāyuktaṃ veṇujaṃ vastraveṣṭitam || 26 || sadakṣiṇaṃ phalairyuktamarghyaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ || kṣīrābdhiṃ ca tato gatvā snānaṃ kuryācca pūrvavat || 27 || kṣīraṃ tatra pradātavyaṃ tāmrapātreṇa pūritam || dadhyabdhau ca tathā kṛtvā dadyāddadhyodanaṃ śubham || 28 || ikṣvabdhau ca tathā kṛtvā dadyādvipre guḍaṃ śubham || yātrāṃ kṛtvā tu vai vyāsa gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm || 29 ||| evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ rājasthalasamīpataḥ || bhavyāṃ hi labhate lakṣmīṃ putrāṃścāpi manoramān || 5.1.14.30 || mṛte svargamavāpnoti yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || tāvatsvargaphalaṃ bhuktvā paścānmokṣaṃ prayāsyati || 31 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhā tmye rājasthaleśvarasamīpe catuḥsamudramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || cha ||
<5.1.15>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa mahātīrthaṃ nāmnā śaṃkaravāpikā || krīḍamānena devena nirmitaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 1 || prakṣiptaṃ devadevena kapālakṣālanaṃ jalam || vāpīgataṃ kṛtaṃ yasmādataḥ śaṃkaravāpikā || 2 || arkāṣṭamyāṃ naraḥ snātvā diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || pūrvādikramato yāvadvāpīmadhye tathaiva ca || 3 || haviṣyānnayutānvyāsa dadyācca karakā nnavān|| śākamūlāṃśca viprebhyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 4 || paratra ceha ye lokāḥ sarvabhāvasamanvitāḥ || tatratatra samāyāti bhunaktyaiśvaryamuttamam || || 5 || ye narā kīrtayiṣyaṃti māhātmyamatibhāvikāḥ || rudraloke'pi te pūjyāstebhyo'pi satataṃ namaḥ || 6 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || tato vai devadeveśaḥ pinākī vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā devadevaṃ divākaram || 7 || ājagāma divānāthaḥ saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāha śaṃkaram || 8 || || || sūrya uvāca || || varaṃ varaya bhūteśa varado'smi dadāmi te || tamāha varadaścettvaṃ yācyamānaṃ kuruṣva me || 9 || aṃśena sthīyatāmatra hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām || avatīrṇo ravistatra śrutvā māheśvaraṃ vacaḥ || 5.1.15.10 || tato devādhidevasya śaṃkarasya mahaujasaḥ || vākyena bhāskarastatra yayau khyātiṃ mahādyutiḥ || 11 || śaṃkarādityanāmeti lokānugrahakārakaḥ || devā daityāśca gaṃdharvā vismitāḥ saha kinnaraiḥ || 12 || aho dhanyamidaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste tripurāṃtakaḥ || bhāskaro'pi ca tatrasthastīrthamadhye ca vartate || 13 || tatastuṣṭāśca te sarve brahmādyāḥ surasattamāḥ || deveśaṃ pūjayāmāsurādityaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tathā||14|| mūrtimaṃtaśca te devā avatīrya ca śobhanam || sthāpayitvā'bravīdvākyaṃ ye'tra snāsyaṃti mānavāḥ ||15|| na duḥkhaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ jarāmaraṇa śokajam || sarvayajñeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam|| tasmāccaivādhikaṃ hyatra śaṃkarādityadarśanāt||16|| vyādhayo nādhayaścaiva dāridryaṃ na kadācana || aiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate
