bhuvi sarvadā ||17|| na rogo na ca dāridryaṃ viyogo na ca bandhubhiḥ || jāyate muniśārdūla śaṃkarādityadarśanāt||18|| ityevaṃ devadevena purā vai śūlapāṇinā || śaṃkarādityanāmnā ca sthāpitaṃ paramaṃ padam || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye śaṃkarādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || cha ||
<5.1.16>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athānyatsaṃ pravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam || sthāpitaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ svanāmnā munisattama || 1 || ekadā samaye vyāsa kapālakṣālanāya vai || śīrṣodakaṃ gṛhītvā tu kapālena maheśvaraḥ || 2 || prakṣālya cākṣipadbhūmau tatra tīrthamanuttamam || nāmnā gandhavatī puṇyā nadī trailokyaviśrutā ||3|| brahmaṇo rudhireṇāśu pari pūrṇābhavatkṣaṇāt || tasyāṃ snānaṃ sadā śastaṃ svayaṃ devena bhāṣitam|| 4 || śrāddhaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || vāyubhūtāstu pitarastasyāstī re tu dakṣiṇe || 5 || tiṣṭhaṃti muniśārdūla ciṃtayaṃti svagotrajam || āgamiṣyati putro'dya naptā vā saṃtatāviha || 6 || saṃyāvaṃ pāyasaṃ vāpi śyāmākaṃ sanivārakam || sakṛtkṣaudratilairyuktaṃ piṇḍaṃ dāsyati vai kadā || 7 || tena piṃḍapradānena tṛptirbhavati cākṣayā || yastu snātvā ca vai piṃḍaṃ dadyādvai caṃdraṃ parvaṇi || 6 || pitarau dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yāsyaṃti tasya vai || ye'trāgatya suvidvāṃso mānavā vā tathā dvijāḥ || 9 || pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyaṃti svargasteṣāṃ sadā'kṣayaḥ || tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ truṭimātraṃ tu kāṃcanam || 5.1.16.10 || akṣayaṃ tasya tatproktaṃ brahmaṇā vai svayaṃbhuvā || gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca kurukṣetre'tha puṣkare || 11 || vārāṇasyāṃ gayāyāṃ ca sā na tṛptirbhaviṣyati || tuṣṭāśca pitaro nṛṇāṃ dāsyaṃti kāṃkṣitānvarān|| 12 || yo yamuddiśya vaikāmamiha śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati || tasya tajjāyate sarvaṃ mṛtasya paramā gatiḥ || 13 || navamī aṣṭamī caiva amāvāsyātha pūrṇimā || sarvāṇyetāni vai vyāsa raveḥ saṃkrama eva ca || 14 || brahmeṃdra rudradevāṃśca sūryāgnibrahmadaivatān || viśvedevānsagandharvānyakṣāśca manujānpaśūn || 15 || sarīsṛpānpitṛgaṇānyaccānyadbhuvi saṃsthitam || śrāddhaṃ vai śraddhayā kurvanprīṇayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 16 || māsimāsyasite pakṣe paṃcadaśyāṃ dvijottama || indukṣaye yadā maitraṃ viśākhāṃ caiva rohiṇīm || 17 || śrāddhe pitṛgaṇāstṛptiṃ prayāṃti pitaro'rjitām || vāsavājaikapādarkṣe pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā || 18 || bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pita rastena tarpitāḥ || api dhanyāḥ kule jātā asmākaṃ matiśālinaḥ || 19 || ye kurvaṃti ca vai śrāddhaṃ piṃḍānye nirvapaṃti ca || tena piṃḍapradānena tṛptirno bhavitā'kṣayā || 5.1.16.20 || ihaitya vai puṇyajaleṣu samyaksnātvā narastāṃstu labheta kāmān || yānprāpya ca pretagaṇaiḥ sametaḥ sa modate devavṛ to'tha siddhaḥ || 21 || cittaṃ ca vittaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ ca śuddhaṃ śastaśca kālaḥ kathito vidhiśca || pātraṃ yathoktaṃ paramā ca bhaktirnṛṇāṃ prayacchaṃti hi vāṃchi tāni || 22 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye nīlagandhavatīprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || cha ||
<5.1.17>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || daśāśvamedhike snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti māna vaḥ || 1 || manunā mānavendreṇa rājñā caiva yayātinā || raghuṇośanasā caiva lomaśena maharṣiṇā || 2 || atriṇā bhṛguṇā vyāsa dattātreyeṇa dhīmatā || purūravasā puṇyena nahuṣeṇa nalena ca || 3 || atra snānena saṃprāptaṃ daśāśvamedhikaṃ phalam || saṃprāpte dvāparasyāṃte rājñā bāṣkalinā tathā || 4 || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phala prāptaṃ dvijottama || kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tathā liṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ bhaktitaḥ sadā || 5 || dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca taṃ devaṃ prāguktaṃ labhate phalam || caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ devaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || 6 || aśvaṃ dadyācca viprāya surūpaṃ ca guṇānvitam || yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi gaṇyaṃte saṃkhyayā dvija || 7 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || śivalokātparibhraṣṭaḥ sārvabhaumo bhavedbhuvi || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye daśāśvamedhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 |||7||
<5.1.18>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || ekānaṃśāṃ namaskṛtya devīṃ trailokyaviśrutām || pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sarvasiddhiphalaṃ labhet || 1 || aṇimādiguṇānsarvānguṭikāsiddhimaṃjanam || khaḍgaṃ ca pāduke caiva vilavāsaṃ rasāyanam || sarvaṃ tuṣṭā prayaccheta nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2 || surāmāṃsopahāraiśca bhakṣyabhojyaiśca pūjitā || sarvānkāmānnṛṇāṃ devī tuṣṭā dadyācca sarvadā || 3 || mahānavamyāṃ yo devīṃ mahiṣeṇa prapūjayet || meṣeṇa vā yathālābhaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 4 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathaṃ devī samutpannā ekānaṃśeti viśrutā || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 5 || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā kṛtayugasyādau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || niśāṃ sasmāra bhagavānsvāṃ tanūṃ pūrvasaṃbhavām || 6 || tato bhagavatī rātrirupatasthe pitāmaham || tāṃ vivikte samālokya brahmovāca vibhāvarīm || 7 || || brahmovāca || || vibhāvarī mahāmāye vibudhānāmupasthitam || yatkartavyaṃ tvayā devi śṛṇu cārthasya niścayam|| 8 || tārakonāma daityeṃdraḥ suraśatruranirjitaḥ || tasya bhayena vai devāstrastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ || 9|| tasmādbhadre maheśo vai janayiṣyati cedvaram || sutaṃ sa bhavitā tasya tārakasyāṃtakaḥ kila || 5.1.18.10 || śaṃkaramyābhavatpatnī satī dakṣasutā tu yā || sā pituḥ kupitā bhadre kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || 11 || bhavitrī himaśailasya duhitā lokapāvanī || viraheṇa harastasyā matvā śūnyaṃjagattrayam || 12 || atapaddhimaśailasya kaṃdare siddhasevite || pratīkṣamāṇastajjanma kiṃcitkālaṃ vasiṣyati || 13 || tasmātsutaptatapasorbhavitā yo mahāprabhuḥ || sa bhaviṣyati daityasya tārakasya nivārakaḥ || 14 || jātamātrā tu sā devī svalpasaṃjñaiva bhāminī || virahotkaṃṭhitā gāḍhaṃ harasaṃgamalālasā || 15 || tayoḥ sutaptatapasoḥ saṃyogaḥ syātsuyuktayoḥ || pārvatīharayostasmātsurataṃ śaktikāraṇam || 16 || bhavettatra surāṇāṃ ca kāryārthe vipramācara || vighnaṃ tvayā vidhātavyaṃ yathā tābhyāṃ tathā śṛṇu || 17 || garbhasthāne'tha tāṃ mātaḥ svena rūpeṇa raṃjaya || tato rahasi śarvastāṃ bibhradānaṃdapūrvakam ||18|| hāsayiṣyati kālīti tataḥ sā kupitā satī || prayāsyati tapaḥ kartuṃ tataḥ sā tapasā yutā || 19 || janayiṣyati yaṃ śarvādiṃduvajjyotimaṃḍa lam || sa bhaviṣyati haṃtā vai surārīṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 5.1.18.20 || tvayāpi dānavā devi haṃtavyā lokadurjayāḥ || yāvacca na satī dehe saṃkrāṃtaguṇasaṃcayā || 21 || tatsaṃgamena tāvattvaṃ daityānhaṃtuṃ bhaviṣyasi || evaṃ kṛte tvayā devi tapaḥ kālī kariṣyati || 22 || samāptaniyamā sā ca yadā gaurī bhaviṣyati || tadā tavāpi sārūpyaṃ śailajā saṃpradāsyati || 23 || tatastavāpi sahajā saikānaṃśā bhaviṣyati || rūpāṃśena ca saṃyuktā tvamumākhyā bhaviṣyasi || 24 || ekānaṃśeti lokastvāṃ varade pūjayiṣyati || bhedairbahuvidhākāraiḥ sarvagāṃ kāmasādhanīm 25 || oṃkāravaktrā gāyatrī tvameva brahmavādinī || ākrāṃtarucirākārā rājñāṃ cāhavaśālinī ||26|| viśāṃ tvaṃ kamalādevī śūdrāṇāṃ jananī svayam || jñānināṃ jñeyarūpā tvaṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvadehinām || 27 || tvaṃ ca kīrtimatāṃ kīrtistvaṃ bhūtiḥ sarvadehinām || ratidā raktacittānāṃ prītistvaṃ snehavartinām|| 28 || tvaṃ kāṃtiḥ kṛtabhūṣā ṇāṃ tvaṃ śāṃtirhṛṣṭakarmaṇām || tvaṃ ca bhrāṃtirabodhānāṃ tvaṃ kīrtiḥ kramayājinām || 29 || mahāvelā samudrāṇāṃ vilāsastvaṃ vilāsinām || saṃbhūtistvaṃ padārthānāṃ sthitistvaṃ lokaśālinām || 5.1.18.30 || ityanekavidhairdevi rūpairlokeṣu carcitā || ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti varade pūjayiṣyaṃti cāpi ye || kāmā nāpsyaṃti te sarve niyataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 31 || ityevaṃ sā samutpannā brahmaṇā saṃstutā satī || ekānaṃśā mahādevī dhyātavyā sāpi bhaktitaḥ ||32|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmya ekānaṃśāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<5.1.19>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi harasiddhiṃ susiddhidām || pārvatyā haraṇe yatra siddhiḥ prāptā hareṇa ca || 1 || balinau dānavau jātau nāmnā caṇḍapracaṃḍakau || utkhāya tridivaṃ sarvaṃ giriṃ kailāsamāgatau || 2 || dṛṣṭvā tatra girīśaṃ tu udyatākṣākṣahastakam || nāgeśaṃ śaśikhaṭvāṃgaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 3 || devidevīti jalpaṃtaṃ dāsaste'smīti vādinam || yāvadekaṃ tu phalakaṃ tāvaddyūtaṃ pravartatām || 4 || rāgībhūte tadā deve tau prāptau devakaṃṭakau || utsāditāḥ śivagaṇā naṃdinā pratiṣedhitau || 5 || tatastābhyāṃ tadā naṃdī śūlābhyāṃ pravidāritaḥ || samaṃ savyadakṣiṇaṃ vai susrāva rudhiraṃ bahu || 6 || naṃdinaṃ tāḍitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā śilādanaṃdanam || dhyātā hareṇa sā devī praṇatā sā'grataḥ sthitā || 7 || vadhyatāṃ tau mahādaityau vadhāmīti vaco'bravīt || gṛhītvā mudgaraṃ ghoramatikrodhādatāḍayat || 8 || yadā tayā hatau dṛṣṭau dānavau balagavitau || harastāmāha he caṃḍi saṃhṛtau duṣṭadānavau || 9 || harasiddhirato loke nāmnā khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi || tataḥ prabhṛti sā devī harasiddhi pradāyinī || harasiddhiriti khyātā mahākāle babhūva ha || 5.1.19.10 || yaḥ paśyetparayā bhaktyā harasiddhiṃ narottamaḥ || so'kṣayām̐llabhate kāmānmṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 11 || ādisiddhiṃ mahādevīṃ nityāṃ vyomasvarūpiṇīm || harasiddhiṃ prapaśyedyaḥ so'bhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam || 12 || yaḥ smareddharasiddhīti maṃtraṃ ca caturakṣaram || na vairiṇo bhayaṃ tasya dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate || 13 || naro mahānavamyāṃ yo harasiddhiṃ prapūjayet || mahiṣaṃ ca baliṃ dadyātsa bhavedbhūpatirbhuvi || 14 || navamyāṃ pūjitā devī harasiddhirharapriyā || tuṣṭā nṛṇāṃ sadā vyāsa dadātyanavamaṃ phalam || 15 || sā puṇyā sā pavitrā ca sarvatra sukhadāyinī || smṛtā saṃpūjitā dṛṣṭā dhanaputrasukhapradā || 16 || mahānavamyāṃ ye vyāsa hanyaṃte mahiṣādayaḥ || sarve te svargatiṃ yāṃti ghnatāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvatyakhaṃḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye harasiddhimāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || cha ||
<5.1.20>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || māsamekaṃ naro bhaktyā paśyedvā vaṭayakṣiṇīm || pūjayetsvarṇapuṣpaiśca tasya siddhirna hīyate || 1 || iti vaṭayakṣiṇīmāhātmyam || piśācake naraḥ snātvā caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || tilāndadāti yo bhaktyā na piśācaḥ prajāyate || 2 || yaṃ samuddiśya yaddattaṃ tadakṣayataraṃ bhavet || tatkulaṃ hi piśācatvānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3 || yasya nāmnā naraḥ snāti piśāca tvātsa mucyate || kuṃbhānvā karakānvāpi yo'tra dadyātsamaṃḍakān || 4 || tasya vai śāśvatī muktiḥ kule preto na jāyate || śiprāguṃpheśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rudra bhakto jiteṃdriyaḥ || 5 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ kaṃcukena phaṇī yathā || snātvāgastyeśvaraṃ paśyedyo'tibhaktyā ca mānavaḥ || 6 || tyaktvā yamagṛhaṃ vyāsa rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || śiprāyāṃ yo naraḥ snātvā paśyeḍḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ śivam || 7 || so'śvamedhaphalaṃ vyāsa labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || devenātra purā vyāsa vādito ḍamaruryataḥ || 8 || devastena samākhyāto nāmnā ḍamarukeśvaraḥ || bhaktyā paśyennaro yastu devaṃ ḍamarukeśvaram || 9 || naiva vyādhibhayaṃ tasya mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || anādikalpeśvaraṃ yastu bhaktyā paśyati mānavaḥ || 5.1.20.10 || rājyaṃ sa labhate svargaṃ yathā devaḥ puraṃdaraḥ || devānāmapyasau vyāsa spardhanīyaḥ sadā bhavet || 11|| kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ bhogayuktastu modate || paśyetsiddheśvaraṃ yastu vīrabhadraṃ ca caṃḍikām|| || 12 || sotraiva labhate siddhiṃ jayaṃ sarvatra mānavaḥ || svarṇajāleśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā snātastīrthe triviṣṭape ||13|| svarṇena pūjayeddevaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || snātvā paśyennaro bhaktyā yaḥ karkoṭeśvaraṃ śivam || 14 || sarpato na bhayaṃ tasya dāridyaṃ naiva jāyate || yaḥ paśyetparayā bhaktyā mahāmāyāṃ sanātanīm || || 15 || viṣṇumāyāvinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam || arcayetparayā bhaktyā yaḥ kapāleśvaraṃ naraḥ || 16 || sa mucyeta mahāpāpairyadyapi brahmahā bhavet || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ca bhairavam || 17 || darśanāttasya devasya śatayajñaphalaṃ bhavet || 18 || itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye caturdaśatīrthayātrāvarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha ||
<5.1.21>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi devaṃ tridaśapūjitam || hanumatkeśvaraṃnāma bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 1 || śaive sarasi yaḥ snātvā paśyeddhanumatkeśvaram || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi vāyuloke sa modate || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || hanumatkeśvaro yastu hyuktaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā'nagha || kathāṃ kathaya hyetasya vṛttapūrvāṃ sanātanīm || 3 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || trailokyakaṇṭakaḥ pūrvaṃ rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ || viṣṇunā rāmarūpeṇa laṃkāyāṃ vinipātitaḥ || 4 || ghātayitvā tu taṃ duṣṭaṃ sītāmādāya jānakīm || vānaraiḥ saha ṛkṣaiśca nagarīṃ svāmupāgataḥ || 5 || tatra rājyamanuprāpya ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ || kathāvasāne rāmeṇa hyagastyo munisattamaḥ || 6 || papraccha ca dvayorvīryaṃ śaṃbhuvātajayostadā || tadā dāśarathiṃ prāha aga stirmunisattamaḥ || 7 || anaupamyo yathā devo yuddhe śauryaṃ? maheśvaraḥ || jñeyo vāyusutastadvatsatyametadbravīmi te || 8 || etacchutvātha hanumānyaddhareṇo pamā mama || kṛtā munivareṇeha pratyakṣaṃ rāghavasya ha || 9 || gamiṣye nagarīṃ laṃkāṃ liṃgamekaṃ prayācitum || rākṣasendraṃ mahābhāgaṃ vibhīṣaṇamakalma ṣam || 5.1.21.10 || tato gataḥ sa laṃkāyāṃ vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha || dehi me tvaṃ mahābhāga liṃgamekaṃ ca śobhanam || 11 || uktaṃ ca rākṣasendreṇa gṛhāṇaitadyathā ruci || etāni ṣaṭ ca liṃgāni rāvaṇasthāpitāni vai || 12 || trailokyavijayātpūrvaṃ mama bhrātrā mahātmanā || eteṣu yadabhīṣṭaṃ te liṃgaṃ kathaya suvrata || tatprayacchāmi te'dyaiva satyametatplavaṃgama || 13 || tato jagrāha hanumām̐lliṃgaṃ mauktikasaṃnibham || yadetaddṛśyate vīra tatprayaccha mamānagha || || 14 || śrutvā hanumato vākyamathovāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ || dattametanmahāvīra liṃgaṃ yaddhṛtavānasi || 15 || śrūyate hi purāvṛttaṃ liṃgametaddhaneśvaraḥ || rudra bhaktyā samāyuktastrikālamapyapūjayat || 16 || rāvaṇena yadā baddhastadānīṃ hi dhaneśvaraḥ || liṃgasyāsya prabhāvena vimuktaḥ samapadyata || 17 || prasādāttasya liṃgasya dhaneśo dhanarakṣakaḥ || gṛhītvā tanmahāliṃgaṃ svastho jāto'tha vānaraḥ || 18 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || gṛhītvā tu tato liṃgaṃ prasthito vimaleṃ'bare || saptame divase caiva saṃprāpto'vaṃtikāṃ purīm || 19 || tatra rudrasarastīre sthāpya snānamathākarot || mahākālasya pūjārthaṃ gamanaṃ pratyaciṃtayat || 5.1.21.20 || uddhartukāmastalligamuddhartuṃ na śaśāka saḥ || 21 || tato vyavasthito devaḥ prāha taṃ vāyunandanam || asminkṣetre hanūmanmāṃ tvannāmnaiva pratiṣṭhāpaya || 22 || hanumatkeśvaraṃ cātha loke khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || śailavacconnataṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ vāyusūnunā || 23 || śanau paśyennaro yastu hanumatkeśvaraṃ śivam || tasya śatrubhayaṃ nāsti saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt || 24 || na ca caurabhayaṃ tasya na dāridryaṃ na durgatiḥ || tailābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryāddhanumatkeśvare śive ||25|| tasya rogāḥ pralīyante grahapīḍā na jāyate || ye drakṣyaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā teṣāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati ||26|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye hanumatkeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmai kaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21|| || cha ||
<5.1.22>
|| śrīsanatkumāra uvāca || || yameśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyetsnāpayitvā tilāṃbhasā || kuṃkumena samālipya pūjayedutpalaistataḥ || 1 || dahetkṛṣṇāgaruṃ dhūpaṃ dāpayettilataṇḍulān || ya evamarcayeddevamīśvaraṃ śūlahastakam|| 2 || yatra kutra mṛtasyāpi yamaḥ pitṛsamo bhavet || 3 || || iti yameśvaramāhātmyam|| || sanatkumāra uvāca || || kathayāmi paraṃ vyāsa tīrthaṃ tīrtheṣu cottamam || nāmnā rudrasaraḥ proktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 4 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā paśyetkoṭeśvaraṃ śivam || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 5 || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kṛtvā tu śṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ vājapeyaśatasya ca||6|| phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ vyāsa labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| pitṝnuddiśya yatkiṃcitkoṭitītheṃ pradīyate||7|| tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā dhyāyedyaḥ paramākṣaram||8|| mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nirmokena yathoragaḥ || prātarutthāya yo vipra tatra snānaṃ karoti vai ||9|| dṛṣṭvā devaṃ mahākālaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet|| koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā saptarātroṣitaḥ śuciḥ ||5.1.22.10|| cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || jāgaraṃ tatra kuryādyo hyanaṃtaphalamaśnute || 11 || gandhapuṣpārcanaṃ kṛtvā mahāsnapanapūrvakam || ya evaṃ nayate rātriṃ sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ || 12 || labhate sarvakāmitvaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham || kārtikyāmatha vaiśākhyāṃ devaṃ tatra prapūjayet || 13 || gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca kālīnaistathā vastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva śrīkhaṇḍamagaruṃ tathā || 14 || samabhāgāni kṛtvā tu śilāpṛṣṭhe ca peṣayet || anulipya mahākālaṃ rudrasyānucaro bhavet || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye rudrasaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 22 || || cha ||
<5.1.23>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || atha yātrāṃ pravakṣyāmi mahākālasya yatnataḥ || śivāṃ śreyaskarīṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyalokapradāyinīm || || 1 || snātvā sarasi rudrasya dṛṣṭvā koṭeśvaraṃ śivam|| namaskṛtya tato gacchenmahākālaṃ sanātanam || 2 || gandhaiḥ puṣpairnamaskāraiḥ saṃpūjya tridaśeśvaram|| praṇipatya tato gaccheddevaṃ kapālamocanam || 3 || tatraiva devadeveśaḥ kapālaṃ nyastavānkṣitau || kapāle tatkṣaṇānnyaste tatrābhūlliṃgamuttamam || || 4 || kapālamocanaṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tatra vai snapanaṃ kuryādājyapalaśatena vai || 5 || tadardhārdhena pādena vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || kāle pūrṇe sa viprendra śivaloke mahīyate || 6 || namaskṛtya tato gacchetkapileśvaramuttamam || darśanādasya devasya mucyate brahmahatyayā || 7 || hanumatkeśvaraṃ devaṃ tato gacchetsamāhitaḥ || aiśvaryamatulaṃ vyāsa darśanādasya jāyate || 8 || tato gacchenmahādevaṃ paippalākhyaṃ sanātanam || yasya darśanamātreṇa muktiḥ syāddvijasattama || 9 || svapneśvaraṃ tato gacchedbhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || darśanādasya devasya duḥsvapnaṃ ca vinaśyati || 5.1.23.10 || tato gacchenmahādevamīśānaṃ viśvatomukham|| yasya darśanamātreṇa viśvasyaiva patirbhavet || 11 || someśvaraṃ tato gacchejjitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || kuṣṭharogādidoṣebhyo darśanādasya mucyate || 12 || vaiśvānareśvaraṃ vyāsa tato gacchetsamāhitaḥ || tasya vṛddhiḥ sadā loke jāyate tasya darśanāt || 13 || bījapūrakahastaṃ tu laku līśaṃ tato vrajet || rudratvaṃ darśanāttasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || tato gacchenmahādevaṃ gadyāṇeśvaramuttamam || yasya darśanamātreṇa jāyaṃte sarva siddhayaḥ ||15|| abhyarthitaḥ sadā devaiḥ pūjitaḥ siddhikāraṇāt || tenābhyarthiteśvaro'yaṃ vikhyāto vighnanāyakaḥ ||16|| vayovṛddhaṃ tato gacchenmahākālaṃ sanātanam || na rogo na jarāvyādhirdarśanānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 17 || vighnanāśaṃ tato gacchetprāṇīśaṃ balamuttamam || snānaṃ ghaṭaśataistasya kuryādbhaktyā samāhitaḥ || 18 || tasya caiva kṛte snāne labhyaṃte sarvasiddhayaḥ || svargaścāpi sadā vyāsa darśanādasya jāyate || 19 || tanayaṃ tamanūllaṃghya daṃḍa pāṇiṃ tato vrajet || yasya darśanamātreṇa yamaloko na dṛśyate || 5.1.23.20 || puṣpadantaṃ tato gacchedbhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 21 || guhyaṃ caiva mahākālaṃ tato gacchetsamāhitaḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa guhyapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 22 || tato gacchetsamādhistho durvāseśvaramuttamam || yasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 23 || śvāsāvarodhanaṃ kṛtvā durvāsasaḥ samīpataḥ || gaurīṃ gatvā mahādurgāṃ tyajecchvāsamanaṃtaram || 24 || tatrocchvāso vimoktyastāmabhyarcya tu sarvathā || kāleśvaraṃ tato gaccheddevadevaṃ maheśvaram || 25 || yasya darśanamātreṇa yamalokaṃ na paśyati || vidhīśaṃ ca tato gaccheddevadevaṃ maheśvaram || 26 || yasya darśanamātreṇa badhiratvaṃ na jāyate || kīrtayedātmano nāma sthānaṃ gotraṃ ca tasya vai || 27 || na kīrtayedyadā nāma sā yātrā viphalī bhavet || devasyāgre tato vyāsa upaviśya samāhitaḥ || || 28 || bhaktiyuktastato brūyānnamaskṛtvā punaḥpunaḥ || mayā samarpitā yātrā tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 29 || saṃsārasāgarāddhorānmāmuddhara jagatpate || anena vidhinā yastu mahākālaṃ pradakṣayet || 5.1.23.30 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || golakṣaṃ dvijalakṣāya dattvā yallabhate phalam || 31 || tatphalaṃ devadevasya sakṛddattvā pradakṣiṇam|| bhaktyā paramayā yukto mahākālaṃ pradakṣayet || 32 || padepade yajñaphalamiti me śaṃkaro'bravīt || ṣaṣṭikoṭi sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || 33 || pūjitāni bhavaṃtyatra yātreśvarasamarcanāt || ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 34 || sahasradakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35 || evaṃ yātrāṃ samāpyātha gatvā nijagṛhaṃ naraḥ || yātrādaivata saṃkhyānvai ṣaḍviṃśatidvijottamān|| 36 || bhojayecchivabhaktāṃśca śivadhyānaparāyaṇān || savastrāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā prāpyānujñāṃ visarjayet || 37 || yātrākrameṇa caikaikaṃ dvārāṃtaramanuvrajet || dharmopadeśake paścātsarvopaskarasaṃyutām || 38 || dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ dadyādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || bhuñjītātha svayaṃ vyāsa sarvabhṛtyasamanvitaḥ || 39 || dīnānāthadaridrāṃdhavikalādyāṃśca bhojayet || yadatra phalamuddiṣṭaṃ tadvadāmi śṛṇuṣva me || 5.1.23.40 || kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya mātāpitroḥ samāhitaḥ || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi śivaloke sa modate || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye mahākāleśvarayātrāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<5.1.24>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || vālmīkeśvaramityākhyaṃ yastu devaṃ prapūjayet || maunī dhyānaparo bhūtvā sa kavitvamavāpnuyāt || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathamatra samutpannaḥ ko'sau vālmīkeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa kavitvamupajāyate || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || āsīdvyāsa purā vipraḥ sumatirbhṛgu vaṃśajaḥ || rūpayauvanasaṃpannā tasya bhāryātha kauśikī || 3 || tasya putraḥ samutpanno hyagniśarmeti nāmataḥ || sa pitrā procyamāno'pi vedābhyāsaṃ na manyate || 4 || tato bahutithe kāle anāvṛṣṭirajāyata || tasyāṃ vipadgataḥ so'tha dakṣiṇāmāśrito diśam || 5 || tato'sau sumatirvipraḥ sabhāryaḥ sa sutastathā || videśaṃ kānanaṃ prāptaḥ kṛtvā cāśramamāśritaḥ || 6 || ābhīrairdasyubhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃgo'bhūdagniśarmaṇaḥ|| āgacchati pathā tena yastaṃ haṃti sa pāpakṛt|| 7 || smṛtirnaṣṭā gatā vedā gataṃ gotraṃ gatā śrutiḥ || kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ|| 8 || saptarṣayaḥ pathā tena suvratāḥ samupasthitāḥ || agniśarmātha tāndṛṣṭvā hantukāmo'bravīdidam|| 9 || vastrāṇīmāni mucyadhvaṃ chatrikopānahau tathā || hantavyā hi mayā yūyaṃ gantāro yama sādane || 5.1.24.10 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā atrirvacanamabravīt|| asmatpīḍanajaṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃ te hṛdi vartate || vayaṃ tapasvino bhūtvā tīrthayātrākṛtodyamāḥ || 11 || || agniśarmovāca || || mamāsti mātātha pitā suto bhāryā garīyasī || poṣayāmi sadā tāṃstu etanme hṛdi saṃsthitam || 12 || || atriruvāca || || pitrādīnāśu pṛcchasva svakarmopārjitaṃ prati || yadyuṣmadarthaṃ kriyate pāpaṃ tatkasya kathyatām ||13|| yadi te kathayaṃti sma mā mṛṣā prāṇino vadhīḥ || 14 || || agniśarmovāca || || na kadācinmayā te tu saṃpṛṣṭā īdṛśaṃ vacaḥ|| yuṣmākaṃ vacasā me'dya pratibodhaḥ pravartate || 15|| gatvā pṛcchāmi tānsarvānkasya bhāvaśca kīdṛśaḥ || yūyamatraiva tiṣṭhadhvaṃ yāvadāgamanaṃ mama || 16 || ityuktvā tāñjagāmāśu pitaraṃ svamuvāca ha || dharmasya pratighātena prāṇināṃ pīḍanena ca || 17 || sumahaddṛśyate pāpaṃ kasya tatkathyatāṃ mama || pitā prāha tathā mātā nāpuṇyamāvayoriha || 18 || tvaṃ jānāsi yatkuruṣe kṛtaṃ bhāvyaṃ punastvayā || tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāryā vacanamabravīt || 19 || tayāpyuktaṃ na me pāpaṃ pāpametattavaiva hi || tadvākyamabravītputraṃ bālo'hamitiso'bravīt || 5.1.24.20 || tajjñātvā hṛdayaṃ teṣāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ caiva tattvataḥ || naṣṭo'hamiti manvānaḥ śaraṇaṃ me tapasvinaḥ || || 21 || kṣiptvātha laguḍaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yena vai jaṃtavo hatāḥ|| prakīrya keśāṃstvarita ṛṣīṇāmagrataḥ sthitaḥ || 22 || praṇamya daṃḍapātena tato vacanamavravīt || na me mātā na ca pitā na bhāryā na ca me sutaḥ || 23 || sarvaistaiḥ parimuktau'haṃ bhavatāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || suṣṭhūpadeśadānānmāṃ narakāttrātumarhatha || 24 || evaṃ taṃ vādinaṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayo'trimathābruvan|| bhavato vacanādasya pratibodhaḥ samāgataḥ || 25 || bhavatā'yamanugrāhyaḥ śiṣyo bhavatu te mune || tathetyuktātha tānprāha cāgniṃ dhyānaṃ samācara || 26 || anena dhyānayogena mahāmaṃtrajapena ca || anekadustarātyugrapāpakṛjjanaghātakaḥ|| saṃsthito vṛkṣa mūle tvaṃ parā siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi || 27 || ityuktvā te yayuḥ sarve saṃkāmaṃ so'pi tatra vai || taddhyānastho'bhavadyogī vatsarāṇi trayodaśa || 28 || tasyoparyabhavattatra valmīko'vicalasya ca || nivṛttāstu pathā tena munayastatra śuśruvuḥ || 29 || udīritaṃ dhvaniṃ tena valmīke vismayānvitāḥ || tataḥ khanitvā valmīkaṃ kāṣṭhībhūtoruśaṃkubhiḥ ||5.1.24.30|| taṃ dṛṣṭvotthāpayāmāsurmunayo nayasaṃyutam || namaścakre'tha tānsarvānsa vipro munipuṃgavān ||31|| tānprāha praṇato bhūtvā tapasā dīptatejasaḥ|| prasādādbhavatāmadya jñānaṃ labdhaṃ mayā śubham||32|| dīno'hamuddhṛtaḥ sarvairmagno'haṃ pāpakardame || tasyeti te vākyamūcuḥ paramadhārmikāḥ || 33 || valmīke'sminsthitaḥ putra yatastvamekacittataḥ || vālmīkiriti te nāma bhuvi khyātaṃ bhavi ṣyati || 34 || ityuktvā munayo jagmuḥ svāṃ diśāṃ tapasānvitāḥ || gateṣu munimukhyeṣu vālmīkistapatāṃ varaḥ || kuśasthalyāmathāgamya samārādhya maheśvaram || 35 || tasmātkavitvamāsādya cakre kāvyaṃ manoramam || rāmāyaṇaṃ ca yatprāhuḥ kathāṃ suprathamasthitām|| 36 || tataḥ prabhṛti deveśo vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || khyāto'vaṃtyāṃ tato vyāsa nṛṇāṃ kavitvadāyakaḥ || 37 || iti te kathitaṃ liṃgaṃ vālmīkeśvaramuttamam || yasya darśanamātre ṇa kavitvamupapadyate || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vaṃtīkṣetramāhātmya vālmīkeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||cha ||
<5.1.25>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || śukreśvaraṃ samabhyarcya sitapuṣpairvilepanaiḥ || praṇipatya tato bhaktyā rudraloke mahīyate || 1 || bhīmeśvaraṃ naro dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || na bhayaṃ labhate vyāsa raṇe rātrau jale'nale || 2 || gargeśvaraṃ snāpayitvā tilatailena mānavaḥ || bilvapatraistu saṃpūjya dharmavṛddhimavāpnuyāt || 3 || upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ tilaprasthatilāṃbhasā || snāpayitvā tilairiṣṭvā sadā saukhyamavāpnuyāt || 4 || gosahasraṃ naro dattvā bhāvaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ || bhavabaṃdhavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 5 || kāmeśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kuṃkumādivilepanaiḥ || kāmikena vimānena yāti svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || cūḍāmaṇiṃ namaskṛtya navamyāṃ kārtike site || na viyoniṃ naro yāti dharmabuddhiḥ sa jāyate || 7 || caṃḍīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmupoṣitaḥ || nirmālyollaṃghanotthena na śokenāpi lipyate || 8 || ityāditīrthāni maheśvarasya puṇyāni sarvāṇi naro'bhigamya || viśuddhacitto bhuvi bhāvitātmā prayāti śaṃbhorbhuvanaṃ suramyam|| 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśī tisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye śukreśvarabhīmeśvara gargeśvarakāmeśvara cūḍāmaṇīśvara caṇḍīśvarāditīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || | cha ||
<5.1.26>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || guhyasthāne pavitrāṇi kīrtitāni tvayā mune || pramāṇaṃ kathayasvādya mahākālavanasya me || 1 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || yathāśrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ gadato brahmaṇaḥ svayam || tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ gadato mama || 2 || yojanasyaiva paryaṃtaṃ caturdikṣūpaśobhitam || sauvarṇaistoraṇaiścaiva muktādāmavilaṃbibhiḥ || 3 || dvārāṇi tatra śobhaṃte kāṃcanaiḥ kalaśaiḥ sthitaiḥ || sitapadmamukhairdvārairanekamaṇimaṃḍitaiḥ || 4 || maheśvaraprayuktāśca dvārādhyakṣā mahābalāḥ || dvāreṣu teṣu śobhaṃte lokānugrahakārakāḥ || 5 || piṃgaleśaḥ sthitaḥ pūrve bālarūpo vibhāvasuḥ || tīrthasyābhimukho gauro gururgaṇairathānugaḥ || || 6 || dakṣiṇe'pi mahāyogī kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraḥ || vitteśaḥ paścime dvāre kṣetrasyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 7 || niyukto vai maheśena vāruṇīṃ diśa māsthitaḥ || uttarāṃ diśamāśritya sthitaścaivottareśvaraḥ || 8 || sādhakaḥ sarvakāryāṇāmādiṣṭaḥ śaṃkareṇa saḥ || mānavā ye vasaṃtyatra kṣetramadhye sudhā rmikāḥ || 9 || mṛtā rudrapuraṃ yāṃti vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmatha vārkendusaṃgame || 5.1.26.10 || paṃceśānīṃ namaskṛtya pratilomānu lomataḥ || upoṣito dinaikena dhyāyamāno maheśvaram || 11 || mucyate sarvapāpaistu bahujanmakṛtairapi || evaṃ ca vipra yo yātrāṃ paṃceśānīṃ samārabhet || 12 || anenaiva svadehena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || paṃceśānīmathānyāṃ te sukhena kriyate yathā || 13 || tathā śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇā śinīm || prātaḥ snātvā rudrasarasyekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 14 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā mahākālaṃ natvā ceśānamīśvaram || piṃgaleśaṃ tataḥ prāpya snātvā śrāddhaṃ samācaret || 15 || upagamya tato devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ piṃgaleśvaram || gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca tamabhyarcya nivartayet || 16 || mahākāleśvaraṃ prāpya bhūyaḥ snāto jiteṃdriyaḥ || arcayeddevadeveśaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ sanātanam || 17 || īśāne gamayedrātriṃ kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam || dhyāyamāno maheśānaṃ bhūmau vinyasya vigraham || 18 || dvādaśyāṃ pūrvavatsarvaṃ prātaḥ snātvā vrajennaraḥ || kāyāvarohaṇaṃ gatvā piṃgaleśvaravadyajet || 19 || trayodaśyāmathāpyevaṃ bilveśaṃ paścime'rcayet || caturdaśyāṃ tathā saumye pūjayeduttareśvaram || 5.1.26.20 || amāvāsyāṃ śuciḥ snāto mahākāleśvaraṃ yajet || gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca naivedyairvividhaistathā || 21 || gītanṛtyādikaṃ kṛtvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet || yātrāṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvoktāṃ tato nijagṛhaṃ vrajet || 22 || brāhmaṇānbhojayetpañca śivabhaktiparāyaṇān || praṇamya devatārūpānmahākāloṣitāndvijān || 23 || pūjayitvā hiraṇyena sūkṣmavastraguṇairnavaiḥ || rathaṃ piṃgalake dadyādgajaṃ kāyāvarohaṇe || 24 || dattvā bilveśvare cāśvaṃ vṛṣaṃ dattvā tu cottare || dhenuṃ dattvā mahākāle sarvopaskarasaṃyutam || 25 || ya evaṃ kurute vyāsa tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 26 || pitṛkairmātṛkaiḥ sārdhaṃ kulaiḥ sa divi modate || apsarogītanṛtyādyairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || 27 || || iti paṃce śānīyātrāmāhātmyam || || yastu pradakṣiṇāṃ kuryānniyamena kuśasthalīm || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā || 28 || yastu padmāvatīṃ paśye ddarcayetpaṃkajairnaraḥ || dattvā dhūpaṃ sanaivedyaṃ mṛto brahmapuraṃ vrajet || 29 || svarṇaśṛṃgāṭikāṃ vyāsa kusumaiḥ svarṇasaṃnibhaiḥ || samabhyarcya mahābhaktyā sa yāti śivamandiram || 5.1.26.30 || avantinīṃ tu yaḥ paśyeddevīṃ trailokyaviśrutām || kāmikena vimānena yāti pauraṃdaraṃ puram || 31 || arcayetpaṃkajairbhaktyā yo devīmamarāvatīm || amaraiḥ saha saṃhṛṣṭo modate divi sarvadā || 32 || devīmujjayanīṃ bhaktyā yaḥ paśyati samāhitaḥ || sarvaiśvaryasamāyukto rudraloke mahīyate || 33 || viśālāṃ caiva yaḥ paśyedrudrabhaktyā samāhitaḥ || mucyate trividhaiḥ pāpairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 34 || || iti śrīkalpasaptakamahimā || || śṛṇu vyāsa mahātīrthaṃ purā yadbrahmaṇārcitam || akūreśvaramityākhyaṃ yatra siddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 35 || tatra devārcanaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmupoṣitaḥ || jiteṃdriyaḥ śucirdāṃto rudralokamavāpnuyāt || 36 || na vadetkenacitsārdhaṃ naraḥ prātargṛhe sthitaḥ || dṛṣṭvā'krūreśvaraṃ devaṃ hemadā naphalaṃ labhet ||37|| || ityakrūreśvaramāhātmyam || || yastu paśyati brahmāṇaṃ śuciḥ snāto jiteṃdriyaḥ || mucyate pātakāddhorādbrahmalokaṃ mṛto vrajet || 38 || padmāsanasthito brahmā dhyāyamānaḥ paraṃ padam || vasiṣṭhādyairmunivarairvijñaptaḥ karmasaṃbhavān || 39 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || ādityā marutaḥ sādhyāstathā caivāśvināvubhau || pitaro ye ca lokānāṃ pūjyaṃte bhuvi mānavaiḥ || 5.1.26.40 || grahārkatārakā yakṣā diggajāścyānalānilāḥ || amī devā vayaṃ sarve tvadaṃśāḥ paripaṭhyate || 41 || kathaṃ dhyāyasi deveśa etatsarvaṃ bravīhi naḥ || 42 || || brahmovāca || || dve vidye tattvarūpe ye parā caivāparā tathā || te dve ca mama rūpe dve nitye mūrtātmike mama || 43 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || pitāmaha kathaṃ vidmo bhavaṃtaṃ paramaṃ vibhum || yenāsmākaṃ parā siddhirjāyate tava darśanāt || 44 || || brahmovāca || || māheśvaraṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ kuśasthalīti śabditam || yajñārthinā mayā devaḥ śrīkaṃṭhaḥ pārvatī patiḥ || 45 || yācitastena devena ukto'haṃ parameṣṭhinā || samaṃtādyojanaṃ sāgraṃ kṣetrametatpitāmahaḥ || 46 || mayā dattaṃ tava vibho mahākālavanādṛte || vāritaḥ sa mayā tatra vane gupto hi roṣataḥ || kapardinā ca tatrokto yāsyāmo na tavāṃtikam || 47 || ārabdho vai tato yajño nārāyaṇaparigrahāt || jñātastathāpi me yajño devadevena śaṃbhunā || 48 || yajñavāṭaṃ kapardīśastato bhikṣārthamāgataḥ || yājñikaiḥ so'tha tatrokto mātra tiṣṭha jugupsitaḥ || 49 || kapardinā ca te tatra uktā yāsyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || evamuktvā kapālaṃ sa bhūmau saṃsthāpya tatra hi ||5.1.26.50|| snātuṃ nadīṃ yayau śiprāṃ kapardī parameśvaraḥ|| uktaṃ tasmingate śiprāṃ kapardini dvijātibhiḥ||51|| kathaṃ hi kriyate homaḥ kapāle sadasi sthite|| akapālāni śaucāni purā proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 52 || tatkapālaṃ sadasyena ukṣiptaṃ pāṇinā svayam || tasminkṣipte'bhavaccānyatpunaḥ kṣipte'bhavatpunaḥ || 53 | evaṃ nāṃtaṃ kapālānāṃ prāpyate munisattamāḥ || rudraṃ kapardinaṃ matvā śaraṇaṃ taṃ samāgatāḥ || 54 || tataḥ sa darśanaṃ prādādbhaktyā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || kapālapāṇirbhagavānmāmuvā ca tataḥ prabhuḥ || 55 || varaṃ varaya bho brahmanyatte manasi vartate || nāstyadeyaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyāmi tattvataḥ ||56|| brahmottaramidaṃ sthānaṃ mayā dattaṃ caturmukha || kārayasva yathākāmaṃ yathāvarṇacatuṣṭayam || 57 || evaṃ vadaṃtaṃ varadamīśānaṃ parameśvaram || tatheti coktvā sadasi na mayā'nyo varo vṛtaḥ | || 58 || ujjayinīti vai nāma kuśasthalyā niveśitam || kuṃḍaṃ maṃdākinī tatra mayā kṛtamanaṃtaram || 59 || tatra viprāḥ kṛte snāne sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddikṣu caturo'rthaghaṭāñchubhān || 5.1.26.60 || satilāstānsavastrāṃśca saphalānmaṃḍakaiḥ saha || kārtikyāmatha māghyāṃ ca cātu rvidye pradāpayet || 61 || prathamaṃ ca ṛgvedāya yajurvedāya dakṣiṇam || paścimaṃ sāmavedāya atharvaṇe tathottaram || 62 || vedānuddiśya cāpyevaṃ prīyatāṃ me pitāmahaḥ || kṛte caivaṃ hi yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 63 || sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ maṃdākinyāṃ tathā bhavet || sahasraguṇitaṃ snānaṃ jāpyaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet || 64 || dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ maṃdākinyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || kaumude māsi saṃprāpte godānaṃ tatra kārayet || 65 || ghṛtadhenuṃ ca kārtikyāṃ māghyāṃ tilamayīṃ tathā || jaladhenuṃ tu vaiśākhyāṃ dattvā mucyeta pātakaiḥ || 66 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yacca duṣkṛ tam || vinaśyetkilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ maṃdākinyāstu darśanāt | 67 || maṃdākinīsamaṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ naiva dṛśyate || yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmaloke sa modate || 68 || maṃdākinyāṃ tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ pradāsyati || darśe ca pūrṇimāyāṃ vā pitṛloke sa modate || || 69 || pitāmahaṃ tu yo bhaktyā nityaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || aśvamedhasahasreṇa rājasūyaśatena ca || 5.1.26.70 || yujyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyametatta podhanāḥ || tato manvaṃtare'tīte prāpte vaivasvate punaḥ || 71 || tenaivonmattaveṣeṇa ūrdhvaśeṣo maheśvaraḥ || praviṣṭo brahmaṇaḥ satre dṛṣṭastairdvija sattamaiḥ || 72 || te brāhmaṇāḥ śapaṃti sma nindāṃ kurvaṃti cāpare || apare pāṃśubhiḥ śiśnaṃ ghnaṃti tasyāśapandvijāḥ || 73 || loṣṭhairlaguḍakaiścā nye ghnaṃti taṃ balagarvitāḥ || jaṭāmukuṭakaṃ keciddhṛtvā karṣaṃti cāpare || 74 || pṛcchaṃti bratacaryāṃ vai kena vrataṃ ca darśitam || atra caiva striyaḥ saṃti kathametattvayā kṛtam || 75 || brahmaṇā cedṛśī caryā viṣṇunā vā kṛtā svayam || giriśenāpi devena kenedaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 76 || mā viḍambaya deveśaṃ vadhyo hi nastvamadya vai || evaṃ tairhanyamānastu brāhmaṇaistatra śaṃkaraḥ || 77 || smitaṃ kṛtvā'bravītsarvānbrāhmaṇānparameśvaraḥ || kiṃ yūyaṃ māmabhi hatha hyunmattaṃ naṣṭacetasam || 78 || yūyaṃ kāruṇikāḥ sarve maitrabhāve vyavasthitāḥ || tamevaṃ vādinaṃ devaṃ jālmarūpadharaṃ haram || 79 || māyayā tasya devasya mohitāste dvijātayaḥ || punaḥ kapardinaṃ jaghnuḥ pāṇipādena vai dvijāḥ || 5.1.26.80 || tāḍyamānastu tairvipraiḥ paraṃ kopamupāgamat || tato devena te śaptā yūyaṃ vedavivarjitāḥ || 81 || ūrdhvajūṭāḥ salaguḍāḥ paradāropajīvinaḥ || ratā dyūte ca veśyāyāṃ pitṛmātṛvivarjitāḥ || 82 || na putre pitṛ vittaṃ ca vidyā vāpi bhaviṣyati || śeṣo mama hato yaiśca te sarveṃdriyavarjitāḥ || 83 || raudrāṃ bhikṣāṃ tu bhikṣaṃtaḥ parapiṃḍopajīvinaḥ || ātmānaṃ varṇayiṣyaṃti dhanadhānyavivarjitāḥ || 84 || yaiśca tatra kṛtā viprairhanyamāne kṛpā mayi || teṣāṃ dhanaṃ ca putrāśca dāsīdāsādayaśca vai ||85|| kulotpannāśca vai nāryo bhaviṣyaṃti varānmama || evaṃ śāpaṃ varaṃ dattvā gatoṃ'tardhānamīśvaraḥ || 86 || tato dvijā gate deve matvā taṃ śaṃkaraṃ vibhum || anveṣayaṃto yatnena mahākālavanaṃ gatāḥ || 87 || snātvā sarasi rudrasya japataḥ śatarudriyam || jāpyāvasāne tāndevo'śarīriṇyā girā'bravīt || 88 || anṛtaṃ na mayā proktaṃ svaireṣvepi kutaḥ sukham || bhūyo'pyanugrahaṃ viprā yuṣmākaṃ karavāṇyaham || 89 || śāṃtā dāṃtāśca ye viprā bhaktimaṃto mayi sthitāḥ || na teṣāṃ chidyate vaṃśo na dhanaṃ na ca saṃtatiḥ || 5.1.26.90 || agnihotraratā ye ca bhaktimaṃto janārdane || pūjayaṃti ca brahmāṇaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram ||91|| nāśubhaṃ vidyate teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ sakhye sthitā matiḥ || etāvaduktvā deveśastūṣṇīmāsījjagatprabhuḥ || 92 || evaṃ śāpaṃ varaṃ labdhvā devadevānmaheśvarāt || ājagmuḥ sahitāḥ sarve yatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 93 || viraṃcimatha te jāpyaistoṣayanto'grataḥ sthitāḥ || tuṣṭastānabravīdbrahmā matto'pi vriyatāṃ varaḥ || 94 || brahmaṇastena vākyena tuṣṭāḥ sarve dvijottamāḥ || ko varo yācyatāṃ viprāḥ parituṣṭe pitāmahe || 95 || eke tatrābruvanviprā vedānvai vṛṇa vāmahai || tato'nye ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vriyatāmaviśaṃkitaiḥ || 96 || anye prāhuḥ kimasmākaṃ dhanaistuṣṭe pitāmahe || agnihotrāṇi vedāśca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 97 || śāṃtā āḍhyāśca lokāśca varadānādbhavaṃtu naḥ || evaṃ prajalpatāṃ tatra viprāṇāṃ kopa āviśat || 98 || parasparaṃ varārthe'tha yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ || yudhyaṃte sāyudhāḥ kecitkecittatropasarpakāḥ || 99 || kecidviprā udāsīnāḥ kecidvai maunamāsthitāḥ || dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhagavānprāha viprānyuddhaṃ prakurvataḥ || 5.1.26.100 || yasmātkumaṃtritā viprāḥ śālāyā bāhyasaṃsthite || tasmādāmūlato viprā gulme yuddhopasarpakāḥ || 101 || udāsīnastu yo gulmo vṛttihīno bhaviṣyati || vedāstasya bhaveyurvai yastvasti maunasaṃsthitaḥ || 102 || tṛtīyaḥ sāyudho gulmo yoddhukāmastu yaḥ sthitaḥ || paradāreṣu veśyāyāṃ dyūte caurye sadā rataḥ ||103|| caturvidhaḥ sa vai vipro vṛttihīno bhaviṣyati || evamuktvā yayau brahmā vairājaṃ bhavanottamam || 104 || evaṃ me paramaṃ kṣetraṃ munayo'vaṃtimaṃḍale || yāṃ devanagarīṃ loke pravadantīha mānavāḥ || 105 || tasyāṃ tu ye dvijāḥ śāṃtā vasaṃti kṣetravāsina || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcinma ma loke bhaviṣyati || 106 || kolāmukhe kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkareṣu ca || vārāṇasyāṃ prabhāse ca tathā badarikāśrame || 107 || gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca gaṃgāsā garasaṃgame || rudrakoṭyāṃ virūpākṣe mitrasyāpi tathā vane || 108 || tīrtheṣveteṣu kṣetreṣu yā siddhirdvādaśābdikā || prāpyate mānavairloke sā māseneha labhyate || ujjayinyāṃ na saṃdeho brahmacarye mano yadi || 109 || tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetrāṇāmapi cottamam || sadābhirucitaṃ mahyametadvai munisattamāḥ || 5.1.26.110|| maṃdākinyāstu māhātmyaṃ kṣetrasyotpattiruttamā || bhūyaḥ kimanyadicchāsti śrotuṃ vai dvijasattamāḥ || 111 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || etatte brahmaṇo vākyaṃ śrutvā vyāsa tathāvidham || vasiṣṭhādyāśca munayaḥ paraṃ dhyānamatho gatāḥ || 112 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ tatra vāse mano dadhuḥ || sāgnihotrāḥ sapatnīkā gatāścāvaṃtimaṃḍale || 113 || mahākālavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiprāṃ caiva mahānadīm || śmaśānamūṣaraṃ caiva nadīṃ gandhavatīṃ tathā || 114 || koṭitīrthamupaspṛśya cakurvāsaṃ ca tatra vai || smṛtvā tadbrahmaṇo vākyaṃ rucisteṣāṃ tadā'bhavat || 115 || arundhatyā vasiṣṭhaśca gamanaṃ prati noditaḥ || uvāca tāṃ mahātmāsau svāṃ bhāryāṃ munisattamāḥ || 116 || mahākālaḥ saricchiprā gatiścaiva sunirmalā || ujjayinyāṃ viśālākṣi vāsaḥ kasya na rocate || 117 || snānaṃ kṛtvā naro yastu mahānadyāṃ hi durlabham || mahākālaṃ namaskṛtya naro mṛtyuṃ na śocayet || 118 || mṛtaḥ kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā rudra syānucaro bhavet || yatraiṣā śrūyate muktiḥ kathaṃ sā tyajate mayā || 119 || evaṃ prajalpyātha munipradhānastatraiva vāsaṃ sahasā cakāra || vanasya vyuṣṭiṃ parikīrtayaṃstu sthitaḥ sahaivātra munipradhānaiḥ || 5.1.26.120 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣe tramāhātmye maṃdākinīkṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || ||cha||
<5.1.27>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || yo'vaṃtyāmaṃkapādākhye paśyedrāmajanārdanau || yayordarśanamātreṇa yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kathaṃ tāvaṃkapādākhye yātāvatra mahāmune || na paśyedyamalokaṃ sa yadyapi brahmahā bhavet || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || bhārāvatāraṇārthāya devau rāmajanārdanau || avatīrṇau yadorvaṃśe divyarūpau mahādyutau || 3 || kaṃsaṃ hatvā sacāṇūramugrasenaṃ narādhipam || abhiṣicya svayaṃ rājye yadusiṃha uvāca tam || 4 || kiṃ kāryaṃ te mayā brūhi kartavyaṃ te sute hate || evamuktaḥ sa rājā vāṃ ugraseno'bravīdidam|| 5 || sarvaṃ saṃpatsyate kṛṣṇa bhavato hi na durlabham || vijñātākhilavijñānau bhavitārāvubhāvapi || 6 || gacchetamujjayinyāṃ vai kṛtavidyau bhaviṣyatha|| tataḥ sāṃdīpaniṃ vipraṃ jagmatū rāmakeśavau||7|| kaṇṭhasthāṃścakaturvedānācāramakhilaṃ ca tau|| sarahasyaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sasaṃhāraṃ tathaiva ca ||8|| ahorātraiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā tadadbhutamabhūddvija || sāṃdīpanirasaṃbhāvyaṃ tayoḥ karmātimānuṣam || 9 || viciṃtya tau tadā mene prāptau caṃdra divākarau|| tataḥ kiṃcitsa novāca snātuṃ tīrthamathāyayau ||5.1.27.10|| śiṣyaistu sahito vipro mahākālavane'viśat || śiṣyaiḥ saha praviṣṭau dvau tadā tau rāmake śavau|11|| vandamānau mahākālaṃ sa taṃ keśavamavravīt|| tvayā nāthena devānāṃ mānuṣyatve hi tiṣṭhatā || 12|| sukhamāsīcca sādhūnāmajñānānāṃ ca sarvadā || jane pīḍākarā ye tu sadā vā baladarpitāḥ ||13|| yuvābhyāṃ te hatāḥ sarve kaṃsapramukhato nṛpāḥ | munisiddhasurādīnāṃ sthitiḥ kāryā tvayā'nagha ||14|| kariṣyāmi tamityuktvā sa namasya tato yayau || dṛṣṭvā sāṃdīpaniṃ śiṣyā ūcurevaṃ dinedine || 15 || kasya na śraddadhe teṣāṃ vacastvatyadbhutaṃ yataḥ || svayaṃ yayau tato draṣṭumāścaryaṃ śiṣyabhāṣitam || 16 || tatastatrotthitaḥ śabdaḥ saṃśleṣe ca tathā tayoḥ|| tāvāgatau gṛhaṃ tatra gururvacanamabravīt || 17 || na vai jñātau mayā vīrau yaduvṛṣṇikulodbhavau || tataḥ sāṃdīpaniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'bravīdvacaḥ || 18 || gurvarthaṃ kiṃ dadāmīti saha rāmeṇa harṣitaḥ || tacchutvā vacanaṃ hṛdyaṃ guruḥ provāca harṣitaḥ || 19 || putramicchāmyahaṃ tvatto yo mṛto lavaṇāṃbhasi || putra eko hi me jātaḥ sa cāpi timinā hṛtaḥ || 5.1.27.20 || prabhāse tīrthayātrāyāṃ tvameva tamihānaya || tatheti cābravītkṛṣṇo rāmasyānumate gataḥ || 21 || taṃ samudra uvācedaṃ daityaḥ paṃcajano mahān|| timi rūpeṇa taṃ bālaṃ grastavānmayi saṃsthitaḥ || 22 || tataḥ paṃcajanaṃ hatvā grāharūpaṃ mahābalam || tanmadhyasthaṃ ca jagrāha śaṃkhaṃ grasto hi yaḥ purā || 23 || jaleśvaragṛhāttena grāheṇātīva līlayā || tasyodare yadā bālaṃ nāptavāṃstu janārdanaḥ || 24 || yamālayagataṃ matvā tadā varuṇamabravīt || bhagavānsādasāmīśa ratho me dīyatāṃ mahān||25|| purājire hatā daityā dānavā baladarpitāḥ|| mayā yena rathenādya mahyaṃ sa dīyatāṃ rathaḥ||26|| nyāsabhūto ratho yaste vidhṛto nihatāriṇā|| mayā dharmaṃ puraskṛtya sa dīyatāmapāṃpate||27|| yenāhave pretarājaṃ jitvā paśyāmi bālakam|| etacchrutvā prahṛṣṭātmā jñātvā kāryārthinaṃ harim || dadau taṃ rathamakṣobhyaṃ raṇe tasmai surāsuraiḥ || 28 || tato hariḥ samālokya rathaṃ ratnapariṣkṛtam || dvīpicarmaparīdhānaṃ vaiyāghraparivāritam || 29 || nānā citravicitrāṃgaṃ garuḍadhvajarājitam || saṃyuktaṃ śaibyasugrīvapuṣpadaṃtabalāhakaiḥ || 5.1.27.30 || ajeyaṃ devadeveṃdradānavāsurarākṣasaiḥ || anekāyudhasaṃpūrṇaṃ maṇividrumabhūṣitam ||31|| sahasrasūryapratimaṃ cāruvaktracaturyugam|| kiṃkiṇīśataśobhāḍhyaṃ ghaṃṭācāmaracaṃ drikam || 32 || saṃvartākāraviṣamaṃ khageṃdravaraketanam || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ sarāmastu mumude vītavismayāt || 33 || pradakṣiṇamupākṛtya devatābhyaḥ praṇamya ca || āruroha rathaṃ viṣṇurvimānaṃ sāgrayojanam || 34 || tato jagāma tvarito janārdano jagannivāso yamalokamāśritām || diśaṃ sahasraiḥ kiraṇai rvṛtāṃ purīṃ dadhmau ca śaṃkhaṃ parigṛhya cācyutaḥ || 35 || tatra pradhyāpayāmāsa śaṃkhaṃ śārṅgadhanurdharaḥ || tena śabdena vitrastāḥ kṛtāṃtālayavāsinaḥ ||| 36 || narakāṃtargatā martyāḥ pāpācāraparāyaṇāḥ || sukhamāpuḥ prasannāśca vahnayaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanāt || 37|| śastrāṇi kuṃṭhatāṃ prāpuryaṃtrāṇi vividhāni ca || vidīrṇāni tadā cāsurdevadevasya darśanāt || 38 || asipatravanaṃnāma śīrṇaparṇamajāyata || rauravanāma narakamabhairavamabhūttadā || 39 || abhairavaṃ bhairavākhyaṃ kuṃbhīpākamavācikam || śṛṃgāṭaṃ śṛṃgasadṛśaṃ lohasūcyapyasūcikā || 5.1.27.40 || dustarā sutarā jātā nadī vaitaraṇī nṛṇām || narakāṃte tadā jāte gate viśveśvare vibhau | 41 || pāpakṣayāttataḥ sarve te muktā nārakā narāḥ || padamavyayamāsādya dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ tamo'paham || 42 || vimāneṣu sahasreṣu hyārūḍhāste samaṃtataḥ || samīkṣya puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ muktāste sarvapātakāt || 43 || tataḥ śūnyaṃ mune jātaṃ sarvaṃ nirayamaṃḍalam || darśanāttasya devasya viṣṇorviśvasvarūpiṇaḥ || 44 || tato dūtāḥ kṛtāṃtasya kṛṣṇaṃ ca yuddhakāriṇam || vārayāmāsuratyugrā viśaṃtaṃ narakānprati || 45 || || || kiṃkarā ūcuḥ || || mā vīrānena mārgeṇa rathamānaya mānavan || prayāṃtyadhogatiṃ pāpātparastrīsvāpahārakāḥ || 46 || yamādiṣṭā narāḥ pāpā ye'mocyā varṣakoṭibhiḥ || dṛṣṭvā ta eva sadyastvāṃ gatāḥ svargamapāvṛtāḥ || 47 || etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ kṛpayā pīḍito bhṛśam || punaḥ provāca madhuhā mokṣāyāhamupāgataḥ || 48 || sarveṣāṃ svargadātāhaṃ yamalokanivārakaḥ || aṃjasā yamarāḍdūtā yamāyākhyāta me vacaḥ || 49 || etacchrutvā vaco dūtāḥ satvarā yamamāgatāḥ || sarvamācakṣire vṛttaṃ yathā nārakamokṣaṇam || 5.1.27.50 || tato yamo ruṣāviṣṭaḥ prāha tānyamakiṃkarān || yaḥ kaścidāgato martyo maryādābhedakṛnnaraḥ || 51 || taṃ gatvā vārayadhvaṃ vai gṛhītvānīyatāmiti || ayaṃ narāṃtako yātu kiṃkaraḥ saha kiṃkaraiḥ || 52 || evamukto yamenātha kiṃkaraḥ sa narāṃtakaḥ || gatvā taṃ vārayāmāsa vāgbhirugrābhiracyutam || 53 || yadā na vāritastasthau tadā kruddho narāṃtakaḥ || tadā śarairatīvograistāḍitastena keśavaḥ || 54 || baladevopi samare tāḍito vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ || tāvubhau tāḍitau ghoraiḥ samaṃtādyamakiṃkaraiḥ || 55 || ādāya dhanuṣī divye jaghnaturyamakiṃkarān|| bāṇairanekasāhasraiḥ kruddhau rāmajanādarnau || 56 || narāṃtako'pi samare balena balinārditaḥ || papāta gadayā bhinno mūrdhni niryātalocanaḥ || 57 || tato narāṃtake vīre patite yamakiṃkare || kiṃkarāṇāmabhūtsainyamārtaṃ raṇaparāṅmukham || 58 || rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ te dūtā hanyamānā bhayāturāḥ || yamāya kathayāmāsurnarāṃtakastu pātitaḥ || 59 || tato yamo yayau kruddhaḥ samaṃtātkiṃkarairvṛtaḥ || prāha tato yamaḥ kruddho no jitohaṃ purā paraiḥ ||5.1.27.60 || tato vāditranirghoṣaistumulānakagomukhaiḥ || nānāḍamarukaiścaiva citraguptaiśca gacchati || 61 || devā vidyādharāḥ siddhā dṛṣṭvā yāṃtaṃ mahābalam || kṛtāṃtasya raṇe'kṣobhyaṃ kāmapālaṃ jagatpatim || 62 || tataste kiṃkarāḥ sarve citraguptena noditāḥ|| rathamāvṛtya bāṇaughaiḥ pravivyadhuḥ samaṃtataḥ || 63 || balaṃ ca keśavaṃ saṃkhye jaghnatustāvubhāvapi || raṇe ca vividhairbāṇaiścitraguptasya paśyataḥ || 64 || vidārya ca sahasrāṇi kiṃkarāṇāṃ samaṃtataḥ || kṛtāṃtānīkinīmadhye kṛtāṃta iva keśavaḥ || cacāra raṇadurdharṣaḥ kāmapālena pālitaḥ || 65 || tataścitragupto raṇe kiṃkarādyaṃ vidīrṇaṃ nirīkṣyārtanādaṃ cakāra || 66 || śaraiḥ paṃcabhiḥ kṛṣṇamāyāṃtamājau jaghānāṣṭabhirvaktradeśe sa bhinnaḥ || śarārto rathopastha āsīttadārtastamālokya bhinnaṃ raṇe naṣṭasaṃjñam || 67 || rathaṃ svaṃ samādāya yātaḥ kṛtāṃtastataścitragupte śarārte prasupte || raṇe kīrtilupte bhayakṣobhayuktaḥ svasainyaiśca yukto bhayārto niṣaṇṇaḥ || 68 || pradhānāśca bhagnā vicitrāśca bhagrāstataścitraguptaṃ niśamyātha bhagnam || sa kālastamāyāṃtamālokya dūrādvarasainyamādāya devāri śatrum || 69 || vināśāya yudhyadyugāṃte prajānāṃ yathā vāḍavo jvālavṛddhaḥ pravṛttaḥ || tamāyāṃtamālokya kālaṃ karālaṃ śarairāvṛṇodaṃtakaṃ kālakalpaiḥ || 5.1.27.70 || sa kālaḥ karālaṃ samādāya daṃḍaṃ mumocācyute paśyatāṃ devatānām || tataḥ kāladaṃḍaḥ prajānāṃ vināśo hareḥ saṃnikāśaṃ samabhyājagāma || 71 || tato devagaṃdharvayakṣā munīṃdrāḥ paraṃ vismayaṃ prāpurāvīkṣya rāmam || jvalaṃtaṃ ca jagrāha kālasya daṃḍaṃ sa rāmo varalīlayā'naṃtamūrtiḥ || 72 || gṛhīte balenāhave kāladaṃḍe moktukāme punaḥ kālanāśāya vai| tūrṇamabhyetya tatrāṃtare raṇe vārayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ tadā||73|| mā muṃcetyabravīdvedhāḥ kālaṃ kālāyudhaṃ bala|| tvayā balavatā vīra carācaradharā dharā||74|| dhāryate śirasā deva saṃsāre nāsti te samaḥ || tvayā viśvapatirviṣṇurutsaṃgena sadohyate|| ko'nyosti tvatsamo rāma yo jagaddahane kṣamaḥ || jagatsraṣṭā jagadgoptā jagaddhartā jagatpatiḥ ||76|| pālyate yattvayā sopi viṣṇurviśvaikanāyakaḥ || kaste stutikaro'stīha ko guṇānvaktumarhati || 77 || tato vayaṃ tvadaṃkasthaviṣṇunābhibhavā yataḥ || ityuktvā baladevaṃ ca vāsudevaṃ punarvacaḥ || 78 || uvāca caturāsyastu stutiśca vṛtaḥ suraiḥ || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa karālasya kālasyāsya kṛpāṃ kuru || 79 || yato bhavaṃtamāyāṃtaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaikanāyakam || vetti nāyaṃ jagannāthaṃ narakārṇavatārakam || 5.1.27.80 || tvayā vai bhagavanpūrvaṃ yamaḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ pade || nṛṇāṃ duṣkṛtakartṝṇāṃ narakāya yamaḥ prabho || 81 || tasmādasya jagannātha kṣamyatāṃ puruṣottama || vibho kṛpāṃ kuruṣvāsya brūhi yatte vivakṣitam || 82 || etacchutvā'bravītkṛṣṇo dhātaḥ śṛṇu gurormama || sāṃdīpaneḥ samānītaḥ sutastenāgatāviha || 83 || samarpyatāṃ guruśreṣṭha śreṣṭhāya gurudakṣiṇā || āvābhyāṃ vai pratijñāto tasmātsā pālyatāṃ vibho || 84 || etatpitāmahaḥ śrutvā yamaṃ samaranirjitam || samāhūyābravīdviṣṇuryadbravīti kuruṣva tat || 85 || tacchrutvā dharmarājastu viraṃcimidamabravīt || bhagavanviśvakṛlloke naiṣa mārgastvayā kṛtaḥ || 86 || yamalokamanuprāpya kāyahīnaḥ śarīravān || yatkāyarahito yāti naitadatra prapadyate || 87 || tacchutvā hi punarbrahmā viśvasyāsya vibhuḥ svayam || viśvakṛdviśvahadyasmādyadicchati karotu tat || 88 || tasmādarpaya putraṃ tvaṃ muneḥ sāṃdīpaneśca yaḥ || narake yaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā taṃ cānaya mahāmate || 89 || tacchutvā dharmarājastu putraṃ sāṃdīpanestathā || sasarja bāla rūpaṃ ca tadātmānaṃ tadudbhavam || 5.1.27.90 || arpayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya bālaṃ rūpasamanvitam || sa sarvadevatānāṃ ca tadadbhutamivābhavat || 91 || tataḥ prāpya guroḥ putraṃ prabhuḥ prītaḥ prajāpatim || prāha prāpto mayā brahmansvarūpo dvijadārakaḥ || 92 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || adyaprabhṛti lokeśa deśe maccaraṇāṃ kite || avaṃtyāmaṃkapādākhye mṛtā nekṣaṃti te yamam || 93 || mahākālapure devamādyaṃ vai puruṣottamam || viśvarūpaṃ ca goviṃdaṃ śaṃkhoddhāraṃ ca keśa vam || 94 || ye paśyaṃti kuśasthalyāmeteṣāṃ mūrtipaṃcakam || te narā na gamiṣyaṃti viraṃce nirayaṃ kvacit || 95 || tathaivāgamanādatra mama rāmasya nā rakāḥ || vimuktāste tvaghādghorātprāpnuvaṃtvakhilā divam || 96 || ityukte vacane vedhāḥ provāca prītimānharim || yattvayoktaṃ vacaḥ kṛṣṇa tadastu sakalaṃ sadā || 97 || ye ca tvāmādipuruṣaṃ prathamaṃ puruṣottamam || praṇamya paścādrakṣyaṃti snātvā śivasarasyapi || 98 || adhojvālaṃ mahākālaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || evamukto hariḥ putramādāya balinā saha || 99 || saṃmānya vedhasaṃ kālaṃ samārohadrathaṃ tataḥ || śaṃkhamāpūrayāmāsa kṛtakāryo janārdanaḥ || 5.1.27.100 || mokṣāya nirayasthānāṃ nṛṇāṃ vai pāpakarmaṇām || tataste śaṃkhaśabdena smaraṇenācyutasya ca || 101 || divyānvimānānāruhya divamevākhilā gatāḥ || śūnyaṃ tanmaṃḍalaṃ jātaṃ nārāyaṇasamāgame || 102 || kālo'pi daṃḍamāsādya baladevātpunaḥ puram || praviveśa tato dhātā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 103 || kṛṣṇopi balavāndhīraḥ prāpta ujjayinīṃ purīm || baladevasahāyastu satvareṇāśugāminā || 104 || tataḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ putramarpayāmāsa keśihā || gurave yatpratijñātaṃ sa tasmādanṛṇo'bhavat || 105 || evaṃ sāṃdīpaniḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punarāgatam || nāgarāstatra rājā ca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || 106 || tau vīrāvarcayāmāsurmatvā devottamottamau || sāṃdīpaniruvācedaṃ tau ca rāmajanārdanau || 107 || iha sthāsyati vāṃ kīrtiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || sthāne madīya etasmiṃstiṣṭhaṃtau yadunaṃdanau ||108|| na vijñātau mayā vīrau yaduvṛṣṇikulodbhavau || naranārāyaṇau devau devakāryārthamāgatau ||109|| nālpamṛtyurbhavettasya na vyādhirna ca durgatiḥ || prāpya hyatra ca yaḥ snāti svargaloke sa modate ||5.1.27.110|| śaṃkhinaṃ viśvarūpaṃ ca govidaṃ cakriṇaṃ tathā || catvāri viṣṇukṣetrāṇi aṃkapādastu paṃcamaḥ || 111 || eṣāṃ yātrāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā kāryā manīṣibhiḥ || maṃdākinyāṃ kṛtasnāno dṛṣṭvā rāmajanārdanau || 112 || śaṃkhoddhāre tataḥ snātvā prapaśyedbalakeśavau || snānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuṃḍe goviṃdaṃ ca samarcayeta || 113 || cakriṇaṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā devadevaṃ ca śaṃkhinam || aṃkapādau tato dṛṣṭvā viśvarūpaṃ tato vrajet || 114 || tasyāgrataḥ karīkuṃḍe snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || punastena prakāreṇa prapaśyedbalakeśavau || 115 || snānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuṃḍe goviṃdaṃ ca samarcayet || tathaiva cakrihalinau dṛṣṭvā taṃ keśavaṃ vrajet || 116 || śiprāṃbhasi naraḥ snātvā bhaktyā saṃpūjya keśavam || parāvṛtyāṃkapāde tu tāṃ rātriṃ gamayecchuciḥ || 117 || prātarvai bhojayettatra paṃca viprāṃśca suvratān || godakṣiṇāṃ śaṃkhine tu viśvarūpāya vai hayam || 118 || goviṃdāya gajaṃ dadyātsarvaṃ dadyācca keśave || upoṣya dvādaśīṃ vipra yoṃ'kapādaṃ samarcayet || 119 || gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca naivedyairvividhaistathā || śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute sarvaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 5.1.27.120 || kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ || gītanṛtyādibhogaiśca vaikuṃṭhe suciraṃ vaset || 121 || punarloka mimaṃ prāpya pavitre jāyate kule || prāpnotyanaṃtasaṃtānaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ punarvrajet ||122|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtsayakhaṇḍe'vaṃtīkṣetramāhātmyeṃ'kapādamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||27|| || cha ||
<5.1.28>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi devaṃ trailokyaviśrutam|| caṃdrādityamiti khyātaṃ caṃdrādityārcitaṃ purā ||1|| yastaṃ samarcayeddevaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || gaṃdhapupostathā dhūpairnaivedyaivividhaistathā || 2 || caṃdrādityādisālokyaṃ prayāti sarvakāmikam || vimānaṃ sūryasaṃkāśairyāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 3 || || iti candrādityamāhātmyam || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || karabheśaṃ tato gaccheddevadevaṃ maheśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa kuyonau naiva jāyate || 4 || || vyāsa uvāca || || karabheśamahaṃ devaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || kathaṃ devaḥ samutpannaḥ karabheśetisaṃjñitaḥ || 5 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || vane'sminkrīḍayāmāsa paramāhlādasaṃyutaḥ || 6 || krīḍanbahutithe kāle śaṃkaraḥ karabho'bhavat || jñāyate ca sa no devaiḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabhākṛtiḥ || 7 || anveṣayaṃti te devāstato vismayasaṃyutāḥ || na paśyaṃti yadā tatra taṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 8 || devaiḥ pṛṣṭastato brahmā kvāsti devo maheśvaraḥ || dhyātvātha brahmaṇā dṛṣṭo gupto yogaprabhurharaḥ || 9 || devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tato brahmā papraccha gaṇanāyakam || na dṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaro'smābhirgataḥ kutra vināyaka || 5.1.28.10 || kathayasva namastubhyaṃ dāsyāmo laḍḍukānvibho || evamuktastadā hṛṣṭaḥ provāca gaṇanāyakaḥ || 11 || karabho'yaṃ mahā'devo dṛśyate vibudho ttamāḥ || śrutvā caivaṃ vaco devāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ karabhaṃ yayuḥ || 12 || jñāto'smābhirmahādeva jalpaṃta iti te svayam || gatvā caiva tataḥ sarva caturdikṣu sthitāḥ svayam ||13|| viciṃtyeti kathaṃ jñātaḥ śaṃkaro vismayaṃ gataḥ || tyaktvātha kārabhaṃ rūpaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 14 || liṃgamutpādayāmāsa divyaṃ yatkarabhe śvaram || te dṛṣṭvā'tha surāḥ sarve sāṣṭāṃgapraṇatisthitāḥ || 15 || tataḥprabhṛti vikhyātaḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabheśvaraḥ || koṭitīrthāduttarasminsthāpayāmāsa vighnapam || 16 || svanāmnā prathitaṃ cakre karabhaṃ cātipūjitam || snātvā tatra śucirbhūtvā yastamarcayate śivam || 17 || gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca naivedyaiḥ śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam || sarvamedheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || 18 || tato'dhikaṃ sa labhate nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || mahākālaṃ tato gacchansaṃpūrṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 19 || tataḥ prasiddho loke'sminnṛddhidaḥ karabheśvaraḥ || 5.1.28.20 || || iti karabheśvaramāhātmyam || || cha || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || laiḍukaiśca tato devairvighnanāthaḥ samarcitaḥ || tadāprabhṛti vikhyāto viśveśo laḍḍukapriyaḥ || 21 || yaḥ samarcayate bhaktyā tasya vighno na jāyate || tasmai dadāti saṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvānkāmānvināyakaḥ || 22 || nirāhāraścaturthyāṃ ca snātvā śiprāṃ viśeṣataḥ || raktāṃbaradharobhūtvā raktapuṣpairvināyakam || 23 || raktacaṃdanatoyena maṃtraiḥ snapanapūrvakam || caṃdanenāpi raktena taṃ vilepya prapūjayet || 24 || dhūpaṃ dadyāttathā divyaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ laḍḍukapriye || naivedye laḍḍukā deyā ājyakhaṃḍapariplutāḥ || 25 || na tasya jāyate vyādhirbhayaṃ vighnaṃ kadācana || labhate ca sadābhīṣṭaṃ mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet|| 26 || avatīrṇaḥ punarloke jāyate vasudhādhipaḥ || matimānputravāñchūro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 27 || || iti gaṇeśamā hātmyam || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || kusumeśaṃ suradvāre surāsuranamaskṛtam || śraddhayā pūjayedyastu śivaloke sa modate || 28 || jayeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyeddevadevaṃ maheśvaram || jayī syātsarvakāryeṣu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 29 || śivadvāre śivaṃ liṃgamarcayenmānavo yadi || tridivaṃ yāti yānena gāṇapatyaṃ ca viṃdati || 5.1.28.30 || athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mārkaṃḍeśvaramuttamam || mārkaṇḍeyo muniryatra taptavānsumahattapaḥ || 31 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā cirāyurjāyate naraḥ || 32 || śṛṇu vyāsa mahāsthānaṃ yasyāṃ puryāmanuttamam || yatra tiṣṭhati sā devī brahmāṇī haṃsavāhinī || 33 || bhaktānāṃ pūrayedāśāṃ putravatparipālayet || yathā mātā tathā devī dṛṣṭā śāṃtiparairapi || 34 || arcitā brahmaṇā sā tu stutā devī surottamaiḥ || arcayedgaṃdhṛpuṣpaiśca naivedyaiḥ sarvasiddhidām || api yā brahmaṇaḥ pūrvamabhūdeva susiddhidā || 35 || yaḥ snātvā brahmasarasi paśye dbrahmeśvaraṃ śivam|| bhavabaṃdhavinirmukto brahmaloke sa modate || 36 || athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yajñavāpīmanuttamām || yatra vai brahmaṇā pūrvamiṣṭo yajñaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ || 37 || yajñārthaṃ yatkṛtaṃ kuṃḍaṃ yajñavāpī ca sā smṛtā || paśuśca patito yasmāttasmātpaśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 38 || tasyāṃ snātvā śucirbhūtvā paśyetpaśupatiṃ tu yaḥ || uddharetsa pitṝnvyāsa paśuyonigatānapi || 39 || suvarṇamaṇimuktādyairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmagaiḥ || yāti rudrapuraṃ divyaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 5.1.28.40 || rūpakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā surūpo jāyatenaraḥ || svarge sa devagaṃdharvaiḥ spṛhaṇīyavapurbhavet || 41 || kuṃḍe snātvāpyanaṃge yaḥ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || paśyecca devadeveśamanaṃgenārcitaṃ purā || kāmaṃ sa labhate'bhīṣṭaṃ mṛto yāti śivālayam || 42 || āṣāḍhe tu sitāṣṭamyāṃ jāgaraṃ yastu kārayet || kedāre yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tatsamānamavāpnuyāt || 43 || karīkuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā viśvarūpaṃ tu yo'rcayet || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 44 || ajāgaṃdhe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā brahmeśvaraṃ śivam || brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇātsaṃvyapohati || 45 || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā cakra svāminamarcayet || jāyate sa naro vyāsa cakravartī sadā bhuvi || 46.|| siddheśvaraṃ yadā paśyetsnātvā suvidhipūrvakam || kāmikena vimānena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 47 || || iti yajñavāpīmāhātmyam || || somavatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yaḥ someśvaramarcayet || somavannirmalo bhūtvā somaloke sa modate || 48 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tīrthaṃ somavatīnāma liṃgaṃ someśvaraṃ tathā || abhūdetatkathaṃ nāma śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 49 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa yathotpannaṃ somatīrthaṃ suśobhanam || someśvaraṃ yathā liṃgametatsatyaṃ vadāmi te ||5.1.28.50|| yo devo bhagavānsomo lokasyāpyāyanaṃ param || āsīttasya purā vyāsa pitā vipro mahātapāḥ || 51 || avantyāṃ ca mahābhāgo yo'trirnāmā taponidhiḥ || varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi divyāni sahasrāṇi tapo mahat || 52 || ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa vai tepe brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || ūrdhvaṃ gataṃ tato vyāsa brāhmyaṃ tejo mahātmanaḥ || 53 || netrābhyāṃ tena susrāva bhāsayacca diśo daśa || tejastatsahasā dṛṣṭvā diśo daśoddhataṃ svataḥ || 54 || diśaśca tadyadā vyāsa sarvā dhartuṃ na cāśakan || asusravattadā digbhyastaddhi tejotiduḥsaham || 55 || lokāṃśca bhāsayatsarvāndharaṇyāṃ vai papāta ha || somo jātastatastena śītāṃśuśca janapriyaḥ || 56 || vāri somātsamutpannaṃ vyāsa tenaiva tejasā || praviṣṭā sā nadī śiprāmamṛtenātipūritā || 57 || tataḥ somavatī śiprā vikhyātā sarvasi ddhidā || somayuktāṃ nadīṃ śiprāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaṃ vyapohati || 58 || khyātā ca triṣu lokeṣu pāpināṃ puṇyadāyinī || brahmahā vā surāpo vā steyī vā gurutalpagaḥ || 59 || catvāro'pyatra pāpena mucyaṃte darśanāddhruvam || amāsomau yadā yuktau somavatyāṃ tadā mune || 5.1.28.60 || snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yo dhīmāñjapaṃ homaṃ samācaret || akṣayaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 61 || tilodakapradānena piṃḍadānena kāritā || akāle kālikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca yato matā || 62 || sarvatra durlabhā siprā somaṃ somagrahastathā || someśvaraḥ somavāraḥ sakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ || 63 || śiprāsomajalaṃ vyāsa koṭitīrthaphalapradam || amāsomasamāyoge pitṛtīrthasamaṃ smṛtam || 64 || amāyāṃ somavāraścedvyatīpāto yadā bhavet || śataguṇaṃ gayāyāstu somavatyāṃ prakīrtitam || 65 || evaṃ somavatītīrthaṃ jātamatra mahāmune || somaṃ dṛṣṭvātha patitaṃ kṣitau brahmā jagadguruḥ || 66 || rathe taṃ sthāpayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || saṃ tu vedamayo vyāsa dharmākṣaḥ satyasaṃgrahaḥ || 67 || yukto vājisahasreṇa brahmaṇā preritastadā || dṛṣṭvā somaṃ tato devā rathe taṃ brahmaṇā yutam || 68 || tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvabhāvena hṛṣṭāḥ sarve samāhitāḥ || tasya saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvaram || 69 || āpyāyamānaṃ trīm̐llokānpapāta dharaṇītale || brahmā tena rathenātha sāgarāṃtāṃ vasundharām || 5.1.28.70 || triḥsaptakṛtvo'tiśayāccakārābdhipradakṣiṇam || tasya tatpatitaṃ tejo vyāsa somasya śītalam || 71|| tadevauṣadhayo divyā jātā bhuvi sunirmalāḥ || yābhirdhāryo hyayaṃ lokaḥ prajāścaiva caturvidhāḥ || 72 || tuṣṭo'tha bhagavānsomo jagateḥ sarvadā mune || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tepe'tiduḥsahaṃ tapaḥ || 73 || tatastasmai dadau vākyaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || bījauṣadhāni viprāṇāṃ somo rājā babhūva ha || 74 || saptaviṃśatiṃ somāya dākṣāyaṇīrmahāvratāḥ || patnīḥ prācetaso dakṣo dadau nakṣatrasaṃjñakāḥ || 75 || sa tatprāpya mahadrājyaṃ somo bhāryāyutastadā || samārebhe rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam || 76 || hotā ca bhagavānatriradhvaryurbhagavānbhṛguḥ || hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvameyivān || 77 || sadasyo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sanakādimukhairyutaḥ || dadau sa dakṣiṇāṃ somastrīm̐llokānsusamāhitaḥ || 78 || sinīvālī kuhūścaiva dhṛtiḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ || kīrtirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīstaṃ devyo divyāḥ siṣevire || 79 || prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ || atīva rājate candro daśadhā bhāsayandiśaḥ || 5.1.28.80 || tasya tatprāpya duṣprāpyamaiśvaryamṛṣisaṃskṛtam || vibabhrāma matirvyāsa vinayādyamapāsya ca || 81 || bṛhaspatestadā bhāryāṃ tārānāmnīṃ yaśasvinīm || jahāra tamasā sādhvīmavamānyāṃ giraḥsutam || 82 || vācyamānastadā somo devadevarṣibhistathā || naiva vyasarjayattārāṃ tasmā āṃgirasāya ca || 83 || bṛhaspatestataḥ pakṣaṃ śakro jagrāha kopataḥ || sa hi śiṣyo mahātejā guroḥ pūrvaṃ vṛhaspateḥ || 84 || tato yuddhamabhūttatra sughoraṃ śakrasomayoḥ || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca vyāsa trāsakaraṃ mahat || 85 || sarve bhītāstato devā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || agrato brahmaṇo yuddhaṃ kathitaṃ śakrasomayoḥ || 86 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sārddhaṃ devaiḥ pitāmahaḥ || āgatya yuddhabhūmiṃ so'vārayaddevadānavān|| 87 || vāritāste sthitāstatra yuddhaṃ tyaktvā surāsurāḥ || tārāmādāya sa tadā dadā vāṃgirase dvije || 88 || tāmaṃtaḥprasavāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bhāryāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || madīyāyāṃ na te yonyāṃ garbho dhāryaḥ kathaṃcana || 89 || utsasarja tatastārā kumāraṃ devarūpiṇam || iṣīkāstraṃ samāsādya jvalaṃtamiva pāvakam|| 5.1.28.90 || sa tejo jātamātro'pi devānāmākṣipacchiśuḥ || tataḥ saṃśayamāpannā ūcustārāṃ divaukasaḥ || 91 || kasyāyaṃ brūhi subhage somasyātha bṛhaspateḥ || nācacakṣe tu devānāṃ vedhāḥ papraccha tāṃ punaḥ || 92 || yadatra satyaṃ tadbrūhi tāre kasya suto hyayam || sā prāṃjaliruvācedaṃ brahmāṇaṃ varadaṃ vibhum || 93 || somasyeti rahaḥ so'yaṃ kumāro devasaṃnibhaḥ || somasya taṃ sutaṃ jñātvā pariṣvajya pitāmahaḥ || 94 || budha ityakaronnāma tasya putrasya vai tadā || paradārāpahārācca yatpāpaṃ tena duḥsaham || 95 || tena somo'bhavatkuṣṭhī kṣayarogayutastadā || tato rājye svakaṃ putraṃ sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 96 || avantīmājagāmāśu somo devadidṛkṣayā || somāhe somavatyāṃ ca amāyoge jiteṃdriyaḥ || 97 || snātvā saṃpūjayāmāsa somaḥ someśvaraṃ tataḥ || tasya bhaktyā ca santuṣṭaḥ prāha somaṃ mahe śvaraḥ || 98 || matprasādādvapuḥ kāṃtaṃ tava soma bhaviṣyati || someśvaramiti khyātaṃ bhuktipradāyakam || 99 || evaṃ vyāsa tu tattīrthaṃ liṃgaṃ caivāti durlabham || kathitaṃ tathyabhāvena mayā tuṣṭena sāṃpratam || 5.1.28.100 || śrāvaṇaṃ prāpya yo māsaṃ somanāthaṃ jiteṃdriyaḥ || nityaṃ paśyennaro vyāsa tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 101 || saurāṣṭre somanāthasya pūjāyāḥ pratyahaṃ phalam || labhate sa naro vyāsa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 102 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye somavatītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || cha ||
<5.1.29>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || tīrthasyā'narakasyāsya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam || tīrthe cānarake snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || na paśyennarakaṃ kvāpi yadyapi brahmahā bhavet || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kiyaṃto narakāstāta kasminsthāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ|| patanti kena pāpena pāpinasteṣu duḥkhitāḥ || 2 || tatkathaṃ prāṇinastatra gacchanti pāpakāriṇaḥ || etatsarvaṃ samākhyāhi yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho || 3 || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva narakānvyāsa tāvanto yatra saṃsthitāḥ || na labhyaṃte yathā caite satyametadvadāmi te || 4 || pātālani layāḥ sarve vikhyātā duḥkhadāḥ sadā || puṇyaplāvena te sarve tiryagyāṃti svakarmabhiḥ || 5 || rauravaḥ sūkaro raudrastālo vinaśakastathā || taptakumbhastu taptāyo mahājvālastathaiva ca || 6 || kuṃbhīpākaḥ krakacanastathā devātidāruṇaḥ || kṛmibhuktiśca raktākhyo lālābhakṣaśca gaṃḍakaḥ || 7 || adhomukhaścāsthibhaṃgo yaṃtrapīḍanakastathā || saṃdaṃśo rudhirāṃgaśca śvabhojyaśca kubhojanaḥ || 8 || ityevamādayaḥ sarve narakā bhṛśadāruṇāḥ || yamasya viṣaye saṃti stutā hi bhayadāyinaḥ ||9|| pataṃti puruṣāsteṣu pāpakarmaratāśca ye || patitāśca prapacyaṃte narāḥ karmānurūpataḥ ||5.1.29.10|| yātanābhirvicitrābhī raudrakarma kṣayādbhṛśam || sugāḍhaṃ hastayorbaddhāstaptaśṛṃkhalayā narāḥ || 11 || mahāvṛkṣāgraśṛṃgeṣu laṃbyaṃte yamakiṃkaraiḥ || śocaṃtaḥ svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhaṃti niścalāḥ || 12 || agnivarṇaiḥ śaṃkubhiśca lohadaṃḍaiḥ sakaṃṭakaiḥ|| hanyaṃte kiṃkarairghoraiḥ samaṃtātpāpakāriṇaḥ || 13 || tattatkṣaṇātpradīptena vahninā ca viśeṣataḥ || samaṃtataḥ prakṣipyaṃte kṛttāśca jarjarīkṛtāḥ || 14 || kūṭasākṣī tathā'samyakpakṣapātena yo vadet || yaścānyadanṛtaṃ brūyātsa naro yāti rauravam || 15 || surāpo brahmahā hartā suvarṇasya ca sūcakaḥ || prayāṃti narakāṃścaiva taiḥ saṃsargamupaiti yaḥ || 16 || bhrūṇahā guruhaṃtā ca goghnaśca munisattama || yāṃtyete narakaṃ raudraṃ ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ || 17 || taptaloṣṭheṣu pacyaṃte yastu bhaktaṃ parityajet || snuṣāṃ sutāṃ ca yo gacchenmahā jvāle sa pātyate || 18 || kuṃbhīpāke prayātyeva pādairūrdhvairadhomukhaḥ || karoti karma vai nityaṃ yaśca gāṃ pratiṣedhayet || 19 || svāmidrohī ca yo raudrastaptakuṃbhe sa pātyate || devadūṣayitā yaśca vedavikrayikastathā || 5.1.29.20 || parastrīgāmino ye ca yāṃti krakacane tu te || cauro'tidāruṇe yāti maryādābhedakastathā || 21 || devadvijapitṛdveṣṭā ratnadūṣayitā ca yaḥ || sa yāti kṛmibhakṣe vai raktākhye ca pataṃti te || 22 || pitṛdevagurūṇāṃ ca saparyāṃ na karoti yaḥ || lālābhakṣe sa yātyugre kūṭakarma karoti yaḥ || 23 || aṃtyajebhyo grahītā ca narake yātyadhomukhe || asthibhaṃge prayātyeva eko miṣṭānnabhuṅnaraḥ || 24 || kṛtaghnaḥ piśunaḥ krūraḥ kūṭamānī viḍaṃbakaḥ || yaṃtrapīḍanake yāti paraguhyaprakāśakaḥ || 25 || lākṣāmāṃsarasānāṃ ca tilānāṃ rasakasya ca || vikrayī brāhmaṇo yāti śvadaṃśe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26 || madhuhā grāmahaṃtā ca yāti vaitaraṇīṃ naraḥ || varṇāśramaviruddhaṃ ca karma kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || 27 || karmaṇā manasā vācā mahānadyāṃ prayāṃti te || gurūṇāmavamaṃtā ca śāstradūṣayitā ca yaḥ || 28 || asipatre prayātyeva tathā parvavilaṃghakaḥ || dhanayauvanamattā ye maryādābhedino narāḥ || 29 || te yāṃti narake ghore kṛṣṇasūtre'tidāruṇe || asaṃskṛtaśca yo vipro vṛṣalīṃ sevate tu vai || 5.1.29.30 || vṛṣalīmithuno yaśca patatastāvubhāvapi || ucchiṣṭā ye spṛśaṃtīha gāvo'gniṃ jananīṃ dvijān || 31 || te pacyaṃte kubhojye ca mitra dveṣī viśeṣataḥ || paṃktibhede divāsvapre ye naro'brahmacāriṇaḥ || 32 || putrairadhyāpitā ye tai te pataṃti śvabhojane || ete cānye ca narakāḥ śataśo' tha sahasraśaḥ || 33 || tatra duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ pacyaṃte yātanāgatāḥ || nṛṇāṃ svargāśca yāvaṃtastāvaṃto nirayāstathā || 34 || pāpaṃ kṛtvā tu bahulaṃ prāyaścittaparāṅmukhāḥ || kṛte pāpe ca vai tāpo yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate || 35 || prāyaścittaṃ tu tasyaikaṃ śivasaṃsmaraṇaṃ param || tasmādaharniśaṃ śaṃbhuṃ saṃsmaranpuruṣottamaḥ || 36 || na yāti narakaṃ śuddhaḥ saṃkṣīṇākhilapātakaḥ || kārtikasyāsite pakṣe kṛṣṇā yā ca caturdaśī || tasyāṃ dīpaḥ pradātavyo devadevasya cāgrataḥ || 37 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye naraka'kathanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || cha ||
<5.1.30>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || dīpe'sminyatphalaṃ cāsti vidhinā yena dīyate || tatsarvaṃ brūhi me tāta dīpotpattiṃ ca śobhanām || 1 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā kṛtayuge vyāsa pārvatīṃ śaṃkaro'grataḥ || abhiprayācituṃ yātastayāpi so'bhiyācitaḥ || 2 || || pārvatyuvāca || || śarīre kṛṣṇatā śaṃbho mamāsti rūpahāriṇī || tasmādyāce bhṛśaṃ śaṃbho prasīda divya locana || 3 || bhavena varṇitā sā vai atīva śobhanā mama || locane pakṣmamālāyāḥ śobhase'titarāṃ sadā || 4 || sitābjasaṃsthito bhṛṃgo yathā śobhayate ca tam || tayā tathā yācitosau dhūrjaṭirvṛṣabhāsanaḥ || 5 || virūparūpakartāsi na śṛṇoṣi vaco yadā || tadā tvahaṃ savai rāgyā careyaṃ duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || 6 || bhavastayeti coktastu tasyā vai pāṇimagrahīt || kadācicchaṃkaro devo ratiṃ yācitavānpriyām || 7 || ratiṃ dattavatī sā tu jahāsa nāma kīrtayan || suduḥkhitā'bhavatsā tu parāṅmukhī vihāya tam || 8 || uvāca roṣasaṃyuktā saṃsmṛtya devabhāṣitam || tapovanaṃ vrajāmyadya sugauratvopalabdhaye || 9 || suvarṇarūparūpā ca yadā punarbhavāmi ca || tadā tava sānurāgā bhavāmi caiva nānyathā || 5.1.30.10 || itīdameva jalpaṃtī jagāma viṃdhyaparvatam || haraḥ śuśoca tatastāṃ kva gatā sā vihāya mām || 11 || smaraṃstadeva ceṣṭitaṃ tadeva pūrvabhāṣitam || tadaiva me vṛthā matirmudā yadā na mānitā || 12 || yato mayā himādrijā samastalokasundarī || puraiva nābhinaṃditā gatā vihāya māmiti || 13 || itīdameva so'vadadgatastvaddarśanaṃ tataḥ || priyāviyogamīdṛśaṃ guruṃ na soḍhumutsahe || 14 || tato jagaddhi saṃkulaṃ mahābhayena saṃyutam || surāsurā maharṣayaḥ paraṃ viṣādamabhyaguḥ || 15 || vihāya maṃdirāṇi te paraṃ viṣādamāgatāḥ || harastutiṃ parāṃ ca te pracakruradbhutopamāḥ || 16 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || na dṛśyate yadā devo rudro bāleṃduśekharaḥ || naṣṭālokaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kāṃtāramabhavattadā || 17 || trīṇi netrāṇi rudrasya yataḥ sūryeṃduva hnayaḥ || gate rudre na te bhāṃti jagatyasmiṃścarācare || 18 || tatastamasi dustāre saṃbhūte lomaharṣaṇe || anyonyaṃ hi na paśyaṃti surāsurāstamovṛtāḥ || || 19 || eṣā buddhistatasteṣāmutpannā kāryasiddhaye || yayā buddhyā jagannātho jñāyate pārvatīpatiḥ || 5.1.30.20 || na hyāloko vinā tena śaśisūryāgnica kṣuṣā || parasparaṃ bruvaṃti sma duḥkhitāste visaṃjñayā || 21 || he deva he mune siddhe he ṛṣe he niśācara || he daitya he danuśreṣṭha he manuṣyanideśaka || || 22 || gato'si kāṃ diśaṃ tāta ko vā labdhastvayā vibho || kvacidviśrāmabhūmiste kvacidālaṃbane'pi vā || 23 || pātheyamasti kiṃcitte diśi kiṃ vātha kutracit || prakāśaṃ vāhanaṃ chatramaśanaṃ śayanaṃ gṛham || 24 || kvacidvāsi kathaṃ toyamathavā cittanirvṛtiḥ || bandhuḥ putro'si vā tāta vṛkṣa cchāyā suśītalā || 25 || evaṃ prakāraṃ karuṇaṃ samābhāṣya parasparam || bhūyaścintāparāḥ sarve devāśceṃdrapurogamāḥ || 26 || bhūmervivaramāśritya prāṇino ye vasaṃtyapi || rasātale ca daiteyāḥ saṃsthitāḥ pannagāśca ye || 27 || na teṣāṃ vidyate sūryo nendurnānye mahāgrahāḥ || nāgnirdevamukhaṃ vidyunnaiva tārakako ṭayaḥ || 28 || kenālokena paśyaṃti samāni viṣamāṇi ca || narakasthā narā loke na paśyaṃtyanyalokagāḥ || 29 || vicarantaḥ samaṃ ko vā mano rathaśatapradaḥ || tṛṣṇāṃbhaḥ kṣudhitānnaṃ ca śrāṃtānāmatha vāhanam || 5.1.30.30 || same śayyā jale nauśca roge satparicārakaḥ || śreṣṭhauṣadhībhiḥ sanmaṃtraiḥ saṃpado vyādhisaṃkaṭe || 31 || suhṛdvideśe cchāyoṣṇe nirdhūmaḥ śiśire śikhī || mahābhaye paritrāṇaṃ prakāśaśca mahāniśi || 32 || sarvadaścaiva sarveṣāṃ manorathaśatapradaḥ || eka eva bhavāndyotastvāṃ ca jānīmahe vayam || 33 || bruvaṃta iti te vyāsa śuśruvurmadhurāṃ giram || śrutapūrvāṃ tamomadhyādviṣṇora tulakarmaṇaḥ || 34 || na jānaṃti sthitaḥ kutra bhāṣate keśavo vibhuḥ || śṛṇudhvamiti me vākyaṃ sarve caiva samāhitāḥ || 35 || dānamekaṃ sadā samya kciṃtāmaṇisamaṃ smṛtam || sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ dīpadānaṃ praśasyate || 36 || tacca deyamataḥ sarvaiḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ tattvato bhṛśam || mayā rasātale pūrvaṃ nāgā nāmanukaṃpayā || 37 || utpādito dīpavaro yena dhvastamidaṃ tamaḥ || evaṃbhūtastu vāyūnāmapradhṛṣyo mahāprabhaḥ ||38|| niṣkaṃpo nirmalo hṛdyaḥ susthiro bhāskaraprabhaḥ || nātyuṣṇo nātiśītaśca devyā yogasamudbhavaḥ || tena dīpaprakāśena gokarṇo nirvṛtiṃ yayau || 39 || nāgāḥ śeṣādayaḥ sarve nodyamānāśca saṃghaśaḥ || dīpāddīpasahasrāṇi daduste vai śivāgrataḥ || 5.1.30.40 || parvateṣu samudreṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || nadītīreṣu sarvatra dīpānprajvālya remire || 41 || bhuṃjānāḥ pañca mūlāni divyāni kṣīrasaṃyutam || paramānnaṃ ca māṃsāni makaraṃdaṃ ghṛtaudanam || 42 || candraśālibhavaṃ bhaktaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ saptadhā gatam || madyamaṣṭaprakāraṃ tu bhāryāpītāvaśeṣakam|| 43 || śayaneṣu mahārheṣu hṛdyāsu vanarājiṣu || vṛkṣamūleṣu sarveṣu vanacchāyopaśobhiṣu || 44 || ramante sma ca te sarve hyudveṣṭaṃtaḥ parasparam || kāmatantropadiṣṭaistu śāstraiśca cuṃbanādibhiḥ || 45 || sūryatāpabhayānmuktāścaṃdraraśmibhayācca te || vimuktāśca bhayāddhorātpipīlikodbhavāttathā || 46 || sūryatāpena dāhaḥ syācchītaṃ caṃdramarīcibhiḥ || mayūranakulādyaiśca pipīlīmaraṇādbhayam || 47 || sauvarṇāndīpakā nkṛtvā dvijebhyaste daduḥ punaḥ || tena pātālamāśritya kṛtvā bhogavatīṃ purīm || 48 || vasaṃti sukhinastatra svargādaṣṭaguṇaiḥ sukhaiḥ || evamaṃdhaṃ tamo devāḥ pātālāddīpato gatam || 49 || etadguhyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ bhavatāṃ cānukampayā || dīpadānamatoyūyaṃ kurudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 5.1.30.50 || dīpāgninā vinā naiva tamodāru pradahyate || nārāyaṇaparā devā niśamyātha samāhitāḥ || 51 || papracchuste punaḥ sarve hṛṣṭā dāmodaraṃ vibhum || brūhi nogniṃ jagannātha sa dīpo yena jāyate || 52 || ghore tamasi vai magnā nāgniṃ jānīmahe vayam || devānāṃ mānaso vahniratha kṛṣṇena kīrtitaḥ || 53 || tena dīpaṃ pratijvālya devāḥ śivaparāyaṇāḥ || daduste śivamuddiśya sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 54 || datte dīpe tato devairdṛṣṭo hṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || timiraṃ tadgataṃ cāpi jagadyena jaḍīkṛtam || 55 || tato devāḥ sukhaṃ prāpuḥ svarge sendrapurogamāḥ || rājyaṃ bhogānvitaṃ prāpya sārdhaṃ strībhiśca remire || 56 || dīpadānaphalaṃ jñātvā daiteyāścāpi vismitāḥ || tathaiva tatphalaṃ jñātvā vyāsa yakṣāśca vismitāḥ || 57 || pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ puṣpaiśca nirmalairjalaiḥ || dadurdīpa sahasrāṇi sarve śivaparāyaṇāḥ || 58 || svasthāne cābhavansarve dīpadānācca śobhanāḥ || svecchayā bhuṃjate bhogānbandhubhṛtyādisaṃyutāḥ || 59 || nirāhārāstato vyāsa piśācā vai nirāśrayāḥ || dīpadānaphalaṃ jñātvā sarve te'tīva vismitāḥ || 5.1.30.60 || caṃḍālādagnimānīya dadurdīpaṃ śive ratāḥ || | dīpadānaphalaṃ te vai putradārasamanvitāḥ || 61 || līḍhamannaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ tathā || ucchiṣṭaṃ sūtikāspṛṣṭaṃ na medhyaṃ cātilaṃghitam || 62 || bhuṃjānāste sadā hṛṣṭā ramaṃte duṣṭabhūmiṣu || vidyādharāstathā martyāḥ siddhāśca śivamānasāḥ || 63 || dīpadānaphalaṃ jñātvā dadurdīpaṃ śivāgrataḥ || dīpadānāttataḥ sarve sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ || 64 || sthāneṣu muditāsteṣu ramaṃte sukhinastadā || timiraṃ tadgataṃ caiva vyāsa lokeṣu dīpataḥ || 65 || tato ghoraṃ sthitaṃ samyakpretalokeṣu sarvadā || pretalokaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā ghoreṇa tamasā vṛtāḥ || 66 || dāmodaraṃ jagannāthamūcuḥ sarve surottamāḥ || ghoraṃ caiva tamo hatvā prasannāste sadā vibho || 67 || gaṃdharvāśca tathā yakṣāḥ siddhā vidyādharoragāḥ || vayaṃ caiva tathā martyāḥ sarvabhogaiśca saṃyutāḥ || || 68 || sthāneṣu ca sadā hyeṣu sukhinaśca ramāmahe || pretaloke narā ye vai ghoreṇa tamasā vṛtāḥ || 69 || vasaṃti ca jagannātha vartaṃte te'tiduḥkhitāḥ || yairno kṛtaṃ hi tatkarma kṛṣṇālaṃ pāpamohitaiḥ || 5.1.30.70 || na teṣāṃ vidyate kiṃcidyatprakāśaṃ karoti ca || ghore tamasi te magnāstatra nārkenduvahnayaḥ || 71 || na sahāyo na jāyeyaṃ nālaṃbo na ca deśikāḥ || na vāhanaṃ na śayyā ca kevalaṃ tu mahattamaḥ || 72 || tatrāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ khyātā ghorā narakakoṭayaḥ || tamomayāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ pāpināṃ bhayadāḥ sadā || 73 || sukhaṃ tatra kathaṃ kṛṣṇa labhaṃte duḥkhitā narāḥ || dāridryaduḥkharogaiśca māyāmohaiśca sarvadā || 74 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || iti śrutvā tu devānāṃ prārthanāṃ garuḍa dhvajaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ hṛdyaṃ manorathaphalapradam ||75|| śṛṇudhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve yatpravakṣyāmi vo vacaḥ||76|| avaṃtyāṃ vartate tīrthaṃ sadyaḥ pāpaharaṃ param || anarakākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam || 77 || kārtikasyāsite pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || tatra snātvā naro yastu yamadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 78 || saṃgṛhya vai tilānkṛṣṇānpitṛbhakto jiteṃdriyaḥ || dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā madhyāhne surasattamāḥ || 79 || apasavyaṃ tathā kṛtvā maṃtraiḥ saṃtarpa yedyamam || yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāṃtakāya ca || 5.1.30.80 || vaivasvatāya kālāya dakṣāya manave tathā || kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇaguptāya pretalokaparāya ca || 81 || haraye raviputrāya kāliṃdīsodarāya ca || tathā vai śrāddhadevāya pitṛṇāṃ pataye tathā || 82 || maṃtrairebhirnamaḥproktairoṃkārādyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || jalāṃjaliṃ sadarbhaṃ vai dadyācca tilasaṃyutam || 83 || saṃtarpayedyamaṃ devaṃ tilapātraṃ samāhitaḥ || prājño viprāya vai dadyādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || 84 || anena vidhinā yastu saṃtarpayedyamaṃ vibhum || pitarastasya mucyaṃte niraye ye gatā api || 85 || rātriṃ tatrātha saṃprāpya mānavaḥ kāmasaṃyutaḥ || namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pretebhyo namo dharmāya viṣṇave || 86 || namaḥ sūryāya rudrāya kālāṃtapataye namaḥ || ebhirmaṃtrairyame dīpaṃ yo dadyāddhṛtapūritam || 87 || kārtikaṃ hi samagraṃ tu vardhaṃte tasya saṃpadaḥ || saṃpūrṇe kārtike caiva dīpodyāpanamācaret || 88 || divākarāhne'stamite ca sūrye dīpasya varttiṃ puruṣa pramāṇām || yūpākṛtau dārumaye karoti yayā ca dhīmānyamabhakticittaḥ ||89|| nikṣipya bhūmāvatha hastamātraṃ mūrdhni dvihastāṣṭadalānvitasya || dhāryāścatasraḥ śubhapaṭṭikāśca cchidreṇa yuktāścaturaṃgulena || 5.1.30.90 || tatkarṇikāyāṃ tu mahāprakāśo deyo hi dīpaḥ parayā ca bhaktyā || udaṅmukhāndīpavarāṃsta thāṣṭau daleṣu tasyā ghṛtapūryamāṇāḥ || 91 || anaṃgalagnaṃ dhavalaṃ ca vastraṃ navaṃ suraktaṃ hyathavā suśuklam || vartyāṃ pradeyaṃ ca svake ca dadyātsnigdhe tvakhaṇḍe susame praśaste || 92 || tacchālipiṣṭopari saṃnidhāya yathā na niryāti na kaṃpate ca || sarvaṃ prakuryāttriguṇapramāṇaṃ madhyasthitastasya ca dīparājaḥ || 93 || daleṣu śobhārthamatīva kuryānmanorathapratyupalabdhaye ca || ghaṃṭāṣṭakaṃ laṃbitapuṣpadāma savastraśobhānvitamaṃtra kāryam || 94 || saṃlipya bhūmiṃ tvatha gomayena punaḥ sugaṃdhena jalena liptvā || kuryādvicitraṃ tvatha maṃḍale ca dalāṣṭakaṃ vai kamalaṃ ca ramyam || 95 || tato jalaṃ śītalamānayitvā āpūrya cāṣṭau kalaśāṃstu ramyān || nidhāya mūrdhni kramaśo hi dhīmānphalāni mūlāni tathekṣukāni || 96 || madhvājyayuktā dadhidugdhapūrṇā nairṛtyakoṇādatha dakṣiṇāṃtam || dharmāya dadyādatha śaṃkarāya dāmodarāyāpyatha vedhase ca ||97|| prajāpatibhyaḥ kramaśo hi bhaktyā pretebhya iṃdrāya tathā pitṛbhyaḥ || homādipātraṃ tilacūrṇameva dadyāddvijānāṃ ca sadakṣiṇaṃ ca || 98 || gāvo hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ ca vastraṃ phalāni mūlāni yavāśca dhānyam|| gṛhaṃ rathaṃ kuṃjaramaśvameva manojñamanyaṃ hṛdayapriyaṃ yat || 99 || vidyādhikebhyo dvijasattamebhyaḥ paurāṇikebhyaśca tathā dvijebhyaḥ || ekaikasu prīṇanamatra kuryāddīpairdalasthaiśca yamādikānām || 5.1.30.100 || dharmāya deyastvatha madhyadīpa ājñāṃ ca labdhvā vratadeśikasya || nṛtyena gītena suśobhane na yuktaṃ suvādyena ca kārayecca || 101 || etatsamagraṃ vidhivacca kuryātsaśaktimādau svadhanaṃ samīkṣya || āhūya viprāñchubhabhāvayuktānvadecca dhīmānparayā ca bhaktyā || 102 || dīpānsamagrānnava varjayitvā sarvaṃ nayeyuḥ sthitamatra viprāḥ || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visṛjya viprāṃstato bhavadvai sa ca naktabhojī || 103 || evaṃ kṛte nāgalokādviśiṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ bhavetpretalokesthitānām || 104 || evaṃ hyanarake vyāsa dīpadānaṃ karoti yaḥ || tasyaiva yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu || 105 || vimānaiḥ kāmikairdivyairapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ || uhyamāno divaṃ yāti yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 106 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'narakeśvaradīpadānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || || cha || || ||
<5.1.31>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi kedāreśvaramuttamam || pravaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 1 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā yaḥ paśyati maheśvaram || kedāre yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tadatrāpi labhennaraḥ || 2 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svakīyakulasaṃyutaḥ || vimānenārkavarṇena śiva loke sa modate || 3 || jaṭāśṛṃge naraḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā jiteṃdriyaḥ || dṛṣṭvā jaṭeśvaraṃ devaṃ tataḥ pāpādvimucyate || 4 || mahātapanamādau ca kṛtvā gacchecchivaṃ prati || mātṛkaṃ pitṛkaṃ caiva kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 5 || iṃdratīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ceṃdreśvaraṃ śivam || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śakraloke mahīyate || 6 || kuṃḍeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyecchivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || labhate sa naro vyāsa śivadīkṣāphalaṃ śivam || 7 || gopatīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā gopeśvaraṃ śivam || śivalokaṃ naro yāti hyamṛtādamaro yathā || 8 || snātvā tu cipiṭātīrthe śivaṃ devaṃ praṇamya ca || tiryagyoniṃ naro naiva prayāti munipuṃgava || 9 || vijaye ca naraḥ snātvā ānaṃdeśvarapūjanāt || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ svarloke vijayī bhavet || 5.1.31.10 || athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi kuśasthalyāṃ vinirmitam || devaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ vyāsa bhuktimuktipradāyakam || 11 || citrakūṭātpurā rāmo maithilyā lakṣmaṇena ca || samanvitaḥ samāgatya papraccha munisattamam || 12 || || rāma uvāca || || kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni kiṃ vā kṣetraṃ mahāmune || yatra gatvā na cāpnoti viyogaṃ saha bāṃdhavaiḥ || 13 || anena
