vanavāsena maraṇena pituḥ prabho || bharatasya viyogena pratapye'haṃ tribhirmune || 14 || tadvākyaṃ rāghaveṇoktaṃ śrutvā viprarṣabhastadā || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 15 || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vīra raghūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana || mama pitrā kṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ prayācya śivamādarāta || 16 || avaṃtīviṣaye rāma purī tasminkuśasthalī || ujjayinīti vai nāmnā khyātiṃ loke gatā vibho || 17 || tasyāṃ gatvā daśarathaṃ piṃḍadānena tarpaya || surāsuragurustatra mahākālo vyavasthitaḥ || 16 || devaḥ sa vai sadā rājanvāṃchitārthaphalapradaḥ || dṛṣṭe tasmiñjagannāthe viyogo naiva jāyate || 19 || tatra gacchaṃti ye viprā rājā caiva mahāvalaḥ || labhaṃte paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 5.1.31.20 || tīrthānāmapi tattīrthaṃ praviṣṭo'vaṃtimaṃḍale || ājagāma tatovaṃtīṃ sā śiprā yatra puṇyadā || 21 || tasyāṃ snātvā tato rāmastarpayāmāsa pūrvajān || mahākālaṃ yadā draṣṭuṃ pratasthe raghunaṃdanaḥ||22|| vāṇyā tato'śarīriṇyā devadevena bhāṣitam || bho bho rāghava bhadraṃ te svanāmnā sthāpayasva mām ||23|| atra sthānaṃ mayā datta mā vicāraya rāghava || tato ddṛṣṭamanā rāmo lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || 24 || anugṛhītāḥ saumitre devadevena śaṃbhunā || tasmātsthāpaya tīrthe'smim̐lliṃgaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ śubham|| 25 || vākyaṃ tallakṣmaṇaḥ śrutvā sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram || dṛṣṭvā devaṃ purā rāmo lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || 26 || ehi lakṣmaṇa śīghraṃ tvaṃ śiprāyā jalamānaya || kariṣyāmi yato'trāhaṃ devasya snapanaṃ śubham || 27 || lakṣmaṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ sītayā kiṃ kariṣyasi || rāma nāhaṃ sarvakālaṃ dāsabhāvaṃ karomi te || 28 || iyaṃ ca puṣṭā sudṛḍhā pīvarā ca mamāgrataḥ || vada rāghava satyena anayā kiṃ kariṣyasi || 29 || śrutvā rāmo hi tadvākyaṃ lakṣmaṇena prabhāṣitam|| vimanā rāghavastasthau sītā cāpi varānanā || 5.1.31.30 || yaduktaṃ lakṣmaṇenātha tacca sītā cakāra ha || snātvā bhuktvā ca tau vīrau mahākālamupāgatau || 31 || nītvā vibhāvarīṃ tatra gamanāya mano dadhe || uttiṣṭha vatsa saumitre vrajāmo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam|| || 32 || saumitrirabravīdvākyaṃ nāhaṃ gantā kathaṃcana || vraja tvamanayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā kamalekṣaṇa || 33 || nāhamagre vanaṃ yāmi na vāyodhyāṃ kathaṃ cana || evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ saumitrimuvāca raghunaṃdanaḥ || 34 || kathaṃ pūrvamūyodhyāyā nirgato'si mayā saha || vane vasāmyahaṃ rāma nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca || 35 || pramādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ naya māmapi rāghava || idānīṃ tvamardhapathe kathaṃ sthātāsi śatruhan || 36 || lakṣmaṇastvabravīdrāma nāhaṃ gantā vanaṃ punaḥ || lakṣmaṇaṃ vikṛtaṃ jñātvā rāmo vacanamabravīt || 37 || mā mā'nuvraja saumitre hyeko yāsyāmi kānanam || dvitīyāpi tviyaṃ sītā ukto rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ || 38 || dhanuḥ saṃgṛhya vimanā uttasthau lakṣmaṇastadā || prāptau prākāramaryādāṃ kṣetrasīmāṃ paraṃtapau || || kṣetrasīmāṃ samullaṃghya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt || 5.1.31.40 || nivartayasva saumitre samarpaya ca me dhanuḥ || rāmavākyamupaśrutya sītāṃ vai lakṣmaṇo'bravīt || 41 || kimarthaṃ hi parityaktaḥ ko'parādhaḥ kṛto mayā || rāmeṇa hi parityaktaḥ prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 42 || rāmaṃ tato'bravītsītā kimarthaṃ lakṣmaṇastvayā || deva saṃtyajyate vīraḥ sumitrānaṃdivardhanaḥ || 43 || rāghavastvabravītsītāṃ nāhaṃ tyakṣyāmi lakṣmaṇam || na kadācidapi svapne lakṣmaṇasadṛśaṃ priyam || 44 || śrutapūrvaṃ tu suśroṇi kṣetrasyāsya viceṣṭitam || asminkṣetre na saubhrātraṃ sarvo hi svārthatatparaḥ || 45 || parasparaṃ na manyaṃte svārthaniṣṭhaikahetavaḥ || na śṛṇvaṃti pituḥ putrāḥ putrāṇāṃ vā tathā pitā || 46 || na ca śiṣyo gurorvākyaṃ gururvā śiṣyakarma ca || arthānubaṃdhinī prītirna kaścitkasyaci tpriyaḥ ||47|| evamuktvā yayau rāmo lakṣmaṇo jānakī tathā || liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya svanāmnā raghunaṃdanaḥ ||48|| rāmatīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā rāmeśvaraṃ śivam|| vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ||49|| || iti rāmeśvaramāhātmyam || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || tīrthe saubhāgyake snātvā dṛṣṭvā saubhāmyamīśvaram || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labhet || 5.1.31.50 || ghṛtatīrthe naraḥ snātvā ghṛtena snāpayecchivam || ghṛtamagnāvatho hutvā rudraloke mahīyate||51|| devīṃ yogīśvarīṃ pūjya surāsuranamaskṛtām || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ yogamavāpnuyāt||52|| śaṃkhāvarte naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ ||| dhanadhānyasamāyukto jāyate nirmale kule || 53 || sudhodake caturdaśyāṃ muktyarthaṃ snāpayennaraḥ|| śivaṃ sudheśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tato mokṣagatirbhavet ||54|| tathānya tsaṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || kiṃ puneti ca vikhyātaṃ brahmahatyāvimocanam ||55|| pūrvaṃ tretāyuge vyāsa sunetro nāma vai dvijaḥ|| tasya putraḥ samu tpanno viśvāvasuriti smṛtaḥ ||56|| yavakrītasya śāpena svapitā tena ghātitaḥ || brahmahatyānvito vyāsa tīrthāttīrthaṃ paribhraman ||57|| tīrthe kiṃpunake snātvā dhārātīrthe gato dvijaḥ || tataḥ kapiladhārāyāṃ ciṃtayatyātmanā svayam || 58 || kathaṃ me patitā dhārā anṛtā vā śrutistathā || evaṃ hyaciṃta yatso'tha punarāyādavaṃtikām || 59 || atra tīrthe punaḥ snāti yāvadvāṇīṃ tato'śṛṇot || kiṃ punardhyāyasi brahmanyena jāto dvijottamaḥ || 5.1.31.60 || na te'sti brahmahatyā vai tīrthasnānena nāśitā || gaccha śīghraṃ gṛhaṃ vipra pāpahīno yathāsukham || 61 || || iti kiṃpunāmāhātmyam || || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || punaranyatpravakṣyāmi pattaneśvaramuttamam || tatra sthitvā maheśena punaḥ pattanamīkṣitam || 62 || pattaneśvara ityākhyo devadevo maheśvaraḥ || yastu gaṃdhaiśca puṣpaiśca dhūpairdīpairmanoramaiḥ || 63 || bhāvayukto naro vyāsa pūjayedvidhivatsadā || yathāvattiṣṭhate liṃgaṃ vaṃśacchedo na jāyate || 64 || haṃsayuktena yānena śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || tathānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 65 || durdharṣamiti vikhyātaṃ brahmahatyāvimocanam || purā divākaro vyāsa cakre durdharṣanāmataḥ || 66 || tīrthamāsīnnadītīre vikhyātaṃ sūryasaṃskṛtam || tejaḥpuṃjaṃ bhavelliṃgaṃ gaṇagaṃ dharvapūjitam || 67 || saptamyāmathavāṣṭamyāṃ saṃkrātau ravivāsare || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā dinamekamupoṣitaḥ || 68 || dṛṣṭvā maheśvaraṃ tatra śiprākūle vyavasthitam || pūjayitvā tu bhāvena yatphalaṃ tacchraṇuṣva me || 69 || pitṛmātṛkulaṃ sarvaṃ samuddhṛtya śivaṃ vrajet || tatra yacchati yo dānaṃ gohemādi viśeṣataḥ || 5.1.31.70 || tāvattadakṣayaṃ loke yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || tathānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi gopīṃdraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 71 || gautamena purā yatra indraḥ śāpādbha gīkṛtaḥ || bhagavrīḍāyutaḥ śakraḥ praviśya vanamuttamam || 72 || atoṣayattadogreṇa tapasā śaṃkaraṃ purā || tuṣṭena śaṃbhunā vipra ye bhagāstaccharīragāḥ ||| || 73 || gosahasrīkṛtāstena gopīṃdrastena kathyate || tatra snātvā divaṃ yāti śakratulyaparākramaḥ || 74 || ye mṛtāste punarjanma nāpnuvaṃti mahītale ||| gaṃgātīrthe naraḥ snātvā puṇyamāpnoti puṣkalam || 75 || jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyāṃ tu gaṃgāyāṃ phalamādiśet || snātvā puṣpakaraṃḍe ca dṛṣṭvā puṣpakaraṇḍakam || 76 || puṣpakena vimānena prayāto divi modate || narakāduddharatyāśu naraḥ snātvottareśvare||77|| iṣṭabhogasamāpanno yāti svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || bhūteśvare naraḥ snātvā bhūteśvaramathārcayet || 78 || gaṃdhapuṣpādinaivedyairmṛto rudrapuraṃ vrajet || śiprāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā kailāsaṃ tu namasyati || 79 ||| sūryā''hataṃ tamo yadvattadvatpāpaṃ praṇaśyati || aṃbālikāṃ ca yaḥ paśyetsamādhiniyamena ca || 5.1.31.80 || sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ kaṃcukena phaṇī yathā || ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ pravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi pūjitam || 81 || yatra kūpodakaṃ pītvā saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet || arcayedyastu deveśaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpairanukramāt || 82 || śivaloke vasettāvadyāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || puṇyeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyecchuciḥ snāto jiteṃndriyaḥ || 83 || sa gāṇapatyamāpnoti yatsurairapi durlabham || laṃpeśvare naraḥ snātvā samabhyarcya maheśvaram||84|| na yāti narakaṃ martyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate|| tathānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi durlabham ||85|| pūjitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ sthavirākhyaṃ vināyakam || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā pūjayedyo vināyakam||86|| gaṃdhairdhūpaiśca naivedyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ phalaṃ śṛṇu || samīhitā bhavetsiddhirmṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet||87|| navanadyāḥ samīpe tu pārvatīṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ|| gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet||88|| kāmodake naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā kāmaṃ ratipriyam || svarge ca devagaṃdharvaspṛhaṇīyavapurbhavet ||89|| prayāge tu naraḥ snātvā prayāgeśaṃ tu paśyati || sarvalokānatikramya śivaloke mahī yate || 5.1.31.90 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye saubhāgyeśvarādinānātīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || || cha ||
<5.1.32>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi narādityaṃ divākaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvarogairvimucyate || 1 || sthāpanāṃ te pravakṣyāmi narādityasya yādṛśī || yuddhe nivārite tasminraktasvedajayoḥ purā || 2 || naranārāyaṇau devāvavatīrṇau dharātale || kuṃtyāṃ devyāṃ ca devakyāṃ mathurāyāmajāyatām || 3 || evaṃ tau vartitau loke kāṃtau vṛddhiṃ parāṃ gatau || anyasmātkāraṇātkṛṣṇo 'nyasmājjāto dhanaṃjayaḥ ||4|| kaṃsādīndānavānsarvānnijaghāna raṇe hi saḥ || svargaṃ gatastataḥ pārtho vāsavādastrasiddhaye || 5 || kṛtāstreṇa tu vīreṇa devarājasya dakṣiṇā || saṃstutā devarājastu yayāce tāṃ hi dakṣiṇām || 6 || nivātakavacā hyugrā hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ || vadhyaṃtāmarjuna kṣiprameṣā me gurudakṣiṇā || 7 || arjunena pratijñāto vadhasteṣāṃ durātmanām || aiṃdraṃ sa rathamāsthāya gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ || 8 || nihatya tāṃstataḥ pārthaḥ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram || prītimutpādayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām || 9 || kṛtakāryaṃ tadā śakrastvarjunaṃ vākyamabravīt || yatte'bhiruciraṃ vīra mṛtyuloke sudurlabham || 5.1.32.10 || manasā kāṃkṣitaṃ pārtha varaṃ tvaṃ varayottamam || sa vavre pratime dve tu ye'rcite brahmaṇā svayam || 11 || brahmaṇā prītiyuktena dakṣāya pratipādite || dakṣeṇāpi yugaṃ sāgraṃ pūjite timirāpahe || 12 || surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca vigrahe samupasthite || dānavairnirjitaḥ śakro hṛtarājyo vanaṃ gataḥ || 13 || tapaścacāra durdharṣamekapādaḥ śatakratuḥ || divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu dhiṣaṇastaṃ dadarśa ha || 14 || dṛṣṭvā tu devarājaṃ taṃ bṛhaspatiruvāca ha || hitvā tridivamāyātaḥ kathaṃ śakra tvidaṃ vanam || 15 || ekākinā vanasthena na sādhyāḥ śatravastvayā || jñātvaivaṃ devarāja tvaṃ śīghraṃ dakṣāśramaṃ vraja || 16 || pūjārthe brahmaṇā datte pārijātasamudbhave || cakāra viśvakarmā ye te yācasva prajāpatim || 17 || śatrūṇāṃ ca kṣayo bhāvī prasādādarcayo stayoḥ || gurostu tena vākyena hṛṣṭo devaḥ śatakratuḥ ||18|| jagāma satvarastatra yatra dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || vinayāvanato bhūtvā yayāce pratime śubhe || 19 pūjite pratime vyāsa śakreṇa śaradāṃ śatam || tayostu tejasā sarve vināśaṃ dānavā gatāḥ||5.1.32.20||| pratime cocutuḥ śakraṃ varayasva varottamam|| bhaktyānayā paraṃ tuṣṭāvāvāṃ jānīhi vāsava||21|| varaṃ vavre tadā śakraḥ prasannātmā dvijotma|| asmākaṃ pratipakṣā ye dānavāḥ pāpacetasaḥ || 22 || sarve te nāśamṛcchaṃtu vara eṣa mato mama || yuvāṃ pūjitumicchāmi yāvadiṃdro bhavāmyaham || 23 || tatheti coktvā pratime te nākaṃ prati jagmatuḥ || tattu yāce hyavaśyārthe varārthe pratimādvayam || 24 || || iṃdra uvāca || || sādhu pārtha punaḥ sādhu yatretthaṃ pratitiṣṭhataḥ || ime ca pratime pārtha śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā || 25 || suraktaiḥ śatapatraiśca pūjite brahmaṇo dinam ||| trailokyapālanārthāya pūjite viṣṇunā purā || 26 || nīlotpalaiḥ sugaṃdhaiśca sahasraparivatsarān || tataḥ prajāpatiḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kartukāmaḥ samā hitaḥ || 27 || pūjayāmāsa pratime padmai raktotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || tvameva hi kathaṃ pārtha mṛtyuloke nayiṣyati || 28 || etābhyāṃ rahitaḥ svargo mṛtyutulyo bhaviṣyati || adātukāmaṃ deveṃdraṃ praṇipatya tamarjunaḥ || 29 || uvāca nāhamarthyasminvareṇānena vai prabho || tataḥ śakraḥ punaḥ pārthamuvāca munipuṃgava || 5.1.32.30 || gṛhītvā tvamime vīra kuśasthalyāṃ niveśaya || śiprāyā uttare tīre keśavārkaṃ tu keśavaḥ || 31 || prati tiṣṭhati vai yatra sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || saṃsthāpayasva vai tatra sarvapāpapraṇāśane || bhaviṣyati tadā yātrā āṣāḍhī cātha kaumudī || 32 || āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra sahito'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || marutaścāgamiṣyaṃti meghāścaiva savidyutaḥ || 33 || meghakhaṇḍe samudbhūte mayi tatra pravarṣati || pravadiṣyaṃti vai lokāḥ prāpto devaḥ puraṃdaraḥ || 34 || bhāskaraṃ ca namaskṛtya brahmādyaiḥ pūjitaṃ vibhum || pratiyāmi tu bībhatso punareva yathāgatam || 35 || evaṃ mṛrtidvayaṃ vyāsa dattvā pārthāya vāsavaḥ || bhūrlokaṃ preṣayāmāsa sūtena saha pāṃḍavam || 36 || nārado dvārakāyāṃ tu kṛṣṇasyāhvānakāraṇāt || devarājasya tadvākyaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca keśavam || 37 || śrāvayāmāsa vipreṃdraṃ ehi kṛṣṇa kuśasthalīm || arcce hi pārijātasya viśvakarmasukārite || 38 || iṃdreṇātha pradatte vai te tubhyaṃ pāṃḍavāya ca || śrutvā śauristu tadvākyaṃ pratasthe'vaṃtinīpurīm || 39 || avātaracca ākāśāttamāliṃgya ca pāṃḍavam || prītaḥ provāca vacanaṃ pariṣvajya ca phālgunam || 5.1.32.40 || janma me saphalaṃ jātaṃ prītirme janitārjuna || yato me prītiratulā kriyatāṃ kāryamuttamam|| || 41 || ityuktvā tau tadā vyāsa samāyātau kuśasthalīm || pārthaṃ prāha tadā kṛṣṇaḥ susaṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ || 42 || gatvārjuna diśaṃ prācīṃ mūrtimekāṃ niveśaya || pūrvāhne hi śubhaṃ lagnaṃ bhaviṣyati manoramam || 43 || ahamapyuttarāṃ yāmi sthāpanārthaṃ nadīṃ mune || mama śaṃkhasya nādena pratitiṣṭha raviṃ prabhum || 44 || pūrvāṃ gatvā tataḥ pārtha śubhaṃ sthānaṃ vyalokayat || vyāsa saṃsthāpayāmāsa dinanāthaṃ ca susthiram || 45 || arkaṃ devaṃ sthāpayāmi yāvaddadhyau ca pāṃḍavaḥ || tāvatsa cābravīdenaṃ sthānaṃ kāraya śobhanam || 46 || kathayāmāsa pārthāya tejasā tena duḥsaham || savyasācī tato bhīto dṛṣṭvārccāṃ tāṃ prajalpatīm || 47 || tejastvasahamāno vai devaṃ vacanamabravīt || kva deva tvāṃ sthāpayāmi kiṃ sthānaṃ tava rocate || 48 || saumya rūpaḥ sudarśaśca prajābhyo bhava gopate || divisaṃsthāśca ye devā nāgāḥ pātālasaṃśrayāḥ || 49 || bhuvisthā mānavāḥ pūtā bhavaṃtu tava darśanāt || so'rjunamabravīddevo mā bhaistvaṃ mama darśanāt || 5.1.32.50 || dakṣiṇena kareṇātha hyabhayenābhayapradaḥ || samāśvāsyātha taṃ śāṃtaṃ saumyamūrtirbabhūva ha || 51 || prabhākareṇa devena nijaṃ tejaḥ pradarśitama || tataḥ sūryo'bravītsthānametadevācalaṃ mama || 52 || prāpte lagne ca hariṇā śaṃkhaścāpūrito mahān || nareṇa ca sa vai sūryaḥ sthāpito'marasaṃstutaḥ || 53 || || arjuna uvāca || || jayati kiraṇamālī bhāsuraḥ śrāṃtasaptiḥ sakalabhuvanadhāmā prāgdigaṃtāṭṭahāsaḥ || bhavati vigatapāpaṃ kīrtanādeva yasya pracurakaluṣadoṣairgrastamaṃgaṃ narāṇām || 54 || brahmādyairmunibhirabhiṣṭutaṃ pataṃgaṃ kaḥ stotuṃ kavirabhivāṃchate prakāmam || stoṣyehaṃ tadapi suvistarātsubuddhe kiṃ dīpo jvalati hi nodite śaśāṃke || 55 || śāstrārthakāmanipuṇairmunibhiḥ stutasya kiṃ vastu yanna racitaṃ vividhaiḥ prayogaiḥ || dvaipāyanaprabhṛtibhirmunibhiḥ purāṇairāpītasāramiha bhāti jagatsamastam || 56 || kāmaṃ tathāpyahamatīva vicārya bruddhyā bhānostrilokagurupūjitapādayugmam || vṛttaiḥ sphuṭārthamadhurākṣarasaṃdhiyuktaistvāṃ vai vicitragatibhiḥ parikīrtayiṣye || 57 || tāvajjagadbhavati niścalameva sarvaṃ tāvatkriyāśca vividhā na ca yāṃti siddhim || yāvacca nātha kamalāmalamaṃḍala tvamuttiṣṭhase vyapanayankiraṇaistamāṃsi || 58 || tāvanna bhāṃti śikharāṇi mahīruhāṇāṃ gucchaistu phullavanamīlitalocanāni || suptāni bodhayasi ṣaṭcaraṇākulāni yāvanna bhābhiramalābhiranuttamābhiḥ || 59 || udyaṃtamaṃbaratale surasiddhasaṃghāḥ sabrahmadaityamunikinnaranāgayakṣāḥ || tvāmarcayaṃti vibudhāḥ praṇataiḥ śirobhiścañcatkirīṭamaṇibhābhiranuttamābhiḥ || 5.1.32.60 || astaṃ gate tvayi jagadbhavati prasuptaṃ bhūyastvayi pratapati pratibodhameti || evaṃ sadā varada lokahitārthahetorekastvameva bhagavaṃstimirasya haṃtā || 61 || utsāhaśaktinayaśauryasamanvitānāṃ sevāprayogaracanāvidhitatparāṇām || kāryāṇi yanna phaladāni bhavaṃti puṃsāṃ hetustvabhaktiriha nātha veti nūnam || 62 || yatsaṃyugeṣu rathakuñjarakuntaśaktinārācacakraśaratomarabhīmakhaḍgaiḥ || kṣipraṃ narāḥ samupayāṃti vijitya śatrūnsarvaṃ sadā praṇatavatsala veṣṭitaṃ te || 63 || kāṃtāradurgaviṣameṣvapi vartamānā ṛkṣebhasiṃhabahukaṇṭakataskareṣu || tṛṣṇānvitāśca bahuśokavimūḍhacittāstvatkīrtanāddhi gatamṛtyu bhayā bhavaṃti || 64 || tejorāśistvamiha śaraṇaṃ sarvatoduḥkhitānāṃ tvattulyo'nyo jagati sakale nāsti kaściddayāluḥ || tvayyekasminbhavati sakalā bhaktiranviṣyamāṇā tvāmāsādya prabhavati kuto vyādhiduḥkhaṃ narāṇām|| 65 || kaḥ kuṣṭhābhihataḥ kva cāribhiratho ko vyādhibhiḥ pīḍitaḥ ke paṃgvaṃdhajaḍāḥ kva śīrṇacaraṇaḥ ko vā vipannakriyaḥ || ityevaṃ prasamīkṣya deva kṛpayā doṣātparitrāyase kasyānyasya paropakāraniratā ceṣṭā yathaiṣā tava || 66 || dharmaḥ paratra kila tiṣṭhati sevito'sau kālāṃtareṇa vibudhā varadā bhavaṃti || tvaṃ sevitaḥ praṇatavatsala bhūtikāmaiḥ sadyaḥ prayacchasi phalaṃ yadabhīpsitaṃ taiḥ || 67 || vibhrāṃtakāṃtahariṇīsadṛśekṣaṇābhiḥ kāṃtoruhāramaṇikuṇḍalamekhalābhiḥ || teṣāṃ bhavaṃti bhavanāni vilāsinībhiryeṣāṃ nṛṇāṃ tvamasi vai varadaḥ prasannaḥ || 68 || yaistvaṃ naraiḥ sakṛdapi praṇataḥ kathaṃciddhyāto'thavā bhuvananātha tathāṃtakāle || niṣkalmaṣā jagati duṣkṛtino bhavaṃti te nirmalāḥ sukṛtino gatimāpnuvaṃti || 69 || ye tvāṃ kutarkamatibhirna namaṃti bhaktyā romāṃcakaṃcukaśatākulitaiḥ śarīraiḥ || te nirdhanāḥ paragṛheṣvavabhūtamannaṃ kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhavadanāḥ paritarkayaṃti || 5.1.32.70 || udadhijalataraṃgakṣobhalolākṣiyugmaiḥ saphaṇimaṇimayūkhodbhāsitairlelihadbhiḥ || praṇipatitaśirobhirnāgamukhyairajasraṃ śrutibhiranupamābhiḥ stūyase puṣkalābhiḥ || 71 || tava suravara gacchato'nusaraṃti tridaśanadīkamalodga tāni vātaiḥ || kanakakamalareṇupiṃjaritāni bhramarakulāni pataṃga cāmarāṇi || 72 || tattvadhyānaṃ jalanidhinivahe sthitvā sthitvā caraṇanivahaiḥ || ājīvārthaṃ pratapasi bhagavankaste tulyastribhuvanasamaye || 73 || udayādrinitaṃbasaṃsthitasya hyudayeṣvastamayeṣu cāvṛtasya || kiraṇāstapanīyasaprabhāste vilasantastaḍito viḍaṃbayaṃti || 74 || yathāyathā vrajati rathastavāṃbare vipāṭayandhanatimiraughasaṃcayān || tathātathā kṣubhitamahānilāsṛtaṃ pratīyate muhuriva dundubhiryathā || 75 || cārupadmavinimīlitekṣaṇāṃ cakravākakalahaṃsamekhalām || kāminīmiva ratiśramālasāṃ tāṃ vibodhayasi padminīṃ karaiḥ || 76 || nīlalolamatikāntamutpalaṃ bhṛṃgatuṃgacaraṇākulīkṛtam || tvatprabhābhiranurāgaraṃjitaṃ padmarāgamiva śobhate bhṛśam || 77 || sphuracchaśāṃkahāranirmalaṃ khaga tvadaṃkeṣvacaṃcalam || vibhātyatīva kāṃtamaṃbaraṃ samaṃ bṛhaccaika pāṭalam|| 78 || hariti ca tāvanmuhirniṣevitatamasyaśubhaṃ bhavati ca yāvadaiva kiraṇaistava pūjitataram || ṛṣibhirmunibhirudāradhībhiḥ śāśva tamārgaparairvarada na śakyate tava guṇastutirāśrayitum || 79 || tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ śaśāṃkastvamasuramathanaḥ śaṇmukhastvaṃ dhaneśastvaṃ kālastvaṃ ca dhātā kṣitidharamalayāpāśrayastvaṃ hutāśaḥ || oṃkārastvaṃ dvijānāṃ tvamiha jalanidhitvaṃ śarastvaṃ ca rudrastvaṃ mukhyastvaṃ payodo vratayamaniyamāstvaṃ jagatsarvameva || 5.1.32.80 || tvamaniṃdya gopate tripuramathana manmathadāhakarastvamasurabhīmadarpahā pāhi mām || tridaśādhipakamalavarānanastvamiha devagururbhagavāṃ stribhuvanamaṇḍale'sti katamastava tulyaguṇaḥ || 81 || āditya bhāskara divākara saptasapte mārtaṃḍa sūrya haridaśvapate ca bhāno || aśrāṃtavāhana kharūpa gabhastimāliṃstvāṃ lokanātha śaraṇaṃ pratipadyate'sau || 82 || prāgdigvadhūtilakabhāsurakarṇapūra maṃdākinīdayitanātha jagatpradīpa || hemādritāpana nabhastalahāriratna sandhyāṃganāvadanarāga namonamaste || 83 || brahmaiva satya śubhamaṃgala lokanātha vyomāṃgaṇeśa munisaṃstuta viśvamūrte || ārtasya śokahara kiṃkarapālakaśca tvaṃ me prasīda bhagavañcharaṇāgatasya || 84 || kṛtvāṃjaliṃ śirasi paṃkajakuḍmalābhaṃ yatsaṃstutastvamiha deva mayādya bhaktyā || tena prabho bhava mamopari saumyamūrtirdharme matiṃ kuru sadā śriyamūrjitāṃ ca || 85 || namaḥ savitre jagadekacakṣuṣe jagatprasūtisthitināśahe tave || trayīmayāya triguṇātmadhāraṇe viraṃcinārāyaṇaśaṃkarātmane || 86 || || sūrya uvāca || || tuṣṭohamadhunā pārtha stotreṇānena suvrata || varaṃ dāsyāmi yatnena yatte manasi vartate || 87 || maddarśanaṃ hi viphalaṃ na kadācitprajāyate || śūrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa hyadeyaṃ nāsti yatnataḥ || 88 || || || arjuna uvāca || || eṣa eva varo mahyaṃ varāṇāmuttamottamaḥ || atra saṃnihito deva sarvakālaṃ bhava prabho || 89 || ye ca tvāṃ mānavā bhaktyā sto ṣyaṃti praṇatāḥ sadā || teṣāṃ dhanaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca putradārādikaṃ vasu ||5.1.32.90 || manasaścepsitaṃ sarva dātavyaṃ hi varo mama || sanatkumāra uvāca || ādityo 'smai varaṃ dattvā hyuvāca vacanaṃ śubham|| 91 || yastvatkṛtena stotreṇa māṃ stoṣyati narottamaḥ || śriyā na vicyutistasya bhavedeṣa varo mama || 92 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye narādityamāhātmye'rjunastutivarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃ śo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || cha ||
<5.1.33>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || nārāyaṇo'pi saṃsthāpya śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau prayatnataḥ || tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā stotreṇā nena bhāskaram || 1 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhānuṃ raviṃ sūryaṃ divākaram || divākaraṃ divānāthaṃ tapanaṃ tapatāṃ varam || 2 || vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumanaghaṃ vāsavānujam || balavīryaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrakiraṇadyutim || 3 || mayūkhamālinaṃ viśvaṃ mārtaṃḍaṃ caṃḍarociṣam || sadātītaṃ subhāsvaṃtaṃ saptasaptiṃ sukhodayam || 4|| devadevamahirbudhnyaṃ dhāmnāṃ nidhimanuttamam || tapobrahmamayālokaṃ lokapālamapāṃpatim || 5|| jagatprabodhajanakaṃ jagadbījaṃ jagatprabhum || arkaṃ niḥśreyasaparaṃ kāraṇaṃ śreyasāṃ param || 6 || inaṃ prabhāviṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pataṃgaṃ pavageśvaram || dātāraṃ vāṃchitārthānāṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam || 7 || gṛhaṃ gṛhakaraṃ haṃsaṃ haridaśvaṃ hutāśanam || maṃgalyaṃ maṃgalaṃ geyaṃ dhruvaṃ dharmaprabodhanam || 8 || bhavasaṃbhāvita bhāvaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam || durgamaṃ durgatiharaṃ haranetraṃ trayīmayam || 9 || trailokyatilakaṃ tīrthaṃ taraṇiṃ sarvatomukham || tejorāśisunirvāṇaṃ viśveśaṃ dhāma sāṃpratam || 5.1.33.10 || kalpaṃ kalpānalaṃ kālaṃ kālacakraṃ kratupriyam || bhūṣaṇaṃ marutaṃ sūryaṃ maṇiratnaṃ sulocanam || 11 || tvaṣṭāraṃ viṣṭaraṃ viśvaṃ sadasatkarmasākṣikam || savitāraṃ sahasrākṣaṃ prajāpālamadhokṣajam|| 12 || brahmāṇaṃ vāsarāraṃbhe raktavarṇaṃ mahādyutim || śuklaṃ madhyaṃdine rudraṃ śyāmaṃ viṣṇuṃ dinakṣaye || 13 || nāmnāmaṣṭaśataṃ divyaṃ viṣṇunā samudāhṛtam || ya idaṃ prayato bhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā samāhitaḥ || 14 || na tasya vipadaḥ kvāpi sarvatrāpi śubhā gatiḥ || dhanadhānyasukhāvāptiḥ putralābhaśca jāyate || 15 || tejaḥ prajñāṃ paraṃ lābhaṃ jñānaṃ ca labhate gatim || etacchrutvā jagannātho jagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ || 16 || keśavārkamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā padmarāgasamaprabham || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate || 17 || keśavārkasamīpe tu reṇutīrthaṃ pracakṣate || taddṛṣṭvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe' vantīkṣetramāhātmye keśavādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || || cha ||
<5.1.34>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || tīrthamanyattathā vakṣye śaktibhedamiti smṛtam || skaṃdasya ca jaṭābhadraṃ cakre yatra purā śivaḥ || 1 || tārakaṃ ca tathā daityaṃ hatvā yatra suradviṣam || śaktiṃ skaṃdaḥ svayaṃ kruddho niścikṣepa mahītale || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbrūhi yatnena saṃśayo me mahāmune || kathaṃ skaṃdaḥ samutpanna etadicchāmi veditum ||3|| || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā devāsure yuddhe nirjitā dānavaiḥ surāḥ || divaṃ tyaktvā diśo yātāḥ śakrādyā bhayavihvalāḥ || 4 || tatra tu deva rājena tapasogreṇa vai mune || ārādhito mahādevastryaṃbakastripurāṃtakaḥ || 5 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ śakrasyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ varamiṣṭaṃ dadāmi te || 6 || || śakra uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavankāruṇyānmama śaṃkara || mahāsenāpatiṃ deva prayaccha parameśvara || 7 || || || || hara uvāca || || utpādayāmi deveṣu svavīryādūrjitaṃ sutam || senānyāṃ ca mahāsenaṃ surāṇāṃ bhayahārakam || 8 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devaḥ sarvabhūtapatirharaḥ || sutaciṃtāparo devo jagāma ca himālayam || 9 || devadāruvane tasthau jñānadhyānaparo'bhavat || brahmādayo'pi yaṃ devaṃ yogino dhyānaciṃtakāḥ || 5.1.34.10 || dhyāyaṃti niyatātmanaḥ prāṇāyāmaparā mune || liṃgamūrtiśca yo nityaṃ pūjyate sarvajaṃtubhiḥ || 11 || sa dhyāyati kimarthaṃ tanna vidmaḥ paramārthinaḥ || vaṃ dhyānapare deve devī himavato gṛhe || 12 || madhye vayasi vartaṃtī yāsīddākṣāyaṇī satī || piturgehe nijo deho yayā yogādvisarjitaḥ || 13 || nimaṃtrito na me bhartā iti kopaṃ cakāra yā || tāṃ devīṃ himavānpūrvaṃ śrutvā devarṣināradāt || || 14 || bhavabhāryā bhavitrīti nānyaṃ varamaciṃtayat || tapasyati ca rudrāya sā sakhībhyāṃ samanvitā || 15 || kathaṃ hi śaṃkaro devo mama bhartā bhaviṣyati || yāvadevaṃ gato devo devī himavataḥ sutā || 16 || tataḥ samāgatā devāḥ kṛtvāgre balasūdanam || jagmurbrahmasadaḥ puṇyaṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmāṇama vyayam || 17 || te surāstatstuti kṛtvā vākyametatsamairayan || śaraṇaṃ bhava devānāṃ dānavairvijitātmanām || 18 || tato'vocatsurānbrahmā jñātaṃ kāryaṃ samāhitam || naitacchaṃbhorvinā vīryātkāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati || 19 || tathā yatadhvaṃ deveśaṃ yathā vāṃchati pārvatīm || ityuktvāṃtardadhe brahmā svapne labdhaṃ dhanaṃ yathā || 5.1.34.20 || tato meruṃ samāgatya punarmaṃtraṃ pracakrire || teṣāmāhedṛśaṃ śakrastuṣṭaḥ śaṃbhuḥ purā mama || 21 || pratipannaṃ ca devena svāṃgātsenā patiṃ prati || tasmādevaṃ gate kārye kāraṇaṃ makaradhvajaḥ || 22 || iti saṃcitya deveśaḥ kāmamāhūya satvaram || uvāca vacanaṃ hṛdyaṃ devānā manukaṃpayā || 23 || yathā devo bhajeddevīṃ tathā kāma vidhīyatām || kāraṇaṃ mahadetadvai devānāṃ samupasthitam || 24 || kāmo vākyaṃ hareḥ śrutvā prahasyedamuvāca ha || kariṣye sarvamevaṃ hi sakhā me cedbhavenmadhuḥ || 25 || tasminkṣaṇe'tha śakreṇa kāmavākyādanaṃtaram|| samādiṣṭo madhuḥ kṣipraṃ kāmasyānucaro bhava || 26 || labdhvā kāmo madhuṃ mitraṃ pratasthe bhāryayā saha || kṛtvā sajyaṃ dhanurbāṇaṃ pauṣpaṃ pāṇau samāhitaḥ || 27 || yatra devādhideveśo devadāruvane sthitaḥ || nandīśvaraḥ pratīhāraḥ kṛtadhyāno'vatiṣṭhati || 28 || cūtavṛkṣāśritaḥ kāmo yāvadbāṇaṃ sumohanam || saṃdadhātyaṃtare cāsmindevī prāpa bhavāśramam || 29 || tyaktadhyānavrato devo hṛṣṭaścāhrādacetanaḥ || tato vilokayāmāsa diśaḥ sarvāḥ prayatnataḥ || 5.1.34.30 || cūtavṛkṣāśritaṃ kāmamapaśyacca ruṣānvitaḥ || bhasmīkṛtastṛtīyākṣṇā vahnijvālāvatā tataḥ || 31 || devo'pyantardadhe tasmātsthānādāśu gaṇaiḥ saha || pārvatī vismitā sādhvī lajjitā duḥkhitā'bhavat || 32 || himavāṃstāṃ samutthāpya nināyāśu nijaṃ gṛham || gate deve ca devyāṃ ca kāmapatnī suduḥ khitā || 23 || bhasmīkṛtaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa suduḥkhitā || dṛṣṭvā ratiṃ suduḥkhārtā vāguvācāśarīriṇī ||34|| āśvāsayaṃtīṃ kṛpayā sakhīmiva suduḥ khitām || mā rodīstvaṃ śubhāpāṃgi tava bhartā kariṣyati||35|| sarvakāryāṇyanaṃgopi mitrakāryaṃ vidhānataḥ || yadā cāyaṃ mahādevaḥ pariṇeṣyati pārvatīm || 36 || tataḥ śaṃbhoranudhyānātthāsyati na saṃśayaḥ || dvāparāṃte yadā kṛṣṇo dvārakāyāṃ nivatsyati || 37 || tatputro bhavitā dehī pradyumnonāma te patiḥ || ityuktā sā'jahācchokamākāśājjātayā girā|| 38 || aciṃtayattadā devī umāpi himavadgṛhe || kāmasya dahanaṃ tejaḥ śaṃbhoryattadanuttamam || 39 || kathaṃ bharttā bhaveddevaḥ kāmasyotthāpanaṃ katham || naitattapo vinā kāryaṃ kvacitkasyāpi sidhyati || 5.1.34.40 || evaṃ saṃciṃtayitvātha sakhībhiḥ sahitā tataḥ || tapaścakāra sumahatpitrādeśācchubhavratā || 41 || varṣāsvabhrāvakāśasthā hemaṃte jalaśāyinī|| grīṣme paṃcāgnitaptāṃgī tapasyugre samā sthitā || 42 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tapasopetāṃ brahmacārivayā haraḥ || ājagāmāśramaṃ devyāḥ kṛtātithyo'bravīdidam || 43 || kṛśamadhye kṛśāpāṃgi kimarthaṃ navayauvane || tapaḥ karoṣi kalyāṇi kasyārthe kāraṇaṃ vada || 44 || uvāca cottaraṃ sā vai satyaṃ ca madhuraṃ tathā || baṭo tapaḥsamāraṃbhaḥ kriyate śaṃkarā ptaye || 45 || vicārya ca haraḥ śrutvā'naṃdayatkāryamātmanaḥ || umābhaktiparīkṣārthaṃ śivaṃ vācā nininda vai || 46 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā na sehe sā gireḥ sutā || gaṃtukāmāmumāṃ matvā tasmātsthānānmaheśvaraḥ || svaṃ vapurdarśayāmāsa trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam || 47 || lajjitābhūdbhavānīśaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasthāvadhomukhī || vijayāthāha yogīndraṃ prārthyā cābhijane tviyam || pārvatīharaṇārthāya yatnaṃ ca prakaromyaham || 48 || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devo devyāgācca piturgṛham || devīlābhāya saptarṣīnsasmāra smaraśāsanaḥ || 49 || praṇemustepyathāgamya saṃsmṛtāḥ parameśvaram || ūcuśca prāṃja lipuṭāḥ kurma kiṃ śādhi no bhṛśam || 5.1.34.50 || tato'bravīnmunīnīśaḥ samastāṃśca girergṛham || gatvā tathā kurudhvaṃ me pārvatī syādyathā priyā || || 51 || tatheti te pratijñāya saṃketaṃ śaṃbhunā samam || kṛtvā jagmuḥ sapatnīkā girīṃdrasya niveśanam || 52 || dattārghā bhūdhareṃdreṇa kṛtāsana parigrahāḥ || ūcuradrimumāṃ yaccha śaṃkarāyārthine priyām || 53 || dattetyuktā girīṃdreṇa nirūpyodvāhavāsaram || labdhvānujñāṃ samāyātā yatrāste sa maheśvaraḥ || 54 || ūcuste śaṃkaraṃ sarve dattā himavatā śivā || kṛtakāryāśca sarve'pi vavrajuste yathāgatam || 55 || cakrurvivāha sāmagrīṃ brahmendrādisurāstadā || vṛṣāsano jagāmātha naṃdīśapramukhairgaṇaiḥ || 56 || śaṃkhaduṃdubhinādaiśca brahmādyairamaraiḥ saha || prāpyāgeṃdrālayaṃ hīśaḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ || 57 || vivāhyemāṃ vidhānena jagāma svālayaṃ punaḥ || tatraikāṃtaratirdevo yāvattiṣṭhati kāmavān || 58 || tāvattrastaiḥ surairagniḥ preṣito'gānmaheśvaram || agnau tatra gate devo ratiṃ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ || 59 || nicikṣepa mukhe vahneḥ svareto vrīḍito bhṛśam || retasā tena tapto 'gnirgaṃgātoye nikṣiptavān || 5.1.34.60 || harareto'gninodgīrṇaṃ gaṃgāmadhye papāta ha || tayā tu svataṭe nyastaṃ dagdhayā rudraretasā || 61 || saptarṣīṇāṃ ca ṣaṭpatnyaḥ snānārthaṃ jāhnavīṃ yayuḥ || śītārtāstāḥ kṛtasnānā dṛṣṭvā tejastaṭe jvalat || 62 || matvāgnimiti tāḥ sarvāstapaṃti sma yathecchayā || tapaṃtīnāṃ ca vai tāsāṃ tadbījasaṃbhava mune || 63 || ṣaḍānanaṃ samārūḍhaṃ śroṇidvāreṇa satvaram || yadānyonyamutpatituṃ śaktā nāgnipurogamāt || 64 || ciṃtāṃ jagmustadā sarvā munitrāsāttato bhayāt || tataśca tapaso vīryānniṣkṛṣya svodarāttataḥ || 65 || ṣaḍbhirekatvamāpadya śvetaparvatamastake || madhye śarāṇāṃ vai kṛtya nikṣiptaṃ vīryamuttamam || 66 || śuklāyāṃ pratipadyāsīddvitīyāyāṃ samīkṛtaḥ || tṛtīyāyāṃ ca sākāraḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ || 67 || caturthyāṃ paripūrṇāṃgaḥ ṣaṇmukho dvādaśekṣaṇaḥ || alaṃkṛtastu paṃcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca sa samutthitaḥ || 68 || tejasā śvetatāmreṇa tatāpa sa jagattrayam || jātamitthaṃ samākarṇya sarve śakramukhāḥ surāḥ || 69 || samāgatyāsya saṃskāraṃ brahmā cakre yathāvidhi || tuṣṭena pārvatīśena śaktirdattā dṛḍhā śubhā || 5.1.34.70 || tato gauryā mayūraśca vāhane parikalpitaḥ || chāgaścaivāgninā dattaḥ kukkuṭaṃ saritāṃ patiḥ || 71 || śūlena kṛttikābhiśca vardhitaḥ putrakāmyayā || tatastu prāptasaṃskāro brahmādyairabhinaṃditaḥ || 72 || śaktihasto'bhiṣiktastu devasenāsamādṛtaḥ || vittādhipena sāhyena pāvakiḥ paṇmukhoṃ 'śataḥ || 73 || gāṃgeyaḥ kārtikeyaśca guhaḥ skaṃda umāsutaḥ || devasenāpatiḥ svāmī senānīśca śikhidhvajaḥ || 74 || kumāraḥ śaktidhārī ca tasya nāmāni ṣoḍaśa || yaḥ paṭhenmānavo bhaktyā bādhā tasya na jāyate || 75 || evaṃ jāto mahāseno dānavānāṃ kṣayakaraḥ || kuśasthalyāṃ samānītaḥ śaṃbhunā sthānakāraṇāt || 76 || abhiṣiktaḥ sa tenāsau bhadritaḥ sa jaṭāḥ purā || tena bhadrajaṭaṃnāma devatīrthaṃ ca kathyate || 77 || kṛtābhiṣekaṃ labdhāstraṃ mahāsenaṃ maheśvaraḥ || tamuvāca samadhuraṃ sarvadevasamāgame || 78 || rakṣā kāryā tvayā putra sāmarasya śatakratoḥ || devānāṃ bādhakāḥ sarve nihaṃtavyāḥ suradviṣaḥ || 79 || itthaṃ mahotsave jāte dṛptapramathasāgare || mātaro'nvāgatāḥ sarvāḥ pātālatalasaṃsthitāḥ || 5.1.34.80 || tāsāmāhārasaṃjñābhiścakre nāmāni śaṃkaraḥ || yāni tāni pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ munipuṃgava ||81|| vaṭabhojanakāmā yā jñeyāstā vaṭamātaraḥ || bhuñjate carpaṭānyāstu tā vai carpaṭamātaraḥ ||82|| krīḍārthaṃ śaṃbhunā cātha prāptā yāḥ paulabhojane || ṣaṇṇavatimātaraḥ satyāḥ sarvāstāḥ paulamātaraḥ ||83|| sarvāsāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ grahabhūtavināśanam || prayatnataḥ sadā devyo draṣṭavyā mānavairmune ||84|| labdhvā śaktiṃ mahāseno devaseno mahāvrataḥ || jaghāna dānaveṃdraṃ taṃ tārakaṃ tarasā tadā || 85 || dattvā rājyaṃ tatheṃdrāya sphītaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam || kuśasthalīṃ samāgamya tatra vāsaṃ samācarat ||86|| evaṃ nihatya daityeṃdraṃ sa gāṃgeyo mahāba laḥ || śaktiṃ śiprājale muktvā pātālaṃ ca bibheda sā ||87|| tato bhogavatī vyāsa śaktibhedena nirgatā || vaṃditā sarvadevaiśca munibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ||88|| pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni samudrādigatāni ca || śaktibhede tu nyastāni śatakoṭisahasraśaḥ || 89 || ato'tipuṇyaṃ trailokye koṭitīrthamudāhṛtam || brahmaṇā sthāpitastatra koṭitīrtheśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 5.1.34.90 || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ śivam || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nirmokādiva pannagaḥ || || 91 || śrāddhaṃ karoti yastatra pitṛbhakto naro mune || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ prāpnoti sakalaṃ phalam || 92 || pitṝnuddiśya yatkiñcitkoṭitīrthe pradīyate || tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 93 || tatra tīrthe naro yastu gāṃ dadāti payasvinīm || sarvalokānatikramya sa gacchetpa ramāṃ gatim || 94 || yāvantyaṃgeṣu romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 95 || paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ paśyecchaktidharaṃ tu yaḥ || nāputro nādhano rogī saptajanmasu jāyate || 96 || jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe narottamaḥ || so'kṣayaṃ labhate lokaṃ yāvaccandra divākarau || 97 || vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yaḥ kuryātpitṛbhakto naro mune || so'kṣayaṃ labhate sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham || 98 || iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye śaktibhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || |||cha|| ||
<5.1.35>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || svarṇakṣure naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || kapilāśatadānasya phalamapyadhikaṃ bhavet || 1 || vāpyāṃ pitāmaha syāpi yaḥ snāyādvijiteṃdriyaḥ || haṃsayuktena yānena brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 2 || tailābhidhānamātṝṇāṃ rātrau yacchati yo balim || tasya siddhirbhave tsadyo mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ yajet || 3 || viṣṇuvāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā caitre vā phālgune'thavā || jāgaraṃ yastu kurvīta sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || mucyate sarva pāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 4 || abhayeśvaradevasya bhaktyā niyatamānasaḥ || pūjābandhamatho dṛṣṭvā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 5 || loke tu jāyate dātā sārvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ || yastvagastveśvaraṃ gacchedekacitto naro mune || 6 || dṛṣṭvāgastyeśvaraṃ devaṃ sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ || agastyodayavelāyāṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 7 || kṛtvāgastyaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vātha svaśaktitaḥ || pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ vastreṇa ca samanvitam ||8|| tatkālīnaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanīyo vidhānataḥ || vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi cāturvarṇye dvijottama || 9 || saptadhānyāni mukhyāni tāvantyeva phalāni ca || ekaṃ dhānyaṃ phalaṃ caikamagre tyājyaṃ bhavenmune || 5.1.35.10 || yāvadvai sapta varṣāṇi vratamevaṃ samācaret || 11 || || arghyamantraḥ || || kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa vahnimārutasaṃ bhava || mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo'stu te || 12 || datte'rghe yatphalaṃ vyāsa tadvai hyekamanāḥ śṛṇu || putravāndhanavāṃścaiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 || mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti saṃpanne jāyatekule || martyalokaṃ punaḥ prāpya mahāyogīśvaro bhavet || 14 || yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā susamāhitaḥ|| sarvapāpavinirmukto muniloke sa modate || 15 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'gastyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || || cha ||
<5.1.36>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || mahākālaṃ kimarthaṃ tu kiṃ vā śivapadaṃ smṛtam || koṭīśvaraṃ kimarthaṃ tu pāvakaṃ tatkimucyate || 1 || naradīpaṃ kimarthaṃ tu dvitīyā vaṭamātaraḥ || abhayeśvaraṃ kimarthaṃ tu śaṃkhoddhā raṇameva ca || 2 || śūleśvaraṃ kimarthaṃ tu kimoṃkārastu kathyate || dhūtapāpaṃ kimarthaṃ tu kimaṃgāreśvaraṃ tathā || 3 || purī cojjayinī divyā saptakalpā kathaṃ smṛtā || kathayasva muniśreṣṭha tasyā nāmāni yāni ca || 4 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa yathā khyātā purī divyā kuśa sthalī || nāmataḥ karmataḥ śreṣṭhā saptakalpānuvāsinī || 5 || prākkalpe svarṇaśṛṃgākhyā dvitīye tu kuśasthalī || tṛtīye'vaṃtikā proktā caturthetvamarā vatī || 6 || vikhyātā pañcame kalpe purī cūḍāmaṇīti ca || ṣaṣṭhe padmāvatī jñeyā saptame cojjayinī purī || 7 || punaraṃte tu kalpasya svarṇaśṛṅgādi kā smṛtā || etāni sapta nāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet || 8 || saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || ujjayinyāṃ purā rājā babhūva kila cāṃdhakaḥ || 9 || tasya putro mahāvīryo nāmnā kanakadānavaḥ || yuddhārthaṃ sa mahāvīryaḥ śakraṃ yuddhe samāhvayat || 5.1.36.10 || krodhādiṃdreṇa saṃgrāme yudhya māno nipātitaḥ || nihatya dānavaṃ śakro bhayādaṃdhāsurasya tu || 11 || jagāma śaṃkarānveṣī kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam || dṛṣṭvā praṇamya deveśaṃ caṃdrārdhakṛta śekharam || 12 || bhīto vijñāpayāmāsa sa cāśrvākulalocanaḥ || abhayaṃ dehi me deva dānavādaṃdhakācca vai || 13 || śakrasyetthaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śaraṇā gatavatsalaḥ || dadāvabhayamevāsau mā bhaistvamaṃdhakāddhi vai || 14 || kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahādevo viśvarūpaṃ subhairavam || sarpairlaladbhiratyugraistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrairviṣolbaṇaiḥ || 15 || pātālodararūpaiśca bhairavārāvanādibhiḥ || bhujairanekasāhasrairbahuśastradhṛtaistathā || 16 || siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ vyāghratvaguttarīyakam || gavājina kṛtāṭopaṃ caṃdrāgniravilocanam || 17 || mahāmahīdhratulyābhyāṃ jaṃghābhyāṃ bhūṣitaṃ sadā || kṣobhayaṃścālayansarvānpātālasya talāvadhi || 18 || īdṛgrūpaṃ vidhāyeśo danudaityabhayāvaham || avātaranmahīṃ bhīmaḥ pādenaikena śaṃkaraḥ || 19 || tatraiva hi hrado jātaḥ sarvadaivatavaṃditaḥ || khyātaṃ śivapadaṃ taddhi yatpadā''krāṃtavānvibhuḥ || 5.1.36.20 || pāpānāṃ ca purā koṭiḥ pādāṃguṣṭhena dāritā || koṭitīrthamataḥ khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 21 || agastyena tathā koṭistīrthānāmavadhāritā || ato'pīdaṃ śubhaṃ loke koṭitīrthaṃ sadā smṛtam || 22 || dṛṣṭvā tu tridaśāḥ sarve snātā vai hitakāmyayā || mahā kālakṛtaṃ rūpaṃ mahākālastataḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 || aṃdhāsuro'pi danujaḥ putraṃ śrutvā hataṃ yudhi || krodhena tamasāviṣṭo raṇatūryāṇyavādayata || 24 || sasainyo nirgataḥ prāpto yatra te tridaśāḥ sthitāḥ || mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ rathavāraṇayuktayā || 25 || tadaiva dānavānvīkṣya mahāhavakṛtodyamān || vepaṃtaste susaṃnaddhā śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ || 26 || mā bhairiti mahākālo devānuktvā trilocanaḥ || gṛhītvā śūlamātiṣṭhaddaṣṭādaṃṣṭrādharo ruṣā || 27 || kopayukte virūpākṣe jvālābhiḥ pūritaṃ nabhaḥ || aṃdhakenātha ruṣṭena śarakoṭistu duḥsahā || 28 || muktā jagāma devānāṃ nanāśa śalabhākṛti || visphuliṃgārciṣaṃ vahniṃ muṃcamānaḥ pinākadhṛk || 29 || śataśaḥ śakalīcakre taṃ ca bāṇairatāḍayat || aṃdhako'pi hi yuddhasthaḥ śithilaḥ śithilā yudhaḥ || 5.1.36.30 || niruddhaḥ śaṃbhunā bāṇairalibhiḥ paṃkajaṃ yathā || tasya sainyaṃ praviddhaṃ ca tadgaṇairyudhi yodhibhiḥ || 31 || yodhavarairhatā divyaiḥ sthāṇu sānnidhyamāśritaiḥ || tatoṃ'dhakena sainyaṃ svaṃ bhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāsuraiḥ || 32 || ātmānaṃ ca maheśena viddhaṃ ca bāṇakoṭibhiḥ || vidalīkṛtadeho'sau bhaya māśritya vegataḥ || 33 || cakāra tāmasīṃ māyāṃ māyāśataviśāradaḥ || tayāṃtarhitadeveśo jagāma diśamuttarām || 34 || śaṃbhurbhītibharaṃ bibhradbabhrāma bhuvi bhinnahṛt || yasminmārge gato devastena daityo jagāma ha || 35 || vadanna dṛśyate kvāsau gato duṣṭaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || uvāca cāṃdhakaḥ śabdaṃ tathovā ca maheśvaraḥ || 36 || tatra tīrthamathotpannaṃ vāgaṃdhakamabhiśrutam || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā yo vai dadyātsaśarkaram || 37 || navamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya śuklāyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || akṣayaṃ tadbhaveddattaṃ dātā śivapuraṃ vrajet || 38 || pitṛnuddiśya yatkiṃciddīyate bhaktitaḥ śive || tṛptāstiṣṭhaṃti te tāvadyāvadābhūta saṃplavam || 39 || tamasā cchāditā devāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ samākulāḥ || saṃbhrāṃtamanasaḥ sarve na kiṃcidapi menire || 5.1.36.40 || etasminnaṃtare vyāsa narādityaḥ svatejasā || uttasthau nararūpeṇa kurvanvitimirā diśaḥ || 41 || naṣṭe tamasi daityepi prakāśa prakaṭe sati || devā mudamavāpuste dṛṣṭvā naraṃ vilocanaiḥ || 42 || stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stotrairnararūpaṃ divākaram || uttasthau nararūpeṇa dīpto yasmāddivākaraḥ || 43 || tenāsya nāma te cakurnaradīpa itīśvarāḥ || yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā naradīpaṃ divākaram || 44 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo yadyapi brahmahā bhavet || ṣaṣṭhyāmarkadine vipra saptamyāmupa vāsayet || 45 || dinacchidretha saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe viṣuvatyatha || kuṃḍe snātvā śucirbhūtvā japanniyatamānasaḥ || 46 || naradīpaṃ naraḥ paśyetstotravā ditramaṃgalaiḥ || gaṃdhairdhūpaistathā dīpairnaivedyaiḥ pūjayettathā || 47 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ puraskṛtya praṇamyāṣṭāṃgameva ca || prātarmadhyāparāhne vā kṛtvārkasya pradakṣiṇām || 48 || sa muktaḥ sarvapāpaistu saptajanmakṛtairapi || sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||49|| sūryalokaṃ prayātyāśu yatsurairapi durlabham || śakrātprāpya purā yasmādbhānuratra pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 5.1.36.50 || nareṇaiva prasādena naradīpastato hyayam || tadaivāsya purā vyāsa yātrā śakreṇa nirmitā || 51 || āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ pārtha sārdhaṃ devaiḥ samāhitaḥ || jyeṣṭhe site dvitīyāyāṃ naradīpe tu sarvadā ||52|| tatrāhamāgato jñeyo loke devasya varṣaṇāt || tato'naṃtaramāgatya devā ye tridaśālayāt || 53 || dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tathārūḍhaṃ naradīpaṃ sudīpitam || kṛtvā yātrāṃ ca te yāṃti devayānairitastataḥ || 54 || yaḥ paśyenmānavo bhaktyā naradīpaṃ rathasthitam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate || 55 || rathayātrāmatho vakṣye naradīpasya yā mune || tāṃ kṛtvā caiva yatpuṇyaṃ munibhiḥ parikīrtitam || 56 || jyeṣṭhe site dvitīyāyāṃ rathastho hi divākaraḥ || kuśasthalyāṃ dvijaiḥ śreṣṭhairbāhukṣepaiḥ praṇīyate || 57 || uttarāṃ diśamāyāṃtaṃ yaḥ paśyati divaspatim || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya labhate so'khilaṃ phalam ||58|| nivṛtya keśavārkādyo rathaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ|| śuṃḍīrasvāmino yātrā kṛtā tena na saṃśayaḥ || 59 || rathamākarṣate yastu rajjvākarṣeṇa vai mune || kulamuddharate so'pi pūrvānpitṛpitāmahān || 5.1.36.60 || dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ yāṃtaṃ naradīpaṃ dvijottama || ye saṃyatāḥ prapaśyaṃti te yāṃti ca triviṣṭapam || 61 || sūtreṇa veṣṭayetkṣetraṃ rathaṃ devamathāpi vā || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti kṛtapuṇyaśca jāyate || 62 || pradakṣiṇāṃ tu sūryasya bhaktyā kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā taistu saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || 63 || prātarutthāya yo bhaktyā maunī yāti divākaram|| dṛṣṭvā tu pūrvadvāreṇa namaskṛtya dvijottama || 64 || praviśya dakṣiṇenaiva rathacakraṃ prapūjayet || tena dvāreṇa niṣkramya praṇipatya vrajettataḥ ||65|| paścimaṃ dvāramāśritya rathasthaṃ sūryamarcayet || cāmaraṃ ca vitānaṃ ca ghaṃṭādīni nivedayet ||66|| pūrvadvāre tu gaurde yā tathāśvaścaiva dakṣiṇe || paścime ca gajaḥ prokta uttare ratha eva ca ||67|| kuryādeva tu yo yātrāṃ naradīpasya mānavaḥ|| sarvānkāmānavāpnoti kṛtapuṇyaśca jāyate ||68|| gosūryaśivaśakrāṇāṃ svarlokaṃ labhate śubham || pradakṣiṇā mahāmeroḥ kṛtā tena bhavenmune||69|| dadyādgavāṃ sahasraṃ yo vyatīpātaśate naraḥ|| aśvānāṃ ca sahasreṇa yadyāyāttatphalaṃ labhet ||5.1.36.70|| naradīpe rathārūḍhe vapanaṃ kārayettu yaḥ|| śriyā na vicyutistasya sūryaloke mahīyate||71|| sūryasya purato vāpyāṃ māsaṃ nityaṃ sarasvatī|| yastāmālokate martyo duḥsvapnaṃ tasya naśyati||72|| bhaktyā yo'nudinaṃ vyāsa naradīpaṃ prapaśyati|| uttamaṃ sthāna māsādya putrapautrasamanvitaḥ||73|| prakrīḍya baṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ mṛtaḥ sūryapuraṃ vrajet|| pranaṣṭe timire vipra jāte sarvatra suprabhe ||74|| hateṃ'dhake maheśena śūlena triśikhena vai || prahṛṣṭāśca surāḥ sarve brahmeṃdrapramukhāstadā ||75|| śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau tadā viṣṇuḥ surāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || tatra tīrthamathotpannaṃ śaṃkhoddhāraṇasaṃjña kam ||76|| tatra saṃnihito viṣṇurliṃgaṃ caiva caturmukham || anādyaṃ caiva vipreṃdra liṃgasyaiva samīpataḥ ||77|| devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge śūlenādhiṣṭhitaḥ sthitaḥ || caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ ye paśyaṃti jiteṃdriyāḥ || 78 || te kṣīṇāśeṣapāpaughāḥ prāpsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || yoginīnāṃ baliṃ yastu yathāvatsaṃpradā syati || 79 || bhūtapretapiśācādyairnāsau kenāpi bādhyate || dvādaśīṃ samupoṣyaiva snātvā devaṃ janārdanam || 5.1.36.80 || yaḥ paśyecchaṃkhinaṃ devaṃ so'cyutaṃ sthānamāpnuyāt || 81 || yaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaprakaṭaprakāśo yaḥ sarvabhūto na ca sarvabhūtaḥ || viśva yataścaiva hi viśvaheturnamostu tasmai puruṣottamāya || 82 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye naradīpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36|| || cha ||
<5.1.37>
sanatkumāra uvāca || || bhinneṃ'dhake triśūlena dhvanī rudrasya nirgataḥ || tatroṃkāraḥ samutpanno devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 1 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā samādhiniyamena ca || dṛṣṭvoṃkāraṃ mahādevaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || hatvāṃdhake triśūlaśca bhogavatyā jale yayau || dṛṣṭvā śūlaṃ sutejaskaṃ hāṭako vismayaṃ gataḥ || papraccha kena kāryeṇa bhavāniha samāgataḥ || 3 || kathayāmāsa śūlosau śaṃkareṇāhamīritaḥ || aṃdhakasya vadhārthāya pāpavṛtteḥ sudu rmateḥ||4|| bhittvā tamahamāyāto bhogavatyā jale śubhe || gamiṣyāmi punastatra yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ || 5 || śūloktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā parameśadidṛkṣayā || hāṭakaḥ śūlamārgeṇa nirjagāma javena saḥ || bahuvaktrasamākīrṇaṃ suprabhaṃ sumanoramam|| 6 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridaśāḥ sarve śūleśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram||| praṇamya hṛṣṭaromāṇo yathā protphullapaṃkajam || 7 || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || hāṭakeśvaranāmāsītpātāle yo vyavasthitaḥ || 8 || nirgataḥ śūlamārgeṇa tena śūleśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || dhūtapāpaṃ ca yattīrthaṃ devadevasya cottare || 9 || tatra pāpaḥ sa daityeṃdro dhūtaḥ śūlena vīryavān || tena tīrthamidaṃ vyāsa dhūtapāpaṃ nigadyate || 5.1.37.10 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā paurṇamāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ śanau tathā || upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ śivabhakto jiteṃdriyaḥ || 11 || dhūtapāpaṃ tu yaḥ paśyeddevadevaṃ maheśvaram|| vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ sa saptajanmakṛtairapi ||12|| kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ ca gacchati || kṛtābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ paśyetpauṣe māsi sa vai naraḥ || 13 || śūleśvaraprabhāvena mucyate brahmahatyayā || vimānānāṃ sahasreṇa mṛto yāti paraṃ padam || 14 || iti cāṃdhakaśūloyaṃ yāvadbhogavatīṃ gataḥ || tāvatsamutthitā ghorā asurā rudhirodbhavāḥ || 15 || khaḍgahastā mahāvīryā anekaśatasaṃkhyayā || caturdikṣu sthitairghorairhanya māno maheśvaraḥ || siṃhanādaṃ mumocātha pīḍitastairdurātmabhiḥ || 16 || siṃhanādena te pāpā mūrchitāḥ patitā bhuvi || punaḥ samutthitā jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram || vitrastāśca tato devā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || 17 || asādhyāṃstāṃstathā matvā maṃtraṃ kṛtvā hitaiṣiṇaḥ || tato devā vicāryātha strīṃ sṛjāma iti svayam || 18 || ityuktvotpādayāmāsa brahmā haṃsāsanāṃ śubhām || caturvaktrāṃ caturhastāṃ brahmāṇīṃ rūpadhāriṇīm || 19 || kumāraścaiva kaumārīṃ mayūravaravāhanām || raktamālyābaradharāṃ śaktikukkuṭadhāriṇīm || 5.1.37.20 || punaḥ kumāraḥ kaumārīṃ pakṣīṃdravaravāhanām || kṛṣṇāṃ karāladaśanāṃ dharmarājasya vāhanīm || 21 || daityadehapramathanīṃ daṃḍamudgaradhāriṇīm || lalāṭalocanāṃ nīlāṃ kapālakarabhūṣitām || 22 || siṃhājinadharāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām|| kartrīhastāṃ khaḍgahastāṃ kheṭakhaṭvāṃgadhāriṇīm || carmāsthikeśavapuṣaṃ cāmuṃḍāmamṛjatprabhuḥ || 23 || vaṭasya nikaṭe pūrvaṃ nirmitā lokamātaraḥ || tato loke suvikhyātāḥ pratyakṣā vaṭamātaraḥ || 24 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā mātṝḥ paśyati yo naraḥ || sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo mātṛloke mahīyate || 25 || siṃhanādo'pi devena kṛto yatra mahāmune || tatra siṃheśvaro devaḥ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanaḥ || 26 || darśanāttasya devasya siṃhavatsa balī bhavet || siṃhanāde kṛte yatra jātaṃ kaṇṭakitaṃ vapuḥ || 27 || tatra kaṇṭeśvaro devo bhaktānāṃ sarvadaḥ sadā || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā kaṇṭeśvaraṃ śivam || 28|| grahabhūtapiśācebhyo na bhayaṃ prāpnuyātkvacit || tatastā mātaraḥ sarvā ādiṣṭāstu hareṇa vai || 29 || andhāsurasya raudrasya pibadhvaṃ rudhiraṃ drutam || etasminnantare vyāsa prajvalajjvalanopamaḥ || 5.1.37.30 || abhayaṃ śakra mā bhaistvaṃ yatrovāceti śaṃkaraḥ || tatra liṃgaṃ samudbhūtamabhayeśvaramuttamam || 31 || vaṃditaṃ devagaṃdharvaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || 32 || arcaye ddevadeveśamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || bhūtapretapiśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate || 33 || siṃhayuktena yānena śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || andhakasya tu yā māyā raktāsurasamudbhavā || 34 || mātṛbhiryudhyamānābhiḥ kṣayamāśu jagāma sā || devyaḥ pibantyo raktaughaṃ daiteyatanutaścyutam || 35 || ṣaṭtṛptiṃ paramā jagmurna tu tṛptā lalāṭajā || hatamāyaḥ śiṣṭakastu bhinnaśūlatanucchadaḥ || 36 || uttarābhimukhaṃ śūlamaṃdhako'karṣayadbalī || saṃniruddho mahādeho vārito gaṇapena saḥ || 37 || mahāvināyakaḥ khyātastasmālloke'bhavanmune || darśanāttasya devasya na vighnaiḥ pīḍyate naraḥ || 38 || māsemāse caturthyāṃ yo gaṇeśaṃ pūjayeddvija || na tasya vighnaṃ jāyeta iha loke paratra ca || 39 || svedabiṃduratho tasya lalāṭādapatadbhuvi || tasmādaṃgārako jāto raktamālyānulepanaḥ || 5.1.37.40 || āvantye viṣaye jāto lohitāṃgo dharāsutaḥ || aṃgārakastu raktākṣo mahādevasutastathā || 41 || nāmabhirbrahmaṇā stutvā grahamadhye'dhiropitaḥ || tatra tīrthamathotpannamaṃgāreśvaramuttamam || 42 || brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ gaṇagaṃdharvasevitam || śucistatra ca yaḥ snāti naro hyaṃgāravāsare || 43 || dṛṣṭvāṃgāreśvaraṃ sotha mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || caturthyāṃ maṃgaladine nakte cārghyaṃ nivedayet || 44 || yāvatpūrṇāścatasraḥ syustāvatkāryāḥ prayatnataḥ || pañca vai karakāḥ kāryāstāmrapātreṇa saṃyutāḥ || 45 || guḍapīṭhamayāḥ kāryā raktavastrasamanvitāḥ || raktacaṃdanasaṃyuktā raktapuṣpaiśca pūjitāḥ || 46 || tilataṇḍulasaṃpūrṇamekaṃ tatraiva kārayet || dvitīyaṃ laḍḍukaiścaiva tṛtīyaṃ payasā tathā || 47 || uttarībhiścaturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ mūlakaistathā || kṛtvā hyevaṃ vidhānena maṃtreṇārghyaṃ nivedayet || 48 || kujāya lohitāṃgāya grahamaghyasthitāya ca || kārtikeyānurūpāya surūpāya namo namaḥ ||49|| śivalalāṭasaṃbhūta dharaṇīgarbhasaṃbhava || rūpārthaṃ tvāṃ prapannosmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te ||5.1.37.50|| jvalitāṃgāravarṇābha snigdhavidrumabhā sura || putrārthī tvāṃ prapannosmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ dharātmaja || 51 || āvantyamaṇḍale jāto dharaṇyāṃ ca śivena vai || putraṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi yaśo dehi namo'stu te || 52 || evaṃ saṃpūjito bhaumaścaturthyāṃ munisattama || bhuktvā bhogāṃstathā putrānprāpya vai kṣitimaṃḍale || 53 || mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'ṅgārakīcaturthī vratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || || cha ||
<5.1.38>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || nāsti śeṣaṃ yadā raktaṃ pīyamānaṃ ca rakṣasaḥ || cāmuṃḍāyāstato raktamabhūdāsyaṃ ca bhāsuram ||1|| kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtāṃtakalpāṃtaṃ karāladaśanādharam || prajvalatyaṃdhake śāṃtaṃ jvalatkesaralocanam ||2|| ghoraghargharanirghoṣasphītaphetkāravisvaram || tārkṣyapakṣakṛtāpīḍaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrākurojjvalam ||3|| tasminmukhe kapālāgraṃ nidhāya ruṣitānanā || apibadrudhiraṃ caṃḍī caṇḍa dordaṃḍamaṃḍitā || 4 || tayā pibaṃtyā daityeṃdraḥ śarīre kṛśatāṃ gataḥ || kṣayaṃ ninye'tha saṃkṣīṇakṣudrakṣubhitavīkṣaṇaḥ || 5 || itthaṃ nirvīryadeho'sau babhūvāṃdha kadānavaḥ || sarvāṃ saṃhṛtya māyāṃ yo balaṃ kṣīṇamathākarot || 6 || tīvraṃ bhayaṃ samāsādya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ || dṛṣṭvā nānyāṃ gatiṃ loke daityastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || 7 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā romāṃcitaśarīrakaḥ || sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāpannastyaktvā caiva rajastamaḥ || 8 || lokānāṃ kāraṇaṃ devaṃ vibudhādhi patiṃ prabhum || śaśvadbuddhyānvito bhaktyā nirmalenāṃtarātmanā || 9 || ślāghyaṃ śivaṃ ca tuṣṭāva devaṃ caṃdrārdhaśekharam || 5.1.38.10 || || aṃdhaka uvāca || || kṛtsnasya yo'sya jagataḥ sacarācarasya kartā kṛtasya ca tathā sukhaduḥkhadātā|| saṃsāraheturapi yaḥ punaraṃtakāle taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||11|| yaṃ yogino vigatamohatamorajaskā bhaktyaikatānamanaso vinivṛttakāmāḥ || dhyāyaṃti ye'khiladhiyo'mitadivyabhūtiṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 12 || yaścaṃdrakhaṃḍamamalaṃ vilasanmayūkhaṃ baddhvā sadā surasaricchirasā bibharti || yasyārdhadehamabhajadgirirājaputrī taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || || 13 || yaḥ siddhacāraṇaniṣevitapādapadmo gaṃgāṃ mahormiviṣamāṃ gaganātpataṃtīm || mūrdhnā dadhe srajamiva trijagatpunaṃtīṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 14 || kailāsaśailaśikharaṃ pravikaṃpyamānaṃ kailāsaśṛṃgasadṛśena daśānanena || yaḥ pādapadmaparipīḍanasevyamānastaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 15 || dakṣādhvare ca nayane ca tathā bhagasya pūṣṇastathā daśanapaṃktimaśātayadyaḥ || vyaṣṭaṃbhayatkuliśahastamatheṃdramīśaṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||16|| yenāsakṛdditisutāśca danoḥ sutāśca vidyādharoragagaṇāśca varaiḥ samagraiḥ || saṃyojitā munivarāḥ phalamūlabhakṣāstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 17 || evaṃ kṛtepi viṣayeṣvapi saktabhāvā jñānena ca śrutaguṇairapi tena yuktāḥ || yaṃ saṃśritāḥ sukhabhujaḥ puruṣā bhavaṃti taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajā mi || 18 || brahmeṃdraviṣṇumarutāṃ ca saṣaṇmukhānāṃ yo'dādvarānsubahuśo bhagavānmaheśaḥ || sūtaṃ ca mṛtyuvadanātpunarujjahāra taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 19 || ārādhitastu tapasā himavannikuṃje dhūmravratena tapasā ca parairagamyaḥ || saṃjīvanīṃ samadadādbhṛgave mahātmā taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||5.1.38.20|| krīḍārthameva bhagavānbhuvanāni sapta nānānadīvihagapādapamaṃḍitāni || sabrahmakāni sasṛje sukṛtābhidhāni taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 21 || yaḥ savyapāṇikamalāgranakhena devastatpaṃcamaṃ prasabhameva karālaraṃdhram || brāhmyaṃ śirastaraṇipadmanibhaṃ cakarta taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 22 || ye tvāṃ surottamaguruṃ puruṣā vimūḍhā jānaṃti nāsya jagataḥ sacarācarasya || aiśvaryamānavigame'nuśayena paścātte yātanāmanubhavaṃti yathāhameva || 23 || yaḥ paṭhetstutimimāṃ śucikarmā yaḥ śṛṇoti satataṃ śivabhaktaḥ || viprasaṃsadi sadā śubhakarmā sa prayāti śivaloka makhaṃḍam || 24 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || tasyaivaṃ stuvato devaḥ śūlapāṇirvṛṣadhvajaḥ || pūrṇe varṣaśatasyāṃte prītaḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ || 25 || putra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te jātastvaṃ nirmalo'dhunā || divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 26 || yacca te manasā vāpi kiṃcicca kāṃkṣitaṃ phalam || tattatsarvaṃ pradāsyāmi brūhi dānavasattama || 27 || || dānava uvāca || || brāhmyaṃ vaiṣṇavameṃdraṃ vā padamāvṛttilakṣaṇam || viditaṃ mama tatsarvaṃ manāgapi na kāṃkṣaye || 28 || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa gāṇapatyaṃ dadasva me || saviśeṣaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca tadakṣayyaṃ ca sarvadā || 29 || || mahādeva uvāca || || amaro jarayā tyaktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || bhaviṣyasi gaṇādhyakṣaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 5.1.38.30 || kāmarūpo mahāyogī mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ || aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ priyaśca mama sarvadā || 31 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || tataśca soṃ'dhakaḥ śrīmānvarām̐llabdhvā sudurlabhān || mahādevagaṇo bhūtvā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 32 || gateṃ'dhake tato devyo brahmāṇyādyāḥ samāgatāḥ || sa devo yatra bhagavānaṃdhakasya varapradaḥ || 33 || tāstaṣṭuvurmahādevamatha tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || cāmuṃḍā ca maheśena samāśvastā śivā'bhavat || 34 || śaṃkaraṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā tāsāmagre vyavasthitam || brahmādayo'pi te hṛṣṭāstuṣṭuburvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 35 || praśāṃtāstā yadā hṛṣṭāḥ śaṃbhunā rudhirāśanāḥ|| tadā vocadidaṃ vākyaṃ tāsāṃ sthityarthamuttamam || 36 || āvaṃtye viṣaye sarvā yasmājātā mahābalāḥ || āvaṃtyamātarastasmātkhyātā loke bhaviṣyatha || || 37 || avaṃtyāṃ prītisaṃpannāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīḥ || sthirā vasaṃtyo lokānāṃ varadāśca bhaviṣyatha || 38 || śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya amāvāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ || ye drakṣyaṃti sadā bhaktyā teṣāṃ lokā mahodayāḥ || 39 || aputro labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam || rūpavānsubhago bhogī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 5.1.38.40 || haṃsayuktena yānena pitṛloke mahīyate || purīmimāṃ ca rakṣadhvaṃ kalpekalpe krameṇa tu|| 41 || evamuktvā tu deveśo gataḥ kailāsa parvatam || stūyamāno gaṇai raudrairdaityāmaragaṇeśvaraiḥ || 42 || asurasuragaṇānāṃ nāyakasyānukīrtiṃ kathayati kathanīyāṃ śraddhayā yaḥ śṛṇoti || sakala sukhanidhānaṃ rudralokaṃ sa kāṃtaṃ suragaṇadanunāthairarcitaṃ yātyanaṃtam || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'ndhakavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || || cha ||
<5.1.39>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavankṣetramāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ ca yathātatham || tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyānāṃ puṇyavardhanam || 1 || kati saṃtyatra tīrthāni liṃgāni ca tathā kati || kathayasva prasādena pṛcchato mama sāṃpratam || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || mahākālavane vyāsa liṃgasaṃkhyā na vidyate || 3 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā jāyate yo'tra mānavaḥ || mahākālavane ramye śivaloke mahīyate || 4 || kṛtakāmāni tīrthāni prāsādāyatanāni ca || teṣu snātvā śucirbhūtvā śivaloke mahīyate || 5 || puṇyāni sarvatīrthāni siddhikṣetrāṇi sarvataḥ || teṣāṃ mukhyatamaṃ viddhi kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ tathottamam || || 6 || yaḥ śṛṇoti mahābhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 7 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantya khaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye mahākālavanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || || cha ||
<5.1.40>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbhavatā sarvaṃ bhavabhītivināśakam || īśvarasthānamākhyātaṃ samaṃtātsāgrayojanam || 1 || yatra kṣetre mṛtā martyāḥ sadācārāstathottamāḥ || vimānasthā pure nūnamaiśvare te vasaṃti ca || 2 || yatra kīṭapataṃgādyā mṛtā yāṃti parāṃ gatim || kiṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyamanyacca mahākālavanādṛte || 3 || tasmādbrūhi mamaikaṃ tu praśnaṃ tathyena sāṃpratam || kathaṃ kanakaśṛṃgeti khyātā hyeṣā purā mune || 4 || kuśasthalī kathaṃ nāma tathāvaṃtī kathaṃ smṛtā || padmāvatī kathaṃ sādho kathamujjayinī tathā || 5 || nāmnāṃ hetumatho teṣāṃ brūhi tvaṃ munisattama || 6 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa pravakṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ viraṃcinā || kathitaṃ vāmadevāya gaurakalpe purātane || 7 || maheśena bhagavatā vidhiścaivātra hetutaḥ || pṛṣṭastu svaścyutānāṃ ca kuto nivasatāṃ sukham || 8 || svargaprāptiśca bhavati svecchācāravihāriṇām || ko'tipuṇyatamaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pradeśaḥ pāpadārakaḥ || 9 || kuto nivartitaṃ cittaṃ jāyate vasatāṃ kvacit || vasatāmapi loke śamaihikaṃ pāralaukikam || etanme bhagavanbrūhi hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām || || 5.1.40.10 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || evamādau purā kalpe proktaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa śaṃbhunā || 11 || provāca pārvatīkāṃtaṃ prabhuḥ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ || bhagavansarvakartā tvaṃ sarvadarśī sadāśivaḥ || 12 || ajānanniva tvaṃ sarvaṃ māṃ pṛcchasi sanātana || yatra kalpāṃtako vahniradhijvālaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || || 13 || tvameva ca mahākālaḥ sarvaṃ vai jñāyate tvayā || nātha ye mānavāstatra sadācārāstathā pare || 14 || nivasaṃti na te martyāḥ surāste vai na saṃśayaḥ || labhaṃte ca punaḥ svargaṃ mṛtā vai kālaparyaye || 15 || vartate ca purī tatra ramyaharmyā suśobhanā || yasyāṃ bhāṃti vicitrāṇi harmyāṇi vividhāni ca || 16 || svarṇaśṛṅgāśca prāsādā vihitā viśvakarmaṇā || devāḥ saṃti sadā tatra tīrthāni vividhāni ca || 17 || pūrvakalpe sthito'haṃ ca yatra tvaṃ keśavastathā || tāmeva ca purīṃ draṣṭuṃ sarve lokā hyavaṃtikām || 18 || tathā devarṣayaḥ siddhā yakṣakiṃnaradānavāḥ || ājagmuḥ sthāṇunā sārdhaṃ vedhasā brahmayoninā || 19 || tathaiva ca varā nāryo devānāmativallabhāḥ || samāpetuḥ sahasrāṇi draṣṭumatyadbhutāṃ purīm || 5.1.40.20 || āgatya ca yadā devaḥ saha devairmaheśvaraḥ || vīkṣate nagarīṃ ramyāmapaśyadāvṛtāṃ tathā || 21 || prāsādaiḥ svarṇaśṛṃgāḍhyairmaṇiratnavibhūṣitaiḥ || viśvarūpo hi bhagavānrājā viśvaika nāyakaḥ || 22 || tatrāste śobhane divye prāsāde maṇibhūṣite || sevyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhairmunividyādharoragaiḥ || 23 || tato maheśaśca pitāmahaśca sametya taṃ viśvapatiṃ nanaṃdatuḥ || samarcitau tena yathārhamādarātsahānugāvāgamanaṃ tvapṛcchat || 24 || kimāgatau vā tridivānmahītalaṃ sahānugāvāśa yakaśca kathyatām || tatastu tāvūcaturabjajeśvarau bhavāntare yatra ca tatra nau ratiḥ || 25 || tvayā vinā naiva surālaye sukhaṃ mahītale vātha rasātale' sti naḥ || kadā tvayā kāṃcanaśekharā purī niveśitā veśmavatī vicitritā || 26 || || hariruvāca || || tvadarthameveśa viśeṣaśālinī sṛṣṭā hi vai sarvaguṇākarā mayā || prayaccha viśveśvara cāvayoriha sthānaṃ ca tīrthaṃ pralaye'kṣayaṃ ca || 27 || dadāmyabhīṣṭaṃ yuvayorihālayaṃ prajāpate hyuttaratastava sthitiḥ || maheśvara tvaṃ vraja dakṣiṇālayaṃ sthānaṃ sudattaṃ yuvayoḥ suśobhanam || 28 || mahākālo hyadhojvālo jagadātmā prabhuḥ sthitaḥ || gaṇairaneka sāhasrairādṛtaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 29 || krīḍārthaṃ nagarī sṛṣṭā sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇā || mayādya yuvayordattā vihāyā'calamātmanaḥ || 5.1.40.30 || bhavadbhyāṃ hemaśṛṃ geti yasmācca samudīritā || purī kanakaśṛṃgeti loke khyātā bhaviṣyati || 31 || evaṃ kanakaśṛṅgeti prathamaṃ nāma kathyate || 32 || japaṃtaśca sthitā yatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || nityaṃ ramaṃti bhaktānāṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye kanakaśṛṅgābhidhānavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || || cha ||
<5.1.41>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa yatheyaṃ tu procyate hi kuśasthalī || kalpe tatpuruṣe pūrvaṃ vedavidbhirmanīṣibhiḥ || 1 || vedhasā sṛjitaṃ viśvaṃ daityadānavarā kṣasam || anyonyamadasaṃmattamanyonyadveṣi vai raṇe || 2 || devāśca dānavāḥ saṃkhye nityaṃ spardhāsamanvitāḥ || manuṣyā manujaiḥ sārdhaṃ siddhavidyādharaiḥ saha || 3 || cāraṇāḥ kiṃnaraiḥ sārdhamevaṃ te dveṣatatparāḥ || yuddhaṃ kurvaṃti satatamavispaṣṭārthayā girā || 4 || sarve caiva ca balino durbalairmanujaiḥ saha || paśavaḥ paśubhiḥ sārdhaṃ pakṣiṇaḥ saha pakṣibhiḥ || 5 || evamanyonyamanyaiśca nirmaryādamidaṃ jagat || dṛṣṭvā viśvasya kartāraṃ viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ param || 6 || vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇārttiharaṃ harim || evaṃ manasi saṃdhāya dadhyau dhyānena mādhavam || 7 || tato dhyāto mahāyogī viśvarūpadharo hariḥ || lohadaṇḍadharaḥ śrīmānidamāha pitāmaham || 8 || brahmandhyātastvayā samyagdhyānayogena paśya mām || samāyāṃtaṃ tathā dhyātaṃ jagatāṃ pātumudyatam || 9 || tato dhātā niśamyaitattyaktvā dhyānamavekṣya tam || samutthāyaikamanasā namaścakre'rcayatpunaḥ || 5.1.41.10 || pādyenācamanīyena madhuparkeṇa keśavam || pūjayitvā punarvākyamuvācācyutamabjajaḥ || 11 || || brahmovāca || || devadeva jagannātha jagatsṛṣṭamidaṃ tvayā || ṛte tvayā jagadviṣṇo naivāvasthātu marhati || 12 || śāstā tvamasya viśvasya viśuddhasya ca nāparaḥ || tvattostīdaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tasmāttvamanuśāsaya || 13 || devadānavagaṃdharvāḥ sayakṣo ragarākṣasāḥ || tvāmṛte puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ vyāpitāśeṣavigrahāḥ || parasparaṃ vinighnaṃti tāṃśca tvaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ || 14 || tvamasya viśvasya carācarasya sthiteḥ sadā prāṇabhṛdātmarūpiṇī || 15 || tvayā dhṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagadvai yatastato'si tvamupendrasaṃjñaḥ || praveśanaṃ vyāptamidaṃ svadhāma yattvamucyase viṣṇurato munīṃdraiḥ || 16 || nivāsitaṃ viśvamidaṃ tvayādya vāsaśca dhātoriti vāsudevaḥ || tavānugaṃ viśvamidaṃ vibhustvamaśeṣaviśvasya vibhāsi rājā || 17 || senānurūpaṃ jagadeva yasmādataḥ smṛtastvaṃ kila viśvasenaḥ || vilekhanādasya carācarasya kṛteśca dhātostvamato'si kṛṣṇaḥ || 18 || jitaṃ tvayā deva jagattrayaṃ yajjiteśca dhātostvamato'si jiṣṇuḥ || tasmātsamastagrahalokapālaṃ jagadvibho pālaya sarvakālam ||19|| tvamasya sarvasya bhavādirājastavāstu bhadrāsanamadvitīyama|| pradakṣiṇāvartanakastu śaṃkhaḥ karasthitaḥ śobhati pūruṣasya || 5.1.41.20 || sudarśanaṃ nāma tavāsti cakramato hi gītaḥ kavibhi stu cakrī || dhvajo'sti te deva suparṇasevitastathāsuparṇaśca tavāsti vāhanam ||21|| turaṃgamāḥ saṃtu tavārisaṃhare tathā hṛṣīkeśa sudantadantinaḥ|| kirīṭaniṣkāṃgadakarṇapūrakeyūrahārottamahemasūtraiḥ || 22 || vicitravastrottamaraktamālyairvibhūṣitastvaṃ bhava bhīmasenaḥ || śriyā kadācicca na mucyate bhavānbhavaṃ ti te nityamanaṃtasaṃpadaḥ || 23 || tavānugā bhaktirihāstu vai satī mukunda bhakte tvamataḥ prasīda me || 24 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || sa evamuktastu puro divaukasāṃ vibhuḥ prasannastvidamabravīddharaḥ || viriṃca me darśaya tasya maṃḍalaṃ tvayā vimuktaṃ ca sadāśivaṃ vibho || 25 || sthiraṃ sthi yatra jagatkaromyahaṃ tato viraṃciḥ kuśamuṣṭimādade || pavitradeśasya nidarśanāya jagāma puṇyaṃ cyavanāśramaṃ tadā || 26 || tataḥ sthalīmuccatarāmavāpya pitāmahaḥ keśavamāha cādarāt || tvadudbhavaṃ cātra pavitramaṃḍalaṃ tvayā vimuktaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ vibho || 27 || tvameva viṣṇurvibudhārcitaḥ sadā smṛto munīṃdraiḥ sa ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ || niṣīda viśveśa kuśasthalaṃ yadā tadāśrito mādhavamāsarūpavān || 28 || kuśasthalīṃ saṃsthita eva deva itthaṃ vidhātrā puruṣottamaḥ stutaḥ || sthalīṃ kuśairāstaritāmupāviśatkuśasthalīṃ devamunīndrasevitām || 29 || samaṃtato yojanasaṃ khyayāvṛtāṃ tato vidhātā puruṣottamastathā || kuśasthalīti prathitaṃ jagattraye pracakraturnāma ca tāvubhāvapi || 5.1.41.30 || tatra viśvapatiḥ śrīmānviśveśo viśvakṛdvibhuḥ || viśvaṃ śaśāsa viśvātmā sarvaviśvasya nāyakaḥ || 31 || evaṃ kuśasthalī khyātā hemaśṛṅgeti yā purā || stīrṇā kuśairyato dhātrā kuśasthalī tataḥ smṛtā || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye vyāsasanatkumārasaṃvāde kuśasthalīnāmahetukathāvarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || || cha || ||
<5.1.42>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā caiśānakalpe tu smṛtāvaṃtī yathā purī || tathā śṛṇu suraiḥ pūrvaṃ daityasainyaparājitaiḥ || 1 || āśritaṃ meruśikharaṃ vanakaṃdaguhāvṛtam|| tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭha maṃtraṃ ca cakrurudyatāḥ||2|| anyonyaṃ ca samāsādya samabhyarcya parasparam|| jagmuḥ sarve suragaṇā yatra brahmā prajāpatiḥ||3|| nivedayāṃcakrire sarvaṃ tatrāgamanakāraṇam|| teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ sa prajeśvaraḥ||4|| jagāma tridaśaiḥ sākaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram|| sa cāpi hyagamattatra vaikuṭhaṃ dhāma yatra vai || 5 || ṛddhisiddhipradaṃ nityaṃ municāraṇasevitam || kinnarairgīyamānaṃ ca apsarogaṇasevitam || 6 || ṛṣibhirbhārgavādibhirdevarṣināradottamaiḥ || siddhagaṃdharvamukhyaiśca kumāraiḥ sanakādibhiḥ || 7 || prajāpatigaṇākīrṇaṃ mānavaiśca caturdaśaiḥ || vasubhirviśvedevaiśca pitṝṇāmuttamairgaṇaiḥ || 8 || saṃsevyaṃ ca sadācāraiḥ puṇyavadbhirjanaistathā || divyaṃ divyaiśca prāsādairdivyapādapaśobhitam || 9 || maṇiratnaiśca sopānai rdivyaṃ sarasaśobhitam || haṃsakāraṃḍavākīrṇaṃ maṇibhābhiḥ subhāsvaram || 5.1.42.10 || ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ sthānaṃ yatra tiṣṭhanti pakṣiṇaḥ || tatra gatvā surāḥ sarve vāsu devadidṛkṣayā || stutimārebhire kartuṃ devadevajagatpateḥ ||11 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namo'naṃtāya bṛhate kūrmāya vai namonamaḥ || 12 || nṛsiṃharūpāyogrāya namo vārāharūpiṇe || rāghavāya ca rāmāya brahmaṇe'naṃtaśaktaye || 13 || vāsudevāya śāṃtāya yadūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || namo buddhāya śuddhāya kalkaye mlecchanāśine || 14 || iti stavābhiyuktānāṃ vāguvācāśarīriṇī || śṛṇudhvaṃ bhoḥ surāḥ sarve bhūtvā caikāgramānasāḥ || 15 || mahākālavane ramye brahmarṣigaṇasevite || tatra puṇyā purī hyekā sarvakāmaphalapradā || 16 || nāmnā kuśasthalī ramyā siddhagaṃdharvasevitā || kalpādau kalpamadhye vā yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || 17 || kalpakṣaye kṣayaṃ yāṃti sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || tīrthāni caiva sarvāṇi puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 18 || saritaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve sarāṃsyupavanāni ca || auṣadhīrvṛkṣavallīśca yaṃtraṃ maṃtraṃ śubhāśubham || 19 || jyotīṃṣi caṃdrasūryau ca sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat || teṣāṃ bījaṃ ca puṇyaṃ ca jīvakarmāśaya tathā || 5.1.42.20 || sarvamādāya bhagavāñchaṃkarastatra tiṣṭhati || sarvatīrthamayī gaṃgā sarvadevamayo hariḥ || 21 || sarvayajñamayo vedaḥ sarvadharmamayī dayā || revā ca saritāṃ śreṣṭhā bhuvi puṇyakṛtādhikā || 22 || tasmāddhitakaraṃ kṣetraṃ kurūṇāṃ vai surottamāḥ || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ manye prayāgaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 23 || tasmāddaśaguṇā kāśī kāśyā daśaguṇā gayā || tato daśaguṇā proktā kuśasthalī ca puṇyadā || 24 || uparāgasahasrāṇi vyatipātāyutāni ca || amālakṣaṃ tu etasyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 25 || lakṣamiṃdukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ cāyanadvaye || vyatīpāte ca koṭiḥ syādrā kāyāṃ ca hyanaṃtakam || 26 || tasmāddhitakarā devā purī hyeṣā kuśasthalī || anaṃtā'naṃtasaṃkhyātaṃ dānaṃ kiṃcitkṛtaṃ naraiḥ || 27 || tatsarvaṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭhāḥ sarvaṃ taccākṣayaṃ bhavet || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yūyaṃ yāta hi mā ciram || 28 || kṣīṇapuṇyā bhavaṃto vai bādhaṃte tena vaḥ surāḥ || mahākālavane ramye purī hyeṣā kuśasthalī || 29 || tatra gatvā bhavaṃto vai snānadānādikaṃ bhuvi || ācaradhvaṃ suvidhinā puṇyātsvargamavāpsyatha || 5.1.42.30 || etacchutvā vacastasyā vāṇyāścākāśagaṃ tadā || praṇamya śirasā tasyai brahmeśānapurogamāḥ || 31 || punarjagmuḥ surāḥ sarve yatra māheśvaraṃ vanam || purīṃ caiva dvijaśreṣṭha sarvakāmaphalapradām || 32 || cāturvarṇyasamākīrṇāmṛṣigaṃdharvasevitām || puṇyavadbhirjanaiḥ pūrṇāṃ siddhacāraṇasevitām || 33 || daridro na jaḍo mūrkho na rogī na ca matsarī || na vyādhito nāpakārī janaḥ kvacitpradṛśyate || 34 || dātā śāṃtāḥ suśīlāśca jarārogavivarjiṃtāḥ || svadharmaniratā nityaṃ sadācārātithipriyāḥ || 35 || narā yatra nivasaṃti nāryaścaiva pativratāḥ || mahotsavāḥ sugītāni havyaṃ kavyaṃ gṛhegṛhe || 36 || īdṛśīṃ ca purīṃ dṛṣṭvā devā harṣaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ || tatra tīrthaṃ samākhyātaṃ nāmnā paiśācamocanam || 37 || puṇyavadbhiḥ sadā sevyaṃ sarvatīrthaniṣe vitam || tasminsnātvā ca japtvā ca hutvā dattvā ca devatāḥ || 38 || puṇyaṃ cāthākṣayaṃ labdhvā punaryātāḥ surālayam || jitvā'surānmahāduṣṭānsthānaṃ prāptāḥ svakaṃsvakam|| 39 || ye'syāṃ kuryurmahābhāgāḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ tathārcanam || havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ pitṝṃstatsarvaṃ syāddhyanaṃtakam || 5.1.42.40 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena etatkāryaṃ sadā budhaiḥ|| devatīrthoṣadhībījabhūtānāṃ caiva pālanam || 41 || kalpekalpe ca yasyāṃ vai tenāvaṃtī purī smṛtā || adyaprabhṛti purī hyeṣā nāmnāvaṃtī kuśasthalī ||42 || ityuktvā vai tadā devāḥ svadhāma paramaṃ gatāḥ || tadārabhya dvijaśreṣṭha hyavaṃtī bhuvi viśrutā || 43 || ya etāṃ sukathāṃ divyāṃ puṇyāṃ ca pāpahāriṇīm|| śṛṇuyācchrāvayedyo vai sarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyate || 44 || aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt || vājapeyasahasrāṇāṃ rājasūyaśatādhikam || 45 || puṇyaṃ labdhvā naro nityaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'vaṃtyabhidhānakathāvarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || || cha ||
<5.1.43>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || ekasminnaṃtare vyāsa yathojjayanī smṛtā purī || tathāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ samāhitaḥ || 1 || tripurākhyo mahādaityaḥ sarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ || tapastepe sudurdharṣaṃ brahmaṇastuṣṭikāraṇāt|| 2 || ātape cāgnisevāṃ vai prāvṛṣi meghaḍaṃbaram || damayitvā tadātmānaṃ śītakāle jalāśaye || 3 || śīrṇapatra jalāhāro vāyubhakṣī nirāśrayaḥ || gāyatrīvratamāsthāya tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ ||4|| evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tapastaptaṃ suduścaram || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu brahmā prītatamo 'bravīt||5|| vriyatāṃ bho'suraśreṣṭha varaṃ mattobhivāṃchitam|| tatsarvaṃ sāṃprataṃ loke varaṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmi vai|| || 6|| evamuktaḥ sa vidhinā daityastripurasaṃjñitaḥ|| uvāca vacanaṃ sadyo brahmāṇaṃ saṃśitavratam|| tripura uvāca|| yadi tuṣṭamanā brahmanvaraṃ me dātumicchasi|| devadānagaṃdharvapiśācoragarākṣasaiḥ || avadhyo'haṃ sadā bhūyāṃ varametadvṛṇomyaham || 8 || || brahmovāca || || evaṃ bhavatu bho vatsa vicarasvākutobhayaḥ || ityuktvā sahasā brahmā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||9|| tadārabhya mahādaityo devānāṃ kadanaṃ mahat || cakāra kopapūrṇo vai pūrvavairamanusmaran || 5.1.43.10 || vāsayitvā yatra tatra tripurāṇi carāṇi ca || atra vāsakṛtaḥ sarve varṇāśramaparā janāḥ || 11 || teṣāṃ vai kadanaṃ cakre nānopāyena pāpadhīḥ || tasminpure duṣṭavāse brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || 12 || na juhuyuścāgnihotraṃ somapānaṃ na karhicit || kutaścitsukṛtaṃ karma janāḥ kurvaṃti no mune || 13 || svāhākārasvadhākāravaṣaṭkāravivarjitāḥ || notsavo dṛśyate gehe kasyacidbhuvi vistṛtaḥ || 14 || devatāyatanaṃ nāsti tathā no śivapūjanam || nāsti yajño na dānāni na gobrāhmaṇapūjanam || || 15 || sadācārajano nāsti dayā mānavivarjitā || na dānī nopakārī ca tapasvī naiva dṛśyate || 16 || evaṃ vyāsa pure tasminnaṣṭaprāyamidaṃ jagat || prajānāṃ brāhmaṇā mūlaṃ vedamūlā hi brāhmaṇāḥ || 17 || vedamūlaparā yajñā yajñamūlā hi devatāḥ || tasmādvyāsa hataṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena durātmanā || || 16 || tena devagaṇāḥ sarve hataprāyā hataujasaḥ || vicaraṃti yathā martyā bhuvi tena parājitāḥ || 19 || anyonyakṛtasaṃdhānā maṃtraṃ kṛtvā samā hitāḥ || jagmuste tatra yatrāste prajāpatirakalmaṣaḥ || 5.1.43.20 || tridaśāḥ kathayāmāsurātmavyasanakāraṇam || tajjñātvā sahasotthāya brahmā lokapitā mahaḥ || 21 || jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ mahākālavanotamam || yatrāste satataṃ deva umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ || 22 || yatrāvaṃtī purī divyā sarvatīrthaniṣevitā || tatrāgatya suraiḥ sākaṃ svayaṃbhūścaturānanaḥ ||23|| snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā rudrasare tadā || pūjayitvā mahākālaṃ brahmā vacanamabravīt ||24|| || || brahmovāca || || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara || śrūyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭha devakāryamanuttamam ||25|| tripuronāma daityeṃdro devānāṃ kadanaṃ mahat || karoti satataṃ daityo devabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ ||26|| vāsayitvā purastisro vistīrṇā vicaratyatha || tatra sthitāni bhūtāni nāśaṃ yāṃti durātmanā ||27|| evaṃ kṛtvā prajāḥ sarvāḥ kṣayaṃ nītāścarācarāḥ || udvāsitāni dvīpāni grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca ||28|| ṛṣīṇāmāśramāḥ sarve yatīnāmāyatanāni ca || evaṃ kṛtvā surāḥ sarve bhraṣṭarājyāḥ parājitāḥ || 29 || vicaraṃti yathā martyāstripureṇa durātmanā || matto labdhavaro nityaṃ vrajatyevākutobhayaḥ || || 5.1.43.30 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vadhastasya viciṃtyatām || 31 || iti śrutvā vacastasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃśitātmanaḥ || ciraṃ dhyātvā mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ tamuvāca ha || 32 || || mahādeva uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭhā brahmaśakrapurogamāḥ || jayopāyaṃ kariṣyāmi daityasyāsya durātmanaḥ ||33|| tapaścarata yūyaṃ vā ātmano jayakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || avaṃtyāṃ yaddhutaṃ dattaṃ tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 34 || ityuktvā sarvadevānāṃ tatraivāṃtarhitaḥ śivaḥ || gatvā smaśānanilaye bhūtapretaniṣevite || 35 || jayārthaṃ tasya daityasya tripurasya durātmanaḥ || upāsāṃcakrire tatra cāmuṇḍāyāḥ sureśvarāḥ|| || 36 || mahiṣaiśca mahāmedhyaiḥ paśupuṣpārghatarpaṇaiḥ || balibhirvividhairdānairdhūpadīpāgnitarpaṇaiḥ || pūjayitvā tadā devīṃ tāmīḍe vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 37 || durgāṃ bhagavatīṃ bhadrāṃ durgasaṃsāratāraṇīm || tripurāṃtakāriṇīṃ kṛtyāṃ caṃḍamuṃḍavadhodyamām || 38 || daityamedomadonmattāṃ raktākhyāṃ raktadaṃtikām || raktāṃbaradharāṃ dhīrāṃ raktapuṣpāvatīṃ satīm || 39 || mahiṣavāhinīṃ śyāmāṃ yakṣāsanaparigrahām || dvīpicarmaparīdhānāṃ śuṣkamāṃsāti bhairavām || 5.1.43.40 || pūjayitvā prasannātmā dhyānamāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ || tadā bhagavatī bhadrā yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat || prasannavadanā bhūtvā pratyakṣaṃ prāha caṃḍikā || 41 || || devyuvāca || || vriyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭha varaṃ matto'bhivāṃchitam || sarvaṃ tvayoktaṃ yacchāmi jagatāmupakārakam || 42 || || śrīhara uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭāsi vai devi dehi me varamuttamam || yena hanmi mahādaityaṃ tripuraṃ devakaṃṭakam || 43 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || jaya hyenaṃ mahādeva gṛhāṇa pāśupataṃ param || mayā dattaṃ suraśreṣṭha daityanāśakaraṃ param || 44 || mahāpāśupataṃ śastraṃ kare kṛtvā ca śaṃkaraḥ || 45 || ujjahāra tadā śaṃbhurdaityanāśāya satvaraḥ || mahāḍaṃbariko bhūtvā sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ || 46 || stutiṃ kṛtvā yayau vāgbhiḥ pṛṣṭhato'nuyayuḥ surāḥ || śareṇaikena vai rudro jaghāna taṃ mahāsuram || 47 || māyinaṃ taṃ tridhā bhittvā māyāyuddhena śaṃkaraḥ || punarāgātpurīmetāmavaṃtīmamarasevitām || 48 || jayāśiṣā prayuṃjānā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || tuṣṭuvuśca tadā devā jayaśabdena harṣitāḥ || 49 || apsarā nanṛtustatra gaṃdharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ || vavau tadā puṇyatamo vāyuḥ sukhaprado nṛṇām ||5.1.43.50|| jayaśabdastadā jātaḥ prāṇināṃ ca gṛhegṛhe || jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtā digja nitasvanāḥ || 51 || pravartaṃte tadā yajñā mahotsavasadakṣiṇāḥ || devāḥ prapedire sthānaṃ svakīyaṃ punarādṛtam || 52 || ujjito dānavo yasmāttrailokye sthāpitaṃ yaśaḥ || tasmātsarvaiḥ suraśreṣṭhairṛṣibhiḥ sanakādibhiḥ || 53 || kṛtaṃ nāma hyavaṃtyā vā ujjayinī pāpanāśinī || avaṃtī ca purā proktā sarvakāmavarapradā || 54 || adyaprabhṛti purī vyāsa ujjayinī samāśritāḥ || ye'syāṃ ca snānadānādi bhuvi kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 55 || na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃciddehe tiṣṭhati pāpajam || 56 || vidyārthī girīśaṃ dhanārthī dhaneśaṃ sutārthī suteśaṃ dineśaṃ sukhārthī || dhiyorthī gaṇeśaṃ priyārthī vasedvai girāṃ grāhya mānī janaścojjayinyām || 57 ya etasyāṃ mahābhāga sadā vasati mānavaḥ || bhuktvā kāmānmano'bhīṣṭānmṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 58 || tatraiva vasate nityaṃ kalpakoṭiśatādhikam || 59 || ya etāṃ vai kathāṃ puṇyāṃ paṭhate śṛṇute'tha vā || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 5.1.43.60 ||| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye ujjayinyabhidhānakathanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || || cha ||
<5.1.44>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi padmāvatī yathā'bhavat || śṛṇuṣva cādṛto vyāsa bahupuṇyakṛtāṃ kathām || 1 || ekadā sarvaratnānāṃ hānirjātā durātmabhiḥ|| dharmaglānirnirodhaśca jāto vai duṣṭadānavaiḥ || 2 || tadā surāsuraiḥ sarvairmilitvā mathitoṃ'bu dhiḥ || merurvaṃśodadhiḥ pātraṃ rajjurvāsukipannagaḥ || 3 || kūrmapṛṣṭhe vidhiṃ kṛtvā ratnāni duduhustadā || ādau lakṣmīrviniryātā kṛṣṇāya pratipāditā || || 4 || tena kṛtvā viṣādo'bhūddevadānavayostadā || etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado devadarśanaḥ||| 5 || vāritaḥ kalahastena devadaityasamudbhavaḥ || mahākālavane sā'stu padmā siṃdhusamudbhavā || 6 || sāgarāṃte ca ratnāni tiṣṭhaṃti vividhāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi cādāya bhavatāṃ vai dadāmyaham || 7 || mathyatāmudadhiḥ śīghraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| punaste tūdyamaṃ cakruramṛtārthaṃ surāsurāḥ || 8 || mathyamāneṃ'budhau teṣāṃ maṇiḥ prāptaśca kaustubhaḥ || parijātataruḥ paścātsurā jātā tataḥ param || 9 || dhanvaṃtarirathotpannaścaṃdro jāto'pi vai tataḥ || kāmadhenustato jātā gajaratnaṃ tataḥ param || 5.1.44.10 || uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭhaḥ sudhā raṃbhā tatastataḥ || tataḥ paraṃ ca sāraṃgaṃ dhanuḥ sarvāstrasaṃbhavam || 11 || pāṃcajanyastathā śaṃkhaḥ kare tiṣṭhati muradviṣaḥ || nidhireṣa mahāpadmo viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ tataḥ || 12 || caturdaśāpi ratnāni prāptāni vividhāni ca || samādāya gatāstatra yatra māheśvaraṃ vanam || 13 || gatvā te ca samāsīnā maṃtraṃ cakruḥ parasparam || ahaṃpūrvamahaṃpūrvamiti te samayaṃtritāḥ || 14 || kolāhalastathotpanno nāradaḥ punarabhyagāt || teṣāṃ kalimalaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumārādhayattataḥ || 15 || mohanīrūpamāsthāya nārībhūtvābhyagāddhariḥ || atirūpavatī tanvī tāmālokya mahāsurāḥ || 16 || vihvalāṃgāśca te sarve kāmabāṇavaśaṃgatāḥ || etasminnaṃtare teṣāṃ surāṃ prādātsureśvaraḥ || 17 || hastalāghavayogena devānāmamṛtaṃ dadau || etasminnaṃtare vyāsa rāhustadrū padhārakaḥ || 18 || teṣāmaṃtarago bhūtvā papau cāmṛtamuttamam || tajjñātvā ca drutaṃ viṣṇuḥ śiraścakreṇa cācchinat ||19|| sudhāsparśaprasaṃgena na mamārāsurastadā || rāhuḥ keturiti khyātau kṣetre'sminmunisattama || 5.1.44.20 || rāhukāyātsamudbhūtaṃ bahu susrāva śoṇitam || tasminkṣetre mahattīrthaṃ jātaṃ taddoṣa nāśanam || 21 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā rāhordarśanatatparāḥ || na teṣāṃ jāyate kiṃcidrāhupīḍā kadācana || 22 || vāṃchitārthamavāpnoti gosahasra phalaṃ bhavet || tatastāni ca ratnāni mahākālavane surāḥ|| 23 || vibhajya bhāgāṃste sarve prāpya ratnabhujo'bhavan || maṇiṃ padmāṃ dhanuḥ śaṃkhaṃ viṣṇave nāra do dadau || 24 || sūryāya ca dadau hyaśvaṃ saptāsyaṃ cābdhisaṃbhavam || airāvataṃ gajaśreṣṭhaṃ vāsavāya samarpayat || 25 || pīyūṣaṃ diviṣadgaṇāndadau caṃdraṃ ca śaṃbhave || pārijātaṃ taruśreṣṭhaṃ raṃbhāṃ caiva varāṃganām || 26 || iṃdrakrīḍāvane ramye naṃdane ca samarpayat || ṛṣīṇāṃ samadāddhenuṃ kāmadogdhrīṃ yajñasiddhaye || 27 || nidhireṣa mahāpadmaḥ kuberabhavanaṃ gataḥ || yattaddhālāhalaṃ proktaṃ viṣaṃ kenāpi nādṛtam || 28 || yatoyataḥ prasarati pralayaṃ yāṃti jaṃtavaḥ || dadhāra tadviṣaṃ śaṃbhurjagatāṃ hitakāmyayā || 29 || tadāprabhṛti mahādevo nīlakaṃṭha iti smṛtaḥ || ratnakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā nīlagrīvaṃ ca paśyati || 5.1.44.30 || muktvā sa sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvaratnabhujo bhavet || śatāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ labdhvā śivapuraṃ vrajet || 31 || tadādāya surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || ūcuśca te tadā vyāsa harṣanirbharamānasāḥ || 32 || ujjayinīṃ samāsādya jātā ratnabhujo vayam || padmāyāśca nivāsena yasmātsarvasukhāvahā || 33 || tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu padmā vasatu niścalā || adyaprabhṛti pūreṣā padmāvatīti ca smṛtā || 34 || ya etasyāṃ mahābhāgāḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ tathārcanam || tarpaṇaṃ caiva devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 35 || na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcinna dāridryaṃ na durgatiḥ || śataṃ kulāni sarvāṇi tārayennirayāttadā || 36 || dhanārthī caiva putrārtho vidyārtho bahukāmukaḥ || yatrakutra sthito bhūtvā padmāvatīti ca smaret || 37 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti śivaḥ sākṣādbhavennaraḥ || etadvyāsa phalaṃ nāmnaḥ kiṃ ciraṃ sevanena vai || 38 || ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ ye śrāvayaṃti nityaśaḥ || na teṣāṃ pātakaṃ kiṃcidaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye padmāvatīnāmakathāvarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃ śo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || cha ||
<5.1.45>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvāvahito vyāsa kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || eṣā kumudvatī jātā yathā padmāvatī purī || tathāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā me lomaśo'bravīt || 1 || || lomaśa uvāca || || śṛṇu vatsa mayā dṛṣṭā bahupuṇyatamā purī || ekadā tīrthayātrāyāṃ gato'haṃ vai kuśasthalīm || guhyādguhyataraṃ sthānaṃ yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || 2 || yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || yatra tatra sthitā viprā brahmaghoṣamakurvata || 3 || yajñāṃścaiva tathā citrānṛtvijodārakarmaṇaḥ || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāḥ prakurvaṃti samāhitāḥ || 4 || ṛṣipatnyastathā sādhvyaḥ paricaryāṃ prakurvate || daśa viṣṇusamāḥ khyātāstatraiva nivasaṃti te || 5 || rudrā hyekādaśa proktā dvādaśārkāstathaiva ca || aṣṭau ca vasavaḥ khyātā viśve devāstrayodaśa || 6 || aṣṭau ca diggajāścaiva manavaśca caturdaśa || marudgaṇāśca te sarve tatraiveṃdrapurogamāḥ || 7 || gaṃdharvāsarasaścaiva kiṃnaroragarākṣasāḥ | siddhāstapasvino vatsa tatraiva samupasthitāḥ ||8|| aṣṭau vai bhairavāḥ khyātāścatvāraḥ pavanātmajāḥ || vināyakāśca ṣaṭ proktā devyaśca caturviṃśatiḥ || || 9 || ete devagaṇāḥ proktā raudrāścaiva tathā gaṇāḥ || brahmā vedavidāṃ śreṣṭho maricikaśyapādayaḥ || 5.1.45.10 || dakṣaḥ prajāpatiśreṣṭho ditirvai devamātaraḥ | surabhīpramukhā gāvaḥ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 11 || tīrthāni yāni sarvāṇi nadyaḥ prasravaṇāni ca || kṣetrāṇi caiva sarvāṇi bhuvi puṇyatamāni vai || 12 || sapta puryastrayo grāmā navāraṇyā navoṣarāḥ || caturdaśāni guhyāni muktidvārāṇi bhūtale || 13 || samudrāścaiva catvāro ratnāni vividhāni ca || satī pativratāḥ sādhvyastathā brahmarṣayo'malāḥ || rājarṣayastathā śāṃtā brāhmaṇā
