visarjayettato viprāndattvā tāṃbūladakṣiṇāḥ || caturbhirmiṃlitairdevi tāṃbūlaṃ mama vallabham || 55 || yo dadāti dvijaśreṣṭhe sa bhavetsubhago naraḥ || subhagā ca sadācārā vallabhā svajane sadā || 56 || putrasaubhāgyayuktā ca tāṃbūlairjāyate priye || patraistu keśavaḥ prītaḥ pūgairīśaḥ sahomayā || 57 || cūrṇakenānalaḥ prītaḥ khadireṇa tu manmathaḥ || caturbhirviśvarūpo'sau yaḥ puṣṇāti jagattrayam || 58 || paritoṣya sapatnīkānhaste dattvā ca modakān || ā sīmāṃtamanuvrajya bhuṃjīta saha baṃdhubhiḥ ||59|| asaṃkrāṃte vrataṃ nārī yā karotīha supriye || dāridryaṃ putraśokaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit ||5.1.60.60|| naro vā yadi vā nārī yaḥ kuryācca malimluce || sa sarvasukhabhoktā ca bhavennāstyeva saṃśayaḥ || 61 || malimluce prāpya na pūjito yairnārāyaṇo'haṃ parayeha bhaktyā || kathaṃ bhaveyuḥ sukhaputrasaṃpatsuhṛtsubhāryāḥ suguṇairupetāḥ ||62|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṃḍe 'vantīkṣetramāhātmye puruṣottamamāhātmye dānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 || || cha ||
<5.1.61>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || adhimāsaṃ samāsādya yo'nyatra sthitimātmanaḥ || karoti sa naro mūrkho mahākālavanādṛte || 1 || adhimāse naro vyāsa tīrthe puruṣottamābhidhe || snātvā dattvā ca dānāni teṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || 2 || puruṣottamaṃ samabhyarcya ramālālitapādakam || tathaiva ca umāṃ devīṃ śaṃkareṇa ca pūjayet || 3 || vāṃchitārthaśataṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || bhādrapade site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || upoṣya vidhivadvyāsa rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 4 || viṣṇośca pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ jalayātrā tathaiva ca || puruṣottamasare nityaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 5 || putradāradhanaṃ samyagāyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ||6|| tasya pūrvatare bhāge jaṭeśvaramaheśvaraḥ || tiṣṭhati tāpasastīre yatra rājā bhagīrathaḥ || 7 || tapastaptvā paraṃ lebhe puṇyaṃ puṇyavatāṃ varaḥ || gaṃgāṃ bhūtalamānīya sarvalokasukhāya vai || 8 || tasya tīrthe naraḥ snātvā tiladhenuṃ pradāpayet || sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya putravāñjā yate naraḥ||9|| tasyeśānatare bhāge rāmo bhārgavasattamaḥ|| tapastepe sudharmātmā ātmakāyaviśuddhaye||5.1.61.10|| kauśikī ca saricchreṣṭhā sarvatīrthavarapradā|| tatra snātvā naro jātihatyādoṣavivarjitaḥ ||11|| rāmeśvaraṃ samālokya dhūtapāpo bhavennaraḥ|12|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye puruṣottameśvaramāhātmye'dhimāsasnānadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||61||
<5.1.62>
|| vyāsa uvāca || gomatīkuṇḍaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purā brahmansanātanam || kasminkāle kadā jātaṃ tanno vada suvistarāt || 1 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || śṛṇuṣva bho mahāprājña kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || gomatīkuṇḍodbhavāṃ puṇyāṃ purā rudreṇa bhāṣitām || 2 || naimiṣe ca samāsīnā ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ || kathayaṃti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvatīrthodbhavāṃ śubhām || 3 || tasminnavasare puṇye kāśīmāhātmyamuttamam || kathitaṃ nāradenaiva pavitraṃ pāpahārakam || 4 || ūṣaraḥ puṇya pāpānāṃ dhanyā vārāṇasī purī || dhruvaṃ labhaṃte mokṣaṃ ca samaṃ caṃḍālapaṃḍitāḥ || 5|| asīvaruṇayormadhye paṃcakrośī mahāphalam || amarā maraṇamicchanti kā kathā itare janāḥ || 6 || iti smṛtvā tadā vyāsa svayaṃbhūḥ pratyabhāṣata || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca paraṃtapa || 7 || nadī na gomatītulyā kṛṣṇatulyā na devatā || sarvapātālabhūmadhye na dvārakāsamā purī || 8 || iti te niścayaṃ jñātvā ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ || yatra tatra sthitāḥ sarve prātaḥsaṃdhyāmupāsitum|| 9 || tatraiva gomatītīre cakruste lā dhṛtavratāḥ || sāṃdīpano'pi tatraiva prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ samācarat || 5.1.62.10 || evaṃ bahutithe kāle caratastasya vai vratam|| sāṃdīpanasya vai vyāsa hyavaṃtīpuravāsinaḥ||11|| tasyaiva kāmapūrtyarthaṃ vidyārthinau rāmajanārdanau || samāyātau sukumārāṃgau satataṃ brahmacāriṇau || 12 || nivāsaṃ cakratustasya gurorgehe paraṃtapa || tasya pāṭhayataḥ samyagvidyāṃ sarvaśrutīḥ param || 13 || uṣasyuṣasi tatraiva dṛśyate na tadā guruḥ || vidyopadeśakālo'yaṃ kva gato nau gururvaraḥ || 14 || iti pṛṣṭe tayorevaṃ gurupatnī hyuvāca ha || sadaiva kurute vatsa prātaḥsaṃdhyādyupāsa nam || 15 || tatraiva yāti vai nityaṃ guruste snānakāraṇāt || gomatī vai saricchreṣṭhā dvārakāyāṃ ca pāvanī ||16|| iti śrutvā tadā kṛṣṇo rāmeṇa saha saṃyutaḥ || kiṃ kartavyamihāsmābhirātmano hitamuttamam || 17 || gurorāgamanaṃ kāṃkṣe atraiva sthitikāṃkṣayā || etasminneva kāle tu sāṃdīpaniragā dgṛham|| 18 || tata utthāya tau vīrau gurorāvaṃdanaṃ tataḥ || praśrayāvanatau kṛtvā hyabrūtāṃ vacanaṃ gurum || 19 || śrūyatāṃ bho mahāyoginnasmākaṃ vāsakāra ṇam|| vidyārthināviha prāptau yuṣmākaṃ ca gṛhottame || 5.1.62.20 || prātaḥkāle ca te brahmansamayo nāsti nau prabho || etacchutvā vacastasya kṛṣṇasya ca balasya ca || 21 || uvāca bhagavānvyāsa ātmano vratakāraṇam || asmākaṃ paramaṃ vatsa vrataṃ vai śāśvataṃ matam || 22 || gomatīsnānaṃ kartavyaṃ prātaḥkāle sadā budhaiḥ || tatraivopāsanaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃdhyāyā iti niścitam || 23 || iti niścitya yuṣmābhiryadyogyaṃ kriyatāṃ tathā || tacchrutvā bhagavānviṣṇurmāyāmānuṣarūpavān || 24 || gomatyārādhanaṃ cakre kuśasthalyāṃ dvijottama || yatra śiveśvaro devo yajñakuṇḍamanuttamam || 25 || kaṃthaḍeśvarasyottare bhāge gomatī sā samāgatā || pātālatalamābhedya sarasvatyā sahāgatā || 26 || prātarutthāya te sarve gomatīṃ saritāṃ varām || dadṛśuḥ sucirāpāṃgīṃ vyāsa svāśramagāminīm || 27 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || atraiva cāgatā brahmangomatī saritāṃvarā || snānadānādikaṃ sarvamatraiva samupāsaya|| 28 || gomatyatra samālīnā yajñakuṇḍe sarasvatī || tadāprabhṛti loke'smingomatīkuṇḍamucyate || 29 || sarveṣāmapi lokānāṃ mārgo' traiva ca vidyate || tasmādvyāsa mahāpuṇyaṃ bhuvi tīrthamanuttamam|| 5.1.62.30 || gomatīkuṇḍamākhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇānaśanam || bhādre māsyasitā'ṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇa janmasamudbhavam || 31|| tatra snātvā naro nityaṃ rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || upoṣya vidhivadvyāsa saśiṣyaṃ vyāsamarcayet || 32 || vaiṣṇavāṃśca narāṃścaiva kṛṣṇajanmotsukānvarān|| nānāsugaṃdhapuṣpādyairvastrālaṃkārasaṃyutaiḥ || 33 || gobrāhmaṇānāṃ pūjāśca kriyate yaiḥ samāhitaiḥ || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcitsarvalokeṣu vidyate || 34 || gomatīsnānajātpuṇyādvāsudevasamāgamāt || manorathaphalaprāptirjāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 35 || tathā caitrasite pakṣe yāvaccaikādaśī bhavet || taddine ca naraḥ snātvā gomatyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 36 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇupūjāṃ tathaiva ca || āmalakīṃ tato gatvā pradakṣiṇātpadepade || 37 || gosahasraphalaṃ teṣāṃ prāpyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ pavitrāṃ pāpahāriṇīm || 38 || sarvapāpavinirmuktā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāṃti te || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye gomatītīrthakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||
<5.1.63>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || kaṃthaḍeśvara iti khyātaṃ tatra tīrthamanuttamam || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 1 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || vimānaśatasaṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 2 || bhuvi puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param || khagartāsaṃgamo yatra gaṃgeśvarasamīpataḥ || 3 || mahāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || ākāśātpatitā yatra gaṃgā trailokya pāvanī || 4 || vidhṛtā śirasi sadyo mahādevena śaṃbhunā || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā gaṃgeśamavalokayet || 5 || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇu loke mahīyate || vīreśvaramanuprāpya tasmiṃstīrthe naro vaset || 6 || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā vīralokamavāpnuyāt|| tīrthamanyanmahāpuṇyaṃ bhuvi khyātaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 7 || vāmanakuṇḍeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 8 || manorathaśataṃ prāpya paścādviṣṇu puraṃ vrajet || || vyāsa uvāca || || kadā kāle samutpannaṃ vāmanākhyaṃ purā'nagha || 9 || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || 5.1.63.10 || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpātpramucyate || daityeṃdrastu purā prokto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 11 || prahrāda iti vikhyātaḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || ācāravijito dharmaḥ satyena vijitā ramā || 12 || dhairyeṇa ca dhṛtā lokāḥ kṣamayā vidhṛtā mahī || gāṃbhīryeṇā'rṇavā divyāḥ śauryeṇa śatruṇā gaṇāḥ || 13 || praśrayeṇābhyāgatāśca jitāstena mahātmanā ||| dakṣiṇābhirjito yajño haviṣā havyavāhanaḥ || 14 || śaucā''cāraviśuddhātmā tapasā ca hatā'śubhaḥ || dānamānajitā viprā bhojanācchādanā dibhiḥ || 15 || saṃskāreṇa jitaṃ janma damenā''tmā sanātanaḥ || prāṇāyāmajito vāyuryogadhyānajito hariḥ || 16 || īdṛśaśca mahāyogī satyadharma parāyaṇaḥ || prahlādena samo dhīro na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 17 || tasya pautraḥ sadācārī balirityabhidhīyate || tasya pālayataḥ samyakprajāḥ samyagvivardhitāḥ || 18 || nālpāyurna jaḍo mūrkho na rogī na ca matsarī || aputro dravyahīnaśca ko'pi nā'sti mahītale || 19 || mahārājo mahīpālo yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ || saptadvīpavatī tena pālitā vasudhā sadā || 5.1.63.20 || ekadā ca samāsīne sabhāmadhye varāsane || jaya śabde vartamāne gaṃdharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ || 21 || vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nanṛtuścā'psarogaṇāḥ || kathāyāṃ kathyamānāyāṃ śubhāyāṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 22 || sūtā vaitālikāḥ siddhāścāraṇāśca bahuśrutāḥ || ṛṣayaśca samāyātāstatraiva dvijasattama || 23 || sundopasundatuhuṃḍādyā mahiṣāsurakolbaṇāḥ || śumbhaniśumbhadhūmrākṣakālakeyāśca dānavāḥ || 24 || kālanemiśca vikrāṃto daurhṛdo mūṣako yamaḥ || nikumbhaḥ kumbhaviśaṭho hyandhakaśca mahābalaḥ || || 25 || śaṃkho jalaṃdharo raudro vātāpī ca balādhikaḥ || sarvajidviśvahaṃtā ca kāmacārī halāyudhaḥ || 26 || ete cā'nye ca bahavo danuvaṃśavi vardhanāḥ || upāsāṃcakrire tatra balirājamakalmaṣam || 27 || siddhā nāgāśca yakṣāśca kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā || khecarā bhūcarā bālā rākṣasāścaiva dāruṇāḥ || 28 || ete cā'nye ca bahavo rājānaṃ paryupāsata || tatra sabhā mahādivyā śuśubhe ca dvijottama || 29 || grahairujvalitaiḥ kīrṇo śaradīva nabhaḥsthalam || tatsabhāyāṃ samāsīno rarāja balirāṭ tathā || 5.1.63.30 || marudbhiriva saṃvīto vāsavo divi devataiḥ || ekadā ca sabhāmadhye nārado devadarśanaḥ || 31 || āgatasteṣu sarveṣu dānaveṣu sthiteṣu ca || dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ sarve hyuttasthurditinaṃdanāḥ || 32 || vavandire sarvaśastu balinā kiṃnarotta mam|| sakṛtya cāsanaṃ dattvā papraccha kuśalaṃ nṛpaḥ || 33 || kṛtvā''tithyaṃ samāsīno nāradaḥ prāha sattamaḥ || meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā baliṃ prāharṣisa ttamaḥ || 34 || || nārada uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ ditijaśreṣṭha gato'haṃ vṛṣamaṃdire || tatra devasabhā ramyā divyā'bhiprāyasaṃyutā || tatra devāḥ sagaṃdharvāḥ puraṃdarapurogamāḥ || 35 || samāsīnāḥ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ kathayaṃti parasparam || tatra daityakathāṃ śubhrāṃ mayā khyātāṃ na sehire || 36 || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ purā''sīcca prajāpatiḥ || trailokyavijayī netā yeneyaṃ vasudhā jitā || 37 || sarvalokaṃ vaśīkṛtya bubhuje ca vasundharām || atīva tejaḥsaṃpanno mahābalaparākramaḥ || 38 || vaśī sarvatragaḥ kāmī nṛsiṃhena nipātitaḥ || baliṃ kiyadbalaṃ loke nārada tva praśaṃsasi || 39 || iti māṃ dharṣayitvā ca biḍaujā lokasaṃgrahī || bahudhā vādayanvādānkaṭukāndānavottama || 5.1.63.40 || tasmāttvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha pitṛparyāgatāṃ mahīm || vijitya sārvabhaumatvaṃ labhasva vasudhādhipa || 41 || kiyadbaladhṛtā nūnaṃ devāśca danujottama || palāyanaparā dāṃtā sadaiva raṇabhīravaḥ || 42 || mama vākyaparo bhūtvā trailokyādhipatirbhava || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā valirvairocanistadā || 43 || cakāra kopamatulaṃ trailokyavijaye dvija || maṃtrayitvā'surānsarvānsarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ || 44 || saṃgrāmamakarottīvraṃ vāsavena balīyasā || jitvā ca sakalāldevānvaśīcakre savāsavān || 45 || sarvalokeśvaro jāto balirvairocano'suraḥ || hatādhikārāstridaśā bhraṣṭarājyāḥ parājitāḥ || 46 || vicaraṃti yathā martyāstena devagaṇā bhuvi || kiṃcitkālaṃ samāsādya brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 47 || bho brahmanbalinā bhraṣṭā devalokātparaṃtapa || kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kamupā yaṃ carāmahe || 48 || || brahmovāca || || śrūyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ sādhanaṃ param || yūyaṃ yāta purīṃ ramyāṃ padmāvatīmama rottamāḥ || 49 || tatra tīrthavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nāmnā cottaramānasam || yatrā'ṣṭasiddhidā khyātā mahāsiddhipradā nṛṇām || 5.1.63.50 || nidhayaśca navaivāpi tatra tiṣṭhaṃti sattama || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇutīrthamanuttamam||51|| tatra snātvā naraḥ paśyetsiddheśvarīṃ susiddhidām || ṛddhisiddhiparobhūtvā viṣṇu loke mahīyate || 52 || āśvinasya site pakṣe daśamyāṃ divase tathā || aṣṭasiddhiśamīdeśe gaṇeśvaraṃ prapūjayet || 53 || vijayī sarvalokeṣu jāya te nātra saṃśayaḥ || śamīmūlasthitaṃ nityamṛddhisiddhivarapradam|| 54 || pūjayedvai naro nityaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sarvakāmadam || sarvakāmavaraṃ labdhvā putravāndhanavānbhavet || 55 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mahākālavanaṃ vrajet || yatra viṣṇusarastīrthaṃ tatra gacchata māciram || 56 || upāsanāṃ suraśreṣṭhā viṣṇoratu letejasaḥ || kurudhvaṃ sarvabhītibhyastrātā sa syātsurottamāḥ || 57 || iti śrutvā vacastasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṃsitātmanaḥ || mahākālavane prāptā devāste kāryasādhakāḥ || 58 || atrā''gātya śucībhūya snānadānādikarmabhiḥ || upāsāṃcakrire siddhā viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 59 || brahmāṇamatha te sarve papracchurvidhimādarāt|| upāsanāyā devasya devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 5.1.63.60 || || devā ūcuḥ || || brahmankena prakāreṇa viṣṇubhaktiḥ parā bhavet|| tatsarvaṃ śrotu micchāmastvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || 61 || || brahmovāca || || śrūyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭhā viṣṇubhaktimanuttamām || śuklāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam || 62 || prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyetsarvavighnopaśāṃtaye || lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ kutasteṣāṃ parājayaḥ || 63 || yeṣāmiṃdīvaraśyāmo hṛdayastho janārdanaḥ || abhīpsitārthasiddhyarthaṃ pūjyate yaḥ surairapi || 64 || sarvavighnaharastasmai gaṇādhipataye namaḥ || kalpādau sṛṣṭikāmena preritohaṃ ca śauriṇā || 65 || na śakto vai prajāḥ kartuṃ viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || etasminnaṃtare sadyo mārkaṇḍeyo mahāṛṣiḥ || 66 || sarvasiddheśvaro dāṃto dīrghāyurvijiteṃdriyaḥ || mayā dṛṣṭo 'tha gatvā taṃ tadāhaṃ samupasthitaḥ || tataḥ praphullanayanau satkṛtya cetaretaram || 67 || pṛcchamānau paraṃ svāsthyaṃ sukhāsīnau surottamāḥ || tadā mayā sa pṛṣṭo vai mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || 68 || bhagavankena prakāreṇa prajā me'nāmayā bhavet || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavanmunivaṃdita || 69 || || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || viṣṇubhaktiḥ parā nityā sarvārtiduḥkhanāśinī || sarvapāpaharā puṇyā sarvasukhapradāyinī || 5.1.63.70 || eṣā brāhmī mahāvidyā na deyā yasya kasyacit || kṛtaghnāya hyaśiṣyāya nāstikāyānṛtāya ca || 71 || īrṣyakāya ca rūkṣāya kāmikāya kadācana || tadgataṃ sarvaṃ vighraṃti yattaddharmaṃ sanātanam || 72 || etadguhyatamaṃ śāstraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanam ||73|| viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ ca viṣṇubhaktikaraṃ śubham || sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham || 74 || oṃ asya śrīviṣṇusahasranāmastotramaṃtrasya mārkaṃḍeya ṛṣiḥ viṣṇurdevatā anuṣṭupcchaṃdaḥ sarvakāmāvātyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || atha dhyānam || sajalajaladanīlaṃ darśitodāraśīlaṃ karataladhṛtaśailaṃ veṇuvādye rasālam || vrajajana kulapālaṃ kāminīkelilolaṃ taruṇatulasimālaṃ naumi gopālabālam ||75 || oṃviśvaṃ viṣṇurhaṣīkeśaḥ sarvātmā sarvabhāvanaḥ || sarvagaḥ śarvarīnātho bhūtagrāmā''śayāśayaḥ || 76 || anādinidhano devaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃbhavaḥ || sarvavyāpī jagaddhātā sarvaśaktidharo'naghaḥ ||77| jagadbījaṃ jagatsraṣṭā jagadīśo jagatpatiḥ || jagadgururjagannātho jagaddhātā jaganmayaḥ ||78|| sarvā''kṛtidharaḥ sarvaviśvarūpī janārdanaḥ || ajanmā śāśvato nityo viśvādhā ro vibhuḥ prabhuḥ || 79 || bahurūpaikarūpaśca sarvarūpadharo haraḥ || kālāgniprabhavo vāyuḥ pralayāṃtakaro'kṣayaḥ || 5.1.63.80 || mahārṇavo mahāmegho jalabudbudasaṃ bhavaḥ || saṃskṛto vikṛto matsyo mahāmatsyastimiṃgilaḥ || 81 || anaṃto vāsukiḥ śeṣo varāho dharaṇīdharaḥ || payaḥkṣīravivekāḍhyo haṃso hema giristhitaḥ || 82 || hayagrīvo viśālākṣo hayakarṇo hayākṛtiḥ || maṃthano ratnahārī ca kūrmo dharadharādharaḥ || 83 || vinidro nidrito naṃdī sunaṃdo naṃdanapriyaḥ || nābhinālamṛṇālī ca svayaṃbhūścaturānanaḥ || 84 || prajāpatiparo dakṣaḥ sṛṣṭikartā prajākaraḥ || marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣaḥ surāsurā guruḥ kaviḥ || 85 || vāmano vāmamārgī ca vāmakarmā bṛhadvapuḥ || trailokyakramaṇo dīpo baliyajñavināśanaḥ || 86 || yajñahartā yajñakartā yajñeśo yajñabhugvibhuḥ || sahasrāṃśurbhago bhānurvivasvānraviraṃśumān || 87 || tigmatejāścālpatejāḥ karmasākṣī manuryamaḥ || devarājaḥ surapatirdānavāriḥ śacī patiḥ || 88 || agnirvāyusakho vahnirvaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ || nairṛto nādano'nādī rakṣayakṣodhanādhipaḥ || 89 || kubero vittavānvego vasupālo vilāsakṛt || amṛtasravaṇaḥ somaḥ somapānakaraḥ sudhīḥ || 5.1.63.90 || sarvauṣadhikaraḥ śrīmānniśākaradivākaraḥ || viṣārirviṣahartā ca viṣakaṃṭhadharo giriḥ || 91 || nīlakaṃṭho vṛṣī rudro bhālacaṃdro hyumāpatiḥ || śivaḥ śāṃto vaśī vīro dhyānī mānī ca mānadaḥ || 92 || kṛmikīṭo mṛgavyādho mṛgahā mṛgalāñchanaḥ || baṭuko bhairavo bālaḥ kapālī daṃḍavigrahaḥ || 93 || smaśānavāsī māṃsāśī duṣṭanāśī varāṃtakṛt || yoginītrāsako yogī dhyā nastho dhyānavāsanaḥ || 94 || senānīḥ senadeḥ skaṃdo mahākālo gaṇādhipaḥ || ādidevo gaṇapatirvighnahā vighnanāśanaḥ || 95 || ṛddhisiddhiprado daṃtī bhālacandro gajānanaḥ || nṛsiṃha ugradaṃṣṭraśca nakhī dānavanāśakṛt || 96 || prahrādapoṣakartā ca sarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ || śalabhaḥ sāgaraḥ sākṣī kalpa kalpakaḥ ||97 || hemado hemabhāgīca himakartā himācalaḥ || bhūdharo bhūmido meruḥ kailāsaśikharo giriḥ || 98 || lokālokāṃtaro lokī vilokī bhuvaneśvaraḥ || dikpālo dikpatirdivyo divyakāyo jiteṃdriyaḥ || 99 || virūpo rūpavānrāgī nṛtyagītaviśāradaḥ || hāhā hūhūścitraratho deva rṣirnāradaḥ sakhā || 5.1.63.100 || viśvedevāḥ sādhyadevā dhṛtāśīśca calo'calaḥ || kapilo jalpako vādī datto haihayasaṃgharāṭ || 101 || vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca saptarṣipravaro bhṛguḥ || jāmadagnyo mahāvīraḥ kṣatriyāṃ'takaro hyṛṣiḥ || 102 || hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva hiraṇyākṣo harapriyaḥ || agastiḥ pulaho dakṣaḥ paula styo rāvaṇo ghaṭaḥ ||103|| devāristāpasastāpī vibhīṣaṇaharipriyaḥ || tejasvī tejadastejī īśo rājapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 104 || dāśarathī rāghavo rāmo raghuvaṃśa vivardhanaḥ|| sītāpatiḥ patiḥ śrīmānbrahmaṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ||105|| sannaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī cīravāsā digaṃbaraḥ || kirīṭī kuḍalī cāpī śaṃkhacakrī gadādharaḥ ||106|| kausalyānaṃdanodāro bhūmiśāyī guhapriyaḥ || saumitro bharato bālaḥ śatrughno bharatā'grajaḥ || 107 || lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīraghnaḥ strīsahāyaḥ kapīśvaraḥ || hanumānṛkṣarājaśca sugrīvo vālināśanaḥ || 108 || dūtapriyo dūtakārī hyaṃgado gadatāṃ varaḥ || vanadhvaṃsī vanī vego vānaradhvaja lāṃgulī || 109 || ravidaṃṣṭrī ca laṃkāhā hāhākāro varapradaḥ || bhavaseturmahāseturbaddhasetū rameśvaraḥ || 5.1.63.110 || jānakīvallabhaḥ kāmī kirīṭī kuṇḍalī khagī || puṇḍarīkaviśālākṣo mahābāhurghanākṛtiḥ || 111 || caṃcalaścapalaḥ kāmī vāmī vāmāṃgavatsalaḥ || strīpriyaḥ strīparaḥ straiṇaḥ striyo vāmāṃgavāsakaḥ || 112 || jitavairī jitakāmo jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || śāṃto dāṃto dayārāmo hyekastrīvratadhārakaḥ || 113 || sāttvikaḥ sattvasaṃsthāno madahā krodhahā kharaḥ || bahurākṣasa saṃvītaḥ sarvarākṣasanāśakṛt || 114 || rāvaṇārī raṇakṣudra daśamastakacchedakaḥ || rājyakārī yajñakārī dātā bhoktā tapodhanaḥ || 115 || ayodhyādhipatiḥ kāṃto vaikuṃṭho'kuṃṭhavigrahaḥ || satyavrato vratī śūrastapī satyaphalapradaḥ || 116 || sarvasākṣīḥ sarvagaśca sarvaprāṇaharo'vyayaḥ || prāṇaścāthāpyapānaśca vyānodānaḥ samānataḥ || 117 || nāgaḥ kṛkalaḥ kūrmaśca devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ || sarvaprāṇavido vyāpī yogadhārakadhārakaḥ ||118|| tattvavittattvadastattvī sarvatattvaviśāradaḥ || dhyānastho dhyānaśālī ca manasvī yogavittamaḥ || 119 || brahmajño brahmado bahmajñātā ca brahmasaṃbhavaḥ || adhyātmavidvido dīpo jyotīrūpo niraṃjanaḥ || 5.1.63.120 || jñānado'jñānahā jñānī guruḥ śiṣyopadeśakaḥ || suśiṣyaḥ śikṣitaḥ śālī śiṣyaśikṣāviśāradaḥ || 121 || maṃtrado maṃtrahā maṃtrī taṃtrī tantrajanapriyaḥ || sanmaṃtro mantravinmantrī yantramantraikabhaṃjanaḥ || 122 || māraṇo mohano mohī staṃbhoccāṭanakṛtkhalaḥ || bahumāyo vimāyaśca mahāmāyāvimohakaḥ || 123 || mokṣado baṃdhako baṃdī hyākarṣaṇavikarṣaṇaḥ || hrīṃkāro bījarūpī ca klīṃkāraḥ kīlakādhipaḥ || 124 || sauṃkāra śaktimāñcchaktiḥ sarvaśaktidharo dharaḥ || akārokāra oṃkāraśchaṃdogāyatrasambhavaḥ || 125 || vedo vedavido vedī vedā'dhyāyī sadāśivaḥ || ṛgyajuḥsāmātharveśaḥ sāmagānakaro'karī || 126 || tripado bahupādī ca śatapathaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ || prākṛtaḥ saṃskṛto yogī gītagraṃthaprahelikaḥ || 127 || saguṇo viguṇaśchaṃdo niḥsaṃgo viguṇo guṇī || nirguṇo guṇavānsaṃgī karmī dharmī ca karmadaḥ || 128 || niṣkarmā kāmakāmī ca niḥsaṃgaḥ saṃgavarjitaḥ || nirlobho nirahaṃkārī niṣkiṃcanajanapriyaḥ || 129 || sarvasaṃgakaro rāgī sarvatyāgī bahiścaraḥ || ekapādo dvipādaśca bahu pādo'lpapādakaḥ || 5.1.63.130 || dvipadastripado'pādī vipādī padasaṃgrahaḥ || khecaro bhūcaro bhrāmī bhṛṃgakīṭamadhupriyaḥ || 131 || kratuḥ saṃvatsaro māso gaṇitārko hyaharniśaḥ || kṛtaṃ tretā kaliścaiva dvāparaścaturākṛtiḥ || 132 || divākālakaraḥ kālaḥ kuladharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || kalā kāṣṭhā kalā nāḍyo yāmaḥ pakṣaḥ sitāsitaḥ || 133 || yugo yugandharo yogyo yugadharmapravartakaḥ || kulācāraḥ kulakaraḥ kuladaivakaraḥ kulī || 134 || caturā''śramacārī ca gṛhastho hyatithipriyaḥ || vanastho vanacārī ca vānaprasthā''śramo'śramī || 135 || baṭuko brahmacārī ca śikhāsūtrī kamaṇḍalī || trijaṭī dhyānavāndhyānī badrikāśramavāsakṛt || 136 || hemādriprabhavo haimo hemarāśirhi mākaraḥ || mahāprasthānako vipro virāgī rāgavāngṛhī || 137 || naranārāyaṇo'nāgo kedārodāravigrahaḥ || gaṃgādvāratapaḥsārastapovana taponidhiḥ || 138 || nidhireṣa mahāpadmaḥ padmākaraśriyālayaḥ || padmanābhaḥ parītātmā parivrāṭpuruṣottamaḥ || 139 || parānaṃdaḥ purāṇaśca samrāḍrāja virājakaḥ || cakrasthaścakrapālasthaścakravartī narādhipaḥ ||5.1.63.140|| āyurvedavido vaidyo dhanvaṃtariśca rogahā|| auṣadhībījasaṃbhūto rogī rogavināśakṛta ||141|| cetanaścetako'ciṃtyaścittaciṃtāvināśakṛt || atīṃdriyaḥ sukhasparśaścaracārī vihaṃgamaḥ || 142 || garuḍaḥ pakṣirājaśca cākṣuṣo vinatā tmajaḥ || viṣṇuyānavimānastho manomayaturaṃgamaḥ || 143 || bahuvṛṣṭikaro varṣo airāvaṇavirāvaṇaḥ || uccaiḥśravā'ruṇo gāmī haridaśvo haripriyaḥ ||144|| prāvṛṣo meghamālī ca gajaratnapuraṃdaraḥ || vasudo vasudhāraśca nidrāluḥ pannagāśanaḥ || 145 || śeṣaśāyī jaleśāyī vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || vedavyāsakaro vāggmī bahuśākhāvikalpakaḥ || 146 || smṛtiḥ purāṇadharmārthī parāvaravicakṣaṇaḥ || sahasraśīrṣā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasravadanojjvalaḥ || 147 || sahasrabāhuḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ sahasrakiraṇo naraḥ || bahuśīrṣaikaśīrṣaśca triśirā viśirāḥ śirī || 148 || jaṭilo bhasmarāgī ca divyāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ || aṇurūpo bṛhadrūpo virūpo vikarākṛtiḥ || 149 || samudramāthako māthī sarvaratnaharo hariḥ || vajravaiḍūryako vajrī ciṃtāmaṇimahāmaṇiḥ ||5.1.63.150|| anirmūlyo mahāmūlyo nirmūlyaḥ surabhiḥ sukhī || pitā mātā śiśurbaṃdhurdhātā tvaṣṭāryamā yamaḥ || 151 || aṃtaḥstho bāhyakārī ca bahiḥstho vai bahiścaraḥ || pāvanaḥ pāvakaḥ pākī sarvabhakṣī hutāśanaḥ || 152 || bhagavānbhagahā bhāgī bhavabhaṃjo bhayaṃkaraḥ || kāyasthaḥ kāryakārī ca kāryakartā karapradaḥ || 153 || ekadharmā dvidharmā ca sukhī dūtyopajīvakaḥ || bālakastārakastrātā kālo mūṣakabhakṣakaḥ || 154 || saṃjīvano jīvakartā sajīvo jīvasaṃbhavaḥ|| ṣaḍviṃśako mahā viṣṇuḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ || 155 || divyāṃgado muktamālī śrīvatso makaradhvajaḥ || śyāmamūrtirghanaśyāmaḥ pītavāsāḥ śubhānanaḥ || 156 || cīravāsā vivāsāśca bhūtadānavavallabhaḥ || amṛto'mṛtabhāgī ca mohinīrūpadhārakaḥ || 157 || divyadṛṣṭiḥ samadṛṣṭirdevadānavavaṃcakaḥ || kabaṃdhaḥ ketukārī ca svarbhānuścaṃdratāpanaḥ || 158 || graharājo grahī grāhaḥ sarvagrahavimocakaḥ || dānamānajapo homaḥ sānukūlaḥ śubhagrahaḥ || 159 || vighnakartā'pahartā ca vighnanāśo vināyakaḥ || apakāropakārī ca sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ || 5.1.63.160 || sevakaḥ sāmadānī ca bhedī daṃḍī ca matsarī || dayāvāndānaśīlaśca dānī yajvā pratigrahī || 161 || haviragniścarusthālī samidhaścānilo yamaḥ || hotodgātā śuciḥ kuṇḍaḥ sāmago vaikṛtiḥ savaḥ || 162 || dravyaṃ pātrāṇi saṃkalpo muśalo hyaraṇiḥ kuśaḥ || dīkṣito maṃḍapo vediryajamānaḥ paśuḥ kratuḥ || 163 || dakṣiṇā svastimānsvasti hyāśīrvādaḥ śubhapradaḥ || ādivṛkṣo mahāvṛkṣo devavṛkṣo vanaspatiḥ || 164 || prayāgo veṇumānveṇī nyagrodhaścā'kṣayo vaṭaḥ || sutīrthastīrthakārī ca tīrtharājo vratī vataḥ || 165 || vṛttidātā pṛthuḥ putro dogdhā gaurvatsa eva ca || kṣīraṃ kṣīravahaḥ kṣīrī kṣīrabhāgavibhāmavit || 166 || rājyabhāgavido bhāgī sarvabhāgavikalpakaḥ || vāhano vāhako vegī pādacārī tapaścaraḥ || 167 || gopano gopako gopī gopakanyāvihārakṛt|| vāsudevo viśālākṣaḥ kṛṣṇogopījanapriyaḥ || 168 || devakīnaṃdano naṃdī naṃdagopagṛhā''śramī || yaśodānaṃdano dāmī dāmodara ulūkhalī || 169|| pūtanāriḥ padākārī līlāśakaṭabhaṃjakaḥ || navanītapriyo vāggmī vatsapālakabālakaḥ || 5.1.63.170 || vatsarūpadharo vatsī vatsahā dhenukāṃtakṛt|| bakārirvanavāsī ca vanakrīḍāviśāradaḥ || 171 || kṛṣṇavarṇā''kṛtiḥ kāṃto veṇuvetravidhārakaḥ || gopamokṣakaro mokṣo yamunāpulinecaraḥ || 172 || māyāvatsakaro māyī brahmamāyāpamohakaḥ || ātmasāravihārajño gopadārakadārakaḥ || 173 || gocārī gopatirgopo govardhanadharo balī || indradyumno makhadhvaṃsī vṛṣṭihā goparakṣakaḥ || 174 || surabhitrāṇakartā ca dāvapānakaraḥ kalī | kālīyamardanaḥ kālī yamunāhradavihārakaḥ||175|| saṃkarṣaṇo balaślāghyo baladevo halāyudhaḥ|| lāṃgalī musalī cakrī rāmo rohiṇinaṃdanaḥ||176|| yamunākarṣaṇoddhāro nīlavāsā halo halī|| revatī ramaṇo lolo bahumānakaraḥ paraḥ || 177 || dhenukārirmahāvīro gopakanyāvidūṣakaḥ || kāmamānaharaḥ kāmī gopīvāso'pataskaraḥ || 178 || veṇuvādī ca nādī ca nṛtyagītaviśāradaḥ || gopīmohakaro gānī rāsako rajanīcaraḥ || 179 || divyamālī vimālī ca vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || kaiṭabhāriśca kaṃsārirmadhuhā madhusūdanaḥ ||5.1.63.180|| cāṇūramardano mallo muṣṭī muṣṭikanāśakṛt || murahā modakā modī madaghno narakāṃtakṛta ||181|| vidyādhyāyī bhūmiśāyī sudāmā susakhā sukhī || sakalo vikalo vaidyaḥ kalito vai kalānidhiḥ || 182 || vidyāśālī viśālī ca pitṛmātṛvimokṣakaḥ|| rukmiṇī ramaṇo ramyaḥ kāliṃdīpatiḥ śaṃkhahā||183|| pāṃcajanyo mahāpadmo bahunāyakanāyakaḥ|| dhuṃdhumāro nikuṃbhaghnaḥ śaṃbarāṃto ratipriyaḥ|| 184|| pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca sātvatāṃ patirarjunaḥ || phālgunaśca guḍākeśaḥ savyasācī dhanaṃjayaḥ || 185 || kirīṭī ca dhanuṣpāṇirdhanurvedaviśāradaḥ || śikhaṃḍī sātyakiḥ śaibyo bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ || 186 || pāṃcālaścābhimanyuśca saubhadro draupadīpati || yudhiṣṭhiro dharmarājaḥ satyavādī śucivrataḥ || 187 || nakulaḥ sahadeva śca karṇo duryodhano ghṛṇī || gāṃgeyo'tha gadāpāṇirbhīṣmo bhāgīrathīsutaḥ || 188 || prajñācakṣurdhṛtarāṣṭro bhāradvājotha gautamaḥ || aśvatthāmā vikarṇaścajahu?ryuddhaviśāradaḥ||189|| sīmaṃtiko gadī gālvo viśvāmitro durāsadaḥ || durvāsā durvinītaśca mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ||5.1.63.190|| lomaśo nirmalo'lomī dīrghāyuśca ciro'cirī || punarjīvī mṛto bhāvī bhūto bhavyo bhaviṣyakaḥ || 191 || trikālo'tha triliṃgaśca trinetrastripadīpatiḥ || yādavo yājñavalkyaśca yaduvaṃśavivardhanaḥ || 192 || śalyakrīḍī vikrīḍaśca yādavāṃtakaraḥ kaliḥ || sadayo hṛdayo dāyo dāyado dāyabhāgdayī || 193 || mahodadhi rmahīpṛṣṭho nīlaparvatavāsakṛta || ekavarṇo vivarṇaśca sarvavarṇabahiścaraḥ || 194 || yajñaniṃdī vedaniṃdī vedabāhyo balo baliḥ || bauddhārirbādhako bādho jagannātho jagatpatiḥ || 195 || bhaktirbhāgavato bhāgī vibhakto bhagavatpriyaḥ || trigrāmo'tha navāraṇyo guhyopaniṣadāsanaḥ || 196 || śāligrāmaḥ śilāyukto viśālo gaṃḍakāśrayaḥ || śrutadevaḥ śrutaḥ śrāvī śrutabodhaḥ śrutaśravāḥ || 197 || kalkiḥ kālakalaḥ kalko duṣṭamlecchavināśa kṛt|| kuṃkumī dhavalo dhīraḥ kṣamākaro vṛṣākapiḥ |1|98|| kiṃkaraḥ kinnaraḥ kaṇvaḥ kekī kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ || ekaromā viromā ca bahuromā bṛhatkaviḥ || || 199 || vajrapraharaṇo vajrī vṛtraghno vāsavānujaḥ || bahutīrthakarastīrthaḥ sarvatīrthajaneśvaraḥ || 5.1.63.200 || vyatīpātoparāgaśca dānavṛddhikaraḥ śubhaḥ || asaṃkhyeyo'prameyaśca saṃkhyākāro visaṃkhyakaḥ || 201 || mihikottārakastāro bālacaṃdraḥ sudhākaraḥ || kiṃvarṇaḥ kīdṛśaḥ kiñcitkiṃsvabhāvaḥ kimāśrayaḥ ||202|| nirlokaśca nirākārī bahvākāraikakārakaḥ || dauhitraḥ putrikaḥ pautro naptā vaṃśadharo dharaḥ || 203 || dravībhūto dayāluśca sarvasiddhiprado maṇiḥ || || 204 || ādhāro'pi vidhāraśca dharāsūnuḥ sumaṃgalaḥ || maṃgalo maṃgalākāro māṃgalyaḥ sarvamaṃgalaḥ || 205 || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ nāmedaṃ viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ || sarvasiddhikaraṃ kāmyaṃ puṇyaṃ hariharātmakam || 206 || yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ naro niścalamānasaḥ || 207 || trisaṃdhyaṃ śraddhayā yuktaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate|| naṃdate putrapautraiśca dārairbhṛtyaiśca pūjitaḥ || 208 || prāpnute vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ mucyate sarvasaṃkaṭāt || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti labhate vipulaṃ yaśaḥ || 209 || vidyāvāñjāyate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || vaiśyaśca dhanalābhāḍhyaḥ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt || 5.1.63.210 || raṇe ghore vivāde ca vyāpāre pārataṃtrake || vijayī jayamāpnoti sarvadā sarvakarmasu || 211 || ekadhā daśadhā caiva śatadhā ca sahasradhā || paṭhate hi naro nityaṃ tathaiva phalamaśnute || 212 || putrārthī prāpnute putrāndhanārthī dhanamavyayam || mokṣārthī prāpnute mokṣaṃ dharmārthī dharmasaṃcayam || 213 || kanyārthī prāpnute kanyāṃ durlabhāṃ yatsurairapi || jñānārthī jāyate jñānī yogī yogeṣu yujyate || 214 || mahotpāteṣu ghoreṣu durbhikṣe rājavigrahe || mahāmārīsamudbhūte dāridrye duḥkhapīḍite || 215 || araṇye prāṃtare vā'pi dāvāgniparivārite || siṃhavyāghrābhibhūte'pi vane hastisamākule || 216 || rājñā kruddhena cājñapte dasyubhiḥ saha saṃgame || vidyutpāteṣu ghoreṣu smartavyaṃ hi sadā naraiḥ || 217 || grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu vadhabandhagatāvapi || mahārṇave mahānadyāṃ potastheṣu na cāpadaḥ || 218 || rogagrasto vivarṇaśca gatakeśanakhatvacaḥ || paṭhanācchavaṇādvāpi divyakāyā bhavaṃti te || 219 || tulasīvanasaṃsthāne sarodvīpe surālaye || badrikāśrame śubhe deśe gaṃgādvāre tapovane || 5.1.63.220 || madhuvane prayāge ca dvārakāyāṃ samāhitaḥ || mahākālavane siddhe niyatāḥ sarvakāmikāḥ || 221 || ye paṭhaṃti śatāvartaṃ bhaktimaṃto jiteṃdriyāḥ || te siddhāḥ siddhidā loke vicaraṃti mahītale || 222 || anyonyabhedabhedānāṃ maitrīkaraṇamuttamam || mohanaṃ mohanānāṃ ca pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || 223 || bālagrahavināśāya śāṃtīkaraṇamuttamam || durvṛttānāṃ ca pāpānāṃ buddhināśakaraṃ param || 224 || patadgarbhā ca vaṃdhyā ca srāviṇī kākavandhyakā || anāyāsena satataṃ putrameva prasūyate || || 225 || payaḥpuṣkaladā gāvo bahudhānyaphalā| kṛṣiḥ || svāmidharmaparā bhṛtyā nārī pativratā bhavet || 226 || akālamṛtyunāśāya tathā duḥsvapnadarśane || śāṃtikarmaṇi sarvatra smartavyaṃ ca sadā naraiḥ || 227 || yaḥ paṭhatyanvahaṃ martyaḥ śuciṣmānviṣṇusannidhau || ekākī ca jitāhāro jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || 228 || garuḍārohasaṃpannaḥ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ || vāñchitaṃ prāpya loke'sminviṣṇuloke sa gacchati ||229 || ekataḥ sakalā vidyā ekataḥ sakalaṃ tapaḥ || ekataḥ sakalo dharmo nāma viṣṇostathaikataḥ || 5.1.63.230 || yo hi nāmasahasreṇa stotumicchati vai dvijaḥ|| so'yamekena ślokena stuta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 231 || sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapātsahasravadanojjvalaḥ || sahasranāmānaṃtākṣaḥ sahasrabāhurnamostu te || 232 || viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ vai purāṇaṃ vedasammatam || paṭhitavyaṃ sadā bhaktaiḥ sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam || 233 || iti stavābhiyuktānāṃ devānāṃ tatra vai dvija || pratyakṣaṃ prāha bhagavānvarado varadārcitaḥ || 234 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || vriyatāṃ bhoḥ surāḥ sarvairvaro'smattobhivāṃchitaḥ || tatsarvaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 235 || || devā ūcuḥ || || varado'si yadā viṣṇo varametaṃ dadasva naḥ || aditergarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ śakrasyā'pyanujo bhava || 236 || iti saṃprārthito devairbrahmaśakrapurogameḥ || tathetyuktā ca bhagavāṃstatraivāṃ'taradhīyata || 237 || tataḥ katipaye kāle bhagavānaditinaṃdanaḥ || viṣṇurūpadharo 'naṃto vāmanatvācca vāmanaḥ || 238 || balirvairocano vyāsa vājimedhaśatena ca || īje dvijavaraśreṣṭha iṃdrarājyajihīrṣayā ||239|| ṛtvijaṃ kaśyapaṃ kṛtvā hotāraṃ bhṛgusattamam || brahmā tatrābhavaccaiva svayameva pitāmahaḥ || 5.1.63.240 || adhvaryurbhagavānatrirbabhūva munisattamaḥ || udgātā nāradaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca sabhāsadaḥ || 241 || ye yatra vihitāḥ sarve tatra tatra munīśvarāḥ || balistatrā'bhavadvyāsa dīkṣito rājasattamaḥ || 242 || evaṃ pravartamāneṣu yajñeṣu munisattama || hūyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ caiva dīyatāṃ dhīyatāṃ tathā || 243 || iti vācaḥ śubhāstatra śrūyaṃte ca dvijottama || tasminkāle sucitreṣu vāmano'gācchucismitaḥ || 244 || paṭhamāno mukhāgreṇa cāturvedikamaṃtrakān || dvāre tiṣṭhati rājeṃdra vāmano dvijasattamaḥ || 245 || pratihāreṇa vai vyāsa sarvaṃ rājñe niveditam || utthāya ca mahārājo balirvairocanistadā || 246 || arghyamādāya tatsarvaṃ jagāma svaiḥ sabhāsadaiḥ || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vāmanaṃ lokabhāvanam || 247 || ānayitvā sabhāmadhye dattvā''sanaparigraham || kutastvāgamanaṃ brahmankiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmi vai || 248 || || || vāmana uvāca || || rājarājākhilā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || tato'hamāgato bhūmanyajñaṃ caiva didṛkṣayā || 249 || varuṇasya ca yajño vai dṛṣṭo me vai purānagha || yakṣādhipaternūnaṃ ca yajñaṃ vai dṛṣṭavānaham || 5.1.63.250 || dharmasyā'pi ca yajño me prajāpateśca sattama || vāyoryajño mahārāja dṛṣṭo me vidhipūrvakaḥ || 251 || rājarṣīṇāṃ ca ye yajñā dṛṣṭāste'pi mahāvrata || yādṛśaṃ vai mahārāja yajñaṃ te dṛṣṭavānaham || 252 || īdṛśo rājarājeṃdra na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || tasmādihāgato rājanyācanārthaṃ tavā'nagha || 253 || || baliruvāca || || yācasva tvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmya ham ||254|| || vāmana uvāca || || dehi me rājarājeṃdra padāni trīṇi medinīm || vāsārthaṃ rocate te'dya yadi pārthivasattama ||255|| || baliruvāca|| || kimidaṃ yācitaṃ vipra svalpaṃ te nahi te param || gajavājirathāḥ kṣoṇī ratnāni vividhāni ca || 256 || dāsadāsīrvarārohāḥ striyo nānā vasūni ca || dravyāṇi vāsasī śubhre yācasva tvaṃ dvijottama ||257|| pātro'si kṛtakṛtyo'si vedavedāṃgapāraga||258|| || vāmana uvāca || || na me kiṃcitspṛhā rāja nvidyate bhuvi mānada || dehi tvaṃ tripadāṃ bhūmiṃ yadi śraddhā'sti te'dhunā || 259 || ityukte vāmanenātha balirvacanamabravīt || gṛhāṇa tripadāṃ bhūmiṃ vāsasyārthaṃ hi mānada || 5.1.63.260 || ityuktvā sa ca rājarṣirdadau bhūmiṃ dvijāya vai || vārito'pi tadā vyāsa bhṛguṇā daivanoditaḥ || 261 || dattamātre jale sadyo brahmāṇḍaṃ cākramaddhariḥ || sārdhaṃ pādadvayaṃ jātā saśailavanakānanā || 262 || vasudheyaṃ tadā vyāsa balinā cārpitaṃ vasu || jitvā'suragaṇāntsarvā nrājyaṃ dattvā śatakratoḥ || 263 || paścātkumudvatīṃ prāpto viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk || 264 || ṛddhisiddhyāśrame puṇye tīrthaṃ kṛtvā''tmasaṃbhavam|| nivāsamakarodvyāsa tatraiva sa surottamaḥ || 265 || vāmanena kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ vāmanaṃ kuṇḍamucyate || bhādre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā || 266 || vāmana dvādaśī proktā hatyākoṭivināśinī || asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā hyupoṣyaikādaśīṃ yadā || 267 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādbrahmabhūyāya kalpate || dvādaśyāṃ vai viśeṣeṇa mahādānāni kurvate || 268 || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || evaṃ vai vāmanaṃ tīrthaṃ purā proktaṃ maharṣiṇā || || 269 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmavarapradam || prāpyate tena sarvaṃ hi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5.1.63.270 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye vāmanakuṇḍamahimaviṣṇusahasranāmakathanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 || || cha || ||
<5.1.64>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vīreśvaramatho śṛṇu || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vīralokamavāpnuyāt || 1 || nāgānāṃ pravaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmavarapradam || kālabhairavamityākhyaṃ tacca tīrthaṃ paraṃ smṛtam || 2 || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet || 3 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kasminkāle hi vikhyātaṃ kālabhairavasaṃjñitam || tīrthaṃ munivaraśreṣṭha etadvistarato vada || 4 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || purā'yaṃ bhairavo yogī yoginītrāsakārakaḥ || kālacakrakṛtāḥ kṛtyā yoginīnāṃ gaṇāstadā || 5 || tāsāṃ kālīti vikhyātā yoginī paramottamā || tayāyaṃ pālito nityaṃ putravadbhairavo'malaḥ || 6 || tenaite ca vinirdhūtā doṣotpātāśca sattama || trividhā bhuvi vikhyātāḥ sarvavighnakarāḥ parāḥ || 7 || kālakṛtyāstadā tena bhraṃśitāḥ paramātmanā|| mahāmārī pūtanā kṛtyā śakunī revatī khalā||8|| koṭarī tāmasī māyā navaitā mātṛkāḥ smṛtāḥ|| duṣṭadoṣavahā duṣṭāḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarāḥ ||9|| vaśīcakre sa dharmātmā sarvakāmavarapradāḥ || śiprātīre sthito nityaṃ kūle cottarataḥ śubhe ||5.1.64.10|| ūṣarasya pare pūrve so'pi tiṣṭhati sarvadā || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ravivāre samāhitaḥ ||11 || navamīṃ cā'ṣṭamīṃ prāpya caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || pūjāṃ kurvaṃti ye kecinnarā niścalamānasāḥ || 12 || vivāhe putrajanane māṃgalye ca śubhe param || patrapuṣpārkagaṃdhaiśca naivedyairvividhaistathā || 13 || tāṃbūlavāsagaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayedvarada rūpiṇam || viprāṇāṃ bhojanairhomaistarpayetsatataṃ vibhum || 14 || etatparamakalyāṇametatparamamaṃgalam || natvā stutvā ca taṃ devaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || || 15 || sakalakaluṣahārī dhūrtaduṣṭāṃ'takārī suciracaritacārī muṃḍamauṃjīpracārī || karakalitakapālī kuṇḍalī daṃḍapāṇiḥ sa bhavatu sukhakārī bhairavo bhāvahārī || 16 || vividharāsavilāsavilāsitaṃ navavadhūravadhūtaparākramam || madavighūrṇitagoṣpadagoṣpadaṃ bhavapadaṃ satataṃ satataṃ smare || 17 ||| amalakamalanetraṃ cārucaṃdrāvataṃsaṃ sakalaguṇagariṣṭaṃ kāminīkāmarūpam || parihṛtaparitāpaṃ ḍākinīnāśahetuṃ bhaja jana śivarūpaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtanātham ||| || 18 || sabalabalavighātaṃ kṣetrapālaikapālaṃ vikaṭakaṭikarālaṃ hyaṭṭahāsaṃ viśālam || karagatakaravālaṃ nāgayajñopavītaṃ bhaja jana śivarūpaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtanātham || 19 || bhavabhayaparihāraṃ yoginītrāsakāraṃ sakalasuragaṇeśaṃ cārucaṃdrārkanetram || mukuṭarucirabhālaṃ muktamālaṃ viśālaṃ bhaja jana śivarūpaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtanātham || 5.1.64.20 || caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhagadādharā''yudhaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ sāṃdrapayodasaubhagam || śrīvatsalakṣmaṃ galaśobhikaustubhaṃ śīlapradaṃ śaṃkararakṣaṇaṃ bhaje || 21 || lokā'bhirāmaṃ bhuvanābhirāmaṃ priyābhirāmaṃ yaśasābhirāmam || kīrtyābhirāmaṃ tapasā'bhirāmaṃ taṃ bhūtanāthaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 22 || ādyaṃ brahmasanātanaṃ śuciparaṃ siddhipradaṃ kāmadaṃ sevyaṃ bhaktisamanvitaṃ hariharaiḥ sṛṣṭyāsahaṃ sādhubhiḥ || yogyaṃ yogavicāritaṃ yugadharaṃ yogyānanaṃ yoginaṃ vaṃdehaṃ sakalaṃ kalaṃkarahitaṃ satsevitaṃ bhairavam || 23 || bhairavāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ prātaḥkāle paṭhennaraḥ || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ tasya vāṃchitārthaphalaṃ bhavet| || 24 || rājadvāre vivāde ca saṃgrāme saṃkaṭetathā|| rājñā kuddhena cā''jñapte śatrubaṃdhagate tathā || 25 || dāridryaduḥkhanāśāya paṭhitavyaṃ samāhitaiḥ || na teṣāṃ jāyate kiṃciddurlabhaṃ bhuvi vāṃchitam ||26|| || iti bhairavāṣṭakam || || asmiṃstīrthe prakartavyaṃ snānadānādikaṃ naraiḥ|| saṃsārabhayabhītaiśca pūjito bhairavo varaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ tīrthamuttamam|| 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe 'vantīkṣetramāhātmye kālabhairavatīrthayātrāvarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<5.1.65>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || nāgatīrthaṃ tvayā brahmanpurā proktaṃ yaśasvinā || tasya tīrthavarasyā'pi mahimānaṃ ca sattama || 1 || bhūyastu śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || kiyatkāle samākhyātametadvistarato vada || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca|| || śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣyāmi tavāgre nāgatīrthajām || kathāṃ puṇyatamāṃ tubhyaṃ bhuvi pāpaharāṃ parām || 3 || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa śāpamukto bhavennaraḥ || purā nāgāḥ paribhraṣṭā mātuḥ śāpātparaṃtapa || 4 || janamejayena dagdhāste mokṣitā hyāstikena ca || papracchuste dvijaśreṣṭha jaratkārvātmajaṃ tadā || 5 || || nāgā ūcuḥ || || brahmaṃstava prasādena mokṣitā havyavāhanāt || janamejayasya yajñesmindevarājasya saṃnidhau || 6 || asmākaṃ bhūtimanvicchanvāsasyārthaṃ paraṃtapa || yasminsthāne sadā brahmannivāso jāyate'bhayaḥ ||7 || || āstīka uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ mātulaśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ hitamuttamam || mahākālavane ramye yā vai kuśasthalī smṛtā || 8 || tasyāṃ hi dakṣiṇe bhāge pūrvatīrthaṃ sanā tanam|| nāgālayaṃ purā proktaṃ yatra sannihito hariḥ || 9 || yoganidrāṃ samāsādya śete brahma sanātanam || śeṣaśāyīti vikhyātaḥ sarvalokeṣu gīyate || 10 || kalpadoṣo na tatraiva bādhate savadehinām|| bakadālbhya ṛṣistatra tapastepe dhṛtavrataḥ || 5.1.65.10 || lomaśaśca mahātejāstatraiva pratitiṣṭhati || dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ samāpanno mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || 12 || na vartate kālacakraṃ mahākālapratāpataḥ || kapilaḥ siddhimāpanno yatra tīrthavarottame ||13|| hariścaṃdro vimukto'bhūdgarhyacaṇḍālayonitaḥ|| saptarṣipravarā ye te nirvāṇapadavīṃ gatāḥ ||14|| etasmātkāraṇātsarvaistatra viśramyatāṃ sadā|| mātuḥ śāpodbhavo doṣo yuṣmākaṃ naiva bādhate||15|| etatte vacanaṃ śrutvā maharṣerāstikasya ca|| āgacchaṃstatra te śīghraṃ vāsārthaṃ pannagottamāḥ||16|| elāpatraḥ kaṃbalaśca karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau|| vāsukiḥ pannagaśreṣṭhastakṣako nīla eva ca||17|| padmakaścārbudaścaiva nāgāste sarva eva hi|| atrāgatya svasvasthānāni cakruste suciravratāḥ||18|| tatra ramyāṇi tīrthāni jātāni paramāṇi ca|| navāni cakruḥ kuṃḍāni tīrthabhūtāni sattama||19|| mahāpuṇyapradānyāhurmahāpāpaharāṇi ca || yatra siddhāśca gaṃdharvā ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 5.1.65.20 || apsarogaṇasaṃghaiśca sevyaṃte ca sadā varaiḥ || yatra śeṣo mahānāgaḥ purā prokto maharṣiṇā || 21 || śeṣaśāyī hyalaṃ viṣṇurbhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ || tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvi sarvadā || 22 || śvetadvīpeti vikhyātā maṇivikrāṃtabhūmikā || yatra puṇyāśca vai vṛkṣāḥ puṣpitāścaiva sarvaśaḥ || 23 || haṃsakāraṃḍakākādi pikakokilasārasāḥ || padmakhaṃḍagaṇāstatra nṛtyaṃti ca śikhaṃḍinaḥ || 24 || nidhireṣa mahāpadmo nīlotpalasugaṃdhinā || vāsito vāyunā śubhraḥ kinnarodgāranāditaḥ || 25 || yatra susaṃskṛtā nāryo viharaṃti surāṃganāḥ|| nāgakanyābhī ramyābhirmaṃḍitaṃ paramādbhutam ||26|| yatra snātvā naro yāti vaikuṃṭhaṃ dhāma śobhanam || śeṣaśāyī hariryatra śete hi ca ramāpatiḥ || 27 || tatra ramāsaro nāma tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam || yatra snātvā naro nityaṃ śrīmānbhavati nā'nyathā ||28|| evaṃ vyāsa paraṃ sthānaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param || atraiva ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ balerāśramamadbhutam || 29 || atra snānādikaṃ kāryaṃ yatra saṃnihito hariḥ || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā naro bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 5.1.65.30 || kiyatpramāṇamātrāṃ ca ye dadati vasuṃdharām || tanūruhāṇi yāvanti tāvatkālasusaṃkhyayā || 31 || akṣayyā labhyate vṛddhisteṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || śrāvaṇe māsi darśe ca paṃcamyāṃ somavāsare || 32 || nāgānāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ darśe vidhīyate || akṣayaṃ jāyate śrāddhaṃ vāṃchitārthaṃ bhavettataḥ || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye tīrthayātrāyāṃ nāgatīrthamahimavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 || || cha ||
<5.1.66>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || bhūyaḥ śṛṇu paraṃ vyāsa tīrthānāmuttamaṃ varam ||| tattīrthaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ nṛsiṃhasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaṃ samuttaret || daityarājaḥ samākhyāto hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā || 2 || teneyaṃ vasudhā sarvā saṃprāptā ca durātmanā || duṣṭadaityabalairvyāptā bhārākrāṃtā śucārditā || 3 || gaurbhūtvā'śrumukhī devairbrahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || bhārākrāṃtāṃ dharāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 4 || uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā tasyāḥ śramaṃ vyapohitum || śrūyatāṃ bho'vane puṇye bhavatyā upakārakam || 5 || vaco vadāmi te tathyaṃ deśakālocitaṃ tathā || purā'nena tapaścīrṇaṃ duṣkaraṃ sarvadehinām || 6 || gāyatryupāsanā tena kṛtā suniyatātmanā || mayā cāsya varo dattaḥ prītiyuktena cetasā || 7 || na divā na tathā rātrau nāṃtarikṣe na bhūtale || nātiśuṣkeṇa cārdreṇa na cāstraśastraghātanaiḥ || 8 || na devāsura gaṃdharvairna yakṣoragakinnaraiḥ || piśācairguhyakādyaiśca rākṣasairna kadācana || 9 || mānavaiḥ pakṣijātaiśca na me mṛtyurbhavediti || ekakaratalāghātaiḥ sakulabalavāhanam || 5.1.66.1 0|| mārayiṣyati māṃ vīraḥ sa me mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || tathetyuktvā'tihṛṣṭātmā tamahaṃ ca tadā'vane ||11|| āgamaṃ caiva lokaṃ svaṃ sa daityo ghoraśāsanaḥ || babhūva sarvalokānāṃ śāstā cātulavikramaḥ || 12 || tasyaivā'dhikṛtā loke babhūvurvigatajvarāḥ || trailokyaṃ bubhuje nityaṃ sarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ||13|| tasmādyūyaṃ vanaṃ yāta mahākālaṃ maheśituḥ|| tatra tīrthaṃ mahaccāsītsarvatīrthavarotamam ||14|| saṃgameśvarasya dakṣiṇe karkarājottare tathā || śiprātīre śubhe deśe pūrvaṃ vaikuṇṭhasannibham || 15 || nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ paraṃ dhāma tasya tīrthaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || tatra gatvā suraśreṣṭhāḥ snānadānā dikāḥ kriyāḥ || 16 || kuruta satvaraṃ sarve punarlokānavāpsyatha || te tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devā indrapurogamāḥ || 17 || mahākālavanaṃ prāptā yatra śiprā payasvinī || nṛsiṃhatīrthopakūle uṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 18 || snānadānādikaṃ kṛtvā nṛsiṃhasyā'rcanaṃ tathā || evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ || 19 || nṛsiṃhasya svarūpeṇa hato dānavapuṃgavaḥ || sabhāmadhye tadā vyāsa hariṇā'mitraghātinā || 5.1.66.20 || kareṇaikaprahāreṇa hira ṇyakaśipurhataḥ || tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve svādhikārānyayustadā || 21 || tadārabhya surāḥ sarve madhyāhnohnopāsanaṃ sadā || prakurvaṃti ca tatraiva yatra tīrthe hariḥ param || 22 || evaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ vyāsa avaṃtyāṃ vidyate bhuvi || asmiṃstīrthe dvijaśreṣṭha snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 23 || ye kurvaṃti narāḥ puṇyāste yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || sarvadā sarvakāleṣu puṇyadaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 24 || kadācinnṛsiṃhatithiṃ prāpya caiva caturdaśīm || snānaṃ kṛtvā'rcanaṃ tasya nṛsiṃhasya ca dhīmataḥ || 25|| nṛsiṃheśvaradeveśaṃ pūjayedyaḥ samāhitaḥ || tasya hastagatā lakṣmīrbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 26 || tato'gastyeśvaraṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyetyusamāhitaḥ || tasya vyāsa kṣitau kiṃciddurlabhaṃ naiva dṛśyate || 27 || yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto hanumānpavanātmajaḥ || brahmacārī sadācāro yatiḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 28 || tiṣṭhati paradaivajñaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || yasminvaṭe purā taptaṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 29 || mitrāvaruṇaputreṇa siddhihetostapasvinā || bodhī nyagrodha ityākhyo hyagastivaṭa eva ca || 5.1.66.30 || naro nārīsamāyuktaḥ sāvitrīvratamācaret || saubhāgyaṃ labhate nityaṃ sāvitryāśca paraṃtapa ||31|| yasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā dattvā dānaṃ ca saubhagam || aṣṭasaubhāgyasaṃpūrṇaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ savāsakam || || 32 || saptadhānyasamopetaṃ paṃcaratnapariṣkṛtam || saugaṃdhyādīni mālyāni maulisūtrasamāyutam || 33 || sāvitrīṃ hāṭakīṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti paraṃtapa || yo vai dadāti viprāya vedavedāṃgadhīmate || 34 || labhate vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ bahubhogakarīṃ śubhām || bhuktvā vai vividhānbhogānpunaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt || 35 || sāvitrīvratakṛnnārī jāyate pativallabhā || pativratā mahābhāgā vidhavā na kadācana || 36 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe avantīkṣetramāhātmye nṛsiṃhatīrthamahimavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || ||
<5.1.67>
śṛṇu vyāsa paraṃ tīrthaṃ bhuvi vikhyātamuttamam || kuṭumbeśvareti vikhyāto nāmnā caiva maheśvaraḥ || 1 || tasya tīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || yasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā kuṭumbī jāyate dhuvam || 2 || kuṭumbārthaṃ tapastepe purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || nāradena purā vyāsa putraṣaṣṭirvivāsitā || 3 || prajākāmaḥ sa dharmātmā suciraṃ vratamācarat || sapatnīko mahātejā nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 4 || asmiṃstīrthe śuciḥ snāto japanbrahma sanātanam || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vyāsa tapastepe sudāruṇam || 5 || tena tīrthaprasādena labhetsa bahulāṃ prajām|| pra jāpatiriti khyāto jāto dakṣaḥ pratāpavān|| 6 || brahmā'pi tatra vai paścāttapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram || niṣkalaṃ kamalaṃ rūpaṃ prāptavāṃstatkṣaṇādvidhiḥ || 7 || mahādevo'pi tatraiva prāptavānbrahmaṇaḥ padam || caturmukhadharaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛśyate'dyāpi sattama || 8 || bhadrapīṭhadharā devī bhadrakālīti viśrutā || tatraiva ca sadā vyāsa krīḍati sma dhṛtavratā || 9 || dvāre tiṣṭhati tatraiva bhairavaḥ kṣetrapālakaḥ || pādena khaṃjatāṃ yātaḥ purā daityavarārditaḥ || 5.1.67.10 || putravatpālito devyā sadā tiṣṭhati tatsthale || ye te devagaṇāḥ sarve tasmiṃstīrthe pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 11 || ṛṣayo'pi mahābhāgāḥ sadā parvaṇiparvaṇi || āyāṃti caiva saṃdhyārthaṃ bahuputraprade sare || 12 || asmiṃstīrthe sadācārāḥ snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcijjāyate janmajanmani || 13 || mahābādhāsu ghorāsu mahāmārīṣu tatparaiḥ || havanaṃ kriyate nityaṃ sarṣapai rājikairyavaiḥ || 14 || pāyasai rvividhairbhogaisteṣāṃ doṣo na jāyate || durbhikṣe rājyabhraṃśe ca saṃgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe || 15 || pūjayetkṣettrapālaṃ ca sarvā''padi samāhitaḥ || sarvaduḥkhavi nirmukto jāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || snātvā kuṭuṃbake tīrthe pūjayitvā maheśvaram || dānaṃ kūṣmāṃḍakaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya tapasvine ||17|| sauvarṇamaṇi muktābhirvāso'laṃkārasaṃyutam || dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ kuṭuṃbī jāyate naraḥ || 18 || phālgune ca site pakṣe yā vai caturdaśī bhavet || trayodaśīyutā vyāsa śivarātristathocyate || 19 || taddine ca naraḥ snātvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || bilvodakena gaṃdhena bahupuṣpaphalaistathā || 5.1.67.20 || dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvāso'laṃkārakādibhiḥ || pūjayedyo naro bhaktyā girīśaṃ sagaṇaṃ param || 21 || tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti śivaloke mahīyate || dvādaśaikādaśīpuṇyaṃ labhate bhuvi mānavaḥ || 22 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya jāgare ca kṣaṇekṣaṇe || tatastu prātarutthāya snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 23 || kṛtvā tu vidhivadvyāsa śivapūjā'rcanaṃ tathā || viprāṃśca bhojayetsapta tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 24 || kapilānāṃ savatsānāṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa || vājapeya sahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti nānyathā || 25 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetra māhātmye kuṭuṃbeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 || || || cha ||
<5.1.68>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa mahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam || devaprayāgamākhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || devānāṃ ca paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra tīrthaṃ paraṃtapa || somatīrthottare bhāge prayāgasya ca dakṣiṇe || 2 || kṣiprāyāḥ pūrvabhāge ca tatra tīrthaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā paśyeccaiva surottamam || 3 || devaṃ mādhavamityākhyaṃ bhuvi sarvaphalapradam || dadāti tasya deveṃdro vāṃchitārthaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 4 || ānaṃdabhairavastatra sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || || 5 || na tasya jāyate vyāsa yātanā bhairavī kadā || svargadvāre sadā vyāsa jāyate nirbhayaḥ pumān || 6 || jyeṣṭhe māse site pakṣe daśamyāṃ budha hastayoḥ || garānande vyatīpāte kanyācandre vṛṣe ravau || daśālā jāyate vatsa gaṃgājanma paraṃ śuci ||7|| taddine ca naraḥ snātvā sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet|| akhaṇḍaṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ śṛṇu vyāsa hyataḥ param ||8|| yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vratabhaṃgo na jāyate || eka eva purā brahmanbrāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ||9||| dharmaśarmeti vikhyātaḥ sadācārarataḥ śuciḥ || bahuvratadharo dāṃto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ|| 5.1.68.10|| kiṃciddoṣaprasaṃgena vratapūrtirna cābhavat || evaṃ bahutithe kāle nārado devadarśa naḥ ||11|| tasya gehāgato brahmannātithyārthaṃ mahātapāḥ || tadotthāya dvijo nityaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram ||12|| satkṛtya nāradaṃ bhūmanvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ papraccha munisattama || 13 || bhagavanbhavatā sarvaṃ viditaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā || asmākaṃ ca paraṃ doṣaḥ kiṃcijjātaḥ purā'nagha || 14 || yena pāpaprasaṃgena vratabhaṃgo'bhavaddhruvam || kāraṇaṃ brūhi me nātha kiṃ doṣo'tra tu gaṇyate || 15 || || nārada uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ bho dvijaśreṣṭha bhavadbhiśca purākṛtam || mahārāṣṭre suvikhyāto brāhmaṇo dhanasaṃcakaḥ || 16 || brahmadattetyasau vipro vedabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ || dhanalobhī parākrāṃtaḥ sarvadharmabahirmukhaḥ || || 17 || nāstiko devatīrtheṣu paradravyāpahārakaḥ || parastrīṣu rato nityaṃ dyūtavādī ca taskaraḥ || 18 || evamāyuḥparikṣīṇo dhanahīno'bhavattadā || itastato'bhramadbhraṣṭo nadītīre suvihvalaḥ || 19 || gataścauryaprasaṃgena yātrikaiḥ saha saṃgataḥ || kiṃcitkāleṣu duḥśīlo mṛtiṃ prāpto rujārditaḥ || 5.1.68.20 || nītaḥ saṃyaminīṃ viprastatkālaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ || yamarājapuraṃ prāpto bahupāpakaro dvijaḥ ||21|| dṛṣṭo'sau dharmarājena tadā patyaparāyaṇaḥ|| nirīkṣya sahasovāca dharmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ ||22|| śṛṇudhvaṃ kiṃkarāḥ sarve yūyamekāgramānasāḥ || anenācaritaṃ sarvaṃ duṣkarma sarvakilbiṣam || 23 || godātīre mṛtaḥ pāpī tatra naḥ kāraṇaṃ na hi|| tisraḥkoṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca yāni tīrthānyaharniśam ||24|| āyāṃti gautamītīre siṃhasthe'pi bṛhaspatau || teṣāṃ tu vāyusaṃsparśo jātosyāṃte kalevare || 25 || tena puṇyaprabhāvena no'smākaṃ kāraṇaṃ kvacit || grāhyo bhavadbhinaivāyaṃ mucyatāṃ bhoḥ puraḥsarāḥ || 26 || evaṃ tairmocito vipraḥ punarbrahmagatiṃ gataḥ || tena pāpaprasaṃgena vratabhaṃgī gato bhuvi || 27 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || brahmankena prakāreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || kiṃ tapaḥ kiṃ ca dānaṃ ca kiṃ tīrthavratasevanam || 28 || yena puṇyaprabhāvena vratabhaṃgo na jāyate || 29 || || nārada uvāca || || śṛṇu dvijavaraśreṣṭha mahākālavanaṃ smṛtam || yatra rudrasaraḥ proktamṛṣiṇā tattvadarśinā || 5.1.68.30 || koṭikoṭisutīrthāni vartaṃte dvijasattama|| koṭitīrtheti vikhyātaṃ tasmāddvija sanātanam || 31 || tattīrthasyottare bhāge sutīrthaṃ sarvakāmadam || nāmnā'khaṃḍasaraḥ khyātamakhaṃḍeśvarasannidhau || 32 || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || tasmāddhi sarvathā vatsa gaccha tvaṃ tatra mā ciram || 33 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa dvijo'gātkumudvatīm || snātvā'khaṇḍasare vyāsa dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 34 || sadyaḥ puṇyavatāṃlokānprāpto vai dvijasattamaḥ || evaṃ vyāsa mahātīrthamakhaṃḍeśvaramuttamam || 35|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye'khaṃḍeśvaramahimavarṇananāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68||
<5.1.69>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || bhūyaḥ śṛṇu paraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || kīrtitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ mārkaṃḍeyasya pṛcchataḥ || 1 || śṛṇu vatsa mahīpṛṣṭhe śiprā divyatarā nadī || tasyāstīre varaṃ tīrthaṃ karkarājetiviśrutam || 2 || yasya darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpakṣayo bhavet || vikārā mānasāḥ sarve caṃdro mānasasaṃbhavaḥ||3|| tasya sthāne gato bhānuryāmyāyanakaraḥ paraḥ|| ṛtutrayaṃ samākhyātaṃ vidhūmrārcistaducyate ||4|| tatra mṛtāḥ pravartaṃte yogino'pi paraṃtapa|| cāturmāsye harau supte ye narā vratavarjitāḥ ||5|| na teṣāṃ sadgatirvatsa satyameva bravīmi te || cāturmāsye mṛtā ye ca ye mṛtā dakṣiṇāyane || 6 || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya tīrthametadvinirmitam || karkarāja iti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu gīyate || 7 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || bhagavanbhavatā sarvaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvamūrtinā || carācaramidaṃ viśvaṃ jagatsarvaṃ jagatpate || 8 || cātumāsye harau supte dharmā''cāravidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || 9 || || brahmovāca || || śṛṇu vatsa paraṃ puṇyaṃ cāturmāsyaphalaṃ śubham || yacchutvā bhārate khaṇḍe nṛṇāṃ muktirna durlabhā || 5.1.69.10 || muktiprado'yaṃ bhagavānsaṃsārottārakāraṇaḥ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 11 || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ loke tatrā'pi ca kulīnatā || tatrā'pi saṃyamitvaṃ ca tatra satsaṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ || 12 || satsaṃgamo na yatrā'sti viṣṇubhaktirvratāni na || cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa viṣṇuvratakaraḥ śubhaḥ || 13 || cāturmāsye 'vratī yastu tasya puṇyaṃ nirarthakam|| sarvatīrthāni dānāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 14 || viṣṇumāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti cāturmāsye samāgate || sa viṣṇurāśrito nityaṃ karkarājaṃ sutīrthakam|| 15 || supuṣṭena ca dehena jīvitaṃ tasya śobhanam || cāturmāsye samāyāte hariryenā'rcitastadā || 16 || kṛtārthāstasya vibudhā yāvajjīvaṃ varapradāḥ || saṃprāpya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ cāturmāsye parāṅmukhaḥ || 17 || tasya pāpaśatānyāhurdehasthāni na saṃśayaḥ || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ loke haribhaktiśca durlabhā||18|| cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa supte deve janārdane|| cāturmāsye naraḥ snātvā karkarātre dvijottama | dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāyā''dau muktimārgamavāpnuyāt|| 19|| tatrā'pi nirjhare kūpe taḍāge vā sarasyapi|| tasmāttadadhikaṃ puṇyaṃ samākhyātaṃ surāsuraiḥ||5.1.69.20|| teṣu yaḥ snāti vai nityaṃ tasya pāpakṣayo bhavet|| 22 || tasmānnadyadhikā puṇyā samākhyātā surāsuraiḥ || puṣkare ca prayāge ca yatra kvā'pi mahājale ||23|| cāturmāsye tu yaḥ snāti puṇyasaṃkhyā tato'dhikā|| || revāyāṃ bhāskare kṣetre prācyāṃ sāgarasaṃgame || 24|| ekāhamapi yaḥ snāti cāturmāsye na duḥkhabhāk|| dinatrayaṃ ca yaḥ snāti narmadāyāṃ samāhitaḥ||25|| supte deve jagannāthe pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā|| pakṣamekaṃ tu yaḥ snāti godāvaryāṃ dinodaye||26|| sa bhittvā karmajaṃ dehaṃ yāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām|| avaṃtyāṃ karkarāje tu sākṣādviṣṇurbhavennaraḥ|| kṣaṇamekaṃ kṣaṇārdhaṃ vā cāturmāsye 'tilaṃghayet || 27 || tilodakenāmalasaṃyutena bilvodakenāpi ca majjayedyaḥ || na tasya jānāmi phalādhikaṃ vai kiṃ tasya kīdṛṅmunibhiḥ praṇītam || 28 || gaṃgāṃ smarati yo nityamudapānasamīpataḥ || tadgāṃgeyajalaṃ jātaṃ tena snānaṃ samācaret || 29 || gaṃgā'pi devadevasya caraṇāṃ'guṣṭhavāhinī || pāpahā sā sadā proktā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ|| 5.1.69.30 || cāturmāsye jalagato devo nārāyaṇo bhavet || sarvatīrthā'dhikaṃ snānaṃ viṣṇutejoṃ'śasaṃgatam ||31|| snānaṃ daśavidhaṃ kāryaṃ viṣṇunāmnā mahāphalam || supte deve viśeṣeṇa naro devatvamāpnuyāt || 32 || vinā snānaṃ tu yatkarma puṇyakāryamayaṃ śubham || kriyate viphalaṃ brahmaṃstadgṛhṇanti hi rākṣasāḥ || 33 || snānena satyamāpnoti satye dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || dharmānmokṣapathaṃ prāpya punarnaivāvasīdati || || 34 || ye cādhyātmavidaḥ puṇyā ye ca vedāṃtapāragāḥ || sarvadānapradāne ca teṣāṃ snānena śudhyati || 35 || kṛtasnānasya hi harirdehamāśritya tiṣṭha ti || sarvakriyāphalaṃ yeṣu saṃpūrṇaphaladaṃ bhavet || 36 || sarvapāpavināśāya devatātoṣaṇāya ca || cāturmāsye jalasnānaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvaham || 37 || niśāyāṃ caiva na snāyātsaṃdhyāyāṃ grahaṇaṃ vinā || uṣṇodakena na snāyādrātrau śuddhirna jāyate || 38 || bhānusaṃdarśanācchuddhirvihitā sarvakarmasu || cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa jalaśuddhistu bhāvinī || 39 || aśaktyāṃ tu śarīrasya bhasmasnānena śudhyati || maṃtrasnānena vipreṃdra viṣṣupādodakena vā || 5.1.69.40 || nārāyaṇā'grataḥ snānaṃ kṣetre tīrthe nadīṣu ca || viśeṣato'pi śiprāyāṃ tīrthe karkābhidhe vare || 41 || yaśca snāti naro nityaṃ sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ padam|| tasmāttvaṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha tatra gacchasva mā ciram || 42 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi tiṣṭhaṃti karkarājajale sadā || 43 || karkasthe ca divānāthe snānaṃ kurvaṃti ye narā || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 44 || cāturmāsyaṃ samāsādya tatraiva nivasāmyaham || nāsti revāsamā puṇyā nadī brahmāṃḍabhūtale || 45 || maheśānnā'paro devo muktido na janārdanāt || ujjayinīsamā nāsti purī kāmavara pradā || 46 || karkarājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti vatsa mahītale || yasya darśanamātreṇa muktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ || 47 || evaṃ vyāsa samākhyātaṃ brahmaṇā bhārga vāya ca || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mahākālavanaṃ vraja || 48 || asmākaṃ cā'pi tatraiva sthānaṃ paramaśobhanam || cāturmāsye harau supte yāvadyāyātprabo dhinī || 49 || tāvatkālaṃ hi tatraiva muktireva na saṃśayaḥ || cāturmāsye harau supte jahāti cetkalevaram || 5.1.69.50 || yamaloke ciraṃ vāso jāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || tasmāttulasikābhāge śāligrāme surālaye || 51 || ātmānaṃ hi paṇīkṛtya tatraiva saṃniyojayet || yāvatprabodhinī caiti dvādaśī dvijsattama ||52|| paścādghṛtasuvarṇena mocayitvā svakaṃ nayet || cāturmāsyodbhavaṃ doṣaṃ bādhate na ca mānavam ||53|| yasya śiprodake snānaṃ karkarāje'nujāyate || evaṃ vyāsa varaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || 54 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarāśca ye || te sarve ca samāyāṃti cāturmāsye dvijottama|| 55 || tasmācca tadvaraṃ tīrthaṃ karkarāja iti smṛtam || 56 || ya etāṃ vai kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇvaṃti śrāvayaṃti ca || na teṣāṃ jāyate doṣaścāturmā syodbhavaḥ kadā || 57 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye karkarājatīrtha mahimavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 69 || || cha ||
<5.1.70>
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || || merośca dakṣiṇe bhāge dugdhakuṇḍottare tathā || ṛṣabhaḥ parvataśreṣṭho devagandharvasevitaḥ || 1 || yatra devāṃganā ramyāḥ krīḍanti satataṃ dvija || tatra ramyasaronāma tiṣṭhate sarvakāmadam || 2 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā subhago jāyate dhruvam || devaiśca krīḍate nityaṃ bhuvi vikhyātakaḥ param || 3 || bhādrapadasitāṣṭamī maitrarkṣeṇa samanvitā || taddine'tra samāgamya snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 4 || karoti satataṃ vyāsa teṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || merośceśānake tīrthaṃ divyaṃ parama śobhanam ||5|| bindusareti vikhyātaṃ sarvakāmavarapradam|| gaṃgā sarasvatī puṇyā śarayūśca payasvinī ||6|| etāḥ saridvarā yātāstatra satyavatīsuta || ye siddhā ye ca sādhyāśca tapasvino dhṛtavratāḥ||7|| upāsāṃcakrire tatra tasya tīrthasya sarvadā || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā sarvārthānprāpnute dhruvam ||8|| bhādrapade ca śuklā vai caturthī yā prakīrtitā|| siddhā sā sarvadā proktā yatra jāto gaṇādhipaḥ||9|| manaḥkāmeśvaraḥ khyātaḥ sarvakāmavarapradaḥ || tasya tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gaṇeśvaram|| manorathaśataṃ prāpya kāmacārī bhavennaraḥ ||5.1.70.10|| || vyāsa uvāca || || asminkṣetre śubhe brahmanmahākālavanottame ||11|| tīrthāni katisaṃkhyāni devatāyatanāni ca || yāni kāni ca khyātāni tāni no vada vistarāt|| 12 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śṛṇu vyāsa ṛṣiśreṣṭha kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || avantyāṃ yāni tīrthāni liṃgāni ca mahāmune || 13 || tāni varṇayituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃbhūścaturānanaḥ || varṣāṇāmayutaiḥ ṣaḍbhirna ca vaktuṃ kathaṃcana || 14 || yāvaṃto meghamālānāṃ biṃdavo hi sravaṃti ca || dharitryāṃ tṛṇasaṃkhyā vai pṛthivyāṃ sikatāstathā ||15|| nabhaso jyotiṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vaktuṃ ko'pi na śaknute || na hi tīrthaliṅgasaṃkhyāḥ saṃtyavaṃtyāṃ tapodhana ||16|| aṃtarikṣe ca medinyāṃ tīrthabhūtā purī tviyam || vāpīkūpataḍāgādi prasravodgaraṇāni ca || 17 || nadyaḥ sarāṃsi khātāśca tīrthabhūtaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ || tathāpi devayātrāyāṃ prasaṃgena nibodha me || 18 || yāni kāni ca mukhyāni tāni tubhyaṃ vadāmyaham || yajjñātvā mokṣyase nityaṃ pūrvā''cīrṇaśubhāśubhaiḥ || 19 || prātarutthāya yo nityaṃ śuciḥ prayata mānasaḥ || viṣṇusmaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvakāmakriyādikam || 5.1.70.20 || kṛtvā vai sarvagaṃdhāditilākṣatasamanvitaḥ|| snātvā rudrasare tāta tathaiva ca vrataṃ caret || 21 || ūrjamādhavayoścaiva vaiśākhā''ṣāḍhayostathā || śivarātryāṃ viśeṣeṇa devayātrā praśasyate ||22|| yasya devasya yattīrthaṃ yasya devasya saṃnidhau ||| tatrābhiṣekaḥ kāryo vai devatāyāśca pūjanam ||23|| vidhivaccācaredyastu sa sarvaṃphalamaśnute || tasmātsarvaprayatnena devayātrāṃ samācaret|| 24 || || vyāsa uvāca || || brahmankena prakāreṇa devayātrāṃ carennaraḥ|| tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa tapodhana ||25|| || sanatkumāra uvāca |||| śṛṇu vyāsa paraṃ guhyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāśrutam || umāmaheśvarasaṃvādaṃ devayātrādikarmasu ||26|| || umovāca || || prabhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ deva kṣetrasyā'sya maheśvara || yāni tīrthāni vidyaṃte yāni liṃgāni saṃti vai|| tānyādito me bhūmaṃstvaṃ vadasva vadatāṃ vara||27|| īśvara uvāca|| śṛṇu devi prayatnena prabhāvaṃ pāpanāśanam||28|| kṣetramādyaṃ mahādevi mamātīva priyaṃ sadā|| yatra śiprā mahāpuṇyā divyā navanadī priyā|| 29|| nīlagaṃgāsaṃgamaṃ ca tathā gaṃdhavatī nadī|| catasro me priyā nadyaḥ kumudvatyāṃ hi suvrate || 5.1.70.30 || īśvarāścaturāśītistathā'ṣṭau saṃti bhairavāḥ || ekādaśa tathā rudrā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || || 31 || ṣaḍvai vināyakāścā'tra devyaśca caturviṃśatiḥ || yatohamāgato bhadre mahākālavanottame || 32 || viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ sarve hyatraiva nihitāḥ śubhe || devaivyāptamidaṃ kṣetraṃ devi yojanamāyatam || 33 || daśa viṣṇuḥ samākhyātāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || vāsudevo hyanaṃtaśca balarāmo janā rdanaḥ || 34 || nārāyaṇo hṛṣīkeśo vārāho dharaṇīdharaḥ || viṣṇurvāmanarūpeṇa śeṣaśāyī śriyālayaḥ || 35 || daśaite vaiṣṇavāḥ proktāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ parāḥ ||36|| || umovāca || || bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi devānāmanupūrvataḥ || mahākālavane ramye ye vasaṃti sureśvarāḥ || 37 || vināyakā bhairavā devyo ye saṃti pavanātmajāḥ || rudrādityāstathā cā'nye teṣāṃ nāmāni me vada || 38 || || īśvara uvāca || || ṛddhidaḥ siddhido nityaṃ kāmado vai gaṇādhipaḥ|| vighnahā ca pramodī ca caturthīvratakapriyaḥ||39|| ṣaḍete vai samākhyātā vighnanāśakarāḥ parāḥ|| umā caṃḍīśvarī gaurī ṛddhisiddhipradā nṛṇām ||5.1.70.40|| vaṭayakṣiṇī vīrabhadrā ityetāścāṣṭa mātaraḥ|||| mahāmāyā satī khyātā kapālamātṛkā tathā || aṃbikā śītalā caiva ekānaṃśā ca siddhidā||42|| brahmāṇī pārvatī caiva yoginī yogaśālinī || kaumārī bhagavatī caiva ṣaṭkṛttikāstathaiva ca || 43 || carpaṭāmātṛkāḥ khyātā vaṭamātara eva ca || sarasvatī tathā khyātā mahālakṣmīśca vai smṛtā || 44 || yoginīmātṛkā khyātāścatuṣaṣṭistataḥ smṛtāḥ|| kālikā ca mahākālī cāmuṇḍa brahmacā riṇī || 45 || vaiṣṇavī ca samākhyātā vārāhī viṃdhyavāsinī || aṃbā aṃbālikā caiva caturviṃśatikāḥ parāḥ || 46 || hanūmānbrahmacārī ca kumāraśca mahābalī || catvāro vai samākhyātā mayā te pavanātmajāḥ || 47 || daṃḍapāṇiśca vikrāṃto mahābhairavasitā'sitāḥ || baṭuko bālako naṃdī ṣaṭ pañcāśatiko'paraḥ || 48 || kālabhairavaśca vikhyātaḥ kṣetrapālastathāṣṭamaḥ || aṣṭaiva bhairavāḥ khyātā mahāpāpaharāḥ parāḥ || kapardī ca kapālī ca kalā nātho vṛṣāsanaḥ || 49 || tryaṃbakaḥ śūlapāṇiśca cīravāsā digambaraḥ || girīśaḥ kāmacārī ca sarvaḥ sarvāṃgabhūṣaṇaḥ || 5.1.70.50 || rudrāścaikādaśa proktāḥ śatrupakṣavināśanāḥ || aruṇaḥ sūryo vedāṃgo bhānurindro raviraṃśumān || 51 || suvarṇaretā'haḥkartā mitro viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || ityete dvādaśā''dityāḥ sarvarogaharāḥ parāḥ || 52 || agastyeśvaramukhyānāṃ liṃgānāṃ caturāśinām || himācalasute nityaṃ nāmāni gadataḥ śṛṇu || 53 || agastveśvara ākhyāto guheśvarastataḥ param || ḍhuṃḍheśvarastataḥ prokto ḍamarukeśvaraśca bhāmini ||54 || anādikalpeśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ svarṇajāleśvaraḥ paraḥ || triviṣṭapeśvaro devaḥ kapāleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || 55 || karkoṭakeśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ siddheśvarastataḥ param || svargadvāreśvaro rudro lokapāleśvaro'paraḥ || 56 ||| kāmeśvara iti khyātaḥ kuṭumbeśvarastataḥ param|| indradyumneśvaraḥ khyāta īśāneśastataḥ param || 57 || apsareśvaraitikhyātaḥ kalkaleśvara eva ca ||| nāmacaṃḍeścaro devo divāpāpaharo'paraḥ || 58 || pratihāreśvaraścaiva kukkuṭeśastataḥ param|| meghanādeśvaraḥ puṇyo mahākāleśvaraḥ paraḥ || 59 ||| mukteśvaraḥ samākhyātaḥ someśvarastataḥ param || anarakeśvaro devo jaṭeśvarastataḥ param|| 5.1.70.60 || rāmeśvaro mahādevaścyavaneśastataḥ param || akhaṃḍeśaḥ samākhyātaḥ pattaneśastataḥ smṛtaḥ || 61 || ānaṃdeśastataḥ proktaḥ kaṃthaḍeśastataḥ param || indreśvara iti khyāto mārkaṃḍeśastataḥ paraḥ || 62 || śiveśvara iti proktaḥ kusumeśastataḥ param|| akrūreṇa iti khyātaḥ kuṇḍeśvarastataḥ param || 63 || lumpeśvaraḥ samākhyāto gaṃgeśvarastataḥ param || śūleśvareti vikhyāta oṃkāreśastataḥ smṛtaḥ || 64 || kaṃṭakeśo mahārudraḥ siṃheśvarastataḥ param || revaṃteśvaraḥ paro devo ghaṃṭeśvarapuraḥsaraḥ || 65 || prayāgeśvaro mahādevaḥ siddheśvarastataḥ param || mātaṃgeśvaraḥ paro devaḥ saubhāgyeśastato varaḥ || 66 || rūpeśvareti vikhyāto brahmeśvarastataḥ param || jalpeśvarastato devaḥ kedāreśvara eva ca || 67 || piśāceśvaraśaṃbhuśca saṃgameśastataḥ paraḥ || durdharṣeśaśca vikhyātaścaṃḍādityeśvarastataḥ|| 68 || karabheśvaraḥ paraḥ prokto rājasthaleśvaraḥ śivaḥ || vaḍaleśvarastataḥ prokto hyaruṇeśastataḥ smṛtaḥ || 69 || puṣpadaṃteśvaro devo hyavimukteśvarastataḥ || hanumateśvaro devo viśveśvara stataḥ kam || 5.1.70.70 || svapneśvara iti khyātaḥ siddheśvarastataḥ paraḥ || nīlakaṃṭheśvaro devaḥ sthāvareśastataḥ param || 71 || kāmeśvara iti proktaḥ pratihāreśvarastataḥ || paśupatīśvaraḥ prokto viśveśvarastataḥ paraḥ || svarṇajāleśvaraḥ prokto manaḥkāmeśvarastataḥ || 72 || durvāseśvaranāmāsau nāgacaṃḍeśvarastataḥ || kharpareśaśca vikhyāto brahmeśvarastataḥ param || 73 || pātāleśvara ākhyāto gupteśvarastataḥ paraḥ || kapileśvara ityākhyo yogayogeśvaraḥ paraḥ || 74 || bhīmeśvareti vikhyāto dhanuḥsahasrābhidhaḥ paraḥ || agnīśvaraḥ paraḥ prokto deveśvarastataḥ paraḥ || 75 ||| dvādaśārkaḥ samākhyāto daśāśvamedhikeśvaraḥ || gadādhareśvaraḥ khyāto vaijanātheti śaṃbhurāṭ || 76 || somanātheśvaraḥ khyāto ghuṣmeśvarastataḥ paraḥ| bhīmaśaṃkara ityākhyo ghaṃṭeśvarastataḥ paraḥ || 77 || ūṣareśvarasaṃjñaśca candrādityeśvaraḥ paraḥ || keśavārkaḥ samākhyātaḥ śaktibhedeśvaraḥ paraḥ || 78 || rāmeśvaraḥ paro devo vālmīkeśvaraśaṃkaraḥ || jvāleśvaraḥ śivaḥ prokto hyabhayeśastataḥ paraḥ || 79 || vighnahasteśvaraḥ proktaścaṃcaleśastataḥ paraḥ || puruṣottameti vikhyāto vīreśvarastataḥ paraḥ || 5.1.70.80 || karṇeśvaraśca vikhyātaḥ pṛthukeśastataḥ param|| ānaṃdeśaśca vikhyātaḥ koṭeśvarastataḥ paraḥ || 81 || avimukteśvaraḥ prokto hanumatkeśvaraḥ paraḥ || vimaleśvareti vikhyātaścaṃdreśvarastataḥ paraḥ || 82 || biṃdukeśaśca vikhyāto vālukeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || bṛhaspatīśvaro devo hyasaṃkhyāteśvarastataḥ || 83 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni tāni liṃgāni sattama || tiṣṭhaṃti tatra pūjyāni tāni vaṃdyāni sarvaśaḥ || 84 || catvāro viditāḥ sarve dvārapālā mahātmabhiḥ || piṃgaleśvareti ca khyātaḥ pūrvadvāre dvijottama || 85 || dakṣiṇe ca tathā dvāre kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraḥ || bilvakeśvareti vikhyātaḥ paścimadvāramāśritaḥ || 86 || dardureśvarastataḥ prokto dvāre cottarasaṃjñike || ete cā'nye ca bahavo liṃgākhyāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ || 87 || mahākālavane ramye samākhyātā hi pāvanāḥ || ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || 88 || mahākālavane vyāsa liṃgasaṃkhyā na vidyate || tathā'pi ca prādhānyena mayā'tra parikīrtitāḥ || 89 || yasya devasya yattīrthaṃ tannāmnā parikīrtitam || snātvā dattvā ca taddānaṃ tattīrtha syaphalaṃ labhet || 5.1.70.90 || tathā navagrahāḥ puṇyāḥ samākhyātāḥ purā'nagha || teṣāṃ nāmāni puṇyāni tīrthāni ca tathā śṛṇu || 91 || narāditya iti khyātaḥ someśvarastataḥ paraḥ || maṃgaleśvaraḥ samākhyāto budheśvarastataḥ param || 92 || bṛhaspatīśvaraḥ proktastathā śukreśvaraḥ śivaḥ || sthāvareśvaro mahādevaḥ samākhyāto munīśvaraiḥ || 93 || rāhuketū samākhyātau teṣāṃ tīrthāni sattama || tattīrtheṣu naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 7 || grahā rājyaṃ prayacchaṃti grahā rājyaṃ haraṃti ca || grahaistu vyāpitaṃ sarvaṃ trailoktyaṃ sacarācaram || 95 || grahatīrthe naraḥ snātvā grahāṇāmarcanaṃ caret || na tasya grahapīḍā vai bādhate hi kadācana || 96 || evaṃ vyāsa samākhyātā mayā devāśca tīrthakāḥ || yātrā puṇyatarā śreṣṭhā pavitrā pāpanāśinī || 97 || grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu dāridrye ghorasaṃkaṭe || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya devayātrā prakīrtitā || 98 || kṣetrasyāṃtargṛhīṃ nityaṃ ye kurvaṃti narottamāḥ || na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 99 || aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt || vidyāvāñjāyate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || 5.1.70.100 || akṣayā saṃtatistasya śivaloke mahīyate || 101 | iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe 'vantīkṣetramāhātmye devayātrāṃ'targṛhīsarvatīrthayātrā'nukramaṇikādikathanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 || cha ||
<5.1.71>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || bhagava nbhavatā sarvaṃ kathitaṃ devamūrtinā || avaṃtītīrthamāhātmyaṃ pavitraṃ vedasaṃmitam || 1 || bhūyastu śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || mahākālavane ramye avaṃtyāṃ bhuvi sattama || tīrthāni katisaṃkhyāni vidyaṃte hyatra suvrata || 2 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || ||3|| umāmaheśvarasaṃvādaṃ nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ || nāradena purā pṛṣṭaṃ praśnametaddvijottama || 4 || || nārada uvāca || || bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi mahākāla vane śubhe || tīrthāni yāni vartaṃte tāni no vada vistarāt || 5 || iti pṛṣṭastadā vipra nāradena purā'nagha || uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā umayā sahito haraḥ || 6 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva bho ṛṣiśreṣṭha mahākālavane śubhe || tīrthāni yāni tiṣṭhaṃti tāni vakṣyāmi suvrata || 7 || puṣkarādyāni tīrthāni yāni kāni mahītale || tāni sarvāṇi vartaṃte mahākālavanottame || 8 || asaṃkhyātasahasrāṇi koṭikoṭīni sattama || rudrasare nimajjaṃti koṭitīrthaṃ tathocyate || 9 || nīhārakaṇikāvṛṣṭiṃ girau varṣaṃti kinnarāḥ || hemaṃte caiva dṛśyaṃte tīrthe paiśācamocane || 5.1.71.10 || na hi saṃkhyāṃ vijānāmi tīrthānāṃ bhuvi sattama || kiyanti saṃti tīrthāni liṃgāni ca tathaiva ca || 11 || tathā'pi ca prādhānyena kathayiṣyāmi sattama || saṃvatsarasya yāvaṃti ahāni ca dvijottama || 12 || tāvaṃti prāpaṇīyāni prasiddhāni paraṃtapa || vatsare paripūrṇe ca jāyate'vaṃtiyātrikā || 13 || vidhivatkurute yastu sākṣācchaṃbhurbhavecca saḥ || manvaṃtarasahasreṣu kāśīvāse ca yatphalam || 14 || tatphalaṃ jāyate'vaṃtyāṃ vaiśākhe paṃcabhirdinaiḥ || avaṃtī yātrā kartavyā prayatnena mumukṣuṇā || 15 || mādhave'pi viśeṣeṇa hyavaṃtīsnānamācaret || yo hi vaiśākhamāsādya avaṃtyāṃ vyāsa mānavaḥ || 16 || saṃvatsaravratī snātastīrthetīṃrthe yathāvidhi || dattvā dānāni sarvāṇi samūlaṃ phalamaśnute || 17 || bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulāñchivaloke mahīyate ||18|| māhātmyametacchivabhaktivarddhanaṃ yaśaskaraṃ puṇyavivarddhanaṃ ca || yaḥ śrāvayedvā śṛṇuyācca bhaktyā kulaṃ samuddhṛtya haraḥ padaṃ vrajet || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye vyāsasanatkumārasaṃvāde 'vantīkṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaika saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 || || cha || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmyaṃ prathamaṃ sampūrṇam || 5.1 ||
<5.2.1>
||atha śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe pañcamaāvantyakhaṃḍe 'vaṃtīsthacaturaśītiliṅgamāhātmyaṃ dvitīyaṃ prārabhyate|| 5.2 || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmahākālāya namaḥ || || athāvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīsthacaturaśītiliṅgamāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate || || umovāca || || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāśca saritastathā || kathyatāṃ tāni yatnena śrāddhaṃ yeṣu pradīyate || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || asti lokeṣu vikhyātā gaṃgā tripathagāminī || sevitā devagaṃdharvairmunibhiśca niṣevitā || 2 || tapanasya sutā devī yamunā lokapāvanī || pitṝṇāṃ vallabhā devi mahāpātaka hāriṇī || 3 || candrabhāgā vitastā ca narmadā'marakaṃṭake || kurukṣetraṃ gayā devi prabhāsaṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā ||4|| kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva tathā kāyāvarohaṇam || tathā puṇyatamaṃ devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 5 || yatrāste śrīmahākālaḥ pāpeṃdhanahutāśanaḥ || kṣetraṃ yojanaparyaṃtaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam || 6 || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ kṣetraṃ kalikalmaṣanāśanam || pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ devi duṣprāpyaṃ tridaśairapi || 7 || || umovāca || || prabhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ deva kṣetrasyāsya maheśvara|| 8 || yāni tīrthāni vaṃdyāni yāni liṃgāni saṃti vai || tānyahaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 9 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi prayatnena prabhāvaṃ pāpanāśanam || kṣetramādyaṃ mahādevi mamātīva priyaṃ sadā || 5.2.1.10 || yatrāsti ca mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā parā || tathā gaṃdhavatī puṇyā divyā navanadīpriyā || 11 || nīlagaṃgā caturthī tu śreṣṭhā nadyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || āsāṃ tu saṃgame snātvā śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ || || 12 || gaṃgāyāstriguṇaṃ devi caturvargaphalapradam || kṣetraṃ yojanaparyaṃtamavaṃtyā viddhi suvrate || 13 || siddhaliṃgāni tiṣṭhaṃti bhuktimuktikarāṇi ca || īśvarāścaturāśītistathāṣṭau saṃti bhairavāḥ || 14 || ekādaśa tathā rudrā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || ṣaḍvai vināyakāścātra caturviṃśatimātaraḥ || 15 || yadāhaṃ gatavāṃstatra mahākālavane śubhe || brahmaviṣṇvādayaḥ sarve tatrājagmurmudānvitāḥ || 16 || ebhirvyāptaṃ kṣetramidaṃ devi yojanamāyatam || daśa sthānagato viṣṇuḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 17 || etannāmāni yo'dhīte prabhāte bhaktitaḥ pumān || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaistu rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 16 || || umovāca || || caturāśītiliṃgāni tvayoktānīha yāni tu|| tāni vistarato brūhi sarvapāpaharāṇi tu || 19 || || hara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi teṣāṃ nāmāni yāni ca || khyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prathamamagastyeśvaramuttamam || yasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 5.2.1.20 || || || umovāca || || agastyeśvaranāmeha kathaṃ labdhamanena vai|| kasminsthāne kathaṃ jātaṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi || 21 || || hara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi mahābhāge kathāmasya purātanīm || sarvapāpapraśamanīṃ samīhitaphalapradām||22|| purā'surairjitā devā nirutsāhāśca te tataḥ|| bhāgāścaiṣāṃ hṛtāḥ sarve nirāśāḥ pitaraḥ kṛtā || bhraṣṭaiśvaryyāstadā devi cerurdevā mahītale || 23 || tataḥ kadācitte dīnā dīptamādityavarcasam|| dadṛśustejasāyuktamagastyaṃ vipulavratam || 24 || abhivādya tato devā dṛṣṭvā taṃ tejasā vṛtam || idamūcurmahātmānamagastyaṃ lokaviśrutam || 25|| dānavairnirjitā yuddhe sarve svargācca pātitāḥ || tatastvaṃ no bhayāttīvrāttrāyasva munipuṃgava || 26 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā devairagastyaḥ kupito'bhavat || prajajvāla ca tejasvī kālāgniriva saṃkṣaye || 27 || tadā dīptāṃśujālena nirdagdhā dānavāstathā || aṃtarikṣānmahādevi patitāśca sahasraśaḥ || 28 || dahyamānāstato daityā stasyāgastyasya tejasā || ṛṣeśca dānavāḥ sarve pātālaṃ vavrajurbhayāt || 29 || tato 'gastyo mahātmā vai tānhatvā śokamūrchitaḥ || babhūvātiśayaṃ cāsau ciṃtayodvignamānasaḥ || 5.2.1.30 || kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahatpāpaṃ hatā yaddānavā mayā || ahiṃsā paramo dharmo manunā kathyate yataḥ || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ śudhyeya cāpyaham || 31 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya samāgacchatpitāmahaḥ || provāca sa muniṃ tatra kasmāttvaṃ śokavihvalaḥ || 32 || lakṣyase muniśārdūla kāraṇaṃ kathyatāṃ tvaram || sa brahmāṇaṃ namaskṛtya kathayāmāsa pṛcchataḥ || 33 || devadeva jagannātha dāhoṃtarmānasaṃ mama || brahmahatyā samāyātā yanmayā dānavā hatāḥ || 34 || mamopāyaṃ samācakṣva prasādatsurasattama || bahukālārjitaṃ deva gataṃ me saṃkṣayaṃ tapaḥ ||35|| provācedaṃ suraśreṣṭhaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ yatnataḥ param|| upāyaṃ sarvapāpasya kṣayo yena bhaveddhruvam||36|| mahākālavane divye yakṣagaṃdharvasevite|| uttare vaṭayakṣiṇyā yattalliṃgamanuttamam||37|| piśācasyāpi tīrthasya bhāge dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || taṃ samārādhyataḥ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamavāpnuyāt || 38 || ārādhaya śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapāpapraṇā śanam || bāḍhaṃ provāca dharmātmā mahākālavanaṃ yayau ||39|| tasminsa liṃge deveśi samārādhanatatparaḥ || babhūvāharniśaṃ bhaktyā taddhyānaikarato muniḥ || 5.2.1.40 || ahaṃ tuṣṭastadā devi munestasya mahātmanaḥ || 41 || proktaṃ mayā mahābhāga mune śṛṇu samāhitaḥ || varaṃ varaya vipreṃdra yatte manasi varttate || 42 || tuṣṭo'hamanayā bhaktyā tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || liṃgasyāsya prabhāveṇa jātastvaṃ nirmalo'dhunā ||43|| praṇaṣṭā brahmahatyā te dānavotthā munīśvara || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tenoktaṃ varavarṇini || 44 || yadi deva prasannastvaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ || tvadaṃghriyugale bhūyānmama bhaktirmaheśvara || 45 || tapasyatha tathā dharme na me vighno bhavediti || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kuṃbhayonermahātmanaḥ || mayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi mune evaṃ bhaviṣyati || 46 || yastvayā pūjito devo brahmahatyāvināśanaḥ || tvannāmnā triṣu lokeṣu so'haṃ khyāto bhaviṣyati || 47 || agastyeśvaradevopi vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || evamukto mayā devi sa viprastatra saṃsthitaḥ || kṛpayā tasya liṃgasya paṃcamudrāvibhūṣitaḥ || 48 || ye narāstanmahāliṃgaṃ nirīkṣiṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarvakāmairalaṃkṛtāḥ||49|| bhaviṣyaṃti mahātmānaḥ putraiśvaryasamanvitāḥ || aṃtakāle ca māṃ yāṃti vimānaiḥ sarvakāmadaiḥ ||5.2.1.50|| stutā gaṃdharvamukhyaiśca rudraloke ca śāśvate || ye'rcayaṃti sadā devamagastveśvarasaṃjñakam||51 || kṛtapuṇyā narā marttyāste yāṃti paramaṃ padam || saṃsmṛte devade veśe narāṇāṃ koṭijanmajam||52|| aśubhaṃ kṣayamāpnoti kastaṃ na praṇamecchivam|| yaḥ praṇamya naro bhaktyā devaṃ taṃ ca niṣevate||53|| mucyate brahmahatyādipā takairnarakapradaiḥ || 54 || rājasūyaśatenaiva yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi darśanācca bhaviṣyati || 55 || kiṃ tīrthairvividhaiḥ snānaiḥ kiṃ dānairvividhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || te prāpsyaṃti phalaṃ sarve matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ||56|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ dine somasya śaktitaḥ || yaḥ kariṣyati liṃgasya pūjā bhaktisamanvitaḥ || kulānāṃ tārayatyeva mātṛkaṃ pitṛkaṃ śatam ||57|| ye ca paśyaṃti puruṣā bhāvahīnāḥ prasaṃgataḥ || na te paśyaṃti saṃsāre narakaṃ vai kadā cana || 58 || etatte kathitaṃ devi liṃgamahātmyamuttamam || prathamaṃ kathitaṃ loke dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu yatnataḥ|| 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye'gastyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||
<5.2.2>
śrīrudrauvāca || || śṛṇu guheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāpanāśanam || yasya darśanamātreṇa jāyate siddhiruttamā || 1 || purā rāthaṃtare kalpe devadāruvane śubhe || ṛṣirmaṃkaṇakonāma vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || yogābhyāsarato nityaṃ śāṃtidāṃtisamāsthitiḥ || 2 || siddhikāmastapastepe kathaṃ siddho bhavāmyaham || raktamayavikāroyaṃ kathaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣayam || 3 || iti saṃciṃtya hṛdaye prārabdhaṃ tapa uttamam || bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tasyātītāni pārvati || 4 || kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu viddhasya parvatātmaje || karācchākaraso jātaḥ kuśāgreṇa tadaiva hi || 5 || sa ca dṛṣṭvā tadāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || mene siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptāṃ sagarvo vākyamabravīt || 6 || aho tapaḥprabhāvo'yaṃ prāptā siddhirmayādya vai || mattulyo nāsti vai vipro yena siddhiḥ samāgatā || 7 || śarīraṃ kutsitaṃ cedaṃ malamūtreṇa saṃyutam || mantrasnāyuvasāpṛktamāṃsaśoṇitapūritam || harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sa nanartta dvijastathā || 8 || etasminnṛtyati vipre jagatsthāvara jaṃgamam || anṛtyadrāgasaṃyuktaṃ prabhāvāttasya vai muneḥ || 9 || na svādhyāyo vaṣaṭkāraḥ karmakāṃḍo na ca kvacit || 5.2.2.10 || etasminnaṃtare devā brahmaviṣṇu puraḥsarāḥ || māmūcurvismitāḥ sarve nātha nṛtyaṃ tadā kuru || 11 || ṛṣau maṃkaṇake deva nṛtyati nṛtyati sarvataḥ || sadevāsuramānuṣyaṃ sarvaṃ lokatrayaṃ vibho || 12 || calitāḥ parvatāḥ sthānātkṣubhitā meghapaṃktayaḥ || śikharāṇi viśīryaṃte dharaṇī pīḍitā bhṛśam || 13 || srotomātrā mahānadyo grahā unmārgataḥ sthitāḥ || 14 || trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ yāvannāyāti saṃkṣayam || tāvannivārayasvainaṃ nānyaḥ śakto vinā tvayā || 15 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tridaśānāṃ yaśasvini || pratijñātaṃ mayātyarthaṃ gatvā tasya samīpataḥ || 16 || dvijarūpaṃ samāsthāya mayā pṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ || kimarthaṃ nṛtyasi brahmankasmātte harṣa āgataḥ || 17 || viruddhamṛṣidharmāṇāṃ kāmarāgeṇa narttanam || gītaṃ ca narttanaṃ caiva yuvatījanavallabham || 18 || brāhmaṇasya tapo bhraṃśaḥ sadācārasya sattama || iti matvā dvijaśreṣṭha kimarthaṃ nṛtyase bhṛśam|| 19 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || kiṃ na paśyasi bho brahmankarācchākarasaṃ cyutam || ataeva hi me nṛtyaṃ siddho'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5.2.2.20 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hāso'tīva mayā kṛtaḥ || aṃguṣṭhastāḍitaḥ svīyoṃgulyagreṇa ca pārvati || 21 || tato vinirgataṃ bhasma tatkṣaṇāddhimapāṃḍuram || hāsenokto viśālākṣi sagarvo brāhmaṇo mayā || 22 || paśya meṃ'guṣṭhato brahmanbhūri bhasma vinirgatam || na nṛtyehaṃ na me harṣastathāpi munissama || 23 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ lajjito dvijasattamaḥ || dhairyaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 24 || abravītprāṃjalirbhūtvā vismitenāṃtarātmanā || nānyaṃ devamahaṃ manye tvāṃ muktvā
