vṛṣabhadhvajam || 25 || nānyasya vidyate śakti rīdṛśī bhuvanatraye || tasmātkṣamasva deveśa mayājñānādanuṣṭhitam || 26 || tapaḥkṣayakaraṃ karma viruddhaṃ narttanaṃ satām|| bahukālārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tapasā duṣka reṇa tu || tadgataṃ sahasā deva madīyaṃ narttanena su || 27 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mayokto dvijasattamaḥ || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te tuṣṭo'haṃ dvijasattama || 28 || jñānenānena vipreṃdra kaṃ te kāmaṃ karomyaham ||29 || ṛṣiruvāca || || yadi deva prasannastvaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsala || yathā na syāttapohānistathā nītirvidhīyatām||5.2.2.30|| mayā proktaṃ prasannena tasya viprasya pārvati || tapaste varddhatāṃ vipra mahākālavanaṃ vraja||31|| tatrāste sarvadā puṇyā saptakalpodbhavā guhā|| piśāceśvaradevasya uttareṇa vyavasthitā || 32 || tatra drakṣyasi yalliṃgaṃ saptakalpodbhavaṃ śubham|| tasya darśanamātreṇa tapaste vṛddhimeṣyati ||33|| kāma krodhodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ lobhamohasamanvitam || īrṣyāmatsarajaṃ caiva nāśaṃ yāti ca kilbiṣam ||34|| madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sa vipro vedapāragaḥ || śrutvā ca niyamaṃ devi maduktaṃ sa tato dvijaḥ || 35 || niḥsṛto niyato bhūtvā namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ || ājagāma guhā yatra mahākālavanottame|| 36|| dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ tapaso varddhanaṃ param || dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo jāto vai liṃgadarśanāt ||37|| etasminnaṃtare devi devairuktaṃ nabhastale || gopyaṃ liṃgaṃ guhotthaṃ tu dṛṣṭaṃ maṃkaṇakena tu ||38|| siddhiḥ prāptā dvijenaiva darśanena sudurlabhā || tasmādguheśvaro devi bhaviṣyati mahītale ||39|| bhaktyā paramayopetā ye drakṣyaṃti guheśvaram || na teṣāṃ jāyate vighno dharmasya tapasastathā || 5.2.2.40 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ darśanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati || brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti pitarastasya dehinaḥ || 41 || atrāgatya prayatnena darśanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati || uddhariṣyati cātmānaṃ puruṣānekaviṃśatim|| 42 || kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi darśanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 43 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || darśanāttasyaliṃgasya sarvaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣayam || 44 || yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma janmakoṭiśatārjitam || kṣayaṃ yāsyati tatsarvaṃ sparśamātreṇa nānyathā || 45 || mahāpātakayuktā hi dehino ye mahītale || te'pi liṃgaṃ samāsādya mucyaṃte sarvapātakaiḥ || 46 || ityuktvā sa dvijo devi divyo maṃkaṇako muniḥ || kṛtvāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ tatraiva tapasi sthitaḥ || 47 || eṣa vai kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || śravaṇātkīrttanādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye guheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<5.2.3>
|| śrīrudra uvāca || || ḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu sukhasvargaphalapradam || sarvapāpaharaṃ ligaṃ nṛṇāṃ duṣkṛtanāśanam || 1 || ḍhuṃḍhaścāsītpurā devi kailāse gaṇanāyakaḥ || sa ca kāmī durācāro vyasanopahatendriyaḥ || 2 || gato'sau śakralokaṃ tu kautukārthaṃ yadṛcchayā || yatra nṛtyati sā raṃbhā śakrasyāgre vivṛṇvatī || || 3 || bhāvānbahuvidhānramyāndṛṣṭihastādikāñchubhān| sūcīviddhādikaraṇānpatākādikahastakān|| nṛtyaṃ hastādisaṃyuktaṃ layatālānugaṃ tathā ||4|| śakro'pi tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ tanmukhāsaktalocanaḥ || babhūva hṛṣṭacetā vai hṛṣitāṃgaruhānanaḥ || 5 || etasminnaṃtare devi ḍhuṃḍhastallalitena tu || kāmarāgavaśenaiva bhāvyarthena ca mohitaḥ || 6 || tena raṃgaratā raṃbhā puṣpagucchena tāḍitā || sa śapto vāsavenaiva dṛṣṭvā'nyāyaṃ gaṇasya tu || 7 || pata tvaṃ mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ raṃgabhaṃgastvayā kṛtaḥ || iti śapto gaṇo devi śakreṇāmitatejasā || 8 || patito mānuṣe loke visaṃjño vihvalendriyaḥ || kādigbhūto hato tsāho vilalāpa punaḥpunaḥ || 9 || aho'nyāyaphalaṃ prāptaṃ mayā mohādanuṣṭhitam || tasmānnītirvidhātavyā puruṣeṇa vijānatā || 5.2.3.10 || nyāyamārgaṃ samāśritya yena siddhirbhavenmama || 11 || ityuktvā sa tapastepe maheṃdre parvatottame || śrīśaile malaye viṃdhye pāriyātre yamālaye || 12 || no siddho'sau yadā devi tadā gaṃgāmahattaṭam || yamunāṃ caṃdrabhāgāṃ ca vitastāṃ narmadāṃ nadīm || 13 || godāvarīṃ bhīmarathīṃ kauśikīṃ śāradāṃ śivām || carmaṇvatīṃ samāsādya snātvā tyaktakriyo'bhavat || 14 || tīrthaṃ vyarthaṃ tapo vyarthaṃ tīrthayātrāphalaṃ yataḥ || na prāptaṃ ca mayābhīṣṭamaṭatā karmabhūmiṣu || 15 || etasminnaṃtare devi vāguvācāśarīriṇī || āśvāsayaṃtī gaṇapaṃ mahākālāyane vraja || 16 || prayāgādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni saṃti vai || sadā siddhikaraṃ teṣāṃ mahākālaṃ viśiṣyate || 17 || tatrāste sumahāpuṇyaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || piśāceśvarasāṃnidhye tamārādhaya satvaram || 18 || prasādāttasya liṃgasya punaryāsyasi śāṃkaram || lokaṃ tejasvināṃ gamyaṃ durlabhaṃ pāpināṃ sadā || 19 || iti śrutvā tato vāṇīmākāśasthāṃ gaṇastadā || ājagāma mudā yukto mahākālavanottame || 5.2.3.20 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubham|| pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 21 || liṃgamadhyāttato vāṇī niḥsṛtā parva tātmaje || aho tuṣṭosmi te vatsa kiṃ kāmaṃ pradadāmyaham || 22 || || ḍhuṃḍha uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa śaraṇāgatavatsala || tvatpādapaṃkaje bhūyādbhaktirme'vicalā sadā || 23 || varamenaṃ prayacchāśu yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 24 || ye ca tvāṃ mānavā deva paśyaṃti parameśvara || pāpātsadyo vinirmuktāste bhavaṃtu mahītale || 25 || ḍhuṃḍhasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā liṃgenoktaṃ yaśasvini || ye ca māṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā punaḥ|| te bhaviṣyaṃti satataṃ sadā pātakavarjitāḥ || 26 || lapsyaṃti te parānkāmānbhaviṣyaṃti gaṇottamāḥ|| pūjyāḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ||27|| evaṃ labdhavaro ḍhuṃḍhaḥ prāṃjaliḥ punarabravīt || mannāmnā prathitaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃbhūyādbhuvane sadā || 28 || evamastviti liṃgena proktaṃ tuṣṭena pārvati || tadāprabhṛti vikhyāto devo ḍhuṃḍhe śvaraḥ paraḥ || 29 || yasya darśanamātreṇa sadā siddhirbhavennṛṇām|| 5.2.3.30 || bhaktyā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ param || ājanmaprabhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ yāsya ti tatkṣaṇāt ||31|| sa eva sukṛtī loke sa eva mama vallabhaḥ|| yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā liṃgaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ param || 32 || rājasūyaśatenaiva yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || tato bhaviṣyatyadhikaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaranirīkṣaṇāt||33|| mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ guhyasaṃbhavam || prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ ca prasaṃgādapi yatkṛ tam || tatsarvaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya darśanāt||34|| ityuktastu mayā devi sa ḍhuṃḍho gaṇanāyakaḥ || kṛto liṃgasya māhātmyādgato loke madīyake || reje ca gaṇapaiḥ sārddhaṃ mamābhīṣṭataro'bhavat||35|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || śravaṇātkīrttanādvāpi mama loke mahīyate ||36|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye ḍhuṃḍheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3|| ||
<5.2.4>
śrīmahādeva uvāca || khyāto'vaṃtyāṃ caturtho'sau devo ḍamarukeśvaraḥ|| dṛṣṭe yasmiñjagannāthe yāti pāpaṃ ca saṃkṣayam ||1|| purā vaivasvate kalpe rururnāma mahāsuraḥ || tasya putro mahābāhurvajronāma mahābalaḥ || babhūva sumahākāyastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro bhayaṃkaraḥ || 2 || tena devāḥ svādhikārāccālitāstridaśāla yāt || 3 || tato nītaṃ dhanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmāṇaṃ te tato yayuḥ || brahmāpi bhayasaṃvigno babhūvākuliteṃdriyaḥ || 4 || jñātvāvadhyaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvaiḥ so'thamahā balaḥ || teṣu naṣṭeṣu ye viprā yajvāno'tha tapasvinaḥ || tāñjaghāna sa duṣṭātmā ye cānye dharmacāriṇaḥ || 5 || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ tadāsīddharaṇīta talam|| naṣṭayajñotsavaṃ devi hāhābhūtamacetanam || 6|| tataḥ pravyathitā devāstathā sarve maharṣayaḥ || sametyāmaṃtrayanmaṃtraṃ vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ || 7 || tataḥ kāyo'bhavatsadyaḥ sarveṣāṃ puratastadā || teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāṃ devi tejaḥpuṃjena cāvṛtaḥ || 8 || tasmātkṛtyā samutpannā divyā kamalalocanā || dyotayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ svatejobhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 9 || sābravīttridaśānsarvānkasmātsṛṣṭā hyahaṃ surāḥ || yatkartavyaṃ mayā karma tacchīghraṃ saṃnivedyatām || 5.2.4.10 || tatastu tridaśāḥ sarve śrutvā tasyāḥ śubhā giraḥ || ācakhyuḥ sakalaṃ tasyai tadā vajrasya ceṣṭitam || 11 || śrutvā jahāsa sā devī sāṭṭahāsaṃ muhur muhuḥ || tasyā hasaṃtyā niḥsasruḥ kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || 12 || pāśāṃkuśadharā raudrā jvālāmālāvṛtānanāḥ || phetkāreṇa ca saṃnādaiścālayaṃtyaścarācaram || 13 || gatāḥ sarvā mahādevi yatra vajro mahāsuraḥ || yuddhaṃ tu tumulaṃ jātaṃ tābhistasya bhayāvaham || 14 || śastrāstrairbahudhā muktairvyāptaṃ caiva digaṃtaram || saṃnaddhākhilasainyāste yuyudhuḥ samare bhṛśam || 15 || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tayā devyā suradviṣām || tato mātṛgaṇaṃ kruddhaṃ marddayantaṃ mahāsurān || parāṅmukhaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā vajro māyāmathāsṛjat || 16 || tāmasīṃnāma duḥsādhyāṃ yayā muhyati kanyakāḥ || 17 || tamobhūte tatastasminsā devī bhayavihvalā || tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ samāyātā mahākālavanottamam || 18 || kapālavānharo yatra liṃgākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ || jñātvā mātṛgaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ tato māyāprabhāvataḥ || 19 || vajro'pi tridaśāñjñātvā devyā sārddhamathopi(ṣi?)tān || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || 5.2.4.20 || mahākālavane divye rathakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ|| samaṃtācca vanaṃ devi tatkruddho vākyamabravīt ||21|| adya devānhaniṣyāmi tayā sākaṃ suduṣṭayā || kanyābhiḥ saha yā naṣṭā tamomāyābalena tu||22|| etasminnaṃtare kāle nārado munisattamaḥ|| sotsukastu samāyāto maṃdare cārukaṃdare|| 23 || kathayāmāsa devanāṃ vajrāddevaparābhavam||24|| mahākālavane deva tāḍitāsttridaśāḥ prabho|| vajreṇa ruruputreṇa tasmādyāhi maheśvara||25|| nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tato'haṃ parameśvari|| maṃdarādāgatastūrṇaṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ subhairavam||26|| sarpairlasadbhiratyugrairbhīṣaṇairgaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ|| agre dṛṣṭaṃ mahatsainyaṃ dānavānāṃ bhayāvaham||27|| mahākālavanaṃ ruddhaṃ samaṃtādasureṇa tu || vajreṇa ruruputreṇa duḥsahena yaśasvini || 28 || tadāgatya mayā tāḍya raudraṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā || mohitaṃ sahasā sainyaṃ vajrasyaiva durātmanaḥ || 29 || ḍamarukasya nādena hyutthitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || vidārya vasudhāṃ devi jvālāmālākulaṃ tadā || 5.2.4.30 || tasya liṃgasya ca tadā mahājvālā vinirgatā || ekadeśādvarārohe brahmāṃḍavyāpinī tathā || 31 || liṃgasyānyapradeśāttu vāyuḥ samabhavanmahān || 32 || tejojvālāsamūhena vātena preritena ca || saha cakreṇa tatsainyaṃ dagdhaṃ bhasmatvamāgatam || 33 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve harṣanirbharamānasāḥ || namaścakrurha te tasminruruputre mahābale || 34 || asya devasya māhātmyāddagdho vajro mahābalaḥ || sasainyobhūttatastasmādeṣa ḍamarukeśvaraḥ || khyātiṃ yāsyati lokesminsarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 35 || ḍamarukasya tu nādena jāto yasmānmahītale || ataḥ pūjyavaro devo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || dṛṣṭvā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devaṃ ḍamarukeśvaram || te sarve duḥkhanirmuktā bhaviṣyaṃti gatajvarāḥ || 37 || cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ vidhivacchatānāmatha yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ḍamarukeśvarapūjanāt || 38 || asminsthāne sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā ḍamarukeśvaram || prasaṃgādapi paśyaṃti hyapi pāpaparā narāḥ || 39 || te'pyavaśyaṃ tu yāsyaṃti rudralokaṃ sanātanam || bhaktāḥ stoṣyaṃti ye liṃgaṃ khyātaṃ ḍamarukeśvaram ||5.2.4.40|| mānasaiḥ pātakairmuktā yāsyaṃti paramaṃ padam || aśvamedhasahasraṃ tu vājapeyaśataṃ bhavet || gosahasraphalaṃ cātra dṛṣṭvā prāpsyaṃti mānavāḥ || 41 || yo yāti saṃgare dhīro dṛṣṭvā ḍamarukeśvaram || jayedripūnathāṃte sa rudraloke mahīyate || 42 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || stutastu kīrtitaścaiva sarvābhīṣṭaphalaprada || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye ḍamarukeśvarūmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho' dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha || ||
<5.2.5>
|| śrīrudra uvāca || || anādikalpeśvaraṃ devaṃ paṃcamaṃ viddhi pārvati || sarvapāpaharaṃ nityamanādirgīyate sadā || 1 || kalpasyādau purā devi liṃgametadvinirgatam || yadā nāgnirna cādityo na bhūmirna diśo na kham || 2 || na vāyurna jalaṃ caiva na dyaurne ndurgrahā na ca || na devāsuragaṃdharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ || 3 || ato liṃgātsamudbhūtaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || kālena ca layaṃ yāti liṃge'sminparvatātmaje || 4 || asmālliṃgātsamudbhūtā vaṃśā devarṣipaitṛkāḥ || manvaṃtarāṇi vaṃśāni vaṃśyānucaritaṃ ca yat || 5 || yāvatyaḥ sṛṣṭayaścaiva yāvaṃtaḥ pralayāstathā || samudrāḥ parvatāścaiva nimnagāḥ kānanāni ca || 6 || bhūrlokādyāśca ye lokāḥ pātālāḥ sapta ye smṛtāḥ || gatistathārkasomādigraharkṣa jyotiṣāmapi || 7 || dṛśyādṛśyaṃ ca tatsarvamato liṃgādvarānane || anādikāraṇaṃ yattadavyaktākhyaṃ maharṣayaḥ || yadāhuḥ puruṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nityaṃ sadasadā tmakam || 8 || dhruvamakṣayamajaramameyaṃ nānyasaṃśrayam || gaṃdharūparasairhīnaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam || 9 || anādyaṃtaṃ jagadyoniṃ triguṇaprabhavāvyayam || asādṛśyamavijñeyaṃ liṃgaṃ proktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 5.2.5.10 || pralayasyāṃte tenedaṃ divyamāsīdaśeṣataḥ || 11 || ahamurvyāṃ prabuddhastu jagadādiranādimān || sarvaheturaciṃtyātmā paraḥ ko'pyaparakriyaḥ || 12 || prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva pradarśyāśu jagatpatiḥ || kṣobhayāmāsa yogena pareṇa parameśvaraḥ || 13 || yathā saṃnidhimātreṇa gaṃdhaḥ kṣobhāya jāyate || manaso nopakartṛtvāttathāsau parameśvaraḥ || anādiḥ kathyate devo jagatkāraṇatatparam ||14|| pradhānaṃ kṣobhyamāṇaṃ tu tena liṃgena pārvati || jāyate bhuvanādhāro brahmāṃḍa iti viśrutaḥ || 15 || yasminnaṃḍe jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || utpannaṃ ca vilīnaṃ ca yasyāṃto'pi na labhyate ||16|| sa eva kṣobhakaḥ pūrvaṃ sa kṣobhyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || sa saṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ pradhānatve vyavasthitaḥ || 17 || utpannaḥ sa jagannātho nirguṇo'pi rajoguṇaḥ || bhuṃjanpravartate sargaṃ brahmatvaṃ samupāgataḥ || 18 || brahmatve sṛjate lokāṃstataḥ sattvātirekataḥ || viṣṇutvametya dharmeṇa karoti paripālanam || 19 || tatastamoguṇodbhinno rudratvenākhilaṃ jagat || upasaṃhṛtya vai śete trailokyaṃ triguṇo'guṇaḥ || 5.2.5.20 || yathā prāgvāpakaḥ kṣetrī pālako lāvakastathā || sa saṃjñā yāti tadvacca brahmaviṣṇutvarudratāḥ || 21 || brahmatve sṛjate lokānudratve saṃharatyapi || viṣṇutve pāti tānsarvāṃstisro'vasthāḥ smṛtāḥ sadā || 22 || rajo brahmā tamo rudraḥ sattvaṃ viṣṇurjagatpatiḥ || eta eva trayo vedā eta eva trayo narāḥ || 23 || kalpe kalpe hyanādistu gīyate tridaśaiḥ sadā || pitṛbhiśca gaṇaiḥ siddhairato'nādikalpeśvaraḥ || 24 || nāma prāptaṃ viśālākṣi mahākālavanaṃ sadā || yadā jāto vivādastu brahmaṇaḥ keśavasya ca || 25 || ahaṃ jyāyānahaṃ jyāyānkalpādau sṛṣṭikāraṇāt || divyā samutthitā vāṇī nirālaṃbā tadāṃbarāt || || 26 || mahākālavane liṃgaṃ kalpeśvareti saṃjñakam || tasyādimathavāṃtaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa ca prabhuḥ || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho na vādaḥ kriyatā miti || 27 || tato devi gato brahmā ūrddhvalokamanaṃtakam || adholokaṃ gato viṣṇustena vākyena satvaram || 28 || nādirdṛṣṭo na cāṃtaśca brahmaṇā keśavena tu || tadā tau vismayāpannau tuṣṭuvāte parasparam || 29 || vedoktasūktairvividhairabhinaṃdya puraḥsthitau || nādirasti na cāṃtaśca na ca kalpo'tra dṛśyate || 5.2.5.30 || tasmādanādikalpo'yamadyaprabhṛti bhūtale || khyātiṃ yāsyati nāmnā ca mahākālavanottame || 31 || pañcapātakasaṃyukto yo martyo duṣṭamānasaḥ || so'pi gacchecchivaṃ dṛṣṭvānādikalpeśvaraṃ śivam || 32 || śivamastu sadā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ tvaṃ darśanaṃ gataḥ || te dhanyā mānuṣe loke ye tvāṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ || 33 || sarvatīrthābhiṣekaistu yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || tatsarvamadhikaṃ deva labhyate tava darśanāt || 34 || tāvatpataṃti saṃsāre sukhaduḥkhasamākule || tāvanna dṛśyate deva saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ || 35 || yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ tadā tvaddarśanaṃ bhavet || 36 || brahmahā vā surāpo vā steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || tatsaṃsargī naro yastu mahākilbiṣakārakaḥ || so'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 37 || yatphalaṃ cāśvamedhena rājasūyena yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tava deva samarcanāt || 38 || te narāḥ paśavo loke teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || yairna dṛṣṭo mahādevo'nā dikalpeśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 39 || ityuktvā keśavo devo brahmā caiva varānane || vāme dakṣiṇabhāge ca tasya liṃgasya saṃsthitau || 5.2.5.40 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa labhyate paramaṃ padam|| 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye'nādikalpeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<5.2.6>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || ||| svarṇajvāleśvaraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ viddhi cātra yaśasvini || yasya darśanamātreṇa dhanavāniha jāyate || 1 || purā sārddhaṃ tvayā devi krīḍato mama maṃdire || jātaṃ varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ surataikarasasya ca || 2 || devaiḥ sarvaistato vahniḥ prerito mama saṃnidhau || tato vahniḥ samāyātastrailokyārthe yaśasvini|| 3 || tato vahnimukhe kṣiptaṃ vīryaṃ svaṃ krīḍatā mayā || dahyamānastadā tena gaṃgāṃ vahnirjagāma ha || 4 || tatra gatvā pracikṣepa vīryamagniḥ sudurddharam || tathāpi dahyate vahnirvīryaśeṣeṇa pārvati || 5 || jātaṃ ramyaṃ tato divyaṃ vīryaśeṣeṇa kāṃcanam || jvalaṃtaṃ cātitāpena duḥsahaṃ durddharaṃ priye || 6 || agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvotpannaṃ tu pārvati || lobhābhibhūtā asurāḥ surā gandharvakinnarāḥ || || 7 || yakṣāḥ sādhyāḥ piśācāśca manuṣyā rākṣasāḥ khagāḥ || abhyadhāvansusaṃrabdhāste suvarṇajighṛkṣavaḥ || 8 || suvarṇārthe mahānnādo mamedamiti jalpatām || ajñānātsaṃgaraścaiva saṃjātaḥ prāṇahārakaḥ || 9 || athāvaraṇamukhyāni nānāpraharaṇāni ca || pragṛhyābhyanadannādairdevaiḥ sārddhaṃ yaśasvini || 5.2.6.10 || asurā asuraiḥ sārddhaṃ manuṣyā mānuṣaiḥ saha || gandharvāḥ saha gandharvaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ saha kiṃnarāḥ || || 11 || bhūtaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca bhūtāni rākṣasaiḥ saha rākṣasāḥ || vetālaiḥ saha vetālā yuddhaṃ cakruḥ sudāruṇam || 12 || putrastu pitaraṃ dveṣṭi pitā putraṃ tathaiva ca || haṃti bhāryā svabhartāraṃ bhartā ca svāṃ priyāṃ tathā || 13 || mātaraṃ svasuto haṃti mātā putraṃ hinasti ca || tato vairavinirbaṃdhaḥ saṃjātaḥ svarṇakāraṇāt|| 14 || surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca sarvaṃ ghorataraṃ mahat || prāsāśca vipulāstīkṣṇā nyapataṃta sahasraśaḥ || tomarāśca sutīkṣṇāgrāḥ śastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 15 || suvarṇārthe mahādevi vamaṃto rudhiraṃ bahu || 16 || asiśaktigadāṛṣṭyo nipeturdharaṇītale || chinnāni paṭṭiśaiścaiva śirāṃsi yudhi dāruṇaiḥ || 17 || rudhireṇāvaliptāṃgā nihatāśca parasparam || adrīṇāmiva kūṭāni dhātuyuktāni śerate || 18 || hāhākāraḥ samabhavadbhayakṛcca sahasraśaḥ || anyonyaṃ chiṃdatāṃ śastraiḥ suvarṇasya ca kāraṇāt || 19 || parighairāyasaiḥ pāśairvajrakalpaiśca muṣṭibhiḥ || nighnatāṃ samare 'nyonyaṃ śabdo divamivāspṛśat || 5.2.6.20 || chiṃdhibhiṃdhi pradhāva tvaṃ pātayādhisareti ca || aśrūyanta mahāghorāḥ śabdāstatra samaṃtataḥ || 21 || evaṃ tu tumule yuddhe varttamāne mahābhaye || kaṃpitā dharaṇī devi devāstrastāḥ savāsavāḥ || 22 || kṣubhyaṃti sma samudrāśca celuśca dharaṇīdharāḥ || tasyārthe pīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam||23|| ṛṣayo vālakhilyādyā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ|| bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ striyaḥ||24|| socchvāsā kathayāmāsurjarjarīkṛtamastakāḥ || vṛttāṃtaṃ vistarātsarvaṃ lokatrayavināśanam || 25 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ciṃtayitvā ca taiḥ sārddhamājagāma mamāṃtikam || 26 || mayā pṛṣṭāstu te sarve kenaite jarjarīkṛtāḥ || śastrāstraiḥ pīḍitāḥ kena kasmādvo bhayamāgatam || 27 || kaścāsau dānavo duṣṭo yena vai pīḍitā bhṛśam || tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ devi mamāgre bhayavihvalaiḥ || 28 || te māmūcustadā devā brahmādyā bhayakāraṇam || || 29 || lobhātsarve vinaṣṭāḥ sma suvarṇasya ca kāraṇāt || pīḍitaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 5.2.6.30 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā mayā jñātaṃ varānane || tasyārthe kalaho ghoraḥ saṃjāto hi parasparam || 31 || lokatrayavināśaśca sahasā yena vai kṛtaḥ || yamuddiśya tyajetprāṇāṃstamāhurbrahmaghāta kam || 32 || brahmahā vahniputrastu yamuddiśya mṛto janaḥ || śarīraṃ śabalaṃ caiva savikāraṃ bhaviṣyati || 33 || dhātavo hi bhaviṣyaṃti tasya dehe na saṃśayaḥ || lakṣyate duḥkhamatulaṃ chedadāhādigharṣaṇam || 34 || etasminnaṃtare vahnirdṛṣṭvā putrasya ceṣṭitam || jñātvā krodhaṃ madīyaṃ tu bhīto vai putrakāraṇāt || 35 || ājagāma suvarṇena sārddhaṃ devi mamāṃtikam || prasādito'haṃ putrārthe vahninā hi varānane || 36 || rakṣaṇīyastvayā deva putroyaṃ tava śaṃkara || bhāṇḍāgāre svakīye tu kriyatāṃ parameśvara || 37 || tvayi tuṣṭe mahādeva prāpyo'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || icchayā dīyatāṃ devi yasya kasya janasya ca || 38 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā pitṛdevamukhasya ca || tatheti ca pratijñātaṃ mayā lobhādyaśasvini || 39 | snehānmayā vahniputra utsaṃge ca kṛtastadā || snehādvai cuṃbito mūrdhni pariṣvaktaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 5.2.6.40 || dadāmi te mahābhāga varaṃ varaya śobhanam || parituṣṭo'smi vai kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ samavāpnuhi || 41 || ahamājñāpayāmi tvāṃ śreyaścaivamavāpsyasi || mamābhīṣṭakaraṃ sthānaṃ vidyate pṛthivītale || 42 || akṣayaṃ pralaye putra mahākālavanaṃ śubham || tatraiva vidyate liṃgaṃ karkoṭakasya dakṣiṇe || 43 || mahāpāpaharaṃ putra darśanāddīptidāyakam || tasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi || 44 || puṇyaścaiva pavitreṇa durlabhaśca bhaviṣyati || akulīnaḥ kulīnastu samalo nirmalo naraḥ || 45 || virūpo rūpavāṃścaiva tvatprasādādbhaviṣyati || dānāni paripūrṇāni vratāni niyamāstathā || 46 || yajñāścaivopavāsāśca tīrthaṃ piṃḍādikaṃ tvayā || susaṃpūrṇā bhaviṣyaṃti tava dānena suvrata || 47 || sarveṣāṃ caiva ratnānāmādhipatyaṃ kariṣyasi || priyābhīṣṭo hi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca bhaviṣyasi ||48|| ityukto'sau mahādevi divyarūpo varānane || jvālāmālā vṛtaḥ puṇyo nirmalo hi babhūva ha ||49|| liṃgenoktaḥ suvarṇastu diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti kāṃcanam || adyaprabhṛti nāmnā vai khyātiṃ yāsyasi bhūtale || 5.2.6.50 || sthātavyaṃ matsamīpe tu vahniputra tvayā sadā || akṣayā bhavitā kīrttistvadīyā bhuvanatraye || 51 || ityukto devi liṃgena vahniputro'tinirmalaḥ || jvālāvṛtatanurjātaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 52 || dīptirlabdhā suvarṇena jvālāmālākulā tadā || ato devi suvikhyātaḥ svarṇajvāleśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 53 || yastamarcayate bhaktyā svarṇajvāleśvaraṃ śivam || tasya saṃjāyate devi vijayo rājyamūrjitam || aiśvaryaṃ dānaśaktiśca putrapautramanaṃtakam || || 54 || jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ || tatkṣālayati dehotthaṃ darśanānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 55 || yatphalaṃ piṃḍadānena gayāyāṃ labhate naraḥ || tatphalaṃ dviguṇaṃ proktaṃ pūjayā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 56 || gāyatryāḥ śatasāhasraiḥ samyagjaptaiśca yatphalam|| tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti svarṇajvāleśvarastuteḥ || 57 || yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadānena dattena vidhipūrvakam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kīrtanānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 58 || pūjayaṃti caturdaśyāṃ svarṇajvāleśvaraṃ tu ye || pūjyaṃte te sadā lakṣmyā pūrayaṃtyā manorathān || 59 || rakṣitaṃ tridaśairdevi gaṇairnānāvidhaistathā || liṃgaṃ kaścinna jānāti mama māyāvimohitaḥ || 5.2.6.60 || mama prasādāttaddevi dṛśyate liṃgamuttamam || etatte kathitaṃ samyaganyacchṛṇu varānane || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye svarṇajvāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<5.2.7>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || triviṣṭapeśvaraṃ devi saptamaṃ parvatātmaje || yasya darśanamātreṇa labhyate tattriviṣṭapam || 1 || purā vārāhakalpe tu devarṣirnārado'malaḥ || triviṣṭapaṃ gato devi draṣṭukāmaḥ śatakratum || 2 || tatrodyānavane ramye kalpavṛkṣairvirājite || sarvatra kusumāmodasukhasparśānilākule || 3 || vīṇāveṇuravairghuṣṭe devagaṃdharvasevite || vajreṃdranīlavaidūryacaṃdrakāṃtādidīpite || 4 || brahmalokādibhirlokairanaupamyaguṇe śubhe || dadarśa tatra deveśamupaviṣṭaṃ śatakratum || stūyamānaṃ mudā devaiḥ si ddhacāraṇakinnaraiḥ || 5 || pṛṣṭastu nārado devi vāsavena mahāmuniḥ || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ mahākālavanasya ca || 6 || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ sadānaṃdakaraṃ śubham || sevyaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca tīrthānāmuttamottamam || 7 || puṇyaṃ paśyaṃti ye lokā mahākālavanaṃ śubham || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati niścitam || 8 || svayaṃ tiṣṭhati devo'tra sarvabhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ || tasmāttattīrthamukhyānāṃ pravaraṃ kathyate budhaiḥ || 9 || pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 5.2.7.10 || tato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ prayāgaṃ sarvakāmikam || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ vikhyātamamareśvaram || 11 || prācī sarasvatī puṇyā tasmāddaśaguṇā smṛtā || tasmādaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ gayākūpaṃ viśiṣyate || 12 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ devi kurukṣetraṃ viśiṣyate || kurukṣetrāddaśaguṇā puṇyā vārāṇasī tathā || 13 || tasyā daśaguṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahākālaṃ viśiṣyate || mahākālavanaṃ śakra kila trailokyabhūṣaṇam || 14 || ṣaṣṭi koṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || liṃgāni tatra vidyaṃte bhuktimuktikarāṇi ca || 15 || śaktayo nava koṭyastu tasminkṣetre vasanti hi||16|| kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca mṛtā yatra tataḥ kratau || yāṃti divyairvimānaiśca rudralokaṃ sanātanam || māhātmyamadbhutaṃ śrutvā nāradātsurasattamaḥ || 17 || sarvadeva gaṇaiḥ sārddhamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ || vāsavaḥ śrīmahākālavanaṃ harṣasamanvitaḥ || 18 || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ ramyaṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || triviṣṭapādapyadhikaṃ pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ smṛtam ||19|| vicitrāṇi ca harmyāṇi kāṃcanāni śubhāni ca || prāsādāḥ śataśo bhaumamaṇividrumabhūṣitāḥ || 5.2.7.20|| vajreṃdranīlaracitāḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhāḥ || toraṇāni vicitrāṇi māṇikyaracitāni ca || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ ramyaṃ mahākālavanottamam || 21 || nāradaṃ praśaśaṃsuste sarve devā mudānvitāḥ || devarṣīṇāṃ mahāprājñā yeneyaṃ kathitā kathā ||22|| na kailāsaṃ gamiṣyāmo na ca meruṃ tathāvidham || na maṃdaraṃ gamiṣyāmo na yāsyāmastriviṣṭapam || 23 || eṣāmarāvatī śreṣṭhā hyeṣā bhogavatī śubhā || eṣā paitāmaho loko viṣṇulokastathaiva ca || 24 || etasminnaṃtare devi śūnyaṃ jātaṃ triviṣṭapam || jñātvā śūnyamathātmānaṃ ciṃtayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || gamanāya matiṃ cakre kṛtvā dehamathātmanaḥ || 25 || tyaktvā māṃ tridaśāḥ sarve mahākālavanaṃ gatāḥ|| ahaṃ tatraiva yāsyāmi yatra te tridaśā gatāḥ ||26|| ityuktvā tatkṣaṇaṃ prāpto mahākālavanottame || kautukātso'tha vai śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ tatrāpi bhūtale || dadarśa ramaṇīyaṃ tairdevaiḥ parivṛtaṃ tadā || 27 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || bhobhostriviṣṭapātraiva svanāmnā sthāpayasva mām || karkoṭakasya pūrve tu mahāmāyāśca dakṣiṇe ||28|| ityukto devadevena hṛṣṭastadgatacetasā || svanāmnā sthāpayāmāsa devaṃ triviṣṭapeśvaram || 29 || pūjayitvā śubhaiḥ puṣpairuvācedaṃ varānane || adyaprabhṛti bhūrloko nāmnā khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 5.2.7.30 || ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti yatnena api duṣkṛta kāriṇaḥ || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ divyālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || 31 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ saṃkrāṃtau vā viśeṣataḥ || yaḥ kariṣyati pūjāṃ ca bhaktiyukto hi mānavaḥ || 32 || vimānavaramāsthāya kāmagaṃ ratnabhūṣitam || uditādityasaṃkāśaṃ matsamīpe vasiṣyati || 33 || kiṃ dānairvividhairdattaiḥ kiṃ yajñairvividhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || te prāpsyaṃti phalaṃ sarvaṃ ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || 34 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || tattanmanorathaprāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || tridaśaiśca punaḥ proktaṃ dṛṣṭvā malliṃgamuttamam || triviṣṭapena dhanyena sthāpitaṃ devamīśvaram || 36 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye dhanyā devaṃ triviṣṭapeśvaram || teṣāṃ vāso'kṣayo divyo bhaviṣyati triviṣṭape || 37 || ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa bhūyo liṃgaṃ triviṣṭapam || sārddhaṃ triviṣṭapenaiva punaḥ sthānaṃ svakaṃ gataḥ || 38 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || śravaṇātkīrttanādvāpi svargaloko'kṣayo bhavet || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye triviṣṭapeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<5.2.8>
|| śrīrudra uvāca || || kapāleśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca hyaṣṭamaṃ viddhi pārvati || yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā praṇaśyati || 1 || purā vaivasvate kalpe tretākāle samāgate || mahākālavane divye yaje paitāmahe priye || 2 || upaviṣṭeṣu vipreṣu hūyamāne hutāśane || veṣaṃ kāpālikaṃ kṛtvā gato'haṃ tatra saṃsadi || 3 || jīrṇakaṃthāvṛto devi muṃḍaḥ khaṭvāṃgadhārakaḥ || citābhasmaviliptāṃgo vikṛto vikṛtānanaḥ || kapālaṃ ca kare kṛtvā kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ || 4 || brāhmaṇāśca tataḥ kruddhā dṛṣṭvā māṃ jālmarūpiṇam || kapāladhāriṇaṃ sarve dhikchabdaiśca jagarhire || 5 || asakṛtpāpapāpeti gacchagaccha viḍaṃbitāḥ || kathaṃ ca homaḥ kriyate prāpte kāpālike puraḥ || 6 || akapālāni śaucāni iti vedeṣu gīyate || yajñavedirna terhā tu manuṣyāsthi dharasya vai || 7 || mayā proktāstu te viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || yūyaṃ kāruṇikāḥ sarve paraduḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ || 8 || karttavyā ca dayā sadbhiḥ sarvadā sarvadehinām || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ mitraṃ brāhmaṇa ucyate || 9 || ahaṃ kāpāliko vipro bhasmabhūṣitavigrahaḥ || kāpālavratamāsthāya carāmi pṛthivītale || 5.2.8.10 || ārādhayāmi satataṃ mahādevaṃ jagatpatim || brahmahatyāvināśāya vrataṃ dvādaśavārṣikam || 11 || aghaghnaṃ viśrutaṃ loke prārabdhaṃ hi mayā dvijāḥ || prāyaścittanimittaṃ tu śuddho yāsyāmi sadgatim || 12 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā taiḥ proktaṃ dvijasattamaiḥ || atīva pāpiṣṭhataro yo hyevaṃ bhāṣase'dhama || 13 || kapālairbhūṣito niṃdyo viśeṣeṇa tu viprahaḥ || nākārito mahādevo dakṣayajñamahotsave || 14 || yasminyajñe samāyātā ādityā vasavastathā || viśvedevāśca maruto gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnarāstathā || 15 || brahmā viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣo varuṇo vāyureva ca || dhanadaḥ sāgarā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi sakalāni ca || 16 || suparṇā girayo nāgāḥ sarve cākāritāḥ kratau || sānugāste sabhāryāśca brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || 17 || brahmarṣayo mahābhāgāstathā devarṣayo'malāḥ || evamuktvā mahādevaṃ mānuṣāsthivibhūṣitam || 18 || apavitramiti jñātvā kathaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || praveśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ viśeṣeṇāsi brahmahā || 19 || ityukto'haṃ yadā viprairmayā proktaṃ vacastadā || pratīkṣyatāṃ muhūrtaṃ tu bhuktvā yāsyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 5.2.8.20 || ityukte vacane devi tāḍito'haṃ bhṛśaṃ tadā || loṣṭhairlaguḍakaiḥ pādairmuṣṭibhiśca punaḥpunaḥ || 21 || atha prahasya tatkṣiptvā tāṃ vediṃ darbhasaṃstṛtām || kapāladīpavannaṣṭo na jñāto'haṃ dvijottamaiḥ || 22 || mayi naṣṭe kapālaṃ tatkṣiptaṃ maṃḍapabāhyataḥ || athānyattatra saṃjātaṃ tādṛgrūpaṃ yaśasvini || 23 || evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca || tatra kṣiptāni jātāni tataste vismayānvitāḥ || 24 || athāhurjñāninaḥ sarve nedamanyasya ceṣṭitam || ṛte devānmahādevādgaṃgācaṃdrārddhaśekharāt || 25 || tato'haṃ vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ stuto vipraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || homaṃ cakruśca te vahnau maṃtraiśca śatarudriyeḥ || 26 || ahaṃ tuṣṭastadā devi dvijānāmanukaṃpayā || vriyatāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve varaṃ yanmanasepsitam || 27 || tadā te brāhmaṇāḥ procuryadajñānādvadhastava || kṛtastena kṛtāsmābhirbrahmahatyā jagatprabho || 28 || brahmahatyāvināśāya prasādaṃ kurunaḥ prabho || varayāmo varaṃ hyenaṃ nānyaṃ varamabhīpsitam || 29 || dvijānāṃ ca tadā teṣāmagre kathitavānidam || yatra rāśiḥ kapālānāṃ bhavadbhirvihito bhuvi || 5.2.8.30 || anādiliṃgaṃ tatrāsīcchannaṃ kālaviparyaye || paśyaṃtu viprāstalliṃgaṃ brahmahatyāvimocanam || 31 || kṛtā mayāpi vipreṃdrā brahmahatyā svayaṃ purā || chiṃdatā brahmaṇaḥ śīrṣaṃ pañcamaṃ tejasotkaṭam || 32 || brahmahatyā tato jātā mamātīva suduḥsahā || kapālaṃ ca kare lagnaṃ tathā cātīva duḥsaham|| 33 || dahyamānastataścāhaṃ vyāpto vai brahmahatyayā || nāśāya satvaraṃ tasyāḥ svārthayātrāmahaṃ gataḥ || 34 || gataḥ sarveṣu tīrtheṣu naiva muktastu hatyayā || tato duḥkhī susaṃtapto naiva lebhe sukhaṃ kvacita || 35 || etasminnaṃtare daivī vāguvācāśarīriṇī || gacchāvantīṃ svayaṃ nātha kimarthaṃ khidyate vṛthā || 36 || mahākālavanaṃ puṇyaṃ tvayā nātha vinirmitam || kapālakarasaṃsthānaṃ rudramadbhutadarśanam || na jānāsi kathaṃ kṣetraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 37 || tasminkṣetre mahalliṃgaṃ gajarūpasya saṃnidhau || vidyate paśya deveśa brahmahatyā praṇaśyati || 38 || tato'hamāgatastūrṇa vākyaṃ śrutvā tadottamam|| mahalliṃgaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ(?) kapālakarasaṃsthitam || 39 || mama hastāttadā viprāḥ kapālamapatadbhuvi || kapāleśvaradevo'yamiti nāma mayā kṛtam|| 5.2.8.40 || paśyaṃtu viprāstaṃ devaṃ kapāleśvarasaṃjña kam || yasya darśanamātreṇa niṣkalaṃkā bhaviṣyatha || 41 || liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadā taistu kapālairbahubhivṛtam || kṛtārthāste tadā jātāstasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 42 || ato'sau bhuvi vikhyātaḥ kapāleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || ye'rcayanti mahādevi kapāleśvarasaṃjñakam|| 43 || kṛtapuṇyā narā devi te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || kṛtvāpi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ naraḥ || 44 || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti liṃgasyāsya ca darśanāt || karmaṇā manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || tatkṣapayati devo'yaṃ caturddaśyāṃ samarcitaḥ || 45 || prasaṃgādapi ye pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti varānane || te'pi kāmānavāpsyaṃti yāṃśca kāṃścitsudurlabhān || aiśvaryadharmamatulaṃ dīrghamāyurarogatām || 46 || niḥsapatnatvamatulaṃ yaccānyattadavāpnuyāt || atīva pāpino ye ca krūrakarmaratā narāḥ || 47 || vipāpmāno bhaviṣyaṃti gaṇeśāśca mama priye || niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devaṃ vatsaraṃ priye || te paśyaṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīyaṃ bhavanaṃ priyam || 48 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kapāleśvaradevasya svargadvāreśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye kapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<5.2.9>
|| śrīrudra uvāca || || svargadvāreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ navamaṃ viddhi pārvati || sarvapāpaharaṃ devi svargamokṣaphalapradam || 1 || yadā devi samāyātāḥ kailāse parvatottame || aśvinyādyā bhaginyastāstvāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayānvitāḥ || 2 || nimaṃtritā vayaṃ yajñe sakāṃtāḥ saparigrahāḥ || snehena devi tātena bahumānapuraḥ saram || 3 || kaccitsmṛtā viśālākṣi kiṃ vā tātasya vismṛtiḥ || kāraṇaṃ kiṃ samuddiśya tātena na nimaṃtritā || 4 || tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā avamā nāttadā tvayā || prāṇā muktāstu yogena puratastāsu pārvati ||5|| atha tāḥ śokasaṃtaptā gatā yatra prajāpatiḥ|| ācakhyuḥ sakalaṃ vṛttaṃ dakṣasyāgre yathā tatham ||6|| tacchutvā dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ dakṣo novāca kiṃcana ||7|| mayā dṛṣṭā yadā devi bhūmau paṃcatvamāgatā || yajñapradhvaṃsanārthāya tadā vai preritā gaṇāḥ|| ||8|| te gatvātha gaṇā raudrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || virūpā bhīṣaṇā raudrā nānāśastrā mahābalāḥ || mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi kurvaṃto bhairavānravān || 9 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve vasavaḥ saha bhāskaraiḥ || viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca dhanurhastā mahābalāḥ ||5.2.9.10|| yuddhāya ca viniṣkrāṃtā mumucuḥ sāyakānsitān || te sametyātha yuyudhuḥ pramathā vibudhaiḥ saha || mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāridhārā yathā ghanāḥ || 11 || teṣāṃ madhye gaṇo nāma vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ || sa śakraṃ tāḍayāmāsa śūlena hṛdaye tathā || 12 || sa tu tena prahāreṇa visaṃjño niṣasāda ha || atha muṣṭyā hataḥ kumbhe nāga airāvatastathā ||13|| sa hataḥ sahasā tena gajeṃdro bheravānravān || vinadanbhayamāsthāya yajñavāṭamupādravat || 14 || etasminnaṃtare devā kṛtāstena parāṅmukhāḥ || tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurviṣṇuṃ viśvaikanāyakam || 15 || tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo viṣṇurdṛṣṭvā divālayān || gaṇairvidrāvitānsarvānmumocāśu sudarśanam || 16 || tadāpatattu vegena cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ sudarśanam || prasārya vaktraṃ sahasā hyudarasthaṃ cakāra ha || 17 || tasmiṃścakre tadā graste hyamoghe daityasūdane || kruddho nārāyaṇo devi vīrabhadramupādravat || 18 || gṛhītvā pādayorbhūmau nijaghānātidūrataḥ || hanyamānasyātha bhūmau gadayā ca sudarśanam || 19 || rudhirodgārasaṃyuktaṃ vaktrāttacca vinirgatam || matto labdhavaro devi vīrabhadro gaṇottamaḥ || na tu paṃcatvamāpanno gadayā tāḍito'pi saḥ || 5.2.9.20 || tatastu pramathāḥ sarve viṣṇuvīryabalārdditāḥ || kṛcchreṇa sahasā prāptā yatrāhaṃ devi saṃsthitaḥ || 21 || māṃ dṛṣṭvā śūlahastaṃ tu viṣṇuścāṃtaradhīyata || iṃdro'pi tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ pitṛbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 22 || mattastrāsaparītātmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ || evaṃ vidhvaṃsite yajñe naṣṭo devagaṇo yadā || 23 || mayā nirūpito devi svargadvāre gaṇastadā || praveśo naiva dātavyastridaśānāṃ gaṇeśvara || 24 || dvārāvarodhaḥ karttavyo yatnataḥ śāsanānmama || yaḥ kopi dṛśyate devaḥ sa haṃtavyo na saṃśayaḥ || 25 || udvasaśca tato jātaḥ svargo devā vinirjitāḥ ||26|| svargadvāre niruddhe tu śakrādyā bhayavihvalāḥ|| brahmalokaṃ gatā devā maṃtrayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || 27 || tasyāgre kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svargadvārāvarodhanam || maheśvaragaṇairvyāptaṃ svargadvāraṃ pitāmaha || 28 || praveśo durlabho jātaḥ kṛte dvārāvarodhane || kenopāyena yāsyāmaḥ svargalokaṃ tathāvidham 29 || nāsmākaṃ jāyate prītirvinā svargaṃ pitāmaha || || 5.2.9.30 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā proktaṃ tu brahmaṇā tadā || ārādhyaḥ śaṃkaro devo mahādevo jagatpatiḥ || 31 || stutyo vaṃdyo namaskāryaḥ sṛṣṭi saṃhārakārakaḥ || durlabhastu surāḥ svargo vinā tasya prasādataḥ || 32 goptā sraṣṭā samarthaśca sa cāsmākaṃ parā gatiḥ || sa evārādhanīyastu sa ca pūjyatamo mataḥ || 33 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gamyatāṃ śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ || upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ || 34 || tridaśaiḥ sahitaḥ śakra tūrṇaṃ gaccha mamājñayā || mahākālavane ramye kapāleśvarapūrvataḥ || 35 || svargadvāra paraṃ liṃgaṃ vidyate tattu vāsava || lokānāmanukaṃpārthaṃ mahādevena nirmitam || tamārādhayata kṣipraṃ sa vaḥ kāmaṃ pradāsyati || 36 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tridaśā muditā bhṛśam || samāyātā mahādevi mahākālavanaṃ tadā || 37 || svargadvārapradaṃ puṇyaṃ dadṛśurliṃgamuttamam || tasya darśanamātreṇa svargadvāramapāvṛtam || 38 || svargalokaṃ gatāḥ sarve yathāpūrvaṃ yaśasvini || niḥśaṃkāṃstridaśāndṛṣṭvā vijñaptohaṃ gaṇaistadā || 39 || mayājñaptāśca te sarve nivarttadhvaṃ gaṇottamāḥ || svayameva pratijñātaṃ kathaṃ mithyā bhaviṣyati || || 5.2.9.40 || svargadvāraprado devo dṛṣṭo devairna saṃśayaḥ || mahākālavane ramye kathito hi viraṃcinā || 41 || svargadvāraṃ gatāḥ sadyaḥ śakrādyāstridaśā gaṇāḥ || ataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ svargadvāreśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 42 || khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūloke svargalokapradāyakaḥ || 43 || ye paśyaṃti narā loke svargadvāreśvaraṃ śivam || te yāṃti svargalokaṃ hi svargadvāreśvarārcanāt || 44 || svargadvāreśvaraṃ devaṃ ye paśyaṃti prasaṃgataḥ || na teṣāṃ bhayamastīti kalpa koṭiśatairapi || 45 || aśvamedhasahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam || tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi svargadvāreśvarārcanāt || 46 || janmāṃtarasahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ pūrva saṃcitam || yatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāṃti liṃgasyāsya ca kīrtanāt || 47 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmathavā caṃdravāsare || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā svargadvāreśvaraṃ śivam || te devi me śarīraṃ tu praviṣṭāstvapunarbhavāḥ || 48 || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tasmim̐lliṃge tu pūjite || pūjitāni bhavaṃ tīha liṃgānyaṃtaḥsthitāni tu || 49 || sparśanāttasya liṃgasya kīrttanādyajanāttathā || sukhena svargamāyāṃti yathā kāmānavāpnuyāt || 5.2.9.50 || akāmāvā sakāmā vā ye paśyaṃti dine dine || te'pi puṇyā mahābhāgāḥ svargalokaṃ prayāṃti vai || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye svargadvāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || ||
<5.2.10>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || karkoṭeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca daśamaṃ viddhi pārvati || yasya darśanamātreṇa viṣairnaivābhibhūyate || 1 || mātrā ca bhujagāḥ śaptāḥ svavacobhaṃgakāraṇāt || madvaco na kṛtaṃ yasmādbhavadbhiḥ pāpakarmaṇi || 2 || vahnirhi dhakṣyate yuṣmānsatre janmejayasya hi || śrutvā śāpaṃ tato māturmṛtyubhītāśca pannagāḥ || 3 || gatāḥ sarve yathāsthānaṃ jīvanārthaṃ yaśasvini || himaśailaṃ gataḥ śeṣastapaḥ karttuṃ tataḥ priye || 4 || sarpaśca kaṃbalonāma lokaṃ paitāmahaṃ gataḥ || śaṃkhacūḍo'tha nāgeṃdro maṇipūraṃ gatastataḥ || 5 || yamunāṃbhasi saṃlīnaḥ kāliyo bhayavihvalaḥ || 6 || evaṃ te sarparā jāno nāgāḥ susmitaśobhane || kurukṣetre gatāḥ sarve tapaścartuṃ yaśasvini|| dhṛtarāṣṭrastathā nāgaḥ prayāgamagamatpriye 47||| elāpatrastu nāgeṃdro brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || praṇamya tamathovāca māturutsaṃgasaṃsthitāḥ || 8 || mātrā śaptā vayaṃ deva kruddhayā tava saṃnidhau || sā kathaṃ śāpakāle tu bhavatā na nivāri tā || 9 || || brahmovāca || || niṣiddhā naiva te mātā bhāvikarmabalānmama || sarpasatro hi bhavitā rājño janmejayasya ca || 5.2.10.10 || tvaṃ ca vatsa mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ vraja ||] śāṃtyarthaṃ sarvanāgānāṃ bhaktyā yuktastu satvaram ||11|| samārādhaya deveśaṃ mahāmāyāsamīpataḥ|| bhavitā tatra te siddhi devadevaprasādataḥ || 12 || tatra gatvātha karkoṭaḥ svayaṃ devi samāhitaḥ || devamārādhayāmāsa mahāmāyāpuraḥsthitaḥ || tasya tuṣṭotha deveśo varaṃ prādādya śasvini || 13 || ye daṃdaśūkāḥ krūrāśca pāpācārā viṣolbaṇāḥ || teṣāṃ vināśo bhavitā na tu ye dharmacāriṇaḥ || 14 || bhaktyā tavādya tuṣṭosmi tvaṃ me sāyujyatāṃ vraja || deve tatra vilīnotha nāgaḥ karkoṭakaḥ priye || 15 || karkoṭakeśvaraḥ khyātastato devo maheśvaraḥ|| tasya darśanamātreṇa vyādhayo yāṃti saṃkṣayam || 16 || yastaṃ pūjayate devaṃ bhaktyā yukto hi mānavaḥ || aiśvaryaṃ jāyate tasya kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 17 || vyādhito vyādhito mukto duḥkhī duḥkhātpramucyate || darśanāttu bhavetsadya sarvapātakavarjitaḥ || 18 || niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye ca karkoṭakeśvaram || te sarvakāmānāpsyaṃti vasaṃtyaṃte ca matpure || 19 || paṃcamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ ye paśyaṃti raverdine || na teṣāṃ tu kule sarpāḥ pīḍāṃ kurvaṃti karhicit || 5.2.10.20 || yā nārī durbhagā sāpi saubhāgyaṃ labhate sadā || gurviṇī labhate putramarogaṃ kulabhūṣaṇam || śiśugrahāśca naśyaṃti nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ bhavet ||21|| yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyenmana sā bhaktimānnaraḥ || taṃtaṃ durllabhamāpnoti karkoṭeśvaradarśanāt || 22 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || karkoṭeśvaradevasya śṛṇu siddheśvaraṃ param ||23|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye karkoṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10
<5.2.11>
|| || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || liṃgamekādaśaṃ viddhi devi siddheśvaraṃ śubham || vīrabhadrasamīpe tu sarvasiddhipradāyakam ||1|| deva dāruvane pūrvaṃ viprā yogasamanvitāḥ || sparddhayā siddhilabdhyarthaṃ tapo'kurvata saṃyatāḥ||2|| śākāhārā nirāhārāḥ parṇāhārāstathāpare || daṃtolūkhalinaḥ kecidaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare || 3 || kecidvīrāsanaratā dhūmrapānaratāḥ pare || pādairūrdhvairadhovaktraiḥ kecidabhrāvakāśikāḥ || 4 || kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādīni kurvantyanye samāhitāḥ || na cāpi paramā prāptā siddhirvarṣaśatairapi || 5 || duḥkhārttāściṃtayāmāsuḥ kathaṃ siddhirbhaviṣyati || tapasā duṣkareṇaiva siddhirna vātra labhyate || 6 || vyarthā śrutistathā jātā yā gītā munibhiḥ purā || tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ tapomūlamidaṃ jagat || 7 || aṃjanaṃ guṭikā caiva pādukāgamanaṃ tathā || khaḍgasiddhirbile vāsaściṃtāmaṇirapekṣitam || 8 || evaṃ te'ciṃtayasiddhāḥ paramāmarṣapūritāḥ || utsārya tattapodharmaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhāvamāgatāḥ || 9 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || āśvāsayaṃtī tānsiddhānmātā putramivaurasam || 5.2.11.10 || mā'vamanyadhvamāryā hi śrutirvyarthā mahītale || tapo na niṃdyaṃ dharmo vā śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam || 11 || bhavitā bhavatāṃ siddhiratra naiva tapodhanāḥ || sparddhayā siddhikāmaiśca tapastaddhi kṛtaṃ vṛthā || 12 || kāmācca tapaso hānirahaṃkārācca vismayaḥ || krodhāllobhāttathā mohājjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 13 || sparddhayā rahito yastu kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || karoti karma bhāvena sa tapaḥphalamaśnute || 14 || vāsanāvāsito yastu ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ || āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca sa tapaḥphalamaśnute || 15 || mātṛvatparadārāṇi paradravyāṇi loṣṭavat || yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ sa tapaḥ phalamaśnute || 16 || īdṛśe puruṣe viprāstapaḥsiddhiśca dṛśyate || bhavaṃtaḥ sparddhayā caiva kṛtavaṃtaśca duṣkaram ||17|| tasmādvarṣasahasreṇa naiva siddhirbhaviṣyati || yadi madvacanaṃ kāryaṃ nirvikalpena cetasā || 18 || mahākālavanaṃ gatvā yūyaṃ sarve samāhitāḥ || ārādhayadhvaṃ deveśaṃ sadā siddhipradāyakam || 19 || darśanāttasya devasya labhyate siddhiruttamā || sanakādayo'pi ye devamāsādya yogatatparāḥ || pūjayitvāpi bhāvena saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ || 5.2.11.20 || rājñā vasumatā pūrvaṃ khaṅgasiddhiḥ sudurlabhā || prāptā darśanamātreṇa liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||21|| pādukāgamanaṃ labdhaṃ haihayena mahātmanā || kṛtavīrātmajenaiva vāhānāṃ ca sahasrakam ||22|| adṛśyakaraṇaṃ caiva prāptaṃ cānūruṇā purā|| svarṇasiddhiśca siddhena pādalepo rasāyanam|| aṃjanaṃ ca tathā labdhaṃ liṃgasyāsya ca darśanāt||23|| ākāśavacanaṃ śrutvā te siddhā vismayānvitāḥ|| samāyātā mudā yuktā mahākālavanottame||24|| sarvasiddhipradaṃ caiva dadṛśurliṃgamuttamam || darśanāttasya liṃgasya saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ || 25 || tataḥprabhṛti vikhyāto devaiḥ siddheśvaraḥ paraḥ || ye paśyaṃti narā devi devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || na teṣāṃ durlabhā siddhirbhaviṣyati mahītale || 26 || siddheśvaraṃ gamiṣyaṃti bhāvahīnāḥ prasaṃgataḥ || saṃsiddhāste bhaviṣyaṃti niyatā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 27 || mahāpātakasaṃyukto yastu siddheśvaraṃ smaret || saṃsiddhastu bhavennūnaṃ jñānaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 28 || niyamena tu yaḥ paśyeddevaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || ṣaṇmāsājjāyate siddhirvāṃchitā yā bhaveddhṛdi || 29 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || siddheśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyetsa paśyenmama maṃdiram || 5.2.11.30 || aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhanastu dhanaṃ labhet || vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhāryārthī labhate striyam || || 31 || saṃkrāṃtau somavāre ca grahaṇe caiva yo'rcayet || kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya paitṛkaṃ svādhikaṃ priye || modate mama loke ca yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ||32|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || siddheśvarasya devasya lokapāleśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<5.2.12>
|| śrīhara uvāca || dvādaśaṃ viddhi deveśi lokapāleśvaraṃ śivam || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || purā daityagaṇā devi prādurbhūtāḥ sahasraśaḥ || hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣaḥsthalādatiparākramāḥ || 2 || tairiyaṃ vasudhā vyāptā saśailavanakānanā || vidhvastāḥ svāśramāḥ sarve yajñā vidhvaṃsitāstathā || 3 || brāhmaṇā bhakṣitāścaiva veda vedāṃgapāragāḥ || pūritānyagnikuṇḍāni pāṃsunā madhunā tathā || 4 || vidhvastāḥ kalaśāḥ sarve mṛdbhāṃḍādi ca cūrṇitam || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārā svadhāsvāhāvivarjitā || 5 || kṛtā ca dharaṇī devi naṣṭayajñotsavābhavat || lokapālāstato bhītā mādhavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 6 || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve kṣudhārtā duḥkhitāḥ kṛtāḥ || vayaṃ glāniṃ gatā deva yajñabhāgaṃ vinā kṛtāḥ || 7 || vayaṃ trātāstvayā pūrvaṃ namucervṛṣaparvaṇaḥ || hiraṇyakaśipo raudrānnarakācca murostathā || 8 || tathā rakṣa suraśreṣṭha bhayaṃ naḥ samupasthitam || 9 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || jagāma sa tato daityāḥ praviṣṭā varuṇālayam ||5.2.12.1 0|| te niṣkramya tato rātrau nighnaṃti dvijasattamān || tāpasāndīkṣitāndevi dharmavrataparāyaṇān || 11 || atha svargaṃ gatāḥ kāṃte jitaḥ śakro marutpatiḥ || tathaiva dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ dharmarājo jitastataḥ || 12 || gatvātha paścimāmāśāṃ jalarājo vinirjitaḥ || uttare dhanado devi tairdaityaiḥ sa vinirjitaḥ || 13 || tataste vyākulā jātā viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ || upāyaḥ kathito devi devebhyo viṣṇunā tadā || 14 || mahākālavanaṃ gatvā devā bhaktyā samāhitāḥ|| ārādhayata sarveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram||15|| bhavatāṃ bhavitā siddhistatra tasya prasādataḥ|| 16|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ || prasthitā lokapālāste mahākālavane śubhe || 17 || tāvattatraiva saṃruddhā daityaiḥ śastradharaistadā|| bhūyo naṣṭāśca saṃprāptā yatra devo janārdanaḥ || 18 || kathayāmāsuratyugraṃ yathā ruddhaṃ jagattrayam || nārāyaṇena te proktā lokapālāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 19 || yūyaṃ vratadharā bhūtvā kapālaiśca vibhūṣitāḥ || khaṭvāṃgadhāriṇaḥ śāṃtāḥ paṃcamudrāvibhūṣitāḥ || 5.2.12.20 || bhasmabhūṣitasarvāṃgāḥ kṣudraghaṃṭāvirājitāḥ || mahāvratadharā bhūtvā mahākālavano ttamam || gacchadhvaṃ brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ pādabaddhaiśca nūpuraiḥ || 21 || atha te lokapālāśca śrutvā kṛṣṇasya bhāṣitam || samāyātā mahādevi kṛtvā kāpālikaṃ vapuḥ || 22 || tatra dṛṣṭaṃ mahalliṃgaṃ tejasāṃ rāśimadbhutam || stutaṃ ca vividhaiḥ stotrairlokapālaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 23 || tatastu tasya liṃgasya vahnijvālā viniḥsṛtā || yayā te dānavāḥ sarve dagdhā bhasmatvamāgatāḥ || 24 || jñātvā liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ nāma cakruḥ samāhitāḥ || sevitaṃ lokapālaistu liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ param || 25 || lokapāleśvaronāma khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale || ityuktvā tridaśāḥ sarve lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ || svasvasthānaṃ gatā divyaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ mudānvitāḥ || 26 || ye paśyaṃti narā devi lokapāleśvaraṃ śivam || samṛddhibhiḥ susaṃpannā bhaveyurjanmajanmasu || || 27 || na dāridryaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ tathā || aiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate darśanātsadā || 28 || yo yamuddiśya vai kāmaṃ darśanaṃ tu kariṣyati || tasya tajjāyate sarvaṃ mṛtasya paramā gatiḥ || 29 || aśvamedhasya yajñasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate devi lokapāle śvarārcanāt || 5.2.12.30 || prasaṃgenāpi yaḥ paśyellokapāleśvaraṃ śivam || modate svargaloke sa lokapālaiḥ samaṃ sadā || 31 || saṃkrāṃtau somavāre ca caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā hyaṣṭamyāmayanadvaye ||32|| te durddharṣā bhavaṃtīha śatrūṇāṃ saṃgare tathā || mṛtā yāṃti vimānena śakralokaṃ sudurlabham || 33 || krameṇa vāruṇaṃ lokaṃ dhanadasya yathāsukham || punaḥ paitāmahaṃ yāṃti lokaṃ devaiḥ sudurlabham || 34 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || durlabhaḥ paramo guhyaṃ kāmeśvaramatho śṛṇu || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye lokapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<5.2.13>
|| hara uvāca || || viddhi kāmeśvaraṃ devi tatra liṃgaṃ trayodaśam || yasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ jāyate śubham || 1 || brahmaṇo dhyāyamānasya prajākāmasya pārvati || utpanno'rkaprabhākāro lāvaṇyanicayo mahān || alaṃkārāvṛtaḥ kāṃto divyamaṃḍanamaṃḍitaḥ || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ divyaṃ kāṃtaṃ saubhāgyaśobhitam || apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ brahmā provāca taṃ tadā || 3 || ko bhavānkiṃ nimittaṃ tu iha vā kimupāgataḥ || vada tvaṃ manmathākāra kaṃdarpa iva lakṣyame || 4 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā proktaṃ tenaiva sādaram || ahaṃ te sṛṣṭikāmasya bhāvena vihitoṃśakaḥ || prajāpate mahābhāga kiṃ karomi diśasva mām || 5 || brahmovāca || || mayā tu sṛṣṭikāmena ye prajāpatayaḥ kṛtāḥ || na te śaktāḥ prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ kāmaite sukhamāpnuyuḥ || 6 || tvamagraṇīḥ prajāsarge tvadadhīnamidaṃ jagat || kuru sṛṣṭiṃ vicitrāṃ ca kaṃdarpa mama śāsanāt||7|| ityukto brahmaṇā devi jagāmādarśanaṃ smaraḥ|| kruddhena brahmaṇā śapto vināśaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam||8|| madvaco na kṛtaṃ yasmādbhavanetrodbhavāgninā|| tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ kaṃdarpo bhayavihvalaḥ|| brahmāṇaṃ praṇato bhūtvā prahvaḥ prāṃjalirabravīt||9|| prasīda devadeveśa ananyagatike mayi|| nahi nirbharatāṃ yāṃti prabhūṇāmāśrite ruṣaḥ||5.2.13.10|| ||brahmovāca|| yasmātte bhaktiratulā mamopari mahāmate || tasmātsthānāni dattāni tava dvādaśa saṃkhyayā || 11 || kāminīnāṃ kaṭākṣeṣu keśapāśeṣu caiva hi || jaghanastananābhau tu dormūle'dharapallave || 12 || vasaṃte kokilālāpe jyotsnāyāṃ jaladāgame || kāmārthe ca mayā dattau sabalau madhumādhavau || 13 || striyo'mṛtamayā dhanyā saṃsāre sārakāraṇam || rateścaiva nidhānāni saṃtānārthaṃ vinirmitāḥ || 14 || etābhirvaranārībhirjagadevaṃ vaśīkṛtam || strībhirāsaktamanasaḥ kutaḥ puṃso manasvitā || 15 || kṛtaścāpi svavaśatā strīgauravagatasya ca || striya eva vināśāya pūrveṣāmamaradviṣām || 16 || striya eva hi devānāmiṃdrādīnāṃ bhayāśrayāḥ || nārībhirlabdhavṛtteśca puruṣasyāpi sarvataḥ || 17 || parābhavaḥ prabhavati vivaśatvaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam || strībhirājitacittasya sulabho vipadodayaḥ || 18 || ityukto manmatho bhadre brahmaṇā ca visarjitaḥ || dattvā vai puṣpakaṃ cāpaṃ tathā vai bāṇapaṃcakam || 19 || ratiprītisamāyukto jhaṣaketurmanobhavaḥ || viḍaṃbayati lokāṃstrīnsasahāyo dhanurdharaḥ || 5.2.13.20 || paṃḍitāṃstāpasānvīrānsudhiyaśca jiteṃdriyān || kāle kuśalabhāvajñāndevānpitṛgaṇāṃstathā || 21 || bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca yakṣagaṃdharvakiṃnarān || kṛmikīṭapataṃgāṃśca bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham || 22 || mamārthe ca kṛto yatnaściṃtayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || duḥsādhyaḥ śaṃkaro devaḥ śrūyate bhuvanatraye || tasya devasya kaḥ śaktaḥ kṣobhaṇārthaṃ mayā vinā || 23 || ityuktvā tu samāyāto yatrāhaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ || ratyā yutaḥ sa garveṇa sakhyā'yaṃ madhunāśritaḥ || || 24 || dṛṣṭavānmāṃ tadā kāmaḥ piṃjakūṭajaṭāsaṭam || kiṃcinnimittato'nidraṃ bhogīṃdrakṛtabhūṣaṇam || 25 || prekṣamāṇamṛjusthānaṃ nāsāvaṃśāgra locanam|| tato'vamarakākāramālaṃbyāśrayamātrakam||26|| praviṣṭaḥ kararaṃdhreṇa madano hṛdaye mama|| ratyarthaṃ kāmataptena saṃsmṛtā bhavatī mayā||27|| samādherbhāvanā divyā lakṣyapratyakṣarūpiṇī || gatā mama vimalatā tatkṣaṇādeva pārvati || 28 || unmattatāṃ gato'haṃ vai vikṛtiṃ madanātmikām || nirākṛtaṃ mayā devi dhairyamālaṃbya yatnataḥ || 29 || dṛṣṭo mayātmahṛdaye manmatho'pathyakārakaḥ || dehasthaṃ nirdahiṣyāmi pratyāhāraprayogataḥ || 5.2.13.30 || amānuṣīṃ vrajedyoniṃ yoginaṃ praviśedyadi || bāhyāgnau dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā dehasaṃsthe vinirdahet || 31 || etasminnaṃtare so'pi saṃtapto madano bhṛśam|| icchāśarīro durjñeyo niḥsṛto vyasanātmakaḥ || 32 || sahakāratarormūle bhūtvā madhusakhastadā || mumoca mohanaṃ nāma mārgaṇaṃ makaradhvajaḥ || 33 || sa cāpi hṛdaye prāpto madīye līlayā śaraḥ || tatohaṃ kupito devi netraṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyakam || 34 || tannetravisphuliṃgena krośatāṃ nākavāsinām|| gamito bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ kaṃdarpaḥ kāmidarpakaḥ || 35 || tasmindagdhe tataḥ kāme ratiḥ śokaparāyaṇā || vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā patibhaktiparāyaṇā || || 36 || hā nātha hā mama prāṇa hā svāminkiṃ jahāsi mām || pativratāṃ patiprāṇāṃ kasmānmāṃ tyajasi prabho || 37 || evaṃ ca vilapaṃtīṃ tāṃ vāguvā cāśarīriṇī || mā tvaṃ ruda viśālākṣi punareṣa patistava || prasādāddevadevasya utthāsyati śivasya ca || 38 || prārthito'haṃ tato devi tasminnavasare priye || eṣa kāmastvayā dagdhaḥ krodhena parameśvara || 39 || yenānena prabho naṣṭā sṛṣṭirvai dharaṇītale || kṛpāṃ vidhehi deveśa dīnāyai dehi me patim || || 5.2.13.40 || tato'hamabruvaṃ devi tāṃ ratiṃ dīnabhāṣiṇīm || anena madanenādya kṛtaṃ taralitaṃ manaḥ || 41|| tato dagdhaṃ mayāsyāṃgaṃ jīvaye tvatprasādataḥ|| aṃgaṃ dagdhaṃ mayāsyādya tṛtīyanetravahninā || 42 || tasmādanaṃga evaiṣa prajāsu vicariṣyati || anaṃgo'pi yadāvaṃtyāṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsevayiṣyati || 43 || devānāmanukaṃpārthamanaṃgo'sau kṛto mayā || tridaśaiśca samādiṣṭaḥ kāmo'vaṃtyāṃ jagāma ha || 44 || tatra gatvā hyanaṃgo'pi bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ || dadarśa paramaṃ liṃgaṃ samīhitaphalapradam || 45 || proktaṃ tuṣṭena liṃgena kāma kāmamavāpsyasi || anaṃgo'pi samarthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 46 || janma prāpsyati rukmiṇyā garbhe kṛṣṇasya saṃgamāt || bhavitā viśruto loke nāmnā śaṃbarasūdanaḥ || 47 || anaṃgena tvayā yasmānmanasā toṣi to'pi san|| tasmātkhyātiṃ gamiṣyāmi tvannāmnā kāma sarvadā || 48 || ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti kaṃdarpaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || prāpnuvaṃti gatiṃ nityaṃ te sadānaṃdadāyikām || 49 || dīrghāyuṣo bhaviṣyaṃti rūpaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati || kulaṃ ca nirmalaṃ teṣāṃ ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti manmatha || 5.2.13.50 || aiśvaryaṃ paramānbhogānstriyo divyakalānvitāḥ || arogā saṃtatisteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ ye māṃ paśyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || devalokaṃ samāsādya modiṣyaṃti hi te narāḥ || 52 || yakṣā gaṇeśvarāḥ siddhāḥ siddhagaṃdharvasevitāḥ || rudralokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ || 53 || ityuktaḥ kāmadevopi liṃgena parameśvari || tatrāśramapadaṃ cakre tasya liṃgasya saṃnidhau ||54 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kāmeśvarasya śṛṇvagre kuṭuṃbeśvaravaibhavam || 55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<5.2.14>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || kuṭuṃbeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu devaṃ viddhi caturdaśam || yasya darśanamātreṇa gotravṛddhiśca jāyate || 1 || yadā devāsuraiḥ pūrvaṃ mathitaḥ kṣīrasāgaraḥ || tadā ca nirgataṃ devi durddharaṃ duḥsahaṃ viṣam || 2 || kālakūṭamayaṃ raudraṃ viṣaṃ jvālāvibhīṣaṇam || dahyate ca jagattena sadevāsuramānuṣam || 3 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sāsurā yakṣarākṣasāḥ || viṣajvālātibhītāśca māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 4 || stutohaṃ vividhaiḥ stotrairidamuktaṃ varānane || amṛtārthe kṛto yatnaḥ saṃprāptaṃ maraṇaṃ vibho || 5 || anyathā ciṃtitaṃ kāryaṃ daivena kṛtamanyathā || atimathitumārabdhe lobhādvai kṣīrasāgaram ||6|| utpannaṃ kālakūṭaṃ tu yena dagdhaṃ carācaram || tato'smākaṃ bhayaṃ jātaṃ kālakūṭodbhavaṃ prabho || ||7|| rakṣāṃ kuru jagannātha śaraṇāgatavatsala || hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ yathā na pralayo bhavet || 8 || mayā teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tridaśānāṃ yaśasvini || māyūraṃ rūpamāsthāya devānāmanukaṃpayā || kaṃṭhe dhṛtaṃ mahāraudraṃ kālakūṭāhvayaṃ tadā || 9 || tvaṃ bhītā sahasā naṣṭā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu māmakam || viṣavṛkṣamasevyaṃ tu tato'haṃ duḥkhito'bhavam ||5.2.14.10|| nadīsaṃghasamāyuktā gaṃgā dṛṣṭā ca pārśvataḥ || sā ca proktā mayā devi sādaraṃ stutipūrvakam || 11 || kālakūṭaviṣaṃ gaṃge vegānnaya mahodadhim || nānyā śaktā samānetuṃ tvāṃ vinā lokapāvani || 12 || || gaṃgovāca || || nāsti me bhagavañchaktirvivoḍhuṃ ca jagatpate || raudrarūpī ca duḥsevyo dahatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 13 || tatastu yamunā proktā na samarthā sarasvatī || anyāśca vividhā nadyo mayāhūtāḥ pṛtha kpṛthak || 14 || aśaktāstāḥ samānetuṃ kālakūṭāhvayaṃ viṣam || tadāhūtā mayā devi śiprā brahmasamudbhavā || 15 || śipre putri mamādeśānmahākāla vanaṃ vraja || gṛhītvā kālakūṭaṃ tu puraḥ kāmeśvarasya hi ||16|| vidyate paramaṃ liṃgaṃ tasmillige niyojaya || mayā proktā tadā prāha brahmaṇaḥ paramā kalā || 17 || eṣāsmi prasthitā deva tava vākyādasaṃśayam || duḥsparśaḥ kālakūṭo'yaṃ nūnaṃ māṃ bhakṣayiṣyati || 18 || asevyāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi duṣṭasaṃparka yogataḥ || tato mayā punaḥ proktā śiprā pātakanāśinī || 19 || yāni tīrthāni bhūloke pātāle yāni saṃti vai || svargaloke hyaṃtarikṣe puṇyāni cāruhāsini || 5.2.14.20 || tāni sarvāṇi sevārthamāgatya mama vākyataḥ || ājñāṃ tava kariṣyaṃti gaccha putri mamājñayā || 21 || evamuktā tadā śiprā gṛhītvā kālakūṭakam || samāyātā varārohe yatra liṃgamanuttamam || 22 || tadviṣaṃ kālakūṭāhvaṃ nikṣiptaṃ liṃgamūrddhani || viṣaliṃgastato jāto dṛṣṭo mṛtyupradāyakaḥ || 23 || paśuḥ pakṣī naro vāpi yo hi paśyati taṃ śivam || mriyate sa tadā devi tasya devasya darśanāt || 24 || tīrthayātrāṃ tataḥ kartuṃ tatrāyātāṃstapodhanāḥ || taṃ ca devaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā mṛtāḥ sarve ca tatkṣaṇāt || 25 || tato hāhākṛtaṃ devi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| hāhākāraṃ mahacchrutvā mayā te dvijasattamāḥ || saṃjīvitāśca vai sarve dṛṣṭipātena pārvati || 26 || tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatā viprā māmato vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || mayā proktāstu te viprā vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam || 27 || tairuktaṃ praṇatairdevi lokānāṃ ca hitārthataḥ || saṃmriyaṃte prajā deva liṃgenānena śaṃkara || 28 || tāḥ saṃrakṣa jagannātha hyeṣo'smākaṃ varaḥ prabho || pratijñātaṃ mayā devi lokānāmanukaṃpayā || 29 || kṣemārogyakaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || kāyāvarohaṇādviprāḥ svayamatrāgamiṣyati || 5.2.14.30 || lakulīśastadā cāyaṃ devaḥ spṛśyo bhaviṣyati || vṛddhikārī kuṭumbasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||31|| kuṭuṃbeśvara iti nāmnā loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || ityuktāste mayā viprāstatraiva tapasi sthitāḥ || 32 || lakulīśo'tha talliṃgamāruroha mamājñayā || janayanvismayaṃ loke kīrtiṃ janapade tathā || 33 || kuṭumbeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ye paśyaṃti yaśasvini || teṣāṃ kule tu vṛddhiḥ syātkuṭuṃbasya na saṃśayaḥ || 34 || āśvināsitapaṃcamyāṃ darśanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati || bahuputro bahudhano bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti rogaiścāpi pramucyate || sarvakāmasamṛddho'sau mama loke sa modate ||36 || darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti sparśanaṃ yajanaṃ tathā || te sarve kāmasaṃpūrṇāḥ prayāṃti mama maṃdiram || 37 || samīpe tu saricchiprā vāpīkūpena saṃyutā || yasyā darśanamātreṇa naraḥ pāpātpramucyate ||38|| somavārerkavāre ca snātvā tasyāṃ samāhitaḥ|| aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ yaḥ paśyetkuṭuṃbeśvaram || || 39 || rājasūyasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || phalaṃ sa labhate devi satyametanmayoditam || 5.2.14.40 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kuṭuṃbeśvaradevasya tviṃdradyumneśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kuṭuṃbeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
<5.2.15>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || iṃdradyumneśvaraṃ viddhi śivaṃ paṃcadaśaṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa yaśaḥ kīrtiśca jāyate || 1 || āsīdrājā purā devi iṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ || yeneyaṃ rakṣitā pṛthvī pitā putramivaurasam || 2 || dṛṣṭvā so'tha bahūnyajñānbhūmau pracuradakṣiṇān|| gataḥ svargaṃ mahātmā vai sarvakāmaphalapradam || 3 || sa cātha pratyutaḥ svargānnaṣṭakīrtiryadā kṣitau || papāta bhūmau sahasā gatapuṇyo narā dhipaḥ || patitaściṃtayāmāsa bhraśaṃ śokapariplutaḥ || 4 || kṛtasya karmaṇastvatra bhujyate yatphalaṃ divi || na cānyatkriyate tadyadbhūtalasthena bhujyate ||5|| so'tra doṣo matastasyāmatastatpatanaṃ ca yat || patanāttu mahadduḥkhaṃ paritāpaśca jāyate ||6|| svargabhājo bhavaṃtīha yāvatkīrtiśca jāyate || divaṃ spṛśati bhūmiṃ ca śabdaḥ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ|| yāvatsa śabdo bhavati tāvatpuruṣa ucyate ||7|| akīrtiḥ kīrttyate yasya loke bhūtasya kasyacit|| sa patatyadhamām̐llokānyāvacchabdo'sya kīrttitaḥ || 8 || tasmātkalyāṇavṛttaḥ syādanyathā patanaṃ bhuvi || vidhāya vṛttaṃ pāpiṣṭhaṃ kīrtimevābhivarddhayet || 9 || atyaṃtaṃ ślāghayāmyatra kīrttiṃ svargakarāṃ parām || devairapi hi sā kīrtiḥ kāṃkṣyate paramā yataḥ || 5.2.15.10 || yāvatkīrttirmanuṣyāṇāṃ varttate bhuvi cākṣayā || tejaḥ puṃjena yuktāni śarīrāṇi bhavaṃti hi || 11 || na svedo na ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ purīṣaṃ mūtrameva vā || teṣāṃ nirvacanaṃ rājā vidhātā ca triviṣṭape || uhyaṃte te vimānaiśca nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 12 || evaṃ vimṛśya nṛpatiriṃdradyumno varānane || svargakāmo jagāmātha himavaṃtaṃ nagottamam || 13 || yatra tepe tapastīvraṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ ca punaḥpunaḥ || papraccha vinayopetastamṛṣiṃ śaṃsitavratam || 14 || viditāstava dharmajña devadānavarākṣasāḥ || rājavaṃśāśca vividhā ṛṣivaṃśāśca śāśvatāḥ || 15 || na te'styaviditaṃ kiñcidasmim̐lloke dvijottama || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tattvena kathyatāṃ tvayā || kathaṃ kīrttirdhuvā loke jāyate kiṃ tapaḥphalāt || 16 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || haṃta te kathayiṣyāmi yataḥ kīrtiṃ samīhase || yāvatkīrtirbhūmisaṃsthā tāvadvasa suraiḥ saha || tadgaccha śīghraṃ dharmajña mahākālavanottamam || 17 || kalkaleśvaradevasya samīpe vāma bhāgataḥ || liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ tatra samārādhaya yatnataḥ || 18 || tasyābhyarcanamātreṇa lapsyase kīrtimuttamām || svargaṃ sanātanaṃ caiva yatsurairapi durllabham || || 19 || gatvā sa pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ kīrtitaṃ tvidam || tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ praśasya ca mudānvitāḥ || 5.2.15.20 || antarikṣe vimānasthā procurvācaṃ narādhipam || tvatkīrttirnirmalā jātā liṃgasyāsya samarcanāt || 21 || adyaprabhṛti rājeṃdra liṃgaṃ tvannāma nāmataḥ || khyātiṃ yāsyati loke'sminniṃdradyumneti niścitam|| 22 || indradyumneśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ || 23 || svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te hṛṣṭāḥ stūyamānāḥ surarṣibhiḥ|| kiṃcicca durlabhaṃ loke teṣāṃ naiva bhaviṣyati||24|| darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti lobhādvāpi prasaṃgataḥ|| teṣāṃ kīrtiryaśaḥ puṇyaṃ dharmaścaivaṃ bhaviṣyati || 25 || na svargātpatanaṃ teṣāṃ yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa || ye ca pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || te kulaṃ tārayiṣyaṃti mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ sadā || 26 || ityuktā tridaśāḥ sarve liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || iṃdradyumnena sahitāḥ punaḥ svargaṃ gatāḥ priye || 27 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || indradyumneśadevasya śrūyatāmaparaḥ priye || 28 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmya indradyumneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || cha ||
<5.2.16>
|| īśvara uvāca || || īśāneśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ṣoḍaśaṃ viddhi pārvati || yasya darśanamātreṇa aiśvaryaṃ jāyate nṛṇām|| 1 || tuhuṃḍena purā devi sarve hyupadrutāḥ surāḥ || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā yakṣagandharvaki nnarāḥ || 2 || naṃdanākhyaṃ vanaṃ sarvaṃ tadadhīnamabhūtkila || airāvaṇaṃ dvipendraṃ ca jitvā dvāri samādadhat || 3 || uccaiḥśravasasaṃjñaṃ tu hṛtavāndānaveśvaraḥ || devāṃganānāṃ sarvāsāṃ vidhvaṃsaṃ kartumudyataḥ || 4 || svargamārgaḥ khilībhūtastadbhayena hyabhūtsati || hṛtādhikārā devāśca maṃtraṃ samupacakramuḥ || 5 || tasminkāle ca kālajño nārado'tha mahāmuniḥ || ājagāma mahātejā bhramamāṇaśca maṃtribhiḥ || 6 || devairnamaskṛtaḥ so'tha pūjitaśca yathāvidhi || niveditaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tuhuṇḍasya viceṣṭitam || 7 || papracchuratha te maṃtraṃ nāradaṃ munisattamam || kathayasva mahābuddhe sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvvataḥ || 8 || īdṛkkāle samāyāte kiṃ karttavyaṃ mahāmune || nājñātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃciddevarṣisattama || 9 || muhūrtaṃ dhyānamālaṃbya kiṃcinmīlya ca locane || upāyaṃ kathayāmāsa sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 5.2.16.10 || mahākālavane ramye śīghraṃ gacchaṃtu vihvalāḥ || indradyumneśvarasyaiva paścādbhāge vyavasthitāḥ || sevadhvaṃ paramaṃ liṃgamīśāneśvarasaṃjñakam || 11 || purā ceśānakalpe tu īśānena sukhena hi || muninā śrotriyeṇaiva vedābhyāsaratena vai || uttamāṃgapadaṃ labdhaṃ śaṃkarasya ca mūrddhani || 12 || tasyārādhanamātreṇa mano'bhīṣṭaṃ hi labhyate || 13 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā muditamānasāḥ || jagmuryatra mahalliṃgaṃ stutiṃ sarve'pyakurvata || 14 || īśāneśāna īśāna tatpuruṣa namo'stu te || namo vāma mahāghora sadyomukha namonamaḥ || || 15 || tryakṣa bharga mahādeva umākāṃta namonamaḥ || namaḥ śiva namo bhīma namaḥ sarva namonamaḥ || 16 || namaḥ śaṃbho namo rudra virūpākṣa namonamaḥ || tvayā deva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || 17 || sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṃgamāni carāṇi ca || brahma vedāśca vedyaṃ ca tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ maheśvara || 18|| śiraste gaganaṃ devā netre śaśidivākarau || niḥśvāsaḥ pavanaścāpi tejo'gniśca tavācyutaḥ || 19 || bāhavaste diśaḥ sarvāḥ kukṣiścaiva mahārṇavaḥ || urū te parvatā deva caraṇau pṛthivī matā || 5.2.16.20 || iṃdrasomāgnivaruṇā devāsuramahoragāḥ || prahvāstvāmanutiṣṭhaṃti stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 21 || tvayā vyāptāni bhūtāni sarvāṇi bhuvaneśvara || tvayi tuṣṭe jagattuṣṭaṃ tvayi kruddhe mahadbhayam || 22 || bhayānāmapanetāsi tvamekaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ || asurāṇāṃ samarthānāṃ vināśaśca tvayā kṛtaḥ || 23 || na ca vikramaṇairdeva nirvāṇamagamatparam || tvaṃ hi karttā vikarttā ca bhūtānāmiha sarvaśaḥ || 24 || ārādhayitvā sarve te namasyaṃti ca sarvaśaḥ || etasminnaṃtare devi liṃgamadhyātsamutthitā || 25 || dhūmāvṛtā mahā jvālā yayā dagdhaḥ sa dānavaḥ || tuhuṇḍo muṃḍaputrastu sasainyaparivāritaḥ || 26 || svādhikārāṃśca saṃprāpurliṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || suraiścākhyā samādiṣṭā liṃgasyāsyaiva harṣitaḥ || 27 || aiśvaryaśīlamasyāstītyasmākaṃ ca viniścitam || īśāna iti vikhyātastrailokye ca bhaviṣyati || 28 || īśāneśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ye samārādhayaṃti ca || kīrtirlakṣmīrdhruvā teṣāṃ siddhiḥ prītirbhaviṣyati || 29 || pūjyamānaḥ sadā devairgaṃdharvāpsarasāṃgaṇaiḥ || svargalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti vimānairujjvalairmudā || 5.2.16.30 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ striyaḥ kumārikāḥ || yathābhilaṣitānkāmānāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ||31|| yaḥ karoti naraḥ samyagdarśanaṃ niyamasthitaḥ || na kutra tasya hāniḥ syādyāvajanmaśataṃ bhavet || 32 || sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu te samarthā yaśasvini || īśāneśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ye paśyaṃti dinedine || 33 || evaṃ te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || īśāneśvaradevasya śrūyatāmapsareśvaraḥ || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya īśāneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<5.2.17>
|| īśvara uvāca || || devaṃ saptadaśaṃ viddhi vikhyātamapsareśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa loko'bhīṣṭānavāpnuyāt || 1 || naṃdanākhye vane devi sarvakāmasamanvite || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvakiṃnarodgītanādite || 2 || śukakokilacakrāhvacakorakurarāvṛte || divyalokopamasthāne triviṣṭapavi bhūṣaṇe || 3 || tatropaviṣṭo vṛtrāriḥ surajyeṣṭhaśca sevitaḥ || nanartta raṃbhā tasyāgre nṛtyabhāvānvivṛṇvatī || 4 || tatonyacittā saṃjātā kiṃcitsmṛtvā pramādataḥ || layatālavihīnā ca dṛṣṭā vai vāsavena sā || 5 || cukopa ca suraśreṣṭhastasyāḥ śāpaṃ dadau kila || vismṛtirmānuṣaṃ karma na divyaṃ kvāpi dṛśyate || tasmāttu mānuṣe loke gaccha tvaṃ niṣprabhā satī || 6 || atheṃdrakopasaṃkṣobhātpatitā bhuvi sāpsarāḥ|| niśceṣṭā vikalībhūtā rudatī visvaraṃ bahu || 7 || karuṇaṃ vilapaṃtī ca kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || nirmalaṃ na tapastaptaṃ kathaṃ nārādhitaḥ suraḥ || 8 || athāpsarogaṇaḥ sarvaḥ sakhīgaṇa samanvitaḥ || raṃbhā yatraiva patitā samāyāto varānane || tasyāḥ śokāgnidāhena saṃtapto'psarasāṃ gaṇaḥ || 9 || susuptā padminī sābhre yathā naiva virājate || tathā śāpena vidhvastā raṃbhā no rājate sadā || 5.2.17.10 || sakhīgaṇaiḥ parivṛtā raṃbhā dṛṣṭā varānane || devarṣiṇā nāradena vismitenāṃtarātmanā || 11 || kasmādapsarasaḥ sadyo dṛśyaṃte śokavihvalāḥ || kasmācca karuṇaṃ raṃbhā rodityeṣā muhurmuhuḥ || || 12 || papraccha ca samāgatya kasmādapsaraso varāḥ || viṣaṇṇavadanā dīnāḥ kathyatāṃ mama sādaram || 13 || vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsustāśca tasmai purātanam || śrutvā ca nāradastatra dhyānāsakto'bhavanmuniḥ || 14 || upāyaṃ kathayāmāsa hitaṃ tāsāṃ prayatnataḥ || gacchaṃtvapsarasaḥ sarvā mahākālavanottame || 15 || ārādhayadhvaṃ deveśaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || pṛcchādevyāstu purataḥ purā kalpe prapūjitam || 16 || urvaśyā mama vākyena bharttā prāptaḥ purūravāḥ || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā samājagmurgaṇāstathā || 17 || mahākālavane ramye liṃgārādhanakāmyayā || tatastuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ rudrastāsāṃ bhaktyā varaṃ dadau || 18 || raṃbhe prāpsyasi saubhāgyaṃ svargalokaṃ yaśasvini || bhaviṣyasi mahābhāge jiṣṇostvaṃ vallabhā dhuvam || 19 || tasmāttriviṣṭapaṃ gaccha saṃghenānena pūjitā || ārādhito'psarobhiśca purā svargārthakāmyayā || atopsareśvaraḥ khyāto yayau khyātiṃ jagattraye || 5.2.17.20 || ye samārādhayiṣyaṃti bhaktyā cāpsaraseśvaram || te sarvakāmasaṃpūrṇā bhaviṣyaṃti yugeyuge || 21 || prerayiṣyaṃti ye loke darśanārthaṃ yaśasvini || sthānabhraṃśo viyogaśca teṣāṃ svapne na jāyate || 22 || kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kiṃ yajñairbahudakṣiṇaiḥ || sparśanāllabhate rājyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ krameṇa tu || 23 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || apsareśvaradevasya śrūyatāṃ kalkaleśvaraḥ || 24 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye'psareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha || ||
<5.2.18>
|| śrīśiva uvāca || || devamaṣṭādaśaṃ viddhi khyātaṃ kalakaleśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa kalaho naiva jāyate || 1 || sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ sarvapāpa pramocanam|| vyādhisarpāgnicaurāṇāṃ śamanaṃ vāṃchitapradam || 2 || mama devi tvayā sārddhaṃ kalahaḥ samapadyata || purā vistarato vacmi śṛṇvekāgramanāḥ śubhe || 3 || yadā tvaṃ himaśailasya duhitā varavarṇini || tadā vivāhitaṃ kāṃte yathoktavidhinā mayā || 4 || vinivṛtte vivāhe ca tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane || mahākālīti nāmnā vai varṇenāpi ca tādṛśī || 5 || nīlotpalanibhaprakhyā nīlakuṃcitamūrddhajā || apyekasmiṃstadā tvaṃ hi mātṝṇāṃ maṃḍape śubhe || madhye samupaviṣṭāsi kṛṣṇāṃjanasamaprabhā|| 6 || kāli suṃdari matpārśve vallabhe tvamupāviśa || śarīre mama tanvaṃgi site bhāsyasitadyutiḥ||7|| bhujaṃgīvāsitā śubhre saṃśliṣṭā caṃdane tarau || rajanīvāsite pakṣe dṛṣṭidoṣaharāsi me || 8 || ityuktāsi mayā devi girije cāruhāsini || tadā proktaṃ tvayā vākyaṃ māmuddiśya sagadgadam || 9 || yadā tvayā madarthe hi preritā vedapāragāḥ || saptarṣayo mahābhāgāḥ kiṃkṛte na tadāttha mām || 5.2.18.10 || tadā tvayā madarthe'pi prārthito janako mama || himādrirājo yatnena kiṃ kālī na tadāttha mām || 11 || yadāpyuktaṃ tvayā dainyānmadarthe gaccha nārada || prārthyatāṃ pārvatī śīghraṃ kiṃ kālī na tadāttha mām || 12 || satyeyaṃ laukikī gāthā na vṛthā parijāyate || svakṛtena janaḥ sarvo jāḍyena pari bhūyate || 13 || avaśyamarthī prāpnoti khaṃḍanāṃ tuṃḍamuṃḍanām|| tapotidīrghacārairtayattvāṃ prārthitavatyaham || 14 || tasyā me niyatastveṣa hyavamānaḥ padepade || naivāsmi kuṭilā raudrā viṣamā na ca dhūrjaṭe || 15 || nākulīnā vṛthācārā na duṣṭā na samatsarā || saviṣastvaṃ yataḥ khyāto vyaktaṃ doṣā karāśrayaḥ ||16|| akulīno vṛthācāro mātsaryeṇāśritaḥ sadā || nāhaṃ muṣṇāmi nayane tatra haṃtā tvameva ca ||17|| ādityastvāṃ vijānātu bhagavāndvādaśātmakaḥ || mayā notpāṭitā daṃtāḥ kasyāpi nirapatrapa ||18|| pūṣādevo vijānāti dvādaśātmā divākaraḥ || mūrdhni śūlaṃ tava yataḥ svaidoṣairmāmadhikṣipaḥ ||19|| yattu māmāha kṛṣṇeti mahākāleti viśrutaḥ|| ityathāpi pravādo'yaṃ pravaraḥ khyāmi te hara ||5.2.18.20|| nidarśanārthaṃ na dveṣācchrutvā taṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi|| virūpo yāvadādarśe nātmanaḥ paśyate mukham||21|| manyate tāvadātmānamanyebhyo rūpavattamam || yadā tu mukhamādarśe vikṛtaṃ so'bhivīkṣate||22|| tadetaraṃ vijānāti hyātmānaṃ netaraṃ janam|| satyadharmacyutātpuṃsaḥ kṣudrādāśīviṣādiva || 23 || sa nāstikopyudvijate janaḥ kiṃ punarāstikaḥ || ityukto'haṃ tvayā devi mayā kolāhalaḥ kṛtaḥ || 24 || anātmajñāsi girije mṛḍe paṃḍitamānini || satyaṃ sarvairavayavaiḥ stuto'pi sadṛśaḥ pituḥ ||25|| kāṭhinyaṃ kaṣṭamabhyeti dhātubhyo bahughātitā || kuṭilatvaṃ ca sarvebhyo'sevyatvaṃ ca himādiva ||26|| ityuktā'si mayā devi punaḥ proktaṃ tvayā vacaḥ || tathāpi duṣṭasaṃsargātsaṃkrāṃtaṃ sarvameva hi ||27|| vyālebhyo'nekajihvatvaṃ bhasmataḥ snehavarjanam || hṛtkāluṣyaṃ śaśāṃkādvai durbodhatvaṃ vṛṣādapi||28|| śmaśānavāsādbhīrutvaṃ nagnatvaṃ ca na lajjayā || nirghṛṇatvaṃ kapālācca dayā te vigatā ciram || 29 || evaṃ tadābhavadraudraḥ kalaho bhayakṛcchubhe || evaṃ pravṛtte tu tadā kaṃpitaṃ bhuvanatrayam || 5.2.18.30 || bhītāśca devagaṃdharvā yakṣagaṃdharvarākṣasāḥ || tasmātkolāhalo bhūmiṃ bhittvā liṃgamabhūttadā || 31 || liṃgamadhyātsamutpannā vāṇī sukhakarī śubhā || āśvāsayaṃtī devānvai trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 32 || nāmāsya cakrurdeveśāstadā kalakaleśvaram || svaranāmāsau tato'bhūcchaṅkaro bhuvi viśrutaḥ || 33 || yastamarcayate bhaktyā devaṃ kalakaleśvaram|| na rākṣasāḥ piśācāśca na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ || vipraṃ kuryurvarārohe kalaho na bhavedgṛhe || 34 || suśīlā gṛhiṇī tasya surūpā subhagā priye || bahuputrā bahudhanā jāyate darśanāttathā || 35 || ye paśyaṃti caturddaśyāṃ devaṃ kalakaleśvaram || na duḥkhaṃ na jarāvyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ tathā || 36 || na ca śatrubhayaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate giriputrake || loko'kṣayo bhaveddevi yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa || 37|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa kṣemamatra paratra ca || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kalakaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 |||cha|||
<5.2.19>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ekonaviṃśatitamaṃ nāgacaṃḍeśvaraṃ priye || nirmālyalaṃghanāptapāpānmucyate yasya darśanāta||1|| tasya prabhāvaṃ subhagaṃ kathayāmyatha vistarāt|| śṛṇvekāgramanā devi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam|| 2 || purā devarṣigaṃdharvāścāraṇā guhyakāstathā || upaviṣṭāḥ sudharmāyāṃ kathayaṃtaḥ śubhāṃ kathām || 3 || etasminnaṃtare śakro devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ munim || papraccha sādaraṃ devi samāyātaṃ śucivratam || 4 || dṛṣṭvā vinayasaṃpannaṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇam || mekhalājinakaupīnaṃ vīṇādaṇḍavibhūṣitam||5|| tvayā dṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam|| utpādyamānamutpannaṃ pralayacca sahasraśaḥ ||6|| tvattulyo nāsti loke'sminmu ktvaikaṃ parameṣṭhinam|| jagatkāraṇamavyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam|| 7 || yogena tapasā bhaktyā yattvayā paritoṣitaḥ || trailokyamabhijānāsi tatsarvaṃ sarvataḥ sphuṭam|| 8 || ato'haṃ praṣṭumicchāmi kathyatāṃ mama niścayam || pṛthivyāṃ pravaraṃ kṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 9 || evaṃ śrutvā tadā dhyātvā ciṃtayāmāsa nāradaḥ || ciṃtayitvā ciraṃ kālamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||5.2.19.10|| devarāja smṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetrarājamanuttamam || kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ ca praśa syate || 11 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣetraṃ mahākālasya kathyate || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ tacca darśanādapi vāsava || 12 || etacchrutvā sahasrākṣo varṇayitvā ca taṃ munim|| sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ vimānasthastvarānvitaḥ || 13 || aṃtarikṣasthito jiṣṇuradrākṣīcca suraiḥ saha || kṣetraṃ liṃgaiḥ samākīrṇamaṃgulasyāṃtaraṃ na hi || 14 || ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || mahākālavane ramye nirmālyaṃ laṃghyate katham || 15 || nirmālyalaṃghanāddoṣo mahānbhavati niścitam|| ityālocya punardevi jagmuḥ svarge manoramāḥ || 16 || nirmālyadoṣabhītāste kṣetre na viviśuḥ surāḥ || etasminnaṃtare devi vimānasthā gaṇottamāḥ || 17 || gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ geyairgīyamānaśca kiṃnaraiḥ || cāraṇaiḥ stūyamānastu svargalokaṃ vrajansuraiḥ || 18 || praphullanayanairdṛṣṭaḥ ko'yaṃ dhanyo mahātapāḥ || tejasā dīpyamānoyampasarobhiśca sevyate || 19 || papracchuramarāḥ sarve ko'yaṃ rudranibho gaṇaḥ || yāti kutra mahābāho hṛṣṭātmā prahasanmukhaḥ || 5.2.19.20 || pṛṣṭastadā suraiḥ sarvairvismayāviṣṭamānasaiḥ || kastvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla kiṃ tvayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam || 21 || devānāṃ purato devi niḥśeṣaṃ kathitaṃ tadā || mahākālo mahādevaḥ pūjito bhaktitaḥ stutaḥ || 22 || hṛṣṭena tena me dattaṃ gaṇatvaṃ yatsudurlabham || nāma dattaṃ ca subhagaṃ nāgacaṃḍa iti dhruvam || 23 || papracchuramarāstacca sādaraṃ gaṇasattama || nāgacaṃḍa tvayā tatra nirmālyaṃ patitaṃ tvatha || 24 || mahākālavane puṇye laṃghitaṃ caratā tvayā || saṃcāro nāsti tatraiva liṃgasaṃkīrṇatā yataḥ || 25 || upāyastena kathito devānāṃ puratastadā || tatra tiṣṭhati deveśā liṃgaṃ sarvaphalapradam || 26 || īśāneśvaradevasya tiṣṭhatīśānabhāgataḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa na sa gacchati duṣkṛtam || 27 || nirmālyalaṃghanodbhūtaṃ yatpāpaṃ jāyate mahat || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 28 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve mahākālavane punaḥ || samāyātā mahābhāgā mahākālaśca pūjitaḥ || 29 || yathā liṃgaṃ ca taddṛṣṭaṃ sarvadoṣakṣayaṃkaram || tasya darśanamātreṇa nirmālyalaṃghanādibhiḥ || doṣo naṣṭaḥ surāṇāṃ ca tato nāmāsya cakrire || 5.2.19.30 || asmākaṃ tena kathitaṃ nāgacaṃḍena dhīmatā || nāgacaṃḍeśvarākhyānamato loke bhaviṣyati || || 31 || kṛtvāsya nāma te devā jagmuḥ svargehamuttamam || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kecinnāgacaṃḍeśvaraṃ śivam || nirmālyalaṃghanodbhūtaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati pātakam|| || 32 || nāgacaṃḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ ye paśyaṃti dinedine || ajñānājjñānataḥ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati nānyathā || 33 || āhlādaṃ nirvṛtiṃ svāsthyamārogyaṃ cārurūpatām || sapta janmānyavāpnoti darśanena na saṃśayaḥ || 34 || prāpnotyabhimatānkāmāndevānāmapi durlabhān || kīrttanānnātra saṃdeho nāgacaṃḍeśvarasya ca || 35 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || nāgacaṃḍeśvarasyaiva pratīhāreśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 36 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye nāgacaṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || cha || ||
<5.2.20>
|| īśvara uvāca || || pratīhāreśvaraṃ devi viddhi viṃśatimaṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa dhanavāniha jāyate || 1 || dakṣakopāttvaṃ ca devi purā prāṇairvisarjitaiḥ || himācale tathā jātā mayā prāptā punaḥ priye || 2 || prārabdhā ca mayā devi tvayā sārddhaṃ ratistadā || divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ jātaṃ sāgraṃ devi pramodataḥ || anurāgavaśāccaiva manmathena prapīḍitā || 3 || mahāratiṃ samīkṣyātha devāḥ saṃkṣubdhamānasāḥ || cakrurmaṃtraṃ yathākālaṃ vāsavādyā yathocitam || 4 || divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rudro gauryā saha sadā ratim || kurvaṃstiṣṭhati devo'sau maṃdare cārukaṃdare || 5 || anayorbījasaṃpatyoḥ putro yo hi bhavettadā || vinaśyettena trailokyamakhilaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || tasya tejopi no voḍhuṃ samarthā niścitaṃ vayam || tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma ratiryeno paśāmyati || 7 || upāyaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra devānāṃ gururagraṇīḥ || bṛhaspatirmahātejā vedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 8 || gacchaṃtu tridaśāḥ sarve śivasya tu samīpataḥ|| svayaṃ vijñāpyatāṃ devastatkarma na kariṣyati||9|| iti niścitya te devi jagmuḥ śīghraṃ surāstadā|| maṃdarādreḥ śubhe dvāri sthitāste vismayānvitāḥ||5.2.20.10|| gaṇānāmadhipo naṃdī dvāri tiṣṭhati yatnataḥ|| tvayā sārddhamahaṃ devi kurvaṃstiṣṭhāmi tāṃ ratim||11|| atha praveśo devānāṃ duṣkaro mama pārśvataḥ || tadā ciṃtayamānāśca tatra tiṣṭhaṃti te surāḥ || 12 || agninā taddhitaṃ vākyamuktaṃ teṣāṃ puraḥ śubham || haṃsarūpaṃ samāsthāya yāsyāmi śivasannidhau||13|| vaṃcayitvā pratīhāraṃ kṛtaṃ tena tathaiva ca|| haṃsarūpeṇa kathitaṃ karṇe mama śucismite||14|| indrādyā amarā devā dvāri tiṣṭhaṃti saṃyatāḥ|| śrutvā tasya ca tadvākyaṃ tatohaṃ dvāramāgataḥ||15|| tataśca taikuto mahyaṃ praṇāmaśca yathākramam|| mayā dṛṣṭāśca te devā yuṣmākaṃ kiṃ karomyaham||16|| tairuktaṃ tyajyatāṃ caiva saṃbhogastu sudāruṇaḥ|| tathā mayā kṛtaṃ devi gatāste tridivaṃ punaḥ||17|| tataḥ śapto mayā naṃdī bhūlokaṃ gaccha satvaram|| tataḥ śāpaparibhraṣṭaḥ pṛthivyāṃ patitastadā||18|| socchvāsahṛdayo dīno duḥkhavyākulalocanaḥ|| vilapaṃśca tathā naṃdī viluṭhañchokato bhuvi ||19|| vaṃcitaścāgninā bāḍhaṃ vāsavena viśeṣataḥ|| kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ kiṃ citpurātanam || 5.2.20.20 || sa dṛṣṭo lokapālaistu tāmavasthāṃ gato gaṇaḥ || pṛṣṭaśca taiḥ kuto nadinvilāpaṃ kuruṣe mahat || 21 || sarvaṃ niveditaṃ tena teṣāmagre ca naṃdinā || upāyaḥ kathitastaiśca mahākālavanaṃ tataḥ || 22 || tataśca vacanaṃ śrutvā naṃdī romāṃcakaṃcukaḥ || mahākālavane devi jagāma sa tadā gaṇaḥ || pūjayāmāsa vidhivaddhṛtvā kapālikīṃ tanum || 23 || aśarīrasamutpannā vāṇī liṃgāttadā priye || saṃjātā śāpamokṣaste pratīhāra subhaktitaḥ || pūjito'sau mahābhaktyā pratīhāreṇa naṃdinā || 24 || tadāprabhṛti lokesminpratīhāreśvareśvaraḥ || mayā te kathito devi pratīhāreśvarasya ca || prabhāvaḥ sarvalokānāmatyabhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 25 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā pratīhāreśvaraṃ śivam || sthānabhraṃśo viyogaśca teṣāṃ svapne'pi no bhavet || 26 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti pratīhāreśvarārcanāt || 27 || manasā ye smariṣyati pratīhāreśvaraṃ śivam|| evaṃ tasya kulaṃ sarvaṃ yāti svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||28|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye pratīhāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśodhyāyaḥ||20||
<5.2.21>
īśvara uvāca|| ekaviṃśatikaṃ viddhi kukkuṭeśvarasaṃjñakam|| yasya darśanamātreṇa tiryagyonirna labhyate||1|| kauśikonāma rājābhūtkukkuṭo jāyate sadā|| dṛśyate vāsare bhāge sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ||2|| vyāptā ca pṛthivī tena saśailavanakānanā || pūrvakarmaprabhāvena prāptaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam || 3 || viśālānāma vikhyātā bhāryā tasya mahīpateḥ || rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktā catuḥṣaṣṭikalānvitā ||4|| tayā cakāra sahitaḥ sa rājyaṃ rājasattamaḥ || sā vallabhāpi nṛpateḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 5 || tayā sārddhaṃ kadācicca surataṃ nāsti pārvati || saṃtaptā sarvadā sā ca ratyabhāvādbabhūva ha || 6 || evaṃ gacchati kāle tu saha rājñā smarāturā || sarvasattvarutajñā sā viśālā vipulekṣaṇā || dadarśa kīṭamithunamanaṃgakalahāturam || 7 || prasādayaṃstathā kīṭaḥ svāṃ priyāṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ || dāso'smi tava kāṃte'haṃ rūpasaubhāgya sundari || 8 || bhajasva māṃ yathākāmamanaṃgaśarapīḍitam || śirasā praṇatenaiva racitaste mayāṃjaliḥ || 9 || na tvayā sadṛśī loke kāminī vidyate kvacit || suvarṇavarṇasadṛśī madbhaktā cāruhāsinī || 5.2.21.10 || kuto vā mayi dīne tvaṃ kruddheva priyavādini || kimarthaṃ vada kalyāṇi saroṣava danā sthitā || 11 || sā tamāha prakopācca kimālapasi māṃ vṛthā || tvayā modakacūrṇaṃ tu māṃ vihāya manoramām || pradattaṃ kāmalubdhena anyasya kīṭakādhama || 12 || nāhamevaṃ kariṣyāmi kīṭaḥ prāha punaḥpunaḥ || spṛśāmi pādau satyena praṇatasya prasīda me || 13 || iti
