tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sā prasannābhavattadā || ātmānamarpayāmāsa kāmanāya pipīlikā || 14 || dṛṣṭvā tanmahadāścaryaṃ sā rājñī vilalāpa ha || dhigrājyaṃ dhikca me rūpaṃ dhikca yauvanamadya me || na kāmitāhaṃ kāṃtena mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || evaṃ vilapya vahudhā viniḥśvasya punaḥpunaḥ || unmatteva viśālākṣī gālava syāśramaṃ gatā || 16 || dṛṣṭvā tamṛṣimāsīnaṃ tapoyoniṃ dṛḍhavratam || uvāca praṇatāṃgī sā śokasaṃtaptamānasā || 17 || eko'yaṃ saṃśayo brahmanhṛdaye parivarttate|| vaśyo'pi hi ca me bharttā rūpalāvaṇyavānapi|| na jāne kāraṇaṃ kiṃ tu saṃgamo nopajāyate||18|| yo gatvā pramadārājyaṃ jitvā sarvāḥ purā raṇe|| ājahāra śubhāstāsāṃ madhyādaṣṭau varāṃganāḥ|| naiva kāmayate tāsu kimetaditi suvrata||19|| vājino vāraṇāścaiva dhanadhānyamanaṃtakam|| varttate hi janaḥ sarvo mamājñāṃ pālayankṣitau||5.2.21.20|| kena karmavipākena mamedaṃ yauvanaṃ dṛḍham || vyarthaṃ jātaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha ratiṃ na kurute nṛpaḥ|| || 21 || dṛśyate vāsare bhāge rātrau caiva na dṛśyate || ihajanmakṛtaṃ caitadāhosvitpāralaukikam || 22 || duṣkṛtāvarjanaṃ brahmanmamedaṃ vaktumarhasi || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā gālavo vākyamabravīt|| 23|| śṛṇu putri purāvṛttaṃ bālabhāvena yatkṛtam|| anena rājñā dharmajñe rātrau yena na dṛśyate||24|| vidūrathasya tanayastava bhartā sa niścitam|| māṃsāhārī doṣaratirviṣayāsaktamānasaḥ||25|| bahavaḥ kukkuṭāstena bhakṣitā rājasūnunā || 26 || evaṃ bhakṣayatastasya bahuśo vatsarā gatāḥ || kālena mahatā rājñā tāmracūḍena maṃtriṇaḥ|| pṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nātra samāyāṃti hi kukkuṭāḥ || 27 || atha kenāpi kathitaṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇam || vidūrathasya putreṇa kauśikena durātmanā || bhakṣitāḥ kukkuṭāḥ sarve vinā kāraṇato nṛpa || 28 || tāmracūḍo'tha saṃkruddho dadau śāpaṃ durātmane || kauśikāya kṣayo rogo bhaviṣyati bhayāvahaḥ || || 29 || tadāprabhṛtyabhūtkṣīṇo rājaputro dinedine || auṣadhairadhiko'bhyeti vyādhinā pīḍito bhṛśam || 5.2.21.30 || atha kenāpi kāmena vāmadevāśramaṃ gataḥ || kṣayarogābhibhūto'sau maraṇotsukamānasaḥ || papraccha vāmadevaṃ sa namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ ||31|| bhagavankena pāpena kṣīyate'harniśaṃ vapuḥ || madīyaṃ poṣyamāṇaṃ hi māṃsena vividhena ca || 32 || vāmadevo'tha taṃ prāha kukkuṭā bhakṣitāstvayā || tāmracūḍena śapto'si kukkuṭānāṃ nṛpeṇa hi || 33 || tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sa upāyaṃ vadiṣyati || tataḥ sa tāmrabūḍasyābhyarṇamāgānṛpātmajaḥ || 34 || dṛṣṭvā ca tāmracūḍaṃ taṃ mahābhaktyā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || provāca praṇato bhūtvā pāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam||35|| ajñānādbhakṣitā deva kukkuṭāḥ puṣṭikāraṇāt || kṣaṃtumarhasi deveśa mamāgaḥ kṛpaṇasya ca ||36|| provāca tāmra cūḍo'tha yasmātprārthayase nṛpa || tasmātte vāsare prāpte puruṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati||37|| śāstā goptā ca lokānāṃ rājā daṃḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ || kukkuṭo bhavitā rātrau sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ||38|| ato na dṛśyate putri tiryagbhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ||39|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā gālavasya mahātmanaḥ || sā saṃpūjya viśālākṣī gālavaṃ munisattamam || papraccha parayā bhaktyā śāpāṃto hi kathaṃ bhavet || 5.2.21.40 || gālavaḥ kathayāmāsa dhyānenālokya yatnataḥ || 41 || mahākāla vane liṃgaṃ pakṣiyonivimocanam || jvāleśvarasya devasya pūrvabhāge vyavasthitam || tasya darśanamātreṇa śāpasyāṃto bhaviṣyati || 42 || sā praṇamya muniśreṣṭhamājagāma tvarānvitā || yatrāste nṛpaśārdūlo vidhyanbahuvidhānmṛgān || 43 || praphullanayanābhyāṃ sā dṛṣṭā lolekṣaṇā priyā || āhlāditā bahuvidhaiḥ komalairvacanāmṛtaiḥ || 44 || tatastena tadā rājñā proktā sā mṛgalocanā || idānīṃ ki mayā kāṃte kāryaṃ bhavati kathyatām || 45 || tayā proktaṃ mahārāja gamyate'dya mayā saha || mahākālavane puṇye sarvaduṣkṛtanāśane || 46 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tvaramāṇo mudānvitaḥ || tayā nīto'tha nṛpatirliṃgasyāsya samīpataḥ || 47 || pūjayitvātha talliṃgaṃ pakṣiyonivimocanam || tatraiva ca sthito rājā priyayā saha pārvati || 48 || tasyāṃ rātrau na saṃjātaḥ kukkuṭo yādṛśaḥ sadā || śivaprasādādabhavaddivyarūpī manoharaḥ || 49 || rūpeṇa nirjitaḥ kāmastenāpratimatejasā || tato vismayamāpannaściṃtayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || ko'yaṃ prabhāvo yenāhaṃ śāpānmuktaḥ sudustarāt || 5.2.21.50 || priyāṃ papraccha nṛpatiḥ pūrṇenduvadanāṃ bhṛśam || kathaṃ śāpādvimukto'haṃ kena puṇyena karmaṇā || 51 || atha sā kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ vistarānmudā || gālavena hi yatproktaṃ yatkiṃcicchāpamokṣaṇam ||52|| rājañchāpādvimukto'si liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || punaḥ prasādya talliṃgaṃ bhuktvā bhogāṃściraṃ bhuvi || 53 || tayā sārddhaṃ yayau rājā svargaṃ suragaṇaiḥ stutaḥ || tadāprabhṛti talliṃgaṃ kukkuṭeśvarasaṃjñakam || 54 || vikhyātaṃ devi loke'sminsarvakāmaphalapradam || tacca ye pūjayiṣyaṃti kukkuṭeśvarasaṃjñakam || tiryagyoniṃ na yāsyaṃti na viyogo bhaviṣyati || 55 || na cāpi narakāvāptirna duḥkhaṃ na jarā bhayam || nākāle maraṇaṃ nṝṇāṃ na ca kaṣṭaṃ bhavi ṣyati || 56 || rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpannā bhaviṣyaṃti yugeyuge || caturddaśyāṃ prapaśyati liṃgaṃ ye kukkuṭeśvaram || teṣāṃ kule ca ye kecitpitaro nirayasthitāḥ || || 57 || tiryagyonigatā ye ca paśuyoniṃ tu ye gatāḥ || vṛkṣatvamathavā prāptāsteṣāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kukkuṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || cha || ||
<5.2.22>
|| śrīviśvanātha uvāca || || dvāviṃśatitamaṃ viddhi karkaṭeśvarasaṃjñakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa tiryagyonirna dṛśyate || 1 || āsītpurā bṛhatkalpe dharma mūrtirjanādhipaḥ || suhṛcchakrasya nihatā yena daityāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 2 || somasūryādayo yasya tejasā niṣprabhāḥ kṛtāḥ || prajāśca pālitā yena nihatya samare dviṣaḥ || 3 || yathecchārūpadhārī ca saṃgrāmeṣvaparājitaḥ || tasya bhānumatīnāma bhāryā trailokyasuṃdarī || 4 || rājñastasyāgramahiṣī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || daśanārīsahasrāṇāṃ madhye śrīriva rājitā || 5 || nṛpo nṛpasahasreṇa na kadācitpramucyate || kadācidekāṃtagataḥ papraccha svapurohitam || vismayenāvṛtamanā vaśiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam || 6 || bhagavankena dharmeṇa mama lakṣmīranuttamā || kasmācca vipulaṃ tejo duḥsahaṃ mama dṛśyate || 7 || || || vaśiṣṭha uvāca || || purā tvamavanīpā''sīḥ śūdrajātisamudbhavaḥ || bahudoṣasamāviṣṭo duṣṭayā bhāryayā'nayā || 8 || nivasanduṣṭahṛdayo varṣāṇi subahūnyapi || mahākrodhābhibhūtātmā sadā niṣṭhurajalpakaḥ || 9 || sadā brahmasvahārī tvaṃ sadā vedaviniṃdakaḥ || sadā cāsūyako rājansadā viśvāsaghātakaḥ || 5.2.22.10 || atha paṃcatvamāpannaḥ kāle narakamāptavān || tāmrabhrāṣṭre paraṃ dagdho daśavarṣāṇi paṃca ca || 11 || raurave kumbhipāke ca mahārauravasaṃjñake || sūkṣmāṇi tilamātrāṇi kṛtvā khaṃḍānyanekaśaḥ || 12 || mūṣāyāṃ dhīmato rājannasipatre ca dāritaḥ || śeṣapātakaśuddhyarthaṃ dharāyā mavatāritaḥ||13|| vidhāya kārkaṭaṃ rūpaṃ yamena tvayi pārthiva || śivasya saro vikhyātaṃ mahākālavanottame||14|| dattaṃ japtaṃ kṛtaṃ yacca hutaṃ devārcanādi yat|| sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ karma tasminsarasi viśrutam ||15|| nikṣiptastvaṃ tadā tena bhāvipuṇyena karmaṇā|| tatra sthitastvaṃ bhūpāla varṣāṇāṃ paṃcakaṃ tathā||16|| kadācittīrabhūmyāṃ tvaṃ gataḥ saṃkrīḍituṃ śanaiḥ || samīkṣya tatra kākena dhṛtvā caṃcupuṭena ca ||17|| ākāśamārgaṃ coḍḍīnaḥ sa tvayā tāḍito bhṛśam|| tvattīkṣṇapātaiścaraṇaistāḍito vyathitastadā || 18 || muktastvaṃ caṃcupuṭato vāyasenākulena tu || svargadvārasya pūrve tu devyagāre supuṇyade || 19 || śivasya kṣiptastvaṃ śīghraṃ cañcvākṣepaprapīḍitaḥ || mṛto'si saṃnidhau tatra devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ||5.2.22.20|| vimucya dehaṃ tajjīrṇaṃ yāvattaṃ kārkaṭaṃ purā|| tatkṣaṇāddivya dehaśca divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 21 || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādbhūtvā vidyādhareśvaraḥ || kāmagena vimānena pūjyamāno gaṇeśvaraiḥ ||22|| svarge vrajaṃstvaṃ saṃpṛṣṭaḥ surasaṃghaiśca sādaram|| koyaṃ mahātmā mudito yāti divyapathoṃ'barāt || 23 || tato rudragaṇaiḥ sarvaṃ surāṇāṃ kathitaṃ purā || vṛttāṃtaṃ vistarātsarvaṃ kārkaṭatvavimocanūm || 24 || tasya liṃgasya deveśāḥ prabhāvo'yamupasthitaḥ || devaiḥ proktaṃ ca sahasā liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||25|| kārkaṭīyoni muktasya prāptaṃ svargasukhaṃ yataḥ || karkaṭeśvaranāmāyamato loke bhaviṣyati || 26 || tadāprabhṛti devo'yaṃ karkaṭeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || tvayā svarge mahābhogā bhuktā rājanyathecchayā || 27 || āgato'si punarbhūmau labdhaṃ rājyamakaṃṭakam || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyājjātaṃ sarvaṃ tavādhunā || 28 || tasmātpārthiva bhūyastvaṃ liṃgamārādhaya drutam || jātismaratvamāpanno vaśiṣṭhavacanāttadā || 29 || pūrvaṃ karma smṛtaṃ tena svakīyaṃ pārthivena tu || punargatvā ca talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa yatnataḥ ||5.2.22.30 || tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ prāptaḥ svaśarīreṇa pārvati|| ye'rcayaṃti sadā bhaktyā karkaṭeśvarasaṃjñakam|| bhuktvā bhogāṃściraṃ bhūmau te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim||31|| niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devaṃ karkaṭeśvaram|| aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu||32|| sūryadīptipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ|| mṛtā mama puraṃ yāṃti trisaptakulasaṃyutāḥ||33| tatra divyairmahābhogaiḥ strīsahasrairmanoramaiḥ|| kalpakoṭiśatairdevi sevyamānā vasaṃti hi || 34 || tadaṃte viṣṇubhavane tāvatkālaṃ ca saṃti hi || vaiṣṇavairvividhairbhogaiḥ strīsahasraistu sevitāḥ || 35 || viṣṇulokādbrahmalokaṃ saṃprāpya muditāḥ punaḥ || bhogānnānāvidhānbhuktvā tato yāṃti paraṃ padam || 36 || daśāśvamaidhairyatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ tīrthayātrayā || karkaṭeśvaradevasya meghanādeśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 37 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye karkaṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<5.2.23>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || meghanādeśvaraṃ devi trayoviṃśatimaṃ śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa prāpyate sarvasiddhayaḥ ||1|| rājamūlā mahādevi yogakṣemāḥ suvṛṣṭayaḥ|| prajāśca vyādhayaścaiva maraṇaṃ ca bhayāni ca ||2|| rājā kṛtaṃ tathā tretā dvāparaśca tathā kaliḥ || rājamūlāni sarvāṇi rājādharmasya kāraṇam || 3 || rājā babhūva loke'sminmadāṃdhonāma pārvati || ahaṃkārāvṛto duṣṭo devabrāhmaṇakaṃṭakaḥ || 4 || kali dvāparayoḥ saṃdhau tasya doṣācca bhāmini || anāvṛṣṭirabhūddhorā loke dvādaśavārṣikī || 5 || na vavarṣa sahasrākṣaḥ pratilomo'bhavatprabhuḥ || nādṛśyantāpi rātryaṃte kuta evābhrajātayaḥ || 6 || nadyaḥ saṃkṣiptatoyaughāḥ kvacidaṃtarhitāstadā || nivṛttayajñasvādhyāyā nirvaṣaṭkāramaṃgalāḥ || 7 || ucchinnakṛṣi gorakṣā nivṛttavipaṇāstathā || asthikaṃkālasaṃkīrṇā hāhābhūtanarākulāḥ || 8 || śūnyabhūyiṣṭhanagarā dagdhagrāmaniveśinaḥ || gojāśvamahiṣairhīnā bhakṣyamāṇāḥ parasparam || 9 || āśramānsaṃparityajya paryadhāvannitastataḥ || brāhmaṇā duḥkhabahulā mṛtā naṣṭāśca pārvati || 5.2.23.10 || sūṣṭirunmūlitā sarvā jaṃgamā sthāvarākhilā || etasminnaṃtare devāḥ śakrādyā bhayavihvalāḥ || 11 || śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevadevaṃ janārdanam || kṣīrodasyottare kūle śvetadvīpaṃ manoramam || 12 || brahmalokādibhirlokairanaupamyaguṇaṃ śubham || sadānaṃdakaraṃ śāṃtaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 13 || svecchākalpitavi nyāsaprāsādaśayanāsanam || vajreṃdranīlavaiḍūryacaṃdrakāṃtādidīpitam || 14 || jarāmṛtyubhayopetasarvavyādhivivarjitam || tasmindvīpe tato devi sūrya koṭisamaprabham || sāṣṭāṃgāṃ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā te devāḥ stutimabruvan || 15 || bhavānbrahmā ca rudraśca maheṃdro devasattamaḥ || bhavānkarttā vikarttā ca lokānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ || 16 || evaṃ ca satyaṃ paramaṃ tapaśca paramaṃ tathā || pavitraṃ paramamārgaṃ yajñastvaṃ paramaḥ prabho || 17 || paraṃ hautraṃ paraṃ dhāma tvāmāhuḥ puruṣaṃ param || evaṃ stutastadā taistu devadevo varānane || 18 || prāha devāṃstataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kiṃ karomyadya vaḥ surāḥ || vijñaptastairharirdevo hyanāvṛṣṭyā prapīḍitaiḥ || 19 || upāyaḥ kathyatāṃ deva tuṣṭiḥ dhuṣṭiryathā bhavet || dhyānena ciṃtayitvā ca kathayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 5.2.23.20 || gacchadhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve mahākālavane śubhe || liṃgaṃ vṛṣṭikaraṃ tatra purā meghaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || 21 || meghā vṛṣṭikarāḥ sarve tasmim̐lliṃge ca saṃti vai || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādvṛṣṭireva bhaviṣyati || 22 || pratīhāreśvarāddevādīśāne vidyate surāḥ || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vāsudevasya pārvati ||23|| mahākālavane prāptā yatrāste liṃgamuttamam || tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ manoramam || 24 || namaste'stu maheśāya namo'naṃtāya māline || namastaijasamūrttāya namaḥ sauṃdaryaśāline || 25 || namo yogāya vedāya namaḥ piṃgajaṭāya te || anaṃtajñānadehāya nama īśvaramūrttaye || 26 || namaḥ śubhrāṭṭahāsāya namaste'stu śikhaṃḍine || śaṃkarāya namaste'stu namastestu pinākine || 27 || namoṃ'takāya bhavyāya tryaṃbakāyāstu te namaḥ || namaste bahurūpāya namaste'ciṃtyamūrttaye || 28 || namo yogaśarīrāya namaste sarva sarvadā || naṣṭaṃ deva jagatsarvamanāvṛṣṭyā prapīḍitam || 29 || suvṛṣṭyā devadeveśa pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān || etasminnaṃtare meghā pārvaṇāṃgāravarcasaḥ || 5.2.23.30 || liṃgamadhyātsamuttasthurvādayaṃto nabhastalam || anyonyavegābhihatā vavṛṣurbhūtale tadā || 31 || jātaṃ viniṣprabhaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana || timiraughaparikṣiptā rejuścātha diśo daśa || 32 || te tasya devadevasya māhātmyena pratoṣitāḥ || devāḥ prītiṃ parāṃ jagmuḥ sarve'mṛtamivottamāḥ || 33 || tatastamaḥ saṃharato vineśuśca balāhakā || pravavuḥ śītalā vātāḥ praśāṃtāśca diśo daśa || 34 || śuddhaprabhāṇi jyotīṃṣi somaṃ cakruḥ pradakṣiṇām || avigrahaṃ grahāścakruḥ praśāṃtāścāpi sindhavaḥ || 35 || maharṣayo viśokāśca gaṃdharvāśca kalaṃ jaguḥ || abhūtsṛṣṭiḥ punaḥ sarvā liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 36 || suraiḥ saṃpūjya bhaktyā te cakrurnāma yathārthataḥ || asya liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭvā prītāḥ surā bahu || 37 || meghanādeśvaraṃ nāma bhaviṣyatyasya sarvataḥ || meghanādeśvarākhyānaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ priye || 38 || bhaviṣyaṃti narā bhūmau kṛtārthāstatprabhāvataḥ || darśanādasya liṃgasya kāmavṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati || 39 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || kurvaṃlliṃgasya snapanaṃ rudraloke mahīyate || 40 || prabhāvaḥ paṭhyate yatra meghanādasya pārvati || ativṛṣṭiścaiva tato bhaviṣyati ca bhūtale || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaāvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye meghanādeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || a || ||
<5.2.24>
|| īśvara uvāca || || mahālayaṃ mahābhāge caturviṃśatikaṃ śubham || brahmādistaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarā caram || 1 || utpāditaṃ dhṛtaṃ vyāptaṃ tvayā deva mayā śrutam || tvayaikena viśuddhena sarvagena mahātmanā || 2 || atyarthaṃ munayaḥ sarve muditā maunino 'vyayāḥ || vadaṃti kāraṇaṃ cāsya trailokyasya maheśvara || 3 || tvayā sarvamidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam || utpādyamānamutpannaṃ pralīyacca sahasraśaḥ || 4 || devadānavagaṃdharvamunicāraṇabhoginām || utpattisthitisaṃhārāstvayā dṛṣṭā muhurmuhuḥ || 5 || jagaccarācaraṃ deva kutra sthitvāsṛjasyalam || līlayā saṃharasyetatprasādādvaktumarhasi || 6 || ko'sau mahālayo raudragraharūpī vyavasthitaḥ || yasmindhṛtaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam || || 7 || iti pṛṣṭastvayā devi mayā te kathitaṃ purā || idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasā || 8 || pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni mahākālavane priye || dhṛtāni pralayasyāṃte ekoddeśe mahālaye || 9 || brahmalokādibhirlokairanaupamyaguṇaṃ śubham || sthānaṃ mahālayaṃ tatra mamānaṃdakaraṃ param || 5.2.24.10 || paraṃ brahmamayaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra tiṣṭhati sarvadā || tasya liṃgasya madhye tu dhṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ carācaram || 11 || tatra brahmādayo devā viṣṇustatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || liṃgasyābhyaṃtare devi sarvamevādhitiṣṭhati || tasmālliṃgātsamutpanno mahānātmā mahāmatiḥ || 12 || bhūtādiścāpyahaṃkāro viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhuśca pārvati || buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtiḥ khyātiḥ smṛtirlajjā sarasvatī ||13|| sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham || sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||14|| asmādbhūtāni liṃgāni mahābhūtāni pañca vai || pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiḥ pralīyate || 15 || sthalamāpastathākāśaṃ janma cāpi caturvidham|| aṇḍajodbhijjaṃ ca sasvedaṃ jarāyujamathāpi vā || 16 || caturddhā janmacihnaṃ yalliṃgesminneva lakṣyate || tapaḥ karma ca puṇyaṃ ca vrataṃ dānaṃ tathaiva ca || 17 || rajaḥsattvaṃ tamobhāvastasmālliṃgācca jāyate || tasmiṃstacchrūyate satyaṃ jyotirbrahma sanātanam || 18 || avyaktakāraṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yattatsadasadātmakam || yasmātpitāmaho jajñe prabhurekaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 19 || viśvedevāstathādityā vasavo'thāśvināvapi || yakṣāḥ sādhyāḥ piśācāśca guhyakāḥ pitara stathā || 5.2.24.20 || āpo dyauḥ pṛthivī vāyuraṃtarikṣaṃ diśastathā || saṃvatsarartavo māsāḥ pakṣāhorātrayastathā || 21 || yaccānyadapi tatsarvaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ loka sākṣikam || yadidaṃ dṛśyate kiṃcittasyāṃte ca pralīyate || 22 || ato mahālayonāma vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || muktīśvarasya devasya dakṣiṇe saṃvyava sthitaḥ || 23 || yaḥ pūjayati talliṃgaṃ rudramūrtyā mahālayam || trailokyavijayī nityaṃ kīrttimānsa naro bhavet || 24 || mahālayeśvare puṇye pūjite parameśvare || bhaktyā paramayā caiva sarve devāḥ supūjitāḥ || bhavaṃtīha mahābhāge yatastairapi pūjyate || 25 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye mahālayeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || cha ||
<5.2.25>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || paṃcaviṃśatikaṃ devaṃ viddhi muktīśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa muktirbhavati pārvati || 1 || purā rāthaṃtare kalpe babhūva dvijasattamaḥ || muktirnāma mahābhāge saṃśitātmā jiteṃdriyaḥ || 2 || mahākālasamīpe tu muktiliṃgamanuttamam || mahākālavane ramye tatrāste yogata tparaḥ || 3 || tatastepe jitāhāro vatsarāṇi trayodaśa || kadācitso'bhiṣekāya ājagāma mahānadīm|| 4 || śiprāṃ viprapriyāṃ puṇyāṃ mahāpātakanā śinīm || tatra snātvā japanvipro dadarśāyāṃtamagrataḥ || 5 || vyādhaṃ mahādhanuṣpāṇiṃ raktanetraṃ subhīṣaṇam|| vadaṃtaṃ hantukāmaṃ vai valkalānāṃ jighṛkṣayā || || 6 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣubhito vipro brahmaghnasya bhayāditi || dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tasthau tatraiva sa dvijaḥ || 7 || taṃ dṛṣṭvāṃtargataharirvyādho bhīta ivāgrataḥ || vihāya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ tato vacanamabravīt || 8 || || vyādha uvāca || || haṃtumicchurahaṃ brahmanbhagavantamihāgataḥ || idānīṃ svagatā buddhistvāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva mahāprabham || 9 || brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi strīṇāmayutaśastathā || nihatāni mayā brahmanvṛttihetoḥ kuṭuṃbinā || 5.2.25.10 || na ca me vyathitaṃ cittaṃ kadācidapi jāyate || idānīṃ taptumicchāmi tapo'haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ || 11 || upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || evamukto hyasau vipro nottaraṃ pratyapa dyata || 12 || brahmahā pāpakarmeti matvā brāhmaṇapuṃgavaḥ || anukto'pi sa dharmastu vyādhastatraiva tasthivān|| 13 || snātvā sadyaḥ samāyāto mukti liṃgasamīpataḥ || dvijena sahito devi dṛṣṭvā devaṃ sanātanam || 14 || tatkṣaṇāddivyadehastu tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gataḥ || dṛṣṭvā tanmahadāścaryaṃ muktirvipro nijāṃtare || ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā muktiḥ prāptā varānane || 15 || vyādhena pāpayuktena samādhirahitena ca || mayā punaḥ samācīrṇaṃ tapaḥ parama duṣkaram || 16 || na prāptā paramā mūrttirmuktirnaiva ca labhyate || evaṃ saciṃtayitvātha vairāgyādbrāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ || antarjalagato bhūtvā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 17 || kasyacittvatha kālasya tāṃ nadīmagamatkila || vyāghro bubhukṣitaḥ sādhvi taṃ vihaṃtuṃ samudyataḥ || 18 || aṃtarjalacaraṃ vipraṃ yāva dvyāghro jighṛkṣati || namo nārāyaṇāyeti tāvadvākyaṃ dvijo'bravīt || 19 || vyāghreṇāpi śruto maṃtro'jahātprāṇāṃśca tatkṣaṇāt || divyāṃbaradharo devi divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || divyālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaḥ puruṣaścābhavacchubhaḥ || 5.2.25.20 || so'bravīdyāmi taṃ deśaṃ yatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || tvatprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha muktvā śāpānnirāmayaḥ || 21 || ityukte brāhmaṇaḥ prāha ko'si tvaṃ puruṣarṣabha || so'bravīdasmi rājeṃdra pratāpī pūrvajanmani || 22 || dīrghabāhuriti khyātaḥ sarvadharmaviśāradaḥ || ahaṃ jānāmi vedāṃśca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 23 || śubhāśubhamahaṃ vedmi sarvajño'haṃ mahītale || brāhmaṇairnaiva me kāryaṃ kiṃ vastu brāhmaṇā iti || 24 || tasyaikasmindine viprāḥ sarve krodhasamanvitāḥ || daduḥ śāpaṃ durādharṣaṃ krūro vyāghro bhaviṣyati || 25 || apamānena viprāṇāṃ māṃsāhārī bhayāvahaḥ || saṃjāto'smi dvijaśreṣṭha paśya kālaviparyaye || 26 || ityukto'haṃ purā taistu brāhma ṇairvedapāragaiḥ || durdharṣo'yaṃ mayā prāpto brahmaśāpo dvijarṣabha || 27 || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve praṇipatya mayā mune || prasāditā bhṛśaṃ vipra tadā gadgada yā girā || 28 || jānāmi tejo viprāṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ ca dhīmatām || apeyaḥ sāgaraḥ krodhātkṛto yairlavaṇodakaḥ ||29|| tathaiva dīptatapasāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām|| yeṣāṃ krodhāgniradyāpi kaṇḍake nopaśāmyati || 5.2.25.30 || brāhmaṇānāṃ parībhāvādvātāpiśca durātmavān || agastimṛṣimāsādya jīrṇaḥ krūro mahāsuraḥ || 31|| sarvabhakṣaḥ kṛto vahnirbhṛguṇā kāraṇāṃtare || gautamena purā śakraḥ sa sahasrabhagaḥ kṛtaḥ || 32 || daśadhā keśavo jajñe brahmaśā pātsudustarāt || prasannairvālakhilyaiśca pakṣīṃdro garuḍaḥ kṛtaḥ || 33 || aśvinau devabhiṣajau cyavanena mahātmanā || viṣṭaṃbhayitvā kuliśaṃ kṛtau tau somapāyinau || 34|| kārttavīryārjunenaiva bāhūnāṃ ca sahasrakam || dattātreyaprasādena prāptaṃ paramadurlabham || 35 || purā seṃdrā vaśiṣṭhena rakṣitāstri divaukasaḥ || brāhmaṇaprabhavaṃ saukhyaṃ kīrtirāyuryaśo valam || 36 || lokālokeśvarāścaiva sarve brāhmaṇapūrvakāḥ || ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 37 || bhasmīkuryurjagadidaṃ kuddhāḥ pratyakṣadarśanāḥ || prabhāvā bahavaścāpi śrūyate brahmavadinām || 38 || krodhaśca vipulaḥ sadyaḥ sadyaḥ pratya yakārakaḥ || ahaṃ kopāddvijeṃdrāṇāṃ gato nirayayātanām || 39 || nityaṃ krodhācchriyaṃ rakṣeddhanaṃ rakṣetsamatsarāt || vidyāṃ mānāpamānābhyāmātmānaṃ tu pramādataḥ ||5.2.25.40|| mayā'jñānātkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ rājagarveṇa daivataḥ || kṣaṃtumarhatha vipreṃdrā bhavataḥ śaraṇāgatam ||41|| atha tuṣṭā dvijāḥ sarve ta ūcurmāmidaṃ mudā|| ṣaṣṭhānnakālikaste'gre yadā sthāsyati kaścana || 42 || māṃsabhoktā ca bhavitā kañcitkālaṃ narādhipa || yadā śiprāṃtare puṇye snātastu dvijasattamaḥ || || 43 || aṃtarjalagatenokto namo nārāyaṇeti ca || jighṛkṣurvyāghrarūpeṇa tadā mukto bhaviṣyasi || 44 || evaṃ sa bhavatā prokto namo nārāyaṇeti ca || maṃtraḥ śruto mayā tvattastasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭirāgatā || 45 || jāto'haṃ divyadehastu prasādāttava suvrata || sa kṛtārtho'smi saṃjāto bhagavandarśanā ttava || 46 || varaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ matto yaśca te saṃśayo hṛdi || taṃ ca brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ saṃpādayāmi te || 47 || tavopadeśadānena ānṛṇyaṃ gaṃtu mutsahe || 48 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā divyadehasya sa dvijaḥ || provāca parayā tuṣṭyā praphullamukhapaṃkajaḥ || 49 || adya me saphalaṃ jñānamadya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || adya me saphalā jihvā saphalaṃ cakṣuradya me || 5.2.25.50 || śrutaṃ devena saṃproktaṃ snātvā paśyaṃti dehinaḥ || prākcharīragataṃ te'dya vyāghrarūpaṃ tapottama || 51 || tejomayaṃ śarīraṃ tu brahmarūpaṃ sanātanam || yadi tvahamanugrāhyo yadyevaṃ kartumarhasi || 52 || kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi hṛdi me varttate ciram || kathaṃ muktirmahābhāga muktikāmena yatnataḥ ||53|| yogābhyāsaratenāpi vatsarāṃśca trayodaśa || na labdhā paramāścaryaṃ tapasā duṣkareṇa tu ||54||| vyādhenāpi bhṛśaṃ tena prāptā muktiḥ kṣaṇena tu || atra me saṃśayo jātaḥ ko hetuḥ kathyatāṃ bhṛśam || 55 || tasya tadvacana śrutvā tato vacanamabravīt || kathayāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ muktilakṣaṇam || 56 || mahādevamupāsyāśu mune muktiḥ sudurlabhā || purātanaistu vidvadbhiridamuktaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 57 || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vipra kuru yatnaṃ yathārthataḥ || manniyogāddvijaśreṣṭha tato muktimavāpsyasi || 58 || śapto'haṃ tairyadā vipraistadā me toṣitā bhṛśam || mamānukaṃpayā proktaṃ muktiste bhavitā nṛpa || 59 || muktikāmo mahākāle muktirbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ || vidyate tapasā yuktaḥ sa te praśnaṃ kariṣyati || 5.2.25.60 || muktīśvaraṃ tadā liṃgaṃ tasyāgre kathayiṣyasi || tavāpi tasya mukteśca muktirevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 61 || pūrvaṃ hi cihnitaṃ karma dehino na vimuṃcati || dhātrā vidhirayaṃ dṛṣṭo bahudhā karmabhiśca yaḥ || 62 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa vipro brahmavittamaḥ || aṃtarjalātsamutthāya tato vacanamabravīt || 63 || diṣṭyā tvamāgato bhūpa diṣṭyā te saṃgataṃ mayā || īdṛśā durlabhā loke narā muktipradarśakāḥ || 64 || ityuktvā nṛpaviprau tau muktiliṃgaṃ samā gatau || darśanārthaṃ viśālākṣi dṛṣṭvā devaṃ sanātanam || 65 || tatkṣaṇātsaśarīrau tau tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gatau || īdṛśo'yaṃ mayā devi mahimā kathitastava || 66 || asya liṃgasya saṃsparśānmuktirbhavati nānyathā || ye'rcayaṃti sadā bhaktyā muktiliṃgaṃ sanātanam || api pāpasamāyuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 67 || re mūḍhāḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kiṃ dānairniyamaiśca kim || kurudhvaṃ muktiliṃgasya darśanaṃ muktidāyakam || 68 || na māṃ vidurdevagaṇā nāsurā na maharṣayaḥ || paraṃ rūpaṃ viśālākṣi yadaśmadyuti nirmalam || 69 || na me vetti paraṃ rūpaṃ svayaṃ sākṣātprajāpatiḥ || na viṣṇustridaśaśreṣṭhāḥ kutonye munayaḥ priye || 5.2.25.70 || yadetaddṛśyate tejo liṃgarūpaṃ yaśasvini || etadeva śukādyā hi dhyāyaṃti tridaśā amī || 71 || anekajanmasaṃśuddhā yogino'nugrahānmama || praviśaṃtu tanuṃ devi madīyāṃ muktidāyikām || 72 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃnyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye muktīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||25||
<5.2.26>
īśvara uvāca || viddhi ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ devi devaṃ someśvaraṃ param|| yasya darśanamātreṇa niṣkalaṃko naro bhavet||1|| atrirnāma mahābhāgo brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ|| prajāpatirabhūddevi kalpe vārāhasaṃjñake||2|| tasya putro'bhavatsomo dakṣotha mātṛbhāgataḥ|| saptaviṃśata tiryāḥ kanyā dākṣāyaṇyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ||3|| somapatnyo hi maṃtavyāstāsāṃ śreṣṭhā tu rohiṇī|| tāmeva bhajate somo netarāṃ iti śuśruma|| || 4 || itarāḥ procurāgatya dakṣasyāgre yathātatham || dakṣo'tha sa tadāgatya tamuvāca sa nākarot || 5 || yadā na vāritastasthau dakṣaḥ kuddhastadā priye || śaśāpa somaṃ saṃkruddhaḥ śīghramaṃtarhito bhava || 6 || evaṃ śaptastu somo vai tadā hyaṃtarhito'bhavat || śaśāpa somo dakṣaṃ tu bhavānapi bhaviṣyati || || 7 || anekatvaṃ vihāyaitajjaladehaṃ sanātanam || ataḥ prācetaso dakṣo brahmaputro'pi gīyate || 8 || evamaṃtarhitaḥ somo gato vai dakṣaśāpataḥ || devāśca nāgā yakṣāśca gaṃdharvāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha || vairājaṃ brahmasadanaṃ brahmāṇaṃ samupasthitāḥ || 9 || tasyāgre kathayāmāsurnamaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ || bhagavansarvabhūtānāmādikarttā svayaṃbhuvaḥ||5.2.26.10|| sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāṃ pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān|| devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ||11|| āśvāsayāmāsa surānsuśliṣṭairvacanāṃbubhiḥ || avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam || 12 || śāpāṃtaṃ bhagavāndevo viṣṇureva kariṣyati || etacchrutvā tato devā vākyaṃ paṃkajajanmanaḥ || śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurgatavyathāḥ || 13 || brahmaṇā sahitā devi stutiṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ || namaste devadeveśa namaste viśvabhāvana || namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja || 14 || nārāyaṇa jagannātha devāstvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo dhyeya stvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ || 15 || tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devo brahmādīnāṃ surottama || aṃtardhānaṃ gataḥ somo dakṣaśāpājjanārddana || 16 || vinā somena cauṣadhyo naṣṭā deva mahītale || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurvacanamavravīt || 17 || bhayaṃ tyajadhvamamarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmyaham || naṣṭaṃ caṃdramasaṃ śīghraṃ mānayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 18 || evamuktvā tu bhagavānvisṛjya tridaśeśvarān || somaṃ sasmāra sahasā śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 19 || yadā smṛto na cābhyeti tadā kruddho janārdanaḥ || purāṇapuruṣo devo brahmāṇamidamavravīt || 5.2.26.20 || devairasurasaṃghaiśca mathyatāṃ kalaśodadhiḥ || bhaviṣyati punaścaṃdro mathya māne mahodadhau || 21 || amṛtaṃ tatra lapsyadhvaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vāsudevasya pārvati || 22 || maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā ca vāsukim || devā mathitumārabdhāḥ samudraṃ nidhimaṃbhasām || 23 || somārthe ca purā devi tathaivāsuradānavāḥ || etairmukhamupāśliṣṭau nāga rājo maherṣyayā || 24 || vibudhāḥ sahitāḥ sarve yataḥ pucchaṃ tataḥ sthitāḥ || ato vai bhagavāndevo yato nārāyaṇastataḥ || 25 || śirasyudyamya nāgasya punaḥ punaravākṣipat || udadhau mathyamāne vai mahāñchabdo babhūva ha || 26 || tatra nānājalacarā viniṣpiṣṭā mahādriṇā || vilayaṃ samupājagmuḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 27 || tasmiṃstu mathite devi prayatnātkeśavasya ca || prasannātmā samutpannaḥ somaḥ śītāṃśurujvalaḥ || 28 || tameva devā manujāḥ pitaraśca yaśasvini || upajīvaṃti vṛkṣāśca tathaivauṣadhayo vidhum || 29 || samutpannamatho dṛṣṭvā bhagavānprāha keśavaḥ || pālayemāḥ prajāścaṃdra tvaṃ jyeṣṭho jagato bhava || 5.2.26.30 || ityukto vāsudevena prajāḥ pālayituṃ śaśī || pūrvaṃ somopi yo naṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam || 31 || tasyāgre nāradaḥ sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa satvaram || devarṣervacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || 32 || pīḍito dakṣaśāpena somo'pyaṃtarhitastadā || jagāma śaraṇaṃ devi brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || 33 || tatra gatvā yathāśāpaṃ kathayāmāsa gadgadaḥ || pūrvacaṃdravacaḥ śrutvā brahmā vacanamabravīt || 34 || ayaṃ me prathamaḥ putraḥ pīḍitaḥ śaśinā bhṛśam || navenodadhijātena kiṃ mayā kriyate punaḥ || 35 || viṣṇunā ca balaṃ dattamasmai caṃdramase dṛḍham || tasmādyāsyāmi tatrāhaṃ yatra devo janārdanaḥ || 36 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā madhuhaṃtāraṃ brahmā viṣṇumuvāca ha || tvadādeśājagannātha eṣa caṃdraḥ kṛto mayā || 37 || sa cāyaṃ pīḍito deva śaśāṃkena navena vai || ityukto brahmaṇā devi vāsudevo jagatpatiḥ || vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa brahmāgre ca punaḥpuna. || 38 || brahmāpi pūrvacaṃdrārthe viṣṇuṃ lokanamaskṛtam || tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā prāṃjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ || 39 || namaḥ kṛṣṇa namo viṣṇo namo jiṣṇo namonamaḥ || namo vāmana goviṃda namo'naṃta namo'cyuta ||5.2.26.40|| jayasva goviṃda mahānubhāva jayasva viśṇo jaya padmanābha || jayasva sarvādya gadādhareśa jayasva viśveśvara viśvamūrtte || 41 || evaṃ stutastadā devi brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || samīpasthaṃ samālokya somaṃ vacanama bravīt || 42 || yaccha soma mamādeśānmahākālavanottame || uttare muktiliṃgasya liṃgaṃ kātikaraṃ param || tamārādhaya yatnena sa te dehaṃ pradāsyati || || 43 || ityukto vāsudevena brahmaṇā ca punaḥ punaḥ || ājagāma mahādevi mahākālavanottame || liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tuṣṭāva stotreṇānena suvrate || 44 || || || caṃdra uvāca || || namo devādhidevāya trinetrāya mahātmane || raktapiṃgalanetrāya jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇe || 45 || bhūtavetālajuṣṭāya mahādevāya śūline || bhīmāṭṭahāsayuktāya kapardisthāṇave namaḥ || 46 || pūṣṇo daṃtavināśāya tathāṃdhakavināśine || kailāsavaravāsāya sarvadevāyate namaḥ || || 47 || vikarālorddhvakeśāya bhairavāya namonamaḥ || agnijvālākarālāya kalidharmavivāsine || 48 || tathā dāruvanadhvaṃsakāriṇe tigmaśūline || kṛtakaṃkaṇabhogīṃdrakaṃṭhasūtrāya śūline || 49 || pracaṃḍadaṃḍahastāya vaḍavāgnimukhāya ca || vedāṃtavedyāya namo yajñamūrte namonamaḥ || 5.2.26.50 || dakṣayajñavināśāya jagadbhayakarāya ca || viśveśvarāya devāya sthūlasūkṣmāya śaṃbhave || kapardine karālāya sarvadevāya te namaḥ || 51 || evaṃ stutastadā devi caṃdreṇāṃtarhitena ca || liṃgarūpī mahādevastuṣṭo vākyamathābravīt || 52 || stotreṇānena tuṣṭo'smi brūhi soma kimicchasi || yattebhilaṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tatkarttāsmi na saṃśayaḥ || 53 || || soma uvāca || || yadi tvahamanugrāhyo yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho || kāṃtyā dīptyā tathā mūrtyā tathā rūpeṇa ca prabho|| || 54 || svapadaṃ karttumicchāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || evamastviti liṃgena tatkṣaṇādrajanīcara || 55 || dvijarājena tatprāptaṃ liṃgasyāsya prasādataḥ || somenārādhito yasmāddevadevo maheśvari || 56 || tena someśvaronāma vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || ye'rcayaṃti mahādevi devaṃ someśvaraṃparam|| 57 || kṛta puṇyā narā martyāste yāṃti paramaṃ padam || yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā liṃgaṃ someśvaraṃ priye || 58 || vimukto janmaduḥkhādyairlīyate mayi mānavaḥ || te narāḥ paśavo loke kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvite phalam || 59 || yaiśca someśvaro devo na dṛṣṭo na ca pūjitaḥ || saṃsāre'sminmahāghore janmarogabhayākule || 5.2.26.60 || ekaḥ someśvaraḥ pūjyaḥ kuṣṭharogavināśanaḥ || sa eva sukṛtī loke kulaṃ tenābhyalaṃkṛtam || 61 || ādhāraḥ sarvalokānāṃ yena someśvaro 'rcitaḥ || sakṛdabhyarcya someśaṃ bilvapatreṇa mānavaḥ || mukto bhogī nirātaṃko mama loke vasecciram || 62 || kāṃcanaiḥ kusumairdevi liṃgaṃ someśvaraṃ priye || pūjayaṃti narā bhaktyā te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 63 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || someśvarasya devasya śṛṇuṣvānarakeśvaram || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye someśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha ||
<5.2.27>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || saptaviṃśatimaṃ devyanarakeśvarasaṃjñakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa svapnepi narakaḥ kutaḥ || 1 || purā kaliyuge devi kalpe vārāhasaṃjñake || kaluṣaṃ kālamāsādya satye ca pralayaṃ gate || 2 || nirmaryādā nirādhārā niraukā nāstikā janāḥ || varṇāśramāśca saṃjātā vaṃcayaṃti parasparam || 3 || nārcayaṃti surānviprāḥ karma kurvaṃti kutsitam || lobhamohaparā bhūtvā kāmāsaktāśca mānavāḥ || 4 || vairabaddhāśca saṃjātāḥ parasparavadhe ratāḥ || nivṛttayajñasvādhyāyapiṃḍodakavivarjitāḥ || 5 || brāhmaṇāḥ sarvabhakṣyāśca mṛṣāvādaparāyaṇāḥ || bhūyiṣṭhaṃ kūṭamānaiśca paṇyaṃ vikrīṇate tadā || 6 || dṛśyaṃte ṣoḍaśe varṣe narāḥ palitinaḥ priye || āyuḥkṣayo manuṣyāṇāṃ kṣiprameva prapadyate || 7 || evaṃvidhāḥ samudbhūtā narā nāryaśca pātakaiḥ || narakeṣu prapadyaṃte kramātpāpānusārataḥ || 8 || kuṭhārairbhinnamūrddhānaḥ krakacaiḥ pāṭitāḥ pare || agnivarṇaiśca saṃdaṃśairutpāṭitavilocanāḥ || 9 || bhinnāścāyomayaistīkṣṇairagnitaptaiśca kīlakaiḥ || pīḍyaṃte śailaśikharaiścūrṇyaṃte krūrabhūdharaiḥ || 5.2.27.10 || kṣipyaṃte taptakuṇḍeṣu dahyaṃte vahnirāśiṣu || amedhye'dhomukhāścānye mardditā daṃḍapāṇinā || 11 || lauhaiśca śṛṅkhalairbaddhā hyadhovaktraiśca laṃbitaiḥ || aṃtarikṣe parikṣepātkraṃdaṃto'tīva duḥkhitāḥ ||12|| kṛmibhirbhramaraistīkṣṇairdaṃśaiśca maśakaistathā || lohatuṃḍaiśca vihagairnirdayairbhakṣitā narāḥ||13|| kecitkṛttāḥ pradhāvaṃti toyārthaṃ ca tṛṣāturāḥ || svamūtraṃ pāyitāścaṃḍaiḥ kṣubhitāścāpi ghātanaiḥ || 14 || yaiścāṃgaiḥ patitaṃ karma kriyate puruṣairbhuvi || teṣāṃ tānyeva cāṃgāni śodhyaṃte yātanāgataiḥ || 15 || ye paśyaṃti guruṃ devānbrāhmaṇānkruddhacakṣuṣā || duṣṭena paradārāṃśca vīkṣaṃte locanena ye || teṣāṃ netrāṇi bhidyaṃte kṛṣyaṃte lohaśaṃkubhiḥ || 16 || śravaṇau ca prapūryaṃte lauhena śaṃkunā tataḥ || punaśca śastraiḥ kṛṣyaṃte punastaptaiśca kīlakaiḥ || 17 || lauhairvegānnikhanyaṃte yaiḥ śrutaṃ guruniṃdanam || mitrāṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca sādhvīnāmathavā kvacit || 18 || śataśaḥ pāṭyate jihvā vahnivarṇairayomukhaiḥ || śaṃkubhi stīkṣṇasūkṣmāgraiḥ pūryaṃte cānilaiḥ punaḥ || 19 || tadvaktrāṇi bahūnvārānyepavādaratā narāḥ || ye guruṃ mātaraṃ vāpi pāruṣyeṇa vadaṃti vai || 5.2.27.20 || ye nighnaṃti durācārāḥ surārthāyopakalpite || ārāme puṣpapatrāṇi teṣāmaṃgāni kṛṃtati || 21 || yairapyāliṃgitā nārī parasya ca durātmabhiḥ || teṣāmayomayī nārī vahnivarṇā tu vakṣasi || 22 || sthāpyate vadhyate cāpi pracaṃḍairyamakiṃkaraiḥ || nāryaśca puruṣaistaptairāliṃgyaṃte hyayomayaiḥ || 23 || tadā lohamaye gehe jvalitānalasaṃstare || nikṣipyaṃte naraiḥ sārddhamāsādya kālasaṃkṣayam || 24 || yāvatī vedanā dehe iha loke pradṛśyate || narāṇāmaṃgapīḍā vai tasmācchataguṇā bhavet || 25 || kākaiśca vṛścikairgṛdhrairbhakṣyaṃte'pyapare narāḥ || dahyamānā vilapaṃti bhrātastāteti cākulāḥ || vadaṃtyasakṛdudvignā na ca śāṃtiṃ labhaṃti vai || 26 || duḥkhāni te prāpnuvaṃti yānyasahyāni pārvati || evaṃ te yātanāduḥkhaṃ prāpnuvaṃti suniścitam || nimirnāma mahābhāgo yamamārgaṃ dadarśa ha || 27 || raudraṃ bhayānakaṃ durgaṃ pūritaṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ || tamasā saṃvṛtaṃ caiva keśaśaivālaśādvalam || 28 || saṃpṛktaṃ pāpakṛdgaṃdhairmāṃsaśoṇitakarddamaiḥ || vahnijvālena dīptena samaṃtātparivāritam || 29 || adhomukhaiśca karkoṭairgṛdhraiśca samabhidrutam || sūcīmukhaistathā pretaiviṃdhyaśailopamairvṛtam || || 5.2.27.30 || vṛkṣai rudhiramāṃsaiśca chinnabāhūrupāṇibhiḥ || nikṛttodarahastaiśca tatratatra pracāritaiḥ || 31 || vṛtaṃ kuṇapadurgaṃdhairaśivaṃ bhogavarjitam || asipatra vanaṃ caiva samaṃtātparivāritam || 32 || karaṃbhavālukākīrṇamāyasīśca śilāḥ pṛthak || dadarśa cāpi dehotthayātanāṃ pāpakarmaṇām || 33 || sa taṃ durgaṃdhamālakṣya puruṣaṃ tamuvāca ha || kiyadadhvānamasmābhirgaṃtavyamidamabravīt || 34 || deśo'yaṃ kaśca devānāmetadicchāmi veditum || ityukto yamadūtastu daṇḍahasto'gnisaprabhaḥ || purato darśayanmārgamita ehītyuvāca ha || 35 || bhūyaḥ sa rājā taṃ prāha kiṃkaraṃ vinayānvitaḥ || bho yāmyapuruṣācakṣva kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 36 || yenedaṃ vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ mayā ca dhārmikeṇa hi || nimirnāmāhaṃ vikhyāto janakānāmahaṃ kule || 37 || jāto videhaviṣaye samyagmanujapālakaḥ || cāturvarṇyaṃ ca dharmasthaṃ kṛtvā saṃrakṣitaṃ mayā || 38 || dharmapradhānakalpena manunātra yathā purā || yajñairmayeṣṭaṃ bahubhirdharmataḥ pālitā mahī || 39 || notsṛṣṭaścaiva saṃgrāmo nātithirvimukho'bhavat || kṛtā spṛhā ca na mayā parastrīvibhavādiṣu || 5.2.27.40 || so'haṃ kathamimaṃ prāpto narakaṃ bhṛśadāruṇam || iti pṛṣṭastadā tena niminā yamakiṃkaraḥ || uvāca praṇato bhūtvā krūro'pi praśritaṃ vacaḥ || 41 || || puruṣa uvāca || || mahārāja yathāttha tvaṃ tathaitannātra saṃśayaḥ || kintu svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhavaṃtaṃ smārayāmi tat || 42 || uktā yā dakṣiṇā śrāddhe na dattā sā tvayā nṛpa || pramādādvismṛtā caiva tasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam || 43 || etāvadeva te pāpaṃ nānya tkiṃcana vidyate || vaidehāgaccha puṇyānāmupabhogāya pārthiva || 44 || evaṃ śrutvā tu rājarṣirnimirdūtamathābravīt || yāsyāmi devānucara yatra māṃ tvaṃ hi neṣyasi || 45 || kiṃcitpṛcchāmi te tattvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || vajratuṃḍāstvamī kākāḥ puṃsāṃ nayanahāriṇaḥ || 46 || punaḥ punaśca netrāṇi tadvatteṣāṃ bhavaṃti hi || kiṃ kṛtaṃ karma dūteṃdra kathayaitajjugupsitam || 47 || haraṃtyeṣāṃ tathā jihvāṃ jāyamānāṃ punarnavām || karapatreṇa pāṭyaṃte kasmādete suduḥkhitāḥ || 48 || kimete naṣṭacittāśca tudyaṃte'harniśaṃ narāḥ || etāścānyāśca dṛśyaṃte yātanāḥ pāpakarmiṇām || kiyatkālaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti tanmamodde śato vada || 49 || || puruṣa uvāca || || yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhūpāla pāpakarmaphalodayam || tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa yathātatham || 5.2.27.50 || puṇyā puṇye hi puruṣaḥ paryāyeṇa samaśnute || bhuṃjataśca kṣayaṃ yāti puṇyaṃ pāpamathāpi vā || 51 || na tu bhogādṛte puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ karma ca mānavaḥ || parityajati rājendra satyametadudāhṛtam || 52 || evamete mahāpāpā yātanābhiraharniśam || kṣapayaṃti mahāghoraṃ narakāṃtaravarttinaḥ || 53 || devatve'tha manuṣyatve tiryaktve'tha śubhāśubham || puṇyapāpodbhavaṃ bhuṃkte sukhaduḥkhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 54 || etaduddeśato rājanbhavatā kathitaṃ mayā || svakarmaphalamokṣāṇāṃ puṇyānāṃ pāpināṃ tathā || 55 || tadehyanyatra gacchāvi yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tvayādhunā || tatastamagrataḥ kṛtvā sa rājā gaṃtumudyataḥ || 56 || tadā hi sarvairudghuṣṭaṃ yātanā sthāyibhirnṛbhiḥ || prasādaṃ kuru bhūpeti tiṣṭha tāvanmuhūrttakam || tvadaṃgasaṃgī pavano dehānhlādayate hi naḥ || 57 || paritāpaṃ ca gātrebhyaḥ pīḍā bādhāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ || apahaṃti naravyāghra kṛpāṃ kuru mahīpate || 58 || etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ taṃ yāmyapuruṣaṃ nṛpaḥ || papraccha kathameteṣāmāhlādo mayi tiṣṭhati ||59 || kiṃ mayā karma tatpuṇyaṃ martyaloke mahatkṛtam || prahlādajananī dṛṣṭiryasyeyaṃ tadudīryatām || 5.2.27.60 || || puruṣa uvāca || || tvayā dṛṣṭo mahākāle vikhyāto'narakeśvaraḥ || āśvinasya caturdaśyāṃ tasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam || 61 || tatastadgātrasaṃsargī pavano hlādadāyakaḥ || pāpakarmakṛtāṃ rājanyātanā na prabādhate || 62 || || rājovāca || || yadi matsaṃnidhāne sā yātanā na prabādhate || tato bhadramukhātrāhaṃ sthāsye sthāṇurivācalaḥ || 63 || || puruṣa uvāca || || ehi rājeṃdra gacchāvo nijapuṇyasamārjitān || bhuṃkṣva bhogānna yāsyetāṃ yātanāṃ pāpakarmaṇām || || 64 || || rājovāca || || na svarge brahmaloke vā tatsukhaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || yadārttajaṃtuṃ nirvāṇamānetumiti me matiḥ || 65 || tasmānna tāvadyāsyāmi yāvadete suduḥkhitāḥ || matsaṃnidhānātsukhino bhavaṃtu narakaukasaḥ || 66 || prāpsyaṃte te yadi sukhaṃ bahavo duḥkhite mayi || kiṃ tu prāptaṃ mayā sarvaṃ tasmāttvaṃ vraja mā ciram || 67 || || puruṣa uvāca || || eṣa dharmaśca śakraśca tvāṃ netuṃ samupāgatau || avaśyamasmādgaṃtavyaṃ tasmātpārthiva gamyatām|| 68 || etasminnaṃtare dharmaḥ śakreṇa sahitobravīt || nime paramadharmajña prītā devagaṇāstava || 69 || ehyehi puruṣavyāghra kṛtametāvatā prabho|| siddhiḥ prāptā tvayā rājam̐llokāścāpyakṣayānvitāḥ || 5.2.27.70 || na ca manyustvayā kāryaḥ śṛṇu me vacanaṃ vibho || avaśyaṃ narakastāvaddraṣṭavyaḥ sarvarājabhiḥ || 71 || nayāmi tvāmahaṃ svargaṃ tvayā samyagupāsitaḥ || vimānavaramāruhya vimalaṃ cādya gamyatām || 72 || || || nimiruvāca || || narake mānavā dharma pīḍyaṃte'tra sahasraśaḥ || trāhīti vārttāṃ kraṃdaṃto māmato na vrajāmyaham || 73 || || indra uvāca || || karmaṇā narake prāptireṣāṃ ca pāpakarmaṇām || svarge tvayāpi gaṃtavyaṃ nṛpa puṇyena karmaṇā || 74 || || rājovāca || || parijānāsi dharmajña tvaṃ vā śakra śacīpate || viśiṣṭaṃ mama kiṃ puṇyaṃ śubhaṃ tadvaktumarhasi || 75 || || dharma uvāca || || āśvinasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī || tasyāṃ tvayā mahābāho mahākālavanottame || dṛṣṭo devaḥ suvikhyātaḥ svargado'narakeśvaraḥ || 76 || tadviśiṣṭaṃ ca te puṇyaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate || svakarmopārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuṃkṣva rājanyathāsukham || ete nārakikāḥ sarve kṣapayaṃtu svakarmajām || || 77 || || rājovāca || || kathaṃ spṛhāṃ kariṣyaṃti satsaṃgeṣu ca mānavāḥ || yadi matsaṃnidhāveṣāmutkarṣo nopajāyate || 78 || tasmādyatsukṛtaṃ kiṃcidviśiṣṭataramasti vai || tena mucyaṃtu narakātpāpino yātanāgatāḥ || 79 || || dharma uvāca || || rājaṃstvayā kṛtaṃ pūrve'narakeśvaradarśanam || tadutpannasya puṇyasya kalāmebhyaḥ prayaccha vai || 5.2.27.80 || tatpuṇyasya prabhāveṇa mokṣyaṃte narakādime || tathā kṛte tatastena vimuktā narakācca te || 81 || tato'bravīddharmarājo nimiṃ śakrasamanvitaḥ || evaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ sthānaṃ tvayā prāptaṃ mahīpate || 82 || etāṃśca nārakānpaśya vimuktānpāpakarmaṇaḥ|| tato'patatpuṣpavṛṣṭistasyopari mahīpateḥ || 83 || vimānaṃ cādhiropyainaṃ svarlokamanayaddhariḥ || yeye tatrābhavanpāpā yātanābhyaḥ paricyutāḥ || 84 || prabhāvāttasya devasya svargalokaṃ gatāḥ priye || ato devaḥ suvikhyātaḥ sadevo'narakeśvaraḥ || 85 || stuto devagaṇaiḥ sarvairnarakādavatārakaḥ|| jātaḥ sa eva sukṛtī kulaṃ tenaiva pāvitam||86|| yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ devaṃ cānarakeśvaram|| teṣāṃ vilīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmaśatodbhavam||87|| yenumodaṃti devasya darśanaṃ parvatātmaje|| te'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ prayāṃti mama maṃdire||88|| samatītaṃ bhaviṣyacca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ|| mama lokaṃ nayatyāśu tasya liṃgasya darśanāt||89|| śivayogasamāyuktā kṛṣṇā yā ca caturdaśī || sā proktā vallabhā tasya sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 5.2.27.90|| ye cāyāzti narāstasyāṃ devaṃ cānarakeśvaram || upoṣya pāpairmucyaṃte te narāḥ śatajanmajaiḥ || 91 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || tatkṣālayati devosau tithau tasyāṃ samarcitaḥ || 92 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || jaṭeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu māhātmyamuttamam ||93|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye'narakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 |||cha||
<5.2.28>
|| śrīdevadeva uvāca || || aṣṭāviṃśatikaṃ viddhi vikhyātaṃ ca jaṭeśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa mukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 1 || purā rāthaṃtare kalpe vīradhanvā mahīpatiḥ || dharmātmā ca yaśasvī ca babhūva bhuvi viśrutaḥ || 2 || sa kadācidvanaṃ gatvā mṛgahetorvarānane || vyāpādayanmṛgagaṇāndhanuṣā krodhavihvalaḥ || 3 || jagāma tatra yatrāsanbhrātaraḥ paṃca suvratāḥ || saṃvartasya sutā devi mṛgarūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ || 4 || te kadācidvane paṃca dṛṣṭvā hariṇapotakān || śvasato jātamātrāṃśca kautūhalasamanvitāḥ || 5 || ekaikaṃ jagṛhustatra mṛtāste tvatiduḥkhitāḥ || tataḥ sarve ca te paṃca yayurvai pituraṃtikam || 6 || prāyaścittaṃ samīhaṃtaḥ saṃvarttaṃ sāṃsadairvṛtam || ūcuste vacanaṃ cedaṃ mṛgahiṃsāśritaṃ tadā || 7 || jātamātrā mṛgāḥ paṃca asmābhirnihatāḥ prabho || akāmatastato'smākaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatām || 8 || ūce sa śuddhimāpnoti prāyaścitte kṛte sati || anadhītya dharmaśāstraṃ prāyaścittaṃ dadāti yaḥ || prāyaścittī bhavetpūtaḥ kilviṣaṃ dātari vrajet || 9 || dharma śāstrasamārūḍhā vedakhaḍgadharā dvijāḥ || krīḍārthamapi yadbrūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5.2.28.10 || brahmacchidraṃ japacchidraṃ yacchidraṃ yajñakarmaṇi || acchidraṃ jāyate sarvaṃ brāhmaṇairupapāditam || 11 || acchidramiti yadvākyaṃ vadaṃti kṣitidevatāḥ || praṇaśyatyakhilaṃ pāpamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ bhavet || 12 || ityevaṃ vadati śreṣṭhe saṃvarte dvijasattame || samāgatāśca munayo bhṛgvatryaṃgirasādayaḥ || 13 || teṣāmarthe yathāvṛttaṃ kathayāmāsureva te || saṃvartasya sutā dīnā bhaktinamrāḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 14 || te'pyūcurdharmaśāstrāṇi vihitāni yathārthataḥ || prāyaścittaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ deśakālavibhāgataḥ || 19 || aśītiryasya varṣāṇi bālo vāpyūnaṣoḍaśaḥ || prāyaścittārddhamarhaṃti striyo vai vyādhitasya ca || 16 || deśaṃ kālaṃ vayaḥ śaktiṃ pāpaṃ cāvekṣya yatnataḥ || prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syāditi dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 17 || idānīṃ mṛgacarmāṇi paridhāya dhṛtavratāḥ || caradhvaṃ paṃca varṣāṇi tataḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyatha ||| ||18|| evamuktāstu te bālā mṛgadharmopajīvinaḥ|| vanaṃ viviśuravyagrā dhyāyaṃto brahma śāśvatam||19|| tato varṣe hyatikrāṃte vīradhanvā mahīpatiḥ || tatrājagāma yasmiṃste caraṃti mṛgarūpiṇaḥ || 5.2.28.20 || te cāpyekatarormūle mṛgadharmopajīvinaḥ || japaṃtaḥ saṃsthitāste hi rājñā dṛṣṭā mṛgā iti || 21 || matvā viddhāstu nāḥrācairmṛtāste brahmavādinaḥ || tāndṛṣṭvā ca mṛtānrājā brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān || bhayena vepamānastu devarātāśramaṃ yayau || 02 || tatrāpṛcchadbrahmavadhyā mama jātā mahāmune || āmūlāṃtaṃ vadhāṃtasya kathayitvā narādhipaḥ || 23 || bhṛśaṃ śokaparītātmā ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ || sa ṛṣirdevakalpastu rudaṃtaṃ nṛpasattamam || 24 || uvāca mā bhairnṛpate apaneṣyāmi pātakam || pātāle sutalākhye tu nimajjaṃtī yathā dharā || 25 || uddhṛtā devadevena viṣṇunā kroḍamūrttinā || tadvadbhavaṃtaṃ rājeṃdra brahmahatyāpariplutam || uddhariṣyati devo'sau svayameva janārdanaḥ || 26 || evamuktastato rājā durito vākyamabravīta || 27 || kimanena dvijenaiva niṣprabheṇa durātmanā || uddhartuṃ naiva śaknoti svayameva dvijādhamaḥ || 28 || ityuktvā '? khaṅgenaiva jaghāna tam || mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijaṃ rājā krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ || 29 || tasminneva vane devi pāpasaṃghena mohitaḥ || jaghāna kapilāṃ dogdhrīṃ savatsāṃ gālavasya ca || 5.2.28.30 || kṣudhārttaśca tṛṣārttaśca bālyānmohācca sāhasāt || krūrā buddhiḥ samabhavajjaṭībhūtaṃ ca pātakam || 31 || jaṭībhūtena pāpena babhrāma gahane vane || sa kadācitturaṃgeṇa hṛto dūraṃ mahadvanam || 32 || vyāghrasiṃhagajākīrṇaṃ mṛgaśaṃbarasevitam || ekākī tatra rājāsāvaśvaṃ muktvā taroradhaḥ || 33 || kuśopari tadā tatra suṣvāpa ca sa nirbhayam || tatra vyādhāḥ samacarandṛṣṭvā suptaṃ ca nirbhayam || || 24 || te gatāstvaritā vyādhāḥ svabhartuḥ kathanāya vai || svāminā tena nirdiṣṭā nigrahītuṃ pracakramuḥ || 35 || tāvadrājñaḥ śarīrāttu śvetā''bharaṇabhūṣitā || utthāya cakramādāya tayā mlecchāśca pātitāḥ || 36 || dasyūnnihatya sā devī tatraivādarśanaṃ gatā || 37 || atha rājā tayā muktaḥ pratibuddho'tha tatkṣaṇāt || mlecchāṃśca nihatāndṛṣṭvā ciṃtayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 38 || govadhyā brahmavadhyā ca vane hyasminsudāruṇā || kathaṃ mayā nṛśaṃsena prāptā pāpaparaṃparā || 39 || evaṃ sa ciṃtayitvātha niḥśvasya ca punaḥpunaḥ || tamevāśvaṃ samāruhya vāmadevāśramaṃ yayau || 5.2.28.40 || muninā vāmadevena dṛṣṭo rājā tathāvidhaḥ || jaṭībhūtena pāpena pīḍito duḥkhitastadā || 41 || || vāmadeva uvāca || || ayaṃ sa puruṣavyāghro vīradhanvā mahīpatiḥ || somavaṃśasamutpanno daśāṃ kaṣṭāṃ samāgataḥ || 42 || uddhariṣyāmi rājānamenaṃ puruṣasattamam|| ityālocya tadā vipro vāmadevo mahātapāḥ || pratyuvāca mahīpālaṃ vīradhanvānamāturam || 43 || bhobho rājanmahīpāla vīradhanveti viśrutaḥ || vidūrathasya tanayo vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || 44 || prāgbhave vyādharūpeṇa nihithā vipine mṛgān || dṛḍhaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvāmalakyāstaroradhaḥ || 45 || phālgunāmalapakṣe tvāmalakyekādaśī śubhā || puṣyarkṣayoginī tasyāṃ jāmadagnyapradakṣiṇā || 46 || pūjā lokaiḥ kṛtā dṛṣṭā vismayena tvayā purā || akāmādupavāso'bhūttasyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ punaḥ || 47 || tatprabhāvādabhū rājā mahābalaparākramaḥ || tayā saṃrakṣito rājanmlecchavargādvane'dhunā || 48 || nihatāḥ śatravaḥ sarve tayaiva śubhamāpsyasi || pūrvakarmavipākena brahmahatyā samāgatā || 49 || jñātā tapaḥprabhāvena mayā yogabalena ca || jaṭībhūtaṃ śarīraṃ te pāpasaṃghena pārthiva || 5.2.28.50 || idānīṃ pālayiṣyāmi śṛṇu me vacanaṃ param || 51 || ityukto vāmadeven muninā sa mahīpatiḥ || praṇamya prayato bhūtvā papraccha ca punaḥpunaḥ ||52|| kathaṃ yāsyaṃti me hatyā gobrāhmaṇasamudbhavāḥ || upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||53|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vāma devo mahāmuniḥ || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ liṃgasyāsya yaśasvini || 54 || mahākālavanaṃ gaccha mahārāja mamājñayā || tatrāste devadevo'pi jagadvyāpī jaṭeśvaraḥ || 55 || pāpasaṃghapraharttā ca sarvavedeṣu paṭhyate || devasyānarakeśasya uttare sa vyavasthitaḥ ||56|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vāmadevasya pārthivaḥ || ājagāma tvarāyukto mahākālavanottame ||57|| tatra dṛṣṭvā jagadvaṃdyaṃ devadevaṃ jaṭeśvaram || stutiṃ cakāra rājeṃdro bhaktyā paramayā punaḥ ||58|| śivāya te namo nityaṃ viśvakāya namonamaḥ || namo divyāya guhyāya gūḍhavrataśarīriṇe ||59|| namo jaṭāya rāmāya māyayākrāṃtakāriṇe || namostu bahurūpāya namo nīlābharūpiṇe || 5.2.28.60 || namo bhogāya dhūmrāya namo'stu gaganātmane || namo vahnisamūhāya namaste nirmalākara || 61 || namo mahāṃdhakārārka namaste śatrughātine || namaḥ saṃsārapārāya divyarūpaśarīriṇe || namaḥ kanakavarṇāya namo mohitamohine || 62 || namaḥ surūpāya surārcitāya namo virūpāya prakṛteḥ parāya || namonamo rūpanirāśrayāya śyāmāsurūpāya namonamaste || 63 || iti stutastadā devi mahādevo maheśvaraḥ || jaṭāveṣṭitasarvāṃgo liṃgamadhyācca nissṛtaḥ || 64 || bhasmacarcitasarvāṃgo bhogibhogāṃgadojvalaḥ || himarāśinibhākāro rājatācalanirmalaḥ || 65 || muktālatānibhābhistu jaṭābhirbhūṣito vibhuḥ || kapilābhiḥ karālābhirvikaṭābhiśca veṣṭitaḥ || 66 || bhogīṃdraphaṇabaddhābhiḥ sitapītādibhistathā || nadīrūpābhirūtābhiḥ śobhito'sau jaṭeśvaraḥ || 67 || rājānaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ parvatātmaje || stotreṇānena rājeṃdra tuṣṭo'haṃ toṣitastvayā || || 68 || jaṭībhūtaṃ ca te pāpaṃ gataṃ maddarśanena vai || tasmātsthānaṃ paraṃ gaccha madīyaṃ śāśvataṃ mudā || 69 || ityukto devadevena vīradhanvā mahīpatiḥ || jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam || 5.2.28.70 || kāmagena vimānena stūyamāno gaṇaiḥ priye || pāpasaṃghena mukto'sau jaṭībhūteśadarśanāt || 71 || liṃgaścātaḥ samākhyāto nāmnā devo jaṭeśvaraḥ || jaṭeśvaraṃ varārohe ye paśyaṃti subhaktitaḥ || teṣāṃ pāpaṃ jaṭībhūtaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 72 || ye'rcayaṃti sadā devi devadevaṃ jaṭeśvaram || teṣāṃ balaṃ prabhāvaśca saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 73 || yepyanye devagandharvā yakṣarākṣasa mānavāḥ || liṃgaṃ ca pūjayiṣyaṃtiṃ vidhivadbhaktibhāvataḥ || 74 || te'pi kāmānavāpsyanti yāṃśca kāṃśca sudurlabhān || aiśvaryaṃ dharmamatulaṃ dīrghamāyuraro gatām || 75 || niḥsapatnatvamatulaṃ yaccānyattadavāpnuyāt || pāpinaḥ krūrakarmāṇo ye'pi liṃgaṃ samāśritāḥ || tepi pāpavinirmuktā bhaviṣyaṃti gata jvarāḥ || 76 || jaṭeśvaraṃ prapaśyaṃti bhaktyā ye ca dinedine || te dharmadhanasaubhāgyairbhaviṣyaṃti samanvitāḥ || 77 || vyādhito vyādhinā mukto duḥkhī duḥkhātpramucyate || darśanāttu bhavetsadyaḥ sarvapātakavarjitaḥ || 78 || jaṭeśvarasya māhātmyaṃ ye paṭhiṣyaṃti pārvati || śroṣyaṃti ye'pi madbhaktyā prayatāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ || 79 || te sarvakāmānāpsyaṃti gatimaṃte ca matpure || yā nārī durbhagā sāpi saubhāgyaṃ labhate sadā || 5.2.28.80 || gurviṇī labhate putramarogaṃ śrutibhūṣaṇam || śiśugrahāśca naśyaṃti nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ bhavet || 81 || māṃgalyamidamāyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmāśrayaṃ mahat || duḥsvapnajaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ pāpajaṃ yāti saṃkṣayam || 82 || durbhuktaṃ durjanasparśaṃ yaccālpāyuḥkaraṃ bhavet || liṃgākhyānakathāṃ śrutvā vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ || 83 || śrāddheṣu yaḥ paṭhedetāṃ jaṭeśvarakathāṃ śubhām || tadakṣayaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivarddhanam || 84 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || jaṭeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || 85 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye jaṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<5.2.29>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || ekonatriṃśataṃ viddhi devaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate brahmahatyayā || 1 || purā tretāyuge devi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || śūraḥ sarvaguṇopetaḥ pitṛbhakto babhūva ha || 2 || reṇukāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ svayaṃ rāmo babhūva ha || viṣṇurevāvatīrṇo'sau bhṛgoḥ śāpātsudustarāt || 3 || sa kadācinniyukto'sau muninā jamadagninā || śiraśchindhītyuvācedaṃ mātuste vipulaṃ suta || 4 || sa piturvacanaṃ śrutvā bhrātṝṇāṃ mātureva ca || śirāṃsi cicchide rāmo jamadagnirvaraṃ dadau || 5 || sarveṣāṃ pṛthivīśānāṃ tvamajeyo bhaviṣyasi || sarvakṣayakaro bhāvī na cirādeva bhārgava || 6 || gṛhāṇa paraśuṃ putra vahnijvālodbhavaṃ dṛḍham|| anena śitaśastreṇa tataḥ khyāto bhavi ṣyati || 7 || atha kenāpi kālena kārttavīryārjuno nṛpaḥ || haihayānāṃ kule jātaḥ sahasrabāhuviśrutaḥ || 8 || jaghāna jamadagniṃ tu kāmadhenukṛte kudhīḥ || pitaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ kuddho'bravīdidam || 9 || atha paśyaṃtu me vīryaṃ trayo lokāḥ sanātanam || sa ca paśyatu durbuddhirbrahmahā kṛtavīryajaḥ || 10 || matpitā nihato yena satkarmanirataḥ sadā || tasya bāhusahasraṃ tu chetsyāmīha na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || ityuktvā krodharaktākṣaḥ kārttavī ryārjunaṃ bhuvi || dharṣayitvā yathākāmaṃ krośamānaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 12 || kṛtsnaṃ bāhusahasraṃ ca ciccheda bhṛgunaṃdanaḥ || paraśvadhena tīkṣṇena jñātibhiḥ sahitaṃ tadā || 13 || rathasthaṃ pātayāmāsa jaghāna nṛpatiṃ priye || triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā || 14 || kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ caiva bhārgavaḥ sa mahābalaḥ || sarvapāpavināśāya vājimedhena ceṣṭavān || 15 || tasminyajñe mahādāne dakṣiṇāṃ bhṛgunaṃdanaḥ || mārīcāya dadau prītaḥ kaśyapāya vasundharām || 16 || vāruṇāṃsturagāñchubhrānrathaṃ ca rathināṃ varaḥ || hiraṇyamakṣayaṃ dhenūrgajeṃdrāśca mahāmatiḥ || 17 || tadā tasminmahāyajñe vājimedhe mahāyaśāḥ || tathāpi na gatā hatyā hyanekaprāṇisaṃbhavā || 18 || evaṃ kila purāṇeṣu sarvāgamabhidādiṣu || viśvastaghātināṃ caiva niṣkṛtiḥ śrūyate yathā || 19 || aśvamedhena yajñena brahmahatyā vinaśyati || athavā dvādaśābdena yadyekā''syā kṛtā bhuvi || 20 || mayā punarnṛśaṃsena bahavaḥ prāṇino hatāḥ || viśvastāśca pramattāśca garbhasthāśca punaḥpunaḥ || 21 || striyo vṛddhāśca bālāśca mātā caiva viśeṣataḥ || iti duḥkhānvito rāmo viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 22 || ciṃtayitvā muhūrtaṃ tu gato raivatakaṃ girim || tathā tapo 'tapaddhoraṃ bahūnvarṣagaṇānpriye || 23 || tathāpi na gatā hatyā hyanekaprāṇisaṃbhavā || atha rāmo jagāmātha mahendre malaye tathā || 24 || sahye himālaye ramye puṇye badarikāśrame || caritvā parvatānsarvānsnānārthaṃ narmadāṃ yayau || 25 || yamunāṃ caṃdrabhāgāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm || irāvatīṃ vitastāṃ ca parāṃ carmaṇvatīṃ śubhām || 26 || viśālāṃ kapilāṃ durgāṃ gaṃbhīrāṃ gomatīṃ śivām || godāvarīṃ daśārṇāṃ ca puṇyāṃ bhīmarathīṃ tathā || 27 || gayāṃ caiva kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || aṭṭahāsaṃ prabhāsaṃ ca kedāramamareśvaram || 28 || kṛtayātro'pi duḥkhārttaściṃtayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || na nūnaṃ tīrthamāhātmyaṃ dṛśyate bhuvi sāṃpratam || 29 || na gatā brahmahatyā me kṛto dharmo nirarthakaḥ || mithyā tatkathyate śāstre tīrthadānādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || yadi syātsatyametacca naṣṭaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ mama || 5.2.29.30 || etasminneva kāle tu nārado munipuṃgavaḥ || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ || || 31 || viṣaṇṇavadano dīnaściṃtayānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidho rāmaḥ pratyuvācātha nāradam || 32 || bhobho nārada devarṣe śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ || jananī nihatā pūrvaṃ piturvākyāhijottama || 33 || pituḥ parābhavādbhūmau bhṛmipālā mayā hatāḥ || garbhā vidāritāḥ strīṇāṃ bālā vṛddhāśca yoṣitaḥ|| 34 || niraṃtarā hatā lokā viśokenādayālunā || paścāddhṛṇā samutpannā paralokaṃ mamekṣataḥ || 35 || yajñaḥ kṛto'śvamedhaśca dattaṃ dānamanekadhā|| snātohaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvaprasravaṇeṣu ca||36|| parvateṣu tapastaptaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ niraṃtaram|| brahmahatyāvināśārthaṃṃ kiṃ kiṃ nātra mayā kṛtam ||37|| paraṃ naiva gatā hatyā tasmātsarvaṃ nirarthakam || 38 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || pratyuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā vacastadā || bhobho rāma kimātmānaṃ na smarasyadhunā harim || 39 || tvayaiva kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam || mahākālavane kṣetre kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ param || tasminkṣetre mahāliṃgaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam || 5.2.29.40 || jaṭeśvaro mahābhāga vidyate sarvasiddhidam || kṛtāvatāra rāma tvaṃ tatra gacchāvilaṃbitama || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā smṛtvā kṣetramanuttamam || 41 || jagāma tvaritaṃ devi mahākālavane tataḥ || liṃgamārādhayāmāsa tato hatyā gatā kṣayam || liṃgamadhyādahaṃ devi prasanno nirgatastadā || 42 || jāmadagnyo mayā proktaḥ kāṃtakāmaṃ dadāmyaham || sa provāca tato rāmo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ || || 43 || tvatpādapaṃkaje bhūyādbhaktirme vipulā sadā || varametaṃ prayacchādya yadi tuṣṭo maheśvara || 44 || ityukto'haṃ tadā tena yathā tuṣṭena pārvati || tasmai dattā mayābhīṣṭā varā kīrttikarā sthitiḥ || 45 || adyaprabhṛti te nāmnā devaḥ khyāto bhaviṣyati || tadā rāmeśvara iti triṣu lokeṣu gīyate || 46 || bhaktyā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ param || ājanmaprabhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ na3yati tatkṣaṇāt || 47 || sa eva puṇyavānpūjya iha loke paratra ca || yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā devaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || 48 || ye'numodaṃti devasya darśanaṃ yajanaṃ tathā || te'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ prayāṃti mama maṃdiram || || 49 || yaccāpi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahatyāsahasrakam || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti rāmeśvarasamarcanāt|| 5.2.29.50 || duṣprāpyaṃ yatphalaṃ viprairvājapeyādibhirmakhaiḥ || prāpyate tatsukhenaiva śrīrāmeśvaradarśanāt || 51 || ye hatābhimukhāḥ śūrā goviprārthe raṇājire|| gatirabhyadhikā tebhyo dṛṣṭvā rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || || 52 || jitāstena sadā lokā rāmeṇeva jagattrayam || dṛṣṭaṃ yena sadā bhaktyā liṃgaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || 53 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || rāmeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu tvaṃ cyavaneśvaram || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye rāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśodhyāyaḥ|| 29||
<5.2.30>
śrīviśvanātha uvāca|| triṃśattamaṃ vijānīhi tvaṃ devi cyavaneśvaram|| yasya darśanamātreṇa svargabhraṃśo na jāyate||1|| bhṛgormaharṣeḥ putraśca cyavano nāma pārvati|| sthāṇubhūtastapastepe nirāhāro mahāmuniḥ || 2 || vitastāyāstaṭe ramye bahuvarṣagaṇānkila || savalmīko'bhavadvipro latābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ || 3 || kālena mahatā devi samākīrṇaḥ pipīlakaiḥ || tathā sa saṃvṛto dhīmānmṛtpiṃḍa iva sarvaśaḥ || 4 || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ vihartuṃ vana uttame || śaryātirnāma dharmātmā sakuṭuṃbo mudānvitaḥ || 5 || tasya strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi catvāryāsanparigrahaḥ || ekaiva tu sutā subhrūḥ sukanyānāma nāmataḥ || 6 || sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || sā bhramyamāṇā valmīke dṛṣṭvā bhārgavacakṣuṣī || 7 || sā kautukātkaṇṭakena buddhimohavatī tadā || kiṃ nu khalvidamityuktvā nirbibhedāsya locane || 8 || abhavatsa tayā viddho netrayoḥ paramārtimān || tataḥ śaryātisainyasya śakṛnmūtraṃ samāruṇat || 9 || tato ruddhe śakṛnmūtre paryatapyata pārthivaḥ || pratyuvāca tataḥ kruddho rājā gadgadayā girā || 5.2.30.10 || kenāpakṛtamadyeha bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ || taponityasya vṛddhasya roṣaṇasya viśeṣataḥ || 11 || jñātaṃ vā yadi vājñātaṃ tadidaṃ brūta mā ciram || tamūcuḥ sainikāḥ sarve na vidmo'pakṛtaṃ vayam || 12 || tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālaḥ sāmnā cogreṇa ca svayam || paryapṛcchatsvavarga ca bhūyobhūyaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || 13 || pitaraṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukanyā tamathābravīt || mayā kiṃcicca valmīke dṛṣṭaṃ sattvamaticchavi || 14 || khadyotavadabhijñātaṃ tanmayā viddhamaṃtikam || etacchrutvā tu śaryātirvalmīkaṃ kṣipramabhyagāt || 15 || tatrāpaśyattapovṛddhaṃ vayovṛddhaṃ ca bhārgavam || prārthayāmāsa sainyārthe prāṃjaliḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || 16 || ajñānādbālayā yatte'pakṛtaṃ tu mahīsura || imāmeva ca te kanyāṃ dadāmi sudṛḍhavratām || 17 || bhāryārthe tvaṃ gṛhāṇemāṃ prasīda dvijasattama || tatobravīmahīpālaṃ cyavano bhārgavastathā || 18 || yadyevaṃ pratigṛhyaitāṃ kṣamiṣyāmi mahīpate || dadau duhitaraṃ tasmai cyavanāya mahīpatiḥ || 19 || pratigṛhya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ bhagavānprasasāda ha || prāpte prasāde rājātha sasainyo viṣayaṃ gataḥ || 5.2.30.20 || sukanyāpi patiṃ labdhvā tapasvinamaniṃditā || nityaṃ paryacaratprītyā tapasā niyamena ca || 21 || kasyacittvatha kālasya nāsatyāvaśvinau priye || kṛtābhiṣekāṃ vivṛtāṃ sukanyāṃ tāmapaśyatām || 22 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā darśanīyāṃgīṃ devarājasutāmiva || ūcatuḥ samupadrutya kasya tvamatiśobhane || 23 || sā provāca mahābhāgā pativrataparāyaṇā || śaryātitanayāṃ caiva bhāryāṃ ca cyavanasya hi|| 24 || tatośvinau prahasyaināmabrūtāṃ punareva tu || kasmādevaṃvidhā bhūtvā jarājarjaritaṃ patim ||25|| tvamapāsyeha kalyāṇi kāmabhogabahiṣkṛtā || vṛddhaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ || 26 || patyarthaṃ devagarbhābhe mā vṛthā yauvanaṃ kṛthāḥ || evamuktā sukanyā tu dasrau tāvidamabravīt || 27 || ratāhaṃ cyavane deve maivaṃ mā paryaśaṃkatam || tato'brūtāṃ punastvenāmāvāṃ devabhiṣagvarau || 28 || yuvānaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ kariṣyāvaḥ patiṃ tava || etena samayenāvāmāmaṃtraya sumadhyame ||27| sā tayorvacanaṃ śrutvā kathayāmāsa bhārgave || tacchrutvā cyavano bhāryāṃ kriyatāmityabhā ṣata || 5.2.30.30 || ūcatū rājaputrīṃ tāṃ patistava viśatvapaḥ || tato'psu cyavanaḥ śīghraṃ rūpārthī praviveśa ha || 31 || aśvināvapi tatkāle saraḥ prāviśatāṃ priye || tato muhūrttāduttīrṇā sarve te sarasastadā || 32 || divyarūpadharāḥ sarve yuvāno divyakuṃḍalāḥ || tulyaveṣadharāścaiva manasaḥ prītivarddhanāḥ || || 33 || te'bruvansahitāḥ sarve vṛṇīṣvānyatamaṃ śubham || asmākamīpsitaṃ bhadre patitve varavarṇini || 34 || sā samīkṣya tu tānsarvāṃstulyarūpadharā nsthitān || niścitya manasā buddhyā devī vavre svakaṃ patim || 35|| labdhvā tu cyavano bhāryāṃ vayo rūpaṃ tu vāṃchitam || hṛṣṭo'bravīnmahātejāstau nāsatyāvidaṃ vacaḥ || 36 || yadahaṃ rūpasaṃpanno vayasā ca samanvitaḥ || kṛto bhavadbhyāṃ vṛddhaḥ sanbhāryāṃ ca prāptavānimām || 37 || tasmādyuvāṃ kari ṣyāmi prītyāhaṃ somapāyinau || satyametanna saṃdeho devarājasya paśyataḥ || 38 || tacchrutvā hṛṣṭamanasau divaṃ devau prajagmatuḥ || yājayāmāsa somārhau nāsatyāvaśvināviti || 39 || bhiṣajau devatānāṃ hi karmaṇā tena garhitau || ābhyāmarthāya somaṃ tvaṃ pradāsyasi yadi svayam || 5.2.30.40 || vajraṃ te prahariṣyāmi ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇam || evamuktaḥ smayannindramabhivīkṣya sa bhārgavaḥ || balinaṃ vāsavaṃ jñātvā ciṃtayāmāsa satvaram || 41 || devamārādhayiṣyāmi mahādevaṃ maheśvaram || yasya karmakaraḥ śakro yasya devā vaśānugāḥ || yaḥ samartho jagadgoptā sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 42 || ityuktvā cyavano devi mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || rāmeśvarasya devasya liṃgamīśānataḥ sthitam || śraddhayārādhitaṃ tena cyavanena mahātmanā || 43 || tasya prasanno rudrastu sa vajrādabhayaṃ dadau || tasya praharato bāhuṃ staṃbhayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || 44 || samārādhanatuṣṭasya liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || etasminnaṃtare jvālā niḥsṛtā liṃgamadhyataḥ || 46 || tayā devagaṇāḥ sarve dahyamānā vicetasaḥ || procurgadgadayā vācā dhūmenāṃdhīkṛte kṣaṇāḥ || 46 || kriyetāṃ somapāvetāvaśvinau balasūdana || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā cyavanaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ || pratyuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ praṇāmānatakaṃdharaḥ || 47 || somapāvaśvināvetāvadyaprabhṛti bhārgava || bhaviṣyatastataḥ sarvametatsatyaṃ bravīmi te || 48 || mā te'tithyābhisaṃraṃbho bhaviṣyati tapodhana || | liṃgasyāsya prabhāvo'yaṃ yadahaṃ niṣprabhīkṛtaḥ || 49 || tatastvannāmadheyena prasiddhirbhuvi yāsyati || ārādhitaṃ yato devi cyavanena mahātmanā || 5.2.30.50 || cyavaneśvarametadvai khyātaṃ tribhuvane'bhavat || bhaktā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti deveśaṃ cyavaneśvaram || ājanmaprabhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || 51 || yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ cyavaneśvarasaṃjñakam || janmaduḥkhajarārogairmukto muktimavāpnuyāt || 52 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyenmanasābhimataṃ naraḥ || taṃtaṃ durlabhamāpnoti cyavaneśvaradarśanāt || 53 || niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devaṃ cyavaneśvaram || te prayāṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīye bhuvane priye || 54 || yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvapāpaharāṃ śubhām || sa puṇyātmā paraṃ sthānaṃ yāti divyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 55 || bhaktihīnaḥ kriyāhīno yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ || sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnoti yogigamyāṃ yaśasvini || 56 || puṣpairvicitrairye devaṃ yajaṃte cyavaneśvaram || saṃsārārṇavamullaṃghya te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || 57 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || cyavaneśvaradevasya śṛṇu khaṃḍeśvaraṃ śive || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || || cha ||
<5.2.31>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || ekatriṃśattamaṃ viddhi devaṃ khaṃḍeśvaraṃ priye || saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate yasya darśāddānavratādikam || 1 || āsīttretāyuge devi bhadrāśvonāma pārthivaḥ || yasya nāmnā'bhavadvarṣaṃ bhadrāśvaṃnāma nāmataḥ || 2 || tasyāgastyaḥ kadācittu gṛhamāgamya sattamaḥ || uvāca saptarātraṃ tu vasāmi bhavato gṛhe || 3 || taṃ rājā śirasā natvā svāsyatāmityabhāṣata || tasya kāṃtimatīnāma bhāryā paramaśobhanā || 4 || tasyāstejaḥ samabhavaddvādaśādityasaṃnibham || sapatnīnāṃ śataṃ tasyā vidyate varavarṇini || 5 || tā dāsya iva karmāṇi kurvaṃtyaharahaḥ sadā || kāṃtimatyāḥ prabhāvena bhayottra stāḥ sulocanāḥ || 6 || tāmagastyastathā dṛṣṭvā tanmukhāsaktalocanām || evaṃbhūtāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ paramaśobhanām || sādhusādhu jagannāthetyagastyaḥ prāha harṣitaḥ || 7 || dvitīye divasepyevaṃ rājñīṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāprabhām || aho hyaṃganayā muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || 8 || ityagastyo dvitīye'hni rājñīṃ dṛṣṭetyuvāca ha || tṛtīye'hni ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevamuvāca ha || 9 || aho mūḍhā na jānaṃti liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || mahākālavane kṣetre cyavaneśasya pūrvataḥ || 5.2.31.10 || khaṃḍavratāni jāyaṃte pūrṇāni darśanādyadaḥ || caturthe divase hastāvutkṣipya punarabravīt ||11|| sādhusādhu jagannātha sādhu bhadrāśva suvrata || paṃcame divase'pyevaṃ ṣaṣṭhe caiva punaḥpunaḥ || 12 || nṛtyaṃtaṃ saptame dṛṣṭvā dine patnyā samanvitaḥ || provāca cainaṃ rājā sa vismitenāṃtarātmanā || kiṃ harṣakāraṇaṃ brahmanyena nṛtyasamanvitaḥ || 13 || || agastya uvāca || || aho bhūpāla mūḍhastvaṃ mahāmūrkhāśca maṃtriṇaḥ || aho purohito mugdho ye na jānaṃti me matam || 14 || īdṛśā api jāyaṃte rājāno yasya darśanāt || evamuktastato rājā kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata || 15 || na jānīmo vayaṃ brahmannabhiprāyaṃ tavādhunā || kathayasva mahābhāga yadyanugrahakṛdbhavān || 16 || || agastya uvāca || || iyaṃ rājñī tvadīyābhūddāsī vaiśyasya vaidiśe || nagare haridattasya tvamasyāḥ patireva ca || khaṃḍavrataprabhāvena jātaḥ karmakaro bhavān || 17 || sa ca vaiśyo mahākāle gatvā devaṃ maheśvaram|| arcayāmāsa vivivadgaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 18 || abhyarcya tu gṛhaṃ yāvadbhavaṃtau rakṣapālakau || tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtau dvāvapi daṃpatī || 19 || tena puṇyena te janma priyavratagṛhe'bhavat || iyaṃ ca patnī te jātā purā vaiśyapradāsikā || 5.2.31.20 || parakīyaprasaṃgena saṃjātā bhūbhiruttamā || rājyaṃ patnī sutā sādhurityuktaṃ vacanaṃ mayā || 21 || tasya devasya māhātmyādyajaṃtaṃ vividhairmakhaiḥ || paśyāmi tvāṃ mahīpāla bhūpālaśataveditam || 22 || ataḥ sādhupurā proktaṃ mayā tava mahīpate || 23 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kuṃbhayonermahātmanaḥ || mahākālavane gaṃtuṃ matiṃ cakre mahīpatiḥ || tataḥ sāṃtaḥpuraḥ prāyāttena sārddhaṃ maharṣiṇā ||24|| agastyakathitaṃ liṃgaṃ dadarśa śraddhayā punaḥ || pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpatnyā sārddhaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 25 || tatastuṣṭastadā devo nṛpaṃ prāhāmitadyutiḥ || mano'bhīṣṭaṃ tapastestu bhogamaiśvaryameva ca || 26 || kulaṃ prabhāvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ dīrghamāyurarogitām || niḥsapatnaṃ tato rājyaṃ kṛtvā svargamavāpsyati || 27 || ityukto devadeven gato'sau viṣayaṃ svakam || niṣkaṃṭakaṃ tato rājyaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ gataḥ priye || 28 || anekajanmacaritaṃ khaṃḍavratakadambakam || saṃpūrṇamabhavaddevi liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 29 || ataḥ khaṇḍeśvaro devo vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || ye paśyaṃti narā devi devaṃ khaṇḍeśvaraṃ śivam || 5.2.31.30 || khaṇḍavratāni pūrṇāni teṣāmāśu bhavaṃti hi || tapaḥkhaṇḍaṃ vrate khaṇḍaṃ dānakhaṃḍaṃ ca yatkṛ tam|| tatsarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yāti śrīkhaṃḍeśvaradarśanāt || 31 || dṛṣṭvā khaṃḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ pāpavighnaiḥ pramucyate || saptajanmakṛtairdevi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 32 || dṛṣṭvā khaṇḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛtakṛtyatvamāpyate || tasya naśyati daurbhāgyaṃ saptajanmodbhavaṃ priye || 33 || khaṃḍeśvare'rcite deve sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ|| saṃtuṣṭā varadāścaiva bhavaṃti varavarṇini || 34 || devaṃ khaṃḍeśvaraṃ ye vai yajaṃti śraddhayā priye || puṇyairnānāvidhaiḥ snānaiḥ sugandhaiśca viśeṣataḥ || 35 || dhūpa dīpairnamaskārairjapaiḥ stotraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || te sarve kāmasaṃpannāḥ śrīmanto rājyasaṃyutāḥ || 36 || dīrghāyuṣaḥ śubhācārā jāyaṃte dehino'malāḥ || ati śreṣṭhā gatisteṣāṃ viśokā nityamakṣayāḥ || khaṃḍeśvaraprasādena jāyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 37 || ete ca viṣṇubrahmeṃdrakuveradahanādayaḥ || parāṃ siddhiṃ susaṃprāptāḥ khaṃḍeśvarasamarcanāt || 38 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || khaṃḍeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu vai pattaneśvaram || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye khaṇḍe śvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 31 || || cha ||
<5.2.32>
|| īśvara uvāca || || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ dvātriṃśattamamuttamam || viddhi siddhipradaṃ puṃsāṃ pattaneśvaramīśvaram || 1 || purā'haṃ parvate devi maṃdare cārukandar || krīḍansārddhaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaḥ kadācidrahasi sthitaḥ || 2 || kimarthaṃ parvataṃ tyaktvā kailāsaṃ ramaṇīyakam || muktā phalaśilāśubhraṃ śaṅkhacandrāṃśunirmalam || 3 || siddhacāraṇagandharvakiṃnarodgītanāditam || sadā puṣpadrumacchannaṃ kadalīvanarājitam || 4 || atha kokilacakrāhvacakorakurarākulam || pu'ṇyalokopamaṃ sthānaṃ triviṣṭapavibhūṣaṇam || 5 || mahākālavane śūnye nānāgulmalatāvṛte || gajeṃdragajaśārdūla siṃhaśambarasaṃkule || 6 || ṛkṣavānaragomāyujantukādivirājite || mayūrasarpamārjāramūṣikādivirājite || 7 || kathaṃ vāsaḥ kṛto deva kautūhalamidaṃ mama || 8 || iti pṛṣṭastvayā devi maṃdare cārukandare || mayā proktaṃ prasannena pattanaṃ ca mama priye || 9 || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ svargātsukhakaraṃ param ||. smaśānapīṭhasatkṣetravanoparasamāśritam || 5.2.32.10 || anaupamyaguṇaṃ viddhi pattanaṃ parvatātmaje || evaṃ pattanadevo vai na dṛṣṭo bhuvanatraye || gītavāditracāturyaiḥ sparddhate yaḥ surālayam || 11 || etasminnaṃtare devi devarṣirnārado muniḥ || draṣṭukāmaḥ samāyāto mandare māṃ yaśasvini || 12 || vinodārthaṃ mayā pṛṣṭastvatpriyārthaṃ kutūhalāt || kva tvayā gamitaḥ kālaḥ kalpasaṃkhyo mahāmune || 13 || kasminnāśramasaṃsthāne tapasaḥ saṃcayaḥ kṛtaḥ || tīrthāni kāni bhrāṃtāni kva te ratirabhūcciram || 14 || kautukaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tu vada me munisattama || iti pṛṣṭo mayā devi brahmaputro mahāmuniḥ || kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ pattanasya prayatnataḥ || 15 || bahūni saṃparikramya tīrthānyāyatanāni ca || pattanāni vicitrāṇi deśāśca nagarāṇi ca || 16 || aṭanārthaṃ mahādeva jaṃbūdvīpe manorame || dṛṣṭaḥ pattanarājaśca sadānaṃdakaraḥ paraḥ || 17 || svecchākalpitavinyāsaḥ prāsādaśatakalpitaḥ || icchākāmaphalāvāptira nirdeśyasukhāvahaḥ || 18 || sarvartukusumāmodasukhasparśānilāvṛtaḥ || vīṇāveṇuravairghuṣṭo manaḥprahlādakārakaḥ || 19 || vajreṃdranīlavaiḍūryacandrakāṃtādidī pitaḥ || jarāmṛtyubhayopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ || 5.2.32.20 || śakrāgniyamarakṣobdhivāyusomeśasevitaḥ || ūrddhādhaḥ saptalokeṣu puṇyeṣu nivasaṃti hi || || 21 || sadā pramuditā devāste'pi kāṃkṣaṃti pattanann || tatra śāṃtā mahātmāno nivasaṃte maheśvara || 22 || vidyotitadiśo dāṃtāḥ sūrya vaiśvānaraprabhāḥ || divyāṃbaradharā dhīrā jagamukuṭadhāriṇaḥ || 23 || viprā māheśvarāḥ puṇyāḥ kṣatriyā haratatparāḥ || mumukṣavastaponiṣṭhā vaiśyā śūdrāścirāyupaḥ || 24 || sa śubhrarūpaḥ sa ca lohitākṛtiḥ sa cāpi pītaḥ sasitetaraḥ kvacit || sa nāmadheyaḥ sa ca nāmavarjyaḥ so'dṛ śyarūpaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭarūpaḥ || 25 || kvacidravisahasrākṣaḥ kvacidekaraviprabhaḥ || kvaciccandrādviśiṣyeta kvacidaṃgulikāṃtimān || 26 || janma mṛtyujarārogairduḥkhāni vividhāni ca || prayāti vilayaṃ tāni prasanne pattaneśvare || 27 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || pattaneśasya devasya ānaṃdeśamataḥ śṛṇu || 28 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye pattaneśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || cha ||
<5.2.33>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || trayastriṃśattamaṃ devamānaṃdeśvaramīśvaram || viddhi pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ sadā || 1 || purā rāthaṃtare kalpe babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ || anamitra iti khyātaḥ sārvabhaumo mahītale ||2|| dharmātmā mahātmā ca parākramadhano nṛpaḥ || atītya sarvabhūtāni babhau bhānurivāvyayaḥ ||3|| samaḥ śatrau ca putre ca mitre ca paradharmmavit || giribhadrā gireḥ putrī tenoḍhā varavarṇinī ||4|| atīva vallabhā sā ca prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || ānaṃda iti putro'bhūttasya jñānarataḥ sudhīḥ || 5 || jātamātro nijotsaṃge sthiramullāpya vai punaḥ || pariṣvajati hārdena ullāpayati punaḥpunaḥ || 6 || sa jātismaraṇo jāto māturutsaṃgamāsthitaḥ || jahāsa ca tadā mātā saṃkṣubdhā vākyamavravīt || 7 || bhītāsmi kimidaṃ vatsa hāso yadvadane tava || akālabodhaḥ saṃjātaḥ kiṃsvitpaśyasi śobhanam || 8 || ityukto mātaraṃ prāha sarvo'pi svārthamīhate || māṃ netumicchati puro mārjārī kiṃ na paśyasi || aṃtardhānagatā ceyaṃ dvitīyā jātahāriṇī || 9 || putraprītyā ca mātastvamataḥ svārthaṃ samīhase || ullāpyollāpya bahuśaḥ pariṣvajasi māṃ bata || 5.2.33.10 || udbhūte bālake snehātsaṃbhramātstrījano'pyayam || tatoyamāgato hāsaḥ śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam || || 11 || svārthe prasaktā mārjārī lolupā māmavekṣate || tathāṃtarddhānagā ceyaṃ dvitīyā jātahāriṇī || 12 || tvaṃ tu krameṇopabhogyaṃ mattaḥ phalamabhīpsasi || na māṃ jānāsi ko'pyevaṃ na vai copakṛtaṃ mayā || 13 || saṃgatirnāti bālānāṃ paṃcasaptadinātmakam || tathāpi snihyasi prītyā pariṣva jasi saṃtatam || 14 || tateti vatsa bho bhadra ityalīkaṃ bravīṣi mām || putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kruddhā mātā'bravīdidam || 15 || nāhaṃ tvāmupakārārthaṃ vatsa prītyā pariṣvaje || svārtho mayā parityakto yastvatto me bhaviṣyati || 16 || ityuktvā sā tamutsṛjya niṣkrāṃtā sūtikāgṛhāt || jahāra tatparityaktaṃ sā tadā jātahāriṇī || 17 || sā hṛtvā taṃ tadā bālaṃ pūrvajātismaraṃ priye || haiminyāḥ śayane nyasyadvikrāṃtasya mahībhṛtaḥ || 18 || matvā svakīyaṃ putraṃ tu vikrāṃtena mahībhṛtā || kṛtaṃ vai nāmakaraṇamānaṃda iti viśrutam || 19 || vikrāṃtasya suto nīto bodhasya ca dvijanmanaḥ || caitranāmā kṛtastena saṃskṛto vedamaṃtrakaiḥ || 5.2.33.20 || tṛtīyaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa bodhaputraṃ niśācarī|| jātismaro'pyathānaṃdaḥ kṛtopanayanastadā || 21 || guruṇā samanujñātaṃ kriyatāmabhivādanam || jananyāḥ prāgupasthānamityukto vākyamabravīt || 22 || vaṃdyā me katamā mātā janitrī pālinī ca vā || ānaṃdasya vacaḥ śrutvā gururvacanamabravīt || 23 || nanviyaṃ te mahābhāga janitrī janakātmajā || vikrāṃtasyāgramahiṣī haiminīnāma nāmataḥ || 24 || || || ānaṃda uvāca || || caitrasya prasavitrīyaṃ caitro'yaṃ dvijaveśmani || saṃskṛto brāhmaṇairmaṃtrairgiribhadrāsutastvaham || 25 || gururāha tataḥ kastvaṃ caitraḥ ko vā tvayocyate || tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pūrvavṛttāṃtamāditaḥ || 26 || || gururuvāca || || atīva gahanaṃ vatsa saṃkaṭaṃ mahadāgatam || na vedmi kiṃcinmohena bhramaṃti mama buddhayaḥ || 27 || || ānaṃda uvāca || || mohasyāvasaraḥ ko'tra jagatyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || kaḥ kasya putro viprarṣe ko vā kasya na bāṃdhavaḥ || 28 || ataḥ saṃsāratā haṃti saṃsāraṃ prāṇināmiha || mahāmohahataṃ cetaścitramatra kathaṃ guro || 29 || brahmaputrasya duṣṭasya duḥsahasya sutā bhuvi || jātahāriṇikānāma parivarttayate sutān || 5.2.33.30 || mātṛdvayaṃ mayā prāptamasminneva hi janmani || mātṛdvayamatho prāptaṃ jātiṃ saṃsmaratā satā || 31 || so'haṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi caitra ānīyatāmiti || tataḥ suvismito rājā sabhāryaḥ saha baṃdhubhiḥ ||32|| tasmānnivarttya mamatā manumene ca taṃ prati || caitramānīya tanayaṃ rājyayogyaṃ cakāra saḥ || 33 || sanmānya brāhmaṇaṃ yena putrabuddhyā sa pālitaḥ || so'pyānaṃdastapastepe mahākālavane śubhe || 34 || iṃdreśvarasya devasya paścime liṃgamuttamam || bhaktyā hyārādhayāmāsa tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || 35 || tapasyaṃtaṃ tatastaṃ tu devaḥ prāha śucismite || kimarthaṃ tapyase vatsa tapastīvraṃ bravīmi te || 36 || manunā bhavatā bhāvyaṃ ṣaṣṭhena vraja tatkuru || alaṃ te tapasā tasmiṃstato muktimavāpsyasi || 37 || ityukto devadevena tathetyāha mahāmatiḥ || babhūva sa manurdevi brahmatulyo mahāyaśāḥ || 38 || putrānutpādayāmāsa liṃgasyāsya samarcanāt || kṛtaṃ nāma tadā devairānaṃdeśvaramuttamam ||39|| ānaṃdena yataḥ prāptā siddhirdevi sudurllabhā || ato nāma suvikhyātamānaṃdeśvaramīkṣyatām ||5.2.33.40|| ye paśyaṃti viśālākṣi ānaṃdeśvaramīśvaram || te putrapautrasaṃpannā bhaviṣyaṃti mahītale || 41 || yeṣāṃ kṣīṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ pāpaṃ koṭijanmaśatodbhavam || teṣāṃ bhavati sā bhaktirānaṃdeśvaradarśanāt ||42|| tadaiva puruṣo mukto janmamṛtyujarādibhiḥ || yadā paśyati deveśamānaṃdeśvarasaṃjñakam || 43 || mayoktaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇāmānandeśvaradarśanam || svargāpavargadaṃ devamānaṃdaṃ liṃgamuttamam || atra devairviśālākṣi pūjitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || || 44 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || ānaṃdeśvaradevasya śṛṇu tvaṃ kaṃthaḍeśvaram || 45 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya ānaṃdeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || || cha || ||
<5.2.34>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || catustriṃśattamaṃ viddhi devaṃ vai kaṃthaḍeśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || vitastāyāstaṭe ramye brāhmaṇo nivasanpurā || babhūva pāṃḍavonāma daridreṇātipīḍitaḥ || 2 || jñātibhiśca parityakto duṣṭayā bhāryayā tathā || kaṃthāpyekā sthitā yasya sarvasvapremadhāriṇī || 3 || tenāhaṃ sutakāmena toṣito girigahvare || mayāpyuktaṃ viśālākṣi putrastava bhaviṣyati || 4 || tasya putraḥ samutpannaḥ kaṃthāmadhyādayo nijaḥ || śītoṣṇavāriṇī kaṃthā tasya putrasya sā'bhavat || 5|| sa ca labdhaḥ prasādena madīyena varānane || rudreṇa ca varo dattaḥ kaṃthāyā bhavitā punaḥ || 6 || atha ṣaṣṭhe gate varṣe mauṃjībaṃdhamaciṃtayat || tadāmaṃtrya munīnsarvānprasādya ca punaḥ punaḥ || namaskṛtya ṛṣīnsarvānpūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 7 || phalairvittānusāreṇa mauṃjī tasyāpyabaṃdhata || te'pyuktā munayaḥ sarve prasādya ca punaḥpuna || 8 || dīyatāmāśiṣo hyasmai putrāya munisattamāḥ || mama putrasya putro'yaṃ dīrghāyurjāyatāṃ ciram || 9 || tūṣṇīṃbhūyaḥ sthitāḥ sarve tacchrutvā nottaraṃ daduḥ || yadā te nottaraṃ procustadā munivaraḥ svayam || dhyānena ciṃtayāmāsa nūnamalpāyuṣaṃ sutam || 5.2.34.10 || iti jñātvā tu saṃmohamagamatsahasā muniḥ || vilalāpa sa duḥkhārttaḥ sutasnehena duḥkhitaḥ || 11 || || vāḍava uvāca|| || dattaḥ svayaṃ maheśena mamālpāyuḥ kathaṃ sutaḥ || rudreṇa ca varo dattaḥ prasannena purā mama || 12|| mattulyavīryaḥ putraste kaṃthāmadhyādbha viṣyati || jātaṃ ca dattvā hyalpāyuṃ mithyā tryakṣasya tadvacaḥ || 13 || pitaraṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tūṣṇīṃbhūto munistadā || sa bālaḥ sahasā vākyaṃ babhāṣe harṣavarddhanam || 14 || tyajata bhayamidānīṃ yanmamārthe viṣaṇṇā vinihatanijayatnaṃ pretarājaṃ karomi || śṛṇuta mama giraṃ bhoḥ seśvarā lokapālāḥ pitṛpativijayārthaṃ satpratijñā mamaiṣā || 15 || ativiṣamatapobhiḥ śaṃkaraṃ toṣayitvā svapiturapi ca bhaktyā hanmi mṛtyorjayāśām || kimatiśayaviṣāda vyākulāstāta sarve sapadi pitṛpatiṃ taṃ sve vaśe sthāpayāmi || 16 || prayāmi rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ maheśvaraṃ devaṃ varaṃ cāpyumayā'vihīnam || śṛṇvaṃtu sarve munayaḥ samaṃtānna mādṛśe mṛtyuparābhavosti || 17 || tapobhirugraiḥ śitikaṃṭhapādau prasādya mṛtyuṃ na cirādvineṣye || kaṃthājavākyāmṛtalolanetrāḥ saṃjātaromāṃ calasatsvadehāḥ || 18 || papracchurenaṃ munayaḥ śiśuṃ taṃ jānāsi rudraṃ paramaṃ kathaṃ tvam || vayaṃ ciraṃ kālamupāsamānāstapobhirugrairvratasaṃcayaiśca || 19 || tathāpi vidmo na vayaṃ maheśaṃ jñātastvayāsau kathamarbhakeṇa || īhāmahe taṃ kila putra samyakchrotuṃ praharṣādbhutajātaromāḥ || 5.2.34.20 || jñātastvayā kutra kathaṃ maheśo maheśvaro vai bhuvanaikanāthaḥ || 21 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || sa bālaḥ kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ parvatātmaje || 22 || mamātra krīḍataḥ siddhaḥ siddhidaḥ samupāgataḥ || vijñāyālpāyuṣaṃ māṃ tu vātsalyādabravīdidam || 23 || gaccha putra mamādeśānmahākālavanottame || dakṣiṇe cāsti yalliṃgamānaṃdeśvaraliṃgataḥ || 24 || tamārādhaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ cirajīvī bhaviṣyasi || tasyopadeśadānena jñātaṃ samyaṅmaheśvarāt || 25|| nānyo devosti lokeṣu satyaṃ satyaṃ munīśvarāḥ || tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmi mahākālavane śubhe || 26 || liṃgamārādhayiṣyāmi viṣādastyajyatāmiha || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tena sārddhaṃ maharṣayaḥ || 27 || pitā ca vismito devi sarva eva samāgatāḥ || devamārādhayāmāsa bālaḥ kālajighāṃsayā|| 28 || liṃgamadhyāttato vāṇī niḥsṛtā parvatātmaje || aho tuṣṭosmi te vatsa kaṃ kāmaṃ pradadāmyaham || 29 || || bāla uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti śaṃkara || pāpakaṃthāvinirmuktāste saṃtu cirajīvinaḥ || 5.2.34.30 || bālasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā liṃge noktaṃ yaśasvini || ye ca māṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || te bhaviṣyaṃti satataṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ || 31 || lapsyaṃte paramānkāmānbhaviṣyaṃti gaṇottama || pūjyāḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || 32 || evaṃ labdhavaraḥ kaṃthaḥ prāṃjaliḥ samupasthitaḥ || liṃgenoktaḥ prasannena bhūyo varaya suvrata || 33 || varo vai durlabho loke devadānavaguhyakaiḥ || mayāvatārito yasmānnāstyadeyaṃ tavādhunā || 34 || bālenokto mahādeva yadi deyo varaḥ punaḥ || mannāmnā deva te khyātirbhūyāttribhuvane bhuvi || 35 || evamastviti liṃgena proktaṃ tuṣṭena pārvati || tadāprabhṛti deveśo vikhyātaḥ kaṃthaḍeśvaraḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa cirāyurjāyate naraḥ || 36 || yaḥ samīkṣati talliṃgaṃ kaṃthaḍeśvaramīśvaram || 37 || pāpakaṃthāvinirmukto muktiṃ yāsyati gauri saḥ || puṇyaṃ yaśasyaṃ geyaṃ talliṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || punāti pātakānsarvānmama nāmānukīrtanāt || 38 || te'dhanyāḥ puruṣā loke teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam|| yairna dṛṣṭo mahākāle devo'sau kaṃthaḍeśvaraḥ || 39 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kaṃthaḍeśvaradevasya indreśvaramatho śṛṇu || 5.2.34.40 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kaṃthaḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || || cha ||
<5.2.35>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || paṃcatriṃśattamaṃ devarmidreśvaramanuttamam || mahāsiddhipradaṃ devi brahmahatyāvināśanam || 1 || āsītprajāpatistvaṣṭā tasya putraḥ kuśadhvajaḥ || svakarmanirato dāṃto vāsavena nipātitaḥ || 2 || tasya putraṃ hataṃ śrutvā tvaṣṭā kruddhaḥ prajāpatiḥ || avalucya jaṭāmekāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 3 || adya paśyaṃtu me vīryaṃ trayo lokāḥ sadevatāḥ || sa ca paśyatu
