durbuddhirbrahmahā pākaśāsanaḥ || 4 || svakarmanirato yena matsuto vinipātitaḥ || ityuktvā koparaktākṣo jaṭāmagnau juhāva tām || 5 || tato vṛtraḥ samuttasthau jvālāmālāsamākulaḥ || mahākāyo mahādaṃṣṭro bhinnāṃjanacayaprabhaḥ ||6|| iṃdraśatrurameyātmā tvaṣṭustejo'bhibṛṃhitaḥ || ahanyahani so'varddhadiṣupātaṃ mahābalam ||7|| vadhāya cātmano dṛṣṭvā vṛtraṃ śakro mahāsuram|| ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 8 || etasminnaṃtare prāpto vṛtro balavatāṃ varaḥ || dadarśa vāsavaṃ tatra devaiḥ sārddhaṃ varānane || 9 || daityo vṛtro mahākāyaścakre saṃgrāmamulbaṇam || nānāśastrāstrasaṃkṣobhaṃ bhaṭasaṃghaṭṭasaṃkaṭam || 5.2.35.10 || chinnabhinnatanutrāṇakrodharaktadharātalam || lūnānanābjaprakaraṃ karapallavadurgamam ||11|| kabaṃdhasaṃghaghaṭanaṃ ghaṭitāmarasainikam || vikīrṇābharaṇasphītasphuradyodhāṃgabhūṣaṇam || 12 || kallolarudhirodgārapāṭalīkṛtadiṅmukham || tasminraṇe mahābhīme devānbhittvā saguhyakān || 13 || vāsavaṃ baṃdhayitvā tu svargalokaṃ jagāma ha || rājyaṃ cakāra niḥśaṃko nissapatnaṃ varānane || 14 || tatastu baddhe deveṃdre bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ yatra baddhaḥ śatakratuḥ || 15 || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ śakramāśīrbhirabhinaṃdya ca || baṃdhanānmocayitvā tu provācedaṃ vacastadā || 16 || anukūlo na kāloyaṃ sureśasya tavādhunā || udyogaḥ sumahāndṛṣṭaḥ saṃghātaśca suradviṣām || dṛṣṭā hi pravarāḥ sarve mayā tatra mahāsurāḥ || 17 || ekaikopi vijetuṃ tvāṃ śaktaḥ syāditi me matiḥ || na tādṛksaṃgamaḥ śakra kadācitsuravidviṣām || dṛṣṭo vāpi śruto vāpi yādṛśo hyavalokitaḥ || 18 || bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā śakraḥ saṃbhramamāgamata || dhyātvā muhūrttaṃ provāca bṛhadbuddhe bṛhaspate ||19|| kimatra pratikarttavyaṃ vada tāvadbṛhaspate || bahavo balavaṃtaśca dānavāḥ svalpakairdinaiḥ|| matsakāśaṃ sameṣyaṃti sa ca vṛtro mahā balaḥ || 5.2.35.20 || iti śakravacaḥ śrutvā bṛhaspatiruvāca tam || upāyaḥ kriyatāṃ tūrṇaṃ gaccha śakra mamājñayā || 21 || mahākālavane ramye khaṃḍeśvarasya dakṣiṇe || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ liṃgaṃ vidyate tatra vāsava || 22 || tadārādhaya yatnena tatte kāmaṃ pradāsyati || bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā śakraḥ śīghrataraṃ gataḥ || 23 || mahākālavane devi dṛṣṭvā liṃgamanuttamam || stutiṃ cakāra sahasā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ || 24 || namo devādhidevāya śaṃkarāya vṛṣāya ca || kāmyāya bahurūpāya vyālayajñopavītine || vareṇyāya namo nityaṃ namaste sarvakāmada || 25 || ādyaḥ prajā sṛṣṭikarastvameva kālaḥ prajāḥ saṃharasi tvameva || apāṃpatirbhūtapatistvameva dhaneśvarastvaṃ dahanastvameva || 26 || caṃdraśca sūryaḥ pavana stvameva dhātā vidhātā paramaḥ purāṇaḥ || jalāśayastvaṃ varuṇastvameva śailottamastvaṃ bhujageśvaraśca || ḍiṃḍirmahākāla vṛṣastvameva vināyako guhyavarastvameva || 27 || itīritāṃ stutiṃ śrutvā liṃgenoktaḥ śatakratuḥ || gaccha śakra mamādeśānmattejobṛṃhito raṇe || haniṣyasi na saṃdeho vṛtraṃ ripuvidāraṇa || 28 || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādapāṃ phenena pārvati || jaghāna samare vṛtraṃ paśyatāṃ tridaśadviṣām || 29 || nihatya dānavānpaścāllīlayā raṇakarkaśaḥ || uvācendrastadā devānhato vṛtro mahāraṇe || 5.2.35.30 || trailokyādhyakṣatāṃ prāptā bhavaṃto matparākramāt || evamuktāstu śakreṇa te devā vismayānvitāḥ || 31 || asya devasya māhātmyāddhato vṛtro mahāsuraḥ || śarīre ca sthitāḥ pāpā darśanātsaṃkṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 32 || indreṇārādhito yasmāddevadevo maheśvaraḥ || tasmādiṃdreśvaronāma khyāto bhuvi bhaviṣyati || 33 || darśanādasya liṃgasya purīmiṃdrasya śobhanām || pāpinopi gamiṣyaṃti sarvapātakavarjitāḥ || 34 || yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ śrīindreśvarasaṃjñakam || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairdivi modiṣyate ciram || 35 || iṃdreṇārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayiṣyati || sa yāti vai paraṃ sthānaṃ divyakalpacatuṣṭayam || 36 || yena ceṃdreśvaro devo bhaktyā samyakprapūjitaḥ || tena viṣṇuprabhṛtayo vayaṃ sarve savāsavāḥ || munayo lokapālāśca pūjitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ || 37 || ityuktaḥ sa suraiḥ śakro vaikuṇṭhādyaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || taireva sahito devo jagāmātha triviṣṭapam || 38 || iṃdreśvarasya devasya prabhāvaḥ kathitastvayam || mārkaṃḍeyeśvaraṃ devaṃ śṛṇu pārvati sāṃpratam || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmya indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<5.2.36>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || mārkaṇḍeyeśvaraṃ viddhi ṣaṭtriṃśattamamīśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa putravāñjāyate naraḥ || 1 || brahmavaṃśasamutpanno mṛkaṇḍonāma tāpasaḥ || vedādhyayanasaṃpannaḥ sa cāputro babhūva ha || 2 || putrārthaṃ cintayāmāma kathaṃ putro bhavediti || aputrasya kuto loka iti vedeṣu paṭhyate || 3 || tasmāttapaḥ kariṣyāmi yena me tanayo bhavet || evaṃ saṃcitya bahudhā sa jagāma himālayam || 4 || cakāra vasatiṃ cāpi tapase bhāvitātmavān || vāyubhakṣoṃbubhakṣaśca nirāhārordhvapādakaḥ || 5 || śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ parṇāśyekadviparṇabhuk || evamādīni cānyāni tapāṃsi subahūnyapi ||6|| cakāra sa munistatra varṣāṇi dvādaśaiva tu || na tuṣṭo'haṃ tadā devi tapasā duṣkareṇa tu ||7|| tato jñātvā matiṃ tasya vijñapto'haṃ tadā tvayā || karotyeva tapaḥ krūraṃ putrahetormunirmahān ||8|| tejasā dīpayañchailaṃ śoṣayansalilāśayān || tapasā duṣkareṇaiva kṣubhitā nākavāsinaḥ||9|| samudrāḥ kṣubhitāḥ sarve candrādityau tathaiva ca || ṛṣayo vismṛtiṃ prāptāḥ kaṃpete cāpi rodasī || akālapralayo deva bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||5.2.36.10|| munaye tanmṛkaṇḍāya putro vai dīyatāmiti|| mayā proktaṃ varārohe putramicchatyayonijam ||11|| akṣayaṃ suviśālākṣi sahasrākṣamivāparam || candrābhaṃ candravadanaṃ candravadbhuvanapriyam ||12|| nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ nīlotpaladalekṣaṇam || viśālacārujaghanaṃ cārukuṇḍalamaṃḍitam || putramicchati deveśi mṛkaṇḍo'yaṃ mahāmuniḥ || 13 || tvayāpyuktaṃ punardevi kāruṇyādbhaktivatsale || na dadāsi muneḥ putraṃ tapyato viṣamaṃ tapaḥ || 14 || phalasya dātā tapasāṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ gīyase budhaiḥ || kastvāṃ nu śaraṇaṃ gacchellokānāṃ sambhavaṃ bhavam || 15 || karoṣi sarvadaityānāṃ sarvadevākulākulam || tvayāhaṃ suciraṃ devaṃ satkṛtā karuṇākara || 16 || nānyo māmanukampārthaṃ prayacchetpravaraṃ varam || sa tvaṃ sarvajagannātha prabhuḥ karttā praśāsitā || 17 || hetuḥ svāmī maheśāno dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ || sarveśvara stuto'bhīṣṭaṃ kiṃ na viprāya dīyate || 18 || tapasā kṣīṇapāpasya brahmatve bhāvitātmanaḥ || asya putrapradānaṃ tvaṃ kuru madvacanācchiva || 19 || mayā tvaṃ varṇitā devi snehākṣarapadaiḥ śubhaiḥ || lolapaṃkajapatrākṣi gauri bhūdharagātraje || 5.2.36.20 || skaṃdamātaḥ kalāpūrṇacaṃdrabimbanibhānane || kṛśodari viniḥspṛṣṭacāmīkaranibhadyute || 21 || tvayoktaṃ prakariṣyāmi vākyaṃ dviradagāmini || tvaṃ siddhiḥ sādhakā sādhyaṃ tvaṃ kriyā prakramāśrayā || 22 || tvaṃ māyā śrīrdyutiḥ śrīmacchraddhārucirasaṃtatiḥ || kṛtvā mānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ mayaiva saha sundari || 23 || bhrājase vividhākārā mohayitvākhilaṃ jagat || tvayāpyuktaṃ punardevi kriyatāṃ tu vaco mama ||24|| munaye'smai tapaḥkṣīṇasarvagātrāya sāṃpratam || varaḥ pradīyatāmasmai brāhmaṇāya maheśvara || 25 || mayāpyuktaṃ viśālākṣi śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama || asau gacchatu vipreṃdro mahākālavanottame || 26 || pattaneśvarapūrve tu tatrāste liṃgamuttamam || putrapradaṃ viśālākṣi mahāpātakanāśanam || 27 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tvayāpyukto dvijottamaḥ || mahākālavanaṃ gaccha putrārthamṛṣi sattama || tatra liṃgaṃ samārādhya lapsyase putramuttamam || 28 || tvayā saṃprerito viprastatheti kṛtaniścayaḥ || āśayā parayā yuktaḥ putrakāmo jagāma saḥ || 29 || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahāliṃgaṃ putradaṃ pāpanāśanam || bhaktyā saṃsevayāmāsa tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || 5.2.36.30 || atha kenāpi kālena niḥsṛto'haṃ tvayā saha|| liṃgamadhyādvarārohe sa ca prokto dvijottamaḥ || 31 || śarvo'hamiti jānīhi brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || āvāṃ purā prasannau te jñātaṃ tava viceṣṭitam ||32|| yamicchasi varaṃ brahmaṃstadadya pradadāmi te || mayā proktaḥ prasannena muniḥ paramavismitaḥ || 33 || prahvaḥ prāha suhṛdaye sa hṛṣṭo muni sattamaḥ || apatyahetordeveśau kimalabhyaṃ bhavenmama || 34 || mayā proktastadā devi mṛkaṇḍo munisattamaḥ || ayonijaste tanayo mānuṣo vai bhavi ṣyati || aiśvaryajñānasaṃpanno dīrghāyuḥ sarvavitsudhīḥ || 35 || etasminnaṃtare devi prādurbhūto mahātapāḥ || putraḥ paramadharmātmā mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || || 36 || sa jātamātro dharmātmā tatraiva tapasi sthitaḥ || devamārādhayāmāsa sa tuṣṭo'tha varaṃ dadau || 37 || tvayāhaṃ jātamātreṇa tapasā toṣito yataḥ || tasmātkhyātiṃ gamiṣyāmi tvannāmnā dvijasattama || 38 || ye māṃ paśyaṃti vipreṃdra bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || prāpnuvaṃti gatiṃ nityaṃ te sadānaṃda dāyinīm || 39 || prasaṃgādye gamiṣyaṃti te sadā duḥkhavarjitāḥ || devadevaṃ samārādhya modiṣyaṃti hi te narāḥ || 5.2.36.40 || tryakṣā gaṇeśvarāḥ siddhāḥ siddhagaṃdharvasevitāḥ || te bhaviṣyaṃti satataṃ mama bhaktāśca ye narāḥ || 41 || ye māṃ saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti hṛdyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || dīrghāyuṣo bhaviṣyaṃti sadā duḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 42 || ityukte tena liṃgena mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ || tapaścacāra tatraiva mahākālavane sthitaḥ || 43 || prabhāvaḥ kathito devi mārkaṃḍeyeśvarasya ca || śiveśvarasya devasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam || 44 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye mārkaṃḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || || cha ||
<5.2.37>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || saptatriṃśattamaṃ viddhi śiveśvaramanaṃtakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa jāyaṃte sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 1 || rājā ripuṃjayonāma brahmakalpe purābhavat || mahākālavane ramye prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 2 || devapūjāṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ svādhyāyasatkriyām || prajāpālanakaṃ kṛtvā na sa jānāti kiṃcana || 3 || sa prajāḥ pālayāmāsa putravatparipālitāḥ || prajāstāḥ sukhasaṃvṛddhā jarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ || 4 || putriṇo dhanadhānyāḍhyāḥ sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ || tasyaiva tejasā vyāptaṃ mahākālapuraṃ priye || 5 || etasminnaṃtare pṛthvīṃ tasmiñchāsati pārvati || mahākālavanaṃ devi svapuraṃ cihnitaṃ mayā || vinā cojjayinīṃ gaṃtuṃ na ratiṃ prāpa kutracit || 6 || tadā mayā gaṇeśastu śivasaṃjño gaṇāgraṇīḥ || ciṃtitastatkṣaṇātprāptaḥ kiṃ karomītyuvāca ha || 7 || mayāpyukto gaṇeśo hi gaccha putra mama priyam || mahākālapuraṃ vyāptaṃ rājā ripuñjayena hi || 8 || ityuktaḥ sa mayā devi tathetyuktā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || gato'sau mānuṣe loke mamājñāharṣitānanaḥ || 9|| gate śivagaṇe devi saṃtuṣṭo'haṃ śucismite || yuktijñānavṛto dakṣaḥ prabhorbhṛtyo hi durlabhaḥ || 5.2.37.10 || tataḥ sa bhikṣu rūpeṇa bahvoṣadhiparigrahaḥ || gṛhītvā duṃdubhiṃ skaṃdhe vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 11 || kaśca bhūtaviṣagrasto nānādoṣaiḥ samāśritaḥ || kasya ko vyādhiratyugro yamahaṃ praśamaṃ naye || 12 || ko'putraḥ putravānastu manmaṃtrabalamāśritaḥ || vaidyo'smi sarvayuktijñaḥ sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ || 13 || tasya vākyaṃ samākarṇya kautūhalasamanvitaḥ || savṛddhabālanārīko janastamabhijagmivān || 14 || teṣāṃ sa nāśayāmāsa vyādhiṃ durjayamapyati || te ca tasmai sumahatīṃ pūjāṃ cakruḥ suharṣitāḥ || hemaratnāṃbaradhanairdhānyagrāmapurādibhiḥ || 15 || evaṃ sa nyavasattatra varṣāṇi ca caturddaśa || nṛpateraṃtaraprekṣī na cāṃtara mavāpa saḥ || 16 || aho'tiduṣkaro rājā aho lokaparāyaṇaḥ || aho tejonidhirvīro durjayo'sau mahāmatiḥ || 17 || evaṃ sa ciṃtayaṃstatra bhikṣu rūpī śivo gaṇaḥ || jīrṇodyānalatājālagahane saṃvṛtaḥ sthitaḥ || 18 || atrāṃtare tu nṛpatestasya lokavratasya tu || mahiṣī nirjarā rājñaḥ prāṇebhyopi garīyasī || 19 || rūpeṇāpratimā loke sā cāputrā sutārthinī || sapatnībahulā devī śrutvā bhikṣuṃ samāśritā|| 5.2.37.20 || sarvakāmapradaṃ jñātvā nāga rāṇāṃ sakautukam|| svāṃ sakhīṃ preṣayāmāsa sunaṃdāṃnāma bhāminī || 21 || bhikṣorāyatane guptamaṃtaḥpuramataṃdritā || tayā cāsādito bhikṣurviciṃtya nagaraṃ tadā || uvāca ciṃtāparamaṃ bhikṣuṃ bhikṣāsamanvitam || 22 || praṇamya prāṃjalirbhūtvā kāryārthaṃ vigatavyathā || bhagavanmahiṣī rājñaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || vaṃdhyā putrārthinī devī guptaṃ tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati || 23 || bhavānkṛpākaraḥ prāyaḥ prajānāmīhitapradaḥ || evaṃ śrutvā śivagaṇo labdhvā randhra muvāca ha || 24 || || bhikṣuruvāca || || bhadre keyaṃ tava matirviparītapralāpinī || avijñāto narapatergṛhamehīti bhāṣase || avijñātaḥ pure dṛṣṭaḥ sāhasī puruṣo bhavet || 25 || evaṃ matvā vraja kṣipraṃ svamevāṃtaḥpuraṃ śubhe || nāhaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi yāvanna nṛpatervacaḥ || 26 || sā tu tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhikṣoḥ kṣubhitamānasā || jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ devyai tacca nyavedayat || 27 || sakhīvacastu sā śrutvā devī dīnā uvāca tām || sunande ka upāyosti rājā yena pravarttate || bhikṣorānayane kṣipraṃ yāvannāsau vrajetkvacit || 28 || uvāca sā tāṃ yuktyaiva sunaṃdā yuktabhāṣiṇī || tvaṃ tasya vallabhā rājñaḥ prāṇebhyopi garīyasī || 29 || tasmādasvasthacittatvaṃ rājñaḥ svaṃ saṃpradarśaya || hetunā tena rājā ca vākyaṃ tava kariṣyati || 5.2.37.30 || etasminneva kāle tu devyā darśanalālasaḥ || jagāmāṃtaḥpuraṃ rājā priyāṃ dīnāṃ dadarśa ha || tāmapṛcchattato rājā snehārdrīkṛtamānasaḥ || 31 || || || rājovāca || || kimidaṃ devi te rūpaṃ vimanaskeva bhāṣase || bhagnāsi kena duḥkhena kasyāpakṛtamīdṛśam || 32 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñī vacanamabravīt || na putrā nṛpa me saṃti tena me nāsti nirvṛtiḥ || 33 || krīḍanaṃ pīḍanāyaiva teṣāṃ ye putravarjitāḥ || aputrā jagato dīnā duḥkhitāḥ putravarjitāḥ || aputre ca gatirnāsti sutāputravivarjite || 34 || sukhinaste janā loke ye bālaṃ pāṃsubhūṣitam || pariṣvajaṃti svasutamasphuṭākṣarabhāṣakam || 35 || anena kāraṇenāsmi nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gatā || upāyo hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ putrārthe mama sāṃpratam || 36 || iha bhikṣuḥ samāyāto devarūpī sanātanaḥ || tasya cāvyāhatā śaktiḥ śrūyate sarvavastuṣu || 37 || sastrībālo janaścātra śaraṇaṃ yasya gacchati || tasya bhikṣoḥ prasādena sutavatyo vayaṃ nṛpa || bhaviṣyāmo'tra saṃdeho na me manasi varttate || 38 || tasyāḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā jīrṇodyānaṃ jagāma ha || priyayā sahito rājā taṃ ca bhikṣuṃ dadarśa ha || 39 || dṛṣṭamātro nṛpatinā bhikṣurligatvamāgataḥ || dṛṣṭvā sumahadāścaryaṃ bhaktinamro mahīpatiḥ || pūjayāmāsa vidhivattalliṃgaṃ bhikṣu rūpakam || 5.2.37.40 || aputro'smītyuvācedaṃ dhanyeyaṃ mahiṣī mama || dehi me tanayaṃ deva śivo bhavānmaheśvaraḥ || 41 || ityukto rājasiṃhena bhikṣurliṃgā kṛtistadā || pratyuvāca mahīpālaṃ putraste bhavitā nṛpa || 42 || tataḥprabhṛti rājāsau sakalatro mahāmatiḥ || sarvabhāvena taṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ mudā || 43 || devadevasya māhātmyātputro jāto mahābalaḥ || dharmātmā ca yaśasvī ca sārvabhaumo guṇādhikaḥ || 44 || athāhaṃ mandarāddevi kautukāttu samāgataḥ || liṃgākāraṃ gaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ sevakaṃ tathā ||45|| yogaiśvaryeṇa ca mayā kṛtaṃ vai puramātmanaḥ || nānāratnaprabhoddyotaṃ nānāsiddhini ṣevitam || tacchivaṃ śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ dattaṃ devi tadā mayā || 46 || mārkaṃḍeyeśvarāddevāduttare varavarṇini || tadāprabhṛti devo'sau śiveśvara iti smṛtaḥ ||. || 47 || ye'rcayiṣyanti satataṃ śiveśvaramanuttamam|| nirdhūtasarvapāpāste bhaviṣyaṃti gaṇottamāḥ || 48 || viditvārbhaguruṃ lokaṃ ye drakṣyaṃti śiveśva ram || antakāle pradāsyāmi teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam ||49|| mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam || apunarbhavahetutvātsaṃsevyo'sau śiveśvaraḥ || || 5.2.37.50 || sarvāvastho'pi yo martyaḥ saṃśrayettaṃ śiveśvaram || sa tāṃ gatimavāpnoti yajñairdānairhi yā gatiḥ || 51 || ākhyānaṃ prayato marttyo ya idaṃ śrāvayecchuciḥ || paṭhedvā vācayedvāpi sa mucyetsarvakilviṣaiḥ || 52 || eṣa te kathitā devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || śiveśvarasya devasya kusumeśa mataḥ śṛṇu || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye śiveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||37||
<5.2.38>
|| īśvara uvāca || || aṣṭātriṃśattamaṃ viddhi kusumeśvarasaṃjñakam || devaṃ svargapradaṃ devi mahāpātakanā śanam ||1|| purā vaivasvate kalpe prāpte vārāhasaṃjñake || prādurbhūte viśālākṣi kailāsādahamāgataḥ || 2|| mahākālavane ramye ramamāṇasya pārvati || tvayā sārddhaṃ mamākṣaiśca prādurāsīnmahāsvanaḥ || 3 || pṛṣṭo'haṃ ca tadā śrutvā śabdaṃ cātīva duḥsaham || śabdotpattirmayā devi kathitā sā tvadagrataḥ ||4|| ete gaṇeśāḥ krīḍaṃti madhye vai vīrako gaṇaḥ || kusumairbhūṣito'tyarthaṃ mamātīva suvallabhaḥ ||5|| kusumairhanyate'pyarthaṃ pūjyate kusumotkaraiḥ || sa eva vīrako devi sadā me harṣadāyakaḥ ||6|| nānāścaryaguṇādhāro gaṇeśvaraśatārcitaḥ || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tvayāpyuktaṃ varānane ||7|| na dṛśyate vinā puṇyaiḥ putrasyānanapaṃkajam || īdṛśasya sutasyāpi mamotkaṇṭhā maheśvara || 8 || kadāhamīdṛśaṃ putraṃ drakṣyāmyānandadāyakam || mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā hasitvā ca punaḥpunaḥ || proktaṃ pārvati putro'yaṃ pradatto vīrako'dhunā || 9 || eṣa eva sutastestu nayanānandadāyakaḥ || tvayā mātrā kṛtārthastu vīrakaḥ kusumārcitaḥ || 5.2.38.10 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā preṣitā vijayā tvayā || datto hareṇa me putro vijaye śīghramānaya || 11 || vijayovāca gaṇapaṃ gaṇamadhye ca varttinam || ehi vīraka cāpalyāttvayā devaḥ prakopitaḥ || kimunmattavadatyarthaṃ nṛtyarāgeṇa mohitaḥ || 12 || ityukto bhayasaṃtrastaḥ kusumairbhūṣitastadā || tvatsamīpaṃ samāyāto vijayānugataḥ śanaiḥ || 13 || bhūṣitaṃ kusumairdṛṣṭvā bhayatrastaṃ ca vīrakam || tvayā cākārito devi girā madhuravarṇayā ||14|| ehyehi jāto'si me putrakastvaṃ devena datto'dhunā vīrakosi || uktavatyevamaṃke nidhāyātha taṃ paryacumbaḥ kapole kalaṃvādinam || 15 || mūrdhanyupāghrāya sammārjya gātrāṇi sā bhūṣayāmāsa divyaiḥ svayaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ || kiṃkiṇīmekhalānūpuraiḥ sanmaṇīniṣkakeyūrahārotkaraiḥ sadguṇaiḥ || 16 || komalaiḥ pallavaiścitritaiścārubhirdivya mantrodbhavaistasya śubhraistataḥ || bhūtibhiścākarormiśrasiddhārthakairaṃgarakṣāvidhīṃstasyatuṣṭā satī || 17 || evamādhāya covaktha kṛtvā srajaṃ mūrdhni gorocanāpatrabhaṃgojvalaiḥ || vatsa gacchādhunā krīḍa sārddhaṃ gaṇairapramatto yathā bālacaryāṃ śanaiḥ || 18 || so'pi siddhyākule gaṇḍaśaile miladratnajāle vṛhacchā latālākule || kṣaṇaṃ phullamālātamālālimāle kṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣamūle vilolālimāle || 19 || kṣaṇaṃ svalpapaṃke jale paṃkajāle kṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣakhaṇḍe śubhe niṣkalaṃke || parikrīḍate bālako vai vihārī gaṇeśādhipo devatānandakārī || 5.2.38.20 || evaṃ vikrīḍatastasya vīrakasya gaṇasya ca || saṃdhyā tamo mayī prāptā vijñapto'haṃ tvayā priye ||21|| aiśvaryaṃ dīyatāmasya mama putrasya śaṃkara || śarīrārddhaṃ gaṇeśatvaṃ lokapālatvamagrataḥ || 22 || liṃgatvamakṣayatvaṃ ca sthānaṃ divyaṃ sudurllabham || vaṃdyamānaṃ yathā deva siddhagandharvakiṃnaraiḥ || brahmendravaruṇādityalokapāleśvareśvaraiḥ || 23 || etaireva gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ stūya mānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || alaṃkṛto mayā yasmātkusumairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 24 || kusumeśvarasaṃjñastu tasmātkhyāto bhavatviti || mayāpyuktaṃ viśālākṣi vīrakaṃ dayitaṃ mama || 25 || matprabhāvasamaṃ divyaṃ sevitaṃ gaṇapaiḥ sadā || śṛṇu gandharvagītānāṃ mādhuryamamṛtopamam || 26 || paśya kinnaranārīṇāṃ gāyantīnāṃ manoramam || paśyāpsaraḥsamūhasyanṛtyametannirantaram || 27 || vidyādharaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kusumeśo varānane || viśeṣato mayā devi prathamaṃ pramathe śvaraḥ || kusumeśvaratāṃ nīto yadā kusumamaṃḍitaḥ || 28 || sthānaṃ dattaṃ viśālākṣi śivaliṃgasya cottare || varo datto bahumato duṣprāpyastridaśairapi || 29 || ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti gaṇapa kusumeśvarasaṃjñakam || na teṣāṃ jāyate pāpaṃ padmapatre yathā jalam || 5.2.38.30 || kusumairarcayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ kusumeśvaram || matsthānaṃ te samāsādya modiṣyaṃti gatavyathāḥ || 31 || yo'pyekaṃ divasaṃ marttyastvāṃ paśyati samāhitaḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairmama lokaṃ gamiṣyati || 32 || yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena kusumaiḥ kusumeśvaram || sa prāpsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham || 33 || evamādivaraiḥ puṣṭaḥ kṛtoyaṃ kusu meśvaraḥ || kṛtakṛtyo gaṇo devi liṃgeneśvaratāṃ gataḥ || 34 || kusumeśvaradevasya prabhāvaḥ kathitastvayam || akrūreśasya devasya śrūyatāṃ tadanantaram || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe kusumeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || || cha ||
<5.2.39>
|| hara uvāca || || akrūreśvaramekonacatvāriṃśattamaṃ śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa subuddhirjāyate nṛṇām || 1 || purā tvayaiva kalpādau parayā śaktirūpayā || kṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ varārohe trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 2 || tatastvaṃ saṃstutā devaiḥ sakiṃnaramahoragaiḥ || pradakṣiṇāṃ prakurvati gaṇā nānāvidhāstu te || 3 || namaskāraṃ prakurvati stotraṃ kurvaṃti cāpare || na karoti namaskārameko bhṛṃgiriṭistadā || 4 || krūrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsādya garveṇatīva garvitaḥ || 5 || eko devo mahādevaḥ striyā kimanayā mama || yadā nāyāti te pārśvaṃ tadā proktastvayā gataḥ || 6 || kasmānna kuruṣe pūjāṃ pradakṣiṇamatho stutim || madbhakto madadhīno'si mama putro mayā kṛtaḥ || itthaṃbhūtagaṇeśa tvaṃ kiṃ vai laulyena varttase || 7 || iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā kuddhastvāmāha garvitaḥ || nāhaṃ pārvati te putraḥ putro'haṃ śaṃkarasya tu || 8 || eṣa eva ca me mātā eṣa eva ca me pitā || evaṃ rātridinaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ||9|| tvamapyasyaiva śaraṇaṃ nanu pārvati saṃsthitā|| yadi ca tvāmahaṃ vaṃde tadvaṃde sakalāngaṇān ||5.2.39.10|| iti bhṛṃgiriṭeḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ kupitayā tvayā || tasyoktaṃ pramatheśasya bhīru bhṛṃgiriṭeridam ||11|| suto bhūtvā bhavānkasmādadākṣiṇyaṃ bravīṣi mām || tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitāṃtraṃ ca mātṛkaṃ tanayasya tu || 12 || nakhadaṃtāsthisaṃghātaḥ śiśnaṃ vākca śirastathā || tathaiva śukraṃ gaṇapa paitṛkaṃ tu śarīrakam || 13 || iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā sadyo yogabalena tu || māṃsādi tyaktavānsarvaṃ mātṛkaṃ bhāgameva hi || 14 || tataḥ prabhṛti vāmoru nakhadaṃtāsthināsikaḥ || sa ca krūrāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ|| || 15 || tvāṃ parityajya duḥkhārtta ājagāma mamāṃtikam || atha tvayā tadā śapto gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ priye || 16 || krūrā buddhiḥ kṛtā yasmāttvayā kumatinā bhṛśam || tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke gamiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 17 || ityuktastu tvayā devi gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭistathā || papāta mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ puṇyāṃte sukṛtī yathā || 18 || sa gatvā puṣkaradvīpaṃ tapase bhāvitātmavān || tatraikapādūrddhvabhujo daśapadmānyavasthitaḥ || dagdhībhūtaṃ ca tapasā jagadvai duṣkareṇa tu || 19 || tato brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śakraśca tridaśaiḥ saha || vayaṃ ca cārujaghane tatsamīpaṃ samāgataḥ || 5.2.39.20 || upagamya tatastasya kathitaṃ purato mayā || alaṃ krūreṇa tapasā lokasyotsādanena vai || 21 || trailokyamapi niḥsaṃjñaṃ jātamevaṃ sthite tvayi || saṃharasva tapo ghoraṃ lokasaṃtāpanaṃ mahat||22|| prārthyatāṃ pārvatī putra sā dāsyati varaṃ ca te|| asyāḥ prasādānmuktiste śāpāccaiva bhaviṣyati || evamuktastadā tena prārthitā tvaṃ maheśvari || gaṇena bhṛṃgiriṭinā bhaktinamreṇa sādarāt || 24 || tvayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi putra gaccha mamājñayā || mahākālavane ramye tatrā'krūro bhaviṣyasi || 25 || punaḥ prāpsyasi kailāsaṃ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam|| aṃkapādāgrato liṃgaṃ saptakalpānugaṃ mahat || yasya darśanamātreṇa śubhā buddhiḥ prajāyate || 26 || kṛtaghnā nāstikāḥ krūrā ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ || mahāpātakino ye ca ye ca śāpavaśaṃ gatāḥ || darśanāttasya liṃgasya te'pi svarga bhujo narāḥ || 27 || krūrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsādya kaṃsaṃ hatvā ca keśihā || baladevena sahitastyaktvā tāṃ mathurāṃ purīm || 28 || mahākālavanaṃ gatvā toṣa yitvā maheśvaram|| akrūratvaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ kīrttirlabdhā ca śāśvatī || 29 || tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭistadā || tatheti pratyayī jāto mahā kālavanaṃ gataḥ || devamārādhayāmāsa tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || 5.2.39.30 || etasminnaṃtare devi liṃgamadhyāttvamutthitā || arddhāṃgaṃ māmakaṃ kṛtvā svakīyāṃgamathā rddhataḥ || phaṇīṃdrabaddhajūṭārddhamarddhadhamillabhūṣitam|| 31 || patravallīvicitrārdhamarddhacaṃdravirājitam || muktāhāranibaddhārddhamarddhaṃ sarpaiśca veṣṭitam || 32 || tato bhṛṃgiriṭirdevi dṛṣṭvā tanmahadadrutam || ciṃtayāmāsa hṛdaye mayā'jñānādanuṣṭhitam || 33 || umā ca śaṃkaraścaiva dehamekaṃ sanātanam || ekā mūrttiranirdeśyā dvidhā bhedena dṛśyate || 34 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya bhaktinamrasya pārvvati || proktaṃ tvayā prasannāhaṃ varaṃ varaya putraka || 35 || tenoktaṃ yadi tuṣṭāsi mātarmama maheśvari || asya liṃgasya māhātmyātkrūrā buddhirgatā mama || 36 || akrūreśvaranāmāyaṃ devaḥ khyāto bhavatviti || tvaṃ devi sarvabhāvānāmekā kāraṇamucyate ||37|| tvaṃ mūrtā puṇyanicayā tvaṃ gatiḥ puṇyasevinām|| pitā mātā suhṛdbandhustvamekā kāraṇaṃ param || 38 || kuru puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ caiva vāṃchitārthapradāyakam|| 39 || tatheti ca tvayā proktaṃ girā madhurayā tadā || yatte priyatamaṃ vatsa tatpūrvaṃ prakaromyaham || 5.2.39.40 || na me'sti duṣkaraṃ putra tvatkṛte kanakaprabha || asminsthāne tu ye devamakūreśvarasaṃjñakam || prasaṃgādapi paśyaṃti api pāparatā narāḥ || te'pyavaśyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti tvatsamā niyataṃ gaṇāḥ ||41|| bhaktyā stoṣyaṃti ye nāma liṃgasyāsya ca mānavāḥ || mānasaiḥ pātakairmuktā yāsyaṃti svargamakṣayam ||42|| snātvā tu vidhivatpūjāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ|| sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpsyate ravimaṃḍalam ||43|| āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ kāmamatra hi vāṃchitam || gosahasraphalaṃ cātra spṛṣṭvā prāpsyati mānavaḥ ||44|| snātvā maṃdākinīkuṃḍe yo'kūreśvaramīśvaram || pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairmahāpāpahatopi vā||45|| vimānaṃ divyamārūḍho yāvatkalpacatuṣṭayam || gaṃdharvairgīyamānastu so'pi svargaṃ gamiṣyati|| 46 || ityuktaḥ sa gaṇo devi matsamīpamupāgataḥ || śāpānmuktastvayā sārdhaṃ vismṛtā kiṃ varānane || 47 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || akrūreśvaradevasya śṛṇu kuṃḍeśvaraṃ param || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye'krūreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmai konacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || ||
<5.2.40>
|| īśvara uvāca || || catvāriṃśattamaṃ viddhi kuṃḍeśvaramataḥ śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa labhyate sadgatiḥ parā || 1 || vijñapto'haṃ tvayā devi maṃdare cārukaṃdare || vīrakaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kva gato mama putrakaḥ || 2 || mayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi mahākālavano ttame || jalamadhye sthitastepe tapaḥ paramadāruṇam||3|| munibhiḥ sahito dhīmānbhrājamānoṃ'śumāniva || gacchāmastatra taṃ draṣṭuṃ gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ varānane || || 4 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tvayāhaṃ preritastadā || uttiṣṭha śambho gacchāmo vṛṣamāruha satvaram || 5 || saprasnavau stanau jātau sadyaḥ saṃsmṛtya vīrakam || mayā smṛto vṛṣo devi dharmarūpī sanātanaḥ || 6 || madīyaṃ ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā mamapārśvamupāgataḥ || ārūḍho'haṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ tasminneva vṛṣe tadā || 7 || prasthitastatkṣaṇācchīghraṃ gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ saha || vegātprayāto vṛṣabhaskaṃdhālaṃbitayā tvayā || 8 || raṇadvalayabāhubhyāṃ gāḍhamāliṃgito hyaham|| tvaṃ bhītā ca tadā jātā yadātīva praṇoditaḥ || 9 || vṛṣo mayā viśālākṣi sa kṛṣṭo gaṇapaistadā || kṛṣṭaṃ ca satvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā proktaṃ ca bhītayā tadā || 5.2.40.10 || śrāṃtāsmi sāṃprataṃ deva vegenānena bhīṣitā || tadviśramitumicchāmi bhūdharasya taṭe vibho || 11 || kṣaṇaṃ padbhyāṃ gamiṣyāmi viṣamoyaṃ girirmahān|| tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā bāḍhamuktaṃ priye mayā || 12 || muhūrttaṃ cārujaghane śailapādamupāśritā || kuru śramāpanayanaṃ yāvadvegātprayāmyaham || || 13 || paṃthāna tvatsukhaṃ yatra taṃ vayaṃ mṛgayāvahe || eṣa kuṇḍo gaṇādhyakṣastvatsamīpe vasiṣyati || tvadājñāvaśavarttī ca kiṃkaraḥ sthāpito mayā || || 14 || evamuktvā tato devi saṃsthāpya gaṇarakṣakam || ārūḍho'haṃ gireḥ prāṃtamudayādriṃ raviryathā || 15 || tato'valokito'tyarthaṃ ramaṇīyo mahā giriḥ || idaṃ ramyamidaṃ ramyamityasminvaraparvate || 16 || paśyato mama śaileṃdraṃ gatāḥ saṃvatsarā daśa || tvayātha ciṃtitaṃ devi kva gatastripurāṃtakaḥ||17|| nūnaṃ na madanātaptāṃ vetti māṃ rativarjitām || māṃ vihāya mahādevo nirviśaṃkaḥ kva varttate || 18 || harasya kvāpi yātasya vairaṃ saṃsmṛtya cittajaḥ || bādhate māmanaṃgopi cāparopitamārgaṇaḥ || vilokayaṃtīṃ hā dṛṣṭvā vilapaṃtīṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 19 || tataḥ kuṇḍo gaṇādhyakṣo jñātvā bhāvaṃ tvadīyakam || utkṛṣṭena svareṇoktaṃ mā devi vimanā bhava || 5.2.40.20 || āyāta eṣa te bharttā mā cetaḥ kaluṣaṃ kuru || etacchrutvā vacastasya kuṇḍasya kamalānane || 21 || duḥkhārttayā tvayā proktaḥ kuṇḍa vedmi na śaṃkaram || kva gataḥ kiṃ ca kurute kālaṃ dīrghamimaṃ śivaḥ || darśayasva mahādevamityukto' sau punaḥpunaḥ || 22 || yadā na darśitastena kuṇḍenāhaṃ varānane || tadā śaptastvayā devi kruddhayā gaṇarakṣakaḥ || 23 || gaccha tvaṃ mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ yasmānna kathito haraḥ || etasminnaṃtare devi prāpto'haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ || 24 || pṛṣṭaścāhaṃ tvayā devi vihāya kva gato'si mām || durgame parvate śūnye tasmāttya kṣyāmi jīvitam || 25 || gatvāgre bhūdharasyāsya kiṃ kṛtaṃ ca tvayā vibho || mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā kathitaṃ sarvameva tat || 26 || durādharṣataraḥ śailaḥ samaṃtādduratikramaḥ || tvatpriyārthaṃ mahābhāge mayā mārgo'valokitaḥ || 27 || yena mārgeṇa viśrabdhaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sumadhyame || ayaṃ kuṇḍo gaṇo devi viṣaṇṇo vyākulaḥ kṛtaḥ || 28 || tvayāpyuktaṃ mahādeva kuṇḍaḥ śapto mayā gaṇaḥ | mamājñā na kṛtā yasmādviphalaṃ na vaco mama || tasmādyātu mamādeśā nmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 29 || bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya yatra tvaṃ cottare sthitaḥ || tasyāgrataḥ sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ varttate kāmadaṃ sadā || 5.2.40.30 || tasya darśana mātreṇa gaṇapo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || kuṇḍeśvareti vikhyātaḥ sa devo vai bhaviṣyati || 31 || ityuktaḥ sa tvayā devi samāsādya punaḥpunaḥ || prasthāpitastvayādeśādvraja kuṇḍa mamājñayā || 32 || mahākālavanaṃ śīghraṃ liṃgamārādhya satvaram || kīrtiste bhavitā putra triṣu lokeṣu śāśvatī || 33|| ityuktastatkṣaṇātprāpto dṛṣṭvā liṅgaṃ tu śāśvatam || uttarasya śivasyāgre pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 34 || tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || yakṣāścāpsarasaścaiva samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 35 || athāhaṃ tatkṣaṇātprāptastvayā sārddhaṃ gaṇairvṛtaḥ || dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍaṃ gaṇeśaṃ tu liṃgārādhanatatparam || 36 || samādhidhyānanirataṃ proktamasmābhirādarāt || tuṣṭā te pārvatī putra prārthyatāṃ varamuttamam || 37 || akṣayaṃ tu padaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā liṃgasya darśanāt || adyaprabhṛti devo'yaṃ khyāto bhuvi bhaviṣyati || nāmnā kuṇḍeśvaro yasmātsarvasaṃpatkaraḥ sadā || 38 || kuṇḍeśvaramanādiṃ tu bhaktyā paśyati yo naraḥ || so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpsyati nānyathā || 39 || tasya dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ sadā || liṃgaṃ kuṇḍeśvaraṃ yastu bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyati||5.2.40.40|| daśānāmaśvamedhānāmagniṣṭomaśatasya ca|| sparśanātphalamāpnoti kuṇḍeśvarasya sarvadā||41|| prātaḥ paśyaṃti ye bhaktyā kṛtvā niyamapūrvakam|| siddhiṃ sukāmikīṃ hṛṣṭāḥ saṃprāpsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ||42|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kuṇḍeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu luṃpeśvaraṃ param||43|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kuṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || ||cha||
<5.2.41>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || catvāriṃśattamaṃ saikamīśvaraṃ viddhi pārvati || luṃpeśvaramiti khyātaṃ nāma yasya mahītale || 1 || deśe mlecchagaṇākīrṇe babhūva jagatīpatiḥ || luṃpādhipa iti khyāto maheṃdrasamavikramaḥ || 2 || tasyāsīddayitā bhāryā viśālānāma nāmataḥ || sā yauvanaguṇopetā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi || 3 || sa yuddhakāmo nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchadvijottamān || 4 || atha kenāpi kathitamāśrame sāmago dvijaḥ ||| tena sārddhaṃ mahābāho yudhyasva tvaṃ nṛpottama || 5 || tataḥ sa prasthito rājā mlecchaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasraśaḥ || tuṣārairbarbarairluṃpaiḥ pahlavaiḥ śvagaṇaistathā || 6|| dasyubhiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ krūraiḥ krodhenākuliteṃdriyaḥ || ājagāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmagasya munestadā || 7 || muninā pūjitastena madhuparkādiviṣṭaraiḥ || etasminnantare rājā homadhenuṃ dadarśa ha || 8 || prārthayāmāsa sahasā na dattā muninā tadā || pramathya cāśramaṃ tasya homadhenuṃ jahāra saḥ || vanaṃ babhaṃja sakalaṃ tasya viprasya paśyataḥ || 9 || kālyamānāṃ ca gāṃ dṛṣṭvā vatsaṃ cātīva duḥkhitam || uvāca vacanaṃ vipro mā rājansāhasaṃ kuru || 5.2.41.10 || evaṃ vadaṃtaṃ vipreṃdraṃ śaraistīkṣṇairjaghāna ha || luṃpaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo duṣṭo duṣṭajanairvṛtaḥ || 11 || asakṛtputraputreti vilapaṃtamanāthavat || hatvā ca sāmagaṃ vipraṃ jagāma svagṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ || 12 || etasminnaṃtare putraḥ samitpāṇirupāgataḥ || dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ vipraṃ tadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam || anāgasaṃ mahātmānaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 13 || kenedaṃ kutsitaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pāpena me pitā || ayudhyamāno vṛddhaḥ sanhataḥ śaraśataiḥ śiteḥ || 14 || vilapyaivaṃ sakaruṇaṃ bahunā nāvidhaṃ tathā || pretakāryāṇi sarvāṇi pituścakre vidhānataḥ || 15 || dadāha pitaraṃ cāgnau toyamādāya satvaram || tasya luṃpādhipasyāpi dadau śāpaṃ sudāruṇam || 16 || svadharmanirato vidvānyena me nihataḥ pitā || sa pāpātmā durācāraḥ kuṣṭharogamavāpnuyāt || 17 || etasminnantare rājā kuṣṭharogeṇa pīḍitaḥ || acaṃkramaṇatāṃ prāpto luṃpādhīśo varānane || 18 || auṣadhairadhiko'bhyeti brahmaśāpaprabhāvataḥ || vairāgyānmartukāmo'sau kāṣṭhānyādāya duḥkhitaḥ || 19 || citāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe samāyāto'tha nāradaḥ || pūjito vidhinā tena duḥkhitena nṛpeṇa hi || 5.2.41.20 || atha papraccha luṃpo'sau nāradaṃ munisattamam || akasmānmama devarṣe kuṣṭharogo babhūva ha || tenāhaṃ pīḍito'tīva na ca śāṃtiṃ vrajatyasau || 21 || auṣadhairvarddhate kasmādetadākhyātumarhasi || na testvaviditaṃ kiṃcidihaloke paratra ca || 22 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā luṃpādhīśasya nāradaḥ || kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ brahmaśāpaṃ sudustaram|| 23 || tataḥ sabhāryo nṛpatiḥ prārthayāmāsa nāradam || kathaṃ me bhagavañchāpo dustaro yāsyati kṣayam || 24 || evamuktastu lumpena nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || kāruṇyātkathayāmāsa sabhāryasya yaśasvini || 25 || mahākālavane rājam̐lliṃgaṃ kuṣṭhaharaṃ param || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ tatra vidyate pāpanāśanam || 26 || śiprāyāśca taṭe ramye keśavārkasya pūrvataḥ || tatra tvaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra kāṃtyā yukto bhaviṣyasi || 27 || evamuktastu luṃpo'sau hyājagāma tvarānvitaḥ || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam || 28 || prāptaḥ svargopamaṃ bhūpaḥ śiprayā pariśobhitam || viveśa ca mudā yukto dṛṣṭvā liṃgamanuttamam || 29 || snātvā śiprājale puṇye mahāpātakanāśane || darśanāttasya liṃgasya divyarūpo vabhūva ha || 5.2.41.30 || kuṣṭharogeṇa muktastu mukto vai brahmahatyayā || kṛtakṛtyo nṛpo jāto darśanādeva pārvati || 31 || sa tatra tāmuṣitvaikāṃ rajanīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || tāpasānāṃ paraṃ cakre satkāraṃ bhāryayā saha || 32 || tataḥ kṛtasvastvayanastāpasaistairmahātmabhiḥ || divyajñānānvitairdivyaiḥ sūryavaiśvānaraprabhaiḥ || 33 || kṛtaṃ nāma tadā tasya liṃgasya kamalānane || luṃpenārādhito yasmāddevo'yaṃ kuṣṭhanāśanaḥ || lumpeśvara iti khyāto bhaviṣyati mahītale || 34 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā liṃgaṃ lumpeśvaraṃ param || snātvā śiprājale puṇye te yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam || 35 || prārthayiṣyaṃti yānkāmānmanasā| cepsitānpriyān || tānāpsyaṃti na sandeho lumpeśasya ca darśanāt || 36 || mahāpāpasamāyukto yaḥ paśyati samāhitaḥ || liṃgaṃ lumpeśvaraṃ so'pi devatulyo bhaviṣyati || 37 || goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca mātṛhā gurutalpagaḥ || duṣṭakarmasamācāro bhrātṛhā pitṛhā tathā || 38 ||| | lumpeśvaraṃ sakṛtpaśyanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || pūjito'pi dahetpāpaṃ saptajanmārjitaṃ ca yat || 39 || ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve pūjayāmāsu ranvitāḥ || kuṣṭharogavinirmukto rājā svaviṣayaṃ gataḥ || 5.2.41.40 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || lumpeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu gaṃgeśvaraṃ param || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye luṃpeśvaramāhātmyava rṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || || cha ||
<5.2.42>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || dvācatvāriṃśataṃ devaṃ gaṃgeśvaramatho śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || dhruvādhāraṃ jagadyoneḥ padaṃ nārāyaṇasya tu || 1 || padātpravṛttā yā devī gaṃgā tripathagā nadī || sā praviśya sudhāyoniṃ somamādhāramaṃbhasām || 2 || tataḥ saṃvarddhamānārkaraśmisaṃgatipāvanī || papāta merupṛṣṭhe ca sā caturdhā tato yayau || 3 || merukūṭataṭāntebhyo nipatantī yaśasvinī || vikīryamāṇasalilā nirālaṃbā papāta sā || 4 || mandarādiṣu śaileṣu pravibhaktodakā samam || tatra sīteti vikhyātā yayau caitrarathaṃ vanam || 5 || tatplāyitvā ca yayāvaruṇodaṃ saridvarā || 6 || tathaivālakanandākhyā dakṣiṇe gandhamādane || merupādavanaṃ gatvā nandane devanandane ||7|| mānasaṃ ca mahāvegātplāvayitvā sarovaram || tasmācca śailarājānaṃ ramyaṃ triśikharaṃ gatā || 8 || tasmācca parvatāḥ sarve plāvitāstatkṣaṇātpriye || tānplāvayitvā saṃprāptā himavantaṃ mahāgirim || 9 || mayā dhṛtā ca tatraiva jaṭājūṭena pārvati || na muktā ca yadā gaṃgā tadā kruddhā mamopari || 5.2.42.10 || gātrāṇi plāvayāmāsa madīyāni varānane || mayā ca ruddhā krodhena jaṭāmadhye yaśasvini || 11 || tatraiva sā tapaścakre bahukalpaśatāni ca || bhagīrathenopavāsaiḥ stutyā cārādhito hyaham || 12 || tadā muktā mayā devi gaṃgā tripathagāminī || mahākālamanuprāptā plāvayitvottarānkurūn|| 13 || samudramahiṣī jātā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || nadīnāmuttamā gaṃgā samudreṇa kṛtā tadā || sa tayā sahito reme samudraḥ saritāṃpatiḥ || 14 || tataḥ kadācidbrahmāṇamupāsāṃcakrire surāḥ || tathārṇavo jagāmātha brahmalokaṃ sanātanam|| gaṃgayā sahito devi darśanārthaṃ mahotsave || 15 || atha gaṃgā saricchreṣṭhā samupāyātpitāmaham || tasyā vāsaḥ samuddhūtaṃ mārutena śaśiprabham || 16 || tato'bhavansuragaṇāḥ sahasā'vāṅmukhāstadā || mahābhiṣastu rājarṣirniḥśaṃko dṛṣṭavānnadīm || 17 || tasya bhāvaṃ viditvā'tha brahmaṇā sa tiraskṛtaḥ || uktastu jāto martyeṣu punarlokānavāpsyasi || 18 || gaṃgā śaptātha kruddhena samudreṇa yaśasvini || māṃ vihāyānyasaktāsi tasmādyāsyasi mānuṣam || 19 || lokamalpāyuṣaṃ dīnā tatra duḥkhamavāpsyasi || taṃ śāpaṃ dāruṇaṃ śrutvā gaṃgā vacanamabravīt || 5.2.42.20 || vināparādhācchaptāhaṃ kasmādvai devasaṃsadi || pativratā patiprāṇā patinā paramārthataḥ || 21 || pramādādvastramuddhūtaṃ vāyunā vyāpakena tu || pratyuvāca tato brahmā tāṃ nadīṃ lokapāvanīm || 22 || vasūnāṃ kāraṇāddevi śaptā yasmānmahānadi || bhāvyarthe toyanidhinā tasmācchīghraṃ vrajādhunā || 23 || mahākālavane ramye siddhagaṃdharvasevite || śiprāyā dakṣiṇe bhāge vidyate liṃgamuttamam|| 24 || sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || tamārādhaya yatnena sa te dāsyati vāṃchitam||25 || pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā tripathagāminī || gamanaṃ tatra me'bhīṣṭa vidyate yatsakhī mama || śiprāpi me priyā puṇyā mahāpātakanāśinī || 26 || iti saṃciṃtya manasā divyā devanadī tadā || ājagāma mahākāle hyapaśyalliṃgamuttamam || 27 || pūjayāmāsa payasā divyena vidhinā tadā || dṛṣṭvā śiprāṃ sakhīṃ tatra saṃśleṣaṃ cābhavattayoḥ || 28 || tataḥ prabhṛti saṃjātā sā śiprā pūrvavāhinī || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto devo gaṃgeśvaraḥ svayam || gaṃgayārādhito yasmātsamīhitaphalapradaḥ || 29 || saṃstutā devagaṃdharvairgaṃgā devanadī tadā || ṛṣibhirvālakhilyādyaistathānyairmunibhirmudā || 5.2.42.30 || samudrastatra saṃprāpto mānitā sā mahānadī || liṃgenoktā tadā gaṃgā kalayā sthīyatāmiti || 31 || tatsamīpe mahāpuṇye yāvattiṣṭhati medinī || aṃgīkṛtaṃ samudreṇa yathoktaṃ ca tathā stviti ||32|| evamuktvā gatā gaṃgā kalayā tatra saṃsthitā || gaṃgeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyetsnātvā śiprāṃbhasi priye || 33 || gosahasraphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tasya sarvadharmaphalaṃ tathā||34|| sarvayajñaphalaṃ samyaksarvadānaphalaṃ tathā || sarvayogaphalaṃ devi prāpnotyeva nirantaram||35|| tatra tīrthāni subhage pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānicit|| dharmāraṇyaṃ phalgutīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ gayā || 36 || prayāgaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ kedāramamareśvaram || caṃdrabhāgā vipāśā ca sarayūrdevikā kuhū || 37 || godāvarī śatadruśca bāhudā vetravatyapi || sarvā evātra saritaḥ saṃgatāḥ saṃti gaṃgayā || 38 || guptāni puṇyatīrthāni siddhakṣetrāṇi caiva hi || tatra sarvāṇi tiṣṭhaṃti kalāmātreṇa pārvati || 39 || eteṣāṃ phalamāpnoti yaḥ paśyati samāhitaḥ || snātvā gaṃgeśvaraṃ devaṃ satyametanmayoditam || ataḥ puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ gīyate gaṇavaṃdite ||5.2.42.40|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || gaṃgeśvarasya devasya śṛṇvaṃgāreśvaraṃ param || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye gaṃgeśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || || cha ||
<5.2.43>
|| śrīśiva uvāca || || catvāriṃśattamaṃ viddhi tryadhikaṃ parvatātmaje || yasya darśanamātreṇa jāyate sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 1 || ādikalpe purā jāto vakrāṃgo lohitacchaviḥ || raudrastvaṃgārasadṛśo mama gātrādvarānane || mayā dhṛto dharaṇyāṃ sa vikhyāto bhūmiputrakaḥ || 2 || jātamātre sute tasminmahākāye bhayāvahe || kaṃpitā dharaṇī devī devāstrastāḥ savāsavāḥ || 3 || kṣobhaṃ gatāḥ samudrāśca celuśca dharaṇīdharāḥ || tenaiva pīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 4 || ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ priye || 5 || socchvām̐sāḥ kathayāmāsurnamaskṛtya pitāmaham || vṛttāṃtaṃ vistarātsarvaṃ lokatrayavināśanam || 6 || haragātrodbhavenaiva jātamātreṇa līlayā || lokatrayaṃ samākrāṃtaṃ pīḍitaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tathā || 7 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ciṃtayitvā tu taiḥ sārddhamājagāma mamāṃtikam || 8 || mayā pṛṣṭāstu te sarve kimarthaṃ bhayavihvalāḥ || socchvāsahṛdayā dīnāḥ kasmādvo bhayamāgatam || 9 || taiḥ sarvaṃ kathitaṃ devi mamāgre bhayavihvalaiḥ || tvadaṃgasaṃbhavenaiva devadeva jagatpate || pīḍitaṃ bhakṣitaṃ caiva sadevāsuramānavam || 5.2.43.10 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā kṣemārthaṃ kṛpayā mayā || ākārito matsamīpamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 11 || ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva kiṃ karomītyuvāca saḥ || nākarṣa tvaṃ jagadidaṃ mayā proktaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 12 || mamāṃgādrajasā jātastenāṃgāraka ucyase || lokānāṃ svastaye nityaṃ maṃgalosi mayā kṛtaḥ || 13 || idānīṃ vakratāṃ yāto vakrastvaṃ gīyase budhaiḥ || vijñapto'haṃ tadā tena mama vākyaṃ śrutaṃ yadā || āhāreṇa vinā deva kathaṃ tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 14 || tasmānme dehi susthānamādhipatyaṃ ca dehi me || śaktiṃ ca dehi me śīghramāhāraṃ dehi me prabho || 15 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā putro'yaṃ mama vallabhaḥ || tasmāddāsyāmi paramaṃ sthānamakṣayamuttamam || 16 || iti saṃcintya manasā smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ mayottamam || utsaṃge ca sutaṃ kṛtvā premṇā proktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 17 || dattaṃ putra mayā sthānaṃ mahākālavanottame || gaṃgeśvarasya pūrve tu praśasyaṃ sthānamuttamam || 18 || khagartā caiva śiprā ca saṃgamastatra vidyate || 19 || yadā mayā dhṛtā gaṃgā tadā sā candramaṇḍalāt || pramādātpatitā bhūmau mahākālavanottame || 5.2.43.20 || khagarteti ca vikhyātā khādbhraṣṭā prāpatatkṣitau || ato mayāvatārastu sahasā tava vai kṛtaḥ || 21 || liṃgamūrtirahaṃ putra tiṣṭhāmi surapūjitaḥ || tatsthānaṃ durlabhaṃ devaistasmāttvaṃ gaccha satvaram || 22 || pūjito'haṃ tvayā tatra saṃgame lokapūjite || triṣu lokeṣu yāsyāmi khyātiṃ vai tava nāmataḥ || 23 || madhye grahāṇāṃ sarveṣāmādhipatyaṃ mayā tava || dattaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ sthānaṃ tatra tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 24 || pūjāṃ prāpsyasi tatraiva grahamadhye vyavasthitaḥ || tithirdattā caturthī te tasyāṃ ye vratatatparāḥ || || 25|| tvāmuddiśya kariṣyaṃti pūjāṃ śāṃtiṃ sadakṣiṇām || tena sarveṇa te tṛptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 26 || vāraścaikaśca te datto maṃgalārthaṃ mayā tava || navavastraparīdhānaṃ vidyāraṃbhaṃ dine tava || tailābhyaṃgaṃ kariṣyaṃti na ca prāpsyaṃti te balam || 27 || ityuktastu mayā devi vakrāṃgo maṃgalaḥ sutaḥ || aṃgāraketi vikhyātastathetyaṃgīcakāra saḥ || 28 || santuṣṭastena vākyena madīyena varānane || ājagāma mudā yukto mahākālavanottame || 29 || śiprāyāśca taṭe ramye khagarttāsaṃgamāṃtikam || dṛṣṭo'haṃ liṃgarūpeṇa parāṃ tuṣṭimupāgataḥ || || 5.2.43.30 || mayā cāliṃgitaḥ premṇā cumbitaḥ śirasi priye || varo datto viśālākṣi vāṃchitaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 31 || dṛṣṭo'haṃ ca tvayā putra bhaktyā cārādhitastvayā || mama vākyaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāttasmāttuṣṭo'smi maṃgala || 32 || aṃgāreśvaranāmāhamadyaprabhṛti putraka || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyā to bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || ye māṃ paśyaṃti satataṃ saṃgame'tra vyavasthitam || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirbhaviṣyati mahītale || 34 || ye māṃ saṃpūja yiṣyaṃti hyaṃgārakadine narāḥ || kalau yuge kṛtārthāste bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || caturthyāṃ maṃgaladine ye māṃ paśyaṃti suvratāḥ || na te yāsyaṃti saṃsāre ghore duḥkhaśatākule || 36 || amāvāsyā ca bhaumaśca saṃyogo dṛśyate yadā || khagarttāyāśca śiprāyāḥ saṃgame devapūjite || 37 || snātvā tadā prapaśyaṃti māmatraiva vyavasthitam || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ devi samāsācchṛṇu sāṃpratam || 38 || vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge ca kurukṣetre ca yatphalam || gayāyāṃ puṣkare proktaṃ tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ bhavet || 39 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || aṃgāreśvaradevasya śrūyatāmuttareśvaram|| 5.2.43.40 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmyeṃ'gārakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43|| || || cha ||
<5.2.44>
|| īśvara uvāca || || catvāriṃśattamaṃ viddhi caturbhiradhikaṃ param|| yasya darśanamātreṇa samīhitaphalaṃ labhet || uttareśamiti khyātaṃ samīhi taphalapradam||1|| purā niyuktāḥ śakreṇa ye meghā vṛṣṭikārakāḥ || taiḥ plāvitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ saparvatamahītalam||2|| ekārṇave tato jāte devā bhītā varānane || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāḥ svadhāsvāhāvivarjitāḥ ||3|| naivāpyāyanamasmākaṃ vinā homena jāyate|| vayamāpyāyitā viprairyajñabhāgairyathocitaiḥ ||4|| teṣāṃ vayaṃ prayacchāmaḥ kāmānyajñādipūjitāḥ || nāsti tatsarvamevaitadanyonyamavadansurāḥ || 5 || dṛṣṭvā pṛṣvīṃ jale magnāṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || kathayāmāsuratyugraṃ namaskṛtya pitāmaham ||6|| ekārṇavā mahī jātā vinaṣṭāḥ kratavaḥ prabho || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ jagajjātaṃ pitāmaha ||7|| devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || muhūrtta ciṃtayāmāsa kimetaditi vismitaḥ || 8 || akāle pralayaḥ kasmānnimagnā pṛthivī jale || gatā sṛṣṭirmadīyā tu vyarthaṃ jātaṃ vaco mama || 9 || iti saṃciṃtya hṛdaye sasmāra balasūdanam || smṛtamātrastu balahā hyājagāma pitāmaham || 5.2.44.10 || provāca vacanaṃ śrutvā nama skṛtya pitāmaham || smṛto'haṃ kena kāryeṇa dehyājñāṃ me pitāmaha || 11 || brahmaṇoktastadā śakraḥ kimarthaṃ plāvitā mahī || asaṃbaddhaistvadīyaiśca meghaiḥ kiṃ sahasā kṛtam || 12 || tataḥ sarve samāhūtā meghāḥ śakreṇa pārvati || pitāmahasamakṣaṃ tu samāyātāśca tatkṣaṇāt || 13 || pitāmahena śakreṇa maryādā ca kṛtā tadā || gajonāma mahāmeghaḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi nirmitaḥ || 14 || gajākāraistato meghaiḥ sahasrairdaśabhirvṛtaḥ || gavayo dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ ṣaṭ sahasrādhipaḥ kṛtaḥ || 15 || śarabhaḥ paścimāmāśāṃ sahasrādhipatiḥ kṛtaḥ || uttaronāma yo megho meghaiḥ koṭibhirāvṛtaḥ || 16 || uttarasyāṃ diśi tadā prabhutve saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || maryādā ca kṛtā devi brahmaṇā vāsavena tu || 17 || prāvṛṭkāle ca varṣadhvaṃ nakṣatrairjalajaidrutam || ārdrādisvātiparyaṃtaṃ nakṣatrada śakaṃ smṛtam|| 18 || brahmaśakravacaḥ śrutvā tatheti kṛtaniścayāḥ || vavṛṣurniyate kāle tannāmāni bhavaṃti hi || 19 || evaṃ vyavasthite loke maryādāyāṃ sthitā ghanāḥ || brāhmaṇā vijvarā jātāstridaśā muditā bhṛśam|| 5.2.44.20|| krūragrahairatho ruddhāste meghā vṛṣṭikārakāḥ || śanaiścareṇa bhaumena bhāskareṇātha ketunā || 21 || pīḍitāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmurvāsavaṃ bhayavihvalāḥ || niveditaṃ bhayātsarvaṃ namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ || 22 || meghānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃtrasto vāsavastadā || uvāca vacanaṃ teṣāṃ nāhaṃ śakto nivāraṇe || grahāṇāmasamartho'haṃ sarvadaiva payodharāḥ || 23 || ahaṃ rājyātparibhraṣṭaḥ kṛtaḥ krūragrahaiḥ purā || sthāpito'haṃ kadācicca suprasannairgrahaiḥ pade ||24 || mama mānyāśca pūjyāśca grahā eva yatodhikāḥ || grahāḥ srarvaharāḥ proktā iti me varttate matiḥ || || 25 || etasminnaṃtare bhūmau saṃjātā śatavārṣikī || anāvṛṣṭirmahāraudrā sarvaprāṇivināśinī || 26 || asthikaṃkālaśakalā śvetaparvatasannibhā || pṛthivī tatkṣaṇājjātā vinā toyena pārvati || 27 || devāḥ sarve punarbhītā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || ūcuśca praṇatāḥ sarve trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān || ||28|| anāvṛṣṭyā jagatsarvaṃ pīḍitaṃ ca pitāmaha || akāle pralayo jātaḥ punareva ca tādṛśaḥ ||29|| tvayā ca vāsavenaiva niyuktā ye payodharāḥ || kūragrahairatīvograiḥ pīḍitāste pitāmaha|| 5.2.44.30 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ahaṃ bibhemi bho devā grahaistairbalavattaraiḥ || 31 || sarvaṃ jānāmi māhātmyaṃ grahāṇāṃ krūracetasām || śanaiścareṇa vakreṇa bhavaṃtaḥ pīḍitāḥ sadā || 32 || varuṇo yādasāṃ nātho maṃgalena prapīḍitaḥ || rājyabhraṣṭastu bahudhā ketunā vāsavaḥ kṛtaḥ || 33 || śiraśchedo mayā prāpto vakreṇa raviṇā purā || ekaikaśaḥ samarthāste kiṃ punaḥ saṃghaśastvamī || tasmātsarve mahādevaṃ gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ vayam||34|| brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ|| brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya māmava śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ||35|| ukto'haṃ tridaśaiḥ sarvaiḥ pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān || tvaṃ no dhātā vidhātā ca sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ||36|| krūragrahairmahādeva ruddhā meghāḥ samaṃtataḥ|| na kurvaṃti prabho vṛṣṭimanāvṛṣṭiḥ sudāruṇā|| sarvaprāṇivināśāya saṃjātā śatavārṣikī|| teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mayā jñātaṃ varānane|| krūragrahāṇāṃ sāmarthyaṃ yathā ca viditaṃ mama||38|| iti jñātvā mahādevi upāyaściṃtito mayā|| uttaro nāma yo megho meghaiḥ koṭibhirāvṛtaḥ|| āhūtastatkṣaṇātprāptaḥ kiṃ karomītyuvāca ha || 39 || mayā prokto mamādeśādgaccha tvaṃ ghanasaṃyutaḥ || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ vāṃchitārthaphalapradam || 5.2.44.40 || gaṃgeśvarasya devasya dakṣiṇe liṃgamuttamam || tamārādhaya yatnena sa te dāsyati vāṃchitam || 41 || evamukto mayā megha uttaro meghasaṃyutaḥ || jagāma tvarayā yukto mahākālavanottame || 42 || dṛṣṭvā vṛṣṭikaraṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || śiprājalaṃ gṛhītvā tu snātvā snātvā prayatnataḥ || tāvadyāvajjalaṃ śiprāṃ punarevāgataṃ priye || 43 || etasminnaṃtare tasmādudbhūtaṃ dhūmamaṃḍalam || liṃgamadhyādvarārohe jvālāmālākulaṃ mahat || 44 || tato jvālāmayaṃ sarva mabhūdambaragocaram || tasya jvālāsamūhena dagdhaṃ vai grahamaṃḍalam || 45 || sanakṣatrapathaṃ yāvattato bhītā grahāḥ priye || tameva śaraṇaṃ prāptā dhūmajvālākulānanāḥ || 46 || tato brahmā ca viṣṇuśca taddṛṣṭvā mahadadbhutam || devairvṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo liṃgāṃtikamupāgataḥ || 47 || talliṃgaṃ sumahājvālaṃ jvālābhiḥ pūritāṃbaram || duḥprekṣyaṃ durvidaṃ bhīmaṃ varddhamānaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 48 || akṣṇornimeṣamātreṇa vavṛdhe yojanāyutam || dṛṣṭvā tu varddhamānasya liṃgasyātya dbhutākṛtim || sureśo mohamāpanno visaṃjñāśca grahāstadā || 49 || tatastu tasya liṃgasya vāridhārā viniḥsṛtāḥ || ekoddeśādvarārohe dharā tvekārṇa vīkṛtā || 5.2.44.50 || liṃgasyānyapradeśāttu vāyuḥ samabhavanmahān || itarasminpradeśe tu samūhastaḍitāmabhūt || 51 || sadhūmā samabhūjjvālā liṃgasyānya pradeśataḥ || 52 || evamatyadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā varddhamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ || liṅgamavyaktamudbhūtamāpūritanabho'ntaram || 53 || grahāśca vihvalā jātā dhūmenākulite ndriyāḥ || tuṣṭuvuśca tadā ligaṃ dahyamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ || 54 || || grahā ūcuḥ || || namaḥ surūpāya surārcitāya namo virūpaprakṛtikriyāya || namonamo rūpanirāśrayāya jalasvarūpāya namo namaste || 55 || iti stuto yadā devi grahaiḥ krūraistadā priye || liṃgātprādurabhūtkhasthaḥ svarūpo vigrahākṛtiḥ || 56 || bhasmadhūsarasarvāṃgo bhogibhogāṃgadojjvalaḥ || himarāśinibhākāro rajatācalanirmalaḥ || uvāca caitānpraṇatāngrahānkaṃpitaka ndharāna || 57 || kiṃ vā kāmaṃ mano'bhīṣṭaṃ bhavadbhyo yaddadāmyaham || mamāmoghamidaṃ sarvaṃ darśanaṃ cātidurlabham || 58 || bhavadbhyo lokatuṣṭyarthaṃ darśanaṃ hi dadāmyaham || evamuktvā grahāḥ sarve procuḥ prāṃjalayastadā || 59 || yadi deyo varo deva yadi tuṣṭo'si śaṃkara || karmāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu pūjā' smākaṃ yathā bhavet || tathā kuru mahādeva tena tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 5.2.44.60 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā meghaṃ cottaramuktavān || tuṣṭo'smyahaṃ tu te vatsa gṛhāṇa varamīpsitam || 61 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tatra hyuttaraḥ prāha harṣitaḥ || yanme tuṣṭo'si bhagavaṃstanmahyaṃ dīyatāṃ varam || 62 || yadāsmākaṃ mahābādhāṃ kadā kopi kariṣyati || tadā vṛṣṭirvidhātabyā tvayā deva sadā bhuvi || 63 || rakṣā kāryā ca meghānāṃ rakṣaṇīyāstvayā vayam|| evamastviti tenoktaṃ liṃgena nagagātraje || 64 || adyaprabhṛti te nāmnā khyātiṃ yāsyāmi bhūtale.|| uttareśvarasaṃjño'haṃ prabhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 65 || ye māṃ saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || teṣāṃ dāsyāmi satataṃ vāṃchitārthaphalaṃ bhuvi || 66 || paśyaṃti prayatā ye māṃ kṛtvā niyamapūrvakam || te yāsyaṃti puraṃ śaivaṃ yāvatkalpāṣṭakāyutam || 67 || ārūḍhāḥ sūryasaṃkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || rudrakanyāsamākīrṇairhaṃsasārasasaṃyutaiḥ || 68 || nṛtya vāditranirghuṣṭairutkaṭadhvanināditaiḥ || dodhūyamānaiśca naraiḥ stūyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ || 69 || prasaṃgādbhaktihīno'pi yo māṃ paśyatyaśāṭhyataḥ || aiśvaryaṃ tasya dāsyāmi hyuttareṣu kuruṣvatha || 5.2.44.70 || smariṣyati ca yo nityaṃ prabhāte cottareśvaram || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam|| 71 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || uttareśvaradevasya śṛṇu trilocaneśvaram || 72 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya uttareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || || cha ||
<5.2.45>
|| śrīdevadeva uvāca | || paṃcacatvārikaṃ viddhi devaṃ trilocaneśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvasiddhiravāpyate || 1 || itihāsamihāsīdyatpīṭhe virajasaṃjñake || trilocanasya prāsāde maṇimāṇikyanirmite || 2 || nānābhaṃgigavākṣāḍhye ratnasānāvivāpare || dedīpyamānasauvarṇakalaśena virājite || || 3 || pārvaṇena śaśāṃkena khedādiva samāsite || tatra pārāvatadvaṃdvaṃ vasatsvairaṃ kṛtālayam || 4 || prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca madhyāhne kurva nnityapradakṣiṇam || uḍḍīyamānaṃ paritaḥ pakṣavātairitastataḥ || 5 || rajaḥprāsādasaṃlagnaṃ dūrīkurvaddiśo daśa || trilocaneti satataṃ nāma bhaktairudāhṛtam || triviṣṭapeti ca tathā tayoḥ karṇātithībhavet || 6 || caturvidhāni vādyāni śaṃbhuprītikarāṇyalam || tayoḥ karṇaguhāṃ prāpya pratiśabdaṃ pratanvate || 7 || maṃgalārātrikajyotistrisaṃdhyaṃ pakṣiṇostayoḥ || netrāṃtaṃ nirviśannityaṃ bhaktaceṣṭāṃ pradarśayat || 8 || prāṇayātrāṃ vihāyāpi kadācitsthiramānasau || noḍḍīya vāṃchitaṃ yātaḥ paśyaṃtau kautukaṃ khagau || 9 || tatrāsakṛjjanākīrṇaṃ prāsādaṃ parito'vanau || taṃḍulādi caraṃtau tau kurvaṃtau ca pradakṣiṇam || 5.2.45.10 || devadakṣiṇadigbhāge viṣṇudehodbhavaṃ jalam || tṛṣārttau pibato nityaṃ snātvā cājagmatuśca tau || 11|| tayoritthaṃ vicaratostrilocanasamīpataḥ || agādbahutithaḥ kālo dvijayoḥ sādhuceṣṭayoḥ || 12 || atha devālayaskaṃdhe gavākṣāṃtargatau ca tau|| śyenena kenaciddṛṣṭau krūradṛṣṭyā sukhaṃ sthitau || 13 || tacca pārāvatadvaṃdvaṃ śyenaḥ parijighṛkṣayā || avatīryāṃbarādāśu upaviṣṭaḥ śivālaye || 14 || tato vilokayāmāsa tadāgamavinirgamau || kena mārgeṇa viśato durgameṇa patatriṇau || 15 || kenādhvanā ca niryātaḥ kiṃkāle kurutaśca kim || kathaṃ yugapadetau me grāhyau svairaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ || 16 || durbalo'pyākalayituṃ sahasārirna śakyate || kariṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa varāśvānāṃ ca lakṣataḥ || 17 || na karma siddhyennṛpaterdugeṇaikena yadbhavet || durgastho nābhibhūyeta vipakṣaḥ kenacitkvacit|| svataṃtraṃ yadi durgaṃ syādapamārgaprakāśakam ||18|| iti durge balaṃ śaṃsañchyeno roṣāruṇekṣaṇaḥ || asādhvasau kalaravau vīkṣya yāto nabhoṃgaṇe || 19 || atha pārāvatī dakṣā vipakṣakṣapaṇekṣaṇam || mahābalaṃ durgabalātprāha pārā vataṃ patim || 5.2.45.20 || || kalaravyuvāca || || priya pārāvata prājña sarvakāmasukhārava || tava dṛgviṣayaṃ prāptaḥ śyeno'yaṃ prabalo ripuḥ || 21 || sa ca tadvākyamākarṇya pārāvatyāśca satpatiḥ || pārāvatīmuvācedaṃ kā ciṃteti tava priye || 22 || pārāvata uvāca || || kati nāma na saṃtīha subhage vyomacāriṇaḥ || kati devālayādyeṣu khagā nopavasaṃti hi || 23 || kati caiva na paśyaṃti nau sukhasthāviha priye || tebhyo yadīha bhetavyaṃ kuto nau tatsukhaṃ priye || 25 || rama tvaṃ ca mayā sārddha tyaja ciṃtāmimāṃ śubhe || asya śyenavarākasya gaṇanāpi na me hṛdi ||25|| itthaṃ pārāvatavarācchutvā pārāvatī vacaḥ || maunamālambya saṃtasthe patyuḥ pādārpitekṣaṇā || 26 || hitavatyopadiśyāpi priyaṃ priyacikīrṣayā || patnyā joṣaṃ samāstheyaṃ kāryaṃ patyurvacaḥ sadā || 27 || anyedyurapyathāyātaḥ śyenaḥ paśyansa daṃpatī || aparicchinnayā dṛṣṭyā yathā mṛtyurgatāyuṣam || 28 || atha maṃḍalagatyā sa prāsādaṃ parito bhraman || provāca preyasī nātha dṛṣṭo duṣṭastvayā'hitaḥ || 29 || tasyā vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ kalaravo'bravīt || kiṃ kariṣyatyasau mugdhe mama vyomavihāriṇaḥ || 5.2.45.30 || durgaṃ ca svargatulyaṃ me yatra nāstyarito bhayam || ayaṃ na tāṃ gatiṃ vetti yāṃ vedāhaṃ nabhoṃgaṇe || 31 || praḍīnoḍḍīnasaṃḍīnakāṃḍavyāṃḍakapāṭikā || sraṃsinī maṃḍalavatī gatayo'ṣṭāvudāhṛtāḥ || 32 || yathaitāsu hi kauśalyaṃ mayi varttati ca priye || gatiṣu kvāpi kasyāpi pakṣiṇo na tathāṃbare|| sukhena tiṣṭha kā ciṃcā mayi jīvati te priye||33|| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā āsthitā mūkavatsatī|| aparedyurapi śyenastatrāyātaḥ śilātale|| kiyadaṃtaramāsādya upaviṣṭo'tihṛṣṭavat|| āyāmāṃte ca sa sthitvā tatkulāyakulasya ca|35|| punaḥ śyeno viniryātaḥ sāpi kāṃtā'bravītpunaḥ|| priya sthānamidaṃ tyājyaṃ duṣṭadṛṣṭividūṣitam||36|| asau krūro'tinikaṭamupaviṣṭo'tihṛṣṭavat|| sāvajñaṃ sa punaḥ prāha kiṃ kariṣyatyasau priye || 37 || mṛgākṣīṇāṃ svabhāvoyaṃ prāyaśo bhīruvṛttayaḥ || itaredyurapi prāptaḥ sa ca śyeno mahābalaḥ || || 38 || tayorabhimukhaṃ tatra sthito yāmadvayāvadhi || punarvilokya tadvartma śīghraṃ yāto yathāgatam || 39 || gatetha śakunau tasminsā babhāṣe vihaṃgamam|| nātha sthānāṃtaraṃ yāvo mṛtyurvai nikaṭe'nvagāt || 5.2.45.40 || punardṛṣṭe praṇaṣṭaḥ syādāvāsaśca sukhaṃ priya || priya yasyāsti pakṣasya gatiḥ sarvatra siddhidā || 41 || sa kiṃ svadeśarāgeṇa nāśaṃ prāpnoti buddhimān || sopasargaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ tyaktvā yonyaṃ tu na vrajet || 42 || sa paṃgurnā śamāpnoti kūlasthita iva drumaḥ || priyoditaṃ niśamyeti sa bhavitrīdaśārdditaḥ || 43 || tāṃ vākyaṃ punarapyāha priye mā bhaiḥ khagārditā || aparasminnahani ca sa śyenaḥ prātareva hi ||44|| taddvāradeśamāsādya sāyaṃ yāvatsthito'calaḥ || astācalasya śikharaṃ yāte bhānau gate khage || 45 || kulāyādbāhyamāgatyovāca pārāvatī patim || nātha nirgamanasyāyaṃ kālaḥ kālo'sti dūrataḥ ||46|| yāvattāvadviniryāhi tyaktvā māmapi śaṃsinīm || tvayi jīvati duṣprāpyaṃ na kiṃcijjagatītale || 47 || punardārāḥ punaḥ putrāḥ punarvasu punargṛham || yadyātmārakṣitaḥ puṃsāṃ dāraipi dhanairapi || 48 || tadā sarvaṃ hariścaṃdrabhūpateriva labhyate || ayamātmā priyo baṃdhurayamātmā mahaddhanam ||49|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmayamātmārjakaḥ paraḥ || yāvadātmani vai kṣemaṃ tāva tkṣemaṃ jagattraye ||5.2.45.50|| so'pi kṣemaḥ sugatinā yaśasā saha vāṃchyate || yaśohīnaṃ tu yatkṣemaṃ takṣemānnidhanaṃ varam ||51|| tadyaśaḥ prāpyate puṃbhirnītimārgaṃ pravartibhiḥ || ato nītipathaṃ ciṃtyaṃ nātha sthānādito vraja|| na vrajiṣyasi cetprātastato māṃ saṃsmariṣyasi ||52|| ityukto'pi sa vai patnyā pārāvatyā sumedhayā || na niryayau tataḥ sthānādbhavitryā prativāritaḥ ||53|| athoṣasi samāgatya śyenena balinā tadā || nirgamadvāramāruddhaṃ kiṃcidbhakṣya vatā tadā || 54 || dināni katicittatrātiṣṭhacchayeno mahābalaḥ || pārāvatamuvācedaṃ dhiktvā pauruṣavarjitam || 55 || kiṃ vā yudhyasva durbuddhe kiṃ vā niryāhi me girā || kṣudhākṣīṇo mṛtaḥ paścānnirayaṃ paśyasi dhuvam || vidhireva hi sāhāyyaṃ na kuryāttava noditam || 56 || itthaṃ śyenena sa proktaḥ patnyā sa sahitaḥ khagaḥ || ayudhyattena śyenena svadurgadvāramāśritaḥ || 57 || kṣudhitastṛṣitaḥ so'tha śyenena balinā dhṛtaḥ || caraṇena dṛḍhenāśu caṃcvā sāpi dhṛtā khagī || 58 || tāvādāyoḍḍayāṃcakre śyeno vyomani satvaram || ciṃtayanbhakṣaṇasthānamanyatpakṣivivarjitam || 59 || atha patnyā kalaravaḥ proktastatra sumedhayā|| yato'vamānitā nātha tvayāhaṃ strīti buddhitaḥ||5.2.45.60|| ato'vasthāmimāṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ kuryāmabalā yataḥ|| adhunāpi vacaścaikaṃ karoṣi yadi me priya || 61 || tadā hitaṃ te vakṣyāmi kurve tadavicāritam || mamaikavākyakaraṇātstrījito na bhaviṣyasi || 62 || yāvadāsyaṃ gatāsmyasya yāvatkhastho na bhūmigaḥ || tāvadātmavimuktyai tvaṃ caṃcvā pādaṃ dṛḍhaṃ daśa || 63 || iti patnīvacaḥ śrutvā tathā sa kṛtavānkhagaḥ || sa pīḍito dṛḍhaṃ pāde śyenaścītkṛtavānbahu || 64 || tena cītkaraṇenātha muktā sā mukhasaṃpuṭāta || pādāṃgulīnāṃ śūnyatve so'pi pārāvato'patat || || 65 || vipadyapi ca prājñairna saṃtyājyaḥ kvacidudyamaḥ || kva ca caṃcupuṭastasya kva ca tatpādapīḍanam ||66|| kva ca dvayostathābhūtaṃ dūre mokṣaṇamadbhutam|| durbale'pyudyamaḥ śreyāniti śāstreṣu gīyate || 67 || tasmādbhāgyānusāreṇa phalatyeva sadodyamaḥ || praśaṃsaṃtyudyamaṃ cāto vipadyapi manīṣiṇaḥ || 68 || | atha tau kālayogena jaṃbūmārge mṛtau tadā || jaṃbūmārge mṛtā ye vai teṣāṃ svargaḥ sadā'kṣayaḥ || 69 || puṇyaśeṣe tadā jāto gaṃdharvatanayaḥ śubhaḥ || maṃdāradāmatanayo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ || 5.2.45.70 || anekavidyānilayaḥ kalākauśalabhājanam || kaumāraṃ vapurāsādya śivabhaktiparo'bhavat || 71 || niyamaṃ cāpi jagrāha vijitedriyamānasaḥ ||| ekapatnīvrataṃ nityaṃ cariṣyāmīti niścitam || 72 || parayoṣitsamāsaktirāyuḥ kīrtiṃ rbalaṃ sukham || haretsvargagatiṃ cāpi tasmāttāṃ varjayetsudhīḥ || 73 || aparaṃ cāpi niyamaṃ sa śuciṣmānsamādade || gatajanmāṃtarābhyāsāvilocanasamāśrayāt ||74|| | samastapuṇyanilayaḥ samastārthaprakāśakaḥ || samastakāmajanakaṃ parānaṃdaikakāraṇam || 75 || yāvaccharīraṃ nirujaṃ yāvannedriyaviplavaḥ || tāvattrilocanovaṃtyāṃ maṃtavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 76 || itthaṃ maṃdāradāmiḥ sa kāśyāṃ parimalālayaḥ || nityaṃ triviṣṭapaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgacchetprayatnataḥ ||77|| pārāvatyapi saṃjātā ratnadīpasya maṃdire || nāgarājasya pātāle nāmnā ratnāvalīti ca || 78 || samastanāgakanyānāṃ rūpaśīlakalāguṇaiḥ || ekaiva ratnabhūtā''sīdratna dīporagātmajā || 79 || tasyāḥ sakhīdvayaṃ cāsīdekā nāmnā prabhāvatī || kalāvatī tathānyā ca nityaṃ tadanuge śubhe || 5.2.45.80 || svadehādanapāyinyau chāyākāṃtī yathā tathā || pūrve sakhyau bhavetāṃ hi ratnāvalyā maheśvari || 81 || sā tu bālye vyatikrāṃte kiṃcidudbhinnayauvanā || śivabhaktaṃ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā niyamamagrahīt || 82 || pitastrilocanaṃ kāśyāmarcayitvā dinedine || ābhyāṃ sakhībhyāṃ sahitā maunaṃ tyakṣyāmi nānyathā || || 83 || evaṃ nāgakumārī sā sakhīdvayasamanvitā || trilocanaṃ samabhyarcya gṛhānaharaharvrajat || 84 || māṃ pratyagraiḥ sukusumaiḥ suśubhairi ṣṭagaṃdhibhiḥ || suvicitrāṇi mālyāni pariguṃphyārcayedvibhum || 85 || tisro'pi gītaṃ gāyaṃti lalitaṃ caiva susvaram || nārīmaṃḍalabhedena lāsyaṃ tisro'pi rvate || 86 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāṃśca layatālavicakṣaṇāḥ || vādayaṃti mudāyuktāstisro'pi viramaṃti vai || 87 || itthamārādhayaṃtīśaṃ tisro nāgakumārikāḥ || vicitrabhaṃgīmālābhirarcayaṃtyastrilocanam || 88 || prātaścaturthyāṃ tāḥ snātvā tīrthe pilipile śubhe || trilocanaṃ samarcyātha prasuptā raṃgamaṇḍape || 89 || suptāsu tāsu sa śivastrinetraḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || vāmārddhavilasacchaktirnāgayajñopavītakaḥ || 5.2.45.90 || liṃgādeva hi nirgatya gaṃgāpannagamekhalaḥ || pratyuvāca tataḥ kanyā vibhuruttiṣṭhateti saḥ || 91 || utthāya tā vinirmathya locane śrutisaṃgame || aṃgamoṭanavatyaśca tadā nirghūrṇitekṣaṇāḥ || 92 || yāvatpaśyaṃti purataḥ saṃbhramāpannamānasāḥ || atarkitāgamastāvattābhirdṛṣṭastrilocanaḥ || 93 || vavaṃdire'tha tā bālā jñātvā lakṣmabhirīśvaram || tuṣṭuvuśca prahṛṣṭāstāḥ sannakaṃṭhyo'tiviklavam || 94 || jaya śaṃbho jayeśāna jaya sarvaga sarvada || jaya tripurasaṃhartarjayāṃdhakaniṣūdana || 95 || jaya jālaṃdharahara jaya kaṃdarpadarpahṛt || jaya trailokyajanaka jaya trailokyavaṃdita || jaya bhaktajanādhīśa jaya pramatha nāyaka || 96 || namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namonamaḥ || trilocana namastubhyaṃ triviṣṭapa namo'stu te || 97 || ityuktvā daṃḍavadbhūmau praṇipetuḥ kumārikāḥ || athotthāpya kumārīstāḥ provāca śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || 98 || suto maṃdāradāmnaśca nāmnā parimalālayaḥ || patirvidyādharavaro bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati || 99 || ciraṃ vidyādhare loke bhogānbhuktvā samaṃtataḥ || tato hyavaṃtikāṃ prāpya māṃ dhyātvā siddhimāpsyatha || 5.2.45.100 || janmāṃtarepi me bhaktirbhavatībhiśca tena ca || vihitā tena vo janma nirmalaṃ bhaktibhāvitam || 101 || etatprabhāvatīstotraṃ ye paṭhiṣyaṃti me puraḥ || tebhyaḥ kāmānpradāsyāmi bhavatīnāmayaṃ varaḥ || 102 || ityuktavati deveśe tāḥ kanyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || praṇamya procurīśānaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ || 103 || || || nāgakanyā ūcuḥ || pṛcchāmo brūhi no nātha karuṇākara śaṃkara || janmāṃtare kathaṃ sevā caturbhirbhavataḥ kṛtā || 104 || tataḥ prāktanavṛttāṃta metasyāpi kṛtātmanaḥ || asmākamapi cākhyāhi kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe || 105 || iti śrutvā praṇayato bālodīritamīpsitam || provāca tāsāmapi ca bhavāṃtaraviceṣṭitam || 106 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ nāgatanayāstisropi hi samāhitāḥ || prāgbhavaṃ bhavatīnāṃ ca tasyāpi kathayāmyaham ||107|| eṣā ratnāvalī pūrvamāsītpārāvatī khagī || sa ca vidyādharavaraḥ patirasyāḥ khago'bhavat ||108|| prāsāde ca mamaitābhyāmuṣitaṃ suciraṃ sukham|| rajaḥ prāsādasaṃlagnaṃ nunnaṃ pakṣānilaiḥ punaḥ || 109 || upariṣṭādadhastācca kṛtā bhūripradakṣiṇāḥ || vyomni saṃcaramāṇābhyāṃ saṃcīrṇaṃ ca mamājire || 5.2.45.110 || snātaṃ caturnade tīrthe pītaṃ tatrāṃbu cāsakṛt || ābhyāṃ kalaravābhyāṃ ca kṛtāḥ kalaravā mudā || 111 || etābhyāṃ sthiracittābhyāṃ muditā tvamatīva hi || dṛṣṭvā hi kautukānyatra mama bhaktaiḥ kṛtānyapi || 112 || amūbhyāṃ bahuśo dṛṣṭā mama maṃgaladīpikāḥ || pītaṃ śrutipuṭābhyāṃ ca mama nāmākṣarāmṛtam || tiryagyoniprabhāvena na mṛtau mama saṃnidhau ||113|| jaṃbūmārge mṛtau yasmātsvargaprāptikare dhruvam || tasmātpārāvatī hyeṣā ratnadīpasutā'bhavat || 114 || patiḥ pārāvato'syāśca jāto vidyādharāṃgajaḥ || eṣā prabhāvatī nāgī nāgarājasya sadmani || iha janmani kanyāsītpūrvajanma bravīmi ca || 115 || triśikhasyorageṃdrasya sutā ceyaṃ kalāvatī || etasyā api vṛttāṃtaṃ niśāmaya tu vacmyaham || ||116 || bhavāṃtare tṛtīyetaḥ kanye cārāyaṇasya ca || āstāṃ maharṣeḥ śīlāḍhye premavatyau parasparam || 117 || pitrā cārāyaṇenāpi tābhyāṃ saṃpreritena vai || āmuṣyāyaṇaputrāya datte nārāyaṇāya hi || 118 || aprāptayauvanoraṇye samidāharaṇāya vai || gato vidhivaśāddaṣṭo daṃdaśūkena kānane || 119 || bhavānīgautamīnāmnyau te tu cārāyaṇāṃgaje || vaidhavyaduḥkhamāpanne dainyagraste babhūvatuḥ || 5.2.45.120 || ata eva prayatnena pariṇetā vivarjayeta || devatāsaridāhvānakanyāpāṇigrahaṃ sudhīḥ || 121 || atharṣeḥ kasyaciddaivādāśrame devasannibhe || raṃbhāphalānyadattāni mohājjagrahatustadā || || 122 || kṛtvā nānopavāsādivratāni brāhmaṇāṃgaje || adhyāsya nidhanaṃ kālācchākhāmṛgyau babhūvatuḥ || 123 || phalacauryavipākena vānara tvaṃ tayorabhūt || śīlarakṣaṇabhāvenāvaṃtyāṃ janimavāpatuḥ || 124 || sa ca nārāyaṇo vipraḥ pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ || daṣṭo'pi daṃdaśūkena kāśyāṃ pārāvato bhavata || 125 || evaṃ bhavāṃtare cāsīdetayoḥ patireva saḥ || tisṛṇāṃ bhavatīnāṃ ca bhāvī bhartā punaḥ sa vai || 126 || prāsādasyāpi pārśve tu nyagrodhaśca mahānagaḥ || tasmiñchākhini vāsāḍhye śākhāmṛgyo babhūvatuḥ || 127 || viṣṇudehajale tīrthe krīḍayā ca mamajjatuḥ || papatuścāpi pānīyaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe tṛṣāture || 128 || jātisvabhāvacāpalyātkīḍaṃtyau ca pradakṣiṇam || cakraturbahukṛtvaśca liṃgaṃ dadṛśa turbahu || 129 || vicaraṃtyāvitaḥ svairaṃ tatra nyagrodhasaṃnidhau || kenacidyogaveṣeṇa pāśena ca niyaṃtrite ||5.2.45.130|| bhikṣārthaṃ śikṣite tena na plutirna nivarttanam || atha te kvāpi markaṭyau kāladharmavaśaṃgate || 131 || avantīvāsapuṇyena trilocanasya sevayā || prādakṣiṇyānurūpeṇa jāte nāgasute api || 132 || adhunā taṃ patiṃ prāpya vidyādharakumārakam || nirviśya svargabhogāṃścāvaṃtyāṃ nirvṛtimāpsya || 133 || yairalpamapi cāvaṃtyā kṛtaṃ karma śubhāvaham || tasya mokṣaḥ parīpāko niścitaṃ madanugrahāt || trailokye'pi ca sarvasmiñchreṣṭhā'vantīpurī sadā || 134 || tato'pi liṃgamoṃkāraṃ tato'pyatra trilocanam || tiṣṭhagāno'tra liṃge'haṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadāmi vai || 135 || ataḥ sarvaprayatnenāvantyāṃ pūjyastrilocanaḥ || ityuktvā devadeveśastatprāsādāṃtare'viśat ||136|| liṃgasvarūpamāsādya śubhaṃ tribhuvanādapi || tāśca svasadanaṃ prāpya tadvṛttāṃtamaśeṣataḥ || svamātuḥ purataścoktvā kṛtakṛtyā ivābhavan || 137 || ekadā mādhave māsi saha sārthāḥ samāgatāḥ || vidyādharāstathā nāgā militāḥ saparicchadāḥ || 138 || virajaske mahākṣetre trilocanasamīpataḥ || devasya varadānācca pṛṣṭvānyonyaṃ kulāvalim || 139 || vidyādharāya tāḥ kanyā nāgaistisro'pi kalpitāḥ || maṃdāradāmā santuṣṭaḥ prāpya tacca snuśatrayam ||5.2.45.140|| ratnadīpaiśca nāgendraḥ padmī ca bhujageśvaraḥ || viśikho'pi phaṇīṃdraśca hṛṣṭā ete trayo'pi ca || jāmātaraṃ samāsādya śubhaṃ parimalālayam || 141 || anyo'nyaṃ svajanāste tu mudā vikasitekṣaṇāḥ || vivāhotsavamāracya svaṃsvaṃ bhavanamāviśan || 142 || trilocanasya liṃgasya varṇayaṃto'pi gauravam || sa ca vidyādharaḥ śrīmānnāgībhirvipulaṃ sukham || bhuktvāvantīṃ tataḥ prāpya saṃsevya ca trilocanam || 143 || gāyangītaṃ sumadhuraṃ nāgībhiḥ sahitaḥ kṛtī || ātmānaṃ cātivismṛtya madhyeliṃgaṃ layaṃ gataḥ || 144 || trilocanasya mahimā kalau devena gopitaḥ || tatolpasattvā manujā na tallimagamupāsate || 145 || trilocanakathāmetāṃ śrutvā pāpānvito'pyaho || vipāpo jāyate martyo labhate ca parāṃ gatim || 146 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || trilocanasya devasya śṛṇu vīreśvaraṃ param || || 147 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye trilocanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 || || cha ||
<5.2.46>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || ṣaṭcatvāriṃśakaṃ devi vīreśvaramatho śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa kulavṛddhirbhaveddhruvam || 1 || niśāmaya mahā vi vīreśāvirbhavaṃ param || yacchrutvā pitaraḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyurvipulaṃ śive || 2 || āsīdamitrajinnāma rājā parapuraṃjayaḥ || dhārmikaḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ prajāraṃjanatatparaḥ || 3 || yaśodhano vadānyaśca sudhīrbrāhmaṇadaivataḥ || sadaivāvabhṛthasnātaḥ pariklinnaśiroruhaḥ ||4|| vinīto nītisaṃpannaḥ kuśalaḥ sarvakarmasu || vidyāviśāradaścātha guṇavānguṇivatsalaḥ || 5 || kṛtajño madhurālāpaḥ pāpakarmaparāṅmukhaḥ || satyavāñchaucanilayaḥ satyavāgvijiteṃdriyaḥ || 6 || raṇāṃgaṇe kṛtāṃtasya saṃkhyāvāṃśca sadojire || kāminīkelikālajño yuvāpi sthavirapriyaḥ || 7 || dharmārtha dhanakośaśca samṛddhabalavāhanaḥ || subhagaśca surūpaśca sumedhāḥ suprajāpriyaḥ || 8 || sthairyadhairyasamāpanno deśakālavicakṣaṇaḥ || mānyānāṃ mānado nityaṃ sarvadūṣaṇavarjitaḥ || 9 || vāsudevāṃghriyugale cetovṛttiṃ nidhāya ca || cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ dhigdhigītivivarjitama || 5.2.46.10 || alaṃghyaśāsanaḥ śrīmānviṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || abhunakpravarānbhogānsamaṃtādviṣṇusaṃskṛtān || 11 || harerārādhanānyuccaiḥ pratisaudhaṃ padepade || tasya rājye samabhavanmahābhāganidheḥ śive || 12 || govṛndagopagopālagopījanamanohara || gadāpāṇe guṇātīta guṇāśca garuḍadhvaja || 13 || keśihankaiṭabhārāte kaṃsāre kamalāpate ||14|| kṛṣṇa keśava kaṃjākṣa kīnāśabhayanāśana || puruṣottama pāpāre puṇḍarīkavilocana ||15|| pītakauśeyavasana padmanābha parātpara || janārddanajagannātha jāhnavījalajanmabhūḥ ||16|| janmināṃ janmaharaṇa jaṃjapūkaughanāśana || śrīvatsavakṣaḥ śrīkaṃṭha śrīkara śreyasāṃnidhe || 17 || śrīraṃga śārṅgakodaṃḍa śaure śītāṃśulocana|| daityāre dānavārāte dāmodara duraṃtaka ||18|| devakīhṛdayānaṃda daṃdaśūkeśvareśaya || viṣṇo vaikuṇṭhanilaya bāṇāre viṣṭa raśravaḥ ||19|| viṣvaksena vibho vīra vanamālinbalipriya || trivikrama trilokeśa cakrapāṇe caturbhuja ||5.2.46.20|| ityādīni pavitrāṇi nāmāni prati maṃdire || strīvṛddhabālagopālavadanodīritāni tu || 21 || śrūyaṃte yatra kutrāpi ramyāṇi madhuvidviṣaḥ || suramyakānanānyeva vilokyaṃte gṛhegṛhe || || 22 || vicitrāṇi caritrāṇi gīyaṃte ca gṛhegṛhe || saudhabhittiṣu dṛśyaṃte citrāṇi kṛtrimāṇi ca || 23 || ṛte harikathāyāstu nānyā vārttā niśamyate || hariṇā naiva vadhyaṃte hariṇā māṃsadhāriṇaḥ || 24 || tasya rājño bhayādvyādhairaraṇye sukhacāriṇaḥ || na matsyā naiva ca bakā varāhāśca na kenacit || 25 || hanyaṃte kvāpi tadbhītyā matsyamāṃsāśinā'pi va || aputrā na narāstasya rāṣṭre'mitrajitaḥ kvacit || 26 || stanapānaṃ na kurvaṃti saṃprāpya harivāsaram || paśavo'pi tṛṇāhāraṃ parityajya harerdine || upoṣaṇaparā jātā anyeṣāṃ kā kathā nṛṇām || 27 || mahāmahotsavaḥ sarvaiḥ puraukobhirvitanyate || asminpraśāsati bhuvaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare || 28 || yo viṣṇubhaktirahitaḥ prāṇairapi dhanairapi || sa eva daṇḍyo bhuṃkte yo rājño'mitrajitaḥ kṣitau || 29 || antyajā api tadrāṣṭre śaṃkhacakrāṃkadhāriṇaḥ || saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ dīkṣitā iti saṃsthitāḥ || 5.2.46.30 || śubhāni yāni karmāṇi kriyaṃte'nudinaṃ janaiḥ || vāsudeve samarpyaṃte tāni tairaphalepsubhiḥ || 31 || vinā mukuṃdagoviṃda paramānaṃdamacyutam || nānyo japyeta namyeta sabhājyeta janaḥ kvacit || kṛṣṇa eva paro baṃdhustasyāsīdavanīpateḥ ||32|| evaṃ tasminmahīpāle rājye samyakpraśāsati || ekadā nāradaḥ śrīmāṃstaṃ didṛkṣuḥ samāyayau || 33 || rājñā samarcitaḥ so'tha madhuparkavidhānataḥ || nārado varṇayāmāsa tamamitrajitaṃ nṛpam || 34 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si mānyo'pyasi divaukasām || sarvabhūteṣu goviṃdaṃ paripaśyanviśāṃpate || 35 || yo vedapuruṣo viṣṇuryo yajñapuruṣo hariḥ || yoṃ'tarātmāsya jagataḥ kartā hartāvitā vibhuḥ || 36 || tanmayaṃ paśyato viśvaṃ tava bhūpālasattama || darśanaṃ prāpya śubhadaṃ śucitvamagamaṃ param || 37 || eṣa eva hi sāro'tra saṃsāre kṣaṇabhaṃgure || kamalākāṃtapādābjabhaktibhāvo'khilapradaḥ || 38 || parityajya hi yaḥ sarvaṃ viṣṇumekaṃ sadā bhajet || sumedhasaṃ bhajaṃte taṃ padārthāḥ sarva eva hi || 39 || hṛṣīkeśe hṛṣīkāṇi yasya sthairyaṃ gatānyaho || sa eva sthairyamāpnoti brahmāṃḍe'tīva caṃcale || 5.2.46.40 || yauvanaṃ dhanamāyuṣyaṃ jalaṃ padmadale yathā || atīva caṃcalaṃ jñātvā'cyutameva sadāśrayet || 41 || vāci cetasi karṇe'tha yasya devo janārdanaḥ || sa eva sarvadā vedyo nararūpī janārddanaḥ || nirvyājapraṇidhānena śīlayitvā śriyaḥpatim || 42 || puruṣottamatāṃ ko na prāptastvamiva bhūtale || anayā viṣṇubhaktyā te saṃtuṣṭeṃdriyamānasaḥ || upakartumanā brūyāṃ tanniśāmaya bhūpate || 43 || mālāvidyādharasutā nāmnā malayagaṃdhinī || krīḍaṃtī piturākroḍe hṛtā kaṃkālaketunā || 44 || kapālaketuputreṇa dānavena balīyasā || āgāminyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tasyāḥ pāṇigrahaḥ kila || 45 || pātāle caṃpakāvatyāṃ nagaryāṃ sāsti sāṃpratam || hāṭakeśātsamāgacchaṃstayā'haṃ sāśrunetrayā || || 46 || dṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya vijñapto yathā tacca niśāmaya || brahmacārinmuniśreṣṭha gaṃdhamādanaśailataḥ || 47 || bālakrīḍanakāsaktāṃ māṃ jahre trastamāna sām || kaṃkālaketurdurvṛttastasya nāsti ca pātakaḥ || 48 || sa svatriśūlaghātena mriyate nānyathā raṇe || jagatparyākulīkṛtya nidrātyatha vinirbhayaḥ || 49 || yadi kopi kṛtajño māṃ hatvemaṃ duṣṭadānavam || maddattena triśūlena nayedbhadraṃ ca vai kṛtam || 5.2.46.50 || yadyatropacikīrṣustvaṃ rakṣa māṃ duṣṭa dānavāt || mamāpi hi varo datto bhagavatyomayā purā || viṣṇubhakto yuvā dhīmānputri tvāṃ pariṇeṣyati || 51 || ātṛtīyātithi yathā tadvākyaṃ tathyatāṃ vrajet|| tathā nimittamātraṃ tvaṃ bhava yatnaṃ samācara || 52 || iti tadvacanādrājanviṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇam || yuvānaṃ cāpi dhīmantaṃ tvāmanuprāptavānaham ||53|| tadgaccha kāryasiddhyai tvaṃ hatvā taṃ duṣṭadānavam|| ānayāśu mahābāho śubhāṃ malayagaṃdhinīm||54|| sā tu vidyādharī bālā vilokya tvāṃ nareśvara || avaśyameva tacchūlaṃ dāsyatīti viniścitam || pārvatīvacanādduṣṭaṃ ghātayiṣyasyasaṃśayam|| 55|| iti nāradavākyaṃ sa niśamyāmitrajinnṛpaḥ || analpotkaliko jāto vidyādharasutāṃ prati|| upāyaṃ cāpi papraccha gaṃtuṃ vai caṃpakāvatīm ||56|| nāradena punaḥ proktaḥ sa rājā girirājaje || tūrṇamarṇavamāsādya pūrṇimādivase nṛpa ||57|| bhavāndrakṣyati potasthakalpavṛkṣarathāsthitām|| tatra divyāṃganāṃ kāṃciddivyaparyaṃkasusthitām|| vīṇāmādāya gāyaṃtīṃ gāthāmatyaṃtasusvaram ||58|| yatkarma vihitaṃ yena śubhaṃ vāpyathavā'śubham || sa eva bhuṃkte tattathyaṃ vidhistatra niyaṃtritaḥ ||59|| gāthāmimāṃ tu saṃgīya sarathā samahīruhā || saparyaṃkā kṣaṇādeva madhyesiṃdhuṃ pravekṣyati ||5.2.46.60|| bhavānapyaviśaṃkaṃ ca tataḥ potānmahārṇave || tamanuvrajatu kṣipraṃ yajñavārāhasā tmavān || 61 || tato drakṣyasi pātāle nagarīṃ caṃpakāvatīm || mahāmanoharā rājansanāthāṃ bālayā tayā || 62 || ityuktvāṃtarhito devi sa caturmu khanaṃdanaḥ || rājāpyarṇavamāsādya yathoktaṃ parilakṣya ca || 63 || viveśāṃtaḥ samudraṃ ca nagarīmāsasāda tām || sāpi vidyādharī bālā netrayoḥ prāghu ṇīkṛtā || 64 || tena rājñā trijagatīsauṃdaryaśrīrivaikikā || pātāle devateyaṃ vā mama netrotsavāya kim || 65 || niramāyi pramoddeśātsraṣṭṛsṛṣṭirvi lakṣaṇā || kuhūrāhubhayadveṣātkāṃtiścāṃdramasī kimu || 66 || yoṣidrūpaṃ samāśritya tiṣṭhatyatrākutobhayā || itthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ ca nirvarṇya sa rājā'gacchadaṃti kam || 67 || sā vilokyātha taṃ bālaṃ nitarāṃ madhurākṛtim || viśāloraḥsthalatalapralaṃyatulasīsrajam || 68 || śaṃkhacakrāṃkasubhagabhujadvayavirāji tam || harināmākṣarasudhāsudhautaradanāvalim || 69 || bhavānībhaktibījotthabhūruhaṃ puruṣākṛtim || anenātra kṛtaṃ kasya bhavanaṃ madhurākṛti || 5.2.46.70 || iti paryākulīkṛtya cakṣuṣī ca muhurmuhuḥ || kaṃkālaketurdurvṛttastvavadhyaḥ parahetibhiḥ ||71|| tāvadguptaṃ samātiṣṭha śastrāgāre'tra gahvare || na me kanyāvrataṃ bhagnaṃ sāmarthyāccaṇḍikāvarāt ||72|| āgāminyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ paraśvaḥ pāṇipīḍanam || sa cikīrṣati duṣṭātmā gatāyurmama śāpataḥ ||73|| mā tadbhītiṃ kuru yuvaṃstvatkāryaṃ bhavitācirāt || vidyādharyeti coktaḥ sa śastrāgāre nigūḍhavat || 74 || sthiro vīro mahābāhurdānavāgamanekṣaṇaḥ || 75 || atha sāyaṃ samāyāto dānavo bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ || triśūlaṃ kalayanpāṇau mṛtyorapi bhayāvaham || 76 || āgatya dānavo raudraḥ pralayāṃbudanisvanaḥ || vidyādharīṃ jagādeti madāghūrṇitalocanaḥ ||77|| gṛhāṇemāni ratnāni divyāni varavarṇini || kanyātvaṃ hi paraśvaste pāṇigrāho bhaviṣyati || 78 || dāsīnāmayutaṃ prātardāsyāmi tava suṃdari || āsurīṇāṃ surīṇāṃ ca dānavīnāṃ manoharam || 79 || gandharvīṇāṃ kiṃnarīṇāṃ satataṃ paricārikāḥ || vidyādharīṇāṃ nāgīnāṃ yakṣīṇāṃ ca śatāni ṣaṭ || 5.2.46.80 || rākṣasīnāṃ śatānyaṣṭau śatamapsarasāṃ varam || etāste paricāriṇyo bhaviṣyaṃtyamalāśaye || || 81 || yāvatsaṃpattisaṃbhāro dikpālānāṃ gṛheṣu vai || matparigrahatāṃ prāptau tāvatastvaṃ maheśvarī || 82 || divyānbhogānmayā sārddhaṃ bhokṣyase matparigra hāt || kadā paraśvo bhavitā yasminvaivāhiko vidhiḥ || 83||tvadaṃgasaṃgasaṃsparśasukhasvādātimeduraḥ || parāṃ nirvṛtimāpsyāmi paraśvo nikaṭaṃ yadi || || 84 || manorathāściraṃ yāvadye me hṛdi samedhitāḥ || tānkṛtārthī kariṣyāmi paraśvastava saṃgamāt || 85 || jitvā devānraṇe sarvāniṃdrādīnmṛgalo cane|| trailokyaiśvaryasaṃpattestvāṃ kariṣyāmi ceśvarīm ||86|| ādhāyāṃke triśūlaṃ ca suṣvāpeti pralapya saḥ|| naramāṃsasya svādena pramatto vītasādhvasaḥ|| || 87 || varaṃ smaraṃtī sā gauryā vidyādharakumārikā || vijñāya taṃ pramattaṃ ca prasuptaṃ cātinirbhayam || āhūya taṃ naravaraṃ varaṃ sarvāṃgasuṃdaram || 88 || viṣṇubhaktikṛtatrāṇaṃ prāṇanātheti jalpya ca || śūlaṃ tadaṃkādādāya dadau tasmai ca suṃdarī ||89|| tamādāya triśūlaṃ ca sa tadāmitrajinnṛpaḥ || saṃsmaraṃścakriṇaṃ citte jagadrakṣāmaṇiṃ harim|| 5.2.46.90 || jagādottiṣṭha re duṣṭa kanyādūṣaṇalālasa || yudhyasva ca mayā sārddhaṃ na suptaṃ hanmyahaṃ ripum || 91 || iti saṃśrutya saṃprāptaḥ kasya dṛṣṭodya cāṃtakaḥ || ka āyuṣādya saṃtyakto yaḥ prāpto mama gocaram ||92|| mama pracaṃḍadordaṃḍakaṃḍūkaṃḍūyanakṣamaḥ || mālyo naro'yaṃ bhavitā kiṃ triśūlena suṃdari || 93 || mā bhairme kautukaṃ paśya bhakṣoyaṃ mama sāṃpratam || kālena matto bhītena svayamevopaḍhaukitaḥ || 94 || ityuktvā muṣṭighātena tenoccairdaṃḍasūnunā || hṛdaye nihato rājā śilātikaṭhine drutam || 95 || sa cakriṇā kṛtatrāṇaḥ pīḍāṃ nālpīyasīmapi || viveda kaṭhinoraskaḥ karastasya prapīḍitaḥ || 96 || atha kopavatā rājñā hato vaktre capeṭayā || āghūrṇitaśirā bhūmau patitvā punarutthitaḥ || uvāca ca vaco dhairyamavaṣṭabhya mahābalī || 97 || || dānava uvāca || || jñātaṃ tattvaṃ manuṣyosi nṛrūpeṇa caturbhujaḥ || tatastvaṃ chidramāsādya haṃtuṃ māṃ dānavāṃtaka || ||98|| evaṃvidho hi madhubhidyadi tvaṃ balavānasi|| vihāyaitanmahacchūlaṃ yudhyasva svāyudhairmayā|| 99|| tvayā kapaṭarūpeṇa balinā kaiṭabhādayaḥ|| na balena hatāḥ saṃkhye hatā eva cchalena hi ||5.2.46.100|| baliṃ pātālamanayastvaṃ nṛvāmanatāṃ dadhat || nṛmṛgatvena bhavatā hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ ||101|| tathā jaṭilarūpeṇa laṃkeśo vinipātitaḥ|| gopālaveṣamālaṃbya kaṃsādyā ghātitāstvayā || strībhūya cāharastvaṃ hi vipratāryāsurānsudhām ||102|| yādorūpeṇa bhavatā śaṃkhādyā nihatā iha || māyāvinā tvayā'gaṇyāḥ sarvamarmajña mādhava || 103 || na tvatto'haṃ bibhemyadya sadyaḥ pātaḥ śarīriṇām || varaṃ tava śraye mṛtyuṃ balenāpi chalena vā || 104 || na tyakṣyasi triśūlaṃ tvaṃ na tvāṃ yotsyāmyahaṃ raṇe || avaśyameva marttavyaṃ mayā prātaḥ śarīriṇā|| 105 || iyaṃ vidyādharī kanyā na mayā dūṣitā satī || sākṣācchrīriva maṃtavyā tavārthaṃ rakṣitā mayā || 106 || ityuktvā vāmadordaṃḍaprahāreṇāpi niṣṭhuram || nijaghāna danoḥ sūnustaṃ śiloccaya ghātinā || 107 || nṛpatistvatha saṃdhārya viṣahya raṇamūrddhani || jaghānāśu tadā krūraṃ triśūlenātha vakṣasi ||108 || tatprahārānmahābāhuḥ paṃcatvamagama tkṣaṇāt || lakṣyīcakāra tadvaktraṃ triśūlaṃ tolayankare || 109 || paśyato'sya mahābāhoḥ sa ca prāṇāñjahau kṣaṇāt|| itthaṃ kaṃkālaketuṃ sa nihatya surakaṃ panam ||5.2.46.110|| vidyādharīṃ prapaśyaṃtīṃ prāha hṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || nāradasya munervākyāttava suśroṇi vāṃchitam || 111 || kṛtaṃ mayā kṛtajñe kiṃ karavāṇyadhunā vada || śrutveti tasya sā vākyaṃ prāha gaṃbhīracetasā || 112 || || malayagaṃdhinyuvāca || || atyudāramate vīra nijaprāṇaiḥ paṇīkṛtām || kiṃ māṃ pṛcchasi yuvatīṃ kulakanyāmadūṣitām || 113 || iti bruvaṃtyāṃ kanyāyāṃ punaḥ svairacaro muniḥ || atarkitāgamaḥ prāpto nārado devalokataḥ || || 114 || tatastuṣṭuvatustau tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā munisattamam || kṛtapraṇāmau muninā pratijñāprāpitāśiṣau || 115 || pāṇigraheṇa vidhinā'bhiṣiktau nāradena tu || jagmaturnāradādiṣṭavartmanā kṛtamaṃgalau || 116 || tayā malayagaṃdhinyā vṛtaḥ so'mitrajinnṛpaḥ || purīṃ cojjayinīṃ prāpya paurairvihitamaṃgalām|| || 117 || tadvīkṣaṇādapi naro nārakīṃ naiva jātucit || gatiṃ prāpnoti medhāvī tāṃ purīmaviśannṛpaḥ || 116 || yasyāṃ puryāṃ praveśaṃ na labhante vāsa vādayaḥ || kaivalyajayajaitryāṃ hi tāṃ purīmaviśannṛpaḥ || 119 || sāpi vidyādharyavaṃtīṃ samṛddhāṃ vīkṣya dūrataḥ || niniṃda svargalokaṃ ca pātālanagarī mapi || 5.2.46.120 || prāpyāmitrajitaṃ kāṃtaṃ tathā hṛṣṭā na sā vadhūḥ || yathā dṛṣṭvāpyaho'vaṃtīṃ paramānaṃdadāyinīm || 121 || sā kṛtārthāmivātmānaṃ manya mānā manasvinī || tena patyojjayinyāṃ ca parāṃ nirvṛtimāpa sā || 122 || so'pyamitrajidāsādya patnīṃ malayagaṃdhinīm || dharmapradhānaṃ saṃsevya kāmaṃ prāpottamaṃ sukham || 123 || sā patiṃ viṣṇubhajane rataṃ provāca bhāminī || 124 || || rājñyuvāca || || bhūpābhīṣṭatṛtīyāyāṃ cariṣyāmi mahā vratam || || rājovāca || || devyabhīṣṭatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ kīdṛgbhavedvada ||125|| iti rājñoditā rājñī pravaktumupacakrame || iti kartavyatāṃ tasya vratasya savidhānakām|| 126 || || rājñyuvāca || || purā devarṣiṇā cedaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmyai pratiśrutam || tayā prāptāstu sakalāḥ kāmāḥ svargāpavargadāḥ || 127 || mārgaśīrṣatṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kalaśopari || tāmrapātraṃ nidhāyaiva taṃdulaiḥ paripūritam || 128 || acchidraṃ ca navīnaṃ ca rajanīrāgaraṃjitam || vāsaḥ pātropari nyasya sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ param || 129 || tasyopari śubhaṃ padmaṃ raviraśmiprakāśitam || tatkarṇikāyā upari catuḥsvarṇavinirmitam || vidhiṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā raktamālyāṃbarādibhiḥ || 5.2.46.130 || puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhaiḥ
