karpūrakastūryādibhirarcayet || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ viprāṇāṃ paramotsavaiḥ ||131|| homaḥ kāryo mahābhaktyā sahasraparisaṃkhyayā || navaprasūtāṃ kapilāṃ dadyācca supayasvinīm || 132 || dadyādācāryavaryāya sālaṃkārāṃ sadakṣiṇām || upoṣya daṃpatī bhaktyā navāṃbaravibhūṣitau || 133 || prātaḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ ca saṃpūjyācāryamāditaḥ || vastrairābharaṇairmālyairdakṣiṇābhirmudānvitaḥ || sopaskarāṃ ca tāṃ mṛrtimācāryāya pradāpayet || 134 || maṃtraḥ || namo viśvavidhānajñe vidye vividhakāriṇi || sutaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ dehi tuṣṭā hyasmādvratottamāta || 135 || sahasraṃ bhojayitvātha dvijānāṃ bhaktipūrvakam || bhuktaśeṣeṇa cānnena kuryādvai pāraṇaṃ tataḥ || 136 || itthametadvrataṃ nātha cikīrṣāmi tvadājñayā || kuru caitatpriyaṃ mahyamabhīṣṭaphalalabdhaye || 137 || iti bhūpālavaryeṇa śrutvā saṃhṛṣṭacetasā || tadā vrataṃ samācīrṇaṃ sāṃtarvatnī babhūva ha || 138 || tayātha prārthitā gaurī garbhiṇyā bhaktitoṣitā || putraṃ dehi mahāmāye sākṣādviṣṇvaṃśasaṃbha vam || 139 || jātamātro vrajetsvargaṃ punarāyāti cātra vai || bhaktaḥ sadāśive'tyarthaṃ prasiddhaḥ sarvabhūtale || vinaiva stanyapānena ṣoḍaśābdākṛtiḥ kṣaṇāta || 5.2.46.140 || evaṃbhūtaḥ suto gauri yathā syānme tathā kuru || mṛḍānyāpi tathetyuktā rājñī bhaktyātituṣṭayā || 141 || atha kālena tanayaṃ mūlarkṣe sā'pyajījanat || hitairamātyairatha sā vijñaptāriṣṭasaṃsthitā || 142 || devi rājārthinī tvaṃ tu tyaja duṣṭarkṣajaṃ sutam || sā maṃtrivākyamākarṇya kevalaṃ patidevatā || 143 || atyākṣīttaṃ tathā prāptaṃ tanayaṃ nayakovidā || dhātrikāṃ tu samāhūya prāhedaṃ sā nṛpāṃganā || 144 || paṃcamudre mahāpīṭhe vikaṭānāma mātṛkā || tadagre sthāpayitvāmuṃ bālaṃ dhātri tvidaṃ vada || 145 || gauri dattaḥ śiśurasau tavāgre viniveditaḥ || rājñyā patyuḥ priyaiṣiṇyā maṃtrivijñaptinunnayā || 146 || sāpi rājñyuditaṃ śrutvā bālaṃ śiśuśaśiprabham || vikaṭāyāḥ purobhāge saṃsthāpya gṛhamāgatā || 147 || atha sā vikaṭā devī samāhūya ca yoginīḥ || uvāca nayata kṣipraṃ śiśuṃ mātṛgaṇāgrataḥ || 148 || tāsāmājñāṃ ca kuruta rakṣatāmuṃ prayatnataḥ || yoginyo vikaṭāvākyātkhecaryastatkṣaṇena tam || 149 || ninyurgaganamārgeṇa brāhmyādyā yatra mātaraḥ || praṇamya yoginīvṛndaṃ taṃ śiśuṃ sūryavarcasam || 5.2.46.150 || puro nidhāya mātṝṇāṃ procuśca vikaṭoditam || brahmāṇī vaiṣṇavī raudrī vārāhī nārasiṃhikā || kaumārī cāpi māhendrī cāmuṇḍā caiva caṃḍikā || 151 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ bālakaṃ ramyaṃ vikaṭāpreṣitaṃ tataḥ || papracchuryugapadvākyaṃ kaste bāla pramukhyakaḥ || 152 || mātṛbhi śceti pṛṣṭastu yadā kiṃcinna vakti saḥ || tadā ca yoginīcakraṃ prāha mātṛgaṇastviti || 153 || rājyayogyo bhavatyeṣa mahālakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ || punastatraiva netavyo yoginyastvavilaṃbitam || 154 || pañcamudrā mahādevī tiṣṭhate yatra kāmadā || yasyāḥ saṃsevanānnṝṇāṃ nirvāṇaśrīradūrataḥ || 155 || tatpīṭhase vanādasya ṣoḍaśābdākṛteḥ śiśoḥ || siddhirbhavitrī paramā rudrasyānugrahātparā || 156 || evaṃ mātṛgaṇātsadyo yoginībhiḥ kṣaṇena tu || prāpito mātṛvākyena pañcamudrāṃtikaṃ punaḥ || 157 || saṃprāpya tanmahāpīṭhaṃ svargalokādihāgataḥ || mahākālavane puṇye tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 158 || tapasātīva tīvreṇa niścalendriyamānasaḥ || tasya rājakumārasya prasanno'bhūdumādhavaḥ || 159 || āvirbabhūva purato liṃgarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ || uvāca ca prasannosmi varaṃ brūhi nṛpāṃgaja || 5.2.46.160 || sarvajyotirmayaṃ liṃgaṃ purato dṛṣṭavānsvayam || saptapātālamudbhidyotthitaṃ bṛhadanugrahāt || 161 || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau pari tuṣṭāva dhūrjaṭim || sūktairjanmāṃtarābhyāsātsuhṛṣṭo rudradaivataiḥ || varaṃ ca prārthayāṃcakre parihṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 162 || devadeva mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama || tadatra bhavatā stheyaṃ bhavatāpahṛtā sadā || 163 || asmim̐lliṃge sthitaḥ śaṃbho kuru bhaktasamīhitam || vinā mudrādikaraṇaṃ maṃtreṇāpi vinā vibho || || 164 || asya liṃgasya ye bhaktā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || sadaivānugrahasteṣu karttavyo vara eṣa me || 165 || iti tadvaramākarṇya liṃgarūpo'vadatprabhuḥ || evamastu yaduktaṃ te vīra vaiṣṇavasūnunā || 166 || vīra vīreśvaraṃnāma liṃgametattvadākhyayā || avaṃtyāṃ saṃpradāsyāmi bhaktānāṃ ciṃtitānyaho || 167 || atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ stutamarcitameva ca || tadakṣayaṃ bhavedatra bhaktānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 168 || tvaṃ tu rājyaṃ paraṃ prāpya sarvabhūpāladurlabham || bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulānaṃte siddhimavāpsyasi || 169 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || vīreśvarasya devasya nūpureśamatho śṛṇu || 5.2.46.170 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye vīreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || || cha ||
<5.2.47>
|| śrīdevadeva uvāca || || saptādhikaṃ vijānīhi nūpureśvarasaṃjñakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa prāpyaṃte sarvasiddhayaḥ || || 1 || purā rāthantare kalpe nūpuronāma vai gaṇaḥ || rudrabhaktiparonityaṃ paṃcamudrāvibhūṣitaḥ || 2 || sa ekadā kuberasya sabhāyāṃ prāpya saṃsthitaḥ || draṣṭuṃ mahotsavaṃ tatra apsarobhiḥ kṛtaṃ tadā || 3 || nanṛtuścāparāstatra hyurvaśī yoṣitāṃ varā || raṃbhā tilottamā menā nanṛturharṣasaṃyutāḥ || 4 || tāsāṃ nṛtyaṃ tadā vīkṣya nūpuro gaṇapastadā || kāmabāṇārdito nūnaṃ tāsāṃ madhye nanartta ha || 5 || nṛtyamānastato hṛṣṭaḥ puṣpagu cchena vakṣasi || urvaśīṃ tāḍayāmāsa kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ || 6 || urvaśī tu tataḥ kruddhā puṣpagucchena tāḍitā || jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ dhanadaṃ sarvakāmadam || 7 || uvāca dhanadastatra krodhenākulamānasaḥ || 8 || yasmāttvayā raṃgabhaṃgaḥ kṛtaḥ kāmārdditena vai || tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke patasva pāpapūruṣa || 9 || kuberasya ca śāpāttu jagāma dharaṇītalam || vilalāpa suduḥkhārttaḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ pāpinā mayā || 5.2.47.10 || vilapya subhṛśaṃ so'tha śaraṇaṃ parameśvarīm || jagāma manasā devi tvāṃ sa vai varadāyinīm || 11 || tvaṃ tuṣṭā tu tadā jātā pratyakṣā parameśvarī || uvāca gaṇapaṃ prītyā bhaktinamraṃ tadā bhuvi || 12 || gaccha putra mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || prācīsarasvatī tatra vāpyākārā ca vidyate || 13 || tasyā dakṣiṇato vatsa vidyate liṃgamuttamam || vāpyāṃ snātvā ca talliṃgaṃ samārādhaya bhaktitaḥ ||14|| sā prācī sa ca deveśastvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || ityukto nūpuro devi mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || 15 || tvayā ca prerito devi kīrtyarthaṃ tatra gamyatām || ityukto nūpuro divyo gaṇo hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 16 || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ devagaṃdharvasevitam || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ suragandharvasevitam || 17 || prācī sarasvatī tatra vāpyākārā ca saṃsthitā || tasyāṃ snātvā tato devaṃ pūjayāmāsa nūpuraḥ || 18 || tato devaḥ prasannātmā pratyuvācātha nūpuram|| sādhu nūpura bhadraṃ te svasti prāpnuhi sarvadā || || 19 || bhavitā vallabho devyāḥ pārvatyāḥ śaṃkarasya ca || ityuktastena liṃgena tatkṣaṇānnūpuraḥ priye || 5.2.47.20 || uditādityasaṃkāśo vibhāvasusama dyutiḥ || tejorāśiśca saṃjāto durnirīkṣyastriviṣṭapaiḥ || 21 || prabhāvaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā devairuktaṃ varānane || aho liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ dṛśyatetyadbhutaṃ bhuvi || 22 || prāptā ca kāmikī siddhirnūpureṇa ca darśanāt || ato devo'dyaprabhṛti vikhyāto bhūtale'bhavat || 23 || sarvakāmaprado nityaṃ nūpureśvara nāmataḥ || darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti snātvā vāpyāṃ samāhitāḥ || 24 || nūpureśvararudrasya te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || ye ca pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti bhaktibhāvasama nvitāḥ || vasaṃti muditāḥ sarve yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 25 || janmamṛtyujarārogaduḥkhāni vividhāni ca || prayāṃti vilayaṃ sadyaḥ pūjite nūpureśvare || 26 || vāpī gaṃgāsamā sā tu svayameva śubhekṣaṇe || saṃgamastu vitastāyāṃ yamunāyāstu suvrate || prayāgametajjānīhi bhūdhareṃdrāṃgasaṃbhave || 27 ||| somatīrthaṃ tadā devi sarvapātakanāśanam || tatra snātvā pumāndevi vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 28 || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ca yaḥ snātvā pūjayennūpureśvaram || kulaṃ vai tārayetsopi mātṛkaṃ pitṛkaṃ śatam || 29 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || nūpureśvaradevasya śrūyatāmabhayeśvaram || 5.2.47.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye nūpureśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || || cha ||
<5.2.48>
|| śrīrudra uvāca || || aṣṭādhikaṃ vijānīhi catvāriṃśattamaṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa na bhavasya bhayaṃ bhavet || 1 || kalpāvasāne prathame pādme padmanibhekṣaṇe || naṣṭacaṃdrārkanakṣatre naṣṭabhūmitriviṣṭape || brahmā vai ciṃtayāmāsa kathaṃ sṛṣṭirbhavediti || 2 || ityākulitarūpasya tasya netradvayāttadā || papātāśrukaṇaḥ sthūlo netrādvāmānmahātmanaḥ || 3 || tasmādaśrukaṇājjāto hāravonāma dānavaḥ || tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mahākāyo bhinnāṃjanacayaprabhaḥ || 4 || dakṣiṇānnayanājjātaḥ kālakelītiviśrutaḥ || kṛṣṇadeho'tidīrghaśca mahādaṃṣṭrordhvaromakaḥ || 5 || karālavadano duṣṭo yamarūpo durāsadaḥ || kṛṣṇāṃjanacayākāraḥ pāśapāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ || 6 || tau tu daityau samāgatya kṛtasaṃketakau tadā || brahmāṇaṃ haṃtumicchaṃtau pramattāvabhidhāvitau || 7 || tato brahmā bhayāviṣṭaḥ kāṃdiśīkaścacāra ha || tato jale'tigaṃbhīre so'paśyadamitadyutim || 8 || puruṣaṃ pītavasanaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || tamālokya tato brahmā saṃtrāsaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || uvāca ko bhavāñchete niḥśeṣesmiṃścarācare || 9 || tamuvāca tato viṣṇurahamevaṃ jagatpitā || lokakṛllokasaṃharttā lokasthitividhāyakaḥ || 5.2.48.10 || ityuktaḥ padmajastena kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā || pratyuvāca tadā brahmā sraṣṭāhaṃ bhuvanatraye || 11 || mayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || atrāṃtare ca tau daityāvāyātau baladarpitau || 12 || bhoktukāmau kṣudhāviṣṭau dṛṣṭvā brahmābravīdidam || kṛṣṇaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ kaṃpitādharapallavaḥ || 13 || yadi tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃcidasya lokasya kathyase || tadā tāvasurau bhīmau haṃtumarhasi sāṃpratam || 14 || tacchrutvā tu tadā viṣṇurjñātvā duḥkhaṃ parasparam || kṣaṇaṃ viśramyatāṃ tāvatpaścāddvaṃdvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 15 || ityuktvā kṛtasaṃketau tau daityau balagarvitau || brahmanārāyaṇau haṃtuṃ dhāvitau tu tvarānvitau || 16 || brahmaviṣṇū tadā dṛṣṭvā dānavau durjayau raṇe || saṃtrāsaṃ jagmatustatra svedakaṃpapariplutau || 17 || anyonyamūcatustau hi deśakālocitaṃ vacaḥ || kartavyaṃ kiṃ nu vā kāryaṃ mama vā tava vā bhavet || 18 || upasthitaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ tatra kiṃ kāryamasti nau || āsannaṃ maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā provāca keśavam || 19 || gamyatāṃ kṛṣṇa śīghraṃ vai mahākālavanottamam || pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ proktaṃ tatra rakṣā bhaviṣyati || ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi vraja tvaṃ tatra keśava || 5.2.48.20 || ityukto brahmaṇā kṛṣṇo jagāma saha tena vai || mahākālavanaṃ prāptau na ca dṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || tatrāpi daśasāhasrakālaḥ paryaṭatostayoḥ || 21 || tato jvālāmayaṃ divyaṃ nūpureśvaradakṣiṇe || dṛṣṭvā talliṃgamāhātmyaṃ brahmaviṣṇū tataḥ svayam || prārthayāṃcakraturdevamabhayaṃ dehi nau prabho || 22 || śaraṇaṃ bhava deveśa dānavābhyāṃ prapīḍitau || abhayaṃ ca tato dattaṃ tena liṃgena pārvati || 23 || śuśrāva garjitaṃ tābhyāṃ dānavābhyāṃ pitāmahaḥ || pratyuvāca bhayatrasto liṃgaṃ kaṃpitakaṃ dharaḥ || 24 || sa eṣa mṛtyurasmākameti śīghraṃ bhayāvahaḥ || dīyatāmabhayaṃ deva kṛṣṇenoktaṃ tadā priye || 25 || bhayārttavacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ keśavasya ca || tau daivau tena liṃgena jaṭhare saṃniveśitau || 26 || dṛṣṭaṃ tābhyāṃ jagatsarvaṃ sārkacaṃdramahīdharam || sasiddhagaṃdharvakulaṃ śailatālalatākulam || 27 || samudrapīṭhasaṃyuktaṃ nānāvarṇāśramojjvalam || sapātālatalaṃ devi sabhujaṃgamahīruham || 28 || sasaptalokavinyāsaṃ sadevāsurarākṣasam || punastau niḥsṛtau tasmājjaṭharādvismayānvitau || 29 || dṛṣṭvau bhasmīkṛtau daityau tena liṃgena pārvati || tuṣṭuvāte paraṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutau || 5.2.48.30 || liṃgenoktaṃ prasannena bhavadbhyāṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham|| mamāmoghamidaṃ devau darśanaṃ cātidurlabham || 31 || tato brahmā ca viṣṇuśca varayāmāsaturvaram || yadi deyo varo' smākaṃ nṛṇāmabhayado bhava || 32 || ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti yakṣyaṃti ca samāhitāḥ || saṃsmariṣyaṃti satataṃ teṣāmabhayado bhave || 33 || abhayeśvarasaṃjñastu khyāto bhuvi bhaviṣyasi || te kṛtārthā bhaviṣyaṃti ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || 34 || bhaviṣyati bhayaṃ naiva saṃsārapatanaṃ tathā || dhanaputrakalatrāṇāṃ viyogo na bhaviṣyati || 35 || duḥkhitā durbhagā nārī darśanaṃ yā kariṣyati || saubhāgyasukhasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || vīraṃ tu gurviṇī kanyā patimāpsyati śobhanam || 36 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ || taṃtaṃ manorathaṃ sarvaṃ gamiṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 37 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā liṃgena parameśvari || visarjitau gatau daivau brahmaviṣṇū svamālayam || 38 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || abhayeśvara devasya śrūyatāṃ pṛthukeśvaram||39|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye'bhayeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||48||
<5.2.49>
||īśvara uvāca|| śṛṇu paṃcāśadekonaṃ deveśaṃ pṛthukeśvaram|| yasya darśanamātreṇa sārvabhaumo naro bhavet || 1 || vaṃśe svāyaṃbhuve devi hyaṃgo rājā babhūva ha || mṛtyostu duhitā tena pariṇītā sudurmukhā ||2 || venanāmā suto jāto nāstiko dharmadūṣakaḥ || devabrahmasvahārī ca parabhāryāpahārakaḥ || 3 || sa ca śapto dvijairdevi tatkṣaṇānnidhanaṃ gataḥ || tadūrormathyamānāttu nipeturmlechajātayaḥ || 4 || śarīre māturaṃśena kṛṣṇāṃjanacayaprabhāḥ || pituraṃśātsamutpanno dhārmiko dvijasattamaiḥ || mathitāddakṣiṇāddhastātpṛthuḥ prathitavikramaḥ || 5 || sa viprairabhiṣiktaśca tapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram || viṣṇorvareṇa mahatā prabhutvamagamannṛpaḥ || 6 || sa ca svādhyāyarahitā nirvaṣaṭkāranirddhanāḥ || hāhābhūtāḥ prajā dṛṣṭvā tato'bhūdduḥkhito nṛpaḥ || 7 || sa dogdhumaicchattrailokyaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 8 || etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado munisattayaḥ || krodhāviṣṭaṃ pṛthuṃ dṛṣṭvā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 9 || lokatrayavināśāya mā kopaṃ kuru bhūpate || pṛthvyānayā grāsitāni sasyāni vividhāni ca || gilitāni ca annāni viddhyevaitanmataṃ mama || 5.2.49.10 || nāradasya ca vākyena krodhaṃ cakre pṛthustadā || nirdagdhumaicchatpṛthivīṃ saśai lavanakānanām || 11 || mumoca śastramāgneyaṃ tena sā dharaṇī tadā || dahyamānā bhayārttā ca gaurbhūtvā pṛdhumabhyagāt || 12 || sā vadhyamānā tenaiva nṛpaṃ vacanamabravīt || śaraṇaṃ samanuprāptā gaurahaṃ nṛpasattama || 13 || gauravadhyā mahīpāla vatsaṃ kṛtvā ca dugdhi mām || 14 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dudoha nṛpasattamaḥ || bhāsvadratnāni sasyāni kṛtvā vatsaṃ himālayam ||15|| jātāḥ prajāśca sumukhāḥ pravṛttaśca mahotsavaḥ || pravṛttā yāgadānādi kriyā magalapūrvikāḥ || 16 || rājātha ciṃtayāmāsa mayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam || avadhyāśca striyaḥ proktā gauravadhyā dvijastathā || 17 || strīrūpadhāriṇī pṛthvī mohādeṣā mayā hatā || govadhe ca kṛtā buddhiraho pāpaparaṃparā|| tasmādvahniṃ pravekṣyāmi citāṃ kṛtvā na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya pṛthoramitatejasaḥ || ājagāma punastatra nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 19 || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ dīnaṃ ciṃtayānaṃ pṛthuṃ priye || uvāca nārado dhīmānkimetaditi pārthiva|| 5.2.49.20 || tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa mayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam|| avadhyā strī hatā vipra kṛtā buddhiśca govadhe || 21 || kām̐llokānu gami ṣyāmi kṛtvā karma sudāruṇam || mariṣyāmi na saṃdeho brahmahā pāpapūruṣaḥ || 22 || atha ceṣṭopadeśena duḥkhāduddhara māṃ dvija || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ || mahāpāpapraśamanaṃ liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || 23 || mahākālavane liṃgamabhayeśvarapaścime || mahāpāpakṣayakaraṃ vidyate tatra bhūpate || gaccha tvaṃ sahasā rājaṃstatra pūto bhaviṣyasi || 24 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā pṛdhustatra jagāma saḥ || dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ ca vai ramyaṃ vipāpastatkṣaṇādabhūt || || 25 || dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ || 26 || tatoṃ'tarikṣagairdevi kṛtaṃ nāma varānane || pṛthunā pūjito yasmādbhaviṣyati mahītale || adyaprabhṛti vikhyāto devo'yaṃ pṛthukeśvaraḥ || 27 || ye ca drakṣyaṃti deveśaṃ pṛthukeśvaramīśvaram || te sarvakāmasaṃpūrṇā bhaviṣyaṃti mahītale || 28 || ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām|| tatpāpaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ pṛthukeśvaradarśanāt || 29 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ guhyasaṃbhavam || prakāśaṃ vā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prasaṃgādapi yatkṛtam || tatsarvaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ puthukeśvaradarśanāt || 5.2.49.30 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā devaṃ vai pṛdhukeśvaram || rājyaṃ prāpsyaṃti te samyaṅnṛloke ca triviṣṭape || 31 || bhuktvā rājyaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca mahītale || yāsyaṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 32 || ityuktvā devasaṃghaiśca pūjitaḥ pṛthukeśvaraḥ || pṛthuḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sapattanāṃ saparvatām || 33 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || pṛthukeśvara devasya śṛṇu vai sthāvareśvaram || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye pṛthukeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 49|| || cha ||
<5.2.50>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi prayatnena paṃcāśattamamīśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa grahabādhā na jāyate || 1 || saṃjñānāma raverbhāryā sā sutā viśvakarmaṇaḥ || bharttustejo'sahaṃtyātha kadāciccaiva saṃjñayā || chāyāmayī cātmanastu nirmitā tarasā tayā || 2 || sā proktā sādareṇaiva sthīyatāṃ sūryasaṃnidhau || pṛṣṭyāpi na vācyaṃ te madīyaṃ gamanaṃ raveḥ || 3 || ityuktvā sā tadā saṃjñā jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ || saṃjñeyamiti manvāno dvitīyāyāṃ divaspatiḥ || janayāmāsa tanayaṃ nāmato yaḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 4 || tasmiñjāte bhayaṃ jagmuḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || trailokyaṃ jātamātreṇa ākrāṃtaṃ sacarācaram || 5 || indro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || sūryaputrasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa gadgadam || 6 || bhinnaṃ tu rohiṇīcakraṃ vyāptaṃ nakṣatramaṃḍalam || jātamātreṇa cākrāṃtaṃ trailokyaṃ ravisūnunā || 7 || vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || āhūya sahasā sūryaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 8 || maryādā kriyatāṃ bhāno vāryatāṃ putra aurasaḥ || ākrāṃtaṃ tejasā tena trailokyaṃ bhūbhuvādikam|| 9 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā raviṇā proktamīdṛśaḥ || asādhyo'yaṃ mama suto vāryatāṃ svayameva tam || 5.2.50.10 || paśya me caraṇau dagdhau dṛṣṭimātreṇa līlayā|| brahmāpi bhayasaṃtrasto jagāma manasā harim ||11|| sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hariḥ prāptastu tatkṣaṇāt || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā bhītaḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdidam || 12 || gamyatāṃ tatra yatrāste devadevo maheśvaraḥ || kṛṣṇasya vacanātsarve mamāṃtikamupāgatāḥ || 13 || vṛttāṃtaḥ kathitaḥ sarvo raviputrasya pārvati || mayā smṛtastu saṃprāptaḥ sūryaputrastu tatkṣaṇāt || 14 || adhodṛṣṭirmayā dṛṣṭo vakrāṃgo rūpato'sitaḥ || sthairyaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya vijñapto'haṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 15 || kimarthaṃ vai smṛto deva dehyājāṃ mama śaṃkara || ādeśe tava tiṣṭhāmi kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || || 16 || ityukto'haṃ tadā tena raviputreṇa pārvati || mayā sa vārito'tyarthaṃ mā pīḍaya jagattrayam || 17 || tenoktaṃ dehi me sthānaṃ pānamāhārameva ca || mayā dattaṃ viśālākṣi pūjārthaṃ sthānamuttamam || 18 || meṣādirāśisaṃsthaḥ saṃstriṃśanmāsānprapīḍaya || mānuṣānkramaśo vatsa tatra tṛptimavāpsyasi|| 19 || aṣṭamaśca caturthaśca dvitīyo janmasaṃsthitaḥ || dvādaśarāśisaṃstho'pi viruddho bhava sarvadā || 5.2.50.20 || ekādaśo vā ṣaṣṭho vā tṛtīya sthānagothavā || bhava bhavyataro nṝṇāmataḥ pūjā bhaviṣyati || 21 || paṃcamo navamaścaiva udāsīnastu saptamaḥ || bhava rāśigato nityaṃ mānuṣe karma bhiryute || 22 || pūjāṃ prāpsyasi cātyarthaṃ grahāṇāmadhikaṃ sadā || gatiḥ sthirā bhavitrī te varaḥ śreṣṭhobhidhīyate || 23 || ataste sthāvaraṃ nāma bhaviṣyati mahītale || śanaiścarastvaṃ rāśistho grahāṇāmadhiko yataḥ || 24 || ataḥ śanaiścaronāma bhaviṣyasi sadā bhuvi || gajagaṇḍanibhākāro mama kaṇṭhasamopi ca || 25 || varṇato hyasito nāma bhaviṣyasi mahītale || grahamadhye hyadhodṛṣṭirgatirmaṃdā bhaviṣyati || tuṣṭo dadāsi rājyaṃ ca ruṣṭo vai harasi kṣaṇāt ||26|| devāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || tvatkrūradṛṣṭinihatā nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti nānyathā | 27 || tava prasādātprāpsyaṃti mano'bhīṣṭaṃ sudurllabham || anyacca te pradāsyāmi sthānaṃ guhyaṃ manoharam || 28 || manobhīṣṭakaraṃ puṇyaṃ devadānavadurlabham || pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ proktaṃ mahākālavanaṃ param|| 29 || tatra gaccha mamādeśattvapṛthukeśvarapaścime || vidyate tatra yalliṃgaṃ tatte nāmnā bhaviṣyati || 5.2.50.30 || kīrttireṣā tvadīyāpi trailokye bhavitā dhuvam|| 31 || ityuktaḥ sthāvaro devi mamājñāpālakastadā || jagāma tvarito ramyaṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 32 || dṛṣṭvā tatraiva talliṃgaṃ sthānaṃ labdhaṃ suśobhanam|| talliṃgaṃ bhuvane khyātaṃ nāmataḥ sthāvareśvaram || 33 || śaninoktaṃ tadā devi ye'tra drakṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || mayā prapūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ vikhyātaṃ sthāvareśvaram || teṣāṃ pīḍā madīyā tu na bhaviṣyati karhicit || 34 || madīye ca dine yo vai niyamena prapaśyati || tasyāhaṃ sakalāṃ bādhāṃ śamayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam ||35|| dhakṣyāmi satataṃ pīḍāmanyagrahakṛtāmapi || madīyaṃ ca bhayaṃ tasya svapne'pi na bhaviṣyati || 36 || na grahā na piśācāśca na yakṣā na ca rākṣasāḥ || vighnaṃ kurvaṃti tasyāpi mayi tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ || 37 || saṃkrāṃtau śanivāre ca vyatīpāte'yane tathā|| ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā liṃgaṃ vai sthāvareśvaram || bhaviṣyatyakṣayasteṣāṃ sthiro vāsastriviṣṭape || 38 || niyamena prapaśyaṃti mama vāre'tra ye narāḥ || na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidduṣkṛtotthā na cāpadaḥ || 39 || bhaviṣyati na dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam || dāsyāmi putrakāmasya phalaṃ putrakṛtaṃ sadā || || 5.2.50.40 || adhanasya dhanaṃ caiva bhayārttasyābhayaṃ tathā || svargaṃ vai svargakāmasya prayacchāmi ca vāṃchitam || 41 || ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa bhūyo liṃgaṃ śanaiścaraḥ || pūjayitvā śubhaiḥ puṣpairbhaktyā tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 42 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || sthāvareśvaradevasya śūleśvaramatho śṛṇu || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye sthāvareśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || || cha ||
<5.2.51>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ekādhikaṃ vijānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram || devaṃ śūleśvaraṃ devi sarva vyādhivināśanam || 1 || ādye kalpe pravṛtte ca rājyahetorvarānane || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam || daityānāmīśvare jaṃbhe devānāṃ ca śacīpatau || 2 || tato devāḥ parābhūtā daityā vijayino'bhavan || aṃdhako maṃdaraṃ prāpto dūtaṃ me prāhiṇottadā || 3 || sa dūto māmuvācoccaiḥ sagarvo duṣṭamānasaḥ || andhakenāhamādiṣṭaḥ śṛṇu śaṃkara madvacaḥ || 4 || gaurīṃ me dehi patnyarthaṃ maṃdarastyajyatāmayam || evaṃ kṛte kṛtārthastvamanyathā nāsti te gatiḥ || 5 || ukto'haṃ tena dūtena tvayā saha mahāgirau || smitānanaḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā mayā proktamidaṃ vacaḥ || 6 || gaccha dūta mamādeśādaṃdhakaṃ brūhi satvaram|| ihābhyetyāhavaṃ kṛtvā jitvemāṃ sundarīṃ naya || 7 || ityuktaḥ prayayau dūtastenākhyātaṃ vaco mama || andhako'pi tadā daityaḥ samarārthī tu mandaram || samāyātaḥ sahāmātyo balena caturaṃgiṇā || 8 || mayā saha tatastasya ghoraṃ yuddhamabhūcciram || andhakasya ratho ghoraśchinno bhinnaḥ samaṃ tataḥ || 9 || tataḥ kuddhoṃ'dhako devi rathāttasmādavaplutaḥ || madrathaṃ balavāngṛhya mayā saha balotkaṭaḥ || yuyudhe sa mahādaityaḥ śūlena tāḍito mayā || || 5.2.51.10 || mayā dhṛtontarikṣe sa śūlaproto mahāsuraḥ || śūlaproto'tha vai duṣṭastāvatsa bhrāmito mayā || 11 || susrāva tasya gātrebhyaḥ śoṇitogha stato mahān || bindaubindau tu raktasya tattulyā dānavāstathā || 12 || saṃbhūtāḥ koṭiśo devi tairahaṃ punarardditaḥ || kiṃ karttavyamiti dhyāyansthi to'haṃ tatra bhāmini || 13 || mayā cotpāditā durgā raktadaṃtā subhīṣaṇā || andhakasya tadā pītaṃ raktaṃ vahuvidhaṃ tayā || 14 || tasminpīte tato rakte nottasthurdevi cāpare || pūrvotthitāstayaivāśu nihatā dānavādhipāḥ || tena śūlavareṇaiva tatkṣaṇānnidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 15 || sa māmuvāca hṛṣṭātmā kṛtāṃ jalipuṭoṃ'dhakaḥ || tvayi bhaktiḥ sadā mestu durlabhaṃ tava darśanam || 16 || svāminā nihataścāhaṃ ko'nyo dhanyataro hi mat || tvacchalena vinirbhinno hyantarikṣe tato'pyaham || 17 || saṃkalpākṣepavikṣepaṃ kalpakāryapravarttakam || sahasravaktraśirasaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 18 || girīṃdratanayānāthaṃ girīṃdraśikharālayam || mahālayakṛtāvāsaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 19 || evaṃ stuto'haṃ daityena śūlaprotena sundari || tato me karuṇā jātā kṛtoṃdhako gaṇastadā ||5.2.51.20|| sa ca śūlavaro devi mayā prokto mudā tadā || ehi śūla hato daityastvayā duṣṭoṃdhako mṛdhe ||21|| parituṣṭaḥ prayacchāmi paramaṃ sthāna muttamam|| na devairna ca gandharvairnāpi tatparamarṣibhiḥ||22|| saṃprāpyaṃ māmanārādhya tathā vidhvastakalmaṣaiḥ|| māmuvāca tataḥ śūlaḥ praṇamyānatakandharaḥ ||23|| yadi prasanno bhagavankaruṇā mayi te yadi || kathayasva paraṃ sthānaṃ mano me yatra śuddhyati || duṣṭasaṃparkasaṃjātamanyatpātakamātmanaḥ || 24 || tato mayā samādiṣṭaḥ karuṇāśliṣṭacetasā || mahākālavanaṃ ramyamatipuṇyaphalapradam || 25 || tatrāsmatprāptidaṃ liṃgaṃ lokānugrahakārakam || pṛdhukeśvarapūrveṇa tadārādhaya yatnataḥ || 26 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sa jagāma tvarānvitaḥ || dadarśa tatra talliṃgamanekaphaladāyakam || 27 || liṃgena ca punardṛṣṭaḥ śūlaḥ śaṃkaravallabhaḥ || saṃbhūto'nekavaktrastu harṣādvismitamānasaḥ || 28 || snehātsaṃśleṣito'tyarthaṃ pṛṣṭastu kuśalaṃ punaḥ || kathitaṃ tena śūlena duṣṭāṃdhaka vadhaṃ tadā || 29 || prabhuṇā prerito'tyarthaṃ śuddhyarthaṃ bhavatoṃtike || tvaddarśanena pūto'haṃ yāsyāmi śivasaṃnidhau || adyaprabhṛti bhūloke mannāmnā khyā timeṣyasi || 5.2.51.30 || tato bhaviṣyatyadhikaṃ darśanātte vṛṇomyaham || kiṃ tīrthairvividhaiḥ snātaiḥ kiṃ dānairvividhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 31 || te prāpsyaṃti phalaṃ sarvaṃṃ ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || 32 || yaḥ kariṣyati te pūjāṃ bhaktiyukto'pi mānavaḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ dine bhaumasya bhaktitaḥ || || 33 || vimānavaramāsthāya kāmagaṃ ratnabhūṣitam || uditādityasaṃkāśaṃ sa mudā vicariṣyati || 34 || tvannāma ye grahīṣyaṃti sarvadā bhayapīḍitāḥ || vyādhibhiḥ pīḍitā nityaṃ duḥkhairvā kleśitā bhṛśam || na bhaviṣyati bhīsteṣāṃ ghorasaṃsārasāgare || 35 || ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti puruṣā bhāvahīnāḥ prasaṃgataḥ || na patiṣyaṃti saṃsāre narake cātidāruṇe || 36 || ityuktaṃ tena śūlena liṃgamāśliṣya yatnataḥ || 37 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || śūleśvarasya devasya athoṃkāreśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye śūleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 || || cha ||
<5.2.52>
|| śrīviśveśvara uvāca || || dvyadhikaṃ devi jānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram || oṃkāreśvara ityākhyā yasyāsti bhuvanatraye || 1 || prākṛte kalpasaṃjñe tu prathame prathamaṃ mayā || vaktrādutpādito devi puruṣaḥ kapilākṛtiḥ || 2 || tataḥ sa puruṣo divyaḥ kiṃ karomītyupasthitaḥ || vibhajātmānamityukto mayāṃtarddhānago'bhavat || 3 || | nirvāṇasyeva dīpasya gatistasya na lakṣitā || tatastasyābhavacciṃtā kathamātmā vibhajyate || 4 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya caturmityotthitastataḥ || trivarṇasvararūpī ca caturvargaphalapradaḥ || 5 || ṛgyajuḥsāmanāmā ca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ || vyāpnuvansakalām̐llokānprabhāvaiḥ pṛthubhistadā || 6 || oṃkāra iti tasyākhyā mayā datā prasādataḥ || tadoktābhirudārābhirvāṇībhiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ || 7 || hṛdayāttasya devasya vaṣaṭkāraḥ samutthitaḥ || chaṃdasāṃ pravarā devī caturviṃśākṣarā parā || 8 || ṣaṭkukṣiḥ sā tripādā ca paṃcaśīrṣopalakṣitā || samīpavarttinī devī pārśve tatra vyavasthitā || 9 || gāyatrī madhurābhāṣā sāvitrī lokaviśrutā || sa coṃkāro mayā prokto gāyatryā saha pārvati || sṛṣṭiṃ kuru mamādeśādvicitrāmanayā saha || 5.2.52.10 || ityuktastriśikho bhūtvā hiraṇyasadṛśākṛtiḥ || sṛṣṭimutpādayāmāsa svaśarīrānmamājñayā || 11 || pūrvaṃ devagaṇāścaiva trayastriṃśacca devatāḥ || manuṣyā ṛṣayaścaiva vedaprāmāṇyataḥ kṛtāḥ || 12 || teṣāṃ dehe praviṣṭānāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ punarbhavet || yathā sūryasya satatamudayāstamanaṃ bhavet || 13 || saṃhṛtyoṃkāramakhilānsadevāsurapannagān || kṛtātmagarbhe bhagavānoṃkāro jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 14 || sasarja sarvabhūtāni kalpāṃte parvatātmaje || avyaktaḥ śāśvataścaiva tasya sarvamidaṃ jagat || 15 || karttā caiva vikarttā ca saṃhartā ca mahāṃstu yaḥ || oṃkārapūrvakā vedā yajñāścoṃkārapūrvakāḥ || 16 || oṃkārapūrvakaṃ jñānaṃ tapaścoṃkārapūrvakam || svayaṃbhūriti vijñeyaḥ sa brahmā bhuvanādhipaḥ || 17 || sa vāyuriti vijñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa prajākaraḥ || viśve devāstathā sādhyā rudrādityāstathāśvinau || 18 || prajānāṃ patayaścaiva sapta caiva maharṣayaḥ || vasavo'psarasaścaiva gaṃdharvāścaiva rākṣasāḥ || 19 || daityāḥ piśācā rakṣāṃsi bhūtāni vividhāni ca || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā mlecchādayo bhuvi || sarve catuṣpadāścaiva tiryagyonigatāstadā || 5.2.52.20|| jaṃgamāni ca sattvāni yaccānyajjīvasaṃjñakam|| kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣaṃ ca mamāṃtikamupāgataḥ||21|| praṇamya prayato bhūtvā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || kṛtā sṛṣṭirmayā deva tvatprasādānmaheśvara ||22|| dehi me paramaṃ sthānaṃ yathā kīrttirdhruvā bhavet || oṃkārasya vacaḥ śrutvā mayā proktaṃ varānane ||23|| mamābhīṣṭakaraṃ sthānaṃ nityamavyayamakṣayam || mahākālavanaṃ divyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubham ||24|| tatra te bhavitā kīrttiḥ śāśvatī nātra saṃśayaḥ || śūleśvarasya devasya pūrvabhāge vyava sthitam ||25|| trikalpaprabhavaṃ liṃgaṃ tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || oṃkāreśvara ityākhyā bhaviṣyati jagattraye || 26 || ityukto hi mayā devi oṃkāro hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gataḥ ||27|| tataḥ prabhṛti vedeṣu oṃkāraḥ kriyate dvijaiḥ || puṇyārthaṃ maṃgalārthaṃ ca prathamaṃ sarvavastuṣu || || 28 || layaṃgato yadoṃkārastadāprabhṛti pārvati || mayocyamānaṃ liṃgasya prabhāvātiśayaṃ śṛṇu || 29 || yadyugādisahasreṣu vyatīpātaśateṣu ca || ayanānāṃ sahasreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam || tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi oṃkāreśvaradarśanāt ||5.2.52.30|| caturṣvapi ca vedeṣu samadhīteṣu yatphalam || tato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ proktamoṃkāreśvaradarśanāt ||31|| brahmacaryeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtena ca || tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ proktamoṃkāreśvaradarśanāt ||32|| karīṣasādhane puṇyaṃ yacca puṇyamanāśake || tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi oṃkāreśvaradarśanāt || 33 || pūjāyāṃ yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate || 34 || kiṃ yajñairbahuvittāḍhyaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ || oṃkāradarśanādeva tatphalaṃ labhate yataḥ || 35 || pūjanātsparśanādvāpi kīrttanācchravaṇāttathā || oṃkāreśvaradevasya narāḥ syurmuktibhājanāḥ || 36 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || oṃkāreśvaradevasya śṛṇu viśveśvaraṃ param || 37 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya oṃkāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 || || cha || |||
<5.2.53>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tripaṃcāśattamaṃ viddhi suprasiddhamatheśvaram || paraṃ viśveśvaraṃ khyātaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi || 1 || babhūva nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ vidarbhāyāṃ vidūrathaḥ || sontaḥpurāyutopetaṃ cakre rājyamakaṃṭakam || 2 || jaghāna tāpasaṃ so'tha pramādānmṛgayā gataḥ || kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ dhyāyaṃtaṃ brahma śāśva tam || 3 || mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ devamohitaḥ || tena karmavipākena dehāṃte rauravaṃ gataḥ || 4 || tatrāsau yātanā ghorāṃ anubhūyātmakālataḥ || tasmādihāgato marttye sarpo viṣadharo'bhavat || 5 || adaśatso'pi kopena brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe priye || lakuṭena hataḥ so'pi paṃcatvaṃ tatkṣaṇādgataḥ || 6 || cyutastu narakātsiṃho dvitīye'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ || rājānaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa rājalokairnipātitaḥ || 7 || punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye'pi bhavāṃtare || tīkṣṇapādanakhairghorairghātayāmāsa sūkarān || 8 || tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kaścidvanāṃtare || niṣādairnihataḥ so'pi bāṇaiḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 9 || caturthe 'pi gajo jātaḥ siṃhādvadhamavāptavān || paṃcame makaro jātaḥ kṣārāṃbhasi mahodadhau || | 5.2.53.10 || snātukāmāmatho rāmāmājaghānātipāpakṛt || dhīvaraiḥ kṛtadhikkārairbaḍiśaiḥ sannipātitaḥ || 11 || punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ || siddhamaṃtrairathodagrairatharvaprabhavairbhṛśam || 12 || maṃtrī maṃtravidāṃ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇastaṃ jaghāna ha || saptame sa punarjāto durnirīkṣyavapurbhṛśam || 13 || tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ || śuṣkāṃgo marubhūmīṣu pāpiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ || 14 || ākramya nimirājena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā || samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ ||15|| dāruṇaḥ sārameyo'bhūdatikṛṣṇo'ṣṭame bhave || sa śūkarakhurāghātavraṇaiḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 16 || navame jaṃbuko jātaḥ śmaśāne sa ca māṃsabhuk || laulyātsa nidhanaṃ prāpto duḥkhārtto dāvavahninā || 17 || daśame tvabhavadgṛdhrastīkṣṇatuṃḍo bhayāvahaḥ || pūtimāṃsavasāhāro rogeṇa nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 18 || ekādaśe 'pi caṃḍālo gato'vaṃtyāṃ varānane || dravyasya haraṇārthaṃ vai praviṣṭo dvijaveśmani || 19 || sa daṃḍapāśikenaiva prāpto baddhaśca tatkṣaṇāt || ānīto hi vadhārthāya vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃvitaḥ || 5.2.53.20 || tatraiva liṃgamāsannaṃ sādhvi śūleśvarottare || tasya dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptamativiklavacetasaḥ || 21 || kṣaṇena nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ sa gatastridaśālayam || tatra bhuktvā varānbhogānavatīrya ca bhūtale || 22 || jātaḥ khyāto vidarbhāyāṃ viśveśonāma pārthivaḥ || jāti smaratvamāpanno liṃgadarśanapuṇyataḥ || 23 || durlabhānbubhuje bhogānprāptaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ || so'bhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye vinītamatidharmavit || saṃsmaranpūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ jagāmāvaṃtikāṃ purīm || 24 || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahalliṃgaṃ durdarśamatitejasā || divyena cakṣuṣā'paśyalliṃgamadhye carācaram || 25 || liṃgamadhye sthitāḥ sarve sāgarāḥ saritastathā || dvīpāśca parvatāścaiva tathānyā divyabhūtayaḥ || 26 || caṃdramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityaścāgninā saha || dhanado varuṇaścaiva yamaḥ śakro marutpatiḥ || 27 || maruto devagaṃdharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || nāgā yakṣāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ || 28 || brahmādyā devatāścānyāḥ skaṃdo laṃbodarastathā|| sarvaṃ tribhuvanaṃ devi liṃgamadhye vilokitam||29|| prabhāvaṃ tasya liṃgasya jñātvā samyaṅmahīpatiḥ|| saṃyataḥ pūjayāmāsa viśvayoniṃ maheśvaram ||5.2.53.30|| prasannaścābhavattasya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kimabhīṣṭaṃ dadāmi te||31|| tenoktaṃ vacanaṃ rājñā yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho|| ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti manujāḥ śraddhayā'śraddhayā'thavā ||32|| mā bhūtteṣāṃ prapatanaṃ ghore saṃsārasāgare|| viśveśvareti nāmnā vai prasiddho bhava bhūtale ||33|| ityukte vacane bhūyo viśveśo'laṃkṛto gaṇaiḥ || vimānena sudīptena gato lokaṃ madīyakam ||34|| gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ sārddhaṃ stūyamāno varānane || kirīṭī kuṇḍalī caiva muktāhāravibhūṣitaḥ || vimānaṃ tasya taddivyaṃ parikramya samaṃtataḥ || 35 || samaheṃdradhanādhyakṣanānānākanivāsinaḥ || munayaḥ siddhagaṃdharvāstathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 36 || nṛtyenāmaranārīṇāṃ vilokitavinodakaḥ || yugakoṭisahasraṃ tu matsamīpe vyavasthitaḥ || 37 || ato devi bhuvi khyāto devo viśveśvareśvaraḥ || dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ ca viśveśaṃ pātakairvipramucyate || 38 || saptajanmakṛtairdehī manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtakṛtyatvamāpyate || 39 || tasya naśyati daurbhāgyamalakṣmīrnāśameti ca || prāpnoti dehī kāmāṃśca samṛddhiṃ mānasīṃ sadā || 5.2.53.40 || duḥsvapno vyādhayaḥ krūrā grahā bhūtāśca dāruṇāḥ || praṇaśyanti varārohe viśveśe pūjite sadā || 41 || ye kecicchraddhayā yuktā liṃgamārādhayaṃti vai || te sarvakāma saṃpannā jāyaṃte ca yugeyuge || 42 || aṃte gatiśca sā divyā jāyate matprasādataḥ || yatra saṃpūjyate ligaṃ tasmindeśe śubhāḥ kriyāḥ || 43 || na tatra durbhikṣabhayaṃ nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ kvacit || pretayonau ca vetālā na nāgā na ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ || 44 || ete ca viṣṇubrahmeṃdrakuberavaruṇādayaḥ || liṃgārcanena saṃprāptāḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ mahaujasaḥ || 45 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || viśveśvarasya devasya kaṇṭeśvaramataḥ śṛṇu || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye viśveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripaṃcā śattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || || cha ||
<5.2.54>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || catuḥpaṃcāśataṃ viddhi devaṃ kaṃṭeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhaveta || 1 || ādyakalpe purā devi rājābhūtsatyavikramaḥ || sa śatrubhirjitaḥ saṃkhye hṛtakośo'tiduḥkhitaḥ || 2 || vanaṃ jagāma gahanamekākī śramakarśitaḥ || tatrāśramaṃ dadarśātha vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ || 3 || tenarṣiṇā vasiṣṭhena dṛṣṭamātraḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || pūjito viṣṭarādyena rājārheṇa ca sādaram || 4 || jñātvā tapaḥprabhāvena sūryavaṃśodbhavaṃ nṛpam || papracchāgamanaṃ devi kuśalaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 5 || sa nṛpaḥ kathayāmāsa vasiṣṭhāya suduḥkhitaḥ || rājyaṃ ca sakalaṃ brahmanhṛtaṃ vidveṣibhirmama || 6 || tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpto duḥkhaikāyatano yataḥ || niṣkaṇṭakaṃ kathaṃ rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati punaḥ prabho || upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || dhyātvā ca kathayāmāsa bahukautū halānvitaḥ || 8 || mahākālavanaṃ bhūpa vraja tvaṃ kāryasiddhaye || divyā nadī vane tatra viśrutā bhuvanatraye || 9 || tasyāstīre śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ pṛthukeśvara dakṣiṇe || drakṣyase nṛpaśārdūla tapasyaṃtaṃ ca tāpasam || asthicarmāvaśeṣaṃ tu cīravalkaladhāriṇam || 5.2.54.10 || vacanāttasya viprasya vasiṣṭhasya mahā tmanaḥ || jagāma sahasā rājā mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 11 || dadarśa tāpasaṃ tatra ciraṃjīvinamavyayam || upavāsakṛtakṣāmaṃ dvādaśādityavarcasam || || 12 || tāpasena nṛpo dṛṣṭo mitro'yaṃ mama vallabhaḥ || prāpto rājyaparibhraṣṭo jñātvā vacanamabravīt || 13 || ehyehi nṛpaśārdūla diṣṭyā prāpto'si meṃ'tike || ityuktvā tāpasenaiva huṃkāraśca kṛtastadā || 14 || taddhuṃkārāttu pātālaṃ bhittvā paṃca ca kanyakāḥ || niryayuḥ kāṃcanaṃ pīṭhamekā tāsāṃ pragṛhya vai || 15|| bhṛṃgāraṃ tu gṛhītvānyā niḥsṛtā jalasaṃbhṛtam || pādaprakṣālanārthāya tṛtīyā samupasthitā || 16 || anye dve vyajane gṛhya pārśvābhyāṃ ca vyavasthite || tato huṃkāramakarotpunareva mahātapāḥ || 17 || tena huṃkāraśabdena devalokātsamāgatam || dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasāṃ saṃghaṃ nṛtyagītamano haram || 18 || anaṃtaraṃ dadarśātha liṃgaṃ jyotiṣkaraṃ param || utpannaṃ ca jagadyasmim̐llīyate sacarācaram || 19 || taddṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭo babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ || praṇamya śirasā vipraṃ kimidaṃ dvijasattama || 5.2.54.20 || evaṃ pṛṣṭo nṛpeṇātha sa vipro vākyamabravīt || saptajanmāni rājeṃdra tvayāhaṃ paritoṣitaḥ || 21 || ataste darśitā māyā tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || liṃgasyāsya prabhāveṇa paśya me tapaso balam || 22 || huṃkāreṇa kṛtā pṛthvī jalapūrṇā tu tatkṣaṇāt || huṃkārācca jalaṃ grastaṃ mukhādagnirajāyata || 23 || huṃkārātpṛthivī sarvā jātā vahnimayī tadā || saṃhṛtya tatkṣaṇādvahniṃ mukhādvāyurviniryayau || 24 || huṃkāreṇa kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva pārvati || na diśaḥ pradiśo vāpi na nakṣatragrahāstadā || 25 || tato babhrāma tannāsti sa nṛpo vismayānvitaḥ || ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā kva liṃgaṃ kva ca tāpasaḥ || 26 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya tataḥ śabdo mahānabhūt || tasmācchabdācca saṃjātaṃ puraṃ prākārasaṃvṛtam ||27 || suharmyakakṣyāracitaṃ viśālaṃ viśuddhajāṃbūnadabhūṣitaṃ ca || divyairjanaiḥ sevitamātmavidbhirdadarśa rājā sahasā puraṃ tat || 28 || bhūyobhavanmahāśabdastasmātstrīyugalaṃ vabhau || sitavastradharā caikā kṛṣṇavastradharā sitā || 29 || punaḥ śabdo babhūvātha tasmātpuruṣasattamaḥ || dviśirāḥ ṣaṇmukhaścaiva pādairdvādaśabhiryutaḥ || 5.2.54.30 || punaḥ śabdācca saṃjajñe puruṣaḥ saptadhā gataḥ || saṃhṛtaṃ hi punastacca darśayitvā dvijena tu || proktamitthaṃ viśālākṣi jātakaṃṭakitaṃ nṛpam || 31 || paśya lokamimaṃ mahyaṃ tapasā nirmitaṃ nṛpa || tvatpriyārthamayaṃ loko darśitaste nṛpottama || 32 || evamuktastadā tena tāpasena narādhipaḥ || vismayāpannahṛdayaḥ papraccha prayataḥ sudhīḥ || 33 || bhagavansitakṛṣṇe dve ke striyau dvijasa ttama || ko'sau dvādaśapādvipra dviśirāḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ punaḥ || 34 || kaścāsau puruṣo brahmanya ekaḥ saptadhā'bhavat || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kathayāmāsa tāpasaḥ || 38 || ete striyau tvayā dṛṣṭe sitakṛṣṇe nṛpottama || te ca rātryahanī prokte brahmaṇā nirmite purā || 36 || śīrṣadvayaṃ ca yaddṛṣṭaṃ te'yane dve prakīrtite || mukhāni yāni dṛṣṭāni ṣaṭ ca te hyṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ || pādā dvādaśa ye dṛṣṭā māsā dvādaśa te smṛtāḥ || 37 || yaḥ pumānsaptadhā jāta ekībhūto nareśvara || sa samudrastu vijñeyaḥ saptadhaiko vyavasthitaḥ || 388|| etatsaṃvatsaraṃ cakraṃ tvatpriyārthaṃ nidarśitam || evaṃ viditvā rājeṃdra na śokaṃ kartumarhasi || 39 || sarvo vinaśvaro lokaḥ sadevāsuramānuṣaḥ || mayā dṛṣṭo hi bahuśo liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 5.2.54.40 || kuru śatruvināśāya liṃga syāsya ca darśanam || rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājanbhavipyati na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || evamuktastadā rājā dṛṣṭavām̐lliṃgamuttamam || darśanāttasya liṃgasya kaṇṭakā ye mahībhṛtaḥ || vidveṣiṇo mṛtāste'pi śrutāstena mahībhṛtā || 42 || gatastaṃ viṣayaṃ rājā cakravartī babhūva ha || liṃgasyāsya prabhāvena rājyaṃ kṛtvā mahādhanaiḥ || 43 || yajñaiśca vividhairiṣṭvā paraṃ nirvāṇamāptavān || tāpasena śrutaṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dhyānena tena vai || 44 || labdhaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ liṃgasyāsya ca darśanāt || mama mitreṇa sahasā rājyabhraṣṭena tena vai || 45 || ato nāma suvikhyātaṃ kaṇṭeśvara iti kṣitau || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho darśanādrājyadāyakaḥ || 46 || adyaprabhṛti paśyanti devaṃ kaṇṭeśvaraṃ śivam || teṣāṃ ca kaṇṭakāḥ sadyo vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || naimiṣetha kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre ca puṣkare || snānātsaṃsevanādvāpi yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || tatpuṇyaṃ bhavitā samyakchrīgaṇeśvaradarśanāt || 48 || gṛhiṇo liṃgino vāpi ye paśyaṃti yatavratāḥ || devaṃ kaṇṭeśvaraṃ bhaktyā teṣāṃ siddhirbhaviṣyati || 49 || janmāṃtarasahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam || tatsarvaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ śrīkaṇṭeśvaradarśanāt || 5.2.54.50 || dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat || dhyānamadhyayanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 51 || evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ taṃ vipraṃ tāpasaṃ saṃśitavratam || liṃgenoktaṃ viśālākṣi tuṣṭena varapūrvakam || 52 || jarārogavinirmuktaḥ sarvaśokavivarjitaḥ || bhaviṣyati gaṇādhyakṣo varadaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ || avadhyaścāpi sarveṣāṃ yogaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 53 || evamukto'tha liṃgena tāpaso gaṇatāṃ gataḥ || gaṇaiḥ parivṛto devi mama pārśvamupāgataḥ || 54 || andhakena purā yuddhe siṃhanādo yadā kṛtaḥ || tadā devi madīyaṃ tu jātaṃ kaṇṭakitaṃ vapuḥ || 55 || utpannaṃ ca tadā liṃgamaśeṣārivināśanam || devānāṃ kaṇṭakā ye ca dagdhā liṃgāgninā yataḥ || ataḥ kaṃṭeśvaro devo vikhyāto bhuvanatraye ||56|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kaṃṭeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu siṃheśvaraṃ param || 57 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekaśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kaṃṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 || || cha ||
<5.2.55>
|| || śrīīśvara uvāca || || paṃcādhikaṃ vijānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram || siṃheśvaraṃ varārohe mahābhayavināśanama || 1 || sadyaḥkalpe tvayā devi madarthaṃ hi mahattapaḥ || kṛtaṃ nīlotpalāpāṃgi bhīṣaṇaṃ saṃśitavratam || tapasā tava raudreṇa dagdhaṃ hi bhuvanatrayam || 2 || duṣkaraṃ hi tapo jñātvā bhagavāṃ ścaturānanaḥ || āgatyovāca deveśo devi tvāṃ śubhayā girā || 3 || kiṃ putri prāptukāmāsi kimalabhyaṃ dadāmi te || viramyatāmatikleśātta paso'smānmamājñayā || 4 || tvayā ca vacanaṃ śrutvā gurorgauravagarbhitam || priyaṃ tathyaṃ hitaṃ tatra varṇanirṇītavāṃchitam || 5 || pratyuktaḥ sa tadā brahmā praṇāmanamrayā tvayā || tapasā duṣkareṇāptaḥ patitve śaṃkaro mayā || 6 || sa māṃ śyāmalavarṇeti bahuśaḥ proktavānbhavaḥ || śyāmāhaṃ kāṃcanākārā vallabhena ca saṃyutā || bharttā bhūtapatirvaśyaḥ kathaṃ syāditi me tapaḥ || 7 || tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā varārho varadaḥ prabhuḥ || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 8 || kiyatā caiva kālena vāṃchāsiddhirbhaviṣyati || gaurīnāmnā tu te mūrttiḥ kāṃtyā dīptā bhaviṣyati || 9 || etacchrutvā tvayā vākyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || kruddhā tvaṃ girije'tyarthaṃ kāle'bhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati || 5.2.55.10 || krodhātsiṃhaḥ samudbhūto vadanātte bhayāvahaḥ || vivṛtāsyo mahāraudro jaṭājaṭilakaṃdharaḥ || 11 || proddhūtavalgulāṃgūlo daṃṣṭrotkaṭamukhotkaṭaḥ || tasyāsye patituṃ devi vyavasāyaḥ kṛtastvayā || 12 || so'pi siṃhaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭastvāṃ bhakṣayitumudyataḥ || na caivāsau samartho'bhūdvīkṣituṃ vā tapodhikām || 13 || sa dahyamānaḥ sahasā tejasā tapasā tava || parāṅmukhaḥ samabhavatprāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 14 || tatastavābhūtkaruṇā siṃhaṃ prati yatavrate || kṣudhitasya tvayā tasya kṣīraṃ hyamṛtasannibham || 15 || utpāditaṃ stanābhyāṃ tu tasya siṃhasya kāraṇāta || tathāpi dahyate'tyarthaṃ duṣṭabhāvaṃ yato gataḥ || 16 || tenoktaṃ dahyamānena mātardagdhosmi tejasā || tvadīyena durācāro duṣṭohaṃ pāpavigrahaḥ || 17 || tvāmattukāmo duṣṭātmā tvayāhaṃ janito'dhunā || tasmādyāsyāmi narakaṃ mātṛhā gurughātakaḥ || 8 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā duḥkhitasya sutasya tu || mamatvena viśālākṣi siṃhasya kathitaṃ tvayā ||19|| adhamaṃ vidyate kṣetraṃ mahākālavanaṃ suta|| tatra gaccha mamāde śācchīghraṃ devavinimitam || 5.2.55.20 || kaṃṭeśvarasya devasya samīpe liṃgamuttamam || siṃhanādātsamutpannaṃ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ || 21 || aṃdhakāsurayuddhe vai pīḍite vāsave purā || tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā siṃhastvaritavikramaḥ || 22 || gato mahākālavanaṃ dṛṣṭo devo'tha tatkṣaṇāt|| divyadeho mṛgāristu jāto liṃgasya darśanāt || 23 || mamatvāttasya liṃgasya tvaṃ gatā tatra pārvati || siṃhikārūpamāsthāya śīghraṃ siṃhastvayā priye || 24 || dṛṣṭo divyaśarīrastu liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || tava tuṣṭiḥ parā jātā dṛṣṭvā siṃhaṃ mahādyutim || 25 || kṛtaṃ nāma tvayā devi liṃgasyāsya varānane || divyadehastu sihoyaṃ jāto liṃgasya darśanāt || 26 || ataḥ siṃheśvaro devo bhuvi khyāto bhaviṣyati || etasminnaṃtare brahmā saṃprāptastatra suvrate || uvāca tvāṃ varārohe devaiḥ parivṛtastadā ||27|| ya eṣa siṃhaḥ saṃbhūtastava krodhātsuto yataḥ || tato'sau vāhano devi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 28 || liṃgaṃ siṃheśvaraṃ bhaktyā yaḥ paśyati samāhitaḥ || tasya vāso'kṣayo divyo bhaviṣyati triviṣṭape ||29|| kīrtanānmucyate pāpāddṛṣṭvā bhadrāṇi paśyati || sparśanādasya liṃgasya punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam || 5.2.55.30 || manasā ciṃtitānkāmāṃstāṃśca prāpnoti puṣkalān || tadaiva puruṣo mukto janmaduḥkhajarādibhiḥ || 31 || yadā paśyati siṃheśaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam || vyālavyāghrādayaścaurāstathā sāhasikāśca ye ||32|| tebhyo bhayaṃ na bhavati śrīsiṃheśvaradarśanāt || yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva dānādīnāṃ ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ jāyate samyagdṛṣṭvā siṃheśvaraṃ śivam || 33 || madīyaṃ lokamāpnoti surāsuranamaskṛtam || yaḥ paśyati prayatnena devaṃ siṃheśvaraṃ tadā || 34 || ityuktvāsau jagāmātha brahmā loke svakaṃ priye || yadvapustava pūrvaṃ syātkālakāṃtikalaṃkitam || prabhāvāttapasastasya gauratvaṃ prāptamadbhutam || 35 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || siṃheśvarasya devasya revaṃteśamataḥ śṛṇu || 36 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye siṃheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 55 || || cha ||
<5.2.56>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamaṃ viddhi revaṃteśvarasaṃjñakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa parā siddhiḥ prajāyate || 1 || asahaṃtī purā saṃjñā ravestejo'tiduḥsaham || tapaḥ karttuṃ gatā devi jñātā sūryeṇa suvratā || 2 || aśvarūpaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā jagāmāthottarānkurūn || dadṛśe tatra saṃjñāṃ ca vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm || 3 || gatā sā sammukhaṃ tasya pṛṣṭharakṣaṇatatparā || tatobhūnnāsikāyogastayostatra sametayoḥ || 5 || nāsatya dasrau tanayāvaśvavaktrau vinirgatau || retasoṃ'te ca revaṃtaḥ khaḍgī carmī tanutradhṛk || 6 || aśvārūḍhaḥ samudbhūtastato bāṇadhanurddharaḥ || tena vai jātamātreṇa aśvārūḍhena līlayā || nirjitaṃ ca jagaccedaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ||7 || tato devāḥ parābhūtā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || praṇamya kathayāmāsurbhayakaṃpitakaṃ dharāḥ || 8 || asmākaṃ vibhavaṃ tejo raviputreṇa nāśitam || revaṃtena sureṃdreṇa śṛṇu lokapitāmaha || 9 || tasya gātrasamudbhūto vahnirdhāvati kāla jit || jvalaṃti pādapāstena pataṃti śikharāṇi ca || 5.2.56.10 || sarvato vyākulībhūtaṃ hāhākāramacetanam || tenaiva pīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam || 11 || daśadikṣu pravṛtto'yaṃ samṛddho havyavāhanaḥ || sarvaṃ kiṃśukasaṃkāśaṃ prajvalanniva dṛśyate || 12 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇoktaṃ varānane || jñātaṃ mayā suraśreṣṭhā bhavatāṃ kāryamīdṛśam || 13 || bhaviṣyati ca vastacca kāṃkṣitaṃ yatsurottamāḥ || gacchadhvaṃ sahasā tasmācchaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ surāḥ || 14 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā mamāṃtikamupāgatāḥ || tridaśā bhayasaṃtrastā natvā māmi damabruvan || 15 || ādityatanayenaiva revaṃtena maheśvara || dagdhaṃ tribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ śarīrasthena vahninā || tejasā mahatā caiva vikrameṇa balena ca || 16 || asādhyaḥ kila so'smākaṃ sarveṣāṃ devasattama || bhavānprabhavate tasya nānyaḥ śaṃkara kaścana || 17 || tvāṃ prapadyāmahe sarve bhayārttāḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ || śaraṇaṃ varadaṃ devaṃ tridaśānāṃ maheśvara || 18 || mayā smṛtaḥ sūryaputro revaṃtastatkṣaṇātpriye || prāptaḥ prītiprasannātmā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 19 || kiṃ mayā deva karttavyaṃ brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ || tato mayā sūryaputra utsaṃge ca kṛtastadā || 5.2.56.20 || snehādācuṃbito mūrdhni pariṣvaktaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || dadāmi te mahābhāga varaṃ varaya suvrata || 21 || parituṣṭosmi te kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi || idamājñāpayāmi tvāṃ śreyaścaivamavāpsyasi || 22 || mamābhīṣṭaṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ vidyate pṛthivītale || akṣayaṃ pralaye putra mahākālavanaṃ śubham || tatra dāsyāmi te sthānaṃ tatra kīrttirbhavipyati || 23 || pūrve kaṃṭeśvarasyāpi sthānaṃ paramadurlbham || tatra tvaṃ vasa revaṃta liṃgaṃ drakṣyasi śāśvatam || 24 || sarvadā tridaśaiḥ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || guhyakādhipatistvaṃ ca svargaloke bhaviṣyasi || 25 || aśvaśālāsu sarvāsu pūjanīyo bhaviṣyasi || nṛpatīnāṃ gṛhe caiva vasiṣyasi supūjitaḥ || 26 || tejo madīyaṃ tatsthānaṃ liṃgākāraṃ sanātanam || pūjitaṃ tridaśaistatra saṃsevyaṃ yatnatastvayā || 27 || evamukto mayā devi revaṃto ravijastadā || jagāmākāśamāviśya mahākālavanaṃ kṣaṇāt || 28 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam || sūryaputrastu revaṃto dṛṣṭo liṃgena pārvati || 29 || proktaḥ praṇayapūrveṇa diṣṭyā dṛṣṭo'si sūryaja || adyaprabhṛti te nāmnā khyātiṃ yāsyāmi bhūtale || 5.2.56.30 || sthātavyaṃ matsamīpe tu sūryaputra tvayā sadā || akṣayā bhavitā kīrttistvadīyā bhuvanatraye || 31 || revaṃteśvarasaṃjño'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || ye māṃ drakṣyaṃti revaṃta bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || teṣāmaśvā bhaviṣyaṃti vijayo yaśa ūrjitam || 32 || aiśvaryaṃ dānaśaktiśca putrapautramanaṃtakam || guhyakānāṃ patirbhūtvā svargaloke sa vatsyati || 33 || liṃgasya vacanaṃ śrutvā proktaṃ vai ravisūnunā || revaṃtena viśālākṣi saṃtuṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ||34|| dehi me hyacalā bhaktiṃ dehi me sthānamuttamam || dehi me paramaṃ jñānaṃ dhruvāṃ kīrtiṃ ca dehi me || 35 || bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa bhavabaṃdhabhayāpaha | saṃskṛtārtho'smi saṃjātastava devasya darśanāt || 36 || janmakoṭisusaṃśuddhā ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti dehinaḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirghorasaṃsārasāgare | || 37 || ityuktvā ravisūnurvai revaṃto ravivallabhaḥ || revaṃteśvaradevasya samīpe saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 38 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | revaṃteśvaradevasya ghaṃṭeśvaramatho śṛṇu || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅga māhātmye revaṃteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'yāyaḥ || 56 || || cha ||
<5.2.57>
|| īśvara uvāca || || saptapaṃcāśataṃ viddhi ghaṃṭeśvaramatho śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa kāmāvāptiśca jāyate|| 1 || ghaṃṭonāma gaṇaśreṣṭho babhūva mama vallabhaḥ || cākṣuṣasya manoḥ kāle kautukārthaṃ yadṛcchayā || prasthito brahmasadanaṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmāṇamavyayam||2|| athāyāntaṃ samālokya gandharvaṃ gītakovidam|| citrasenaṃ gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ mudā||3|| mayā tatraiva gantavyaṃ sadane parameṣṭhinaḥ|| gītairārādhayiṣyāmi brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim||4|| citraseno'tha taṃ devi pratyukto ghaṃṭamabravīt|| padmayoniḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ guhyaṃ mantramacīkarat || 5 || etacchrutvā gaṇo ghaṃṭastasthau vismitamānasaḥ || mūhūrtaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa pratihāranivāritaḥ || 6 || hitvā svāminamīśānaṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmāṇamāgataḥ || praveśopi na labhyeta prasādo dūrataḥ sthitaḥ || 7|| evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ || ghaṃṭasya brahmaṇo dvāri praveśo devi nābhavat || 8 || nirgacchatamathālokya vīṇāhastaṃ samutsukam || nāradaṃ sa gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ padmayoniṃ gṛhodarāt || 9 || prokto ghaṃṭena sahasā māṃ nivedaya nārada || gaṇo'haṃ gītatattvajño mahādevasya vallabhaḥ || 5.2.57.10 || darśanārthaṃ samāyāto brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || ghaṃṭasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prītimānabhavanmuniḥ || nāradaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ samāśvāsya sakaitavam || 11 || ahaṃ bṛhaspateḥ pārśve preṣito'smi gaṇādhipa || kiṃcitkāryāṃtaraṃ praṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || āyāsyāmi kṣaṇenaiva tāvatkālaṃ pratīkṣyatām || 12 || ityuktvā nārado devi mama pārśvamupāgataḥ|| vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa ghaṃṭasya munisattamaḥ||13|| īdṛśo durllabho bhṛtyo ghaṃṭena sadṛśaḥ prabho || yastvāṃ tyaktvā gaṇo deva sevāyai parameṣṭhinaḥ|| sthitaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ sāgraṃ praveśaṃ na ca labdhavān||14 tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya munestadā|| mayā śaptastu kopena pata ghaṇṭa mahītale||15|| māṃ tyaktvā hi gatonyatra sevārthaṃ paraveśmani|| mayetyukte ca vacane brahmādvāri sthito'pi san|| 16|| patito bhūtale ghaṃṭo devadāruvanāṃtike || ātmānaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūmau ghaṃṭena pārvati || 17 || proktaṃ śokottareṇaiva vacanaṃ gadgadākṣaram || sevārthaṃ yāti yo'nyatra parihṛtya svakaṃ prabhum || 18 || sa yāti narakaṃ ghoramapakīrtiṃ ca viṃdati || nāradena mama tvadya vaṃcitasya dvayaṃ gatam || yasmātsvāmī na me brahmā na ca devo maheśvaraḥ || 19 || evaṃ vilapatastasya nārado munisattamaḥ || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ yatra ghaṃṭo vyavasthitaḥ || 5.2.57.20 || devadāruvane devi darśanārthaṃ tapasvinām || ghaṃṭena nārado dṛṣṭo bhītenākulacetasā || 21 || avasthāmīdṛśīṃ kṛtvā kimanyanme kariṣyati || evaṃ taṃ ciṃtayānaṃ tu nārado vākyamabravīt || 22 || gaṇādhyakṣa na te kāryo manyuḥ puṇyavināśanaḥ || kīrtyarthaṃ patito ghaṃṭa prāyaścittārthameva ca || 23 || prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā prabhuṃ prāpsyasi śaṃkaram || tasmādgaccha mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 24 || revaṃteśvara pūrve tu vidyate liṃgamuttamam || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ divyaṃ tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || 25 || ityukto nāradenaiva jaigīṣavyaḥ samāgataḥ || tenāpi kathitaṃ sarvaṃ satyamuktamanena vai || 26 || nāradena gaṇādhyakṣa kīrttiste bhavitā'kṣayā || kaśyapena mṛkaṇḍena kaṇvena jamadagninā ||27|| atriṇā bhṛguṇā devi lomaśena surarṣiṇā || prokto ghaṃṭo gataḥ śīghraṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 28 || yatra ghaṃṭāninādena yudhyato mama saṃyuge || pāpakṣayakaraṃ devi saṃbhūtaṃ liṃgamuttamam || dṛṣṭaṃ tatra gaṇenaiva liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham || 29 || darśanāttasya liṃgasya bhūyo ghaṃṭo gaṇo'bhavat || lakṣmyā kāṃtyā samāyuktaḥ sahasrakiraṇākṛtiḥ || 5.2.57.30 || ghaṇṭobhinaṃdito'tyarthaṃ vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || mama pārśvaṃ samāyāto mamātīva priyo'bhavat || 31 || ye paśyanti viśālākṣi devaṃ ghaṇḍeśvaraṃ śivam || te ghaṇṭābhirnāditāstu vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||32|| yāsyaṃti suciraṃ kālaṃ mama lokaṃ sanātanam || ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ paraṃ liṃgaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasyakasyacit || 33 || vyādhito yadi vā dīno duḥkhito vā bhavennaraḥ || yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgena devaṃ ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ priye || dīptakāṃcanavarṇābhairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || 34 || gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ madhye svarge modati mānavaḥ || īpsitām̐llabhate kāmānvīṇāveṇuvinoditaḥ || 35 || tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || hiraṇyadhānyasaṃpūrṇe samṛddhe jāyate kule || rājā vā rājatulyo vā jaṃbūdvīpapatirbhavet || 36 || yaḥ pūjayati deveśaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānamapunarbhavakāraṇam || 37 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || ghaṇṭeśvarasya devasya prayāgeśamatho śṛṇu || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye ghaṇṭeśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 || || cha ||
<5.2.58>
|| īśvara uvāca || || prayāgeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvakāmakaraṃ param || aṣṭādhikaṃ vijānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram || 1 || āsītprathamakalpe tu manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ purā || tasya priyavrataḥ putro yajvā paramadhārmikaḥ || 2 || sa ceṣṭvā bahubhiryajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ || saptadvīpeṣu saṃprāpya bharatādīnsutānpriye || 3 || svayaṃ viśālāṃ badarīṃ gatvā tepe mahattapaḥ || kālena bahunā tatra nāradaḥ samupasthitaḥ || 4 || pūjito viṣṭarārgheṇa rājñā priyavratena ca || sa pṛṣṭaḥ pūjayitvā tu kimāścaryaṃ vadasva me || 5 || ityuktaḥ kathayāmāsa nārado munisattamaḥ || śvetadvīpe mayā rājankanyā dṛṣṭā sarovare || 6 || sā ca pṛṣṭā viśālākṣī kasmādvasasi nirjane || kāsi bhadre kathaṃ vāsi kiṃvā kāryamiha tvayā ||7 || karttavyaṃ cārusarvāṃgi tanmamācakṣva śobhane || evamuktā mayā sā hi māṃ dṛṣṭvā mīlitekṣaṇam || 8 || smṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ sthitā yāvattāvanme jñānamuttamam || vismṛtāḥ sarvavedāśca sarvaśāstrāṇi caiva hi ||9|| tato'haṃ vismayāviṣṭaściṃtāmohasamanvitaḥ || tāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatvā yāvatpaśyāmi pārthiva ||5.2.58.10|| tāvaddivyaḥ pumāṃstasyāḥ śarīre samadṛśyata || tasyāpi puṃso hradaye dvitīyastasya corasi || tasyāpi hṛdaye cānyastṛtīyastu vyavasthitaḥ ||11|| tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā devī sā kumārī kathaṃcana || vedā naṣṭā mamāśeṣā bhadre kiṃ brūhi kāraṇam ||12|| || kanyovāca || || mātāhaṃ sarvavedānāṃ sāvitrīnāma nāmataḥ || māṃ na jānāsi yena tvamato vedā hṛtāstava || 13 || evamukte mayā pṛṣṭā vismayena mahīpate || vedānāṃ tvaṃ tu mātā vai kathayasva mamānaghe || 14 || tvadīya hṛdaye devi ka ete puruṣāstrayaḥ || 15 || || kanyovāca || || ya eṣa maccharīrasthaḥ śubhāṃgaścāru śobhanaḥ || eṣa ṛgvedanāmā tu yajurvedo dvitīyakaḥ || 16 || sāmavedastṛtīyastu trayo vedā mayi sthitāḥ || trayo'gnayastrayo devā maccharīre sthitā dvija || 17 || ityuktvā sā tadā kanyā paśyato mama bhūpate || aṃtarddhānaṃ gatā sadyastato'haṃ vismito'bhavam || 18 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi śaraṇaṃ yāmi kaṃ prabhum || kathamāvirbhaviṣyaṃti vedāḥ śāstrāṇi sāṃpratam || 19|| kāmikastīrtharājastu prayāgaḥ śrūyate śrutau || ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi jñānaṃ samyagbhaviṣyati || 5.2.58.20 || naṣṭavedena raibhyeṇa prāptā siddhiranuttamā || sāvitrī śrūyate tatra akṣayyavaṭasannidhau || 21 || evaṃ manasi saṃdhyāya gato'haṃ nṛpasattama || prayāgaṃ kāmikaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 22 || tapastīvraṃ mayā tatra taptaṃ paramaduṣkaram || athājagāma rājeṃdra prayāgo mūrttimānsvayam || 23 || ukto'haṃ praṇayāttena na māṃ tāpaya nārada || brahmaputra prayāgo'haṃ bhīṣitastapasā tava || 24 || bhavataḥ pārśvamāyātaḥ praṇayena tapodhana || dhanyo'si sarvathā brahmaṃstapasā ca viśeṣataḥ || 25 || mayā sārdhaṃ tvayā brahmangatiḥ kāryā'vikalpataḥ || mahākālavane ramye tatra te jñānamuttamam || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho mama kīrtiśca susthirā || 26 || evaṃ hi bruvatastasya prayāgasya nṛpottama || prādurbabhūva sahasā pītavāsā janārddanaḥ || 27 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirgaruḍastho viyadgataḥ || uvāca meghagaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ sa puruṣottamaḥ || 28 || ehi nārada gacchāmaḥ prayāgo yatra yāsyati || kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā mayā prokto janārdanaḥ || 29 || jñānaṃ me dehi deveśa kathaṃ yāsyāmi tadvanam|| mahākālaṃ jagannātha śrutajñānavivarjitaḥ || 5.2.58.30 || ityuktaḥ śrīdhareṇāhaṃ mahākālavanaṃ nṛpa || ānītastatkṣaṇācchīghraṃ prayāgasahitastadā ||31 ||| ghaṃṭeśvarasya pūrve tu navanadyāstu dakṣiṇe || tatra liṃgamanādi tu jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam || 32 || prayāgaḥ pūjayāmāsa paśyato mama bhūpate || liṃgenoktaṃ prasannena kimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ ||33|| prayāga prayato bhūtvā prasanno'haṃ sadā tavā|| darśanaṃ ca madīyaṃ tu viphalaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||34|| ityuktastena liṃgena madarthaṃ prārthitastadā || jñānaṃ dehi dvijāyāsmai nāradāya mahātmane || 35 || naṣṭā vedāśca śāstrāṇi sāvitryā darśanātprabho || 36 || tato liṃgātsamuttasthau brahmā vedairvṛtastadā || ṣaḍaṃgaiḥ sarahasyaiśca purāṇaiḥ sahitastadā || 37 || ityukto'haṃ tadā devyā sāvitryā nṛpasattama || liṃgasyāsya prabhāveṇa prayāgābhyarthitasya vai || 38 || pratibhāsyaṃti te vedā dharmaśāstrāṇi nārada || ityukte vacane bhūyaḥ prāptā vedā mayā nṛpa || 39 || jñānaṃ ṣaḍaṃgasahitaṃ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || labdhajñānena rājeṃdra mayā proktaṃ vacastadā || 5.2.58.40 || prayāgenārcito devo mama jñānasya kāraṇāt || prayāgeśvarasaṃjñastu khyātiṃ lokeṣu yāsyati || 41 || tadāprabhṛti talliṃgaṃ tīrthakoṭiśatairvṛtam || svargāpavargaphaladaṃ tatra tvaṃ gaṃtumarhasi || 42 || kimanenāśvamedhena iṣṭena nṛpasa ttama || aśvamedhaśataphalaṃ jāyate tasya darśanāt || 43 || tapasā kiṃ sutaptena kāyakleśakareṇa tu || vāñchitaṃ labhate sadyaḥ prayāgeśvaradarśanāt || || 44 || || īśvara uvāca || || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā svāyaṃbhuvasuto nṛpaḥ || priyavrato mahādevi mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || 45 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ navanadyāstu dakṣiṇe || darśanāttasya liṃgasya matsamīpaṃ samāgataḥ || 46 || mayā saṃmānito devi gaṇānāmadhipaḥ kṛtaḥ || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā prayāgeśvaramīśvaram || te dhanyā mānuṣe loke kliśyantyanye nirarthakāḥ || 47 || yā gatiryogayuktasya sattvasthasya manīṣiṇaḥ || sā gatirjāyate samyakprayāgeśvaradarśanāt || 48 || māghamāse sameṣyaṃti prayāgeśvaradarśanam || karttuṃ ye mānuṣāsteṣāmaśvamedhaḥ padepade || 49 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || prayāgeśvaradevasya śṛṇu siddheśvaraṃ param || 5.2.58.50 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye prayāgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 || cha ||
<5.2.59>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || ekonaṣaṣṭikaṃ viddhi devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa siddhiḥ puṃsāṃ prajāyate || 1 || āsīdaśvaśirānāma rājā paramadhārmikaḥ || so'śvamedhena yajñena iṣṭvā sabahudakṣiṇam || 2 || snātaścāvabhṛthe hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ || yāvadāste sa rājarṣistāvatsiddho'tidīptimān || 3 || nānauṣadhiprabhāvajño maṃtrataṃtra viśāradaḥ || āyayau kapilaḥ śrīmānjaigīṣavyaśca siddharāṭ || 4 || tayostvaritamutthāya sa rājābhyāgatakriyām || cakāra parayā yukto mudā vai pṛthi vīpatiḥ || 5 || tāvarcitāvāsanasthau kṣamāśīlau śucivratau || mahaujasau mahābhāgau mumukṣū munipuṃgavau || || vidyāvinayasaṃpannau brahmacaryaparāyaṇau || anekasṛṣṭisaṃhārasthitikāryaparāyaṇau || 7 || udayādityasaṃkāśau vibhāvasusamadyutī|| tejorāśisamāyuktau durnirīkṣyau pṛthagjanaiḥ ||8|| vinayenopasaṃgamya praṇipatyābhivādya ca || sa rājā prāṃjalirbhūtvā praśnamenamapṛcchata || 9 || || aśvaśirā uvāca || || śrutaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhau nānyo devo janārddanāt || dhyātotha pūjito nṝṇāṃ muktido bhavabaṃdhanāt || 5.2.59.10 || saṃsmṛte tu hṛṣīkeśe narāṇāṃ koṭijanmajam || aśubhaṃ kṣayamāpnoti kathaṃ na praṇameddharim || 11 || samārādhya jagannāthaṃ śakrādyāstridivaukasaḥ || vasaṃti muditāḥ svarge divyadyutisamanvitāḥ || 12 || janmamṛtyujarā rogairduḥkhāni vividhāni ca || prayāṃti vilayaṃ sadyaḥ prasanne garuḍadhvaje || 13 || iti pṛṣṭastadā tena prārthitena yaśasvinā || ūcatustaṃ nṛpaṃ siddhau siddhivijñānakovidau || 14 || ka eṣa procyate rājaṃstvayā nārāyaṇo'dhunā || āvāṃ nārāyaṇau dvau tu tvatpratyakṣaṃ gatau nṛpa || 15 || || aśvaśirā uvāca || || bhavaṃtau brāhmaṇau siddhau tapasā dagdhakilviṣau || yuvāṃ nārāyaṇau kasmāditi vākyamuvāca saḥ || 16 || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārddanaḥ || garuḍastho hṛṣīkeśaḥ kastasya sadṛśo bhuvi || 17 || tasya rājño vacaḥ śrutvā saṃsiddhau yogakovidau || darśayāmāsatustau hi kṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ vapuḥ || 18 || kapilo maṃtramāhātmyātsvayaṃ viṣṇurbabhūva ha || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsāśca tatkṣaṇāt || 19 || jaigīṣavyaśca garuḍastatkṣaṇātsamajāyata || tataḥ samabhavattatra rājaveśmani kautukam || 5.2.59.20 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ garuḍasthaṃ sanātanam || āścaryaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ || uvāca kṣāmyatāṃ siddhau nāyaṃ viṣṇurathe dṛśaḥ || 21 || tasya brahmā samutpanno nābhipaṃkajamadhyataḥ || tasmāttu brahmaṇo rudraḥ sa viṣṇuḥ parameśvaraḥ || 2 || iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā tadā tau siddhasattamau || cakratuḥ paramāṃ māyāṃ yogācāryau sumāṃtrikau || 23 || kapilaḥ padmanābhastu padmamadhye prajāpatiḥ || babhūva svayamevātra sahasā yogata stadā || 24 || jaigīṣavyo'tha rudrastu tasyaivāṃke vyavasthitaḥ || dadarśa mahadāścaryaṃ sa rājā yogamohitaḥ || 25 || kautukātpratyuvācedaṃ bhītaḥ kaṃpi takandharaḥ || netthaṃ bhavati viśveśo māyā yogināṃ tadā || sarvarūpī hariḥ śrīmānsarvagaḥ sarvadaḥ smṛtaḥ || 26 || tato vākyāvasāne tu tasya rājñaśca saṃsadi || maśakā matkuṇā yūkā bhramarāḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || 27 || aśvā gāvo hayāḥ siṃhā vyāghrā gomahiṣāstathā || anyepi paśavaḥ kīṭā grāmyā raṇyāśca sarvaśaḥ || 28 || dṛśyaṃte rājabhavane koṭiśaḥ parvatātmaje || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtasaṃghātaṃ rājā vismitamānasaḥ || 29 || yāvacciṃtayate kiṃ syāttāva jjñātaṃ nṛpeṇa hi || jaigīṣavyasya māhātmyaṃ kapilasya mahātmanaḥ || 5.2.59.30 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā sa rājā'śvaśirāstadā || papraccha ca dvijau bhaktyā kimidaṃ siddhasattamau || 31 || sāmarthyamīdṛśaṃ labdhaṃ kasmādvai tapaso balāt || adya me saphalotpattiradya me saphalaṃ śrutam || 32 || saphalā me manovṛttiryuvayordarśanena vai || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kapilo vākyamabravīt || 33 || mahākālavane rājanvidyate liṃgamuttamam || khyātaṃ siddheśvaraṃ nāmnā siddhairabhyarcitaṃ sadā || 34 || saubhāgyeśvarapūrve tu saubhāgyārogyadāyakam || prabhāvāttasya liṃgasya prāptā siddhiranuttamā || 35 || jaigīṣavyena siddhena mayā vaiṃ nṛpasattama || tasmādvraja mahābāho mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 36 || tatra drakṣyasi sarveśaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharama || liṃgamūrttau sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yaste siddhiṃ pradāsyati || 37 || saṃsiddhā bahavastatra sanakādyā nareśvara || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kapilasya mahātmanaḥ || 38 || jagāma sahasā tatra sa rājāśvaśirāstadā || dadarśa caiva tau siddhau siddheśvarasamīpataḥ || 39 || anye ca bahavaḥ siddhāḥ siddhanāthāstathā pare || jñātvā siddheśvaraṃ devaṃ siddhasaṃghaiḥ samarcitam || 5.2.59.40 || liṃgamadhye sthita viṣṇuṃ jñātvā sa nṛpasattamaḥ || pūjayāmāsa bhāvena parameṇa samādhinā || 41 || tatastuṣṭo'bravīddevo varaṃ varaya suvrata || yattebhilaṣitaṃ sarvamahaṃ dāsyāmi bhūpate || 42 || liṃgasya vacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpeṇoktaṃ ca tacchṛṇu || yadi me'sti dayā deva prasanno'si hi cetprabho || 43 || yatte rūpaṃ paraṃ nātha taddarśaya mamācyuta || etadeva hi me deva sadābhilaṣitaṃ hṛdi || 44 || ājanmano jagannātha kadā drakṣye janārddanam || etadicchāmyahaṃ deva varāṇāṃ pravaraṃ varam || dīyamānaṃ tvayābhīṣṭaṃ khyātaṃ siddheśvaraṃ kṣitau || 45 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā liṃgenoktaṃ varānane || na me vidurdevagaṇā nāsurā na maharṣayaḥ || 46 || paraṃ rūpaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha kṛṣṇo'haṃ liṃgatāṃ gataḥ || mamalokaṃ tu ye prāptā munayo maṃtrabhūṣitāḥ || 47 || na caite māṃ vijānaṃti paramārthena pārthiva || yadetaddṛśyate tejo liṃgarūpeṇa māmakam || 48 || etadeva hi brahmādyā dhyāyanti tridaśāstvamī || ato na me paraṃ rūpaṃ draṣṭuṃ kaścitkṣamo bhavet || 49 || anekajanmasaṃśuddhā yogino madanugrahāt || praviśaṃti tanau mahyaṃ muktāḥ saṃsārabaṃdhanaiḥ ||5.2.59.50|| evaṃ hi buvatastasya siddhiḥ prāptā nṛpeṇa hi|| viṣṇurūpaṃ samāsthāya tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gataḥ ||51|| ato devi suvikhyātaṃ liṃgaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā teṣāṃ siddhiśca śāśvatī || 52 || aṃjanaṃ pādalepaṃ ca pādukāsiddhireva ca || guṭikā khaḍgasiddhiśca mahāsiddhiḥ sudurlabhā || 53 || divyauṣadhaiśca yā siddhirmaṃtrasparśodbhavā ca yā || etāstu siddhayaḥ proktā aparā laghimādayaḥ || 54 || dharmārthakāma siddhiśca mokṣasiddhiranuttamā || jāyate nātra sandehaḥ śrīsiddheśvaradarśanāt || 55 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || siddheśvarasya devasya mataṃgeśamatho śṛṇu || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅgamāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || || cha ||
<5.2.60>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || mataṃgeśvara saṃjñaṃ tu ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākamīśvaram || viddhi pāpaharaṃ devi samīhitakaraṃ sadā || 1 || sugatirnāma viprendro babhūva dvāpare yuge || satyavādī sadā dāṃto vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || 2 || mataṃgastasya putro'bhūdbālyāddāruṇatāṃ gataḥ || sabālaṃ gardabhaṃ devi tiṣṭhantaṃ māturaṃtike || daṇḍakāṣṭhena sahasā tāḍayāmāsa cāpalāt || 3 || taṃ tu tīvrāhataṃ dṛṣṭvā gardabhī putragṛddhinī || uvāca mā śucaḥ putra caṃḍālo'yaṃ na vai dvijaḥ || 4 || brāhmaṇe dāruṇaṃ nāsti maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate || tudanpāpākṛtirayaṃ bāle na kurute dayām || 5 || svakīyāṃ bhajate cātha prakṛtiṃ mānavaḥ sadā || etacchrutvā mataṃgastu dāruṇaṃ garddabhīvacaḥ || 6 || daṃḍakāṣṭhaṃ parityajya rāsabhīṃ pratyabhāṣata || brūhi rāsabhi kalyāṇi mātā me yena dūṣitā || 7 || kathaṃ māṃ vetsi caṃḍālaṃ yāyāvarakulodbhavam || kena jātosmi caṃḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ yena me gatam || 8 || || gardabhyuvāca || || nāpitena pramattena brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalena hi || tatastvamasi cāṃḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ tena te gatam || 9 || evamukto mataṃgastu pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt || tātāścaryaṃ śrutaṃ me'dya jāto'haṃ nāpitena vai || 5.2.60.10 || gardabhyā kathitaṃ samyaktasmāttapsye mahattapaḥ || evamuktvā sa pitaraṃ pratasthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ||11|| sa gatvā ca tato'raṇyamatapyata mahattapaḥ || tataḥ saṃtāpayāmāsa vibudhāṃstapasānvitaḥ || 12 || taṃ tathā tapasā yuktamuvāca harivāhanaḥ || mataṃga tapyase kiṃ tvaṃ bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān|| varaṃ dadāmi te'haṃ taṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yadicchasi || 13 || || mataṅga uvāca || || brāhmaṇyaṃ kāmayāno'hamidamārabdhavāṃstapaḥ || dehi me śāśvataṃ śakra vara eṣa vṛto mayā || 14 || etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ tamuvāca puraṃdaraḥ || brāhmaṇyaṃ yācase tvaṃ hi duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ || || 15 || nāśameṣyasi durbuddhe tadupārama mā ciram|| caṃḍālayonau jātena na tatprāpyaṃ kathaṃcana || 16 || evamukto mataṃgastu saṃśitātmā yata vrataḥ || atiṣṭhadekapādena varṣāṇāṃ śatasaṃkhyayā || 17 || tamuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ punareva mahāyaśāḥ || brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ vīra mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ vṛthā || 18 || na hi śakyaṃ prāptumevamacirānnāśameṣyasi || vṛṇu vā kāmamanyaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ sudurlabham || 19 || evamukto mataṃgastu saṃśitātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ || sahasramekaṃ pādena tato'bdānāmavarttata ||5.2.60.20|| tadeva ca punarvākyamuvāca balavṛtrahā || caṃḍālāyaunau jātena nāvāpyaṃ te kathaṃcana || 21 || anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ mā kṛthāstatsvayaṃ śramam || evamukto mataṃgastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ || 22 || atiṣṭhata gayāṃ gatvā soṃguṣṭhena śataṃ samāḥ || suduṣkaraṃ vahanyogaṃ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ || 23 || tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ || tapaṃtaṃ tamabhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ || 24 || varāṇāmīśvaro dātā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 25 || || śakra uvāca || || mataṃga brāhmaṇatvaṃ hi viruddhamiha dṛśyate || brāhmaṇyaṃ durllabhaṃ tāta hyasatāṃ pāpaśīlinām || 26 || brāhmaṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ || tadutsṛjyeha duṣprāpyaṃ brāhmaṇyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 27 || anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ durlabho'yaṃ hi te varaḥ || 28 || || mataṃga uvāca || || kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām || taṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ nānupālayet||29|| brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpyaṃ tribhirvarṇaiḥ śatakrato|| tapasā ca kathaṃ labdhaṃ viśvāmitreṇa bhūbhujā||5.2.60.30|| vītahavyaśca rājarṣistapasā vipratāṃ gataḥ|| tasmāttapaḥ kariṣyāmi nirdvaṃdvo niṣparigrahaḥ|| 31|| ahiṃsādamasatyasthaḥ kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām || daivena kṛtametaddhi yadyahaṃ mātṛdoṣataḥ||32|| etāmavasthāṃ saṃprāpto daivayogātpuraṃdara || nūnaṃ daivaṃ na śakyaṃ tu pauruṣeṇa nivarttitum || 33 || yadahaṃ yatnavānevaṃ na labhe vipratāṃ vibho || evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśa dātumarhasi me param||34|| yadi te'hamanugrāhyaḥ kiṃcidvā sukṛtaṃ mama|| tadupāyaṃ hi me śaṃsa kathaṃ vipro bhavāmi vai||35|| yathā mamākṣayā kīttirbhavedvāpi puraṃdara || kartumarhasi taddeva śirasā tvāṃ prasādaye | 36 || ityukto hi mataṃgena vāsavo balavṛtrahā || kathayāmāsa saṃtuṣṭo liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || 37 || || indra uvāca || || mahākālavane liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā purā || divyamūrttidharaṃ divyaṃ śrīsiddheśvarapūrvataḥ || 38 || tasya darśanamātreṇa vipratvaṃ samavāpsyasi || vāsavasya ca vākyena mataṃgo gatavāṃstadā || 39 || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ siddhakṣetramathāparam || dadarśa tatra talliṃgamaśeṣaphaladāyakam || 5.2.60.40 || dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā || pūjitaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ mataṃgaṃ devasattamaḥ || 41 || aho mahānsabhāgyosi yastvayā toṣito'smyaham || mattaḥ sarvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam || 42 || varado'smi varārhāṇāṃ śāpado'smi durātmanāma || brāhmaṇyaṃ matprasādācca akṣayaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 43 || tato'sau vipratāṃ yāto mataṃgo liṃgadarśanāta || punaḥ pūjāprabhāveṇa brahmalokaṃ gato dvija || 44 || brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ labdhaṃ liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || mataṃgena varārohe tasmāddevo vigīyate || 45 || mataṃgeśvarako loke brahmalokapradāyakaḥ || varṇāśrameṣu vidviṣṭāḥ pāṣaṃḍavacane ratāḥ || 46 || nirmaryādā nirācārā niḥśaṃkāścātilolupāḥ || nirghṛṇāḥ krūrarmāṇo dhṛṣṭāḥ kaliyuge narāḥ|| darśanāttasya liṃgasya te'pi yāṃti triviṣṭapam ||47|| ye viśuddhā mahābhāgā dhyānino muktibhāginaḥ || te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvaram ||48|| brahmadhyānaparā ye ca yajñadānakriyāratāḥ|| te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvaram || 49 || ye'rcayaṃti mahā devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvarama || kṛtapuṇyā narā marttye teṣāṃ vāso'kṣayo divi||5.2.60.50|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || mataṃgeśvaradevasya śṛṇu saubhāgyamīśvaram || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye mataṃgeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 || || cha ||
<5.2.61>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ekaṣaṣṭitamaṃ viddhi saubhāgyeśvaramīśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgya matulaṃ labhet || 1 || pradhamaṃ prākṛte kalpe rājābhūdaśvavāhanaḥ || prāgjyotiṣapure ramye dharmātmā kīrttivarddhanaḥ || 2 || anekayajñakṛtprājñaḥ saṃgrāmeṣvapa rājitaḥ || tasya bhāryā viśālākṣi nāmnā madanamañjarī || 3 || kāśirājasutā subhrū rūpeṇātīva śobhanā || dakṣā suśīlā dharmiṣṭhā gṛhavyāpārako vidā || 4 || catuḥṣaṣṭikalāyuktā sadā bhartṛhite ratā || pūrṇenduvadanā saumyā sadā madhurabhāṣiṇī || 5 || pūrvakarmavaśāddevi durbhūgā samajāyata || sā neṣṭā tasya nṛpaternetrodvegakarī sadā || 6 || śrotrodvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ tasya rājñaḥ karoti sā || dadāha locane rājastasyāḥ saṃdarśanaṃ sadā || 7 || mṛrchāṃ prāpnotyasahyāṃ sa tasyāḥ sparśena bhūpatiḥ || kadā cālokito rājā tayā premṇā varānane || dahyamāno'titīvreṇa vahninā vākyamabravīt || || 8 || dvāsthaitāṃ durbhagāṃ bhāryāmādāya vipine vane || parityajāśu naitatte vicāryaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 9 || tato nṛpasya vacanamavicāryamavekṣya saḥ || dvāsthastatyāja tāṃ subhrūmāropya syaṃdanaṃ vane || 5.2.61.10 || sā ca tyaktā vane śūnye rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ || sasmāra taṃ mahīpālaṃ tamamanyata daivatam || || 11 || atha sā cārusarvāṃgī tatrāsaktātmamānasā || niśvāsaparamā ninye dinaśeṣaṃ tathā niśām || 12 || niśvasantyanavadyāṃgī hāheti rudatī muhuḥ || mandabhāgyeti cātmānaṃ nininda madirekṣaṇā || 13 || na vihāre na cāhāre ramaṇīye na tadvane || na kandareṣu śailānāṃ sā babandha tadā ratim || tyaktā tena varārohe nininda nijayauvanam || 14 || durbhagāhaṃ kva jātātra duṣṭadaivavaśīkṛtā || kathaṃ prāptaḥ sa me bharttā tādṛśo nṛpasa ttamaḥ || 15 || dhanyo'yamatipuṇyo'yaṃ yo'yaṃ yauvanagocaraḥ || anyāsāmasatīnāṃ ca ramiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || abhīṣṭā kasyacitkāṃtā kāṃtaḥ kasyāścidīpsitaḥ || parasparānurāgāḍhayaṃ dāṃpatyamatidurlabham || 17 || mamāyaṃ vallabho rājā na cāhaṃ nṛpavallabhā || parasparānurāgo hi dhanyānāmeva jāyate || 18 || yadyadya sa mahīpālo na mayā saṃgameṣyati || tatkāmāgniravaśyaṃ māṃ kṣapayiṣyati duḥsahaḥ || 19 || ramaṇīyamabhūdyattu puṃskokilanināditam || hīnaṃ hi vallabhenaivaṃ dahatīvādya me vanam|| 5.2.61.20 || itthaṃ sā madanāviṣṭā vilapantī punaḥpunaḥ || dadarśa tāpasaṃ tatra trikālajñaṃ dṛḍhavratam || 21 || mekhalājinakaupīnadaṇḍakāṣṭhopajīvanam || mahaujasaṃ mahābhāgaṃ mumukṣuṃ munipuṃgavam ||22|| udayādityasaṃkāśaṃ vibhāvasusamadyutim || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya sā rājñī durmatā satī || 23 || vinayenopasaṃyamya praṇipatyābhivādya ca || viyogakāraṇaṃ rājñaḥ papraccha praṇatā satī || 24 || bhagavankāśirājasya sutāhamativallabhā || bhaginī śatrusenasya mātuścātīva vallabhā || 25 || aśvavāhanasaṃjñena nṛpeṇoḍhā mahāmune || dharmato dharmakalpena prajapatisamena tu || 26 || sā kimarthaṃ na cābhīṣṭā jātā'haṃ tasya bhūpateḥ || sa cātīva mamābhīṣṭo nṛpatiḥ sarvadā vibho || || 27 || durbhagāhaṃ kathaṃ jātā karmaṇā kena tāpasa || kathaṃ bhavati vaśyo me bharttā nṛpatisattamaḥ || saubhāgyaṃ ca kathaṃ me syāditi satyaṃ ca kathyatām || 28 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ || jñānena kathayāmāsa tasyā daurbhāgyakāraṇam || 29 || pāṇigrahaṇakāle tvaṃ grahaiḥ pāpairvilokitā || bhartā te nṛpatiḥ putri grahaiḥ saumyairvilokitaḥ || 5.2.61.30 || tena te vallabho rājā na tvaṃ bhūpasya vallabhā || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sā rājñī dīnamānasā || papraccha vinayopetā bhaktinamrātmakandharā ||31|| bhagavankena dānena snānena niyamena ca || karmaṇā kena saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ hi kathaṃ bhavet || 32 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ yena labhyate || 33 || mahākālavane putri ligaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam|| mataṃgeśvarapārśve tu vidyate'bhīṣṭadāyakam || tasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ samavāpsyasi ||34|| iṃdrāṇyārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ purā saubhāgyakāraṇāt || saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labdhaṃ naṣṭaḥ śakro'pi labdhavān || tasmādgaccha mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 35 || saubhāgyaṃ bhavitā tatra kāṃtena saha darśanam|| putro bhaviṣyati śubhe tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 36 || ityuktā sā tadā tena tāpasena varānane || vidyate yatra talliṃgaṃ mahākālavanaṃ gatā ||37|| dadarśa praṇayopetā liṃgaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam || darśanāttasya liṃgasya rājā sasmāra tāṃ priyām || 38 || papraccha jamadagniṃ tu kva gatā me priyā vibho || bhakṣitā vipine vipra siṃhavyāghraniśācaraiḥ || 39 || mayā tyaktā nṛśaṃsena ahaṃ tasyāstu vallabhaḥ || evaṃ bruvāṇo nṛpatiḥ pratyukto jamadagninā || 5.2.61.40 || na bhakṣitā sā bhūpāla siṃhavyāghraniśācaraiḥ || sā cāviplutacāritrā tvadbhaktā ca pativratā || || 41 || mahākālavanaṃ rājangatā saubhāgyakāmyayā || bhāryā rakṣyā mahīpāla iti sā śrutiruttamā || 42 || bhāryāyāṃ rakṣyamāṇāyāṃ prajā bhavati rakṣitā || ātmā hi jāyate tasyāṃ sā rakṣyāto nareśvara ||43|| dharmahāniścānudinamabhāryasya bhavennṛpa || nityakriyāyā vibhraṃśaḥ sa cāpi patanāya vai || 44 || patnyānukūlayā bhāvyaṃ yathāśīle'pi bharttari || duḥśīlā durbhagā bhāryā poṣaṇīyā nareśvara || 45 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā samāyāto nareśvaraḥ || mahākālavane ramye dadarśa svāṃ priyāṃ tadā || 46 || saubhāgyālaṃkṛtāṃ subhrū pūjayaṃtīṃ maheśvaram || dṛṣṭvā snehena cāliṃgya pratyuvāca sa tāṃ priyām|| 47 || viraheṇa tvadīyena saṃtapto'haṃ varānane || adya me saphalaṃ cakṣurjīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 48 || yattvāṃ paśyāmi subhage kṛtārthohaṃ kṛtastvayā || evaṃ dṛṣṭātiharṣeṇa sā dadarśa tadā patim || uvāca ca prasīdeti bhūyo bhūyo mudānvitā || 49 || tataḥ sa rājā rabhasātpariṣvajyāha bhāminīm || priye prasanna evāhaṃ bhūyo bhūyo bravīmi kim || 5.2.61.50 || tataḥ samāgamo jāto jātaḥ putro'tidhārmikaḥ || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyāddattonāma sa gīyate || 51 || saubhāgyamatulaṃ labdhaṃ tayā devyā himātmaje || saubhāgyeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu tataḥprabhṛti bhūtale || 52|| ye paśyaṃti viśālākṣi saubhāgyeśvaramīśvaram|| teṣāṃ kule na daurbhāgyaṃ jāyate parvatātmaje || 53 || bhaviṣyati na dāridryaṃ viyogo na ca bandhubhiḥ || putramitrakalatrāṇāṃ liṃgasya ca samarcanāt || 54|| nopasargabhayaṃ teṣāṃ ye paśyaṃti varānane || saubhāgyeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu na grahādibhayaṃ bhavet || 55 || sarvabādhāvinirmukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ || manuṣyo jāyate devi saubhāgyeśvaradarśanāt || saṃpūjyaḥ sarvalokeṣu saubhāgyekanidhirbhavet || 56 |||| jāyate bhūpatirloke sārvabhaumo varānane || nāputrā nādhanā nārī na dīnā na ca duḥkhitā || jāyate durbhagā naiva saubhāgyeśvaradarśanāt || 57 || na vaidhavyaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ śriye|| na putrabhartṛjaṃ duḥkhaṃ jāyate liṃgadarśanāt || 58|| yathā lakṣmīrharernityaṃ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ smṛtā || rohiṇī vallabhā ceṃdoḥ śacī śakrasya vallabhā || tathā sā jāyate nārī saubhāgyeśvaradarśanāt || 59 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || saubhāgyeśvaradevasya śṛṇu rūpeśvaraṃ priye || 5.2.61.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśīti liṃgamāhātmye saubhāgyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 || || cha ||
<5.2.62>
|| īśvara uvāca || || dviṣaṣṭikaṃ vijānīhi devaṃ rūpeśvaraṃ priye|| yasya darśanamātreṇa rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ || 1 || pādmakalpe mahādevi padmonāma mahīpatiḥ || padmagarbhasamudbhūto babhūvātiparākramī || pṛthivyāścaturaṃtāyā jāto dharmarato balī || 2 || sa kadācinmahābāhuḥ prabhūtabalavāhanaḥ|| vanaṃ jagāma gahanaṃ hayanāgaśatairvṛtaḥ || 3 || bilvārkakhadirākīrṇaṃ kapitthadhavasaṃkulam || mṛgasiṃhairvṛtaṃ ghorairanyaiścāpi vanecaraiḥ || 4|| tatra vanyasahasrāṇi hatvā sabalavāhanaḥ || rājā mṛgaprasaṃgena vanamanyadviveśa saḥ || 9 || eka evottamabalaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamanvitaḥ| sa vanasyāṃtamāsādya mahadāraṇyamāsadat || 6|| taccāpyatītya nṛpatirdadarśāśramamuttamam || manaḥprahlādajananaṃ dṛṣṭikāṃtamatīva ca || 7|| puṣpitaiḥ pādapaiḥ kīrṇamatīva sukhaśādvalam || tato'gacchanmahābāhureko'mātyānvisṛjya tān || 8|| nāpaśyadāśrame tasmiṃstamṛṣiṃ saṃśitavratam|| uvāca ka ihetyuccairvanaṃ saṃnādyanniva ||9|| śrutvātha taṃ tathā śabdaṃ kanyā śrīriva rūpiṇī ||| niścakrāmāśramāttasmāttāpasākāradhāriṇī||5.2.62.10|| sā taṃ dṛṣṭvaiva rājānaṃ padmagarbhasamudbhavam|| āsanenārcayitvā ca papraccha nāma taṃ tadā ||11|| uvāca smayamānātha kiṃ kāryaṃ kriyatāmiti|| tāmabravīttato rājā kanyāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīm||12|| dṛṣṭvā caivānavadyāṃgīṃ yathāvatpratipūjitaḥ || āgato'haṃ mahābhāge muniśreṣṭhamupāsitum || 13 || kva gato bhagavānbhadre tanmamācakṣva śobhane || evamuktā tu sā kanyā tena rājñā tadāśrame || hasaṃtī pratyuvācedaṃ | vākyaṃ samadhurākṣaram|| 14|| kanyāhaṃ pṛthivīpāla kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ || tapasvino dhṛtimato dharmajñasya manasvinaḥ || 15|| sutā kaṇvasya māmevaṃ viddhi tvaṃ manujādhipa || kaṇvaṃ hi pitaramanye pitaraṃ svamajānatī || 16 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpeṇoktaṃ varānane || suvyaktaṃ rājaputrī tvaṃ yathā kalyāṇi bhāṣase || 17 || bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || suvarṇaratnavāsāṃsi kuṃḍale parihārake || 18 || āharāmi tavādyāhaṃ bhāryā me bhava śobhane || gāṃdharveṇa ca māṃ bhīru vivāhenaiva suṃdari || vivāhānāṃ ca raṃbhoru gāṃdharvaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate || 19 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kanyā vacanamabravīt || muhūrttaṃ saṃpratīkṣasva sa māṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati || 5.2.62.20 || ||rājovāca || || icchāmi tvāṃ varārohe bhajamānamaniṃdite || tadarthaṃ māṃ sthitaṃ viddhi tvayā me'pahṛtaṃ manaḥ || 21 || ātmano baṃdhurātmaiva gatirātmaiva cātmanaḥ || ātmanaivātmano dānaṃ kartumarhasi dharmataḥ || || 22 || || kanyovāca || || yadi dharmapathastveṣa yadi cātmā prabhurmama || satyaṃ me pratijānīhi dattamātmānamadya me || 23 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā pariṇītā nṛpeṇa hi || gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena kāmāsaktena pārvati || 24 || kāmitā sā nṛpeṇeva tato gaṃtuṃ samudyataḥ || etasminnaṃtare devi kaṇvaścāśramamabhyagāt || 25 || sā kanyā pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hriyā nopajagāma tam || vijñāyātha ca tāṃ vipro divyajñāno mahātapāḥ || 26 || uvāca paramaṃ kuddhastāṃ kanyāṃ kāmamohitām || tvayāpi duṣṭe rahasi māmavajñāya yatkṛtaḥ || 27 || svayaṃ svayaṃvaro mohāttasmātkṛṣṇā bhaviṣyasi || kutsitā nirghṛṇā dīnā nirlajjā rūpavarjitā || 28
