|| ayaṃ te nṛpatirbharttā duṣṭarūpo bhaviṣyati || 29 || ityuktā tatkṣaṇājjātā sā kanyā rūpavarjitā || kurūpo nṛpatirjātaḥ śāpāttasya mahātmanaḥ || 5.2.62.30 || atha prasādayāmāsa sā kanyā pitaraṃ tadā || bālānabhijñā mūḍhāhaṃ manmathena prapīḍitā || 31 || ajñānācca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tāta tvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi || ayaṃ mahīpatistāta pratyaglīno mahāvrataḥ || 32 || na cāhaṃ prārthitā tena mayāsau prārthito nṛpaḥ || tasmādanugrahaṃ tāta karttumarhasi cāvayoḥ || 33 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā sa vipro'tikṛpānvitaḥ || uvāca svāṃ duhitaramāśvāsyaivaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 34 || naiva vāganṛtaṃ putri yāvadadya smarāmyaham || daivamatra paraṃ manye dhigbuddhiṃ dhikparākramam || 35 || akāryaṃ kārito yena balādahamaniṃdite || upadeśaṃ pradāsyāmi tattvaṃ kartumihārhasi || 36 || mahākālavane puṇye liṃgaṃ rūpapradāyakam || paśupeśvarapūrve tu vidyate'bhīṣṭadāyakam ||37 || tattvaṃ gaccha tvarā yuktā saha bhartrā nṛpeṇa hi || rūpaṃ prāpsyasi duṣprāpyaṃ liṃgadarśanamātrataḥ || 38 || ityuktā sā tadā kanyā saha bhartrā gatā priye || mahākālavane ramye yatra liṃgamanuttamam || 39 || dadarśa parayā bhaktyā sa ca rājā narottamaḥ || tatkṣaṇāddivyadehā sā rūpeṇātimanoharā || divyavastraparīdhānā divyālaṃkārabhūṣitā || 5.2.62.40 || sa ca rājā tathā jātaḥ kaṃdarpasadṛśākṛtiḥ || rūpeṇāpratimo loke tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 41 || ato lokeṣu vikhyāto devo rūpeśvaraḥ priye || rūpado dhanado'tyarthaṃ putradaḥ svargadastathā || 42 || sa ca rājā svakaṃ prāpto rāṣṭraṃ sasyādisaṃyutam || priyayā parayā sārdhaṃ cakre rājyamakaṃṭakam || 43 || rājyaṃ kṛtvā gataḥ svargaṃ bhāryayā saha pārvati || dedīpyamāno vapuṣā dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ || 44 || vimānena sudīptena vaṃdyamāno divālaye || darśanāttasya liṃgasya prāptaḥ padamanāmayam || 45 || ye paśyaṃti viśālākṣi devaṃ rūpeśvaraṃ śivam || na te rūpeṇa hīyaṃte yaśasā ca kulena ca || 46 || sadā rūpakaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || ye paśyaṃti varārohe teṣāṃ lokāḥ sadā'kṣayāḥ || 47 || ye'rcayaṃti narā nityaṃ devaṃ rūpeśvaraṃ param || te'rcitā yāṃti yānena mama lokaṃ sanātanam || 48 || sa eva sukṛtī loke kulaṃ tenāpyalaṃkṛtam|| yaḥ pūjayati rūpeśaṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam || 49 || yaḥ pūjayati deveśaṃ prasaṃgādapi pārvati || dhanavānrūpavānso'pi rājā bhavati bhūtale || 5.2.62.50 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || rūpeśvarasya devasya dhanuḥsāhasrakaṃ 7b || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye rūpeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 || || cha || || ||
<5.2.63>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || dhanuḥsāhasranāmānamīśvaraṃ śṛṇu pārvati || triṣaṣṭisaṃkhyakaṃ divyaṃ darśanātpāpanāśanam || 1 || vidūrathonāma nṛpaḥ khyātakīrttirabhūdbhuvi || tasya putradvayaṃ jātaṃ sunītiḥ .sumatistathā || 2 || ekadā tu vanaṃ yāto mṛgayāṃ sa vidūrathaḥ || dadarśa garttaṃ sumahadbhūmermukhamivodgatam || 3 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ciṃtayāmāsa kimetaditi pārthivaḥ || pātālavivaraṃ manye vaḍavānalasaṃnibham || 4 || ciṃtayanniva tatrāsau dadarśa vijane vane || brāhmaṇaṃ suvrataṃ nāma tapasvinamakalmaṣam || 5 || sa taṃ papraccha nṛpatiḥ kimetaditi bho dvija || 6 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || dānavaḥ sumahāvīryo vasatyugro rasātale || kujaṃbhonāma vikhyāto bhinatti vasudhāmimām || 7 || tamajitvā kathaṃ rājyaṃ bhokṣyase vasudhādhipa || tena vidhvaṃsitā viprā rātrau niḥsṛtya pārthiva || 8 || upadrutāstathā deśā dhvastāścaiva tathāśramāḥ || āpyāyayati daityo'yaṃ sabalī muśalāyudhaḥ || 9 || yadi tvaṃ ghātayasyenaṃ pātālāṃtaragocaram || tataḥ samastavasudhāpatireva bhaviṣyasi || 5.2.63.10 || iti vipra vacaḥ śrutvā maṃtrayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || maṃtribhiḥ sahito'moghaṃ śrutvā muśalamadrije || 11 || taṃ maṃtraṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tu sūnubhyāṃ saha maṃtribhiḥ || tatpārśvavarttinī kanyā śuśrāvātha mudāvatī || 12 || tataḥ katipayāhe tu tāṃ kanyāṃ jalajekṣaṇām || jahāropavanāddaityaḥ kujaṃbhaḥ svasakhīvṛtām || 13 || etacchrutvā mahīpālaḥ krodhaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ || uvāca putrau jāne'haṃ sakujaṃbho mahāsuraḥ || 14 || dṛṣṭvā bhūmau purā gatteṃ tatra saṃśayite mayi || kathito dvijamukhyena mayā pṛṣṭena putrakau || 15 || sa hanyatāṃ so'paharttā mudāvatyāḥ sudurmatiḥ || prasthitau nṛpabhaktyātha svasainyaparivāritau || 16 || tau sutau tatra saṃprāptau pātāle pitṛśāsanāt|| yuyudhāte kujaṃbhena svaśaktyā senayā vṛtau || 17 || tataḥ parighanistriṃśaśaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ || bāṇaiścirataraṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāmāsītsadāruṇam|| 18 || tato māyābalavatā tena daityena tatkṣaṇāt || amoghenādvitīyena muśalena varānane || 19 || hata sainyau raṇe baddhau rājaputrau mahābalau || 5.2.63.20 || tataḥ śrutvā mahīpālo vivarṇavadano'bhavat || baddhaputraḥ parāmārttiṃ jagāma giriputrike || 21 || ruroda bahudhātyarthaṃ putrasnehena pārthivaḥ || tato vilapatastasya mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || anekasṛṣṭisaṃhāradṛṣṭakāryaparāvaraḥ || 22 || uditādityasaṃkāśaḥ saptakalpānugo vaśī || ājagāma nṛpābhyāśe vilapaṃtaṃ dadarśa saḥ || rājānaṃ kathayāmāsa trikālajño mahāmuniḥ || 23 || mā śucastvaṃ mahīpāla kṣattriyo'si dṛḍhavrataḥ || kva śoka kva mahīpālo durjayo lokapālavat || 24 || śokaṃ kupuruṣācīrṇaṃ tyaja tvaṃ rājasattama || udyamaṃ kuru rājeṃdra kujaṃbhaṃ ghātayiṣyasi || 25 || nātyuccaṃ meruśikharaṃ nātinīcaṃ rasātalam || vyavasāyaḥ sakhā yasya nāsti dūre mahodadhiḥ || 26 || mahākālavane liṃgamārādhaya samāhitaḥ || rūpeśvarasya devasya pārśve dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || 27 || dhanuḥsāhasratulyaṃ tu muśalasya nivāraṇam || dhanuḥ prāpsyasi rājeṃdra kujaṃbhaṃ vinipātaya || 28 || dhanuḥsāhasrahastaistu rakṣitaṃ yodhasattamaiḥ || liṃgaṃ devāsurairyuddhe sahasrākṣeṇa sevitam || iṃdreṇa ca dhanurlabdhaṃ jaṃbho vai yena pātitaḥ ||29 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājātha vidūrathaḥ || jagāma tvarito devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 5.2.63.30 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || tasya tuṣṭastadā devo dadau divyaṃ dhanustadā || 31 || dhanuḥsāhasratulyaṃ ca muśalasya nivāraṇam || dhanurlabdhvā tadā rājā baddhagodhāṃgulitravān|| jagāma dhīraḥ pātālaṃ tena gartena satvaram || 32 || tato jyāsvanamatyugraṃ sa cakre pārthivastadā || yena pātālamakhilamāsīdāpūritāṃtaram|| 33 || tato jyāsvanamākarṇya kujaṃbho dānaveśvaraḥ || ājagāmātikopena svasainyaparivāritaḥ || 34 || tato yuddhamabhūttasya saha rājñā varānane || dināni trīṇi sa yadā yodhitastena dānavaḥ || 35 || tataḥ kopaparītātmā muśalāyābhyadhāvata || gaṃdhairmālyaistathā dhūpaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 36 || yāvadgṛhṇāti muśalaṃ tāvatsā ca mudāvatī || pasparśa caṃdanavyājairanekaiśca punaḥpunaḥ || 37 || tataḥ sa gatvā yuyudhe musalenāsureśvaraḥ || tadā musalapātāste dhanuṣā niṣprabhīkṛtāḥ || 38 || dhanurjyāghātaśabdena patite bhūtale tadā || gato vaivasvataṃ lokaṃ kujaṃbhonāma dānavaḥ || 39 || tato'patatpuṣpavṛṣṭistasyopari mahīpateḥ || jagurgaṃdharvapatayo devavādyāni sasvanuḥ || 5.2.63.40 || sa cāpi rājā taṃ hatvā putrau labdhvā sutāṃ tadā || mudāvatīṃ mudā yukto harṣagadgadanirbharaḥ || 41 || putrābhyāṃ sahito devi susaṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ || sāṃtaḥpuraparīvāraḥ punarāyādvarānane || 42 || mahākālavane ramye yatra talliṃgamuttamam|| pūjayāmāsa ratnaiśca vastrairābharaṇaistathā || 43 || tataḥ sa pūjito devaiḥ śakreṇa ca punaḥpunaḥ || asya liṃgasya māhātmyāddhanuḥ prāptaṃ nṛpeṇa 3 || 44 || kujaṃbho'pi hato daityo devavidveṣakārakaḥ || dhanuḥsāhasranāmāyamataḥ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 45 || bhaktyā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti dhanuḥsāhasramīśvaram|| yāsyanti śatravasteṣāṃ kṣayaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 46 || arcite devadeveśe dhanuḥsāhasrike śive || arcitāḥ sarvadevāḥ syurvaradāśca na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || prātarmadhye'parāhṇe ca dhanuḥsāhasrakaṃ śivam || ye namanti narā nityaṃ na te narakabhoginaḥ ||48 || tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā rakṣitā yodhasattamaiḥ || tathāyaṃ rakṣako devo nāmnā dhanuḥsahasrakaḥ ||49|| tatra gaṃgāditīrthāni vidyante vividhāni ca || surahasyātipuṇyāni sadyaḥ pāpaharāṇi ca || 5.2.63.50 || teṣāṃ phalaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ ye paśyanti tu bhaktitaḥ || dhanuḥsāhasrakaṃ nāma sadā śatrukṣayaṃkaram || 51 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanā śanaḥ || dhanuḥsāhasradevasya devaṃ paśupatiṃ śṛṇu || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅgamāhātmye dhanuḥsāhasramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 || || ||
<5.2.64>
|| īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu tvaṃ paśupatyākhyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭikamīśvaram|| yasya darśanamātreṇa paśuyonirna labhyate || 1 || paśupālo mahādevi babhūva bhuvi viśrutaḥ || rājā parama dharmiṣṭhaḥ paśūnāṃ pālane rataḥ ||2|| didṛkṣuḥ sa kadācicca gatastoyanidhiṃ prati || dadarśa tatra puruṣānpaṃca prādhānyataḥ sthitān || ekā strī muktakeśā sā bhramantī ca punaḥpunaḥ || 3 || atha rājā bhayāviṣṭo visaṃjñaḥ samapadyata || saṃveṣṭito dasyubhistaistayā nāryā viśeṣataḥ || 4 || tatonye samapātaṃ ca āgatya nṛpasattamam || saṃveṣṭya saṃsthitaiḥ sarvaistato ruddho mahīpatiḥ || 5 || ruddhe rājani te sarve ekībhūtāstu dasyavaḥ || ghātitāḥ paśupālena na mṛtāḥ punarutthitāḥ || 6 || tasya tāṃ dhṛṣṭatāṃ jñātvā sthairyaṃ ca nṛpatermṛdhe|| tasyaiva nṛpaterdehe līnāste daśa dasyavaḥ || 7 || amūrtā iva te sarve ekībhūtāstato'bhavan || tāndṛṣṭvā duḥkhito rājā paśupālo'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 8 || athāpaśyattadā''yāṃtaṃ nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam || brahmaputraṃ tapoyuktaṃ papraccha sa nṛpastadā || 9 || || paśu pāla uvāca || || bhagavanbrahmaputrādya mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tu kautukam || akasmātpuruṣāḥ paṃca samāyātā bhayāvahāḥ || 5.2.64.10 || tairahaṃ veṣṭito duṣṭairvyākulaśca kṛtastadā || muṣṭibhirhanyamāno'haṃ svastho jāto dvija kṣaṇāt || 11 || tato'nye puruṣāḥ pañca samāyātā niyudhya mām || hanyatāṃ hanyatāmeṣa muktikāmo nṛpādhamaḥ || 12 || evaṃ taiḥ pīḍito'tyarthaṃ punarmohamupāgataḥ || etasminnantare sā strī māmuvāca punaḥpunaḥ || 13 || dṛḍho bhava mahārāja mā viṣādaṃ kuru prabho || hīnavīryā hyamī corāḥ samarthastvaṃ sthiro bhava || 14 || tasyā vākyena vipreṃdra mayā dhairyeṇa saṃyuge || daśa pradhāna puruṣā jitāste na mṛtāḥ prabho || 15 || pralīnā maccharīre tu kepyate kāpi sā'balā || paśupālavacaḥ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt || 32 || ye tvayā puruṣā dṛṣṭāstvayi līnā jitā mṛdhe || buddhīndriyāṇi te pañca paṃca karmendriyāṇi ca || bhramantī yā ca nārī sā tvayā dṛṣṭā nṛpottama || || 17 || manorūpeṇa sā buddhirbhramatyeva hi na sthirā || jitāni tāni pūrveṇa brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || 18 || so'pi krodhavaśaṃ nīta indriyairviṣayaiḥ priyaiḥ || pitāmahena sve yajñe śambhorbhāgo na kalpitaḥ || 19 || mahādevo jagannāthaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || iṃdriyairmohito rājankrodhaṃ cakre surā nprati || 5.2.64.20 || surā vibhūtayo yasya krīḍārthaṃ bhuvanatrayam || tena bhāganimittārthaṃ cakre sajyaṃ dhanustadā || 21 || pūṣṇaśca daṃtāḥ saṃbhagnā mohitaśca divākaraḥ || netre bhagne bhagasyāpi viddho yajño mṛgākṛtiḥ || 22 || paśavaśca kṛtā devā munayo vedavarjitāḥ || ṛṣīṇāṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi hṛtāni vibhunā tathā || 23 || durjayānīndriyāṇyāhurmunayo vedapāragāḥ || manorūpeṇa yā buddhiḥ sā cātīva sudurjayā || 24 || tasmādrājanmahābāho mā viṣādaṃ vṛthā kṛthāḥ || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || paśupālo mahādevi vaktuṃ samupacakrame || 25 || || paśupāla uvāca || || kathaṃ te bhagavanmuktā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || paśubhāvācca brahmāpi śrotumicchāmi kathyatām ||26|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradaḥ punarabravīt || paśu tve'pi gatā devā ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ saha || 27 || brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā gatāḥ śaraṇamīśvaram || stutibhistoṣito devo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ || 28 || uvāca vacanaṃ rājanyatkartavyaṃ taducyatām||29|| devā ūcuḥ|| vedaśāstrāṇi vijñānaṃ dehi no bhava mā ciram|| devastvaṃ pūrvavaddeva yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||5.2.64.30|| ||īśvara uvāca || || bhavaṃtaḥ paśavaḥ sarve mayā sārddhaṃ ca gamyatām || mahākālavane kṣetre paśubhāvavimokṣake||31|| ahaṃ patirvo bhavitā tato mokṣamavāpsyatha || bhavatāmanukaṃpārthaṃ lokānugrahakāraṇam || liṃgarūpī bhaviṣyāmi nāmnā paśupatīśvaraḥ || 32 || atha te tridaśāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tamīśvaram || paśubhāvavinirmuktā gatā hṛṣṭāstriviṣṭapam || brahmā paśupatiṃ prāha prasannenāṃtarātmanā || 33 || ye tvāṃ paśyanti deveśa bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || teṣāṃ kule paśutvaṃ ca ye gatāḥ pitaraḥ prabho || svakaiḥ karmavipākaiśca teṣāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati ||34|| ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kriyate naraiḥ || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tasya devasya pūjanāt || 35 || te narāḥ paśavo loke kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvite phalam || yairna dṛṣṭaḥ paśupatiḥ paśuyonivimocakaḥ || 36 || kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yadupārjitam || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti dṛṣṭvā paśupatiṃ śivam|| 37 || pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado deva sadābhīṣṭakaro bhavet || 38 || sūryagrahe yathā dattaṃ kurukṣetre viśeṣataḥ || pātre dānaṃ suvarṇasya proktamakṣayyamavyayam || 39 || pauṣamāse dinaikena narāṇāmadhikaṃ tathā || taddarśanena deveśa bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 5.2.64.40 || ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā brahmalokaṃ gato nṛpa || kṛtakṛtyaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā munibhiḥ kavibhiḥ saha || 41 || tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra yadīcchasi parāṃ gatim || samārādhaya talliṃgaṃ paśuyonivimocanam || mahākālavanaṃ gatvā indreśvarasya dakṣiṇe ||42|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || jagāma paśupālo'pi mahākālavanaṃ priye || darśanāttasya liṃgasya gato'sau paramāṃ gatim || 43 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || paśupatyākhyadevasya śṛṇu brahmeśvaraṃ śivam || 44 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye paśupatī śvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 || || cha ||
<5.2.65>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || paṃcaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ viddhi brahmeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmaloko hyavāpyate || 1 || pulomānāma daityeṃdro mahābalaparākramaḥ || paulomānāṃ sahasraistu pūjyamānaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 2 || ānarcuste'pi taṃ daityaṃ sureśaṃ tridaśā iva || sa kadācitsamakṣaṃ tu daityānāmidamabravīt || 3 || adyāpi lokapālānāmarkeṃdujvalanāṃbhasām || śatakratorddhaneśasya yamasya varuṇasya ca||4|| yadi nāma tataḥ kiṃ me tapasā jīvitena ca|| so'haṃ vidrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāneva divaukasaḥ||5|| sarvairetaiḥ parivṛtaḥ paulomairbalavattaraiḥ|| ityuktvā gatavāndevi sāgaraṃ daityasaṃvṛtaḥ|| tāvacchayānaṃ sahasā hyapaśyanmadhusūdanam|| 6|| śāradābhrasamābhāsaṃ madhyekālaṃ yathā ghanam || tamālokya tato daityānabravīdanugāṃstathā || 7 || ayaṃ sa dānavagirivajro hi madhusūdanaḥ || kīrttikāṃtākalākelivaidhavyādeśako dviṣām|| 8 || daityasīmaṃtinīkāṃtapatravallīprabhaṃjakaḥ || ayamasmajjayavadhūvaidhavyādeśakaḥ paraḥ || 9 || gataśaṃkaḥ svapityekaḥ sarvadā kuṭilāśayaḥ || haṃtavyastvarayā duṣṭaḥ kāṃkṣito darśanaṃ gataḥ || 5.2.65.10 || ityuktvā sa hi daityeṃdraḥ pulomātiruṣānvitaḥ || abhidudrāva vegena tāvadagre pitāmaham || dadarśa nābhikamale cintayānaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 11 || atha vyākulatāṃ prāpto brahmā dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutam || āyāṃtaṃ daityasiṃhānāṃ sainyaṃ raṇasudurjayam || || 12 || atha bodhaṃ gataḥ kṣipraṃ kaiṭabhārirmahābalaḥ || dadarśāgre pulomaṃ tu svasainyaparivāritam || 13 || ajeyaḥ saṃgare dhīro brahmāṇamidama bravīt || 14 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || pulomasya vināśārthamudyogaḥ kriyatāmiti || asau labdhavaro daityaḥ sahasā māṃ vijeṣyati || 15 || tasmādgaccha tvarāyukto mahākālavane śubhe || liṃgaṃ drakṣyasi tatraiva saptakalpodbhavaṃ param || 16 || uttare cyavaneśasya śivaśaktisamanvitam || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādbalaṃ prāpsyati śāśvatam || 17 || kuṇḍeśvarakarasparśakāri vāri niraṃtaram || tadānaya gṛhītvā tu tenāyaṃ vadhyatāmiti || 18 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ājagāma muhūrtena yatra talliṃgamuttamam || 19 || stutiṃ cakāra sahasā dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā pitāmahaḥ || || 5.2.65.20 || || brahmovāca || || namaste divyarūpāya namaste bahurūpiṇe || namo'viṣahyavīryāya namo viśvakriyātmane || 21 || namaḥ piṃgakaparddāya namaḥ khaṃḍeṃdudhāriṇe|| namaḥ kanakavarṇāya namo vananivāsine || 22 || vaṃde tvāṃ bhūtabharttāraṃ sadā śatruvināśanam || raṇatkanakakeyūraṃ dhṛtapūrṇeṃdumaṃḍa lam || 23 || vande tvāṃ tridaśādhyakṣaṃ viśvādhyakṣaṃ maheśvaram || kṣīṇasaṃsāraduḥkhaughaṃ munidhyātapadaṃ sadā || 24 || vaṃde tvāṃ sarvadā devaṃ daityasaṃghātanāśanam || ṭaṃkapaṭṭiśaśūlāgradhanuḥkhaḍgagadādharam || 25 || evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavām̐lliṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ || kiṃcitsmitamukhaḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ lokakāraṇam || 26 || kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ karomyadya kiṃ dadāmi pitāmaha || kasmātstauṣi muniśreṣṭha kasmādārto'si dṛśyase || || 27 || iti liṃgavacaḥ śrutvā kathitaṃ brahmaṇā tadā || vṛttāṃtaṃ vistarātsarvaṃ liṃgenoktaṃ tadā priye || 28 || jalaṃ gṛhāṇa vāṇīśa śastrajaṃ śatruvāraṇam || haniṣyasi kṣaṇenaiva pulomaṃ sahasainyakam || 29 || ityuktaḥ satvaro brahmā gato yatra janārddanaḥ || jalena tena tāndai tyānpātayāmāsa bhūtale || 5.2.65.30 || sa pulomā mahānāsītsvārociṣeṃ'tare manau || kṛṣṇo'pi brahmaṇā sārddhamājagāma kuśasthalīm || 31 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ nāma cakre janārddanaḥ || brahmaṇā saṃstuto devo mamānugrahakāraṇāt || tasmādbrahmeśvaronāma khyātiṃ lokeṣu yāsyati || 32|| ye drakṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā devaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ śivam|| te brahmalokamākramya sameṣyanti mamāntikam || 33 || yastu paśyetprasaṃgena devaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ śivam || kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa puruṣo na śocenmaraṇaṃ sadā || 34 || yaḥ puṣkaraṃ naro gatvā tapo varṣaśataṃ caret || anyo brahmeśvaraṃ paśyettasya puṇyaṃ tato'dhikam || 35 || paṃcapātakasaṃyukto yo marttyo duṣṭamānasaḥ || sopi gacchecchivaṃ sthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmeśvaraṃ śivam || 36 || cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ vidhivaddaśānāmeva yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti brahmeśvarasya darśanāt || 37 || ityuktvā gatavānviṣṇurvaikuṃṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ priye || brahmalokaṃ jagāmātha brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 38 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || brahmeśvarasya devasya jalpeśvaramatho śṛṇu || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||65||
<5.2.66>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamakaṃ viddhi devaṃ jalpeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpaṃ śamaṃ vrajet || 1 || jalponāma mahādevi rājābhūdbhuvi viśrutaḥ || sadā jalparato nityaṃ jalpa vādapravartakaḥ ||2 || vikalpabahulo nityaṃ saṃsāragaticiṃtakaḥ || subāhupramukhāḥ paṃca putrā jātā mahābalāḥ ||3|| tasya rājño varārohe mūrtāḥ paṃcāgnayo yathā || subāhuḥ śatrumarddī ca jayo vijaya eva ca || vikrāṃtaḥ paṃcamaḥ putraḥ sarve śastrāstrapāragāḥ |||4| pitrā jalpena te rājñā pṛthagrājye pratiṣṭhitāḥ || pṛthakputrā hi te sarve pṛthagdeśādhipāḥ kṛtāḥ ||5|| prācyāṃ subāhurnṛpatiryāmyāṃ vai śatrumardanaḥ || paścimāyāṃ jayo rājā uttare vijayo nṛpaḥ || 6 || madhye vikāṃtasaṃjñastu svapade viniyojitaḥ || vyavasthāmīdṛśīṃ kṛtvā svayameva vanaṃ yayau || 7 || babhūvurmaṃtriṇasteṣāṃ hitā vaṃśakramāgatāḥ || bubhujuḥ svasvarājyāni maṃtribhiḥ sahitāstadā || 8 || vikrāṃtasya ca yo maṃtrī vikalpaikaparāyaṇaḥ || tenoktaṃ vijane deśe vikrāṃtasya mahībhṛtaḥ || 9 || yasyaiṣā pṛthivī kṛtsnā sa samarthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || udyamena padaṃ labdhaṃ vāsavena mahātmanā || 5.2.66.10 || tridaśaiścāmṛtaṃ labdhamudyamena mahīpate || 11 || hīnodyamā mānavā ye kṣattriyāśca viśeṣataḥ || te hāsyāspadatāṃ yāṃti hīnavīryā dinedine || 12 || snehaṃ ca kurute bhrātā rājyalubdho'rthakāraṇāt || arthavīryeṇa tenaiva saṃtoṣaṃ kurute nṛpaḥ|| kriyate na kimarthaṃ tu bhūpa maṃtraparigrahaḥ|| bhujyate sakalaṃ rājyaṃ mayā te maṃtriṇā balāt||14|| paro'pi hitavānbandhurbandhurapyahitaḥ paraḥ || ahito dehajo vyādhirhitamāraṇyamauṣadham || 15 || bhūmimete nirgilaṃti sarpā bilaśayāniva || rājānamaviroddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam || 16 || māyayā mohitaṃ sarvaṃ ko vā kasya ca bāṃdhavaḥ || udyamaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmādbhrātṝṇāṃ nigrahe drutam || 17 || bhrātṛbhirbhrātaraḥ sarve nihatā rājyakāraṇāt || dharmaṃ ca śāśvataṃ jñātvā nihatāścāsurāḥ suraiḥ || 18 || iti maṃtrivacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ || hasitvā pratyuvācedaṃ mamāyaṃ śatrurāgataḥ || 19 || || vikrānta uvāca || || vayaṃ ca bhrātaraḥ paṃca pṛthivīṃ kāmayāmahe || atuṣṭāḥ pṛthagaiśvaryaṃ kathaṃ kṛtsnā bhaviṣyati ||5.2.66.20|| jyeṣṭho bhrātā subāhuśca dvitīyaḥ śatrumardanaḥ || jayaśca vijayaścaiva teṣāṃ laghurahaṃ yataḥ || 21 || || maṃtryuvāca|| ||| rājye sthitaṃ pūjayaṃti jyeṣṭhaṃ pūjārhaṇairvaraiḥ || kaniṣṭhajyeṣṭhatā keyaṃ rājyaṃ prārthayatāṃ nṛṇām || 22 || tatheti ca pratijñāte vikrāṃtena mahībhṛtā|| sa maṃtrī kārayāmāsa abhicāravidhiṃ tadā || 23 || atharvaṇena maṃtreṇa purodhāḥ pracakāra ha || jñātaṃ purohitaisteṣāṃ te'pi cakruḥ samāhitāḥ || 24 || atha kṛtyā samutpannā paścātkṛtyācatuṣṭayam || sapurohitabhṛtyāṃstānagrasaṃstu samaṃ tadā || 25|| tataḥ samastalokasya vismayaścābhavanmahān || yadaika kālaṃ neśuste pṛthakpuranivāsinaḥ ||26|| tataḥ śrutvā ca nidhanaṃ putrāṇāṃ jalpako nṛpaḥ || vane vaśiṣṭhaṃ papraccha kimetadbhagavanprabho || 27 || tenāpi kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā || divyajñānena vṛttāṃtaṃ vikalpaṃ cākaronnṛpaḥ || 28 || || rājovāca || || nimitto'haṃ vināśasya dhigdhi gjanma madīyakam || sārddhaṃ tvamātyaputraiśca mṛtaṃ brāhmaṇapaṃcakam || 29 || matto'nyaḥ kaḥ pāparato bhaviṣyati mahānbhuvi || yadi janma madīyaṃ syā nna ca jātu mahītale || 5.2.66.30 || tataste na vinaśyeyurmama putrapurohitāḥ || dhigrājyaṃ dhikca me janma bhūbhujāṃ ca mahākule || 31 || kāraṇatvaṃ gato yo'haṃ vināśasya dvijanmanām || kurvantaḥ svāminaste'rthaṃ putrāṇāṃ mama yājakāḥ || nāśaṃ yayurna duṣṭāste duṣṭo'haṃ nāśakāraṇe || 32 || itthamudvignahṛdayaḥ sa jalpaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || papraccha ca punaḥ prahvo vaśiṣṭhaṃ jñānināṃ varam || 33 || || || rājovāca || || bhagavanbrūhi me tīrthamaviyogakaraṃ sadā || sadyaḥ pāpaharaṃ vipra liṃgaṃ vā kathaya prabho || 34 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jalpasya pṛthivīpateḥ || vaśiṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa divyajñānena pārvati || 35 || gaccha jalpa mamādeśānmahākālavanottamam || kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyāṃ pṛthvīṃ yatra rāmastapasyati || tatra liṃgamanādyaṃ ca kukkuṭeśvarapaścime || 36 || tadārādhaya rājeṃdra jāmadagnyāśrame sthitaḥ || vaśiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā jalpo'sau pṛthivīpatiḥ || 37 || devadāruvanaṃ tyaktvā mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || dadarśa tatra talliṃgamanādyaṃ devasaṃstutam|| pūjayāmāsa vidhivatparameṇa samādhinā || 38 || tatra vāṇī samutpannā liṃgamadhyādvarānane || na tvaṃ pāpasamācāro na tvaṃ maraṇakāraṇam || putrāṇāṃ nṛpaviprāṇāmadṛṣṭaṃ tatra kāraṇam || 39 || vipākena svakīyena gatā vaivasvataṃ puram || mā śokaṃ kuru rājeṃdra gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ || 5.2.66.40 || anena śuddhabhāvena tuṣṭo'haṃ nṛpasattama || yadabhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ brūhi tatte dāsyāmi nānyathā ||41|| || rājovāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama || saṃsārasāgare ghore mā bhavenmama janma ca || 42 || akṣayāṃ dehi me kīrttiṃ nāmnā me viśruto bhuvi || ayaṃ jalpeśvaro devo jalpenārādhito vibhuḥ || 43 || vadaṃtu tridaśāḥ sarve eṣa me durlabho varaḥ || ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti manujā mannāmnā khyātimāgatam|| teṣāṃ viyogo mā bhūyātputrato dhanato'pi vā || || 44 || na saṃsārabhayaṃ teṣāṃ dasyuto naiva rājataḥ || na bhūtagraharogebhyo bhayamastu kadācana || 45 || śivamastu sadā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ tvaṃ darśanaṃ gataḥ || te dhanyā mānuṣe loke ye tvāṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ || 46 || sarvatīrthābhiṣekaistu yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || tatsarvamadhikaṃ deva labhyate tava darśanāta || || 47 || tāvatpataṃti saṃsāre ghore duḥkhaśatākule || yāvanna dṛśyate devaḥ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ || 48 || yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ tadā te darśanaṃ bhavet || mahatā sukṛtenaiva nālpena tapasā prabho || 49 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā tena liṃgena pārvati || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ svatanau saṃniveśitaḥ || 5.2.66.50 || tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ prāpte nṛpe jalpe varānane || devo jalpeśvaraḥ khyāto devairukto mahītale || bhuktido muktidaścaiva sadābhīṣṭakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 51 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || jalpeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu kedārasaṃjñakam || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye jalpeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣadaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 || || cha ||
<5.2.67>
|| īśvara uvāca || saptaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ kedāreśvarasaṃjñakam || devaṃ śṛṇu varārohe darśanātpāpanāśanam || 1 || sṛṣṭikāle purā devi devā vyāptā himena hi || śītārttā vihvalāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 2 || himādriṇārditāḥ sarve vayaṃ deva jagatpate || trāhi bhītāṃścatuvaktra pitāmaha namo'stu te || 3 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā proktaṃ vai brahmaṇā priye || pīḍitā himaśailena śaṃkaraśvaśureṇa ca || 4 || nāhaṃ yātuṃ samartho'smi satyametanmayoditam|| || mahādeva mṛte devā gatiranyā na vidyate || 5 || sa eva śaraṇaṃ devaḥ sarveṣāṃ no bhaviṣyati || tasyājñayā mayā sarve parvatā racitāḥ purā || 6 || kṛtā buddhirvicitrā ca himādriśca mayā kṛtaḥ || asevyaḥ sarvajaṃtūnāmadhṛṣyo durgamo giriḥ || 7|| himācalasya tasyaiva śāstā devo maheśvaraḥ || tasmādyāsyāmahe devā kailāsaṃ parvatottamam|| 8 || yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || evamuktvā gato brahmā devaiḥ sārddhaṃ mamāṃtikam || dṛṣṭohaṃ pūjitastaistu stuto'haṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 9 || mayā saṃmānitā devāścatuvaktraḥ prapūjitaḥ || pūjayitvā mayā pṛṣṭo brahmā gamanakāraṇam ||5.2.67.1 0|| kiṃ kāryaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārddhamāgato'si pitāmaha || kathitaṃ brahmaṇā sarvaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mayā priye || 11 || himācalaṃ samāhūya maryādā ca kṛtā mayā || śailānāṃ rājarājatve himādriśca pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 12 || devānāṃ viṣayāścaiva gaṃdharvāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || yakṣāṇāmatha nāgānāṃ kiṃnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 13 || vidyādharāṇāṃ krīḍārthaṃ pṛthakpṛthaṅniveśitāḥ || rūpato bhāti śaileṃdraḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhaḥ || 14 || jāhnavīnirjharoṣṇīṣaḥ śarvāṇījanakastathā || 15 || sarvadevamayo divyaḥ sarvatīrthamayaḥ kṛtaḥ || sarvāśramanivāsaśca sarvāmaraniṣevitaḥ || 16 || evaṃ saṃsthāpya śaileṃdraṃ liṃgamūrttirahaṃ sthitaḥ || vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu kedāreśvaranāmataḥ || 17 || udakaṃ nirmitaṃ tatra maṃtrapūrṇaṃ mayā priye || māhātmyaṃ vividhaṃ proktaṃ liṃgasya ca jalasya ca || 18 || yotrāgatya naro bhaktyā samyaṅmāṃ pūjayiṣyati || jalaṃ yo'traiva gṛhṇāti vidhānena varānane || tasyodare bhaviṣyāmi liṃgarūpī na saṃśayaḥ || 19 || ityukte vacane devi sadevāsurapannagāḥ || yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca bhūtavaitālakiṃnarāḥ || 5.2.67.20 || vidyādharagaṇāścaiva mama darśanalālasāḥ || samāyātā varārohe pītvā tatra jalaṃ śubham || 21 || dṛṣṭo'haṃ vidhinā taistu liṃgamūrttigataḥ priye || mama tulyāśca te jātāstasminnadrivare sthitāḥ || janalokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ pūjyamānā varānane || 22 || atha kālena bahunā śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam || kedāreśvaradevasya jalasya ca viśeṣataḥ || 23 || manuṣyāḥ samupāyātāste rajobahulā yataḥ || tamaḥprāyā viśālākṣi tadāhaṃ māhiṣaṃ vapuḥ || 24 || kṛtavāṃstadbhayārthāya na ca te bhītimāgatāḥ || iha devotra devo'tra babhramuste didṛkṣavaḥ || 25 || na tairdṛṣṭo mahādevi yato'haṃ mahiṣākṛtiḥ || sthito'smyalakṣyarūpeṇa tataste dīnamānasāḥ || udvignā niśvasantaśca vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 26 || nātra devo na tīrthāni na gaṃgā puṇyadāyinī || na dharmo na paro lokaḥ sarvame tadviḍambanam || 27 || evaṃ kila purāṇeṣu śrūyate sarvadā śrutau || himālaye ca kedāraṃ liṃgaṃ mokṣapradāyakam|| 28 || evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ yaśasvini || ākāśādutthitā vāṇī mayā proktānukaṃpayā || 29 || amārgaṃ mā vadatvatra na niṃdyāḥ śrutayo'vyayāḥ || purāṇaṃ nānyathā proktaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || 5.2.67.30 || ye niṃdaṃti purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi nāstikāḥ || te yāṃti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 31 || sadā devotra kedāraḥ svargamokṣapradāyakaḥ || vidyate tridaśaiḥ pūjyaḥ satataṃ naiva dṛśyate || 32 || karoti pūjāṃ himavānmāsānaṣṭau ca śāśvatān || himādristena puṇyena nagendrastu kṛto nagaiḥ || sevyaśca ramaṇīyaśca sarvatīrthanamaskṛtaḥ || 33 || sarvaratnanidhānaśca devānāṃ vallabhastathā || grīṣme caiva vasante ca devadevo'tra dṛśyate || 34 || niyatenaiva kālena mānuṣāṇāṃ ca sarvadā || yadi buddhiḥ parā jātā sarvadā mama darśane || 35 || ākhyāsye tadupāyaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ || mā vikalpo'tra karttavyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpsyatha || 36 || kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam || pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ proktaṃ mahākālavanaṃ narāḥ || 37 || tatrāhaṃ saṃbhaviṣyāmi lokānāmanukaṃpayā || liṃgarūpeṇa śiprāyāstaṭe puṇye suśobhane || 38 || someśvarasya devasya paścime sthānamuttamam || prasiddhamupayāsyāmi kedāreśvaranāmataḥ || 39 || sarvadā darśanaṃ tatra mayā sārddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || sarveṣāṃ ca pradāsyāmi sarvā nkāmānna saṃśayaḥ || 5.2.67.40 || iha yāvatphalaṃ tasmāddāsyāmi hyadhikaṃ tataḥ || iti te mānavāḥ sarve śrutvā vāṇīṃ manoramām || ākāśādutthitāṃ divyāṃ manaḥprahrādakārikām || 41 || gatā vanaṃ mahākālaṃ saṃsmaranto maheśvaram || vikalpena vicitreṇa satyameveti nānyathā || 42 || snātvā śiprājale puṇye yāvatpaśyanti bhāskaram || tāvadṛṣṭipathotpannaṃ liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 43 || atha te harṣitāḥ procuḥ kedāro'yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || dṛṣṭo'smākaṃ na sandeho gaṃgā śiprājale sthitā || 44 || tataste pūjayāmāsuḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā || pūjito'haṃ viśālākṣi teṣāṃ tuṣṭo varānane|| || 45 || durlabho'tivaro dattaḥ kailāse sthānamuttamam || akṣayaṃ ca padaṃ dattaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 46 || ato'haṃ tridaśaiḥ proktaḥ kedāreśvaranā mataḥ || prārthitaḥ parayā bhaktyā lokānāmanukaṃpayā || 47 || ihāgatya narā ye ca tvāṃ paśyaṃti subhaktitaḥ || teṣāṃ phalaṃ tvayā deva dātavyamadhikaṃ yataḥ || 48 || himādrau himanāthasya yātrāyāḥ pratyahaṃ phalam || labhante ca narā nityaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 49 || brahmahā vā surāpo vā ste yī vā gurutalpagaḥ || tatsaṃparkī naro yastu tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kilviṣākaraḥ || 5.2.67.50 || so'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ vidhi vacchatānāṃ caiva yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kedāreśvaradarśanāt || 51 || te narāḥ paśavo loke teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || yairna dṛṣṭo mahākāle kedāreśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || 52 || kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yadupārjitam|| tatpāpaṃ saṃkṣayaṃ yāti kedāreśvaradarśanāt || 53 || himālayakṛtā yātrā tasyāḥ proktaṃ ca yatphalam|| tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kedāreśvaradarśanāt||54|| ityukto'haṃ tadā devi devaiḥ praṇatipūrvakam || tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ te'pi devā divaṃ gatāḥ || 55 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kedāreśvaradevasya piśācākhyamataḥ śṛṇu || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kedāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 || ||cha||| ||
<5.2.68>
|| īśvara uvāca || || aṣṭaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ piśācākhyamatheśvaram|| śṛṇu devi prayatnena darśanātpāpanāśanam || 1 || ādau kaliyuge devi śūdro bahudhano'bhavat|| somo nāma suvikhyāto nāstiko vedaniṃdakaḥ ||2|| abrahmaṇyo nṛśaṃsaśca kadaryo nirapatrapaḥ || viśvāsaghātakaścaiva parasvaharaṇe rataḥ|| ||3|| trivargahaṃtā cānyeṣāmātmakāmānuvarttakaḥ || sa kadācinmṛto devi kaṣṭena parameṇa ca || 4 || marudeśe piśāco'bhūnnagno dīno bhayāvahaḥ || nāśakṛtsa piśācānāṃ svapakṣocchedakārakaḥ ||5|| bahavo mardditāstena piśācā balavattarāḥ ||6|| atha tenaiva mārgeṇa kadācicchākaṭāyanaḥ || svādhyāyanirato vidvānvāggmī śamaparāyaṇaḥ || 7 || udayādityasaṃkāśo vibhāvasusamadyutiḥ || śakaṭena sadā yāti sa paśyanparvatātmaje || 8 || gato dadarśa taṃ raudraṃ piśācaṃ ca bhayāvaham|| sa piśācaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo bhoktukāmo'bhyadhāvata || 9 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ śakaṭārūḍhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śākaṭāyanam ||. śakaṭasya dhvaniṃ śrutvā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijasya ca || 5.2.68.10 || tathārūpaḥ piśācastu karṇābhyāṃ vadhirīkṛtaḥ || ātmatrāṇaparo bhūtvā naṣṭaḥ kaṣṭena pārvati || taṃ dhāvaṃtaṃ samālokya piśācaṃ brāhmaṇo'bravīt|| 11 || piśāca trastarūpo'si tvaritaścaiva lakṣyase || kva dhāvasi samācakṣva kutaste bhayamāgatam || 12 || || || piśāca uvāca || || śakaṭasyāsya mahato ghoṣaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃkaram || karṇābhyāṃ badhiro jāto visaṃjñastava darśanāt || 13 || || ||brāhmaṇa uvāca || || piśācānāṃ baliṣṭhāśca śrūyaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ || sa tvaṃ māṃ bhoktukāmo'si vikhyāto brahmarākṣasaḥ ||14 || || ||piśāca uvāca || piśācānāṃ samartho'smi naṣṭo'haṃ tava darśanāt || duḥkhaṃ hi mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvitaṃ ca sudurllabham || ato bhītaḥ palāyāmi jīvahetoḥ sukhārthataḥ || 15 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || kutaḥ piśāca saukhyaṃ te maraṇaṃ śreya eva te || paiśācī kutsitā yoniḥ pāpināmeva jāyate||16|| ||piśāca uvāca|| || sarvatra hi gato jīvo bhavatyeva sukhāśrayaḥ|| tasmājjīvitumicchāmi prasīda brahmarākṣasa|| ||17|| || brāhmaṇa uvāca|| || nāhaṃ tvāṃ bhoktukāmo'smi brāhmaṇo'haṃ na rākṣasaḥ|| sarvabhūtahitārthāya vicarāmi mahītale||18|| sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate || mā kuruṣva bhayaṃ matto mitrabhāvagato hyaham || 19 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā piśācaḥ svasthamānasaḥ || praṇamya pratyuvācedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śākaṭāyanam || 5.2.68.20 || yadi te sarvabhūtānāṃ dattā hyabhayadakṣiṇā || karmaṇā manasā vācā mitrabhāvaṃ gato yadi || 21 || pṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga saṃśayo hṛdaye sthitaḥ || śrutvānukaṃpayā samyaktanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 22 || kena karmavipākena paiśācaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || piśācatvātkathaṃ muktiḥ prāpyate pāpakarmabhiḥ ||23|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā piśācasya varānane || mamatvenāvṛtastasmai prāvocacchākaṭāyanaḥ ||24|| apahṛtya ca viprasvaṃ devasvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || tena pāpena pāpiṣṭhāḥ piśācatvaṃ prayāṃti ca || 25 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva striyaṃ bālaṃ dvijaṃ tathā || vaṃcayitvā haratyarthaṃ sa piśāco bhavennaraḥ || 26 || rājadravyaṃ gṛhītvā tu na yajenna dadāti yaḥ || ātmānameva puṣṇāti piśācatvaṃ sa gacchati || 27 || viśvāsaghātakā ye ca paradāraratāśca ye || prāpnuvaṃti piśācatvaṃ tathā ye vedaniṃdakāḥ || 28 || niṃdaṃti ye purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvadā || te bhavaṃti piśācāśca ye sadā piśunā narāḥ || 29 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vedaprāmāṇyato'dhunā || idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi yastvaṃ jātosi tacchṛṇu || || 5.2.68.30 || somako nāma śūdrastvaṃ paramarmaprakāśakaḥ || viśvāsaghātako jāto devabrāhmaṇadūṣakaḥ || 31 || nāstiko bhinnamaryādo janmanyatrāpi saptame || sakulaṃ pātayitvātra narake dāruṇe bhṛśam || 32 || piśācayoniṃ saṃprāptaḥ punaḥ prāpsyasi rauravam || mahārauravasaṃjñaṃ tu krakacaṃ kālasūtrakam|| yaṃtrapīḍanakaṃ raudraṃ mathanaṃ kumbhavālukam || 33 || ityevaṃ vadatastasya brāhmaṇasya yaśasvini || sasmāra prāktanaṃ janma satsaṃgātkutsitaṃ svakam || || 34 || duḥkhābhibhūto niśceṣṭo dhigdhigityasakṛdbruvan || patito bhūtale devi idaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 35 || aho kenāpi puṇyena bhavatā saha darśanam || jātaṃ mamālpapuṇyasya dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca || 36 || nāsti dharmasamaṃ mitraṃ nāsti dharmasamā gatiḥ || nāsti dharmasamṃ trāṇaṃ sa ca nāsti mama prabho || 37 || magno'haṃ duḥkhajaladhau magno'haṃ pāpakardame || bhrāṃto'hamaṃdhatamasi tatastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 38 || namaste'stu mahābhāga kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || tattapobalanirdiṣṭamidaṃ prāptaṃ mayā'dhunā || 39 || evaṃ nigadatastasya piśācasya varānane || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ sa vipraḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ || 5.2.68.40 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudragatāni vai || kṣetrāṇi yāni saṃtīha teṣāṃ kṣetraṃ supuṇyadam ||41|| mahākālavanaṃ kṣetraṃ pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ gatam || liṃgaṃ tatra mahākṣetre piśācatvavināśanam || 42 || ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya devasya dakṣiṇe tridaśārcitam || paiśācaṃ vidyate bhūyaḥ piśācayonināśanam || tasya darśanamātreṇa piśācatvātpramokṣyase || 43 | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa piśāco varānane || ājagāma tvarāyukto namaskṛtya dvijaṃ tadā ||44|| mahākālavane puṇye samīhitaphalaprade|| dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ snātvā śiprājale śubhe||45|| darśanāttasya liṃgasya sa piśāco varānane || tatkṣaṇāddivyadehastu divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 46 || divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho gato loke sanātane || uddhṛtya sakalaṃ gotraṃ mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ tathā||47|| dṛṣṭvā tanmahadāścaryaṃ māhātmyātiśayaṃ śriye || proktaṃ devairvimānasthaiḥ siddhairākāśagaistathā || 48|| piśācopi gataḥ svargamasya liṃgasya darśanāt| ato devaḥ sa vikhyāto bhaviṣyati mahītale|| piśāceśvarasaṃjñastu sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 49 || ye paśyaṃti narā devi piśāceśvarasaṃjñakam | teṣāṃ hi pitaraḥ sadyo ye cāpi niraye sthitāḥ || piśācatvādvimucyaṃte svargaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 5.2.68.50 || aśvamedhasya yajñasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate so'pi piśāceśvaradarśanāt || 51 | gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānena yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam|| tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ jñeyaṃ piśāceśvaradarśanāt || 52|| ye paśyaṃti caturdaśyāṃ piśāceśvarasaṃjñakam || pretatvaṃ ca piśācatvaṃ kule teṣāṃ na jāyate || 53|| na viyoniṃ naro yāti narakaṃ ca na paśyati || prasaṃgenāpi yaḥ paśyetpiśāceśvarasaṃjñakam || 54 || sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktaḥ sarvabandhusamanvitaḥ || modate pitṛloke sa piśāceśvaradarśanāt || 55 || kīrtanānmucyate pāpāddṛṣṭvā svargaṃ ca gacchati || sparśanādasya liṃgasya punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam|| 56 || tadaiva sa naro muktaḥ saṃsāranigaḍādibhiḥ || yadaiva vīkṣate liṃgaṃ piśāceśvarasaṃjñakam || 57 || yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva dānānāṃ caiva yatphalam || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ jāyate tasya darśanāt || 58|| yadi paśyeccaturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe kārttike tathā | tasya puṇyamasaṃkhyātaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 59 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || piśāceśvaradevasya śrūyatāṃ saṃgameśvaram || 5.2.68.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe piśāceśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68 | |||cha|| ||
<5.2.69>
īśvara uvāca||| || ekonasaptatiṃ devi śṛṇu pārvati yatnataḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa saṃgamo jāyate sadā || 1 || kaliṃgaviṣaye devi subāhurnāma pārthivaḥ|| babhūva bhuvi vikhyāto yajvā paramadhārmikaḥ || 2 || tasya patnī viśālākṣī duhitā dṛḍhadhanvanaḥ || kāṃcīpuranivāsasya kṣātravrataratasya ca || 3 || parasparānurāgatvātparā prītirabhūttayoḥ || tasya rājñaḥ śiro'rttistu madhyāhne jāyate sadā || 4 || āyurvedavidāṃ mukhyaiḥ śarīrasya cikitsakaiḥ || taiḥ praṇītāḥ priye yogā vyathāvṛddhirdinedine || 5 || evaṃ bahutare kāle gate devi mahīpatim || pratyuvāca viśālākṣī bhartturduḥkhena pīḍitā || 6 || kathameṣā śiroroge jarā te pṛthivīpate || vaidyāśca bahavo deva nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ || prayataṃte'sya nāśāya tathāpyeṣa na śāmyati || 7 || evaṃ sa priyayā proktaḥ subāhuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || pratyuvāca priyāṃ bhāryāṃ premṇā praṇayavatsalām || 8 || sukhaduḥkhāśrayaṃ devi śarīraṃ sarvadehinām || pūrvakarmānusāreṇa sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca jāyate || 9 || iti saṃbodhitā rājñī tena rājñā varānane || punaḥ provāca hārddena tamevārthaṃ suduḥkhitā || 5.2.69.10 || yadā sā vāritātyarthaṃ pṛcchatyeva punaḥpunaḥ || tadā rājā prahasyaiva tāṃ ca rājñīmuvāca ha || 11 || yadi tvaṃ śrotukāmāsi rogasyāsya samudbhavam || kāraṇaṃ tattvato devi nākhyāsyāmyahamatra vai || 12 || mahākālavanaṃ gatvā siddhagaṃdharvasevitam || tatra te kathayiṣyāmi yadi kautūhalaṃ tava || 13 || śvaḥ prabhāte gamiṣyāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ śucismite || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sā rājñī vismitā sthitā|| utsukā gamanārthāya mahākālavanaṃ śubham ||14|| atha sā rajanī vṛttā prabhāte nṛpasattamaḥ || pratasthe bhāryayā sārddhaṃ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 15 || ājagāma krameṇaiva mahākālavanaṃ śubham || āvāsaṃ vidadhe dhīmācchiprātīre nṛpastadā || 16 || pātālavāhinī tatra gaṃgā tripathagāminī || dvitīyā nīlagaṃgā ca śiprayā saha saṃgatā || 17 || tāsāṃ ca saṃgamastatra talliṃgaṃ saṃgameśvaram || pūjitaṃ gaṃgayā sārddhaṃ śiprayā nīlagaṃgayā || 18 || atha prāpte subāhau ca sā rājñī vismayānvitā || papraccha praṇayopetā kathyatāmatra kāraṇam || yattvayoktaṃ purā deva kathayiṣyāmi tatra vai || 19 || evamuktaḥ subāhustu priyayā pṛthivīpatiḥ || pratyuvāca priyāṃ premṇā prahasya ca punaḥpunaḥ || 5.2.69.20 || sukhaṃ svapihi bhadrāṃgi śrāṃtā vayamaniṃdite || prabhāte kathayiṣyāmi śirorogasya kāraṇam || 21 || atha sā rajanī vṛttā prabhāte nṛpasattamaḥ || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 22 || ahamāsaṃ kuśūdrastu sarvadā vedaniṃdakaḥ || viśvāsaghātako nityaṃ tvamapyevaṃ tathāvidhā || 23 || putro jātastu duḥśīlo devabrāhmaṇavaṃcakaḥ || kurūpaḥ karkaśo duṣṭaḥ prakṛtyā pāpapūruṣaḥ || 24 || atha dīrgheṇa kālena dvādaśābdaṃ bhayāvahā || anāvṛṣṭistu saṃjātā sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarī || 25 || viyogastu tvayā prāpto mayā sārddhaṃ sutena ca || tato'haṃ duḥkhasaṃtapto vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 26 || icchatā nidhanaṃ sadyo mayā proktamidaṃ vacaḥ || mama puṇyavihīnasya pāpadhyānaratasya ca||27|| sutena bhāryayā sārddhaṃ saṃgamo durlabhaḥ punaḥ || kathaṃ svapiti pāpiṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā pāpaṃ sudāruṇam ||28|| kuṭuṃbārthe karotyevamekākī nistaratyasau || dharma eva paro baṃdhurdharma eva parā gatiḥ|| dharmeṇa sādhyate sarvaṃ tasmāddharmaṃ samāśrayet ||29|| iti ciṃtayato'tyarthaṃ mama prāṇā gatāḥ priye || vividhā yātanā prāptā mayā narakakoṭiṣu || 5.2.69.30 || aṃtakāle'pi dharmasya praśaṃsā yā mayā kṛtā || matsyo'haṃ tena puṇyena jātaḥ śiprājale śubhe || 31 || tvaṃ ca śyenī tato jātā tasminneva vanottame || prāvṛṭkāle'tha saṃprāpte āśleṣānugate ravau || 32 || nadītrayarayeṇaiva niḥsṛto'haṃ jalāttataḥ || tvayā śirasi saṃprāpto nakhairviddho'smi suṃdari || 33 || ānīto'haṃ tvayā devi saṃgameśvarasaṃnidhau || kaivartairnidhanaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane || 34 || mriyamāṇena me dṛṣṭo devo'sau saṃgameśvaraḥ || śiprayā snāpito'tyarthaṃ gaṃgayā nīlagaṃgayā || 35 || tasya darśana mātreṇa jāto'haṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || kaliṃgaviṣaye devi sarvabhūpālavaṃditaḥ || 36 || sutā tvaṃ vallabhā jātā kāṃcīpuranivāsinaḥ || kṣātravrataratasyaiva subhagā dṛḍhadhanvanaḥ || 37 || āvāṃ rājatvamāpannau tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || tvayā kararuhairviddho mārito laguḍaiśca taiḥ || 38 || madhyāhne kadanaṃ smṛtvā tato me śirasi vyathā || smarāmi jātimātmīyāmasya devasya darśanāt ||39 || etatte kathitaṃ devi pṛṣṭo'haṃ yattvayā purā || gaccha suṃdari bhadraṃ te yatra te varttate manaḥ ||5.2.69.40|| sthātavyaṃ ca mayātraiva sevyo'sau saṃgameśvaraḥ ||41|| tataḥ sā niravadyāṃgī nīlotpalavilocanā || karuṇaṃ susvaraṃ kṛtvā bharttāra midamabravīt || 42 || mayāpi saṃsmṛtaṃ deva pūrvajanmani ceṣṭitam || asya liṃgasya māhātmyāttiryagyonigatāvapi || 43 || prāptāvāvāṃ manuṣyatvaṃ nirmaleṣu kuleṣu ca || prāptā śrīratulā loke prāptaṃ rājyamakaṃṭakam || 44 || prāptā bhāryā priyāhaṃ te tvaṃ ca prāpto mayā nṛpa || khyātoyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nāmataḥ saṃgameśvaraḥ || 45 || asya devasya māhātmyādviyogo na bhaviṣyati || yathā kṛṣṇasya lakṣmyā ca pārvatyā ca śivasya ca || 46 || punaḥ praṇamya praṇatā sahasā manmathākulā || bharttā subāhurme bhūyādanyasminniha janmani || 47 || tava devaprasādena yadi tvaṃ saṃgameśvaraḥ || tato vilokya sonmeṣaṃ kusumeṣutaraṃgitām || kāṃtāṃ pibanniva dṛśā prāha tāṃ taralekṣaṇām || 48 || sahajenābhijanyena guṇaiḥ kāṃtyā vibhūṣitā || mayā prāptā viśālākṣi prāptaṃ majjanmanaḥ phalam||49|| tatastāṃ bhayasaṃtrastāṃ kaṃpitādharapallavām|| gṛhītvā ca kare kāṃtāṃ jagāmāṃtaḥpuraṃ nijam||5.2.69.50|| vadankaṃdarpasarpeṇa daṣṭo'haṃ daivato'dhunā|| cacāra tatra niḥsāraṃ saṃsāraṃ kalayandhiyā||51|| pure mama varārohe ciraṃ reme tayā saha|| evaṃ rājā priyāṃ prāpya nivedya ca nijāṃ kathām || 52 || bheje rājyaṃ tayā sārddhaṃ vistāritamahotsavaḥ || aśāśvatamidaṃ jñātvā arthibhyo'pi dadau dhanam || 53 || apūrvatyāginā tena trailokyaṃ vismayaṃ yayau || rājyaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sabhāryo nṛpasattamaḥ ||54|| bhuktvā ca vipulānbhogāṃstasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gataḥ || ato devi suvikhyāto devo'sau saṃgameśvaraḥ || 55 || yaḥ paśyetparayā bhaktyā talliṃgaṃ saṃgameśvaram || na viyogo bhavettasya putrabhrātṛpriyādibhiḥ || ||| 56 || niyamena tu yaḥ paśyettalliṃgaṃ saṃgameśvaram || rājasūyasahasrasya phalaṃ tasyādhikaṃ bhavet || 57 || gāṃgaṃ ca saphalaṃ puṇyaṃ yāmunaṃ nāmardaṃ tathā|| | jāyate cāṃdrabhāgaṃ ca saṃgameśvaradarśanāt || 58 || yaḥ paśyecchrāvaṇe māsi talliṃgaṃ saṃgameśvaram || kārtikasvāmino yātrā kṛtā tena na saṃśayaḥ || ||| 59|| māsi cāśvayuje devaṃ yaḥ paśyetsaṃgameśvaram|| kṛtaṃ tena sahasraṃ tu vājapeyaṃ varānane || 5.2.69.60 || yaḥ paśyetkārttike māsi talliṃgaṃ saṃgameśvaram|| | rājasūyasahasraṃ tu kṛtaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥ || 61 || caturo vārṣikānmāsānyaḥ paśyetsaṃgameśvaram || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ mamābhīṣṭataraṃ priye || 62|| | eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || saṃgameśvaradevasya śṛṇu durddharṣamīśvaram|| 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye saṃgameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 69 || || cha ||
<5.2.70>
|| īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu saptatikaṃ devaṃ durddhareśvaramīśvaram || yasya darśanato devi naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || durddharṣonāma rājābhūnnepālaviṣaye purā || puṇyaketuryaśasvī ca satyasaṃdho dṛḍhavrataḥ || 2 || tisrastasyābhavanbhāryāstattulyāḥ sumanoharāḥ || viharanta vanodyāne vasante pṛthivīpatiḥ || 3 || kadā mṛgarasāviṣṭo devādvai vātaraṃhasā|| turageṇohitaḥ prāpa vanaṃ rucirapādapam ||4|| gajeṃdramṛgaśārdūlasiṃhasaṃbarasaṃkulam || ṛkṣavānaravārāhagaṇḍakādivirājitam ||5 || tasminvane suvistīrṇaṃ kadalīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitam || haṃsakāraṃḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam || 6 || dadarśa darpaṇasvacchaṃ saro nīrajarājitam || snātasiddha vadhūvṛndakucakuṃkumapiṃjaram || 7 || dadarśa kanyāṃ tatraiva kānanasyeva devatām || sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sucārvaṃgīṃ manmathena prapīḍitaḥ || 8 || citranyasta iva kṣipramabhūdvismayaniścalaḥ || sā bhujaṃgīva saṃkṛṣṭā mantreṇevāṃtikaṃ yayau || 9 || kandarpakoṭisadṛśaṃ viśrāntaṃ nṛpamabravīt || sutāṃ māṃ viddhi rājendra kalpasya prāṇavallabhām || 5.2.70.10 || taporatasya śāṃtasya sarvadā brahmacāriṇaḥ || madarthe prārthyatāṃ vipra sa māṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati || 11 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā manmathenākulīkṛtaḥ || lajjāṃ tyaktvā sa bhūpālo yayāce vijane ca tām || 12 || mama prāṇavyayaḥ subhrūstvāṃ vinā samupasthitaḥ || kāryākāryavicāro hi kasya jīvitaśāṃtaye || 13 || tyajyate prāptamamṛtaṃ yadetadbuddhilāghavam || ko jānīte pare loke kasya kiṃ nu bhaviṣyati || || 14 || bhaja māmanavadyāṃgi tavetadvadanāmṛtam|| na pāyayasi cenmahyaṃ mṛtaṃ jānīhi me priye || 15 || svayaṃ pibāmi cedviddhi paralokagataṃ hi mām || śrutveti cakitā tanvī provāca vinayānvitā || 16 || bhraṣṭāyāṃ mayi tātasya vinaṣṭe kanyakāphale || kulaṃ patati naḥ sarvaṃ tasmādetadvici ntyatām|| 17 || yadi te paramaṃ prema mamopari mahīpate || madarthe prārthyatāṃ vipra sa māṃ nṛnaṃ pradāsyati || 18 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā nānyathā me bhaviṣyati || jñātvā kanyāṃ dvijasyaiva kalpasya brahmacāriṇaḥ || 19 || gatvā yayāce praṇataḥ sthitaṃ nijatapovane || munīndraścaṃdravadanāṃ sa cāsmai tāṃ dadau mudā || 5.2.70.20 || tatraiva saṃgato rājā manmathena vaśīkṛtaḥ || reme ramaṇakairyogairna sasmāra nijaṃ puram || 21 || kadalīkhaṇḍakuñjeṣu ramyāsu vanarājiṣu || bahulāmrakadaṃbeṣu rājā bheje navāṃ vadhūm || siṣeve cāru surataṃ sa vidagdho'timugdhayā || 22 || evaṃ hi vasatastasya durddharṣasya varā nane || ājagāma sudurddharṣo rākṣaso'tibhayaṃkaraḥ || 23 || jvalito vikaṭākāro daṃṣṭrotkaṭakaṭānanaḥ || taṃ nṛpaṃ mohayitvā tu tarasā taralekṣaṇām || jahāra manmathāviṣṭo rūpayauvanaśālinīm || 24 || rājā ca tāṃ hṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā viyogaviṣamūrchitaḥ || smṛtvāsmṛtvā sucārvaṃgīṃ vilalāpākulendriyaḥ || || 25 || hā priye premapīyūṣe praṇayāmṛtadīrghike || hā sundari viśālākṣi vakva gatā māṃ vihāya vai || 26 || punarindumivānaṃdaṃ kadā drakṣyāmi te mukham || iti pralāpamakarotsmaraṃstāṃ cāruhāsinīm || unmatta iva babhrāma tatra tatra smarāturaḥ || 27 || evaṃ vilapatastasya durdarṣasya nṛpasya tu || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ kalpo brāhmaṇasattamaḥ || dadarśa nṛpatiṃ tatra bhramaṃtaṃ bhramaraṃ yathā || 28 || jñātvā jāmātaraṃ samyaksamāśvāsya vaco'bravīt || ehi durddharṣa rājendra gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ || kva gato hi mahīpāla nepālaviṣayastava || 29 || kulīnā rūpavatyaśca tisro bhāryāḥ kva vai gatāḥ || kva te rājyaṃ gataṃ bhūpa kutra putrī gatā mama || 5.2.70.30 || sarvaṃ vinaśvaraṃ loke gandharvanagaropamam || anityaṃ jīvitaṃ bhūpa rājyaṃ vai budbudopamam || 31 || evamāśvāsito rājā kalpena ca punaḥpunaḥ || sasmāra tāṃ sucārvaṃgī manmathena prapīḍitaḥ || 32 || brūhi me bhagavansamyagyadi te'sti dayā mayi || kathaṃ rājyaṃ svakīyaṃ syātkathaṃ me suhṛdāgamaḥ|| 33 || tisro bhāryāḥ kathaṃ vipra paśyāmi pṛthivītale || lāvaṇyāmṛtaśālinyastava putryā dvijottama || kathaṃ samāgamo bhūyo bhaviṣyati mayā saha||34|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā vipreṇoktaṃ varānane|| gaccha bhūpāla nepālaṃ mahākālaṃ tato vraja||35|| tasminkṣetre tīrthavare liṃgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || vidyate yatra sūryeṇa tapastaptaṃ suduṣkaram|| 36 || śiprāyāstu taṭe ramye puṇye brahmeśapaścime|| tasya darśanamātreṇa tavābhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati || 37 || kalpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā satvaro nṛpasattamaḥ || nepālaṃ ca tato gatvā samāśvāsya suhṛjjanam|| 38 || sāṃtaḥpuraparīvāro mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || sarvadā sarvasiddhīnāmāśrayaṃ viṣayaṃ śriyaḥ || 39 || tatra snātvā jale puṇye śiprāyāścāśusiddhide || sūryeṇārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ dadarśa nṛpasattamaḥ || 5.2.70.40 || pūjayāmāsa ratnaiśca divyairvastraiḥ subhūṣaṇaiḥ || karpūreṇa sugandhena liṃgapūjā kṛtā tadā || 41 || muktāphalaiḥ sutāraiśca jaladhārābhireva ca || bhaktyā nanartta tasyāgre saṃstuvanvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 42 || śuśrāva śrotrapīyūṣaṃ gītaṃ devagṛhe śubhe || tacchrutvā kautukāviṣṭo dhvaniṃ śrutvā manoramām || priyāmapaśyattatrasthāṃ lāvaṇyalalanāvadhim || 43 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanastanmayo'bhavat || kṣipraṃ taddarśanenaiva smareṇa taralīkṛtaḥ || 44 || jñātvā me saiva patnīyaṃ dṛṣṭā devaprasādataḥ || sāpi lāvaṇyanalinī rājahaṃsaṃ vilokya tam || 45 || kṣipraṃ pulikitā tasyā virarāja kucasthalī || etasminnaṃtare devi vāṇī liṃgātsamutthitā || 46 || viśvāvasoḥ siddhapateḥ sutaiṣā prāṇavallabhā || kalpena pālitā samyastvadarthaṃ nṛpasattama || 47 || ānītā te mayā patnī hatvā taṃ rākṣasādhi pam || gṛhāṇa ca mayā dattāṃ bhuṃkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam || 48 || ityukto'sau gato devi labdhvā bhāryāṃ priyāṃ tadā || sāṃtaḥpuraparīvāro liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 49 || ārādhito nareṃdreṇa durddharṣeṇa mahātmanā || tadāprabhṛti devo'yaṃ durddharṣeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto vāṃchitārthaphala pradaḥ || 5.2.70.50 || ye paśyaṃti viśālākṣi durddharṣeśvarasaṃjñakam || te durddharṣā bhaviṣyaṃti śatrūṇāṃ samare sadā || 51 || saṃkrāṃtau ravivāre ca grahaṇe caṃdra sūryayoḥ || gatvārcayaṃti ye devi devaṃ durddharṣamīśvaram|| te prayāṃti vimānena madīyaṃ sthānamuttamam || 52 || pāpācārāśca ye jīvā duṣkarmaniratā narāḥ || mucyaṃte pātakātsadyo durddhaṣeṃśvaradarśanāt || 53 || darśanātsparśanātsadyo nāmasaṃkīrtanādapi || brahmahatyāsahasraṃ hi tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || || 54 || kṛtaghno niṃdako duṣṭaḥ pāpakarmā durātmavān || paradārarataścauro brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo durddharṣeśvaradarśanāt || 55 || ayane viṣuve caiva saṃprāpte somaparvaṇi || ye paśyaṃti ca durddharṣaṃ snātvā śiprājale śubhe || gaṃgāyāstriguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 56 || tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate || pitarastoṣitāstena ātmā vai toṣitastataḥ || 57 || kalpakoṭisahasraṃ tu matpure pūjito vaset || yadā yāti ca bhūloke tadāsau bhūpatirbhavet || 58 || adhṛṣyaḥ śatruvargeṇa phalaṃ prāpnoti cākṣayam || padaṃ yattridaśairvaṃdyaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || || 59 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || durddharṣeśvaradevasya prayāgeśamataḥ śṛṇu || 5.2.70.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde durddharṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 || || || cha ||
<5.2.71>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ekasaptatikaṃ viddhi prayāgeśvarasaṃjñakam || advitīyaṃ vijānīhi mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || hāstine' bhūtpure śrīmācchaṃtanurnṛpasattamaḥ || vaivasvateṃ'tare kalpe yuge dvāparasaṃjñake || 2 || sa cādbhutamahāvīryo vajrasaṃhanano yuvā || sarvaśāstreṣu kuśalaḥ kalā puṃjavicakṣaṇaḥ || 3 || balena viṣṇusadṛśastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ || gaṃgāmeṣa cacāraikaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitām || 4 || sa kadācinmahābāhuḥ prabhūta balavāhanaḥ || vanaṃ jagāma gahanaṃ hayanāgaśatairvṛtaḥ || 5 || gatvā tatra mṛgānvyāghrānghātayāmāsa līlayā || mahiṣāśvavarāhāṃśca vinighnanrājasattamaḥ || || 6 || sa kadācidvane tasmindadarśa paramāṃ striyam || jājvalyamānāṃ vapuṣā sākṣātpadmāmivāparām || 7 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaromābhūdvismito rūpasaṃpadā || pibanniva ca netrābhyāṃ nātṛpyata narādhipaḥ || 8 || sā dṛṣṭvaiva ca rājānaṃ vicaraṃtaṃ mahādyutim || snehādāgatasauhārdānnātṛpyata vilāsinī || 9|| tāmuvāca tato rājā sāṃtvayañchlakṣṇayā girā || devī vā dānavī tvaṃ ca gaṃdharvī yadi vāpsarāḥ || 5.2.71.10 || yakṣī vā pannagī vā tvaṃ mānuṣī vā sumadhyame || yāce tvāṃ'bhojagarbhābhe bhāryā me bhava śobhane || 11 || etacchrutvā vaco rājñaḥ saṃstutaṃ mṛdu valgu ca || aṃgīkṛtaṃ tayā devi samayaṃ prārthito nṛpaḥ || 12 || vāritā vipriye vāpi tyajeyaṃ tvāmasaṃśayam || na praṣṭavyā tvayā rājankāsi kasyeti sarvathā || 13 || evamastviti tenoktaṃ satyena sukṛtena ca || sa tasyāḥ śīlavṛttena rūpaudāryaguṇena ca || 14 || upacāreṇa ca rahastutoṣa jagatīpatiḥ || divyarūpā hi sā devī gaṃgā tripathagā nadī || 15 || mānuṣaṃ vigrahaṃ kṛtvā śrīmaṃtaṃ varavarṇini || rājānaṃ ramayāmāsa yathā reme tathaiva ca || 16 || sa rājā rati saktatvāduttamastrīguṇairhṛtaḥ || saṃvatsarānṛtūnmāsānna bubodha bahūngatān|| 17 || ramamāṇastayā sārddhaṃ yathākāmaṃ nareśvaraḥ || aṣṭāvajanayatputrāṃ stasyāmamaravarṇinaḥ || 18 || jātaṃ jātaṃ ca sā putraṃ kṣipatyaṃbhasi muktaye || prīṇāmi tvāmahamiti gaṃgāsrotasi pāvane || 19 || nāsya tattu priyaṃ rājñaḥ śaṃtanorhyabhavattadā || novāca kiṃcittāṃ devīṃ tyāgādbhīto mahīpatiḥ || 5.2.71.20 || athaināmaṣṭame putre jāte prahasatīmiva || uvāca rājā duḥkhārttaḥ parīpsanputramātmanaḥ || 21 || mā vadhīḥ kasya kāsīti kiṃ vidhvaṃsi sutāniti || putrahiṃsā mahatpāpaṃ mā prāpsīstiṣṭha garhite || 22 || || gaṃgovāca || || putrakāmā na te hanmi putraṃ putravatāṃvara || jīrṇastu mama vāso'yaṃ yathā me samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 23 || ahaṃ gaṃgā jahnusutā maharṣigaṇasevitā || devakāryārthasiddhyarthamuṣitvāhaṃ tvayā saha || 24 || ime'ṣṭau vasavo devā mahābhīmā mahaujasaḥ || vaśiṣṭhaśāpadoṣeṇa mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ || 25 || teṣāmānayitā nānyastvadṛte bhuvi vidyate || madvidhā mānuṣī dhātrī na caivāsti kadācana || 26 || tasmāttajjananīhetormānuṣatvamupāgatā || svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi putraṃ pāhi mahāvrata || 27 || saivamuktvā tadā gaṅgā viṣṇumāyāvimohitā || ruroda mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāśritā tanumadhyamā || 28 || aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ yadamī ghātitāḥ sutāḥ || mayā nṛśaṃsayā mohājjale kṣiptāstu bālakāḥ || 29 || hā vatsā hā sutāḥ putrā hā tātāstanayāḥ kva vai || māṃ vihāya gatāḥ kutra hṛdayaṃ kiṃ na dīryate || 5.2.71.30 || mātarmāteti karuṇaṃ bruvāṇāḥ svayamāgatā || upaguhye kadā putrānvatsavatseti sauhṛdāt || 31 || kasya jātu praṇītena piṃgena kṣitireṇunā || mamottarīyamutsaṃgaṃ kadāṅga malayiṣyati || 32 || aṃgapratyaṃgasaṃbhūtā manohṛdayanaṃdanāḥ || mayā tu mātrā hā vatsā māritā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 33 || kām̐llokānnu gamiṣyāmi kṛtvā karma sudāruṇam || kathaṃ puṇyā bhaviṣyāmi putrapnī nirdayā satī || || 34 || ityevaṃ karuṇaṃ kṛtvā ruditvā ca punaḥpunaḥ || mūrchitā patitāpyārtā niśceṣṭā dharaṇītale|| 35|| etasminnaṃtare devi nārado munisattamaḥ || tasyā vilāpaśabdaṃ tamākarṇya sahasā tadā|| 36 || vismayopphullanayanaḥ kimetaditi ciṃtayat || eṣā sā jāhnavī gaṃgā pāvanī devavaṃditā || 37 || samudramahiṣī divyā puṇyā tripathagā nadī || mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāśritya kasmādroditi vihvalā || 38 || ityevaṃ ciṃtayitvā ca samīpamagamanmuniḥ || gaṃgāyā vilapantyāśca brahmaputrastu nāradaḥ || uvācoccairviyatstho'sau devi gaṃge namo'stute || 39 || nārado'haṃ mahāpuṇye kasmādrodiṣi pāvani || himādriputrī vikhyātā devagaṃdharvasevitā|| 5.2.71.40 || dhṛtā śirasi devena śivena parameṣṭhinā || 41 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā divyā devanadī tathā || avalokya vimānasthaṃ pratyuvāca mahāmunim || 42 || mayā nārada mohena kṛto'dharmo jugupsitaḥ || jānaṃtyā sumahatpāpaṃ saptaputrā hatā mayā || || 43 || samudreṇa viyogastu saṃjāto mama daivataḥ || bhāryā jātā manuṣyasya putrā jātā hatāśca me || 44 || ato mayā vilapitaṃ magnayā śokasāgare|| kathyatāṃ mama devarṣe yena puṇyā bhavāmi vai || 45 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ || trikālavedī śuddhātmā gaṃgāṃ vacanamabravīt|| 46 || || nārada uvāca|| || kiṃ vismṛto jagadvaṃdye devānāṃ samayaḥ śubhaḥ || pratijñātaṃ tvayā devi vasūnāṃ mokṣakāraṇe || 47 || prāptā ste vasavo lokānprasādāttava suvrate || tvayāvatārito devi samudraḥ śaṃtanuḥ smṛtaḥ || 48 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || gaṃgā tripathagā puṇyā pratyuvāca mahāmunim|| 49 || satyamuktaṃ tvayā brahmañjñātaṃ sarvaṃ mayā'dhunā || kiṃtu yoniryato labdhā mānuṣī tena mohitā || 5.2.71.50 || apavādabhayādbhītā bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || dīyatāmupadeśo me kathyatāṃ sthānamuttamam || 51 || || nārada uvāca || || kiṃ vismṛto jagadvaṃdye devānāṃ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || apavādabhayādbhītā yadi tvaṃ devi puṇyade || māṃ pṛcchasi paraṃ sthānaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vacmi suvrate || 52 || avaṃtī tu samākhyātā sapta kalpasanātanī || tasyāṃ sakhī tvadīyā tu śiprā viprapriyā sadā || 53 || tasyāstīre śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ durddharṣeśvaradakṣiṇe || vidyate tridaśaiḥ pūjyaṃ sarvatī rthaiśca sevitam || 54 || tasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyasi || tasmādgaccha mahāpuṇye gaṃge devarṣisevite || 55 || ityuktā sā tripathagā nāradena mahātmanā || gatā tatra mahāpuṇyā sakhīṃ śiprāṃ dadarśa ha || 56 || saṃśleṣaṃ ca tadā kṛtvā liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā supāvanam || pūjayāmāsa bhāvena tatraiva ca ciraṃ sthitā || 57 || atha sūryasutā devī yamunā pāpanāśinī || tatrāyātā suhārddena yatra gaṃgā vyavasthitā || 58 || dadarśa devī tāṃ gaṃgāṃ dhyāyaṃtī śaṃkaraṃ śivam|| sāpi tatraiva tiṣṭhaṃtī pūjayaṃtī paraṃ śivam|| 59 || atha tenaiva kālena prācīdevī sarasvatī || samāyātā suguptā ca gaṃgāyamunayo rjale || 5.2.71.60 || etasminnaṃtare devi śakraṃ .prāha sa nāradaḥ || na dṛśyate prayāgastu mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || 61 || gaṃgāyamunayormadhye yatra guptā sarasvatī || prayāgaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 62 || sa sāṃprataṃ prayāgastu mahākālavanottame || kenāpi kāraṇenaiva gato na jñāyate mayā||63|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ|| śakreṇa sahitāḥ sarve hyavaṃtīṃ tu samāgatāḥ||64|| stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stotrairgaṃgāṃ tripathagāṃ śubhām|| gaṃge devi namastubhyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśini||65|| vasūnāṃ jananī devi vasūnāṃ mokṣadāyini|| trailokyapāvanī nityaṃ hareṇa śirasā dhṛtā || 66 || sevitā vālakhilyaiśca kṛṣṇasya paramā kalā || yamune tvāṃ namasyāmaḥ kāliṃdīṃ varavāhinīm|| 67|| sutā tvaṃ pāvinī devi mārttaṃḍasya divaspateḥ|| śipre devi namastubhyaṃ brahmadehodbhave śubhe||68|| prācī tvameva vikhyātā puṇyadehā sarasvatī || yā prācī kauravakṣetre puṣkare yā mahālaye || sā tvaṃ śiprā prasiddhā ca sarvapātakanāśinī|| 69 || tvaṃ dayā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ svargaḥ śaraṇaṃ nṛṇām || tvaṃ mātā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tvaṃ prācī bhuvi gīyase || 5.2.71.70 || bahujanmakalaṃkāṃkaṃ dṛṣṭvā yā dehināṃ bhuvi || karoṣi kṣālanaṃ devi sā tvaṃ trailokyasaṃsthitā || 71 || āsāṃ ca saṃgamo yastu sa prayāgo budhaiḥ smṛtaḥ || atrāgatya tu yuṣmābhiḥ sthāpitaḥ snāpito'dhunā || 72 || sodya prabhṛti devo'yaṃ prayāgeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaḥ smaraṇātpāpanāśanaḥ || 73 || atrāgatya prapaśyaṃti ye prayāgeśvaraṃ tataḥ || te kṛtārthā bhaviṣyaṃti sarvapātakavarjitāḥ || 74 || kulaṃ ca tāritaṃ teṣāṃ paitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā || gaṃgāyāstriyugaṃ puṇyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam || jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ prayāgeśvaradarśanāt || 75 || gaṃgāyāṃ ca prayāge ca devadāruvane śubhe|| naimiṣe puṣkare caiva śrīśaile ca tripuṣkare || 76 || tryaṃbake dhautapāpe ca mahendre bhairave tathā|| gokarṇe ca suvarṇākhye revākapilasaṅgame ||77|| eteṣāṃ darśanenaiva yā siddhirdvādaśābdikā || sā labhyā māsamātreṇa prayāgeśvaradarśanāt || 78|| ye paśyaṃti caturddaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | bhaktyā ca niyamaṃ kṛtvā prayāgeśvarasaṃjñakam || 79 || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || bhogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaviṣyati mahītale || 5.2.71.80|| kalāstisro bhaviṣyaṃti liṃge'sminmokṣade śubhe || gaṃgā ca yamunā prācī sarvapātakanāśinī || 81 || evamuktvā stutā gaṃgā yamunā ca sarasvatī || devaiḥ praṇatipūrveṇa gatāḥ sthānaṃ svakaṃ tadā || 82 || devāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ śakādyāḥ prayāgeśvarasaṃjñakam || stutvā ca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjayitvā divaṃ gatāḥ||83|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ|| prayāgeśvara devasya caṃdrādityeśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 84 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde prayāgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 || || cha ||
<5.2.72>
|| īśvara uvāca || || dvisaptatīśvaraṃ viddhi candrādityeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 1 || śaṃbareṇa purā devi nirjitāḥ saṃgare surāḥ || naṣṭā raṇaṃ parityajya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 2 || grastaṃ ca rāhuṇā dṛṣṭvā śaśāṃkaṃ bhayavihvalam || vinatāyāḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ proktaḥ sūryeṇa sārathiḥ || 3 || vahāruṇa rathaṃ śīghraṃ yatra yuddhaṃ na vidyate || śrūyate candrasūryau tau daityānāṃ balavattarau || 4 || rāhurdaṃṣṭrākarālastu sa tṛtīyo bhayaṃkaraḥ || na jñāyate raṇe candro mṛto naṣṭo'thavā punaḥ ||5 || sa ca na jñāyate śakraḥ kva gato varuṇo raṇe|| yamo na jñāyate kutra dhanadasya ca kā kathā||6|| evamukto'ruṇo rugṇo raviṇā raṇamadhyataḥ|| rathaṃ saṃprerayāmāsa yatra yuddhaṃ na vidyate || 7 || etasminnaṃtare candraḥ samāyātastu tatkṣaṇāt || rāhugrahagṛhīto'pi yatra devo divaspatiḥ || 8 || saṃtrastaḥ sa vilolākṣaḥ kṣaṇamātramacetanaḥ || babhūva sahasā candro dṛṣṭvā devaṃ divākaram || 9 || śaṃbareṇa raṇe ruddhā rudrāśca bhayavidrutāḥ || jagmurdiśo daśa bhayādasurendravibhīṣitāḥ || 5.2.72.10 || sādhyāḥ sarve bhayatrastā gatā yatra na dānavāḥ || teṣu bhagneṣu deveṣu hataśiṣṭeṣu saṃgare || 11 || vyadhamatsarvagātrāṇi varmāṇi ca janakṣaye || palāyamānadevānāmasuro balavaccharaiḥ || 12 || pṛṣṭhato nijaghānātha nikṛttāśca sahasraśaḥ || ahaṃ naṣṭacchalenaiva vyagrībhūte 'sure tadā || 13 || āsuraṃ rūpamāsthāya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ || śīghraṃ ca gamyate tāvadyāvannāyāti śaṃbaraḥ || 14 || ityuktaṃ niśināthena bhayabhītena pārvati || candrādityau kṣaṇānnītāvaruṇena rathena vai || 15 || yatra devo jagannātho garuḍastho janārdanaḥ || surasaṃghātasaṃketakiṃnarākīrṇakaṃdare || || 16 || maṃdare suranārīṇāṃ naṃdane varacandane || dṛṣṭvā tatra jagannāthaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || stutiṃ tau cakraturdevau candrasūryau yaśasvini || 17 || namo lokatrayādhyakṣa svaprabhājitabhāskara || namo viṣṇo namo jiṣṇo namaste kaiṭabhāṃtaka || 18 || namaḥ sarvakriyākartre jagattrātre ca te namaḥ || namaścakrāyudhādhṛṣya namo dānavaghātine || 19 || namaḥ kramatrayākrāṃtatrailokyāṃtarhitodbhava || namaḥ pracaṃḍadaityeṃdrakulakāla mahābala || || 5.2.72.20 || namo nābhihradodbhūtapadmagarbhamahāprabho || janitāśeṣalokeśaviraṃcāya mahādyute || 21 || amarārivināśāya mahāsamaraśāline || namaste vibudhādhīśa śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ prabho || 22 || candrasūryakṛtaṃ stotraṃ śrutvā devo janārdanaḥ || āśvāsya stutipūrveṇa prāha devo hyadhokṣajaḥ || 23 || || || viṣṇuruvāca || || svāgataṃ candrasūryau bho bhavaṃtau stutibhājanau || kiṃ kāraṇamiha prāptau tadbrūtāṃ vigatajvarau || 24 || nārāyaṇenaivamuktau procatuścaṃdrabhāskarau || samare nirjitā devāḥ śaṃbareṇa durātmanā || 25 || na jñātāḥ ktra gatāste ca āvāṃ naṣṭau prayatnataḥ || aruṇena ihānītau dṛṣṭastvaṃ deva daivataḥ || 26 || śaṃbareṇa jitā devāḥ sa ca sarvatra dṛśyate || sthale caiva jale caiva śaṃbaraḥ krūrapauruṣaḥ || 27 || naśyatāṃ tridaśeṃdrāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ || ciccheda naravarmāṇi cchatrāṇi ca dhanūṃṣi ca || 28 || varmāṇi ca vicitrāṇi mukuṭāni mahāṃti ca || pṛthūni cāpi cāpāni carmāṇi vividhāni ca || 29 || gajāśca madasaṃbhinnakapolāḥ koṭiśaḥ surāḥ || vājinaścāmarāpīḍā ratnaparyāṇabhūṣaṇāḥ || 5.2.72.30 || vibudhā dhvastasannāhā vigajā vipadātinaḥ || vipadāmākarākārā babhūva suravāhinī || 31 || tato daityādhipo mānī parivṛtto mahāraṇāt || nirjitārirmahātejā jvālāvāniva pāvakaḥ || 32 || vaṃdyamāno munigaṇaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ || ānaṃdito jayāśīrbhiḥ pravarairdaityapuṃgavaiḥ|| 33|| tatra sarvarddhisaṃpūrṇamāsanaṃ hemabhūṣaṇam || adhyatiṣṭhata daityeṃdrastatra maṃgalaveśmani || tatropaviṣṭaḥ śuśubhe daityarājo mahāyaśāḥ || 34 || divyacaṃdanapuṣṭāṃgaḥ surapuṣpasamujjvalaḥ || mukuṭākārajuṣṭāṃgaḥ sitacāmaravījitaḥ || mṛtotthitaistathā daityairdaityādhīśairadhiṣṭhitaḥ || 35 || kratubhirmūrttimadbhiśca sevya māno mahābalaḥ || sarvapuṣpotkarayutairnānāvihaganādibhiḥ || 36 || tatra śrīratulā loke tatra lakṣmīrnirargalā || tatra kāṃtirdyutiḥ śobhā śaṃbaro yatra dānavaḥ || 37 || evaṃ sa daityanṛpatiḥ sabhṛtyastatra modate || svayamiṃdrastu saṃjātaścaṃdrasūryau kṛtau svakau || 38|| tayoriti vacaḥ śrutvā sa devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || ciraṃ dhyātvā svamanasi tadāvocadidaṃ priye || 39 || caṃdrasūryau mayā jñātaṃ śaṃbarasya viceṣṭitam || brahmaṇo varadānena bhoktavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam|| 5.2.72.40 || śaṃbarāya purā kṣiptaṃ vajraṃ kuliśapāṇinā || hṛdaye nihataḥ so'pi tathāpi na mṛto'suraḥ || 41 || gamyatāṃ ca mayājñaptau mahākā lavanottame || candrasūryau mamādeśāttatra siddhiṃ ca lapsyatha || 42 || tatrānaṃto mahākālo liṃgarūpo maheśvaraḥ || tasya cottarato deśe liṃgaṃ kāmapradaṃ śivam || 43 || tasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyau bhaviṣyathaḥ || tasya jvālāsamūhena maraṇaṃ śaṃbarasya ca || bhaviṣyati na saṃdehastasmāttatraiva gamya tām|| 44 || ityuktau vāsudevena caṃdrasūryau yaśasvini || satvaraṃ hṛṣṭaromāṇau mahākālavanaṃ gatau || 45 || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ tejaso rāśimavya yam || stutaṃ ca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjitaṃ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 46 || etasminnaṃtare vāṇī liṃgamadhyātsamutthitā || āśvāsayaṃtī tarasā candrasūryau himātmaje || 47 || hataḥ sa śaṃbaro daityo gatau tau candrabhāskarau || daityānāṃ nirmitau duṣṭau pātālāṃtarasaṃsthitau || 48 || rāhuketū grahāṃte tu kṛtau samayapūrvakau || sthāpitaḥ svapade śakro devaiḥ saha na saṃśayaḥ || 49 || svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ gatāḥ sarve lokapālā mudā yutāḥ || kāṃtipratāpasaṃyuktau bhavantau bhuvanatraye || 5.2.72.50 || gagane grahanakṣatraiḥ sahitau vicariṣyathaḥ || pūrvavatpuṇyapāpānāṃ sākṣibhūtau bhaviṣyathaḥ || 51 || ityuktau candrasūryau tu tayā vāṇyā varānane || santuṣṭau kṛtakṛtyau tu saṃjātau liṃgadarśanāt || 52 || etasminnaṃtare devā vimānasthā samāgatāḥ || yatra caṃdraśca sūryaśca mahākā lavane śubhau || 53 || jñātvā liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ nāma cakuḥ samāhitāḥ || sevitaṃ caṃdrasūryābhyāṃ liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ param || 54 || candrādityeśvaraṃnāma khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale || liṃgasyāsya samutthena jvālāsaṃghena śaṃbaraḥ|| dagdho bhṛtyajanaiḥ sārddhaṃ candrasūryānusevanāt|| 55 || ityuktvā tridaśāḥ saveṃ samīpe sarvataḥ sthitāḥ|| stuvanto vividhaiḥ stotraiścaṃdrādityeśvaraṃ śivam|| 56 || candrādityau ca tatrasthau sthitau liṃgasamīpataḥ || ārādhayantau deveśaṃ padaṃ prāptau ca pūrvavat || 57 || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā candrādityecaraṃ śivam || te yāṃti sūryalokaṃ tu candralokaṃ tathaiva ca ||58||| vimānaiḥ sūryasakāśaistathā caṃdraprabhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvatteṣāṃ sukhaṃ bhavet || 59 || candrasūryoparāge tu caṃdrādityeśvaraṃ śivam || ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā snātvā śiprāṃ ca pāvanīm|| 5.2.72.60 || teṣāṃ kulaśataṃ yāvatpaitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā || loke caṃdrasya sūryasya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ|| || 61 || amāsomasamāyoge ye paśyanti prasaṃgataḥ || candrādityeśvaraṃ devaṃ na te yāṃti yamālayam || 62 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || candrādityeśvareśasya śrūyatāṃ karabheśvaram || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde cadrādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
<5.2.73>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || trisaptatīśvaraṃ viddhi karabheśaṃ varānane || yasya darśanamātreṇa kuyonirnaiva labhyate || 1 || vīraketurabhūddhīmānayodhyāyā mahīpatiḥ || vidyāvinayasaubhāgyalāvaṇyāmṛta pūritaḥ || 2 || sa samyakpālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān || atītānāgatajñānapariniṣṭhitamānasaḥ || 3 || athaikasmindine rājā jagāma gahanaṃ vanam|| mṛgasiṃhagajākīrṇaṃ vyāghrasaṃbarasaṃkulam || 4 || sa tatra vividhānvanyānvivyādha paravīrahā || mṛgāṃśca mahiṣāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca sahasraśaḥ || 5|| loḍitaṃ tadvanaṃ sarvaṃ paśupakṣimṛgākulam || rahitaṃ śvāpadaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tena mahībhṛtā || 6 || yadā na śvāpadāstasmindṛśyate gahane vane || tadā viddhastu karabho bāṇenānataparvaṇā || 7 || sa cāpi karabho devi bāṇamādāya satvaram || viddho'pi niḥsṛto'tyarthaṃ rājñastasyaiva paśyataḥ || sa ca rājā balī tūrṇaṃ sasāra karabhaṃ prati || 8 || tato nimnasthalaṃ caiva sa coṣṭro'dravadāśugaḥ || muhūrtena tato devi yojanāni bahūnyapi || 9 || tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyā daurasena balena ca || sasāra bāṇāsanadhṛksakhaḍgaḥ sahayo nṛpaḥ || 5.2.73.10 || tato nadānnadīścaiva palvalāni vanāni ca || atikramyānatikramya sasāraiva vanecaram || 11 || sa cāpi karabho devi āsādyāsādya taṃ nṛpam || punarapyeti javano javena mahatā tataḥ || 12 || sa tasya bāṇairbahubhiḥ karabho vihvalīkṛtaḥ || pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścaiva punarabhyeti cāṃtikam || punaśca javamāsyāya pārśve cāgre ca dṛśyate || 13 || athāraṇyaṃ mahāraudraṃ praviṣṭaḥ karabhastadā || antardhānaṃ jagāmāśu sa ca rājā vane'viśat || 14 || praviśya ca mahāraṇyaṃ tāpasānāmathāśramam || āsasāda tato rājā śrāṃtāśvopā viśatpunaḥ||15|| taṃ kārmukakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā śramārttaṃ kṣudhitaṃ tadā || samabhyetyarṣayastasmai pūjāṃ cakuryathāvidhi || 16 || sa pūjāmṛṣibhirdattāṃ pratigṛhya yathāvidhi || apṛcchattāpasānsarvāṃstapaso vṛddhimuttamām || 17 || te tasya rājño vacanaṃ pratigṛhya tapodhanāḥ || ṛṣayo rājaśārdūlaṃ papracchusta tprayojanam|| 18 || kena bhadra sukhārthena saṃprāpto'si tapovanam || padātirbaddhanistriṃśo dhanvī bāṇī nareśvara || 19 || etadicchāmahe śrotuṃ kutaḥ prāpto'si mānada || kasminkule ca jātastvaṃ kiṃ nāmā brūhi pārthiva || 5.2.73.20 || tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ || ācakhyau tadyathā nyāyaṃ kulaṃ gotraṃ ca tattvataḥ || 21 || ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule jāto vīraketurdvijarṣabhāḥ || carāmi mṛgayūthāni nighnanbāṇaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || 22 || balena mahatā yuktaḥ sāmātyaḥ saparicchadaḥ || yadā na labdho gahane mṛgo vā sūkaro'pi vā || 23 || mahiṣaścittalo vāpi śaśo vā śaṃbaro vane || tadā me karabho viddho bāṇenānataparvaṇā || 24 || sa praṇaṣṭaḥ kṣaṇenaiva sabāṇo mama paśyataḥ || taṃ dravaṃtamanuprāpto vanametadyadṛcchayā || 25 || bhavatsakāśaṃ naṣṭaśrīrhatāśaḥ śramakarśitaḥ || bhavatāṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ || bhavaṃtaḥ sumahābhāgāstasmātpṛcchābhi saṃśayam || 26 || kva gataḥ karabho viddho mayā bāṇena sāṃpratam || kva ca prāpsyāmi sahasā brūta tatsusamāhitāḥ || 27 || tatasteṣāṃ samastānāmṛṣīṇāmṛṣisattamaḥ || ṛṣabho devi karabhaṃ smarannidamathābravīt || 28 || gataḥ sa karabho bhūpa mahākālavane śubhe || gaccha tvaṃ ca mahārāja mahākālavane śubhe || 29 || yatra devo mahādevaḥ kārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || vinodārthaṃ ca devānāṃ liṃgamūrttirabhūtpurā||5.2.73.30|| paścime kṣetrapālasya kailāsasya mahīpate || samīpe tasya vighneśo modaka priyasaṃjñakaḥ || 31 || brahmaṇā pūjito rājandevānāmarthasiddhaye || sa ca dharmadhvajo rājā haihayānāṃ kulodvahaḥ || 32 || turageṇa kadācittu nīto badarikāśramam || prasiddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu naranārāyaṇāśramam || 33 || tatra vīrājinadharaṃ kṛśaṃ vipraṃ dadarśa ha || śarīramapi rājeṃdra na kenāpi samaṃ tadā || dṛṣṭvā ca hasito viprastena rājñā pramādataḥ || 34 || yasmāddhasasi māṃ dṛṣṭvā tasmāduṣṭro bhaviṣyasi || laṃboṣṭho laṃbadaṃtaśca visvaro vikṛtā kṛtiḥ || 35 || ityuktastena vipreṇa śaptopi nṛpasattamaḥ || taṃ vipraṃ prārthayāmāsa sa ca tuṣṭobravīdidam || 36 || na me vāganṛtā bhūpa kadā cidapi vidyate || avaśyaṃ karabho bhūtvā paścānmuktimavāpsyasi || 37 || yadā tvaṃ karabho jāto viddho vai vīraketunā || ayodhyādhipabhūpena gamiṣyasi śarāhataḥ || 38 || mahākālavanaṃ divyaṃ tatra tvaṃ liṃgadarśanāt || gamiṣyasi paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 39 || sa cekṣvākukuladbhūto vīraketurmahābalaḥ || liṃgadarśanato bhūpa cakravartitvamāpsyati || 5.2.73.40 || ityukto nṛpa bhūpālaḥ karabhatvaṃ samāgataḥ || sa tvayābhihato bhūpa bāṇenānataparvaṇā || drakṣyasi tvaṃ vimānasthaṃ vimuktaṃ liṃgadarśanāt || 41 || ityukto nṛpatistena ṛṣabheṇa dvijena tu || ājagāma tvarāyukto mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 42 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ tridaśaiḥ sadā || etasminnaṃtare vāṇī śrutā tena mahībhṛtā || || 43 || vimānasthena yā proktā tūṣṭreṇa madhurasvarā || bhobho rājeṃdra māṃ paśya vimāne coddhṛte śubhe || 44 || darśanādasya liṃgasya prāptā me paramā gatiḥ || tvayā hato'haṃ bāṇena tenāhaṃ tvāgato vane || samīpamasya liṃgasya tvaṃ me baṃdhuḥ paro yataḥ || 45 || ityuktvā sa nṛpaṃ devi vacaḥ samadhurākṣaram|| gatastu paramaṃ sthānaṃ nityamavyayamakṣayam || 46 || tato devagaṇā vyomni sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ || yakṣarākṣasagaṃdharvāḥ sapiśācāpsarogaṇāḥ ||47|| brahmeṃdraharimukhyāśca vimānairdevi saṃsthitāḥ || ājagmurmuditāstatra draṣṭuṃ kautukamānasāḥ || 48 || vilokya karabhaṃ muktaṃ vimānasthaṃ virājitam || liṃgadarśanamātreṇa saṃstutaṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 49 || accharatnasamūhena mukuṭenojvalatviṣā || bhāsaṃtaṃ ravikoṭīnāṃ jagadānaṃdakārakam || 5.2.73.50 || nāma cakrustato devā dṛṣṭvā māhātmyamuttamam || darśanādasya liṃgasya mukto'yaṃ karabho yataḥ || 51 || tasmāttriṣvapi lokeṣu vikhyātaḥ karabheśvaraḥ || bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ paśuyonivimocakaḥ || 52 || ityuktvā tridaśāḥ sarve gatāḥ svaṃ dhiṣṇyamuttamam || ayodhyādhipatirvīro vīraketuḥ svamālayam|| samṛddhaṃ niḥsapatnaṃ ca tato rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ || 53 || yaḥ paśyati naro devi karabheśvarasaṃjñakam || sa prayātyakṣayām̐llokānpūjyamāno gaṇādhipaḥ || 54 || yadā kālādihāyāto rājarājeśvaro mahān || pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhūtvā kramānmokṣamavāpnuyāt || || 55 || na duḥkhaṃ jāyate tasya vyādhiśokabhayaṃ tathā || ye paśyaṃti prasaṃgena talliṃgaṃ karabheśvaram || 56 || sarvamedheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ tvadhikaṃ devi karabheśvaradarśanāt||57|| vyādhayo nopajāyaṃte dāridryaṃ na kadācana|| aiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate darśanātsadā||58|| paśuyonigatā ye ca pitaro duḥkhitāstu ye|| tiṣṭhaṃti cāṃbare te tu ciṃtayaṃtaḥ svagotrajam||59|| āgamiṣyati naḥ putro naptā vā saṃtatāviha|| kadā paśyati deveśaṃ karabheśvaramīśvaram|| tena darśanamātreṇa muktirno bhavitā dhruvam||5.2.73.60|| yo yamuddiśya vai kāmaṃ darśanaṃ tu kariṣyati|| tasya tajjāyate sarvaṃ mṛtasya paramā gatiḥ || 61 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || karabheśasya devasya śṛṇu rājasthaleśvaram || 62 ||| iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde karabheśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 || || cha ||
<5.2.74>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || catuḥsaptatikaṃ viddhi śivaṃ rājasthaleśvaram || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || viṣṇukalpe purā vṛtte manvaṃtaramukhapriye || arājake mahīpṛṣṭhe brahmā ciṃtāparo'bhavat || 2 || na manuṣyairvinā devāḥ samarthā lokadhāraṇe || dānejyājapatodevā bhajaṃte puṣṭimuttamām || 3 || yogyo rājā prajāpālaḥ ko bhavejjanavatsalaḥ || so'paśyadatha rājarṣi stapasyaṃtaṃ ripuṃjayam || 4 || pṛthvyāṃ sarvaguṇākīrṇaṃ dharmaniṣṭhaṃ mahāvratam || tamuvācātha deveśo brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 5 || || brahmovāca || || ripuṃjaya nibodhedaṃ vacanaṃ mama putraka || rājyaṃ ca pālyatāṃ vatsa ekakalpena cetasā || 6 || alaṃ te tapasā tāta kaṣṭenānena sāṃpratam || dharmeṇa vijitāḥ sarve tvayā lokā narottama || 7 || kriyatāmadhunā lokapālanaṃ tu mamājñayā || yataḥ paropakāro hi phalaṃ dehasya dehinaḥ || 8 || na dharmastādṛśo'nyo'sti na cānyo'rthasya sādhakaḥ || nirayāptirapi śreya upakṛtya parasya vai ||9|| nāpakāreṇa bhūtānāmapi syādbhuvaneśatā || satataṃ loka kāryārthaṃ madājñāgauraveṇa ca || pṛthvīṃ samudravasanāṃ prajāścaiva prapālaya || 5.2.74.10 || ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣirbrahmaṇā parvatātmaje || provāca prāṃjalirbhūtvā brahmāṇaṃ tu ripuṃjayaḥ || 11 || svabhāvenācalā pṛdhvī tvayā pūrvaṃ vinirmitā || vinaiva pālakaṃ hyeṣā kutra yāsyati medinī || 12 || yadyavaśyaṃ mayā pṛdhvī pālanīyā pitāmaha || dehi me nagarīṃ ramyāmavantīṃ saptakalpagām ||13|| manuṣyaloke vikhyātā sakale sāmarāvatī || svargacyutānāṃ devānāṃ nivāsārthaṃ pratiṣṭhitā || 14 || maryādāmanuvatteṃyuryadi me nākavāsinaḥ || adatte ca mayā sthāne na vāsaḥ kasyacidbhavet || anena vidhinā pṛthvīṃ pālayiṣyāmyahaṃ prabho || 15|| || brahmovāca || || bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmo yastvayokto narottama|| ye kecittridaśāḥ saṃti madgauravavaśena te || tavādeśaṃ kariṣyaṃti sadā tvadvaśavarttinaḥ || 16|| devanātheti vai nāma bhaviṣyati ca suvrata|| ityuktvāṃtardadhe brahmā haṃsayānaṃ samāsthitaḥ ||17|| atha rājā pratijñāya brahmaṇā bhūmipālanam|| pṛthvyāmudghoṣayāmāsa provāca tridivaukasām ||18|| bhavatāṃ vihitaḥ svargo manujānāṃ ca bhūtalam || ye cātra kaṃda raratāḥ sthale vā bhūdhareṣu ca || 19|| ye sthitā yāṃtu te devā manujānāmiyaṃ dharā || tacchrutvā ghoṣitaṃ tasya rājño bhayanipīḍitāḥ || tridaśā brahmaṇo vākyādgauravāttridivaṃ gatāḥ || 5.2.74.20 || atha prajāḥ sa nṛpatirdharmeṇāvardhayattadā || putravatsehayuktena hṛdayenātinirvṛtāḥ||21| prajāstatsukhasaṃvṛddhā jarāmṛ tyuvivarjitāḥ || putriṇo dhanadhānyāḍhyāḥ sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ ||22|| yauvanasthāśca nirdvaṃdvāḥ satataṃ dharmasaṃśrayāḥ || nāsītputhivyāṃ śailastu sthalo vā dvīpa eva ca || 23 || akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī svādavadbhiḥ phalairyutā || devaloka ivāsīdbhūḥ sarvakāmaguṇojjvalā ||24|| evaṃ vrajati kāle vai rājñi rājyaṃ prakurvati || mahāmarṣaparā devā viprakāryārthamudyatāḥ ||25|| prajānāṃ bahuduḥkhāni muhuḥ kurvaṃtyanekaśaḥ || athānāvṛṣṭimakarotsudīrghāṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ||26|| tathā saṃhriyamāṇeṣu lokeṣu nṛpasattamaḥ|| megho bhūtvā divaṃ prāpya suvṛṣṭimakaronnṛpaḥ ||27|| tenaivāpyāyito lokaḥ sukhī jāto yaśasvini|| tataḥ kāle tu kasmiṃścidvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ || saṃvartto vārido bhūtvā meghānvai vinyapātayat || 28 || tatastu māruto bhūtvā nṛpatistāmadhārayat || tatonalaḥ pranaṣṭo'bhūtsarvataḥ pṛthivītalāt || 29 || na yajñā na japo homo na ca paktiravarttata || lokaśca vyādhisaṃkṣubdhastadābhūdviṣame sthitaḥ || 5.2.74.30 || tataḥ sa rājā taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvabhavaddhavyavāhanaḥ || so'dhārayatprajāḥ sarvā yajñāṃśca tridivaukasaḥ || 31 || etasminnaṃtare devi tvayā sārddhaṃ samāgataḥ || darśanārthaṃ svanagarīmahaṃ bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 32 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ || sayakṣarakṣogandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || 33 || bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca ye cānye gaganecarāḥ || catvāraḥ sāgarāścaiva kṣārakṣīrādisiṃdhavaḥ || 34 || gaṃgā ca yamunā siṃdhuścaṃdrabhāgā sarasvatī || carmaṇvatī bhīma rathī puṇyā godāvarī nadī || 35 || vipāśā devikā puṇyā śarayūḥ kauśikī tathā || gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī || 36 || pārā veda smṛtiścaiva vetraghnī narmadā śivā || tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā sarvāstatra samāgatāḥ || 37 || puṣkaraśca prayāgaśca prabhāso naimiṣastathā || pṛthutīrthodakaścaiva tathaivāmarakaṃṭakaḥ | 38 || gaṃgādvāraḥ kuśāvartto bilvako nīlaparvataḥ || vārāhaparvataścaiva tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā || 39 || bhṛgutuṃgaḥ sukukṣaścāpyajagaṃdhaśca pārvati || kāliṃjaraḥ sakedāro rudrakoṭirmahālayaḥ || 5.2.74.40 || sthānāni ca samastāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || merurmaheṃdro malayo maṃdaro gaṃdhamādanaḥ || 41 || munayo vālakhilyāśca vedāścatvāra eva ca || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ samāyātā mayā saha || 42 || anaṃtaraṃ mayā meruḥ sthalākāraḥ kṛtastataḥ || tasminsthale sthito devi upaviṣṭaḥ surairvṛtaḥ || niyuktāḥ sāgarāḥ pārśve catvāro lavaṇādayaḥ || 43 || atha vyākulatāṃ prāptaḥ sa ca rājā ripuṃjayaḥ|| svasthalasthaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyātastu māṃ prati||44|| tejasā dahyamāno'pi madīyena varānane || bhīto'pi toṣayāmāsa ko'si deva namo'stu te || 45 || sthalesminnṛpa rājāhaṃ mayāpyuktaṃ vinodataḥ || caturvargaścaturmūrttiścaturddhā saṃsthito nṛpaḥ || 46 || tenāhaṃ sarvato dṛṣṭo vāṅmaye sacarācare || anaṃtaraṃ stutastena bhaktyā paramayā priye || 47 || prabhāvamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā madīyaṃ vyāpakaṃ param || bhaktyā paramayā devi sa ca māṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ|| bhūyaḥstuto'pi tenāhaṃ tuṣṭo vai tasya bhūpateḥ || tenoktaṃ yadi me deva tuṣṭastvaṃ parameśvara || 49 || bhaktirme sudṛḍhā bhūyāttvayi sarvśa śāśvatī| tuṣṭohaṃ tena vākyena punaḥ prokto mayā nṛpa || 5.2.74.50 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā punarmāṃ brūhi pārthiva | hṛdi sthitaśca te kāmaḥ sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati || 51 || adhṛṣyaḥ sarvedevānāṃ sarvadā saṃbhaviṣyasi || tenāhaṃ prārthito devi bhūyo varamanuttamam || 52 || atīva rājate deva sthalo'yaṃ tava sannidhau || merureṣa na saṃdeho vṛllabhaḥ sarvadā tava || 53|| rājasthaleśvaro'si tvaṃ vikhyāto bhuvanatraye|| bhaviṣyasi yathā deva tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi || 54|| atrāgatya ca yo deva bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || yātrāṃ karoti bhāvena purāṇoktavidhānataḥ ||55 ||| tasya tvayā pradātavyaṃ sarvaṃ manasi ciṃtitam | aṇimādiguṇāḥ sarve guṭikāsiddhiraṃjanam|| 56|| khaḍgaṃ ca pādukāṃ caiva jalavāsaṃ rasāyanam|| rājasthaleśvaraṃ yastu bhaktyā paśyati mānavaḥ || 57|| daśamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā niyamapūrvakam|| devānāmapi devatvaṃ saṃprāpnoti maheśvaraḥ || 58 || pūjanīyastu tridivairyathā devaḥ puraṃdaraḥ|| dṛṣṭvā rājasthale devaṃ yo'tra yātrāṃ kariṣyati ||59|| tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva bhavatyeva varo mama || śatravaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yāṃtu saṃpadyatāṃ manorathāḥ || 5.2.74.60|| vṛddhirbhavatu vaṃśe ca darśanāttava śaṃkara|| sarve'tra devāstiṣṭhaṃtu meruratraiva tiṣṭhatu || tiṣṭhaṃtu sāgarāḥ sarve tava deva samīpataḥ || 61 || ityukto'haṃ tadā tena mayā coktaṃ varānane|| sudyumnonāma bhūpālo yadātraivāgamiṣyati || 62 || putrārthaṃ bhāryayā sārddhaṃ tadā dāsyāmi vāṃchitam || tadā samudrāścatvāraḥ sthāsyanti saphalāḥ svayam ||63|| tasyārādhanato bhūpa putraṃ dāsyāmi śobhanam|| ye cātra mānavā rājanyātrāṃ kurvaṃti bhaktitaḥ || teṣāṃ manorathāvāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 64 | rājā ripuṃjayo bhaktyā gaṇādhīśaḥ kṛto mayā||| 65|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || rājasthaleśvareśasya śrūyatāṃ vaḍaleśvaram || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye rājasthaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||
<5.2.75>
||īśvara uvāca || || pañcasaptatikaṃ devaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam|| viddhi pāpaharaṃ devi darśanātkāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 1 || dhanadasya sakhā devi maṇibhadro babhūva ha || īrṣyāprabhāvastatputro vaḍalonāma kopanaḥ || 2 || rūpavānsarvadā kāmī sadā matto balādhikaḥ || kadācitsa gato ramyāṃ nalinīṃ dhanadasya ca || 3 || ratyarthaṃ kāmasevārthaṃ guptāṃ rahasi nirmitām || dadarśa kusumaiśchannāṃ vajravaiḍūryabhūṣitām || 4 || tāṃ vai vidrumasaṃchannāṃ muktādāmavirā jitām || suramyāṃ vipulacchāyāṃ svarṇapaṃkajaśobhitām || 5 || kuberabhavanābhyāśe vallabhāṃ dhanadasya ca || ākrīḍaṃ rājarājasya kuberasya mahā tmanaḥ || 6 || rākṣasaiḥ kiṃnaraiścaiva guptāṃ khaṅgadharaiḥ sadā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprīto babhūva vaḍalastadā || 7 || priyayā sahito reme sthāne gupte manohare || reme
