ramaṇakairyogairanaṃgena vaśīkṛtaḥ || 8 || tatra guptā raṇe śūrā rākṣasā raṇakovidāḥ || rakṣaṃti śatasāhasraṃ sarvāyudhaparicchadāḥ || 9 || te tu dṛṣṭvaiva vaḍalaṃ maṇibhadrasutaṃ priye || bhakṣyaiḥ saṃpūritamukhaṃ divyacandanabhūṣitam || 5.2.75.10 || ketakīgarbhapatrābhairdaṃtairdivyatarānanam || yuddhārthe baddhanistriṃśaṃ śaktiyuktamariṃdamam || 11 || bhāryāsahāyamunmattaṃ paryaṃke ca sthitaṃ sadā || ratyarthamāgataṃ jñātvā anyonyamabhicukruśuḥ || 12 || mā vīrānena mārgeṇa sabhāryo gantumarhasi || ākrīḍo'yaṃ kuberasya dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 || devā devarṣayo yakṣā gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāstathā || āmantrya yakṣapravaraṃ viharaṃti ramaṃti ca || 14 || neha śakyaṃ vinādeśādvihartuṃ krīḍituṃ ciram|| bhrātrāmātyena suhṛdā kenāpi ca sutena ca || 15 || yenakenacidanyāyādavamanya dhaneśvaram || vihāraḥ kriyate darpātsa vinaśyedasaṃśayam || 16 || evaṃ sa rākṣasairghorairvaḍalo vinivāritaḥ || mā maivamiti sakrodhaṃ bhartsayadbhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 17 || kadarthīkṛtya tu sa tānrākṣasānbhīmavikramaḥ || vyagāhata mahātejāste sarve taṃ nyavārayan || 18 || gṛhṇīta badhnīta nikṛntatainaṃ pibāma khādāma ca vṛttahīnam || kruddhā bruvaṃto hyapatandrutaṃ te śastrāṇi codyamya vivṛttanetrāḥ || 19 || tataḥ sa gurvīṃ yamadaṇḍakalpāṃ mahāgadāṃ kāṃcanapaṭṭanaddhām || pragṛhya tāmabhyapatattarasvī tato'bravīttiṣṭhata tiṣṭhateti || 5.2.75.20 || te tasya vīryaṃ ca valaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vidyābalaṃ bāhubalaṃ tathaiva || na śaknuvaṃtaḥ sahituṃ sametā hatāḥ pravīrāḥ sahasā nivṛttāḥ || 21 || vidāryamāṇāstata eva tūrṇamākāśamāsthāya vimūḍhasaṃjñāḥ || kailāsaśṛṃgāṇyabhi dudruvuste yakṣārditā rakṣapālāḥ prabhagnāḥ || 22 || sa śakravaddānavadaityasaṃghānvikramya jitvā madanābhitaptaḥ || vigāhya tāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ samarthaḥ kāmaṃ sa cikrīḍati yakṣaputraḥ || 23 || tatastu te rakṣapālāḥ sametya dhaneśvaraṃ vai vaḍalena nunnāḥ || yakṣasya dhairyaṃ subalaṃ ca saṃkhye yathāvadācakhyuratīva bhītāḥ || || 24 || teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā maṇibhadro mahāyaśāḥ || śaśāpa putraṃ dayitaṃ vaḍalaṃ prabhukāraṇāt || 25 || yasmātsā nalinī ramyā sevitā vaḍalena tu|| dayitā dhanadasyāpi yathā mātā tathaiva sā ||26|| tasmātputro madīyastu sarvabhāgavivarjitaḥ|| paṃgvandho badhiro dīnaḥ kṣayarogamavāpsyati|| || 27 || iti śaptastadā jāto vaḍalo bhogavarjitaḥ || patito bhūtale caiva tasminsthāne gato'pi san || 28 || pīḍitaḥ kṣayarogeṇa na śaśāka viceṣṭitum || andho'tha badhiro jāto guruśāpahatastadā || 29 || ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā śāpamatyadbhutaṃ mahat || śapto'haṃ kena sahasā jīvanyonyaṃtaraṃ gataḥ || 5.2.75.30 || kathaṃ śapto'smi tātena maṇibhadreṇa vallabhaḥ || putro yuvā ca śūraśca śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 31 || dhanyo'sau maṇibhadro'pi mattāto yena bhūtale || prabhubhaktyā nijaḥ putraḥ śaptastyaktaśca tatkṣaṇāt || 32 || vaḍalena punaḥ proktaṃ dhanyo'haṃ prabhukāraṇāt|| utsavo nidhanaṃnāma bhartṛpiṇḍopajīvinām || 33 || anyāyena yathākāmaṃ prārabdhaḥ saṃcitaściram|| tenāhaṃ śāpatāṃ prāpto yāsyāmi narakaṃ dhruvam|| 34 || evaṃ vilapatastasya vaḍalasya varānane || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ maṇibhadro mahābalaḥ || dadarśa putraṃ paṃgvaṃdhaṃ kṣayarogaprapīḍitam || 35 || niḥśvasaṃtaṃ suduḥkhārttaṃ vila paṃtaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || pratyuvāca sutaṃ yakṣo maṇibhadro'tiduḥkhitaḥ || mayā kupitrā hā vatsa śaptastvaṃ prabhukāraṇāt || 36 || tvayeyaṃ nalinī ramyā dhana dasyātivallabhā || sevitā kāmataptena pravarā rākṣasā hatāḥ || 37 || tasmātputra mayā śapto na mithyā sa bhaviṣyati || prabhurdevaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī prabhurmātā prabhuḥ pitā || 38 || svāmyarthe yaḥ priyānprāṇānparityajati saṃgare || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmalokaṃ sanātanam|| 39 || na mantrasādhyaḥ śāpoyaṃ nauṣadhena vratena ca || niyamena ca dānena tasmānmadvacanaṃ kuru || 5.2.75.40 || mayā śrutaṃ śakraloke purāṇaṃ skaṃdakīrttitam || bruvato nāradasyaiva devānāṃ saṃnidhau purā || 41 || prabhāvo varṇitastena mahākālavanasya ca || kṣetre hyasminmahāliṃgaṃ svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe || 42 || vidyate vyādhiśamanaṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam || tatrāhaṃ tvāṃ ca neṣyāmi vimānenāśugāminā || 43 || ityuktvā maṇibhadreṇa samānītaḥ sutastadā || yatra devādhidevo'sau svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe|| 44 || sparśanāttasya liṃgasya cakṣuṣmānrūpavānbalī || supādaḥ śrutisaṃyuktastatkṣaṇādabhavattadā ||45|| dṛṣṭvā sumahadāścaryaṃ maṇibhadreṇa pārvati|| kṛtaṃ nāma suhṛṣṭena svīyaputrasya nāmataḥ|| cakṣuṣmānvaḍalo jāto liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ||46|| adyaprabhṛti devo'yaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ|| bhaviṣyati trilokeṣu vikhyāto netradāyakaḥ||47|| pūjayiṣyaṃti ye devaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam|| liṃgaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ te prāpsyaṃti manoratham||48|| dṛṣṭo harati pāpāni spṛṣṭo rājyaṃ prayacchati|| arcito bhaktibhāvena mokṣaṃ dadyānna saṃśayaḥ||49|| kārttike śuklapakṣasya tithirvai dvādaśī bhavet || tasyāṃ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam ||5.2.75.50 || dānaṃ taiḥ satataṃ dattaṃ te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || prayāge ca prabhāse ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame ||51|| tapastaptaṃ bhavettaistu te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ || garbhavāse na jāyaṃte sarvasaukhyasamanvitāḥ || 52 || gāṇapatyā bhaviṣyaṃti śaṃkarasya sadā priyāḥ || saubhāgyarūpasaṃpannāḥ putrapautraiśca saṃyutāḥ || jāyaṃte mānavā loke vaḍaleśvaradarśanāt || 53 || garbhavāse mahākaṣṭe yasya vāso na rocate || so'bhyarcayatu bhāvena vaḍaleśvaramīśvaram || 54 || na liṃgena vinā siddhirdurlabhaṃ paramaṃ padam || gatirna jāyate svarge yāvalliṃgaṃ tu nārcayet ||55|| liṃgārcana vihīnānāṃ siddhiścāpi sudurlabhā || mama putreṇa saṃprāptamīpsitaṃ liṃgato yataḥ || 56 || ityuktvā maṇibhadro'pi sutena sahito yayau || yatra devo dhanādhyakṣaḥ sthānaṃ svaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 57 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || vaḍaleśvaradevasya śrūyatāmaruṇeśvaram || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde vaḍaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 || || cha ||
<5.2.76>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ṣaṭsaptatitamaṃ devamaruṇeśvarasaṃjñakam || viddhi pāpaharaṃ devi darśanātkāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 1 || purā devayuge devi prajāpatisute śubhe || āstāṃ bhaginyau rūpeṇa samupete'dbhute'naghe || 2 || te bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ kadrūśca vinatā tathā || prādāttābhyāṃ varaṃ prītaḥ prajāpatisamaḥ patiḥ || 3 || kaśyapo dharmapatnībhyāṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ || varātisargaṃ śrutvaiva kaśyapāduttamaṃ tu te || 4 || harṣādabhyadhikāṃ prītiṃ prāpatuḥ sma varastriyau || vavre kadrūḥ sutānnāgānsahasraṃ tulyavarcasaḥ || 5 || dvau putrau vinatā vavre kadrūputrādhikau bale || ojasā tejasā caiva vikrameṇādhikau ca tau || 6 || tasyai bharttā varaṃ prādāllapsyase putrakottamau || evamastviti tāṃ cāha kaśyapo vinatāṃ tadā || 7 || yathā ca prārthitaṃ labdhvā varaṃ tuṣṭā'bhavattadā || kṛtakṛtyā tu vinatā labdhvā vīryādhikau sutau || 8 || kadrūśca labdhvā putrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ tulyatejasām || dhāryau garbhau prayatnena ityuktvā sa mahātapāḥ || 9 || te bhārye varasaṃhṛṣṭe kaśyapo vanamāviśat || kālena mahatā kadrūrnāgānāṃ sā śatīrdaśa || janayāmāsa cārvaṃgī dve cāṃḍe vinatā tadā || 5.2.76.10 || tayoraṃḍāni nidadhuḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paricārikāḥ || sopasvedeṣu bhāṃḍeṣu paṃcavarṣaśatāni ca || 11 || tataḥ paṃcaśate kāle kadrūputrā vinirgatāḥ || aṃḍabhyāṃ vinatāyāstu mithunaṃ na vyadṛśyata || 12 || tataḥ putrārthinī devī vrīḍitā sā tapasvinī || aṃḍaṃ bibheda vinatā tatra putraṃ dadarśa ha || 13 || pūrvārddhakāyasaṃpannamitareṇā prakāśitam || sa putro roṣasaṃrabdhaḥ śaśāpaināmiti śrutam || 14 || yo'hamevaṃ kṛto mātastvayā lobhaparītayā || śarīreṇāsamagreṇa tasmāddāsī bhaviṣyasi || 15 || paṃcavarṣaśatānyasyā yayā visparddhase sadā || eṣa te ca suto mātardāsyādvai mokṣayiṣyati || 16 || yadyenamapi mātastvaṃ māmivāṃḍavibhedanāt || na kariṣyasyanaṃgaṃ vā putraṃ cāti tarasvinam ||17|| pratipālayitavyaste janmakālo'sya dhīrayā|| viśiṣṭabalamīpsaṃtyā paṃcavarṣaśatānyataḥ||18|| evaṃ śaptvā tato devi vinatāṃ mātaraṃ svakam || aruṇo vilalāpātha vāṣpaśokapariplutaḥ || 19 || hāhā mayā nṛśaṃsena mātā svajananī svakā || śaptā vināparādhena kathaṃ yāsyāmi sadgatim || mātā dehāraṇiḥ puṃsāṃ mātā duḥkhasahā parā ||5.2.76.20|| garbhakleśe paraṃ duḥkhaṃ mātā jānāti yādṛśam || vātsalyaṃ cādhikaṃ māturdṛśyate na tu paitṛkam || 21 || gurūṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ mātā gurutarā smṛtā || ekasyāpi sutasyaiva na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ śrutau ||22|| yadi piṃḍapradānaṃ tu gayāyāṃ kurute sutaḥ || gate pitari paṃcatvaṃ mātā putrasya nirvṛtiḥ || na ca mātṛvihīnasya mamatvaṃ kurute pitā ||23|| vikalo mātṛhīnastu putro hi procyate tadā || yadā sa vṛddho bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ || tadā śūnyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yadā mātā viyujyate || 24 || so'haṃ pāpasamācāro jāto mātṛvihiṃsakaḥ || mariṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ sādhayitvā hutāśanam || 25 || jāto'haṃ vikalāṃgastu prākkṛtenaiva karmaṇā || na mātā kāraṇaṃ yasmātsvakīyaṃ karma bhujyate || || 26 || evaṃ vilapatastasya kaśyapasya sutasya ca || aruṇasya viśālākṣi nāradaḥ samupāgataḥ || 27 || dṛṣṭvāruṇaṃ suduḥkhārttaṃ vilapaṃtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || pratyuvāca prasannātmā nāradaḥ prahasanniva||28|| aruṇo'yamaho rauti kaśyapasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ || vinatāyāḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ saṃbhūtastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || || 29 || utpādito'yamalpāhairarddhakāyo mahābalaḥ || enamāśvāsayiṣyāmi vinatāgarbhasaṃbhavam || mohena vilapaṃtaṃ ca śreyo me bhavitā dhuvam || || 5.2.76.30 || iti saṃciṃtya manasi vākyairmadhvamṛtopamaiḥ || pratyuvācāruṇaṃ tatra nārado dvijasattamaḥ || 31 || tāta kaśyapadāyāda vinatāgarbhasaṃbhava || tejorāśe durādharṣa saṃtāpaṃ mā kṛthā vṛthā|| 32 || bhāvino'rthā bhavaṃtīha duḥkhasya ca sukhasya ca || yattvayā vinatā śaptā rahasyaṃ devanirmitam|| || 33 || yadi testi ghṛṇā citte śaptātmajananī tvayā || tadā gaccha mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham ||34|| uttare devadevasya yātreśasya ca puṇyadam|| vidyate tridaśaiḥ pūjyaṃ sarvadā sarvadaṃ śivam || 35 || aruṇastvevamuktastu nāradena mahātmanā || ājagāma kṣaṇārddhena mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 36 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ tejaḥkūṭopamaṃ śubham || pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpuṣpairbhāvasamanvitaḥ || 37 || liṃgenokto'ruṇo devi sārathyaṃ kuru sarvadā || sūryasya bhramatastasya tvattulyo nāsti sārathiḥ || 38 || mayā dattaṃ tu sāmarthyaṃ sūryasya purataḥ sadā || udayaste'ruṇa prāgvai paścātsūrya udeṣyati || 39 || tvannāmnā triṣu lokeṣu khyāto'hamaruṇeśvaraḥ || bhaviṣyāmi na saṃdeho nṛṇāmarthapradāyakaḥ || 5.2.76.40 || ye māṃ paśyaṃti satataṃ tvannāmnā cāruṇeśvaram || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam || 41 || modiṣyaṃti kulaiḥ sārddhaṃ pitṛmātṛsamudbhavaiḥ || kalpakoṭisahasraṃ tu ye paśyaṃti samāhitāḥ || 42 || na duḥkhaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ ye paśyaṃti raverddine|| saṃsārasāgarotthaṃ vai yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ||43|| yaḥ paśyati caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāmaruṇeśvaram ||44|| sa neṣyati pitṝnsvarge narakasthānna saṃśayaḥ || saṃkrāṃtau ravivāre ca yaḥ paśyedaruṇeśvaram || śuṃḍīrasvāmino yātrā kṛtā tena na saṃśayaḥ ||45|| ityuktastena liṃgena vinatānaṃdanastadā|| āgataḥ kṛtakṛtyātmā yatra devo divaspatiḥ ||46|| asya liṃgasya māhātmyātkaśyapasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ || aruṇo dṛśyate vyomni sūryasya purataḥ sadā || 47 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || aruṇeśvaradevasya puṣpavaṃteśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye'ruṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 || cha || || ||
<5.2.77>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || saptasaptatikaṃ devi puṣpadaṃteśvaraṃ śṛṇu || yasya darśanamātreṇa garbhavāso na jāyate || 1 || śinirnāma dvijo devi sa cāputro'bhavatpurā || putrārthaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa sa tapāṃsi bahūni ha || 2 || vāyubhakṣoṃ'bubhakṣaśca nirāhārordhvabāhukaḥ || śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ parṇāśyekadvi parṇabhuk || 3 || evamādīni cānyāni tapāṃsi śreyase param || eteṣāṃ tapasāṃ madhye tapa ekaṃ samāśraye || 4 || paraṃ vighnopaśāṃtyarthaṃ toṣayiṣye'hamī śvaram || evaṃ saṃciṃtya manasā ūrdhvabāhūrdhvapādakaḥ || ābhyāṃ na sa durāsādyo nāparādho bhaviṣyati || 5 || tathā cakāra sa munirvarṣāṇāṃ dvādaśaiva hi || tapasyaṃtaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā niyame parame sthitam || 6 || vijñaptohaṃ tvayā devi maṃdare cārukaṃdare || karotyeṣa tapaḥ krūraṃ putrahetormunirma hān || 7 || tejasā dīpayacchailaṃ śoṣayansalilāśayān || tapasā duṣkareṇaiva kṣubhitā nākavāsinaḥ || 8 || vyāleṃdrā vyākulībhūtā lulitāścācaleśvarāḥ || munayo vismṛtiṃ prāptāḥ kaṃpete cāpi rodasī || 9 || ayonijaḥ śinirvipraḥ putramicchatyayonijam || tvaṃ yonirguṇasaṃghānāṃ tvaṃ yonistapasāmapi || 5.2.77.10 || tvaṃ tapastvaṃ paraṃ dhāma śikhicaṃdrārkalocana || sarveśvara suto'bhīṣṭaḥ kiṃ na viprāya dīyate || 11 || surāsuraguro kiṃ na putramasmai prayacchasi || tapasā kṣīṇadoṣasya brahmatve bhāvitātmanaḥ || 12 || śineḥ putrapradānaṃ tvaṃ kuru madvacanācchiva || tapasā duṣkareṇaiva gāḍhaṃ kliṣṭo mahāmuniḥ || 13 || tejāṃsi jyotiṣāmeva mahatāṃ ca vidhisthitaḥ || aharattejasā svena tamāṃsīva divākaraḥ || 14 || tvadbhaktasya ca deveśa vyarthaḥ kasmātpariśramaḥ || udite'rke tamāṃsīha na bhavaṃti kadācana || 15 || tvatparasya na devaśa yuktā duḥkhavibhīṣikā || ityahaṃ prārthito devi tvayā parvataputrike || 16 || viprārthamanukaṃpārthaṃ putrārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || ākāritā mayā devi gaṇāstva dgauraveṇa tu || 17 || rudrāśca harabhaktāśca kūṣmāṃḍā gaganecarāḥ || romaraudrā mahānīlāḥ śikhāvaṃtaḥ sakokilāḥ || 18 || anye ca vividhākārāḥ kālāsyā haripiṃgalāḥ || jaṭājūṭadharāścitrā vīthinakṣatracāriṇaḥ || 19 || nīlagrīvā kṛṣṇamukhāḥ piṃgadhautajaṭāsaṭāḥ || jvaro ḍiṃḍirmahākālo lāṃguliśca maheśvaraḥ || 5.2.77.20 || ghaṃṭākarṇo viśākhaśca pariśeṣā gaṇāśca ye || vṛṣārūḍhāḥ kāmatulyāḥ kāmarūpabalāstathā || 21 || śūlacaṃdradharāḥ sarve sarve tulyaparākramāḥ || mamādeśātsamāyātāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ || 22 || stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stotrairūcurevaṃ samāhitāḥ || kiṃ karttavyamihāsmābhirādeśo dīyatāṃ prabho || 23 || gaṇānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā bhaktiṃ ca tādṛśīm || mahātapaḥprabhāvo'yaṃ śiniviprasya kīrttitaḥ || 24 || putrārthaṃ tapyati tapaḥ śinirbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ || madvākyātko nu viprasya putratvaṃ saṃpradāsyati || 25 || tasyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi sarvānkāmā nyathepsitān || amaraṃ cājaraṃ putraṃ munirvāṃchati sāṃpratam || 26 || madvākyaṃ kriyatāṃ sadyo vipraḥ kleśādvimucyatām|| madbhaktasya na saṃkalpo mithyā bhavitumarhati|| 27 || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve kaṃpitakaṃdharāḥ || sarve cāvāṅmukhā jātāḥ sarve dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 28 || na kaścidbhāṣate kiṃcinna kaścidvīkṣate tadā || athoktaṃ puṣpadaṃtena rabhasānmānitena tu || 29 || mama cittamavijñāya gaṇānāmanukaṃpayā || na yāsyaṃti gaṇā deva tvāṃ vihāya mahītalam || 5.2.77.30 || iha sthāsyaṃti satataṃ tvatsamīpe na saṃśayaḥ || kathaṃ yoniṃ prayāsyaṃti saṃprāpya mudamuttamām || 31 || hīnāṃ rajo'dhikāṃ dīnāṃ tamobahuladhāriṇīm || kathaṃ svargaṃ parityajya yāsyāmo narakaṃ param || 32 || bruvannevaṃ bhrameṇaiva bhāvyarthena praṇoditaḥ || ukto mayā viśālākṣi puṣpadaṃto gaṇāgraṇīḥ || 33 || pata tvaṃ mānuṣe loke yasmānme vipriyaṃ kṛtam || śaptvā taṃ puṣpadaṃtaṃ tu vīrakaḥ prerito mayā || || 34 || viprasya putratāṃ tūrṇaṃ putra gaccha mamājñayā || tataste saṃpradāsyāmi sarvānkāmānyathepsitān || 35 || ityukto vīrako devi gato viprasya putratām || puṣpadaṃto'pi karuṇaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 36 || paścāttāpena saṃyukto niśvasya ca punaḥpunaḥ || aho tatsaphalaṃ janma yadājñā kriyate naraiḥ || 37 || prabhūṇāmekacittena te bhṛtyā durlabhāḥ smṛtāḥ || teṣāmarthaśca dharmaśca kulaṃ caiva ca tāritam || 38 || prasannāstridaśāsteṣāṃ prabhu bhaktāśca ye narāḥ || sevādharmo hi gahano yogināmapi duṣkaraḥ || 39 || na jñeyaḥ kena tattvena durārādhyaḥ prabhurbhavet || ekenāpyaparādhena prakopaṃ kurute prabhuḥ || 5.2.77.40 || vinaśyaṃtyupakārāṇi tasmātsevā suduṣkarā || svāmī sarpaśca vahniśca taptabhāvaṃ vrajaṃti hi || 41 || tasmādyatnena saṃsevyā ātmarakṣaṇatatparaiḥ || so'haṃ bhūmau nipatitaḥ prabhorādeśabhaṃjakaḥ || 42 || kāṃstu lokāngamiṣyāmi kaluṣī bhūṇahā iva || evaṃ vilapya bahuśo māmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || uvāca dīnayā vācā praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ || 43 || dīno'smi jñānahīno'smi praṇato'smi ca śaṃkara || kuru prasādaṃ deveśa aparādhaṃ kṣamasva me || 44 || na hi nirvahaṇaṃ yāṃti prabhūṇāmāśritā ruṣaḥ || prasīda devadeveśa dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca || 45 || api kīṭa pataṃgatvaṃ gaccheyaṃ tava śāsanāta || bhaktohaṃ sarvadā deva putratve hi pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 46 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā puṣpadaṃtasya pārvati || mamatvena tadā devi proktamitthaṃ tvayā vacaḥ || 47 || gaccha putra mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || liṃgamārādhaya kṣipraṃ tattvannāmnā bhaviṣyati || 48 || kīrttiste bhavitā putra yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || ityukte tu tvayā devi mayāpyuktaṃ varānane|49|| na me mithyā vacaḥ putra bhaviṣyati kathaṃcana || darśanādeva liṃgasya mamābhīṣṭo bhaviṣyasi || 5.2.77.50 || vimāne puṣpapāde tu samārūḍho bhaviṣyasi || puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjyamānastu padaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam || 51 || gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ mayā caiva mudito vicariṣyasi || mamāpi na ratirvatsa bhaviṣyati tvayā vinā || 52 || ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi mahākālavane śubhe || tuṣṭo'haṃ sarvadā vatsa gaṇānāmagraṇīḥ kṛtaḥ ||53|| anayā śuddhayā bhaktyā lokānāmupakārakaḥ || bhaviṣyasi na saṃdehastasminkṣetre gato dhruvam||54|| ityukto hi mayā devi puṣpadaṃto gaṇāgraṇīḥ || mānī mamājñayā maunī mahākālavane śubham || 55 || liṃgamārādhayāmāsa durvāseśādathottare || liṃgenoktastu sahasā tuṣṭo'haṃ gaṇasattama || tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyāmi prasādaste kṛto'dhunā || 56 || etasminnantare devi tvayā sārddhamahaṃ gataḥ || śakrādyaistridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṇairnānāvidhaistathā || 57 || hṛṣṭastu puṣpadaṃto'pi puṣpapaṭṭāsane śubhe || puṣpaiḥ prakīryamāṇo'pi punaḥ prāpto mamāṃtikam || 58 || mayā saṃśleṣitaḥ snehādutsaṃge'pyadhiropitaḥ || sthānaṃ dattaṃ viśālākṣi idamuktaṃ mayā tadā || 59 || ye paśyaṃti narā liṃgaṃ tvayā saṃpūjitaṃ bhuvi || te yāsyaṃti puṣpakeṇa krīḍanto vai triviṣṭapam || 5.2.77.60 || gaṇādhyakṣā bhaviṣyaṃti sarvakāmairalaṃkṛtāḥ || mama loke gaṇādhyakṣā yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || 61 || darśanātkṣīyate pāpamaihikaṃ pūrvakaṃ tathā || tataḥ prasādānme sarvaṃ jñānaṃ samyagbhaviṣyati || 62 || yaḥ pūjayeccaturddaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ somavāsare || amaraiḥ saha saṃhṛṣṭo modate divi sarvadā || 63 || paitṛkairmātṛkaiḥ sārddhaṃ kulaistu saptabhiryutaḥ || na vadetkenacitsārddhaṃ naro yaḥ prātarutthitaḥ || 64 || puṣpadaṃteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā so'śvamedhaphalaṃlabhet || mucyate pātakādyaiśca yaḥ śāṭhyenāpi paśyati || 65 || mṛto gāṃdharvaloke tu yāti vidyādharairvṛtaḥ || na tasya saṃtati cchedo yaḥ paśyati dinedine || niyamena gaṇādhyakṣa jāyate brahmaṇo dinam|| 66 || aiśvaryaṃ saptalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānyathākramam|| pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhūtvā mamāṃge saṃbhaviṣyati || 67 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || puṣpadanteśvareśasya avimukteśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcam āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde puṣpadanteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma sapta saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 || || cha ||
<5.2.78>
|| īśvara uvāca || || aṣṭasaptatikaṃ viddhi avimukteśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa tīrthayātrāphalaṃ labhet || 1 || śākale nagare devi citraseno mahīpatiḥ || babhūva bhuvi vikhyāto rūpavānmanmathādhikaḥ || 2 || tasya candraprabhā bhāryā prāṇe bhyo'pi garīgasī || pativratā dharmaśīlā rūpayauvanaśālinī || 3 || aputrasyāpi nṛpateḥ putrī jātā manoramā || tasyā nāma tadā cakre pitā pārthivasattamaḥ || 4 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā kanyā lāvaṇyavatyapi || sāpi jātismarā devī sasmāra ca purātanam || 5|| vairāgyādbrahmacaryaṃ ca cacāra tanumadhyamā || kadācidyauvanaṃ prāptā sā ca pṛṣṭā nṛpeṇa vai || 6 || utsaṃge ca nije kṛtvā mūrdhni cāghrāya harṣitaḥ || putri pradānakālaste kasmai deyā varāya ca || 7 || nṛpāya nṛpaputrāya saṃmatāya dvijāya vā || vṛddhāya bahubhāryāya grāmīṇāya ca putriṇe || harṣeṇa cāvṛto rājā punaḥ papraccha tāṃ sutām || 8 || pṛṣṭā ca sā yadā devī na covāca nṛpaṃ prati || adhomukhī ca saṃjātā punaḥ proktā nṛpeṇa tu || 9 || yadi madvacanaṃ putri pratibhāti na sāṃpratam || varaṇaṃ svecchayā putri kuru tarhi svayaṃvaram||5.2.78.10|| ityuktā sā nṛpatinā pitrā proktā punaḥpunaḥ || ruroda sā vai karuṇaṃ śrutvā tāṃ kutsitāṃ gatim || 11 || jahāsa cātihāsena punaḥ śvāsāṃśca muṃcati || praharṣaṃ ca punaḥ kṣipraṃ prāpya vāṣpaṃ ca muṃcati || 12 || tāmavasthāṃ gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā putrī munmattatāṃ gatām|| kimetaditi bhūpālo grasitā kiṃ graheṇa vai || 13 || bhūtena vā piśācena matsutā lakṣaṇairyutā || iti cintāparo rājā yadā jāto yaśasvini || 14 || tadā proktastayā putryā mā tāta vimanā bhava || nāhaṃ grastā graheṇeha na bhūtena na rakṣasā || 15 || na piśācena yakṣeṇa tava kanyā mahīpate || jātismarāhamutpannā śrūyatāṃ mama janma ca || 16 || prāgjyotiṣe pure vipro harasvāmī babhūva ha || bhāryāhaṃ durbhagā jātā tasya viprasya pārthiva || 17 || rūpayauvanasaṃpannā tasya nāhaṃ priyā vibho || sadā vidveṣasaṃyukto mayi niṣṭhurajalpakaḥ || 18 || nānyasya kasyaciddveṣṭā muktvā māṃ pṛthivīpate || pāṇigrahaṇakāle tu grahaiḥ pāpairvilokitā || 19 || ahamūḍhāṃ kulīnena dvijenātiguṇena ca || sa cāvalokito vipro grahaiḥ puṇyairnarādhipa || 5.2.78.20 || tena me vallabho rājanna cāhaṃ tasya vallabhā || sa sadācārasaṃyukto vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || 21 || nānyatra kurute bhāvaṃ brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ || tato'haṃ krodhasaṃyuktā vaśīkaraṇalaṃpaṭā || apṛcchaṃ pramadāstāta yāstyaktāḥ patibhiḥ kila || 22 || tābhiruktā hyahaṃ bhūpa vaśyo bharttā bhaviṣyati || asmākaṃ pratyayo jātastasmāttvaṃ kartumarhasi || 23 || bheṣajairvividhaiścūrṇairmaṃtrairmohakaraiḥ paraiḥ || taistaistu kṛtalepo'pi bhavitā dāsavatpatiḥ || 24 || tato'haṃ tvaritā gatvā tāsāṃ vākyena bhūpate || cūrṇaṃ mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca prāptā bhartṛgṛhaṃ punaḥ || 25 || pradoṣe payasā yuktaścūrṇo bharttari yojitaḥ || grīvāyāṃ ca mayā mantro nyastaḥ sarvāṃgasaṃdhiṣu || 26 || yadā pītaśca cūrṇastu mantreṇātīva guṃṭhitaḥ || vaśagastatkṣaṇājjāto maṃtracūrṇaprabhāvataḥ || 27 || dvāradeśe sthitaḥ kraṃdandāso'smi tava śobhane || trāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ tvadvaśohaṃ ca śobhane || 28 || tattasya ruditaṃ jñātvā maṃtramāhātmyato nṛpa || svasthīkaraṇayogena tadā svasthaḥ kṛtaḥ patiḥ || 29 || tataḥ prabhṛti kāṃto me vaśyo'bhūdbhavane sthitaḥ || paṃcatvaṃ ca gatā kāle tathā nārakayātanām||5.2.78.30|| tāmrabhrāṣṭre ca dagdhāhaṃ yugāni daśa paṃca ca|| sūkṣmāṇi tilamātrāṇi kṛtvā khaṃḍānyanekaśaḥ|| cheditā kālasūtreṇa pīḍitā ghrāṇayaṃtrake||31|| kvāthībhūtā taptatailairghaṭe darvyātha loḍitā|| piṣṭā caiva śilāpṛṣṭhe kuṭṭitā lohamudgaraiḥ||32|| dalitā daṃtadalane dagdhāhaṃ raurave bhṛśam|| adhomukhī vinikṣiptā tvamedhye pūyaśoṇite || 33 || yānyāpi yuvatī tāta bharturvaśyaṃ samācaret || vṛthā dharmādurācārā pacyate narake bhṛśam ||34|| bharttā nātho gururbhartā bharttā vai daivataṃ param || bharttā svamī suhṛdbharttā bhartā ca paramaṃ padam || 35 || tuṣṭe bharttari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarve tasmātsevyaḥ sadā patiḥ || bhasmībhavati sā nārī yayā bharttā na toṣitaḥ || 36 || yasya prasādātprāpyaṃte bhogāśca vividhāḥ sadā || taṃ vaśyaṃ kurute yā ca sā kathaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt || 37 || tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti kṛmipakṣiśatāni ca || tasmāttattatsadā kāryaṃ strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ kila || 38 || evaṃ punarmayā bhuktā narakā bhṛśadāruṇāḥ || tiryagyonisahasraṃ tu karmaṇā kutsitena ca || || 39 || kiṃcitpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ caṃḍālasya ca veśmani || jātāhamatirūpeṇa pīḍitā vividhairvraṇaiḥ||5.2.78.40|| sārameyairvṛtā dīnā bhakṣyamāṇā punaḥpunaḥ || duṣṭāhaṃ bhakṣyamāṇāpi mārge ruddhā vṛkairaham || tairahaṃ tudyamānāpi mahākālavanaṃ gatā ||41|| dṛṣṭo mayā mahādevo daivato mṛgamāṇayā || samīpe devadevasya pippalādeśvarasya ca || 42 || tasya darśanamātreṇa gatā śakrapuraṃ prati || vimānena sudīptena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā || divyāṃbaradharā divyā divyamālāvibhūṣaṇā || 43 || tatrāhaṃ pūjitā devaiḥ stutāhaṃ cāraṇaistathā || darśanāttasya liṃgasya jātāhaṃ tava veśmani || 44 || vallabhā rūpasaṃpannā śākale nagare śubhe || smṛtvā tu kutsitāṃ yoniṃ vilāpaśca kṛto mayā || 45 || smṛtvā liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ harṣo jātastu tatkṣaṇāt || tanme naiva ca vātūlyaṃ gṛhītā na graheṇa ca || 46 || jātā jātismarā tāta brahmacaryavrate sthitā || ato yāsyāmi taṃ devaṃ darśanārthaṃ punaḥ prabho || yathā na bhūyo me janma syācca saṃsārasāgare || 47 || iti putrīvacaḥ śrutvā citraseno mahīpatiḥ || sabhṛtyamaṃtrisahito mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || 48 || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || sāpi dṛṣṭvaiva talliṃgaṃ tasmiṃlliṃge layaṃ gatā || 49 || rājā ca putravāñjāto liṃgadarśanataḥ priye || babhūva cakravartī sa yathā svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ || 5.2.78.50 || etasminnaṃtare devi dṛṣṭvā deve layaṃ gatām || rājaputrīṃ mahādevi kṛtaṃ nāma mudānvitaiḥ || 51 || avimuktasya liṃgasya darśanādeva tatkṣaṇāt || avimukteśvaro deva iti khyāto bhavatviti ||52|| yo'sau kāśyāṃ prasiddho'sti devo viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ || sa caivātra suvikhyāto'vimukteśvarasaṃjñayā || 53 || vārāṇasī yathā puṇyā tathāvaṃtī ca muktidā || tasyā daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śrūyate'tra viśeṣataḥ || 54 || tasmādviśveśvaro devaḥ samāyātaḥ kuśasthalīm|| yatrāgatya suvidvāṃso mānavāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||55|| paśyaṃti parayā bhaktyā hyavimukteśvaraṃ śivam || teṣāṃ muktirna saṃdeho bhaviṣyati suniścalā || 56 || amuktā naiva paśyaṃti muktāḥ paśyaṃti sarvadā || brahmacaryavrataiḥ samyagiṣṭaiḥ sarvamakhairbhavet || 57 || tatphalaṃ prāpyate samyagavimukteśadarśanāt || naiḥśreyasī gatiḥ puṇyā darśanādeva jāyate || 58 || yā gatiḥ prāpyate sāṃkhyaiyogairvā yā gatirbhavet || sā gatiḥ nāpyate samyagavimukteśadarśanāt || 59 || janmamṛtyubhayaṃ hitvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena hyavimukteśvaraṃ śivam || || 5.2.78.60 || brahmahāpi ca yo gacchedavimukteśvaraṃ yajet || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyātsarvvapāpānnivarttate || 61 || śāṭhyenāpi ca yaḥ paśyedavimukte śvaraṃ śivam|| sa muṃcati jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ janma caitadaśāśvatam || 62 || smṛtaḥ saṃpūjito bhaktyā stuto vā vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || muktiṃ dadāti deveśo hyavi mukteśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 63 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || avimukteśvareśasya hanumatkeśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde'vimukteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptati tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 || || cha ||
<5.2.79>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || ekonāśītikaṃ viddhi hanumatkeśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa samīhitaphalaṃ labhet || 1 || prāptarājyasya rāmasya rākṣasānāṃ vadhe kṛte || āgatā munayo devi rāghavaṃ pratinaṃditum || 2 || rāmeṇa pūjitāḥ sarve hyagastipramukhā dvijāḥ || prahṛṣṭamanaso viprā rāmaṃ vacanamabruvan || 3 || diṣṭyā tu nihato rāma rāvaṇaḥ putrapautravān || diṣṭyā vijayinaṃ tvā'dya paśyāmaḥ saha bhāryayā || 4 || hanūmatā ca sahitaṃ vānareṇa mahātmanā || diṣṭyā pavanaputreṇa rākṣasāṃtakareṇa ca || 5 || ciraṃ jīvatu dīrghāyurvānaro hanumānsadā || aṃjanīgarbhasaṃbhūto rudrāṃśo hi dharātale || 6 || ākhaṃḍalo'gnirbhagavānyamo vai niṛtistathā || varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ || brahmaṇā sahitāścaiva dikpālāḥ pātu sarvadā || 7 || śrutvā teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā rāmaḥ prāṃjalirabravīt || 8 || kimarthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ tyaktvā vānaro'yaṃ praśaṃsitaḥ || kīdṛśaḥ kiṃprabhāvo vā kiṃvīryaḥ kiṃparākramaḥ || 9 || athocuḥ satyamevaitatkāraṇaṃ vānarottame || na tvasya sadṛśo vīrye vidyate bhuvanatraye || 5.2.79.10 || eṣa deva mahāprājño yojanānāṃ śataṃ plutaḥ || dharṣayitvā purīṃ laṃkāṃ rāvaṇāṃtaḥpuraṃ gataḥ || 11 || prādeśamātrapratimaṃ kṛtaṃ rūpamanena vai || dṛṣṭā saṃbhāṣitā sītā pṛṣṭā viśvāsitā tathā || 12 || senāgragā maṃtriputrāḥ kiṃkarā rāvaṇātmajāḥ || hatā hanumatā tatra tāḍitā rāvaṇālaye || 13 || bhūyo bandhavimuktena saṃbhāṣya tu daśānanam || laṃkā bhasmīkṛtā tena pātakeneva medinī || 14 || na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇorvedhaso'pi vā || śrūyaṃte tāni karmāṇi yādṛśāni hanūmataḥ || 15 || ||| || rāma uvāca || || etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṃkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ || prāpto mama jayaścaiva rājyaṃ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ || 16 || sakhāyaṃ vānarapatirmuktvainaṃ haripuṃgavam || pravṛttimapi ko vettuṃ jānakyāḥ śaktimānbhavet || 17 || vālī kimarthametena sugrīvapriyakāmyayā || tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdhastṛṇavatkatham || 18 || nāyaṃ viditavānmanye hanumānātmano balam || upekṣitaḥ kliśyimāne kimarthaṃ vānarādhipe || 19 || evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ rāmaṃ tu munayo vākyamabruvan || satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ || 5.2.79.20 || na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matāvapi || amoghavākyaiḥ śāpastu datto'sya munibhiḥ purā || 21 || na jñātaṃ hi balaṃ yena balinā vālimardane || bālye'pyanena yatkarma kṛtaṃ nāma mahātmanā || 22 || tanna varṇayituṃ śakyametasya tu balaṃ mahat || yadi śrotuṃ tavecchāsti niśāmaya vadāmahe || 23 || asau hi jātamātro'pi bālārka iva mūrttimān || grahītukāmo bālārkaṃ puplāvāṃbaramadhyataḥ || 24 || tūrṇamādhāvato rāma śakreṇa viditātmanā || hanustenāsya sahasā kuliśenaiva tāḍitaḥ || 25 || tato girau papātaiṣa śakravajrābhitāḍitaḥ || patatosya mahāvegādvāmo hanurabhajyata || asmiṃstu patite bāle mṛtakalpe'śanikṣatāt || 26 || tato vāyuḥ samādāya mahā kālavanaṃ gataḥ || liṃgamārādhayāmāsa putrārthaṃ pavanastadā || 27 || spṛṣṭamātrastu liṃgena samuttasthau plavaṃgamaḥ || jalasiktaṃ yathā sasyaṃ punarjīvi tamāptavān || 28 || prāṇavaṃtamimaṃ dṛṣṭvā pavano harṣitastadā || pratyuvāca prasannātmā putramādāya satvaram || 29 || sparśanādasya liṃgasya mama putraḥ samutthitaḥ || hanumatkeśvaro devo vikhyāto'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 5.2.79.30 || etasminnaṃtare śakraḥ samāyātaḥ surairvṛtaḥ || nīlotpalamayīṃ mālāṃ saṃpragṛhyedamabravīt || 31 || matkarotsṛṣṭavajreṇa yasmādasyahanurhataḥ || tadeṣa kapiśārdūlo hanumāṃstu bhaviṣyati || 32 || varuṇo'sva varaṃ prādānnāsya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || yamo daṃḍādavadhyatvamārogyaṃ dhanado dadau || 33 || sūryeṇa ca prabhā dattā pavanena gatirdrutā || liṃgena ca varo datto devānāṃ saṃnidhau tadā || 34 || āyudhānāṃ hi sarveṣāmavadhyo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || amitrabhayado hyeṣa mitrāṇāmabhaya pradaḥ || ajeyo bhavitā yuddhe liṃgenoktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 36 || śatrorbalotsādanāya rāghavaprītaye sadā || kiyatkālaṃ balaṃ svīyaṃ na smariṣyati śāpataḥ || 37 || hate tu rāvaṇe bhūyo rāmasyānumate sthitaḥ || vibhīṣaṇaṃ prārthayitvā māmatra sthāpayiṣyati || 38 || tato māṃ tridaśāḥ sarve pūjayiṣyaṃti bhāvitāḥ || tenaiva nāmnā vikhyātiṃ punaryāsyāmi bhūtale || 39 || atha gaṃdhavahaḥ putraṃ pragṛhya gṛhamānayat || aṃjanāyai tadācakhyau varalabdhiṃ ca liṃgataḥ || 5.2.79.40 || evaṃ liṃgaprabhāvācca balavānmārutātmajaḥ || sa jātastriṣulokeṣu rāma tasmātpraśasyate || 41 || parākramotsāhamati pratāpaiḥ sauśīlyamādhuryanayādikaiśca || gāṃbhīryacāturyasuvīryadhairyairhanūmataḥ ko'bhyadhiko'sti loke || 42 || mameva vikṣobhitasāgarasya lokāndi dhakṣoriva pāvakasya || prajā jihīrṣoriva cātakasya hanūmataḥ sthāsyati kaḥ purastāt || 43 || etadvai kathita tubhyaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ pari pṛcchasi || hanūmato'sya bālasya karmāṇyadbhutavikrama || 44 || dṛṣṭaḥ sabhājitaścāpi rāma gacchāmahe vayam || evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve munayo'vaṃtimaṇḍalam || pūjayāmāsurīśānaṃ hanumatkeśvaraṃ śivam || || samarcayaṃti ye bhaktyā liṃgaṃ tridaśapūjitam || hanumatkeśvaraṃ devaṃ te kṛtārthāḥ kalau yuge || 46 || vrajaṃtyeva suduṣprāpyaṃ brahmasāyujyamavyayam| saṃprāpya tu punarjanma labhaṃte mokṣamavyayam || 47 || yaḥ paśyati naro liṃgaṃ hanumatkeśvar priya || so'dhikaṃ phalamāpnoti sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || 48 || sarvalokeṣu tasyaiva gatirna pratihanyate || divyenaiśvaryayogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 49 || bālasūryapratīkāśavimānena suvarcasā || vṛtaḥ strīṇāṃ sahasraistu svacchadagamanāgamaḥ || 5.2.79.50 || vicaratyavicāreṇa sarvalokāndivaukasām || spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ puṃsāṃ sarvavarṇottamodhunā || 51 || svargāccyutaḥ prajāyeta kule mahati rūpavān || dharmajño rudrabhaktaśca sarvavidyārthapāragaḥ ||52|| rājā vā rājatulyo vā darśanādasya jāyate || sparśanātparamaṃ puṇyaṃ yajanātparamaṃ padam ||53|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || hanumatkeśvareśasya svapneśvaramatho śṛṇu || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde hanumatkeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 || || cha ||
<5.2.80>
|| īśvara uvāca || āśītikaṃ vijānīhi devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ priye || yasya darśanamātreṇa duḥsvapnaṃ naśyati dhruvam || 1 || kalmāṣapādeti khyāto loke rājā babhūva ha || ikṣvākuvaṃśajo devi tejasā sūryavadbhuvi || 2 || sa kadācidvane rājā vaśiṣṭhasutamaurasam || śaktiṃ paramadharmajñaṃ dadarśa vijiteṃdriyam || mārgasthitaṃ taponiṣṭhamapagaccheti cābravīt || 3 || amuṃcaṃtaṃ tu paṃthānaṃ tamṛṣiṃ nṛpasattamaḥ || jaghāna kaśayā mohāttadā rākṣasavanmunim || 4 || kaśāprahārābhihatastataḥ sa munipuṃgavaḥ || taṃ śaśāpa ruṣāviṣṭo vāśiṣṭhaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ || 5 || haṃsi rākṣasavadyasmādrājāpasada tāpasam || tasmāttvamadyaprabhṛti puruṣādo bhaviṣyati||6|| satataṃ piśitāsaktaścariṣyasi mahīmimām|| sa tu śaptastadā tena tatkṣaṇādvai nṛpottamaḥ ||7|| jagāma śaraṇaṃ śaktiṃ prasādayituma rhayat|| yadā na tuṣṭo viprarṣiḥ śaktiḥ paramakopanaḥ || prasādyamāno bhūpena tadā tenāpi bhakṣitaḥ || 8 || śaktiṃ taṃ bhakṣayitvā tu vaśiṣṭhasyāparāntu tān || bhakṣayāmāsa sahasā siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgāniva || 9 || tadāprabhṛti saṃjātaḥ puruṣādo nṛpottamaḥ || rātrau paśyati duḥsvapnānpāpasaṃghena mohitaḥ || || 5.2.80.10 || dṛṣṭvā bhayānakānsvapnānsa rājā paryyatapyata || paścāttāpena saṃyukto vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 11 || athāpyuktamamātyaiśca kiṃ karoṣi mahīpate || kasmātte niṣprabhā kāṃtirvivarṇo hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ || 12 || sa rājā kathayāmāsa duḥsvapnānanupūrvaśaḥ || svapne'haṃ sāgaraṃ śuṣkaṃ candraṃ ca patitaṃ bhuvi || 13 || uparuddhāṃ ca jagatīṃ ghanena tamasā vṛtām|| ātmānaṃ cāhamadrākṣaṃ malinaṃ muktamūrddhajam || 14 || pataṃtamadriśikharātkaluṣe gomaye hrade || pibannaṃjalinā tailaṃ hasanniva muhurmuhuḥ || 15 || tailenābhyaktasarvāṃgastailamevāvagāhayan || pīṭhe kārṣṇāyase caiva niṣaṇṇo'hamadho mukhaḥ || 16 || gāyaṃti pramadā raktā raktamālyānulepanāḥ || kṛṣṇāṃbaradharāścānyāḥ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanāḥ || 17 || tābhirākṛṣyamāṇo'pi nīto'haṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || baddhvā rajjvā suvarṇasya lohasya rajatasya ca || 18 || pāṃsukardamayormadhye magnohaṃ lohayaṃtritaḥ || kapotaistudyamāno'haṃ gṛdhraiḥ kākaiśca dāruṇaiḥ || 19 || sṛgālairbhakṣyamāṇaśca sthito madguramastake || ṛkṣavānarayānastho gato'haṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 5.2.80.20 || nadīṃ nimagno niśceṣṭo jalahīnāṃ mahīsamām|| daṃtairvidārito rātrau rāsabhenāhamardditaḥ || 21 || tāḍito hadayetyarthaṃ caraṇairvajrasaṃnibhaiḥ || dṛṣṭiśca hanyate'tyarthaṃ vetālairlohaśaṃ kubhiḥ ||22|| karālaiḥ kaṃṭakaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ|| svapnehaṃ tāḍitotyarthamapramāṇaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||23|| evametanmayā dṛṣṭamimāṃrātriṃ bhayāvahām|| saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyeta duḥsvapnānaparānbahūn ||24|| imāṃ tu duḥsvapnagatiṃ nirīkṣya vai hyanekarūpāmaviciṃtitāṃ purā || bhayaṃ mahanme hṛdayaṃ na śuddhyati pragṛhya bāhū vilapāmyanāthavat || 25 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā amātyā bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ || paśyaṃto durnimittāśca ulkāpātādikāstadā || 26 || sauri sūryakujākrāṃtaṃ nagaraṃ dṛśyate'dhunā|| nāgaṃ catuṣpadaṃ viṣṭiṃ kiṃstughnaṃ śakuniṃ tathā ||27|| karaṇāni na śasyaṃte muhūrttā dāruṇābhavan || viditvā nṛpabhaṃgaṃ tu deśabhaṃgakulakṣayam||28|| āśvāsayaṃto rājānamidaṃ vacanamabruvan || alaṃ śokena kākutstha satyāsatyā hi vibhramāḥ ||29|| dṛśyaṃte bhāvitāḥ puṃsi svapne dhātuvaśena hi || tathā pitrādidevāṃśca pūjaya brāhmaṇāṃstathā || 5.2.80.30 || ebhistato mokṣyase tvaṃ mānasādadhivibhramāt || yasmāddaivopaghātānāṃ daivameva hi rakṣaṇam||31|| evamāśvāsito bhūpo hyamātyairdharmakovidaiḥ || tatpāpaṃ kathayāmāsa guruputravadhādikam ||32|| vaśiṣṭhasya suto jyeṣṭhaḥ śakti rvai bhakṣito mayā || nṛśaṃsena tathāmātyā ekonaṃ bhakṣitaṃ śatam || 33 || tena pāpena saṃtaptaḥ kathaṃ svastho bhavāmi vai || ekāpi brahmahatyāyā sāpi daivātsuduṣkarā || 34 || mayā punarnṛśaṃsena sā tathā na tu varjitā || kāṃstu lokāngamiṣyāmi kṛtvā karma sudāruṇam || rākṣaso'hamanenaiva śarīreṇa kulāṃtakṛt|| 35 || jātaḥ kule raghūṇāṃ vai pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ || so'hamatra mariṣyāmi sādhayitvā hutāśanam || 36 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā saudāsasya suvismitāḥ || amātyā vedatattvajñāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 37|| aho pāpamidaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ pāpena sarvathā || prāyaścittaṃ na jānīmo vaśiṣṭhena vinā'dhunā || 38 || tasmādadyaiva gaṃtavyamasya bhūpasya kāraṇāt || yatra tiṣṭhati viprarṣirvaśiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ || 39 || ityuktvā sahitāstena te'mātyā bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ || gatvā yatrāśrame vipro vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 5.2.80.40 || adṛśyaṃtīṃ vadhūṃ dīnāṃ yatrāśvāsayati prabhuḥ || adṛśyaṃtī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kūrakarmāṇamagrataḥ || bhayasaṃvignayā vācā vaśiṣṭhamidamabravīt || 41 || asau mṛtyurivogreṇa daṇḍena vahugarvitaḥ || pragṛhītena kāṣṭhena rākṣaso'bhyeti bhīṣaṇaḥ ||42|| tannivārayituṃ śakto nānyo vai bhuvi kaścana || tvāmṛte'dya mahābhāga sarvavedavidāṃ vara || 43 || trāhi māṃ bhaga vanpāpādasmāddāruṇadarśanāt || rākṣaso'yamihāgatya nūnamāvāṃ samīhate || 44 || || vaśiṣṭha uvāca || || mā bhaiḥ putri na bhetavyaṃ rākṣasātte kathaṃcana || naitadrakṣo bhayaṃ yasmātpaśyasi tvamupasthitam|| rājā kalmāṣapādo'yamamātyaiḥ sahito vibhuḥ || 45 || sa eṣo'sminvanoddeśe samā yāto mamāṃtikam || tamāyāṃtamathālakṣya vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || vārayāmāsa tejasvī huṃkāreṇa nṛpottamam ||46|| mantrapūtena ca tataḥ samabhyukṣya ca vāriṇā || mokṣayāmāsa vai bhāvādrākṣasādrājasattamam|| 47 || pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāmabhivādya kṛtāṃjaliḥ|| uvāca nṛpatiḥ kāle vaśiṣṭhamṛṣisatta mam || 48 || saudāso'haṃ mahābhāga dāso'haṃ tava suvrata || asminkāle yadiṣṭaṃ te brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 49 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpasya dvijasattamaḥ || jñātvā tapobalenaiva viśvāmitrasya ceṣṭitam || rājānaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vinayāvanataṃ tathā || 5.2.80.50 || jñātameva yathākālaṃ gaccha rājankuśa sthalīm|| mahākālasamīpe tu liṃgaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam|| 51 || rājasaṃpatkaraṃ divyaṃ putrapautravivarddhanam || brahmahatyāsahasrāṇāṃ sphoṭanaṃ pāpanāśa nam || tasya darśanamātreṇa vipāpmā ca bhaviṣyasi || 52 || duḥsvapnajaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ vinaṃkṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || grahāśca sānukūlāste bhaviṣyanti nṛpo ttama ||53|| ityukto guruṇā bhūyo vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā || jagāma tvarito devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham || dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ duṣṭaduḥsvapnanāśanam ||54|| naṣṭāḥ sarvepi duḥsvapnāḥ susvapnāścābhavaṃstadā || rājā niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā punaḥ prāpnonnijaṃ padam || ayodhyāyāṃ gato rājyaṃ cakāra muditastadā || || 55 || tadāprabhṛti devo'yaṃ susvapneśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || babhūva bhuvane khyātaḥ sarvaduḥsvapnanāśanaḥ ||56|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ śivam || darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti snātvā śiprājale śubhe|| ājanmaprabhavaṃ teṣāṃ duḥsvapnaṃ ca vinaśyati||57|| sa eva sarvadā pūjya iha loke paratra ca || yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ śivam || 58 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya manasābhimataṃ naraḥ || taṃ taṃ durllabhamāpnoti susvapneśvaradarśanāt || 59 || niyamena prapaśyaṃti devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ sadā || te prayāṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīyaṃ bhavanaṃ priye || 5.2.80.60 || bhaktihīnaḥ kriyāhīno yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ || supuṇyāṃ gatimāpnoti yogigamyāṃ yaśasvini || 61 || ye ca puṣpairvicitraiśca pūjayanti ca parvasu || te sarvakāmasaṃpannāḥ śrībalārogyasaṃyutāḥ || dīrghāyuṣaḥ śubhācārā jāyante dehino'malāḥ || 62 || ete ca brahmaviṣṇviṃdrakuberadahanādayaḥ || susvapnaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ śrīsvapneśvaradarśanāt ||63|| eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || svapneśvarasya devasya śṛṇu liṃgacatuṣṭayam || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde svapneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 || || cha ||
<5.2.81>
|| īśvara uvāca || || caturdvārasthitaṃ devi śṛṇu liṃgacatuṣṭayam || yasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 1 || ahaṃ pṛṣṭastvayā devi kautukācca varānane || atīva ramaṇīyaṃ ca sthalaṃ darśaya me prabho || 2 || sevitaṃ bahubhiḥ siddhaiḥ punarāvṛttikāṃkṣibhiḥ || yadguhyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca pralaye'pyavināśi yat || 3 || ananyasadṛśaṃ divyaṃ yattīrthaṃ yattapovanam || asaṃkhyeyaguṇopetaṃ bhuktimuktikaraṃ śubham || 4 || suvarṇaśṛṃgāḥ prāsādā harmyāṇi vividhāni ca || udyānāni vicitrāṇi mārgāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ || 5 || samīhitaphalāvāptiryatra labhyā sukhena vai || siddhacāraṇagandharvakiṃnarodgītanāditam || 6 || puṇyaloko pamasthānaṃ triviṣṭapavibhūṣaṇam || evamabhyarthito devi maṃdare cārukandare || 80 || mayā proktaṃ prasannena sthānaṃ śṛṇu sanātanam || mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ svargātsukhakaraṃ param || 8 || anaupamyaguṇopetaṃ bhuktimuktikaraṃ śubham || tatsamaḥ ko'pi dhanyo'nyo na dṛṣṭo bhuvanatraye || 9 || devagandharvvasiddhaiśca sevyaṃ vai muktikāṃkṣibhiḥ || vinodārthaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ tvatpriyārthaṃ kutūhalāt || 5.2.81.10 || tilakaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ jaṃbūdvīpe manorame || icchākāmaphalāvāptiranāyāsena labhyate || 11 || jarārogabhayairhīnaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitam || śakrāgniyamarakṣoṃbuvāyusomeśasevitam || svarge pramuditā devāste'pi kāṃkṣaṃti sarvadā || 12 || asaṃkhyeyaphalaṃ tvatra akṣayā ca gatiḥ sadā || yairna saṃsevitaṃ sthānaṃ vaṃcitāste narā bhuvi || 13 || kṣetrasya ca guṇānvaktuṃ devadānavamānavaiḥ || na śakyate prayatnācca svayaṃ yatra sthito hyaham || 14 || yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣakarmaṇā || mahākālavanaṃ prāpya tatsarvaṃ bhasmasādbhavet || 15 || na sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre tripuṣkare || yā gatirvihitā puṃsāṃ mahākālavane sadā || 16 || tiryagyonigatā gatvā mahākālavane sthitāḥ || tatraiva nidhanaṃ prāptāste yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 17 || merumaṃdaramātropi rāśiḥ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ|| mahākālavanaṃ prāpya sarvopi vrajati kṣayam || 18 || śmaśānamiti cākhyātaṃ mahākālavanaṃ priye || tatra brahmādayo devā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ || 19 || yoginaśca tathā sāṃkhyāḥ siddhāśca sanakādayaḥ || upāsate ca māṃ bhaktyā madbhaktyā matparāyaṇāḥ || 5.2.81.20 || yā gatiryogatapasāṃ yā gatiryajñayājinām || mahākālavane kṣetre sā gatirvihitā mayā || 21 || saṃharāmi ca tatrasthastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || ato devi samākhyātaṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 22 || evaṃ bahuvidhāñchutvā guṇānbahuvidhāṃstathā || devi tvaṃ vismitā jātā gamanāya mano dadhe || 23 || kṣetrasyālokane cittaṃ jātamutkaṃṭhitaṃ tava || tvayā sārddhaṃ samā gatya mahākālavane śubhe || 24 || paśya devi vicitrākhyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ tava || amareśapurasparddhi varddhitānaṃdasuṃdaram || varṇitaṃ yanmayā devi bhukti muktikaraṃ param || 25 || tvayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi dṛṣṭvā kṣetramanuttamam || asya sthānasya rakṣārthaṃ bhaktaṃ gaṇacatuṣṭayam || niyujyatāṃ mahādeva saṃtoṣāya mama prabho || 26 || dvārāṇi tatra catvāri kriyatāṃ parameśvara || catvāraḥ kalaśāścaiva haimāḥ kāryā dṛḍhāḥ śubhāḥ || 27 || pūrvādikramayogena caturvargo niyojyatām || dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaścaiva maheśvara || 28 || tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mayā devi prayatnataḥ || asya kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ smṛtaṃ gaṇacatuṣṭa yam || 29 || catvāra īśvarāste'pi sthāpitāstadanaṃtaram || piṃgaleśo dhanādhyakṣastathā kāyāvarohaṇaḥ || 5.2.81.30 || bilveśvaro gaṇaśreṣṭho durdarśo gaṇa nāyakaḥ || ete mayā niyuktā vai samarthāḥ kṣetrarakṣaṇe || 31 || pūrvādikramayogena tvatpriyārthaṃ varānane || niyuktāstvanmatenaiva pūrvasyāṃ diśi piṃgalaḥ || || 32 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tathā priye kāyāvarohaṇaḥ || bilveśvaraḥ pratīcyāṃ tu durddarśaścottare tathā || 33 || mānavā ye mriyaṃte'tra kṣetramadhye gaṇo ttamāḥ || teṣāṃ rakṣā parā kāryā bhavadbhirmama śāsanāt||34|| kathāṃ śṛṇu prayatnena piṃgaleśvarasaṃbhavām || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || ||| 35 || piṃgalā kanyakā devi kānyakubje babhūva ha || suśīlā ca suveṣā ca sauṃdaryeṇātinirmitā ||36|| pitā tasyā mahāprājñaḥ sarvaśāstrārthatattva vit || jñānadhyānarataścaiva svādhyāyapariniṣṭhitaḥ || 37|| piṃgalonāma vipreṃdro bhāryā tasya pativratā || piṃgākṣī viśrutā loke sā ca paṃcatvamā gatā || 38 || tatastena sa duḥkhena gṛhasthāśramaniḥspṛhaḥ || tapovanaṃ jagāmātha gṛhītvā tanayāṃ svakām || 39 || ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ puṇyaṃ śākamūla phalāśanaiḥ|| sa tatra munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ || 5.2.81.40 || nivāsaṃ kṛtavāndevi piṃgalāyāśca rakṣaṇam || pālayāmāsa dharmātmā putrikāṃ hṛdayopamām || 41 || tāmeva satataṃ sādhvī manyamāno mahātapāḥ || na pāṇiṃ grāhayāmāsa mātṛhīneti ciṃtayan || 42 || virakto'pi mahābhāga saṃsārā tsarvadharmmavit || putrikāṃ prekṣayansamyaksaṃnyāsaṃ nākarodvaśī || 43 || atha saṃrakṣayanbālāṃ mātṛhīnāṃ tapasvinīm || saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmeṇa sa vipraḥ svarjagāma ha ||44 || tataḥ sā rpigalā dīnā hīnā pitrā suduḥkhitā|| vilalāpāturā devi patitā śokasāgare || 45 || piṃgalovāca || || adya me ca pitā daivātkāladharmamupeyivān || māṃ tyaktvā gatavāneko dayālurniḥspṛho yathā ||46|| sa samaḥ sarvabhūteṣu mamātyaṃtaṃ hite rataḥ || māmekāṃ saṃparityajya paralokamito gataḥ || 47 || sā'haṃ paramaduḥkhārtā pitṛśokena vihvalā || śarīraṃ dhārayāmīdaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vyarthajīvitam || 48 || brahmajñopi hi tāto me śāṃto dāṃto jiteṃdriyaḥ || māmeva pālayāmāsa mātṛhīneti ciṃtayan || 49 || yena saṃrakṣitā bālye yenāsmi parivardhitā || tena pitrā viyuktāhaṃ na jīviṣye kadācana || 5.2.81.50 || nadyāṃ vā nipatiṣyāmi samiddhe vā hutāśane || parvatādvā patiṣyāmi pitṛhīnā nirāśrayā || 51 || iti śokāturā bālā vilapaṃtī punaḥpunaḥ || bodhyamānā mahābhāgaiḥ sadārairṛṣisattamaiḥ ||52|| kanyakābhī rudaṃtībhirvayasyābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ|| āliṃgyāliṃgya bahuśaḥ pīḍyamānā suduḥkhitā || āgatya karuṇāviṣṭo dharmaḥ parahite rataḥ || 53 || sthaviro brāhmaṇo bhūtvā provācedaṃ vacastadā || alaṃ bāle viśālākṣi rodanairatidāruṇaiḥ || na bhūyaḥ prāpyate tātastasmānnārhasi śocitum || 54 || anityaṃ yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ dravyasaṃcayaḥ || priyaiḥ saha ca saṃvāsastanna śocanti paṃḍitāḥ || 55 || tvayā vai tatkṛtaṃ karma pūrvajanmani śobhane || yena pitrā viyogaḥ syādaraṇye munisevite || 56 || tvāṃ vihāya gataḥ kvāpi paśya bāle vidherbalam || idaṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam || 57 || evamīhā samāsaktaṃ mṛtyuḥ prakurute vaśe || tasmādduḥkhaṃ samutsṛjya śrotumarhasi śobhane || 58 || pitṛbhyāṃ ca viyogaśca yenābhūttava karmaṇā || purā tvaṃ sundarī nāma veśyārūpeṇa sundarī || 59 || nṛtyageyādi nipuṇā vīṇāveṇuvicakṣaṇā|| ādiśca paṇyanārīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ ||5.2.81.60|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannāṃ suveṣāṃ suvibhūṣitām || brāhmaṇo guṇavānka ścidbabhūva madanāturaḥ || 61 || taṃ viditvā tathābhūtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ madanāturam || samāścatasrastena tvaṃ ramitā kāminā tataḥ || 62 || so'tha pāparatirmūḍho brāhmaṇo viṣayātmakaḥ || hataḥ śūdreṇa kenāpi kāminā tava veśmani || 63 || vihāya bhāryāmaprauḍhāṃ śubhāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm || prayāto narakaṃ ghoraṃ śūdrāsaṃparkadūṣitaḥ ||64|| tatastasya pitā vidvānmātātīva ca duḥkhitā || ārttā putraviyogena śāpo datto bhayāvahaḥ || 65 || || mātovāca || || auṣadhādi prayuktaṃ ca vaśīkartuṃ mamātmajam || yadasmākaṃ viyogāya vaṃcito duṣṭacāriṇi || 66 || yasmācca mama putreṇa sā viyogamakārayat || tena janmāṃtare dīnā patihīnā bhavatvasau || 67 || || pitovāca || || bālye vayasi varttaṃtī mātṛhīnā suduḥkhitā || bahiṣkṛtā vivāhena pitṛhīnā bhaviṣyasi || 68 || || dharmma uvāca || || tasmātpūrvakṛtenaiva karmaṇā varavarṇini || idaṃ duḥkhamanuprāptā kanyakā bhavatī satī || || 69 || || piṃgalovāca || || tvayā janmāṃtare vṛttaṃ mama proktaṃ dvijottama || tasmādbrūhi bhavanpraśnaṃ pṛcchaṃtyā niścayaṃ svakam || 5.2.81.70 || itthaṃ sughorapāpāhaṃ pāpācārā tathā'dhamā || kathaṃ tu brāhmaṇenāhamutpannā brahmavādinā || 71 || daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajaḥ || daśadhvajasamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ ||72|| evaṃ vadaṃti dharmajñā brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || tasmāddvijottamādasmātkathaṃ janmābhavanmama ||73|| || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || pāpācāraparāpi tvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kule śubhe || utpannā tatra vakṣyāmi kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu piṃgale || 74 || brāhmaṇo viṣayāsaktaḥ kaścidbaddho nṛpājñayā || cauryaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena veśyālubdhena sundari || 75 || mucyatāṃ ca tvayāpyuktaṃ na cauro naiva pātakam || yadyanena kṛtaṃ cauryaṃ tanmayaiva kṛtaṃ bhavet || || 76 || dadāmi vittamadhikaṃ mucyatāṃ dvijasattamaḥ || ityuktvā gṛhamānīya tenaiva sahitā punaḥ || 77 || gṛhaṃ ca kalpitaṃ śubhraṃ puṣpadhṛpādivā sitam || ramitaśca tvayā vipro yathāsukhamanuttamam || 78 || tasya puṇyasya māhātmyādgatā svargamanuttamam || samutpannā kule putrī brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ || 79 || śāpāccaiva viyogaṃ tvaṃ prāptā putryadhunā param || 5.2.81.80 || || piṃgalovāca || || pūrvajanmani veśyāhaṃ jātā duṣkṛtakāriṇī || paradravyaparā duṣṭā śaucācāravivarjitā || idānīṃ duḥkhitā jātā pitṛmātṛviyogataḥ || 81 || pāṇigrahaṇadharmeṇa varjitā śāpataḥ prabho || prasādaṃ kuru me vipra ko bhavānkathayasva me || 82 || kathaṃ janma na me bhūyātkathaṃ muktirbhavenmama || bhavabandhavinirmuktā kathaṃ yāsyāmi sadgatim || || 83 || || vipra uvāca || || dharmohaṃ dvijarūpeṇa tvāṃ jijñāsurihāgataḥ || mamopadeśāttanvaṃgi liṃgasyaikasya darśanāt || kṣetrasya ca prasādāttvaṃ parāṃ muktimavāpsyasi || 84 || || piṃgalovāca || || kasminkṣetre parā muktiḥ kasya liṃgasya darśanāt || labhyate sahasā dharma etadicchāmi veditum || 85 || || dharma uvāca || || asti guptatamaṃ kṣetraṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ heturmokṣasya sarvadā || 86 || tasminkṣetravare puṇye sthāne yojanavistṛte || liṃgaṃ mokṣapradaṃ putri pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam || tasya darśanamātreṇa muktimāpsyasi piṃgale || 87 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmasya ca yaśasvini || jagāma piṃgalā tūrṇaṃ yatra talliṃgamuttamam || dadarśa parayā bhaktyā pasparśa ca punaḥpunaḥ || 88 || darśanāttasya liṃgasya tasmilliṃge layaṃ gatā || atra cāvasare devāḥ procustatraiva saṃsthitāḥ || 89 || anyajanmani pāpiṣṭhā muktā tvaṃ piṃgalekṣaṇā || 5.2.81.90 || ato lokeṣu vikhyātaḥ piṃgaleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho mahāpātakanāśanaḥ || 91 || diśi paśyaṃti ye gatvā pūrvasyāṃ piṃgaleśvaram || teṣāṃ śatakratustuṣṭaḥ pūjāṃ samyagvidhāsyati || 92 || devā vaśyā bhaviṣyaṃti svargasteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || bhaviṣyati ca vaśagā nagarī cāmarāvatī || 93 || dharmo dhanena sahitaḥ kule teṣāṃ na naśyati || loko dharmeṇa caratāṃ vaśagaḥ saṃbha viṣyati || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 94 || aśvamedhasahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam || tatsarvaṃ bhavitā samya kpiṃgaleśvaradarśanāt || 95 || yāni liṃgāni kṣetre'smingopyāni prakaṭāni ca || pūjitāni bhavaṃtīha piṃgaleśvaradarśanāt || 96 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || piṃgaleśvaradevasya śṛṇu kāyāvarohaṇam || 97 || iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye piṃgaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 || || cha ||
<5.2.82>
|| mahādeva uvāca || || kāyāvarohaṇasyāpi utpattiṃ śṛṇu pārvati || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa na naraḥ kāyavānbhavet || 1 || brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭikāmasya manovarvaisvateṃ'tare || dakṣastva jāyatāṃguṣṭhāddakṣiṇātsa prajāpatiḥ || 2 || vāmādajāyatāṃguṣṭhādbhāryā tasya mahātmanaḥ || tasyāṃ pañcāśataṃ kanyāḥ sa evājanayatprabhuḥ || 3 || tāḥ sarvāścānavadyāṃgīḥ kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || putrikāḥ sthāpayāmāsa naṣṭaputraḥ prajāpatiḥ || 4 || dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa || divyena vidhinā devi saptaviṃśatimiṃdave || 5 || rohiṇī vallabhā jātā tasya candrasya sarvadā || ṣaḍviṃśatikṛte candraḥ śapto dakṣeṇa pārvati || 6 || caṃdreṇāpi tathā śapto dakṣaḥ prācetasaḥ kṛtaḥ || ayajatso'śvamedhena bhūtvā prācetasātmajaḥ || 7 || nāmaṃtrito'haṃ mohena dakṣeṇa parvatātmaje || tatra devanikāyānāṃ yajñabhāgānaśeṣataḥ || 8 || havyavāhastadā yukto vahanmaṃtraiḥ samīritaḥ || tvayā dṛṣṭo viśālākṣi nirālaṃbeṃ'bare sthitaḥ || 9 || smaraṃtyā pūrvavairaṃ tu vijñapto'haṃ tvayā priye || tvaṃ devaḥ sarvadevānāṃ gatiśca śaraṇaṃ tathā || 5.2.82.10 || tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāro hotā'dhvaryustvameva ca || tvayā vinā kathaṃ yajño varttate sarvadevapa || 11 || devānāṃ bhāgadheyāni vahatyagnirayaṃ bhayāt || sagarvaścāvaliptaśca dakṣaḥ prācetasaḥ kila || 12 || anusmaranpūrvavairaṃ naiva dāsyatyaśāsitaḥ || kāyahīnaśca karttavyo dakṣo vahnistathaiva ca || 13 || ye ca yajñe samānītā devā dakṣasya śaṃkara || te sarve kāyarahitāḥ kāryā stripurasūdana || 14 || evamukte tvayā devi mayāpyuktaṃ varānane || pūrvajanmani dakṣo'yaṃ pitā tava śucismite || 15 || vahniścādeśakārī ca devāḥ krīḍanakāḥ priye || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtaḥ krodhastvayā priye || 16 || lalāṭe bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā procchvasaṃtyā punaḥpunaḥ || krodhātkareṇa nāsāgraṃ marditaṃ bahuśastadā || 17 || tasminsaṃmardyamāne tu nāsāgre parvatātmaje || jātā strī bhrukuṭīvakrā caturdaṃṣṭrā trilocanā || 18 || baddhagodhāṃgulitrā ca kavacābaddhamekhalā || sakhaḍgā sadhanuṣkā ca satūṇā sapatākinī || 19 || sahasrāsyā śatabhujā sahasracaraṇodarī || pratikūlaiḥ padairdevi kaṃpayaṃtī tathā bhuvam || 5.2.82.20 || kṛtaṃ nāma tvayā devi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tamomayīm || bhadrakālī ca māyā ca sarvalokanamaskṛte || 21 || mayā sṛṣṭastu puruṣastādṛśo lomaharṣaṇaḥ || sa cāpi prāṃjalirbhūtvā māmuvāca punaḥpunaḥ|| ājñāpaya sureśāna kiṃ karomi jagatprabho ||22|| tato devi mayājñapto bhāvaṃ jñātvā tvadīyakam || kṛtvā nāma manojñaṃ tu vīrabhadra iti smṛtaḥ || 23 || vīrabhadra mamādeśādbhadrakālyā sahānayā || prācetasātmajaṃ dakṣaṃ sagarvaṃ sahadaivatam || 24 || vidhvaṃsaya gaṇādhyakṣa sayajñaṃ saparigraham || dattaṃ mayā mahatsainyamasaṃkhyeyaguṇasya ca || 25 || tvayāpi bhadrakālyāstu dattaṃ sainyaṃ bhayāvaham || kapālakartrikāhastaṃ mātṝṇāṃ gaṇamakṣayam || 26 || tatastau tena sainyena mahatātisamāvṛtau || jagmatustatra yatrāste dakṣaḥ prācetaso yajan || 27 || devaiḥ parivṛto devi sadasyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || tato devāḥ suruddhāste tena sainyena pārvati || viśrabdhā maṃtrapūtaṃ tu pibaṃtaḥ somamadhvare || || 28 || trinetreṇa triśūlena tridaśādhipa īśvaraḥ || trā sitaḥ sahasā śakro gaṇenādhvaramadhyagaḥ || 29 || yamākhyena gaṇenaiva yamakalpaprabheṇa ca || somapāne prasaktaśca yamaścākarṣito'dhvare||5.2.82.30|| pāśena varuṇo baddhaḥ pāśena gaṇapena tu || paścimāśādhipo vīraḥ prāṇena parameśvari ||31|| tāḍito'nila evātha uttare naravāhanaḥ || uttarāśādhipo devi nidhānaiḥ sahito'dhvare || vīrabhadraniyuktāste cakruryuddhaṃ sudāruṇam || 32 || atha yuddhaṃ cakāro ccairbhadrakālī bhayāvahā || vikarālī mahākālī kālikā kalaśodarī || 33 || prajvālajvalanākārā śuṣkamāṃsātibhairavā || etāścānyāśca śataśo naramālāvibhūṣaṇāḥ || 34 || kapālakartrikāhastā jaghnurdevagaṇāstadā || iti mātṛgaṇaṃ kruddhaṃ mardayaṃtaṃ surāstadā || dṛṣṭvābhyupagatā devāstuṣitā yuddhalālasā ||35|| kecicca cikṣipuḥ śaktīḥ kecitprāsāṃstathāpare || kecicca tomaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kecitkhaṅgaiśca paṭṭiśaiḥ ||36|| arddito mātṛsaṃghastu pīḍitāḥ pramathā yadā || bhadrakālī tadā kruddhā gadayā śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ||37 || khaḍgādibhiḥ ṣaḍarkāṃśuḥ pīḍayāmāsa saṃyuge || bhagasya netre pūṣṇastu daśanāḥ sūditā mukhāt || 38 || karāndinakarasyaiva caraṇau bhāskarasya ca || muśalena hatā ye'ṣṭau vasavo raṇakovidāḥ || 39 || vamanto rudhiraṃ te'pi naṣṭā jarjara mastakāḥ || videhāśca kṛtā yuddhe tuṣitā raṇagarvitāḥ || 5.2.82.40 || baddhaḥ prācetaso dakṣaḥ pāśena sudṛḍhena ca || śeṣāśca tridaśā bhītā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 41 || vṛttāṃtaḥ kathitaḥ sarvo vistareṇa yathā tathā || ādyā ye tuṣitā devā videhāścaiva te kṛtāḥ || 42 || naṣṭāśca vasavo devāḥ pīḍitā bhāskarā raṇe || na jñāyate sahasrākṣo na yamo na dhaneśvaraḥ || varuṇo yādasāṃ nāthaḥ kva gataḥ parameśvaraḥ || 43 || bhadrakālyā hataṃ sarvaṃ vīrabhadragaṇena ca || bhagnaśca yajñayūpo vai vidhvastaṃ kalaśaṃ tadā || 44 || pradīpitā mahāśālā bhagnaṃ vai yajñatoraṇam || teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ājagāma kṛpāviṣṭo yatrāhaṃ mandare sthitaḥ || 45 || stutiṃ kṛtvā madīyāṃ tu vākyamuktamidaṃ tadā|| ādyā ye tuṣitā devā videhāścaiva te kṛtāḥ || || 46 || bhadrakālyā mahādeva vasavo jarjarīkṛtāḥ || pīḍitā bhāskarā yuddhe śeṣā naṣṭā diśo gatāḥ || 47 || kāyāvarohaṇaṃ deva tuṣitānāṃ kathaṃ bhavet|| brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā mayā proktaṃ varānane || 48 || mahākālavane kṣetre gacchantu tuṣitāstvamī || lakuṭīśo gato yatra kāyāvarohaṇādgra ham|| 49 || brāhmaṇāśca mamādeśāccatuḥśiṣyaiḥ samanvitāḥ || dvāpare samatikrāṃte prāpte kaliyuge tathā || 5.2.82.50 || tatra kāyamanuprāptā mama śiṣyā mamo pamāḥ || avasaṃta kṣitau dhanyā rakṣaṇārthaṃ dvijanmanām || 51 || kṣetrasya dakṣiṇe tasya vidyate liṃgamuttamam || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ divyaṃ siddhānāṃ kāya dāyakam|| 52 || prasādāttasya liṃgasya kāyānprāpsyaṃtyamī surāḥ || madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gatāste tuṣitāḥ priye || 53 || muditā brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ yatra talliṃgamuttamam|| prasādāttasya liṃgasya prāptaṃ kāyamanuttamam || 54 || punaste tādṛśā jātāstuṣitā yādṛśā'bhavan || ato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ nāma kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraḥ || samīhitaprado nityaṃ khyāto devo bhaviṣyati || 55 || ye gatvā dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ devaṃ kāyāvarohaṇam || paśyanti parayā bhaktyā yamasteṣāṃ pitā bhavet|| 56 || janmakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti darśanādeva nānyathā || 57 || svakarmaṇā gatā ye ca narake pitaro gaṇāḥ|| darśanāttasya liṃgasya teṣāṃ muktirbhaviṣyati ||58|| ye paśyaṃti prasaṃgena devaṃ kāyārohaṇam || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 59 || sparśanāttasya liṃgasya pāpinopi hi ye narāḥ || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ sarvapāpavivarjitam || 5.2.82.60 || śāṭhyena pūjito devaḥ kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraḥ || dadāti rājyaṃ bhogāṃśca svargalokaṃ sanātanam || 61 || dvādaśyāṃ ye prapaśyaṃti snātvā kāyāvarohaṇam || te bhittvā brahmasadanaṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim|| 62 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kāyāvarohaṇeśasya bilveśvaramatho śṛṇu || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kāyāvarohaṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇa naṃnāma dvayaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 || || cha ||
<5.2.83>
|| śrīhara uvāca || || bilveśvarasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu sundari sādaram || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 1 || ādikalpe mahādevi lokānāmanukampayā || kalpavṛkṣāstato jātā brahmaṇo dhyāyataḥ purā || 2 || teṣāṃ madhye bilvavṛkṣaḥ śrīvṛkṣa iti gīyate || adhastāttasya vṛkṣasya puruṣaḥ kāṃcanaprabhaḥ || 3 || upaviṣṭastadā dṛṣṭo brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā|| phalāni tasya patrāṇi vividhāni nirantaram || 4 || bhakṣayatyatisaṃhṛṣṭo hadyāni ca mṛdūni ca || baddhagodhāṃgulitraśca śarī dhanvī tathaiva ca || 5 || khaṅgī kirīṭamālī ca kuṇḍalī kavacī tathā || mahorasko mahotsāhaḥ siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā || 6 || brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ nāma bilva ityabhiviśrutam || tamindro varayāmāsa rājā tvaṃ bhūtale bhava || 7 || triviṣṭapasya bhūmisthaḥ sakhābhūto mama priyaḥ || dadāmi te vaijayantīṃ mālāmamlānapaṃkajām || 8 || yasyāḥ prabhāvataḥ śastraṃ raṇe na prabhaviṣyati|| so'bravīdyadi me vajramāyudhaṃ tvaṃ prayacchasi ||9|| tatsyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ rājāhaṃ nānyathā rocate mama|| tato'haṃ pālayiṣyāmi satyenemāṃ vasundha rām||5.2.83.10 || iṃdra uvāca || || evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te bhava rājā prajāhitaḥ || smaraṇādeva vajraste kare yāsyati nānyathā ||11|| sa evamuktastejasvī bilvo rājā babhūva ha|| kapilonāma dharmātmā vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ||12|| sakhā babhūva bilvasya tasya viprarṣisattamaḥ || sa tena saha saṃgamya sukhāsīno varānane ||13|| cakre kathā vicitrārthāḥ prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || tathā kathāntare vādaḥ parasparamabhūttayoḥ ||14|| dānaṃ pradhānaṃ tīrthaṃ tu bilvenoktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || brahma śreṣṭhaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhamityuktaṃ kapilena tu||15|| bilva uvāca|| dānādrājyaṃ sukhaṃ bhogā aiśvaryaṃ svargamakṣayam|| prāpyate dvijaśārdūla kathaṃ brahma praśaṃsasasi||16|| kapila uvāca|| vedādyajñāḥ pravarttaṃte vedādiṣṭiśca kāmikā|| pravarttaṃte kriyā vedādvedamūlamidaṃ jagat||17|| || || bilva uvāca || || saṃsāre pārthivāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ samarthā lokapālane || lokapālopamā loke kathaṃ brahma praśaṃsasi || 18 || || kapila uvāca || || mukhyā vai brāhmaṇāḥ proktāḥ śāpānugrahakārakāḥ || pitaraḥ pārthivānāṃ tu kiṃ tvaṃ bilva na manyase || 19 || evaṃ kautūhale jāte kapilo dvijasattamaḥ || bilvena tāḍito mūrdhni vajreṇānataparvaṇā || 5.2.83.20 || vajreṇa sa dvidhā chinnaḥ kapilo brahmavidyayā || saṃdhārya svaśarīraṃ tu mamāṃtikamupāgataḥ || 21 || stuto'haṃ vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ samyagārādhito hyaham || mayā dattamavyayatvaṃ kuliśādbrāhmaṇasya tu || 22 || dvijaḥ samāgato bilvaṃ punaḥ sakhyamabhūttayoḥ || punastu tādṛśo vādaḥ saṃjātaḥ parvatātmaje || 23 || vāmapādena cāpyenaṃ bilvo vipramatāḍayat || punaśca vajramādāya jaghānainaṃ tadā dṛḍham|| 24 || na mṛtiṃ na vyathāṃ tasya tadvajramakarotpunaḥ || avadhyatvamatho jñātvā bilvastasya mahātmanaḥ || 25 || nārāyaṇamathāsādya prārthayāmāsa cepsitam|| varado'smīti tuṣṭena viṣṇunā sa ca moditaḥ || provāca praṇato viṣṇumidaṃ devi mahāmanāḥ || 26 || || bilva uvāca || || kapilonāma viprarṣiravadhyo'kṣaya eva ca || sakhā mama hṛṣīkeśa sa ca māmāha nityaśaḥ || bibhemyahaṃ na devasya rākṣasasyāsurasya ca || || 27 || piśācasyāpi yakṣasya na caivānyasya kasyacit || bibhemīti yathā brūyāṃ tathā tvaṃ karttumarhasi || 28 || evamuktastu bilvena sa devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā kapilasyāśramaṃ gataḥ ||29|| sa praviśyāśramaṃ devaṃ kapilena prapūjitaḥ || kapilaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ janārddanaḥ || || 5.2.83.30 || bhagavanbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭha vedavedāṃgapāraga || varamekaṃ vṛṇomyadya vipreṃdra dātumarhasi || 31 || prasādito'haṃ bilvena nṛpeṃdreṇa punaḥpunaḥ || varado' smīti cāpyukto varaṃ vavre mahāmune || 32 || tvayā proktaṃ bibhemīti brūhi tasmādanugrahāt || abhītastvaṃ tathāpyadya madarthaṃ tu vada prabho || 33 || kapilastvevamukto vai viṣṇunā madhuraṃ vacaḥ || uvāca na bibhemīti bhūyobhūyo janārdana || 34 || nāhaṃ vakṣye bibhemīti tenoktaṃ nocyate mayā || etacchrutvā vacastasya kapilasya janārddanaḥ || uvāca cakramudyamya bhayaṃ viprasya darśayan || 35 || na cedvakṣyasi bhīto'haṃ cakraṃ te praharāmi vai || 36 || || || kapila uvāca || || kiṃ vṛthā priyacakrasya viṣṇo kleśamihecchasi || nāhaṃ cakrasya te gamyaḥ prasādāttryaṃbakasya hi || 37 || tataḥ sa muṣṭimādāya kuśānāṃ kapilastadā || vāsudevaṃ samāsādya tiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyabhāṣata || 38 || adya garvaṃ ca darpaṃ ca balaṃ yacca tavādbhutam || tatsarvaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi tiṣṭhedānīṃ janārdana || 39 || tato yuddhaṃ samabhavattumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || nimeṣāṃtaramātraṃ tu kṛṣṇasya kapilasya ca || 5.2.83.40 || divyāstrāṇāṃ kuśānāṃ ca yuddhaṃ samabhavaddṛḍham || nirālaṃbeṃ'bare devi devānāṃ bhayamāviśat || 41 || etasminnaṃtare brahmā suraiḥ parivṛtastadā || ājagāmāti saṃtaptaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vacanamabravīt || 42 || bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa bhavabaṃdhabhayāpaha || hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa sūṣṭisaṃhārakāraka || 43 || samārādhya jagannātha śakrā dyāstridivaukasaḥ || vasaṃti muditāḥ sarve sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ || 44 || ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || utpāditaṃ dhṛtaṃ vyāptaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 45 || tenaikena viśuddhena sarvagena mahātmanā || iti sma munayaḥ sarve uditā munisattamāḥ || 46 || vadaṃti kāraṇaṃ cāsya trailokyasya janārddanaḥ || devadānavadaityaiśca municāraṇapannagaiḥ || 47 || varārthibhiśca pravaraiḥ pūjyase garuḍadhvaja || kiṃ bhavāneva gorvida vṛthā yudhyasi sa dvijaiḥ || || 48 || kapilasya ca viprasya harāllabdhavarasya ca || kiṃ na vetsi yathā hyeṣa prasādātpārameśvarāt|| 49|| avadhyatvamanuprāpto hyajeyatvaṃ ca saṃyuge || na caivaṃ tvadvidhā deva brāhmaṇeṣu vikurvate || 5.2.83.50 || brahma ca brahmaṇo mūlaṃ tvayaiva prākpratiśrutam || tasmādāśu nivartasva matvainaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vibho || 51 || itthaṃ niśamya deveśo vākyaṃ brahmamukhāccyutam || yogena tadbalaṃ jñātvā kapilasya tu śaṃkaram || 52 || jagāma paramaṃ lokaṃ pūjyamānastriviṣṭapaiḥ || gate janārdane bilvo vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ || 53 || yuddhaṃ sudāruṇaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇasya kapilasya ca || kathaṃ jeṣyāmi kapilaṃ kathaṃ me nirvṛtirbhavet || kasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi ko me trātā bhaviṣyati || 54 || na jitaḥ kapilo yuddhe viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || mayā saṃsparddhate nityaṃ kathaṃ jeyo bhaviṣyati || 55 || ajeyā brāhmaṇā yuddhe śāpānugrahakārakāḥ || bhasma kuryurjagatsarvaṃ sadevā suramānuṣam || 56 || brāhmaṃ hi paramaṃ tejo devairapi durāsadam || evaṃ vilapatastasya vāsavaḥ samupāgataḥ || 57 || vilapaṃtaṃ kṛśaṃ bilvaṃ vajra hastamavekṣya saḥ || mamatvākṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ pratyuvāca puraṃdaraḥ ||58|| alaṃ śokena bhūpāla śṛṇu me vacanaṃ param|| yadāhaṃ pīḍito yuddhe śaṃbareṇa durātmanā || baliṣṭhena sagarveṇa tadā pṛṣṭo mayā guruḥ ||59|| bṛhaspatirmahātejāstenoktaṃ tu tadā nṛpa || gaccha śakra mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 5.2.83.60 || yatra saṃti sudivyāni liṃgāni vividhāni ca || bhuktimuktikarāṇyeva vāṃchitārthapradāni ca||61|| teṣāṃ madhye liṃgamekamārādhaya śacīpate || yasya darśanamātreṇa raṇe dhṛṣṭo bhaviṣyasi || tasya tadvacanādbilva samyagārādhanā kṛtā || 62 || mayā liṃgasya harṣeṇa jito vai śaṃbarastadā || prasiddhiṃ tu gatā devaḥ sa ceṃdreśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || 63 || tasmāttvaṃ paścimāmāśāṃ gatvā kṣetrasya tasya vai || samārādhaya yatnena liṃgaṃ varuṇapūjitam ||64|| talliṃgaṃ triṣu lokeṣu tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || kapilastvatsakhā vipro jito'smīti vadiṣyati || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyānmitrabhāvaṃ gamiṣyati || 65 || ityuktvā tu gate śakre devalokaṃ yaśasvini || pūjayāmāsa bhāvena puṣpairdivyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || 66 || jagāma bilvo bhūpālo mahākālavanaṃ śubham || dadarśa paścime bhāge liṃgaṃ tridaśapūjitam || 67 || muktāphalaiśca ratnaiśca vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā || etasminnaṃtare caiva kapilo'pi samāgataḥ || 68 || dadarśa bilvaṃ bhūpālaṃ pūjayaṃtaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || śarīre tasya bilvasya madīyaṃ rūpamuttamam || dṛṣṭvā matvā mahādevaṃ jito'smīti dvijo'bravīt ||69|| prārthayāmi tvayā sakhyamanaṃtaṃ śivasaṃnidhau || evamuktastadā bilvaḥ kapilena mahātmanā || 5.2.83.70 || prasannaḥ prāṃjalirbhūtvā kapilaṃ dvijasattamam || evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te kṛtārtho'haṃ mahātmanā ||71|| sakhyaṃ tadeva bhavatu śaśvadvadasi manyase || evamanyonyamuktvā tau kṛtvā sakhyamanuttamam ||72|| cikīḍatuściraṃ kālaṃ paraṃ harṣamupāgatau || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādbhūyo rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ || 73 || sa hi mitreṇa bhūpālo bilvo devi mudānvitaḥ || tadāprabhṛti vikhyāto devo bilveśvaraḥ kṣitau || bilvenārādhito loke vāṃchitārthaphalapradaḥ || 74 || ye paśyaṃti viśālākṣi devaṃ bilveśvaraṃ param || te kṛtārthā bhaviṣyaṃti sarvapātakavarjitāḥ||75|| ye'numodaṃti devasya darśanaṃ parvatātmaje || te'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ prayāṃti mama maṃdire ||76|| samatītaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ|| mama lokaṃ nayatyāśu tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 77 || prayāṃti pitaro hṛṣṭā mama loke hyataṃdritāḥ || vimuktāḥ pātakairghoraiḥ kṛtvā liṃgasya darśanama ||78|| kṛtvāpi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ naraḥ || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti śrībilveśvaradarśanāt || 79 || yā tithiḥ śrūyate devi kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśī || sā proktā vallabhā tasya sarvapātakanāśinī || 5.2.83.80 || ye'rcayaṃti narāstasyāṃ devaṃ bilveśvaraṃ priye || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛtti rghorasaṃsāragahvare || 81 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || tatkṣālayati devo'sau tithau tasyāṃ samarcitaḥ || 82 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || bilveśvarasya devasya śrūyatāmuttareśvaram|| 83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye bilveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 || || a ||
<5.2.84>
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || || uttareśvaramāhātmyamaśeṣapāpanāśanam|| janmamṛtyujarāvyādhisphoṭanaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 1 || ayodhyāyāmatikhyātakulotpannaśca pārthivaḥ || sudhīḥ parīkṣinnāmā ca mṛgayāmagamatsa ca || 2 || mṛgamanusasārātha mṛgo dūramapāsarat || 3 || tadādhvani jātaśramaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇābhibhūtaḥ kasmiṃścidvanoddeśe nīlavanamapaśyaccāviveśa || 4 || tasya vanakhaṇḍasya dakṣiṇabhāge saro dṛṣṭvā sāśva eva vyagāhata || 5 || athāśvasthaḥ sanmṛṇālamaśvasyāgrato nikṣipya puṣkariṇīṃ samupāviśat || 6 || śayitastataḥ śayāno gītamaśṛṇot || 7 || sa śrutvāciṃtayanneha manuṣyagatiṃ prapaśyāmi || 8 || kasya khalvayaṃ gītaśabda ityavalokayāmāsa || 9 || athāpaśyatkanyāṃ paramarūpadarśanīyāṃ puṣpāṇi vicinvaṃtīṃ cātha rājā samīpe paryakrāmat || 5.2.84.10 || tāmabravīdrājā kasyāsi tvaṃ kanyā paramarūpadarśanīyā puṣpāṇi vicinvatī || 11 || sātha rājasamīpe gatveti provāca kanyāsmīti || 12 || || || rājovāca || || arthī tavāsmīti || 13 || athovāca kanyā || samayenāhaṃ tvayā śakyopālabdhuṃ nānyatheti || 14 || tāṃ rājā samapṛcchatkaste samaya iti || 15 || tataḥ kanyā tamuvāca nodakaṃ darśayitavyamiti || 16 || rājā bāḍhamityuktā tāṃ samāgamya tayā sahāste || 17 || tatraivāsanne rājani senā tvāgacchat tayā sahopaviṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ parivārya cātiṣṭhat || 18 || sabhājitaśca rājā tathaiva śibi kayā prāyāt || atha jhaṭiti tayā saha svaṃ nagaramanuprāpya rahasi tayā saha ramamāṇaḥ sannānyaṃ kiṃcidapaśyadatha pradhānomātyastasyābhyāśacarāstāḥ striyo'bhyapṛcchat || 19 || kimatra prayojanaṃ vidyate ityabruvaṃstāḥ striyo pūrvameva paśyāmastadudakaṃ nātrāśriyata iti || 5.2.84.20 || athāmā tyaśca nirudakaṃ kārayitvā dāruvṛkṣaṃ vṛddhapuṣpaphalaṃ śaradyupalabhya rājānāmabravīt || vanamidamanudakaṃ sādhvatra ramyatāmiti || 21 || sa tasya vacanātta yaiva saha devyā vanaṃ prāviśat || 22 || sakalatrastasminvane ramye tayaiva saha reme || 23 || praviśya ca rājā saha priyayā sudhādhavalasalilapūrṇāṃ vāpīmapaśyat || 24 || vāpīṃ darduraiḥ pūrṇāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva ca tāṃ tasyā eva tīre tayā devyātiṣṭhat || 25 || atha tāṃ devīṃ rājābravīt || śāṃtataraṃ vāpīsalilamiti || 26 || sā ca tadvacaḥ śrutvā tīrthavāpīṃ nyamajjanna punarudamajjat || tāṃ mṛgayamāṇo rājā nāpaśyat || 27 || vāpīṃ dardurair pūrṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā ājñāpayāmāsa bhṛtyānsarvadarduravadhaḥ kriyatāmiti || 28 || yo mamārthī sa tairdadurairupāyanairmāmanutiṣṭhet || 29 || atha kaścinmahāndarduro darduravadhe kriyamāṇe sarvāsu dikṣvabhyagāt || 5.2.84.30 || upetya cainamuvācedaṃ jñātvā krodhavaśaṃgatam || prasādaṃ kuru nārhasi dardurāṇāmanaparādhināṃ vadhaṃ kartumiti || || 31 || ślokaścātra bhavati || mā durdurānprabhiṃdyāstvaṃ kopaṃ saṃdhārayācyuta || prakṣīyate mahādharmo janānāṃ parijānatām || 32 || tamevaṃ vādinamiṣṭajanaviyoge śākaparītātmānaṃ sa rājā provāca || nahi kāmamapyetanniṣkāmena nibarhaṇīyā iti ||33|| etairdurātmabhirma strī bhakṣitā sarvathaiva tvima vadhyā dardurāḥ || nārhasi vidvannuparoddhumiti || 34 || sa tadvākyamupaśrutya vyathiteṃdriyamanāḥ provāca prasīda rājannahamāyurnāmabhūpālaḥ || 35 || prāptā sā mama duhitā || sā kanyā nāgalokaṃ gatā || atrāste nāgacūḍo nāgarājaḥ || smṛtā āgamiṣyati || 36 || tāmabravīdrājā tāṃ smṛtvānīya me dīyatāmiti || 37 || athaināṃ smṛtvā rājñe adāt || abravīcca || 38 || mayāvahasito gālavo mahānmuniḥ tapasā karśitāṃgaḥ || kṣameśvaro dardurabālyātprakopitaḥ tenāhaṃ śaptaḥ yanmāmanādṛtya dardurabālyādavahasitastasmāddarduro bhaviṣyasi || 39 || prasāditastu vipraḥ pratyuvāca || || 5.2.84.40 || avitatho'yaṃ mama śāpastasmādanyajanmani dardurarājo bhūtvā tvaṃ hi duhitaramikṣvākukulotpannāya sarvaguṇānvitāya dattvā yadā yāsyasi mahākālavane tasyottaradigbhāge tadā liṃgasya darśanena muktimavāpsyasi || 41 || duhitā kiyatpātālaṃ yāsyati smṛtā cāgamiṣyati || svasti te'stu sādhayiṣyāmi kāryāṇi, ityuktvā darduro mahākālavanamagacchat || 42 || tasyottare liṃgaṃ dadarśa tasya darśanādanekamā ṇikyaracitaṃ siddhagandharvasevitaṃ vimānavaramāruhya śakralokaṃ gataḥ || 43 || tasya māhātmyamavalokya devācāryo bṛhaspatirvākyaṃ jagāda || 44 || aho liṃgasya māhātmyamaho liṃgasya vaibhavam || saṃprāpto vāsavaṃ lokaṃ śāpabhraṣṭo hi darduraḥ || 45 || āyurākhyo hi bhūpālo mukto darduratāṃ gataḥ || || 46 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devācāryasya pārvati || devāste haṣṭamanaso nāma cakuḥ samāhitāḥ || 47 || yasmāddardurabhūpālo mukto dardurayonitaḥ || darśanāttasya liṃgasya tasmātkhyāto bhaviṣyati || 48 || uttareśvaradevaśca śāpapāpapraṇodakaḥ || ityuktvā tridaśaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjito hyuttareśvaraḥ || || 49 || bhuktimuktiprado devi mahāpātakanāśanaḥ || kṣetrasya rakṣaṇārthāya niyukto yo mayā gaṇaḥ || darduro hi durādharṣaḥ sa cāpīśvaratāṃ gataḥ || || 5.2.84.50 || uttarāśāmatho gatvā yaḥ paśyeduttareśvaram || sa sarvaiśvaryasaṃyukto yāti lokamathottaram || 51 || subhagaḥ sarvadā dāṃtaḥ surūpaḥ putravāniti || nīrogaḥ puṇyaśīlaśca jāyate saptajanma ca || 52 || yā vṛddhistu kuberasya śakrasya ca yamasya ca || varuṇasya ca yā vṛddhiḥ sā vṛddhiruttarottarā || jāyate nātra sandeha uttareśvaradarśanāta || 53 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ ye paśyaṃti yaśasvini || uttareśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu te kṛtārthāḥ kalau yuge || 54 || kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kiṃ yajñairbahudakṣiṇaiḥ || darśanāllabhate rājyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ krameṇa tu || 55 || ājanma ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti uttareśvaradarśanāt || 56 || ityevaṃ caturāśītiḥ saṃkhyātā īśvarāstava || kathitā ye tvayā pṛṣṭā mahākālavane mayā || 57 || ya eteṣāṃ devi yātrāṃ pratilomānulomataḥ || kariṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā te yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam ||| 58 || yaścāpi pūjayettatra liṃgaṃ bhaktyā tu mānavaḥ || sa kulaṃ tārayatyeva paitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ śatam || 59 || eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ || caturāśītiliṃgānāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 5.2.84.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāda uttareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvaka caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe paṃcama āvantyakhaṇḍe dvitīyamavantīsthacaturaśītiliṃgamāhātmyaṃ samāptam || 5.2 ||
<5.3.1>
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || 1.1 || oṃ namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamāya | oṃ namaḥ śrīnarmadāyai | oṃ namo hariharahiraṇyagarbhebhyo namo vyāsavālmīkiśukaparāśarebhyo namo gurugobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ | oṃ majjanmātaṅgagaṇḍacyutamadamadirāmodamattālimālaṃ snānaiḥ siddhāṅganānāṃ kucayugavigalatkuṅkumāsaṅgapiṅgam | sāyaṃ prātarmunīnāṃ kusumacayasamācchannatīrasthavṛkṣaṃ pāyādvo narmadāmbhaḥ karimakarakarākrāntarahaṃstaraṃgam || 1.2 || ubhayataṭapuṇyatīrthā prakṣālitasakalalalokaduritaughā | devamunimanujavandyā haratu sadā narmadā duritam || 1.3 || nāśayatu duritamakhilaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavacca bhuvi bhavinām | sakalapavitri tava sudhā puṇyajalā narmadā bhavati || 1.4 || taṭapulinaṃ śivadevā yasyā yatayo'pi kāmayante vā | muninivahavihitasevā śivāya mama jāyatāṃ revā || 1.5 || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtvā naraṃ caiva narottamam | devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1.6 || naimiṣe puṇyanilaye nānāṛṣiniṣevite | śaunakaḥ satramāsīnaḥ sūta papraccha vistarāt || 1.7 || manye'haṃ dharmanaipuṇyaṃ tvayi sūta sadārcitam | puṇyāmṛtakathāvaktā vyāsasaśiṣyastvameva hi || 1.8 || atastvāṃ paripṛcchāmi dharmatīrthāśrayaṃ kave | bahūni santi tīrthāni bahuśo me śrutāni ca || 1.9 || śrutā divyanadī brāhmī tathā viṣṇunadī mayā | tṛtīyā na mayā kvāpi śrutā raudrī saridvarā || 1.10 || tāṃ vedagarbhāṃ vikhyātāṃ vibudhaughābhivanditām | vada me tvaṃ mahāprājña tīrthapūgapariṣkṛtām || 1.11 || kaṃ deśamāśritā revā kathaṃ śrīrudrasaṃbhavā | tatsaṃśritāni tīrthāni yāni tāni vadasva me || 1.12 || sūta uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ kulapate caritraṃ narmadāśritam | citraṃ pavitraṃ doṣaghnaṃ śrutamuktaṃ ca sattama || 1.13 || vedopavedavedāṅgādīnyabhivyasya pūritaḥ | aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ vaktā satyavatīsutaḥ || 1.14 || taṃ namaskṛtya vakṣyāmi purāṇāni yathākramam | yeṣāmabhivyāharaṇādabhivṛddhirvṛṣāyuṣoḥ || 1.15 || śrutiḥ smṛtiśca viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī parikīrtite | kāṇastatraikayā hīno dvābhyāmandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 1.16 || śrutismṛtipurāṇāni viduṣāṃ locanatrayam | yastribhirnayanaiḥ paśyetso'ṃśo māheśvaro mataḥ || 1.17 || ātmano vedavidyā ca īśvareṇa vinirmitā | śaunakīyā ca paurāṇī dharmaśāstrātmikā ca yā || 1.18 || tisro vidyā imā mukhyāḥ sarvaśāstravinirṇaye | purāṇaṃ pañcamo veda iti brahmānuśāsanam || 1.19 || yo na veda purāṇaṃ hi na sa vedātra kiṃcana | katamaḥ sa hi dharmo'sti kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tathāvidham || 1.20 || anyadvā tatkimatrāha purāṇe yanna dṛśyate | vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ pūrvaṃ purāṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1.21 || bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ pratariṣyati | itihāsapurāṇaiśca kṛto'yaṃ niścayaḥ purā || 1.22 || ātmā purāṇaṃ vedānāṃ pṛthagaṃgāni tāni ṣaṭ | yacca dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu taddṛṣṭaṃ smṛtibhiḥ kila || 1.23 || ubhābhyāṃ yattu dṛṣṭaṃ hi tatpurāṇeṣu gīyate | purāṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam || 1.24 || anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ | purāṇamekamevāsīdasmin kalpāntare mune || 1.25 || trivargasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram | smṛtvā jagāda ca munīnprati devaścaturmukhaḥ || 1.26 || pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavattataḥ | kālenāgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā purāṇasya tato muniḥ || 1.27 || vyāsarūpaṃ vibhuḥ kṛtvā saṃharetsa yuge yuge | aṣṭalakṣapramāṇe tu dvāpare dvāpare sadā || 1.28 || tadaṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā bhūloke'smin prabhāṣyate | adyāpi devaloke tacchatakoṭipravistaram || 1.29 || tathātra caturlakṣaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa niveśitam | purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāmprataṃ tadihocyate | nāmatastāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvamṛṣisattama || 1.30 || sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca | vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam || 1.31 || brāhmaṃ purāṇaṃ tatrādyaṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vibhūṣitam | ślokānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ nānāpuṇyakathāyutam || 1.32 || pādmaṃ ca pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi nigadyate | tṛtīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃnāma trayoviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 1.33 || caturthaṃ vāyunā proktaṃ vāyavīyamiti smṛtam | śivabhaktisamāyogācchaivaṃ taccāparākhyayā || 1.34 || caturviṃśatisaṃkhyātaṃ sahasrāṇi tu śaunaka | caturbhiḥ parvabhiḥ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ pañcamaṃ tathā || 1.35 || caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañca śatāni tat | mārkaṇḍaṃ navasāhasraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tatparikīrtitam || 1.36 || āgneyaṃ saptamaṃ proktaṃ sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa | aṣṭamaṃ nāradīyaṃ tu proktaṃ vai pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 1.37 || navamaṃ bhagavannāma bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam | tadaṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ procyate granthasaṃkhyayā || 1.38 || daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ tāvatsaṃkhyamihocyate | laiṅgamekādaśaṃ jñeyaṃ tathaikādaśasaṃkhyayā || 1.39 || bhāgadvayaṃ viracitaṃ talliṅgamṛṣipuṃgava | caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ viduḥ || 1.40 || vibhaktaṃ saptabhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ skāndaṃ bhāgyavatāṃ vara | tadekāśītisāhasraṃ saṃkhyayā vai nirūpitam || 1.41 || tatastu vāmanaṃ nāma caturdaśatamaṃ smṛtam | saṃkhyayā daśasāhasraṃ proktaṃ kulapate purā || 1.42 || kaurmaṃ pañcadaśaṃ prāhurbhāgadvayavibhūṣitam | daśasaptasahasrāṇi purā sāṃkhyapate kalau || 1.43 || mātsyaṃ matsyena yatproktaṃ manave ṣoḍaśaṃ kramāt | taccaturdaśasāhasraṃ saṃkhyayā vadatāṃ vara || 1.44 || gāruḍaṃ saptadaśamaṃ smṛtaṃ caikonaviṃśatiḥ | aṣṭādaśaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam || 1.45 || tacca dvādaśasāhasraṃ śatamaṣṭasamanvitam | tathaivopapurāṇāni yāni coktāni vedhasā || 1.46 || idaṃ brahmapurāṇasya sulabhaṃ sauramuttamam | saṃhitādvayasaṃyuktaṃ puṇyaṃ śivakathāśrayam || 1.47 || ādyā sanatkumāroktā dvitīyā sūryabhāṣitā | sanatkumāranāmnā hi tadvikhyātaṃ mahāmune || 1.48 || dvitīyaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca purāṇe pādmasaṃjñite | śaukeyaṃ hi tṛtīyaṃ tu purāṇe vaiṣṇave matam || 1.49 || bārhaspatyaṃ caturthaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ saṃmataṃ sadā | daurvāsasaṃ pañcamaṃ ca smṛtaṃ bhāgavate sadā || 1.50 || bhaviṣye nāradoktaṃ ca sūribhiḥ kathitaṃ purā | kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam || 1.51 || brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cātha kālikādvayameva ca | māheśvaraṃ tathā sāmbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam || 1.52 || pārāśaraṃ bhāgavataṃ kaurmaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ kramāt | etānyupapurāṇāni mayoktāni yathākramam || 1.53 || purāṇasaṃhitāmetāṃ yaḥ paṭhedvā śṛṇoti ca | so'nantapuṇyabhāgī syānmṛto brahmapuraṃ vrajet || 1.54 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe purāṇasaṃhitāvarṇanāṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.2>
sūta uvāca || 2.1 || narmadāyāstu māhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt | tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 2.2 || vistaraṃ narmadāyāstu tīrthānāṃ munisattama | ko'nyaḥ śakto'sti vai vaktumṛte brahmāṇamīśvaram || 2.3 || etameva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭavāñjanamejayaḥ | vaiśaṃpāyanasaṃjñaṃ tu śiṣyaṃ dvaipāyanasya ha || 2.4 || revātīrthāśritaṃ puṇyaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi śaunaka | purā pārīkṣito rājā yajñādīkṣāsu dīkṣitaḥ || 2.5 || saṃbhṛte tu havirdravye vartamāneṣu karmasu | āsīneṣu dvijāgryeṣu hūyamāne hutāśane || 2.6 || vartamānāsu sarvatra tathā dharmakathāsu ca | śrūyamāṇe tathā śabde janairukte tvaharniśam || 2.7 || yajñabhūmau kulapate dīyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti | vividhāṃśca vinodānvai kurvāṇeṣu vinodiṣu || 2.8 || evaṃvidhe vartamāne yajñe svargasadaḥsame | vaiśaṃpāyanamāsīnaṃ papraccha janamejayaḥ || 2.9 || janamejaya uvāca dvaipāyanaprasādena jñānavānasi me mataḥ | vaiśaṃpāyana tasmāttvāṃ pṛcchāmi ṛṣisannidhau || 2.10 || brūhi me tvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ pitḥṇāṃ tīrthasevanam | ciraṃ nānāvidhānkleśān prāptāsta iti me śrutam || 2.11 || kathaṃ dyūtajitāḥ pārthā mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ | āsamudrāṃ mahīṃ vipra bhramantastīrthalobhataḥ || 2.12 || kena te sahitāstāta bhūmibhāgānanekaśaḥ | ceruḥ kathaya tatsarvaṃ sarvajño'si mato mama || 2.13 || vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca || 2.14 || kathayiṣyāmi bhūnātha yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu tvayā'nagha | namaskṛtya virūpākṣaṃ vedavyāsaṃ mahākavim || 2.15 || pitāmahāstu te pañca pāṇḍavāḥ saha kṛṣṇayā | uṣitvā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ kāmyake vana uttame || 2.16 || pradhānoddālake tatra kaśyapo'tha mahāmatiḥ | vibhāṇḍakaśca rājendra muruścaiva mahāmuniḥ || 2.17 || pulastyo lomaśaścaiva tathānye putrapautriṇaḥ | snātvā niḥśeṣatīrtheṣu gatāste vindhyaparvatam || 2.18 || te ca tatrāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvairvṛkṣaiḥ samākulam | campakaiḥ karṇakāraiśca punnāgairnāgakesaraiḥ || 2.19 || bakulaiḥ kovidāraiśca dāḍimairupaśobhitam | puṣpitairarjunaiścaiva bilvapāṭalaketakaiḥ || 2.20 || kadambāmramadhūkaiśca nimbajambīratindukaiḥ | nālikeraiḥ kapitthaiśca kharjūrapanasaistathā || 2.21 || nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāvallībhirāvṛtam | sapuṣpaṃ phalitaṃ kāntaṃ vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ yathā || 2.22 || jalāśrayaistu vipulaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam | sitotpalaiśca saṃchannaṃ nīlapītaiḥ sitāruṇaiḥ || 2.23 || haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam | āḍīkākabalākābhiḥ sevitaṃ kokilādibhiḥ || 2.24 || siṃhairvyāghrairvarāhaiśca gajaiścaiva mahotkaṭaiḥ | mahiṣaiśca mahākāyaiḥ kuraṅgaiścitrakaiḥ śaśaiḥ || 2.25 || gaṇḍakaiścaiva khaḍgaiśca gomāyusurabhī yutam | sāraṅgairmallakaiścaiva dvipadaiśca catuṣpadaiḥ || 2.26 || tathāca kokilākīrṇaṃ manaḥkāntaṃ suśobhitam | jīvaṃjīvakasaṃghaiśca nānāpakṣisamāyutam || 2.27 || duḥkhaśokavinirmuktaṃ sattvotkaṭamanoramam | kṣuttṛṣārahitaṃ kāntaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitam || 2.28 || siṃhīstanaṃ pibantyatra kuraṃgāḥ snehasaṃyutam | mārjāramūṣakau cobhāvavalehata unmukhau || 2.29 || pañcāsyāḥ potakebhāśca bhoginastu kalāpinaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tadvipinaṃ ramyaṃ praviṣṭāḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ || 2.30 || mārkaṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra taruṇādityasannibham | ṛṣibhiḥ sevyamānaṃ tu nānāśāstraviśāradaiḥ || 2.31 || kulīnaiḥ sattvasampannaiḥ śaucācārasamanvitaiḥ |
