dhīsaṃgataiḥ kṣamāyuktaistrisaṃdhyaṃ japatatparaiḥ || 2.32 || ṛgyajuḥsāmavihitairmantrairhomaparāyaṇaiḥ | kecitpañcāgnimadhyasthāḥ kecidekāntasaṃsthitāḥ || 2.33 || ūrdhvabāhunirālambā ādityabhramaṇāḥ pare | sāyaṃprātarbhujaścānye ekāhārāstathā pare || 2.34 || dvādaśāhāttathā cānye anye māsārdhabhojanāḥ | darśe darśe tathā cānye anye śaivālabhojanāḥ || 2.35 || piṇyākamapare'bhujan kecitpālāśabhojanāḥ | apare niyatāhārā vāyubhakṣyāmbubhojanāḥ || 2.36 || evaṃbhūtaistathā vṛddhaiḥ sevyate munipuṃgavaiḥ | tato dharmasutaḥ śrīmānāśramaṃ taṃ praviśya saḥ || 2.37 || dṛṣṭvā munivaraṃ śāntaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ padam | prādakṣiṇyena sahasā daṇḍavatpatito'grataḥ || 2.38 || bhaktyānupatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā cirādādāya locanam | ko bhavānityuvācedaṃ dharmaṃ dhīmānapṛcchata || 2.39 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dārakastatsamīpagaḥ | āhāyaṃ dharmarājaste darśanārthaṃ samāgataḥ || 2.40 || tacchrutvādārakeṇoktaṃ vacanaṃ prāha sādaraḥ | ehyehi vatsavatseti kiṃcitsthānāccalanmuniḥ | taṃ tu snehādupāghrāya āsane upaveśayat || 2.41 || upaviṣṭe sabhāyāṃ tu pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | vanyairdhānyaiḥ phalairmūlai rasaiścaiva pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 2.42 || pāṇḍavā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prapūjitāḥ | muhūrtādatha viśramya dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 2.43 || pṛcchati sma muniśreṣṭhaṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ | bhagavansarvalokānāṃ dīrghāyustvaṃ mato mama || 2.44 || saptakalpānaśeṣeṇa kathayasva mamānagha | kalpakṣaye'pi lokasya sthāvarasyetarasya ca || 2.45 || na vinaṣṭo'si viprendra kathaṃ vā kena hetunā | gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāntāśca yā mune || 2.46 || tāsāṃ madhye sthitāḥ kāḥ svitkāścaiva pralayaṃ gatāḥ | kā nu puṇyajalā nityaṃ kānu na kṣayamāgatā || 2.47 || etatkathaya me tāta prasannenāntarātmanā | śrotumicchāmyaśeṣeṇa ṛṣibhiḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ || 2.48 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhusādhu mahāprājña dharmaputra yudhiṣṭhira | kathayāmi yathā nyāyaṃ yatpṛcchasi mamānagha || 2.49 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ rudrabhāṣitam | yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 2.50 || aśvamedha sahasreṇa vājapeyaśatena ca | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti rājannāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 2.51 || brahmaghnaśca surāpī ca steyī goghnaśca yo naraḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā || 2.52 || gaṅgā tu saritāṃ śreṣṭhā tathā caiva sarasvatī | kāverī devikā caiva sindhuḥ sālakuṭī tathā || 2.53 || sarayūḥ śatarudrā ca mahī carmilayā saha | godāvarī tathā puṇyā tathaiva yamunā nadī || 2.54 || payoṣṇī ca śatadruśca tathā dharmanadī śubhā | etāścānyāśca saritaḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2.55 || kiṃ tu te kāraṇaṃ tāta vakṣyāmi nṛpasattama | samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ kalpe kalpe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 2.56 || saptakalpakṣaye kṣīṇe na mṛtā tena narmadā | narmadaikaiva rājendra paraṃ tiṣṭhetsaridvarā || 2.57 || toyapūrṇā mahābhāga munisaṃghairabhiṣṭutā | gaṃgādyāḥ saritaścānyāḥ kalpe kalpe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 2.58 || eṣā devī purā dṛṣṭā tena vakṣyāmi te'nagha || 2.59 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.3>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca saptakalpakṣayā ghorāstvayā dṛṣṭā mahāmune | na cāpīhāsti bhagavandīrghāyuriha kaścana || 3.1 || tvayā hyekārṇave suptaḥ padmanābhaḥ surārihā | dṛṣṭaḥ sahasracaraṇaḥ sahasranayanodaraḥ || 3.2 || tvaṃ kilānugrahāttasya dahyamāne carācare | na kṣayaṃ samanuprāpto varadānānmahātmanaḥ || 3.3 || kiṃ tvayāścaryabhūtaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ ca bhramatānagha | etadācakṣva bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 3.4 || samprāpte ca mahāghore yugasyānte mahākṣaye | anāvṛṣṭihate loke purā varṣaśatādhike || 3.5 || auṣadhīnāṃ kṣaye ghore devadānavavarjite | nirvīrye nirvaṣaṭkāre kalinā dūṣite bhṛśam || 3.6 || saritsarastaḍāgeṣu palvalopavaneṣu ca | saṃśuṣkeṣu tadā brahmannirākāre yugakṣaye || 3.7 || janaṃ prāpte maharloke brahmakṣatraviśādayaḥ | ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno divyatejaḥsamanvitāḥ || 3.8 || sthitāni kāni bhūtāni gatānyeva mahāmune | etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga kathayasva pṛthakpṛthak || 3.9 || bhūtāni kāni viprendra kathaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt | brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrāṇāṃ kāle prāpte sudāruṇe || 3.10 || evamuktastataḥ so'tha dharmarājena dhīmatā | mārkaṇḍaḥ pratyuvācedamṛṣisaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 3.11 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tvayā saha nareśvara | mahatpurāṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ śaṃbhunā vāyudaivate || 3.12 || vāyoḥ sakāśātskandena śrutametatpurātanam | vasiṣṭhaḥ śrutavāṃstasmātparāśarastataḥ param || 3.13 || tasmācca jātūkarṇyena tasmāccaiva maharṣibhiḥ | evaṃ paramparāproktaṃ śatasaṃkhyairdvijottamaiḥ || 3.14 || saṃhitā śatasāhasrī puroktā śaṃbhunā kila | āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vadārthaṃ tattvataḥ purā || 3.15 || yugarūpeṇa sā paścāccaturdhā viniyojitā | madaprajñānusāreṇa narāṇāṃ tu maharṣibhiḥ || 3.16 || ārādhya paśubhartāraṃ mayā pūrvaṃ maheśvaram | purāṇaṃ śrutametaddhi tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || 3.17 || yacchrutvā mucyate jantuḥ sarvapāpairnareśvara | mānasaiḥ karmajaiścaiva saptajanmasu saṃcitaiḥ || 3.18 || saptakalpakṣayā ghorā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ punaḥpunaḥ | prasādāddevadevasya viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ || 3.19 || dvādaśādityanirdagdhe jagatyekārṇavīkṛte | śrānto'haṃ vibhramaṃstatra taranbāhubhirarṇavam || 3.20 || athāhaṃ salile rājannādityasamarūpiṇam | purā puruṣamadrākṣamanādinidhanaṃ prabhum || 3.21 || śṛṅgaṃ caivādrirājasya bhāsayantaṃ diśo daśa | dvitīyo'nyo manurdṛṣṭaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || 3.22 || agādhe bhramate so'pi tamobhūte mahārṇave | aviśramanmuhūrtaṃ tu cakrārūḍha iva bhraman || 3.23 || athāhaṃ bhayādudvignastaranbāhubhirarṇavam | tatrastho'haṃ mahāmatsyamapaśyaṃ madasaṃyutam || 3.24 || tato'bravītsa māṃ dṛṣṭvā ehyehīti ca bhārata | paraṃ pradhānaḥ sarveṣāṃ matsyarūpo maheśvaraḥ || 3.25 || tato'haṃ tvarayā gatvā tanmukhe manujeśvara | suśrānto vigatajñānaḥ paraṃ nirvedamāgataḥ || 3.26 || tato'drākṣaṃ samudrānte mahadāvartasaṃkulām | udyattaraṃgasalilāṃ phenapuñjāṭṭahāsinīm || 3.27 || nadīṃ kāmagamāṃ puṇyāṃ jhaṣamīnasamākulām | nadyāstasyāstu madhyasthā pramadā kāmarūpiṇī || 3.28 || nīlotpaladalaśyāmā mahatprakṣobhavāhinī | divyahāṭakacitrāṅgī kanakojjvalaśobhitā || 3.29 || dvābhyāṃ saṃgṛhya jānubhyāṃ mahatpotaṃ vyavasthitā | tāṃ manuḥ pratyuvācedaṃ kā tvaṃ divyavarāṅgane || 3.30 || tiṣṭhase kena kāryeṇa tvamatra surasundari | surāsuragaṇe naṣṭe bhramase līlayārṇave || 3.31 || saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ kṣayaṃ prāptā hyanekaśaḥ | tvamekā tu kathaṃ sādhvi tiṣṭhase kāraṇaṃ mahat | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ devi kathayasva hyaśeṣataḥ || 3.32 || abalovāca īśvarāṅgasamudbhūtā hyamṛtānāma viśrutā | saritpāpaharā puṇyā māmāśritya bhayaṃ kutaḥ || 3.33 || sāhaṃ potamimaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītvā hyāgatā dvija | na hyasya potasya kṣayo yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ || 3.34 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ | manunā saha rājendra potārūḍho hyahaṃ tadā || 3.35 || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā vibhum | vyāpinaṃ parameśānamastauṣamabhayapradam || 3.36 || sadyojātāya devāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ | bhave bhave namastubhyaṃ bhaktigamyāya te namaḥ || 3.37 || bhūrbhuvāya namastubhyaṃ rāmajyeṣṭhāya vai namaḥ | namaste bhadrakālāya kalirūpāya vai namaḥ || 3.38 || acintyāvyaktarūpāya mahādevāya dhāmane | vidmahe devadevāya tanno rudra namonamaḥ || 3.39 || jagatsṛṣṭivināśānāṃ kāraṇāya namonamaḥ | evaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭayā mayānagha || 3.40 || prasanno māvadatpaścādvaraṃ varaya suvrata || 3.41 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyadharmarājasaṃvāde kalpakṣaye mārkaṇḍeyakṛtapotārdhārohaṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.4>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato'rṇavātsamuttīrya trikūṭaśikhare sthitam | mahākanakavarṇābhe nānāvarṇaśilācite || 4.1 || mahāśṛṅge samāsīnaṃ rudrakoṭisamanvitam | mahādevaṃ mahātmānamīśānamajamavyayam || 4.2 || sarvabhūtamayaṃ tāta manunā saha suvrata | bhūyo vavande caraṇau sarvadevanamaskṛtau || 4.3 || tatkāle yugasāhasraṃ saha rudreṇa mānada | tasminnekārṇave ghore sthito'haṃ kurunaṃdana || 4.4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca etacchrutvā tu me tāta paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hṛdi | jātaṃ tatkathayasveti śṛṇvataḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ || 4.5 || kā sā padmapalāśākṣī tamobhūte mahārṇave | yogivadbhramate nityaṃ rudrajāṃ svāṃ ca yābravīt || 4.6 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca etameva mayā praśnaṃ purā pṛṣṭo manuḥ svayam | tadeva te'dya vakṣyāmi abalāyāḥ samudbhavam || 4.7 || vyatītāyāṃ niśāyāṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | tataḥ prabhāte vimale sṛjyamāneṣu jantuṣu || 4.8 || manuṃ praṇamya śirasā pṛcchāmyetadyudhiṣṭhira | keyaṃ padmapalāśākṣī śyāmā caṃdranibhānanā || 4.9 || ekārṇave bhramatyekā rudrajāsmīti vādinī | sāvitrī vedamātā ca hyathavā sā sarasvatī || 4.10 || mandākinī saricchreṣṭhā lakṣmīrvā kimatho umā | kālarātrirbhavetsākṣātprakṛtirvā sukhocitā || 4.11 || etadācakṣva bhagavankā sā hyamṛtasaṃbhavā | caratyekārṇave ghore pranaṣṭoragarākṣase || 4.12 || manuruvāca śṛṇu vatsa yathānyāyamasyā vakṣyāmi saṃbhavam | yayā rudrasamudbhūtā yā ceyaṃ varavarṇinī || 4.13 || purā śivaḥ śāntatanuścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāmumayā saha śaṃkaraḥ || 4.14 || ṛkṣaśailaṃ samāruhya tapastepe sudāruṇam | adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtātmako vaśī || 4.15 || tapatastasya devasya svedaḥ samabhavatkila | taṃ giriṃ plāvayāmāsa sa svedo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ || 4.16 || tasmādāsītsamudbhūtā mahāpuṇyā saridvarā | yā sā tvayārṇave dṛṣṭā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā || 4.17 || strīrūpaṃ samavasthāya rudramārādhayatpurā | ādye kṛtayuge tasminsamānāmayutaṃ nṛpa || 4.18 || tatastuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṃkaraḥ | brūhi tvaṃ tu mahābhāge yatte manasi vartate || 4.19 || sariduvāca pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame | prasādāttava deveśa akṣayāhaṃ bhave prabho || 4.20 || saritsu sāgareṣveva parvateṣu kṣayiṣvapi | tava prasādāddeveśa puṇyā kṣayyā bhave prabho || 4.21 || pāpopapātakairyuktā mahāpātakino'pi ye | mucyante sarvapāpebhyo bhaktyā snātvā tu śaṃkara || 4.22 || uttare jāhnavīdeśe mahāpātakanāśinī | bhavāmi dakṣiṇe mārge yadyevaṃ surapūjitā || 4.23 || svargādāgamya gaṃgeti yathā khyātā kṣitau vibho | tathā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhaveyaṃ tridaśeśvara || 4.24 || pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā yallabhate phalam | tatphalaṃ labhate martyo bhaktyā snātvā maheśvara || 4.25 || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yadāste saṃcitaṃ kvacit | māsamātreṇa taddeva kṣayaṃ yātvavagāhanāt || 4.26 || yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvayajñeṣu śaṃkara | avagāhena tatsarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama || 4.27 || sarvadānopavāseṣu sarvatīrthāvagāhane | tatphalaṃ mama toyena jāyatāmiti śaṃkara || 4.28 || mama tīre narā ye tu arcayanti maheśvaram | te gatāstava lokaṃ syuretadeva bhavecchiva || 4.29 || mama kūle maheśāna umayā saha daivataiḥ | vasa nityaṃ jagannātha eṣa eva varo mama || 4.30 || sukarmā vā vikarmā vā śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ | mṛto janturmama jale gacchatādamarāvatīm || 4.31 || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī | bhavāmi devadeveśa prasanno yadi manyase || 4.32 || etāṃścānyānvarāndivyānprārthito nṛpasattama | narmadayā tataḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 4.33 || śrīmaheśa uvāca evaṃ bhavatu kalyāṇi yattvayoktamanindite | nānyā varārhā lokeṣu muktvā tvāṃ kamalekṣaṇe || 4.34 || yadaiva mama dehāttvaṃ samudbhūtā varānane | tadaiva sarvapāpānāṃ mocinī tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 4.35 || kalpakṣayakare kāle kāle ghore viśeṣataḥ | uttaraṃ kūlamāśritya nivasanti ca ye narāḥ || 4.36 || api kīṭapataṅgāśca vṛkṣagulmalatādayaḥ | ā dehapatanāddevi te'pi yāsyanti sadgatim || 4.37 || dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamāśritya ye dvijā dharmavatsalāḥ | ā mṛtyornivasiṣyanti te gatāḥ pitṛmandire || 4.38 || ahaṃ hi tava vākyena kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare | tvattīre nivasiṣyāmi sadaiva hyumayā samam || 4.39 || evaṃ devi mahādevi evameva na saṃśayaḥ | brahmendracandravaruṇaiḥ sādhyaiśca saha viṣṇunā || 4.40 || uttare devi te kūle vasiṣyanti mamājñayā | dakṣiṇe pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tathānye surasundari || 4.41 || vasiṣyanti mayā sārddhameṣa te vara uttamaḥ | gaccha gaccha mahābhāge martyānpāpādvimocaya || 4.42 || sahitā ṛṣisaṃghaiśca tathā siddhasurāsuraiḥ | evamuktā mahādeva umayā sahito vibhuḥ || 4.43 || vandyamāno'tha manunā mayā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ | tena caiṣā mahāpuṇyā mahāpātakanāśinī || 4.44 || kathitā pṛcchyate yā te mā te bhavatu vismayaḥ | eṣā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā || 4.45 || daśābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ srotaiḥ plāvayantī diśo daśa | śoṇo mahānadaścaiva narmadā surasā kṛtā || 4.46 || mandākinī daśārṇā ca citrakūṭā tathaiva ca | tamasā vidiśā caiva karabhā yamunā tathā || 4.47 || citrotpalā vipāśā ca rañjanā vāluvāhinī | ṛkṣapādaprasūtāstāḥ sarvā vai rudrasaṃbhavāḥ || 4.48 || sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvamaṃgaladāḥ śivāḥ | ityetairnāmabhirdivyaiḥ stūyate vedapāragaiḥ || 4.49 || purāṇajñairmahābhāgairājyapaiḥ somapaistathā | ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ narottama || 4.50 || manunoktaṃ purā mahyamamṛtāyāḥ samudbhavam | puṇyaṃ pavitramatulaṃ rudrodgītamidaṃ śubham || 4.51 || ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti bhaktyā śṛṇvanti ye'pi ca | prātarutthāya nāmāni daśa pañca ca bhārata || 4.52 || te narāḥ sakalaṃ puṇyaṃ labhiṣyantyavagāhajam | vimānenārkavarṇena ghaṇṭāśataninādinā || 4.53 || tyaktvā mānuṣyakaṃ bhāvaṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim || 4.54 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāpañcadaśanāmavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.5>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryametadakhilaṃ kathitaṃ bho dvijottama | vismayaṃ paramāpannā ṛṣisaṃghā mayā saha || 5.1 || aho bhagavatī puṇyā narmadeyamayonijā | rudradehādviniṣkrāntā mahāpāpakṣayaṃkarī || 5.2 || saptakalpakṣaye prāpte tvayeyaṃ saha suvrata | na mṛtā ca mahābhāgā kimataḥ puṇyamuttamam || 5.3 || ke te kalpāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ sapta kalpakṣayaṃkarāḥ | na mṛtā cediyaṃ devī tvaṃ caiva ṛṣipuṃgava || 5.4 || apakṣigaṇasaṃghāte jagatyekārṇavīkṛte | kīdṛgrūpaḥ samabhavanmahādevo yugakṣaye || 5.5 || kathaṃ saṃharate viśvaṃ kathaṃ cāste mahārṇave | kathaṃ ca sṛjate viśvaṃ kathaṃ dhārayate prajāḥ || 5.6 || kīdṛgrūpā bhaveddevī saridekārṇavīkṛte | kimarthaṃ narmadā proktā revatī ca kathaṃ smṛtā || 5.7 || añjaneti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ suraseti ca | mandākinī kimarthaṃ ca śoṇaśceti kathaṃ bhavet || 5.8 || trikūṭeti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ vāluvāhinī | koṭikoṭyo hi tīrthānāṃ praviṣṭā yā mahārṇavam || 5.9 || kiyatyaḥ saritāṃ koṭyo narmadāṃ samupāsate | yajñopavītairṛṣibhirdevatābhistathaiva ca || 5.10 || vibhakteyaṃ kimarthaṃ ca śrūyate munisattama | vaiṣṇavīti purāṇajñaiḥ kimarthamiha cocyate || 5.11 || keṣu sthāneṣu tīrtheṣu pūjanīyā saridvarā | tīrthāni ca pṛthagbrūhi yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || 5.12 || yatpramāṇā ca sā devī yā rudreṇa vinirmitā | kīdṛśāni ca karmāṇi rudreṇa kathitāni te || 5.13 || kathaṃ mlecchasamākīrṇo deśo'yaṃ dvijasattama | etadācakṣva māṃ brahmanmārkaṇḍeya mahāmate || 5.14 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tvaṃ ca tāta yudhiṣṭhira | purāṇaṃ narmadāyāṃ tu kathitaṃ ca triśūlinā || 5.15 || vāyoḥ sakāśācca mayā tenāpi ca maheśvarāt | aśakyatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ saṃkṣiptamṛṣibhiḥ purā || 5.16 || māyūraṃ prathamaṃ tāta kaurmyaṃ ca tadanantaram | puraṃ tathā kauśikaṃ ca mātsyaṃ dviradameva ca || 5.17 || vārāhaṃ yanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ param | nyagrodhākhyamataḥ cāsīdākāṅkṣaṃ punaruttamam || 5.18 || padmaṃ ca tāmasaṃ caiva saṃvartodvartameva ca | mahāpralayamityāhuḥ purāṇe vedacintakāḥ || 5.19 || etatsaṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ tairmahātmabhiḥ | vibhaktaṃ ca caturbhāgairbrahmādyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 5.20 || tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi purāṇārthaviśārada | sapta kalpā mahāghorā yairiyaṃ na mṛtā sarit || 5.21 || ā jaṅgamaṃ tamobhūtamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam | naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇamāsīdbhūtavivarjitam || 5.22 || tamaso'to mahānāmnā puruṣaḥ sa jagadguruḥ | cacāra tasminnekākī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ || 5.23 || sa cauṃkāramayo'tīto gāyatrīmasṛjaddvijaḥ | sa tayā sārddhamīśānaścikrīḍa puruṣo virāṭ || 5.24 || svadehādasṛjadviśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam | krīḍansamasṛjadviśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam || 5.25 || krīḍan sṛjadvirāṭsaṃjñaḥ sabījaṃ ca hiraṇmayam | taccāṇḍamabhavaddivyaṃ dvādaśādityasannibham || 5.26 || tadbhittvā puruṣo jajñe caturvaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ | so'sṛjadviśvamevaṃ tu sadevāsuramānuṣam || 5.27 || satiryakpaśupakṣīkaṃ svedāṇḍajajarāyujam | etadaṇḍaṃ purāṇeṣu prathamaṃ parikīrtitam || 5.28 || pūrvakalpe nṛpaśreṣṭha krīḍantyā parameṣṭhinā | umayā saha rudrasya krīḍataścārṇavīkṛtaḥ || 5.29 || harṣājjajñe śubhā kanyā umāyāḥ svedasaṃbhavā | śarvasyoraḥsthalājjajñe umā kucavimardanāt || 5.30 || svedādvijajñe mahatī kanyā rājīvalocanā | dvitīyaḥ saṃbhavo yasyā rudradehādyudhiṣṭhira || 5.31 || sā paribhramate lokān sadevāsuramānavān | trailokyonmādajananī rūpeṇa'pratimā tadā || 5.32 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadaityendrā mohitā labhate katham | mṛgayanti sma tāṃ kanyāmitaścetaśca bhārata || 5.33 || hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca mohayatyakhilaṃ jagat | bhramate divyarūpā sā vidyutsaudāminī yathā || 5.34 || meghamadhye sthitā bhābhiḥ sarvayoṣidanuttamā | tato rudraṃ surāḥ sarve daityāśca saha dānavaiḥ || 5.35 || varayanti sma tāṃ kanyāṃ kāmenākulitā bhṛśam | tato'bravīnmahādevo devadānavayordvayoḥ || 5.36 || balena tejasā caiva hyadhiko yo bhaviṣyati | sa imāṃ prāpsyate kanyāṃ nānyathā vai surottamāḥ || 5.37 || tato devāsurāḥ sarve kanyāṃ vai samupāgaman | ahamenāṃ grahīṣyāmi ahamenāmiti bruvan || 5.38 || paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ sā kanyāntaradhīyata | punastāṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve yojanāntaradhiṣṭhitām || 5.39 || jagmuste tvaritāḥ sarve yatra sā samadṛśyata | tribhiścaturbhiśca tathā yojanairdaśabhiḥ punaḥ || 5.40 || dhiṣṭhitāṃ samapaśyaṃste sarve mātaṃgagāminīm | yojanānāṃ śatairbhūyaḥ sahasraiścāpyadhiṣṭhitām || 5.41 || tathā śatasahasreṇa laghutvātsamadṛśyata | agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 5.42 || tāṃ paśyanti varārohāmekadhā bahudhā punaḥ | divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu bhrāmitāste tayā purā || 5.43 || na cāvāptā tu sā kanyā mahādevāṅgasaṃbhavā | sahomayā tato devo jahāsoccaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 5.44 || gaṇāstālakasaṃpātairnṛtyanti ca mudānvitāḥ | akasmāddṛśyate kanyā śaṃkarasya samīpagā || 5.45 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpannā devā yānti parāṅmukhāḥ | tasyāścakre tato nāma svayameva pinākadhṛk || 5.46 || narma caibhyo dade yasmāttatkṛtaiśceṣṭitaiḥ pṛthak | bhaviṣyasi varārohe saricchreṣṭhā tu narmadā || 5.47 || svarūpamāsthito devaḥ prāpa hāsyaṃ yato bhuvi | narmadā tena cokteyaṃ suśītalajalā śivā || 5.48 || saptakalpakṣaye jāte yaduktaṃ śaṃbhunā purā | na mṛtā tena rājendra narmadā khyātimāgatā || 5.49 || tatastāmadadātkanyāṃ śīlavatīṃ suśobhanām | mahārṇavāya deveśaḥ sarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 5.50 || tataḥ sā ṛkṣaśailendrātphenapuñjāṭṭahāsinī | viveśa narmadā devī samudraṃ saritāṃ patim || 5.51 || evaṃ brāhme purā kalpe samudbhūteyamīśvarāt | mātsye kalpe mayā dṛṣṭā samākhyātā mayā śṛṇu || 5.52 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.6>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca punaryugānte samprāpte tṛtīye nṛpasattama | dādaśārkavapurbhūtvā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ || 6.1 || saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ saśailavanakānanām | nirdagdhāṃ tu mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ || 6.2 || tato mahāghano bhūtvā plāvayāmāsa vāriṇā | kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇavapustvenāṃ vidyuccandrāyudhāṅkitām || 6.3 || plāvayitvā jagatsarvaṃ tasminnekārṇavīkṛte | suṣvāpa vimale toye jagatsaṃkṣipya māyayā || 6.4 || tato'haṃ bhramamāstu tamobhūte mahārṇave | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhūte maheśvare || 6.5 || oṃkṛtvā devadeveśaṃ yenedaṃ gahanīkṛtam | dhyāyamānastato devaṃ rājendra vimale jale || 6.6 || tasminmahārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame | mayūraṃ svarṇapatrāḍhyamapaśyaṃsahasā jale | vicitracandrakopetaṃ nīlakaṃṭhaṃ sulocanam || 6.7 || tato mayūraḥ sa mahārṇavānte vikṣobhayitvā hi mahāsveṇa | cacāra devastriśikhī śikhaṇḍī trailokyagoptā sa mahānubhāvaḥ || 6.8 || śivaśca raudreṇa mayūrarūpiṇā vikṣobhyamāṇe salile'pi tasmin | saha bhramantīṃ ca mahārṇavānte sarinmahaughāṃ sumahāndadarśa || 6.9 || sa tāṃ mahādevamayūrarūpo dṛṣṭvā bhramantīṃ sahasormijālaiḥ | kā tvaṃ śubhe śāśvatadehabhūtā kṣayaṃ na yātāsi mahākṣayānte || 6.10 || devāsuragaṇe naṣṭe saritsaramahārṇave | kā tvaṃ bhramasi padmākṣi kva gatāsi ca na kṣayam || 6.11 || narmadovāca tava prasādāddeveśa mṛtyurmama na vidyate | sṛja deva punarviśvaṃ śarvarī kṣayamāgatā || 6.12 || evamukto mahādevo vyadhunotpakṣapañjaram | tāvatpañjaramadhyānte tasya pakṣādviniḥsṛtāḥ || 6.13 || tāvanto devadaityendrāḥ pakṣābhyāṃ tasya jajñire | teṣāṃ madhye punaḥ sā tu narmadā bhramate sarit || 6.14 || tataścānyo mahāśailo dṛśyate bharatarṣabha | tribhiḥ kūṭaiḥ suvistīrṇaiḥ śṛṅgavāniva govṛṣaḥ || 6.15 || trikūṭastu iti khyātaḥ sarvaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ | tatastasmāttrikūṭācca plāvayantī mahīṃ yayau || 6.16 || trikūṭī tena vikhyātā pitḥṇāṃ trāyaṇī parā | dvitīyācca tato gaṅgā vistīrṇā dharaṇītale || 6.17 || tṛtīyaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṅgaṃ saptadhā khaṇḍaśo gatam | jambūdvīpe tu saṃjātāḥ sapta te kulaparvatāḥ || 6.18 || candranakṣatrasahitā grahagrāmanadīnadāḥ | aṇḍajaṃ svedajaṃ jātamudbhijjaṃ ca jarāyujam || 6.19 || evaṃ jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ mayūrādabhavatpurā | samastaṃ naraśārdūla mahādevasamudbhavam || 6.20 || tato nadīḥ samudrāṃśca saṃvibhajya pṛthakpṛthak | narmadāmāha deveśo gaccha tvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 6.21 || evaṃ sā dakṣiṇā gaṃgā mahāpātakanāśinī | uttare jāhnavī deśe puṇyā tvaṃ dakṣiṇe śubhā || 6.22 || yathā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā mama mastakasaṃbhavā | tadviśiṣṭā mahābhāge tvaṃ caiveti na saṃśayaḥ || 6.23 || tvayā saha bhaviṣyāmi ekenāṃśena suvrate | mahāpātakayuktānāmauṣadhaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 6.24 || evamuktā tu devena mahāpātakanāśinī | dakṣiṇaṃ digvibhāgaṃ tu sā jagāmāśu vikramā || 6.25 || ṛkṣaśailendramāsādya candramauleranugrahāt | vāryaughaiḥ prasthitā yasmānmahādevapraṇoditā || 6.26 || mahatā cāpi vegena yasmādeṣā samucchritā | mahatī tena sā proktā mahādevānmahīpate || 6.27 || tapatastasya devasya śūlāgrādbindavo'patan | tenaiṣā śoṇasaṃjñā tu daśa sapta ca tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 6.28 || sarveṣāṃ narmadā puṇyā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā | sarvābhyaśca saridbhyaśca varadānānmahātmanaḥ || 6.29 || śaṃkarānuprahāddevī mahāpātakanāśinī | yasmānmahārṇave ghore dṛśyate mahatī ca sā || 6.30 || suvyaktāṅgī mahākāyā mahatī tena sā smṛtā | tasmādvikṣobhyamāṇā hi diggajairambudopamaiḥ || 6.31 || kaluṣatvaṃ nayatyeva rasena surasā tathā | kṛpāṃ karoti sā yasmāllokānāmabhayapradā || 6.32 || saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ tena caiṣā kṛpā smṛtā | purā kṛtayuge puṇye divyamandārabhūṣitā || 6.33 || kalpavṛkṣasamākīrṇā rohītakasamākulā | vahatyeṣā ca mandena tena mandākinī smṛtā || 6.34 || bhittvā mahārṇavaṃ kṣipraṃ yasmāllokamihāgatā | pūjyā suraiśca siddhaiśca tasmādeṣā mahārṇavā || 6.35 || vicitrotpalasaṃghātairṛkṣadvipasamākulā || 6.36 || bhittvā śailaṃ ca vipulaṃ prayātyevaṃ mahārṇavam | bhrāmayantī diśaḥ sarvā raveṇa mahatā purā || 6.37 || plāvayantī virājantī tena revā iti smṛtā | bhāryāputrasuduḥkhāḍhyānnarāñchāpaiḥ samāvṛtān || 6.38 || vipāpānkurute yasmādvipāpā tena sā smṛtā | viṇmūtranicayāṃ ghorāṃ pāṃśuśoṇitakardamām || 6.39 || pāśairnityaṃ tu sambādhāṃ yasmānmocayate bhṛśam | vipāśeti ca sā proktā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī || 6.40 || narmadā vimalāmbhā ca vimalenduśubhānanā | tamobhūte mahāghore yasmādeṣā mahāprabhā || 6.41 || vimalā tena sā proktā vidvadbhirnṛpasattama | karairindukaraprakhyaiḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhā || 6.42 || kṣarantī modate viśvaṃ karabhā tena cocyate | yasmādrañjayate lokāndarśanādeva bhārata || 6.43 || rañjanādrañjanā proktā dhātvarthe rājasattama | tṛṇavīrudhagulmādyāstiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā | tānudbhūtānnayetsvargaṃ tenoktā vāyuvāhinī || 6.44 || evaṃ yo vetti nāmāni nirgamaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | sa yāti pāpavirmukto rudralokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 6.45 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sahaitukarevānāmamāhātmyavarṇane mayūrakalpasamudbhavo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.7>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca punarekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame | salilenāplute loke nirāloke tamodbhave || 7.1 || brahmaiko vicaraṃstatra tamībhūte mahārṇave | divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu khadyota iva rūpavān || 7.2 || śete yojanasāhasramaprameyamanuttamam | dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇam || 7.3 || prasuptaṃ cārṇave ghore hyapaśyatkūrmarūpiṇam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpanno brahmā bodhayate śanaiḥ || 7.4 || stutibhirmaṃgalaiścaiva vedavedāṃgasaṃbhavaiḥ | vācaspate vibudhyasva mahābhūta namo'stu te || 7.5 || tavodare jagatsarvaṃ tiṣṭhate parameśvara | tadvimuñca mahāsattva yatpūrvaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ tvayā || 7.6 || vyatītā rajanī brāhmī dinaṃ samanuvartate | nirīkṣya sarvalokeśa yena saṃbhavate jagat || 7.7 || sa niśamya vacastasya utthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | samudgiran sa lokāṃstrīn grastān kalpakṣaye tadā || 7.8 || devadānavagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | sacandrārkagrahāḥ sarve śarīrāttasya nirgatāḥ || 7.9 || tato hyekārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ vibhajya parameśvaraḥ | vistīrṇopalatoyaughāṃ saritsaravivardhitām || 7.10 || paśyate medinīṃ devaḥ savṛkṣauṣadhipalvalām | himavantaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ parvatamuttamam || 7.11 || śṛṅgavantaṃ mahāśailaṃ ye cānye kulaparvatāḥ | jaṃbudvīpaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ sagomedaṃ saśālmalam || 7.12 || puṣkarāntāśca ye dvīpā ye ca saptamahārṇavāḥ | lokālokaṃ mahāśailaṃ sarvaṃ ca purataḥ sthitam || 7.13 || catuḥprakṛtisaṃyuktaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam | yugānte tu viniṣkrāntamapaśyatsa maheśvaraḥ || 7.14 || viprakīrṇaśilājālāmapaśyatsa vasuṃdharām | kūrmapṛṣṭhopagāṃ devīṃ mahārṇavagatāṃ prabhuḥ || 7.15 || tasmin viśīrṇaśailāgre saritsarovivarjite | nānātaraṃgabhinnoda āvartodvartasaṃkule || 7.16 || nānauṣadhiprajvalite nānotpalaśilātale | nānāvihaṃgasaṃghuṣṭāṃ matsyakūrmasamākulām || 7.17 || divyamāyāmayīṃ devīmutkṛṣṭāmbudasannibhām | nadīmapaśyaddeveśo hyanaupamyajalāśayām || 7.18 || madhye tasyāmbudaśyāmāṃ pīnorujaghanastanīm | vastrairanupamairdivyairnānābharaṇabhūṣitām || 7.19 || sanūpuraravoddāmāṃ hārakeyūramaṇḍitām | tādṛśīṃ narmadāṃ devīṃ svayaṃ strīrūpadhāriṇīm || 7.20 || yogamāyāmayaiścitrairbhūṣaṇaiḥ svairvibhūṣitām | avyaktāṅgīṃ mahābhāgāmapaśyatsa tu narmadām || 7.21 || ardhodyatabhujāṃ bālāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇām | stuvantīṃ devadeveśamutthitāṃ tu jalāttadā || 7.22 || vismayāviṣṭahṛdayo hyahamudvīkṣya tāṃ śubhām | snātvā jale śubhe tasyāḥ stotumabhyudyatastataḥ || 7.23 || arcayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo mantrairvedāṃgasaṃbhavaiḥ | sṛṣṭaṃ ca tatpurā rājanpaśyeyaṃ sacarācaram || 7.24 || sadevāsuragandharvaṃ sapannagamahoragam | paśyāmyeṣā mahābhāgā naiva yātā kṣayaṃ purā || 7.25 || mahādevaprasādācca taccharīrasamudbhavā | bhūyo bhūyo mayā dṛṣṭā kathitā te nṛpottama || 7.26 || prādurbhāvamimaṃ kaurmyaṃ ye'dhīyante dvijottamāḥ | ye'pi śṛṇvanti vidvāṃso mucyante te'pi kilbiṣaiḥ || 7.27 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kūrmakalpasamudbhavo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.8>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca naṣṭe loke punaścānye salilena samāvṛte | mahārṇavasya madhyastho bāhubhyāmataraṃ jalam || 8.1 || divye varṣaśate pūrṇe śrānto'haṃ nṛpasattama | dhyātuṃ samārabhaṃ devaṃ mahadarṇavatāraṇam || 8.2 || dhyāyamānastataḥ kāle apaśyaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ param | hārakundendusaṃkāśaṃ bakaṃ gokṣīrapāṇḍuram || 8.3 || tato'haṃ vismayāviṣṭastaṃ bakaṃ samudīkṣya vai | asminmahārṇave ghore kuto'yaṃ pakṣisaṃbhavaḥ || 8.4 || taranbāhubhiraśrāntastaṃ bakaṃ pratyabhāṣiṣi | pākṣarūpaṃ samāsthāya kastvamekārṇavīkṛte || 8.5 || bhramase divyayogātmanmohayanniva māṃ prabho | etatkathaya me sarvaṃ yo'si so'si namo'stu te || 8.6 || so'bravīnmāṃ mahādevo brahmāhaṃ viṣṇureva ca | jagatsarvaṃ mayā vatsa saṃhṛtaṃ kiṃ na budhyase || 8.7 || tava mātā pitāhaṃ vai viśvasya ca mahāmune | kāruṇyaṃ mama saṃjātaṃ dṛṣṭvā magnaṃ mahārṇave || 8.8 || pakṣirūpaṃ samāsthāya ato'trāhaṃ samāgataḥ | kimarthamāturo bhūtvā bhramasītthaṃ mahārṇave || 8.9 || śīghraṃ praviśa matpakṣau yena viśramase dvija | evamuktastatastena devenāhaṃ nareśvara || 8.10 || tato'haṃ tasya pakṣānte pralīnastu bhramañjale | kāle yugasāhasrānte aśrānto'rṇavamadhyagaḥ || 8.11 || tataḥ śṛṇomi sahasā dikṣu sarvāsu suvrata | kiṃcinnūpurasaṃmiśramadbhutaṃ śabdamuttamam || 8.12 || tadārṇavajalaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ sahasābhavat | kimetaditi saṃcintya diśaḥ samavalokayam || 8.13 || daśa kanyāstato dikṣu āgatāśca mahārṇave | vastrālaṃkārasahitā digbhyo nūpurabhūṣitāḥ || 8.14 || kāciccandrasamābhāsā kācidādityasaprabhā | kācidaṃjanapuñjābhā kācidraktotpalaprabhā || 8.15 || nānārūpadharā saumyā nānābharaṇabhūṣitā | arghyapādyādibhirmālyairbakamabhyarcya suvratāḥ || 8.16 || tatastaṃ parvatākāraṃ guhyaṃ pakṣiṇamavyayam | praviveśa mahāghoraṃ parvato hyarṇavaṃ svarāṭ || 8.17 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi tāvantyeva śatāni ca | triṃśadyojanasāhasraṃ yāvadbhūmaṇḍalaṃ tviti || 8.18 || tato bhūmaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ pañcaratnasamākulam | divyasphaṭikasopānaṃ rukmastaṃbhamanoramam || 8.19 || yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu vistarāddviguṇāyatam | vāpīkūpasamākīrṇaṃ prāsādāṭṭālakāvṛtam || 8.20 || kalpavṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ dhvajaṣaṣṭivibhūṣitam | tasminpuravare ramye nānāratnopaśobhitam || 8.21 || tathānyacca puraṃ ramyaṃ patākojjvalavedikam | śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ tāvaddviguṇamāyatam || 8.22 || puramadhye tatastasminnadī paramaśobhanā | mahatī puṇyasalilā nānāratnaśilā tathā || 8.23 || tasyāstīre mayā dṛṣṭaṃ taḍitsūryasamaprabham | indranīlamahānīlaiścitaṃ ratnaiḥ samantataḥ || 8.24 || kvacidvahnisamākāraṃ kvacidindrāyudhaprabham | kvaciddhūmraṃ kvacitpītaṃ kvacidraktaṃ kvacitsitam || 8.25 || nānāvarṇaiḥ samāyuktaṃ liṅgamadbhutadarśanam | brahmaviṣṇvindrasādhyaiśca samantātparivāritam || 8.26 || nandīśvaragaṇādhyakṣaiścendrādityaiśca tadvṛtam | paśyāmi liṅgamīśānaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ tameva ca || 8.27 || parivārya tatastaṃ tu prasuptāndevadānavān | nimīlitākṣānpaśyāmi divyābharaṇabhūṣitān || 8.28 || tatastāḥ padmapatrākṣyo nāryaḥ paramasaṃmatāḥ | nadyāstasyā jale snātvā divyapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ || 8.29 || dattvārghapādyaṃ vidhivalliṃgasya saha pakṣiṇā | arcayantīrvarārohā daśa tāḥ pramadottamāḥ || 8.30 || tatastvabhyarcya talliṅgaṃ tasminneva purottame | sarvā adarśanaṃ jagmurvidyuto'bhragaṇeṣviva || 8.31 || na cāsau pakṣirāṭtasminna striyo na ca devatāḥ | tadevaikaṃ sthitaṃ liṅgamarcayanvismayānvitaḥ || 8.32 || tato'haṃ duḥkhamūḍhātmā rudramāyeti cintayan | tataḥ kanyāḥ samuttīrya divyāṃbaravibhūṣaṇāḥ || 8.33 || bhāsayantyo jagatsarvaṃ vidyuto'bhragaṇāniva | padmairhiraṇmayairdivyairarcayitvā śubhānanāḥ || 8.34 || viviśustajjalaṃ kṣipraṃ samaṃtādvarabhūṣaṇāḥ | tasminpuravare cānye tāmevāhaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 8.35 || paśyāmi hyamarāṃ kanyāmarcayantīṃ maheśvaram | tato'haṃ tāṃ varārohāmapṛcchaṃ kamalekṣaṇām || 8.36 || kā tvamasminpure devi vasase śivamarcatī | tāścāgatāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ kva gatāste gaṇeśvarāḥ || 8.37 || namo'stu te mahābhāge brūhi puṇye maheśvari | tava prasādādvijñātumetadicchāmi suvrate | dayāṃ kṛtvā mahādevi kathayasva mamānaghe || 8.38 || śryuvāca vismṛtāhaṃ kathaṃ vipra dṛṣṭvā kalpe purātane | mā te'bhūtsmṛtivibhraṃśaḥ sā cāhaṃ kalpavāhinī || 8.39 || narmadā nāma vikhyātā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā | yāstāḥ kanyāstvayā dṛṣṭā hyarcayantyo maheśvaram || 8.40 || yābhistviha samānītaḥ pakṣirājasamanvitāḥ | diśastā viddhi sarveśāḥ sarvāstvaṃ munisattama || 8.41 || tiryakpakṣisvarūpeṇa mahāyogī maheśvaraḥ | ebhiḥ śivapurādvipra ānītaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || 8.42 || saiṣa devo mahādevo liṅgamūrtirvyavasthitaḥ | arcyate brahmaviṣṇvindraiḥ surāsurajagadguruḥ || 8.43 || layamāyāti yasmāddhi jagatsarvaṃ carācaram | tena liṅgamiti proktaṃ purāṇajñairmaharṣibhiḥ || 8.44 || tena devagaṇāḥ sarve saṃkṣiptā māyayā purā | pralīnāścaiva lokeśa na dṛśyante hi sāṃpratam || 8.45 || punardṛśyā bhaviṣyanti sṛjamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā | sāhaṃ liṅgārcanaparā narmadā nāma nāmataḥ || 8.46 || kālaṃ yugasahasrasya rudrasya paricārikā | asya prasādādamarastathā tvaṃ dvijapuṃgava || 8.47 || satyārjavadayāyuktaḥ siddho'si tvaṃ śivārcanāt | evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata || 8.48 || tāḥ striyaḥ sa ca deveśo bakarūpo maheśvaraḥ | tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā avatīrya mahānadīm || 8.49 || snātvā samarcaya tvaṃ hi vidhinā mantrapūrvakam | tato'haṃ sahasā tasmātsamuttīrya jalāśayāt || 8.50 || na ca paśyāmi talliṅgaṃ na ca tāṃ nimnagāṃ nṛpa | tadaiva lokāḥ saṃjātāḥ kṣitiścaiva sakānanā || 8.51 || ṛkṣacandrārkavitataṃ tadeva ca nabhastalam | yathāpūrvamadṛṣṭaṃ tu tathaiva ca punaḥ kṛtam | nato'haṃ manasā devamapūjayaṃ maheśvaram || 8.52 || evaṃ bake purā kalpe mayā dṛṣṭeyamavyayā | narmadā martyalokasya mahāpātakanāśinī || 8.53 || tasmāddharmaparairvipraiḥ kṣatraśūdraviśādibhiḥ | sadā sevyā mahābhāgā dharmavṛddhyarthakāribhiḥ || 8.54 || ye'pi bhaktayā sakṛttoye narmadāyā maheśvaram | snātvā te sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayantyasaṃśayam || 8.55 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye bakakalpasamudbhavo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.9>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca punaryugāntaṃ te cānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu | sūryairādīpite loke jaṅgame sthāvare purā || 9.1 || saritsaraḥsamudreṣu kṣayaṃ yāteṣu sarvaśaḥ | nirmānuṣavaṣaṭkāre hyamaryādagatiṃ gate || 9.2 || nānārūpaistato medhaiḥ śakrāyudhavirājitaiḥ | sarvamāpūritaṃ vyoma vāryaughaiḥ pūrite tadā || 9.3 || tatastvekārṇavībhūte sarvataḥ salilāvṛte | jagatkṛtvodare sarvaṃ suṣvāpa bhagavānharaḥ || 9.4 || prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya yogātmā sa prajāpatiḥ | śete yugasahasrāntaṃ kālamāviśya sārṇavam || 9.5 || tatra suptaṃ mahātmānaṃ brahmalokanivāsinaḥ | bhṛgvādiṛṣayaḥ sarve ye cānye sanakādayaḥ || 9.6 || paryaṅke vimale śubhre nānāstaraṇasaṃstṛte | śayānaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ vṛṣadhvajam || 9.7 || viśvarūpā tu sā nārī viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ | gāḍhamāliṅgya suptastāṃ dadṛśe cāhamavyayam || 9.8 || pādamūle tatastasya śyāmāṃ tāṃ padmalakṣaṇām | kanyāṃ paśyāmi suśroṇīṃ caraṇau tasya mṛdgatīm || 9.9 || vimalāmbarasaṃvītāṃ vyālayajñopavītinīm | śyāmāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 9.10 || sakalaṃ yugasāhasraṃ narmadeyaṃ vijānatī | prasuptaṃ devadeveśamupāste varavarṇinī || 9.11 || hṛtairvedaiścaturbhiśca brahmāpyevaṃ maheśvaraḥ | bhṛgvādyairmānasaiḥ putraiḥ stauti śaṅkaramavyayam || 9.12 || bhaktyā paramayā rājaṃstatra śambhumanāmayam | stuvantastatra deveśaṃ mantrairīśvarasambhavaiḥ || 9.13 || prasuptaṃ devamīśānaṃ bodhayansamupasthitaḥ | uttiṣṭha hara piṅgākṣa mahādeva maheśvara || 9.14 || mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve ato'haṃ stotumudyataḥ | vedairvyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ divyādivyaṃ carācaram || 9.15 || atītaṃ vartamānaṃ ca smarāmi ca sṛjāmyaham | tairvinā cāhamekastu mūko'dho jaḍavatsadā || 9.16 || gatirvīryaṃ balotsāhau tairvinā na prajāyate | tairvinā devadeveśa nāhaṃ kiṃcitsmarāmi vai || 9.17 || tānvedāndevadeveśa śīghraṃ me dātumarhasi | jaḍāndhabadhiraṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 9.18 || sthānādi daśa catvāri na śobhante sureśvara | praṇamāmyalpavīryatvādvedahīnaḥ sureśvara || 9.19 || vedebhyaḥ sakalaṃ jātaṃ yatkiṃcitsacarācaram | tāvacchobhanti śāstrāṇi samastāni jagadguro || 9.20 || yāvadvedanidhirayaṃ nopatiṣṭhetsanātanaḥ | yathoditena sūryeṇa tamo yāti vināśatām || 9.21 || evaṃ samastapāpāni yānti vedasya dhāraṇāt | vede rahasi yatsūkṣmaṃ yattadbrahma sanātanam || 9.22 || hṛdisthaṃ deva jānāmi gataṃ tadvedagarjanāt | vedānuccarato me'dya tava śaṅkara cāgrataḥ || 9.23 || akasmātte gatā vedā na sṛjeyaṃ vibho bhuvam | te'pi sarve mahādeva praviṣṭāḥ sammukhārṇavam || 9.24 || te yācyamānā deveśa tiṣṭhantu smaraṇe mama | duhiteyaṃ viśālākṣī sarvaḥ sarvaṃ vijānate || 9.25 || jāyatī yugasāhasraṃ nānyā kācidbhavedṛśī | ṛṣiścāyaṃ mahābhāgo mārkaṇḍo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ || 9.26 || kalpe kalpe mahādeva tvāmayaṃ paryupāsate | jagattrayahitārthāya carate vratamuttamam || 9.27 || evamuktastu deveśo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā narmadāṃ saritāṃ varām || 9.28 || kathayasva mahābhāge brahmaṇastvaṃ tu pṛcchataḥ | kena vedā hṛtāḥ sarve vedhaso jagatīguroḥ || 9.29 || evamuktā tu rudreṇa uvāca mṛgalocanā | brahmaṇo japato vedāṃstvayi supte maheśvara || 9.30 || bhavataśchidramāsādya ghore'sminsalilāvṛte | pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāvasurau suradurjayau || 9.31 || śriyāvṛttau mahādeva tvayā cotpāditau purā | surāsurasudurjeyau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau || 9.32 || tau vāyubhūtau sūkṣmau ca paṭhato'smātpitāmahāt | tāvāśu hṛtvā vedāṃśca praviṣṭau ca mahārṇavam || 9.33 || etacchrutvā mahātejā hyamṛtāyāstato vacaḥ | sasmāra sa ca deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 9.34 || sa viveśa mahārāja bhūtalaṃ sasurottamaḥ | dānavāntakaro devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ || 9.35 || mīnarūpadharo devo loḍayāmāsa cārṇam | vedāṃśca dadṛśe tatra pātāle nihitānprabhuḥ || 9.36 || tau ca daityau mahāvīryau dṛṣṭavānmadhusūdanaḥ | mahāvegau mahābāhū sūdayāmāsa tejasā || 9.37 || vedāṃstatrāpi toyasthānānināya jagadguruḥ | caturvaktrāya devāyādadāccakravibhūṣitaḥ || 9.38 || tataḥ prahṛṣṭo bhagavān vedāṃllabdhvā pitāmahaḥ | janayāmāsa nikhilaṃ jagadbhūyaścarācaram || 9.39 || sā ca devī nadī puṇyā rudrasya paricārikā | pāvanī sarvabhūtānāṃ provāha salilaṃ tadā || 9.40 || tasyāstīre tato devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | yajanti tryambakaṃ devaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 9.41 || ekā mūrtirmaheśasya kāraṇāntaragatā | traiguṇyā kurute karma brahmacakrīśarūpataḥ || 9.42 || eteṣāṃ tu pṛthagbhāvaṃ ye kurvanti sumohitāḥ | teṣāṃ dharmaḥ kutaḥ siddhirjāyate pāpakarmiṇām || 9.43 || evametā mahānadyastisro rudrasamudbhavāḥ | ekā eva tridhā bhūtā gaṅgā revā sarasvatī || 9.44 || gaṅgā tu vaiṣṇavī mūrtiḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | rudradehasamudbhūtā narmadā caivameva tu || 9.45 || brāhmī sarasvatī mūrtistriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā | divyā kāmagamā devī vāgvibhūtyai tu saṃsthitā || 9.46 || narmadā paramā kācinmartyamūrtikalā śivā | divyā kāmagamā devī sarvatra surapūjitā || 9.47 || vyāpinī sarvabhūtānāṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarā smṛtā | akṣayā hyamṛtā hyeṣā svargasopānamuttamā || 9.48 || sṛṣṭā rudreṇa lokānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī || 9.49 || sīrajalaṃ ye'pi pibanti loke mucyanti te pāpaviśeṣasaṅghaiḥ | vrajanti saṃsāramanādibhāvaṃ tyaktvā ciraṃ mokṣapadaṃ viśuddham || 9.50 || yathā gaṅgā tathā revā tathā caiva sarasvatī | samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ proktaṃ snānadarśanacintanaiḥ || 9.51 || varadānānmahābhāgā hyadhikā cocyate budhaiḥ | kāruṇyāntarabhāvena na mṛtā samupāgatā || 9.52 || mucyante darśanāttena pātakaiḥ snānamaṅgalaiḥ | narmadāyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye namanti trilocanam || 9.53 || umārudrāṅgasambhūtā yena caiṣā mahānadī | lokānprāpayate svargaṃ tena puṇyatvamāgatā || 9.54 || ya evamīśānavarasya dehaṃ vibhajya devīmiha saṃśṛṇoti | sa yāti rudraṃ mahatāraveṇa gandharvayakṣairiva gīyamānaḥ || 9.55 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadotpattitatsnānaphalādikathanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.10>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kasminkalpe mahābhāgā narmadeyaṃ dvijottama | vibhaktā ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaistapoyuktairmahātmabhiḥ || 10.1 || etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara | kalpānte yadbhavetkaṣṭaṃ lokānāṃ tattvameva ca || 10.2 || atīte tu purā kalpe yatheyaṃ vartate'nagha | asyāntyasya ca kalpasya vyavasthāṃ kathaya prabho | evamuktaḥ sabhāmadhye mārkaṇḍo vākyamabravīt || 10.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca vakṣye'haṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvaiḥ katheyaṃ pūrvataḥ śrutā || 10.4 || mahatkatheyaṃ vaiśiṣṭī kalpādasmātparaṃ tu yā | lokakṣayakaro ghora āsītkālaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 10.5 || tasminnapi mahāghore yatheyaṃ vā mṛtā satī | parituṣṭairvibhaktā ca śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāmimām || 10.6 || yugānte samanuprāpte pitāmahadinatraye | mānasā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sākṣādbrahmeva sattamāḥ || 10.7 || sanakādyā mahātmāno ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ | yamendravaruṇādyāśca lokapālā dinatraye || 10.8 || kālāpekṣāstu tiṣṭhanti lokavṛttāntatatparāḥ | tataḥ kalpakṣaye prāpte teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam || 10.9 || sarveṣāṃ naśyate cāyuryugarūpānusārataḥ | bhūrlokaṃ te parityajya agamaṃśca bhuvaṃ tadā || 10.10 || svarlokaṃ ca mahaścaiva janaścaiva tapastadā | āśrayaṃ satyalokaṃ ca sarvalokamanuttamam || 10.11 || kālaṃ yugasahasrāntaṃ putrapautrasamanvitāḥ | satyaloke ca tiṣṭhanti yāvatsaṃjāyate jagat || 10.12 || brahmaputrāśca ye kecitkalpādau na bhavanti ha | trailokyaṃ te parityajya anādhāraṃ bhavanti ca || 10.13 || taiḥ sārdhaṃ ye tu te viprā anye cāpi tapodhanāḥ | yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca anye vaimānikā gaṇāḥ || 10.14 || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā varṇāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ | sīdanti bhūmyāṃ sahitā ye cānye talavāsinaḥ || 10.15 || anāvṛṣṭirabhūttatra mahatī śatavārṣikī | lokakṣayakarī raudrā vṛkṣavīrudvināśinī || 10.16 || trailokyasaṃkṣobhakarī saptārṇavaviśoṣaṇī | tato lokāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭā bhramantīva diśo daśa || 10.17 || kaṃdairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi vartayante suduḥkhitāḥ | saritaḥ sāgarāḥ kūpāḥ sevante pāvanāni ca || 10.18 || tatrāpi sarve śuṣyanti saridbhiḥ saha sāgarāḥ | tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale || 10.19 || tānyevāgre pralīyante bhinnānyurujalena vai | atha saṃkṣīyamāṇāsu saritsu saha sāgaraiḥ || 10.20 || ṛṣīṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ kurukṣetranivāsinām | ye ca vaikhānasā viprā dantolūkhalinastathā || 10.21 || himācalaguhāguhye ye vasanti tapodhanāḥ | sarve te māmupāgamya kṣuttṛṣārtāstapodhanāḥ || 10.22 || ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve sīdayāmo mahāmune | saritsāgaraśailāntaṃ jagatsaṃśuṣyate dvija || 10.23 || kutra yāsyāma sahitā yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ | dīrghāyurasi viprendra na mṛtastvaṃ yugakṣaye || 10.24 || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ tava hṛdi sthitam | tasmāttvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ ca kathayasva mahāvrata || 10.25 || kīdṛkkālaṃ mahābhāga kṣapiṣyāmo'tha suvrata | anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ sīdate sacarācaram || 10.26 || paritrāhi mahābhāga na yathā yāma saṃkṣayam | tataḥ saṃcintya manasā tvaranviprānathābravam || 10.27 || kurukṣetraṃ tyajadhvaṃ ca putradārasamanvitāḥ | tyaktvodīcīṃ diśaṃ sarve yāmo yāmyāmanuttamām || 10.28 || nagaragrāmaghoṣāḍhyāṃ purapattanaśobhitām | gacchāmo narmadātīraṃ bahusiddhaniṣevitam || 10.29 || rudrāṅgīṃ tāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm | paśyāmastāṃ mahābhāgāṃ nyagrodhāvārasaṃkulām || 10.30 || māheśvarairbhāgavataiḥ sāṃkhyaiḥ siddhaiḥ susevitām | anāvṛṣṭibhayādbhītāḥ kūlayorubhayorapi || 10.31 || āśrame hyāśramāndivyānkārayāmo jitavratāḥ | evamuktāstu te sarve sametānucaraiḥ saha || 10.32 || narmadātīramāsādya sthitāḥ sarve'kutobhayāḥ | kiṃcitpūrvamanusmṛtya purā kalpādibhirbhayam || 10.33 || prāptāstu narmadātīramādāveva kalau yuge | tato varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ divyaṃ revātaṭe'vasan || 10.34 || ṣaḍviṃśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi ca | tatrāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamṛṣīṇāṃ vasatāṃ nṛpa || 10.35 || anāvṛṣṭihate loke saṃśuṣke sthāvare care | bhinne yugādikalane hāhābhūte vicetane || 10.36 || cāturvarṇe pralīne tu naṣṭe homabalikrame | niḥsvāhe nirvaṣaṭkāre śaucācāravivarjite || 10.37 || iyamekā saricchreṣṭhā ṛṣikoṭiniṣevitā | nānyā kācittriloke'pi ramaṇīyā nareśvara || 10.38 || yatheyaṃ puṇyasalilā indrasyevāmarāvatī | devatāyatanaiḥ śubhrairāśramaiśca sukalpitaiḥ || 10.39 || śobhate narmadā devī svarge mandākinī yathā | yāvadvṛkṣā mahāśailā yāvatsāgarasaṃbhavā || 10.40 || ubhayoḥ kūlayostāvanmaṇḍitāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ | hūyadbhiragnihotraiśca havirdhūmasamākulā || 10.41 || babhūva narmadā devī prāvṛṭkāla iva śarvarī | devatāyatanairnaikaiḥ pūjāsaṃskāraśobhitā || 10.42 || saridbhirbhrājate śreṣṭhā purī śākrī ca bhāskarī | kecitpañcāgnitapasaḥ kecidapyagnihotriṇaḥ || 10.43 || keciddhūmakamaśnanti tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ | ātmayajñaratāḥ kecidapare bhaktibhāginaḥ || 10.44 || vaiṣṇavajñānamāsādya kecicchaivaṃ vrataṃ tathā | ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ ca kecitṣaṣṭhāhabhojanāḥ || 10.45 || cāndrāyaṇavidhānaiśca kṛcchriṇaścātikṛcchriṇaḥ | evaṃvidhaistapobhiśca narmadātīraśobhitaiḥ || 10.46 || yajadbhiḥ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ bhāti nityadā | ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca yajatāṃ ca maheśvaram || 10.47 || kalau yuge mahāghore prāptāḥ siddhimanuttamām | yasya yasya hi yā bhaktirvijñānaṃ yasya yādṛśam || 10.48 || yasminyasmiṃśca deve tu tāṃtāmīśo'dadātprabhuḥ | svabhāvaikatayā bhaktyā tāmetyāntaḥ pralīyate || 10.49 || saṃsāre parivartante ye pṛthagbhājino narāḥ | ye mahāvṛkṣamīśānaṃ tyaktvā śākhāvalambinaḥ || 10.50 || punarāvartamānāste jāyante hi caturyuge | devānte sthāvarānte ca saṃsāre cābhramankramāt || 10.51 || punarjanma punaḥ svarge punarghore ca raurave | ye punardevamīśānaṃ bhavaṃ bhaktisusaṃsthitāḥ || 10.52 || yajanti narmadātīre na punaste bhavanti ca | ā dehapatanātkecidupāsantaḥ paraṃ gatāḥ || 10.53 || keciddvādaśabhirvarṣaiḥ ṣaḍbharanye tapodhanāḥ | tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ kecitkecitsaṃvatsareṇa tu || 10.54 || ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu saṃsiddhāstribhirmāsaistathāpare | munayo devamāśritya narmadāṃ ca yaśasvinīm || 10.55 || chittvā saṃsāradoṣāṃśca agamanbrahma śāśvatam | evaṃ kaliyuge ghore śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 10.56 || narmadātīramāśritya munayo rudramāviśan || 10.57 || ye narmadātīramupetya viprāḥ śaive vrate yatnamupaprapannāḥ | trikālamambhaḥ pravigāhya bhaktyā devaṃ samabhyarcya śivaṃ vrajanti || 10.58 || dhyānārcanairjāpyamahāvrataiśca nārāyaṇaṃ vā satataṃ smaranti | te dhautapāṇḍurapaṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram || 10.59 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujamucyate | idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā || 10.60 || yo vā haraṃ pūjayate jitātmā māsaṃ ca pakṣaṃ ca vasennarendra | revāṃ samāśritya mahānubhāvaḥ sa devadevo'tha bhavetpinākī || 10.61 || kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāśca ye vai mriyante'mbhasi narmadāyāḥ | te divyarūpāstu kulaprasūtāḥ śataṃ samā dharmaparā bhavanti || 10.62 || kālena vṛkṣāḥ prapatanti ye'pi mahātaraṃgaughanikṛttamūlāḥ | te narmadāṃbhobhirapāstapāpā dedīpyamānāstridivaṃ prayānti || 10.63 || akāmakāmāśca tathā sakāmā revāntamāśritya mriyanti tīre | jaḍāndhamūkāstridivaṃ prayānti kimatra viprā bhavabhāvayuktāḥ || 10.64 || māsopavāsairapi śoṣitāṅgā na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti vimuktadehāḥ | mriyanti revājalapūtakāyāḥ śivārcane keśavabhāvayuktāḥ || 10.65 || nīvāraśyāmākayaveṅgudādyairanyairmunīndrā iha vartayanti | āpritya kūlaṃ tridaśānugītaṃ te narmadāyā na viśanti mṛtyum || 10.66 || bhramanti ye tīramupetya devyāstrikāladevārcanasatyapūtāḥ | viṇmūtracarmāsthitiropadhānāḥ kukṣau yuvatyā na vasanti bhūyaḥ || 10.67 || kiṃ yajñadānairbahubhiśca teṣāṃ niṣevitaistīrthavaraiḥ samastaiḥ | revātaṭaṃ dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ vā sevanti te rudracarānupūrvam || 10.68 || te vañcitāḥ paṅgujaḍāndhabhūtā lokeṣu martyāḥ paśubhiśca tulyāḥ | ye nāśritā rudraśarīrabhūtāṃ sopānapaṅktiṃ tridivasya revām || 10.69 || yugaṃ kaliṃ ghoramimaṃ ya iccheddraṣṭuṃ kadācinna punardvijendraḥ | sa narmadātīramupetya sarvaṃ sampūjayetsarvavimuktasaṃgaḥ || 10.70 || vighnairanekairatiyojyamānā ye tīramujhanti na narmadāyāḥ | te caiva sarvasya hitārthabhūtā vandyāśca te sarvajanasya mānyāḥ || 10.71 || bhṛgvatrigārgeyavaśiṣṭhakaṅkāḥ śataiḥ sametairniyatāstvasaṃkhyaiḥ | siddhiṃ parāṃ te hi jalaplutāṅgāḥ prāptāstu lokānmarutāṃ na cānye || 10.72 || jñānaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ pavitraṃ paṭhantyado nityaviśuddhasattvāḥ | gatiṃ parāṃ yānti mahānubhāvā rudrasya vākyaṃ hi yathā pramāṇam || 10.73 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadāsnānaphalaśrutikathanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.11>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca aho mahatpuṇyatamā viśiṣṭā kṣayaṃ na yātā iha yā yugānte | tasmātsadā sevyatamā munīndrairdhyānārcanasnānaparāyaṇaiśca || 11.1 || yāmāśritya gatā mokṣamṛṣayo dharmavatsalāḥ | ye tvayoktāstu niyamā ṛṣīṇāṃ vedanirmitāḥ || 11.2 || mokṣāvāptirbhavedyeṣāṃ niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ | daśadvādaśabhirvāpi ṣaḍbhiraṣṭābhireva vā || 11.3 || tribhistathā caturbhirvā varṣairmāsaistathaiva ca | mucyante kalidoṣaiste deveśānasamarcanāt || 11.4 || brahmāṇaṃ vā suraśreṣṭha keśavaṃ vā jagadgurum | arcayanpāpamakhilaṃ jahātyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 11.5 || etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha | yasminsaṃsāragahane nimagnāḥ sarvajantavaḥ | te kathaṃ tridivaṃ prāptā iti me saṃśayo vada || 11.6 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca janmāntarairanekaistu mānuṣyamupalabhyate | bhaktirutpadyate cātra kathaṃcidapi śaṅkare || 11.7 || tīrthadānopavāsānāṃ yajñairdevadvijārcanaiḥ | avāptirjāyate puṃsāṃ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa || 11.8 || tasmācchraddhā prakartavyā mānavairdharmavatsalaiḥ | īśo'pi śraddhayā sādhyastena śraddhā viśiṣyate || 11.9 || anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ tu bhārata | tasmātsamāśrayedbhaktiṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 11.10 || teṣāṃhi saphalaṃ janma yeṣāṃ bhaktiracañcalā | sā caiva trividhā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī rājasī tathā || 11.11 || tāmasī sarvalokasya trividhaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet | te karmaphalasaṃyogādāvartante punaḥpunaḥ || 11.12 || janmāntaraśataisteṣāṃ jñānināṃ devayājinām | devatraye bhavedbhaktiḥ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ || 11.13 || īśānāttu punarmokṣo jāyate chinnasaṃśayaḥ | ye punarnarmadātīramāśritya dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 11.14 || trayīmārgamasandigdhāste yānti paramāṃ gatim | ekāgramanaso ye tu śaṅkaraṃ śivamavyayam || 11.15 || arcayantīha niratāḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyanti te janāḥ | kālena mahatā siddhirjāyate'nyatra dehinām || 11.16 || narmadāyāḥ punastīre kṣipraṃ siddhiravāpyate | ṣaḍbhirvarṣaistu sidhyanti ye tu sāṃkhyavido janāḥ || 11.17 || vaiṣṇavā jñānasampannāste'pi sidhyanti cāgrataḥ | sarvayogavido ye ca samudramiva sindhavaḥ || 11.18 || ekībhavanti kalpānte yoge māheśvare gatāḥ | sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ yogo māheśvaro varaḥ || 11.19 || tamāsādya vimucyante ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ | śivamarcya nadīkūle jāyante te na yoniṣu || 11.20 || gatireṣā durārohā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | mucyante maṅkṣu saṃsārādrevāmāśritya jantavaḥ || 11.21 || tasmātsnāyī bhavennityaṃ tathā bhasmavilepanaḥ | narmadātīramāsādya kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 11.22 || trikālaṃ pūjayecchānto yo naro liṅgamādarāt | sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 11.23 || ṣaḍbhiḥ sidhyati masaistu yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt | ye punaḥ śuddhamanaso māsaiḥ śudhyanti te tribhiḥ || 11.24 || yathā dinakaraspṛṣṭaṃ himaṃ śailādviśīryante | tadvadvilīyate pāpaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ bhasmakaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 11.25 || vainateyabhayatrastā yathā naśyanti pannagāḥ | tadvatpāpāni naśyanti bhasmanābhyukṣitāni ha || 11.26 || narmadātoyapūtena bhasmanoddhūlayanti ye | sadyaste pāpasaṅghācca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11.27 || vrataṃ pāśupataṃ bhaktayā yathoktaṃ pālayanti ye | śūdrānnena vihīnāstu te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 11.28 || amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam | vaiśyānnamannameva syācchūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam || 11.29 || śūdrānnarasasaṃpuṣṭā ye mriyante dvijottamāḥ | te tapojñānahīnāstu kākā gṛdhrā bhavanti te || 11.30 || duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāmannamāśritya tiṣṭhati | yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam || 11.31 || viśeṣādyatidharmeṇa tapolaulyaṃ samāśritāḥ | narakaṃ yāntyasandigdhamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 11.32 || īdṛgrūpāśca ye viprāḥ pāśupatye vyavasthitāḥ | te mahatpāpasaṃghātaṃ dahantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 11.33 || viḍambena ca saṃyuktā laulupyena ca pīḍitāḥ | asaṃgrāhyā ityevaṃ śrutinodanā || 11.34 || mātāpitṛkṛtairdoṣairanye kecitsvakarmajaiḥ | naṣṭā jñānāvalepena ahaṅkāreṇa'pare || 11.35 || śāṅkare prasthitā dharme ye smṛtyarthabahiṣkṛtāḥ | kliśyamānāstu kalena te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 11.36 || aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā mūrkhā dambhavivardhitāḥ | na sidhyanti durātmānaḥ kudṛṣṭāntārthakīrtanāḥ || 11.37 || mahābhāgye'pi tīrthasya śāṅkaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ | viyoniṃ yāntyasandigdhaṃ laulupyena samanvitāḥ || 11.38 || na tīrthairna ca dānaiśca duṣkṛtaṃ hi vilupyate | ajñānācca pramādācca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati || 11.39 || evaṃ jñātvā tu vidhinā vartitavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ | paraṃ brahma japadbhiśca vārtitavyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 11.40 || ūrdhvarūpaṃ virūpākṣaṃ yo'dhīte rudrameva ca | īśānaṃ paśyate sākṣātṣaṇmāsātsaṅgavarjitaḥ || 11.41 || saṃhitāyā daśāvṛttīryaḥ karoti susaṃyataḥ | narmadātaṭamāśritya sa mucyetsarvapātakaiḥ || 11.42 || purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vāpi śaivīṃ vā vaiṣṇavīmapi | yaḥ paṭhennarmadātīre śivāgre sa śivātmakaḥ || 11.43 || ā bhūtasaṃkṣayaṃ yāvatsvargaloke mahīyate | saṃsākhyasanaṃ hātuṃ purā proktaṃ tu nandinā || 11.44 || devarṣisiddhagandharvasamavāye śivālaye | nandigītāmimāṃ rājañchṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śubhām || 11.45 || svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ saṃsārabhayanāśinīm || 11.46 || saṃsāragahvaraguhāṃ pravihātumetāṃ cedicchatha pratipadaṃ bhavatāpakhinnāḥ | nānāvidhairnijakṛtairbahukarmapāśairbaddhāḥ sukhāya śṛṇutaikahitaṃ mayoktam || 11.47 || śakra vakragatiṃ mā gā mā kṛthā yama yātanām | cetaḥ pracetaḥ śamaya laulupyaṃ tyaja vittapa || 11.48 || dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyo dhanaṃ sarvaṃ parityaja | yadi saṃsārajaladhervīcīpreṅkhollanāturaḥ || 11.49 || janmodvignaṃ mṛtestrastaṃ grastaṃ kāmādibhirnaram | srastaṃ yo na yamādibhyaḥ pinākī pāti pāvanaḥ || 11.50 || mā dhehi garvaṃ kīnāśa hāsyaṃ yāsyasi pīḍayan | prāṇinaṃ sarvaśaraṇaṃ tadbhāvi śaraṇaṃ tava || 11.51 || kālaḥ karālako bālaḥ ko mṛtyuḥ ko yamādhamaḥ | śivaviṣṇuparāṇāṃ hi narāṇāṃ kiṃ bhayaṃ bhavet || 11.52 || bhavabhārārtajantūnāṃ revātīranivāsinām | bhargaśca bhagavāṃścaiva bhavabhītivibhedanau || 11.53 || śivaṃ bhaja śivaṃ dhyāya śivaṃ stuhi śivaṃ yaja | śivaṃ nama varāka tvaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ yadīcchasi || 11.54 || paṭha pañcānanaṃ śāstraṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ japa | dhehi pañcātmakaṃ tattvaṃ yaja pañcānanaṃ param || 11.55 || kiṃ taiḥ karmagaṇaiḥ śocyairnānābhāvaviśeṣitaiḥ | yadi pañcānanaḥ śrīmān sevyate sarvathā śivaḥ || 11.56 || kiṃ saṃsāragajonmattabṛṃhitairnibhṛtairapi | yadi pañcānano devo bhāvagandhopasevitaḥ || 11.57 || re mūḍha kiṃ viṣādena prāpya karmakadarthanām | bhavānīvallabhaṃ bhīmaṃ japa tvaṃ bhayanāśanam || 11.58 || narmadātīranilayaṃ duḥkhaughavilayaṃkaram | svargamokṣapradaṃ bhargaṃ bhaja mūḍha sureśvaram || 11.59 || vihāya revāṃ surasindhusevyāṃ tattīrasaṃsthaṃ ca haraṃ hariṃ ca | unmattavadbhāvavivarjitastvaṃ kva yāsi re mūḍha digantarāṇi || 11.60 || bhaja revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ yaja rudraṃ sanātanam | japa pañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vraja sthānaṃ ca vāñchitam || 11.61 || kleśayitvā nijaṃ kāyamupāyairbahubhistu kim | bhaja revāṃ śivaṃ prāpya sukhasādhyaṃ paraṃ padam || 11.62 || evaṃ kailāsamāsādya nadīṃ sa śivasannidhau | jagau yallokapālānāṃ tanmayoktaṃ tavādhunā || 11.63 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca snānadānaparo yastu nityaṃ dharmamanuvrataḥ | narmadātīramāśritya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 11.64 || vidhihīno japennityaṃ vedānsarvāñchataṃ samāḥ | mṛtyulāṅgalajāpyena samo yo'pyadhiko guṇaiḥ || 11.65 || bījayonyaviśuddhastu yathā rudraṃ na vindati | tathā lāṅgalamantro'pi na tiṣṭhati gatāyuṣi || 11.66 || gāyatrījapasaṃyuktaḥ saṃyamī hyadhiko guṇaiḥ | agnimīḍe iṣetvo vā agna āyāhi nityadā || 11.67 || śanno devīti kūlastho japenmucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ || 11.68 || sāṅgopāṅgāṃstathā vedāñjapannityaṃ samāhitaḥ | na tatphalamavāpnoti gāyatryā saṃyamī yathā || 11.69 || rudrādhyāyaṃ sakṛjjaptvā vipro vedasamanvitaḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 11.70 || anyadvai japyasaṃsthānaṃ sūktamāraṇyakaṃ tathā | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 11.71 || yatkiṃcitkriyate jāpyaṃ yacca dānaṃ pradīyate | narmadājalamāśritya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 11.72 || evaṃvidhairvratairnityaṃ narmadāṃ ye samāśritāḥ | te mṛtā vaiṣṇavaṃ yānti padaṃ vā śaivamavyayam || 11.73 || satyalokaṃ narāḥ kecitsūryalokaṃ tathāpare | apsarogaṇasaṃvītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 11.74 || evaṃ vai vartamāne'smiṃlloke tu nṛpapuṃgava | ṛṣīṇāṃ daśakoṭyastu kurukṣetranivāsinām || 11.75 || mayā saha mahābhāga narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ | phalamūlakṛtāhārā arcayantaḥ sthitāḥ śivam || 11.76 || tacca varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ kālasaṃkhyānumānataḥ | ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi tāni mānuṣasaṃkhyayā || 11.77 || tatastasyāmatītāyāṃ sandhyāyāṃ nṛpasattama | śeṣaṃ mānuṣyamekaṃ tu kāle varṣaśataṃ sthitam || 11.78 || tato'bhavadanāvṛṣṭirlokakṣayakarī tadā | yayā yātaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ bhūyo hi dāruṇam || 11.79 || ye pūrvamiha saṃsiddhā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ | teṣāṃ prabhāvādbhagavān vavarṣa balavṛtrahā || 11.80 || mahatī bhūrisalilā samantādvṛṣṭirāhitā | tato vṛṣṭyā tu teṣāṃ vai vartanaṃ samajāyata || 11.81 || punaryugānte samprāpte kiṃciccheṣe kalau yuge | niḥśeṣamabhavatsarvaṃ śuṣkaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam || 11.82 || nirvṛkṣauṣadhagulmaṃ ca tṛṇavīrudvivarjitam | anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ bhūmaṇḍalamabhūdbhṛśam || 11.83 || tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṣuttṛṣārtāḥ sahasraśaḥ | yugasvabhāvamāviṣṭā hīnasattvā abhavannṛpa || 11.84 || naṣṭahomasvadhākāre yugānte samupasthite | kiṃ kāryaṃ kva nu yāsyāmaḥ ko'smākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavet || 11.85 || tānahaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mā bhaiṣṭeti punaḥpunaḥ | īdṛgvidhā mayā dṛṣṭā bahavaḥ kālaparyayāḥ || 11.86 || narmadātīramāśritya te sarve gamitā mayā | eṣā hi śaraṇaṃ devī samprāpte hi yugakṣaye || 11.87 || nānyā gatirihāsmākaṃ vidyate dvijasattamāḥ | janitrī sarvabhūtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ || 11.88 || pitāmahā ye pitaro ye cānye prapitāmahāḥ | te samastā gatāḥ svargaṃ samāśritya mahānadīm || 11.89 || bhṛgvādyāḥ sapta ye tvāsanmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ | dhaumṛṇī ca mahābhāgā mama bhāryā śucismitā | manasvatī ca yā matā bhārgavo'ṅgirasastathā || 11.90 || pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva vasiṣṭhātreyakāśyapāḥ | tathānye ca mahābhāgā niyamavratacāriṇaḥ | anye ca śatasāhasrā atra siddhiṃ samāgatāḥ || 11.91 || tasmādiyaṃ mahābhāgā na moktavyā kadācana | nānyā kācinnadī śaktā lokatrayaphalapradā || 11.92 || dvandvairanekairbahubhiḥ kṣuttṛṣādyairmahābhayaiḥ | mucyante te narāḥ sadyo narmadātīravāsinaḥ || 11.93 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sevitavyā saridvarā | vāñchadbhiḥ paramaṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca || 11.94 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.12>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca etacchrutvā vaco rājansaṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayo'bhavan | narmadāṃ stotumārabdhāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā dvijāḥ || 12.1 || namo'stu te puṇyajale namo makaragāmini | namaste pāpamocinyai namo devi varānane || 12.2 || namo'stu te puṇyajalāśraye śubhe viśuddhasattvaṃ surasiddhasevite | namo'stu te tīrthagaṇairniṣevite namo'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare || 12.3 || namo'stu te devi samudragāmini namo'stu te devi varaprade śive | namo'stu lokadvayasaukhyadāyini hyanekabhūtaughasamāśrite'naghe || 12.4 || saridvare pāpahare vicitrite gandharvayakṣoragasevitāṅge | sanātani prāṇigaṇānukampini mokṣaprade devi vidhehi śaṃ naḥ || 12.5 || mahāgajairghamahiṣairvarāhaiḥ saṃsevite devi mahormimāle | natāḥ sma sarve varade sukhaprade vimocayāsmānpaśupāśabandhāt || 12.6 || pāpairanekairaśubhairvibaddhā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ | mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhūtaṃ yāvattavāmbho hi na saṃspṛśanti || 12.7 || anekaduḥkhaughabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām | gatistvamambhojasamānavakre dvandvairanekairapi saṃvṛtānām || 12.8 || nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo'tra | duḥkhāturāṇāmabhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi || 12.9 || spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveśca tadaiva dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu | yatropalāḥ puṇyajalāplutāste śivatvamāyānti kimatra citram || 12.10 || bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā duḥkhāturāḥ pāpaparītadehāḥ | mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ yāvattavāmbho na hi saṃśrayanti || 12.11 || mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye'mbhastava devi puṇyam | muktā bhavantīha bhayāttu ghorānniḥsaṃśayaṃ te'pi kimatra citram || 12.12 || sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge'smin hi kalau pradūṣite | tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā || 12.13 || tava prasādādvarade variṣṭhe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā | yāmo'tha rudraṃ tava suprasādādvayaṃ tathā tvaṃ kuru vai prasādam || 12.14 || gatistvamambeva piteva putrāṃstvaṃ pāhi no yāvadimaṃ yugāntam | kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ sughoraṃ yāvattarāmastava suprasādāt || 12.15 || paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ dvijendrāḥ śṛṇvanti ye cāpi narāḥ praśāntāḥ | te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāśca || 12.16 || ye stotrametatsatataṃ paṭhanti snātvā tu toye khalu narmadāyāḥ | ante hi teṣāṃ sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhāmacirāddadāti || 12.17 || prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavaṃ ca | sa muktapāpaḥ suviśuddhadehaḥ samāśrayaṃ yāti maheśvarasya || 12.18 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye narmadāstotrakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.13>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ bhagavatī puṇyā stutā sā munipuṃgavaiḥ | cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam || 13.1 || tataḥ prasuptāṃstāñjñātvā rātrau devī jagāma ha | ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ svapne darśanaṃ cāruhāsinī || 13.2 || tato'rdharātre samprāpta utthitā jalamadhyataḥ | vimalāmbarasaṃvītā divyamālāvibhūṣitā || 13.3 || ghṛtātapatrā suśroṇī padmarāgavibhūṣitā | jagāda mā bhairiti tānekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak || 13.4 || vasadhvaṃ mama pārśve tu bhayaṃ tyaktvā kṣudhādijam || 13.5 || evamuktvā tadā devī svapnānte tānmahāmunīn | jagāmādarśanaṃ paścātpraviśya jalamātmikam || 13.6 || tataḥ prabhāte munayo mitha ūcurmudanvitāḥ | tathā dṛṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭā svapne devī sudarśanā || 13.7 || abhayaṃ dattamasmākaṃ siddhiścāpyacireṇa tu | praśastaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā narmadāyā na saṃśayaḥ || 13.8 || athānyadivase rājanmatsyānāṃ rūpamuttamam | paśyanti saparīvārāḥ svakīyāśramasannidhau || 13.9 || tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā matsyāṃstatra maharṣayaḥ | pūjayāmāsuravyagrā havyakavyena devatāḥ || 13.10 || tānmatsyasaṅghānsamprāpya mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ | saputradārabhṛtyāste vartayanti pṛthakpṛthak || 13.11 || dine dine tathāpyevamāśrameṣu dvijātayaḥ | matsyānāṃ sañcayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāścābhavaṃstadā || 13.12 || mṛtāṃstāṃstu supuṣṭāṅgān pāṭhīnāṃśca viśeṣataḥ | dvāre dvāre cāśramāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 13.13 || hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstadā sarve narmadātīravāsinaḥ | ṛṣayaste bhayaṃ sarve tatyajuḥ kṣuttṛṣodbhavam || 13.14 || te japantastapantaśca tiṣṭhanti bharatarṣabha | arcayanti pitḥndevānnarmadātaṭamāśritāḥ || 13.15 || tairjapadbhistapadbhiśca satataṃ dvijasattamaiḥ | bhrājate sā saricchreṣṭhā tārābhirdyaurgrahairiva || 13.16 || tatra tairbahulaiḥ śubhrairbrāhmaṇairvedaparāgaiḥ | narmadā dharmadā pūrvaṃ saṃvibhaktā yathākramam || 13.17 || ṛṣibhirdaśakoṭibhirnarmadātīravāsibhiḥ | vibhakteyaṃ vibhaktāṅgī narmadā śarmadā nṛṇām || 13.18 || yajñopavītaiśca śubhairakṣasūtraiśca bhārata | kūladvaye mahāpuṇyā narmadodadhigāminī || 13.19 || pṛthagāyatanaiḥ śubhrairliṅgairvālukamṛnmayaiḥ | bhrājate yā saricchreṣṭhā nakṣatrairiva śarvarī || 13.20 || evaṃ ta ṛṣayaḥ sarve tarpayantaḥ surānpitḥn | nyavasannarmadātīre yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 13.21 || kiṃcidgate tatastasminghore varṣaśatādhike | ardharātre tadā kanyā jalāduttīrya bhārata || 13.22 || vidyutpuṃjasamābhāsā vyālayajñopavītinī | triśūlāgrakarā saumyā tānuvāca ṛṣīṃstadā || 13.23 || āgacchadhvaṃ munigaṇā viśadhvaṃ māmayonijām | sametāḥ putradāraiśca tataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha || 13.24 || yasya yasya hi yā vāñchā tasya tāṃ tāṃ dadāmyaham | viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamīśānamanyaṃ vā suramuttamam || 13.25 || tatra sarvānnayiṣyāmi prasannā varadā hyaham | prāṇāyāmaparā bhūtvā māṃ viśadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 13.26 || saha putraiśca dāraiśca tyaktvāśramapadāni ca | kālakṣepo na kartavyaḥ pralayo'yamupasthitaḥ || 13.27 || saṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kalpadāhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ | ekāhamabhavaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāghore janakṣaye || 13.28 || śeṣā nadyaḥ samudrāśca sarva eva kṣayaṃgatāḥ | varadānānmaheśasya tenāhaṃ na kṣayaṃ gatā || 13.29 || amṛtaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sthāṇurīśaḥ sanātanaḥ | sa pūjitaḥ prārthito vā kiṃ na dadyāddvijottamāḥ || 13.30 || evamuktvā ṛṣīvrevā praviveśa jalaṃ tataḥ | karāttaśūlā sā devī vyālayajñopavītinī || 13.31 || tataste tadvacaḥ śrutvā vismayāpannamānasāḥ | abhivandya ca māṃ sarve kṣāmayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 13.32 || kṣamyatāṃ no yaduktaṃ hi vasatāṃ tava saṃśraye | gṛhāṃstyaktvā mahābhāgāḥ saśiṣyāḥ sahabāndhavāḥ || 13.33 || japtvā caikākṣaraṃ brahma hṛdi dhyātvā maheśvaram | snātvā ca mantrapūtābhiratha cādbhirjitavratāḥ || 13.34 || viviśurnarmadātoyaṃ sapakṣā iva parvatāḥ | dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvāḥ kuśahastāḥ sahāgrayaḥ || 13.35 || gateṣu teṣu rājendra ahamekaḥ sthitastadā | amareśaṃ samāsādya pūjayannarmadāṃ nadīm || 13.36 || anubhūtāḥ saptakalpā māyūrādyā mayā nṛpa | prasādādvedhasaḥ sarve revayā saha bhārata || 13.37 || janmato'dya dinaṃ yāvanna jāne'syāḥ purāsthitim || 13.38 || iyaṃ hi śāṃkarī śaktiḥ kalā śambhorilāhvayā | narmadā duritadhvaṃsakāriṇī bhavatāriṇī || 13.39 || yadāhamapi nābhūvaṃ purākalpeṣu pāṇḍava | caturdaśasu kalpeṣu teṣviyaṃ sukhasaṃsthitā || 13.40 || caturdaśa purā kalpā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā | tānahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devī prāha yathā mama || 13.41 || kāpilaṃ prathamaṃ viddhi prājāpatyaṃ dvitīyakam | brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ ca sāvitraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ prabhāsakam || 13.42 || māhendramagnikalpaṃ ca jayantaṃ mārutaṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavaṃ bahurūpaṃ ca jyautiṣaṃ ca caturdaśam || 13.43 || ete kalpā mayā khyātā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā | māyūraṃ pañcadaśamaṃ kaurmaṃ caivātra ṣoḍaśam || 13.44 || bakaṃ mātsyaṃ ca pādmaṃ ca vaṭakalpaṃ ca bhārata | ekaviṃśatimaṃ caitaṃ vārāhaṃ sāṃpratīnakam || 13.45 || ime sapta mayā sākaṃ revayā pariśīlitāḥ | ekaviṃśatikalpāstu narmadāyāḥ śivāṅgataḥ || 13.46 || saṃjātāyā nṛpaśreṣṭha mayā dṛṣṭā hyanekaśaḥ | kathitā nṛpatiśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi te || 13.47 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmya ekaviṃśatikalpakathānakavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.14>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve mahābhāgāstapodhanāḥ | gatāstu paramaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ kiṃ jātamadbhutam || 14.1 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatasteṣu prayāteṣu narmadātīravāsiṣu | babhūva raudrasaṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 14.2 || kailāsaśikharasthaṃ tu mahādevaṃ sanātanam | brahmādyāḥ prāstuvan devamṛgyajuḥsāmabhiḥ śivam || 14.3 || saṃhara tvaṃ jagaddeva sadevāsuramānuṣam | prāpto yugasahasrāntaḥ kālaḥ saṃharaṇakṣamaḥ || 14.4 || madrūpaṃ tu samāsthāya tvayā caitadvinirmitam | vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtimāsthāya tvayaitatparipālitam || 14.5 || ekā mūrtistridhā jātā brāhmī śaivī ca vaiṣṇavī | sṛṣṭisaṃhārarakṣārthaṃ bhavedevaṃ maheśvara || 14.6 || etacchrutvā vacastathyaṃ viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ | sagaṇaḥ saparīvāraḥ saha tābhyāṃ sahomayā || 14.7 || samalokānvibhidyemānbhagavānnīlalohitaḥ | bhūrādyabrahmalokāntaṃ bhittvāṇḍaṃ parataḥ param || 14.8 || śaivaṃ padamajaṃ divyamāviśatsaha tairvibhuḥ | na tatra vāyurnākāśaṃ nāgnistatra na bhūtalam || 14.9 || yatra saṃtiṣṭhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ | na sūryo na grahāstatra na ṛkṣāṇi diśastathā || 14.10 || na lokapālā na sukhaṃ na ca duḥkhaṃ nṛpottama || 14.11 || brāhmaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti śaivaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti | kṣetrajñamīśaṃ pravadanti cānye sāṃkhyāśca gāyanti kilādimokṣam || 14.12 || yadbrahma ādyaṃ pravadanti kecidyaṃ sarvamīśānamajaṃ purāṇam | tamekarūpaṃ tamanekarūpamarūpamādyaṃ paramavyayākhyam || 14.13 || avarṇamapyarthamanāmagotraṃ turyaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti | dhyānārthavijñānamayaṃ susūkṣmamātmasthamīśānavaraṃ vareṇyam || 14.14 || tatastrayaste bhagavantamīśaṃ samprāpya saṃkṣipya bhavantyarthakam | pṛthaksvarūpaistu punasta eva jagatsamastaṃ paripālayanti || 14.15 || saṃhāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudratve kurute prabhuḥ | viṣṇutve pālayellokānbrahmatve sṛṣṭikārakaḥ || 14.16 || prakṛtyā saha saṃyuktaḥ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ | viśvarūpā mahābhāgā tasya pārśve vyavasthitā || 14.17 || yāmāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ tajjñāḥ padārthānāṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ | puruṣatve prakṛtitve ca kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 14.18 || tasmādetajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram | tasminneva layaṃ yāti yugānte samupasthite || 14.19 || bhagaliṅgāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ vai parameṣṭhinā | bhagarūpo bhavedviṣṇurliṅgarūpo maheśvaraḥ || 14.20 || bhāti sarveṣu lokeṣu gīyate bhūrbhuvādiṣu | praviṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteṣu tena viṣṇurbhagaḥ smṛtaḥ || 14.21 || viśanādviṣṇurityuktaḥ sarvadevamayo mahān | bhāsanādgamanāccaiva bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā || 14.22 || brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yasminneti layaṃ jagat | ekabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmādvidurbudhāḥ || 14.23 || mahādevastato devīmāha pārśve sthitāṃ tadā | saṃharasva jagatsarvaṃ mā vilambasva śobhane || 14.24 || tyaja saumyamidaṃ rūpaṃ sitacandrāṃśunirmalam | rudraṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya saṃharasva carācaram || 14.25 || raudrairbhūtagaṇairghorairdevi tvaṃ parivāritā | jīvalokamimaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣayasvāmbujekṣaṇe || 14.26 || tato'haṃ mardayiṣyāmi plāvayiṣye tathā jagat | kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhaṃ svapsye tvayā saha || 14.27 || śrīdevyuvāca nāhaṃ deva jagaccaitatsaṃharāmi mahādyute | ambā bhūtvā viceṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayāmi bhṛśāturam || 14.28 || strīsvabhāvena kāruṇyaṃ karoti hṛdayaṃ mama | kathaṃ vai nirdahiṣyāmi jagadetajjagatpate || 14.29 || tasmāttvaṃ svayamevedaṃ jagatsaṃhara śaṅkara | athaivamuktastāṃ devīṃ dhūrjaṭirnīlalohitaḥ || 14.30 || kruddho nirbhartsayāmāsa huṅkāreṇa maheśvarīm | oṃ huṃphaṭtvaṃ sa ityāha kopāviṣṭairathekṣaṇaiḥ || 14.31 || huṃkāritā viśālākṣī pīnorujaghanasthalā | tatkṣaṇāccābhavadraudrā kālarātrīva bhārata || 14.32 || huṃkurvatī mahānādairnādayantī diśo daśa | vyavardhata mahāraudrā vidyutsaudāminī yathā || 14.33 || vidyutsampātaduṣprekṣyā vidyutsaṃghātacañcalā | vidyujjvālākulā raudrā vidyudagninibhekṣaṇā || 14.34 || muktakeśī viśālākṣī kṛśagrīvā kṛśodarī | vyāghracarmāmbaradharā vyālayajñopavītinī || 14.35 || vṛścikairagnipuñjābhairgonasaiśca vibhūṣitā | trailokyaṃ pūrayāmāsa vistāreṇocchrayeṇa ca || 14.36 || bhāsurāṅgā tu saṃvṛttā kṛṣṇasarpaikakuṇḍalā | citradaṇḍodyatakarā vyāghracarmopasevitā || 14.37 || vyavardhata mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇī | sṛkkiṇī lelihānā ca krūraphūtkārakāriṇī || 14.38 || vyāttāsyā ghurghurārāvā jagatsaṃkṣobhakāriṇī | kheladbhūtānugā krūrā niḥśvāsocchvāsakāriṇī || 14.39 || jātāṭṭaahāsā durnāsā vahnikuṇḍasamekṣaṇā | prodyatkilakilārāvā dadāha sakalaṃ jagat || 14.40 || dahyamānāḥ surāstatra patanti dharaṇītale | patanti yakṣagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ || 14.41 || patanti bhūtasaṅghāśca hāhāhaihaivirāviṇaḥ | bumbāpātaiḥ sanirghātairuditārtasvarairapi || 14.42 || vyāptamāsīttadā viśvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | saṃpatadbhiḥ patadbhiśca jvaladbhūtagaṇairmahī || 14.43 || jātaiścaṭacaṭāśabdaiḥ patadbhirgirisānubhiḥ | tatra raudrotsave jātā rudrānandavivardhinī || 14.44 || vihiṃsamānā bhūtāni carvamāṇācarānapi | tattadgandhamupādāya śivārāvavirāviṇī || 14.45 || galacchoṇitadhārābhimukhā digdhakalevarā | caṇḍaśīlābhavaccaṇḍī jagatsaṃhārakarmaṇi || 14.46 || ye'pi prāptā maharlokaṃ bhṛgvādyāśca maharṣayaḥ | te'pi naśyanti śataśo brahmakṣattraviśādayaḥ || 14.47 || devāsurā bhayatrastāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | viśanti ke'pi pātālaṃ līyante ca guhādiṣu || 14.48 || sā ca devī diśaḥ sarvā vyāpya mṛtyuriva sthitā | yugakṣayakare kāle devena viniyojitā || 14.49 || ekāpi navadhā jātā daśadhā daśadhā tathā | catuḥṣaṣṭisvarūpā ca śatarūpāṭṭahāsinī || 14.50 || jajñe sahasrarūpā ca lakṣakoṭitanuḥ śivā | nānārūpāyudhākārā nānāvādanacāriṇī || 14.51 || evaṃrūpā'bhavaddevī śivasyānujñayā nṛpa | dikṣu sarvāsu gagane vikaṭāyudhaśīlinaḥ || 14.52 || rundhanto naśyamānāṃstāngaṇā māheśvarāḥ sthitāḥ | vicaranti tayā sārddhaṃ śūlapaṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ || 14.53 || tato mātṛgaṇāḥ kecidvināyakagaṇaiḥ saha | vyavardhanta mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇaḥ || 14.54 || tatastasyā vyavardhanta daṃṣṭrāḥ kundendusannibhāḥ | yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ayutānyarbudāni ca || 14.55 || daṃṣṭrāvaliḥ kararuhāḥ krūrāstīkṣṇāśca karkaśāḥ | viyaddiśo likhantyeva saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām || 14.56 || tasyā daṃṣṭrābhisampātaiścūrṇitā vanaparvatāḥ | śilāsaṃcayasaṃghātā viśīryate sahasraśaḥ || 14.57 || himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ | mālyavāṃścaiva nīlaśca śvetaścaiva mahāgiriḥ || 14.58 || merumadhyamilāpīṭhaṃ saptadvīpaṃ ca sārṇavam | lokālokena sahitaṃ prākampata nṛpottama || 14.59 || daṃṣṭrāśanivispṛṣṭāśca viśīryante mahādrumāḥ | utpātaiśca diśo vyāptā ghorarūpaiḥ samantataḥ || 14.60 || tārā grahagaṇāḥ sarve ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ | śivāsahasrairākīrṇā mahāmātṛgaṇaistathā || 14.61 || sā cacāra jagatkṛtsnaṃ yugānte samupasthite | bhramadbhiśca bruvadbhiśca krośadbhiśca samantataḥ || 14.62 || pramathadbhirjvaladbhiśca raudrairvyāptā diśo daśa | vistīrṇaṃ śailasaṅghātaṃ vighūrṇitagiridrumam || 14.63 || prabhinnagopuradvāraṃ keśaśuṣkāsthisaṃkulam | pradagdhagrāmanagaraṃ bhasmapuṃjābhisaṃvṛtam || 14.64 || citādhūmākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | hāhākārākulaṃ sarvamahahasvananisvanam || 14.65 || jagadetadabhūtsarvamaśaraṇyaṃ nirāśrayam || 14.66 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kalpānukathane kālarātrikṛtajagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.15>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato mātṛsahasraiśca raudraiśca parivāritā | kālarātrirjagatsarvaṃ harate dīptalocanā || 15.1 || tatastā mātaro ghorā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikāḥ | vāyvindrānalakauberā yamatoyeśaśaktayaḥ || 15.2 || skandakroḍanṛsiṃhānāṃ vicarantyo bhayānakāḥ | cakraśūlagadākhaḍgavajraśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ || 15.3 || khaṭvāṅgairulmukairdīptairvyacaranmātaraḥ kṣaye | umāsaṃnoditā sarvāḥ pradhāvantyo diśo daśa || 15.4 || tāsāṃ caraṇavikṣepairhuṅkārodgāranisvanaiḥ | trailokyametatsakalaṃ vipradagdhaṃ samantataḥ || 15.5 || hāhāravākranditanisvanaiśca prabhinnarathyāgṛhagopuraiśca | babhūva ghorā dharaṇī samantātkapālakośākulakarburāṅgī || 15.6 || yadetacchatasāhasraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ nigadyate | sarvameva taducchannaṃ samādhṛṣya nṛpottama || 15.7 || jambuṃ śākaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ gomedaṃ śālmalistathā | puṣkaradvīpasahitā ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ || 15.8 || te grastā mṛtyunā sarve bhūtairmātṛgaṇaistathā | mahāsurakapālaiśca māṃsamedovasotkaṭaiḥ || 15.9 || rudhirodgāraśoṇāṅgī mahāmāyā subhīṣaṇā | pibantī rudhiraṃ tatra mahāmāṃsavasāpriyā || 15.10 || kapālahastā vikaṭā bhakṣayantī surāsurān | nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca viparītā mahāravā || 15.11 || trailokyasaṃtrāsakarī vidyutsaṃsphoṭahāsinī | saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca medinīm || 15.12 || tataḥ svasthānamagamadyatra devo maheśvaraḥ | narmadātīramāśrityāvasanmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha || 15.13 || amarāṇāṃ kaṭe tuṅge nṛtyantī hasitānanā | amarā devatāḥ proktāḥ śarīraṃ kaṭamucyate || 15.14 || taiḥ kaṭairāvṛto yasmātparvato'yaṃ nṛpottama | chinnabhinnāsthinikarairvasāmedo'sraviplutaiḥ || 15.15 || amaraṃkaṭa ityevaṃ tena prokto manīṣibhiḥ | mahāpavitro lokeṣu śambhunā sa vinirmitaḥ || 15.16 || nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra śaṅkaro hyumayā saha | tato'haṃ niyatastatra tasya pādāgrasaṃsthitaḥ || 15.17 || prahvaḥ praṇatabhāvena staumi taṃ nīlalohitam | tatastālakasampātairgaṇairmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha || 15.18 || saṃpranṛtyati saṃhṛṣṭo mṛtyunā saha śaṅkaraḥ | khaṭvāṅgairulmukaiścaiva paṭṭiśaiḥ parighaistathā || 15.19 || māṃsamedovasāhastā hṛṣṭā nṛtyanti saṃghaśaḥ | vāmanā jaṭilā muṇḍā lambagrīvoṣṭhamūrddhajāḥ || 15.20 || mahāśiśnodarabhujā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca | vikṛtairānanairghorairarbhujolbaṇamukhādibhiḥ || 15.21 || amaraṃ kaṇṭakaṃ cakruḥ prāpte kālaviparyaye | teṣāṃ madhye mahāghoraṃ jagatsantrāsakāraṇam || 15.22 || mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi nṛtyantaṃ taḍitpiṅgalamūrddhajam | tasya pārśve sthitāṃ devīṃ vimalāmbarabhūṣitām || 15.23 || kuṇḍalodghuṣṭagaṇḍāṃ tāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm | vicitrairupahāraiśca pūjayantīṃ maheśvaram || 15.24 || apaśyaṃ narmadāṃ tatra mātaraṃ viśvavanditām | nānātaraṅgāṃ sāvartāṃ suvelārṇavasaṃnibhām || 15.25 || mahāsaraḥsaritpātairadṛśyāṃ dṛśyarūpiṇīm | vandyamānāṃ suraiḥ siddhairmunisaṅghaiśca bhārata || 15.26 || etasminnantare ghorāṃ saptasaptakasaṃjñitām | mahāvīcyaughaphenāḍhyāṃ kurvantīṃ sajalaṃ jagat || 15.27 || dṛṣṭavānnarmadāṃ devīṃ mṛgakṛṣṇāmbarāṃ punaḥ | sadhūmāśaninirhrādairvahantīṃ saptadhā tadā || 15.28 || iti saṃhāramatulaṃ dṛṣṭavānrājasattama | naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇamabhūdetaccarācaram || 15.29 || mahotpātasamudbhūtaṃ naṣṭanakṣatramaṇḍalam | alātacakravattūrṇamaśeṣaṃ bhrāmayaṃstataḥ || 15.30 || vimānakoṭisaṃkīrṇaḥ sa kiṃnaramahoragaḥ | mahāvātaḥ sanirghāto yenākampaccarācaram || 15.31 || rudravaktrātsamudbhūtaḥ saṃvarto nāma viśrutaḥ | vāyuḥ saṃśoṣayāmāsa vitatan saptasāgarān || 15.32 || uddhūlitāṅgaḥ kapilākṣamūrddhajo jaṭākalāpairavabaddhamūrddhajaḥ | mahāravo dīptaviśālaśūladhṛksa pātu yuṣmāṃśca dine dine haraḥ || 15.33 || śūlī dhanuṣmānkavacī kirīṭī śmaśānabhasmokṣitasarvagātraḥ | kapālamālākulakaṇṭhanālo mahāhisūtrairavabaddhamauliḥ || 15.34 || sa gonasaughaiḥ pariveṣṭitāṅgo viṣāgnicandrāmarasindhumauliḥ | pinākakhaṇṭūvāṅgakarālapāṇiḥ sa kṛttivāsā ḍamarupraṇādaḥ || 15.35 || sa saptalokāntaraniḥsṛtātmā mahabhujāveṣṭitasarvagātraḥ | netreṇa sūryodayasannibhena pravālakāṅkūranibhodareṇa || 15.36 || sandhyābhraraktotpalapadmarāgasindūravidyutprakarāruṇena | tatena liṅgena ca locanena cikrīḍamānaḥ sa yugāntakāle || 15.37 || hiraṇmayenaiva samutsṛjan sa daṇḍena yadvadbhagavān sameruḥ | pādāgravikṣepaviśīrṇaśailaḥ kurvañjagatso'pi jagāma tatra || 15.38 || saṃhartukāmastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ pramuñcamāno vikṛtāṭṭahāsam | jahāra sarvaṃ tridivaṃ mahātmā saṃkṣobhayanvai jagadīśa ekaḥ || 15.39 || taṃ devamīśānamajaṃ vareṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatsaṃharaṇaṃ maheśam | sā kālarātriḥ saha mātṛbhiśca gaṇāśca sarve śivamarcayanti || 15.40 || nandī ca bhṛṅgī ca gaṇādayaśca taṃ sarvabhūtaṃ praṇamanti devam | jāgadvaraṃ sarvajanasya kāraṇaṃ haraṃ smarārātimaharniśaṃ te || 15.41 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇasaṃrambhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.16>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca samātṛbhirbhūtagaṇaśca ghorairvṛtaḥ samantātsa nanarta śūlī | gajendracarmāvaraṇe vasānaḥ saṃhartukāmaśca jagatsamastam || 16.1 || maheśvaraḥ sarvasureśvarāṇāṃ mantrairanekekhabaddhamālī | medovasāraktavicarcitāṅgastrailokyadāhe praṇanarta śambhuḥ || 16.2 || sa kālarātryā sahito mahātmā kāle trilokīṃ sakalāṃ jahāra | saṃvartakākhyaḥ sahabhānubhāvaḥ śambhurmahātmā jagato variṣṭhaḥ || 16.3 || sa visphuliṅgotkaradhūmamiśraṃ maholkavajrāśanivātatulyam | tato'ṭṭahāsaṃ pramumoca ghoraṃ vivṛtya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābham || 16.4 || sahasravajrāśanisaṃnibhena tenāṭṭahāsena harodgatena | āpūritāstatra diśo daśaiva saṃkṣobhitāḥ sarvamahārṇavāśca || 16.5 || sa brahmalokaṃ prajagāma śabdo brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ pracacāla sarvam | kimetadityākulacetanāste vitrastarūpā ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ || 16.6 || praṇamya sarve sahasaiva bhītā brahmāṇamūcuḥ parameśvareśam | bhītāśca sarve ṛṣayastataste surāsuraiścaiva mahoragaiśca || 16.7 || vidyutprabhābhāsurabhīṣaṇāṅgaḥ ka eṣa cikrīḍati bhūtalasthaḥ | kālānalaṃ gātramidaṃ dadhāno yasyāṭṭahāsena jagadvimūḍham || 16.8 || vitrastarūpaṃ prababhau kṣaṇena saṃhartumicchetkimayaṃ trilokīm | sārdhaṃ tvayā saptabhirarṇakaiśca janastapaḥ satyamabhiprayāti || 16.9 || saṃhartukāmo hi ka eṣa deva etatsamastaṃ kathayāprameya | na dṛṣṭametadviṣamaṃ kadāpi jānāsi tattvaṃ paramo mato naḥ || 16.10 || niśamya tadvākyamathābabhāṣe brahmā samāśvāsya surādisaṅghān || 16.11 || śrībrahmovāca sa eṣa kālastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ saṃhartukāmo jagadakṣayātmā | pūrṇe ca śete parivatsarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyatīśānavibhurna citram || 16.12 || saṃvatsaro'yaṃ parivatsaraśca udvatsaro vatsara eṣa devaḥ | dṛṣṭo'pyadṛṣṭaḥ prahutaḥ prakāśī sthūlaśca sūkṣmaḥ paramāṇureṣaḥ || 16.13 || nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcidihāsti loke parāparo'yaṃ prabhurātmavādī | tuṣyeta me kālasamānarūpa ityevamuktvā bhagavānsureśaḥ || 16.14 || sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sametaḥ saṃtoṣayāmāsa tato yatātmā || 16.15 || brahmovāca namo'stu sarvāya suśāntamūrtāye hyaghorarūpāya namonamaste | sarvātmane sarva namonamaste mahātmane bhūtapate namaste || 16.16 || oṅkāra huṅkārapariṣkṛtāya svadhāvaṣaṭkāra namonamaste | guṇatrayeśāya maheśvarāya te trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ || 16.17 || tvaṃ śaṅkaratvaṃ hi maheśvaro'si pradhānamagryaṃ tvamasi praviṣṭaḥ | tvaṃ viṣṇurīśaḥ prapitāmahaśca tvaṃ saptajihvastvamanantajihvaḥ || 16.18 || sraṣṭāsi sṛṣṭiśca vibho tvameva viśvasya vedyaṃ ca paraṃ nidhānam | āhurdvijā vedavido vareṇyaṃ parātparastvaṃ parataḥ paro'si || 16.19 || sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ pravadanti yacca vāco nivartanti mano yataśca || 16.20 || śrīmahādeva uvāca tvayā stuto'haṃ vividhaiśca mantraiḥ puṣṇāmi śāntiṃ tava padmayone | īkṣasva māṃ lokamimaṃ jvalantaṃ vaktrairanekaiḥ prasabhaṃ harantam || 16.21 || evamuktvā sa deveśo devyā saha jagatpatiḥ | pitāmahaṃ samāśvāsya tatraivāntaradhīyata || 16.22 || idaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ variṣṭhaṃ stotraṃ niśamyeha gatiṃ labhante | pāpairanekaiḥ pariveṣṭitā ye prayānti rudraṃ vimalairvimānaiḥ || 16.23 || bhayaṃ ca teṣāṃ na bhavetkadācitpaṭhanti ye tāta idaṃ dvijāgryāḥ | saṅgrāmacaurāgnivane tathābdhau teṣāṃ śivastrāti na saṃśayo'tra || 16.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye brahmakṛtaśivastutivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.17>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu brahmādyairmunipuṃgavaiḥ | brahmalokagataistatra saṃjahāra jagatprabhuḥ || 17.1 || sa tadbhīmaṃ mahāraudraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktramavyayam | mahādaṃṣṭrotkaṭārāvaṃ pātālatalasaṃnibham || 17.2 || vidyujjvalanapiṅgākṣaṃ bhairavaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | mahājihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahāsarpaśirodharam || 17.3 || mahāsuraśiromālaṃ mahāpralayakāraṇam | grasatsamudranihitavātavārimayaṃ haviḥ || 17.4 || vaḍavāmukhasaṅkāśaṃ mahādevasya tanmukham | jihvāgreṇa jagatsarvaṃ lelihānamapaśyata || 17.5 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca | diśo daśa mahāghorā māṃsamedovasotkaṭāḥ || 17.6 || tasya daṃṣṭrā vyavardhata śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | sāsurānsuragandharvān sayakṣoragarākṣasān || 17.7 || tasya daṃṣṭrāgrasaṃlagnānsa dadarśa pitāmahaḥ | dantayantrāntasaṃviṣṭaṃ vicūrṇitaśirodharam || 17.8 || jagatpaśyāmi rājendra viśantaṃ vyādite mukhe | nānātaraṅgabhaṅgāṅgā mahāphenaughasaṃkulāḥ | yathā nadyo layaṃ yānti samudraṃ prāpya sasvanāḥ || 17.9 || tathā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastamanekajīvārṇavadurvigāhyam | viveśa rudrasya mukhaṃ viśālaṃ jvalattadugraṃ ghananādaghoram || 17.10 || jvālāstatastasya mukhātsughorāḥ savisphuliṅgā bahulāḥ sadhūmāḥ | anekarūpā jvalanaprakāśāḥ pradīpayantīva diśo'khilāśca || 17.11 || tato ravijvālasahasramāli babhūva vaktraṃ calajihvadaṃṣṭram | maheśvarasyādbhutarūpiṇastadā sa dvādaśātmā prababhūva ekaḥ || 17.12 || tataste dvādaśādityā rudravaktrādvinirgatāḥ | āśritya dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ nirdahanto vasuṃdharām || 17.13 || bhaumaṃ yajjīvanaṃ kiṃcinnānāvṛkṣatṛṇālayam | śuṣkaṃ pūrvamanāvṛṣṭyā sakalākulabhūtalam || 17.14 || taddīpyamānaṃ sahasā sūryaistai rudrasambhavaiḥ | dhūmākulamabhūtsarvaṃ praṇaṣṭagrahatārakam || 17.15 || jajvāla sahasā dīptaṃ bhūmaṇḍalamaśeṣataḥ | jvālāmālākulaṃ
