sarvamabhūdetaccarācaram || 17.16 || saptadvīpasamudreṣu saritsu ca sarassu ca agniratti jagatsarvamājyāhutimivādhvare || 17.17 || viśālatejasā dīptā mahājvālāsamākulāḥ | dadahurvai jagatsarvamādityā rudrasambhavāḥ || 17.18 || ādityānāṃ raśmayaśca saṃspṛṣṭā vai parasparam | evaṃ dadāha bhagavāṃstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 17.19 || saptadvīpapramāṇastu so'gnirbhūtvā maheśvaraḥ | saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ nirdadāha vasuṃdharām || 17.20 || sumerumandarāntāṃ ca nirdahurvasudhāṃ tadā | bhittvā tu saptapātālaṃ nāgalokaṃ tato'dahat || 17.21 || bhūmyadhaḥ saptapātālānnirdahaṃstārakaiḥ saha | cacārāgniḥ samantāttu nirdahanvai yudhiṣṭhira || 17.22 || dhamyamāna ivāṅgārairloharātririva jvalan | tathā tatprājvalatsarvaṃ saṃvartāgnipradīpitam || 17.23 || nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmirnirnirjharasaraḥ sarit | viśīrṇaśailaśṛṅgaughā kūrmapṛṣṭhopamābhavat || 17.24 || jvālāmālākulaṃ kṛtvā jagatsarvaṃ cidāmakam | mahārūpadharo rudro vyatiṣṭhata maheśvaraḥ || 17.25 || samātṛgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā sayakṣoragarākṣasā | tato devī mahādevaṃ viveśa harilocanā || 17.26 || nirvāṇaṃ paramāpannā śānteva śikhinaḥ śikhā | jagatsarvaṃ hi nirdagdhaṃ tribhirlokaiḥ sahānagha || 17.27 || rudraprasādānmuktvā māṃ narmadāṃ cāpyayonijām | yugānāmayutaṃ devo mayā cādya bubhakṣaṇāt || 17.28 || purā hyārādhitaḥ śūlī tenāhamajarāmaraḥ | aghamarṣaṇaghoraṃ ca vāmadevaṃ ca tryambakam || 17.29 || ṛṣabhaṃ trisuparṇaṃ ca durgāṃ sāvitrameva ca | bṛhadāraṇyakaṃ caiva bṛhatsāma tathottaram || 17.30 || raudrīṃ paramagāyatrīṃ śivopaniṣadaṃ tathā | yathā pratirathaṃ sūktaṃ japtvā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tathā || 17.31 || saritsāgaraparyantā vasudhā bhasmasātkṛtā | varjayitvā mahābhāgāṃ narmadāmamṛtopamām || 17.32 || mahendro malayaḥ sahyo hemakūṭo'tha mālyavān | vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ || 17.33 || dvādaśādityanirdagdhāḥ śailāḥ śīrṇaśilāḥ pṛthak | bhasmībhūtāstu dṛśyante na naṣṭā narmadā tadā || 17.34 || himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ | mālyavāṃśca giriśreṣṭho nīlaḥ śveto'tha śṛṅgavān || 17.35 || ete parvatarā jāno devagandharvasevitāḥ | yugāntāgnivinirdagdhāḥ sarve śīrṇamahāśilāḥ || 17.36 || evaṃ mayā purā dṛṣṭo yugānte sarvasaṃkṣayaḥ | varjayitvā mahāpuṇyāṃ narmadāṃ nṛpasattama || 17.37 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye dvādaśādityarūpeṇa jagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.18>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca nirdagdhe'smiṃstato loke sūryairīśvarasambhavaiḥ | saptabhiścārṇavaiḥ śuṣkairdvīpaiḥ saptabhireva ca || 18.1 || tato mukhāttasya ghanā maholbaṇā niścerurindrāyudhatulyarūpāḥ | ghorāḥ payodā jagadandhakāraṃ kurvanta īśānavaraprayuktāḥ || 18.2 || nīlotpalābhāḥ kvacidaṃjanābhā gokṣīrakundendunibhāśca kecit | mayūracandrākṛtayastathā'nye kecidvidhūmānalasaprabhāśca || 18.3 || kecinmahāparvatakalparūpāḥ kecinmahāmīnakulopamāśca | kecidgajendrākṛtayaḥ surūpāḥ kecinmahākūṭanibhāḥ payodāḥ || 18.4 || calattaraṅgormisamānarūpā mahāpurodhānanibhāśca kecit | sagopurāṭṭālakasaṃnikāśāḥ savidyudulkāśanimaṇḍitāntāḥ || 18.5 || samāvṛtāṅgaḥ sa babhūva devaḥ saṃvartakonāma gaṇaḥ sa raudraḥ | pravarṣamāṇo jagadapramāṇamekārṇavaṃ sarvamidaṃ cakāra || 18.6 || tato mahāmeghavivardhamānamīśānamindrāśanibhirvṛtāṅgam | dadarśa nāhaṃ bhayavihvalāṅgo gaṅgājalaughaiśca samāvṛtāṅgaḥ || 18.7 || gajāḥ punaścaiva punaḥ pibanto jagatsamantātparidahyamānam | āpūritaṃ caiva jagatsamantātsarvaiśca tairjagmuradarśanaṃ ca te || 18.8 || mahārṇavāḥ sapta sarāṃsi dvīpā nadyo'tha sarvā atha bhūrbhuvaśca | āpūryamāṇāḥ salilaughajālairekārṇavaṃ sarvamidaṃ babhūva || 18.9 || na dṛśyate kiṃcidaho carācaraṃ niragnicandrārkamaye'pi loke | praṇaṣṭanakṣatratamo'ndhakāre praśāntavātāstamitaikanīḍeḥ || 18.10 || mahājalaughe'sya viśuddhasattvā stutirmayā bhūpa kṛtā tadānīm | tato'hamityeva vicintayānaḥ śaraṇyamekaṃ kva nu yāmi śāntam || 18.11 || smarāmi devaṃ hṛdi cintayitvā prabhuṃ śaraṇyaṃ jalasaṃniviṣṭaḥ | namāmi devaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye dhyānaṃ ca tasyeti kṛtaṃ mayā ca || 18.12 || dhyātvā tato'haṃ salilaṃ tatāra tasya prasādādavimūḍhacetāḥ | glāniḥ śramaścaiva mama praṇaṣṭau devyāḥ prasādena narendraputra || 18.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.19>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatastvekārṇave tasminmumūrṣurahamāturaḥ | kākūcchvāsastaraṃstoyaṃ bāhubhyāṃ nṛpasattama || 19.1 || śṛṇomyarṇavamadhyastho niḥśabdastimite tadā | ambhoravamanaupamyaṃ diśo daśa vinādinam || 19.2 || haṃsakudendusaṃkāśāṃ hāragokṣīrapāṇḍurām | nānāratnavicitrāṅgīṃ svarṇaśṛṅgāṃ manoramām || 19.3 || suraiḥ pravālakamayairlāṅguladhvajaśobhitām | pralambaghoṇāṃ nardantīṃ khurairarṇavagāhinīm || 19.4 || gāṃ dadarśāhamudvigno māmevābhimukhīṃ sthitām | kiṃkiṇījālamuktābhiḥ svarṇaghaṇṭāsamāvṛtām || 19.5 || tasyāścaraṇavikṣepaiḥ sarvamekārṇavaṃ jalam | vikṣiptaphenapuñjaughairnṛtyantīva samaṃ tataḥ || 19.6 || rarāsa salilotkṣepaiḥ kṣobhayantī mahārṇavam | sā māmāha mahābhāga ślakṣṇagambhīrayā girā || 19.7 || mā bhaiṣīrvatsa vatseti mṛtyustava na vidyate | mahādevaprasādena na mṛtyuste mamāpi ca || 19.8 || mamāśrayasva lāṅgūlaṃ tvāmatastārayāmyaham | ghorādasmādbhayādvipra yāvatsaṃplavate jagat || 19.9 || kṣuttṛṣāpratighātārthaṃ stanau me tvaṃ pibasva ha | payo'mṛtāśrayaṃ divyaṃ tatpītvā nirvṛto bhava || 19.10 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣātpīto mayā stanaḥ | na kṣuttṛṣā pītamātre stane mahyaṃ tadābhavat || 19.11 || divyaṃ prāṇabalaṃ jajñe samudraplavanakṣamam | tatastāṃ pratyuvācedaṃ kā tvamekārṇavīkṛte || 19.12 || bhramase brūhi tattvena vismayo me mahānhṛdi | bhramato'tra mamārtasya mumūrṣoḥ prahatasya || 19.13 || tvaṃ hi me śaraṇaṃ jātā bhāgyaśeṣeṇa suvrate || 19.14 || gauruvāca kimahaṃ vismṛtā tubhyaṃ viśvarūpā maheśvarī | narmadā dharmadā nḥṇāṃ svargaśarmabalapradā || 19.15 || dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ sīdamānaṃ tu rudreṇāhaṃ visarjitā | taṃ dvijaṃ tārayasvārye mā prāṇāṃstyajatāṃ jale || 19.16 || gorūpeṇa vibhorvākyāttvatsakāśamihāgatā | mā mṛṣāvacanaḥ śambhurbhavediti ca satvarā || 19.17 || evamuktastayāhaṃ tu indrāyudhanibhaṃ śubham | lāṅgūlamavyayaṃ jñātvā bhujābhyāmavalambitaḥ || 19.18 || tato'taraṃ taṃ jaladhiṃ lāṅgūladhvajamāśritaḥ | asau devo mahādeva iti māṃ pratyabhāṣata || 19.19 || tato yugasahasrāntamahaṃ kālaṃ tayā saha | vyacaraṃ vai tamobhūte sarvataḥ salilāvṛte || 19.20 || mahārṇave tatastasmin bhramangoḥ pucchamāśritaḥ | nirvāte cāndhakāre ca nirāloke nirāmaye || 19.21 || akasmātsalile tasminnatasīpuṣpasannibham | vibhinnāṃjanasaṅkāśamākāśamiva nirmalam || 19.22 || nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamavyayam | kirīṭenārkavarṇena vidyudvidyotakāriṇā || 19.23 || bhrājamānena śirasā khamivātyantarūpiṇam | kuṇḍaloddhaṣṭagallaṃ tu hāroddyotitavakṣasam || 19.24 || jāmbūnadamayairdivyairbhūṣaṇairupaśobhitam | nāgopadhānaśayanaṃ sahasrādityavarcasam || 19.25 || anekabāhūrudharaṃ naikavaktraṃ manoramam | suptamekārṇave vīraṃ sahasrākṣaśirodharam || 19.26 || jaṭājūṭena mahatā sphuradvidyutsamārciṣā | ekārṇavaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vyāpya devaṃ vyavasthitam || 19.27 || grasitvā śaṅkaraḥ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānavam | prapaśyāmyahamīśānaṃ suptamekārṇave prabhum || 19.28 || sarvavyāpinamavyaktamanantaṃ viśvatomukham | tasya pādatalābhyāśe svarṇakeyūramaṇḍitām || 19.29 || viśvarūpāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viśvamāyāvadhāriṇīm | śrīmayīṃ hrīmayīṃ devīṃ dhīmayīṃ vāṅmayīṃ śivām || 19.30 || siddhiṃ kīrtiṃ ratiṃ brāhmīṃ kālarātrimayonijām | tāmevāhaṃ tadātyantamīśvarāntikamāsthitām || 19.31 || adrākṣaṃ candravadanāṃ dhṛtiṃ sarveśvarīmumām || 19.32 || śāntaṃ prasuptaṃ navahemavarṇamumāsahāyaṃ bhagavantamīśam | tamovṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ vīraṣṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskaromi || 19.33 || tataḥ prasuptaḥ sahasā vibuddho rātrikṣaye devavaraḥ svabhāvāt | vikṣobhayan bāhubhirarṇavāmbho jagatpraṇaṣṭaṃ salile vimṛśya || 19.34 || kiṃ kāryamityeva vicintayitvā vārāharūpo'bhavadadbhutāṅgaḥ | mahāghanāmbhodharatulyavarcāḥ pralambamālāmbaraniṣkamālī || 19.35 || saśaṅkhacakrāsidharaḥ kirīṭī savedavedāṅgamayo mahātmā | trailokyanirmāṇakaraḥ purāṇo devatrayīrūpadharaśca kārye || 19.36 || sa eva rudraḥ sa jagajjahāra sṛṣṭyarthamīśaḥ prapitāmaho'bhūt | saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jagataḥ sa eva hariḥ sucakrāsigadābjapāṇiḥ || 19.37 || teṣāṃ vibhāgo na hi kartumarho mahātmanāmekaśarīrabhājām | mīmāṃsāhetvarthaviśeṣatarkairyasteṣu kuryātpravibhedamajñaḥ || 19.38 || sa yāti ghoraṃ narakaṃ krameṇa vibhāgakṛddveṣamatirdurātmā | yā yasya bhaktiḥ sa tayaiva nūnaṃ dehaṃ tyajan svaṃ hyamṛtatvameti || 19.39 || saṃmohayanmūrtibhiratra lokaṃ sraṣṭā ca goptā kṣayakṛtsa devaḥ | tasmānna mohātmakamāviśeta dveṣaṃ na kuryātpravibhinnamūrtiḥ || 19.40 || vārāhamīśānavaro'pyato'sau rūpaṃ samāsthāya jagadvidhātā | naṣṭe triloke'rṇavatoyamagne vimārgitoyaughamaye'ntarātmā || 19.41 || bhittvārṇavaṃ toyamathāntarasthaṃ viveśa pātālatalaṃ kṣaṇena | jale nimagnāṃ dharaṇīṃ samastāṃ samaspṛśatpaṅkajapatranetrām || 19.42 || viśīrṇaśailopalaśṛṅgakūṭāṃ vasuṃdharāṃ tāṃ pralaye pralīnām | daṃṣṭraikayā viṣṇuratulyasāhasaḥ samuddadhāra svayameva devaḥ || 19.43 || sā tasya daṃṣṭrāgravilambitāṅgī kailāsaśṛṅgāgragateva jyotsnā | vibhrājate sāpyasamānamūrtiḥ śaśāṅkaśṛṅge ca taḍidvilagnā || 19.44 || tāmujjahārārṇavatoyamagnāṃ karī nimagnāmiva hastinīṃ haṭhāt | nāvaṃ viśīrṇāmiva toyamadhyādudīrṇasattvo'nupamaprabhāvaḥ || 19.45 || sa tāṃ samuttārya mahājalaughātsamudramāryo vyabhajatsamastam | mahārṇaveṣveva mahārṇavāmbho nikṣepayāmāsa punarnadīṣu || 19.46 || śīrṇāṃśca śailānsa cakāra bhūyo dvīpānsamastāṃśca tathārṇavāṃśca | śailopalairye vicitāḥ samantācchiloccayāṃstānsa cakāra kalpe || 19.47 || anekarūpaṃ pravibhajya dehaṃ cakāra devendragaṇānsamastān | mukhācca vahnirmanasaśca candraścakṣośca sūryaḥ sahasā babhūva || 19.48 || jajñe'tha tasyeśvarayogamūrteḥ pradhyāyamānasya surendrasaṅghaḥ | vedāśca yajñāśca tathaiva varṇāstathā hi sarvauṣadhayo rasāśca || 19.49 || jagatsamastaṃ manasā babhūva yatsthāvaraṃ kiṃcidihāṇḍajaṃ vā | jarāyujaṃ svedajamudbhijjaṃ vā yatkiṃcidā kīṭapipīlakādyam || 19.50 || tato vijajñe manasā kṣaṇena anekarūpāḥ sahasā maheśā | cakāra yanmūrtibhiravyayātmā aṣṭābhirāviśya punaḥ sa tatra || 19.51 || līlāṃ cakārātha samṛddhatejā ato'tra me paśyata eva viprāḥ | teṣāṃ mayā darśanameva sarvaṃ yāvanmuhūrtātsamakāri bhūpa || 19.52 || kṛtvā tvaśeṣaṃ kila līlayaiva sa devadevo jagatāṃ vidhātā | sarvatradṛksarvaga eva devo jagāma cādarśanamādikartā || 19.53 || yattanmuhūrtādiha nāmarūpaṃ tāvatprapaśyāmi jagattathaiva | dvīpaiḥ samudrairabhisaṃvṛtaṃ hi nakṣatratārādivimānakīrṇam || 19.54 || viyatpayodagrahacakracitraṃ nānāvidhaiḥ prāṇigaṇairvṛtaṃ ca | tāṃ vai na paśyāmi mahānubhāvāṃ gorūpiṇīṃ sarvasureśvarīṃ ca || 19.55 || kva sāṃprataṃ seti vicintya rājanvibhrāntacittastvabhavaṃ tadaiva | diśo vibhāgānavalokayānṛte punastāṃ kathamīśvarāṅgīm || 19.56 || paśyāmi tāmatra punaśca śubhrāṃ mahābhranīlāṃ śuciśubhratoyām | vṛkṣairanekairupaśobhitāṅgīṃ gajaisturaṅgairvihagairvṛtāṃ ca || 19.57 || yathā purātīramupetya devyāḥ samāsthitaścāpyamarakaṇṭake tu | tathaiva paśyāmi sukhopaviṣṭa ātmānamavyagramavāptasaukhyam || 19.58 || tathaiva puṇyā malatoyavāhāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ kalpaparikṣaye'pi | ambāmivāryāmanukampamānāmakṣīṇatoyāṃ virujāṃ viśokaḥ || 19.59 || evaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ ca kalpaṃ paṭhanti śṛṇvanti ca ye dvijendrāḥ | mahāvarāhasya maheśvarasya dine dine te vimalā bhavanti || 19.60 || aśubhaśatasahasraṃ te vidhūya prapannāstridivamamarajuṣṭaṃ siddhagandharvayuktam | vimalaśaśinibhābhiḥ sarva evāpsarobhiḥ saha vividhavilāsaiḥ svargasaukhyaṃ labhante || 19.61 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye vārāhakalpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.20>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutā me vividhā dharmāḥ saṃhārāstvatprasādataḥ | kṛtā devena sarveṇa ye ca dṛṣṭāstvayānagha || 20.1 || sāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi prabhāvaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ | tvayānubhūtaṃ viprendra tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 20.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prajāsaṃhāralakṣaṇam | yaccihnaṃ dṛśyate tatra yathā kalpo vidhīyate || 20.3 || ulkāpātāḥ sanirghātā bhūmikampastathaiva ca | patate pāṃśuvarṣaṃ ca nirghoṣaścaiva dāruṇaḥ || 20.4 || yakṣakinnaragandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ | sarve te pralayaṃ yānti yugānte samupasthite || 20.5 || parvatāḥ sāgarā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi vividhāni ca | vṛkṣāḥ śeṣaṃ samāyānti vallījātaṃ tṛṇāni ca || 20.6 || evaṃ hi vyākulībhūte sarvauṣadhijalojjhite | kāṣṭhabhūte tu saṃjāte trailokye sacarācare || 20.7 || yāvatpaśyāmi madhyāhne snānakāla upasthite | trailokyaṃ jvalanākāraṃ durnirīkṣaṃ durāsadam || 20.8 || dvau sūryau pūrvatastāta paścimottarayostathā | tathaiva dakṣiṇe dvau ca sūryau dṛṣṭau pratāpinau || 20.9 || dvau sūryau nāgalokasthau madhye dvau gaganasya ca | ityete dvādaśādityāstapante sarvato diśam || 20.10 || pṛthivīmadahansarvāṃ saśailavanakānanām | nādagdhaṃ dṛśyate kiṃcidṛte revāṃ ca māṃ tathā || 20.11 || pṛthivyāṃ dahyamānāyāṃ havirgandhaśca jāyate | tato me śuṣyate gātraṃ tṛṣāpyevaṃ durāsadā || 20.12 || na hi vindāmi pānīyaṃ śoṣitaṃ ca divākaraiḥ | yāvatkamaṇḍaluṃ vīkṣe śuṣkaṃ tatrāpi tajjalam || 20.13 || tato'haṃ śokasaṃtapto viśeṣātkṣuttṛṣārditaḥ | utpapāta kṣiterūrdhvaṃ paśyamāno divaṃ prati || 20.14 || tāvatpaśyāmi gagane gṛhaṃ śṛṅgārabhūṣitam | tatastajjñātukāmo'haṃ prasthito rājasattama || 20.15 || prākāreṇa vicitreṇa kapāṭārgalabhūṣitam | vicitraśikharopetaṃ dvāradeśamupāgataḥ || 20.16 || ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ samucchraye | tadardhaṃ tu pṛthaktvena kāñcanaṃ ratnabhūṣitam || 20.17 || tatra madhye parāṃ śayyāṃ paśyāmi nṛpasattama | śayyopari śayānaṃ tu puruṣaṃ divyamūrdhajam || 20.18 || vikuñcitāgrakeśāntaṃ samastaṃ yojanāyatam | mukuṭena vicitreṇa dīptikāntena śobhitam || 20.19 || śyāmaṃ kamalapatrābhaṃ suprabhaṃ ca sunāsikam | siṃhāsyamāyatabhujaṃ gallaśmaśruvarāṅkitam || 20.20 || trivalībhaṅgasubhagaṃ karṇakuṇḍalabhūṣitam | viśālābhaṃ supīnāṅgaṃ pārśvasvāvartabhūṣitam || 20.21 || śobhitaṃ kaṭibhāgena vibhaktaṃ jānujaṅghayoḥ | padmāṅkitatalaṃ devamātāmrasunakhāṅgulim || 20.22 || meghanādasugambhīraṃ sarvāvayavasundaram | śayyāmadhyagataṃ devamapaśyaṃ puruṣottamam || 20.23 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ śayānaṃ dakṣiṇena tu | akṣasūtrodyatakaraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham || 20.24 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktimāndevaṃ stotukāmo vyavasthitaḥ | jayeśa jaya vāgīśa jaya divyāṅgabhūṣaṇa || 20.25 || jaya devapate śrīmansākṣādbrahma sanātana | tava lokāḥ śarīrasthāstvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvara || 20.26 || tvadādhārā hi deveśa sarve lokā vyavasthitāḥ | tvaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ tvaṃ kartā dharaṇīdharaḥ || 20.27 || tvaṃ hautramagnihotrāṇāṃ sūtramantrastvameva ca | gokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca tvaṃ ca māheśvaraṃ padam || 20.28 || tvaṃ kīrtiḥ sarvakīrtīnāṃ dainyapāpapraṇāśinī | tvaṃ naimiṣaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tvaṃ ca viṣṇupadaṃ param || 20.29 || tvayā tu līlayā deva padākrāntā ca medinī | tvayā baddho balirdeva tvayendrasya padaṃ kṛtam || 20.30 || tvaṃ kalirdvāparaṃ deva tretā kṛtayugaṃ tathā | pralambadamanaśca tvaṃ sraṣṭā tvaṃ ca vināśakṛt || 20.31 || tvayā vai dhāryate lokāstvaṃ kālaḥ sarvasaṃkṣayaḥ | tvayā hi deva sṛṣṭāstāḥ sarvā vai devayonayaḥ || 20.32 || tvaṃ panthāḥ sarvalokānāṃ tvaṃ ca mokṣaḥ parā gatiḥ | brahmā tvadudbhavo devo rajorūpaḥ sanātanaḥ | rudraḥ krodhodbhavo'pyevaṃ tvaṃ ca sattve vyavasthitaḥ || 20.33 || etaccarācaraṃ deva krīḍanārthaṃ tvayā kṛtam | evaṃ saṃtaptadehena stuto devo mayā prabhuḥ || 20.34 || bhaktyā paramayā rājansarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ | stuvanvai tatra paśyāmi vāripūrṇāṃstato ghaṭān || 20.35 || tato mayā vismṛtā yā tṛṣā sā vardhitā punaḥ | upāsarpaṃ tatastasya pārśvaṃ vai puruṣasya hi || 20.36 || pānīyaṃ pātukāmena cintitaṃ ca mayā punaḥ | nāpaśyata hi māṃ caiṣa supto'pi na ca budhyate || 20.37 || yastu pāpena saṃmūḍhaḥ sukhaṃ suptaṃ prabodhayet | jāyate tasya pāpasya brahmahatyāphalaṃ mahat || 20.38 || evaṃ saṃcintyamāne tu dvitīyo hyāgataḥ pumān | nekṣate jalpate kiṃcidvāmaskandhe mṛgājinī || 20.39 || jaṭī kamaṇḍaludharo daṇḍī mekhalayā vṛtaḥ | bhasmonmṛditasarvāṅgo mahātejāstrilocanaḥ || 20.40 || yāvattaṃ stotukāmo'hamapaśyaṃ svacchacakṣuṣā | tāvatsarvāṅgasambhūtyāmahatyā rūpasampadā || 20.41 || apaśyaṃ saṃvṛtāṃ nārīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ patito bhūmau jayasveti bruvaṃstataḥ || 20.42 || jaya rudrāṅgasambhūte jayavāhini sanātani | jaya kaumāri māhendri vaiṣṇavī vāruṇī tathā || 20.43 || jaya kauberi sāvitri jaya dhātri varānane | tṛṣṇayā taptade hasya rakṣāṃ kuru carācare || 20.44 || śrīdevyuvāca prasannā vipraśārdūla tava vākyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ | vartate mānase yatte mayā jñātaṃ dvijottama || 20.45 || śṛṇu vipra mamāpyasti vratametatsudāruṇam | strīlaghutvānmayārabdhaṃ duṣkaraṃ mandamedhayā || 20.46 || yadi bhāvī ca me putro dharmiṣṭho lokaviśrutaḥ | viprasya tu stanaṃ dattvā paścāddāsyāmi bālake || 20.47 || sa me putraḥ samutpanno yathokto me mahāmune | stanaṃ piba tvaṃ viprendra yadi jīvitumicchasi || 20.48 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca akāryametadviprāṇāṃ yastvimaṃ pibate stanam | punaścaivopanayanaṃ vratasiddhiṃ na gacchati || 20.49 || brāhmaṇatvaṃ tribhirlokairdurlabhaṃ padmalocane | saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto vipro yaiśca jāyeta tacchṛṇu || 20.50 || prathamaṃ caiva nārīṣu saṃskārairbījavāpatam | bījaprakṣepaṇādeva bījakṣepaḥ sa ucyate || 20.51 || tadante ca mahābhāge garbhādhānaṃ dvitīyakam | puṃsavanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu sīmantaṃ ca caturthakam || 20.52 || pañcamaṃ jātakarma syānnāma vai ṣaṣṭhamucyate | niṣkrāmaḥ saptamaścaiva hyannaprāśanamaṣṭamam || 20.53 || navamaṃ vai cūḍakarma daśamaṃ mauñjibandhanam | aiṣikaṃ dārvikaṃ caiva saumikaṃ bhaumikaṃ tathā || 20.54 || patnīsaṃyojanaṃ cānyaddaivakarma tataḥ param | mānuṣyaṃ pitṛkarma syāddaśamāṣṭāsu śobhane || 20.55 || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ tatheṣṭaṃ ca pārvaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param || 20.56 || śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāmāgrayaṇaṃ ca caitrāśvayujyāṃ daśapaurṇamāsyām | nirūḍhapaśusavanasautrāmaṇyagniṣṭomātyagniṣṭomāḥ || 20.57 || ṣoḍaṣīvājapeyātirātrāptoryāmodaśavājapeyāḥ | sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntiranasūyā śaucamaṅgalamakārpaṇyamaspṛheti || 20.58 || ebhiraṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhiḥ saṃskāraiḥ saṃkṛto brāhmaṇo bhavati || 20.59 || evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge na tu māṃ pātumarhasi | śiśupeyaṃ stanaṃ bhadre kathaṃ vai madvidhaḥ pibet || 20.60 || mamaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā nārī vacanamabravīt || 20.61 || yadi tvaṃ na pibeḥ stanyaṃ payo bālo mariṣyati | śrūyate triṣu lokeṣu vedeṣu ca smṛtiṣvapi | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo bhrūṇahatyā na muñcati || 20.62 || bhavitrī tava hatyā ca mahābhāgavataḥ punaḥ | janmāni ca śatānyaṣṭau kliśyate bhrūṇahatyayā || 20.63 || mṛtaḥ śunatvaṃ cāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ tu śatatrayam | tatastasya kṣaye jāte kākayoniṃ vrajetpunaḥ || 20.64 || tatrāpi ca śatānyaṣṭau kliśyate pāpakarmaṇi | varāho daśa janmāni tadante jāyate kṛmiḥ || 20.65 || tataścārohiṇīṃ prāpya gogajāśvanṛjanmabhāk | śrūyate śrutiśāstreṣu vedeṣu ca paraṃtapa || 20.66 || sarvapāpādhikaṃ pāpaṃ bālahatyā dvijottama | bālahatyāyuto vipraḥ pacyate narake dhruvam || 20.67 || varṣāṇi ca śatānyaṣṭau prāpnoti yamayātanām | tasmādalpataro doṣaḥ pibato me stanaṃ tava || 20.68 || tathaivāpibataḥ pāpaṃ jāyate bahuvarṣikam | kṣudhātṛṣāvirāmaste puṇyaṃ ca pibataḥ stanam || 20.69 || ato na cetaḥ saṃdigdhaṃ kartavyamiha karhicit | ehi vipra yathākāmaṃ bālārthe piba me stanam || 20.70 || tato'haṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā stanaṃ pātuṃ samudyataḥ | na ca tṛptiṃ vijānāmi pibataḥ stanamuttamam || 20.71 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi bhārataivaṃ śatāni ca | tataḥ prabuddhotsaṅge'haṃ māyānidrāvimohitaḥ || 20.72 || nidrāvigatamoho'haṃ yāvatpaśyāmi pāṇḍava | tāvatsuptaṃ na paśyāmi na ca taṃ bālakaṃ vibho || 20.73 || caturastāṃśca vai kumbhān paśyāmi tatra bhārata | na ca paśyāmi tāṃ devīṃ gatā vai kutracicca te || 20.74 || evaṃ vimṛśyamānasya cintayānasya tiṣṭhataḥ | īṣaddhasitayā vācā devī vacanamabravīt || 20.75 || śrīdevyuvāca kṛṣṇaḥ sa puruṣaḥ supto dvitīyo'pyāgato haraḥ | ye catvāraśca te kumbhāḥ samudrāste dvijottama || 20.76 || yaśca bālastvayā dṛṣṭo brāhmā lokapitāmahaḥ | ahaṃ ca pṛthivī jñeyā saptadvīpā sarvatā || 20.77 || yā gatā tvāṃ parityajya bhūtale supratiṣṭhitā | imāṃ ca prekṣase vipra narmadāṃ saritāṃ varām || 20.78 || sarvasattvopakārāya bṛhate puṇyalakṣaṇā | revānadī tu vikhyātā na mṛtā tena narmadā || 20.79 || evaṃ jñātvā śamaṃ gaccha svastho bhava mahāmune | ityuktvā māṃ tadā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata || 20.80 || evaṃ hi śete bhagavānsattvasthaḥ pralaye sadā | sattvarūpo mahādevo yadādhāre jagatsthitam || 20.81 || evaṃ mayānubhūtaṃ tu dṛṣṭamāścaryamuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ te narottama || 20.82 || viṣṇoścaritamityuktaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitam | bhūya eva mahābāho kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 20.83 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vārāhakalpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.21>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutaṃ me vividhāścaryaṃ tvatprasādāddvijottama | bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi tanme kathaya suvrata || 21.1 || kathameṣā nadī puṇyā sarvanadīṣu cottamā | narmadā nāma vikhyātā bhūyo me kathayānagha || 21.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | tārayetsarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 21.3 || narmadāyāstu māhātmyaṃ yatpūrveṇa mayā śrutam | tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 21.4 || gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī | grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā || 21.5 || tribhiḥ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ saptāhena tu yāmunam | sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādeva nārmadam || 21.6 || kaliṅgadeśātpaścārdhe parvate'marakaṇṭake | puṇyā ca triṣu lokeṣu ramaṇīyā pade pade || 21.7 || tatra devāśca gandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | tapastaptvā mahārāja siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gatāḥ || 21.8 || tatra snātvā naro rājanniyamastho jitendriyaḥ | upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 21.9 || siddhikṣetraṃ paraṃ tāta parvato hyamaraṃkaṭaḥ | sarvadevāśrito yasmādṛṣibhiḥ parisevitaḥ || 21.10 || siddhavidyādharā bhūtagandharvāḥ sthānamuttamam | dṛśyādṛśyāśca rājendra sevante siddhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 21.11 || ahaṃ ca paramaṃ sthānaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti saṃśritaḥ | atra praṇavarūpo vai sthāne tiṣṭhatyumāpatiḥ || 21.12 || śrīkaṇṭhaḥ sagaṇaḥ sarvabhūtasaṅghairniṣevitaḥ | asmādgirivarādbhūpa vakṣye tīrthasya vistaram || 21.13 || yāni santīha tīrthāni puṇyāni nṛpasattama | yāni yānīha tīrthāni narmadāyāstaṭadvaye || 21.14 || na teṣāṃ vistaraṃ vaktuṃ śakto brahmāpi bhūpate | yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ śrūyate sariduttamā || 21.15 || vistareṇa tu rājendra ardhayojanamāyatā | ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca || 21.16 || parvatādudadhiṃ yāvadubhe kūle na saṃśayaḥ || 21.17 || saptaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi saptaṣaṣṭiśatāni ca | saptaṣaṣṭistathā koṭyo vāyustīrthāni cābravīt || 21.18 || paraṃ kṛtayuge tāni yānti pratyakṣatāṃ nṛpa | paśyanti mānavāḥ sarve satataṃ dharmabuddhayaḥ || 21.19 || yathāyathā kalirghoro vartate dāruṇo nṛpa | tathātathālpatāṃ yānti hīnasattvā yato narāḥ || 21.20 || jāleśvarāditīrthāni parvate'sminnarādhipa | pitṛtṛptipradānyāhuḥ svargamokṣapradāni ca || 21.21 || śreṣṭhaṃ dāruvanaṃ tatra carukāsaṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ | uttare narmadāyāstu carukeśvaramuttamam || 21.22 || dārukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca vyatīpāteśvaraṃ tathā | pātāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca koṭiyajñaṃ tathaiva ca || 21.23 || iti caivottare kūle revāyā nṛpasattama | amareśvarapārśve ca liṅgānyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 21.24 || varuṇeśvaramukhyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca || 21.25 || māndhātṛpurapārśve ca siddheśvarayameśvarau | oṅkārātpūrvabhāge ca kedāraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 21.26 || tatsamīpe mahārāja svargadvāramaghāpaham | nāmnā brahmeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ saptasārasvataṃ puraḥ || 21.27 || rudrāṣṭakaṃ ca sāvitraṃ somatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca | etāni dakṣiṇe tīre revāyā bharatarṣabha || 21.28 || asmiṃstu parvate tāta rudrāṇāṃ koṭayaḥ sthitāḥ | snānaistuṣṭirbhavetteṣāṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 21.29 || prītāste'pi bhavantyatra rudrā rājanna saṃśayaḥ | japena pāpasaṃśuddhirdhyānenānantyamaśnute || 21.30 || dānena bhogānāpnoti ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt | parvatātpaścime deśe svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ | sthitaḥ praṇavarūpo'sau jagadādiḥ sanātanaḥ || 21.31 || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ | pitṛkāryaṃ prakurvīta vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 21.32 || tilodakena tatraiva tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | ā saptamaṃ kulaṃ tasya svarge modati pāṇḍava || 21.33 || ātmanā saha bhogāṃśca vividhān labhate sukhī | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi krīḍate surapūjitaḥ || 21.34 || modate suciraṃ kālaṃ pitṛpūjāphaladhitaḥ | tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo jāyate vimale kule || 21.35 || dhanavāndānaśīlaśca nīrogo lokapūjitaḥ | punaḥ smarati tattīrthaṃ gamanaṃ kurute punaḥ || 21.36 || dvitīye janmani bhaveddhradasyānucarotkaṭaḥ | tathaiva brahmacaryeṇa sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || 21.37 || sarvahiṃsānivṛttastu labhate phalamuttamam | evaṃ dharmasamācāro yastu prāṇānparityajet || 21.38 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yadvai tannibodha narādhipa | śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇi svarge modati pāṇḍava || 21.39 || apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe divyaśabdānunādite | divyagandhānuliptāṅgo divyālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ || 21.40 || krīḍate daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ siddhagandharvasaṃstutaḥ | tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo rājā bhavati vīryavān || 21.41 || hastyaśvarathayānaiśca dharmajñaḥ śāstratatparaḥ | gṛhe stambhaśatākīrṇe sauvarṇe rajatānvite || 21.42 || saptāṣṭabhūmisudvāre dāsīdāsasamākule | mattamātaṅganiḥśvāsairvājiheṣitanāditaiḥ || 21.43 || kṣubhyate tasya taddvāramindrasya bhuvanaṃ yathā | rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmānsarvastrījanavallabhaḥ || 21.44 || tasmingṛhe vasitvā tu krīḍābhogasamanvitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ || 21.45 || evaṃ teṣāṃ bhavetsarvaṃ ye mṛtā hyamareśvare | agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryādbhaktyā hyamarakaṇṭake || 21.46 || sa mṛtaḥ svargamāpnoti yāsyate paramāṃ gatim | snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham || 21.47 || purāṇe śrūyate rājansarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | tasyāstīre tu ye vṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyaye || 21.48 || narmadātoyasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim | anivṛttikā gatistasya pavanasyāmbare yathā || 21.49 || patanaṃ kurute yastu tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | kanyāstrīṇi sahasrāṇi pātāle bhogabhāginaḥ || 21.50 || tiṣṭhanti bhavane tasya preṣaṇe prārthayanti ca | divyabhogaiḥ susampannaḥ krīḍate kālam || 21.51 || pṛthivyāṃ hyāsamudrāyāṃ tādṛśo naiva jāyate | yādṛśo'yaṃ naraśreṣṭha parvato'marakaṇṭakaḥ || 21.52 || tatra tīrthaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ parvatasyānu paścime | hrado jāleśvaro nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 21.53 || tatra piṇḍapradānena sandhyopāsanakena tu | pitaro dvādaśābdāni tarpitāstu bhavanti vai || 21.54 || dakṣiṇe narmadātīre kapilā tu mahānadī | saralārjunasaṃchannā khadirairupaśobhitā || 21.55 || mādhavīsallakībhiśca vallībhiścāpyalaṃkṛtā | śvāpadairgarjamānaiśca gomāyuvānarādibhiḥ || 21.56 || pakṣijātiviśeṣaiśca nityaṃ pramuditā nṛpa | sāgraṃ koṭiśataṃ tatra ṛṣīṇāmiti śuśruma || 21.57 || tapastaptvā gataṃ mokṣaṃ yeṣāṃ janma na cāgamaḥ | yena tatra tapastaptaṃ kapilena mahātmanā || 21.58 || tatra taccābhavattīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhaniṣevitam | yena sā kāpilaistāta sevitā ṛṣibhiḥ purā || 21.59 || tena sā kapilā nāma gītā pāpakṣayaṃkarī | tatra koṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tīrthānāmamareśvare || 21.60 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | dānaṃ ca vidhivaddattvā yathāśaktyā dvijottame || 21.61 || īśvarānugrahātsarvaṃ tatra koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | yasmādanakṣaraṃ rūpaṃ praṇavasyeha bhārata || 21.62 || śivasvarūpasya tataḥ kṛtamātrākṣaraṃ bhavet | tiryañcaḥ paśavaścaiva vṛkṣā gulmalatādayaḥ || 21.63 || te'pi tatra kṣayaṃ yātāḥ svargaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ | viśalyā tatra yā proktā tatraiva tu mahānadī || 21.64 || snātvā dattvā yathānyāyaṃ tatrāpi sukṛtī bhavet | tatra devagaṇāḥ sarve sakinnaramahoragāḥ || 21.65 || yakṣarākṣasagandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | sarve samāgatāstāṃ vai paśyanti hyamareśvare || 21.66 || taiśca sarvaiḥ samāgamya vanditau tau śubhau kaṭau | purā yuge mahāghore sarvalokabhayaṃkare || 21.67 || narmadāyāḥ sutastatra saśalyo viśalīkṛtaḥ | sarvadevaiśca ṛṣibhirviśalyā tena sā smṛtā || 21.68 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca utpannā tu kathaṃ tāta viśalyā kapilā katham | kathaṃ vā narmadāputraḥ śalyayukto'bhavanmune || 21.69 || āścaryabhūtaṃ lokasya śrotumicchāmi suvrata || 21.70 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā dākṣāyaṇī nāma sahitā śūlapāṇinā | krīḍitvā narmadātoye parayā ca mudā nṛpa || 21.71 || jalāduttīrya sahasā vastramanyatsamāharat | devyāstu snānavastraṃ tatpīḍitaṃ līlayā nṛpa || 21.72 || sahitānucarībhistu indrāyudhanibhaṃ bhṛśam | tasminniṣpīḍyamāne tu vāri yanniḥsṛtaṃ tadā || 21.73 || tasmādiyaṃ sarijjajñe kapilākhyā mahānadī | saṃyogādaṅgarāgasya vastrodyatkapilaṃ jalam || 21.74 || galitaṃ tena kapilā varṇato nāmato'bhavat | tathā gandharasairyuktaṃ nānāpuṣpaistu vāsitam || 21.75 || nānāvarṇāruṇaṃ śubhraṃ vastrādyadvāri niḥsṛtam | pīḍyamānaṃ karaiḥ śubhraistaistu pallavakomalaiḥ || 21.76 || kapilaṃ jalamiśraistu tasmādeṣā saridvarā | kapilā cocyate tajjñaiḥ purāṇārthaviśāradaiḥ || 21.77 || eṣā vai vastrasambhūtā narmadātoyasambhavā | mahāpuṇyatamā jñeyā kapilā sariduttamā || 21.78 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kapilāsaritsambhavavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.22>
śrī mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sā viśalyā hyabhūdyathā | āścaryabhūtā lokasya sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī || 22.1 || brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro mukhyo hyagnirajāyata | mukhyo vahniritiprokta ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || 22.2 || tasya svāhābhavatpatnī smṛtā dākṣāyaṇī tu sā | tasyāṃ mukhyā mahārāja trayaḥ putrāstadā'bhavan || 22.3 || agnirāhavanīyastu dakṣiṇāgnistathaiva ca | gārhapatyastṛtīyastu trailokyaṃ yaiśca dhāryate || 22.4 || tathā vai gārhapatyo'gnirjajñe putradvayaṃ śubham | padmakaḥ śaṅkunāmā ca tāvubhāvagnisattamau || 22.5 || vasannagnirnadītīre samāśritya mahattapaḥ | rudramārādhayāmāsa jitātmā susamāhitaḥ || 22.6 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | tamuvāca mahādevaḥ prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 22.7 || bhobho brūhi mahābhāga yatte manasi vartate | dātā hyahamasaṃdeho yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 22.8 || agniruvāca narmadeyaṃ mahābhāgā sarito yāśca ṣoḍaśa | bhavantu mama patnyastāstvatprasādānmaheśvara || 22.9 || tāsu vai cintitān putrānagryānutpādayāmyaham | eṣa eva varo deva dīyatāṃ me maheśvara || 22.10 || īśvara uvāca etāstu dhiṣṇināmnyo vai bhaviṣyanti saridvarāḥ | patnyastava viśālākṣyo vede khyātā na saṃśayaḥ || 22.11 || tāsāṃ putrā bhaviṣyanti hyagnayo ye'dhvare smṛtāḥ | dhiṣṇyānāma suvikhyātā yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 22.12 || evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata | narmadā ca saricchreṣṭhā tasya bhāryā babhūva ha || 22.13 || kāverī kṛṣṇaveṇī ca revā ca yamunā tathā | godāvarī vitastā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī || 22.14 || vipāśā kauśikī caiva sarayūḥ śatarudrikā | śiprā sarasvatī caiva hrādinī pāvanī tathā || 22.15 || etāḥ ṣoḍaśā nadyo vai bhāryārthaṃ saṃvyavasthitāḥ | tadātmānaṃ vibhajyāśu dhiṣṇīṣu sa mahādyutiḥ || 22.16 || vyabhicārāttu bharturvai narmadādyāsu dhiṣṇiṣu | utpannāḥ śucayaḥ putrāḥ sarve te dhiṣṇyapāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22.17 || tasyāśca narmadāyāstu dhiṣṇīndro nāma viśrutaḥ | babhūva putro balavānrūpeṇāpratimo nṛpa || 22.18 || tato devāsuraṃ yuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam | mayatārakamityevaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 22.19 || tatra daityairmahāghorairmayatārapurogamaiḥ | tāḍitāste surāstrastā viṣṇuṃ vai śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 22.20 || trāyasva no hṛṣīkeśā ghorādasmānmahābhayāt | daityānsarvānsaṃharasva mayatārapurogamān || 22.21 || evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāndiśo daśa vyalokayat | tato bhagavatā dṛṣṭau raṇe pāvakamārutau || 22.22 || āhūtau viṣṇunā tau tu sakāśaṃ jagmatuḥ kṣaṇāt | sthitau tau praṇatau cāgre devadevasya dhīmataḥ || 22.23 || tato dhiṣṇiḥ pāvakendro devenokto mahātmanā | nirdahemānmahāghorānnārmadeya mahāsurān || 22.24 || athaivamukau tau devau raṇe pāvakamārutau | daityān dadahatuḥ sarvānmayatārapurogamān || 22.25 || dahyamānāstu te sarve śastrairagniṃ tvaveṣṭayan | divyairagnyarkasaṅkāśaiḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 22.26 || tāṃścāgniḥ śastranikarairnirdadāha mahāsurān | jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvaṃ vāyunā nirmitaṃ tadā || 22.27 || dahyamānāstato daityā agnijvālāsamāvṛtāḥ | praviśya pātālatalaṃ jale līnāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 22.28 || tataḥ kumāramagniṃ tu narmadāputramavyayam | pūjayitvā surāḥ sarve jagmuste tridaśālayam || 22.29 || saśalyastu mahātejā revāputro vṛto'gnibhiḥ | narmadāmāgataḥ kṣipraṃ mātaraṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ || 22.30 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā putramāyāntaṃ śastraugheṇa parikṣatam | narmadā puṇyasalilā abhyutthāya suvismitā || 22.31 || paryaṣvajata bāhubhyāṃ prasnavāpīḍitastanī | saśalyaṃ putramādāya kāpilaṃ hradamāviśat || 22.32 || praviṣṭamātre tu hrade kāpile pāpanāśini | saśalyaṃ taṃ viśalyaṃ ca kṣaṇātkṛtavatī tadā || 22.33 || sa viśalyo'bhavadyasmātprāpya tasyāḥ śivaṃ jalam | kapilā nāmatastena viśalyā cocyate budhaiḥ || 22.34 || anye'pi tatra ye snātāḥ śucayastu samāhitāḥ | pāpaśalyaiḥ pramucyante mṛtā yānti surālayam || 22.35 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ purā tvayā | utpattikāraṇaṃ tāta viśalyāyā nareśvara || 22.36 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye viśalyāsambhavo nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.23>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatraiva saṅgame rājanbhaktyā paramayā nṛpa | prāṇāṃstyajanti ye martyāste yānti paramāṃ gatim || 23.1 || saṃnyastasarvasaṃkalpo yastu prāṇānparityajet | amareśvaramāsādya sa svarge niyataṃ vaset || 23.2 || śailendraṃ yaḥ samāsādya ātmānaṃ muñcate naraḥ | vimānenārkavarṇena sa gacchedamarāvatīm || 23.3 || naraṃ patantamālokya nagādamarakaṇṭakāt | bruvantyapsarasaḥ sarvā mama bhartā bhavediti || 23.4 || samaṃ jalaṃ dharmavido vadanti sārasvataṃ gāṅgamiti prabuddhāḥ | tasyopariṣṭātpravadanti tajjñā revājalaṃ nātra vicāraṇāsti || 23.5 || anekavidyādharakinnarādyairadhyāsitaṃ puṇyatamādhivāsaiḥ | revājalaṃ dhārayato hi mūrdhnā sthānaṃ surendrādhipateḥ samīpe || 23.6 || narmadā sarvadā sevyā bahunoktena kiṃ nṛpa | yadīcchenna punardraṣṭuṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram || 23.7 || trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ mahatī pāvanī smṛtā | yatra tatra mṛtasyāpi dhruvaṃ gāṇeśvarī gatiḥ || 23.8 || anekayajñāyatanairvṛtāṅgī na hyatra kiṃcidyadatīrthamasti | tasyāstu tīre bhavatā yaduktaṃ tapasvino vāpyatapasvino vā || 23.9 || mriyanti ye pāpakṛto manuṣyāste svargamāyānti yathā'marendrāḥ || 23.10 || evaṃ tu kapilā caiva viśalyā rājasattama | īśvareṇa purā sṛṣṭā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 23.11 || tatra snātvā naro rājansopavāso jitendriyaḥ | aśvamedhasya mahato'saṃśayaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 23.12 || anāśakaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti vai śivamandiram || 23.13 || pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snānadānena yatphalam | viśalyāsaṅgame snātvā sakṛttatphalamaśnute || 23.14 || evaṃ puṇyā pavitrā ca kathitā tava bhūpate | bhūyo māṃ pṛcchasi ca yattaccaiva kathayāmyaham || 23.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe viśalyāsaṅgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.24>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca saṅgamaḥ karanarmadayoḥ pure māndhātṛsaṃjñite | gatvā snātvā tapayitvā pitḥnviṣṇupuraṃ nayet || 24.1 || mardayitvā karau pūrvaṃ viṣṇurdaityajighāṃsayā | cakraṃ jagrāha tatraiva svedājjātā saridvarā || 24.2 || saṃgatā revayā tatra snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 24.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye karanarmadāsaṅgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.25>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca oṃkārātpūrvabhāge vai saṅgamo lokaviśrutaḥ | revayā saṃgatā yatra nīlagaṅgā nṛpottama || 25.1 || tatra snātvā japitvā ca ko'rtho'labhyo bhavedbhuvi | ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi nīlakaṇṭhapure vaset || 25.2 || tarpayitvā pitḥñśrāddhe tilamiśrairjalairapi | uddharedātmanā sārdhaṃ puruṣānekaviṃśatim || 25.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye nīlagaṅgāyāḥ saṅgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.26>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca jāleśvare'pi yatproktaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ dvijottama | tatkathaṃ tu bhavetpuṇyamṛṣisiddhaniṣevitam || 26.1 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca jāleśvarātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | tasyotpattiṃ kathayataḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṇḍunandana || 26.2 || purā ṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve sendrāścaiva marudgaṇāḥ | tāpitā asuraiḥ sarvaiḥ kṣayaṃ nītā hyanekaśaḥ || 26.3 || bāṇāsuraprabhṛtibhirjambhaśumbhapurogamaiḥ | vadhyamānā hyanekaiśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 26.4 || vimānaiḥ parvatākārairhayaiścaiva gajopamaiḥ | syandanairnagarākāraiḥ siṃhaśārdūlayojitaiḥ || 26.5 || kacchapairmakaraiścānye jagmuranye padātayaḥ | prāpya te paramaṃ sthānamaśakyaṃ yadadhārmikaiḥ || 26.6 || dṛṣṭvā padmodbhavaṃ devaṃ sarvalokasya śaṅkaram | te sarve tatra gatvā tu stutiṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ || 26.7 || devā ūcuḥ | jayāmeya jayābheda jaya sambhūtikāraka | padmayone suraśreṣṭha tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 26.8 || tacchrutvā tu vaco devo devānāṃ bhāvitātmanām | meghagambhīrayā vācā pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ || 26.9 || kiṃ vo hyāgamanaṃ devāḥ sarveṣāṃ ca vivarṇatā | kenāvamānitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ kathayatāmarāḥ || 26.10 || devā ūcuḥ | bāṇo nāma mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ | tenāsmākaṃ hṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dhanaratnairviyojitāḥ || 26.11 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | cintayāmāsa deveśastasya nāśāya yā kriyā || 26.12 || avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarveṣāṃ vai divaukasām | muktvā tu śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ na mayā na ca viṣṇunā || 26.13 || tatraiva sarve gacchāmo yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | sa gatiścaiva sarveṣāṃ vidyate'nyo na kaścana || 26.14 || evamuktvā suraiḥ sarvairbrahmā vedavidāṃvaraḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ saha vidvadbhirato yatra maheśvaraḥ || 26.15 || stutibhiśca supuṣṭābhistuṣṭāva parameśvaram || 26.16 || devā ūcuḥ | jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa jayomārdhaśarīradhṛk | vṛṣāsana mahābāho śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇa || 26.17 || namaḥ śūlāgrahastāya namaḥ khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇe | jaya bhūtapate deva dakṣayajñavināśana || 26.18 || pañcākṣara namo deva pañcabhūtātmavigraha | pañcavaktramayeśāna vedaistvaṃ tu pragīyase || 26.19 || sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhārāṃstvaṃ sadā kuruṣe namaḥ | aṣṭamūrte smarahara smara satyaṃ yathā stutaḥ || 26.20 || pañcātmikā tanurdeva brāhmaṇaiste pragīyate | sadyo vāme tathāghore īśo tatpuruṣe tathā || 26.21 || hemajāle suvistīrṇe haṃsavatkūjase hara | evaṃ stuto munigaṇairbrahmādyaiśca surāsuraiḥ || 26.22 || prahṛṣṭaḥ sumanā bhūtvā surasaṅghānuvāca ha || 26.23 || īśvara uvāca svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī | kiṃ kurmo vadata kṣipraṃ ko'nyaḥ sevyaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 26.24 || kiṃ duḥkhaṃ ko nu santāpaḥ kuto vo bhayamāgatam | kathayadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam || 26.25 || evamuktāstu rudreṇa pratyavocansurarṣabhāḥ | svānsvāndehāndarśayanto lajjamānā adhomukhāḥ || 26.26 || asti ghoro mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ | bāṇo nāmeti vikhyāto yasya tattripuraṃ mahat || 26.27 || tena vai sutapastaptaṃ daśavarṣaśatāni hi | tasya tuṣṭo'bhavadbrahmā niyamena damena ca || 26.28 || purāṇi tānyabhedyāni dadau kāmagamāni vai | āyasaṃ rājataṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ ca tathāparam || 26.29 || tripuraṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ bhramattatkāmagāmi ca | tasyaiva tu balotkṛṣṭāstripure dānavāḥ sthitāḥ || 26.30 || trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ deva pīḍayanti mahāsurāḥ | daṇḍapāśāsiśastrāṇi avikāre vikurvate | tripuraṃ dānavairjuṣṭaṃ bhramattaccakrasaṃnibham || 26.31 || kvaciddṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vā mṛgatṛṣṇaiva lakṣyate || 26.32 || yasminpatati taddivyaṃ dṛptasya tripuraṃ mahat | na tatra brāhmaṇā devā gāvo naiva tu jantavaḥ || 26.33 || na tatra dṛśyate kiṃcitpatedyatra puratrayam | nadyo grāmāśca deśāśca bahavo bhasmasātkṛtāḥ || 26.34 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva maṇimauktikameva ca | strīratnaṃ śobhanaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ karṣate balāt || 26.35 || na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa na divā niśi vā hara | śakyate devasaṅghaiśca nihantuṃ sa kathaṃcana || 26.36 || taddahasva mahādeva tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ | evaṃ prasādaṃ deveśa sarveṣāṃ kartumarhasi || 26.37 || yena devāśca gandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | parāṃ dhṛtiṃ samāyānti tatprabho kartumarhasi || 26.38 || īśvara uvāca etatsarvaṃ kariṣyāmi mā viṣādaṃ gamiṣyatha | acireṇaiva kālena kuryāṃ yuṣmatsukhāvaham || 26.39 || āśvāsayitvā tāndevānsarvānindrapurogamān | cintayāmāsa deveśastripurasya vadhaṃ prati || 26.40 || kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa hantavyaṃ tripuraṃ mayā | tamekaṃ nāradaṃ muktvā nānyopāyo vidhīyate || 26.41 || evaṃ saṃstabhya cātmānaṃ tato dhyātaḥ sa nāradaḥ | tatkṣaṇādeva samprāpto vāyubhūto mahātapāḥ || 26.42 || kamaṇḍaludharo devastridaṇḍī jñānakovidaḥ | yogapaṭṭākṣasūtreṇa chatreṇaiva virājitaḥ || 26.43 || jaṭājūṭābaddhaśirā jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ | tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi || 26.44 || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā nārado bhagavānmuniḥ | stotreṇa mahatā śarvaḥ stuto bhaktyā mahāmanāḥ || 26.45 || nārada uvāca jaya śambho virūpākṣa jaya deva trilocana | jaya śaṅkara īśāna rudreśvara namo'stu te || 26.46 || tvaṃ patistvaṃ jagatkartā tvameva layakṛdvibho | tvameva jagatāṃ nātho duṣṭātakaniṣūdanaḥ || 26.47 || tvaṃ naḥ pāhi sureśāna trayīmūrte sanātana | bhavamūrte bhavāre tvaṃ bhajatāmabhayo bhava || 26.48 || bhavabhāvavināśārthaṃ bhava tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaje | kimarthaṃ cintito deva ājñā me dīyatāṃ prabho || 26.49 || kasya saṃkṣobhaye cittaṃ ko vādya patatu kṣitau | kamadya kalahenāhaṃ yojaye jayatāṃvara || 26.50 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ | utphullanayano bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 26.51 || svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha sadaiva kalahapriya | vīṇāvādanatattvajña brahmaputra sanātana || 26.52 || gaccha nārada śīghraṃ tvaṃ yatra tattripuraṃ mahat | bāṇasya dānavendrasya sarvalokabhayāvaham || 26.53 || bhartāro devatātulyāḥ striyastatrāpsaraḥsamāḥ | tāsāṃ vai tejasā caiva bhramate tripuraṃ mahat || 26.54 || na śakyate kathaṃ bhettuṃ sarvopāyairdvijottama | gatvā tvaṃ mohaya kṣipraṃ pṛthagdharmairanekadhā || 26.55 || nārada uvāca tava vākyena deveśa bhedayāmi purottamam | abhedyaṃ bahudhopāyairyattu devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || 26.56 || evamuktvā gato bhūpa śatayojanamāyatam | bāṇasya tatpuraśreṣṭhamṛddhivṛddhisamāyutam || 26.57 || kṛtakautukasambādhaṃ nānādhātuvicitritam | anekaharmyasaṃchannamanekāyatanojjvalam || 26.58 || dvāratoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ kapāṭārgalabhūṣitam | bahuyantrasamopetaṃ prākāraparikhojjvalam || 26.59 || vāpīkṛpataḍāgaiśca devatāyatanairyutam | haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || 26.60 || anekavanaśobhāḍhyaṃ nānāvihagamaṇḍitam | evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ bāṇasya puramuttamam || 26.61 || tasya madhye mahākāyaṃ saptakakṣaṃ suśobhitam | bāṇasya bhavanaṃ divyaṃ sarvaṃ kāñcanabhūṣitam || 26.62 || mauktikādāmaśobhāḍhyaṃ vajravaiḍūryabhūṣitam | rukmapaṭṭatalākīrṇaṃ ratnabhūmyā suśobhitam || 26.63 || mattamātaṅganiḥśvāsaiḥ syandanaiḥ saṃkulīkṛtam | hayaheṣitaśabdaiśca nārīṇāṃ nūpurasvanaiḥ || 26.64 || khaḍgatomarahastaiśca vajrāṅkuśaśarāyudhaiḥ | rakṣitaṃ ghorarūpaiśca dānavairbaladarpitaiḥ || 26.65 || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ bāṇasya bhavanottamam | kailāsaśikharaprakhyaṃ mahendrabhavanopamam || 26.66 || nārado gagane śīghramagamatpurasaṃmukhaḥ | dvāradeśaṃ samāsādya kṣattāraṃ vākyamabravīt || 26.67 || bhobhoḥ kṣattarmahābuddhe rājakāryaviśārada | śīghraṃ bāṇāya cācakṣva nārado dvāri tiṣṭhati || 26.68 || sa vandayitvā caraṇau nāradasya tvarānvitaḥ | sabhāmadhyagataṃ bāṇaṃ vijñaptumupacakrame || 26.69 || vepamānāṅgayaṣṭistu kareṇāpihitānanaḥ | śṛṇvatāṃ sarvayodhānāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 26.70 || vandito devagandharvairyakṣakinnaradānavaiḥ | kalipriyo durārādhyo nārado dvāri tiṣṭhati || 26.71 || dvārapālasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā bāṇastvarānvitaḥ | dvāḥsthamāha mahādaityaḥ savismayamidaṃ tadā || 26.72 || bāṇa uvāca brahmaputraṃ satejaskaṃ duḥsahaṃ duratikramam | praveśaya mahābhāgaṃ kimarthaṃ vārito bahiḥ || 26.73 || śrutvā prabhorvacastasya prāveśayadudīritam | gatvā vegena mahatā nāradaṃ gṛhamāgatam || 26.74 || dṛṣṭvā devarṣimāyāntaṃ nāradaṃ surapūjitam | sāhasotthāya saṃhṛṣṭo vavande caraṇau muneḥ || 26.75 || dadau cāsanamarghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ pūjāṃ yathāvidhi | nyavedayacca tadrājyamātmānaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha || 26.76 || papraccha kuśalaṃ cāpi muniṃ bāṇāsuraḥ svayam || 26.77 || nārada uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābāho danorvaṃśavivarddhana | ko'nyastribhuvane ślāghyastvāṃ muktvā danupuṃgava || 26.78 || pūjito'haṃ danuśreṣṭha dhanaratnaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ | rājyena cātmanā vāpi hyevaṃ kaḥ pūjayetparaḥ || 26.79 || na me kāryaṃ hi bhogena bhuṅkṣva rājyamanāmayam | tvaddarśanotsukaḥ prāpto dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 26.80 || bhramate tripuraṃ loke strīsatītvānmayā śrutam | tāndraṣṭukāmaḥ samprāptastvaddārāndānaveśvara || 26.81 || manyase yadi me śīghraṃ darśayasva ca māciram | nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kañcukiṃ samudīkṣya vai || 26.82 || antaḥpuracaraṃ vṛddhaṃ daṇḍapāṇiṃ guṇānvitam | uvāca rājā hṛṣṭātmā śabdenāpūrayandiśaḥ || 26.83 || nāradāya mahādevīṃ darśayasveha kañcukin | antaḥpuracaraiḥ sarvaiḥ sametāmaviśaṅkitaḥ || 26.84 || nāthasyājñāṃ puraskṛtya gṛhītvā nāradaṃ kare | praviśyākathayaddevyai nārado'yaṃ samāgataḥ || 26.85 || dṛṣṭvā devī muniśreṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā pādābhivandanam | āsanaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubhramarghyapādyādikaṃ dadau || 26.86 || tasyai sa bhagavāṃstuṣṭo hyāśīrvādamadātparam | nānyā devi triloke'pi tvatsamā dṛśyate'ṅganā || 26.87 || pativratā śubhācārā satyaśaucasamanvitā | yasyāḥ prabhāvāttripuraṃ bhramate cakravatsadā || 26.88 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devī nāradasya sudānvitam | paryapṛcchadṛṣiṃ bhaktyā dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃvarā || 26.89 || rājñyuvāca bhagavanmānuṣe loke devāstuṣyanti kairvrataiḥ | kāni dānāni dīyante yeṣāṃ ca syānmahatphalam || 26.90 || upavāsāśca ye kecitstrīdharme kathitā budhaiḥ | yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ svargamāyānti sukṛtinyaḥ striyo yathā || 26.91 || yattatsarvaṃ mahābhāga kathayasva yathātatham | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ kathayasvāviśaṅkitaḥ || 26.92 || nārada uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābhāge praśno'yaṃ veditastvayā | yaṃ śrutvā sarvanārīṇāṃ dharmavṛddhistu jāyate || 26.93 || upavāsaiśca dānaiśca patiputrau vaśānugau | bāndhavaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ kathayāmi te || 26.94 || durbhagā subhagā yaistu subhagā durbhagā bhavet | putriṇī putrarahitā hyaputrā putriṇī tathā || 26.95 || bhartāraṃ labhate kanyā tathānyā bhartṛvarjitā | kṛtākṛtaiśca jāyante tannibodhasva sundari || 26.96 || tiladhenuṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rūpyaṃ gā vāsasī tathā | pānīyaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca gandhadhūpānulepanam || 26.97 || pādukopānahau chatraṃ puṇyāni vyañjanāni ca | pādābhyaṅgaṃ śiro'bhyaṅgaṃ snānaṃ śayyāsanāni ca || 26.98 || etāni ye prayacchanti nopasarpanti te yamam | madhu māṣaṃ payaḥ sarpirlavaṇaṃ guḍamauṣadham || 26.99 || pānīyaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca śālīnikṣurasāṃstathā | āraktavāsasī ślakṣṇe dampatyorlalitādine || 26.100 || saubhāgyaṃ jāyate caiva iha loke paratra ca | brāhmaṇe vṛttasampanne surūpe ca guṇānvite || 26.101 || tithau yasyāmidaṃ deyaṃ tatte rājñi vadāmyaham | pratipatsu ca yā nārī pūrvāhṇe ca śucivratā || 26.102 || indhanaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyātprīyatāṃ me hutāśanaḥ | tasyā janmāni ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgapratyaṅgasandhiṣu || 26.103 || na rajo naiva santāpo jāyate rājavallabhe | dvitīyāyāṃ tu yā nārī navanītamudānvitā || 26.104 || dadāti dvijamukhyāya sukumāratanurbhavet | lavaṇaṃ vipravaryāya tṛtīyāyāṃ prayacchati || 26.105 || gaurī me prīyatāṃ devī tasyāḥ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | kaumārikā patiṃ prāpya tena sārddhamumā yathā || 26.106 || krīḍatyavidhavā cāpi labhate sā mahadyaśaḥ | naktaṃ kṛtvā caturthyāṃ vai dadyādviprāya modakān || 26.107 || prīyatāṃ mama deveśo gaṇanātho vināyakaḥ | tasyāstena phalenāśu sarvakarmasu bhāmini || 26.108 || vighnaṃ na jāyate kvāpi evamāha pitāmahaḥ | pañcamīṃ tu tataḥ prāpya brāhmaṇe tiladā tu yā || 26.109 || sā bhavedrūpasampannā yathā caiva tilottamā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu yā madhūkasya phaladā tu bhavetsadā || 26.110 || uddiśya cāgnijaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage | tasyāḥ putro yathā skando devasaṅgheṣu cottamaḥ || 26.111 || utpadyate mahārājaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ | saptamyāṃ yā dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ suvarṇena prapūjayet || 26.112 || uddiśya jagato nāthaṃ devadevaṃ divākaram | tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yadvai kathitaṃ dvijasattamaiḥ || 26.113 || tatte rājñi pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sati | dadrūcitrakakuṣṭhāni maṇḍalāni vicarcikā || 26.114 || na bhavantīha cāṅgeṣu pūrvakarmārjitānyapi | kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ yā prayacchati bhāminī || 26.115 || brāhmaṇe vṛttasampanne prīyatāṃ me maheśvaraḥ | tasyā janmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate vibhavānvitā || 26.116 || jāyate nātra sandeho yasmāddānamanuttamam | gandhadhūpaṃ tu yā nārī bhaktyā viprāya dāpayet || 26.117 || kātyāyanīṃ samuddiśya navamyāṃ śṛṇu yatphalam | tasyā bhrātā pitā putraḥ patirvā raṇamuttamam || 26.118 || prāpyate naiva sīdanti tena dānena rakṣitāḥ | ikṣudaṇḍarasaṃ devi daśamyāṃ yā prayacchati || 26.119 || lokapālānsamuddiśya brāhmaṇe vyaṅgavarjite | tena dānena sā nityaṃ sarvalokasya vallabhā || 26.120 || jāyate nātra sandeha ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt | ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāmudakapradā || 26.121 || nārāyaṇaṃ samuddiśya brāhmaṇe viṣṇutatpare | sā sadā sparśasambhāṣairdrāvayedbhāvayejjanam || 26.122 || yasmāddānaṃ maharloke hyanantamudake bhavet | pādābhyaṅgaṃ śiro'bhyaṅgaṃ kāmamuddiśya vai dvije || 26.123 || dadāti ca trayodaśyāṃ bhaktyā paramayāṅganā | yasyāṃ yasyāṃ mṛtā jāyedbhūyo yonyāṃ tu janmani || 26.124 || tasyāṃ tasyāṃ tu sā bharturna viyujyeta karhicit | tathāpyevaṃ caturdaśyāṃ dadyātpātramupānahau || 26.125 || brahmaṇe dharmamuddiśya tasyā lokā hyanāmayāḥ | evaṃ ca pakṣapakṣānte śrāddhe tarpeddvijottamān || 26.126 || avyucchinnā sadā rājñi santatirjāyate bhuvi | evaṃ te tithimāhātmyaṃ dānayogena bhāṣitam || 26.127 || tathā vanaspatīnāṃ tu ārādhanavidhiṃ śṛṇu | jambūṃ nimbataruṃ caiva tindukaṃ madhukaṃ tathā || 26.128 || āmraṃ cāmalakaṃ caiva śālmaliṃ vaṭapippalau | śamībilvāmalīvṛkṣaṃ kadalīṃ pāṭalīṃ tathā || 26.129 || anyānpuṇyatamānvṛkṣānupetya svargamāpnuyāt || 26.130 || nārada uvāca caitre māse tu yā nārī kuryādvratamanuttamam | tasya vratasya cānyāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 26.131 || śrutena yena subhage durbhagatvaṃ na paśyati | yathā himaṃ raviṃ prāpya vilayaṃ yāti bhūtale || 26.132 || tathā duḥkhaṃ ca daurbhāgyaṃ vratādasmādvilīyate | madhukākhyāṃ tu lalitāmārādhayati yena vai || 26.133 || vidhiṃ taṃ śṛṇu subhage kathyamānaṃ sukhāvaham | caitre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ susnātā śuddhamānasā || 26.134 || pratimāṃ madhuvṛkṣasya śāṅkarīmumayā saha | kārayitvā dvijavaraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 26.135 || sugandhikusumairdhūpaistathā karpūrakuṅkumaiḥ | pūjayedvidhinā devaṃ mantrayuktena bhāminī || 26.136 || pādau namaḥ śivāyeti meḍhre vai manmathāya ca | kālodarāyetyudaraṃ nīlakaṃṭhāya kaṇṭhakam || 26.137 || śiraḥ sarvātmane pūjya umāṃ paścātprapūjayet | kṣāmodarāyaihyudaraṃ sukaṇṭhāyai ca kaṇṭhakam || 26.138 || śiraḥ saubhāgyadāyinyai paścādarghyaṃ pradāpayet || 26.139 || namaste devadeveśa umāvara jagatpate | arghyeṇānena me sarvaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ nāśaya prabho | iti arghyamantraḥ || 26.140 || arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ paścātkarakaṃ vāripūritam | madhūkapātropabhṛtaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ tu śaktitaḥ || 26.141 || karakaṃ vārisampūrṇaṃ saubhāgyena tu saṃyutam | dattaṃ tu lalite tubhyaṃ saubhāgyādivivardhanam | iti karakadānamantraḥ || 26.142 || mantreṇānena viprāya dadyātkarakamuttamam | lavaṇaṃ varjayecchuklāṃ yāvadanyāṃ tṛtīyikām || 26.143 || kṣamāpya devīṃ deveśāṃ naktamadyātsvayaṃ haviḥ | anena vidhinā sārdhaṃ māsi māsi hyapakramet || 26.144 || phālgunasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ tu samāpyate | vaiśākhe lavaṇaṃ deyaṃ jyeṣṭhe cājyaṃ pradīyate || 26.145 || āṣāḍhe māsi niṣpāvāḥ payo deyaṃ tu śrāvaṇe | mudgā deyā nabhasye tu śālimāśvayuje tathā || 26.146 || kārttike śarkarāpātraṃ karakaṃ rasasaṃbhṛtam | mārgaśīrṣe tu kārpāsaṃ karakaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam || 26.147 || pauṣe tu kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ māghe pātraṃ tilairbhṛtam | phālgune māsi samprāpte pātraṃ modakasaṃbhṛtam || 26.148 || paścāttṛtīyādeyaṃ yattatpūrvasyāṃ vivarjayet | vidhānamāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ sāmānyaṃ manasaḥ priye || 26.149 || pratimāṃ madhuvṛkṣasya tāmeva pratipūjayet | tasmai sarvaṃ tu viprāya ācāryāya pradīyate || 26.150 || tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte udyāpanavidhiṃ śṛṇu | madhuvṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā bahusambhārasaṃvṛtaḥ || 26.151 || nikhanetpratimāṃ madhye mādhūkīṃ madhukasya ca | tatrasthaṃ pūjayetsarvamumādehārddhadhāriṇam || 26.152 || pūjopahārairvipulaiḥ kuṅkumena punaḥpunaḥ | ślakṣṇābhiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ kausumbhaiḥ kesareṇa ca || 26.153 || kausumbhe vāsasī śubhre atasīpuṣpasannibhe | paridhāpya tāṃ pratimāṃ dampatī ravisaṃkhyayā || 26.154 || upānadyugalaiśchatraiḥ kaṇṭhasūtraiḥ sakaṇṭhikaiḥ | kaṭakairaṅgulīyaiśca śayanīyaiḥ śubhāstṛtaiḥ || 26.155 || kuṅkumena viliptāṅgau bahupuṣpaiśca pūjitau | bhojayedvividhai ratnairmadhūkāvāsake sthitau || 26.156 || bhuktotthitau tu viśrāmya śayyāsu ca kṣamāpayet | gurumūlaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ gururjñeyo maheśvaraḥ || 26.157 || prīte gurau tataḥ sarvaṃ jagatprītaṃ surāsuram | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yatkiṃciddayitaṃ gṛhe || 26.158 || tatsarvaṃ gurave deyamātmanaḥ śreya icchatā | idaṃ tu dhanibhirdeyamanyairdeyaṃ yathocyate || 26.159 || dāmpatyamekaṃ vidhivatpratipūjya śubhavrataiḥ | dvitīyaṃ gurudāmpatyaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || 26.160 || tataḥ kṣamāpayeddevīṃ devaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ gurum | yathā tvaṃ devi lalite na viyuktāsi śambhunā || 26.161 || tathā me patiputrāṇāmaviyogaḥ pradīyatām | anena vidhinā kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ madhusaṃjñikām || 26.162 || indrāṇī cendrapatnītvamavāpa sutamuttamam | saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokeṣu sarvarddhisukhamuttamam || 26.163 || anena vidhinā yā tu kumārī vratamācaret | śobhanaṃ patimāpnoti yathendrāṇyā śatakratuḥ || 26.164 || durbhagā subhagatvaṃ ca subhagā putriṇī bhavet | putriṇyakṣayamāpnoti na śokaṃ paśyati kvacit || 26.165 || anekajanmajanitaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ naśyati dhruvam | mṛtā tu tridivaṃ prāpya umayā saha modate || 26.166 || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān | punastu sambhave loke pārthivaṃ patimāpnuyāt || 26.167 || subhagā rūpasampannā pārthivaṃ janayetsutam || 26.168 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam | anyatpṛcchasva subhage vāñchitaṃ yaddhṛdi sthitam || 26.169 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye madhūkatṛtīyāvratavidhānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.27>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājñī vacanamabravīt | prasādaṃ kuru viprendra gṛhṇa dānaṃ yathepsitam || 27.1 || suvarṇamaṇiratnāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca | tatte dārayāmi viprendra yaccānyadapi durlabham || 27.2 || rājñyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt | anyeṣāṃ dīyatāṃ bhadre ye dvijāḥ kṣīṇavṛttayaḥ || 27.3 || vayaṃ tu sarvasampannā bhaktigrāhyāḥ sadaiva hi | ityuktā sā tadā rājñī vedavedāṅgapāragān || 27.4 || āhūya brāhmaṇānniḥsvāndātuṃ samupacakrame | yatkiṃcinnāradenoktaṃ dānasaubhāgyavardhanam || 27.5 || tena dānena me nityaṃ prīyetāṃ hariśaṅkarau | tato rājñī ca sā prāha nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam || 27.6 || rājñyuvāca dānaṃ dattaṃ tvayoktaṃ yadbhartṛkarmaparaṃ hi tat | ājanmajanma me bhartā bhavedbāṇo dvijottama || 27.7 || nānyo hi daivataṃ tāta muktvā bāṇaṃ dvijottama | tena satyena me bhartā jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 27.8 || nānyo dharmo bhavetstrīṇāṃ daivataṃ hi patiryathā | tathāpi tava vākyena dānaṃ dattaṃ yathāvidhi || 27.9 || svakaṃ karma kariṣyāmo bhartāraṃ prati mānada | brahmarṣe gaccha cedānīṃ tvamāśīrvādaḥ pradīyatām || 27.10 || tatheti tāmanujñāpya nārado nṛpasattama | sarvāsāṃ mānasaṃ hṛtvā anyataḥ kṛtamānasaḥ || 27.11 || jagāmādarśanaṃ vipraḥ pūjyamānastu khecaraiḥ | tato gatamanaskāstā bhartāraṃ prati bhārata || 27.12 || vivarṇā niṣprabhā jātā nāradena vimohitāḥ || 27.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye tripurakṣobhaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.28>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca etasminnantare rudro narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ | krīḍate hyumayā sārddhaṃ nāradastatra cāgataḥ || 28.1 || praṇamya devadeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram | vyajñāpayattadā devaṃ yadvṛttaṃ tripure tadā || 28.2 || gato'haṃ svāminirdeśādyatra tadbāṇamandiram | dṛṣṭā bāṇaṃ yathānyāyaṃ gato hyantaḥpuraṃ mahat || 28.3 || tatra bhāryāsahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā bāṇasya dhīmataḥ | yathāyogyaṃ yathākāmamāgataḥ kṣobhya tatpuram || 28.4 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sādhu sādhviti pūjayan | cintayāmāsa deveśo bhramaṇaṃ tripurasya hi || 28.5 || karamuktaṃ yathā cakraṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | mahāvegaṃ mahāyāmaṃ rakṣitaṃ tejasā mama || 28.6 || sa ca me bhaktinirato bāṇo loke ca viśrutaḥ | bhāratī ca mayā dattā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 28.7 || evaṃ sa suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ | cintayitvā sunirvāṇaṃ kāryaṃ prati janeśvaraḥ || 28.8 || tato'sau mandaraṃ dhyātvā cāpe kṛtvā guṇe mahīm | viṣṇuṃ sanātanaṃ devaṃ bāṇe dhyātvā trilocanaḥ || 28.9 || phale hutāśanaṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham | suparṇaṃ puṅkhayormadhye jave vāyuṃ prakalpya ca || 28.10 || rathaṃ mahīmayaṃ kṛtvā dhuri tāvaśvināvubhau | akṣe sureśvaraṃ devamagrakīlyāṃ dhanādhipam || 28.11 || yamaṃ tu dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme kālaṃ sudāruṇam | ādityacandrau cakre tu gandharvānārakādiṣu || 28.12 || yantāraṃ ca surajyeṣṭhaṃ vedānkṛtvā hayottamān | khalīnādiṣu cāṅgāni raśmīṃśchandāṃsi cākarot || 28.13 || kṛtvā pratodamoṃkāraṃ mukhagrāhyaṃ maheśvaraḥ | dhātāraṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā vidhātāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 28.14 || mārutātsarvato digbhya ūrdhvayantre tathaiva ca | mahoragapiśācāṃśca siddhavidyādharāṃstathā || 28.15 || gaṇāṃśca bhūtasaṅghāṃśca sarve sarvāṅgasaṃdhiṣu | yugamadhye sthito meruryugasyādho mahāgiriḥ || 28.16 || sarpā yantrasthitā ghorāḥ śamye varuṇanairṛtau | gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī sthite te raśmibandhane || 28.17 || satyaṃ rathadhvaje śaucaṃ damaṃ rakṣāṃ samantataḥ | rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 28.18 || saṃnaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī baddhagodhāṅgulitravān | baddhā parikaraṃ gāḍhaṃ jaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya ca || 28.19 || sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdivyaṃ yojayitvā rathottamam | rathamadhye sthito devaḥ śuśubhe ca yudhiṣṭhira || 28.20 || dhanuṣaḥ śabdanādenākampayacca jagattrayam | sthānaṃ kṛtvā tu vaiśākhaṃ nibhṛtaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ || 28.21 || nirīkṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ | dhyātvā taṃ paramaṃ mantramātmānaṃ ca nirudhya saḥ || 28.22 || mumoca sahasā bāṇaṃ purasya vadhakāṅkṣayā | yadā trīṇi sametāni antarikṣasthitāni tu || 28.23 || tataḥ kālanimeṣārdhaṃ dṛṣṭvaikyaṃ tripurasya ca | triparvaṇā triśalyena tatastānyavasādayat || 28.24 || tato lokā bhayatrastāstripure bharatottama | sarvāsuravināśāya kālarūpā bhayāvahāḥ || 28.25 || aṭṭahāsān pramuñcanti kaṣṭarūpā narāstadā | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ caiva kurvanti lipikarmasu || 28.26 || niṣpandanayanā martyāścitreṣvālikhitā iva | devāyatanagā devā raṭanti prahasanti ca | svapne paśyanti cātmānaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitam || 28.27 || raktamālyottamāṅgāśca patantaḥ kārdame hrade | paśyanti nāma cātmānaṃ satailābhyaṅgamastakam || 28.28 || paśyanti yānamārūḍhaṃ rāsabhaiśca nṛpottama | saṃvartako mahāvāyuryugāntapratimo mahān || 28.29 || gṛhānunmūlayāmāsa vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ | bhūmikampāḥ sanirghātā ulkāpātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 28.30 || rudhiraṃ varṣate devo miśritaṃ karkarairbahu | agnikuṇḍeṣu viprāṇāṃ hutaḥ samyagghutāśanaḥ || 28.31 || jvalate dhūmasaṃyukto visphuliṅgakaṇaiḥ saha | kuṃjarā vimadā jātāsturagāḥ sattvavarjitāḥ || 28.32 || avāditāni vādyante vāditrāṇi sahasraśaḥ | dhvajā hyakampitāḥ petuśchatrāṇi vividhāni ca || 28.33 || jvalati pādapāstatra parṇāni ca sabhaṃ tataḥ | sarvaṃ tadvyākulībhūtaṃ hāhākārasamanvitam || 28.34 || udyānāni vicitrāṇi prababhañja prabhañjanaḥ | tena saṃpreritāḥ sarve jvalanti viśikhāḥ śikhāḥ || 28.35 || vṛkṣagulmalatāvallyo gṛhāṇi ca samantataḥ | digvibhāgaiśca sarvaiśca pravṛtto havyavāhanaḥ || 28.36 || sarvaṃ kiṃśukaparṇābhaṃ prajvalaccaiva dṛśyate | gṛhādgṛhaṃ tadā gantuṃ naiva dhūmena śakyate || 28.37 || harakopāgninirdagdhāḥ krandante tripure janāḥ | pradīptaṃ sarvato dikṣu dahyate tripuraṃ param || 28.38 || patanti śikharāgrāṇi viśīrṇāni sahasraśaḥ | pāvako dhūmasaṃpṛkto dahyamānaḥ samantataḥ || 28.39 || nṛtyanvai vyāptadigdeśaḥ kāntāreṣvabhidhāvati | devāgāreṣu sarveṣu gṛheṣvaṭṭālakeṣu ca || 28.40 || pravṛtto hutabhuktatra pure kālapracoditaḥ | dadāha lokānsarvatra harakopaprakopitaḥ || 28.41 || dahate traipuraṃ lokaṃ bālavṛddhasamanvitam | sapuraṃ sagṛhadvāraṃ savāhanavanaṃ nṛpa || 28.42 || kecidbhojanasaktāśca pānāsaktāstathāpare | aparā nṛtyagīteṣu saṃsaktā vārayoṣitaḥ || 28.43 || anyonyaṃ ca pariṣvajya hutāśanaśikhārditāḥ | dahyamānā nṛpaśreṣṭha sarve gacchantyacetanāḥ || 28.44 || athānye dānavāstatra dahyante'gnivimohitāḥ | na śaktāścānyato gantuṃ dhūmenākulitānanāḥ | haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇā nalinyo hemapaṅkajāḥ || 28.45 || dahyante vividhāstatra vāpyaḥ kūpāśca bhārata | dṛśyante'naladagdhāni purodyānāni dīrghikāḥ | amlānaiḥ paṅkajaiśchannā vistīrṇāvasuyojanāḥ || 28.46 || girikūṭanibhāstatra prāsādā ratnaśobhitāḥ | dṛśyante'nalasaṃdagdhā viśīrṇā dharaṇītale || 28.47 || narastrībālavṛddheṣu dahyamāneṣu sarvataḥ | nirdayaṃ jvalate vahnirhāhākāro mahānabhūt | kācicca sukhasaṃsuptāpramattānyā nṛpottama || 28.48 || krīḍitvā ca suvistīrṇaśayanasthā varāṅganā | kācitsuptā viśālākṣī hārāvalivibhūṣitā | dhūmenākulitā dīnā nyapataddhavyavāhane || 28.49 || kācittasminpure dīpte putrasnehānulālasā | putramāliṅgate gāḍhaṃ dahyate tripure'gninā || 28.50 || kācitkanakavarṇābhā indranīlavibhūṣitā | bhartāraṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā patitā tasya copari || 28.51 || kācidādityavarṇābhā prasuptā tu priyopari | agnijvālāhatā gāḍhaṃ kaṃṭhamāliṅgate nṛpa || 28.52 || medhavarṇā parā nārī calatkanakamekhalā | śvetavastrottarīyā tu papāta dharaṇītale || 28.53 || kācitkundenduvarṇābhā nīlaratnavibhūṣitā | śirasā prāñjalirbhūtvā vijñāpayati pāvakam || 28.54 || kasyāścijjvalate vastraṃ keśāḥ kasyāśca bhārata | jvalajjvalanasaṅkāśairhemabhāṇḍaistrasaṃhita ca || 28.55 || kācitprabhūtaduḥkhārtā vilalāpa varāṅganā | bhasmībhūtaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā krandantī kurarī yathā || 28.56 || āliṅgya gāḍhaṃ sahasā patitā tasya mūrdhani | kācicca bahuduḥkhārtā vyalapatstrī svaveśmani || 28.57 || bhasmasācca kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā krandate kurarī yathā | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ kāciddṛṣṭvā vigatacetanam || 28.58 || vepate patitā bhūmau kheditā vaḍavā yathā | itaścetaśca kācicca dahyamānā varāṅganā || 28.59 || nāpaśyadbālamutsaṅge viparītamukhī sthitā | kumbhilasya gṛhaṃ dagdhaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale || 28.60 || kūṣmāṇḍasya ca dhūmrasya kuhakasya bakasya ca | virūpanayanasyāpi virūpākṣasya caiva hi || 28.61 || śumbho ḍimbhaśca raudraśca prahlādaścāsurottamaḥ | daṇḍapāṇirvipāṇiśca siṃhavaktrastathānagha || 28.62 || dundubhaścaiva saṃhrādo ḍiṇḍirmuṇḍistathaiva ca | bāṇabhrātā ca bāṇaśca kravyādavyāghravaktrakau || 28.63 || evamanye'pi ye keciddānavā baladarpitāḥ | teṣāṃ gṛhe tathā vahnirjvalate nirdayo nṛpa | dahyamānāḥ striyastāta vilapanti gṛhe gṛhe || 28.64 || karuṇākṣaravādinyo nirādhārā gatāḥ śivam | yadi vairaṃ surāreśca puruṣoparipāvaka || 28.65 || striyaḥ kimaparādhyanti gṛhapañjarakokilāḥ | anirdayo nṛśaṃsastvaṃ kaste kopaḥ striyaṃ prati || 28.66 || kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ loke avadhyāḥ sarvathā striyaḥ | kiṃ tu tubhyaṃ guṇo hyasti dahane pavaneritaḥ || 28.67 || na kāruṇyaṃ tvayā kiṃciddākṣiṇyaṃ ca striyaṃ prati | dayāṃ mlecchā hi kurvanti vacanaṃ vīkṣya yoṣitām || 28.68 || mlecchānāmapi ca mleccho durnivāryo hyacetanaḥ | evaṃ vilapamānānāṃ strīṇāṃ tatraiva bhārata || 28.69 || jvālākalāpabahulaḥ prajvalatyeva pāvakaḥ | evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato bāṇo dahyamāna uvāca ha || 28.70 || avajñāya vinaṣṭo'haṃ pāpātmā haramañjasā | mayā pāpena mūrkheṇa ye lokā nāśitā dhruvam || 28.71 || gobrāhmaṇā hatā nityamiha loke paratra ca | nāśitānyannapānāni maṭhārāmāśramāstathā || 28.72 || ṛṣīṇāmāśramāścaiva devārāmā gaṇālayāḥ | tena pāpena me dhvaṃsastapasaśca balasya ca || 28.73 || kiṃ dhanena kariṣyāmi rājyeṇāntaḥpureṇa ca || 28.74 || varaṃ śaṅkarapādau ca śaraṇaṃ yāmi mūḍhadhīḥ | na mātā na pitā caiva na bandhurnāparo janaḥ || 28.75 || muktvā caiva maheśānaṃ paramārtiharaṃ param | ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ pāpamātmanaiva tu bhujyate || 28.76 || ahaṃ punaḥ samastaiśca dahyāmi saha sādhubhiḥ | evamuktvā śivaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tanmastakopari || 28.77 || nirjagāma gṛhācchīghraṃ pāvakenāvaguṇṭhitaḥ | sa khinnaḥ svinnagātrastu praskhalaṃstu muhurmuhuḥ || 28.78 || haraṃ gadgadayā vācā stuvanvai śaraṇaṃ yayau | tvatkopānalanirdagdho yadi vadhyo'smi śaṅkara || 28.79 || tvatprasādānmahādeva mā me liṅgaṃ praṇaśyatu | arcitaṃ me suraśreṣṭha dhyātaṃ bhaktyā mayā vibho || 28.80 || prāṇādiṣṭatamaṃ deva tasmādrakṣitumarhasi | yadi te'hamanugrāhyo vadhyo vā surasattama || 28.81 || pratijanma mahādeva tvadbhaktiracalāstu me | paśukīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyonigateṣu ca | svakarmaṇā mahādeva tvadbhaktiracalāstu me || 28.82 || evamuktvā mahābhāgo bāṇo bhaktimatāṃ varaḥ | stotreṇa devadeveśaṃ chandayāmāsa bhārata || 28.83 || bāṇa uvāca śiva śaṅkara sarvaharāya namo bhavabhītabhayārtiharāya namaḥ | kusumāyudhadehavināśaṃkara pramadāpriyakāmaka deva namaḥ || 28.84 || jaya pārvatīśa paramārthasāra jaya viracitabhīmabhujaṅgahāra | jaya nirmalabhasmaviliptagātra jaya mantramūla jagadekapātra || 28.85 || jaya viṣadharakapilajaṭākalāpa jaya bhairavavighṛtapinākacāpa | jaya viṣamanayanaparimuktasaṅga jaya śaṅkara dhṛtagāṅgataraṅga || 28.86 || jaya bhīmarūpa khaṭvāṅgahasta śaśiśekhara jaya jagatāṃ praśasta | jaya sukhareśa suralokasāra jaya sarvasakalanirdagdhasāra || 28.87 || jaya kīrtanīya jagatāṃ pavitra jaya vṛṣāṅka bahuvidhacaritra | jaya viracitanarakaṅkālamāla aghāsuradehakaṅkālakāla || 28.88 || jaya nīlakaṃṭha varavṛṣabhagamana jaya sakalalokaduritānuśamana | jaya siddhasurāsuravinatacaraṇa jaya rudra raudrabhavajaladhitaraṇa || 28.89 || jaya giriśa sureśvaramānanīya jaya sūkṣmarūpa saṃcitanīya | jaya dagdhatripura viśvasattva jaya sakalaśāstraparamārthatattva || 28.90 || jaya duravabodha saṃsāratāra kalikaluṣamahārṇavaghoratāra | jaya surāsuradevagaṇeśa namo hayavānarasiṃhagajendramukha || 28.91 || atihrasvasthūlasudīrghatama upalabdhirna śakyate te hyamaraiḥ | praṇato'smi nirañjana te caraṇau jaya sāmba sulocanakāntihara || 28.92 || aprāpya tvāṃ kimatyantamucchrayī na vināśayet | atipramāthi ca tadā tapo mahatsudāruṇam || 28.93 || na putrabāndhavā dārā na samastaḥ suhṛjjanaḥ | saṅkaṭe'bhyupagacchanti vrajantamekagāminam || 28.94 || yadeva karma kaivalyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śubhāśubham | tadeva sārthavattasya bhavatyagre tu gacchataḥ || 28.95 || nirdhanasyaiva carato na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit | dhanībhayairna mucyeta dhanaṃ tasmāttyajāmyaham || 28.96 || lubdhāḥ pāpāni kurvanti śuddhāṃśā naiva mānavāḥ | śrutvā dharmasya sarvasvaṃ śrutvā caivāvadhārya tat || 28.97 || tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ jagannātho brahmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ | indrastvaṃ devadeveśa suranātha namo'stu te || 28.98 || tvaṃ kṣitirvaruṇaścaiva pavanastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ | tvaṃ dīkṣā yajamānaśca ākāśaṃ soma eva ca || 28.99 || tvaṃ sūryastvaṃ tu vitteśo yamastvaṃ gurureva ca | tvayā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhāsvatā yathā || 28.100 || etadbāṇakṛtaṃ stotraṃ śrutvā devo maheśvaraḥ | krodhaṃ muktvā prasannātmā tadā vacanamabravīt || 28.101 || īśvara uvāca na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyamadyaprabhṛti dānava | sauvarṇe bhavane tiṣṭha mama pārśve'thavā punaḥ || 28.102 || putrapautraprapautraiśca bāndhavaiḥ saha bhāryayā | adyaprabhṛti vatsa tvamavadhyaḥ sarvaśatruṣu || 28.103 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhūyastasya varo datto devadevena bhārata | svarge martye ca pātāle pūjitaḥ sasurāsuraiḥ || 28.104 || akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva vasa tvaṃ vai yathāsukham | tato nivārayāmāsa rudraḥ saptaśikhaṃ tadā || 28.105 || tṛtīyaṃ rakṣitaṃ tasya puraṃ devena śambhunā | jvālāmālākulaṃ cānyatpatitaṃ dharaṇītale || 28.106 || ardhena prasthitādūrdhvaṃ tasya jvālā divaṃ gatāḥ | hāhākāro mahāṃstatra ṛṣisaṅghairudīritaḥ || 28.107 || daivataiśca mahābhāgaiḥ siddhavidyādharādibhiḥ | ekaṃ tu patitaṃ tatra śrīśaile khaṇḍamuttaram || 28.108 || dvitīyaṃ patitaṃ rājañchaile hyamarakaṇṭake | prajvalatpatitaṃ tatra tena jvāleśvaraṃ smṛtam || 28.109 || dagdhe tu tripure rājanpatite khaṇḍa uttame | rudro devaḥ sthitastatra jvālāmālānivārakaḥ || 28.110 || hāhākāraparāṇāṃ tu ṛṣīṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca | svayaṃ mūrtirmaheśānumāvṛṣabhasaṃyutaḥ || 28.111 || manasāpi smaredyastu bhaktyā hyamarakaṇṭakam | cāndrāyaṇādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sa labhennātra saṃśayaḥ || 28.112 || atipuṇyo giriśreṣṭho yasmādbharatasattama | asmānnityaṃ bhavedrājansarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 28.113 || nānādrumalatākīrṇo nānāpuṣpopaśobhitaḥ | nānāgulmalatākīrṇo nānāvallībhirāvṛtaḥ || 28.114 || siṃhavyāghrasamākīrṇo mṛgayūthairalaṃkṛtaḥ | śvāpadānāṃ ca ghoṣeṇa nityaṃ pramudito'bhavat || 28.115 || brahmendraviṣṇupramukhairhyamaraiśca sahasraśaḥ | sevyate devadeveśaḥ śaṅkarastatra parvate || 28.116 || patanaṃ kurute yo'sminparvate'marakaṇṭake | krīḍate kramaśo rājanbhuvanāni caturdaśa || 28.117 || aindraṃ vāhnaṃ ca kauberaṃ vāyavyaṃ yāmyameva ca | nairṛtyaṃ vāruṇaṃ caiva saumyaṃ sauraṃ tathaiva ca || 28.118 || brāhmaṃ ca padamakliṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tadanantaram | umārudraṃ mahābhāga aiśvaraṃ tadanantaram || 28.119 || paraṃ sadāśivaṃ śāntaṃ sūkṣmaṃ jyotiratīndriyam | tasminyāti layaṃ dhīro vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28.120 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ko'pyatra vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ patane ṛṣisattama | etanme sarvamācakṣva saṃśayo'sti mahāmune || 28.121 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇuṣva kathayiṣyāmi taṃ vidhiṃ pāṇḍunandana | yatkṛtvā prathamaṃ karma nipatettadanantaram || 28.122 || kṛtvā kṛcchratrayaṃ pūrvaṃ japtvā lakṣaṃ daśaiva tu | śākayāvakabhukcaiva śucistriṣavaṇo nṛpa || 28.123 || trikālamarcayedīśaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam | daśāṃśena tu rājendra homaṃ tatraiva kārayet || 28.124 || lakṣavāraṃ japeddevaṃ gandhamālyaiśca pūjayet | rātrau svapne tadā paśyedvimānasthaṃ tataḥ kṣipet || 28.125 || anenaiva vidhānena ātmānaṃ yastu nikṣipet | svargalokamanuprāpya krīḍate tridaśaiḥ saha || 28.126 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyastathaiva ca | muktvā manoramānbhogāṃstadā gacchenmahītalam || 28.127 || pṛthivīmekacchatreṇa bhunakti lokapūjitaḥ | vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 28.128 || jvāleśvaraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | tatra jvālā nadī pārtha prasrutā śivanirmitā || 28.129 || nirvāpya tadbāṇapuraṃ revayā saha saṃgatā | tatra snātvā mahārāja vidhinā mantrasaṃyutaḥ || 28.130 || tilasaṃmiśratoyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | piṇḍadānena ca pitḥn paiṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet || 28.131 || anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 28.132 || amarāṇāṃ śataiścaiva sevito hyamareśvaraḥ | tathaiva ṛṣisaṅghaiśca tena puṇyatamo mahān || 28.133 || samantādyojanaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ hyamarakaṇṭakam | rudrakoṭisamopetaṃ tena tatpuṇyamuttamam || 28.134 || tasya parvatarājasya yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28.135 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ trividhaṃ ca yat | naśyate pātakaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 28.136 || amareśvarapārśve ca tīrthaṃ śakreśvaraṃ nṛpa | tapastaptvā purā tatra śakreṇa sthāpitaṃ kila || 28.137 || kuśāvartaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ śubham | brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathā param || 28.138 || ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā | kāveryāḥ pūrvabhāge ca tīrthaṃ vai mātṛkeśvaram || 28.139 || etāni dakṣiṇe tīre revāyā bharatarṣabha | saṃsevanasnānadānaiḥ pāpasaṅghaharāṇi ca || 28.140 || bhṛgutuṅge mahārāja prasiddho bhairavaḥ śivaḥ | tasya yāmyavibhāge ca tīrthaṃ vai capaleśvaram || 28.141 || etau sthitau duḥkhaharau revāyā uttare taṭe | tāvabhyarcya tathā natvā samyagyātrāphalaṃ bhavet | adṛṣṭapūjitau tau hi narāṇāṃ vighnakārakau || 28.142 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tripuravidhvaṃsane jvāleśvaratīrthāmareśvatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.29>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kāverīti ca vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu sattama | māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tasyā mārkaṇḍa tattvataḥ || 29.1 || kīdṛśaṃ darśanaṃ tasyāḥ phalaṃ sparśe'thavā vibho | snāne jāpye'thavā dāna upavāse tathā mune || 29.2 || kathayasva mahābhāga kāverīsaṅgame phalam | dharmaḥ śruto'tha dṛṣṭo vā kathito vā kṛto'pi vā || 29.3 || anumodito vā viprendra punātīti śrutaṃ mayā | yathā dharmaprasaṅge tu mune dharmo'pi jāyate || 29.4 || svargaśca narakaścaiva ityevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ || 29.5 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayādhunā | śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā kāverīphalamuttamam || 29.6 || asti yakṣo mahāsattvaḥ kuberonāma viśrutaḥ | so'pi tīrthaprabhāvena rājanyakṣādhipo'bhavat || 29.7 || tacchṛṇuṣva vidhānena bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa | siddhiṃ prāpto mahābhāga kāverīsaṅgamena tu || 29.8 || kāveryā narmadāyāstu saṅgame lokaviśrute | tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā kuberaḥ satyavikramaḥ || 29.9 || vidhivanniyamaṃ kṛtvā śāstrayuktyā narottama | ārādhayanmahādevamekacittaḥ sanātanam || 29.10 || ekāhāro vasanmāsaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhāhnakālikaḥ | pakṣopavāsī nyavasatkaṃcitkālaṃ nṛpottama || 29.11 || mūlaśākaphalaiścānyaṃ kālaṃ nayati buddhimān | kiṃcitkālaṃ vasaṃstatra tīrthe śaivālabhojanaḥ || 29.12 || parākeṇānayatkālaṃ kṛcchreṇāpi ca mānada | cāndrāyaṇena cāpyanyamanyaṃ vāyvambubhojanaḥ || 29.13 || evaṃ tatra naraśreṣṭha kāmarāgavivarjitaḥ | sthito varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ karṣayansvaṃ tathā vapuḥ || 29.14 || tato varṣaśatasyānte devadevo maheśvaraḥ | tuṣṭastu parayā bhaktyā tamuvāca hasanniva || 29.15 || bhobho yakṣa mahāsattva varaṃ varaya suvrata | parituṣṭo'smi te bhaktyā tava dāsye yathepsitam || 29.16 || yakṣa uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa umayā saha śaṅkara | adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ yakṣāṇāmadhipo bhave || 29.17 || akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva tava bhaktipuraḥsaraḥ | dharme matiṃ ca me nityaṃ dadasva parameśvara || 29.18 || īśvara uvāca yattvayā prārthitaṃ sarvaṃ phalaṃ dharmasya tattathā | ityevamuktvā taṃ tatra jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ || 29.19 || so'pi snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | āmantrayitvā tattīrthaṃ kṛtārthaśca gṛhaṃ yayau || 29.20 || pūjitastatra yakṣaistu so'bhiṣikto vidhānataḥ | cakāra vipulaṃ tatra rājyamīpsitamuttamam || 29.21 || tatra cānye surāḥ siddhā yakṣagandharvakiṃnarāḥ | gaṇāścāpsarasāṃ tatra ṛṣayaśca tathānagha || 29.22 || kāverīsaṅgamaṃ tena sarvapāpaharaṃ viduḥ | svargāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ dvārametadyudhiṣṭhira || 29.23 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | kāverīsaṅgame snātvā yairdattaṃ hi tilodakam || 29.24 || daśa pūrve pare tāta mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā | pitaraḥ pitāmahāstena uddhṛtā narakārṇavāt || 29.25 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snāyīta mānavaḥ | arcayedīśvaraṃ devaṃ yadīcchecchāśvatīṃ gatim || 29.26 || kāverīsaṅgame rājansnānadānārcanaṃ naraiḥ | kṛtaṃ bhaktyā naraśreṣṭha aśvamedhādhikaṃ phalam || 29.27 || homena cākṣayaḥ svargo japādāyurvivardhate | dhyānato nityamāyāti padaṃ śivakalātmakam || 29.28 || agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe nareśvara | agniloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 29.29 || anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yadvai tacchṛṇuṣva narottama || 29.30 || gandharvāpsaraḥsaṃkīrṇe vimāne sūryasannibhe | vījyamāno varastrībhirdaivataiḥ saha modate || 29.31 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca | krīḍate rudralokasthastadante bhuvi cāgataḥ || 29.32 || bhogavāndānaśīlaśca jāyate pṛthivīpatiḥ | ādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 29.33 || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇā kāverī sā sarinnṛpa | triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā narmadāsaṅgame sadā || 29.34 || jitavākkāyacittāśca dhyeyadhyānaratāstathā | kāverīsaṅgame tāta te'pi mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 29.35 || śṛṇu te'nyatpravakṣyāmi āścaryaṃ nṛpasattama | triṣu lokeṣu kā tvanyā dṛśyate saritā samā || 29.36 || labdhaṃ yairnarmadātoyaṃ ye ca kuryuḥ pradakṣiṇam | ye pibanti jalaṃ tatra te puṇyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29.37 || na teṣāṃ santaticchedo daśa janmāni pañca ca | teṣāṃ pāpaṃ vilīyeta himaṃ sūryodaye yathā || 29.38 || gaṅgāyamunasaṅge vai yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ kāverīsnānamācaran || 29.39 || bhaume tu bhūtajāyoge vyatīpāte ca saṃkrame | rāhusomasamāyoge tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam || 29.40 || aśītiśca yavāḥ proktā gaṅgāyāmunasaṅgame | kāverīnarmadāyoge tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam || 29.41 || gaṅgā ṣaṣṭisahasraistu kṣetrapālaiḥ prapūjyate | tadardhairanyatīrthāni rakṣante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29.42 || amareśvare tu saritāṃ ye yogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | te tvaśītisahasraistu kṣetrapālaistu rakṣitāḥ || 29.43 || tathāmareśvare yāmye liṅgaṃ vai capaleśvaram | dvitīyaṃ caṇḍahastākhyaṃ dve liṅge tīrtharakṣake || 29.44 || śivena sthāpite pūrvaṃ kāveryādyabhirakṣake | lakṣeṇa rakṣitā devī narmadā bahukalpagā || 29.45 || dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭyabhiyutaiḥ puruṣairīśayojitaiḥ | oṃ kāraśatasāhasraiḥ parvataścābhirakṣitaḥ || 29.46 || anyadeśakṛtaṃ pāpamasmin kṣetre vinaśyati | asmiṃstīrthe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepo bhaviṣyati || 29.47 || eṣā te kathitā tāta kāverī saritāṃ varā | rudradehasamutpannā tena puṇyā saridvarā || 29.48 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kāverīsaṅgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.30>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadottarakūle tu dārutīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddho mahābhāga tapastaptvā dvijottamaḥ || 30.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ko'sau dvijavaraśreṣṭhaḥ siddhastatra mahāmune | dāruketi sutaḥ kasya etanme vaktumarhasi || 30.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhārgave vipule vaṃśe dhīmato devaśārmaṇaḥ | dārurnāma mahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 30.3 || brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho vidhikramāt | yatidharmavidhānena cacāra vipulatapaḥ || 30.4 || dhyāyanvai sa mahādevaṃ nirāhāro yudhiṣṭhira | uvāsa tīrthe tasmin vai yāvatprāṇaparikṣayam || 30.5 || tasya nāmnā tu tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | tatra snātvā vidhānena arcayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 30.6 || satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti rājannatraiva savarthā || 30.7 || yaḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ ca satyaśaucaparāyaṇaḥ sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ cāsya sambhavatyavicāritam || 30.8 || ṛgvedajāpī ṛgvedī sāma vā sāmapāragaḥ | yajurvedī yajurjaptvā labhate phalamuttamam || 30.9 || prāṇāṃstyajati yo martyastasmiṃstīrthe vidhānataḥ | anivartikā gatistasya ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 30.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.31>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchecca rājendra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam | brahmāvartamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 31.1 || tatra saṃnihito brahmā nityasevī yudhiṣṭhira | ūrdhvabāhurnirālambacakāra bhramaṇaṃ sadā || 31.2 || ekāhāravaśe'tiṣṭhaddvādaśābdaṃ mahāvratī | atra tīrthe vidhānena cintayan vai maheśvaram || 31.3 || tena tatpuṇyamākhyātaṃ brahmāvartamiti prabho | tatra snātvā vidhānena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 31.4 || arcayeddevamīśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā parameśvaram | yatphalaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatām || 31.5 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ | yasmiṃstīrthe tu yo devo dānavo vā dvijo'tha vā || 31.6 || siddhastenaiva tannāmnā khyātaṃ loke mahacca tat | na jalaṃ na sthalaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ vā hyūṣarāṇi ca || 31.7 || pavitratvaṃ labhantyete pauruṣeṇa vinā nṛṇām | sāmarthyānniścayāddhairyātsidhyanti puruṣā nṛpa || 31.8 || pramādāttasya lobhena patanti narake dhruvam || 31.9 || saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatra yatra vasenmuniḥ | tatra tatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 31.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmāvartatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.32>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca pattreśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśanam | yatra siddho mahābhāgaścitrasenasuto balī || 32.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ko'sau siddhastadā brahmaṃstasmiṃstīrthe mahātapāḥ | putraḥ kasya tu ko heturetadicchāmi veditum || 32.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca citronāma mahātejā indrasya dayitaḥ purā | tasya putro nṛpaśreṣṭha pattreśvara iti śrutaḥ || 32.3 || rūpavān subhagaścaiva sarvaśatrubhayaṃkaraḥ | indrasya dayito'tyarthaṃ jaya ityeva cāparaḥ || 32.4 || sa kadācitsabhāmadhye sarvadevasamāgame | menakānṛtyagītena mohitaḥ suciraṃ kila || 32.5 || tiṣṭhate gatamaryādo gataprāṇa iva kṣaṇāt | tāvatsurapatirdevaḥ śaśāpāthājitendriyam || 32.6 || yasmāttvaṃ svargasaṃstho'pi martyadharmamupeyivān | tasmānmartye ciraṃ kālaṃ kṣapayiṣyasyasaṃśayam || 32.7 || evamuktaḥ surendreṇa citrasenasuto yuvā | vepamānaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha || 32.8 || pattreśvara uvāca mayā pāpena mūḍhena ajitendriyacetasā | prāptaṃ vai yatphalaṃ tasya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 32.9 || śakra uvāca narmadātaṭamāśritya dvādaśābdaṃ jitendriyaḥ | ārādhaya śivaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ prāpsyasi sadgatim || 32.10 || satyaśaucaratānāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhānāṃ jitātmanām | loko'yaṃ pāpināṃ naiva iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 32.11 || evamukte mahārāja sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā | gandharvatanayo dhīmānpraṇamyāgāttu bhūtalam || 32.12 || revāyā vimale toye brahmāvartasamīpataḥ | snātvā japtvā vidhānena arcayitvā ca śaṅkaram || 32.13 || vāyvambupiṇyākaphalaiśca puṣpaiḥ parṇaiśca mūlāśanayāvakena | tatāpa pañcāgnitapobhirugraistataśca toṣaṃ samagātsa devaḥ || 32.14 || pinākapāṇiṃ varadaṃ triśūlinamumāpatiṃ hyandhakanāśanaṃ ca | candrārdhamauliṃ gajakṛttivāsasaṃ dṛṣṭvā papātāgragataṃ samīkṣya || 32.15 || īśvara uvāca varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te varado'haṃ tavānagha | yamicchasi dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 32.16 || pattreśvara uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | atra tvaṃ satataṃ tīrthe mama nāmnā bhava prabho || 32.17 || etacchrutvā mahādevo harṣagadgadayā girā | tathetyuktvā yayau hṛṣṭa umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ || 32.18 || so'pi tattīrthamāplutya gate deve divaṃ prati | snātvā jāpyavidhānena tarpayitvā pitḥn punaḥ || 32.19 || sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe vidhānataḥ | pattreśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata || 32.20 || indralokaṃ gataḥ śāpānmuktaḥ so'pi nareśvara | hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito ramyaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ || 32.21 || eṣa te kathitaḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭo yo vai yudhiṣṭhira | tatra snānena caikena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 32.22 || yastvarcayenmahādevaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | snātvābhyarcya pitḥn devān so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 32.23 || mṛto varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍitvā ca śive pure | rājā vā rājatulyo vā paścānmartyeṣu jāyate || 32.24 || vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam | vyādhiśokavinirmuktaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam || 32.25
