|| || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe patreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.33>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam | yatra saṃnihito hyagnirgataḥ kāmena mohitaḥ || 33.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ | kathaṃ ca nityadā vāsa ekasthāneṣu jāyate || 33.2 || etattvāścaryamatulaṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttamam | kathayasva mahābhāga paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 33.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña pṛṣṭaḥ praśnastvayānava | kathayāmi yathāpūrvaṃ śrutametanmaheśvarāt || 33.4 || āsītkṛtayuge rājā nāmnā duryodhano mahān | hastyaśvarathasampūrṇo medinīparipālakaḥ || 33.5 || rūpayauvanasampannaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ pṛthivīpatim | divyopabhogasampannaṃ prārthayāmāsa narmadā || 33.6 || sa tu tāṃ cakame kanyāṃ tyaktvā'nyaṃ pramadājanam | mudā paramayā yukto māhiṣmatyāḥ patirnṛpa || 33.7 || ramate sa tayā sārddhaṃ kāle vai nṛpasattama | narmadā janayāmāsa kanyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām || 33.8 || aṅgapratyaṅgasampannā yasmāllokeṣu viśrutā | tasyāṃ pitā ca mātā ca cakratuḥ premabandhanam || 33.9 || kālenātisudīrgheṇa yauvanasthā varāṅganā | prārthyamānāpi rājanvai nātmānaṃ dātumicchati || 33.10 || tato'nyadivase vahnirdvijarūpo mahātapāḥ | rājānaṃ prārthayāmāsa raho gatvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 33.11 || bhobho raghukulaśreṣṭha dvijo'haṃ mandasantatiḥ | daridro hyasahāyaśca bhāryārthe varayāmi tām || 33.12 || kanyā sudarśanā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi | tāṃ dadasva mahābhāga vardhate tava mandire || 33.13 || brahmacaryeṇa nirviṇṇa ekākī kāmapīḍitaḥ | yācamānasya me tāta prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 33.14 || rājovāca nāhaṃ dravyavihīnasya asavarṇasya karhicit | dāsyāmi svāṃ sutāṃ śubhrāṃ gamyatāṃ dvijapuṃgava || 33.15 || evamuktastadā vahniḥ parāṃ pīḍāmupāgataḥ | na kiṃciduktvā rājānaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || 33.16 || gate cādarśanaṃ vipre rājā mantripurohitaiḥ | mantrayitvātha kāle tu tuṣṭo makhamukhe sthitaḥ || 33.17 || yajataśca makhe bhaktyā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhārata | tataścādarśanaṃ vahniḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmagāt || 33.18 || viprā durmanaso bhūtvā gatā rājño hi mandiram | vahnināśaṃ vimanaso rājānamidamabruvan || 33.19 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ | duryodhana mahārāja śrūyatāṃ mahadadbhutam | na śrutaṃ na ca dṛṣṭaṃ vā kautukaṃ nṛpapuṃgava || 33.20 || agnikāryapravṛttānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidhivannṛpa | kenāpi hetunā vahnirdṛśyate na jvalatyuta || 33.21 || tacchrutvā vipriyaṃ ghoraṃ rājā vipramukhāccyutam | āsanātpatito bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ || 33.22 || āśvasya ca muhūrtena unmatta iva saṃstadā | nirīkṣya ca diśaḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 33.23 || kimetadāścaryaparamiti bhobho dvijottamāḥ | kathyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā vibhāvya ca || 33.24 || mama vā duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidutāho bhavatāmiha | yena naṣṭo'gniśālāyāṃ hutabhukkena hetunā || 33.25 || mantracchidramathānyadvā naiva kiṃcidadakṣiṇam | kriyāhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ vātha kena vahnirna dṛśyate || 33.26 || annahīno dahedrāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ | dātāraṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ || 33.27 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ | na mantrahīnā hi vayaṃ na ca rājanvrataistathā | dravyeṇa ca na hīnastvamanyatpāpaṃ vicintyatām || 33.28 || rājovāca tathāpi yūyaṃ sahitā upāyaṃ cintayantviti | yena śreyo bhavennityamiha loke paratra ca || 33.29 || evamuktāstataḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ | nirāhārāḥ sthitāḥ śarve yatra naṣṭo hutāśanaḥ || 33.30 || tataḥ svapne mahātejā hutabhugbrāhmaṇāṃstadā | uvāca śrūyatāṃ sarvairmama nāśasya kāraṇam || 33.31 || prārthito'yaṃ mayā rājā sutāṃ dātuṃ na cecchati | tena naṣṭo'gniśaraṇādahaṃ bho dvijasattamāḥ || 33.32 || yadi me svasutāṃ rājā dadāti paramārcitām | tadāsya jvalamāno'haṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhāmi nānyathā || 33.33 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viprā vaiśvānaramukhodgatam | vismayotphullanayanā rājānamidamabruvan || 33.34 || bhavato matamājñāya sarve gatvāgnimandiram | nirāhārāḥ sthitā rātrau paśyāmo jātavedasam || 33.35 || tenoktāḥ svasutāṃ cettu rājā me dātumicchati | tato'sya bhūyo'pi gṛhe jvale'haṃ nānyathā dvijāḥ || 33.36 || evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja svasutāṃ dātumarhasi || 33.37 || rājovāca bhavatāṃ tasya vā kāryaṃ devasya vacanaṃ hṛdi | samayaṃ kartumicchāmi kanyādāne hyanuttamam || 33.38 || mama saṃnihito nityaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhatu pāvakaḥ | dadāmi rucirāpāṅgīṃ nānyathā karavāṇi vai || 33.39 || evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā tathāgniṃ prāpya satvaram | kathayitvā vivāhena yojayāmāsurāśu vai || 33.40 || sudarśanāyā lābhena parituṣṭo hutāśanaḥ | jvalate sannidhau nityaṃ māhiṣmatyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 33.41 || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamagnitīrthaṃ pracakṣate | ye tatra pakṣasandhau tu snānadānaistu bhāvitāḥ || 33.42 || tarpayanti pitḥn devāṃste'śvamedhaphalairyutāḥ | suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa || 33.43 || pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ tatra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa || 33.44 || sa mṛto hyagniloke tu krīḍate surapūjitaḥ | eṣa te hyagnitīrthasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā || 33.45 || sarvapāpaharaḥ puṇyaḥ śrutamātro narottama | dhanyaḥ pāpaharo nityamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 33.46 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'gnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.34>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatraiva tu bhavedanyadādityasya mahātmanaḥ | kīrtayāmi naraśreṣṭha yadi te śravaṇe matiḥ || 34.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca etadāścaryamatulaṃ śrutvā tava mukhodgatam | vismayāddhṛṣṭaromāhaṃ jāto'smi munisattama || 34.2 || sahasrakiraṇo devo hartā kartā nirañjanaḥ | avatāreṇa lokānāmuddhartā narmadātaṭe || 34.3 || puruṣākāro bhagavānutāho tapasaḥ phalāt | kasya gotre samutpannaḥ kasya devo'bhavadvaśī || 34.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kulikānvayasambhūto brāhmaṇo bhaktimāñchuciḥ | īkṣyāmīti raviṃ tatra tīrthe yātrākṛtodyamaḥ || 34.5 || yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ nirāhāro gatodakaḥ | prasthito devadevena svapnānte vāritaḥ kila || 34.6 || bhobho mune mahāsattva alaṃ te vratamīdṛśam | sarvaṃ vyāpya sthitaṃ paśya sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca mām || 34.7 || tapāmyahaṃ tato varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca | na bhṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati || 34.8 || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ tvamātmano yastavepsitam || 34.9 || brāhmaṇa uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva deyo yadi varo mama | uttare narmadākūle sadā saṃnihito bhava || 34.10 || ye bhaktyā parayā deva yojanānāṃ śate sthitāḥ | smariṣyanti jitātmānasteṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava || 34.11 || kubjāndhabadhirā mūkā ye kecidvikalendriyāḥ | tava pādau namasyanti teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava || 34.12 || śīrṇaghrāṇā gatadhiyo hyasthicarmāvaśeṣitāḥ | teṣāṃ tvaṃ karuṇāṃ deva acireṇa kuruṣva ha || 34.13 || ye'pi tvāṃ narmadātoye snātvā tatra dine dine | arcayanti jagannātha teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava || 34.14 || prabhāte ye staviṣyanti stavairvaidikalaukikaiḥ | abhipretaṃ varaṃ deva teṣāṃ tvaṃ dada bhocyuta || 34.15 || tavāgre vapanaṃ deva kārayanti narā bhuvi | svāmiṃsteṣāṃ varo deya eṣa me paramo varaḥ || 34.16 || evamastviti taṃ coktvā muniṃ karuṇayā punaḥ | śatabhāgena rājendra sthitvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ || 34.17 || tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā gatvā snānaṃ samācaret | tarpayetpitṛdevāṃśca so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 34.18 || agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | dyotayanvai diśaḥ sarvā agnilokaṃ sa gacchati || 34.19 || yastattīrthaṃ samāsādya tyajatīha kalevaram | sa gato vāruṇaṃ lokamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 34.20 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsena tanuṃ tyajet | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 34.21 || apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe divyaśabdānunādite | uṣitvāyāti martye vai vedavedāṅgavidbhavet || 34.22 || vyādhiśokavinirmukto dhanakoṭipatirbhavet | putradārasamopeto jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam || 34.23 || prātarutthāya yastatra smarate bhāskaraṃ tadā | ājanmajanitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 34.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.35>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca jalamadhye mahādevaḥ kena tiṣṭhati hetunā | uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottama || 35.1 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca etadākhyānamatulaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutimukhāvaham | purāṇe yacchrutaṃ tāta tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || 35.2 || tretāyuge mahābhāga rāvaṇo devakaṇṭakaḥ | trailokyavijayī raudraḥ surāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ || 35.3 || devadānavagandharvairṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ | avadhyo'tha vimānena yāvatparyaṭate mahīm || 35.4 || tāvaddhindhyagirermadhye dānavo baladarpitaḥ | mayo nāmeti vikhyāto guhāvāsī tapaścaran || 35.5 || tasya pārśvagato rakṣo vinayādavaniṃ gataḥ | pūjito dānasanmānairidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 35.6 || kasyeyaṃ padmapatrākṣī pūrṇacandranibhānanā | kiṃnāmadheyā tapati tapa ugraṃ kathaṃ vibho || 35.7 || maya uvāca dānavānāṃ patiḥ śreṣṭho mayo'haṃ nāma nāmataḥ | bhāryā tejovatī nāma tasyāstu tanayā śubhā || 35.8 || mandodarīti vikhyātā tapate bhartṛkāraṇāt | ārādhayantī bhartāramumāyā dayitaṃ śubham || 35.9 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya rāvaṇo madamohitaḥ | prasṛtaḥ praṇato bhūtvā mayaṃ vacanamabravīt || 35.10 || paulastyānvayasaṃjāto devadānavadarpahā | prārthayāmi mahābhāga sutāṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi || 35.11 || jñātvā paitāmahaṃ vṛttaṃ mayenāpi mahātmanā | rāvaṇāya sutā dattā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || 35.12 || gṛhītvā tāṃ tadā rakṣo'bhyarcyamāno niśācaraiḥ | devodyāne vimānaiśca krīḍate sa tayā saha || 35.13 || kenacittvatha kālena rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ | putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭho janayāmāsa bhārata || 35.14 || tenaiva jātamātreṇa rāvo mukto mahātmanā | saṃvartakasya meghasya tena lokā jaḍīkṛtāḥ || 35.15 || śrutvā tannarditaṃ ghoraṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | nāma cakre tadā tasya meghanādo bhaviṣyati || 35.16 || evaṃnāmā kṛtaḥ so'pi paramaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ | toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram || 35.17 || vratairniyamadānaiśca homajāpyavidhānataḥ | kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairnityaṃ kṛśaṃ kurvankalevaram || 35.18 || evamanyaddine tāta kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam | gatvā liṅgadvayaṃ gṛhya prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 35.19 || narmadātaṭamāśritya snātukāmo mahābalaḥ | nikṣipya pūjayan devaṃ kṛtajāpyo nareśvara || 35.20 || tatrāyatanāvāsena snāto hutahutāśanaḥ | kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mānayitvā niśācaraḥ || 35.21 || gantukāmaḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ laṅkāyāṃ nṛpasattama | ekamuddharato liṅgaṃ praṇataḥ savyapāṇinā || 35.22 || dvitīyaṃ tu dvitīyena bhaktyā paulastyanandanaḥ | tāvadeva mahāliṅgaṃ patitaṃ narmadāṃbhasi || 35.23 || yāhi yāhīti cetyuktvā jalamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | namitvā rāvaṇistasya devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 35.24 || jagāmākāśamāviśya pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ | tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ meghanādeti viśrutam || 35.25 || pūrvaṃ tu garjanaṃ nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram | tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yastu snānaṃ samācaret || 35.26 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | piṇḍadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa || 35.27 || yatphalaṃ sattrayajñena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥ | tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraḥ saṃpratarpitāḥ || 35.28 || yastu bhojayate vipraṃ ṣaḍrasātrena bhārata | akṣayapuṇyamāpnoti tatra tīrthe narottama || 35.29 || prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādbhāvito bhāvitātmanā | sa vasecchāṅkare loke yāvadā bhūtasamplavam || 35.30 || eṣā te naraśārdūla garjanotpattiruttamā | kathitā snehabandhena sarvapāpakṣayakarī || 35.31 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe meghanādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.36>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchecca rājendra dārutīrthamanuttamam | dāruko yatra saṃsiddha indrasya dayitaḥ purā || 36.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca dārukeṇa kathaṃ tāta tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha | vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatsakāśāddvijottama || 36.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca hanta te kathayiṣyāmi vicitraṃ yatpurātanam | vṛttaṃ svargasabhāmadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 36.3 || sūto vajradharasyeṣṭo mātalirnāma nāmataḥ | sa putraṃ śaptavānpūrvaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare || 36.4 || śāpāhato vepamāna indrasya caraṇau śubhau | prapīḍya mūrdhnā deveśaṃ vijñāpayati bhārata || 36.5 || tamuvācābhiśaptaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ | karmaṇā kena śāpasya ghorasyānto bhaviṣyati || 36.6 || narmadātaṭamāśritya toṣayanvai maheśvaram | tiṣṭha yāvadyugasyāntaṃ punarjanma hyavāpsyasi || 36.7 || punarbhūtvā tu pūtastvaṃ dāruko nāma viśrutaḥ | saṃsevya paramaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 36.8 || mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpannastataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi | evamuktastu devena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā || 36.9 || praṇamya śirasā bhūmimāgato'sau hyacetanaḥ | narmadātaṭamāśritya karṣayannijavigraham || 36.10 || vratopavāsasaṃkhinno japahomarataḥ sadā | mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ varadaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 36.11 || bhaktyā tu parayā rājanyāvadābhūtasamplavam | aṃśāvataraṇādviṣṇoḥ sūto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ || 36.12 || toṣayan vai jagannāthaṃ tato yāto hi sadgatim || 36.13 || eṣa tatsambhavastāta dārutīrthasya suvrata | kathito'yaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt || 36.14 || tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | bhrātḥn vilokayāmāsa hṛṣṭaromā muhurmuhuḥ || 36.15 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhipūrvaṃ nareśvara | upāsya saṃdhyāṃ deveśamarcayedyaśca śaṅkaram || 36.16 || vedābhyāsaṃ tu tatraiva yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ | so'śvamedhaphalaṃ rājaṃllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 36.17 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchuciḥ | sa tu viprasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamam || 36.18 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam | yatkṛtaṃ śuddhabhāvena tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet || 36.19 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārukatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.37>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheta rājendra devatīrthamanuttamam | yena devāstrayastriṃśatsnātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ || 37.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ tāta surāḥ sarve dānavairbalavattaraiḥ | nirjitāstatra tīrthe ca snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ || 37.2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā daityagaṇairugrairyuddhe'tibalavattaraiḥ | indro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svarājyāccyāvito nṛpa || 37.3 || hastyaśvarathayānaughairmardayitvā varūthinīm | vidhvastā bhejire mārgaṃ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ || 37.4 || jambhaśumbhaiśca kūṣmāṇḍakuhakādibhiḥ | vepamānārditāḥ sarve brahmāṇamupatasthire || 37.5 || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam | tadā vijñāpayāmāsurdevā vahnipurogamāḥ || 37.6 || paśya paśya mahābhāga dānavaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ | viyojitāḥ putradāraistvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 37.7 || paritrāyasva deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha | nānyā gatiḥ sureśāna tvāṃ muktvā parameśvara || 37.8 || brahmovāca dānavānāṃ vighātārthaṃ narmadātaṭamāsthitāḥ | tapaḥ kurudhvaṃ svasthāḥ stha tapo hi paramaṃ balam || 37.9 || nānyopāyo na vai mantro vidyate na ca me kriyā | vinā revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 37.10 || dāridryavyādhimaraṇabandhanavyasanāni ca | etāni caiva pāpasya phalānīti matirmama || 37.11 || evaṃ jñātvā tataścaiva tapaḥ kuruta duṣkaram | tathā caiva surāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ || 37.12 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tathyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | narmadāmāgatāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ || 37.13 || cerurvai tatra vipulaṃ tapaḥ siddhimavāpnuvan | tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ devatīrthamanuttamam || 37.14 || gīyate triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram | tatra gatvā ca yo martyo vidhinā saṃyatendriyaḥ || 37.15 || snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā sa labhenmauktikaṃ phalam | yastu bhojayate viprāṃstasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa || 37.16 || sa labhenmukhyaviprāṇāṃ phalaṃ sāhasrikaṃ nṛpa | tatra devaśilā ramyā mahāpuṇyavivardhinī || 37.17 || saṃnyāsena mṛtā ye tu teṣāṃ syādakṣayā gatiḥ | agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa || 37.18 || rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | evaṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam || 37.19 || sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vā'pi tatra tīrthe'kṣayaṃ bhavet | eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭa utpattiścaiva bhārata || 37.20 || devatīrthasya nikhilā yathā vai śaṅkarācchrutā | paṭhanti ye pāpaharaṃ sarvaduḥkhavimocanam || 37.21 || devatīrthasya caritaṃ devalokaṃ vrajanti te || 37.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.38>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheta rājendra guhāvāsīti cottamam | yatra siddho mahādevo guhāvāsī samārbudam || 38.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kena kāryeṇa bho tāta mahādevo jagadguruḥ | guhāyāmanayatkālaṃ sudīrghaṃ dvijasattama || 38.2 || etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ sarvaparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 38.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu praśno mahārāja pṛṣṭo yo vai tvayottamaḥ | purāṇe vistaro hyasya na śakyo hi mayādhunā || 38.4 || kathituṃ vṛddhabhāvatvādatīto bahukālikaḥ | saṃkṣepāttena te tāta kathayāmi nibodha me || 38.5 || purā kṛtayuge rājannāsīddāruvanaṃ mahat | nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāvallyupaśobhitam || 38.6 || siṃhavyāghravarāhaiśca gajaiḥ khaḍgairniṣevitam | bahupakṣiyutaṃ divyaṃ yathā caitrarathaṃ vanam || 38.7 || tatra kecinmahāprājñā vasanti saṃśitavratāḥ | vasanti parayā bhaktyā caturāśramabhāvitāḥ || 38.8 || brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā | svadharmaniratāḥ sarve vāñchantaḥ paramaṃ padam || 38.9 || tāvadvasantasamaye kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare | vimānastho mahādevo gacchanvai hyumayā saha || 38.10 || dadarśa toya āvāsamṛksāmayajurnāditam | alakṣyāgatanirgamyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 38.11 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā muditā devī harṣagaṅgadayā girā | papraccha devadeveśaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇam || 38.12 || devyuvāca kasyāyamāśramo deva vedadhvaninināditaḥ | yaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣutpipāsādyaiḥ śramaiśca parihīyate || 38.13 || maheśvara uvāca kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ devi mahādāruvanaṃ mahat | bahuviprajano yatra gṛhadharmeṇa vartate || 38.14 || atra yaḥ strījanaḥ kaścidbhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ | nānyo devo na vai dharmo jñāyate śailanandini || 38.15 || etacchrutvā paraṃ vākyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam | kautūhalasamāviṣṭā śaṅkaraṃ punarabravīt || 38.16 || yattvayoktaṃ mahādeva patidharmaratāḥ striyaḥ | tāsāṃ tvaṃ madano bhūtvā cāritraṃ kṣobhaya prabho || 38.17 || īśvara uvāca yattvayoktaṃ ca vacanaṃ na hi me rocate priye | brāhmaṇā hi mahadbhūtaṃ na caiṣāṃ vipriyaṃ caret || 38.18 || manyupraharaṇā viprāścakrapraharaṇo hariḥ | cakrātkrūrataro manyustasmādvipraṃ na kopayet || 38.19 || na te devā na te lokā na te nagā na cāsurāḥ | dṛśyante triṣu lokeṣu ye tairdṛṣṭairna nāśitāḥ || 38.20 || teṣāṃ mokṣastathā svargo bhūmirmartye phalāni ca | yeṣāṃ tuṣṭā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣitidevatāḥ || 38.21 || evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge asadgrāhaṃ parityaja | tatra loke viruddhaṃ vai kupyante yena vai dvijāḥ || 38.22 || devyuvāca nāhaṃ te dayitā deva nāhaṃ te vaśavartinī | akṛtvādhaśva vai tāsāṃ mānaṃ surasupūjitam || 38.23 || lokaloke mahādeva aśakyaṃ nāsti te prabho | kriyatāṃ mama caivaikametatkāryaṃ surottama || 38.24 || evamukto mahādevo devyā vākyahite rataḥ | kṛtvā kāpālikaṃ rūpaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ prati || 38.25 || mahāhitajaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya śaśibhūṣaṇam | kaṇṭhatrāṇaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā dhārayan karṇakuṇḍale || 38.26 || vyāghracarmaparīdhāno mekhalāhārabhūṣitaḥ | nūpuradhvaninighoṣaiḥ kampayan vai vasuṃdharām || 38.27 || mahānūrddhvajaṭāmālī kṛttibhasmānulepanaḥ | kṛtvā haste kapālaṃ tu brahmaṇaśca mahātmanaḥ || 38.28 || mahāḍamarughoṣeṇa kampayan vai vasuṃdharām | prabhātasamaye prāpto mahādāruvanaṃ prati || 38.29 || tāvatpuṇyajanaḥ sarvapuṣpapatraphalārthikaḥ | nirgato bahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ pavamānaḥ samantataḥ || 38.30 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rūpaṃ devasya bhārata | yuvatīnāṃ manastāsāṃ kāmena kaluṣīkṛtam || 38.31 || śobhanaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvā api varāṅganāḥ | kledabhāvaṃ tato jagmurmudā dāruvanastriyaḥ || 38.32 || vikārā bahavastāsāṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahādbhutam | saṃjātā viprapatnīnāṃ tadā tāsu narottama || 38.33 || paridhānaṃ na jānanti kāściddṛṣṭvā varāṅganāḥ | uttarīyaṃ tathā cānyā mahāmohasamanvitāḥ || 38.34 || keśabhāraparibhraṣṭā kācidevāsanotthitā | dātukāmā tadā bhaikṣyaṃ ceṣṭituṃ naiva cāśakat || 38.35 || kāciddṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ rūpayauvanagarvitā | utsaṅge saṃsthitaṃ bālaṃ vismṛtā pāyituṃ stanam || 38.36 || kāmabāṇahatā cānyā bāhubhyāṃ pīḍya sustanau | niḥśvasantī tadā coṣṇaṃ na kiṃcitpratijalpati || 38.37 || evaṃ saṃkṣobhya taṃ sarvaṃ strījanaṃ parameśvaraḥ | jagāma tatra vai tāsāṃ kṣobhaṃ kṛtvā mahādbhutam || 38.38 || tāvatte brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhramitvā kānanaṃ mahat | āgatāḥ svagṛhe dārān dadṛśuśca hataujasaḥ || 38.39 || yāsāṃ pūrvatarā bhaktiḥ pātivratye patīnprati | calitāstā viditvāśu nirjagmurdvijasattamāḥ || 38.40 || saṃvidaṃ paramāṃ kṛtvā jñātvā devaṃ maheśvaram | kṣobhayitvā manastāsāṃ tataścādarśanaṃ gatam || 38.41 || krodhāviṣṭo dvijaḥ kaściddaṇḍamudyamya dhāvati | kalmāṣayaṣṭimanye ca tathānye darbhamuṣṭikām || 38.42 || itaścetaśca te sarve bhramitvā kānanaṃ nṛpa | ekībhūtvā mahātmāno vyājahruśca ruṣā giram || 38.43 || yadidaṃ ca hutaṃ kiṃcidguravastoṣitā yadi | tena satyena devasya liṅgaṃ patatu cottamam || 38.44 || āśramādāśramaṃ sarve na tyajāmo vidhikramāt | tena satyena devasya liṅgaṃ patatu bhūtale || 38.45 || evaṃ satyaprabhāvena triruktena dvijanmanām | śivasya paśyato liṅgaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale || 38.46 || hāhākāro mahānāsīllokāloke'pi bhārata | devasya patite liṅge jagataśca mahākṣaye || 38.47 || patamānasya liṅgasya śabdo'bhūcca sudāruṇaḥ | ulkāpātā diśāṃ hāhā bhūmikampāśca dāruṇāḥ || 38.48 || patanti parvatāgrāṇi śoṣaṃ yānti ca sāgarāḥ | devasya patite liṅge devā vimanaso'bhavan || 38.49 || sametya sahitāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam | kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 38.50 || tatastuṣṭo jagannāthaścaturvadanapaṅkajaḥ | ārtānprāha surānsarvānmā viṣādaṃ gamiṣyatha || 38.51 || brahmaśāpābhibhūto'sau devadevastrilocanaḥ | tuṣṭaistaistapasā yuktaiḥ punarmokṣaṃ gamiṣyati || 38.52 || etacchrutvā yayurdevā yathāgatamarindama | bhāvayitvā tataḥ sarve munayaścaiva bhārata || 38.53 || viśvāmitravasiṣṭhādyā jābāliratha kaśyapaḥ | sametya sahitāḥ sarve tamūcustripurāntakam || 38.54 || brahmatejo hi balavaddvijānāṃ hi sureśvara | kṣāntiyuktastapastaptvā bhaviṣyasi gataklamaḥ || 38.55 || yataḥ kṣobhādṛṣīṇāṃ ca tadevaṃ liṅgamuttamam | patitaṃ te mahādeva na tatpūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 38.56 || na tacchreyo'gnihotreṇa nāgniṣṭomena labhyate | prāpnuvanti ca yacchreyo mānavā liṅgapūjane || 38.57 || devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām | vacanena tu viprāṇāmetatpūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 38.58 || brahmaviṣṇvindracandrāṇāmetatpūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati | yatphalaṃ tava liṅgasya iha loke paratra ca || 38.59 || evamukto jagannāthaḥ praṇipatya dvijottamān | mudā paramayā yuktaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata || 38.60 || brāhmaṇā jaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirjalaṃ sārvakāmikam | yeṣāṃ vākyodakenaiva śudhyanti malino janāḥ || 38.61 || na tatkṣetraṃ na tattīrthamūṣaraṃ puṣkarāṇi ca | brāhmaṇe manyumutpādya yatra gatvā sa śudhyati || 38.62 || na tacchāstraṃ yanna viprapraṇītaṃ na taddānaṃ yanna viprapradeyam | na tatsaukhyaṃ yannavipraprasādānna tadduḥkhaṃ yanna vipraprakopāt || 38.63 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritastathā | ekasya vipravākyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 38.64 || abhinandya dvijānsarvānanujñāto maharṣibhiḥ | tato'gamattadā devo narmadātaṭamuttamam || 38.65 || paramaṃ vratamāsthāya guhāvāsī samārbudam | tapaścacāra bhagavāñjapasnānarataḥ sadā || 38.66 || samāpte niyame tāta sthāpayitvā maheśvaram | vandyamānaḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ kailāsamagamatprabhuḥ || 38.67 || narmadāyāstaṭe tena sthāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | tenaiva kāraṇenāsau narmadeśvara ucyate || 38.68 || yo'rcayennarmadeśānaṃ yatirvai saṃjitendriyaḥ | snātvā caiva mahādevamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 38.69 || dadāti yaḥ pitṛbhyastu tilapuṣpakuśodakam | triḥsaptapūrvajāstasya svarge modanti pāṇḍava || 38.70 || yastu bhojayate viprāṃstasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | pāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ tu sa labhetkoṭijaṃ phalam || 38.71 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira | dadāti toyamadhyasthaḥ so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 38.72 || aṣṭamyāṃvā caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro vasettu yaḥ | narmadeśvaramāsādya prāpnuyājjanmanaḥ phalam || 38.73 || agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | tasya vyādhibhayaṃ na syātsaptajanmasu bhārata || 38.74 || anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | anivartikā gatistasya rudraloke bhaviṣyati || 38.75 || eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭastasyotpattirnarottama | purāṇe vihitā tāta saṃjñā tasya tu vistarāt || 38.76 || etaṃ kīrtayate yastu narmadeśvarasambhavam | bhaktyā śṛṇoti ca naraḥ so'pi snānaphalaṃ labhet || 38.77 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.39>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchecca rājendra kapilātīrthamuttamam | snānamātrānnaro bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 39.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu kathitaṃ dvijasattama | narmadeśvaramāhātmyaṃ kāpilaṃ kathayasva me || 39.2 || yasmin kāle'tha sambandhe utpannaṃ tīrthamuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ prabho || 39.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu vakṣye'dya te rājankapilātīrthamuttamam | yena te vismayaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā gacchati bhārata || 39.4 || purā kṛtayugasyādau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | utpādayitvā sakalaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham || 39.5 || japahomaparo bhaktyā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā ca tiṣṭhati | jvalamānāttu kapilā tāvatkuṇḍātsamutthitā || 39.6 || agnijvālojjvalaiḥ śṛṅgaistrinetrā supayasvinī | agnipūrṇā hyagnimukhā agnighrāṇāgnilocanā || 39.7 || agnikhurā hyagnipṛṣṭhā agnisarvāṅgasaṃsthitiḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā ghaṇṭālalitaniḥsvanā || 39.8 || dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ mahābhāgāṃ kapilāṃ kuṇḍamadhyagām | brahmā lokagurustāta praṇamyedamuvāca ha || 39.9 || namaste kapile puṇye sarvalokanamaskṛte | maṅgalye maṅgale devi triṣu lokeṣvanupame || 39.10 || tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ smṛtirmedhā tvaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ varānane | umādevīti vikhyātā tvaṃ satī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 39.11 || vaiṣṇavī tvaṃ mahādevī brahmāṇī tvaṃ varānane | kumārī tvaṃ mahābhāge bhaktiḥ śraddhā tathaiva ca || 39.12 || kālarātristu bhūtānāṃ kumārī parameśvarī | tvaṃ lavastvaṃ truṭiścaiva muhūrtaṃ lakṣameva ca || 39.13 || saṃvatsarastvaṃ māsastvaṃ kālastvaṃ ca kṣaṇastathā | nāsti kiṃcittvayā hīnaṃ trailokye sacarācare || 39.14 || evaṃ stutā tu mānena kapilā parameṣṭhinā | tamuvāca mahābhāgaṃ prahṛṣya padmasambhavam || 39.15 || prasannā tava vākyena devadeva jagadguro | kiṃ karomi priyaṃ te'dya brūhi sarvaṃ pitāmaha || 39.16 || brahmovāca jagaddhitāya janitā mayā tvaṃ parameśvari | svargānmartyaṃ tato yāhi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 39.17 || sarvadevamayī tvaṃ tu sarvalokamayī tathā | vidhinā ye pradāsyanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape || 39.18 || evamuktvā tato devī brahmāṇaṃ parameśvarī | vandyamānā suraiḥ siddhairājagāma dharātalam || 39.19 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yadāyāteha sā tāta brāhmaṇo vacanācchubhā | tadā devāśca lokāśca kathamaṅgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 39.20 || kathaṃ vā saṃsthitāgatya kapilā sā dvijottama | tīrthe vā hyūṣare kṣetra etanme kathaya dvija || 39.21 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca sā tadā brahmaṇā coktā dhātrā lokasya bhārata | brahmalokādgatā puṇyāṃ narmadāṃ lokapāvanīm || 39.22 || tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritā | cacāra pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saśailavanakānanām || 39.23 || tadāprabhṛti rājendra kapilātīrthamuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ khyātamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam || 39.24 || tattīrthe vidhivatsnātvā kapilāyāḥ prayacchati | pṛthvī tena bhaveddattā saśailavanakānanā || 39.25 || tāṃ tu paśyati yo bhaktyā dīyamānāṃ dvijottame | tasya varṣaśataṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 39.26 || bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva janaḥ satyaṃ tapastathā | te tatpṛṣṭhaṃ samāśritya sthitā lokā nṛpottama || 39.27 || mukhe hyagniḥ sthito devo danteṣu ca bhujaṅgamāḥ | dhātā vidhātā hyoṣṭhau ca jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī || 39.28 || sahasrakiraṇau devau candrādityau sulocanau | nāsikāmadhyagaścaiva māruto nṛpasattama || 39.29 || lalāṭe tu mahādevo hyaśvinau karṇasaṃsthitau | naranārāyaṇau śṛṅge śṛṅgamadhye pitāmahaḥ || 39.30 || kambalo'dhigatastāta pāśadhṛgvaruṇastathā | yamaśca bhagavāndeva āśritya codaraṃ śritaḥ || 39.31 || khureṣu pannagāścaivaṃ pucchāgre sūryaraśmayaḥ | evambhūtāṃ hi kapilāṃ sarvadevamayīṃ nṛpa || 39.32 || ye dhārayanti ca gṛhe dhanyāste nātra saṃśayaḥ | prātarutthāya yastasyāḥ kurute tu pradakṣiṇām || 39.33 || pradakṣiṇā kṛtā tena saśailavanakānanā | kapilāpañcagavyena yaḥ snāpayati śaṅkaram || 39.34 || upavāsaparo yastu tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | snātvā hyuktavidhānena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 39.35 || tasya te vaṃśajāḥ sarve daśa pūrve daśāpare | tṛptā rohanti vai svarge dhyāyanto'sya manorathān || 39.36 || eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ sambhavo nṛpasattama | tīrthasya ca phalaṃ puṇyaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 39.37 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 39.38 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye kapilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.40>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra karañjeśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahābhāgo daityo lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 40.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yo'sau siddho mahābhāga tatra tīrthe mahātapāḥ | kasya putraḥ kathaṃ siddhaḥ kasminkāle vada dvija || 40.2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā kṛtayuge rājanmānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | vedavedāṅgatattvajño marīcirnāma nāmataḥ || 40.3 || tasyāpi tapaso rāśeḥ kālena mahatānagha | putro'tha mānaso jātaḥ sākṣādbrahmeva cāparaḥ || 40.4 || kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucamathārjavam | marīceśca guṇā hyete santi tasya ca bhārata || 40.5 || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ dvijasattamam | jñātvā prajāpatirdakṣo bhāryārthe svasutāṃ dadau || 40.6 || aditirditirdanuścaiva tathāpyevaṃ daśāparāḥ | yāsāṃ putrāśca saṃjātāḥ pautrāśca bharatarṣabha || 40.7 || aditirjanayāmāsa putrānindrapurogamān | jātāstasya mahābāho kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ || 40.8 || yaistu lokatrayaṃ vyāptaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ mahat | tathānyasya mahābhāgo danoḥ putro vyajāyata || 40.9 || sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ karañjo nāma nāmataḥ | bāla eva mahābhāga cacāra sa mahattapaḥ || 40.10 || narmadātaṭamāśritya cātighoramanuttamam | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇaṃ nṛpa || 40.11 || śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ snānahomaparāyaṇaḥ | tatastuṣṭo mahādeva umayā sahitaḥ kila || 40.12 || vareṇa chandayāmāsa tripurāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ | bhoḥ karañja mahāsattva parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha || 40.13 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadmi hyamaratvamṛte mama || 40.14 || karañja uvāca yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama | tarhi putrāśca pautrāśca santu me dharmavatsalāḥ || 40.15 || tathetyuktvā mahādeva umayā sahitastadā | vṛṣārūḍho gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || 40.16 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve so'pi daityo mudānvitaḥ | svanāmnātra mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā yayau gṛham || 40.17 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam | snānamātrānarastatra mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 40.18 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | so'gniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 40.19 || anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | anivartyā gatistasya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 40.20 || athavāgnijale prāṇānyastyajeddharmanandana | ayutadvitayaṃ vaste varṣāṇāṃ śivamandire || 40.21 || tataścaiva kṣaye jāte jāyate vimale kule | vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 40.22 || rājā vā rājatulyo vā jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam | putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ || 40.23 || evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ yadyattvayānagha | tīrthasya tu phalaṃ tasya snānadāneṣu bhārata || 40.24 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || 40.25 || yastu śrāvayate śrāddhe paṭhetpitṛparāyaṇaḥ | akṣayaṃ jāyate puṇyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 40.26 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye karañjeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.41>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchecca rājendra kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahāyakṣaḥ kuṇḍadhāro nṛpottama || 41.1 || tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ surāsurabhayaṃkaram | paulastyamandire caiva cikrīḍa nṛpasattama || 41.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kasminyuge samutpannaḥ kasya putro mahāmatiḥ | tapastaptvā suvipulaṃ toṣito yena śaṅkaraḥ || 41.3 || etadvistaratastāta kathayasva mamānagha | śṛṇvataśca na tṛptirme kathāmṛtamanuttamam || 41.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tretāyuge brahmasamaḥ paulastyonāma viśravāḥ | tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ bharadvājasutodbhavaḥ || 41.5 || putraṃ pautragaṇairyuktaṃ patnyā bhaktyā sutoṣitaḥ | dhanadaṃ janayāmāsa sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 41.6 || jātamātraṃ tu taṃ jñātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | cakāra nāma suprīta ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ || 41.7 || yasmādviśravaso jāto mama pautratvamāgataḥ | tasmādvaiśravaṇo nāma tava dattaṃ mayānagha || 41.8 || tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhanagoptā bhaviṣyasi | caturtho lokapālānāmakṣayaścāvyayo bhuvi || 41.9 || tasya bhāryā mahārāja īśvarīti ca viśrutā | yakṣo yakṣādhipaḥ śreṣṭhastasya kuṇḍo'bhavatsutaḥ || 41.10 || sa ca rūpaṃ paraṃ prāpya mātāpitroranujñayā | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 41.11 || grīṣme pañcāgnisaṃtapto varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ | hemante jalamadhyastho vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ samāḥ || 41.12 || evaṃ varṣaśate pūrṇe ekāṅguṣṭhe'bhavannṛpa | asthibhūtaḥ paraṃ tāta ūrdhvabāhustataḥ param || 41.13 || atapacca ghṛtaśvāsaḥ kuṇḍalo bharatarṣabha | caturthe varṣaśatake tutoṣa vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 41.14 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bho vatsa yatte manasi rocate | dadāmi te na sandehastapasā toṣito hyaham || 41.15 || kuṇḍala uvāca yakṣādhipaprasādena tasyaivānucaraḥ pure | vicarāmi yathākāmamavadhyaḥ sarvaśatruṣu || 41.16 || tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ | jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam || 41.17 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve so'pi yakṣo mudānvitaḥ | sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam || 41.18 || alaṃkṛtvā jagannāthaṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ | vimānaiścāmaraiśchatraistathā vai liṅgapūraṇaiḥ || 41.19 || tarpayitvā dvijānsamyagannapānādibhūṣaṇaiḥ | prīṇayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau || 41.20 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | uttamaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaranāmataḥ || 41.21 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścidupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ | arcayeddevamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 41.22 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇiṃ mauktikameva ca | dadyādbhojyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa sukhī modate divi || 41.23 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā ṛgyajuḥsāmago'pi vā | ṛcamekāṃ japitvā tu sakalaṃ phalamaśnute || 41.24 || gāṃ prayacchati viprebhyastatphalaṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava | yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca || 41.25 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate | svarge vāso bhavettasya putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ || 41.26 || tāvanti varṣāṇi mahānubhāvaḥ svarge vasetputrapautraiśca sārddham | tatrānnado yāti maheśalokamasaṃkhyavarṣāṇi na saṃśayo'tra || 41.27 || sa vai sukhī modate svargaloke gandharvasiddhāpsaraḥsampragīte | evaṃ tu te dharmasuta prabhāvastīrthasya sarvaḥ kathitaśca pārtha || 41.28 || śrutvā stuvanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ punastrilokīmiha tatprabhāvāt || 41.29 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.42>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra pippaleśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahāyogī pippalādo mahātapāḥ || 42.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca pippalādasya caritaṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho | māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya yatra siddho mahātapāḥ || 42.2 || kasya putro mahābhāga kimarthaṃ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ | etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha || 42.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca mithilāstho mahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | yājñavalkyaḥ purā tāta cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 42.4 || tāpasī tasya bhaginī yājñavalkyasya dhīmataḥ | sā saptame'pi varṣe ca vaidhavyaṃ prāpa daivataḥ || 42.5 || pūrvakarmavipākena hīnābhūtpitṛmātṛtaḥ | nābhūttatpatipakṣe'pi ko'pītyekākinī sthitā || 42.6 || bhūmau bhramantī bhrātuḥ sā samīpamagamacchanaiḥ | cacāra ca tapaḥ so'pi paralokasukhepsayā || 42.7 || cacāra sāpi tatrasthā śuśrūṣantī mahattapaḥ | kasmiṃścitsamaye sātha snātāhani rajasvalā || 42.8 || antarvāso dhṛtavatī dṛṣṭvā karpaṭakaṃ rahaḥ | yājñavalkyo'pi tadrātrau supto yatra susaṃvṛtaḥ || 42.9 || svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvātyajacchukraṃ kaupīne raktabinduvat | virājitena tapasā siddhaṃ tadanalaprabham || 42.10 || yāvatprabuddho vipro'sau vīkṣyocchiṣṭaṃ tadaṃśukam | cikṣepa dūrato'spṛśyaṃ śaucaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 42.11 || niṣiddhaṃ tu niśi snānamiti suṣvāpa sa dvijaḥ | niśīthe sāpi tadvastraṃ bhagasyāvaraṇaṃ vyadhāt || 42.12 || prātaranveṣayāmāsa munirvastramitastataḥ | tataḥ sā brāhmaṇī prāha kiṃ anveṣayase prabho | kena kāryaṃ tava tathā vadasva mama tattvataḥ || 42.13 || yājñavalkya uvāca apavitro mayā bhadre svapno dṛṣṭo'dya vai niśi | sakledaṃ tatra me vastraṃ nikṣiptaṃ tanna dṛśyate || 42.14 || tacchrutvā brāhmaṇī vākyaṃ bhītabhītāvadannṛpa | tadvastraṃ tu mayā vipra snātvā hyantaḥ kṛtaṃ mahat || 42.15 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā hāhetyuktvā mahāmuniḥ | nipapāta tadā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ || 42.16 || kimetaditi setyuktvā hyākāśamiva nirmalā | āśvāsayantī taṃ vipraṃ provāca vacanaṃ tadā || 42.17 || vadasva kāraṇaṃ tāta guhyādguhyataraṃ yadi | pratīkāro'sya yenaiva vimṛśya kriyate tvarā || 42.18 || tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā labdhavāgvai tataḥ kṣaṇam | provāca sādhvasamanā yattacchṛṇu nareśvara || 42.19 || nātra doṣo'sti te kaścinmama caiva śubhavrate | tavodare tu garbho yastatra daivaṃ parāyaṇam || 42.20 || tasya tattvena rakṣā ca tvayā kāryā sadaiva hi | vināśī naiva kartavyo yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ || 42.21 || tatheti vrīḍitā sādhvī dūyamānena cetasā | apālayacca taṃ garbhaṃ yāvatputro hyajāyata || 42.22 || jātamātraṃ ca taṃ garbhaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇī ca sā | aśvatthacchāyāmāśritya tamutsṛjya vaco'bravīt || 42.23 || yāni sattvāni lokeṣu sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | tāni sarvāṇi rakṣantu tyaktaṃ vai bālakaṃ mayā || 42.24 || evamuktvā gatā sā tu brāhmaṇī nṛpasattama | tathāgataḥ sa tu śiśustatra sthitvā muhūrtakam || 42.25 || pāṇipādau vinikṣipya nikuñcya nayane śubhe | āsyaṃ tu vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā ruroda vikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ || 42.26 || tena śabdena vitrastāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca ye | ākampitā mahotpātaiḥ saśailavanakānanā || 42.27 || tato jñātvā mahadbhūtaṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ dvijarṣabham | na jahāti nagaśchāyāṃ pānārthāya tataḥ param | apibacca sutaṃ tasmādabhṛtaṃ caiva bhārata || 42.28 || evaṃ sa vardhitastatra kumāro nijacetasi | cintayāmāsa viśrabdhaḥ kiṃ mama grahagocaram || 42.29 || tataḥ krūrasabhācāraḥ krūraṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣitaḥ | papāta sahasā bhūmau śanaiścārī śanaiścaraḥ || 42.30 || uvāca ca bhayatrastaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā | kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ vipra pippalāda mahāmune || 42.31 || caranvai gaganādyena pātito dharaṇītale | sauriṇā hyevamuktastu pippalādo mahāmuniḥ || 42.32 || krodharūpo'bravīdvākyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa | pitṛmātṛvihīnasya mama bālasya durmate | pīḍāṃ karoṣi kasmāttvaṃ saure brūhi hyaśeṣataḥ || 42.33 || śanaiścara uvāca krūrasvabhāvaḥ sahajo mama dṛṣṭistathedṛśī | muñcasva māṃ tathā kartā yadbravīṣi na saṃśayaḥ || 42.34 || pippalāda uvāca adyaprabhṛti bālānāṃ varṣādā ṣoḍaśādgraha | pīḍā tvayā na kartavyā eṣa te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 42.35 || evamastviti coktvā sa jagāma punarāgataḥ | devamārgaṃ śanaiścārī praṇamya ṛṣisattamam || 42.36 || gate cādarśanaṃ tatra so'pi bālo mahāgrahaḥ | vicintayanvai pitaraṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ || 42.37 || āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā janayāmāsa pāvakam | kṛtyāmantrairjuhāvāgnau kṛtyā vai saṃbhavatviti || 42.38 || tāvajjhaṭiti sā kanyā jvālāmālāvibhūṣitā | hutabhuksadṛśākārā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt || 42.39 || śoṣayāmi samudrān kiṃ cūrṇayāmi ca parvatān | avaniṃ veṣṭayāmīti pātaye kiṃ nabhastalam || 42.40 || kasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi ghātayāmi ca kaṃ dvija | śīghramādiśyatāṃ kāryaṃ mā me kālātyayo bhavet || 42.41 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pippalādo mahātapāḥ | krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 42.42 || mahatā krodhavegena mayā tvaṃ cintitā śubhe | pitā me yājñavalkyaśca tasya tvaṃ pata māciram || 42.43 || evamuktvāgamacchīghraṃ sphoṭayantī nabhastalam | mithilāstho mahāprājñastapastepe mahāmanāḥ || 42.44 || yāvatpaśyati digbhāgaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham | yājñavalkyo mahātejā mahadbhūtamupasthitam || 42.45 || taddṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ bhītabhīto mahāmuniḥ | anuyukto'tha bhūtena janakaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau || 42.46 || śaraṇyaṃ māmanuprāptaṃ viddhi tvaṃ nṛpasattama | mahadbhūtabhayādrakṣa yadi śaknoṣi pārthiva || 42.47 || brahmatejobhavaṃ bhūtamanivāryaṃ durāsadam | na ca śaknomyahaṃ trātuṃ rājā vacanamabravīt || 42.48 || tataścānyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaraṇārthī mahātapāḥ | jagāma tena mukto'sau cendrasya sadanaṃ bhayāt || 42.49 || devarāja namaste'stu mahābhūtabhayānnṛpa | kampamāno'bravīdvipro rakṣasveti punaḥpunaḥ || 42.50 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājo'bravīdidam | na śaknomi paritrātuṃ brahmakopādahaṃ mune || 42.51 || tataḥ sa brahmabhavanaṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ | jagāma viṣṇulokaṃ ca tenāpītyukta eva saḥ || 42.52 || tataḥ sa munirudvigno nirāśo jīvite nṛpa | anugamyamāno bhūtena agacchacchaṅkarālayam || 42.53 || tasya yogabalopeto mahādevasya pāṇḍava | nakhamāṃsāntare gupto yathā devo na paśyati || 42.54 || tadante cāgamadbhūtaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham | muñca muñceti puruṣaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 42.55 || evamukto mahādevastena bhūtena bhārata | yogīndraṃ darśayāmāsa nakhamāṃsāntare tadā || 42.56 || saṃsthāpya bhūtaṃ bhūteśaḥ paramāpadgataṃ munim | uvāca mā bhaistvaṃ vipra nirgacchasva mahāmune || 42.57 || tataḥ susūkṣmadehasthaṃ bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvābravīdidam | kimasya tvaṃ mahābhūta kariṣyasi vadasva me || 42.58 || kṛtyovāca krodhāviṣṭena deveśa pippalādena cintitā | asya dehaṃ haniṣyāmi hiṃsārthaṃ viddhi māṃ prabho || 42.59 || etacchrutvā mahādevo bhūtasya vadanāccyutam | kaṭisthaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ ca mantrayāmāsa mantravit || 42.60 || yogīśvareti viprasya kṛtvā nāma yudhiṣṭhira | visarjayitvā deveśastatraivāntaradhīyata || 42.61 || preṣayitvā tu taṃ bhūtaṃ pippalādo'pi durmanāḥ | pitṛmātṛsamudvigno narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 42.62 || ekāṅguṣṭho nirāhāro varṣādā ṣoḍaśānnṛpa | toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram || 42.63 || tatastattapasā tuṣṭaḥ śaṅkaro vākyamabravīt || 42.64 || īśvara uvāca parituṣṭo'smi te vipra tapasānena suvrata | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadmi manasā cepsitaṃ śubham || 42.65 || pippalāda uvāca yadi me bhagavāṃstuṣṭo yadi deyo varo mama | atra saṃnihito deva tīrthe bhava maheśvara || 42.66 || evamuktastathetyuktvā pippalādaṃ mahāmunim | jagāmādarśanaṃ devo bhūtasaṅghasamanvitaḥ || 42.67 || pippalādo gate deve snātvā tatra mahāmbhasi | sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāmottaraparvatam || 42.68 || tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā snātvā mantrayutaṃ nṛpa | tarpayitvā pitḥn devān pūjayecca maheśvaram || 42.69 || aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam | mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 42.70 || atha yo bhojayedviprān pitḥnuddiśya bhārata | tasya te dvādaśābdāni modante divi tarpitāḥ || 42.71 || saṃnyāsena tu yaḥ kaścittatra tīrthe tanuṃ tyajet | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokātkadācana || 42.72 || etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭhe hi tvayānagha | māhātmyaṃ pippalādasya tīrthasyotpattireva ca || 42.73 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 42.74 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pippalādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.43>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra vimaleśvaramuttamam | tatra devaśilā ramyā svayaṃ devairvinirmitā || 43.1 || tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇānpūjayennṛpa | svalpenāpi hi dānena tasya cānto na vidyate || 43.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kāni dānāni viprendra śastāni dharaṇītale | yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 43.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikameva ca | bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ mocayatpaśubhānnaram || 43.4 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitkurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam | rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadā bhūtasamplavam || 43.5 || tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchetsarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm | tatra snātvārcayeddevaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram || 43.6 || ṛcamekāṃ japetsāmnaḥ sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet | yajurvedasya japanādṛgvedasya tathaiva ca || 43.7 || akṣaraṃ vā japenmantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram | ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 43.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vidhinā japeddvijān | tasya koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 43.9 || anāśakenāgnigatyā jale vā dehapātanāt | tasmiṃstīrthe mṛto yastu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 43.10 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā nṛpasattama | vihitaṃ karma kurvāṇaḥ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || 43.11 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca vyādhiṃ sattvakṣayaṃ mohaṃ jñātvā varṇā dvijottama | pāpebhyo vipramucyante kena tatsādhanaṃ vada || 43.12 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tilodakī tilasnāyī kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ | brāhmaṇo'naśanaiḥ prāṇāṃstyajallabhati sadgatim || 43.13 || saṅgrāme sadgatiṃ tāta kṣatriyo nidhane labhet | tadabhāvānmahāprājña sevamāno labhediti || 43.14 || vyādhigrahagṛhīto vā vṛddho vā vikalendriyaḥ | ātmānaṃ dāhayitvāgnau vidhinā sadgatiṃ labhet || 43.15 || vaiśyo'pi hi tyajanprāṇānevaṃ vai śubhabhāgbhavet | jale vā śuddhabhāvena tyaktvā prāṇāñchivo bhavet || 43.16 || śūdro'pi dvijaśuśrūṣustoṣayitvā maheśvaram | vimucya nānyathā pāpaḥ patate narake dhruvam || 43.17 || athavā praṇavāśakto dvijebhyo gurave tathā | pañcāgnau śoṣayeddehamāpṛcchya dvijasattamān || 43.18 || śāntadāntajitakrodhāñchāstrayuktān vicakṣaṇān | teṣāṃ caivopadeśena karīṣāgniṃ prasādhayet || 43.19 || evaṃ varṇā yathātvena mūḍhāhaṅkāramohitāḥ | patanti narake ghore yathāndho girigahvare || 43.20 || ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartante kāmacārataḥ | kṛmiyoniṃ prapadyante teṣāṃ piṇḍo na ca kriyā || 43.21 || śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ tyaktvā yathecchācārasevinaḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatirvai koṭyo narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 43.22 || pratyekaṃ vā patantyete magnā narakasāgare | durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma bahudharmārjitaṃ nṛpa || 43.23 || tallabdhvā madamātsaryaṃ yo vai tyajati mānavaḥ | saṃniyamya sadātmānaṃ jñānacakṣurnaro hi saḥ || 43.24 || ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā || 43.25 || yasya nonmīlitaṃ cakṣurjñeyo jātyandha eva saḥ | etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ nṛpasattama || 43.26 || tathāniṣṭatarāṇāṃ hi rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā | narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā || 43.27 || tārayetsarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | sarvadevādhidevena īśvareṇa mahātmanā || 43.28 || lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mahāpuṇyāvatāritā | mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati karmajam || 43.29 || rudradehādviniṣkrāntā tena puṇyatamā hi sā | prātarutthāya yo nityaṃ bhūmimākramya bhaktitaḥ || 43.30 || etanmantraṃ japettāta snānasya labhate phalam | namaḥ puṇyajale devi namaḥ sāgaragāmini || 43.31 || namo'stu pāpanirmoce namo devi varānane || 43.32 || namo'stu te ṛṣivarasaṅghasevite namo'stu te trinayanadehaniḥsṛte | namo'stu te sukṛtavatāṃ sadā vare namo'stu te satatapavitrapāvani || 43.33 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.44>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa | revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle nirmitaṃ śūlapāṇinā || 44.1 || mokṣārthaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ nṛpasattama | yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutā me vividhā dharmāstīrthāni vividhāni ca | dānadharmāḥ samastāśca tvatprasādāddvijottama || 44.2 || anyacca śrotumicchāmi saṃsāraśchidyate yathā | punarāgamanaṃ nāsti mokṣaprāptirbhavedyathā || 44.3 || etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādāddvijasattama || 44.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā tīrthāttīrthāntaraṃ mahat | śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate cābdikādaghāt || 44.5 || vācikairmānasairvāpi śārīraiśca viśeṣataḥ | kīrtanāttasya tīrthasya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 44.6 || pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ tu tacca tīrthaṃ mahīpate | bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpakarmiṇām || 44.7 || revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle parvato bhṛgusaṃjñitaḥ | tasya mūrdhni ca tattīrthaṃ sthāpitaṃ caiva śambhunā || 44.8 || śūlabhedeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhūpate | tatra sthitāśca ye vṛkṣāstīrthāccaiva caturdiśam || 44.9 || patitā nilayaṃ yānti rudrasya nātra saṃśayaḥ | mṛtāstatraiva ye kecijjantavo bhuvi pakṣiṇaḥ || 44.10 || te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ | pātālānniḥsṛtā gaṅgā bhogavatītisaṃjñitā || 44.11 || niṣkrāntā śūlabhedācca sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | yā sā gīrvāṇanāmnyanyā vahetpuṇyā mahānadī || 44.12 || patitā kuṇḍamadhye tu yatra bhinnaṃ triśūlinā | śambhunā ca purā tāta utpādya ca sarasvatī || 44.13 || sā tatra patitā rājan prācīnāghavimocinī | bhāsvatyā tritayaṃ yatra śilā gīrvāṇasaṃjñitā || 44.14 || tatra tīrthe ca tattīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayā tathā || 44.15 || anyāni ca sutīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | pañca sthānāni tīrthāni pṛthagbhūtāni yāni ca || 44.16 || vakṣyāmi ca samāsena ekaikaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | gayā nābhyāṃ yathā puṇyā cakratīrthaṃ ca tatsamam || 44.17 || dharmāraṇye yathā kūpaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca tatsamam | brahmayūpaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ devanadyāstathaiva ca || 44.18 || yathā gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ surāṇāṃ ca yathā śilā | yathā ca puṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ mārkaṇḍahrada eva ca || 44.19 || dattvā piṇḍodakaṃ tatra piṇḍāṇāṃ ca tathākṣayam | yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ toyaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ | mucyate sarvapāpaistu uragaḥ kañcukairiva | anindyānpūjayedviprān dambhakrodhavivarjitān || 44.20 || trayodaśadinaṃ dānaṃ trayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet | abhyarcitaṃ suraṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇanāthaṃ gajānanam || 44.21 || sarve vighnā vinaśyanti dṛṣṭvā kambalakṣetrapam || 44.22 || pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram || 44.23 || devasya pūrvabhāge tu umā pūjyā prayatnataḥ | mārkaṇḍeśaṃ tato bhaktyā pūjayedguhavāsinam || 44.24 || mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvairajñānajñānasaṃcitaiḥ | guhāmadhye praviṣṭastu japetsūktaṃ tu tryakṣaram || 44.25 || nīlaparvatajaṃ puṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśena labheta saḥ | trinarāstatra tiṣṭhanti sādityamarutaiḥ saha || 44.26 || sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ koṭiliṅgamanuttamam | yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam || 44.27 || tathā pāpāni naśyanti śūlabhedasya darśanāt | pratyakṣo dṛśyate'dyāpi pratyayo hyavanīpate || 44.28 || visphuliṅgā liṅgamadhye spandante snānayogataḥ | dvitīyaḥ pratyayastatra tailabindurna sarpati || 44.29 || evaṃ hi pratyayastatra śūlabhedaprabhāvajaḥ | yaḥ smarecchūlabhedaṃ tu trikālaṃ nityameva ca || 44.30 || sa pūtaśca bhavetsākṣātsabāhyābhyantaro nṛpa | na kasyacinmayā khyātaṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ tridaśairapi || 44.31 || guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ sadā gopyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadoṣaghnamuttamam || 44.32 || sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ śūlabhedaṃ janeśvara | śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 44.33 || śūlabhedaṃ mayā tāta saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ tava | yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 44.34 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.45>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ paripṛṣṭo maheśvaram | rājñā cottānapādena ṛṣidevasamāgame || 45.1 || uttānapāda uvāca idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param | guhyādguhyataraṃ sthānaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ hara || 45.2 || śūlabhedaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kenaivotpāditaṃ purā | māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya vistarācchaṃsa me prabho || 45.3 || īśvara uvāca āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ | martye na tādṛśaḥ kaścidvikrameṇa balena vā || 45.4 || sūnurbrahmasutasyāyamandhako nāma durmadaḥ | nijasthāne vasan pāpaḥ kurvan rājyamakaṇṭakam || 45.5 || hṛṣṭapuṣṭo vasanmartye sa surairnābhibhūyate | bhavanaṃ tasya pāpasya vahnerupavanaṃ yathā || 45.6 || etasminnandhakaḥ kāle cintayāmāsa bhārata | toṣayāmi mahādevaṃ yena sānugraho bhavet || 45.7 || prārthayāmi varaṃ divyaṃ yo me manasi vartate | paraṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā so'ndhako nirgato gṛhāt || 45.8 || revātaṭaṃ samāsādya dānavastapasi sthitaḥ | ugraṃ tapaścacārāsau dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 45.9 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa nirāhāro'bhavattataḥ | dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa nyavasadvāribhojanaḥ || 45.10 || tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa dhūmapānarato'bhavat | caturthaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ yogābhyāsena saṃsthitaḥ || 45.11 || kopīha nedṛśa cakre tapaḥ paramadāruṇam | asthicarmāvaśeṣo'sau yāvattiṣṭhati bhārata || 45.12 || tasya mūrdhni tato rājan dhūmavārttirviniḥsṛtā | devalokamatītyāsau kailāsaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitā || 45.13 || tāvaddevasamīpasthā umā vacanamabravīt | ko'styayaṃ mānuṣe loke tapasogreṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 45.14 || caturvarṣasahasrāṇi vyatīyuḥ parameśvara | na kenāpīdṛśaṃ taptaṃ tapo dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā || 45.15 || avajñāṃ kuruṣe deva kimatra niyamānvite | sarvasya datse śīghraṃ tvamalpena tapasā vibho || 45.16 || nākṣakrīḍāṃ kariṣye'dya tvayā saha maheśvara | yāvannotthāpyate hyeṣa dānavo bhaktavatsala || 45.17 || īśvara uvāca sādhu sādhu mahādevi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite | ahaṃ taṃ na vijānāmi kliśyantaṃ dānaveśvaram || 45.18 || yogābhyāse sthito bhadre dhyāyaṃstatparamaṃ padam | tatrāgaccha mayā sārddhaṃ yatra tapyatyasau tapaḥ || 45.19 || umayā sahito devo gatastatra maheśvaraḥ | asthicarmāvaśeṣastu dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā || 45.20 || pratyuvāca prasanno'sau devadevo maheśvaraḥ | bhobhoḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ bhīmaṃ dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 45.21 || īdṛśaṃ ca tapo ghoraṃ kasmādvatsa tvayā kṛtam | varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa yaste manasi vartate || 45.22 || andhaka uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varado yadi śaṅkara | surān sarvān vijeṣyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 45.23 || īśvara uvāca svapne'pi tridaśāḥ sarve na yoddhavyāḥ kadācana | asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manaso yanna rocate || 45.24 || anyaṃ kimapi yācasva yaste manasi vartate | svarge vā yadi vā martye pātāleṣu ca saṃsthitān || 45.25 || martyeṣu vividhān bhogān bhokṣyasi tvaṃ yathepsitān | kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ svarge devapatiryathā || 45.26 || devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so'ndhako vimanāḥ sthitaḥ | vṛthā kleśaśca me jāto na kiṃcitsādhitaṃ mayā || 45.27 || niśvāsaṃ paramaṃ muktvā nipapāta dharātale | mūlacchinno yathā vṛkṣo nirucchvāsastadābhavat || 45.28 || mūrcchāpannaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā devī vacanamabravīt | yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayatyeṣa tamasmai dehi śaṅkara || 45.29 || bhaktānupekṣamāṇasya tavākīrtirbhaviṣyati || 45.30 || īśvara uvāca yadi dāsye varaṃ devi icchābhūtaṃ kadācana | tato na maṃsyate viṣṇuṃ na brahmāṇaṃ na māmapi || 45.31 || uccatvamāpto deveśi anyānapi surāsurān || 45.32 || devyuvāca kamapyupāyamāśritya utthāpaya maheśvara | viṣṇuvarjaṃ surānsarvāñjayasveti varaṃ vada || 45.33 || īśvara uvāca upāyaḥ śobhano devi yo me manasi vartate | tamevāsmai pradāsyāmi yastvayā kathito varaḥ || 45.34 || tato'mṛtena saṃsiktaḥ svastho'bhūttatkṣaṇādayam | tathā punarnavo jātaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥ || 45.35 || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā gṛhāṇa varamuttamam | viṣṇuvarjaṃ pradāsyāmi yattavābhimataṃ priyam || 45.36 || sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ tubhyaṃ mā dharmaste'nyathā bhavet | dadāmīti varaṃ tubhyaṃ manyase yadi cāsura || 45.37 || viṣṇuvarjaṃ surān sarvāñjeṣyasi tvaṃ ca māṃ vinā || 45.38 || andhaka uvāca bhavatvevamiti prāha balamāsthāya kevalam | viṣṇuvarjaṃ vijeṣye'haṃ svabalena maheśvara || 45.39 || kṛtārtho'haṃ hi saṃjāta ityuktvā praṇatiṃ gataḥ | gaccha devomayāsārddhaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ varam || 45.40 || vṛṣapuṃgavamāruhya devo'sāvumayā saha | varaṃ dattvā sa tasyaivaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || 45.41 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe andhakavarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.46>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sa dānavo varaṃ labdhvā jagāma svapuraṃ prati | dadarśa svapuraṃ rājañchobhitaṃ citracatvaraiḥ || 46.1 || udyānaiścaiva vividhaiḥ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ | panasairbakulaiścaivāmrātairāmraiśca campakaiḥ || 46.2 || aśokairnālikeraiśca mātuliṅgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ | nānāvṛkṣaiśca śobhāḍhyaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam || 46.3 || devatāyatanairdivyairdhvajamālāsuśobhitaiḥ | vedādhyayananirghoṣairmaṅgalādyairvināditam || 46.4 || prāviśadbhavane divye kāñcane rukmamālini | apaśyatsa sutān bhāryāmamātyān dāsabhṛtyakān || 46.5 || tato jayapradān sarvānitaścetaśca dhāvataḥ | hṛcchobhāṃ ca prakurvāṇān vai jayantībhiruccakaiḥ || 46.6 || kecittoraṇamābadhya kecitpuṣpāṇyavākiran | mātuliṅgakarāścānye dhāvanti hyandhakaṃ prati || 46.7 || pure janāśca dṛśyante bhājanairannapūritaiḥ | pūrṇahastāḥ pradṛśyante tatraiva bahavo janāḥ || 46.8 || sākṣatairbhājanaistatra śatasāhasrayoṣitaḥ | mantrān paṭhanti viprāśca maṅgalānyapi yoṣitaḥ || 46.9 || amātyāścaiva bhṛtyāśca gajāṃścāḍhaukayanti ca | vardhāpayanti te sarve ye kecitpuravāsinaḥ || 46.10 || hṛṣṭastuṣṭo'vasattatra sacivaiḥ saha so'ndhakaḥ | dadarśa sa jagatsarvaṃ turaṅgāṃśca padātikān || 46.11 || tathaiva vividhān kośāṃstatra kāñcanapūritān | mahiṣīrgā vṛṣāṃścaivāpaśyacchatrāṇyanekadhā || 46.12 || sa evamandhakastatra kiyantaṃ kālamāvasat | hṛṣṭastuṣṭo vasanmartye sa surairnābhyabhūyata || 46.13 || varaṃ labdhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śaṅkitāḥ svargavāsinaḥ | ekībhūtāśca te sarve vāsavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 46.14 || śakra uvāca kathamāgamanaṃ vo'tra sarveṣāmapi nākinām | kasmādvo bhayamutpannamāgatāḥ śaraṇaṃ katham || 46.15 || tataste hyamarāḥ sarve śakrametadvaco'bruvan || 46.16 || devā ūcuḥ | suranāthāndhako nāma daityaḥ śambhuvarorjitaḥ | ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ kiṃ nu kāryamataḥ param || 46.17 || tattvaṃ cintaya deveśa ka upāyo vidhīyatām | itthaṃ vadanti te devāḥ śakrāgre mantraṇodyatāḥ || 46.18 || mantrayanti ca yāvadvai tāvaccāramukheritam | jñātvā tatra sa devaughaṃ dānavo nirgato gṛhāt || 46.19 || ekākī syandanārūḍha āyurdhaibahubhirvṛtaḥ | durgamaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ sa līlayaiva gato nṛpa || 46.20 || svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ vividhāśramaiḥ | durgamaṃ śatruvargasya tadā pārthivasattama || 46.21 || praviveśāsurastatra līlayā svagṛhe yathā | vṛtrahā bhayamāpannaḥ svakīyaṃ cāsanaṃ dadau || 46.22 || upaviṣṭo'ndhakastatra śakrasyaivāsane śubhe | āsthānaṃ kalayāmāsa sarvatastridaśāvṛtam || 46.23 || śakra uvāca kiṃ tavāgamanaṃ cātra kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva me | yadasmadīyaṃ vittaṃ hi tatte dāsyāmi dānava || 46.24 || andhaka uvāca nāhaṃ vai kāmaye kośaṃ na gajāṃśca sureśvara | svakīyaṃ darśayasvādya svargaśṛṅgārabhūṣitam || 46.25 || airāvataṃ mahānāgaṃ taṃ caivoccaiḥśravohayam | urvaśyādīni ratnāni mama darśaya gopate || 46.26 || pārijātakapuṣpāṇi vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ | vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi darśayasva śacīpate || 46.27 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakraścintitavānidam | yo'muṃ nihanti pāpmānaṃ na taṃ paśyāmi karhicit || 46.28 || nāsti rakṣāpradaḥ kaścitsvargalokasya duḥkhinaḥ | bhayatrasto dadāvanyadvāditrādyapsarogaṇaiḥ || 46.29 || raṅgabhūmāvupāviśya kārayāmāsa tāṇḍavam | upaviṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve yamamārutakinnarāḥ || 46.30 || urvaśyādyā apsaraso gītavāditrayogataḥ | nanṛtuḥ puratastasya sarvā ekaikaśo nṛpa || 46.31 || na vyaśrāmyata taccittaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasastadā | śacīṃ prati manastasya sakāmamabhavannṛpa || 46.32 || gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati | tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhamandhakasya suraiḥ saha || 46.33 || tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhvastāḥ pārthivasattama | saṃgrāme vividhaiḥ śastraiścakravajrādibhirghanaiḥ || 46.34 || saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ nītā hyanekaśaḥ | sarve'pi marutastena bhagnāḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani || 46.35 || yathā siṃhogajān sarvān vicitya vicaredvanam | tadvadekena te devā jitāḥ sarve parāṅmukhāḥ || 46.36 || bālo'dhipo yathā grāme svecchayā pīḍayejjanān | svairamākramya gṛhṇāti kośavāsāṃsi cāsakṛt || 46.37 || gataṃ na paśyatyātmānaṃ prajāsaṃtāpanena ca | gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa gato vai dānavottamaḥ || 46.38 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye śacīharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.47>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gīrvāṇāśca tataḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | gajairgirivarākārairhayaiścaiva gajopamaiḥ || 47.1 || syandanairnagarākāraiḥ siṃhaśārdūlayojitaiḥ | kacchapairmahiṣaiścānyairmakaraiśca tathāpare || 47.2 || brahmalokamanuprāptā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | dṛṣṭvā padmodbhavaṃ devaṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatāḥ surāḥ || 47.3 || devā ūcuḥ | jaya deva jagadvandya jaya saṃsṛtikāraka | padmayone suraśreṣṭha tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 47.4 || sodvegaṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ bhāvitātmanām | meghagambhīrayā vācā devarājamuvāca ha || 47.5 || kimatrāgamanaṃ devāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai vivarṇatā | kenāpamānitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ me kathyatāṃ svayam || 47.6 || devā ūcuḥ | andhakākhyo mahādaityo balavān padmasambhava | tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhanaratnairviyojitāḥ || 47.7 || hatvā devagaṇāṃstāvadasicakraparaddviśvadhaiḥ | gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa dānavo'pi gato balāt || 47.8 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | cintayāmāsa rājendra vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ha || 47.9 || avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarveṣāṃ vo divaukasām | sa trātā sarvajagatāṃ nānyo vidyeta kutracit || 47.10 || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā tadanantaram | brahmāṇaṃ te puraskṛtya gatā yatra sa keśavaḥ | tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmādyāścakrapāṇinam || 47.11 || devā ūcuḥ | jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa lakṣmyā vakṣaḥsthalāśritaḥ | asurakṣaya deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 47.12 || stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvairbrahmādyaiśca janārdanaḥ | samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā surasaṅghamuvāca ha || 47.13 || śrīvāsudeva uvāca svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī | kiṃ kāryaṃ procyatāṃ kṣipraṃ kasya ruṣṭā divaukasaḥ || 47.14 || kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kaśca saṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayamāgatam | kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam || 47.15 || parābhavaḥ kṛto yena so'dya yātu yamālayam | evamuktāstu kṛṣṇena kathayāmāsurasya tat || 47.16 || darśayantaḥ svakāndehān lajjamānā hyadhomukhāḥ | hṛtarājyā hyandhakena kṛtā nistejasaḥ prabho || 47.17 || piteva putraṃ parirakṣa deva jahīndraśatruṃ saha putrapautraiḥ | tatheti coktaḥ kamalāsanena surāsurairvanditapādapadmaḥ || 47.18 || śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ cāpaṃ saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ | utthito bhogaparyaṅkāddevānāṃ puratastadā || 47.19 || śrīvāsudeva uvāca pātāle yadi vā martye nāke vā yadi tiṣṭhati | taṃ haniṣyāmyahaṃ pāpaṃ yena saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ || 47.20 || svaṃ sthānaṃ yāntu gīrvāṇāḥ saṃtuṣṭā bhāvitaujasaḥ | viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyāste savāsavāḥ || 47.21 || svayānaistu hariṃ natvā hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ || 47.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gīrvāṇasvargamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.48>
uttānapāda uvāca kasminsthāne'vasaddeva so'ndhako daityapuṃgavaḥ | sarvāndevāṃśca nirjitya kasminsthāne samāsthitaḥ || 48.1 || śrīmaheśa uvāca praviṣṭo dānavo yatra kathayāmi narādhipa | pātālalokamāśritya kanyā vidhvaṃsate tu saḥ || 48.2 || tatra sthitaṃ taṃ vijñāya cāpamādāya keśavaḥ | vyasṛjadbāṇamāgneyaṃ dahyatāmiti cintayan || 48.3 || dahyamāno'gninā so'pi vāruṇāstraṃ sa saṃdadhe | vāruṇāstreṇa mahatā āgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tadā || 48.4 || tato'sau cintayāmāsa kena bāṇo visarjitaḥ | kasyaiṣā pauruṣī śaktiḥ ko yāsyati yamālayam || 48.5 || tato'ndhako mṛdhe kruddho bāṇamārgeṇa nirgataḥ | sa dṛṣṭvā bāṇamārgeṇa cāpahastaṃ janārdanam || 48.6 || andhaka uvāca na śarma lapsyase hyadya mayā dṛṣṭyābhivīkṣitaḥ | na śaknoṣi tathā gantuṃ nāgaḥ śārdūladarśanāt || 48.7 || āgacchati yathā bhakṣyaṃ mārjārasya ca mūṣikaḥ | na śaknoṣi tathā yātuṃ saṃsthitastvaṃ mamāgrataḥ || 48.8 || ahaṃ tvāṃ preṣayiṣyāmi yamamārge sudāruṇe | ahamanveṣayiṣyāmi kila yāsyāmi te gṛham || 48.9 || upanīto'si kālena saṅgrāme mama keśava | ye tvayā nirjitāḥ pūrvaṃ dānavā apyanekaśaḥ || 48.10 || na bhavanti pumāṃsaste striyastāścaiva keśava | paraṃ na śastrasaṅgrāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā saha || 48.11 || vadato dānavendrasya na cukopa sa keśavaḥ | ayudhyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 48.12 || dvandvayuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi niścitya yuyudhe nṛpa | sa kṛṣṇena padākṣiptaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivītale || 48.13 || muhūrtātsa samāśvasya utthāyedaṃ vyacintayat | aśakto dvandvayuddhāya tataḥ sāma prayuktavān | pāṇibhyāṃ sampuṭaṃ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇataḥ śuciḥ || 48.14 || andhaka uvāca jaya kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ | hṛṣīkeśa jagaddhātre acyutāya mahātmane || 48.15 || namaḥ paṅkajanābhāya namaḥ paṅkajamāline | janārdanāya śrīśāya śrīpate pītavāsase || 48.16 || govindāya namo nityaṃ namo jaladhiśāyine | namaḥ karālavaktrāya narasiṃhāya nādine || 48.17 || śārṅgiṇe sitavarṇāya śaṅkhacakragadābhṛte | namo vāmanarūpāya yajñarūpāya te namaḥ || 48.18 || namo varāharūpāya krāntalokatrayāya ca | vyāptāśeṣadigantāya keśavāya namonamaḥ || 48.19 || vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhanāśine | lakṣmyālaya suraśreṣṭha namaste suranāyaka || 48.20 || viṣṇordevādhidevasya pramāṇaṃ ye'pi kurvate | prajāpaterjagaddhātusteṣāmapi namāmyaham || 48.21 || samastabhūtadevasya vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ | praṇāmaṃ ye prakurvanti teṣāmapi namāmyaham || 48.22 || tasya yajñavarāhasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ | praṇāmaṃ ye prakurvanti teṣāmapi namāmyaham || 48.23 || guṇānāṃ hi nidhānāya namaste'stu punaḥpunaḥ | kāruṇyāmbunidhe deva sarvabhaktipriyāya ca || 48.24 || śrībhagavānuvāca tuṣṭaste dānavendrāhaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam | dadāmi te varaṃ nūnamapi trailokyadurlabham || 48.25 || andhaka uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi cepsitam | tadā dadasva me deva yuddhaṃ paramaśobhanam | avaddhastapūto yenāhaṃ lokāngantāsmi śobhanān || 48.26 || śrībhagavānuvāca kathaṃ dadāmi te yuddhaṃ toṣito'haṃ tvayā punaḥ | na tvāṃ tu prabhavetkopaḥ kathaṃ yudhyāmi te'ndhaka || 48.27 || yadi te vartate buddhiryuddhaṃ prati na saṃśayaḥ | tato gacchasva yuddhāya devaṃ prati maheśvaram || 48.28 || andhaka uvāca na tatra sidhyate kāryaṃ devaṃ prati maheśvaram || 48.29 || śrībhagavānuvāca putra tvaṃ śikharaṃ gatvā dhūnayasva balena ca || 48.30 || vidhūte tatra deveśaḥ kopaṃ kartā sudāruṇam | kopitaḥ śaṅkaro raudraṃ yuddhaṃ dāsyati dānava || 48.31 || viṣṇuvākyādasau pāpo gato yatra maheśvaraḥ | kailāsaśikharaṃ prāpya dhunoti sma muhurmuhuḥ || 48.32 || dhūnite tatra śikhare kampitaṃ bhuvanatrayam | nipetuḥ śikharāgrāṇi kampamānānyanekaśaḥ || 48.33 || catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ kṣipramekībhūtā mahīpate | nipeturulkāpātāśca pādapā apyanekaśaḥ || 48.34 || umayā sahito devo vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | gāḍhamāliṅgya girijā devaṃ vacanamabravīt || 48.35 || kimarthaṃ kampate śailaḥ kimarthaṃ kampate dharā | kimarthaṃ kampate nāgo martyaḥ pātālameva ca | kiṃ vā yugakṣayo deva tanmamākhyātumarhasi || 48.36 || īśvara uvāca kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā kṣiptaḥ sarpamukhe karaḥ | lalāṭe ca kṛtaṃ varma sa yāsyati yamālayam || 48.37 || kailāsamāśrito yena supto'haṃ yena bodhitaḥ | taṃ vadhiṣye na sandehaḥ sammukho vā bhavedyadi || 48.38 || cintayāmāsa deveśo hyandhako'yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | upāyaṃ cintayāmāsa yenāsau vadhyate kṣaṇāt || 48.39 || āgatāśca surāḥ sarve brahmādyā vasubhiḥ saha | rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 48.40 || keciddevāḥ sthitāścakre kecittuṇḍāgrapārśvayoḥ | kecinnābhyāṃ sthitā devāḥ keciddhuryeṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 48.41 || dhurīṣu niścalāḥ kecitkecidyūpeṣu saṃsthitāḥ | kecitsyandanasaṃstambhāḥ kecitsyandanaveṣṭakāḥ || 48.42 || āmalasārake'nye'pi anye'pi kalaśe sthitāḥ | riporbhayaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ dhvajamālādiśobhitam || 48.43 || rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā tamārūḍho jagadguruḥ | niryayau dānavo yatra kopāviṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 48.44 || tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyuvācātha kva prayāsyasi durmate | śarāsanaṃ kare gṛhya śarāṃścikṣepa dānave || 48.45 || dānave'dhiṣṭhite yuddhe śaraiścicheda sāyakān | śarāsaneṇa tatraiva andhakaśchāditastadā || 48.46 || na tatra dṛśyate sūryo nākāśaṃ na ca candramāḥ | āgneyamastraṃ vyasṛjaddānavo'pi śivaṃ prati || 48.47 || dahyamānāḥ śarāṅgāraistatrasuḥ sarvadevatāḥ | rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva dahyamānāṃstu dānavāt || 48.48 || tato devādhidevo'sau vāruṇāstramayo'jayat | vāruṇāstreṇa nimiṣādāgneyaṃ nāśitaṃ tadā || 48.49 || dānavena tadā muktaṃ vāyavyāstraṃ raṇājire | vāruṇaṃ ca gataṃ tāta vāyavyāstravināśitam || 48.50 || devo vyasarjayatsārpaṃ krodhāviṣṭena cetasā | mārutaṃ nāśitaṃ bāṇaiḥ sarpaistatra na saṃśayaḥ || 48.51 || dānavena tato muktaṃ garuḍāstraṃ ca līlayā | gāruḍāstraṃ ca taddṛṣṭvā sārpaṃ naiva vyadṛśyata || 48.52 || tato devādhidevena nārasiṃhaṃ visarjitam | nārasiṃhāstrabāṇena gāruḍāstraṃ praśāmitam || 48.53 || astramastreṇa śamyeta na bādhyeta parasparam | mahadyuddhamabhūttātasurāsurabhayaṃkaram || 48.54 || cakranālīkanārācaistomaraiḥ khaḍgamudgaraiḥ | vatsadantaistathā bhallaiḥ karṇikāraiśca śobhanaiḥ || 48.55 || evaṃ na śakyate hantuṃ dānavo vividhāyudhaiḥ | tadā jvālākarālāśca khaḍganārācatomarāḥ || 48.56 || vṛṣāṅkena vimuktāstu samare dānavaṃ prati | na saṃspṛśanti śastrāṇi gātraṃ gauḍavadhūriva || 48.57 || āyudhāni tatastyaktvā bāhuyuddhamupasthitau | karaṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya praharantau svamuṣṭibhiḥ | raṇaprayogairyudhyantau yuyudhāte śivāndhakau || 48.58 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca andhakaṃ prati deveśaścintayāmāsa nigraham | haniṣyāmi na sandeho duṣṭātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 48.59 || sa śivena yadā kṣiptaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivītale | ūrdhvabāhuradhovaktro dānavo nṛpasattama || 48.60 || krodhāviṣṭena deveśaḥ saṅgrāme devaśatruṇā | kakṣayoḥ kuhare kṣiptvā bandhenākramya pīḍitaḥ || 48.61 || nispandaścābhavaddevo mūrcchāyukto maheśvaraḥ | mūrcchāpannaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 48.62 || hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ me'dya duṣkṛtaṃ pāpakarmaṇā | kiṃ karomi kathaṃ karma kasminsthāne tu mocaye || 48.63 || gṛhītvā devamutsaṅge gataḥ kailāsaparvatam | śayyāyāṃ śaṅkaraṃ nyasya niryayau daityarāṭtataḥ || 48.64 || śayyāyāṃ patito devaḥ prapede vedanāṃ tataḥ | tāvaddadarśa cātmānaṃ svakīyabhavanasthitam || 48.65 || parābhavaḥ kṛto madyaṃ kathaṃ tena durātmanā | krodhavegasamāviṣṭo niryayau dānavaṃ prati || 48.66 || āyasīṃ laguḍīṃ gṛhya prabhurbhārasahasrajām | dānavaṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā prākṣipattasya mūrdhani || 48.67 || khaḍgena tāḍayāmāsa dānavaḥ prahasanraṇe | devenāthasmṛtaṃ cāstraṃ kauccherākhyaṃ mahāhave || 48.68 || dīpyamānaṃ samutsṛjya hṛdaye tāḍitaḥ kṣaṇāt | tataḥ sa tāḍitastena rudhirodgāramudvaman || 48.69 || patito'dhomukho bhūtvā tataḥ śūlena bheditaḥ | punaśca devadevena śūlena dvidalīkṛtaḥ || 48.70 || śūlāgre'sau sthitaḥ pāpo bhrāntavāṃścakravattadā | ye ye bhūmyāṃ patanti sma tatkāyādraktabindavaḥ || 48.71 || te te sarve samuttasthurdānavāḥ śāstrapāṇayaḥ | vyākulastu tato devo dānavena tarasvinā || 48.72 || devenātha smṛtā durgā cāmuṇḍā bhīṣaṇānanā | āyātā bhīṣaṇākārā nānāyudhavirājitā || 48.73 || mahādaṃṣṭrā mahākāyā piṅgākṣī lambakarṇikā | ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva ko yāsyati yamālayam || 48.74 || īśvara uvāca pibāsya rudhiraṃ bhadre yatheṣṭaṃ dānavasya ca | nipatadrudhiraṃ bhūmau durge gṛhṇīṣva māciram || 48.75 || nihanmi dānavaṃ yāvatsāhāyyaṃ kuru sundari | evamuktā tu sā durgā papau ca rudhiraṃ tataḥ || 48.76 || nihatā dānavāḥ sarve deveśena sahasraśaḥ | andhako'pi ca tān dṛṣṭvā dānavānavaniṃ gatān | tato vāgbhiḥ pratuṣṭāva devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 48.77 || andhaka uvāca jayasva devadeveśa umārdhārdhāśarīradhṛk | namaste devadeveśa sarvāya triguṇātmane || 48.78 || vṛṣabhāsanamārūḍha śaśāṅkakṛtaśekhara | jaya khaṭvāṅgahastāya gaṅgādhara namo'stu te || 48.79 || namo ḍamaruhastāya namaḥ kapālamāline | smaradehavināśāya maheśāya namo'stu te || 48.80 || pūṣṇo dantanipātāya gaṇanāthāya te namaḥ | jaya svarūpadehāya arūpabahurūpiṇe || 48.81 || uttamāṅgavināśāya viriñcerapi śaṅkara | śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ nityaṃ bhairavarūpiṇe || 48.82 || tvaṃ sarvago'si tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ hartā nānya eva ca | tvaṃ bhūmistvaṃ diśaścaiva tvaṃ gururbhārgavastathā || 48.83 || sauristvaṃ devadeveśa bhūmiputrastathaiva ca | ṛkṣagrahādikaṃ sarvaṃ yaddṛśyaṃ tattvameva ca || 48.84 || evaṃ stutiṃ tadā kṛtvā devaṃ prati sa dānavaḥ | saṃhatābhyāṃ tu pāṇibhyāṃ praṇanāma maheśvaram || 48.85 || īśvara uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāsattva varaṃ yācasva dānava | dātāhaṃ yācakastvaṃ hi dadāmīha yathepsitam || 48.86 || andhaka uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | tadātmasadṛśo'haṃ te kartavyo nāparo varaḥ || 48.87 || bhasmī jaṭī trinetrī ca triśūlī ca caturbhujaḥ | vyāghracarmottarīyaśca nāgayajñopavītakaḥ || 48.88 || etadicchāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ yadi tuṣṭo maheśvara || 48.89 || īśvara uvāca dadāmi te varaṃ hyadya yastvayā yācito'nagha | gaṇeṣu me sthitaḥ putra bhṛṅgīśastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 48.90 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'ndhakavadhatadvarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.49>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca andhakaṃ tu nihatyātha devadevo maheśvaraḥ | umayā sahito rudraḥ kailāsamagamannagam || 49.1 || āgatāśca tato devā brahmādyāśca savāsavāḥ | hṛṣṭāstuṣṭāśca te sarve praṇemuḥ pārvatīpatim || 49.2 || īśvara uvāca upāviśantu te sarve ye kecana samāgatāḥ | nihato dānavo hyeṣa gīrvāṇārthe pitāmaha || 49.3 || raktena tasya me śūlaṃ nirmalaṃ naiva jāyate | śubhavratatapojapyarato brahmanmayā hataḥ || 49.4 || kartumicchāmyahaṃ samyaktīrthayānaṃ caturmukha | āgacchantu mayā sārddhaṃ ye yūyamiha saṃgatāḥ || 49.5 || ityuktvā devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ pratiniryayau | prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni gaṅgāsāgaramadhyataḥ || 49.6 || avagāhyāpi sarvāṇi nairmalyaṃ nābhavannṛpa | narmadāyāṃ tato gatvā devo devaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 49.7 || uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamavāgāhatpriyavrataḥ | gatastu dakṣiṇe kūle parvate bhṛgusaṃjñitam || 49.8 || tatra sthitvā mahādevo devaiḥ saha mahīpate | bhrāntvā bhrāntvā ciraṃ śrānto nirviṇṇo niṣasāda ha || 49.9 || manohāri yataḥ sthānaṃ sarveṣāṃ vai divaukasām | tīrthaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tanmatvā sthito devo maheśvaraḥ || 49.10 || giriṃ vivyādha śūlena bhinnaṃ tena rasātalam | nirmalaṃ cābhavacchūlaṃ na lepo dṛśyate kvacit || 49.11 || devairāhvānitā tatra mahāpuṇyā ca bhāratī | parvatānniḥsṛtā tatra mahāpuṇyā sarasvatī || 49.12 || dvitīyaḥ saṅgamastatra yathā veṇyāṃ sitāsitaḥ | tatra brahmā svayaṃ devo brahmeśaṃ liṅgamuttamam || 49.13 || saṃsthāpayāmāsa puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | tasya yāmye diśo bhāge svayaṃ devo janārdanaḥ || 49.14 || tiṣṭhate ca sadā tatra viṣṇupādāgrasaṃsthitā | ambhaso na bhavenmārgaḥ kuṇḍamadhyasthitasya ca || 49.15 || śūlāgreṇa kṛtā rekhā tatastoyaṃ vahennṛpa | tattoyaṃ ca gataṃ tatra yatra revā mahānadī || 49.16 || jalaliṅgaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ cakatīrthaṃ nṛpottama | śūlabhede ca deveśaḥ snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 49.17 || ātmānaṃ manyate śuddhaṃ na kiṃcitkalmaṣaṃ kṛtam | tasyaivottarakāṣṭhāyāṃ devadevo jagadguruḥ || 49.18 || ātmanā devadeveśaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | sarvatīrtheṣu tattīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param || 49.19 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | tatra tīrthe pratiṣṭhāpya devadevaṃ jagadguruḥ || 49.20 || rakṣāpālāṃstato muktvā śataṃ sāṣṭavināyakān | kṣetrapālāḥ śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ tadrakṣanti prayatnataḥ || 49.21 || vighnāstasyopajāyante yastatra sthātumicchati | kecitkuṭumbāttatāsu vyāgrāḥ kecitkṛṣīṣu ca || 49.22 || kecitsabhāṃ prakurvanti keciddravyārjane ratāḥ | parokṣavādaṃ kurvanti ke'pi hiṃsāratāḥ sadā || 49.23 || paradāraratāḥ kecitkecidvṛttivihiṃsakāḥ | anye kecidvadantyevaṃ kathaṃ tīrtheṣu gamyate || 49.24 || kṣudhayā pīḍyate bhāryā putrabhṛtyādayastadā | mohajāleṣu yojyante evaṃ devagaṇairnarāḥ || 49.25 || pāpācārāśca ye martyāḥ snānaṃ teṣāṃ na jāyate | saṃrakṣanti ca tattīrthaṃ devabhṛtyagaṇāḥ sadā || 49.26 || dhanyāḥ puṇyāśca ye martyāsteṣāṃ snānaṃ prajāyate | sarasvatyā bhogavatyā devanadyā viśeṣataḥ || 49.27 || ayaṃ tu saṅgamaḥ puṇyo yathā veṇyāṃ sitāsitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ tu te sarve gīrvāṇā hṛṣṭacetasaḥ || 49.28 || devasya sannidhau bhūtvā varṇayāmāsuruttamam | idaṃ tīrthaṃ tu deveśa gayātīrthena te samam || 49.29 || guhyādguhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | śūlapāṇiḥ samabhyarcya indrādyairapsarogaṇaiḥ || 49.30 || yakṣakinnaragandharvairdikpālairlokapairapi | nṛtyagītaistathā stotraiḥ sarvaiścāpi surāsuraiḥ || 49.31 || pūjyamāno gaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ siddhairnāgairmaheśvaraḥ | devena bheditaṃ tatra śūlāgreṇa narādhipa || 49.32 || tridhā yatrekṣyate'dyāpi hyāvartaḥ surapūritaḥ | kuṇḍatrayaṃ naravyāghra mahatkalakalānvitam || 49.33 || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāti upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 49.34 || dīkṣāmantravihīno'pi mucyate cābdikādaghāt | ye punarvidhivatsnānti mantraiḥ pañcabhireva ca || 49.35 || vedoktaiḥ pañcabhirmantraiḥ sahiraṇyaghaṭaiḥ śubhaiḥ | akṣarairdaśabhiścaiva ṣaḍbhirvā tribhireva vā || 49.36 || pṛthagbhūtairdvijātīnāṃ tīrthe kāryaṃ narādhipa | brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vāpi strīśūdrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 49.37 || puruṣāṇāṃ trayīṃ dhyātvā snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi | daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa ye pibanti jalaṃ narāḥ || 49.38 || te gacchanti paraṃ lokaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | kedāre ca yathā pītaṃ rudrakuṇḍe tathaiva ca || 49.39 || pañcarephasamāyuktaṃ kṣakāraṃ surapūjitam | oṅkāreṇa samāyuktametadvedyaṃ prakīrtitam || 49.40 || yastatra kurute snānaṃ vidhiyukto jitendriyaḥ | tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 49.41 || kulānāṃ tārayedviṃśaṃ daśapūrvāndaśāparān | gayādipañcasthāneṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || 49.42 || sa tatra phalamāpnoti śūlabhede na saṃśayaḥ | yastatra vidhinā yukto dadyāddānāni bhaktitaḥ || 49.43 || tudakṣayaṃ phalaṃ tatra sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tathā | gayāśiro yathā puṇyaṃ pitṛkāryeṣu sarvadā || 49.44 || śūlabhedaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ snānadānāditarpaṇaiḥ | bhaktyā dadāti yastatra kāñcanaṃ gāṃ mahīṃ tilān || 49.45 || āsanopānahau śayyāṃ varāśvān kṣatriyastathā | vastrayugmaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca gṛhaṃ pūrṇaṃ prayatnataḥ || 49.46 || sayoktraṃ lāṅgalaṃ dadyātkṛṣṭāṃ caiva vasuṃdharām | dānānyetāni yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage || 49.47 || śrotriye kulasampanne śuciṣmati jitendriye | śrutādhyayanasampanne dambhahīne kriyānvite | trayodaśāhaḥsvekaikaṃ trayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet || 49.48 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.50>
uttānapāda uvāca dvijāśca kīdṛśāḥ pūjyā apūjyāḥ kīdṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ | śrāddhe vaivāhike kārye dāne caiva viśeṣataḥ || 50.1 || yadi śraddhā bhaveddaivayogācchrāddhādike vidhau | etadākhyāhi me deva kasya dānaṃ na dīyate || 50.2 || īśvara uvāca yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ | brāhmaṇaścānadhīyānastrayaste nāmadhārakāḥ || 50.3 || yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā | yathā cājñe'phalaṃ dānaṃ tathā vipro'nṛco'phalaḥ || 50.4 || yathā'nṛṇe bījamuptvā vaptā na labhate phalam | tathānṛce havirdattvā na dātā labhate phalam || 50.5 || rogī hīnātiriktāṅgaḥ kāṇaḥ paunarbhavastathā | avakīrṇī śyāvadantaḥ sarvāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 50.6 || mitradhrukpiśunaḥ somavikrayī paranindakaḥ | pitṛmātṛgurutyāgī nityaṃ brāhmaṇanindakaḥ || 50.7 || śūdrānnaṃ mantrasaṃyuktaṃ yo vipro bhakṣayennṛpa | so'spṛśyaḥ karmacāṇḍālaḥ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ samācaret || 50.8 || kunakhī vṛṣalī steyī vārddhuṣyaḥ kuṇḍagolakau | mahādānarato yaśca yaścātmahanane rataḥ || 50.9 || bhṛtakādhyāpakaḥ klībaḥ kanyādūṣyabhiśastakaḥ | ete viprāḥ sadā tyājyāḥ paribhāvya prayatnataḥ || 50.10 || pratigrahaṃ gṛhītvā tu vāṇijyaṃ yastu kārayet | tasya dānaṃ na dātavyaṃ vṛthā bhavati tasya tat || 50.11 || śrutādhyayanasampannā ye dvijā vṛttatatparāḥ | teṣāṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 50.12 || daridrānbhara bhūpāla mā samṛddhān kadācana | vyādhitasyauṣadhaṃ pathyaṃ nīrujasya kimauṣadhaiḥ || 50.13 || uttānapāda uvāca kīdṛśo'tha vidhistatra tīrthaśrāddhasya kā kriyā | dānaṃ ca dīyate yadvattanmamākhyāhi śaṅkara || 50.14 || īśvara uvāca śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe bhaktyā śuciścāpi jitendriyaḥ | guruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhojya sīmāntake tataḥ || 50.15 || vāgyataḥ pravrajettāvadyāvatsīmāṃ na laṅghayet | śūlabhedaṃ tato gatvā snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 50.16 || pañcasthāneṣu ca śrāddhaṃ havyakavyādibhiḥ kramāt | piṇḍadānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātpāyasairmadhusarpiṣā || 50.17 || pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pañca ca | akṣatairbadarairbilvairgudamadhusarpiṣā || 50.18 || sāpi tatphalamāpnoti tīrthe'sminnātra saṃśayaḥ | upānahau ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 50.19 || so'pi svargamavāpnoti hayārūḍho na saṃśayaḥ | śayyāmaśvaṃ ca yo dadyācchattrikāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 50.20 || gacchedvimānamārūḍhaḥ so'psarovṛndaveṣṭitaḥ | uttamaṃ yo gṛhaṃ dadyātsaptadhānyasamanvitam || 50.21 || svecchayā me vaselloke kāñcane bhavane hi saḥ | tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyātsavatsāṃ vastrasaṃplutām || 50.22 || nākapṛṣṭhe vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam | gṛhe vā yadi vāraṇye tīrthavartmani vā nṛpa || 50.23 || toyamannaṃ ca yo dadyādyamalokaṃ sa nekṣate | sarvadānāni dīyante teṣāṃ phalamavāpyate || 50.24 || udakaṃ cātra dānaṃ ca dadyādabhayameva ca | annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 50.25 || kanyādānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādvṛṣaṃ vā yaḥ samutsṛjet | tasya vāso bhavettatra yatrāhamiti nānyathā || 50.26 || uttānapāda uvāca kanyādānaṃ kathaṃ svāmin kartavyaṃ dhārmikaiḥ sadā | parigraho yathā poṣyaḥ kanyodvāhastathaiva ca || 50.27 || anyatpṛcchāmi deveśa kasya kanyā na dīyate | dātavyaṃ kutra taddeva kasmai dattamathākṣayam || 50.28 || uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpi kanīyaḥ syātkathaṃ vibho | rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi niḥśreyasamathāpi vā || 50.29 || īśvara uvāca sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate | yo dadyātparayā bhaktyābhigamya tanayāṃ nijām || 50.30 || kulīnāya surūpāya guṇajñāya manīṣiṇe | sulagne sumuhūrte ca dadyātkanyāmalaṃkṛtām || 50.31 || aśvānnā gāṃśca vāsāṃsi yo'tra dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ | tasya vāso bhavettatra padaṃ yatra nirāmayam || 50.32 || yenātra duhitā dattā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī | tena sarvamidaṃ dattaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 50.33 || yaḥ kanyārthaṃ tato labdhvā bhikṣate caiva taddhanam | sa bhavetkarmacaṇḍālaḥ kāṣṭhakīlo bhavenmṛtaḥ || 50.34 || gṛhe'pi tasya yo'śnīyājjihvālaulyātkathaṃcana | cāndrāyaṇena śudhyeta taptakṛcchreṇa vā punaḥ || 50.35 || uttānapāda uvāca vittaṃ na vidyate yasya kanyaivāsti ca yadgṛhe | kathaṃ codvāhanaṃ tasya na yāñcāṃ kurute yadi || 50.36 || īśvara uvāca avitenaiva kartavyaṃ kanyodvahanakaṃ nṛpa | kanyānāma samuccārya na doṣāya kadācana || 50.37 || abhigamyottamaṃ dānaṃ yacca dānamayācitam | bhaviṣyati yugasyāntastasyānto naiva vidyate || 50.38 || abhigamyottamaṃ dānaṃ smṛtamāhūya madhyamam | yācyamānaṃ kanīyaḥ syāddehi dehīti cādhamam || 50.39 || yathaivāśmāśmanābaddho nikṣipto vārimadhyataḥ | dvāvetau nidhanaṃ yātastadvadannamapātrake || 50.40 || asamarthe tato dānaṃ na pradeyaṃ kadācana
