| dātāraṃ nayate'dhastādātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 50.41 || samarthastārayeddvau tu kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaṃ yathā jale | yathā nauśca tathā vidvānprāpayedaparaṃ taṭam || 50.42 || āhitāgniśca gṛhṇāti yaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ pratigraham | iha janmani śūdro'sau mṛtaḥ śvā copajāyate || 50.43 || vṛthā kleśaśca jāyeta brāhmaṇe hyagnihotriṇi | asatpratigrahaṃ kurvanguptaṃ nīcasya garhitam || 50.44 || abhojyaḥ sa bhavenmartyo dahyate kāriṣāgninā | kaṭakāro bhavetpaścātsapta janma na saṃśayaḥ || 50.45 || lajjādākṣiṇyalobhācca yaddānaṃ coparodhajam | bhṛtyebhyaśca tu yaddānaṃ tadvṛthā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 50.46 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye pātrāpātraparīkṣādānādiniyamavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.51>
uttānapāda uvāca kāle tatkriyate kasmiñchrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tatheśvara | yātrā tatra prakartavyā tithau yasyāṃ vadāśu tat || 51.1 || īśvara uvāca pitṛtīrthaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sarvakāmikamuttamam | idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ snānadānāditarpaṇaiḥ || 51.2 || viśeṣeṇa tu kurvīta śrāddhaṃ sarvayugādiṣu | manvantarādayo vatsa śrūyantāṃ ca caturdaśa || 51.3 || aśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttikasya ca | tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca || 51.4 || āṣāḍhasyaiva daśamī māghasyaiva tu saptamī | śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhasya pūrṇimā || 51.5 || phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā | kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tathā || 51.6 || manvantarādayaścaite anantaphaladāḥ smṛtāḥ | ayane cottare rājandakṣiṇe śrāddhamācaret || 51.7 || kārttikī ca tathā māghī vaiśākhasya tṛtīyikā | paurṇamāsī ca caitrasya jyeṣṭhasya ca viśeṣataḥ || 51.8 || aṣṭakāsu ca saṃkrāntau vyatīpāte tathaiva ca | śrāddhakālā ime sarve dattameṣvakṣayaṃ smṛtam || 51.9 || madhumāse site pakṣa ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādviṣṇupādasamīpataḥ || 51.10 || dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ sraṅmālāgurucandanaiḥ | arcāṃ kurvanti ye viṣṇoḥ paṭheyuḥ prāktanīṃ kathām || 51.11 || ṛgyajuḥsāmamantroktaṃ sūktaṃ japati yo dvijaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 51.12 || prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dvijān sampūjya yatnataḥ | dānaṃ dadyādyathāśakti gohiraṇyāmbarādikam || 51.13 || pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadābhūtasamplavam | śrāddhadastu vrajettatra yatra devo janārdanaḥ || 51.14 || trayodaśyāṃ tato gacchedguhāvāsini liṅgake | dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍamīśānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 51.15 || uttānapāda uvāca guhāmadhye mahādeva liṅgaṃ paramaśobhitam | yena pratiṣṭhitaṃ deva tanmamākhyātumarhasi || 51.16 || īśvara uvāca triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa tapastepe sudāruṇam || 51.17 || guhāmadhyaṃ praviṣṭo'sau yogābhyāsamupāśritaḥ | liṅgaṃ tu sthāpitaṃ tena mārkaṇḍeśvarasaṃjñitam || 51.18 || tatra snātvā ca yo bhaktyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kurvan dadyāddīpaṃ prayatnataḥ || 51.19 || devasya snapanaṃ kuryānmṛtaiḥ pañcabhistathā | yathā śaktyā samālabhya pūjāṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 51.20 || svaśākhotpannamantraiśca japaṃ kuryurdvijātayaḥ | sāvitryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu śatāṣṭakamathāpi vā || 51.21 || etatkṛtvā nṛpaśreṣṭha janmanaḥ phalamāpnuyāt | caturdaśyāṃ tu vai snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 51.22 || pātraṃ parīkṣya dātavyamātmanaḥ śreya icchatā | pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam || 51.23 || dātā sa gacchate tatra yatra bhogāḥ sanātanāḥ | guhāmadhye praviṣṭastu loṭayeccaiva śaktitaḥ || 51.24 || nīle girau hi yatpuṇyaṃ tatsamastaṃ labhanti te | śūlabhede tu yaḥ kuryācchrāddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi || 51.25 || viśeṣāccaitramāsānte tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | kedāre caiva yatpuṇyaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame || 51.26 || sitāsite tu yatpuṇyamanyatīrthe viśeṣataḥ | arbude vidyate puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ cāmaraparvate || 51.27 || gayādisarvatīrthānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ | vidhimantrasamāyuktastarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 51.28 || kulānāṃ tārayedviṃśaṃ daśa pūrvān daśāparān | dakṣiṇasyāṃ tato mūrtau śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 51.29 || nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvoktaṃ pradadyādaṣṭapuṣpikām | śāstroktairaṣṭabhiḥ puṣpairmānasaiḥ śṛṇu tadyathā || 51.30 || vārijaṃ saumyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ | vānaspatyaṃ bhavetṣaṣṭhaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu saptamam || 51.31 || aṣṭamaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ syādeṣāṃ śṛṇu vinirṇayam | vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhughṛtaṃ payaḥ || 51.32 || āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpādyaṃ vāyavyaṃ candanādikam | pārthivaṃ kandamūlādyaṃ vānaspatyaṃ phalātmakam || 51.33 || prājāpatyaṃ tu pāṭhādyaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ tu vāsanā | ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ || 51.34 || tṛtīyaṃ tu dayā puṣpaṃ kṣamā puṣpaṃ caturthakam | dhyānapuṣpaṃ tapaḥ puṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpaṃ tu saptamam || 51.35 || satyaṃ caivāṣṭamaṃ puṣpamebhistuṣyanti devatāḥ | bhaktyā tapasvinaḥ pūjyā jñāninaśca narādhipa || 51.36 || chatramāvaraṇaṃ dadyādupānadyugalaṃ tathā | tena pūjitamātreṇa pūjitāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ || 51.37 || svargaloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam | śūlapāṇestu bhaktyā vai jāpyaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ || 51.38 || pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyairyakṣakardamakuṅkumaiḥ | samālabheta deveśaṃ śrīkhaṇḍāgurucandanaiḥ || 51.39 || nānāvidhaiśca ye puṣpairarcāṃ kurvanti śūlinaḥ | niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryurdīpadānaṃ prayatnataḥ || 51.40 || dhūpanaivedyakaṃ dadyātpaṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām | tatra sthāne sthitā bhaktyā japaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ || 51.41 || śrīsūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ vṛṣākapim | vedoktaiścaiva mantraiśca raudrīṃ vā bahurūpiṇīm || 51.42 || brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca | nānāvidhairmahābhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 51.43 || agnimityādi jāpyāni ṛgvedī japate tu yaḥ | rudrān puruṣasūktaṃ ca ślokādhyāyaṃ ca śukriyam || 51.44 || iṣetvā dikamantraughaṃ jyotirbrāhmaṇameva ca | gāyatryaṃ vai madhu caiva maṇḍalabrāhmaṇāni ca || 51.45 || etāñjapyāṃstu yo bhaktyā yajurvedī japedyadi | devavrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ puruṣarṣabhameva ca || 51.46 || bṛhadrathāntaraṃ caiva yo japedbhaktitatparaḥ | sa prayāti naraḥ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 51.47 || pādaśaucaṃ tathābhyaṅgaṃ kurute yo'tra bhaktitaḥ | godāne caiva yatpuṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 51.48 || brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra madhunā pāyasena ca | ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 51.49 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ dadyādbhaktyā dvijottame | tarpitāstena devāḥ syurmanuṣyāḥ pitarastathā || 51.50 || candrasūryagrahe bhaktyā snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ | devārcanaṃ ye ca kuryurjapaṃ homaṃ viśeṣataḥ | dadyāddānaṃ yathāśakti brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 51.51 || aśvaṃ rathaṃ gajaṃ yānaṃ tulāpuruṣameva ca | śakaṭaṃ yaḥ pradadyādvā saptadhānyaprapūritam || 51.52 || sayoktraṃ lāṅgalaṃ dadyādyuvānau tu dhuraṃdharau | gobhūtilahiraṇyādi pātre dātavyamarcitam || 51.53 || apātre viduṣā kiṃcinna deyaṃ bhūtimicchatā | yato'sau sarvabhūtāni dadhāti dharaṇī kila || 51.54 || tato viprāya sā deyā sarvasasyaughamālinī | athānyacchṛṇu rājendra godānasya tu yatphalam || 51.55 || yāvadvatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate | tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati || 51.56 || yena kenāpyupāyena brāhmaṇe tāṃ samarpayet | pṛthvī dattā bhavettena saśailavanakānanā || 51.57 || tārayenniyataṃ dattā kulānāmekaviṃśatim | raupyakhurīṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ savastrāṃ ca payasvinīm || 51.58 || ye prayacchanti kṛtino graste sūrye niśākare | teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāmi puṇyasyābdaśātairapi || 51.59 || sarvasyāpi hi dānasya saṃkhyāstīha narādhipa | candrasūryoparāge ca dānasaṃkhyā na vidyate || 51.60 || yatra gaurdṛśyate rājan sarvatīrthāni tatra hi | tatra parva vijānīyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 51.61 || punaḥ smṛtvā tu tattīrthaṃ yaḥ kuryādgamanaṃ naraḥ | athavā mriyate yo'tra rudrasyānucaro bhavet || 51.62 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhede dānadharmapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.52>
īśvara uvāca anyadākhyānakaṃ vakṣye purā vṛttaṃ narādhipa | sakuṭumbo gataḥ svargaṃ muniryatra mahātapāḥ || 52.1 || uttānapāda uvāca kathaṃ nākaṃ gato vipraḥ sakuṭumbo mahānṛṣiḥ | kautukaṃ paramaṃ deva kathayasva mama prabho || 52.2 || īśvara uvāca citrasena iti khyātaḥ kāśīrājaḥ purābhavat | śūro dātā sudharmātmā sarvakāmasamṛddhimān || 52.3 || sā purī janasaṃkīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā | vārāṇasīti vikhyātā gaṅgātīramupāśritā || 52.4 || śaraccandrapratīkāśā vidvajjanavibhūṣitā | indrayaṣṭisamākīrṇā gopagokulasaṃvṛtā || 52.5 || bahudhvajasamākīrṇā vedadhvaninināditā | vaṇigjanairbahuvidhaiḥ krayavikrayaśālinī || 52.6 || yantrādānaiḥ pratolībhiruccaiścānyaiḥ suśobhitā | devatāyatanairdivyairāśramairgahanairyutā || 52.7 || nānāpuṣpaphalairramyā kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitā | panasairbakulaistālairaśokairāmrakaistathā || 52.8 || rājavṛkṣakapitthaiśca dāḍimairupaśobhitā | vedādhyayananirghoṣaiḥ pavitrīkṛtamaṅgalā || 52.9 || tasyā uttaradigbhāge āśramo'bhūtsuśobhanaḥ | tanmandāravanaṃ nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 52.10 || bahumandārasaṃyuktaṃ tena mandārakaṃ viduḥ | vipro dīrghatapā nāma sarvadā tatra tiṣṭhati || 52.11 || tapastapati so'tyarthaṃ tena dīrghatapāḥ smṛtaḥ | sa tiṣṭhati sapatnīkaḥ sasutaḥ sasnuṣastathā || 52.12 || śuśrūṣanti sadā tasya putrāḥ pañca prayatnataḥ | tasya putraḥ kanīyāṃstu ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ || 52.13 || vedādhyayanasampanno brahmacārī guṇānvitaḥ | yogābhyāsarato nityaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ || 52.14 || tiṣṭhate mṛgarūpeṇa mṛgayūthacarastadā | dinānte ca dinānte ca mātāpitroḥ samīpagaḥ || 52.15 || abhivādayate nityaṃ bhaktimānmuniputrakaḥ | punargacchati tatraiva kānane girigahvare || 52.16 || krīḍanbālamṛgaiḥ sārddhaṃ pratyahaṃ sa muneḥ sutaḥ | kadāciddaivayogena ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mamāra saḥ || 52.17 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgacaritre dīrghatapomunyākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.53>
uttānapāda uvāca āśrame vasatastasya sa dīrghatapaso muneḥ | kanīyāṃstanayo deva kathaṃ mṛtyumupāgataḥ || 53.1 || īśvara uvāca śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā kathāṃ divyāṃ mahīpate | śravaṇādeva yasyāstu mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 53.2 || kāśīrājo mahāvīryo mahābalaparākramaḥ | citrasena iti khyātāṃ dharaṇyāṃ sa narādhipa || 53.3 || tasya rājye sadā dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit | vedadharmarato nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan || 53.4 || svadharmanirataścaiva yuddhātithyapriyaḥ sadā | kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritya bhogānbhuṅkte sa kāmataḥ || 53.5 || kośasyānto na vidyeta hastyaśvarathapattimān | itihāsapurāṇajñaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ saha saṃkathām || 53.6 || kathayanrājate rājā kailāsa iva śaṅkaraḥ | evaṃ sa pālayanrājyaṃ rājā mantriṇamabravīt || 53.7 || mṛgayāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ rājyapālane | gamyatāṃ sacivaiḥ prokte gato'sau vasudhādhipaḥ || 53.8 || aśvārūḍhāśca dhāvanto rājāno maṇḍalādhipāḥ | chatraiśchatrāṇi ghṛṣyanto'nujagmuḥ kānanaṃ prati || 53.9 || rajastatrotthitaṃ bhaumaṃ gajavājipadāhatam | tenaitacchāditaṃ sarvaṃ sadiṅmārtaṇḍamaṃlam || 53.10 || na tatra dṛśyate sūryo na kāṣṭhā na ca candramāḥ | pādapāśca na dṛśyante giriśṛṅgāṇi sarvataḥ || 53.11 || parasparaṃ na paśyanti niśārddhe vārṣike yathā | tatrāsau sumahadyūthaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ samalakṣyata || 53.12 || adhāvatsahitaḥ sarvaiḥ sa rājā rājaputrakaiḥ | vṛndāsphoṭo'bhavatteṣāṃ śīghraṃ jagmurdiśo daśa || 53.13 || ekamārgagato rājā citraseno mahīpatiḥ | ekākī sa gatastatra yatra yatra ca te mṛgāḥ || 53.14 || praviṣṭo'sau tato durgaṃ kānanaṃ girigahvaram | vallīgulmasamākīrṇaṃ sthito yatra na lakṣyate || 53.15 || adṛśyāṃstu mṛgānmatvā diśo rājā vyalokayat | kāṃ diśaṃ nu gamiṣyāmi kva me sainyasamāgamaḥ || 53.16 || evaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gato rājā citraseno narādhipaḥ | vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya viśrāmamakaronnṛpaḥ || 53.17 || kṣuttṛṣārto bhramandurge kānane girigahvare | tato'paśyatsaro divyaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || 53.18 || haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam | tato dṛṣṭvā sa rājendraḥ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 53.19 || kamalāni gṛhītvā tu tataḥ snānaṃ samācarat | tarpayitvā pitṛdevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathāvidhi || 53.20 || ācchādya śatapatraiśca pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram | yayau pānīyamamalaṃ yathāvatsa samāhitaḥ || 53.21 || uttīrya salilāttīre dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣaṃ samīpagam | uttarīyamadhaḥ kṛtvopaviṣṭo dharaṇītale || 53.22 || cintayannupaviṣṭo'sau kimadya prakaromyaham | tatrāsīno dadarśātha vanoddeśe mṛgānbahūn || 53.23 || kecitpūrvamukhāstatra cāpare dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ | vāruṇyamimukhāḥ kecitkecitkauberadiṅmukhāḥ || 53.24 || kecinnidrāparāḥ kecidūrdhvakarṇāḥ sthitāḥ pare | mṛgamadhye sthito yogī ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ || 53.25 || mṛgāndṛṣṭvā tato rājā āhārārthamacintayat | hatvaiteṣu mṛgaṃ kaṃcidbhakṣayāmi yadṛcchayā || 53.26 || svasthāvastho bhaviṣyāmi mṛgamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt | kāśīṃ prati gamiṣyāmi mārgamanviṣya yatnataḥ || 53.27 || vicintyaivaṃ tato rājā vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ | cāpaṃ gṛhya karāgreṇa sa śaraṃ saṃdadhe tataḥ || 53.28 || vicikṣepa śaraṃ tatra yatra te bahavo mṛgāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye sa vai viddha ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ || 53.29 || jagmustrastāstu te sarve śabdaṃ kṛtvā vanaukasaḥ | sa ṛṣiḥ patitastatra kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cābravīt || 53.30 || hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenāhaṃ ghātito'dhunā | kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā pāpabuddhermamopari || 53.31 || mṛgamadhye sthitaścāhaṃ na kaṃciduparodhaye | tāṃ vācaṃ mānuṣīṃ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ || 53.32 || śīghraṃ gatvā tato'paśyadbrāhmaṇaṃ brahmatejasā | hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ me'dya yenāsau ghātito dvijaḥ || 53.33 || citrasena uvāca akāmādghātitastvaṃ tu mṛgabhrāntyā mayānagha | gṛhītvā bahudārūṇi svatanuṃ dāhayāmyaham || 53.34 || dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ tu yatkiṃcinna samaṃ brahmahatyayā | anyathā brahmahatyāyāḥ śuddhirme na bhaviṣyati || 53.35 || ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca na te siddhirbhavetkācinmayi pañcatvamāgate | bahvyo hatyā bhaviṣyanti vināśe mama sāmpratam || 53.36 || jananī me pitā vṛddho bhrātaraśca tapasvinaḥ | bhrātṛjāyā mariṣyanti mayi pañcatvamāgate || 53.37 || etā hatyā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ śuddhirbhavettava | upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi taṃ kartuṃ yadi manyase || 53.38 || citrasena uvāca upāyaḥ kathyatāṃ me'dya yaste manasi vartate | kariṣye tamahaṃ sarvaṃ yatnenāpi mahāmune || 53.39 || ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kathaṃ ko vā kutastvamiha cāgataḥ | brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye ko bhavānuta śūdrajaḥ || 53.40 || citrasena uvāca nāhaṃ śūdro'smi bhostāta na vaiśyo brāhmaṇo na vā | na cāntyajo'smi viprendra kṣatriyo'smi mahāmune || 53.41 || dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca sarvasattvahite rataḥ | akāmātpātakaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ śuddhirbhaviṣyati || 53.42 || ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca māṃ gṛhītvā āśramaṃ gaccha yatra tau pitarau mama | āvedayasva cātmānaṃ putraghātinamāturam || 53.43 || te dṛṣṭvā māṃ kariṣyanti kāruṇyaṃ ca tavopari | upāyaṃ kathayiṣyanti yena śāntirbhaviṣyati || 53.44 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā citraseno nṛpottama | skandhe kṛtvā tu taṃ vipraṃ jagāmāśramasannidhau || 53.45 || na śaknoti yadā voḍhuṃ viśrāmyati punaḥpunaḥ | tāvatpaśyati taṃ vipraṃ mūrchitaṃ vikalendriyam || 53.46 || mumoca citrasenastaṃ chāyāyāṃ vaṭabhūruhaḥ | vastraṃ caturguṇaṃ kṛtvā cakre vātaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 53.47 || paśyatastasya rājendra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ | pañcatvamagamacchīghraṃ dhyānayogena yogavit || 53.48 || dāhayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā | snānaṃ kṛtvā sa śokārto vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ || 53.49 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.54>
īśvara uvāca tataścānantaraṃ rājā jagāmodvegamuttamam | kathaṃ yāmi gṛhaṃ tvadya vārāṇasyāmahaṃ punaḥ || 54.1 || brahmahatyāsamāviṣṭo juhomyagnau kalevaram | athavā tasya vākyena taṃ gacchāmyāśramaṃ prati || 54.2 || kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ gatvā tasya mahāmuneḥ | evaṃ saṃcintya rājāsau jagāmāśramasannidhau || 54.3 || ṛkṣaśṛṅgasya cāsthīni gṛhītvā sa nṛpottamaḥ | dṛṣṭimārge sthitastasya maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ || 54.4 || dīrghatapā uvāca āgaccha svāgataṃ te'stu āsane'tropaviśyatām | arghaṃ dadāmyahaṃ yena madhuparkaṃ saviṣṭaram || 54.5 || citrasena uvāca arghasyāsya na yogyo'haṃ maharṣe nāsmi bhāṣaṇe | mṛgamadhyasthito viprastava putro mayā hataḥ || 54.6 || putraghnaṃ viddhi māṃ vipra tīvradaṇḍena daṇḍaya | mṛgabhrāntyā hato vipra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ || 54.7 || iti matvā muniśreṣṭha kuru me tvaṃ yathocitam | mātā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhānniṣkramya vihvalā || 54.8 || hā hatāsmītyuvācedaṃ papāta dharaṇītale | vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā putraśokena pīḍitā || 54.9 || hā hatā putra putreti karuṇaṃ kurarī yathā | vilalāpāturā mātā kva gato māṃ vihāya vai | mukhaṃ darśaya cātmīyaṃ mātaraṃ māṃ hi mānaya || 54.10 || śrutādhyayanasampannaṃ japahomaparāyaṇam | āgataṃ tvāṃ gṛhadvāre kadā drakṣyāmi putraka || 54.11 || lokoktyā śrūyate caitaccandanaṃ kila śītalam | putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanādapi śītalaḥ || 54.12 || kiṃ candanena pīyūpabindunā kiṃ kimindunā || 54.13 || putragātrapariṣvaṅgapātraṃ gātraṃ bhavedyadi || 54.14 || pariṣvajitumicchāmi tvāmahaṃ putra supriya | pañcatvamanuyāsyāmi tvadvihīnādya duḥkhitā || 54.15 || evaṃ vilapatī dīnā putraśokena pīḍitā | mūrchitā vihvalā dīnā nipapāta mahītale || 54.16 || bhāryāṃ ca patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā putraśokena pīḍitām | cukopa sa munistatra citrasenāya bhūbhṛte || 54.17 || dīrghatapā uvāca yāhi yāhi mahāpāpa mā mukhaṃ darśayasva me | kiṃ tvayā ghātito vipro hyakāmācca suto mama || 54.18 || brahmahatyā bhaviṣyanti bahvyaste vasudhādhipa | sakuṭumbasya me tvaṃ hi mṛtyureṣa upasthitaḥ || 54.19 || evamuktvā tato vipro vicintya ca punaḥpunaḥ | parityajya tadā krodhaṃ munibhāvājjagāda ha || 54.20 || dīrghatapā uvāca udvegaṃ tyaja bho vatsa duruktaṃ gadito mayā | putraśokābhibhūtena duḥkhataptena mānada || 54.21 || kiṃ karoti naraḥ prājñaḥ preryamāṇaḥ svakarmabhiḥ | prāgeva hi manuṣyāṇāṃ buddhiḥ karmānusāriṇī || 54.22 || anenaiva vidhānena pañcatvaṃ vihitaṃ mama | hatyāstava bhaviṣyanti pūrvamuktā na saṃśayaḥ || 54.23 || brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye śūdracaṇḍālajātiṣu | kastvaṃ kathaya satyaṃ me kasmācca nihato dvijaḥ || 54.24 || citrasena uvāca vijñāpayāmi viprarṣe kṣantavyaṃ te mamopari | nāhaṃ vipro'smi vai tāta na vaiśyo na ca śūdrajaḥ || 54.25 || na vyādhaścāntyajāto vā kṣatriyo'haṃ mahāmune | kāśīrājo mṛgān hantumāgato vanamuttamam || 54.26 || bhrāntyā nipātito hyeṣa mṛgarūpadharo muniḥ | idānīṃ tava pādānte saṃśritaḥ pātakānvitaḥ || 54.27 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vipra upāyaṃ kathayasva me || 54.28 || dīrghatapā uvāca brahmahatyā na śakyetāpyekā nistarituṃ prabho | daśaikā ca kathaṃ śakyāstāḥ śṛṇuṣva nareśvara || 54.29 || catvāro me sutā rājan sabhāryā mātṛpūrvakāḥ | mayā saha na jīvanti ṛkṣaśṛṅgasya kāraṇe || 54.30 || upāyaṃ śobhanaṃ tāta kathayiṣye śṛṇuṣva tam | śakro'pi yadi taṃ kartuṃ sukhopāyaṃ nareśvara || 54.31 || sakuṭumbaṃ samastaṃ māṃ dāhayitvānale nṛpa | asthīni narmadātoye śūlabhede vinikṣipa || 54.32 || narmadādakṣiṇe kūle śūlabhedaṃ hi viśrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam || 54.33 || śucirbhūtvā mamāsthīni tatra tīrthe vinikṣipa | mokṣyase sarvapāpaistvaṃ mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ || 54.34 || rājovāca ādeśo dīyatāṃ tāta kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | samastaṃ me'sti yatkiṃcidrājyaṃ kośaḥ suhṛtsutāḥ || 54.35 || tavādhīnaṃ mahāvipra prayacchāmi prasīda me | parasparaṃ vivadatorvipra rājñostadā nṛpa || 54.36 || sphuṭitvā hṛdayaṃ śīghraṃ munibhāryā mṛtā tadā | putraśokasamāviṣṭā nirjīvā patitā kṣitau || 54.37 || putrāśca mātṛśokena sarve pañcatvamāgatāḥ | snuṣāścaiva tadā sarvā mṛtāśca saha bhartṛbhiḥ || 54.38 || pañcatvaṃ ca gatāḥ sarve munimukhyā nṛpottama | viprānāhvāpayāmāsa ye tatrāśramavāsinaḥ || 54.39 || tebhyo nivedayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ nṛpottamaḥ | sa taistadābhyanujñātaḥ kāṣṭhānyādāya yatnataḥ || 54.40 || dāhaṃ saṃcayanaṃ cakre citraseno mahīpatiḥ | ṛkṣaśṛṅgādisarveṣāṃ gṛhītvāsthīni yatnataḥ || 54.41 || yāmyāśāṃ prasthito rājā pādacārī mahīpate | na śaknoti yadā gantuṃ chāyāmāśritya tiṣṭhati || 54.42 || viśramya ca punargacchedbhārākrānto mahīpatiḥ | sacailaṃ kurute snānaṃ muktvāsthīni pade pade || 54.43 || pibejjalaṃ nirāhāraḥ sa gacchan dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena saṃgato narmadātaṭam || 54.44 || āśramasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā papraccha pṛthivīpatiḥ || 54.45 || citrasena uvāca kathyatāṃ śūlabhedasya mārgaṃ me dvijasattamāḥ | yena yāmi mahābhāgāḥ svakāryārthasya siddhaye || 54.46 || munaya ūcuḥ | itaḥ krośāntarādarvāktīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tato drakṣyasi nānyathā || 54.47 || ṛṣivākyena rājāsau śīghraṃ gatvā nareśvaraḥ | sa dadarśa tataḥ śīghraṃ bahudvijasamākulam || 54.48 || bahudrumalatākīrṇaṃ bahupuṣpopaśobhitam | ṛkṣasiṃhasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvratadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 54.49 || ekapādāsthitāḥ kecidapare sūryadṛṣṭayaḥ | ekāṅguṣṭha sthitāḥ kecidūrdhvabāhusthitāḥ pare || 54.50 || dinaikabhojanāḥ kecitkecitkandaphalāśanāḥ | trirātrabhojanāḥ kecitparākavratino'pare || 54.51 || cāndrāyaṇaratāḥ kecitkecitpakṣopavāsinaḥ | māsopavāsinaḥ kecitkecidṛtvantapāraṇāḥ || 54.52 || yogābhyāsaratāḥ kecitkeciddhyāyanti tatpadam | śīrṇaparṇāśinaḥ kecitkecicca kaṭukāśanāḥ || 54.53 || śaivālabhojanāḥ kecitkecinmārutabhojanāḥ | gārhasthye ca sthitāḥ kecitkeciccaivāgnihotriṇaḥ || 54.54 || evaṃvidhān dvijān dṛṣṭvā jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ | praṇamya śirasā rājanrājā vacanamabravīt || 54.55 || citrasena uvāca kasmindeśe ca tattīrthaṃ satyaṃ kathayata dvijāḥ | yenābhivāñchitā siddhiḥ saphalā me bhaviṣyati || 54.56 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | dhanvantaraśataṃ gaccha bhṛgutuṅgasya mūrdhani | kuṇḍaṃ drakṣyasi tatpūrṇaṃ vistīrṇaṃ payasā śivam || 54.57 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gataḥ kuṇḍasya sannidhau | dṛṣṭvā caiva tu tattīrthaṃ bhrāntirjātā nṛpasya vai || 54.58 || tato vismayamāpannaścintayanvai muhurmuhuḥ | ākāśasthaṃ dadarśāsau sāmiṣaṃ kuraraṃ nṛpaḥ || 54.59 || bhramamāṇaṃ gṛhītāhiṃ vadhyamānaṃ nirāmiṣaiḥ | parasparaṃ ca yuyudhuḥ sarve'pyāmiṣakāṅkṣayā || 54.60 || hataścañcuprahāreṇa sa tataḥ patito'ṃbhasi | śūlena śūlinā yatra bhūbhāgo bheditaḥ purā || 54.61 || tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa sa sadyaḥ puruṣo'bhavat | vimānasthaṃ dadarśāsau pumāṃsaṃ divyarūpiṇam || 54.62 || gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāstaṃ yāntaṃ tuṣṭuvurdivi | apsarogīyamāne tu gate sūryasya mūrdhani | citrasenastatastasminnāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 54.63 || ṛṣiṇā kathitaṃ yadvattadvattīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | hṛṣṭaromābhavaddṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ tīrthasambhavam || 54.64 || mamādya divaso dhanyo yasmādatra samāgataḥ | asthīni bhūmau nikṣipya snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 54.65 || tilamiśreṇa toyenātarpayatpitṛdevatāḥ | gṛhyāsthīni tato rājā cikṣepāntarjale tadā || 54.66 || kṣaṇamekaṃ tato vīkṣya rājorddhvavadanaḥ sthitaḥ | tān dadarśa punaḥ sarvān divyarūpadharāñchubhān || 54.67 || divyavastraiśca saṃvītān divyābharaṇabhūṣitān | vimānairvividhairdivyairapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ || 54.68 || pṛthagbhūtāṃśca tān sarvān vimāneṣu vyavasthitān | utpattivatsamālokya rājā saṃharṣī so'bhavat || 54.69 || ṛṣirvimānamārūḍhaścitrasenamathābravīt | bhobhoḥ sādho mahārāja citrasena mahīpate || 54.70 || tvatprasādānnṛpaśreṣṭha gatirdivyā mamedṛṣī | jāteyaṃ yattvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ paramaśobhanam || 54.71 || svasuto'pi na śaknoti pitḥṇāṃ kartumīdṛśam | madīyavacanāttāta niṣpāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 54.72 || phalaṃ prāpsyasi rājendra kāmikaṃ manasepsitam | āśīrvādāṃstato dattvā citrasenāya dhīmate | svargaṃ jagāma sasutastato dīrghatapā muniḥ || 54.73 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamāvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dīrghatapasaḥ svargārohaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.55>
uttānapāda uvāca māhātmyaṃ tīrthajaṃ dṛṣṭvā citraseno nareśvaraḥ | kiṃ cakāra kva vā vāsaṃ kimāhāro babhūva ha || 55.1 || īśvara uvāca bhṛgutuṅgaṃ samāruhya aiśānīṃ diśamāśritaḥ | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ kuṇḍe tatra nṛpottamaḥ || 55.2 || sarvān devān hṛdi dhyātvā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān | vicikṣepa yadātmānaṃ pratyakṣau rudrakeśavau | kare gṛhītvā rājānaṃ rudro vacanamabravīt || 55.3 || īśvara uvāca prāṇatyāgaṃ mahārāja mā kāle tvaṃ kṛthā vṛthā | adyāpyasi yuvā tvaṃ vai na yuktaṃ maraṇaṃ tava || 55.4 || svasthānaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān | kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ nāke śakra ivāparaḥ || 55.5 || citrasena uvāca na rājyaṃ kāmaye deva na putrānna ca bāndhavān | na bhāryāṃ na ca kośaṃ ca na gajānna turaṃgamān || 55.6 || muñca muñca mahādeva mā vighnaḥ kriyatāṃ mama | svargaprāptirmamādyaiva tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 55.7 || īśvara uvāca yasyāgrato bhavedbrahmā viṣṇuḥ śambhustathaiva ca | svargeṇa tasya kiṃ kāryaṃ sa gataḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || 55.8 || tuṣṭā vayaṃ trayo devā vṛṇīṣva varamuttamam | yathepsitaṃ mahārāja satyametadasaṃśayam || 55.9 || citrasena uvāca yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | adyaprabhṛti yuṣmābhiḥ sthātavyamiha sarvadā || 55.10 || gayāśiro yathā puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ yuṣmābhireva ca | tathaivedaṃ prakartavyaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca pāvanam || 55.11 || yatrayatra sthitā yūyaṃ tatratatra vasāmyaham | gaṇānāṃ caiva sarveṣāmādhipatyamathāstu me || 55.12 || īśvara uvāca adyaprabhṛti tiṣṭhāmaḥ śūlabhede nareśvara | trikālāṃ hi trayo devāḥ kalāṃśena vasāmahe || 55.13 || nandisaṃjño gaṇādhīśo bhaviṣyati bhavāndhruvam | matsamīpe tu bhavata ādau pūjā bhaviṣyati || 55.14 || prakṣipya tāni cāsthīni yatra dīrghatapā yayau | sakuṭumbo vimānasthaḥ svargatastvaṃ tathā kuru || 55.15 || evaṃ devā varaṃ dattvā citrasenāya pārthiva | kuṇḍamūrdhani yāmyāyāṃ trayo devāstadā sthitāḥ || 55.16 || parasparaṃ vadantyevaṃ puṇyatīrthamidaṃ param | yathā hi gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ pūrvameva paṭhyate | tathā revātaṭe puṇyaṃ śūlabhedaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 55.17 || īśvara uvāca idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ gayāśiraḥ | sakṛtpiṇḍodakenaiva naro nirmalatāṃ vrajet || 55.18 || ekaṃ gayāśiro muktvā sarvatīrthāni bhūpate | śūlabhedasya tīrthasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 55.19 || kuṇḍamudīcyāṃ yāmyāyāṃ daśahastapramāṇataḥ | raudravāruṇakāṣṭhāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ caikaviṃśati || 55.20 || etatpramāṇaṃ tattīrthaṃ piṇḍadānādikarmasu | nādharmaniratā dātuṃ labhante dānamatra hi || 55.21 || viṣṇustu pitṛrūpeṇa brahmarūpī pitāmahaḥ | prapitāmaho rudro'bhūdevaṃ tripuruṣāḥ sthitāḥ || 55.22 || kadā paśyati tīrthaṃ vai kadā nastārayiṣyati | iti pratīkṣāṃ kurvanti putrāṇāṃ satataṃ nṛpa | śūlabhede naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā śūladharaṃ sakṛt || 55.23 || nāputro nādhano rogī saptajanmasu jāyate | ekaviṃśatiṃ pituḥ pakṣe mātuśvaivekaviṃśatim || 55.24 || bhāryāpakṣe daśaiveha kulānyetāni tārayet | śūlabhedavane rājañchākamūlaphalairapi || 55.25 || ekasminbhojite vipre koṭīrbhavati bhojitā | pañcasthāneṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute bhaktimānnaraḥ || 55.26 || kulāni pretabhūtāni sarvāṇyapi hi tārayet | dvijadevaprasādena pitḥṇāṃ ca prasādataḥ || 55.27 || śrāddhado nivasettatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | syurātmaghātino ye ca gobrāhmaṇahanāśca ye || 55.28 || daṃṣṭribhirjalapāte ca vidyutpāteṣu ye mṛtāḥ | na yeṣāmagnisaṃskāro nāśaucaṃ nodakakriyā || 55.29 || tatra tīrthe tu yasteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ | mokṣāvāptirbhavetteṣāṃ yugamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 55.30 || ajñānādyatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bālabhāvācca yatkṛtam | tatsarvaṃ nāśayetpāpaṃ snānamātreṇa bhūpate || 55.31 || rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam | tathā pāpo'pi tattīrthe snāto bhavati nirmalaḥ || 55.32 || saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yo'tra tīrthe vidhisamanvitam | dhyāyannityaṃ mahādevaṃ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam || 55.33 || krīḍitvā sa yathākāmaṃ svecchayā śivamandire | vedavedāṅgatattvajño jāyate'sau śubhe kule || 55.34 || rūpavānsubhagaścaiva sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | rājā vā rājaputro vācārasamanvitaḥ || 55.35 || etatte kathitaṃ rājaṃstīrthasya phalamuttamam | yacchrutvā mānavo nityaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 55.36 || ya idaṃ śrāvayennityamākhyānaṃ dvijapuṃgavān | śrāddhe devakule vāpi paṭhetparvṇi parvṇi || 55.37 || gīrvāṇāstasya tuṣyanti manuṣyāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva naśyate sarvapātakam || 55.38 || likhitvā tīrthamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ | jātismaratvaṃ labhate prāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam || 55.39 || rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadakṣaramanvitam || 55.40 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye kāśīrājamokṣagamanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.56>
uttānapāda uvāca anyacca śrotumicchāmi kena gaṅgāvatāritā | rudraśīrṣe sthitā devī puṇyā kathamihāgatā || 56.1 || puṇyā devāśilā nāma tasyā māhātmyamuttamam | etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasanno yadi śaṅkara || 56.2 || īśvara uvāca śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā yathā gaṅgāvatāritā | devaiḥ sarvairmahābhāgā sarvalokahitāya vai || 56.3 || asti vindhyo nago nāma yāmyāśāyāṃ mahīpate | gīrvāṇāstu gatāḥ sarve tasya mūrdhni nareśvara || 56.4 || tatra cāhvānitā gaṅgā brahmādyairakhilaiḥ suraiḥ | abhyarcyeśaṃ jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum || 56.5 || jaṭāmadhyasthitāṃ gaṅgāṃ mocayasveti bhūtale | bhāsvantī sā tato muktā rudreṇa śirasā bhuvi || 56.6 || tatra sthāne mahāpuṇyā devairutpāditā svayam | tato devanadī jātā sā hitāya nṛṇāṃ bhuvi || 56.7 || vasanti ye taṭe tasyāḥ snānaṃ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ | pibanti ca jalaṃ nityaṃ na te yānti yamālayam || 56.8 || yatra sā patitā kuṇḍe śūlabhede narādhipa | devanadyāḥ pratīcyāṃ tu tatra prācī sarasvatī || 56.9 || yāmyāyāṃ śūlabhedasya tatra tīrthamanuttamam | tatra devaśilā puṇyā svayaṃ devena nirmitā || 56.10 || tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 56.11 || tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayennṛpa | svalpānnenāpi dattena tasya cānto na vidyate || 56.12 || uttānapāda uvāca kāni dānāni dattāni śastāni dharaṇītale | yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 56.13 || devaśilāyā māhātmyaṃ snānadānādijaṃ phalam | vratopavāsaniyamairyatprāpyaṃ tadvadasva me || 56.14 || īśvara uvāca āsītpurā mahāvīryaścedinātho mahābalaḥ | vīrasena iti khyāto maṇḍalādhipatirnṛpa || 56.15 || rāṣṭre tasya ripurnāsti na vyādhirna ca taskarāḥ | na cādharmo'bhavattatra dharma eva hi sarvadā || 56.16 || sadā mudānvito rājā sabhāryo bahuputrakaḥ | ekāsīdduhitā tasya surūpā girijā yathā || 56.17 || iṣṭā sā pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ bandhuvargajanasya ca | kṛtaṃ vaivāhikaṃ karma kāle prāpte yathāvidhi || 56.18 || anantaraṃ cedipatirdvādaśābdamakhe sthitaḥ | tatastasyāstu yo bhartā sa mṛtyuvaśamāgataḥ || 56.19 || vidhavāṃ tāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā śokasamanvitaḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ tatra svabhāryāṃ duḥkhapīḍitām || 56.20 || priye duḥkhamidaṃ jātaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ suduḥsaham | naiṣā rakṣayituṃ śakyā rūpayauvanagarvitā || 56.21 || dūṣayeta kulaṃ kvāpi kathaṃ rakṣyā hi bālikā | nopāyo vidyate kvāpi bhānumatyāśca rakṣaṇe | parasparaṃ vivadatoḥ śrutvā tatkanyakābravīt || 56.22 || bhānumatyuvāca na lajjāmi tavāgre'haṃ jalpantī tāta karhicit | satyaṃ notpadyate doṣo madarthe te narādhipa || 56.23 || adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ tāta dhārayiṣye na mūrdhajān | sthūlavastrapaṭārddhaṃ tu dhārayiṣyāmi te gṛhe || 56.24 || kariṣyāmi vratānyāśu purāṇavihitāni ca | ātmānaṃ śoṣayiṣyāmi toṣayiṣye janārdanam || 56.25 || mamaiṣā vartate buddhiryadi tvaṃ tāta manyase | bhānumatyā vacaḥ śrutvā rājā saṃharṣito'bhavat || 56.26 || tīrthayātrāṃ samuddiśya kośaṃ dattvā supuṣkalam | visṛjya puruṣānvṛddhān kṛtvā tasyāḥ surakṣaṇe || 56.27 || puruṣān sāyudhāṃścāpi brāhmaṇānsapurohitān | dāsīdāsānpadātīṃśca cāsyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇakṣamān || 56.28 || tataḥ piturmatenaiva gaṅgātīraṃ gatā satī | avagāhya taṭe dve tu gaṅgāyāḥ sa narādhipa || 56.29 || nityaṃ sampūjya sadviprāngandhamālyādibhūṣaṇaiḥ | dvādaśābdāni sā tīre gaṅgāyāḥ samavasthitā || 56.30 || tyaktvā gaṅgāṃ tadā rājñī gatā kāṣṭhāṃ tu dakṣiṇām | prāptā sā sacivaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra revā mahānadī || 56.31 || samāḥ pañca sthitā tatra oṅkāre'marakaṇṭake | udagyāmyeṣu tīrtheṣu tīrthāttīrthaṃ jagāma sā || 56.32 || snātvā snātvā pūjya viprān bhaktipūrvamatandritā | vāruṇīṃ sā diśaṃ gatvā devanadyāśca saṅgame || 56.33 || dadarśa cāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ munisaṅghaiḥ samākulam | dṛṣṭvā munisamūhaṃ sā praṇipatyedamabravīt || 56.34 || māhātmyamasya tīrthasya nāma caivāsya kīdṛśam | kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama || 56.35 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | cakratīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ cakraṃ dattaṃ purā hareḥ | maheśvareṇa tuṣṭena devadevena śūlinā || 56.36 || atra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | anivartikā gatistasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 56.37 || dvitīye'hni tato gacchecchūlabhede tapasvini | pūrvoktena vidhānena snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 56.38 || janmatrayakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | jalena tilamātreṇa pradadyādañjalitrayam || 56.39 || tṛpyanti pitarastasya dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam | yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute bhaktyā śrotriyairbrāhmaṇairnṛpa || 56.40 || vārddhuṣyādyāstu varjyante pitḥṇāṃ dattamakṣayam | apare'hṇi tato gacchetpuṇyāṃ devaśilāṃ śubhām || 56.41 || vīkṣyate jāhnavī puṇyā devairutpāditā purā | snātvā tatra jalaṃ dadyāttilamiśraṃ narādhipa || 56.42 || sakṛtpiṇḍapradānena mucyate brahmahatyayā | ekādaśyāmupoṣitvā pakṣayorubhayorapi || 56.43 || kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpaṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām | viṣṇupūjāṃ prakurvīta puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ || 56.44 || prabhāte bhojayedviprān dānaṃ dadyātsaśaktitaḥ | caturthe'hni tato gacchedyatra prācī sarasvatī || 56.45 || brahmadehādviniṣkrāntā pāvanārthaṃ śarīriṇām | tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 56.46 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamanindyān bhojayeddvijān | pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam || 56.47 || sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ tathā | devakoṭisamākīrṇaṃ koṭiliṅgottamottamam || 56.48 || trirātraṃ kurute yo'tra śuciḥ snātvā jitendriyaḥ | pakṣaṃ māsaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsamabdamekaṃ kadācana || 56.49 || na tasya sambhavo martye tasya vāso bhaveddivi | niyamastho vimucyeta trijanmajanitādaghāt || 56.50 || vinā puṃsā tu yā nārī dvādaśābdaṃ śucivratā | tiṣṭhate sākṣayaṃ kālaṃ rudraloke mahīyate || 56.51 || munīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mudā paramayā yayau | tato'vagāhya tattīrthamaharniśamatandritā || 56.52 || dṛṣṭvā tīrthaprabhāvaṃ tu punarvacanamabravīt | śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ me'dya brāhmaṇāḥ sapurohitāḥ || 56.53 || na tyajāmīdṛśaṃ sthānaṃ yāvajjīvamaharniśam | matpituśca tathā mātuḥ kathayadhvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 56.54 || tvatkanyā śūlabhedasthā niyatā vratacāriṇī | evamuktvā sthitā sā tu tatra bhānumatī nṛpaḥ || 56.55 || ekāntaropavāsasthā śanairmāsopavāsitā | devaśilāsthitā nityaṃ dadhyau sā cakrapāṇinam || 56.56 || aharniśaṃ daheddhūpaṃ candanaṃ ca sadīpakam | pādaśaucaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ bhojayate dvijān | dvādaśābdāni sā rājñī suvratā tatra saṃsthitā || 56.57 || īśvara uvāca anyaddevaśilāyāstu māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate | kathayāmi mahābāho setihāsaṃ purātanam || 56.58 || kaścidvanecaro vyādhaḥ śabaraḥ saha bhāryayā | durbhikṣapīḍitastatra āmiṣārthaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ || 56.59 || nāpaśyatpakṣiṇastatra na mṛgānna phalāni ca | sarastato dadarśātha padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || 56.60 || dṛṣṭvā sarovaraṃ tatra śabarī vākyamabravīt | kumudāni gṛhāṇa tvaṃ divyānyāhārasiddhaye || 56.61 || devasya pūjanārthaṃ tu śūlabhedasya yatnataḥ | vikrayo bhavitā tatra dharmaśīlo jano yataḥ || 56.62 || bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā jagrāha kumudāni saḥ | uttīrṇastu taṭe yāvaddṛṣṭvā śrīvṛkṣamagrataḥ || 56.63 || śrīphalāni gṛhītvā tu supakvāni viśeṣataḥ | śūlabhedaṃ sa samprāpto dadarśa subahūñjanān || 56.64 || caitramāse site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ narādhipa | tasminnahani nāśnīyurbālā vṛddhāstathā striyaḥ || 56.65 || maṇḍapaṃ dadṛśe tatra kṛtaṃ devaśilopari | vastraiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ divyaṃ sraṅmālyairupaśobhitam || 56.66 || ṛṣayaścāgatāstatra ye cāśramanivāsinaḥ | sopavāsāḥ saniyamāḥ sarve sāgniparigrahāḥ || 56.67 || devanadyāstaṭe ramye munisaṅghaiḥ samākule | āgacchadbhirnṛpaśreṣṭha mārgastatra na labhyate || 56.68 || dṛṣṭvā janapadaṃ tatra tāṃ bhāryāṃ śabaro'bravīt | gaccha pṛcchasva kimapi kimadya snānakāraṇam || 56.69 || parvāṇi yāni śrūyante kiṃsvitsūryendusamplavaḥ | ayanaṃ kiṃ bhavedadya kiṃ vākṣayatṛtīyakā || 56.70 || tataḥ svabharturvacanācchabarī prasthitā tadā | papraccha nārīṃ dṛṣṭvāgre dattvāgre kamale śubhe || 56.71 || tithiradyaiva kā proktā kiṃ parva kathayasva me | kimayaṃ snāti loko'yaṃ kiṃ vā snānasya kāraṇam || 56.72 || nāryuvāca adya caikādaśī puṇyā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | upoṣitā sakṛdyena nākaprāptiṃ karoti sā || 56.73 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā śabarī śābarāya vai | kathayāmāsa cāvyagrā strīvākyaṃ nṛpasattama || 56.74 || adya tvekādaśī puṇyā bālavṛddhairupoṣitā | madanaikādaśī nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī || 56.75 || niyatā śrūyate tatra rājaputrī suśobhanā | vratasthā niyatāhārā nāmnā bhānumatī satī || 56.76 || naitayā sadṛśī kācittriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā | dṛśyate sā varārohā hyavatīrṇā mahītale || 56.77 || bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śabarastāṃ jagāda ha | kamalāni yathālābhaṃ dattvā bhuṅkṣva hi satvaram || 56.78 || mamaiṣā vartate buddhirna bhoktavyaṃ mayā dhruvam | na mayopārjitaṃ bhadre pāpabuddhyā śubhaṃ kvacit || 56.79 || śabaryuvāca na pūrvaṃ tu mayā bhuktaṃ kasmiṃścaiva tu vāsare | bhuktaśeṣaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ yāvatkālaṃ smarāmyaham || 56.80 || bhāryāyā niścayaṃ jñātvā snānaṃ kartuṃ jagāma ha | ardhottarīyavastreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ || 56.81 || sarvān devānnamaskṛtya gato devaśilāṃ prati | tasthau sa śaṅkamāno'pi namaskṛtya janārdanam || 56.82 || yasyāstu kumude datte tayā rājñyai niveditam | taddṛṣṭvā padmayugalaṃ tāṃ dāsīṃ sābravīttadā || 56.83 || kutra padmadvayaṃ labdhaṃ kathyatāmagrato mama | śīghraṃ tatraiva gatvā ca padmānānaya cāparān || 56.84 || dhānyena vasunā vāpi kamalāni samānaya | bhānumatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gatā sā śabaraṃ prati || 56.85 || śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi bahūnyanyāni dehi me || 56.86 || śabaryuvāca śrīphalāni sapuṣpāṇi dāsyāmi ca viśeṣataḥ | na lobho na spṛhā me'sti gatvā rājñīṃ nivedaya || 56.87 || tayā ca satvaraṃ gatvā yathāvṛttaṃ niveditam | śabaryuktaṃ purastasyāḥ savistaraparaṃ vacaḥ || 56.88 || tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñī tatra svayaṃ gatā | uvāca śabarīṃ prītyā dehi padmāni mūlyataḥ || 56.89 || śabaryuvāca na mūlyaṃ kāmaye devi phalapuṣpasamudbhavam | śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ mama gṛhyatām || 56.90 || arcāṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ vāsudeve jagatpatau || 56.91 || rājñyuvāca vinā mūlyaṃ na gṛhṇāmi kamalāni tavādhunā | dhānyasya khārikāmekāṃ dadāmi pratigṛhyatām || 56.92 || daśa viṃśatyatha triṃśaccatvāriṃśadathāpi vā | gṛhāṇa vā khāriśataṃ durbhikṣāṃ bodhimuttara || 56.93 || vasu ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca anyatte yadabhīpsitam | tatsarvaṃ sampradāsyāmi kamalārthe na saṃśayaḥ || 56.94 || śabaryuvāca nāhāraṃ cintayāmyadya muktvā devaṃ varānane | devakāryaṃ vinā bhadre nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate || 56.95 || rājñyuvāca na tvayānnaṃ parityājyaṃ sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam | tasmātsarvaprayatnena mamānnaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 56.96 || tapasvino mahābhāgā ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ | gṛhasthadvāri te sarve yācante'nnamatandritāḥ || 56.97 || śabaryuvāca niṣedhaśca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam | satyena tapate sūryaḥ satyena jvalate'nalaḥ || 56.98 || satyena tiṣṭhatyudadhirvāyuḥ satyena vāti hi | satyena pacyate sasyaṃ gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sravanti ca || 56.99 || satyādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | tasmātsarvaprayatnena satyaṃ satyena pālayet || 56.100 || devakāryaṃ tu me muktvā nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate | gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ || 56.101 || śrūyate dvijavākyaistu na doṣo vidyate kvacit | kuśāḥ śākaṃ payo matsyā gandhāḥ puṣpākṣatā dadhi | māṃsaṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānāḥ pratyākhyeyā na vāri ca || 56.102 || rājñyuvāca ārāmopahṛtaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ puṣpameva ca | krītaṃ pratigrahe labdhaṃ puṣpamevaṃ caturvidham || 56.103 || uttamaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ gṛhītaṃ svayameva ca | madhyamaṃ phalamārāme tvadhamaṃ krītameva ca | pratigraheṇa yallabdhaṃ niṣphalaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ || 56.104 || purohita uvāca gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ | upakāraḥ prakartavyo vyapadeśena karhicit || 56.105 || īśvara uvāca śrīphalāni sapadmāni dattāni śabareṇa tu | gṛhītvā tāni rājñī sā pūjāṃ cakre suśobhanām || 56.106 || kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ cakre śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām | śabarastu tato bhāryāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 56.107 || dīpārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sneho yathālābhena sundari | kṛtvā dīpaṃ tatastau tu kṛtvā pūjāṃ hareḥ śubhām || 56.108 || cakraturjāgaraṃ rātrau dhyāyanto dharaṇīdharam | tataḥ prabhātasamaye dṛṣṭvā snānotsukaṃ janam || 56.109 || snāti vai śūlabhede tu devanadyāṃ tathāpare | sarasvatyāṃ narāḥ kecinmārkaṇḍasya hrade'pare || 56.110 || cakratīrthaṃ gatāścakruḥ snānaṃ kecidvidhānataḥ | śucayaste janāḥ sarve snātvā devāśilopari || 56.111 || śrāddhaṃ cakruḥ prayatnena śraddhayā pūtacetasā | tāndṛṣṭvā śabaro bilvaiḥ piṇḍāṃścakre prayatnataḥ || 56.112 || bhānumatyā tathā bhartuḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtam | anindyā bhojitā viprā dambhavārddhuṣyavarjitāḥ || 56.113 || haviṣyānnaistathā dadhnā śarkarāmadhusarpiṣā | pāyasena tu gavyena kṛtānnena viśeṣataḥ || 56.114 || bhojayitvā tathā rājñī dadau dānaṃ yathāvidhi | pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ govṛṣameva ca || 56.115 || vividhāni ca dānāni hemaratnadhanāni ca | cakratīrthe mahārāja kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati | pṛthvī tena bhaveddattā saśailavanakānanā || 56.116 || uttānapāda uvāca yāni yāni ca dattāni śastāni jagatīpateḥ | tāni sarvāṇi deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ || 56.117 || īśvara uvāca tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam | bhūmidaḥ svargamāpnoti dīrghamāyurhiraṇyadaḥ || 56.118 || gṛhado rogarahito rūpyado rūpavān bhavet | vāsodaścandrasālokyamarkasāyujyamaśvadaḥ || 56.119 || vṛṣadastu śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godātā ca triviṣṭapam | yānaśayyāprado bhāryāmaiśvaryamabhayapradaḥ || 56.120 || dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahma śāśvatam | vāryannapṛthivīvāsastilakāñcanasarpiṣām || 56.121 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate | yena yena hi bhāvena yadyaddānaṃ prayacchati || 56.122 || tena tena sa bhāvena prāpnoti pratipūjitam | dṛṣṭvā dānāni sarvāṇi rājñī dattāni yāni ca || 56.123 || uvāca śabaro bhāryāṃ yattacchṛṇu nareśvara | purāṇaṃ paṭhitaṃ bhadre brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || 56.124 || śrutaṃ ca tanmayā sarvaṃ dānadharmaphalaṃ śubham | pūrvajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ snānadānavratādibhiḥ || 56.125 || śarīraṃ dustyajaṃ muktvā labhate gatimuttamām | saṃsārasāgarādbhītaḥ satyaṃ bhadre vadāmi te || 56.126 || anekāni ca pāpāni kṛtāni bahuśo mayā | ghātitā jantavo bhadre nirdagdhāḥ parvatāḥ sadā || 56.127 || tena pāpena dagdho'haṃ dāridryaṃ na nivartate | tīrthāvagāhanaṃ pūrvaṃ pāpena na kṛtaṃ mayā || 56.128 || tenāhaṃ duḥkhito bhadre dāridryamanivartikam | māturgṛhaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ tyaja snehaṃ mamopari | nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya moktumicchāmyahaṃ tanum || 56.129 || śabaryuvāca mātrā pitrā na me kāryaṃ nāpi svajanabāndhavaiḥ | yā gatistava jīveśa sā mamāpi bhaviṣyati || 56.130 || na strīṇāmīdṛśo dharmo vinā bhartrā svajīvitam | śrūyante bahavo doṣā dharmaśāstreṣvanekadhā || 56.131 || pāraṇaṃ kuru bhojendra vrataṃ yena na naśyati | yatte'bhivāñchitaṃ kiṃcidviṣṇave kartumarhasi || 56.132 || bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā mumude śabarastataḥ | gṛhītvā śrīphalaṃ śīghraṃ homaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 56.133 || sarvadevānnamaskṛtya bhukto'pi ca tayā saha | caitryāṃ tu viṣuvaṃ jñātvā tasthau tatra dinatrayam || 56.134 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe vyādhavākyopadeśakathanapūrvakadānādiphalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.57>
īśvara uvāca bhānumatī dvijānbhojya bubhuje bhuktaśeṣataḥ | bhuktvā susukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmya ca || 57.1 || trayodaśyāṃ tato gatvā madanākhyatithau tadā | mārkaṇḍasya hrade snātvānarcya devaṃ guhāśayam || 57.2 || kṛtopavāsaniyamā snāpayitvā maheśvaram | pañcāmṛtasugandhena dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 57.3 || ārcayadvividhaiḥ puṣpairnaivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ | kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām || 57.4 || nṛtyagītaistathā stotrairdadhyau devaṃ maheśvaram | annaṃ vistāritaṃ sarvaṃ devasyāgre yathāvidhi || 57.5 || cāturvarṇyasutāḥ sarve bhojitāḥ saparicchadāḥ | caturdaśyāṃ dinaṃ yāvatsampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam || 57.6 || śaṅkhavāditrabherībhiḥ paṭahadhvanināditam | kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhūtajanasaṃkulam || 57.7 || nṛtyagītaistathā stotraiḥ preritā sā niśā tadā | prabhāte bhojitā viprāḥ pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā || 57.8 || dattvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ śaktyā viprānusārataḥ | arcayitvā mahāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhairmadanena ca || 57.9 || vicitraiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca devaḥ sampūjya veṣṭitaḥ | sragdāmalambamānaiśca bahudīpasamujjvalaiḥ || 57.10 || pakvānnairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ suvṛttairmodakādibhiḥ | tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vedādhyayanatatparāḥ || 57.11 || tatparva kīrtayāṃścakruḥ padmakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ | ādityasya dinaṃ tvadya tithiḥ pañcadaśī tathā || 57.12 || tvāṣṭrameva ca nakṣatraṃ saṃkrāntirviṣuvantathā | vyatīpātastathā yogaḥ karaṇaviṣṭireva ca || 57.13 || padmakaṃ nāma parvaitadayanādicaturguṇam | atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 57.14 || te dvijā bhānumatyātha śūlabhedaṃ gatāḥ saha | dadṛśuḥ śabaraṃ kuṇḍe bhāryayā saha saṃsthitam || 57.15 || aiśānīṃ sa diśaṃ gatvā parvate bhṛgumūrdhani | patituṃ ca samārūḍho bhāryayā saha pārthiva || 57.16 || bhānumatyuvāca tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahāsattva śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama | kimarthaṃ tyajasi prāṇānadyāpi ca yuvā bhavān || 57.17 || kaḥ santāpaḥ ka udvegaḥ kiṃ duḥkhaṃ vyādhireva ca | śiśuḥ saṃdṛśyase'dyāpi kāraṇaṃ kathyatāmidam || 57.18 || śabara uvāca kāraṇaṃ nāsti me kiṃcinna duḥkhaṃ kiṃcideva tu | saṃsārabhayabhīto'haṃ nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate || 57.19 || duḥkhena labhyate yasmānmānuṣyaṃ janma bhāgyataḥ | mānuṣyaṃ janma cāsādya yā na dharmaṃ samācaret || 57.20 || sa gacchennirayaṃ ghoramātmadoṣeṇa sundari | tasmātpatitumicchāmi tīrthe'sminpāpanāśane || 57.21 || rājñyuvāca adyāpi vartate kālo dharmasyopārjane tava | kṛtāpakṛtakarmā vai vratadānairviśudhyati || 57.22 || ahaṃ dāsyāmi dhānyaṃ vā vāsāṃsi draviṇaṃ bahu | nityamācara dharmaṃ tvaṃ dhyāyannityaṃ maheśvaram || 57.23 || śabara uvāca naivāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na dhānyaṃ vastrameva ca | yo yasyaivānnamaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam || 57.24 || rājñyuvāca kandamūlaphalāhāro bhramitvā bhaikṣyamuttamam | avagāhya sutīrthāni sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 57.25 || tato vimuktapāpastu yatkiṃcitkurute śuciḥ | karmaṇā tena pūtastvaṃ sadgatiṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam || 57.26 || śabara uvāca annamadya mayā tyaktaṃ prāṇebhyo'pi mahattaram | satyaṃ na lopayeddevi niścitātra matirmama || 57.27 || prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ devi kṣamasvādya janaiḥ saha | ardhottarīyavastreṇa saṃyamyātmānamudyataḥ || 57.28 || bhāryayā sahito vyādho hariṃ dhyātvā papāta ha | nagārdhātpatito yāvadgatajīvo narādhipa || 57.29 || cūrṇībhūtau hi tau dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasyopari bhūmipa | trimuhūrte gate kāle śabaro bhāryayā saha || 57.30 || divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho gataścānuttamāṃ gatim || 57.31 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyādhasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.58>
uttānapāda uvāca athāto devadeveśa bhānumatyakarocca kim | eṣa me saṃśayo deva kathayasva prasādataḥ || 58.1 || īśvara uvāca cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ sā gatā kuṇḍasya sannidhau | dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ rājñī harṣeṇa pūritā || 58.2 || viprān bahūn samāhūya pūjayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt | dattvā tu vidhivaddānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nṛpātmaja || 58.3 || niścayaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā sthitā śāntena cetasā | tataḥ sampūjya vidhivatpitḥndevānnarādhipa || 58.4 || kṣapayitvā pakṣamekaṃ madhumāsasya sā sthitā | amāvāsyāṃ tato rājñī gatā parvatasannidhau || 58.5 || nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya kṛtvā mukulitau karau | vijñāpya brāhmaṇān sarvānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 58.6 || mama mātā pitā bhrātā ye cānye sakhibāndhavāḥ | kṣamāpayitvā sarvāṃstānvacanaṃ mama kathyatām || 58.7 || tvatputrī śūlabhede tu tapaḥ kṛtvā svaśaktitaḥ | visṛjya caiva sātmānaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe divaṃ yayau || 58.8 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ | saṃdeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmastvayoktaṃ śobhanavrate | mātāpitṛbhyāṃ suśroṇi mā te'bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ || 58.9 || tato visṛjya tāṃllokān sthitā parvatamūrdhani | ardhottarīyavastreṇa gāḍhaṃ baddhā punaḥpunaḥ || 58.10 || tataścikṣepa sātmānamekacittā narādhipa | nagārddhe patitā yāvattāvaddṛṣṭāḥ surāṅganāḥ || 58.11 || bhobho vatse mahābhāge bhānumatyatitāpasi | divyaṃ vimānamāruhya kailāsaṃ prati gamyatām || 58.12 || tataḥ sā paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ janānāṃ tridivaṃ gatā || 58.13 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca iti te kathitaḥ sarvaḥ śūlabhedasya vistaraḥ | yaḥ śrutaḥ śaṅkarātpūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame || 58.14 || ya idaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā tīrthe devakule'pi vā | sa mucyate mahāpāpādapi janmaśatārjitāt || 58.15 || brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ | goghātī strīvighātī ca devabrahmasvahārakaḥ || 58.16 || svāmidrohī mitraghātī tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ | paranyāsāpahārī ca paranikṣepalopakaḥ || 58.17 || rasabhedī tulābhedī tathā vārddhuṣikastu yaḥ | yaḥ kanyāvighnakartā ca tathā vikrayakārakaḥ || 58.18 || parabhāryā bhrātṛbhāryā gauḥ snuṣā kanyakā tathā | abhigāmī paradveṣī tathā dharmapradūṣakaḥ || 58.19 || mucyante sarve evaite śūlabhedaprabhāvataḥ || 58.20 || ya idaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ nṛpa | mudaṃ prayānti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pitarastasya sarvaśaḥ || 58.21 || yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhyamānaṃ naro vaśī | sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhāgbhavet || 58.22 || idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamidaṃ pāvanamuttamam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥkīrtivivardhanam || 58.23 || iti kathitamidaṃ te śūlabhedasya puṇyaṃ mahimana hi manuṣyaiḥ śrūyate yatsapāpaiḥ | madanariputaṭinyā yāmyakūlasthitasya prabaladuritakandocchedakuddālakalpam || 58.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| śūlabhedamāhātmyaṃ samāptam
<5.3.59>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśinīm | śrute yasyāḥ prabhāve tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 59.1 || revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | yatrāste sarvadā devo vedamūrtirdivākaraḥ || 59.2 || kurukṣetraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sārvakāmikamuttamam | idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 59.3 || kurukṣetre yathā vṛddhirdānasya jagatīpate | puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā dānaṃ vardhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 59.4 || yavamekaṃ tu yo dadyātsauvarṇaṃ mastake nṛpa | puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā sthānaṃ yathā sthānaṃ nare smṛtam || 59.5 || sūryagrahe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyāddānaṃ yathāvidhi | hastyaśvaratharatnādi gṛhaṃ gāśca yugaṃdharān || 59.6 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ | trayodaśa dinaṃ yāvattrayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet || 59.7 || tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | dvādaśābde bhavetprītistatra tīrthe mahīpate || 59.8 || yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā | śrāddhado labhate svargaṃ pitḥṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || 59.9 || akṣatairbadarairbilvairiṅgudairvā tilaiḥ saha | akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti tasmiṃstīrthe na saṃśayaḥ || 59.10 || tatra snātvā tu yo devaṃ pūjayecca divākaram | ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā punarādityamarcayet | sa gacchetparamaṃ lokaṃ tridaśairapi vanditam || 59.11 || ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu yajurvā sāma eva ca | sa samagrasya vedasya phalamāpnoti vai nṛpa || 59.12 || yastryakṣaraṃ japenmantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram | ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 59.13 || yastatra vidhivatprāṇāṃstyajate nṛpasattama | sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ || 59.14 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe puṣkariṇyāmādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.60>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhūyo'pyahaṃ pravakṣyāmi ādityeśvaramuttamam | sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ pārtha sarvavighnavināśanam || 60.1 || āyuḥśrīvarddhanaṃ nityaṃ putradaṃ svargadaṃ śivam | yasya tīrthasya cānyāni tīrthāni kurunandana || 60.2 || nālabhanta śriyaṃ nāke martye pātālagocare | kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṅgā naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || 60.3 || vārāṇasī ca kedāraṃ prayāgaṃ rudranandanam | mahākālaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ nṛpottama || 60.4 || ravitīrthasya sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | ravitīrthe hi yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama || 60.5 || snehātte kathayiṣyāmi vārddhakenātipīḍitaḥ | śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve taponiṣṭhā mahaujasaḥ || 60.6 || śrutaṃ me rudrasāṃnidhye nandiskandagaṇaiḥ saha | pārvatyā pṛṣṭaḥ śambhuśca ravitīrthasya yatphalam || 60.7 || śambhunā ca yadākhyātaṃ girijāyāḥ sasambhramam | tatsarvamekacittena rudrodgītaṃ śrutaṃ mayā || 60.8 || tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena pāṇḍava | durbhikṣopahatā viprā narmadāṃ tu samāśritāḥ || 60.9 || uddālako vaśiṣṭhaśca māṇḍavyo gautamastathā | yājñavalkyo'tha gargaśca śāṇḍilyo gālavastathā || 60.10 || nāciketo vibhāṇḍaśca vālakhilyādayastathā | śātātapaśca śaṅkhaśca jaiminirgobhilastathā || 60.11 || jaigīṣavyaḥ śatānīkaḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ | tīrthayātrā kṛtā taistu narmadāyāḥ samantataḥ || 60.12 || ādityeśvaramāyātāḥ prasaṅgādṛṣipuṃgavāḥ | vṛkṣaiḥ saṃchāditaṃ śubhraṃ dhavatindukapāṭalaiḥ || 60.13 || jambīrairarjunaiḥ kubjaiḥ śamīkesarakiṃśukaiḥ | tasmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye sugandhikusumākule || 60.14 || punnāganālikeraiśca khadiraiḥ kalpapādapaiḥ | anekaśvāpadākīrṇaṃ mṛgamārjārasaṃkulam || 60.15 || ṛkṣahastisamākīrṇaṃ citrakaiścopaśobhitam | praviṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve vane puṣpasamākule || 60.16 || vanānte ca striyo dṛṣṭvā raktā raktāmbarānvitāḥ | raktamālyānuśobhāḍhyā raktacandanacarcitāḥ || 60.17 || raktābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ | tāsāṃ samīpagā dṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇajīmūtasannibhāḥ || 60.18 || mahākāyā bhīmavaktrāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ | anāvṛṣṭyupamā dṛṣṭā āturāḥ piṅgalocanāḥ || 60.19 || dīrghajihvā karālāsyā tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā durāsadā | vṛddhā nārī kuruśreṣṭha dṛṣṭānyā ṛṣipuṃgavaiḥ || 60.20 || tataḥ samīpagā vṛddhā tasya vṛndasya bhārata | svādhyāyaniratā viprā dṛṣṭāstaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ || 60.21 || ūcuste tu samūhena brāhmaṇāṃstapasi sthitān | asmākaṃ svāminaḥ sarve tiṣṭhante tīrthamadhyataḥ | te prasthāpyā mahābhāgāḥ sarvathaiva tvarānvitāḥ || 60.22 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sarve caiva tvarānvitāḥ | jagmuste narmadākakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā revāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 60.23 || tataḥ kecitstuvantyanye jaya devi namo'stu te || 60.24 || namo'stu te siddhagaṇairniṣevite namo'stu te sarvapavitramaṅgale | namo'stu te viprasahasrasevite namo'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare || 60.25 || namo'stu te sarvapavitrapāvane namo'stu te devi varaprade śive | namāmi te śītajale sukhaprade saridvare pāpahare vicitrite || 60.26 || anekabhūtaughasusevitāṅge gandharvayakṣoragapāvitāṅge | mahāgajaughairmahiṣairvarāhairāpīyase toyamahormimāle || 60.27 || namāmi te sarvavare sukhaprade vimocayāsmānaghapāśabaddhān || 60.28 || bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā yāvattavāmbho nahi saṃśrayanti | spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveścettaddevi dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu || 60.29 || anekasaṃsārabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām | gatistvamambhojasamānavaktre dvandvairanekairabhisaṃvṛtānām || 60.30 || nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo'tra | duḥkhāturāṇāmabhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi || 60.31 || viṇmūtradehāśca nimagnadehā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ | mahābaladhvastataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ jalaṃ na yāvattava saṃspṛśanti || 60.32 || mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye'ṃbhastava devi puṇyam | te'pi pramucyanti bhayācca ghorātkimatra viprā bhavapāśabhītāḥ || 60.33 || sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge'sminkalināvasṛṣṭe | tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā || 60.34 || tava prāsādādvarade viśiṣṭe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā | yāsyāma mokṣaṃ tava suprasādādvayaṃ yathā tvaṃ kuru naḥ prasādam || 60.35 || tvāmāśritā ye śaraṇaṃ gatāśca gatistvamambeva piteva putrān | tvatpālitā yāvadimaṃ sughoraṃ kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ kṣipāmaḥ || 60.36 || evaṃ stutā tadā devī narmadā saritāṃ varā | pratyakṣā sā parā mūrtirbrāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 60.37 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ narendra śṛṇvanti bhaktyā parayā praśāntāḥ | te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāṅgāḥ || 60.38 || ye stotrametatsatataṃ japanti snātvā ca toyena tu narmadāyāḥ | tebhyo'ntakāle sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhāmacirāddadāti || 60.39 || prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavendram | dehakṣayaṃ sve salile dadāti samāśrayaṃ tasya mahānubhāva || 60.40 || pāpairvimuktā divi modamānāḥ sambhoginaścaiva tu nānyathā ca || 60.41 || prasannā narmadā devī stotreṇānena bhārata | jalenāpyāyitān viprān dakṣiṇāpathavāhinī || 60.42 || amṛtatvaṃ tu vo dadmi yogibhiryanna gamyate | durlabhaṃ yatsuraiḥ sarvairmatprasādāllabhiṣyatha || 60.43 || iti te brāhmaṇā rājaṃllabdhā varamanuttamam | gamiṣyantaḥ prītacittā dadṛśuścitramadbhutam || 60.44 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca dṛṣṭāstaiḥ puruṣāḥ pārtha narmadātaṭasaṃsthitāḥ | snānadevārcanāsaktāḥ pañca eva mahābalāḥ || 60.45 || te dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ | saṃpṛṣṭāstairmahārāja yathā tadavadhāraya || 60.46 || viprā ūcuḥ | vanānte strīyugaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāraudraṃ bhayāvaham | vṛddhāśca puruṣāstatra pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ || 60.47 || durdharṣā durnirīkṣyāśca itaścetaśca cañcalāḥ | vyāharantaḥ śubhāṃ vācaṃ na tatra gatirasti vai || 60.48 || aparasparayoḥ sarve nirīkṣantaḥ punaḥpunaḥ | taistu yadvacanaṃ proktaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathyatāmiti || 60.49 || asmākaṃ puruṣāḥ pañca tiṣṭhanti tatra sattamāḥ | te prasthāpyā mahābhāgāḥ sarvathaiva tvarānvitāḥ || 60.50 || atha te puruṣāḥ pañca śrutvā vākyamidaṃ śubham | parasparaṃ nirīkṣanto vadanti ca punaḥpunaḥ || 60.51 || kva te kasya kuto yātāḥ kimuktaṃ tairbhayāvahaiḥ || 60.52 || puruṣā ūcuḥ | tīrthāvagāhanaṃ sarvaiḥ pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimaiḥ | uttaraiśca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā na pāpaṃ tairvyapohitam || 60.53 || niṣpāpāścātha saṃjātāstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve vahnikālopamā dvijāḥ || 60.54 || pātakāni ca ghorāṇi yānyacintyāni dehinām | pāpiṣṭhena tu caikena gurudārā niṣevitā || 60.55 || hṛtaṃ cānyena mitrasvaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ tathā | brahmahatyā mahāraudrā kṛtā cānyena pātakam || 60.56 || surāpānaṃ tu cānyasya saṃjātaṃ cāpyakāmataḥ | govadhyā cāpyakāmena kṛtā caikena pāpinā || 60.57 || akāmato'pi sarveṣāṃ pātakāni narādhipa | brāhmaṇānāṃ tu te śrutvā vākyaṃ tadvismayānvitāḥ || 60.58 || sadya eva tadā jātāḥ pāpiṣṭhā gatakalmaṣāḥ | tīrthasyāsya prabhāvena narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 60.59 || na kvacitpātakānāṃ tu praveśaścātra jāyate | evaṃ saṃcitya te sarve pāpiṣṭhāśca parasparam || 60.60 || citrabhānuḥ smṛtastaistu vicintya hṛdaye harim | snātvā revājale puṇye tarpitāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ || 60.61 || natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam | pradakṣiṇaṃ tu taṃ bhaktyā jvalantaṃ jātavedasam || 60.62 || patitāḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha pāpodvignā mahīpate | sāttvikīṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā rajastamastathā || 60.63 || hataṃ taiḥ pāvake sarvaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe | vimānasthāstadā dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiste yudhiṣṭhira || 60.64 || āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭamṛṣibhirnarmadātaṭe | tadāprabhṛti te sarve rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ || 60.65 || ravitīrthaṃ dvijā hṛṣṭāḥ sevante mokṣakāṅkṣayā | tīrthasyāsya ca yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 60.66 || pīḍito vṛddhabhāvena bhaktyā prīto nareśvara | uddeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmi dvikrośābhyantare sthitaḥ || 60.67 || kurukṣetraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ ravitīrthaṃ śrutaṃ mayā | īśvareṇa purā khyātaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya narādhipa || 60.68 || śrutaṃ rudrācca taiḥ sarvairahaṃ tatra samīpagaḥ | īśvara uvāca mārtaṇḍagrahaṇe prāpte ye vrajanti ṣaḍānana | ravitīrthe kurukṣetre tulyametatphalaṃ labhet || 60.69 || snāne dāne tathā japye home caiva viśeṣataḥ | kurukṣetre samaṃ puṇyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 60.70 || grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā | ravitīrthe viśeṣeṇa revā puṇyaphalapradā || 60.71 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūryadine bhaktyā vyatīpāte ca vai dhṛtau | saṃkrāntau grahaṇe'māyāṃ ye vrajanti jitendriyāḥ || 60.72 || kāmakrodhairvimuktāśca rāgadveṣaistathaiva ca | upoṣya parayā bhaktyā devasyāgre narādhipa || 60.73 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpaṃ devasya bodhayet | kathāṃ vai vaiṣṇavīṃ pārtha vedābhyasanameva ca || 60.74 || ṛgvedaṃ vā yajurvedaṃ sāmavedamatharvaṇam | ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu sa vedaphalamāpnuyāt || 60.75 || gāyatryā ca caturvedaphalamāpnoti mānavaḥ | prabhāte pūjayedviprānannadānahiraṇyataḥ || 60.76 || bhūmidānena vastreṇa annadānena śaktitaḥ | chatropānahaśayyādigṛhadānena pāṇḍava || 60.77 || grāmadhūrvahadānena gajakanyāhayena ca | vidyāśakaṭadānena sarveṣāmabhayaṃ bhavet || 60.78 || śatruśca mitratāṃ yāti viṣaṃ caivāmṛtaṃ bhavet | grahā bhavanti suprītāḥ prītastasya divākaraḥ || 60.79 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ ravitīrthaphalaṃ nṛpa | ye śṛṇvanti narā bhaktyā ravitīrthaphalaṃ śubham || 60.80 || te'pi pāpavinirmuktā raviloke vasanti hi | godānena ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ bhṛgudarśane || 60.81 || kedāra udakaṃ pītvā tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | abdamaśvatthasevāyāṃ tilapātraprado bhavet || 60.82 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ādityeśvarakīrtanāt | śrute yasya prabhāve na jāyate yannṛpātmaja || 60.83 || tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhaktyā tava mahīpate | pāpāni ca pralīyante bhinnapātre yathā jalam || 60.84 || tīrthasyābhimukho nityaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ kathitaṃ tava pāṇḍava || 60.85 || pāpiṣṭhānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ svāmimitrāvaghātinām | tīrthākhyānaṃ śubhaṃ teṣāṃ gopitavyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || 60.86 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādityeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.61>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchetparaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe | śakratīrthaṃ suvikhyātamaśeṣāghavināśanam || 61.1 || purā śakreṇa tatraiva tapo vai duratikramam | prārabdhaṃ parayā bhaktyā devaṃ prati maheśvaram || 61.2 || tataḥ saṃtoṣito deva umāpatirnarādhipa | devendratvaṃ varaṃ rājyaṃ dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ dadau || 61.3 || labdhaṃ śakreṇa nṛpate narmadātīrthabhāvataḥ | tataḥ puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃjātaṃ vasudhātale || 61.4 || kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīm | upoṣya vai naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 61.5 || duḥsvapnasambhavaiḥ pāpairdurnimittasamudbhavaiḥ | grahaśākinisambhūtairmucyate pāṇḍunandana || 61.6 || śakreśvaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye prapaśyanti bhaktitaḥ | teṣāṃ janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 61.7 || agamyāgamane caiva avāhye caiva vāhite | svāmimitravighāte yannaśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 61.8 || gopradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śubhaṃ brāhmaṇapuṃgave | dhuryaṃ vā dāpayettasmin sarvāṅgaruciraṃ nṛpa || 61.9 || dātavyaṃ parayā bhaktyā svarge vāsamabhīpsatā | etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ śakreśvaraphalaṃ nṛpa || 61.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.62>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra karoḍīśvaramuttamam | yatra vai nihatāstāta dānavāḥ sapadānugāḥ || 62.1 || indrādidevaiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaiḥ satataṃ jayabuddhibhiḥ | teṣāṃ ye putrapautrāśca pūrvavairamanusmaram || 62.2 || kruddhairdevasamūhaiśca dānavā nihatā raṇe | teṣāṃ śirāṃsi saṃgṛhya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 62.3 || nikṣipya narmadātoye bandhubhāvamanusmaram | tatra snātvā surāḥ sarve sthāpayitvā umāpatim || 62.4 || indreṇa sahitāḥ sarve'pūjayaṃllokasiddhaye | hṛṣṭacittāḥ surāḥ sarve jagmurākāśamaṇḍalam || 62.5 || dānavānāṃ mahābhāga sūditā koṭiruttamā | tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ karoḍīti mahītale || 62.6 || vikhyātaṃ tu tadā loke pāpaghnaṃ pāṇḍunandana | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmubhau pakṣau ca bhaktitaḥ | upoṣya śūlinaścāgre rātrau kurvīta jāgaram || 62.7 || satkathāpāṭhasaṃyukto vedādhyayanasaṃyutaḥ | prabhāte vimale prāpte pūjayettridaśeśvaram || 62.8 || pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śrīkhaṇḍena ca guṇṭhayet | śastaiḥ pallavapuṣpaiśca pūjayettu prayatnataḥ || 62.9 || bahurūpaṃ japanmantraṃ dakṣiṇāśāṃ vyavasthitaḥ | yathoktena vidhānena nābhimātre jale kṣipet || 62.10 || tilāñjaliṃ tu pretāya dakṣiṇāśāmupasthitaḥ | śrāddhaṃ tatraiva viprāya kārayedvijitendriyaḥ || 62.11 || viṣamairagrajātaiśca vedābhyasanatatparaiḥ | gohiraṇyena sampūjya tāmbūlairbhojanaistathā || 62.12 || bhūṣaṇaiḥ pādukābhiśca brāhmaṇānpāṇḍunandana | bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 62.13 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kaścittyajeddehaṃ vidhānataḥ | tasya bhavati yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 62.14 || yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti martyasya narmadājale | tāvadvasati dharmātmā śivaloke sudurlabhe || 62.15 || tataḥ kālāccyutastasmādiha mānuṣatāṃ gataḥ | koṭidhanapatiḥ śrīmāñjāyate rājapūjitaḥ || 62.16 || sarvadharmasamāyukto medhāvī bījaputrakaḥ | vikhyāto vasudhāpṛṣṭhe dīrghāyurmānavo bhavet || 62.17 || punaḥ smarati tattīrthaṃ tatra gatvā nṛpottama | karoḍeśvaramabhyarcya prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 62.18 || indracandrayamairrudrairādityairvasubhistathā | viśvedevaistathā sarvaiḥ sthāpitastridaśeśvaraḥ || 62.19 || revāyā uttare kūle lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | mānavo bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ prāsādaṃ kārayettu yaḥ || 62.20 || tasmiṃstīrthe naraśreṣṭha sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāt | nyāyopāttadhanenaiva dārupāṣāṇakeṣṭakaiḥ || 62.21 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhiśca śaktitaḥ | te'pi yānti narā loke śāṃkare surapūjite || 62.22 || yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā bhaktyā māhātmyaṃ tīrthajaṃ nṛpa | tasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyeta ṣaṇmāsābhyantaraṃ ca yat || 62.23 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karoḍīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.63>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra kumāreśvaramuttamam | prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthānāmagastyeśvarasannidhau || 63.1 || ṣaṇmukhena purā tāta sarvapātakanāśanam | ārādhya parayā bhaktyā siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa || 63.2 || devasainyādhipo jātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ | ugratejā mahātmāsau saṃjātastīrthasevanāt || 63.3 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ saṃjātaṃnarmadātaṭe | tatra tīrthe tu yo gatvā ekacitto jitendriyaḥ || 63.4 || kārttikasya caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | snāpayedgirijānāthaṃ dadhidugdhena sarpiṣā || 63.5 || gītaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi | brāhmaṇaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ pārtha ṣaṭkarmanirataiḥ śubhaiḥ || 63.6 || yatkiṃciddīyate tatra akṣayaṃ pāṇḍunandana | sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrtha nirmitaṃ śikhinā nṛpa || 63.7 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kumāreśvarajaṃ phalam | kumāradarśanātpuṇyaṃ prāpyate pāṇḍunandana || 63.8 || mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti satyamīśvarabhāṣitam || 63.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.64>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | narāṇāṃ pāpanāśāya agastyeśvaramuttamam || 64.1 || tatra snātvā naro rājanmucyate brahmahatyayā | kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī || 64.2 || ghṛtena snāpayeddevaṃ samādhistho jitendriyaḥ | ekaviṃśatikulopeto cyavedaiśvarātpadāt || 64.3 || dhanaṃ copānahau chatraṃ dadyācca ghṛtakambalam | bhojanaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 64.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agastyeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.65>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra ānandeśvaramuttamam | tattīrthaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 65.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ānandaścaiva saṃjāto rudrasya dvijasattama | kathyatāṃ me ca tatsarvaṃ saṃkṣepātsaha bāndhavaiḥ || 65.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayāmi nṛpaśreṣṭha ānandeśvaramuttamam | dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 65.3 || pūjito daivataiḥ sarvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣapannagaiḥ | ānandasaṃyuto devo nanarta vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 65.4 || bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya gauryā cārddhāṅgasaṃsthitaḥ | bhūtavetālakaṅkālairbhairavairbhairavo vṛtaḥ || 65.5 || nanarta narmadātīre dakṣiṇe pāṇḍunandana | tuṣṭairmarudgaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpitaḥ kamalāsanaḥ || 65.6 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthamānandeśvaramucyate | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ narādhipa || 65.7 || vidhivaccārcayeddevaṃ sugandhena vilepayet | brāhmaṇānpūjayettatra yathāśaktyā yudhiṣṭhira || 65.8 || godānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vastradānaṃ śubhāvaham | vasantasya trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kārayet || 65.9 || iṅgudairbadarairbilvairakṣataiśca jalena vā | pretānāṃ kārayecchrāddhamānandeśvara uttame || 65.10 || ānanditā bhaveyuste yāvadābhūtasamplavam | santatervai na vicchedaḥ saptajanmasu jāyate | ānando hi bhavatteṣāṃ pratijanmani bhārata || 65.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ānandeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.66>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra mātṛtīrthamanuttamam | saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 66.1 || mātarastatra rājendra saṃjātā narmadātaṭe | umārdhanārirdeveśo vyālayajñopavītadhṛk || 66.2 || uvāca yoginīvṛndaṃ kaṣṭaṃkaṣṭamaho hara | ajeyāḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 66.3 || tīrthamatra vidhānena prakhyātaṃ vasudhātale | evaṃ bhavatu yoginya ityuktvāntaradhācchivaḥ || 66.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā navamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ | upoṣya parayā bhaktyā pūjayenmātṛgocaram || 66.5 || tasya syurmātaraḥ prītāḥ prīto'yaṃ vṛṣavāhanaḥ | vandhyāyā mṛtavatsāyā aputrāyā yudhiṣṭhira || 66.6 || snāpanaṃ cārabhettatra mantraśāstraviduttamaḥ | sahiraṇyena kumbhena pañcaratnaphalānvitaḥ || 66.7 || snāpayetputrakāmāyāḥ kāṃsyapātreṇa deśikaḥ | putraṃ sā labhate nārī vīryavantaṃ guṇānvitam || 66.8 || yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettataḥ sa labhate nṛpa | mātṛtīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 66.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mātṛtīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.67>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta jalamadhye vyavasthitam | luṅkeśvaramiti khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || 67.1 || idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ nānāścaryaṃ mahītale | asya tīrthasya māhātmyamutpattiṃ śṛṇu bhārata || 67.2 || āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ | kālapṛṣṭha iti khyātaḥ suto brahmasutasya ca || 67.3 || gaṅgātaṭaṃ samāśritya cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | adhomukho'pi saṃsthitvāpibaddhūmamaharniśam || 67.4 || tataścānantaraṃ devastiṣṭhate hyumayā saha | dṛṣṭvā taṃ pārvatī sā tu tapasyugre vyavasthitam || 67.5 || paśya paśya mahādeva dhūmāśī tiṣṭhate naraḥ | prasīda taṃ kuruṣvādya dehi śīghraṃ varaṃ vibho || 67.6 || īśvara uvāca yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ devi na tanme rocate priye | svakāryaṃ ca sadā cintyaṃ parakāryaṃ visarjayet || 67.7 || mūrkhastrībālaśatrūṇāṃ yaśchandenānuvartate | vyasane patate ghore satyametadudīritam || 67.8 || devyuvāca bhāryayābhyarthito bhartā kāraṇaṃ bahu bhāṣate | laghutvaṃ yāti sā nārī evaṃ śāstreṣu paṭhyate || 67.9 || prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi yadi māṃ tvaṃ na manyase | pārvatyā prerito devo gato'sau dānavaṃ prati || 67.10 || īśvara uvāca kimarthaṃ pibase dhūmaṃ kimarthaṃ tapyase tapaḥ | kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ nu santāpo vada kāryamabhīpsitam || 67.11 || yuvā tvaṃ dṛśyase'dyāpi varṣaviṃśatireva ca | tadācakṣva hi me sarvaṃ tapasaḥ kāraṇaṃ mahat || 67.12 || dānava uvāca acalā dīyatāṃ bhaktirmama sthairyaṃ tavopari | aparaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ nirvighnaṃ me gataṃ vibho || 67.13 || divasānāṃ sahasre dve pūrṇe tvattapasā mama || 67.14 || īśvara uvāca yācayābhīpsitaṃ kāryaṃ tuṣṭo'haṃ tava suvrata | devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 67.15 || kiṃ nākaṃ yācayāmyadya kimadya sakalāṃ mahīm | evaṃ saṃcintayāmāsa kāmabāṇena pīḍitaḥ || 67.16 || dānava uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi me prabho | saṅgrāmaistu na tuṣṭo'haṃ balaṃ nāstīti kiṃcana || 67.17 || yasya mūrdhanyahaṃ deva pāṇinā samupaspṛśe | devadānavagandharvo bhasmasādyātu tatkṣaṇāt || 67.18 || īśvara uvāca yattvayā cintitaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ tava | uttiṣṭha gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhavanaṃ prati dānava || 67.19 || dānava uvāca sthīyatāṃ devadeveśa yāvajjñāsyāmi te varam | yuṣmanmūrdhni nyase pāṇiṃ pratyayo me bhavedyathā || 67.20 || tataścānantaraṃ devaścintayāno maheśvaraḥ | na skando na harirbrahmā yaḥ kāryeṣu kṣamo'dhunā || 67.21 || jñātvā caivāpadaṃ prāptāṃ devaḥ prārthayate vṛṣam | anena saha pāpena yudhyasva sāmprataṃ kṣaṇam || 67.22 || karaṃ prāsārayaddaityo devaṃ mūrdhni kila spṛśet | lāṅgūlenāhato daityo viṣaṇṇaḥ patito bhuvi || 67.23 || devastu dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ gataścaivomayā saha | bhayabhīto nirīkṣeta grīvāṃ bhajya punaḥpunaḥ || 67.24 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve yuyudhe vṛṣabheṇa saḥ | dvāvetau balināṃ śreṣṭhau yuyudhāte mahābalau || 67.25 || prahārairvajrasadṛśaiḥ kopena ghaṭikātrayam | pāṇibhyāṃ na spṛśedyo vai vṛṣabhasya śirastathā || 67.26 || hatvā lāṅgūlapātena āgato vṛṣabhastadā | utthitaścāpyasau daityo vrajate vṛṣapṛṣṭhataḥ || 67.27 || vāyuvegena samprāpto yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | āgataṃ dānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣo vacanamabravīt || 67.28 || āruhya pṛṣṭhe me deva śīghrameva hi gamyatām | āruhya vṛṣabhaṃ devo jagāma comayā saha || 67.29 || nākaṃ prāptastato devo gataḥ śakrasya mandiram | nātyajaddevapṛṣṭhaṃ tu dānavo baladarpitaḥ || 67.30 || indralokaṃ parityajya brahmalokaṃ gatastadā | yatrayatra vrajeddevo bhayātsaha divaukasaiḥ || 67.31 || apaśyattatra tatraiva pṛṣṭhe lagnaṃ tu dānavam | sarvāṃllokān bhramitvā tu devo vismayamāgataḥ || 67.32 || na sthānaṃ vidyate kiṃcidyatra viśramyate kṣaṇam | devadānavayostatra yuddhaṃ jñātvā sudāruṇam || 67.33 || harṣitātmā munistatra ciraṃ nṛtyati nāradaḥ | dhanyo'hamadya me janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 67.34 || mahāntaṃ ca kaliṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtoṣaḥ paramo'bhavat | devadānavayostatra yuddhaṃ tyaktvā ca nāradaḥ || 67.35 || ājagāma tato vipro yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | dṛṣṭvā devo'tha taṃ vipraṃ pratipūjyābravīdidam || 67.36 || bho nārada muniśreṣṭha jānīṣe keśavaṃ kvacit | gatvā tatra ca śīghraṃ tvaṃ keśavāya nivedaya || 67.37 || nārada uvāca devadānavasiddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām | sarveṣāmeva deveśo harate dhruvamāpadam || 67.38 || asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manasāpi na cintayet | īdṛśīṃ naiva budhyāmi āpadaṃ ca vibho tava || 67.39 || īśvara uvāca gaccha nārada śīghraṃ tvaṃ yatra devo janārdanaḥ | viditaṃ ca tvayā sarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ dānavena tu || 67.40 || avadhyo dānavo hyeṣa sendrairapi marudgaṇaiḥ | gatvā tu keśavaṃ devaṃ nivedaya mahāmune || 67.41 || nārada uvāca na tu gacchāmyahaṃ deva suptaḥ kṣīrodadhau sukhī | keśavaḥ preraṇe hyeṣāmādeśo dīyatāṃ prabho || 67.42 || mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā rājānaṃ ca tathā prabhum | guruṃ caivāditaḥ kṛtvā śayānaṃ na prabodhayet || 67.43 || īśvara uvāca yadi kvacidagāreṣu vahnirutpadyate mahān | nidhanaṃ yānti tatrasthā yadbudhyerannasūrayaḥ || 67.44 || nārada uvāca śīghraṃ gaccha mahādeva ātmānaṃ rakṣa suprabho | gacchāmyahaṃ na sandeho yatra devo janārdanaḥ || 67.45 || tato nandimahākālau stambhahastau bhayānakau | jaghnaturdānavaṃ tatra mudgarādibhirāyudhaiḥ || 67.46 || trayo'pi ca mahākāyāḥ saptatālapramāṇakāḥ | na śamo jāyate teṣāṃ yudhyatāṃ ca parasparam || 67.47 || tataścānantaraṃ vipro'gacchattaṃ keśavaṃ prati | suptaṃ kṣīrārṇave'paśyaccheṣaparyaṅkasaṃsthitam || 67.48 || lakṣmyā pādayugaṃ gṛhya ūrūpari niveśitam | apsarogīyamānaṃ tu bhaktyānamya ca keśavam || 67.49 || adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam | utthāpayasva deveśaṃ lakṣmi tvamaviśaṅkitā || 67.50 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā padāṅguṣṭhaṃ vyamardayat | nāradastiṣṭhate dvāri uttiṣṭha madhusūdana || 67.51 || devo'pi nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣamupāgataḥ | svāgataṃ tu muniśreṣṭha suprabhātādya śarvarī || 67.52 || nārada uvāca adya me saphalaṃ deva prabhātaṃ tava darśanāt | kuśalaṃ ca na devānāṃ śīghramuttiṣṭha gamyatām || 67.53 || śrīviṣṇuruvāca brahmā cendraśca rudraśca ye cānye tu marudgaṇāḥ | āpadaḥ kāraṇaṃ yacca tatsamākhyātumarhasi || 67.54 || nārada uvāca dānavena mahātīvraṃ tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam | rudreṇa ca varo datto bhasmatvaṃ manasepsitam || 67.55 || varadānabalenaiva sa devaṃ hantumarhati | īdṛśaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā nīto devo'maraiḥ saha || 67.56 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā jagāma samunirhariḥ | dṛṣṭvā devastamīśānaṃ gacchantaṃ diśamuttarām || 67.57 || dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ca rudro'tha pariṣvajya punaḥpunaḥ | namaskṛtya jagannāthaṃ devaṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ || 67.58 || viṣṇuruvāca bhayasya kāraṇaṃ deva kathyatāṃ ca maheśvara | devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ preṣayeyaṃ yamālayam || 67.59 || lalāṭe ca kṛto dharmo yuṣmākaṃ ca maheśvara | chittvā śirastathāṅgāni indriyāṇi na saṃśayaḥ || 67.60 || īśvara uvāca nāsti saukhyaṃ ca mūrkheṣu nāsti saukhyaṃ ca rogiṣu | parādhīnena saukhyaṃ tu strījite ca viśeṣataḥ || 67.61 || strījitena mayā viṣṇo varo dattastu dānave | yasya mūrdhni nyasetpāṇiṃ sa bhavedbhasmapuṃjavat || 67.62 || ajeyaścāmaraścaiva mayā hyuktaḥ sa keśava | hantumicchati māṃ pāpa upāyastava vidyate || 67.63 || viṣṇuruvāca gacchantu amarāḥ sarve yuṣmābhiḥ saha śaṅkara | upāyaṃ sarjayāmyadya vadhārthaṃ dānasya ca || 67.64 || revāyāśca taṭe tiṣṭha deva tvamamaraiḥ saha | kālakṣepo na kartavyo gamyatāṃ tvaritaṃ prabho || 67.65 || dakṣiṇā yatra gaṅgā ca revā caiva mahānadī | yatrayatra ca dṛśyeta prācī caiva sarasvatī || 67.66 || tatsamaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ na martye caiva dṛśyate | snānaṃ ye tatra kurvanti dānaṃ caiva tu bhaktitaḥ || 67.67 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | etattīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 67.68 || gamyatāṃ tatra deveśa luṅkeśaṃ tvaṃ sahāmaraiḥ | viṣṇostu vacanādeva praviṣṭo hradamuttamam || 67.69 || ratiṃ sumahatīṃ cakre saha tatra marudgaṇaiḥ | tataścānantaraṃ devo māyāṃ kṛtvā hyanekadhā || 67.70 || vasantamāsaṃ saṃsṛjya udyānavanaśobhitam | aśokairbakulaiścaiva brahmavṛkṣaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || 67.71 || śrīvṛkṣaiśca kapitthaiśca śirīṣairrājacampakaiḥ | śrīphalaiśca tathā tālaiḥ kadambodumbaraistathā || 67.72 || aśvatthādidrumaiścaiva nānāvṛkṣairanekaśaḥ | nānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhāḍhyairbhramaraiśca nināditam || 67.73 || tasminmadhye mahāvṛkṣo nyagrodhaśca suśobhanaḥ | bahupakṣisamāyuktaḥ kokilārāvanāditaḥ || 67.74 || kṛṣṇena ca kṛtaṃ tasminkanyārūpaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt | na tasyāḥ sadṛśī kanyā trailokye sacarācare || 67.75 || anyāśca kanyakāḥ sapta surūpāḥ śubhalocanāḥ | divyarūpadharāḥ sarvā divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 67.76 || pumāṃsamabhikāṅkṣantyo yadyekaḥ kāmayetstriyaḥ | mauktikairratnamāṇikyairvaiḍūryaiśca suśobhanaiḥ || 67.77 || kāmahāraiśca vaṃśaiśca baddho hindolakaḥ kṛtaḥ | ārūḍhāśca mahākanyā gāyante susvaraṃ tadā || 67.78 || mārutaḥ śītalo vāti vanaṃ spṛṣṭvā suśobhanam | vātena prerito gandho dānavo ghrāṇapīḍitaḥ || 67.79 || tataḥ kusumagandhena vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | āghrāya cedṛśaṃ puṇyaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ mayā || 67.80 || vane cintayataḥ kiṃciddhvanigītaṃ suśobhanam | gītasya ca dhvaniṃ śrutvā mohito māyayā hareḥ || 67.81 || vyādhasyaiva mahākūṭe patanti ca yathā mṛgāḥ | kālaspṛṣṭastathā kṛṣṇe patitaśca narādhipa || 67.82 || dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ ca tāṃ daityo mūrcchayā patito bhuvi | patitena tu dṛṣṭaikā kanyā vaṭatale sthitā || 67.83 || āsyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu nārīṇāṃ punaḥ kāmena pīḍitaḥ | gṛhītvā hemadaṇḍaṃ tu tāṃ pātayitumicchati || 67.84 || kanyovāca mā mānusparśayatvaṃ hi kumāryahaṃ kulottama | bho muñca muñca māṃ śīghraṃ yāvadgacchāmyahaṃ gṛham || 67.85 || dānava uvāca ahaṃ vivāhamicchāmi tvayā saha suśobhane | bhūpṛṣṭhe sakale rājñī bhavasyevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 67.86 || kanyovāca pitā rakṣati kaumārye bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putro rakṣati vṛddhatve na strī svātantryamarhati || 67.87 || na svātantryaṃ mamaivāsti utpannāhaṃ mahatkule | yācyastu matpitā bhrātā mātāpi hi tathaiva ca || 67.88 || dānava uvāca yadi māṃ necchase tvadya svātantryaṃ nāvalambase | mamāpi ca tadā hatyā satyaṃ ca śubhalocane || 67.89 || kanyovāca viśvāso naiva kartavyo yādṛśe tādṛśe nare | narāḥ strīṣu vicitrāśca lampaṭāḥ kāmamohitāḥ || 67.90 || pariṇīya tu māṃ tvaṃ hi bhuṅkṣva bhogānmayā saha | janmanāśo bhavetpaścānna tvaṃ nānyo bhavenmama || 67.91 || brāhmaṇī kṣatriṇī vaiśī śūdrī yāvattathaiva ca | dvitīyo na bhavedbhartā ekākī ceha janmani || 67.92 || dānava uvāca yattvayā gaditaṃ vākyaṃ tanmayā dhāritaṃ hṛdi | pratyayaṃ me kuruṣvādya yatte manasi rocate || 67.93 || kanyovāca jānīṣva gopakanyāṃ māṃ krīḍāmi sakhibhiḥ saha | asmatkuleṣu yaddivyaṃ tatkuruṣva yathāvidhi || 67.94 || na taddivyaṃ kule'smākaṃ viṣaṃ kośaṃ na tattulā | gopānvayeṣu sarveṣu hastaḥ śirasi dīyate || 67.95 || kāmāndhenaiva rājendra nikṣipto mastake karaḥ | tatkṣaṇādbhasmasādbhūto dagdhastṛṇacayo yathā || 67.96 || keśavopari devaistu puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ śubhā kṛtā | hṛṣṭāḥ sarve'gamandevāḥ svasthānaṃ vigatajvarāḥ || 67.97 || kṣīrodaṃ keśavo gacchatkālapṛṣṭhe nipātite | ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā caritaṃ dānavasya ca || 67.98 || sa jayī jāyate nityaṃ śaṅkarasya vaco yathā | etasmātkāraṇādrājaṃlliṅgeśvaramiti śrutam || 67.99 || līnaṃ ca pātakaṃ yasmātsnānamātreṇa naśyati | tvagasthi śoṇitaṃ māṃsaṃ medaḥsnāyustathaiva ca || 67.100 || majjāśukragataṃ pāpaṃ naśyate janmakoṭijam | luṅkeśvare mahārāja toyaṃ pibati bhaktitaḥ || 67.101 || tribhiḥ prasṛtimātrābhiḥ pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā | viśeṣeṇa caturdaśyāmubhau pakṣau tu cāṣṭamī || 67.102 || upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā pitḥṇāṃ pāṇḍunandana | uddhṛtāstena te sarve nārakīyāḥ pitāmahāḥ || 67.103 || kākiṇīṃ caiva yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage | tena dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ ca yat || 67.104 || prāptaṃ tu nānyathā rājañchaṅkaro vadate tvidam | sparśaliṅgamidaṃ rājañchaṅkareṇa tu nirmitam || 67.105 || sparśamātre manuṣyāṇāṃ rudravāso'bhijāyate | tena dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ ca yat || 67.106 || etasmātkāraṇādrājaṃllokapālāśca rakṣakāḥ | durgā ca rakṣaṇe sṛṣṭā caturhastadharā śubhā || 67.107 || dhanado lokapāleśo rakṣakaśceśvarasya ca | rakṣati ca sadā kālaṃ grahavyāpārarūpataḥ || 67.108 || putrabhrātṛsamārūpaiḥ svāmisambandharūpibhiḥ | laṅkeśvaraṃ ca rājendra devairnādyāpi mucyate || 67.109 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe luṅkeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.68>
