śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca dhanadasya tu tattīrthaṃ tato gacchedyudhiṣṭhira | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 68.1 || sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tatra prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | caitramāsatrayodaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ || 68.2 || upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram | pañcāmṛtena rājendra snāpayeddhanadaṃ budhaḥ || 68.3 || dīpaṃ ghṛtena dātavyaṃ gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca kārayet | prabhāte pūjayedviprānātmanaḥ śreya icchati || 68.4 || pratigrahasamarthāṃśca vidyāsiddhāntavādinaḥ | śrautasmārtakriyāyuktān paradāraparāṅmukhān || 68.5 || pūjayedgohiraṇyena vastropānahabhojanaiḥ | chatraśayyāpradānena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 68.6 || trijanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ varadasya prabhāvataḥ | svargadaṃ durvinītānāṃ vinītānāṃ ca mokṣadam || 68.7 || annadaṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ bhavejjanmanijanmani | kulīnatvaṃ duḥkhahāniḥ svabhāvājāyate nare || 68.8 || vyādhidhvaṃso bhavetteṣāṃ narmadodakasevanāt | dhanadasya tu yastīrthe vidyādānaṃ prayacchati || 68.9 || sa yāti bhāskare loke sarvavyādhivivarjite | devadroṇīṃ ca tatraiva svaśaktyā pāṇḍunandana || 68.10 || ye prakurvanti bhūyiṣṭhāṃ revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | te yānti śāṃkare loke sarvaduḥkhavivarjite || 68.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhanadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.69>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra maṅgaleśvaramuttamam | sthāpitaṃ bhūmiputreṇa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 69.1 || toṣitaḥ parayā bhaktyā śaṅkaraḥ śaśiśekharaḥ | caturdaśyāṃ gururdevaḥ pratyakṣo maṅgaleśvaraḥ || 69.2 || brūhi putra varaṃ śubhraṃ taṃ te dāsyāmi maṅgala || 69.3 || maṅgala uvāca prasādaṃ kuru me śambho pratijanmani śaṅkara | tvadaṅgasvedasambhūto grahamadhye vasāmyaham || 69.4 || tvatprasādena īśāna pūjyo'haṃ sarvadaivataiḥ | kṛtārtho hyadya saṃjātastava darśanabhāṣaṇāt || 69.5 || sthāne'smin devadeveśa mama nāmnā maheśvaraḥ | evaṃ bhavatu te putretyuktvā cāntaradhīyata || 69.6 || maṅgalo'pi mahātmā vai sthāpayitvā maheśvaram | ātmayogabalenaiva śūlināpūjayattataḥ || 69.7 || sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ liṅgaṃ nāmnā vai maṅgaleśvaram | tatra tīrthe tu vai rājanbrāhmaṇānprīṇayetsudhīḥ || 69.8 || sapatnīkānnṛpaśreṣṭha caturthyaṅgārake vrate | patnībhartārasaṃyuktaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ śrotriyaṃ dvijam || 69.9 || vratānte caiva gaurdhuryaiḥ śivamuddiśya dīyate | prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 69.10 || vastrayugmaṃ pradātavyaṃ lohitaṃ pāṇḍunandana | dhūrvahau raktavarṇau ca śubhraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 69.11 || chatraṃ śayyāṃ śubhāṃ caiva raktamālyānulepanam | dātavyaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha viśuddhenāntarātmanā || 69.12 || caturthyāṃ tu tathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ | śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kartavyaṃ vittaśāṭhyena varjitaḥ || 69.13 || pretā bhavanti suprītā yugamekaṃ mahīpate | saputro jāyate martyaḥ pratijanma nṛpottama || 69.14 || tasya tīrthasya bhāvena sarvāṅgaruciro nṛpa | maṅgalaṃ bhavate vaṃśo nāśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit || 69.15 || bhaktyā yaḥ kīrtayennityaṃ tasya pāpaṃ vyapohati || 69.16 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.70>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | raviṇā nirmitaṃ pārtha sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 70.1 || svāṃśena bhāskarastatra tiṣṭhate cottare taṭe | sarvavyādhiharaḥ puṃsāṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 70.2 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃṣaṣṭhyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśīm | snānaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartyaḥ śrāddhaṃ preteṣu bhaktitaḥ | tasya pāpakṣayaḥ pārtha sūryaloke mahīyate || 70.3 || tataḥ svargāccyutaḥ so'pi jāyate vimale kule | dhanāḍhyo vyādhinirmukto jīvejjanmanijanmani || 70.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.71>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kāmeśvaraṃ tataścānyacchṛṇu pāṇḍavasattama | siddho yatra gaṇādhyakṣo gaurīputro mahābalaḥ || 71.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhaktiyukto jitendriyaḥ | pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya dhūpanaivedyapūjanaiḥ || 71.2 || prasādya jagatāmīśaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | aṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya tatra snātvā yudhiṣṭhira || 71.3 || yo yena yajate tatra sa taṃ kāmamavāpnuyāt || 71.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.72>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra maṇināgeśvaraṃ śubham | uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram | sthāpitaṃ maṇināgena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 72.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āśīviṣeṇa sarpeṇa īśvarastoṣitaḥ katham | kṣudrāḥ sarvasya lokasya bhayadā viṣaśālinaḥ || 72.2 || kathyatāṃ tāta me sarvaṃ pātakasyopaśāntidam | mama santāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam || 72.3 || karṇabhīṣmodbhavaṃ raudraṃ duḥkhaṃ pāñcālisambhavam | tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gataḥ || 72.4 || śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ vai pāpanāśinīm | ayuktamidamasmākaṃ dvija kleśo na śāmyati || 72.5 || athavā prāpsyate tāta vidyādānasya yatphalam | tatphalaṃ prāpyate nityaṃ kathāśravaṇato hareḥ || 72.6 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca yathāyathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathātathā me sukhameti bhāratī | śaithilyatā vā jarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta | śṛṇuṣva tasmātsaha bāndhavaiśca kathāmimāṃ pāpaharāṃ praśastām || 72.7 || kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam || 72.8 || kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛttaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata || 72.9 || dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame | garutmantaṃ ca vinatāsūta kadrūrahīnatha || 72.10 || saṃtoṣeṇa ca te tāta tiṣṭhataḥ kāśyape gṛhe | kadrūśca vinatā nāma hṛṣṭe ca vanite sadā || 72.11 || tābhyāṃ sārddhaṃ krīḍate ca kaśyapo'pi prajāpatiḥ | tatastvekadine prāpte āśramasthā śubhānanā || 72.12 || uccaiḥśravaṃ hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā manovegasamanvitam | paśya paśya hi tanvaṅgī hayaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram || 72.13 || dhāvamānamaviśrāntaṃ javena manasopamam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā cāśvamīrṣyābhāvena cābravīt || 72.14 || kadrūruvāca brūhi bhadre sahasrāṃśoraśvaḥ kiṃvarṇako bhavet | ahaṃ bravīmi kṛṣṇo'yaṃ tvaṃ kiṃ vadasi tadvada || 72.15 || vinatovāca paśyase nanu netraiśca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ na paśyasi | asatyabhāṣaṇādbhadre yamalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 72.16 || satyānṛte tu vacane paṇastava mamaiva tu | sahasraṃ caiva varṣāṇāṃ dāsyahaṃ tava mandire || 72.17 || asatyā yadi me vāṇī kṛṣṇa uccaiḥśravā yadi | tadāhaṃ tvadgṛhe dāsī bhavāmi sarpamātṛke || 72.18 || yadi uccaiḥśravāḥ śveto'haṃ dāsī ca tavaiva tu | evaṃ parasparaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃvādo'yaṃ vyavardhata || 72.19 || āśrameṣu gatā bālā rātrau cintāparā sthitā | bandhuvargasya kathitaṃ samastaṃ tadviceṣṭitam || 72.20 || putrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ pārtha paṇaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam | hāhākāraḥ kṛtaḥ sarpaiḥ śrutvā mātrā paṇaṃ kṛtam || 72.21 || jātā dāsī na sandehaḥ śveto bhāskaravāhanaḥ | uccaiḥśravā hayaḥ śveto na kṛṣṇo vidyate kvacit || 72.22 || kadrūruvāca yathāhaṃ na bhave dāsī tatkāryaṃ ca vicintyatām | viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu hyuccaiḥśravahayasya tu || 72.23 || ekaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ tu yāvatkṛṣṇaḥ sa dṛśyate | kṣaṇamātreṇa caikena dāsī sā bhavate mama || 72.24 || dāsīṃ kṛtvā tu tāṃ tanvīṃ vinatāṃ satyagarvitām | tataḥ svasthānagāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham || 72.25 || sarpā ūcuḥ | yathā tvaṃ jananī cāmba sarveṣāṃ bhuvi pūjitā | tathā sāpi viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na mātaraḥ || 72.26 || mātā ca pitṛbhāryā ca mātṛmātā pitāmahī | karmaṇā manasā vācā hitaṃ tāsāṃ samācaret || 72.27 || sā tatastena vākyena kruddhā kālānalopamā | mama vākyamakurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ || 72.28 || havyavāhamukhe sarve te yāsyantyavicāritam | mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve caiva bhujaṅgamāḥ || 72.29 || kecitpraviṣṭā romeṣu uccaiḥśravahayasya ca | naṣṭāḥ keciddaśadiśaṃ kadrūśāpabhayāttataḥ || 72.30 || kecidgaṅgājale naṣṭāḥ kecinnaṣṭāḥ sarasvatīm | kecinmahodadhau līnāḥ praviṣṭā vindhyakandare || 72.31 || āśritya narmadātoye maṇināgottamo nṛpa | tapaścacāra vipulamuttare narmadātaṭe || 72.32 || mātṛśāpabhayātpārtha dhyāyate kāmanāśanam | acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca vināśotpattivarjitam || 72.33 || vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ sāgraṃ tadardhaṃ ravivīkṣakaḥ | evaṃ dhyānaratasyaiva pratyakṣastripurāntakaḥ || 72.34 || sādhu sādhu mahābhāga sattvavāṃstu bhujaṃgama | tvayā bhaktyā gṛhīto'haṃ prītaste hyurageśvara | varaṃ yācaya me kṣipraṃ yaste manasi vartate || 72.35 || maṇināga uvāca mātṛśāpabhayānnātha kliṣṭo'haṃ narmadātaṭe | tvatprasādena me nātha mātṛśāpo bhavedvṛthā || 72.36 || īśvara uvāca havyavāhamukhaṃ vatsa na prāpsyasi mamājñayā | mama loke nivāsaśca tava putra bhaviṣyati || 72.37 || maṇināga uvāca atra sthāne mahādeva sthīyatāmaṃśabhāgataḥ | sahasrāṃśena bhāgena sthīyatāṃ narmadājale | upakārāya lokānāṃ mama nāmnaiva śaṅkara || 72.38 || īśvara uvāca sthāpayasva paraṃ liṅgamājñayā mama pannaga | ityuktvāntarhito devo jagāma hyumayā saha || 72.39 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tatra tīrthe tu ye gatvā śuciprayatamānasāḥ | pañcamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ || 72.40 || arcayanti sadā pārtha nopasarpanti te yamam | dadhnā ca madhunā caiva ghṛtena kṣīrayogataḥ || 72.41 || snāpayanti virūpākṣamumādehārdhadhāriṇam | kāmāṅgadahanaṃ devamaghāsuraniṣūdanam || 72.42 || snāpyamānaṃ ca ye bhaktvā paśyanti parameśvaram | te yānti ca pare loke sarvapāpavivarjitaiḥ || 72.43 || śrāddhaṃ preteṣu ye pārtha cāṣṭamyāṃ pañcamīṣu ca | brāhmaṇaiśca sadā yogyairvedapāṭhakacintakaiḥ || 72.44 || svadāranirataiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ paradāravivarjitaiḥ | ṣaṭkarmanirataistāta śūdrapreṣaṇavarjitaiḥ || 72.45 || khañjāśca dardurāḥ ṣaṇḍhā vārddhuṣyāśca kṛṣīvalāḥ | bhinnavṛttikarāḥ putra niyojyā na kadācana || 72.46 || vṛṣalīmandire yasya mahiṣīṃ yastu pālayet | sa vipro dūratastyājyo vrate śrāddhe narādhipa || 72.47 || kāṇāṣṭuṃṭāśca maṇṭāśca vedapāṭhavivarjitāḥ | na te pūjyā dvijāḥ pārtha maṇināgeśvare śubhe || 72.48 || yadīcchedūrdhvagamanamātmanaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha | sarvāṅgarucirāṃ dhenuṃ yo dadyādagrajanmane || 72.49 || sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam | tataḥ svargāccyutaḥ so'pi jāyate vimale kule || 72.50 || ye paśyanti paraṃ bhaktyā maṇināgeśvaraṃ nṛpa | na teṣāṃ jāyate vaṃśe pannagānāṃ bhayaṃ nṛpa || 72.51 || pannagaḥ śaṅkate teṣāṃ maṇināgapradarśanāt | sauparṇarūpiṇaste vai dṛśyante nāgamaṇḍale || 72.52 || phalāni caiva dānānāṃ śṛṇuṣvātha nṛpottama | annaṃ saṃskārasaṃyuktaṃ ye dadante narottamāḥ || 72.53 || toyaṃ śayyāṃ tathā chatraṃ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ subhāṣiṇīm | pātre deyaṃ yato rājan yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 72.54 || surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi gandhavastrāṇi dāpayet | dīpaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ śubhraṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam || 72.55 || ye dadante paraṃ bhaktyā te vrajanti triviṣṭapam | maṇināge nṛpaśreṣṭha yacca dānaṃ pradīyate || 72.56 || tasya dānasya bhāvena svarge vāso bhaveddhruvam | pātakāni pralīyante āmapātre yathā jalam || 72.57 || narmadātoyasaṃsiddhaṃ bhojyaṃ vipre dadāti yaḥ | so'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ krīḍate daivataiḥ saha || 72.58 || tataḥ svargacyutānāṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmyaham | dīrghāyuṣo jīvaputrā dhanavantaḥ suśobhanāḥ || 72.59 || sarvavyādhivinirmuktāḥ sutabhṛtyaiḥ samanvitāḥ | tyāgino bhogasaṃyuktā dharmākhyānaratāḥ sadā || 72.60 || devadvijagurorbhaktāstīrthasevāparāyaṇāḥ | mātāpitṛvaśā nityaṃ drohakrodhavivarjitāḥ || 72.61 || ebhireva guṇairyuktā ye narāḥ pāṇḍunandana | satyaṃ te svargādāyātāḥ svarge vāsaṃ vrajanti te || 72.62 || sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ maṇināgaṃ nṛpottama | tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi || 72.63 || so'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate | na viṣaṃ kramate teṣāṃ vicaranti yathecchayā || 72.64 || bhādrapadyāṃ ca yatṣaṣṭhyāṃ puṇyaṃ sūryasya darśane | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ākhyānaśravaṇena tu || 72.65 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṇināgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.73>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha gopāreśvaramuttamam | godehānniḥsṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūmitale nṛpa || 73.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca godehānniḥsṛtaṃ kasmālliṅgaṃ pāpakṣayaṃkaram | dakṣiṇe narmadākūle maṇināgasamīpataḥ | saṃkṣepātkathyatāṃ vipra gopāreśvarasambhavam || 73.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kāmadhenustapastatra purā pārtha cakāra ha | dhyāyate parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 73.3 || tuṣṭastasyā jagannātha kapilāya maheśvaraḥ | niḥsṛto dehamadhyāttu acchedyaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 73.4 || tuṣṭo devi jaganmātaḥ kapile parameśvari | ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāttadvadāśu śubhānane || 73.5 || surabhyuvāca lokānāmupakārāya sṛṣṭāhaṃ parameṣṭhinā | lokakāryāṇi sarvāṇi sidhyanti matprasādataḥ || 73.6 || lokāḥ svargaṃ prayāsyanti matprasādena śaṅkara | tīrthe tvaṃ bhava me śambho lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 73.7 || tatheti bhagavānuktvā tīrthe tatrāvasanmudā | tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ vasudhātale | snānenaikena rājendra pāpasaṅghaṃ vyapohati || 73.8 || gopāreśvaragodānaṃ yastu bhaktyā ca kārayet | yogye dvijottame deyā yogyā dhenuḥ sakāñcanā || 73.9 || savatsā taruṇī śubhrā bahukṣīrā savastrakā | kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vā pradāpayet || 73.10 || sarveṣu caiva māseṣu kārttike ca viśeṣataḥ | dāpayetparayā bhaktyā dvije svādhyāyatatpare || 73.11 || vidhinā ca pradadyādyo vidhinā yastu gṛhṇate | tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau prekṣakaḥ puṇyabhājanam || 73.12 || piṇḍadānaṃ prakuryādyaḥ pretānāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | piṇḍenaikena rājendra pretā yānti parāṃ gatim || 73.13 || bhaktyā praṇāmaṃ rudrasya ye kurvanti dine dine | teṣāṃ pāpaṃ pralīyeta bhinnapātre jalaṃ yathā || 73.14 || tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanvṛṣabhaṃ ca samutsṛjet | pitaraścoddhṛtāstena śivaloke mahīyate || 73.15 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca vṛṣotsarge kṛte tāta phalaṃ yajjāyate nṛṇām | tatsarvaṃ kathayasvāśu prayatnena dvijottama || 73.16 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇe vṛṣe caiva tu yatphalam | tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva dharmanandana || 73.17 || kārttike caiva vaiśākhe pūrṇimāyāṃ narādhipa | rudrasya sannidhau bhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ || 73.18 || vṛṣasyaiva samutsargaṃ kārayetprīyatāṃ haraḥ | sāṃnidhye kārayetputra catasro vatsikāḥ śubhāḥ || 73.19 || dattvā tu vipramukhyāya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ | prīyatāṃ ca mahādevo brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ || 73.20 || vṛṣabhe romasaṃkhyā yā sarvāṅgeṣu narādhipa | tāvadvarṣapramāṇaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate || 73.21 || śivaloke vasitvā tu yadā martyeṣu jāyate | kule mahati sambhūtirdhanadhānyasamākule || 73.22 || nīrogo rūpavāṃścaiva vidyāḍhyaḥ satyavākśuciḥ | gopāreśvaramāhātmyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | godehānniḥsṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 73.23 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.74>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | sarvapāpaharaṃ martye nāmnā vai gautameśvaram || 74.1 || sthāpitaṃ gautamenaiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | svargasopānarūpaṃ tu tīrthaṃ puṃsāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 74.2 || tatra gaccha paraṃ bhaktyā yatra devo jagadguruḥ | pātakasya vināśārthaṃ svargavāsapradastathā || 74.3 || saubhāgyavarddhanaṃ tīrthaṃ jayadaṃ duḥkhanāśanam | piṇḍadānena caikena kulānāmuddharettrayam || 74.4 || yatkiṃciddīyate bhaktyā svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu | tatsarvaṃ śatasāhasramājñayā gautamasya hi || 74.5 || tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitam || 74.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamāvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gautameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.75>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | śaṅkhacūḍasya nāmnā vai prasiddhaṃ bhūmimaṇḍale || 75.1 || śaṅkhacūḍaḥ svayaṃ tatra saṃsthitaḥ pāṇḍunandana | vainateyabhayātpārtha sukhadanarmadātaṭe || 75.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | snāpayecchaṅkhacūḍaṃ tu kṣīrakṣaudreṇa sarpiṣā || 75.3 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāddevasyāgre narādhipa | dadhibhaktena sampūjya brāhmaṇāñchaṃsitavratān | gopradāne dvijendro'yaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 75.4 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ pārtha sarpadaṣṭaṃ pratarpayet | sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ śaṅkarasya vaco yathā || 75.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śaṅkhacūḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.76>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra pāreśvaramanuttamam | parāśaro mahātmā vai narmadāyāstaṭe śubhe || 76.1 || tapaścacāra vipulaṃ putrārthaṃ pāṇḍunandana | himavadduhitā tena gaurī nārāyaṇī nṛpa || 76.2 || toṣitā parayā bhaktyā narmadottarake taṭe | tasya tuṣṭā mahādevī śaṅkarārdhāṅgadhāriṇī || 76.3 || bhobho ṛṣivara śreṣṭha tuṣṭāhaṃ tava bhaktitaḥ | varaṃ yācaya me vipra parāśara mahāmate || 76.4 || parāśara uvāca parituṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama | dehi putraṃ bhagavati satyaśaucaguṇānvitam || 76.5 || vedābhyasanaśīlaṃ hi sarvaśāstraviśāradam | tīrthe cātra bhaveddevi sannidhānavareṇa tu || 76.6 || lokopakārahetośca sthīyatāṃ girinandini | parāśarābhidhānena narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 76.7 || śrīdevyuvāca evaṃ bhavatu te vipra tatraivāntaradhīyata | parāśaro mahātmā vai sthāpayāmāsa pārvatīm || 76.8 || śaṅkaraṃ sthāpayāmāsa surāsuranamaskṛtam | acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca devānāṃ tu durāsadam || 76.9 || parāśaro mahātmā vai kṛtārtho hyabhavannṛpa || 76.10 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | stryathavā puruṣo vāpi kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || 76.11 || māghe caitre'tha vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe nṛpanandana | māsi mārgaśire caiva śuklapakṣe tu sarvadā || 76.12 || tatra gatvā śubhe sthāne narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 76.13 || upoṣya parayā bhaktyā vratametatsamācaret | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpadānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 76.14 || gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tathā vādyaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ | prabhāte vimale prāpte dvijāḥ pūjyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ || 76.15 || sampūjya brāhmaṇān pārtha dhanadānahiraṇyataḥ | vastreṇa chatradānena śayyātāmbūlabhojanaiḥ || 76.16 || prīṇayennarmadātīre brāhmaṇāñchaṃsitavratān | śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha āmaiḥ pakvairjalena ca || 76.17 || strīṇāṃ caiva tu śūdrāṇāmāmaśrāddhaṃ praśasyate | āmaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 76.18 || vedoktena vidhānena dvijāḥ pūjyāḥ prayatnataḥ | hastamātraiḥ kuśaiścaiva tilaiścaivākṣatairnṛpa || 76.19 || viprā udaṅmukhāḥ kāryāḥ svayaṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | darbheṣu nikṣipedannamityuccārya dvijāgrataḥ || 76.20 || pretā yāntu pare loke tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | pāpaṃ me praśamaṃ yātu etu vṛddhiṃ śubhaṃ sadā || 76.21 || vṛddhiṃ yātu sadā vaṃśo jñātivargo dvijottama | evamuccārya viprāya dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 76.22 || gobhūtisahiraṇyādi cānnaṃ vastraṃ svaśaktitaḥ | dātavyaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha pāreśvaravarāśrame || 76.23 || ye śṛṇvanti paraṃ bhaktyā mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ || 76.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.77>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram | sevitaṃ ṛṣisaṅghaiśca bhīmavratadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 77.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | japedekākṣaraṃ mantramūrdhvabāhurdivākare || 77.2 || tasya janmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati | saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ gāyatryā naśyate dhruvam || 77.3 || daśabhirjanmabhirjātaṃ śatena tu purā kṛtam | sahasreṇa trijanmotthaṃ gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam || 77.4 || vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ vāpi jāpyaṃ japtaṃ nareśvara | tatkṣaṇāddahate sarvaṃ tṛṇaṃ tu jvalano yathā || 77.5 || na devabalamāśritya kadācitpāpamācaret | ajñānānnaśyate kṣipraṃ nottaraṃ tu kadācana || 77.6 || tatra tīrthe tu yo dānaṃ śaktimāśritya cācaret | tadakṣayyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate pāṇḍunandana || 77.7 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhīmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.78>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra naradeśvaramuttamam | tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu || 78.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca nāradena muniśreṣṭha kasmāttīrthaṃ vinirmitam | etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasanno yadi sattama || 78.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca parameṣṭhisutaḥ pārtha nārado munisattamaḥ | revāyāścottare kūle tapastena purā kṛtam || 78.3 || navanāḍīnirodhena kāṣṭhāvatyāṃ gatena ca | toṣitaḥ paśubhartā vai nāradena yudhiṣṭhira || 78.4 || īśvara uvāca tuṣṭo'haṃ tava viprendra yoginātha ayonija | varaṃ prārthaya me vatsa yaste manasi vartate || 78.5 || nārada uvāca tvatprasādena me śambho yogaścaiva prasidhyatu | acalā te bhavedbhaktiḥ sarvakālaṃ mamaiva tu || 78.6 || svecchācārī bhave deva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | trikālajño jagannātha gītajño'haṃ sadā bhave || 78.7 || dine dine yathā yuddhaṃ devadānavamānuṣaiḥ | pātāle martyaloke vā svarge vāpi maheśvara || 78.8 || paśyeyaṃ tvatprasādena bhavantaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā | tīrthaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 78.9 || īśvara uvāca evaṃ nārada sarvaṃ tu bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | cintitaṃ matprasādena sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 78.10 || svecchācāro bhavervatsa svarge pātālagocare | martye vā bhrama vai yoginna kenāpi nivāryase || 78.11 || sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrcchanāścaikaviṃśatiḥ | tānā ekonapañcāśatprasādānme tava dhruvam || 78.12 || mama priyaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ nṛtyagītaṃ bhaviṣyati | kaliṃ ca paśyase nityaṃ devadānavakinnaraiḥ || 78.13 || tvattīrthaṃ bhūtale puṇyaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyati | vedavedāṅgatattvajño hyaśeṣajñānakovidaḥ | ekastvamasi niḥsaṅgo matprasādena nārada || 78.14 || ityuktvāntardadhe devo nāradastatra śūlinam | sthāpayāmāsa rājendra sarvasattvopakārakam || 78.15 || pṛthivyāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu | tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha yo gacchedvijitendriyaḥ || 78.16 || māsi bhādrapade pārtha kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī | upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram || 78.17 || chatraṃ tatra pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe śubhalakṣaṇe | śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pradāpayet | te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ piṇḍadānaprabhāvataḥ || 78.18 || kapilā tatra dātavyā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata | ityuccārya dvije deyā yāntu te paramāṃ gatim || 78.19 || asya śrāddhasya bhāvena brāhmaṇasya prasādataḥ | narmadātoyabhāvena nyāyārjitadhanasya ca | teṣāṃ caiva prabhāvena pretā yāntu parāṃ gatim || 78.20 || ityuccārya dvije deyā dakṣiṇā ca svaśaktitaḥ | haviṣyānnaṃ viśālākṣa dvijānāṃ caiva dāpayet || 78.21 || dīpaṃ bhaktyā pradātavyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet | avāptaṃ tena vai sarvaṃ yaḥ karotīśvarālaye || 78.22 || sa yāti rudrasāṃnidhyamiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau | vidyādānena caikena akṣayāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || 78.23 || dhūrvahāstatra dātavyā bhūmiḥ sasyavatī nṛpa | citrabhānuṃ śubhairmantraiḥ prīṇayettatra bhaktitaḥ || 78.24 || ājyena suprabhūtena homadravyeṇa bhārata | ye yajanti sadā bhaktyā trikālaṃ nṛtyameva ca || 78.25 || tīrthe nāradanāmākhye revāyāścottare taṭe | citrabhānumukhā devāḥ sarvadevamaya ṛṣiḥ || 78.26 || ṛṣiṇā prīṇitāḥ sarve tasmātprītyo hutāśanaḥ | pūjite havyavāhe tu dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate || 78.27 || dhanena vipulā prītirjāyate pratijanmani | kulīnāśca suveṣāśca sarvakālaṃ dhanena tu || 78.28 || plavo nadīnāṃ patiraṅganānāṃ rājā ca sadvṛttarataḥ prajānām | dhanaṃ narāṇāmṛtavastarūṇāṃ gataṃ gataṃ yauvanamānayanti || 78.29 || dhanadatvaṃ dhaneśena tasmiṃstīrthe hyupārjitam | yamena ca yamatvaṃ hi indratvaṃ caiva vajriṇā || 78.30 || anyairapi mahīpālaiḥ pārthivatvamupārjitam | nāradeśvaramāhātmyāddhruvo niścalatāṃ gataḥ || 78.31 || sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu | pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ revāyāścottare taṭe | tadvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 78.32 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāradeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.79>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthadvayamanuttamam | dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 79.1 || dadhiskande naraḥ snātvā yastu dadyāddvije dadhi | upatiṣṭhettatastasya saptajanmani bhārata || 79.2 || na vyādhirna jarā tasya na śoko naiva matsaraḥ | daśacandraśataṃ yāvajjāyate vimale kule || 79.3 || madhuskande'pi madhunā miśritānyastilāndadet | nāsau vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyedvai janmasaptatim || 79.4 || madhunā saha sammiśraṃ piṇḍaṃ yastu pradāpayet | tasya pautraprapautrebhyo dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate || 79.5 || dadhibhiḥ saha saṃmiśraṃ piṇḍaṃ yastu pradāpayet | tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhivaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 79.6 || pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 79.7 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dadhiskandamadhuskandatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.80>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra nandikeśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahānandī tatte sarvaṃ vadāmyaham || 80.1 || revāyāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā purā nandī gaṇeśvaraḥ | tapastapañjayaṃ kurvaṃstīrthāttīrthaṃ jagāma ha || 80.2 || dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ yāvattyaktvā tu gacchati | tāvattuṣṭo mahādevo nandināthamuvāca ha || 80.3 || īśvara uvāca bhobhoḥ prasanno nandīśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam | tapasā tena tuṣṭo'haṃ tīrthayātrākṛtena te || 80.4 || nandīśvara uvāca na cāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na cāhaṃ kulasantatim | muktvā na kāmaye kāmaṃ tava pādāmbujātparam || 80.5 || kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyoniṃ gatasya vā | janma janmāntare'pyastu bhaktistvayi mamācalā || 80.6 || tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa | gṛhītvā taṃ kare siddhaṃ jagāma nilayaṃ haraḥ || 80.7 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā tryakṣaṃ prapūjayet | agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 80.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti cet | śivasyānucaro bhūtvā modate kalpamakṣayam || 80.9 || tataḥ kālena mahatā jāyate vimale kule | vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 80.10 || etatte kathitaṃ tāta tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | durlabhaṃ martyasaṃjñasya sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 80.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.81>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja varuṇeśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahādevo varuṇo nṛpasattama || 81.1 || piṇyākaśākaparṇaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ | ārādhya girijānāthaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ || 81.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 81.3 || kuṇḍikāṃ vardhanīṃ vāpi mahadvā jalabhājanam | annena sahitaṃ pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 81.4 || yatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ satre dvādaśavārṣike | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 81.5 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam | sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ toyamannaṃ ca nṛpasattama || 81.6 || tatratīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | varuṇasya pure vāso yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 81.7 || paścātpūrṇe tataḥ kāle martyaloke prajāyate | annadānaprado nityaṃ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ || 81.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe varuṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.82>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla vahnitīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddho mahātejāstapaḥ kṛtvā hutāśanaḥ || 82.1 || sarvabhakṣyaḥ kṛto yo'sau daṇḍake muninā purā | narmadātaṭamāśritya pūto jāto hutāśanaḥ || 82.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram | agnipraveśaṃ kurute sa gacchedagnisāmyatām || 82.3 || bhaktyā snātvā tu yastatra tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 82.4 || tasyaivānantaraṃ rājankauberaṃ tīrthamuttamam | kubero yatra saṃsiddho yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ purā || 82.5 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā samabhyarcya jagadgurum | umayā sahitaṃ bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 82.6 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyādviprāya kāṃcanam | nābhimātre jale tiṣṭhansa labhetārbudaṃ phalam || 82.7 || dadhiskande madhuskande nandīśe varuṇālaye | āgneye yatphalaṃ tāta snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt || 82.8 || te vandyā mānuṣe loke dhanyāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ | yaistu dṛṣṭaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ narmadātīrthapañcakam || 82.9 || te yānti bhāskare loke parame duḥkhanāśane | bhāskarādaiśvare loke caiśvarādanivartake || 82.10 || nīyate sa pare loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | tataḥ svargāccyuto martyo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 82.11 || sarvarogavinirmukto bhunakti sacarācaram | viṣṇuśca devatā yeṣāṃ narmadātīrthasevinām || 82.12 || akhaṇḍitapratāpāste jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī || 82.13 || grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā | revātīre vasennityaṃ revātoyaṃ sadā pibet || 82.14 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu somapānaṃ dine dine | gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi ca | kalpānte saṃkṣayaṃ yānti na mṛtā tena narmadā || 82.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dadhiskandādipañcatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.83>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | brahmahatyāharaṃ proktaṃ revātaṭasamāśrayam | hanūmatābhidhaṃ hyatra vidyate liṅgamuttamam || 83.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca hanūmanteśvaraṃ nāma kathaṃ jātaṃ vadasva me | brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ revādakṣiṇasaṃsthitam || 83.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa | guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā || 83.3 || tava snehātpravakṣyāmi pīḍito vārddhakena tu | pūrvaṃ jātaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayorapi || 83.4 || pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ putro viśravāstasya vai sutaḥ | rāvaṇastena saṃjāto daśāsyo brahmarākṣasaḥ || 83.5 || trailokyavijayī bhūtaḥ prasādācchūlinaḥ sa ca | gīrvāṇā vijitāḥ sarve rāmasya gṛhiṇī hṛtā || 83.6 || vāritaḥ kumbhakarṇena sītāṃ mocaya mocaya | vibhīṣaṇena vai pāpo mandodaryā punaḥpunaḥ || 83.7 || tvaṃ jitaḥ kārtavīryeṇa raiṇukeyena so'pi ca | sa rāmo rāmabhadreṇa tasya saṃkhye kathaṃ jayaḥ || 83.8 || rāvaṇa uvāca vānaraiśca narairṛkṣairvarāhaiśca nirāyudhaiḥ | devāsurasamūhaiśca na jito'haṃ kadācana || 83.9 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sugrīvahanumadbhyāṃ ca kumudenāṅgadena ca | etairanyaiḥ sahāyaiśca rāmacandreṇa vai jitaḥ || 83.10 || rāmacandreṇa paulastyo hataḥ saṃkhye mahābalaḥ | vanaṃ bhagnaṃ hatāḥ śūrāḥ prabhañjanasutena ca || 83.11 || rāvaṇasya suto janye hataścākṣakumārakaḥ | āyāmo rakṣasāṃ bhīmaḥ sampiṣṭo vānareṇa tu || 83.12 || evaṃ rāmāyaṇe vṛtte sītāmokṣe kṛte sati | ayodhyāṃ tu gate rāme hanumānsa mahākapiḥ || 83.13 || kailāsākhyaṃ gataḥ śailaṃ praṇāmāya maheśituḥ | tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyasau prokto nandinā vānarottamaḥ || 83.14 || brahmahatyāyutastvaṃ hi rākṣasānāṃ vadhena hi | bhairavasya sabhā nūnaṃ na draṣṭavyā tvayā kape || 83.15 || hanumānuvāca nandinātha haraṃ pṛccha pātakasyopaśāntidam | pāpo'haṃ plavago yasmātsaṃjātaḥ kāraṇāntarāt || 83.16 || nandyuvāca rudradehodbhavā kiṃ te na śrutā bhūtale sthitā | śravaṇājjanmajanitaṃ dviguṇaṃ kīrtanādvrajet || 83.17 || triṃśajjanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyedrevāvagāhanāt | tasmāttvaṃ narmadātīraṃ gatvā cara tapo mahat || 83.18 || gandharvāhasuto'pyevaṃ nandinoktaṃ niśamya ca | prayāto narmadātīramaurvyādakṣiṇasaṅgamam || 83.19 || dadhyau sudakṣiṇe devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ triśūlinam | jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ vyālayajñopavītinam || 83.20 || bhasmopacitasarvāṅgaṃ ḍamarusvaranāditam | umārddhāṅgaharaṃ śāntaṃ gonāthāsanasaṃsthitam || 83.21 || vatsarān subahūn yāvadupāsāṃcakra īśvaram | tāvattuṣṭo mahādeva ājagāma sahomayā || 83.22 || uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ meghagambhīranisvanām | sādhu sādhvityuvāceśaḥ kaṣṭaṃ vatsa tvayā kṛtam || 83.23 || na ca pūrvaṃ tvayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ rāvaṇasaṃkṣaye | svāmikāryaratastvaṃ hi siddho'si mama darśanāt || 83.24 || hanumāṃśca haraṃ dṛṣṭvā umārddhāṅgaharaṃ sthiram | sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato'vocajjaya śambho namo'stu te | jayāndhakavināśāya jaya gaṅgāśirodhara || 83.25 || evaṃ stuto mahādevo varado vākyamabravīt | varaṃ prārthaya me vatsa prāṇasambhavasambhava || 83.26 || śrīhanumānuvāca brahmarakṣovadhājjātā mama hatyā maheśvara | na pāpo'haṃ bhavedeva yuṣmatsambhāṣaṇe kṣaṇāt || 83.27 || īśvara uvāca narmadātīrthamāhātmyāddharmayogaprabhāvataḥ | manmūrtidarśanātputra niṣpāpo'si na saṃśayaḥ || 83.28 || anyaṃ ca te prayacchāmi varaṃ vānarapuṃgava | upakārāya lokānāṃ nāmāni tava mārute || 83.29 || hanūmānaṃ janisuto vāyuputro mahābalaḥ | rāmeṣṭaḥ phālguno gotraḥ piṅgākṣo'mitavikramaḥ || 83.30 || udadhikramaṇaśreṣṭho daśagrīvasya darpahā | lakṣmaṇaprāṇadātā ca sītāśokanivartanaḥ || 83.31 || ityuktvāntardadhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ | hanūmānīśvaraṃ tatra sthāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 83.32 || ātmayogabalenaiva brahmacaryaprabhāvataḥ | īśvarasya prasādena liṅgaṃ kāmapradaṃ hi tat | acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca vināśotpattivarjitam || 83.33 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca hanūmanteśvare putra pratyakṣapratyayaṃ śṛṇu | yadvṛttaṃ dvāparasyādau tretānte pāṇḍunandana || 83.34 || suparvā nāma bhūpālo babhūva vasudhātale | tasya rājñaḥ sadā saukhyaṃ narā dīrghāyuṣaḥ sadā || 83.35 || sa putradhanasaṃyuktaścauropadravavarjitaḥ | śatabāhurbabhūvāsya putro bhīmaparākramaḥ || 83.36 || āsakto'sau sadā kālaṃ pāpadharmairnareśvara | aṭāṭyata dharāṃ sarvāṃ parvatāṃśca vanāni ca || 83.37 || vadhārthaṃ mṛgayūthānāmāgato vindhyaparvatam | tarujātisamākīrṇe hastiyūthasamācite || 83.38 || siṃhacitrakaśobhāḍhye mṛgavārāhasaṃkule | krīḍitvā sa vane rājā narmadāmānataḥ kvacit || 83.39 || hanūmantavane prāptaḥ śatakrośapramāṇake | ciñciṇīvanaśobhāḍhye kadambatarusaṃkule || 83.40 || nityaṃ pālāśajambīraiḥ karaṃjakhadiraistathā | pāṭalairbadarairyuktaiḥ śamītindukaśobhitam || 83.41 || mṛgayūthaiḥ samāchannaśikhaṇḍisvaranāditam | pārāvatakasaṅghānāṃ samantātsvaraśobhitam || 83.42 || śaratkāle'ramadrājā bahule cāśvinasya saḥ | vanamadhyaṃ gato'drākṣīdbhramantaṃ piṅgaladvijam || 83.43 || pustikākarasaṃsthaṃ ca papraccha capalaṃ dvijam || 83.44 || śatabāhuruvāca ekākī tvaṃ vane kasmādbhramase pustikākaraḥ | itastato'pi sampaśyan kathayasva dvijottama || 83.45 || brāhmaṇa uvāca kānyakubjātsamāyātaḥ preṣito rājakanyayā | asthikṣepāya vai rājanhanūmanteśvare jale || 83.46 || rājovāca asthikṣepo jale kasmāddhanūmanteśvare dvija | kriyate kena kāryeṇa sāścaryaṃ kathyatāṃ mama || 83.47 || suparvaṇaḥ suto yānaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau praṇamya ca | kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā brāhmaṇāya nareśvara | samastaṃ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ svaṃ purātanam || 83.48 || brāhmaṇa uvāca śikhaṇḍī nāma rājāsti kanyakubje pratāpavān | aputro'sau mahīpālaḥ kanyā jātā manorathaiḥ || 83.49 || jātismarā sucārvaṅgī narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ | pitrā ca saikadā kanyā vivāhāya prajalpitā || 83.50 || anitye putri saṃsāre kanyādānaṃ dadāmyaham | śvaḥkṛtyamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam | na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ cāsya na cākṛtam || 83.51 || kanyovāca iccheyaṃ yatra kale hi tatra deyā tvayā pituḥ | putrīvākyādasau rājā vismito vākyamabravīt || 83.52 || śikhaṇḍyuvāca kathyatāṃ me mahābhāge sāścaryaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tvayā | piturvākyena sā bālottamā hyāgatāntikam || 83.53 || kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ hanūmanteśvare nṛpa | kalāpinī hyahaṃ tāta yutā bhartrāvasaṃ tadā || 83.54 || revaurvyāsaṅgamantisthā revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | hanūmantavane puṇye cikrīḍāhaṃ yadṛcchayā || 83.55 || bhartṛyuktā ca saṃsuptā rajanyāṃ sarale nage | āgatā lubdhakāstatra kṣudhārtā vanamuttamam || 83.56 || bhartṛyogayutā pāpairdṛṣṭāhaṃ vadhacintakaiḥ | pāśabandhaṃ samādāya baddhāhaṃ svāminā saha || 83.57 || grīvāṃ te moṭayāmāsuḥ picchāchoṭanakaṃ kṛtam | hutāśanamukhe taistu saha kāntena lubdhakaiḥ || 83.58 || paribharjyāvayormāṃsaṃ bhakṣayitvā yatheṣṭataḥ | suptāḥ svasthendriyā rātrau sā gatā śarvarī kṣayam || 83.59 || prabhāte māṃsaśeṣaṃ ca jambukairgṛdhraghātibhiḥ | maccharīrodbhavaṃ cāsthi snāyumāṃsena cāvṛtam || 83.60 || gṛhītaṃ ghātinaikena cākāśātpatitaṃ tadā | taṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pare pakṣiṇa āgatāḥ || 83.61 || dṛṣṭvā pakṣisamūhaṃ tu asthikhaṇḍaṃ vyasarjayat | vihagānāṃ samastānāṃ dhāvatāṃ caiva paśyatām || 83.62 || patitaṃ narmadātoye hanūmanteśvare nṛpa | madīyamasthikhaṇḍaṃ ca patitaṃ narmadājale || 83.63 || tasya tīrthasya puṇyena jātāhaṃ putrikā tava | bhūpakanyā tvahaṃ jātā pūrṇacandranibhānanā || 83.64 || jātismarā narendrasya saṃjātā bhavataḥ kule | tasmādvivāhaṃ necchāmi mama bhartā nṛpottama || 83.65 || viṣame vartate'dyāpi śakuntamṛgajātiṣu | tasyāsthiśeṣaṃ rājendra tasmiṃstīrthe bhaviṣyati || 83.66 || tatkṣepaṇārthaṃ vai tāta preṣayādya dvijottamam | etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kāraṇaṃ nṛpasattama || 83.67 || madbhartā viṣame sthāne śakuntamṛgajātiṣu | yadi preṣayase tāta kaṃcittvaṃ narmadātaṭe || 83.68 || tasyāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sthānaiścihnaiśca lakṣitam | śikhaṇḍināpyahaṃ tatra hyāhūto hyavanīpate || 83.69 || dāsyāmi viṃśatigrāmāngaccha tvaṃ narmadātaṭe | preṣaṇaṃ me pratijñātamalakṣmyā pīḍitena tu || 83.70 || kanyovāca gaccha tvaṃ narmadāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm | āgneyyāṃ somanāthasya hanūmanteśvaraḥ paraḥ || 83.71 || ardhakrośena revāyā vistīrṇo vaṭapādapaḥ | karaṃjaḥ kaṭahaścaiva sannidhāne vaṭasya ca || 83.72 || nyagrodhamūlasāṃnidhye sūkṣmānyasthīni drakṣyasi | samūhya tāni saṃgṛhya gaccha revāṃ dvijottama || 83.73 || āśvinasyāsite pakṣe tripurāristu vai tithau | snāpya triśūlinaṃ bhaktyā rātrau tvaṃ kuru jāgaram || 83.74 || kṣipeḥ prabhāte tāni tvaṃ nābhimātrajalasthitaḥ | ityuccārya dvijaśreṣṭha vimuktistasya jāyatām || 83.75 || kṣiptvāsthīni punaḥ snānaṃ kartavyaṃ tvaghanāśanam | evaṃ kṛte tu rājendra gatistasya bhaviṣyati || 83.76 || kathitaṃ kanyayā yacca tatsarvaṃ pustikākṛtam | āgato'haṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthe'tra duritāpahe || 83.77 || so'bhijñānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā nītvāsthīni nareśvara | pūrvoktena vidhānena prākṣipaṃ nārmadā masipuṣpavṛṣṭiḥ'śu sādhu sādhviti pāṇḍava | vimānaṃ ca tato divyamāgataṃ barhiṇastadā || 83.78 || divyarūpadharo bhūtvā gato nāke kalāpavān | evaṃ tu pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmanteśvare nṛpa || 83.79 || cakārānaśanaṃ vipraḥ śatabāhuśca bhūpatiḥ | śoṣayāmāsatustau svamīśvarārādhane ratau || 83.80 || dhyāyantau tasthaturdevaṃ śatabāhudvijottamau | māsārdhena mṛto rājā śatabāhurmahāmanāḥ || 83.81 || kiṅkaṇījālaśobhāḍhyaṃ vimānaṃ tatra cāgatam | sādhu sādhu nṛpaśreṣṭha vimānārohaṇaṃ kuru || 83.82 || śatabāhuruvāca nāyāmi svargamārgāgraṃ vipro yāvanna saṃsthitaḥ | upadeśaprado mahyaṃ gururūpī dvijottamaḥ || 83.83 || apsarasa ūcuḥ | lobhāvṛto hyayaṃ vipro lobhātpāpasya saṃgrahaḥ | hanūmanteśvare rājanye mṛtāḥ sattvamāsthitāḥ || 83.84 || te yānti śāṃkare loke sarvapāpakṣayaṃkare | naiva pāpakṣayaścāsya brāhmaṇasya nareśvara || 83.85 || gṛhaṃ ca gṛhiṇī citte brāhmaṇasya pravartate | śatabāhustato vipramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ || 83.86 || tyaja mūlamanarthasya lobhamenaṃ dvijottama | ityuktvā svaryayau rājā svargakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ || 83.87 || dinaiḥ kaiścidgato vipraḥ svargaṃ vaitālikairvṛtaḥ | barhī ca kāśīrājasya putrastīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 83.88 || ātmānaṃ kanyayā dattaṃ pūrvajanma vyacintayan | sā ca taṃ prauḍhamālokya piturājñāmavāpya ca | svayaṃvare svabhartāraṃ lebhe sādhvī nṛpātmajam || 83.89 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca etadvṛttāntamabhavattasmiṃstīrthe nṛpottama | etasmātkāraṇānmedhyaṃ tīrthametatsadā nṛpa || 83.90 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ nareśvara | viśeṣāccāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm || 83.91 || snāpayedīśvaraṃ bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā | dadhnā ca khaṇḍayuktena kuśatoyena vai punaḥ || 83.92 || śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayecca maheśvaram | tataḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca bilvapatraiśca pūjayet || 83.93 || mucakundena kadena jātīkāśakuśodbhavaiḥ | unmattamunipuṣpaughaiḥ puṣpaistatkālasambhavaiḥ || 83.94 || arcayetparayā bhaktyā hanūmanteśvaraṃ śivam | ghṛtena dāpayeddīpaṃ tailena tadabhāvataḥ || 83.95 || śrāddhaṃ ca kārayettatra brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaiḥ kulīnairgṛhapālakaiḥ || 83.96 || tarpayedbrāhmaṇān bhaktyā vasanānnahiraṇyataḥ | narakasthā divaṃ yāntu procyeti praṇameddvijān || 83.97 || patitān varjayedviprān vṛṣalī yasya gehinī | svavṛṣaṃ cāparityajya vṛṣairanyairvṛṣāyate || 83.98 || vṛṣalīṃ tāṃ vidurdevā na śūdrī vṛṣalī bhavet | brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam || 83.99 || suvarṇaharaṇanyāsamitradrohodbhavaṃ tathā | naśyate pātakaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 83.100 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca vākpralāpena bho vatsa bahunoktena kiṃ mayā | sarvapātakasaṃyukto dadyāddānaṃ dvijanmane || 83.101 || godānaṃ ca prakartavyamasmiṃstīrthe viśeṣataḥ | godānaṃ hi yataḥ pārtha sarvadānādhikaṃ smṛtam || 83.102 || sarvadevamayā gāvaḥ sarve devāstadātmakāḥ | śṛṅgāgreṣu mahīpāla śakro vasati nityaśaḥ || 83.103 || uraḥ skandaḥ śiro brahmā lalāṭe vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | candrārkau locane devau jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī || 83.104 || marudgaṇāḥ sadā sādhyā yasyā dantā nareśvara | huṅkāre caturo vedān vidyātsāṅgapadakramān || 83.105 || ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu hyasaṃkhyātāstapasvinaḥ | daṇḍahasto mahākāyaḥ kṛṣṇo mahiṣavāhanaḥ || 83.106 || yamaḥ pṛṣṭhasthito nityaṃ śubhāśubhaparīkṣakaḥ | catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ puṇyāḥ kṣīradhārāḥ staneṣu ca || 83.107 || viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṅgā darśanātpāpanāśanī | prasrāve saṃsthitā yasmāttasmādvandyā sadā budhaiḥ || 83.108 || lakṣmīśca gomaye nityaṃ pavitrā sarvamaṅgalā | gomayālepanaṃ tasmātkartavyaṃ pāṇḍunandana || 83.109 || gandharvāpsaraso nāgāḥ khurāgreṣu vyavasthitāḥ | pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhārata | tāni sarvāṇi jānīyādgaurgavyaṃ tena pāvanam || 83.110 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca sarvadevamayī dhenurgīrvāṇādyairalaṃkṛtā | etatkathaya me tāta kasmādgoṣu samāśritāḥ || 83.111 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sarvadevamayo viṣṇurgāvo viṣṇuśarīrajāḥ | devāstadubhayāttasmātkalpitā vividhā janaiḥ || 83.112 || śvetā vā kapilā vāpi kṣīriṇī pāṇḍunandana | savatsā ca suśīlā ca sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitā || 83.113 || kāṃsyadohanikā deyā svarṇaśṛṅgī subhūṣitā | hanūmanteśvarasyāgre bhaktyā viprāya dāpayet || 83.114 || niyamasthena sā deyā svargamānantyamicchatā | asamarthāya ye dadyurviṣṇuloke prayānti te || 83.115 || asau loke cyuto rājanbhūtale dvijamandire | kuśalo jāyate putro guṇavidyādhanarddhimān || 83.116 || sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ hanūmanteśvaraṃ nṛpa | śṛṇvanvimucyate pāpādvarṇasaṃkarasaṃbhavāt || 83.117 || dūrasthaścintayan paśyanmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 83.118 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe hanūmanteśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.84>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | kailāse pṛcchate bhaktyā ṣaṇmukhāya śivoditam || 84.1 || īśvara uvāca pūrvaṃ tretāyuge skanda hato rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ | caturdaśa tadā koṭyo nihatā brahmarakṣasām || 84.2 || hateṣu teṣu vai tatra rakṣaṇāya divaukasām | mahānandastadā jātastriṣu lokeṣu putraka || 84.3 || tataḥ sītāṃ samāsādya samaṃ vānarapuṃgavaiḥ | rāmo'pyayodhyāmāyāto bharatena kṛtotsavaḥ | tasmai samarpayāmāsa sa rājyaṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ || 84.4 || tasminpraśāsati tato rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam | kṛtakāryo'tha hanumānkailāsamagātpurā || 84.5 || tato nandī pratīhāro rudrāṃśamapi taṃ kapim | na ca saṃgamayāmāsa rudreṇāghaughahāriṇā || 84.6 || tena pṛṣṭastadā nandī kiṃ mayā pātakaṃ kṛtam | yena rudravapuḥ puṇyaṃ na paśyāmyambikānvitam || 84.7 || nandyuvāca tvayāvataraṇaṃ cakre kapīndrāmarahetunā | tathāpi hi kṛtaṃ pāpamupabhogena śāmyati || 84.8 || hanumānuvāca kiṃ mayākāri tatpāpaṃ nandindevārthakāriṇā | rākṣasāśca hatā duṣṭā viprayajñāṅgaghātinaḥ || 84.9 || tatastadālāpakutūhalī haro nijāṃśabhājaṃ kapimugratejasam | uvāca dvārāntaradattadṛṣṭiḥ puraḥsthitaṃ prekṣya kapīśvaraṃ punaḥ || 84.10 || īśvara uvāca gaṅgā gayā kape revā yamunā ca sarasvatī | sarvapāpaharā nadyastāsu snānaṃ samācara || 84.11 || narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | somanāthasamīpasthaṃ tatra tvaṃ gaccha vānara || 84.12 || tatra snātvā mahāpāpaṃ gamiṣyati mamājñayā | utpatya vegāddhanumāñchrīrevādakṣiṇe taṭe || 84.13 || jagāma sumahānādastapaścakre suduṣkaram | tasya vai tapyamānasya rakṣovadhakṛtaṃ tamaḥ || 84.14 || vilīnaṃ pārtha kālena kiyateśaprasādataḥ | tato devaiḥ samaṃ devastattīrthamagamaddharaḥ || 84.15 || kapimāliṅgayāmāsa varaṃ tasmai pradattavān | adyaprabhṛti te tīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 84.16 || kapitīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ tasthau tatra svayaṃ haraḥ | hanūmanteśvaro nāmnā sarvahatyāharastadā || 84.17 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā liṅgaṃ prapūjayet | sarvapāpāni naśyanti harasya vacanaṃ yathā || 84.18 || tatrāsthīni vilīyante piṇḍadāne'kṣayā gatiḥ | yatkiṃciddīyate tatra taddhi koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 84.19 || hanumānapyayodhyāyāṃ rāmaṃ draṣṭumathāgamat | cakāra kuśalapraśnaṃ svasvarūpaṃ nyavedayat || 84.20 || śrīrāma uvāca kurvato devakāryaṃ te mama kāryaṃ ca kurvataḥ | tato'hamapi pāpīyāṃstapastapsyāmyasaṃśayam || 84.21 || tatraiva dakṣiṇe kūle revāyāḥ pāpahāriṇi | caturviṃśativarṣāṇi tapastepe'tha rāghavaḥ || 84.22 || jyotiṣmatīpurīsaṃsthaḥ śrīrevāsnānamācaran | tasya śuśrūṣaṇaṃ cakre lakṣmaṇo'pi tadājñayā || 84.23 || sthāpayāmāsaturliṅge tau tadā rāmalakṣmaṇau | prabhāvātsatyatapaso revātīre mahāmatī | niṣpāpatāṃ tadā vīrau jagmatū rāmalakṣmaṇau || 84.24 || tatastadā devapurogamo haro gato hi vai puṇyamunīśvaraiḥ saha | āgatya tīrthaṃ ca varaṃ dadau tadā nijāṃ kalāṃ tatra vimucya tīrthe || 84.25 || munibhiḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣiptaṃ kumbhodakaṃ bhuvi | ekasthaṃ liṅganāmātha kalākumbhastathābhavat || 84.26 || kumbheśvara iti khyātastadā devagaṇārcitaḥ | rāmo'pi pūjayāmāsa talliṅgaṃ devasevivatam || 84.27 || tato varaṃ dadau devo rāmakīrtyabhivṛddhaye | caturviṃśatime varṣe rāmo niṣpāpatāṃ gataḥ || 84.28 || yadā kanyāgataḥ paṅgurguruṇā sahito bhavet | tadeva devayātreyamiti devā jagurmudā || 84.29 || yathā godāvarītīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet | tathātra revāsnānena liṅgānāṃ darśanairnḥṇām || 84.30 || kariṣyantyatra ye śrāddhaṃ pitḥṇāṃ narmadātaṭe | kumbheśvarasamīpasthāstatphalaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha || 84.31 || yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ śarīre sarvadehinām | tāvadvarṣapramāṇena pitḥṇāmakṣayā gatiḥ || 84.32 || pṛthivyāṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvatīrthāni yāni tu | labhante tatphalaṃ martyā liṅgatrayavilokanāt || 84.33 || aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt | sarogo mucyate rogānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 84.34 || siṃharāśiṃ gate jīve yatsyādgodāvarīphalam | taddvādaśaguṇaṃ skanda kumbheśvarasamīpataḥ || 84.35 || ye jānanti na paśyanti kumbhaśambhumumāpatim | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || 84.36 || yathā godāvarīyātrā kartavyā muniśāsanāt | caturviṃśatime varṣe tatheyaṃ devabhāṣitam || 84.37 || yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvadvai divi tārakaḥ | tāvattadakṣayaṃ dānaṃ revākumbheśvarāntike || 84.38 || mahādānāni deyāni tatra laukairvicakṣaṇaiḥ | godānamatra śaṃsanti sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā || 84.39 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ | snānena kiṃ punaḥ skanda brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 84.40 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryādyudhiṣṭhira | ekottaraṃ kulaśatamuddharecchivaśāsanāt || 84.41 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni cāsamudrasarāṃsi ca | śivaliṅgārcanasyeha kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 84.42 || evaṃ devā varaṃ dattvā harīśvarapurogamāḥ | svasthānamagaman pūrvaṃ muktvā tannāma cottamam || 84.43 || tīrthasyāsya varaṃ dattvā sa rāmo lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ | ayodhyāṃ praviveśāsau niṣpāpo narmadājalāt || 84.44 || sauvarṇīṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā sītāṃ yajñaṃ cakāra saḥ | anumantrya munīṃllokāndevatāśca nijaṃ kulam || 84.45 || purā tretāyuge jātaṃ tattīrthaṃ skandanāmakam | niyamena tato lokaiḥ kartavyaṃ liṅgadarśanam || 84.46 || tāvatpāpāni deheṣu mahāpātakajānyapi | yāvanna prekṣate jantustattīrthaṃ devasevitam || 84.47 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | jyotiṣmatīpurīsaṃsthaṃ ye drakṣyanti haraṃ param || 84.48 || tasmānmohaṃ parityajya janairgantavyamādarāt | tīrthāśeṣaphalāvāptyai tīrthaṃ kumbheśvarāhvayam || 84.49 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śrutveti śambhuvacasā sa ṣaḍānano'tha natvā pituḥ padayugāmbujamādareṇa | samprāpya dakṣiṇataṭaṃ giriśasravantyāḥ kīśāgryarāmakalaśākhyaśivān dadarśa || 84.50 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapitīrtharāmeśvaralakṣmaṇeśvarakumbheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.85>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra narmadāyāḥ purātanam | brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāṇasyā samaṃ hi tat || 85.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryaṃ kathyatāṃ brahmanyadvṛttaṃ narmadātaṭe | vārāṇasyā samaṃ kasmādetatkathaya me prabho || 85.2 || nimagno duḥkhasaṃsāre hṛtarājyo dvijottama | yuṣmadvāṇījalasnāto nirduḥkhaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ || 85.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa | pṛṣṭo'smi durlabhaṃ tīrthaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param || 85.4 || ādau pitāmahastāvatsamastajagataḥ prabhuḥ | manasā tasya saṃjātā daśaiva ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ || 85.5 || marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum | pracetasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradameva ca || 85.6 || jajñe prācetasaṃ dakṣaṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ | dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitāḥ kila || 85.7 || dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa | tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave || 85.8 || rohiṇī nāma yā tāsāmabhīṣṭā sābhavadvidhoḥ | śeṣāsu karuṇāṃ kṛtvā śapto dakṣeṇa candramāḥ || 85.9 || kṣayarogyabhavaccandro dakṣasyāyaṃ prajāpateḥ | sa ca śāpaprabhāveṇa nistejāḥ śarvarīpatiḥ || 85.10 || gataḥ pitāmahaṃ somo vepamāno'mṛtāṃśumān | padmayone namastubhyaṃ vedagarbha namo'stu te | śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prasanno'smi pāhi māṃ kamalāsana || 85.11 || brahmovāca nistejāḥ śarvarīnātha kalāhīnaśca dṛśyase | udvignamānasastāta saṃjātaḥ kena hetunā || 85.12 || soma uvāca dakṣaśāpena me brahmannistejastvaṃ jagatpate | nirhāraścāsya śāpasya kathyatāṃ me pitāmaha || 85.13 || brahmovāca sarvatra sulabhā revā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā | oṅkāre'tha bhṛgukṣetre tathā caivaurvasaṃgame || 85.14 || tatra gaccha kṣapānātha yatra revāntaraṃ taṭam | tvarito'sau gatastatra yatra revaurvisaṃgamaḥ || 85.15 || kāṣṭhāvasthaḥ sthitaḥ somo dadhyau tripuravairiṇam | yāvadvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tāvattuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 85.16 || pratyakṣaḥ somarājasya vṛṣāsana umāpatiḥ | sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyoccairjaya śambho namo'stu te || 85.17 || jaya śaṅkara pāpaharāya namo jaya īśvara te jagadīśa namaḥ | jaya vāsukibhūṣaṇadhāra namo jaya śūlakapāladharāya namaḥ || 85.18 || jaya andhakadehavināśa namo jaya dānavavṛndavadhāya namaḥ | jaya niṣkalarūpa sakalāya namo jaya kāla kāmadahāya namaḥ || 85.19 || jaya mecakakaṇṭhadharāya namo jaya sūkṣmanirañjanaśabda namaḥ | jaya ādiranādirananta namo jaya śaṅkara kiṃkaramīśa bhaja || 85.20 || evaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ somarājena pāṇḍava | tuṣṭastasya nṛpaśreṣṭha śivayā śaṅkaro'bravīt || 85.21 || īśvara uvāca varaṃ prārthaya me bhadra yatte manasi vartate | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā tava || 85.22 || soma uvāca dakṣaśāpena dagdho'haṃ kṣīṇasattvo maheśvara | śāpasyopaśamaṃ deva kuru śarma mama prabho || 85.23 || īśvara uvāca tava bhaktigṛhīto'hamumayā saha toṣitaḥ | niṣpāpaḥ somanāthastvaṃ saṃjātastīrthasevanāt || 85.24 || ityūce devadeveśaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvendunā tataḥ | sthāpitaṃ paramaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmadaṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi | sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ tattu brahmahatyāvināśanam || 85.25 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca somanāthaprabhāvaṃ me saṃkṣepātkathaya prabho | duḥkhārṇavanimagnānāṃ trātā prāpto dvijottama || 85.26 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu tīrthaprabhāvaṃ te saṃkṣepātkathayāmyaham | yadvṛttamuttare kūle revāyā urisaṃgame || 85.27 || śambaro nāma rājābhūttasya putrastrilocanaḥ | trilocanasutaḥ kaṇvaḥ sa pāparddhiparo'bhavat || 85.28 || vane nityaṃ bhramanso'tha mṛgayūthaṃ dadarśa ha | mṛgayūthaṃ hataṃ tattu trilocanasutena ca || 85.29 || mṛgarūpī dvijo madhye carate nirjane vane | sa hatastena saṅgena kaṇvena munisattama || 85.30 || brahmahatyānvitaḥ kaṇvo nistejā vyacaranmahīm | vyacaraṃścaiva samprāpto narmadāmurisaṃgame || 85.31 || kiṃśukāśokabahale jambīrapanasākule | kadambapāṭalākīrṇe bilvanāraṅgaśobhite || 85.32 || ciñciṇīcampakopete hyagastitaruchādite | prabhūtabhūtasaṃyuktaṃ vanaṃ sarvatra śobhitam || 85.33 || citrakairmṛgamārjārairhiṃsraiḥ śambaraśūkaraiḥ | śaśairgavayasaṃyuktaiḥ śikhaṇḍikharamaṇḍitam || 85.34 || praviṣṭastu vane kaṇvastṛṣārtaḥ śramapīḍitaḥ | snāto revājale puṇye saṅgame pāpanāśane || 85.35 || arcitaḥ parayā bhaktyā somanātho yudhiṣṭhira | papau suvimalaṃ toyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 85.36 || phalāni ca vicitrāṇi cakhāda saha kiṃkaraiḥ | suptaḥ pādapacchāyāyāṃ śrānto mṛgavadhena ca || 85.37 || tāvattīrthavaraṃ vipraḥ snānārthaṃ saṅgamaṃ gataḥ | mārgago brāhmaṇo harṣodyuktastadgatamānasaḥ || 85.38 || abalā tamuvācedaṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha dvijottama | trasto nirīkṣate yāvaddiśaḥ sarvā nareśvara || 85.39 || tāvadvṛkṣasamārūḍhāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarāvṛtām | raktamālyāṃ tadā bālāṃ raktacandanacarcitām | raktābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ pāśahastāṃ dadarśa ha || 85.40 || stryuvāca saṃdeśaṃ śrūyatāṃ vipra yadi gacchasi saṅgame | madbhartā tiṣṭhate tatra śīghrameva visarjaya || 85.41 || ekākinī ca te bhāryā tiṣṭhate vanamadhyagā | ityākarṇya gato vipraḥ saṅgamaṃ suradurlabhe || 85.42 || vṛkṣacchāyānvitaḥ kaṇvo brāhmaṇenāvalokitaḥ | uvāca taṃ prati tadā vacanaṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ || 85.43 || brāhmaṇa uvāca vanāntare mayā dṛṣṭā bālā kamalalocanā | raktāmbaradharā tanvī raktacandanacarcitā || 85.44 || raktamālyā suśobhāḍhyā pāśahastā mṛgekṣaṇā | vṛkṣārūḍhāvadadvākyaṃ madbhartā preṣyatāmiti || 85.45 || kaṇva uvāca kasminsthāne tu viprendra vidyate mṛgalocanā | kasya sā kena kāryeṇa sarvametadvadāśu me || 85.46 || brāhmaṇa uvāca saṅgamādardhakrośe sā udyānānte hi vidyate | vacanādbrahmaṇasyaiṣā na jñātā pārthivena tu || 85.47 || tadā sa kaṇvabhūpālaḥ svakaṃ dūtaṃ samādiśat | kaṇva uvāca gaccha tvaṃ pṛcchatāṃ tāṃ kvāgatā kvaca gamiṣyasi | preṣitastvarito dūto gato nārīsamīpataḥ || 85.48 || vṛkṣasthāṃ dadṛśo bālāmuvāca nṛpasattama | mannāthaḥ pṛcchati tvāṃ tu kāsi tvaṃ kva gamiṣyasi || 85.49 || kanyovāca gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām | iha pracchanna pāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ || 85.50 || brahmahatyā ca saṃjātā mṛgarūpadharadvijāt | mayā yukto'pi te rājā muktastīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 85.51 || ardhakrośāntarānmadhye brahmahatyā na saṃviśet | somanāthaprabhāvo'yaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ samaḥ smṛtaḥ || 85.52 || gaccha tvaṃ preṣyatāṃ rājā śīghramatra na saṃśayaḥ | gato bhṛtyastataḥ śīghraṃ vepamānaḥ suvihvalaḥ || 85.53 || samastaṃ kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ hi purātanam | tasya vākyādasau rājā patito dharaṇītale || 85.54 || bhṛtya uvāca kasmāttvaṃ śocase nātha pūrvopāttaṃ śubhāśubham | ityākarṇya vacastasya rājā vacanamabravīt || 85.55 || prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi somanāthasamīpataḥ | śīghramānīyatāṃ vahnirindhanāni bahūni ca || 85.56 || ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇātsarvaṃ bhṛtyaistadvaśavartibhiḥ | snānaṃ kṛtvā śubhe toye saṅgame pāpanāśane || 85.57 || arcitaḥ parayā bhaktyā somanātho mahībhṛtā | triḥpradakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā jvalantaṃ jātavedasam || 85.58 || praviṣṭaḥ kaṇvarājāsau hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam | pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam || 85.59 || śriyā yuktaṃ suparṇasthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam | surārisūdanaṃ dadhyau sugatirme bhavatviti || 85.60 || papāta puṣpavṛṣṭistu sādhu sādhu nṛpātmaja | āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣya ca parasparam || 85.61 || mṛtaṃ taiḥ pāvake bhṛtyairhṛdi dhyātvā gadādharam | vimānasthāstataḥ sarve saṃjātāḥ pāṇḍunandana || 85.62 || niṣpāpāste divaṃ yātāḥ somanāthaprabhāvataḥ | brāhmaṇe saṅgame tatra dhyāyamāne vṛṣadhvajam || 85.63 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca somanāthaprabhāvo'yaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vidhim | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ raverdine || 85.64 || viśeṣācchuklapakṣe cetsūryavāreṇa saptamī | upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram || 85.65 || pañcāmṛtena gavyena snāpayetparameśvaram | śrīkhaṇḍena tato guṇṭhya puṣpadhūpādikaṃ dadet || 85.66 || ghṛtena bodhayeddīpaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet | somavāre tathāṣṭamyāṃ prabhāte pūjayeddvijān || 85.67 || jitakrodhānātmavataḥ paranindāvivarjitān | sarvāṅgarucirāñchastān svadāraparipālakān || 85.68 || gāyatrīpāṭhamātrāṃśca vikarmaviratān sadā | punarbhūvṛṣalīśūdrī careyuryasya mandire || 85.69 || dūrato'sau dvijastyājya ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā | hīnāṅgānatiriktāṅgān yeṣāṃ pūrvāparaṃ na hi || 85.70 || vrate śrāddhe tathā dāne dūratastān vivarjayet | āyasī taruṇī tulyā dvijāḥ svādhyāyavarjitāḥ || 85.71 || ātmānaṃ saha yājyena pātayanti na saṃśayaḥ | śālmalīnāvatulyāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭkarmaniratā dvijāḥ || 85.72 || dātāraṃ ca tathātmānaṃ tārayanti taranti ca | śrāddhaṃ someśvare pārtha yaḥ kuryādgatamatsaraḥ || 85.73 || pretāstasya hi suprītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam | annaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca yo dadyādagrajanmane || 85.74 || sa yāti śāṅkare loka iti me satyabhāṣitam | hayaṃ yo yacchate tatra sampūrṇaṃ taruṇaṃ sitam || 85.75 || raktaṃ vā pītavarṇaṃ vā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam | kuṅkumena viliptāṅgāvagrajanmahayāvapi || 85.76 || sragdāmabhūṣitau kāryau sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitau | aṅghriḥ pradīyatāṃ skandhe madīye hayamāruha || 85.77 || ārūḍhe brāhmaṇe brūyādbhāskaraḥ prīyatāmiti | sa yāti śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ || 85.78 || uparāge tu somasya tīrthaṃ gatvā jitendriyaḥ | satyalokāccyutaścāpi rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 85.79 || tasya vāsaḥ sadā rājanna naśyati kadācana | dīrghāyurjāyate putro bhāryā ca vaśavartinī || 85.80 || jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ | sopavāso jitakrodho dhenuṃ dadyāddvijanmane || 85.81 || savatsāṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktāṃ śvetavastrāvalokitām | śabalāṃ pītavarṇāṃ ca dhūmrāṃ vā nīlakarburām || 85.82 || kapilāṃ vā savatsāṃ ca ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām | rūpyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ nareśvara || 85.83 || śvetayā vardhate vaṃśo raktā saubhāgyavardhinī | śabalā pītavarṇā ca duḥkhaghnyau saṃprakīrtite || 85.84 || kapilā nāśayetpāpaṃ saptajanmasamudbhavam | satyalokamavāpnoti gopradāyī nareśvara || 85.85 || pakṣānte'tha vyatīpāte vai dhṛtau ravisaṃkrame | dinakṣaye gajacchāyāṃ grahaṇe bhāskarasya ca || 85.86 || ye vrajanti mahātmānaḥ saṅgame suradurlabhe | mṛdāvaguṇṭhayitvā tu cātmānaṃ saṅgame viśet || 85.87 || hṛdayāntarjale jāpyā prāṇāyāmo'thavā nṛpa | gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī caiva saurī śaivī yadṛcchayā | te'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyanta ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 85.88 || jagatīṃ somanāthasya yastu kuryātpradakṣiṇām | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || 85.89 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam | bhrūṇahā svarṇahartā ca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 85.90 || tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti jitendriyaḥ | vyādhito mucyate rogī cārogī sukhamāpnuyāt || 85.91 || yatte saṃdahyate cetaḥ śṛṇu tanme yudhiṣṭhira | naikāpi nṛpa loke'smin bhrūṇahatyā sudustyajā || 85.92 || kimu ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ pārtha prāpa yāḥ kṣaṇadākaraḥ | so'pi tīrthamidaṃ prāpya tapastaptvā suduścaram || 85.93 || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śītaraśmirabhūtsukhī | śrūyate nṛpa paurāṇī gāthā gītā maharṣibhiḥ || 85.94 || liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ hyekaṃ daśabhrūṇahanaṃ bhavet | ato liṅgatrayaṃ somaḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhārata || 85.95 || revaurisaṃgame hyādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhṛgukacchake | tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya prabhāse tu tṛtīyakam || 85.96 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ saṃśuddhikṛnnṛṇām || 85.97 || putrārthī labhate putrānniṣkāmaḥ svargamāpnuyāt | mucyate sarvapāpebhyastīrthaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ nṛpa || 85.98 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ somanāthasya yatphalam | śrutvā putramavāpnoti snātvā cāṣṭau na saṃśayaḥ || 85.99 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.86>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja piṅgalāvartamuttamam | saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe | havyavāhena rājendra sthāpitaḥ piṅgaleśvaraḥ || 86.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca havyavāhena bhagavannīśvaraḥ sthāpitaḥ katham | etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādādvaktumarhasi || 86.2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śambhunā retasā rājaṃstarpito havyavāhanaḥ | prāptasaukhyena raudreṇa gauryākrīḍanacetasā || 86.3 || havyavāhamukhe kṣiptaṃ rudreṇāmitatejasā | rudrasya retasā dagdhastīrthayātrākṛtādaraḥ || 86.4 || sāgarāṃśca nadīrgatvā kramādrevāṃ samāgataḥ | cacāra parayā bhaktyā dhyānamugraṃ hutāśanaḥ || 86.5 || vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ sāgraṃ yāvattepe hutāśanaḥ | tāvattuṣṭo mahādevo varado jātavedasaḥ | saṃnidhau samupetyātha vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 86.6 || īśvara uvāca varaṃ vṛṇīṣva havyāśa yaste manasi vartate || 86.7 || vahniruvāca namaste sarvalokeśa ugramūrte namo'stu te | retasā tava saṃdagdhaḥ kuṣṭhī jāto maheśvara | kṛpāṃ kuru mahādeva mama rogaṃ vināśaya || 86.8 || īśvara uvāca havyavāha bhavārogo matprasādācca satvaram | atra tīrthe kṛtasnānaḥ svarūpaṃ pratipatsyase || 86.9 || ityuktvā ca mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata | anantaraṃ havyavāhaḥ sasnau revājale tvaran || 86.10 || tadaiva roganirmukto'bhavaddivyasvarūpavān | sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ sa vahniḥ piṅgaleśvaram || 86.11 || nāmnā saṃpūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva stutibhirmudā | tato jagāma deśaṃ svaṃ devānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ || 86.12 || havyavāhena bhūpaivaṃ sthāpitaḥ piṅgaleśvaraḥ | jitakrodho hi yastatra upavāsaṃ samācaret || 86.13 || atirāntraphalaṃ tasya ante rudratvamāpnuyāt | guṇānvitāya viprāya kapilāṃ tatra bhārata || 86.14 || alaṃkṛtya savatsāṃ ca śaktyālaṅkārabhūṣitām | yaḥ prayacchati rājendra sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || 86.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe piṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.87>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | sthāpitaṃ munisaṅghairyadbrahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ || 87.1 || ṛṇamocanamityākhyaṃ revātaṭasamāśritam | ṣaṇmāsaṃ manujo bhaktyā tarpayan pitṛdevatāḥ || 87.2 || devaiḥ pitṛmanuṣyaiśca ṛṇamātmakṛtaṃ ca yat | mucyate tatkṣaṇānmartyaḥ snāto vai narmadājale || 87.3 || pratyakṣaṃ duritaṃ tatra dṛśyate phalarūpataḥ | tatra tīrthe tu yo rājannekacitto jitendriyaḥ || 87.4 || snātvā dānaṃ ca vai dadyādarcayedgirijāpatim | ṛṇatrayavinirmukto nāke dīpyati devavat || 87.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ṛṇatrayamocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.88>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha kāpilaṃ tīrthamāśrayet | sthāpitaṃ kapilenaiva sarvapātakanāśanam || 88.1 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nareśvara | snāpayetparayā bhaktyā kapilākṣīrasarpiṣā || 88.2 || śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayeta maheśvaram | tataḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca śvetaiśca nṛpasattama || 88.3 || ye'rcayanti jitakrodhā na te yānti yamālayam | asipattravanaṃ ghoraṃ yamaculhī sudāruṇā || 88.4 || dṛśyate naiva vidvadbhiḥ kapileśvarapūjanāt | snātvā revājale puṇye bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān || 88.5 || gopradānena vastreṇa tiladānena bhārata | chatraśayyāpradānena rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 88.6 || tīvratejā vighoraśca jīvatputraḥ priyaṃvadaḥ | śatruvargo na tasya syātkadācitpāṇḍunandana || 88.7 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapileśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.89>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra pūtikeśvaramuttamam | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 89.1 || sthāpitaṃ jāmbuvantena lokānāṃ tu hitārthinā | rājā prasenajinnāma tasyāṃ vakṣasthalānmaṇau || 89.2 || samutkṣipte tu tenaiva sapūtirabhavadvraṇaḥ | tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā nirvraṇaḥ samajāyata || 89.3 || tena tatsthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ pūtikeśvaramuttamam | yastatra manujo bhaktyā snāyādbharatasattama || 89.4 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sampūjya parameśvaram | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ narādhipa | ye'rcayanti sadā devaṃ te na yānti yamālayam || 89.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pūtikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.90>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca revāyā uttare kūle vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam | jalaśāyīti vai nāma vikhyātaṃ vasudhātale || 90.1 || dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā suptastatra janārdanaḥ | cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ tatra devadevena cakriṇā | sudarśanaṃ ca niṣpāpaṃ revājalasamāśrayāt || 90.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca cakratīrthaṃ samācakṣva munisaṃghaiśca vanditam | viṣṇoḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ revāyāścaiva yatphalam || 90.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña viraktastvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ cakriṇā svayam || 90.4 || tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm | āsītpurā mahādaityastālamegha iti śrutaḥ || 90.5 || tena devā jitāḥ sarve hṛtarājyā narādhipa | yajñabhāgān svayaṃ bhuṅkte ahaṃ viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ || 90.6 || dhanadasya hṛtaṃ cittaṃ hṛtaḥ śakrasya vāraṇaḥ | indrāṇīṃ vāñchate pāpo hayaratnaṃ raverapi || 90.7 || tālameghabhayātpārtha ravirudrāḥ savāsavāḥ | yamaḥ skando jaleśo'gnirvāyurdevo dhaneśvaraḥ || 90.8 || savākpatimaheśāśca naṣṭacittāḥ pitāmaham | gatā devā brahmalokaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā pitāmaham || 90.9 || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairvāgīśapramukhāḥ surāḥ | guṇatrayavibhāgāya paścādbhedamupeyuṣe || 90.10 || dṛṣṭvā devānnirutsāhān vivarṇānavanīpate | prasādābhimukho devaḥ pratyuvāca divaukasaḥ || 90.11 || brahmovāca svāgataṃ surasaṅghasya kāntirnaṣṭā purātanī | himakliṣṭaprabhāveṇa jyotīṃṣīva mukhāni vaḥ || 90.12 || praśamādarciṣāmetadanudgīrṇaṃ surāyudham | vṛtrasya hantuḥ kuliśaṃ kuṇṭhitaśrīva lakṣyate || 90.13 || kiṃ cāyamaridurvāraḥ pāṇau pāśaḥ pracetasaḥ | mantreṇa hatavīryasya phaṇino dainyamāśritaḥ || 90.14 || kuberasya manaḥśalyaṃ śaṃsatīva parābhavam | apaviddhagato vāyurbhagnaśākha iva drumaḥ || 90.15 || yamo'pi vilikhanbhūmiṃ daṇḍenāstamitatviṣā | kurute'sminnamogho'pi nirvāṇālātalāghavam || 90.16 || amī ca kathamādityāḥ pratāpakṣatiśītalāḥ | citranyastā iva gatāḥ prakāmālokanīyatām || 90.17 || tadbrūta vatsāḥ kimitaḥ prārthayadhvaṃ samāgatāḥ | kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ vo brūta niḥsaṃśayaṃ surāḥ || 90.18 || mayi sṛṣṭirhi lokānāṃ rakṣā yuṣmāsvavasthitā | tato mandānilodbhūtakamalākaraśobhinā || 90.19 || guruṃ netrasahasreṇa prerayāmāsa vṛtrahā | sa dvinetraṃ hareścakṣuḥ sahasranayanādhikam || 90.20 || vācaspatiruvācedaṃ prāñjalirjalajāsanam | yuṣmadvaṃśodbhavastāta tālamegho mahābalaḥ || 90.21 || upatāpayate devāndhūmaketurivocchritaḥ | tena devagaṇāḥ sarve duḥkhitā dānavena ca || 90.22 || tālamegho daityapatiḥ sarvānno bādhate balī | tasmāttvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ śaraṇaṃ no vidhe bhava || 90.23 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavān vedhāstānabravīdvacaḥ || 90.24 || brahmovāca tālameghena vo madhye balī tena samaḥ surāḥ | vinā mādhavadevena sādhyo me naiva dānavaḥ || 90.25 || tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve viriñcipramukhā nṛpa | kṣīrodaṃ prasthitāḥ sarve duḥkhitāstena vairiṇā || 90.26 || tvaritāḥ prasthitā devāḥ keśavaṃ draṣṭukāmyayā | kṣīrodaṃ sāgaraṃ gatvāstuvaṃste jalaśāyinam || 90.27 || devā ūcuḥ | jagadādiranādistvaṃ jagadanto'pyanantakaḥ | jaganmūrtiramūrtistvaṃ jaya gīrvāṇapūjita || 90.28 || jaya kṣīrodaśayana jaya lakṣmyā sadā vṛta | jaya dānavanāśāya jaya devakinandana || 90.29 || jaya śaṅkhagadāpāṇe jaya cakradhara prabho | iti devastutiṃ śrutvā prabuddho jalaśāyyatha || 90.30 || uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ meghagambhīranisvanām | kimarthaṃ bodhito brahman samarthairvaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 90.31 || brahmovāca tālameghabhayātkṛṣṇa samprāptāstava mandiram | na vadhyaḥ kasyacitpāpastālamegho janārdana || 90.32 || tvameva jahi taṃ duṣṭaṃ mṛtyuṃ yāsyati nānyathā || 90.33 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca svasthānaṃ gamyatāṃ devāḥ svakīyāṃ labhata prajām | duṣṭātmānaṃ haniṣyāmi tālameghaṃ mahābalam || 90.34 || sthānaṃ bruvantu me devā vasedyatra sa dānavaḥ || 90.35 || devā ūcuḥ | himācalaguhāyāṃ sa vasate dānaveśvaraḥ | caturviṃśatisāhasraiḥ kanyābhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 90.36 || turaṅgaiḥ syandanaiḥ kṛṣṇa saṃkhyā tasya na vidyate | naṭā nānāvidhāstatra asaṃkhyātaguṇā hare || 90.37 || dviradāḥ parvatākārā hayāśca dviradopamāḥ | mahābalo vasettatra gīrvāṇabhayadāyakaḥ || 90.38 || śrutvā devo vacasteṣāṃ devānāmāturātmanām | acintayadgarutmantaṃ śatrusaṅghavināśanam || 90.39 || cakraṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya gadācakradharaḥ prabhuḥ | śārṅgaṃ ca muśalaṃ sīraṃ karairgṛhya janārdanaḥ || 90.40 || ārūḍhaḥ pakṣirājendraṃ vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ca | dānavasya pure peturutpātā ghorarūpiṇaḥ || 90.41 || gomāyurgṛdhramadhye tu kapotaiḥ samamāviśat | vinā vātena tasyaiva dhvajadaṇḍaḥ papāta ha || 90.42 || sarpasūṣakayoryuddhaṃ tathā kesarināgayoḥ | unmārgāḥ saritastatrāvahanraktavimiśritāḥ | akālatarupuṣpāṇi dṛśyante sma samantataḥ || 90.43 || tataḥ prāpto jagannātho himavantaṃ nageśvaram | pāñcajanyaśvasahasā pūritaḥ purasannidhau || 90.44 || tena śabdena mahatā hyārūḍho dānaveśvaraḥ | uvāca ca tadā vākyaṃ tālamegho mahābalaḥ || 90.45 || tālamegha uvāca ko'yaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prāpto hyajñātvā mama vikramam | dhundhumārājñayā hyāśu svasainyaparivāritaḥ || 90.46 || balādānaya taṃ baddhvā mamāgre bahuśālinam || 90.47 || dhundhumāra uvāca ānayāmi na sandehaḥ suro yakṣo'tha kinnaraḥ | syandanaughaiḥ samāyukto gajavājibhaṭaiḥ saha || 90.48 || hṛṣṭastato jagadyoniḥ suparṇastho mahābalaḥ | gṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāmeṣa ityuktāstena kiṃkarāḥ || 90.49 || caturdikṣu pradhāvanta itaścetaśca sarvataḥ | suparṇenāgnirūpeṇa dagdhāste śalabhā yathā || 90.50 || dhundhumāro'pi kṛṣṇena śaraghātena tāḍitaḥ | hato vakṣaḥsthale pāpo mṛtāvastho rathopari || 90.51 || hāhākāraṃ tataḥ sarve dānavāścakrurāturāḥ | tālameghastataḥ kruddho rathārūḍho vinirgataḥ | dadṛśe keśavaṃ pārtha śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 90.52 || tālamegha uvāca anye te dānavāḥ kṛṣṇa ye hatāḥ samare tvayā | hiraṇyakaśipuprakhyānapumāṃso hi te'cyuta || 90.53 || ityuktvā dānavaḥ pārtha varṣayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ | dānavasya śarānmuktān chedayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 90.54 || garutmānavadhītsainyamavadhyaṃ yatsurāsuraiḥ | kṛṣṇena dviguṇāstasya preṣitāḥ svaśilīmukhāḥ || 90.55 || dviguṇaṃ dviguṇīkṛtya preṣayāmāsa dānavaḥ | tānapyaṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛṣṇaśchādayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ || 90.56 || tataḥ kruddhena daityena hyāgneyaṃ bāṇamuttamam || 90.57 || vāruṇaṃ preṣayāmāsa tvāgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tataḥ | vāruṇenaiva vāyavyaṃ tālamegho vyasarjayat || 90.58 || sārpaṃ caiva hṛṣīkeśo vāyavyasya praśāntaye | nārasiṃhaṃ nṛsiṃho'pi preṣayāmāsa pāṇḍava || 90.59 || nārasiṃhaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tālamegho mahābalaḥ | uttīrya syandanācchīghraṃ gṛhītvā khaḍgacarmaṇī || 90.60 || kṛṣṇa tvāṃ preṣayiṣyāmi yamamārgaṃ sudāruṇam | ityuktvā dānavaḥ pārtha āgataḥ keśavaṃ prati || 90.61 || khaḍgenātāḍayaddaityo gadāpāṇiṃ janārdanam | maṇḍalāgraṃ tato gṛhya keśavo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 90.62 || jaghanoraḥsthale pārtha tālameghaṃ mahāhave | janārdanastadā daityaṃ daityo harimahanmṛdhe || 90.63 || janārdanastataḥ kruddhastālameghāya bhārata | amoghaṃ cakramādāya muktaṃ tasya ca mūrdhani || 90.64 || nipapāta śirastasya parvatāśca cakampire | samudrāḥ kṣubhitāḥ pārtha nadya unmārgagāminīḥ || 90.65 || puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā mumucuḥ keśavopari | avadhyaḥ surasaṅghānāṃ sūditaḥ keśava tvayā || 90.66 || svasthāścaiva tato devāstālameghe nipātite | janārdano'pi kaunteya narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 90.67 || kṣīrodāṃ narmadāṃ matvā anantabhujagopari | lakṣmyā samanvitaḥ kṛṣṇo nilīnaścottare taṭe || 90.68 || cakraṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃ martye jvālāmālāsamanvitam | patitaṃ narmadātoye jalaśāyisamīpataḥ || 90.69 || nirdhūtakalmaṣaṃ jātaṃ narmadātoyayogataḥ | tālameghavadhotpannaṃ yatpāpaṃ nṛpanandana || 90.70 || tatsravaṃ kṣālitaṃ sadyo narmadāṃbhasi bhārata | tadāprabhṛti loke'smiñjalaśāyī mahīpate || 90.71 || cakratīrthaṃ vadantyanye kecitkālāghanāśanam | vikhyātaṃ bhārate varṣe narmadāyāṃ mahīpate || 90.72 || tattīrthasya prabhāvo'yaṃ śrūyatāmavanīpate | yathā'nanto hi nāgānāṃ devānāṃ ca janārdanaḥ || 90.73 || māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'sti nadīnāṃ narmadā yathā | māsi mārgaśire pārtha hyekādaśyāṃ site'hani || 90.74 || gatvā yo manujo bhaktyā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ | vaiṣṇavīṃ bhāvanāṃ kṛtvā jaleśaṃ tu vrajeta vai || 90.75 || ekabhuktaṃ ca naktaṃ ca tathaivāyācitaṃ nṛpa | upavāsaṃ tathā dānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam || 90.76 || karoti ca kuruśreṣṭha na sa yāti yamālayam | yamalokabhayādbhītā ye lokāḥ pāṇḍunandana || 90.77 || te paśyantu śriyaḥ kāntaṃ nāgaparyaṅkaśāyinam | gopījanasamāvṛttaṃ yoganidrāṃ samāśritam | viśvarūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ saṃsārabhayanāśanam || 90.78 || snāpayetparayā bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā | khaṇḍena toyamiśreṇa jagadyoniṃ janārdanam || 90.79 || snāpyamānaṃ ca paśyanti ye lokā gatamatsarāḥ | te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || 90.80 || ghṛtena bodhayeddīpamathavā tailapūritam | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā daivasyāgre vimatsarāḥ || 90.81 || ye kathāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktyā śṛṇvanti ca nṛpottama | brahmahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 90.82 || pradakṣiṇanti ye martyā jalaśāyijagadgurum | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā taistu saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || 90.83 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale pitḥn saṃtarpayejjalaiḥ | śrāddhaṃ ca brāhmaṇaistatra yogyaiḥ pāṇḍava mānavāḥ || 90.84 || svadāranirataiḥ śāntaiḥ paradāravivarjakaiḥ | vedābhyasanaśīlaiśca svakarmanirataiḥ śubhaiḥ || 90.85 || nityaṃ yajanaśīlaiśca trisandhyāparipālakaiḥ | śraddhayā kārayecchrāddhaṃ yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 90.86 || te dhanyā mānuṣe loke vandyā hi bhuvi mānavāḥ | ye vasanti sadākālaṃ pādapadmāśrayā hareḥ || 90.87 || jalaśāyaṃ prapaśyanti pratyakṣaṃ suranāyakam | pakṣopavāsaṃ pārākaṃ vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham || 90.88 || māsopavāsamugraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhānnaṃ pañcamaṃ vratam | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryātso'kṣayāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || 90.89 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tiladhenośca yatphalam | yathā yasminyadā deyā dāne tasyāḥ śubhaṃ phalam || 90.90 || etatkathāntaraṃ puṇyamṛṣerdvaipāyanātpurā | śrutaṃ hi naimiṣe puṇye nāradādyairanekadhā || 90.91 || idaṃ paramamāyuṣyaṃ maṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam | viprāṇāṃ śrāvayanvidvānphalānantyaṃsamaśnute || 90.92 || bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ | vibhaktadakṣiṇā hyetā dātāraṃ nāpnuvanti ca || 90.93 || ekametatpradātavyaṃ na bahūnāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | sā ca vikrayamāpannā dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam || 90.94 || yathālābhā tu sarveṣāṃ caturdroṇā tu gauḥ smṛtā | droṇasya vatsakaḥ kāryo bahūnāṃ vāpi kāmataḥ || 90.95 || yasmindeśe tu yanmānaṃ viṣaye vā vicāritam | tena mānena tāṃ kurvannakṣayaṃ phalamaśnute || 90.96 || sukhapūrvaṃ śucau bhūmau puṣpadhūpākṣataistathā | karṇābhyāṃ ratne dātavye dīpau netradvaye tathā || 90.97 || śrīkhaṇḍamurasi sthāpyaṃ tābhyāṃ caiva tu kāñcanam | ūrdhve madhu ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ kuryātsarṣaparomakam || 90.98 || kambale kambalaṃ dadyācchroṇyāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tathā | yavasaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyādghṛtaṃ kṣaudrasamanvitam || 90.99 || svarṇaśṛṅgī rūpyaśiphārukmalāṅgūlasaṃyutā | ratnapṛṣṭhī tu dātavyā kāṃsyapātrāvadohinī || 90.100 || yatsyādbālyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadvā kṛtamajānatā | vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yadvicintitam || 90.101 || jale niṣṭhīvitaṃ caiva muśalaṃ vāpi laṅghitam | vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva gurudāraniṣevaṇam || 90.102 || kanyāyā gamanaṃ caiva suvarṇasteyameva ca | surāpānaṃ tathā cānyattiladhenuḥ punāti hi || 90.103 || ahorātropavāsena vidhivattāṃ visarjayet | yā sā yamapure ghore nadī vaitaraṇī smṛtā || 90.104 || vālukāyo'śmasthalā ca pacyate yatra duṣkṛtī | avīcirnarako yatra yatra yāmalaparvatau || 90.105 || yatra lohamukhāḥ kākā yatra śvāno bhayaṃkarāḥ | asipattravanaṃ caiva yatra sā kūṭaśālmalī || 90.106 || tānsukhena vyatikramya dharmarājālayaṃ vrajet | dharmarājastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sūnṛtaṃ vakti bhārata || 90.107 || vimānamuttamaṃ yogyaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam | atrāruhya naraśreṣṭha prayāhi paramāṃ gatim || 90.108 || mā ca cāṭu bhaṭe dehi maiva dehi purohite | mā ca kāṇe virūpe ca nyūnāṅge na ca devale || 90.109 || avedaviduṣe naiva brāhmaṇe sarvavikraye | mitraghne ca kṛtaghne ca mantrahīne tathaiva ca || 90.110 || vedāntagāya dātavyā śrotriyāya kuṭumbine | vedāntagasute deyā śrotriye gṛhapālake || 90.111 || sarvāṅgarucire vipre sadvṛtte ca priyaṃvade | pūrṇimāyāṃ tu māghasya kārttikyāmatha bhārata || 90.112 || vaiśākhyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vāṣāḍhyāṃ caitryāmathāpi vā | ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte ca sarvadā || 90.113 || ṣaḍaśītimukhe puṇye chāyāyāṃ kuṃjarasya vā | eṣa te kathitaḥ kalpastiladhenormayānagha || 90.114 || vrajanti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ dattvā pādaṃ yamopari | prāṇatyāgātparaṃ lokaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | bhittvāśu bhāskaraṃ yānti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 90.115 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ cakratīrthaphalaṃ nṛpa | yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 90.116 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe jalaśāyitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.91>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaparamapāvanam | caṇḍādityaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sthāpitaṃ caṇḍamuṇḍayoḥ || 91.1 || āstāṃ purā mahādaityau caṇḍamuṇḍau sudāruṇau | narmadātīramāśritya ceraturvipulaṃ tapaḥ || 91.2 || dhyāyantau bhāskaraṃ devaṃ tamonāśaṃ jagattraye | tuṣṭastattapasā devaḥ sahasrāṃśuruvāca ha || 91.3 || sādhu sādhviti tau pārtha narmadāyāḥ śubhe taṭe | varaṃ prārthayataṃ vīrau yatheṣṭaṃ cetasecchitam || 91.4 || caṇḍamuṇḍāvūcatuḥ | ajeyau sarvadevānāṃ bhūyāsvāvāṃ samāhitau | sarvarogaiḥ parityaktau sarvakālaṃ divākara || 91.5 || evamastviti tau prāha bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ | ityuktvāntardadhe bhānurdaityābhyāṃ tatra bhāskaraḥ || 91.6 || sthāpitaḥ parayā bhaktyā taṃ gacchedātmasiddhaye | gīrvāṇāṃśca manuṣyāṃśca pitḥṃstatrāpi tarpayet || 91.7 || sa vasedbhāskare loke viriñcidivasaṃ nṛpa | ghṛtena bodhayeddīpaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sa ca nareśvara | mucyate sarvapāpaistu pratiyāti puraṃ raveḥ || 91.8 || utpattiṃ caṇḍabhānoryaḥ śṛṇoti bharatarṣabha | vijayī sa sadā nūnamādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ || 91.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe caṇḍādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.92>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra yamahāsyamanuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritam || 92.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yamahāsyaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dvijapuṃgava | etatsarvaṃ mamākhyāhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 92.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña pṛṣṭo'haṃ nṛpanandana | snānārthaṃ narmadāṃ puṇyāmāgataste pitā purā || 92.3 || rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam | tathāsau nirmalo jāto dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhira || 92.4 || sa paśyannirmalaṃ dehaṃ hasanprovāca vismitaḥ || 92.5 || yama uvāca matpuraṃ kathamāyānti manujāḥ pāpabṛṃhitāḥ | snānenaikena revāyāḥ prāpyate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 92.6 || samarthā ye na paśyanti revāṃ puṇyajalāṃ śubhām | jātyandhaiste samā jñeyā mṛtaiḥ paṅgubhireva vā || 92.7 || samarthā ye na paśyanti revāṃ puṇyajalāṃ nadīm | etasmātkāraṇādrājanhasito lokaśāsanaḥ || 92.8 || sthāpayitvā yamastatra devaṃ svargaṃ jagāma ha | yamahāseśvare rājañjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 92.9 || viśeṣāccāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | upoṣya parayā bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 92.10 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāddīpaṃ devasya bodhayet | ghṛtena caiva rājendra śṛṇu tatrāsti yatphalam || 92.11 || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairagamyāgamanodbhavaiḥ | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇodbhūtairapeyāpeyajairapi || 92.12 || avāhyavāhite yatsyādadohyādohane yathā | snānamātreṇa tasyaivaṃ yānti pāpānyanekadhā || 92.13 || yamalokaṃ na vīkṣeta manujaḥ sa kadācana | pitḥṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyamidaṃ bhūmau nareśvara || 92.14 || dadatāmakṣayaṃ sarvaṃ yamahāsye na saṃśayaḥ | amāvāsyāṃ jitakrodho yastu pūjayate dvijān || 92.15 || hiraṇyabhūmidānena tiladānena bhūyasā | kṛṣṇājinapradānena tiladhenupradānataḥ || 92.16 || vidhānoktadvijāgryāya ye pradāsyanti bhaktitaḥ | hayaṃ vā kuṃjaraṃ vātha dhūrvahau sīrasaṃyutau || 92.17 || kanyāṃ vasumatīṃ gāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ vā payasvinīm | dadate ye nṛpaśreṣṭha nopasarpanti te yamam || 92.18 || yamo'pi bhavati prītaḥ pratijanma yudhiṣṭhira | yamasya vāho mahiṣo mahiṣyastasya mātaraḥ || 92.19 || tāsāṃ dānaprabhāveṇa yamaḥ prīto bhaveddhruvam | nāsau yamamavāpnoti yadi pāpaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 92.20 || etasmātkāraṇādatra mahiṣīdānamuttamam | tasyāḥ śṛṅge jalaṃ kāryaṃ dhūmravastrānuveṣṭitā || 92.21 || āyasasya khurāḥ kāryāstāmrapṛṣṭhāḥ subhūṣitāḥ | lavaṇācalaṃ pūrvasyāmāgneyyāṃ guḍaparvatam || 92.22 || kārpāsaṃ yāmyabhāgaṃ tu navanītaṃ tu nairṛte | paścime saptadhānyāni vāyavye taṃdulāḥ smṛtāḥ || 92.23 || saumye tu kāñcanaṃ dadyādīśāne ghṛtameva ca | pradadyādyamarājo me prīyatāmityudīrayan || 92.24 || ityuccārya dvijasyāgre yamalokaṃ mahābhayam | asipattravanaṃ ghoraṃ yamacullī sudāruṇā || 92.25 || raudrā vaitaraṇī caiva kumbhīpāko bhayāvahaḥ | kālasūtro mahābhīmastathā yamalaparvatau || 92.26 || krakacaṃ tailayantraṃ ca śvāno gṛdhrāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | nirucchvāsā mahānādā bhairavo rauravastathā || 92.27 || ete ghorā yāmyaloke śrūyante dvijasattama | tvatprasādena te somyāstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 92.28 || dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa yamarājaprasādataḥ | narake'haṃ na yāsyāmi dvija janmani janmani || 92.29 || yamahāsyasya cākhyānamidaṃ śṛṇvanti ye narāḥ | te'pi pāpavinirmuktā na paśyanti yamālayam || 92.30 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe yamahāsyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.93>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam | vikhyātaṃ bhārate loke gaṅgāyāḥ pāpanāśanam || 93.1 || durlabhaṃ manujaiḥ pārtha revātaṭasamāśritam | prāṇināṃ pāpanāśāya ūṣaraṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || 93.2 || tattu tīrthamidaṃ puṇyamityevaṃ śūlino vacaḥ | jāhnavī paśurūpeṇa tatra snānārthamāgatā || 93.3 || atastadviśrutaṃ loke kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam | trirātraṃ kārayettatra pūrṇimāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 93.4 || rajastamastathā krodhaṃ dambhaṃ mātsaryameva ca | etāṃstyajati yaḥ pārtha tenāptaṃ mokṣajaṃ phalam || 93.5 || payasā snāpayeddevaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca tryahaṃ tathā | payo gosambhavaṃ sadyaḥ savatsā jīvaputriṇī || 93.6 || kṛtvā tattāmraje pātre kṣaudreṇa caiva yojite | oṃ namaḥ śrīśivāyeti snānaṃ devasya kārayet || 93.7 || sa yāti tridaśasthānaṃ nākastrībhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ | yastatra vidhivatsnātvā dānaṃ preteṣu yacchati || 93.8 || śuklāṃ gāṃ dāpayettatra prīyatāṃ me pitāmahāḥ | brāhmaṇe śaucasampanne svadāranirate sadā || 93.9 || savatsāṃ vastrasaṃyuktāṃ hiraṇyopari saṃsthitām | sattvayukto dadadrājañchāmbhavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 93.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kalhoḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.94>
