śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ rājannanditīrthaṃ vrajecchubham | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ nandinā nirmitaṃ purā || 94.1 || pāpaughahatajantūnāṃ mokṣadaṃ narmadātaṭe | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā nandināthe yudhiṣṭhira || 94.2 || pañcopacārapūjāyāmarcayennandikeśvaram | ratnāni caiva viprebhyo yo dadyāddharmanandana || 94.3 || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra vāsaḥ pinākinaḥ | sarvasaukhyasamāyukto'psarobhiḥ saha modate || 94.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.95>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra badaryāśramamuttamam | sarvatīrthavaraṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ śaṃbhunā purā || 95.1 || yaścaiṣa bhāratasyārthe tatra siddhaḥ kirīṭabhṛt | bhrātā te phālguno nāma viddhyenaṃ naradaivatam || 95.2 || naranārāyaṇau dvau tāvāgatau narmadātaṭe | jñānaṃ tasyaiva yo rājanbhaktimānvai janārdane || 95.3 || samaṃ paśyati sarveṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca | brāhmaṇaṃ śvapacaṃ caiva tatra prīto janārdanaḥ || 95.4 || aikātmyaṃ paśya kaunteya mayi cātmani nāntaram | naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ hi kṛtaṃ badarikāśramam || 95.5 || sthāpitaḥ śaṅkarastatra lokānugrahakāraṇāt | trimūrtisthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ svargamārgānumuktidam || 95.6 || tatra gatvā śucirbhūtvā hyekarātropavāsakṛt | rajastamastathā tyaktvā sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāśrayet || 95.7 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā madhumāsāṣṭamīdine | athavā ca caturdaśyāmubhau pakṣau ca kārayet || 95.8 || āśvinasya viśeṣeṇa kathitaṃ tava pāṇḍava | snāpayetparayā bhaktyā kṣīreṇa madhunā saha || 95.9 || dadhnā śarkarayā yuktaṃ ghṛtena samalaṃkṛtam | pañcāmṛtamidaṃ puṇyaṃ snāpayedvṛṣabhadhvajam || 95.10 || snāpyamānaṃ śivaṃ bhaktyā vīkṣate yo vimatsaraḥ | tasya vāsaḥ śivopānte śakraloke na saṃśayaḥ || 95.11 || śāṭhyenāpi namaskāraḥ prayuktaḥ śūlapāṇine | saṃsāramūlabaddhānāmudveṣṭanakaro hi yaḥ || 95.12 || tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam | yenauṃ namaḥ śivāyeti mantrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ || 95.13 || yaḥ punaḥ snāpayedbhaktyā ekabhakto jitendriyaḥ | tasyāpi yatphalaṃ pārtha vakṣye talleśatastava || 95.14 || pīḍito vṛddhabhāvena tava bhaktyā vadāmyaham | te yānti paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhittvā bhāskaramaṇḍalam || 95.15 || saṃsāre sarvasaukhyānāṃ nilayāste bhavanti ca | āścaryaṃ jñātivargāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ nilayāstu te || 95.16 || sampannāḥ sarvakāmaiste pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate | śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yaḥ kuryānnarmadodakamiśritam || 95.17 || yogyaiśca brāhmaṇairrājankulīnairvedapāragaiḥ | surūpaiśca suśīlaiśca svadāranirataiḥ śubhaiḥ || 95.18 || āryadeśaprasūtaiśca ślakṣṇaiścaiva surūpibhiḥ | kārayetpiṇḍadānaṃ vai bhāskare kutapasthite || 95.19 || pitḥṇāṃ paramaṃ lokaṃ yadīccheddharmanandana | varjayettānprayatnena kāṇānduṣṭāṃśca dāmbhikān || 95.20 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yogyaṃ vipraṃ samāśrayet | narakānmocayetpretānkumbhīpākapurogamān || 95.21 || mokṣo bhavati sarveṣāṃ pitḥṇāṃ nṛpanandana | viprebhyaḥ kāñcanaṃ dadyātprīyatāṃ me pitāmahaḥ || 95.22 || annaṃ ca dāpayettatra bhaktyā vastraṃ ca bhārata | gāṃ vṛṣaṃ medinīṃ dadyācchatraṃ śastaṃ nṛpottama || 95.23 || sa pumānsvargamāpnoti ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt | prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryācchikhinā salilena vā || 95.24 || anāśakena vā bhūyaḥ sa gacchecchivamandiram | naranārāyaṇītīre devadroṇyāṃ ca yo nṛpa || 95.25 || sa vasedīśvarasyāgre yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | punaḥ svargāccyutaḥ so'pi rājā bhavati vīryavān || 95.26 || sarvaiśvaryaguṇairyuktaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ | tataḥ smarati tattīrthaṃ punarevāgamiṣyati || 95.27 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nārāyaṇītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.96>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param | ṛṣikoṭiḥ samāyātā yatra vai kurunandana || 96.1 || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasyaiva kṣemārthaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ | mantrayitvā dvijaiḥ sarvairvedamaṅgalapāṭhakaiḥ || 96.2 || sthāpitaḥ śaṅkarastatra kāraṇaṃ bandhanāśanam | saṃsāracchedakaraṇaṃ prāṇināmārtināśanam || 96.3 || koṭīśvaramiti proktaṃ pṛthivyāṃ nṛpanandana | snāpayettaṃ tu yo bhaktyā pūrṇimāyāṃ nṛpottama || 96.4 || pitḥṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi | śrāvaṇasya viśeṣeṇa pūrṇimāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 96.5 || pitḥṇāmakṣayā tṛptiryāvadābhūtasamplavam | pitḥṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ revātaṭasamāśritam | mokṣadaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ nirmitaṃ munisattamaiḥ || 96.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.97>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla vyāsatīrthamanuttamam | durlabhaṃ manujaiḥ puṇyamantarikṣe vyavasthitam || 97.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kasmādvai vyāsatīrthaṃ tadantarikṣe vyavasthitam | etadākhyāhi saṃkṣepāttyaja granthasya vistaram || 97.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābāho dharmavānsādhuvatsala | svakarmanirataḥ pārtha tīrthayātrākṛtādaraḥ || 97.3 || durlabhaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ vyāsatīrthaṃ nareśvara | pīḍito vṛddhabhāvena akalpo'haṃ nṛpātmaja || 97.4 || visaṃjño gatavittastu saṃjātaḥ smṛtivarjitaḥ | guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā || 97.5 || kalistatraiva rājendra na viśedvyāsasaṃśrayāt | antarikṣe tu saṃjātaṃ revāyāśceṣṭitena tu || 97.6 || viriñcirnaiva śaknoti revāyā guṇakīrtanam | kathaṃ jñāsyāmyahaṃ tāta revāmāhātmyamuttamam || 97.7 || vyāsatīrthaṃ viśeṣeṇa lavamātraṃ bravīmyataḥ | pratyakṣaḥ pratyayo yatra dṛśyate'dya kalau yuge || 97.8 || vihaṅgo gacchate naiva bhittvā śūlaṃ sudāruṇam | tasyotpattiṃ samāsena kathayāmi nṛpātmaja || 97.9 || āsītpūrvaṃ mahīpāla munirmānyaḥ parāśaraḥ | tenātyugraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ gaṅgāmbhasi mahāphalam || 97.10 || prāṇāyāmena saṃtasthau praviṣṭo jāhnavījale | pūrṇe dvādaśame varṣe niṣkrānto jalamadhyataḥ || 97.11 || bhikṣārthī saṃcaredgrāmaṃ nāvā yatraiva tiṣṭhati | tatra tena parā dṛṣṭā bālā caiva manoharā || 97.12 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ca kāmārta uvāca madhuraṃ tadā | māṃ nayasva paraṃ pāraṃ kāsi tvaṃ mṛgalocane || 97.13 || nāvārūḍhe nadītīre mama cittapramāthini | evamuktā tu sā tena praṇamya ṛṣipuṃgavam || 97.14 || kathayāmāsa cātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ kāmamohitam | kaivartānāṃ gṛhe dāsī kanyāhaṃ dvijasattama || 97.15 || nāvāsaṃrakṣaṇārthāya ādiṣṭā svāminā vibho | mayā vijñāpitaṃ vṛttamaśeṣaṃ jñātumarhasi || 97.16 || evamuktastayā so'tha kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvābravīdidam || 97.17 || parāśara uvāca ahaṃ jñānabalādbhadre tava jānāmi sambhavam | kaivartaputrikā na tvaṃ rājakanyāsi sundari || 97.18 || kanyovāca kaḥ pitā kathyatāṃ brahmankasyā vā hyudarodbhavā | kasminvaṃśe prasūtāhaṃ kaivartatanayā katham || 97.19 || parāśara uvāca kathayāmi samastaṃ yattvayā pṛṣṭamaśeṣataḥ | vasurnāmeti bhūpālaḥ somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 97.20 || jambūdvīpādhipo bhadre śatrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ | śatāni sapta bhāryāṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ ca daśaiva tu || 97.21 || dharmeṇa pālayellokānīśavatpūjyate sadā | mlecchāstasyāvidheyāśca kṣīradvīpanivāsinaḥ || 97.22 || teṣāmutsādanārthāya yayāvullaṅghya sāgaram | saṃyuktaḥ putrabhṛtyaiśca pauruṣe mahati sthitaiḥ || 97.23 || samaraṃ taiḥ samārabdhaṃ mlecchaiśca vasunā saha | jitā mlecchāḥ samastāste vasunā mṛgalocane || 97.24 || karadāste kṛtāstena saputrabalavāhanāḥ | pradhānā tasya sā rājñī tava mātā mṛgekṣaṇe || 97.25 || pravāsasthe mahīpāle saṃjātā sā rajasvalā | nārīṇāṃ tu sadākālaṃ manmatho hyadhiko bhavet || 97.26 || viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyante kāmasāyakaiḥ | manmathena tu saṃtaptācintayatsā śubhekṣaṇā || 97.27 || dūtaṃ vai preṣayāmyadya vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ | āhūtaḥ satvaraṃ dūta gaccha tvaṃ nṛpasannidhau || 97.28 || dūta uvāca paratīraṃ gato devi vasurājāriśāsanaḥ | tatra gantumaśakyeta jalayānairvinā śubhe || 97.29 || tāni yānāni sarvāṇi gṛhītāni pare taṭe | dūtavākyena sā rājñī viṣaṇṇā kāmapīḍitā || 97.30 || tatsakhī tāmuvācātha kasmāttvaṃ paritapyase | svalekhaḥ preṣyatāṃ devi śukahaste yathārthataḥ || 97.31 || samudraṃ laṅghayitvā tu śakuntā yānti sundari | sakhivākyena sā rājñī svasthā jātā narādhipa || 97.32 || vyāhṛto lekhakastatra likha lekhaṃ mamājñayā | tvaddhīnā satyabhāmādya vaso rājanna jīvati || 97.33 || ṛtukālo'dya saṃjāto likha lekhaṃ tu lekhakaṃ | likhite bhūrjapatre tu lekhe vai lekhakena tu || 97.34 || śukaḥ pañjaramadhyastha ānītoddhaiva sannidhau || 97.35 || satyabhāmovāca nītvā lekhaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ | śakuniḥ praṇato bhūtvā gṛhītvā lekhamuttamam || 97.36 || utpatya sahasā rājañjagāmākāśamaṇḍalam | tataḥ pakṣī gataḥ śīghraṃ vasurājasamīpataḥ || 97.37 || kṣipte lekhe śukenaiva satyabhāmāvisarjite | vasurājñā tato lekho gṛhya haste'vadhāritaḥ || 97.38 || lekhārthaṃ cintayitvā tu gṛhya vīryaṃ nareśvaraḥ | amoghaṃ puṭikāṃ kṛtvā pratilekhena miśritam || 97.39 || śukasya so'payāmāsa gaccha rājñīsamīpataḥ | praṇamya vasurājānaṃ bījaṃ gṛhyotpapāta ha || 97.40 || samudropari samprāptaḥ śukaḥ śyenena vīkṣitaḥ | sāmiṣaṃ taṃ śukaṃ jñātvā śyenastamabhyadhāvata || 97.41 || hataścañcuprahāreṇa śukaḥ śyenena bhārata | mūrcchayā tasya tadbījaṃ patitaṃ sāgarāmbhasi || 97.42 || matsyena gilitaṃ tacca bījaṃ vasumahīpateḥ | kanyā matsyodare jātā tena bījena sundari || 97.43 || prāpto'sau lubdhakairmatsya ānītaḥ svagṛhaṃ tataḥ | yāvadvidārito matsyastāvaddṛṣṭā tvamuttame || 97.44 || śaśimaṇḍalasaṅkāśā sūryatejaḥsamaprabhā | dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ harṣitāḥ sarve kaivartā jāhnavītaṭe || 97.45 || harṣitāste gatāḥ sarve pradhānasya ca mandiram | strīratnaṃ kathayāmāsurgṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahāprabham || 97.46 || gṛhītā tena tanvaṅgī hyaputreṇa mṛgekṣaṇā | bhāryāṃ svāmāha tanvaṅgi pālayasva mṛgekṣaṇe || 97.47 || tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa parāśaravacastadā | evamuktvā tu sā tena dattātmānaṃ nareśvara || 97.48 || uvāca sādhu me brahmanmatsyagandho'nu vartate | tatastena tu sā bālā divyagandhādhivāsitā || 97.49 || kṛtā yogabalenaiva jvālayitvā vibhāvasum | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ vahnimūḍhā tena rasāttadā || 97.50 || jalayānasya madhye tu kāmasthānānyasaṃspṛśat | jñātvā kāmotsukaṃ vipraṃ bhītā sā dharmanandana || 97.51 || hasantī tamuvācātha deva tvaṃ lokasannidhau | na lajjase kathaṃ dhīmankurvāṇaḥ pāmarocitam || 97.52 || tatastena kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā saṃsmṛtā hṛdi tāmasī | āgatā tāmasī māyā yayā vyāptaṃ carācaram || 97.53 || tataḥ sā vismitā tena karmaṇaiva tu rañjitā | brahmacaryābhitaptena strīsaukhyaṃ krīḍitaṃ tadā || 97.54 || tataḥ sā tatkṣaṇādeva garbhabhāreṇa pīḍitā | prasūtā bālakaṃ tatra jaṭilaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam || 97.55 || kamaṇḍaludharaṃ śāntaṃ mekhalākaṭibhūṣitam | uttarīyakṛtaskandhaṃ viṣṇumāyāvivarjitam || 97.56 || tato'pi śaṅkitā pārtha dṛṣṭvā taṃ kalabālakam | vepamānā tato bālā jagāma śaraṇaṃ muneḥ || 97.57 || rakṣa rakṣa muniśreṣṭha parāśara mahāmate | jātaṃ me'tyadbhutaṃ putraṃ kaupīnavaramekhalam | daṇḍahastaṃ jaṭāyuktamuttarīyavibhūṣitam || 97.58 || parāśara uvāca mā bhaiṣīḥ svasute jāte kumārī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | nāmnā yojanagandheti dvitīyaṃ satyavatyapi || 97.59 || śaṃtanurnāma rājā yaḥ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati | prathamā mahiṣī tasya somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇā || 97.60 || gaccha tvaṃ svāśrayaṃ śubhre pūrvarūpeṇa saṃsthitā | mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvātra dṛṣṭaṃ jñānasya me balam || 97.61 || ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ sā bālā putramāśritā | natvoce mātaraṃ bhaktyā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ vinayānataḥ || 97.62 || kṣamyatāṃ mātaruktaṃ me prasādaḥ kriyatāmapi | īśvarārādhane yatnaṃ kariṣyāmyahamambike || 97.63 || tataḥ sā putravākyena viṣaṇṇā vākyamabravīt || 97.64 || yojanagandhovāca mā tyaktvā gaccha vatsādya mātaraṃ māmanāgasam | tvadviyogena me putra pañcatvaṃ bhāvyasaṃśayam || 97.65 || nāsti putrasamaḥ sneho nāsti bhrātṛsamaṃ kulam | nāsti satyaparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param || 97.66 || bālabhāve mayā jāta ādhāraḥ kila jāyase | na me bhartā na me putraḥ paśya karmaviḍambanam || 97.67 || vyāsa uvāca mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvāntaḥ satyametanmayoritam | āpatkāle'smi te devi smartavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye || 97.68 || āpadastārayiṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ me duruttaram | ityuktvā prayayau vyāsaḥ kanyā sāpi gatā gṛham || 97.69 || parāśarasutastatra viṣaṣṇo vanamadhyataḥ | tretāyugāvasāne tu dvāparādau nareśvara || 97.70 || vyāsārthaṃ cintayāmāsurdevāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | ākhyāto nāradenaiva putraḥ parāśarasya saḥ || 97.71 || kaivartaputrikājāto jñānī jahnusutātaṭe | tato nāradavākyena āgatāḥ surasattamāḥ || 97.72 || rāmaḥ pitāmahaḥ śakro munisaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ | āsyādikaṃ pṛthagdattvā sādhu sādhvityudīrayan || 97.73 || pitāmahena vai bālo garbhādhānādisaṃskṛtaḥ | dvīpāyano dvīpajanmā pārāśaryaḥ parāśarāt || 97.74 || kṛṣṇāṃśātkṛṣṇanāmāyaṃ vyāso vedānvyasiṣyati | virañcinābhiṣikto'sau munisaṅghaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 97.75 || vyāsastvaṃ sarvalokeṣu ityuktvā prayayuḥ surāḥ | tīrthayātrā samārabdhā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena tu || 97.76 || gaṅgāvagāhitā tena kedāraśca sapuṣkaraḥ | gayā ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatī || 97.77 || ujjayinyāṃ mahākālaṃ somanāthaṃ prabhāsake | pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snātvā yāto mahāmuniḥ || 97.78 || amṛtāṃ narmadāṃ prāpto rudradehodbhavāṃ śubhām | sāhlādo narmadāṃ dṛṣṭvā cittaviśrāntimāpa ca || 97.79 || tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ | grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ || 97.80 || sārdravāsāśca hemante tiṣṭhandadhyau maheśvaram | svāntarhṛtkamale sthāpya dhyāyate parameśvaram || 97.81 || sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāramachedyaṃ varadaṃ śubham | nityaṃ siddheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayeddhyānatatparaḥ || 97.82 || arcanātsiddhaliṅgasya dhyānayogaprabhāvataḥ | pratyakṣaḥ śaṅkaro jātaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya saḥ || 97.83 || īśvara uvāca toṣito'haṃ tvayā vatsa varaṃ varaya śobhanam || 97.84 || vyāsa uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama | pratyakṣo narmadātīre svayameva bhaviṣyasi | atītānāgatajño'haṃ tvatprasādādumāpate || 97.85 || īśvara uvāca evaṃ bhavatu te putra matprasādādasaṃśayam | tvayi bhaktigṛhīto'haṃ pratyakṣo narmadātaṭe || 97.86 || sahasrāṃśārdhabhāvena pratyakṣo'haṃ tvadāśrame | ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ kailāsaṃ nagamuttamam || 97.87 || patnīsaṃgrahaṇaṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya tu | śāstroktena vidhānena patnī pālayatastathā || 97.88 || putro jāto hyaputrasya parāśarasutasya ca | devairvardhāpitaḥ sarvairiñcendrapurogamaiḥ || 97.89 || putrajanmanyathājagmurvaśiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ | tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena parāśarapurogamāḥ || 97.90 || manvatriviṣṇuhārītayājñavalkyośano'ṅgirāḥ | yamāpastambasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī || 97.91 || evamādisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca | saśiṣyāśca mahābhāgā narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ || 97.92 || vyāsāśrame śubhe ramye saṃtuṣṭā āyayurnṛpa | dṛṣṭvā tānso'pi viprendrānabhyutthānakṛtodyamaḥ || 97.93 || pituḥ pūrvaṃ praṇamyādau sarveṣāṃ ca yathāvidhi | āsanāni dadau bhaktyā pādyamarghaṃ nyavedayat || 97.94 || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha | uddhṛto'haṃ na sandeho yuṣmatsambhāṣaṇārcanāt || 97.95 || āraṇyāni ca śākāni phalānyāraṇyajāni ca | tāni dāsyāmi yuṣmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ prītipūrvakam || 97.96 || nyamantrayata tānsarvānpratyekaṃ praṇipatya ca | tataste praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim || 97.97 || vardhayitvā jayāśīrbhiravalokya parasparam | parāśaraḥ samastaiśca vīkṣito munipuṃgavaiḥ || 97.98 || uttaraṃ dīyatāṃ tāta kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca | evamuktastu taiḥ sarvairbhagavānsa parāśaraḥ | provāca svātmajaṃ vyāsamṛṣīṇāṃ yaccikīrṣitam || 97.99 || śrīparāśara uvāca necchanti dakṣiṇe kūle vratabhaṅgabhayādatha | bhojanaṃ bhoktukāmāste śrāddhe caiva viśeṣataḥ || 97.100 || vyāsa uvāca karomi bhavatāmuktamatraiva sthīyatāṃ kṣaṇam | yāvatprasādya saritaṃ karomi vidhimuttamam || 97.101 || evamuktvā śucirbhūtvā narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ | stotraṃ jagāda sahasā tannibodha nareśvara || 97.102 || jaya bhagavati devi namo varade jaya pāpavināśinī bahuphalade | jaya śumbhaniśumbhakapāladhare praṇamāmi tu devanarārtihare || 97.103 || jaya candradivākaranetradhare jaya pāvakabhūṣitavaktravare | jaya bhairavadehanilīnapare jaya andhakaraktaviśoṣakare || 97.104 || jaya mahiṣavimardini śūlakare jaya lokasamastakapāpahare | jaya devi pitāmaharāmanate jaya bhāskaraśakraśiro'vanate || 97.105 || jaya ṣaṇmukhasāyudha īśanute jaya sāgaragāmini śambhunute | jaya duḥkhadaridravināśakare jaya putrakalatravivṛddhikare || 97.106 || jaya devi samastaśarīradhare jaya nākavidarśini duḥkhahare | jaya vyādhivināśini mokṣakare jaya vāñchitadāyini siddhavare || 97.107 || etadvyāsakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau | gṛhe vā śuddhabhāvena kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || 97.108 || tasya vyāso bhavetprītaḥ prītaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ | prītā syānnarmadā devī sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī || 97.109 || na te yānti yamālokaṃ yaiḥ stutā bhuvi narmadā | pitāmaho'pi muhyeta devi tvadguṇakīrtanāt || 97.110 || vākpatirnaiva te vaktuṃ svarūpaṃ veda narmade | kathaṃ guṇānahaṃ devi tvadīyāñjñātumutsahe || 97.111 || iti jñātvā śuciṃ bhāvaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ | prasannā narmadādevī tato vacanamabravīt || 97.112 || satyavādena tuṣṭāhaṃ bhobho vyāsa mahāmune | yadīcchasi varaṃ kiṃcittaṃ te sarvaṃ dadāmyaham || 97.113 || vyāsa uvāca yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama | ātithyamuttare kūle ṛṣīṇāṃ dātumarhasi || 97.114 || narmadovāca ayuktaṃ yācitaṃ vyāsa vimārge yatpravartanam | indracandrayamaiḥ śakyamunmārge na pravartitum || 97.115 || yācasvānyaṃ varaṃ putra yatkiṃcidbhuvi durlabham | etacchrutvā vaco devyā vyāso mūrcchāṃ yatastadā || 97.116 || vṛthā kleśo'dya me jāta iti matvā papāta ha | dharaṇī calitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā || 97.117 || mūrcchāpannaṃ tato vyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ | hāhākāramukhāḥ sarve tatrājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 97.118 || vyāsamutthāpayāmāsurvedavyasanatatparam | brāhmaṇārthe ca saṃkliṣṭo nātmahetoḥ saridvare || 97.119 || gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca sadyaḥ prāṇānparityajet | evaṃ sā narmadā proktā brahmādyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ || 97.120 || suśītalaistaṃ bahubhiśca vātairrevābhyaṣiñcatsvajalena bhītā | sacetanaḥ satyavatīsuto'pi praṇamya devānsaritaṃ jagāda || 97.121 || vyāsa uvāca tīrthaiḥ samastaiḥ kila sevanāya phalaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ mama mandabhāgyāt | yaddevi puṇyā viphalā mamāśā āraṇyapuṣpāṇi yathā janānām || 97.122 || narmadovāca yato yato māṃ hi mahānubhāva ninīṣate cittamilātale'tra | vindhyena sārddhaṃ tava mārgamadya yāsyāmyahaṃ daṇḍadharasya pṛṣṭhe || 97.123 || evamukto mahātejā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | dakṣiṇe cālayāmāsa svāśramasya saridvarām || 97.124 || daṇḍahasto mahātejā huṅkāramakaronmuniḥ | vyāsahuṅkārabhītā sā calitā rudranandinī || 97.125 || daṇḍena darśayanmārgaṃ devī tatra pravartitā | vyāsamārgaṃ gatā devī dṛṣṭā śakrapurogamaiḥ || 97.126 || puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā vyamuñcan saha kiṃkaraiḥ | kiṃ kurmo brūhi me putra karmaṇā te sma rañjitāḥ || 97.127 || vyāsa uvāca tapaśca vipulaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dattvā mahāphalam | etadeva naraiḥ kāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ yatsukhāvaham || 97.128 || yadi tuṣṭā mahābhāgā anugrāhyo hyahaṃ yadi | tasmānmamāśrame sarvaiḥ sthīyatāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 97.129 || ātithyaṃ śākaparṇena revāmṛtavimiśritam | pratipannaṃ samastairvaḥ parāśaramukhairmama | sthātavyaṃ svāśrame sarvairrevāyā uttare taṭe || 97.130 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca snānatarpaṇanityāni kṛtāni dvijasattamaiḥ | vyāsakuṇḍe tato gatvā homaḥ sarvaiḥ prakalpitaḥ || 97.131 || śrīphalairbilvapatraiśca juhuvurjātavedasam | gautamo bhṛgurmāṇḍavyo nārado lomaśastathā || 97.132 || parāśarastathā śaṅkhaḥ kauśikaścyavano muniḥ | pippalādo vasiṣṭhaśca nāciketo mahātapāḥ || 97.133 || viśvāmitro'pyagastyaśca uddālakayamau tathā | śāṇḍilyo jaiminiḥ kaṇvo yājñavalkyośano'ṅgirāḥ || 97.134 || śātātapo dadhīciśca kapilo gālavastathā | jaigīṣavyastathā dakṣo bharato mudgalastathā || 97.135 || vātsyāyano mahātejāḥ saṃvartaḥ śaktireva ca | jātūkarṇyo bharadvājo vālakhilyāruṇistathā || 97.136 || evamādisahasrāṇi juhvate jātavedasam | akṣamālākarotkīrṇā dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ || 97.137 || ekacittā dvijāḥ sarve cakrurhomakriyāṃ tadā | tataḥ samutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ mokṣadaṃ vyādhināśanam || 97.138 || acchedyaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāsastutoṣa ca | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ dadurdevā āśīrvādāndvijottamāḥ || 97.139 || sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato vyāso devaṃ dṛṣṭvā trilocanam | brāhmaṇānpūjayāmāsa śākamūlaphalena ca || 97.140 || pitṛpūrvaṃ dvijāḥ sarve bhojitāḥ pāṇḍunandana | āśīrvādāṃstataḥ puṇyān dattvā viprā yayuḥ punaḥ || 97.141 || tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ procyate budhaiḥ || 97.142 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca vyāsatīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me | snānadānavidhānaṃ ca yasminkāle mahāphalam || 97.143 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayāmi samastaṃ te bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍava | kārttikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ || 97.144 || upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram | snāpayedīśvaraṃ bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā || 97.145 || dadhnā ca khaṇḍayuktena kuśatoyena vai punaḥ | śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayetparameśvaram || 97.146 || tataḥ sugandhakusumairbilvapatraiśca pūjayet | mucukundena kundena kuśajātīprasūnakaiḥ || 97.147 || unmattamunipuṣpaiśca tathānyaiḥ kālasambhavaiḥ | arcayetparayā bhaktyā dvīpeśvaramanuttamam || 97.148 || ikṣugaḍukadānena tuṣyate parameśvaraḥ | gaḍukāṣṭakadānena pātakaṃ yātyahorjitam || 97.149 || māsarjitaṃ ca naśyeta gaḍukāṣṭaśatena ca | ṣāṇmāsikaṃ sahasreṇa dviguṇairabdikaṃ tathā || 97.150 || ājanmajanitaṃ pāpamayutena praṇaśyati | dviguṇairnaśyate vyādhistriguṇaiḥ syāddhanāgamaḥ || 97.151 || ṣaḍguṇairjāyate vāgmī siddhastaddviguṇaistathā | rudratvaṃ daśalakṣaiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 97.152 || paurṇamāsyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ | mantroktena vidhānena sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 97.153 || vāruṇaṃ ca tathāgneyaṃ brāhmayaṃ caivākṣayaṃkaram | devānpitḥnmanuṣyāṃśca vidhivattarpayedbudhaḥ || 97.154 || ṛcā ṛgvedajaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmnā sāmaphalaṃ labhet | yajurvedasya yajuṣā gāyatryā sarvamāpnuyāt || 97.155 || akṣaraṃ ca japenmantraṃ sauraṃ vā śivadaivatam | athavā vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣarasaṃjñitam || 97.156 || pūjayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān | svadāraniratānviprāndambhalobhavivarjitān || 97.157 || bhinnavṛttikarān pāpān patitāñchūdrasevanān | śūdrīgrahaṇasaṃyuktānvṛṣalī yasya mandire || 97.158 || parokṣavādino duṣṭāngurunindāparāyaṇān | vedadveṣaṇaśīlāṃśca haitukān bakavṛttikān || 97.159 || īdṛśānvarjayecchrāddhe dāne sarvavrateṣu ca | gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ || 97.160 || nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī | īdṛśānpūjayedviprānannadānahiraṇyataḥ || 97.161 || upānahau ca vastrāṇi śayyāṃ chatramathāsanam | yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe bhaktyā so'pi svarge mahīyate || 97.162 || pratyakṣā surabhī tatra jaladhenustathāghṛtā | tiladhenuḥ pradātavyā mahiṣyaśca tathaiva ca || 97.163 || kṛṣṇājinapradātā yo dātā yastilasarpiṣoḥ | kanyāpustakayordātā so'kṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 97.164 || dhūrvāhau khurasaṃyuktau dhānyopaskarasaṃyutau | dāpayetsvargakāmastu iti me satyabhāṣitam || 97.165 || sūtreṇa veṣṭayeddvīpamathavā jagatīṃ śubham | mandiraṃ parayā bhaktyā parameśamathāpi vā || 97.166 || pradakṣiṇāṃ vidhānena yaḥ karotyatra mānavaḥ | jambūplākṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo nṛpa || 97.167 || kuśaḥ krauñcastathā kāśaḥ puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ | saptasāgaraparyantā veṣṭitā tena bhārata || 97.168 || dvīpeśvare mahārāja vṛṣotsargaṃ ca kārayet | vṛṣeṇāruṇavarṇena māheśaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 97.169 || yastu vai pāṇḍuro vaktre lalāṭe pādayostathā | lāṅgūle yastu vai śubhraḥ sa vai nākasya darśakaḥ || 97.170 || nīlo'yamīdṛśaḥ prokto yastu dvīpeśvare tyajet | sa samāḥ romasaṃkhyātā nāke vasati bhārata || 97.171 || sauraṃ ca śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ vairañcaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kramāt | bhunakti svecchayā rājanvyāsatīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 97.172 || sapatnīkaṃ tato vipraṃ pūjayettatra bhaktitaḥ | sitaraktāni vastrāṇi yo dadyādagrajanmane || 97.173 || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yugmaṃ prīyatāṃ me jagadguruḥ | nāsti viprasamo bandhuriha loke paratra ca || 97.174 || yamaloke mahāghore patantaṃ yo'bhirakṣati | itihāsapurāṇajñaṃ viṣṇubhaktaṃ jitendriyam || 97.175 || pūjayetparayā bhaktyā sāmagaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ | dvīpeśvaraṃ ca ye bhaktyā saṃsmaranti gṛhe sthitāḥ || 97.176 || na teṣāṃ jāyate śoko na hānirna ca duṣkṛtam | prathamaṃ pūjayettatra liṅgaṃ siddheśvaraṃ tataḥ || 97.177 || yatra siddho mahābhāgo vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | asyaiva pūjanātsiddho dhārāsarpo mahāmatiḥ || 97.178 || tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti ca | sūryalokamasau bhittvā prayāti śivasannidhau || 97.179 || samāḥ sahasrāṇi ca sapta vai jale daśaikamagnau patane ca ṣoḍaśa | mahāhave ṣaṣṭiraśīti gograhe hyanāśake bhārata cākṣayā gatiḥ || 97.180 || pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | vāyubhūtaṃ nirīkṣante hyāgacchantaṃ svagotrajam || 97.181 || asmadgotre'sti kaḥ putro yo no dadyāttilodakam | kārttikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa veśākhyāṃ vā tathaiva ca || 97.182 || svargatiṃ ca prayāsyāmastatra tīrthopasevanāt | etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvīpeśvaramanuttamam || 97.183 || yaḥ paṭhetparayā bhaktyā śṛṇuyāttadgato nṛpa | so'pi pāpavinirmukto modate śivamandire || 97.184 || ūṣaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ nirmitaṃ munipuṃgavaiḥ | kāmapradaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha vyāsatīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 97.185 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.98>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra prabhāseśvaramuttamam | vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu svargasopānamuttamam || 98.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca prabhāsaṃ tāta me brūhi kathaṃ jātaṃ mahāphalam | svargasopānadaṃ dṛśyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathayasva me || 98.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca durbhagā ravipatnī ca prabhānāmeti viśrutā | tayā cārādhitaḥ śambhurugreṇa tapasā purā || 98.3 || vāyubhakṣā sthitā varṣaṃ varṣaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇā | tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prabhāyāḥ pāṇḍunandana || 98.4 || īśvara uvāca kasmātsaṃkliśyase bāle kathyatāṃ yadvivakṣitam | ahaṃ hi bhāskaro'pyeko nānātvaṃ naiva vidyate || 98.5 || prabhovāca nānyo devaḥ striyaḥ śambho vinā bhartrā kvacitprabho | saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi dhanāḍhyo vāpyakiṃcanaḥ || 98.6 || priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartaiva daivatam | durbhagatvena dagdhāhaṃ sakhīmadhye sureśvara | bharttaryallabdhasaukhyāsmi tena kliśyāmyahaṃ bhṛśam || 98.7 || īśvara uvāca vallabhā bhāskarasyaiva matprasādādbhaviṣyasi || 98.8 || pārvatyuvāca apramāṇaṃ bhavadvākyaṃ bhāskaro'pi kariṣyati | vṛthā kleśo bhavedasyāḥ prabhāyāḥ parameśvara || 98.9 || umāvākyānmaheśānadhyātastimiranāśanaḥ | āgato gaganādbhānurnarmadottararodhasi || 98.10 || bhānuruvāca āhūto'smi kathaṃ deva hyaghāsuraniṣūdana || 98.11 || īśvara uvāca prabhāṃ pālaya bho bhāno saṃtoṣeṇa pareṇa hi || 98.12 || umovāca prabhāyā mandire nityaṃ sthīyatāṃ himanāśana | agrapatnī samastānāṃ bhāryāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ rave || 98.13 || bhānuruvāca evaṃ devi kariṣyāmi tava vākyaṃ varānane | etacchrutvā prabhāhūtā pratyuvāca maheśvaram || 98.14 || prabhovāca svāṃśena sthīyatāṃ deva manmathāre umāpate | ekāṃśaḥ sthāpyatāmatra tīrthasyonmīlanāya ca || 98.15 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sarvadevamayaṃ liṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra pāṇḍava | prabhāseśa iti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu durlabham || 98.16 || anyāni yāni tīrthāni kāle tāni phalanti vai | prabhāseśastu rājendra sadyaḥ kāmaphalapradaḥ || 98.17 || māghamāse site pakṣe saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | aśvaṃ yaḥ sparśayettatra yathoktabrāhmaṇe nṛpa || 98.18 || indratvaṃ prāpyate tena bhāskarasyāthavā padam | snātvā paramayā bhaktyā dānaṃ dadyāddvijātaye || 98.19 || gopradātā labhetsvargaṃ satyalokaṃ vareśvara | sarvāṅgasundarīṃ śubhrāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ śubhām || 98.20 || savatsāṃ ghaṇṭāsaṃyuktāṃ kāṃsyapātrāvadohinīm | dadate ye nṛpaśreṣṭha na te yānti yamālayam || 98.21 || atha yaḥ parayā bhaktyā snānaṃ devasya kārayet | sa prāpnoti paraṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 98.22 || daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāyāti snānamātreṇa pāṇḍava | tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā kanyādānaṃ prayacchati || 98.23 || brāhmaṇāya vivāhena dāpayetpāṇḍunandana | samānavayase deyā kulaśīladhanaistathā || 98.24 || ye dadante mahārāja hyapi pātakasaṃyutāḥ | teṣāṃ pāpāni līyante hyudake lavaṇaṃ yathā || 98.25 || svāmidrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nikṣepasyāpahāriṇi | mitraghne ca kṛtaghne ca kūṭasākṣyasamudbhavam || 98.26 || tadgrāmodyānabhedotthaṃ paradāraniṣevaṇam | vārddhuṣikasya yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ steyasambhavam || 98.27 || kūpabhedodbhavaṃ yacca baiḍālavratadhāriṇaḥ | dāmbhikaṃ vṛkṣacchedotthaṃ vivāhasya niṣedhajam || 98.28 || ārāmasthatarucchedamagamyāgamanodbhavam | svabhāryātyajane yacca parabhāryāsamīhanāt || 98.29 || brahmasvaharaṇe yacca garade govighātini | vidyāvikrayaṇotthaṃ ca saṃsargādyacca pātakam || 98.30 || śvabiḍālavadhādghoraṃ sarpaśūdrodbhavaṃ tathā | bhūmihartuśca yatpāpaṃ bhūmihāriṇi caiva hi || 98.31 || mā dadasveti yatpāpaṃ govahnibrāhmaṇeṣu ca | tatpāpaṃ yāti vilayaṃ kanyādānena pāṇḍava || 98.32 || sa gatvā bhāskaraṃ lokaṃ rudraloke śubhe vrajet | krīḍate rudralokastho yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 98.33 || sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā | etadvrajati yastīrthaṃ prabhāsaṃ pāṇḍunandana || 98.34 || sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | gopradānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param | praśastaṃ sarvakālaṃ hi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 98.35 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe prabhāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.99>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe | sthāpitaṃ vāsukīśaṃ tu samastāghaughanāśanam || 99.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kasmācca kāraṇāttāta revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | vāsukīśasthāpito vai vistarādvada me guro || 99.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca etatsarvaṃ samāsthāya nṛtyaṃ śambhuścakāra vai || 99.3 || śramādajāyata svedo gaṅgātoyavimiśritam | patantamurago'śnāti haramaulivinirgatam || 99.4 || mandākinī tataḥ kruddhā vyālasyopari bhārata | prāpnuhyajagarattvaṃ hi bhujaṅga kṣudrajantuka || 99.5 || vāsukiruvāca anugrāhyo'smi te pāpo durnayo'haṃ harādṛte | trailokyapāvanī puṇyā sarittvaṃ śubhalakṣaṇā || 99.6 || saṃsāracchedanakarī hyārtānāmārtināśanī | svargadvāre sthitā tvaṃ hi dayāṃ kuru mayīśvari || 99.7 || gaṅgovāca kuruṣva vipulaṃ vindhyaṃ tapastvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ prati | tataḥ prāpsyasi svaṃ sthānaṃ pannagatvaṃ mamājñayā || 99.8 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato'sau tvarito vindhyaṃ nāgo gatvā nagaṃ śubham | tapastaptuṃ samārebhe śaṅkarārādhanodyataḥ || 99.9 || nityaṃ dadhyau mahādevaṃ tryakṣaṃ ḍamarukodyatam | tato varṣaśate pūrṇa uparuddho jagadguruḥ | āgatastatsamīpaṃ tu ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīmudāharat || 99.10 || varaṃ varaya me vatsa pannaga tvaṃ kṛtādara || 99.11 || vāsukiruvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi śaṅkara | prasādāttava deveśa bhūyānniṣpāpatā mama | tīrthaṃ kiṃcitsamākhyāhi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 99.12 || īśvara uvāca pannaga tvaṃ mahābāho revāṃ gaccha śubhaṃkarīm | yāmye tasyāstaṭe puṇye snānaṃ kuru yathāvidhi || 99.13 || ityuktvāntardadhe devo vāsukistvarayānvitaḥ | rūpeṇājagareṇaiva praviṣṭo narmadājalam || 99.14 || mārgeṇa tasya saṃjātaṃ jāhnavyāḥ srota uttamam | nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ sarpaḥ saṃjāto narmadājale || 99.15 || sthāpitaḥ śaṅkarastatra narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | tato nāgeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ prasiddhaṃ pāpanāśanam || 99.16 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ snāpayenmadhunā śivam | vimuktakalmaṣaḥ sadyo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 99.17 || aputrā ye narāḥ pārtha snānaṃ kurvanti saṅgame | te labhante sutāñchreṣṭhān kārttavīryopamāñchubhān || 99.18 || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yaḥ kuryādupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ | kurvanpramocayetpretānnarakānnṛpanandana || 99.19 || sarpāṇāṃ ca bhayaṃ vaṃśe jñātivarge na jāyate | nirdoṣaṃ nandate tasya kulaṃ nāgaprasādataḥ || 99.20 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tava snehānnṛpottama || 99.21 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.100>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramarocanam | mārkaṇḍeśamiti khyātaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 100.1 || uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ gīrvāṇairvanditaṃ śivam | guhyādguhyataraṃ putra nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā || 100.2 || sthāpitaṃ tu mayā pūrvaṃ svargasopānasaṃnibham | jñānaṃ tatraiva me jātaṃ prasādācchaṅkarasya ca || 100.3 || anyastatraiva yo gatvā drupadāmantarjale japet | sa pātakairaśeṣaśca mucyate pāṇḍunandana || 100.4 || vācikairmānasaiśca vā karmajairapi pātakaiḥ | piṇḍikāṃ cāpyavaṣṭabhya yāmyāmāśāṃ ca saṃsthitaḥ || 100.5 || yojayecchūlinaṃ bhaktyā dvātriṃśadbahurūpiṇam | dehapāte śivaṃ gacchediti me niścayo nṛpa || 100.6 || ājyena bodhayeddīpamaṣṭamyāṃ niśi bhārata | svargalokamavāpnoti ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 100.7 || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo bhaktyā kurvīta nṛpanandana | pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 100.8 || iṅgudairbadarairbilvairakṣatena jalena vā | tarpayettatra yo vaṃśyānāpnuyājjanmanaḥ phalam || 100.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.101>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | uttare narmadākūle yajñavāṭasya madhyataḥ || 101.1 || saṃkarṣaṇamiti khyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pāpanāśanam | tapaścīrṇaṃ purā rājanbalabhadreṇa tatra vai || 101.2 || gīrvāṇā api tatraiva saṃnidhau nṛpanandana | umayā sahitaḥ śambhuḥ sthitastatraiva keśavaḥ || 101.3 || balabhadreṇa rājendra prāṇināmupakārataḥ | sthāpitaḥ parayā bhaktyā śaṅkaraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || 101.4 || yastatra snāti vai bhaktyā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe madhunā snāpayecchivam || 101.5 || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo bhaktyā pitḥṇāmatha dāpayet | sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ balabhadravaco yathā || 101.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe saṃkarṣaṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.102>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca manmatheśaṃ tato gacchetsarvadevanamaskṛtam | snānamātrānnaro rājanyamalokaṃ na paśyati || 102.1 || anapatyā yā ca nārī snāyādvai pāṇḍunandana | putraṃ sā labhate pārtha satyasaṅghaṃ dṛḍhavratam || 102.2 || tatra snātvā naro rājañchuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 102.3 || kāmikaṃ tīrtharājaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ na bhaviṣyati | trirātraṃ kurute rājansa golakṣaphalaṃ labhet || 102.4 || tatra nṛtyaṃ prakartavyaṃ tuṣyate parameśvaraḥ | gītavāditranirghoṣai rātrau jāgaraṇena ca || 102.5 || eraṇḍyāṃ ca mahādevo dṛṣṭo me manmatheśvaraḥ | kiṃ samartho yamo ruṣṭo bhadro bhadrāṇi paśyati || 102.6 || kāmena sthāpitaḥ śambhuretasmātkāmado nṛpa | sopānaḥ svargamārgasya pṛthivyāṃ manmatheśvaraḥ || 102.7 || viśeṣaścātra sandhyāyāṃ śrāddhadāne ca bhārata | annadānena rājendra kīrtitaṃ phalamuttamam || 102.8 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tava bhaktyā tu bhārata | pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ prakhyāto manmatheśvaraḥ || 102.9 || godānaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha trayodaśyāṃ prakārayet | caitre māsi site pakṣe tatra gatvā jitendriyaḥ || 102.10 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā devasyāgre nṛpottama | dīpaṃ bhaktyā ghṛtenaiva devasyāgre nivedayet || 102.11 || stryatha vā puruṣo vāpi samametatphalaṃ smṛtam || 102.12 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe manmatheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.103>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ param | yacchrutaṃ vai mayā rājañchivasya vadataḥ purā || 103.1 || etadeva purā praśnaṃ gauryā pṛṣṭastu śaṅkaraḥ | provāca nṛpaśārdūla guhyādguhyataraṃ śubham || 103.2 || īśvara uvāca śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā | revāyāścottare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | bhrūṇahatyāharaṃ devi kāmadaṃ putravardhanam || 103.3 || pārvatyuvāca kathayasva mahādeva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | bhrūṇahatyāharaṃ kasmātkāmadaṃ svargadarśanam || 103.4 || īśvara uvāca atrirnāma mahādevi mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | agnihotrarato nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ || 103.5 || somasaṃsthāśca saptaiva kṛtā vipreṇa pārvati | anasūyeti vikhyātā bhāryā tasya guṇānvitā || 103.6 || pativratā patiprāṇā patyuḥ kāryahite ratā | evaṃ yāti tataḥ kāle na putrā na ca putrikā || 103.7 || aparāhṇe mahādevi sukhāsīnau tu sundari | vadantau sukhaduḥkhāni pūrvavṛttāni yāni ca || 103.8 || atriruvāca saumye śubhe priye kānte cārusarvāṅgasundari | vidyāvinayasampanne padmapatranibhekṣaṇe || 103.9 || pūrṇacandranibhākāre pṛthuśroṇibharālase | na tvayā sadṛśī nārī trailokye sacarācare || 103.10 || ratiputraphalā nārī paṭhyate vedavādibhiḥ | putrahīnasya yatsaukhyaṃ tatsaukhyaṃ mama sundari || 103.11 || yathāhaṃ na tathā putraḥ samarthaḥ sarvakarmasu | punnāmanarakādbhadre jātamātreṇa sundari || 103.12 || patantaṃ rakṣayeddevi mahāpātakinaṃ yadi | mahāghore gatā vāpi duṣṭakarmapitāmahāḥ || 103.13 || taddharanti suputrāśca vaitaraṇyāṃ gatānapi | putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇa paramā gatiḥ || 103.14 || atha putrasya pautreṇa pragacchedbrahma śāśvatam | nāsti putrasamo bandhuriha loke paratra ca || 103.15 || ahaśca madhyarātre ca cintayānasya sarvadā | śuṣyanti mama gātrāṇi grīṣme nadyudakaṃ yathā || 103.16 || anasūyovāca yattvayā śocitaṃ vipra tatsarvaṃ śocayāmyaham | tavodvegakaraṃ yacca tanme dahati cetasi || 103.17 || yena putrā bhaviṣyanti āyuṣmanto guṇānvitāḥ | tatkāryaṃ ca samīkṣasva yena tuṣyetprajāpatiḥ || 103.18 || atriruvāca tapastaptaṃ mayā bhadre jātamātreṇa duṣkaram | vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ śākāhāreṇa sundari || 103.19 || kṣīṇadehastu tiṣṭhāmi hyaśakto'haṃ mahāvrate | tena śocāmi cātmānaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || 103.20 || anasūyovāca bhartuḥ pativratā nārī ratiputravivardhinī | trivargasādhanā sā ca ślāghyā ca viduṣāṃ jane || 103.21 || japastapastīrthayātrā mṛḍejyāmantrasādhanam | devatārādhanaṃ caiva strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ || 103.22 || īdṛśaṃ tu mahādoṣaṃ strīṇāṃ tu vratasādhane | vadanti munayaḥ sarve yathoktaṃ vedabhāṣitam || 103.23 || anujñātā tvayā brahmaṃstapastapsyāmi duṣkaram | putrārthitvaṃ samuddiśya toṣayāmi surottamān || 103.24 || atriruvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe mama saṃtoṣakāriṇi | ājñātā tvaṃ mayā bhadre putrārthaṃ tapa āśraya || 103.25 || devatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pitḥṇāmanṛṇo bhave | na bhāryāsadṛśo bandhustriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 103.26 || tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti na bhāryāsadṛśaṃ sukham | sanmukhe manmukhāḥ putrāḥ vilome tu parāṅmukhāḥ || 103.27 || tena bhāryāṃ praśaṃsanti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ | mahāvrate mahāprājñe sattvavati śubhekṣaṇe || 103.28 || tapastapasva śīghraṃ tvaṃ putrārthaṃ tu mamājñayā | etadvākyāvasāne tu sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt || 103.29 || tvatprasādena viprendra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyām | haṃsalīlāgatiḥ sā ca mṛgākṣī varavarṇinī || 103.30 || niyamasthā tato bhūtvā samprāptā narmadāṃ nadīm | śivasvedodbhavāṃ devīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm || 103.31 || yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ | snānamātreṇa vai yasyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 103.32 || ye pibanti mahādevi śraddadhānāḥ payaḥ śubham | somapānena tattulyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 103.33 || ye smaranti divā rātrau yojanānāṃ śatairapi | mucyante sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ prayānti te || 103.34 || narmadāyāḥ samīpe tu tāvubhau yojanadvaye | na paśyanti yamaṃ tatra ye mṛtā varavarṇini || 103.35 || tatastaduttare kūle eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe | niyamasthā viśālākṣī śākāhāreṇa sundari || 103.36 || toṣayantī trīṃśca devāñchubhaiḥ stotrairvrataistathā | grīṣmeṣu ca mahādevi pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ || 103.37 || varṣākāle cārdravāsāścareccāndrāyaṇāni ca | hemante tu tataḥ prāpte toyamadhye vasetsadā || 103.38 || prātaḥsnānaṃ tataḥ sandhyāṃ kuryāddevarṣitarpaṇam | devānāmarcanaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 103.39 || yajate vaiṣṇavāṃllokān snānajāpyahutena ca | evaṃ varṣaśate prāpte rudraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ || 103.40 || samprāptā dvijarūpaistu eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame priye | purataḥ saṃsthitāstasyā vedamabhyuddharanti ca || 103.41 || anasūyā japaṃ tyaktvā nirīkṣya tānmuhurmuhuḥ | utthitā sā viśālākṣī arghaṃ dattvā yathāvidhi || 103.42 || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ | darśanena tu viprāṇāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 103.43 || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt | kandamūlaphalaṃ śākaṃ nīvārānapi pāvanān | prayacchāmyahamadyaiva munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 103.44 || viprā ūcuḥ | tapasā tu vicitreṇa tapaḥsatyena suvrate | tṛptāḥ sma sarvakāmaistu suvrate tava darśanāt || 103.45 || asmākaṃ kautukaṃ jātaṃ tāpasena vratena yat | svargamokṣasutasyārthe tapastapasi duṣkaram || 103.46 || anasūyovāca tapasā sidhyate svargastapasā paramā gatiḥ | tapasā cārthakāmau ca tapasā guṇavānsutaḥ | tapa eva ca me viprāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 103.47 || viprā ūcuḥ | tanvī śyāmā viśālākṣī snigdhāṅgī rūpasaṃyutā | haṃsalīlāgatigamā tvaṃ ca sarvāṅgasundarī || 103.48 || kiṃ ca te tapasā kāryamātmānaṃ śocyase katham || 103.49 || anasūyovāca yadi rudraśca viṣṇuśca svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ | gūḍharūpadharāḥ sarve taccihnamupalakṣaye || 103.50 || tasyā vākyāvasāne tu svarūpaṃ darśayanti te | svasvarūpaiḥ sthitā devāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ || 103.51 || caturbhujo mahādevi śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | atasīpuṣpavarṇastu pītavāsā janārdanaḥ || 103.52 || garutmānvāhanaṃ yasya śriyā ca sahito hariḥ | prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānsvayaṃrūpo vyavasthitaḥ || 103.53 || pītavāsā mahādevi caturvadanapaṅkajaḥ | haṃsopari samārūḍho hyakṣamālākarodyataḥ || 103.54 || āgato narmadātīre brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | yo'sau sarvajagadvyāpī svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ || 103.55 || vṛṣabhaṃ tu samārūḍho daśabāhusamanvitaḥ | bhasmāṅgarāgaśobhāḍhyaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ || 103.56 || jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaḥ kṛtacandrārddhaśekharaḥ | evaṃrūpadharo devaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ || 103.57 || anasūyā nirīkṣyaitaddevānāṃ darśanaṃ param | vepamānā tataḥ sādhvī surāndṛṣṭvā muhurmuhuḥ || 103.58 || anasūyovāca kiṃ vyāpārasvarūpāstu viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ | etadvai śrotumicchāmi hyaśeṣaṃ kathayantu me || 103.59 || brahmovāca prāvṛṭkālo hyahaṃ brahmā āpaścaiva prakīrtitāḥ | megharūpo hyahaṃ prokto varṣayāmi ca bhūtale || 103.60 || ahaṃ sarvāṇi bījāni prāksandhyāsūdite ravau | etadvai kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ param || 103.61 || viṣṇuruvāca hemantaśca bhavedviṣṇurviśvarūpaṃ carācaram | pālanāya jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam || 103.62 || rudra uvāca grīṣmakālo hyahaṃ proktaḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ | karṣayāmi jagatsarvaṃ rudrarūpastapasvini || 103.63 || evaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva mahāvrate | trayo devāstrayaḥ sandhyāstrayaḥ kālāstrayo'gnayaḥ || 103.64 || tathā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaikātmatāṃ gataḥ | varaṃ dadyuśca te bhadre yastvayā manasīpsitam || 103.65 || anasūyovāca dhanyā puṇyā hyahaṃ loke ślāghyā vandyā ca sarvadā | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca prasannavadanāḥ śubhāḥ || 103.66 || yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari | asmiṃstīrthe tu sāṃnidhyādvaradāḥ santu me sadā || 103.67 || rudra uvāca evaṃ bhavatu te vākyaṃ yattvayā prārthitaṃ śubhe | pratyakṣā vaiṣṇavī māyā eraṇḍīnāma nāmataḥ || 103.68 || yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ | caitramāse tu samprāpte ahorātroṣito bhavet || 103.69 || eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātprabhāte bhojayeddvijān || 103.70 || yathoktena vidhānena piṇḍaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi | pradakṣiṇāṃ tato dadyāddhiraṇyaṃ vastrameva ca || 103.71 || rajataṃ ca tathā gāvo bhūmidānamathāpi vā | sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktamiti svāyambhuvo'bravīt || 103.72 || ye mriyanti narā devi eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe | yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu rudraloke vasanti te || 103.73 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā japedrudrāṃśca vaidikān | ekādaśaikasaṃjñāṃśca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 103.74 || vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam | putrārthī labhate putrāṃllabhetkāmān yathepsitān || 103.75 || eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā revāyā vimale jale | mahāpātakino vāpi te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 103.76 || anasūyovāca yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā mama bhaktipracoditāḥ | mama putrā bhavantveva harirudrapitāmahāḥ || 103.77 || viṣṇuruvāca pūjyā yatputratāṃ yānti na kadācicchrutaṃ mayā | śubhe dadāmi putrāṃste devatulyaparākramān | rūpavanto guṇopetānyajvinaśca bahuśrutān || 103.78 || anasūyovāca īpsitaṃ tacca dātavyaṃ yanmayā prārthitaṃ hare | nānyathā caiva kartavyā mama putraiṣaṇā tu yā || 103.79 || viṣṇuruvāca pūrvaṃ tu bhṛgusaṃvāde garbhavāsa upārjitaḥ | tasyāhaṃ caiva pāraṃ tu naiva paśyāmi śobhane || 103.80 || smaramāṇaḥ purāvṛttaṃ cintayāmi punaḥpunaḥ | evaṃ saṃcintya te devāḥ pitāmahamaheśvarāḥ || 103.81 || ayonijā bhaviṣyāmastava putrā varānane | yonivāse mahāprājñi devā naiva vrajanti ca || 103.82 || sāṃnidhyātsaṅgame devi lokānāṃ tu varapradāḥ | eraṇḍī vaiṣṇavī māyā pratyakṣā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 103.83 || trayo devāḥ sthitāḥ pātha revāyā uttare taṭe | varaprāptā tu sā devī gatā māhendraparvatam || 103.84 || kṣīṇāṅgī śukladehā ca rūkṣakeśī sudāruṇā | kṛtayajñopavītā sā taponiṣṭhā śubhekṣaṇā || 103.85 || śilātalaniviṣṭo'sau dṛṣṭaḥ kānto mahāyaśāḥ | hṛṣṭacitto'bhavaddevi uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha sābravīt || 103.86 || atriruvāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe hyanasūye mahāvrate | acintyaṃ gālavādīnāṃ varaṃ prāptāsi durlabham || 103.87 || anasūyovāca tvatprasādena devarṣe varaṃ prāptāsmi durlabham | tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti siddhāśca ṛṣayo'malāḥ || 103.88 || evamuktā tu sā devī harṣeṇa mahatā yutā | ālokayettataḥ kāntaṃ tenāpi śubhadarśanā || 103.89 || īkṣaṇāccaiva saṃjātaṃ lalāṭe maṇḍalaṃ śubham | navayojanasāhasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ raśmibhirvṛtam || 103.90 || kadambagolakākāraṃ triguṇaṃ parimaṇḍalam | tasya madhye tu deveśi puruṣo divyarūpadhṛk || 103.91 || hemavarṇo'mṛtamayaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | ādyaḥ putro'nasūyāyāḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ || 103.92 || candramā iti vikhyātaḥ somarūpo nṛpātmaja | iṣṭāpūrte ca saṃpāti kalāṣoḍaśakena tu || 103.93 || pratipacca dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca maheśvari | caturthī pañcamī caiva avyayā ṣoḍaśī kalā || 103.94 || caturvidhasya lokasya sūkṣmo bhūtvā varānane | āprīṇāti jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 103.95 || sarve te hyupajīvanti hutaṃ dattaṃ śaśisthitam | vanaspatigate some dhanavāṃśca varānane || 103.96 || bhuñjan paragṛhe mūḍho dadedabdakṛtaṃ śubham | vanaspatigate some yastu chindyādvanaspatīn | tena pāpena deveśi narā yānti yamālayam || 103.97 || vanaspatigate some maithunaṃ yo niṣevate | brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 103.98 || vanaspatigate some manthānaṃ yo'dhivāhayet | gāvastasya praṇaśyanti yāśca vai pūrvasaṃcitāḥ || 103.99 || vanaspatigate some hyadhvānaṃ yo'dhigacchati | bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ reṇubhojanāḥ || 103.100 || amāvasyāṃ mahādevi yastu śrāddhaprado bhavet | abdamekaṃ viśālākṣi tṛptāstatpitaro dhruvam || 103.101 || hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ yo dadāti dvijātiṣu | sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 103.102 || evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭo'sau somarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ | saṃjātaḥ prathamaḥ putro hyanasūyāsunandanaḥ || 103.103 || dvitīyastu mahādevi durvāsā nāma nāmataḥ | sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartā ca svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ || 103.104 || ṛṣimadhyagato devi tapastapati duṣkaram | so'pi rudratvamāyāti samprāpte bhūtaviplave || 103.105 || indro'pi śaptastenaiva durvāsasā varānane | dvitīyasya tu putrasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā || 103.106 || dattātreyasvarūpeṇa bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ | jagadvyāpī jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ sākṣājjanārdanaḥ || 103.107 || ete devāstrayaḥ putrā anasūyāyā maheśvari | varadānena te devā hyavatīrṇā mahītale || 103.108 || putraprāptikaraṃ tīrthaṃ revāyāścottare taṭe | anasūyākṛtaṃ pārtha sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param || 103.109 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca āścaryabhūtaṃ loke'sminnarmadāyāṃ purātanam | bhrūṇahatyā gatā tatra brāhmaṇasya narādhipa || 103.110 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca itihāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kathayasva mamānagha | sarvapāpaharaṃ loke duḥkhārtasya ca kathyatām || 103.111 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca suvarṇaśilake grāme gautamānvayasambhavaḥ | kṛṣīvalo mahādevi bhāryāputrasamanvitaḥ || 103.112 || vasate tatra govindaḥ saṃjāto vipule kule | putradārasamopeto gṛhakṣetrarataḥ sadā || 103.113 || śakaṭaṃ pūrayitvā tu kāṣṭhānāmagamadguham | prakṣiptāni ca kāṣṭhāni hyekākī kṣudhayānvitaḥ || 103.114 || riṅgamāṇastadā putraḥ pituḥ śabdātsamāgataḥ | na dṛṣṭastena vai putraḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ saṃchādito'vaśaḥ || 103.115 || āgatastvarito gehe pipāsārto narādhipa | śakaṭaṃ mocya taddvāri savṛṣaṃ rajjusaṃyutam || 103.116 || bhāryā tasyaiva yā dṛṣṭā cittajñā vaśavartinī | dṛṣṭvā nipātitaṃ putraṃ kāṣṭhairnirbhinnamastakam || 103.117 || ajalpamānākaruṇaṃ nikṣiptaṃ jñolikāṃ śiśum | śuśrūṣaṇe ratā sādhvī priyasya ca narādhipa || 103.118 || tataḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā bhojanācchayanaṃ śubham | putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭhā hyutthāpayati śāsanaiḥ || 103.119 || yadā ca notthitaḥ suptaḥ putraḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ | tadā sā dīnavadanā ruroda ca mumoha ca || 103.120 || tacchrutvā ruditaṃ śabdaṃ govindastrastamānasaḥ | kimetaditi coktvā tu patito dharaṇītale || 103.121 || dvāvetau muktakeśau tu bhūmau nipatitau nṛpa | vilepāte ca rājendra niḥśvāsocchvāsitena ca || 103.122 || kaṃ paśye prāṅgaṇe putraṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍantamāturam | saṃdhārayiṣye hṛdayaṃ sphuṭitaṃ tava kāraṇe || 103.123 || tvajjanmāntaṃ yaśo nityamakṣayāṃ kulasantatim | dṛṣṭvā kimanṛṇībhūto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim || 103.124 || mama vṛddhasya dīnasya gatistvaṃ kila putraka | ete manorathāḥ sarve cintitā viphalā gatāḥ || 103.125 || imāṃ tu vikalāṃ dīnāṃ vihīnāṃ sutabāndhavaiḥ | rudantīṃ patitāṃ pāhi mātaraṃ dharaṇītale || 103.126 || punnāmno narakādyasmātpitaraṃ trāyate sutaḥ | tena putra iti proktaḥ svayameva svayambhuvā || 103.127 || aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ diśaḥ śūnyā hyabāndhavāḥ | mūrkhasya hṛdayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaśūnyaṃ daridratā || 103.128 || mṛṣāyaṃ vadate lokaścandanaṃ kila śītalam | putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanādapi śītalaḥ || 103.129 || śmaśrugrahaṇakrīḍantaṃ dhūlidhūsaritānanam | puṇyahīnā na paśyanti nijotsaṅgasamāsthitam || 103.130 || digambaraṃ gatavrīḍaṃ jaṭilaṃ dhūlidhūsaram | puṇyahīnā na paśyanti gaṅgādharamivātmajam || 103.131 || vīṇāvādyasvaro loke susvaraḥ śrūyate kila | ruditaṃ bālakasyaiva tasmādāhlādakārakam || 103.132 || mṛgapakṣiṣu kākeṣu paśūnāṃ svarayoniṣu | putraṃ teṣu samasteṣu vallabhaṃ bruvate budhāḥ || 103.133 || matsyāśvaprakarāścaiva kūrmagrāhādayo'pi vā | putrotpattau ca hṛṣyanti vipattau yānti duḥkhitām || 103.134 || devagandharvayakṣāśca hṛṣyante putrajanmani | pañcatve te'pi śocanti mandabhāgyo'smi putraka || 103.135 || ṛṣimelāpakaṃ cakre putrārthe rāghavo nṛpa | indrasthāne sthitastasya prokṣate hyāsanaṃ yataḥ || 103.136 || svargavāsaṃ sutādbāhyaṃ vidyate na tu pāṇḍava | cakre daśarathastasmātputrārthaṃ yajñamuttamam || 103.137 || rāmo lakṣmaṇaśatrughnau bharatastatra sambhavāt | kārtavīryo jito yena rāmeṇāmitatejasā || 103.138 || sa rāmo rāmacandreṇa aṣṭavarṣeṇa nirjitaḥ | ekākinā hato vālī plavagaḥ śatrudurjayaḥ || 103.139 || rāvaṇo brahmaputro yastrailokyaṃ yasya śaṅkate | hataḥ sa rāmacandreṇa saputraḥ sahabāndhavaḥ || 103.140 || evaṃ putraṃ vinā saukhyaṃ martyaloke na vidyate | vaṃśārthe maithunaṃ yasya svargārthe yasya bhāratī || 103.141 || mṛṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇasyārthe svarge vāsaṃ tu yānti te | brahmahatyāśvamedhābhyāṃ na paraṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ || 103.142 || putrotpattivipattibhyāṃ na paraṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | kiṃ bravīmīti bho vatsa na tu saukhyaṃ sutaṃ vinā || 103.143 || evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pralapitvā punaḥpunaḥ | janaiścāśvāsito vipro bālaṃ gṛhya bahirgataḥ || 103.144 || tataḥ saṃskṛtya taṃ bālaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā | samavetau tu duḥkhārtāvāgatau svagṛhaṃ punaḥ || 103.145 || evaṃ gṛhāgate vipre rātrirjātā yudhiṣṭhira | bhūmau prasupto govindaḥ putraśokena pīḍitaḥ || 103.146 || yāvannirīkṣate bhāryā bhartāraṃ duḥkhapīḍitam | kṛmirāśigataṃ sarvaṃ govindaṃ samapaśyata || 103.147 || duḥkhādduḥkhatare magnā dṛṣṭvā taṃ pātakānvitam | evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāyāḥ śarvarī vigatā tadā || 103.148 || paśupālastu mahiṣīmuktvāraṇye'gamadgṛhāt | araṇye mahiṣīḥ sarvā rakṣayitvā gṛhāgataḥ || 103.149 || vijñaptaḥ paśupālena govindo brāhmaṇottamaḥ | yāvadbhokṣyāmyahaṃ svāminmahiṣīstvaṃ ca rakṣase || 103.150 || tataḥ sa tvarito vipro jagāma mahiṣīḥ prati | na tatra mahiṣīḥ paśyetpaścātkṣetrābhisammukham || 103.151 || dhāvamānaśca viprastu eraṇḍīsaṅgame gataḥ | tataḥ praviṣṭastu jale revairaṇḍyostu saṅgame || 103.152 || tajjalaṃ pītamātraṃ tu tvarayā cātitarṣitaḥ | akāmātsalilaṃ pītvā prakṣālya nayane śubhe || 103.153 || ājagāma tataḥ paścādbhavanaṃ divasakṣaye | bhuktvā duḥkhānvito rātrau govindaḥ śayanaṃ yayau || 103.154 || nidrābhibhūtaḥ śokena śrameṇaiva tu kheditaḥ | punastaccārdharātre tu tasya bhāryā yudhiṣṭhira || 103.155 || kṛmibhirveṣṭitaṃ gāntraṃ kvacitpaśyatyaveṣṭitam | punaḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā tasya bhāryā guṇānvitā | uvāca duṣkṛtaṃ tasya sādhvasāviṣṭacetasā || 103.156 || bhāryovāca atīte pañcame cāhni tvindhanaṃ kṣipatastu te | gṛhapaścādgato bālo hyajñānādghātitastvayā || 103.157 || mayā tatpātakaṃ ghoraṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśitam | tena pracchannapāpena dahyamānā divāniśam || 103.158 || na sukhaṃ tava gātrasya paśyāmi na hi cātmanaḥ | nidrā mama śamaṃ yātā ratiścaiva tvayā saha || 103.159 || śrūyate mānave śāstre śloko gīto maharṣibhiḥ | smṛtvā smṛtvā tu taṃ citte paritāpo na śāmyati || 103.160 || kīrtanānnaśyate dharmo vardhate'sau nigūhanāt | iha loke pare caiva pāpasyāpyevameva ca || 103.161 || evaṃ saṃcityamānāhaṃ sthitā rātrau bhayāturā | kṛmirāśigataṃ tvāṃ hi kasyāhaṃ kathayāmi kim || 103.162 || punastvaṃ cādya me dṛṣṭo bhrūṇahatyākṛmiśritaḥ | kvacidbhindanti te gātraṃ kvacinnaṣṭāḥ samantataḥ || 103.163 || etatsaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya vimṛśāmi punaḥpunaḥ | na jāne kāraṇaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchantyāḥ kathayasva me || 103.164 || taḍāgaṃ vā saridvāpi tīrthaṃ vā devatārcanam | yaṃ gato'si prabhāvo'yaṃ tasya nānyasya me sthitam || 103.165 || evamuktastu vipro'sau kathayāmāsa bhārata | bhāryāyā yaddivā vṛttaṃ śaṅkamāno nṛpottama || 103.166 || adyāhaṃ mahiṣīsārthaṃ eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ gataḥ | nābhimātre jale gatvā pītavānsalilaṃ bahu || 103.167 || nānyattīrthaṃ vijānāmi saritaṃ sara eva vā | satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kathitaṃ tava bhāmini || 103.168 || evaṃ jñātvā tu sā sarvamupavāsakṛtakṣaṇā | sapatnīko gatastatra saṅgame varavarṇini || 103.169 || snātvā tatra jale ramye natvā devaṃ tu bhāskaram | snāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ comayā saha || 103.170 || pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīrairdadhikṣaudraghṛtairjalaiḥ | gandhamālyādidhūpaiśca naivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ || 103.171 || pūjya trayīmayaṃ liṅgaṃ devīṃ kātyāyanīṃ śubhām | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā patyāsi pativratā || 103.172 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijānsampūjya yatnataḥ | godānena hiraṇyena vastreṇānnena bhārata || 103.173 || govindaḥ pūjayāmāsa svaśaktyā brāhmaṇāñchubhān | muktapāpo gṛhāyātaḥ svabhāryāsahito nṛpa || 103.174 || evaṃ yaḥ śṛṇute bhaktyā govindākhyānamuttamam | paṭhate parayā bhaktyā bhrūṇahatyā praṇaśyati || 103.175 || krīḍate śāṃkare loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam | yaścaivāśvayuje māsi caitre vā nṛpasattama || 103.176 || saptamyāṃ ca site pakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | sāttvikīṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā yo vasecchivamandire || 103.177 || dhyāyamāno virūpākṣaṃ triśūlakarasaṃsthitam | kaṃsāsuranihantāraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 103.178 || pakṣirājasamārūḍhaṃ trailokyavaradāyakam | pitāmahaṃ tato dhyāyeddhaṃsasthaṃ caturānanam || 103.179 || sargapradaṃ samastasya kamalākaraśobhitam | yo hyevaṃ vasate tatra triyame sthāna uttame || 103.180 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca narādhipa | brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyā sarvadoṣavivarjitān || 103.181 || sarvāvayavasampūrṇānsarvaśāstraviśāradān | vedābhyāsaratānnityaṃ svadāraniratānsadā || 103.182 || śrāddhe dāne vrate yogyān brāhmaṇān pāṇḍunandana | pretānāṃ pūjanaṃ tatra devapūrvaṃ samārabhet || 103.183 || pretatvānmucyate śīghrameraṇḍyāṃ piṇḍatarpaṇaiḥ | dānāni tatra deyāni hyannamukhyāni sarvadā || 103.184 || hiraṇyabhūmikanyāśca dhūrvāhau śubhalakṣaṇau | sīreṇa sahitau pārtha dhānyaṃ droṇakasaṃkhyayā || 103.185 || alaṃkṛtāṃ savatsāṃ ca kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ sitām | raktāṃ vā kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ vā pāṭalāṃ kapilāṃ tathā || 103.186 || kāṃsyadohanasaṃyuktāṃ rukmakhuravibhūṣaṇām | svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāyopapādayet || 103.187 || prīyatāṃ me jagannāthā harakṛṣṇapitāmahāḥ | saṃsārarakṣaṇī devī surabhī māṃ samuddharet || 103.188 || putrārthaṃ yāḥ striyaḥ pārtha hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa | snāpyante rudrasūktaiśca caturvedodbhavaistathā || 103.189 || caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ śastaṃ dvābhyāṃ yogyaiśca kārayet | ekena sārdrakumbhena dāmpatyamabhiṣecayet || 103.190 || daivajñenaiva caikena athavā sāmagena vā | pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ kumbhe tatraiva kārayet || 103.191 || gandhatoyasamāyuktaṃ sarvauṣadhivimiśritam | āmrapallavasaṃyuktamaśvatthamadhukaṃ tathā || 103.192 || guṇṭhitaṃ sitavastreṇa sitacandanacarcitam | sitapuṣpaistu saṃchannaṃ siddhārthakṛtamadhyamam || 103.193 || kāṃsyapātre tu saṃsthāpya putrārthī deśikottamaḥ | aṅgalagnaṃ tu yadvastraṃ kaṭakābharaṇaṃ tathā || 103.194 || tatsarvaṃ maṇḍale tyājyaṃ siddhyarthaṃ cātmanastadā | praṇamya bhāskaraṃ paścādācāryaṃ rudrarūpiṇam || 103.195 || madhuraṃ ca tato'śnīyāddevyā bhuvana uttame | phaladānaṃ ca viprāya chatraṃ tāmbūlameva ca || 103.196 || upānahau ca yānaṃ ca sa bhavedduḥkhavarjitaḥ | bhāskare krīḍate loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 103.197 || dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam || 103.198 || evaṃ pāpāni naśyanti hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛṇām | samantācchastrapātena hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa || 103.199 || bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate śaṅkaro'bravīt | prāṇatyāgaṃ ca yo bhaktyā jātavedasi kārayet || 103.200 || anāśakaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha jale vā tadanantaram | pañcasāhasrikaṃ mānaṃ varṣāṇāṃ jātavedasi || 103.201 || jale trīṇi sahasrāṇyanāśake ṣaṣṭiṃ bhuñjate | kākā bakāḥ kapotāśca hyulūkāḥ paśavastathā || 103.202 || saṃgamodakasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim | vṛkṣāśca tatpadaṃ jñātvā yāṃ gatiṃ yānti yoginaḥ || 103.203 || eraṇḍikā mayā devī dṛṣṭo me manmatheśvaraḥ | kiṃ samartho yamo ruṣṭo bhadro bhadrāṇi paśyati || 103.204 || mṛttikāṃ saṅgamodbhūtāṃ ye ca guṇṭhanti nityaśaḥ | bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 103.205 || eraṇḍīsaṅgame martyo luṇṭhyamāno narādhipa | sarvapāpairvinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam || 103.206 || eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgamaṃ martyāḥ kīrtayantyāśramasthitāḥ | vimuktapāpā jāyante satyaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitam || 103.207 || eraṇḍīpādapāgraistu dṛṣṭaiḥ pāpaṃ vyapohati || 103.208 || tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti mānavāḥ | śṛṇvanti cāpare bhaktyā muktapāpā bhavanti te || 103.209 || etatte sarvamākhyātameraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ nṛpa | bhūyaścānyatpravakṣyāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 103.210 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍīsaṅgamatīrthaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.104>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpālaṃ sauvarṇaśilamuttamam | prakhyātamuttare kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 104.1 || samantācchatapātena munisaṅghaiḥ purā kṛtam | revāyāṃ durlabhaṃ sthānaṃ saṅgamasya samīpataḥ || 104.2 || vibhaktaṃ hastamātraṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ narādhipa | suvarṇaśilake snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram || 104.3 || natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hotavyaṃ ca hutāśane | bilvenājyavimiśreṇa bilvapatrairathāpi vā || 104.4 || prīyatāṃ me jagannātho vyādhirnaśyatu me dhruvam | dvijāya kāñcane datte yatphalaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me || 104.5 || bahusvarṇasya yatproktaṃ yāgasya phalamuttamam | tathāsau labhate sarvaṃ kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 104.6 || tena dānena pūtātmā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt | rudrasyānucarastāvadyāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 104.7 || tataḥ svargāvatīrṇastu jāyate viśade kule | dhanadhānyasamopetaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam || 104.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇaśilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.105>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca karañjākhyaṃ tato gacchetsopavāso jitendriyaḥ | tatra snātvā tu rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 105.1 || arcayitvā mahādevaṃ dattvā dānaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇimauktikavidrumān || 105.2 || pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ prāvaraṇāni ca | koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 105.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karañjatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.106>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ divyaṃ naranārīmanoramam || 106.1 || tatra yā durbhagā nārī naro vā nṛpasattama | snātvārcayedumārudrau saubhāgyaṃ tasya jāyate || 106.2 || tṛtīyāyāmahorātraṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | nimantrayeddvijaṃ bhaktyā sapatnīkaṃ surūpiṇam || 106.3 || gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastradhūpādivāsitam | bhojayetpāyasānnena kṛsareṇātha bhaktitaḥ || 106.4 || bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pradakṣiṇamudāharet | prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 106.5 || yathā te devadeveśa na viyogaḥ kadācana | mamāpi karuṇāṃ kṛtvā tathāstviti vicintayet || 106.6 || evaṃ kṛte tatastasya yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam | tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā devena bhāṣitam || 106.7 || daurbhāgyaṃ durgatiścaiva dāridryaṃ śokabandhanam | vandhyatvaṃ saptajanmāni jāyate na yudhiṣṭhira || 106.8 || jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ || 106.9 || so'pi pāpairaśeṣaistu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | guggulaṃ dahate yastu dvidhā cittavivarjitaḥ || 106.10 || śarīraṃ bhedayedyastu gauryāścaiva samīpataḥ | tasminkarmapraviṣṭasya utkrāntirjāyate yadi || 106.11 || dehapāte vrajetsvargamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt | sitaraktaistathā pītairvastraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 106.12 || brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi | puṣpairnānāvidhaiścaiva gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || 106.13 || kaṇṭhasūtrakasindūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet | kalpayeta striyaṃ gaurīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śivarūpiṇam || 106.14 || teṣāṃ tadrūpakaṃ kṛtvā dānamutsṛjyate tataḥ | kaṅkaṇaṃ karṇaveṣṭaṃ ca kaṇṭhikāṃ mudrikāṃ tathā || 106.15 || saptadhānyaṃ tathā caiva bhojanaṃ nṛpasattama | anyānyapi ca dānāni tasmiṃstīrthe dadāti yaḥ || 106.16 || sarvadānaiśca yatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ | sahasraguṇitaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 106.17 || śaṅkareṇa samaṃ tasmādbhogaṃ bhuṅkte hyanuttamam | saubhāgyaṃ tasya vipulaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 106.18 || aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt | rājendra kāmadaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 106.19 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.107>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheta rājendra bhaṇḍārītīrthamuttamam | daridracchedakaraṇaṃ yugānyekonaviṃśatiḥ || 107.1 || dhanadena tapastaptvā prasanne padmasambhave | tatraiva svalpadānena prāptaṃ vittasya rakṣaṇam || 107.2 || tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā snātvā vittaṃ prayacchati | tasya vittaparicchedo na kadācidbhaviṣyati || 107.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhaṇḍārītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.108>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla rohiṇītīrthamuttamam | vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpaharaṃ param || 108.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca rohiṇītīrthamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 108.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame | udadhau ca śayānasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 108.3 || nābhau samutthitaṃ padmaṃ ravimaṇḍalasannibham | karṇikākesaropetaṃ patraiśca samalaṃkṛtam || 108.4 || tatra brahmā samutpannaścaturvadanapaṅkajaḥ | kiṃ karomīti deveśa ājñā me dīyatāṃ prabho || 108.5 || evamuktastu deveśaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tadā devaṃ pitāmaham || 108.6 || sarasvatyāṃ mahābāho lokaṃ kuru mamājñayā | bhūtagrāmamaśeṣasya utpādanavidhikṣayam || 108.7 || etacchrutaṃ tu vacanaṃ padmanābhasya bhārata | cintayāmāsa bhagavānsaptarṣīnhitakāmyayā || 108.8 || kramātte cintitāḥ prājñāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca || 108.9 || yajñe prācetaso dakṣo mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ | dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitaro'nagha || 108.10 || dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa | tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave || 108.11 || rohiṇīnāma yā tāsāṃ madhye tasya narādhipa | aniṣṭā sarvanārīṇāṃ bhartuścaiva viśeṣataḥ || 108.12 || tataḥ sā paramaṃ kṛtvā vairāgyaṃ nṛpasattama | āgatya narmadātīre cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 108.13 || ekarātraistrirātraiśca ṣaḍdvādaśabhireva ca | pakṣamāsopavāsaiśca karśayanti kalevaram || 108.14 || ārādhayantī satataṃ mahiṣāsuranāśinīṃ | devīṃ bhagavatīṃ tāta sarvārtivinivāraṇīm || 108.15 || snātvā snātvā jale nityaṃ narmadāyāḥ śucismitā | tatastuṣṭā mahābhāgā devī nārāyaṇī nṛpa || 108.16 || prasannā te mahābhāge vratena niyamena ca | etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā || 108.17 || yathā bhavāmi na cirāttathā bhavatu mānade | evamastviti sā coktvā bhavānī bhaktavatsalā || 108.18 || stūyamānā munigaṇaistatraivāntaradhīyata | tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā || 108.19 || saṃjātā sarvakālaṃ tu vallabhā nṛpasattama | tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī naro vā snāni bhaktitaḥ || 108.20 || vallabhā jāyate sā tu bharturvai rohiṇī yathā | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai || 108.21 || saptajanmāni dāmpatyaviyogo na bhavetkvacit || 108.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rohiṇīsomanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.109>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla cakratīrthamanuttamam | senāpuramitikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 109.1 || saināpatyābhiṣekāya devadevena cakriṇā | ānītaśca mahāseno devaiḥ sendrapurogamaiḥ || 109.2 || dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya jayāya ca divaukasām | bhūmidānena viprendrāṃstarpayitvā yathāvidhi || 109.3 || śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca paṭahānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ | vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca jhallarīsvaramaṅgalaiḥ || 109.4 || tataḥ kṛtvā svanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavo baladarpitaḥ | rururnāma vighātārthamabhiṣekasya cāgataḥ || 109.5 || hastyaśvarathapattyoghaiḥ pūrayanvai diśo daśa | tatra tena mahadyuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ kila bhārata || 109.6 || śaktyṛṣṭipāśamuśalaiḥ khaḍgaistomaraṭaṅkanaiḥ | bhallaiḥ karṇikanārācaiḥ kabandhapaṭasaṃkulaiḥ || 109.7 || tatastu tāṃ śatrubalasya senāṃ kṣaṇena cāpancyutabāṇaghātaiḥ | vidhvastahastyaśvarathānmahātmā jagrāha cakraṃ ripusaṅghanāśanaḥ || 109.8 || jvalacca cakraṃ niśitaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ surāsurāṇāṃ ca sudarśanaṃ raṇe | cakarta daityasya śirastadānīṃ karātpramuktaṃ madhughātinaśca tat || 109.9 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā vighnamabhiṣeke ṣaḍānanaḥ | tyaktvā tu tatra saṃsthānaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 109.10 || muktaṃ cakraṃ vināśāya hariṇā lokadhāriṇā | dvidalaṃ dānavaṃ kṛtvā papāta vimale jale || 109.11 || tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti śrutam | sarvapāpavināśāya nirmitaṃ viśvamūrtinā || 109.12 || cakratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamacyutam | puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 109.13 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān | śāntadāntajitakrodhānsa labhetkoṭijaṃ phalam || 109.14 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajate dehamātmanaḥ | viṣṇulokaṃ mṛto yāti jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ || 109.15 || krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ devagandharvapūjitaḥ | ihāgatya ca bhūyo'pi jāyate vipule kule || 109.16 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam | kathitaṃ te mahābhāga bhūyaścānyacchṛṇuṣva me || 109.17 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe senāpure cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.110>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchenmahāpātakanāśanam | samīpe cakratīrthasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ purā || 110.1 || nihatairdānavairghorairdevadevo janārdanaḥ | tatpāpasya vināśārthaṃ dānavāntodbhavasya ca || 110.2 || tatra tīrthe jitakrodhaścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | duścaraṃ maunamāsthāya hyaśakyaṃ devadānavaiḥ || 110.3 || snātvā dattvā dvijātibhyo dānāni vividhāni ca | tatkṣaṇātsupāpastu gatastadvaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 110.4 || evaṃ yuktastu yastatra pāpaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam | snātvā japtvā vidhānena mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 110.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.111>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | skandena nirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam || 111.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca skandasya caritaṃ sarvamājanma dvijasattama | tīrthasya ca vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ kathayasva yathārthataḥ || 111.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca devadevena vai taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | vijñaptena suraiḥ sarvairumādevī vivāhitā || 111.3 || nāsti senāpatiḥ kaściddevānāṃ surasattama | nīyante dānavairghoraiḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 111.4 || yathā niśā vinā candraṃ divaso bhāskaraṃ vinā | na śobhate muhūrtaṃ vai tathā senā vināyakā || 111.5 || evaṃ jñātvā mahādeva parayā dayayā vibho | senānīrdīyatāṃ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 111.6 || etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | kāmayāna umāṃ devīṃ sasmāra manasā smaram || 111.7 || tena mūrchitasarvāṅgaḥ kāmarūpo jagadguruḥ | kāmayāmāsa rudrāṇīṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila || 111.8 || devarājastato jñātvā mahāmaithunagaṃ haram | saṃmantrya daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ praiṣayajjātavedasam || 111.9 || tena gatvā mahādevaḥ paramānandasaṃsthitaḥ | sahasā tena dṛṣṭo'sau hāhetyuktvā samutthitaḥ || 111.10 || tataḥ kruddhā mahādevī śāpavācamuvāca ha | vepamānā mahārāja śṛṇu yatte vadāmyaham || 111.11 || ahaṃ yasmātsuraiḥ sarvairyācitā putrajanmani | kṛtā ratiśca viphalā saṃpreṣya jātavedasam || 111.12 || tasmātsarve putrahīnā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | hareṇoktastato vahnirasmākaṃ bījamāvaha || 111.13 || yathā bhavati lokeṣu tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi | mama tejastvayā śakyaṃ gṛhītuṃ surasattama | devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ nānyaḥ śakto jagattraye || 111.14 || agniruvāca tejasastava me deva kā śaktirdhāraṇe vibho | karoti bhasmasātsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 111.15 || īśvara uvāca udarasthena bījena yadi te jāyate rujā | tadā kṣipasva tattejo gaṅgātoye hutāśana || 111.16 || evamuktvā mahādevo'moghaṃ bījamuttamam | havyavāhamukhe sarvaṃ prakṣipyāntaradhīyata || 111.17 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve dahyamāno hutāśanaḥ | gaṅgātoye vinikṣipya jagāma svaṃniveśanam || 111.18 || asahantī tu tattejo gaṅgāpi saritāṃ varā | śarastambe vinikṣipya jagāmāśu yathāgatam || 111.19 || tatra jātaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ | kṛttikāṃ preṣayāmāsuḥ stanyaṃ pāyayituṃ tadā || 111.20 || dṛṣṭvā tā āgatāḥ sarvā gaṅgāgarbhe mahāmateḥ | ṣaṇmukhaiḥ ṣaṇmukho bhūtvā pipāsurapibatstanam || 111.21 || jātakarmādisaṃskārānvedoktānpadmasambhavaḥ | cakāra sarvāndājendra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 111.22 || ṣaṇmukhātṣaṇmukho nāma kārttikeyastu kṛttikāt | kumāraśca kumāratvādgaṅgāgarbho'gnijo'paraḥ || 111.23 || evaṃ kumāraḥ sambhūto hyanadhītya sa vedavit | śāstrāṇyanekāni veda cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 111.24 || devāraṇyeṣu sarveṣu nadīṣu ca nadeṣu ca | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni samudrādyāni bhārata || 111.25 || tataḥ paryāyayogena narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 111.26 || ṛgyajuḥsāmavihitaṃ japañjāpyamaharniśam | dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ śucirdhamanisaṃtataḥ || 111.27 || tato varṣasahasrānte pūrṇe devo maheśvaraḥ | umayā sahitaḥ kāle tadā vacanamabravīt || 111.28 || īśvara uvāca ahaṃ te varadastāta gaurī mātā pitā hyaham | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yacceṣṭaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || 111.29 || ṣaṇmukha uvāca yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṅkara | vṛṇomi mātāpitarau nānyā gatirmatirmama || 111.30 || etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ putrasya vadanāccyutam | tathetyuktvā tu snehena premṇā taṃ pariṣasvaje || 111.31 || tatastaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya hyumayovāca śaṅkaraḥ || 111.32 || īśvara uvāca akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva senānīstvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 111.33 || śikhī ca te vāhanaṃ divyarūpo datto mayā śaktidharasya saṃkhye | surāsurādīṃśca jayeti coktvā jagāma kailāsavaraṃ mahātmā || 111.34 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve tadā sa śikhivāhanaḥ | sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma surasannidhau || 111.35 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ skandatīrthamiti śrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ martyānāṃ bhuvi durlabham || 111.36 || tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanbhaktyā snātvārcayecchivam | gandhamālyābhiṣekaiśca yājñikaṃ sa labhetphalam || 111.37 || skandatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ | tilamiśreṇa toyena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 111.38 || piṇḍadānena caikena vidhiyuktena bhārata | dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 111.39 || tatra tīrthe tu rājendra śubhaṃ vā yādi vāśubham | iha loke pare caiva tatsarvaṃ jāyate'kṣayam || 111.40 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati | śāstrayuktena vidhinā sa gacchecchivamandiram || 111.41 || kalpamekaṃ vasitvā tu devagandharvapūjitaḥ | atra bhāratavarṣe tu jāyate vimale kule || 111.42 || vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || 111.43 || idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanskandatīrthasya sambhavam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam || 111.44 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe skandatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.112>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthamāṅgirasasya tu | uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpavināśanam || 112.1 || purāsīdaṅgirānāma brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ | putrahetoryugasyādau cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 112.2 || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī japandevaṃ sanātanam | pūjayaṃśca mahādevaṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ || 112.3 || dvādaśābde tataḥ pūrṇe tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ | vareṇa chandayāmāsa dvijamāṅgirasaṃ varam || 112.4 || vavre sa tu mahādevaṃ putraṃ putravatāṃ varam | vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam || 112.5 || devānāṃ mantriṇaṃ rājan sarvalokeṣu pūjitam | brahmalakṣmyāḥ sadāvāsamakṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ sutam || 112.6 || tathābhilaṣitaḥ putraḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ | bhaviṣyati na sandehaścaivamuktvā yayau haraḥ || 112.7 || varairaṅgirasaścāpi bṛhaspatirajāyata | yathābhilaṣitaḥ putro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 112.8 || jāte putre'ṅgirāstatra sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram | hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā bhūtvā jagāmottaraparvatam || 112.9 || tatra cāṅgirase tīrthe yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivam | sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 112.10 || aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt | icchate yaśca yaṃ kāmaṃ sa taṃ labhati mānavaḥ || 112.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'gnirasatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.113>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra koṭitīrthamanuttamam | ṛṣikoṭirgatā tatra parāṃ siddhimupāgatā || 113.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchuciḥ | ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 113.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pūjite tu mahādeve vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 113.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikaśātatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.114>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | ayonijaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 114.1 || ayonije naraḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | pitṛdevārcanaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 114.2 || tatra tīrthe tu vidhinā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ | sa kadācinmahārāja yonidvāraṃ na paśyati || 114.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayonisambhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.115>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthamaṅgārakaṃ param | rūpadaṃ sarvalokānāṃ viśrutaṃ narmadātaṭe || 115.1 || aṅgārakeṇa rājendra purā taptaṃ tapaḥ kila | arbudaṃ ca nikharvaṃ ca prayutaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā || 115.2 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa | pratyakṣadarśī bhagavānuvāca kṣitinandanam || 115.3 || varado'smi mahābhāga durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi | varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa brūhi yatte vivakṣitam || 115.4 || aṅgāraka uvāca tava prasādāddeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara | grahamadhyagato nityaṃ vicarāmi nabhastale || 115.5 || yāvaddharādharo loke yāvaccandradivākarau | nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca varo me cākṣayo bhavet || 115.6 || evamastviti deveśo dattvā varamanuttamam | jagāmākāśamāviśya vandyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 115.7 || bhūmiputrastatastasminsthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram | gataḥ surālaye loke grahabhāve niveśitaḥ || 115.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | hutahomo jitakrodhaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 115.9 || caturthyaṅgārake yastu snātvā cābhyarcayedgraham | aṅgārakaṃ vidhānena saptajanmāni bhārata || 115.10 || daśayojanavistīrṇe maṇḍale rūpavān bhavet | tatraiva tā mṛto jantuḥ kāmato'kāmato'pi vā | rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate || 115.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṅgārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.116>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca pāṇḍutīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpavināśanam | tatra snātvā naro rājanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 116.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dāpayetkāñcanaṃ śuciḥ | bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 116.2 || piṇḍodakapradānena vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet | pitaraḥ pitāmahāśca nṛtyante ca praharṣitāḥ || 116.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pāṇḍutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.117>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ trilocanam | tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 117.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyārcayati śaṅkaram | rudrasya bhavanaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 117.2 || kalpakṣaye tataḥ pūrṇe krīḍitvā ca ihāgataḥ | āviyogena tiṣṭheta pūjyamānaḥ śataṃ samāḥ || 117.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe trilocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.118>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | indratīrthetivikhyātaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe || 118.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle indratīrthaṃ kathaṃ bhavet | śrotumicchāmi viprendra hyādimadhyāntavistaraiḥ || 118.2 || etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ | kathayāmāsa tadvattamitihāsaṃ purātanam || 118.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca viśvāsayitvā suciraṃ dharmaśatruṃ mahābalam | vṛtraṃ jitvātha hatvā tu gacchamānaṃ śacīpatim || 118.4 || niṣkrāmamāṇaṃ mārgeṇa brahmahatyā durāsadā | ahorātramaviśrāntā jagāma bhuvanatrayam || 118.5 || yatoyato brahmahaṇaṃ yāti yānena śobhanam | diśo bhāgaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tato hatyā na muñcati || 118.6 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaganāgamaḥ | pātakānāṃ gatirdṛṣṭā na tu viśvāsaghātinām || 118.7 || pāpakarmamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānadānairviśudhyati | nārī vā puruṣo vāpi naiva viśvāsaghātinaḥ || 118.8 || evamādīni cānyāni śrutvā vākyāni devarāṭ | vacanaṃ tadvidhairuktaṃ viṣādamagamatparam || 118.9 || tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma tapa uttamam | putradāragṛhaṃ rājyaṃ vasūni vividhāni ca || 118.10 || phalānyetāni dharmasya śobhayanti janeśvaram | phalaṃ dharmasya bhuñjeti suhṛtsvajanabāndhavāḥ || 118.11 || paśyatāṃ sarvameteṣāṃ pāpamekena bhujyate | paraṃ hi sukhamutsṛjya karśayanvai kalevaram || 118.12 || devarājo jagāmāsau tīrthānyāyatanāni ca | gaṅgātīrtheṣu sarveṣu yāmuneṣu tathaiva ca || 118.13 || sārasvateṣu sarveṣu sāmudreṣu pṛthakpṛthak | nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca || 118.14 || pāpaṃ na muñcate sarve paścāddevasamāgame | revāprabhavatīrtheṣu kūlayorubhayorapi || 118.15 || pūjayanvai mahādevaṃ skandatīrthaṃ samāsadat | tava sthitvopavāsaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ || 118.16 || karśayanvai svakaṃ dehaṃ na lebhe śarma vai kvacit | grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ || 118.17 || ārdravāsāstu hemante cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | evaṃ tu tapatastasya indrasya viditātmanaḥ || 118.18 || vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gatāni daśa bhārata | tatastvekādaśe prāpte varṣe tu nṛpasattama || 118.19 || sahasā bhagavāndevastu tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ | tathā brahmarṣayaḥ siddhā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || 118.20 || tatrājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve yatra devaḥ śatakratuḥ | dṛṣṭvā samāgatān devānṛṣīṃścaiva mahāmatiḥ || 118.21 || uvāca praṇato bhūtvā sarvadevapurohitaḥ | viditaṃ sarvameteṣāṃ yathā vṛtravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 118.22 || yuṣmākaṃ cājñayā pūrvaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | tathāpyevaṃ brahmahaṇaṃ matvā pāpasya kāriṇam || 118.23 || bhramantaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati | na nandati jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 118.24 || yathā vihīnacandrārkaṃ tathā rājyamanāyakam | tasmātsarve suraśreṣṭhā vijñāpyaṃ mama samprati || 118.25 || kurvantu śakraṃ nirdoṣaṃ tathā sarve maharṣayaḥ | bṛhaspatimukhodgīrṇaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ śubham || 118.26 || tataḥ provāca bhagavānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | etatpāpaṃ mahāghoraṃ brahmahatyāsamudbhavam || 118.27 || daivatebhyo'tha bhūtebhyaścaturbhāgaṃ kṣipāmyaham | evaṃ muktvā kṣipaccaino jalopari mahāmatiḥ || 118.28 || avagāhya tataḥ peyā āpo vai nānyathā budhaiḥ | dharāyāmakṣipadbhāgaṃ dvitīyaṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ || 118.29 || abhakṣyā tena saṃjātā sadākālaṃ vasuṃdharā | tadārdhamarddhaṃ nārīṇāṃ dvitīye'hni yudhiṣṭhira || 118.30 || nikṣipya bhagavāndevaḥ punaranyajjagāda ha | asaṃgrāhyā tvasaṃgrāhyā tena jātā rajasvalā || 118.31 || caturdināni sā prājñaiḥ pāpasya mahato mahāt | caturthaṃ tu tato bhāgaṃ vibhajya parameśvaraḥ || 118.32 || kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaiḥ śūdrasevākare dvije | tato'bhinandayāmāsuḥ sarve devā maharṣayaḥ || 118.33 || devendraṃ vāgbhiriṣṭābhirnarmadājalasaṃsthitam | vareṇa chandayāmāsa tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 118.34 || varaṃ dāsyāmi deveśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam || 118.35 || indra uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | atra saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi sadā saṃnihito bhava || 118.36 || evamastviti coktvā taṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | jagmurākāśamāviśya stūyamānā maharṣibhiḥ || 118.37 || gateṣu devadeveṣu devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ | sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma tridaśālayam || 118.38 || indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | mahāpātakayukto'pi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 118.39 || indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | so'śvamedhasya yajñasya puṣkalaṃ phalamaśnute || 118.40 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | śrutamātreṇa yenaiva mucyante pātakairnarāḥ || 118.41 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe indratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.119>
