śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra kahloḍītīrthamuttamam | revāyāścottare kūle sarvapāpavināśanam || 119.1 || hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāmṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaṃ purā | tapasā tu samuddhṛtya narmadāyāṃ mahāmbhasi || 119.2 || snātvā tu kapilātīrthe kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati | śrutvā cākhyānakaṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇāñchṛṇu yatphalam || 119.3 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kapilādānamuttamam | brāhmaṇānveṣitaṃ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame || 119.4 || sadyaḥ prasūtāṃ kapilāṃ śobhanāṃ yaḥ prayacchati | sopavāso jitakrodhastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 119.5 || sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā | dattā caiva mahābāho pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 119.6 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam | naśyate kapilāṃ dattvā saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛpa || 119.7 || bhūmidānaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvakanakādikam | kapilādānasyaikasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 119.8 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati | mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti gīyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 119.9 || yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyāstu bhārata | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sa svarge krīḍate ciram || 119.10 || tato'vakīrṇakālena tviha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ | dhanadhānyasamopeto jāyate vipule kule || 119.11 || vedavidyā vratasnātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ | vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 119.12 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam | yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 119.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kahloḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.120>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kambukeśvaramuttamam | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo dānavo baladarpitaḥ || 120.1 || avadhyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma nāmataḥ || 120.2 || viṣṇuprasādādbhaktyā ca tasya rājye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | virocanastasya sutastasyāpi balireva ca || 120.3 || baliputro'bhavadbāṇastasmādapi ca śambaraḥ | śambarasyānvaye jātaḥ kamburnāma mahāsuraḥ || 120.4 || jñātvā viṣṇumayaṃ ghoraṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam | dānavānāṃ vināśāya nānyo hetuḥ kadācana || 120.5 || sa tyaktvā putradārāṃśca suhṛdbandhuparigrahān | cacāra maunamāsthāya tapaḥ kamburmahāmatiḥ || 120.6 || akṣasūtrakaro bhūtvā daṇḍī muṇḍī ca mekhalī | śākayāvakabhakṣaśca valkalājinasaṃvṛtaḥ || 120.7 || snātvā nityaṃ dhṛtiparo narmadājalamāśritaḥ | pūjayaṃstu mahādevamarbudaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā || 120.8 || tatastutoṣa bhagavāndevadevo maheśvaraḥ | uvāca dānavaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā || 120.9 || bhobhoḥ kambo mahābhāga tuṣṭo'haṃ tava suvrata | iṣṭaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ maunaṃ sarvārthasādhanam || 120.10 || caritaṃ ca tvayā loke devadānavaduścaram | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi rocate || 120.11 || kamburuvāca yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva svecchayā vicarāmyaham || 120.12 || daityadānavasaṅghānāṃ saṃyugeṣvapalāyitā | bhayaṃ cānyanna vidyeta muktvā devaṃ gadādharam || 120.13 || tasyāhaṃ saṃyuge sādhyo yenopāyena śaṅkara | bhavāmi na sadā kālaṃ taṃ vadasva varaṃ mama || 120.14 || īśvara uvāca mama saṃnihito yatra tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi dānava | tatra viṣṇubhayaṃ nāsti vasātra vigatajvaraḥ || 120.15 || tasya devādhidevasya vedagarbhasya saṃyuge | śaṅkhacakradharasyeśā nāhaṃ sarve surāsurāḥ || 120.16 || kiṃ punaryo dviṣatyenaṃ lokālokaprabhuṃ harim | sa sukhī vartate kālaṃ na nimeṣaṃ mataṃ mama || 120.17 || tasmāttvaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ | vasiṣyasi ciraṃ kālamityuktvādarśanaṃ gataḥ || 120.18 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve tatra tīrthe mahāmatiḥ | sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śivaṃ śāntamanāmayam || 120.19 || tasmiṃstīrthe mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā divaṃ gataḥ | tadāprabhṛti tatpārtha kambutīrthamiti śrutam | vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam || 120.20 || kambutīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhinābhyarcya bhāskaram | ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca stūyamāno nṛpottama || 120.21 || tasya puṇyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | tatsarvaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvādya mamaiva gadato nṛpa || 120.22 || ṛgyajuḥsāmagīteṣu sāṅgopāṅgeṣu yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gāyatrīmātramantravit || 120.23 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 120.24 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe kalevaram | yastyajennātra sandeho rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 120.25 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kambukeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.121>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla candrahāsamataḥ param | yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somarājaḥ surottamaḥ || 121.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ | tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha || 121.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata | asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi || 121.3 || udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam | yā niṣṭhā jāyate nṛṇāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 121.4 || ṛtāvṛtau hi nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ | sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca ityevaṃ śrutibhāṣitam || 121.5 || tatkālocitadharmeṇa veṣṭito raurave patet | tasyāstadrudhiraṃ pāpaḥ pibate kālamīpsitam || 121.6 || tato'vatīrṇaḥ kālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati | tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā || 121.7 || nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo'bhyadhikāḥ parivartate | viśeṣeṇa ṛtau kāle pīḍyate kāmasāyakaiḥ || 121.8 || paribhūtā hitā bhartrā dhyāyante'nyaṃ patiṃ striyaḥ | tataḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam || 121.9 || svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvajāste pitāmahāḥ | patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate || 121.10 || tena karmavipākena kṣayarogyabhavacchaśī | tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ || 121.11 || tatastīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | bhramanvai narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm || 121.12 || upavāsaṃ ca dānāni vratāni niyamāṃstathā | cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ || 121.13 || snāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ sa ca lokamanuttamam || 121.14 || yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke sa pūjyate || 121.15 || tena devānvidhānoktānsthāpayanti narā bhuvi | akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātkālaṃ bhuñjanti mānavāḥ || 121.16 || somatīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram | sa bhrājate naro loke somavatpriyadarśanaḥ || 121.17 || candrahāse tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 121.18 || tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāse śubhāśubham | kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 121.19 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | candrahāse tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ || 121.20 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam | snānamātreṇa rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati || 121.21 || bahavastaṃ na jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ | dehasthamiva sarveṣāṃ paramānandarūpiṇam || 121.22 || paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam | tatsamagramavāpnoti candrahāse na saṃśayaḥ || 121.23 || saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā | candrahāse naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 121.24 || te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam | candrahāsaṃ na jānanti ye revāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 121.25 || candrahāse tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute dvijaḥ | anivartikā gatistasya somalokānna saṃśayaḥ || 121.26 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.122>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla kohanasveti viśrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam || 122.1 || purā tatra dvijaḥ kaścidvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | patnīputrasuhṛdvargaiḥ svakarmanirato'vasat || 122.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca brāhmaṇasya tu yatkarma utpattiḥ kṣatriyasya tu | vaiśyasyāpi ca śūdrasya tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me || 122.3 || dharmasyārhasya kāmasya mokṣasya ca paraṃ vidhim | nikhilaṃ jñātumicchāmi nānyo vettā matirmama || 122.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca utpattikāraṇaṃ brahmā devadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | prathamaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ carācarajagadguruḥ || 122.5 || dvijātayo mukhājjātāḥ kṣatriyā bāhuyantrataḥ | ūrupradeśādvaiśyāstu śūdrāḥ pādeṣvathābhavan || 122.6 || tatastvanye pṛthagvarṇāḥ pṛthagdharmān samācaran | paryāyeṇa samutpannā hyanulomavilomataḥ || 122.7 || teṣāṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrutismṛtyarthacoditam | yena samyakkṛtenaiva sarve yānti parāṃ gatim || 122.8 || gatirdhyānaṃ vinā bhaktairbrāhmaṇaiḥ prāpyate nṛpa | adhyāpayanyato vedānvedaṃ vāpi yathāvidhi || 122.9 || kulajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām | udvāhayettataḥ patnīṃ guruṇānumate tadā || 122.10 || tataḥ smārtaṃ vivāhāgniṃ śrautaṃ vā pūjayetkramāt | pratigrahadhano bhūtvā dambhalobhavivarjitaḥ || 122.11 || pañcayajñavidhānāni kārayedvai yathāvidhi | vanaṃ gacchettataḥ paścāddvitīyāśramasevanāt || 122.12 || putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ | iṣṭāṃllokānavāpnoti na ceha jāyate punaḥ || 122.13 || kṣatriyastu sthito rājye pālayitvā vasuṃdharām | śaśvaddharmamanāścaiva prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 122.14 || vaiśyadharmo na sandehaḥ kṛṣigorakṣaṇe rataḥ | satyaśaucasamopeto gacchate svargamuttamam || 122.15 || na śūdrasya pṛthagdharmo vihitaḥ parameṣṭhinā | na mantro na ca saṃskāro na vidyāparisevanam || 122.16 || na śabdavidyāsamayo devatābhyarcanāni ca | yathā jātena satataṃ vartitavyamaharniśam || 122.17 || sa dharmaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā | mantrasaṃskārasampannāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ || 122.18 || teṣāṃ matamanādṛtya yadi varteta kāmataḥ | sa mṛto jāyate śvā vai gatirūrdhvā na vidyate || 122.19 || na teṣāṃ preṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ teṣāṃ matamanusmaran | yaśobhāgī svadharmasthaḥ svargabhāgī sa jāyate || 122.20 || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo'vasadvipraḥ sa bhārata | hanasveti hanasveti śṛṇoti vākyamīdṛśam || 122.21 || tato nirīkṣate cordhvamadhaścaiva diśo daśa | vepamānaḥ sa bhītaśca praskhalaṃśca pade pade || 122.22 || śṛṅkhalāyudhahastaiśca pāśaiścaiva sudāruṇaiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ naraṃ paśyati manmukham || 122.23 || kṛṣṇāṃjanacayaprakhyaṃ kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣitam | raktākṣamāyatabhujaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 122.24 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu samāyāntaṃ nirīkṣyātmānamātmanā | japañjāpyaṃ ca paramaṃ śatarudrīyasaṃstavam || 122.25 || tataḥ provāca bhagavānyamaḥ saṃyamano mahān | śṛṇu vākyamato brahmanyamo'haṃ sarvajantuṣu || 122.26 || saṃharasva mahābhāga rudrajāpyaṃ sudurbhidam | yenāhaṃ kālapāśaistvāṃ saṃyamāmi gatavyathaḥ || 122.27 || tacchrutvā niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ yamasya mukhanirgatam | mahābhayasamopeto brāhmaṇaḥ prapalāyitaḥ || 122.28 || tasya mārge gatāḥ sarve yamena saha kiṃkarāḥ | tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti taṃ vipramūcuste so'pyadhāvata || 122.29 || tvaramāṇaḥ pariśrānto hā hato'haṃ durātmabhiḥ | rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala || 122.30 || evamuktvāpatadbhūmau liṅgamāliṅgya bhārata | gatasattvaḥ sa viprendraḥ samāśritya sureśvaram || 122.31 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau devadevo maheśvaraḥ | ko haniṣyati mābhaistvaṃ huṅkāramakarottadā || 122.32 || tena te kiṃkarāḥ sarve yamena saha bhārata | huṅkāreṇa gatāḥ sarve meghā vātahatā yathā || 122.33 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kohanasveti viśrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam || 122.34 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyanuttamam || 122.35 || tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ | na paśyati yamaṃ devamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 122.36 || agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryājjale vā nṛpasattama | agniloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpaśatatrayam || 122.37 || evaṃ varuṇaloke'pi vasitvā kālamīpsitam | iha lokamanuprāpto mahādhanapatirbhavet || 122.38 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kohanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.123>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra karmadītīrthamuttamam | yatra tiṣṭhati vighneśo gaṇanātho mahābalaḥ || 123.1 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ vā hyupoṣitaḥ | vighnaṃ na vidyate tasya saptajanmani bhārata || 123.2 || tatra tīrthe hi yatkiṃciddīyate nṛpasattama | tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 123.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karmadeśvaratīrthamāhatmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.124>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadeśvaramuttamam | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 124.1 || agnipraveśaśca jale'thavā mṛtyuranāśake | anivartikā gatistasya yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt || 124.2 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.125>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla ravitīrthamanuttamam | yatra devaḥ sahasrāṃśustapastaptvā divaṃ gataḥ || 125.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ | tapastapati deveśastāpaso bhāskaro raviḥ || 125.2 || ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevaiśca pūjitaḥ | pratyakṣo dṛśyate loke sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 125.3 || ādityatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ bhāskara ucyate | sarvametatsamāsena kathayasva mamānagha || 125.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca mahāpraśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ | tatsarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayambhuvam || 125.5 || āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam | apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ prasuptamiva sarvataḥ || 125.6 || tatastejaśca divyaṃ ca taptapiṇḍamanuttamam | ākāśāttu yathaivolkā sṛṣṭihetoradhomukhī || 125.7 || tattejaso'ntaḥ puruṣaḥ saṃjātaḥ sarvabhūṣitaḥ | sa śivo'pāṇipādaśca yena sarvamidaṃ tatam || 125.8 || tasyotpannasya bhūtasya tejo rūpasya bhārata | paścātprajāpatirbhūyaḥ kālaḥ kālāntareṇa vai || 125.9 || agnirjātaḥ sa bhūtānāṃ manuṣyāsurarakṣasām | sarvadevādhidevaśca ādityastena cocyate || 125.10 || ādau tasya namaskāro'nyeṣāṃ ca tadanantaram | kriyate daivataiḥ sarvaistena sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ || 125.11 || tisraḥ sandhyāstrayo devāḥ sāṃnidhyāḥ sūryamaṇḍale | namaskṛtena sūryeṇa sarve devā namaskṛtāḥ || 125.12 || na divā na bhavedrātriḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam | ayanaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi bhāskareṇa vinā nṛpa || 125.13 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam | na vartate vinā sūryaṃ tena pūjyatamo raviḥ || 125.14 || śabdagāḥ śrutimukhyāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | pratyakṣo bhagavāndevo dṛśyate lokapāvanaḥ || 125.15 || utpattiḥ pralayasthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam | hetureko jagannātho nānyo vidyeta bhāskarāt || 125.16 || evamātmabhavaṃ kṛtvā jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | lokānāṃ tu hitārthāya sthāpayeddharmapaddhatim || 125.17 || narmadātaṭamāśritya sthāpayitvātmanastanum | sahasrāṃśuṃ nidhiṃ dhāmnāṃ jagāmākāśamavyayam || 125.18 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ nāmamantravidhānataḥ || 125.19 || tena taptaṃ hutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam | tena samyagvidhānena samprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam || 125.20 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | snātvā ye narmadātoye devaṃ paśyanti bhāskaram || 125.21 || tathā devasya rājendra ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam | ananyabhaktyā satataṃ trirakṣarasamanvitāḥ || 125.22 || tena pūtaśarīrāste mantreṇa gatapātakāḥ | yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavetteṣāṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu || 125.23 || sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā sarvā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 125.24 || mantramūlamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | tena mantravihīnaṃ tu kāryaṃ loke na sidhyati || 125.25 || yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ | kāryārthaṃ naiva sidhyeta tathā karma hyamantrakam || 125.26 || bhasmahutaṃ pārtha yathā toyavivarjitam | niṣphalaṃ jāyate dānaṃ tathā mantravivarjitam || 125.27 || kāṣṭhapāṣāṇaloṣṭeṣu mṛnmayeṣu viśeṣataḥ | mantreṇa loke pūjāṃ tu kurvanti na hyamantrataḥ || 125.28 || dvādaśābdānnamaskārādbhaktyā yallabhate phalam | mantrayuktanamaskārātsakṛttallabhate phalam || 125.29 || saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā | narmadāyā jale snātvā yastu pūjayate ravim || 125.30 || dvādaśābdena yatpāpamajñānajñānasaṃcitam | tatkṣaṇānnaśyate sarvaṃ vahninā tu tuṣaṃ yathā || 125.31 || candrasūryagrahe snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | tatrādityamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 125.32 || māghamāse tu samprāpte saptamyāṃ nṛpasattama | sopavāso jitakrodha uṣitvā sūryamandire || 125.33 || prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena dadātyarghaṃ divākare | vidhinā mantrayuktena sa labhetpuṇyamuttamam || 125.34 || pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ kṛtvā hyudakatarpaṇam | mandire devadevasya tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret || 125.35 || gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpanaivedyaśobhanaiḥ | pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato mantramudīrayet || 125.36 || viṣṇuḥ śakro yamo dhātā mitro'tha varuṇastathā | vivasvānsavitā pūṣā caṇḍāṃśurbharga eva ca || 125.37 || iti dvādaśanāmāni japankṛtvā pradakṣiṇām | yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu || 125.38 || daridro vyādhito mūko badhiro jaḍa eva ca | na bhavetsapta janmāni ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 125.39 || evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena japanmantraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | ārādhayedraviṃ bhaktyā ya icchetpuṇyamuttamam || 125.40 || mantrahīnāṃ tu yaḥ kuryādbhaktiṃ devasya bhārata | sa viḍambati cātmānaṃ paśukīṭapataṅgavat || 125.41 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścittyajate dehamuttamam | sa gatastatra devaistu pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ || 125.42 || svecchayā suciraṃ kālamiha loke nṛpo bhavet || 125.43 || putrapautrasamāyukto hastyaśvarathasaṅkulaḥ | dāsīdāsaśatopeto jāyate vipule kule || 125.44 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.126>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra paraṃ tīrthamayonijam | snātamātro narastatra na paśyedyonisaṅkaṭam || 126.1 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram | ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara || 126.2 || tathā mocaya māṃ deva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt | gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca sa mucyetsarvapātakaiḥ || 126.3 || tasya devasya yo bhaktyā kurute liṅgapūraṇam | sa vaseddevadevasya yāvatsikthasya saṃkhyayā || 126.4 || ayonije mahādevaṃ snāpayedgandhavāriṇā | madhukṣīreṇa dadhnā vā sa labhedvipulāṃ śriyam || 126.5 || aṣṭabhyāṃ ca site pakṣe asitāṃ vā caturdaśīm | pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ prīṇayedgītavādyakaiḥ || 126.6 || vasetsa ca śive loke ye kurvanti manoharam | te vasanti śive loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 126.7 || tasya devasya bhaktyā tu yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām | vijñāpayaṃśca satataṃ mantreṇānena bhārata || 126.8 || tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ pāramparyeṇa mānavaiḥ | sakāśāddevadevasya tacchṛṇuṣva samādhinā || 126.9 || ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara | tathā mocaya māṃ śarva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt || 126.10 || kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ kaṃṭhaśoṣaṇatatparaiḥ | yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti proktaṃ devasya saṃnidhau || 126.11 || tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam | yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti mantrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ || 126.12 || na tatphalamavāpnoti sarvadeveṣu vai dvijaḥ | yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ṣaḍakṣara udīraṇāt || 126.13 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivayoginam | dvijānāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ sa labhetphalamuttamam || 126.14 || athavā bhaktiyuktastu teṣāṃ dānte jitendriye | saṃskṛtya dadate bhikṣāṃ phalaṃ tasya tato'dhikam || 126.15 || yatihaste jalaṃ dadyādbhikṣāṃ dattvā punarjalam | sā bhikṣā meruṇā tulyā tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam || 126.16 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayoniprabhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.127>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam | tatra snātvā tu pakṣādau mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 127.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadyātsvayamalaṃkṛtām | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narottama || 127.2 || agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ śataṃ śataguṇīkṛtam | prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā hyalaṃkṛtām || 127.3 || tasyāḥ putraprapautrāṇāṃ yā bhavedromasaṃgatiḥ | sa yāti tena mānena śivaloke parāṃ gatim || 127.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.128>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra bhṛkuṭeśvaramuttamam | yatra siddho mahābhāgo bhṛguḥ paramakopanaḥ || 128.1 || tena varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha | putrārthaṃ varayāmāsa putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ || 128.2 || varo datto mahābhāga devenāndhakaghātinā | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram || 128.3 || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet | bhṛkuṭeśaṃ tu yaḥ kaścidghṛtena madhunā saha || 128.4 || putrārthī snāpayedbhaktyā sa labhetputramīpsitam | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyādviprāya kāñcanam || 128.5 || godānaṃ vā mahīṃ vāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 128.6 || sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā | dattā pṛthvī na sandehastena sarvā nṛpottama || 128.7 || tena dānena sa svarge krīḍayitvā yathāsukham | martye bhavati rājendro brāhmaṇo vā supūjitaḥ || 128.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛkuṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.129>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla brahmatīrthamanuttamam | anyeṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ parātparataraṃ mahat || 129.1 || tatra tīrthe suraśreṣṭho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 129.2 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam | tatkṣālayati deveśo darśanādeva pātakam || 129.3 || śrutismṛtyuditānyeva tatra snātvā dvijarṣabhāḥ | prāyaścittāni kurvanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape || 129.4 || ye punaḥ śāstramutsṛjya kāmalobhaprapīḍitāḥ | prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 129.5 || snātvādau pātakī brahmannatvā tu kīrtayedagham | tasya tannaśyate kṣipraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 129.6 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ | agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa labhetphalamuttamam || 129.7 || tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ brahmoddiśya prayacchati | tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 129.8 || gāyatrīsāramātro'pi tatra yaḥ kriyate japaḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmasahitaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ || 129.9 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajeddehaṃ sudustyajam | anivartikā gatistasya brahmalokānna saṃśayaḥ || 129.10 || yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti brahmatīrthe ca dehinām | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi devaloke mahīyate || 129.11 || avatīrṇastato loke brahmajño jāyate kule | uttamaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ devānāmiva devatā || 129.12 || vidyāsthānāni sarvāṇi vetti vedāṅgapāragaḥ | jāyate pūjito loke rājabhiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ || 129.13 || putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmatīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 129.14 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavatāṃ varam | ye paśyanti mahātmāno hyamṛtatvaṃ prayānti te || 129.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.130>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle devatīrthamanuttamam | tatra devaiḥ samāgatya toṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 130.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ | sa labhennātra sandeho gosahasraphalaṃ dhruvam || 130.2 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.131>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle nāgatīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddhā mahānāgā bhaye jāte tato nṛpa || 131.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca mahābhayānāṃ lokasya nāgānāṃ dvijasattama | kathaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ yena te tapasi sthitāḥ || 131.2 || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca yatsurāsuramānave | tāta te viditaṃ sarvaṃ tena me kautukaṃ mahat || 131.3 || mama saṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam | tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gatam || 131.4 || śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm | bhūyo bhūyaḥ smṛtirjātā śravaṇe mama suvrata || 131.5 || na kleśatvaṃ dvije yuktaṃ na cānyo jānate phalam | vidyādānasya mahataḥ śrāvitasya sutasya ca || 131.6 || evaṃ jñātvā yathānyāyaṃ yaḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchito mayā | kathā tu kathyatāṃ vipra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 131.7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca yathā yathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathā tathā me sukhameti bhāratī | śaithilyabhāvājjarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta || 131.8 || kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam | kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata || 131.9 || dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame | garutmato vai vinatā sarpāṇāṃ kadrureva ca || 131.10 || aśvasaṃdarśanāttābhyāṃ kalirūpaṃ vyavasthitam | prabhātakāle rājendra bhāskarākāravarcasam || 131.11 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā rūpamaśvaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram | atha tāṃ kadrūmavocatsā paśya paśya varānane || 131.12 || uccaiḥśravasaḥ sādṛśyaṃ paśya sarvatra pāṇḍuram | dhāvamānamaviśrāntaṃ javena pavanopamam || 131.13 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā yāntamīrṣyābhāvena mohitā | kṛṣṇaṃ matvā tathājalpattayā saha nṛpottama || 131.14 || vinate tvaṃ mṛṣā loke nṛśaṃse kulapāṃsani | kṛṣṇaṃ cainaṃ vada śvetaṃ narakaṃ yāsyase param || 131.15 || vinatovāca satyānṛte tu vacane paṇo'yaṃ te mamaiva tu | sahasraṃ vatsarāndāsī bhaveyaṃ tava veśmani || 131.16 || tatheti te pratijñāya rātrau gatvā svakaṃ gṛham | parityajya ubhe te tu krodhamūrchitamūrchite || 131.17 || bandhugarvasya gatvā tu kathayāmāsa taṃ paṇam | kadrūrvinatayā sārddhaṃ yadvṛttaṃ pramadālaye || 131.18 || tacchrutvā bāndhavāḥ sarve kadrūputrāstathaiva ca | na manyante hitaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mātrā vigarhitam || 131.19 || akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇatāmamba kathaṃ gaccheddhayottamaḥ | dāsatvaṃ prāpsyase tvaṃ hi paṇenānena suvrate || 131.20 || kadrūruvāca bhaveyaṃ na yathādāsī tatkurudhvaṃ hi satvaram | viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu tasyāśvasya matirmama || 131.21 || kṣaṇamātraṃ kṛte kārye sā dāsī ca bhavenmama | tataḥ svasthoragāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham || 131.22 || sarpā ūcuḥ | yathā tvaṃ jananī devi pannagānāṃ matā bhuvi | tathāpi sā viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na karhicit || 131.23 || kadrūruvāca mama vākyamakurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ | havyavāhamukhaṃ sarve te yāsyantyavicāritāḥ || 131.24 || etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ ghoraṃ mātṛmukhodbhavam | kecitpraviṣṭā romāṇi tathānye girisaṃsthitāḥ || 131.25 || kecitpraviṣṭā jāhnavyāmanye ca tapasi sthitāḥ || 131.26 || tato varṣasahasrānte tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ | mahādevo jagaddhātā hyuvāca parayā girā || 131.27 || bho bhoḥ sarpā nivartadhvaṃ tapaso'sya mahatphalam | yamicchatha dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 131.28 || sarpā ūcuḥ | kadrūśāpabhayādbhītā devadeva maheśvara | tava pārśve vasiṣyāmo yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 131.29 || devadeva uvāca ekaścāyaṃ mahābāhurvāsukirbhujagottamaḥ | mama pārśve vasennityaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhayarakṣakaḥ || 131.30 || anyeṣāṃ caiva sarpāṇāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti mamājñayā | āplutya narmadātoye bhujagāste ca rakṣitāḥ || 131.31 || nāsti mṛtyubhayaṃ teṣāṃ vasadhvaṃ yatra cepsitam | kadrūśāpabhayaṃ nāsti hyeṣa me vistaraḥ paraḥ || 131.32 || evaṃ dattvā varaṃ teṣāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ | jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam || 131.33 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve vāsukipramukhā nṛpa | sthāpayitvā tathā jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram || 131.34 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitpañcamyāmarcayecchivam | tasya nāgakulānyaṣṭau na hiṃsanti kadācana || 131.35 || mṛtaḥ kālena mahatā tatra tīrthe nareśvara | śivasyānucaro bhūtvā vasate kālamīpsitam || 131.36 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.132>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra uttare narmadātaṭe | sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 132.1 || tatra devo jagaddhātā vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | sthito lokahitārthāya saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ || 132.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddharaṇīdharam | gandhamālyaviśeṣaiśca jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ || 132.3 || upavāsaparo bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ nṛpasattama | vṛṣalāḥ pāpakarmāṇastathaivāndhapiśācinaḥ || 132.4 || ālāpādgātrasaṃparkānniḥśvāsātsahabhojanāt | pāpaṃ saṃkramate yasmāttasmāttān parivarjayet || 132.5 || brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyā yathāśaktyā yathāvidhi | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathāyāṃ tatra bhārata || 132.6 || prabhāte vimale snātvā tatra tīrthe jagadgurum | ye paśyanti jitakrodhāste muktāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ || 132.7 || yathā tu dṛṣṭvā bhujagāḥ suparṇaṃ naśyanti muktvā viṣamugratejaḥ | naśyanti pāpāni tathaiva śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ śūkararūpiṇastu || 132.8 || nabhogataṃ naśyati cāndhakāraṃ dṛṣṭvā raviṃ devavaraṃ tathaiva | naśyanti pāpāni sudustarāṇi dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ pārtha dharādharasya || 132.9 || kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantrairbhaktiryasya janārdane | namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 132.10 || eko'pi kṛṣṇasya kṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ | daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya || 132.11 || dhyāyamānā mahātmāno rūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hareḥ | ye tyajanti svakaṃ dehaṃ tatra tīrthe jitendriyāḥ || 132.12 || te gacchantyamalaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham | kṣarākṣaravinirmuktaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 132.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādivārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.133>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla paraṃ tīrthacatuṣṭayam | yeṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 133.1 || kauberaṃ vāruṇaṃ yāmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ tu tataḥ param | yatra siddhā mahāprājñā lokapālā mahābalāḥ || 133.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kimarthaṃ lokapālaiśca tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha | narmadātaṭamāśritya hyetanme vaktumarhasi || 133.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca adhiṣṭhānaṃ samicchanti hyacalaṃ nirbale sati | saṃsāre sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛṇabinduvadasthire || 133.4 || kadalīsāraniḥsāre mṛgatṛṣṇeva cañcale | sthāvare jaṅgame sarve bhūtagrāme caturvidhe || 133.5 || dharmo mātā pitā dharmo dharmo bandhuḥ suhṛttathā | ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ trailokye sacarācare || 133.6 || evaṃ jñātvā tu te sarve lokapālāḥ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ | tapaste cakruratulaṃ mārutāhāratatparāḥ || 133.7 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ kṛtasyārddhe gate tadā | anurūpeṇa rājendra yugasya parameśvaraḥ || 133.8 || vareṇa chandayāmāsa lokapālānmahābalān | yo yamicchati kāmaṃ vai taṃ taṃ tasya dadāmyaham || 133.9 || etacchrutvā vacastasya lokapālā jagaddhitāḥ | varadaṃ prārthayāmāsurdevaṃ varamanuttamam || 133.10 || kubera uvāca yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama | yakṣāṇāmīśvaraścāhaṃ bhavāmi dhanadastviti || 133.11 || tataḥ provāca deveśaṃ yamaḥ saṃyamane rataḥ | tatra pradhāno bhagavān bhaveyaṃ sarvajantuṣu || 133.12 || varuṇo'nantaraṃ prāha praṇamya tu maheśvaram | krīḍeyaṃ vāruṇe loke yādogaṇasamanvitaḥ || 133.13 || jagādāśu tato vāyuḥ praṇamya tu maheśvaram | vyāpakatvaṃ trilokeṣu prārthayāmāsa bhārata || 133.14 || teṣāṃ yadīpsitaṃ kāmamumayā saha śaṅkaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ lokapālānaḥ dattvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ || 133.15 || gate maheśvare deve yathāsthānaṃ tu te sthitāḥ | sthāpanā ca kṛtā sarvaiḥ svanāmnaiva pṛthakpṛthak || 133.16 || kuberaśca kubereśaṃ yamaścaiva yameśvaram | varuṇo varuṇeśaṃ tu vāto vāteśvaraṃ nṛpa || 133.17 || tarpaṇaṃ vidadhuḥ sarve mantraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sarve sarveśvaraṃ deva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 133.18 || āhvayāmāsustān viprānsarve sarveśvarā iva | kṣāntadāntajitakrodhānsarvabhūtābhayapradān || 133.19 || vedavidyāvratasnātān sarvaśāstraviśāradān | ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktāṃstathātharvavibhūṣitān || 133.20 || cāturvidhyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dānaṃ dāsyāma gṛhṇata | evamuktvā tu sarveṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ dānamuttamam || 133.21 || tatra sthāne dadusteṣāṃ bhūmidānamanuttamam | yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī || 133.22 || tāvaddānaṃ tu yuṣmākaṃ paripanthī na kaścana | rājā vā rājatulyo vā lokapālairanuttamam || 133.23 || dattaṃ lopayate mūḍhaḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya yo vidhiḥ | śoṣayeddhanado vittaṃ tasya pāpasya bhārata || 133.24 || śarīraṃ varuṇo devaḥ saṃtatīṃ śvasanastathā | āyurnayati tasyāśu yamaḥ saṃyamano mahān || 133.25 || niḥśeṣaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā hutabhugyāti bhārata | tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira | bhaktiḥ kāryā nṛpaiḥ sarvairicchadbhiḥ śreya ātmanaḥ || 133.26 || rājā vṛkṣo brāhmaṇāstasya mūlaṃ bhṛtyāḥ parṇā mantriṇastasya śākhāḥ | tasmānmūlaṃ yatnato rakṣaṇīyaṃ mūle gupte nāsti vṛkṣasya nāśaḥ || 133.27 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidaḥ | ācchettā cāvamantā ca tānyeva narake vaset || 133.28 || svadattā paradattā vā pālanīyā vasuṃdharā | yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalam || 133.29 || devatājñāmanusmṛtya rājāno ye'pi tāṃ nṛpa | pālayiṣyanti satataṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape || 133.30 || svadattā paradattā vā yatnādrakṣyā yudhiṣṭhira | mahī mahīkṣitā nityaṃ dānācchreyo'nupālanam || 133.31 || āyuryaśo balaṃ vittaṃ saṃtatiścākṣayā nṛpa | teṣāṃ bhaviṣyate nūnaṃ ye prajāpālane ratāḥ || 133.32 || evamuktvā tu tān sarvāṃllokapālān dvijottamān | pūjayitvā vidhānena praṇipatya vyasarjayan || 133.33 || gateṣu vipramukhyeṣu snātvā hutahutāśanāḥ | lokapālāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ paryaṭanbhaikṣamātmanaḥ || 133.34 || asthicarmāvaśeṣāṅgāḥ kapāloddhṛtapāṇayaḥ | alabdhagrāsamarddhārdhaṃ niryayurnagarādbahiḥ || 133.35 || śāpaṃ dattvā tadā krodhādbrāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira | daridrāḥ satataṃ mūrkhā bhaveyuśca yayurgṛhān || 133.36 || tadāprabhṛti te sarve brāhmaṇā dhanavarjitāḥ | śāpadoṣeṇa kauberyāṃ saṃjātā duḥkhabhājanāḥ || 133.37 || na dhanaṃ paitṛkaṃ putrairna pitā putrapautrikam | bhuñjate sakalaṃ kālamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 133.38 || kubereśo naraḥ snātvā yastu pūjayate śivam | gandhadhūpanamaskāraiḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 133.39 || yamatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampaśyati yameśvaram | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta saptajanmāntarārjitaiḥ || 133.40 || pūrṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ snātvā tu pitṛtarpaṇam | yaḥ karoti tilaiḥ snānaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 133.41 || sutṛptāstena toyena pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ | svargasthā dvādaśābdāni krīḍanti prapitāmahāḥ || 133.42 || varuṇeśe naraḥ snātvā hyarcayitvā maheśvaram | vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam || 133.43 || mṛtāṃ kālena mahatā loke yatra jaleśvaraḥ | sa gacchettatra yānena gīyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 133.44 || vāteśvare naraḥ snātvā sampūjya ca maheśvaram | jāyate kṛtakṛtyo'sau lokapālānavekṣayan || 133.45 || kiṃ tasya bahubhiryajñairdānairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ | snātvā catuṣṭaye loke avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam || 133.46 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | nityaṃ vasanti kaurilyāṃ lokapālānnimantrya ye || 133.47 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyamāyurvivardhanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 133.48 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kuberāditīrthacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.134>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle rāmeśvaramanuttamam | tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam || 134.1 || tatra tīrthe tu ye snātvā pūjayanti maheśvaram | mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 134.2 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.135>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyatsiddheśvaramanuttamam | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam || 135.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyumārudraṃ prapūjayet | vājapeyasya yajñasya sa labhetphalamuttamam || 135.2 || tena puṇyena mahatā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt | apsarogaṇasaṃvīto jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ || 135.3 || sahasravatsarāṃstatra krīḍayitvā yathāsukham | dhanadhānyasamopete kule mahati jāyate || 135.4 || pūjyamāno naraśreṣṭha vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 135.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.136>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla cāhalyeśvaramuttamam | yatra siddhā mahābhāgā tvahalyā tāpasī purā || 136.1 || gautamo brāhmaṇastvāsītsākṣādbrahmeva cāparaḥ | satyadharmasamāyukto vānaprasthāśrame rataḥ || 136.2 || tasya patnī mahābhāgā hyahalyā nāma viśrutā | rūpayauvanasampannā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā || 136.3 || asyā apyatirūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ | mohito lobhayāmāsa hyahalyāṃ balasūdanaḥ || 136.4 || māṃ bhajasva varārohe devarājamanindite | krīḍayasva mayā sārddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā || 136.5 || kiṃ kariṣyasi vipreṇa śaucācārakṛśena tu | tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlena kliśyantīva sulocane || 136.6 || evamuktā varārohā strīsvabhāvātsucañcalā | manasādhyāya śakraṃ sā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtā || 136.7 || tasyā viditvā taṃ bhāvaṃ sa devaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | gautamaṃ vañcayāmāsa duṣṭabhāvena bhāvitaḥ || 136.8 || viditvā cāntaraṃ tasya gṛhītvā veṣamuttamam | ahalyāṃ ramayāmāsa viśvastāṃ mandirāntike || 136.9 || kṣaṇamātrāntare tatra devarājasya bhārata | ājagāma muniśreṣṭho mandiraṃ tvarayānvitaḥ || 136.10 || āgataṃ gautamaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhītaḥ puraṃdaraḥ | nirgataḥ sa tato dṛṣṭvā śakro'yamiti cintayan || 136.11 || tataḥ śaśāpa devendraṃ gautamaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ | ajitendriyo'si yasmāttvaṃ tasmādbahubhago bhava || 136.12 || evamuktastu devendrastatkṣaṇādeva bhārata | bhagānāṃ tu sahasreṇa tatkṣaṇādeva veṣṭitaḥ || 136.13 || tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ gataśrīko jagāma ha | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gautamena mahītale || 136.14 || ahalyāpi tataḥ śaptā yasmāttvaṃ duṣṭacāriṇī | prekṣya māṃ ramase śakraṃ tasmādaśmamayī bhava || 136.15 || gate varṣasahasrānte rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśasvinam | tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena dhautapāpā bhaviṣyasi || 136.16 || evaṃ gate tataḥ kāle dṛṣṭā rāmeṇa dhīmatā | viśvāmitrasahāyena tyaktvā sāśmamayīṃ tanum || 136.17 || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gatapāpā vimatsarā | āgatā narmadātīre tīrthe snātvā yathāvidhi || 136.18 || kṛtaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ cānyaṃ tataḥ param | tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dattvā varamanuttamam || 136.19 || jagāmādarśanaṃ bhūyo reme comāpatiściram | ahalyā tu gate deve sthāpayitvā jagadgurum || 136.20 || ahalyeśvaranāmānaṃ svagṛhe cāgamatpunaḥ | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram || 136.21 || sa mṛtaḥ svargamāpnoti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ | krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ tatra loke mahātapāḥ || 136.22 || gate varṣasahasrānte mānuṣyaṃ labhate punaḥ | dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || 136.23 || vedavidyāśrayo dhīmāñjāyate vimale kule | rūpasaubhāgyasampannaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgramahalyātīrthasevanāt || 136.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ahalyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.137>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca dharmaputra tato gacchetkarkaṭeśvaramuttamam | uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 137.1 || tatra snātvā vidhānena yastu pūjayate śivam | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 137.2 || tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā | na tadvarṇayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vadāmyataḥ || 137.3 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryātkiṃcitkarma śubhāśubham | harṣānmadānmahārāja tatsarvaṃ jāyate'kṣayam || 137.4 || tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā vālakhilyā marīcayaḥ | ramante'dyāpi lokeṣu svecchayā kurunandana || 137.5 || tatrasthāstanna jānanti narājñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ | śarīrasthamivātmānamakṣayaṃ jyotikhyayam || 137.6 || tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha devī nārāyaṇī purā | adyāpi tapate ghoraṃ tapo yāvatkilārbudam || 137.7 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ || 137.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karkaṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.138>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchetpāṇḍuputra śakratīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddho mahābhāgo devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ || 138.1 || gautamena purā śaptaṃ jñātvā devāḥ sureśvaram | brahmādyā devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 138.2 || gautamaṃ prārthayāmāsurvākyaiḥ sānunayaiḥ śubhaiḥ | gatarājyaṃ gataśrīkaṃ śakraṃ prati munīśvara || 138.3 || indrena rahitaṃ rājyaṃ na kaścitkāmayeddvija | devo vā mānavo vāpi etatte viditaṃ prabho || 138.4 || tasya tvaṃ bhagayuktasya dayāṃ kuru dvijottama | gataścādarśanaṃ śakro dūṣitaḥ svena pāpmanā || 138.5 || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gautamo vedavittamaḥ | tatheti kṛtvā śakrasya varaṃ dātuṃ pracakrame || 138.6 || etadbhagasahasraṃ tu purā jātaṃ śatakrato | tallocanasahasraṃ tu matprasādādbhaviṣyati || 138.7 || evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ praṇamya munisattamam | brāhmaṇāṃstānmahābhāgānnarmadāṃ pratyagāttataḥ || 138.8 || snātvā sa vimale toye saṃsthāpya tripurāntakam | jagāma tridaśāvāsaṃ pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 138.9 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | paradārābhigamanānmucyate pātakānnaraḥ || 138.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.139>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja somatīrthamanuttamam | yatra somastapastaptvā nakṣatrapathamāsthitaḥ || 139.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāyādācamya vidhipūrvakam | kṛtajāpyo raviṃ dhyāyettasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 139.2 || ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ sāmavedena bhārata | japato yatphalaṃ proktaṃ gāyatryā cātra tatphalam || 139.3 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayecchuciḥ | tena samyagvidhānena koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 139.4 || pādukopānahau chatraṃ vastrakambalavājinaḥ | yo datte vipramukhyāya tasya tatkoṭisaṃmitam || 139.5 || sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāmanṛcāṃ yastu bhojayet | ekasya mantrayuktasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 139.6 || evaṃ tu bhojayettatra bahvṛcaṃ vedapāragam | śākhāntargamathādhvaryuṃ chandogaṃ vā samāptigam || 139.7 || agnihotrasahasrasya yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ | samaṃ tadvedaviduṣā tīrthe somasya tatphalam || 139.8 || bhojayedyaḥ śataṃ teṣāṃ sahasraṃ labhate naraḥ | ekasya yogayuktasya tatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ || 139.9 || saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasenmuniḥ | tatratatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 139.10 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte yogī bhojyo viśeṣataḥ || 139.11 || saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | vimānena mahābhāgāḥ sa yāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 139.12 || somasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate || 139.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.140>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja nandāhradamanuttamam | yatra siddhā mahābhāgā nandā devī varapradā || 140.1 || mahiṣāsure mahākāye purā devabhayaṃkare | śūlinyā śūlabhinnāṅge kṛte dānavasattame || 140.2 || yenaikādaśarudrāśca hyādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ | vasavo vāyunā sārddhaṃ candrādityau sureśvara || 140.3 || balinā nirjitā yena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | saṅgrāme sumahāghore kṛte devabhayaṃkare || 140.4 || kṛtvā tatkadanaṃ ghoraṃ nandā devī sureśvarī | yasmātsnātā viśālākṣī tena nandāhradaḥ smṛtaḥ || 140.5 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāmuddiśya bhārata | dadāti dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 140.6 || bhairavaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudraṃ mahālayam | nandāhradaścaturthaḥ syātpañcamaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 140.7 || bahavastaṃ na jānanti kāmarāgasamanvitāḥ | narmadāyā hradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 140.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāṃ devīṃ prapūjayet | kiṃ tasya himavanmadhyagamanena prayojanam || 140.9 || paramārthamavijñāya paryaṭanti tamovṛtāḥ | teṣāṃ samāgame pārtha śrama eva hi kevalam || 140.10 || pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snānadānena yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti snātvā nandāhrade nṛpa || 140.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandāhradatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.141>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tāpeśvaramanuttamam | yatra sā hariṇī siddhā vyādhabhītā nareśvara || 141.1 || jale prakṣipya gātrāṇi hyantarikṣaṃ gatā tu sā | vyādho vismitacittastu tāṃ mṛgīmavalokya ca || 141.2 || vimucya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ prārebhe tapa uttamam | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu vyādhenācaritaṃ tapaḥ || 141.3 || atīte tu tataḥ kāle parituṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | varaṃ brūhi mahāvyādha yatte manasi rocate || 141.4 || vyādha uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | tava pārśve mahādeva vāso me pratidīyatām || 141.5 || īśvara uvāca evaṃ bhavatu te vyādha yastvayā kāṅkṣito varaḥ | daivadevo mahādeva ityuktvāntaradhīyata | gate cādarśanaṃ deve sthāpayitvā maheśvaram || 141.6 || pūjayitvā vidhānena gato vyādhastato divam | tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 141.7 || vyādhānutāpasaṃjātaṃ tāpeśvaramiti śrutam | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampūjayati śaṅkaram || 141.8 || śivalokamavāpnoti māmuvāca maheśvaraḥ | ye snātā narmadātoye tīrthe tāpeśvare narāḥ || 141.9 || tāpatrayavimuktāste nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 141.10 || snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ sarvapātakaśāntaye || 141.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tāpeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.142>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja rukmiṇītīrthamuttamam | yatraiva snānamātreṇa rūpavānsubhago bhavet || 142.1 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | snānaṃ samācarettatra na ceha jāyate punaḥ || 142.2 || yaḥ snātvā rukmiṇītīrthe dānaṃ dadyāttu kāṃcanam | tattīrthasya prabhāvena śokaṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ || 142.3 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca tīrthasyāsya kathaṃ jāto mahimedṛṅmunīśvara | rūpasaubhāgyadaṃ yena tīrthametadbravīhi me || 142.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam | kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata || 142.5 || taṃ te'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ | nagaraṃ kuṇḍinaṃ nāma bhīṣmakaḥ paripāti hi || 142.6 || hastyaśvarathasampanno dhanāḍhyo'ti pratāpavān | strīsahasrasya madhyasthaḥ kurute rājyamuttamam || 142.7 || tasya bhāryā mahādevī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī | tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putramekaṃ ca rukmakam || 142.8 || dvitīyā tanayā jajñe rukmiṇī nāma nāmataḥ | tadāśarīriṇī vācā rājānaṃ tamuvāca ha || 142.9 || caturbhujāya dātavyā kanyeyaṃ bhuvi bhīṣmaka | evaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jaharṣa priyayā saha || 142.10 || brāhmaṇaiḥ saha vidvadbhiḥ praviṣṭaḥ sūtikāgṛham | svastikaṃ vācayitvāsyāścakre nāmeti rukmiṇī || 142.11 || yataḥ suvarṇatilako janmanā saha bhārata | tataḥ sā rukmiṇīnāma brāhmaṇaiḥ kīrtitā tadā || 142.12 || tataḥ sā kālaparyāyādaṣṭavarṣā vyajāyata | pūrvoktaṃ caiva tadvākyamaśarīriṇyudīritam || 142.13 || smṛtvā smṛtvātha nṛpatiścintayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | kasmai deyā mayā bālā bhavitā kaścaturbhujaḥ || 142.14 || etasminnantare tāvadraivatātparvatottamāt | mukhyaścedipatistatra damaghoṣaḥ samāgataḥ || 142.15 || praviṣṭo rājasadanaṃ yatra rājā sa bhīṣmakaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāgataṃ gehe pūjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 142.16 || āsanaṃ vipulaṃ dattvā sabhāṃ gatvā niveśitaḥ | kuśalaṃ tava rājendra damaghoṣa śriyāyuta || 142.17 || puṇyāhamadya saṃjātamahaṃ tvaddarśanotsukaḥ | kanyā madīyā rājendra hyaṣṭavarṣā vyajāyata || 142.18 || caturbhujāya dātavyā vāguvācāśarīriṇī | bhīṣmakasya vacaḥ śrutvā damaghoṣo'bravīdidam || 142.19 || caturbhujo mama sutastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | tasyeyaṃ dīyatāṃ kanyā śiśupālasya bhīṣmaka || 142.20 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā damaghoṣasya bhūmipa | bhīṣmakena tato dattā śiśupālāya rukmiṇī || 142.21 || prārabdhaṃ maṅgalaṃ tatra bhīṣmakeṇa yudhiṣṭhira | dikṣu deśāntareṣveva ye vasanti svagotrajāḥ || 142.22 || nimantritāstu te sarve samājagmuryathākramam | tato yādavavaṃśasya tilakau balakeśavau || 142.23 || nimantritau samāyātau kuṇḍinaṃ bhīṣmakasya tu | bhīṣmakeṇa yathānyāyaṃ pūjitau tau yadūttamau || 142.24 || tataḥ pradoṣasamaye rukmiṇī kāmamohinī | sakhībhiḥ sahitā yātā pūrbahiścāmbikārcane || 142.25 || sāpaśyattatra deveśaṃ gopaveṣadharaṃ harim | taṃ dṛṣṭvā mohamāpannā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtā || 142.26 || keśavo'pi ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkarṣaṇamuvāca ha | strīratnapravaraṃ tāta hartavyamiti me matiḥ || 142.27 || keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā saṃkarṣaṇa uvāca ha | gaccha kṛṣṇa mahābāho strīratnaṃ cāśu gṛhyatām || 142.28 || ahaṃ ca tava mārgeṇa hyāgamiṣyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ | dānavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kurvaṃśca kadanaṃ mahat || 142.29 || saṃkarṣaṇamataṃ prāpya keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ | yayau kanyāṃ gṛhītvā tu rathamāropya satvaram || 142.30 || nirgataḥ sahasā rājanvegenaivānilo yathā | hāhākārastadā jāto bhīṣmakasya pure mahān || 142.31 || nirgatā dānavāḥ kruddhā velā iva mahodadheḥ | garjantaḥ sāyudhāḥ sarve dhāvanto rathavartmani || 142.32 || baladevaṃ tataḥ prāptā rathamārgānugāminam | teṣāṃ yuddhaṃ balasyāsītsarvalokakṣayaṃkaram || 142.33 || yathā tārāmaye pūrvaṃ saṅgrāme lokaviśrute | gadāhasto mahābāhustrailokye'pratimo balaḥ || 142.34 || halenākṛṣya sahasā gadāpātairapātayat | aśakyo dānavairhantuṃ balabhadro mahābalaḥ || 142.35 || babhañja dānavānsarvāṃstasthau giririvācalaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca balaṃ kruddhaṃ durdharṣaṃ tridaśairapi || 142.36 || bhīṣmaputro mahātejā rukmīnāṃ mahayaśāḥ | narāṇāmatiśūrāṇāmakṣauhiṇyā samanvitaḥ || 142.37 || balabhadramatikramya tato yuddhe nirākarot | tadyuddhaṃ vañcayitvā tu rathamārgeṇa satvaram || 142.38 || keśavo'pi tadā devo rukmiṇyā sahito yayau | vindhyaṃ tu laṅghayitvāgre trailokyagururavyayaḥ || 142.39 || narmadātaṭamāpede yatra siddhaḥ purā punaḥ | ajeyo yena saṃjātastīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 142.40 || etasmātkāraṇāttāta yodhanīpuramucyate | rukmo'pi dānavendro'sau prāptaḥ || 142.41 || pratyuvācācyutaṃ kruddhastiṣṭha tiṣṭheti mā vraja | adya tvāṃ niśitairbāṇairneṣyāmi yamasādanam || 142.42 || evaṃ parasparaṃ vīrau jagarjaturubhāvapi | tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ tārakāgnijasannibham || 142.43 || cikṣepa śarajālāni keśavaṃ prati dānavaḥ | nānucintya śarāṃstasya keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ || 142.44 || tato viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ kruddhaścakraṃ gṛhya sudarśanam | sampraharatyamuṃ yāvadrukmiṇyātra nivāritaḥ || 142.45 || tvāṃ na jānāti deveśaṃ caturbāhuṃ janārdanam | darśayasva svakaṃ rūpaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 142.46 || evamuktastu rukmiṇyā darśayāmāsa bhārata | devā dṛṣṭvāpi tadrūpaṃ stuvantyākāśasaṃsthitāḥ | divyaṃ cakṣustadā devo dadau rukmasya bhārata || 142.47 || rukma uvāca yanmayā pāpaniṣṭhena mandabhāgyena keśava | sāyakairāhataṃ vakṣastatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi || 142.48 || pūrvaṃ dattā svayaṃ deva jānakī janakena vai | mayā pradattā deveśa rukmiṇī tava keśava || 142.49 || udvāhaya yathānyāyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā | rukmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tatastuṣṭo jagadguruḥ || 142.50 || babhāṣe devadeveśo rukmiṇaṃ bhīṣmakātmajam | gaccha svakaṃ puraṃ mā bhaiḥ kuru rājyamakaṇṭakam || 142.51 || keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rukmo dānavapuṃgavaḥ | taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ || 142.52 || gate rukme tadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāmantrya dvijottamān | marīcimatryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum || 142.53 || vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahābhāgamityete sapta mānasāḥ | ityete brāhmaṇāḥ sapta purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ || 142.54 || kṣamāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhiralaṃkṛtāḥ | ityevaṃ brahmaputrāśca satyavanto mahāmate || 142.55 || narmadātaṭamāśritya nivasanti jitendriyāḥ | tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā japahomaparāyaṇāḥ || 142.56 || nimantritāstu rājendra keśavena mahātmanā | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ brahmoktavidhinā tataḥ || 142.57 || haristānpūjayāmāsa saptabrahmarṣipuṃgavān | pradadau dvādaśa grāmāṃstebhyastatra janārdanaḥ || 142.58 || yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī | tāvaddānaṃ mayā dattaṃ paripanthī na kaścana || 142.59 || maddattaṃ pālayiṣyante ye nṛpā gatakalmaṣāḥ | tebhyaḥ svasti kariṣyāmi dāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim || 142.60 || yāvaddhi yānti lokeṣu mahābhūtāni pañca ca | tāvatte divi modante maddattaparipālakāḥ || 142.61 || yastu lopayate mūḍho dattaṃ vaḥ pṛthivītale | narake tasya vāsaḥ syādyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 142.62 || svadattā paradattā vā pālanīyā vasuṃdharā | yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalam || 142.63 || svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharām | sa viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmirbhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || 142.64 || anyāyena hṛtā bhūmiranyāyena ca hāritā | hartā hārayitā caiva viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 142.65 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidaḥ | ācchettā cānumantā ca tānyeva narake vaset || 142.66 || yānīha dattāni purā narendrairdānāni dharmārthayaśaskarāṇi | nirmālyarūpapratimāni tāni ko nāma sādhuḥ punarādadāti || 142.67 || evaṃ tānpūjayitvā tu samyaṅnyāyena pāṇḍava | rukmiṇyā vidhivatpāṇiṃ jagrāha madhusūdanaḥ || 142.68 || muśalī ca tataḥ sarvāñjitvā dānavapuṃgavān | svasthānamagamattatra kṛtvā kāryaṃ suśobhanam || 142.69 || prayātau dvāravatyāṃ tau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau | gacchamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavaṃ kleśanāśanam || 142.70 || brāhmaṇāḥ satyavantaśca nirgatāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | āgacchamānāṃstau vīkṣya rathamārgeṇa brāhmaṇān || 142.71 || muhūrtaṃ tatra viśramya keśavo vākyamabravīt | kimāgamanakāryaṃ vo brūta sarvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 142.72 || kurvāṇāḥ svīyakarmāṇi mama kṛtyaṃ tu tiṣṭhate | devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā munayo vākyamabruvan || 142.73 || kalpakoṭisahasreṇa satyabhāvāttu vanditaḥ | duṣprāpyo'si manuṣyāṇāṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ tyajase hi naḥ || 142.74 || brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānidamabravīt | mathurāyāṃ dvāravatyāṃ yodhanīpura eva ca || 142.75 || trikālamāgamiṣyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā yodhanīpuramāgatāḥ || 142.76 || avatīrṇastribhāgena prādurbhāve tu māthure | etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthasyotpattikāraṇam || 142.77 || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ tathāparam | yaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 142.78 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayedbalakeśavau | tena devo jagaddhātā pūjitastriguṇātmavān || 142.79 || upavāsī naro bhūtvā yastu kuryātpradakṣiṇam | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 142.80 || tatra tīrthe tu ye vṛkṣāstānpaśyantyapi ye narāḥ | te'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyante bhrūṇahatyāsamairapi || 142.81 || prātarutthāya ye kecitpaśyanti balakeśavau | tena te sadṛśāḥ syurvai devadevena cakriṇā || 142.82 || te pūjyāste namaskāryāsteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | ye namanti jagannāthaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 142.83 || tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ snānaṃ devārcanaṃ nṛpa | tatsarvamakṣayaṃ tasya ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 142.84 || praviśyāgnau mṛtānāṃ ca yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam | tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha procyamānamaśeṣataḥ || 142.85 || vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā | āgneye bhavate tatra modate kālamīpsitam || 142.86 || jale caivā mṛtānāṃ tu yodhanīpuramadhyataḥ | vasanti vāruṇe loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 142.87 || anāśake mṛtānāṃ tu tatra tīrthe narādhipa | anivartikā gatirnṛṇāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 142.88 || tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyātkapilādānamuttamam | vidhānena tu saṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam || 142.89 || yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūteśca bhārata | tāvanti divi modante sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitāḥ || 142.90 || yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti dhenvāstāvanti varṣāṇi mahīyate saḥ | svargāccyutaścāpi tatastrilokyāṃ kule samutpatsyati gomatāṃ saḥ || 142.91 || tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyādrūpyaṃ kāñcanameva vā | kāñcanena vimānena viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 142.92 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo dadyātpāduke vastrameva ca | dānasyāsya prabhāvena labhate svargamīpsitam || 142.93 || ṛgyajuḥsāmavedānāṃ paṭhanādyatphalaṃ bhavet | tatra tīrthe tu rājendra gāyatryā tatphalaṃ labhet || 142.94 || prayāge yadbhavetpuṇyaṃ gayāyāṃ ca tripuṣkare | kurukṣetre tu rājendra rāhugraste divākare || 142.95 || someśvare ca yatpuṇyaṃ somasya grahaṇe tathā | tatphalaṃ labhate tatra snānamātrānna saṃśayaḥ || 142.96 || dvādaśyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā namaskṛtya janārdanam | uddhṛtāḥ pitarastena avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam || 142.97 || saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 142.98 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hyāsamudrāṇi pāṇḍava | tāni sarvāṇi tatraiva dvādaśyāṃ pāṇḍunandana || 142.99 || kṣayaṃ yānti ca dānāni yajñahomabalikriyāḥ | na kṣīyate mahārāja tatra tīrthe tu yatkṛtam || 142.100 || yadbhūtaṃ yadbhaviṣyacca tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | kathitaṃ te mayā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhāvena bhārata || 142.101 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rukmiṇītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.143>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja yojaneśvaramuttamam | yatra siddhau purā kalpe naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || 143.1 || tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā saṅgrāme devadānavaiḥ | jayaṃ prāptau mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvubhau || 143.2 || punastretāyuge prāpte tau devau rāmalakṣmaṇau | tatra tīrthe punaḥ snātvā rāvaṇo durjayo hataḥ || 143.3 || punaḥ pārtha kalau prāpte tau devau balakeśavau | vasudevakule jātau duṣkaraṃ karma cakratuḥ || 143.4 || narakaṃ kālanemiṃ ca kaṃsaṃ cāṇūramuṣṭikau | śiśupālaṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ jaghnaturbalakeśavau || 143.5 || tatastatra ripūnsaṃkhye bhīṣmadroṇapuraḥsarān | karṇaduryodhanādīṃśca nihaniṣyati sa prabhuḥ || 143.6 || dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre tatra yudhyanti te kṣaṇam | bhīmārjunanimittena śiṣyau kṛtvā parasparam || 143.7 || tatra tīrthe punargatvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram | pūjayitvā dvijānbhaktyā yāsyete dvārakāṃ punaḥ || 143.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayedbalakeśavau | tena devo jagaddhātā pūjitastriguṇātmavān || 143.9 || upavāsī naro bhūtvā yastu kuryātprajāgaram | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gāyaṃstasya śubhāṃ kathām || 143.10 || yāvatastatra tīrthe tu vṛkṣān paśyanti mānavāḥ | brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ tāvadeṣāṃ praṇaśyati || 143.11 || prātarutthāya ye kecitpaśyanti balakeśavau | tenaiva sadṛśāḥ sarve devadevena cakriṇā || 143.12 || te pūjyāste namaskāryāsteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | ye namanti jagatpūjyaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 143.13 || tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ snānaṃ devārcanaṃ nṛpa | kriyate tatphalaṃ sarvamakṣayāyopakalpate || 143.14 || agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhūrvaiṣṇavī sūryasutāśca gāvaḥ | lokāstrayastena bhavanti dattā yaḥ kāñcanaṃ gāṃ ca bhuvaṃ ca dadyāt || 143.15 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | atītaṃ ca bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ mahābalam || 143.16 || śrutvā vāpi paṭhitvedaṃ śrāvayipatvātha dhārmikān | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 143.17 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe yojaneśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.144>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja dvādaśītīrthamuttamam | kṣaranti sarvadānāni japahomabalikriyāḥ || 144.1 || na kṣīyate tu rājendra cakratīrthe tu yatkṛtam | yadbhūtaṃ yadbhaviṣyacca tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || 144.2 || kathitaṃ tanmayā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhāvena bhārata || 144.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dvādaśītīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.145>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharāpāla śīvatīrthamanuttamam | darśanādyasya devasya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 145.1 || śivatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ | pūjayeta mahādevaṃ so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 145.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā sopavāso'rcayecchivam | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 145.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śivatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.146>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca asmāhakaṃ tato gacchetpitṛtīrthamanuttamam | pretatvādyatra mucyante piṇḍenaikena pūrvajāḥ || 146.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca asmāhakasya māhātmyaṃ kathayasva mamānagha | snānadānena yatpuṇyaṃ tathā piṇḍodakena ca || 146.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā kalpe nṛpaśreṣṭha ṛṣidevasamāgame | praśnaḥ pṛṣṭo mayā tāta yathā tvamanupṛcchasi || 146.3 || ekatra sāgarāḥ sapta saprayāgāḥ sapuṣkarāḥ | nāsya sāmyaṃ labhante te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 146.4 || somanāthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ yatsomena pratiṣṭhitam | tatra somagrahe puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ || 146.5 || māsānte pitaro nṛṇāṃ vīkṣante santatiṃ svakām | kaścidasmatkule'smākaṃ piṇḍamatra pradāsyati || 146.6 || prapitāmahāstathādityāḥ śrutireṣā sanātanī | evaṃ bruvanti devāśca ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ || 146.7 || sakṛtpiṇḍodakenaiva śṛṇu pārthiva yatphalam | dvādaśābdāni rājendra yogaṃ bhuktvā suśobhanam || 146.8 || yuge yuge mahārāja asmāhake pitāmahāḥ | sarvadā hyavalokanta āgacchantaṃ svagotrajam || 146.9 || bhaviṣyati kimasmākamamāvāsyāpyamāhake | snānaṃ dānaṃ ca ye kuryuḥ pitḥṇāṃ tilatarpaṇam || 146.10 || te sarvapāpanirmuktāḥ sarvānkāmāṃllabhati vai | jalamadhye'tra bhūpāla agnitīrthaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 146.11 || darśanāttasya tīrthasya pāparāśirvilīyate | snānamātreṇa rājendra brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 146.12 || śuklāmbaradharo nityaṃ niyataḥ sa jitendriyaḥ | ekakālaṃ tu bhuñjāno māsaṃ tīrthasya sannidhau || 146.13 || suvarṇālaṃkṛtānāṃ tu kanyānāṃ śatadānajam | phalamāpnoti sampūrṇaṃ pitṛloke mahīyate || 146.14 || pṛthivyāmāsamudrāyāṃ mahābhogapatirbhavet | dhanadhānyasamāyukto dātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 146.15 || upavāsī śucirbhūtvā brahmalokamavāpnuyāt | asmāhakaṃ samāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet || 146.16 || koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate | tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇakarmā divaścyutaḥ || 146.17 || suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhye kule jāyeta rūpavān | kṛtvābhiṣekavidhinā hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 146.18 || dhanāḍhyo rūpavāndakṣo dātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ | caturvedeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ satyavādiṣu yatphalam || 146.19 || tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ tatra tīrthe'bhiṣecanāt | tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ śambhunā purā || 146.20 || hṛdayeśaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurjapeddevaṃ maheśvaram | gandharvāpsarasaścaiva maruto mārutāstathā || 146.21 || viśvedevāśca pitaraḥ sacandrāḥ sadivākarāḥ | marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || 146.22 || pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca | cyavano gālavaścaiva vāmadevo mahāmuniḥ || 146.23 || vālakhilyāśca gandhārāstṛṇabinduśca jājaliḥ | uddālakaścarṣyaśṛṅgo vasiṣṭhaśca sanandanaḥ || 146.24 || śukraścaiva bharadvājo vātsyo vātsyāyanastathā | agastirmitrāvaruṇau viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ || 146.25 || gautamaśca pulastyaśca paulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | sanātanastu kapilo vāhniḥ pañcaśikhastathā || 146.26 || anye'pi bahavastatra munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | krīḍanti devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ || 146.27 || manuṣyāścaiva yogīndrāḥ pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ | asmāhake'tra tiṣṭhanti sarva eva na saṃśayaḥ || 146.28 || pitaraḥ pitāmahāścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ | yeṣāṃ dattamupasthāyi sukṛtaṃ vāpi duṣkṛtam || 146.29 || akṣayaṃ tatra tatsarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ yodhanīpure | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā sarvabandhusuhṛjjanān || 146.30 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ priyānputrāṃstathā dehaṃ nṛpottama | gacchate vāyubhūtastu śubhāśubhasamanvitaḥ || 146.31 || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ paramātmā mahattaraḥ | śubhāśubhagatiṃ prāptaḥ karmaṇā svena pārthiva || 146.32 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śubhāśubhaṃ na bandhūnāṃ jāyate kena hetunā | ekaḥ prasūyate jantureka eva pralīyate || 146.33 || eko hi bhuṅkte sukṛtameka eva hi duṣkṛtam || 146.34 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca eṣa tvayokto nṛpate mahāpraśnaḥ smṛto mayā || 146.35 || pitāmahamukhodgītaṃ śrutaṃ te kathayāmyaham | yanme pitāmahātpūrvaṃ vijñātamṛṣisaṃsadi || 146.36 || na mātā na pitā bandhuḥ kasyacinna suhṛtkvacit | kasya na jñāyate rūpaṃ vāyubhūtasya dehinaḥ || 146.37 || yadyevaṃ na bhavettāta lokasya tu nareśvara | amaryādaṃ bhavennūnaṃ vinaśyati carācaram || 146.38 || evaṃ jñātvā pūrā rājansamastairlokakartṛbhiḥ | maryādā sthāpitā loke yathā dharmo na naśyati || 146.39 || dharme naṣṭe manuṣyāṇāmadharmo'bhibhavetpunaḥ | tataḥ svadharmacalanānnarake gamanaṃ dhruvam || 146.40 || loko niraṅkuśaḥ sarvo maryādālaṅghane rataḥ | maryādā sthāpitā tena śāstraṃ vīkṣya maharṣibhiḥ || 146.41 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam | piṇḍodakapradānaṃ ca tathaivātithipūjanam || 146.42 || pitaraḥ pitāmahāścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ | trayo devāḥ smṛtāstāta brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 146.43 || pūjitaiḥ pūjitāḥ sarve tathā mātāmahāstrayaḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrutismṛtyarthanoditān || 146.44 || dharmaṃ samācarannityaṃ pāpāṃśena na lipyate | śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ manasāpi na laṅghayet || 146.45 || iha loke pare caiva yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ | pitāputrau sadāpyekau bimbādbimbamivoddhṛtau || 146.46 || vibhaktau vāvibhaktau vā śrutismṛtyarthatastathā | uddharedātmanātmānamātmānamavasādayet || 146.47 || piṇḍodakapradānābhyāmṛte pārtha na saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ jñātvā prayatnena piṇḍodakaprado bhavet || 146.48 || āyurdharmo yaśastejaḥ santatiścaiva vardhate | pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ pitṛkṣetrāṇi yāni ca || 146.49 || tāni te sampravakṣyāmi yeṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam | gayāyāṃ puṣkare jyeṣṭhe prayāge naimiṣe tathā || 146.50 || saṃnihatyāṃ kurukṣetre prabhāse kurunandana | piṇḍodakapradānena yatphalaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ || 146.51 || asmāhake tadāpnoti narmadāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | tatra brahmā murāriśca rudraśca umayā saha || 146.52 || indrādyā devatāḥ sarve pitaro munayastathā | sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva parvatāśca balāhakāḥ || 146.53 || tiṣṭhanti pitaraḥ sarve sarvatīrthādhikaṃ tataḥ | sthitā brahmaśilā tatra gajakumbhanibhā nṛpa || 146.54 || kalau na dṛśyā bhavati pradhānaṃ yadgayāśiraḥ | vaiśākhe māsi samprāpte'māvāsyāṃ nṛpottama || 146.55 || vyāpya sā tiṣṭhate tīrthaṃ gajakumbhanibhā śilā | tacca gavyūtimātraṃ hi tīrthaṃ tataḥ pravakṣate || 146.56 || tasmindine tatra gatvā yastu śrāddhaprado bhavet | pitḥṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate śatavārṣikī || 146.57 || anyasyāmapyamāvāsyāṃ yaḥ snātvā vijitendriyaḥ | karoti manujaḥ śrāddhaṃ vidhivanmantrasaṃyutam || 146.58 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yatsyāttacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa | agniṣṭomāśvamedhābhyāṃ vājapeyasya yatphalam || 146.59 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt | rauravādiṣu sarveṣu narakeṣu vyavasthitāḥ || 146.60 || pitā pitāmahādyāśca pitṛke mātṛke tathā | piṇḍodakena caikena tarpaṇena viśeṣataḥ || 146.61 || krīḍanti pitṛlokasthā yāvadābhūtasamplavam | ye karmasthā vikarmasthā ye jātāḥ pretakalmaṣāḥ || 146.62 || piṇḍenaikena mucyante te'pi tatra na saṃśayaḥ | asmāhake śilā divyā tiṣṭhate gajasannibhā || 146.63 || brahmaṇā nirmitā pūrvaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | uparyasyā yathānyāyaṃ pitḥnuddiśya bhārata || 146.64 || dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu dadyātpiṇḍānvicakṣaṇaḥ | bhūmau cānnena siddhena śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 146.65 || śrāddhibhyo vastrayugmāni chatropānatkamaṇḍalu | dakṣiṇā vividhā deyā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata || 146.66 || yo dadāti dvijaśreṣṭha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ || 146.67 || asmāhake mahārāja pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ | vāyubhūtā nirīkṣante āgacchantaṃ svagotrajam || 146.68 || atra tīrthe suto'bhyetya snātvā toyaṃ pradāsyati | śrāddhaṃ vā piṇḍadānaṃ vā tena yāsyāma sadgatim || 146.69 || snāne kṛte tu ye kecijjāyante vastravipluṣaḥ | prīṇayennarakasthāṃstu taiḥ pitḥnnātra saṃśayaḥ || 146.70 || keśodabindavastasya ye cānye lepabhājinaḥ | tṛpyantyanagninasaṃskārā yaṃ mṛtāḥ syuḥ svagotrajāḥ || 146.71 || tatra tīrthe tu ye kecicchrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | narakāduddharantyāśu japantaḥ pitṛsaṃhitām || 146.72 || vanaspatigate some yadā somadinaṃ bhavet | akṣayāllabhate lokānpiṇḍenaikena mānavaḥ || 146.73 || akṣayaṃ tatra vai sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | narakāduddharantyāśu japante pitṛsaṃhitām || 146.74 || tasmiṃstīrthe tvamāvāsyāṃ pitḥnuddiśya bhārata | nīlaṃ sarvāṅgasampūrṇaṃ yo'bhiṣicya samutsṛjet || 146.75 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na tu vācaspatiḥ kṣamaḥ | asmāhake vṛṣotsargādyatpuṇyaṃ samavāpyate || 146.76 || tava śuśrūṣaṇātsarvaṃ tatpravakṣyāmi bhārata | rauravādiṣu ye kiṃcitpacyante tasya pūrvajāḥ || 146.77 || vṛṣotsargeṇa tānsarvāṃstārayedekaviṃśatim | lohito yastu varṇena mukhe pucche ca pāṇḍuraḥ || 146.78 || piṅgaḥ khuraviṣāṇābhyāṃ sa nīlo vṛṣa ucyate | yastu sarvāṅgapiṅgaśca śvetaḥ pucchakhureṣu ca || 146.79 || sa piṅgo vṛṣa ityāhuḥ pitḥṇāṃ prītivardhanaḥ | pārāvatasavarṇaśca lalāṭe tilako bhavet || 146.80 || taṃ vṛṣaṃ babhrumityāhuḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanam | sarvāṅgeṣvekavarṇo yaḥ piṅgaḥ pucchakhureṣu ca || 146.81 || khurapiṅgaṃ tamityāhuḥ pitḥṇāṃ sadgatipradam | nīlaṃ sarvaśarīreṇa svāraktanayanaṃ dṛḍham || 146.82 || tameva nīlamityāhurnīlaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ | yastu vaiśyagṛhe jātaḥ sa vai nīlo viśiṣyate || 146.83 || na vāhayedgṛhe jātaṃ vatsakaṃ tu kadācana | tenaiva ca vṛṣotsarge pitḥṇāmanṛṇo bhavet || 146.84 || jātaṃ tu svagṛhe vatsaṃ dvijanmā yastu vāhayet | patanti pitarastasya brahmakokagatā api || 146.85 || yathāyathā hi pibati pītvā dhūnāti mastakam | pibanpitḥn prīṇayati narakāduddhareddhunan || 146.86 || yathā pucchābhighātena skandhaṃ gacchanti bindavaḥ | narakāduddharantyāśu patitān gotriṇastathā || 146.87 || garjanprāvṛṣi kāle tu viṣāṇābhyāṃ bhuvaṃ likhan | khurebhyo yā mṛdudbhūtā tayā saṃprīṇayedṛṣīn || 146.88 || pibanpitḥn prīṇayate khādanollekhane surān | garjannṛṣimanuṣyāṃśca dharmarūpo hi dharmaja || 146.89 || bhūtairvāpi piśācairvā cāturthikajvareṇa vā | gṛhīto'smāhakaṃ gacchetsarveṣāmādhināśanam || 146.90 || snātvā tu vimale toye darbhagranthiṃ nibandhayet | mastake bāhumūle vā nābhyāṃ vā galake'pi vā || 146.91 || gatvā devasamīpaṃ ca prādakṣiṇyena keśavam | tataḥ samuccaranmantraṃ gāyatryā vātha vaiṣṇavam || 146.92 || nārāyaṇaṃ śaraṇyeśaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam | namo yajñāṅgasambhūta sarvavyāpinnamo'stu te || 146.93 || namo namaste deveśa padmagarbha sanātana | dāmodara jayānanta rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 146.94 || tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ ca hartā ca jagatyasmiṃścarācare | tvaṃ pālayasi bhūtāni bhuvanaṃ tvaṃ bibharṣi ca || 146.95 || prasīda devadeveśa suptamaṅgaṃ prabodhaya | tvaddhyānanirato nityaṃ tvadbhaktiparamo hare || 146.96 || iti stuto mayā deva prasādaṃ kuru me'cyuta | māṃ rakṣa rakṣa pāpebhyastrāyasva śaraṇāgatam || 146.97 || evaṃ stutvā ca deveśaṃ dānavāntakaraṃ harim | punaruktena vai snātvā tato viprāṃstu bhojayet || 146.98 || vedoktena vidhānena snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā vācayetsvastikaṃ tataḥ || 146.99 || evaṃ stutvā ca deveśaṃ dānavāntakaraṃ harim | punaruktena vai snātvā tato viprāṃstu bhojayet || 146.100 || vedoktena vidhānena snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | evaṃ tānvācayitvā tu tato viprānvisarjayet || 146.101 || yattatroccaritaṃ kiṃcittadviprebhyo nivedayet | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā nārī vā bhaktitatparā | śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi || 146.102 || tatra tīrthe naro yāvatsnāpayedvidhipūrvakam | kṣīreṇa madhunā vāpi dadhnā vā śītavāriṇā || 146.103 || tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam | ayane viṣuve caiva yugādau sūryasaṃkrame || 146.104 || puṣpaiḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ naivedyaṃ yaḥ pradāpayet | so'śvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam || 146.105 || tatra tīrthe tu yo rājan sūryagrahaṇamācaret | sūryatejonibhairyānairviṣṇuloke mahīyate || 146.106 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ samprayacchati | satputreṇa ca tenaiva samprāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam || 146.107 || iti śrutvā tato devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca sthāpayāṃcakrurīśvaram || 146.108 || sarvarogopaśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇamamāvāsyāṃ tu bhāvitaḥ || 146.109 || pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍadānaṃ ca kuryādasmāhake nṛpa | tripuṣkare gayāyāṃ ca prabhāse naimiṣe tathā || 146.110 || yatpuṇyaṃ śrāddhakartḥṇāṃ tadihaiva bhaveddhruvam | tilodakaṃ kuśairmiśraṃ yo dadyāddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 146.111 || manvādau ca yugādau ca vyatīpāte dinakṣaye | yo dadyātpitṛmātṛbhyaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 146.112 || asmāhake naro yastu snātvā sampūjayeddharim | brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā kuryājjāgaraṇakriyām || 146.113 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakrātithyamavāpnuyāt | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyati janārdanam || 146.114 || viśeṣavidhinābhyarcya praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ | saputreṇa ca tenaiva pitḥṇāṃ vihitā gatiḥ || 146.115 || ekamūrtistrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | satkāryakāraṇopetāḥ susūkṣmāḥ sumahāphalāḥ || 146.116 || etatte kathitaṃ rājanmahāpātakanāśanam | asmāhakasya māhātmyaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 146.117 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe asmāhakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.147>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla siddheśvaramanuttamam | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam || 147.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayedvṛṣabhadhvajam | sarvapāpavinirmukto gatiṃ yātyaśvamedhinām || 147.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ | pitḥṇāṃ prīṇanārthāya sarvaṃ tena kṛtaṃ bhavet || 147.3 || tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu jantūnāṃ nṛpasattama | garbhavāse matisteṣāṃ na jāyeta kadācana || 147.4 || garbhavāso hi duḥkhāya na sukhāya kadācana | tattīrthavāriṇā snāturna punarbhavasambhavaḥ || 147.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.148>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthamaṅgārakaṃ śivam | uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 148.1 || caturthyaṅgārakadine saṃkalpya kṛtaniścayaḥ | snāyādastaṃ gate sūrye sandhyopāsanatatparaḥ || 148.2 || pūjayellohitaṃ bhaktyā gandhamālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | saṃsthāpyasthaṇḍile devaṃ raktacandanacarcitam || 148.3 || aṅgārakāyeti namaḥ karṇikāyāṃ prapūjayet | kujāya bhūmiputrāya raktāṅgāya suvāsase || 148.4 || harakopodbhavāyeti svedajāyātibāhave | sarvakāmapradāyeti pūrvādiṣu daleṣu ca || 148.5 || evaṃ sampūjya vidhivaddadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ | bhūmiputra mahāvīrya svedodbhava pinākinaḥ || 148.6 || aṅgāraka mahātejā lohitāṅga namo'stu te | karakaṃ vārisaṃyuktaṃ śālitaṃdulapūritam || 148.7 || sahiraṇyaṃ savastraṃ ca modakopari saṃsthitam | brāhmaṇāya nivedyaṃ tatkujo me prīyatāmiti || 148.8 || arghaṃ dattvā vidhānena raktacandanavāriṇā | raktapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ tilataṃdulamiśritam || 148.9 || kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre maṇḍale vartule śubhe | kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ || 148.10 || mantrapūtaṃ mahābhāga dadyādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | tato bhuñjīta maunena kṣāratilāmlavarjitam || 148.11 || snigdhaṃ mṛdusamadhuramātmanaḥ śreya icchatā | evaṃ caturthe samprāpte caturthyaṅgārake nṛpa || 148.12 || sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ yathāśakti surūpiṇam | sthāpayettāmrake pātre guḍapīṭhasamanvite || 148.13 || gandhapuṣpādibhirdevaṃ pūjayedguḍasaṃsthitam | īśānyāṃ sthāpayeddevaṃ guḍatoyasamanvitam || 148.14 || kāsāreṇa tathāgneyyāṃ sthāpayetkarakaṃ param | raktatandulasaṃmiśraṃ nairṛtyāṃ vāyugocare || 148.15 || sthāpayenmodakaiḥ sārdhaṃ caturthaṃ karakaṃ budhaḥ | sūtreṇa veṣṭitagrīvaṃ gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtam || 148.16 || śaṅkhatūryaninādena jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ | raktāmbaradharaṃ vipraṃ raktamālyānulepanam || 148.17 || vedimadhyagataṃ vāpi mahadāsanasaṃsthitam | surūpaṃ subhagaṃ śāntaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam || 148.18 || vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam | pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vācayetpāṇḍunandana || 148.19 || raktāṃ gāṃ ca tato dadyādraktenānaḍuhā saha | prīyatāṃ bhūmijo devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ || 148.20 || vipraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya patnīputrasamanvitaḥ | pitṛmātṛsuhṛtsārddhaṃ kṣamāpya ca visarjayet || 148.21 || evaṃ kṛtasya tasyātha tasmiṃstīrthe viśeṣataḥ | yatpuṇyaṃ phalamuddiṣṭaṃ tatte sarvaṃ vadāmyaham || 148.22 || sapta janmāni rājendra surūpaḥ subhago bhavet | tīrthasyāsya prabhāvena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 148.23 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe mṛto naraḥ | aṅgārakapuraṃ yāti devagandharvapūjitaḥ || 148.24 || upabhujya yathānyāyaṃ divyānbhogānanuttamān | iha mānuṣyaloke vai rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 148.25 || surūpaḥ subhagaścaiva sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 148.26 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.149>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ tīrthaṃ liṅgeśvaramiti śrutam | darśanāddevadevasya yatra pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 149.1 || kṛtvā tu kadanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 149.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ namasyati | sa mucyate nṛpaśreṣṭha mahāpāpaiḥ purākṛtaiḥ || 149.3 || dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya śukle ca samupoṣitaḥ | gandhamālyairjagannāthaṃ pūjayetpāṇḍunandana || 149.4 || brāhmaṇāṃśca mahābhāga dānasaṃmānabhojanaiḥ | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 149.5 || satrayājiphalaṃ janturlabhate dvādaśābdakaiḥ | brāhmaṇānbhojayaṃstatra tadeva labhate phalam || 149.6 || tarpayitvā pitḥn devān snātvā tadgatamānasaḥ | japeddvādaśanāmāni devasya purataḥ sthitaḥ || 149.7 || māsi māsi nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ kurunandana | keśavaṃ pūjayennityaṃ māsi mārgaśire budhaḥ || 149.8 || pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ māghamāse tu mādhavam | govindaṃ phālgune māsi viṣṇuṃ caitre samarcayet || 149.9 || vaiśākhe madhuhantāraṃ jyeṣṭhe devaṃ trivikramam | vāmanaṃ tu tathāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ smaret || 149.10 || hṛṣīkeśaṃ bhādrapade padmanābhaṃ tathāśvine | dāmodaraṃ kārttike tu kīrtayannāvasīdati || 149.11 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam | tannaśyati na sandeho māsanāmānukīrtanāt || 149.12 || svayaṃ vinuddhaḥ satatamunmiṣannimiṣaṃstathā | śīghraṃ prapaśya bhuñjāno mantrahīnaṃ samudgiret || 149.13 || paramāpadgatasyāpi jantoreṣā pratikriyā | yanmāsādhipaterviṣṇormāsanāmānukīrtanam || 149.14 || tā niśāste ca divasāste māsāste ca vatsarāḥ | narāṇāṃ saphalā yeṣu cintito bhagavānhariḥ || 149.15 || paramāpadgatasyāpi yasya devo janārdanaḥ | nāvasarpati hṛtpadmātsa yogī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 149.16 || te bhāgyahīnā manujāḥ suśocyāste bhūmibhārāya kṛtāvatārāḥ | acetanāste paśubhiḥ samānā ye bhaktihīnā bhagavatyanante || 149.17 || te pūrṇakāryāḥ puruṣāḥ pṛthivyāṃ te svāṅgapātādbhuvanaṃ punanti | vicakṣaṇā viśvavibhūṣaṇāste ye bhaktiyuktā bhagavatyanante || 149.18 || sa eva sukṛtī tena labdhaṃ janmataroḥ phalam | citte vacasi kāye ca yasya devo janārdanaḥ || 149.19 || etattīrthavaraṃ puṇyaṃ liṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ | vañcayitvā ripūnsaṃkhye krodho bhūtvā sanātanaḥ || 149.20 || upaplave candramaso raveśca yo hyaṣṭakānāmayanadvaye ca | pānīyamapyatra tilairvimiśraṃ dadyātpitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ || 149.21 || ghoṇonmīlitamerurandhranivaho duḥkhābdhimajjatplavaḥ prādurbhūtarasātalodarabṛhatpaṅkārdhamagnakṣuraḥ | phūtkārotkaranunnavātavidaladdigdantinādaśrutinyastastabdhavapuḥ śrutirbhavatu vaḥ kroḍo hariḥ śāntaye || 149.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe liṅgavārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.150>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja kusumeśvaramuttamam | dakṣiṇe narmadākūle upapātakanāśanam || 150.1 || kāmena sthāpito devaḥ kusumeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ | khyātaḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 150.2 || kāmo manobhavo viśvaḥ kusumāyudhacāpabhṛt | sa kāmān dadāti sarvān pūjito mīnaketanaḥ || 150.3 || tena nirdagdhakāyena cārādhya parameśvaram | anaṅgena tathā prāptamaṅgitvaṃ narmadātaṭe || 150.4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca aṅgibhṛtasya nāśatvamanaṅgasya tu me vada | na śrutaṃ na ca me dṛṣṭaṃ bhūtapūrvaṃ kadācana || 150.5 || etatsarvaṃ yathā vṛttamācakṣva dvijasattama | śrotumicchāmi viprendra bhīmārjunayamaiḥ saha || 150.6 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ādau kṛtayuge tāta devadevo maheśvaraḥ | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃsthitaḥ || 150.7 || tena sampāditā lokāstapasā sasurāsurāḥ | jagmuste śaraṇaṃ sarve devadevaṃ śacīpatim || 150.8 || vyāpakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ | saṃtāpayati lokāṃstrīṃstannivāraya gopate || 150.9 || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ devānāṃ balavṛtrahā | cintayāmāsa manasā tapovighnāyacādiśat || 150.10 || apsarāṃ menakāṃ rambhāṃ ghṛtācīṃ ca tilottamām | vasantaṃ kokilaṃ kāmaṃ dakṣiṇānilamuttamam || 150.11 || gatvā tatra mahādevaṃ tapaścaraṇatatparam | kṣobhayadhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ gaṅgāsāgaravāsinam || 150.12 || evamuktāstu te sarve devarājena bhārata | devāpsaraḥsamopetā jagmuste harasannidhau || 150.13 || vasantamāse kusumākarākule mayūradātyūhasukokilākule | pranṛtya devāpsaragītasaṃkule pravāti vāte yamanairṛtākule || 150.14 || tena saṃmūrchitāḥ sarve saṃsargācca khagottamāḥ | madhumādhavagandhena sakinnaramahoragāḥ || 150.15 || yāvadālokate tāvattadvanaṃ vyākulīkṛtam | vīkṣate madanāviṣṭaṃ daśāvasthāgataṃ janam || 150.16 || devadevo'pi devānāmavasthātritayaṃ gataḥ | sāttvikīṃ rājasīṃ rājaṃstāmasīṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 150.17 || ekaṃ yogasamādhinā mukulitaṃ cakṣurdvitīyaṃ punaḥ pārvatyā jaghanasthalastanataṭe śṛṅgārabhārālasam | anyaddūranirastacāpamadanakrodhānaloddīpitaṃ śambhorbhinnarasaṃ samādhisamaye netratrayaṃ pātu vaḥ || 150.18 || evaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa devena saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ | bhasmībhūto gataḥ kāmo vināśaḥ sarvadehinām || 150.19 || kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣayaṃ yātaṃ tatra devāpsarogaṇāḥ | bhītā yathāgataṃ sarve jagmuścaiva diśo daśa || 150.20 || kāmena rahitā lokāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevā indrapurogamāḥ || 150.21 || sīdamānaṃ jagaddṛṣṭvā tamūcuḥ parameṣṭhinam | jānāsi tvaṃ jagaccheṣaṃ prabho maithunasambhavāt || 150.22 || prajāḥ sarvā viśuṣyanti kāmena rahitā vibho || 150.23 || etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ devānāṃ prapitāmahaḥ | jagāma sahitastatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 150.24 || atoṣayajjagannāthaṃ sarvabhūtamaheśvaram | stutibhistaṇḍakaiḥ stotrairvedavedāṅgasambhavaiḥ || 150.25 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ devānbrahmapurogamān || 150.26 || kiṃ kāryaṃ kaśca santāpaḥ kiṃ vāgamanakāraṇam | devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca kathyatāṃ mama māciram || 150.27 || devā ūcuḥ | kāmanāśājjagannāśo bhavitāyaṃ carācare | trailokyaṃ tvaṃ punaḥ śambho utpādayitumarhasi || 150.28 || etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ vimṛśya parameśvaraḥ | cintayāmāsa kāmasya vigrahaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 150.29 || ājagāma tataḥ śīghramanaṅgo hyaṅgatāṃ gataḥ | prāṇadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpasattama || 150.30 || tataḥ śaṅkhaninādena bherīṇāṃ niḥsvanena ca | abhyanandaṃstato devaṃ surāsuramahoragāḥ || 150.31 || namaste devadeveśa kṛtārthāḥ surasattamāḥ | visarjitāḥ punarjagmuryathāgatamarindama || 150.32 || gateṣu sarvadeveṣu kāmadevo'pi bhārata | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 150.33 || tapojapakṛśībhūto divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila |
