mahābhūtairvighnakaraiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ samantataḥ || 150.34 || ātmavighnavināśārthaṃ saṃsmṛtaḥ kuṇḍaleśvaraḥ | cakāra rakṣāṃ sarvatra śarapāte nṛpottama || 150.35 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dṛḍhabhaktyā varapradaḥ | vareṇa chandayāmāsa kāmaṃ kāmavināśanaḥ || 150.36 || jñātvā tuṣṭaṃ mahādevamuvāca jhaṣaketanaḥ | praṇataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā devadevaṃ trilocanam || 150.37 || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | atra tīrthe jagannātha sadā saṃnihito bhava || 150.38 || tatheti coktvā vacanaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ | jagāmākāśamāviśya stūyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 150.39 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve kāmadevo jagadgurum | sthāpayāmāsa rājendra kusumeśvarasaṃjñitam || 150.40 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ | caitramāse caturdaśyāṃ madanasya dine'thavā || 150.41 || prabhāte vimale prāpte snātvā pūjya divākaram | tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 150.42 || kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānena pūjayitvā ca taṃ nṛpa | piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 150.43 || sattrayājiphalaṃ yacca labhate dvādaśābdikam | piṇḍadānātphalaṃ tacca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 150.44 || aṅkullamūle yaḥ piṇḍaṃ pitḥnuddiśya dāpayet | tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ || 150.45 || kṛmikīṭapataṅgā ye tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | prāpnuvanti mṛtāḥ svargaṃ kiṃ punarye narā mṛtāḥ || 150.46 || saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yo'tra jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ | kusumeśe naro bhaktyā sa gacchecchivamandiram || 150.47 || tatra divyāpsarobhiśca devagandharvagāyanaiḥ | krīḍate sevyamānastu kalpakoṭiśataṃ nṛpa || 150.48 || pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ | jāyate rājarājendraiḥ pūjyamāno nṛpo mahān || 150.49 || surūpaḥ subhago vāgmī vikrānto matimāñchuciḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ || 150.50 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthakoṭiśatādhikam | kusumeśeti vikhyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 150.51 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kusumeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.151>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca uttare narmadākūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | jayavārāhamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 151.1 || uddhṛtā jagatī yena sarvadevanamaskṛtā | lokānugrahabuddhyā ca saṃsthito narmadātaṭe || 151.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vīkṣate madhusūdanam | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo daśajanmānukīrtanāt || 151.3 || matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkiśca te daśa || 151.4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca matsyena kiṃ kṛtaṃ tāta kūrmeṇa munisattama | varāheṇa ca kiṃ karma narasiṃhena kiṃ kṛtam || 151.5 || vāmanena ca rāmeṇa rāghaveṇa ca kiṃ kṛtam | buddharūpeṇa kiṃ vāpi kalkinā kiṃ kṛtaṃ vada || 151.6 || evamuktastu viprendro dharmaputreṇa dhīmatā | uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tadā dharmasutaṃ prati || 151.7 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca mīno bhūtvā purā kalpe prītyarthaṃ brahmaṇo vibhuḥ | samarpayatsamuddhṛtya vandānmagnānmahārṇave || 151.8 || amṛtotpādane rājankūrmo bhūtvā jagadguruḥ | mandaraṃ dhārayāmāsa tathā devīṃ vasuṃdharām || 151.9 || ujjahāra dharāṃ magnāṃ pātālatalavāsinīm | vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya devadevo janārdanaḥ || 151.10 || narasyārddhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārddhatanuṃ tathā | hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo vidadāra nakhāṅkuśaiḥ || 151.11 || jaṭī vāmanarūpeṇa stūyamāno dvijottamaiḥ | taddivyaṃ rūpamāsthāya kramitvā medinīṃ kramaiḥ || 151.12 || kṛtavāṃśca baliṃ paścātpātālatalavāsinam | sthāpayitvā surān sarvān gato viṣṇuḥ svakaṃ puram || 151.13 || jamadagnisuto rāmo bhūtvā śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | kṣatriyān pṛthivīpālānavadhīddhaihayādikān || 151.14 || kaśyapāya mahīṃ dattvā saparvatavanākarām | tapastapati deveśo mahendre'dyāpi bhārata || 151.15 || tato dāśarathī rāmo rāvaṇaṃ devakaṇṭakam | sagaṇaṃ samare hatvā rājyaṃ dattvā vibhīṣaṇe || 151.16 || pālayitvā nayādbhūmiṃ makhaiḥ saṃtarpya devatāḥ | svargaṃ gato mahātejā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || 151.17 || vasudevagṛhe bhūyaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān | avatīrṇo jagannātho vāsudevo yudhiṣṭhira || 151.18 || so'vadhīttava sāmarthyādvadhārthaṃ duṣṭabhūbhṛtām | cāṇūrakaṃsakeśīnāṃ jarāsaṃdhasya bhārata || 151.19 || tena tvaṃ susahāyena hatvā śatrūnnareśvara | bhokṣyase pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha saṃbhṛtām || 151.20 || tathā buddhatvamaparaṃ navamaṃ prāpsyate'cyutaḥ | śāntimāndevadeveśo madhuhantā madhupriyaḥ || 151.21 || tena buddhasvarūpeṇa devena parameṣṭhinā | bhaviṣyati jagatsarvaṃ mohitaṃ sacarācaram || 151.22 || na śroṣyanti pituḥ putrāstadāprabhṛti bhārata | na gurorbāndhavāḥ śiṣyā bhaviṣyatyadharottaram || 151.23 || jito dharmo hyadharmeṇa cāsatyena ṛtaṃ jitam | jitāścauraiśca rājānaḥ strībhiśca puruṣā jitāḥ || 151.24 || sīdanti cāgnihotrāṇi gurau pūjā praṇaśyati | sīdanti mānavā dharmāḥ kalau prāpte yudhiṣṭhira || 151.25 || dvādaśe daśame varṣe nārī garbhavatī bhavet | kanyāstatra prasūyante brāhmaṇo haripiṅgalaḥ || 151.26 || bhaviṣyati tataḥ kalkirdaśame janmani prabhuḥ || 151.27 || etatte kathitaṃ rājandevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ | kāraṇaṃ daśa janmanāṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 151.28 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śvetavārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.152>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharāpāla bhārgaleśvaramuttamam | śaṅkaraṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ smṛtamātrāghanāśanam || 152.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 152.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 152.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhārgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.153>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyadravitīrthamanuttamam | yasya saṃdarśanādeva mucyante pātakairnarāḥ || 153.1 || ravitīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā naraḥ paśyati bhāskaram | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ devena tacchṛṇu || 153.2 || nāndho na mūko badhiraḥ kule bhavati kaścana | kurūpaḥ kunakhī vāpi tasya janmāni ṣoḍaśa || 153.3 || dadrucitrakakuṣṭhāni maṇḍalāni vicarcikā | naśyanti devabhaktasya ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 153.4 || caritaṃ tasya devasya purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā | na tatkathayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa nṛpottama || 153.5 || tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ ravimuddiśya dīyate | vidhinā pātraviprāya tasyānto nāsti karhicit || 153.6 || ayane viṣuve caiva candrasūryagrahe tathā | ravitīrthe pradattānāṃ dānānāṃ phalamuttamam || 153.7 || saṃkrāntau yāni dānāni havyakavyāni bhārata | apāmiva samudrasya teṣāmanto na labhyate || 153.8 || yena yena yadā dattaṃ yena yena yadā hutam | tasya tasya tadā kāle savitā pratidāyakaḥ || 153.9 || sapta janmāni tānyeva dadātyarkaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | śatamindukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ tu dinakṣaye || 153.10 || saṃkrāntau śatasāhasraṃ vyatīpāte tvanantakam || 153.11 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ravitīrthaṃ kathaṃ tāta puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ smṛtam | vistareṇa mamākhyāhi śravaṇau mama lampaṭau || 153.12 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā hyādityeśvaramuttamam | uttare narmadākūle sarvavyādhivināśanam || 153.13 || purā kṛtayugasyādau jābālirbrāhmaṇo'bhavat | vasiṣṭhānvayasambhūto vedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 153.14 || pativratā sādhuśīlā tasya bhāryā manasvinī | ṛtukāle tu sā gatvā bhartāramidamabravīt || 153.15 || vartate ṛtukālo me bhartāraṃ tvāmupasthitā | bhaja māṃ prītisaṃyuktaḥ putrakāmāṃ tu kāminīm || 153.16 || evamukto dvijaḥ prāha priye'dyāhaṃ vratānvitaḥ | gacchedānīṃ varārohe dāsya ṛtvantare punaḥ || 153.17 || punardvitīye samprāpte ṛtukāle'pyupasthitā | punaḥ sā chanditā tena vratastho'dyeti bhārata || 153.18 || itthaṃ vā bahuśastena chanditā ca punaḥ punaḥ | nirāśā cābhavattatra bhartāraṃ prati bhāminī || 153.19 || duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭā vidhāyānaśanaṃ mṛtā | tena bhrūṇahatenaiva pāpena sahasā dvijaḥ || 153.20 || śīrṇaghrāṇāṅghrirabhavattapaḥ sarvaṃ nanāśa ca | dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ sa kuṣṭhena vyāptaṃ brāhmaṇasattamaḥ || 153.21 || viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatvā narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ | apṛcchadbhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ dvijebhyo dvijasattamaḥ || 153.22 || ārogyaṃ bhāskarādicchediti saṃcintya cetasi | kutastadbhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ bho dvijāḥ kathyatāṃ mama || 153.23 || tapastapyāmyahaṃ gatvā tasmiṃstīrthe subhāvitaḥ || 153.24 || dvijā ūcuḥ | revāyā uttare kūle ādityeśvaranāmataḥ | vidyate bhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 153.25 || tatra yāhyavicāreṇa gantuṃ cecchakyate tvayā | evamukto dvijairvipro gantuṃ tatra pracakrame || 153.26 || vyādhinā paribhūtastu ghoreṇa prāṇahāriṇā | yadā gantuṃ na śaknoti tadā tena vicintitam || 153.27 || sāmarthyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hi vidyate bhuvanatraye | liṅgapātaḥ kṛto viprairdevadevasya śūlinaḥ || 153.28 || samudraḥ śoṣito viprairvindhyaścāpi nivāritaḥ | ahamapyatra saṃsthastu hyānayiṣyāmi bhāskaram || 153.29 || tapobalena mahatā hyādityeśvarasaṃjñitam | iti niścitya manasā hyugre tapasi saṃsthitaḥ || 153.30 || vāyubhakṣo nirāhāro grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyagaḥ | śiśire toyamadhyastho varṣāsvaprāvṛtākṛtiḥ || 153.31 || sāgre varṣaśate pūrṇe ravistuṣṭo'bravīdidam || 153.32 || sūrya uvāca varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kiṃ te manasi vāñchitam | adeyamapi dāsyāmi brūhi māṃ tvaṃ ciraṃ kṛthāḥ || 153.33 || kimasādhyaṃ hi te vipra idānīṃ tapasi sthitaḥ || 153.34 || jābāliruvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama | mama pratijñā deveśa hyādityeśvaradarśane || 153.35 || kṛtā tāṃ pārituṃ deva na śakto vyādhinā vṛtaḥ | śuklatīrthe'tra tiṣṭha tvamādityeśvaramūrtidhṛk || 153.36 || evamukte tu deveśo bahurūpo divākaraḥ | uttare narmadākūle kṣaṇādeva vyadṛśyata || 153.37 || tadāprabhṛti bhūpāla taddhi tīrthaṃ pracakṣate | sarvapāpaharaṃ proktaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 153.38 || yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ nityamādityavāsare | snātvā pradakṣiṇāḥ sapta dattvā paśyati bhāskaram || 153.39 || yatphalaṃ labhate tena tacchṛṇuṣva mayoditam | prasuptaṃ maṇḍalānīha dadrukuṣṭhavicarcikāḥ || 153.40 || naśyanti satvaraṃ rājaṃstūlarāśirivānale | dhanaputrakalatrāṇāṃ pūrayedvatsaratrayāt || 153.41 || yastu śrāddhapradastatra pitḥnuddiśya saṃkrame | tṛpyanti pitarastasya pitṛdevo hi bhāskaraḥ || 153.42 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvamādityeśvaramuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvarogavināśanam || 153.43 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādityeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.154>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ kalakaleśvaram | vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu svayaṃ devena nirmitam || 154.1 || andhakaṃ samare hatvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ | sahito devagandharvaiḥ kinnaraiśca mahoragaiḥ || 154.2 || śaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca mṛdaṅgapaṇavādibhiḥ | vīṇāveṇuravaiścānyaiḥ stutibhiḥ puṣkalādibhiḥ || 154.3 || gāyanti sāmāni yajūṃṣi cānye chandāṃsi cānye ṛcamudgiranti | stotrairanekairapare gṛṇanti maheśvaraṃ tatra mahānubhāvāḥ || 154.4 || pramathānāṃ ninādena kalkalena ca bandinām | yasmātpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmājjātaṃ tadākhyayā || 154.5 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vīkṣetkalakaleśvaram | vājapeyātparaṃ puṇyaṃ sa labhenmānavo bhuvi || 154.6 || tena puṇyena pūtātmā prāṇatyāgāddivaṃ vrajet | ārūḍhaḥ paramaṃ yānaṃ gīyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 154.7 || upabhujya mahābhogānkālena mahatā tataḥ | martyaloke mahātmāsau jāyate vimale kule || 154.8 || brāhmaṇaḥ subhago loke vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 154.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kalakaleśvaratīrthaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.155>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvatīrthādanuttamam | uttare narmadākūle śuklatīrthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 155.1 || tasya tīrthasya cānyāni puṇyatvācchubhadarśanāt | pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 155.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaistathānyairdvijasattamaiḥ || 155.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śuklatīrthasya cotpattimākarṇaya nareśvara | yasya saṃdarśanādeva brahmahatyā pralīyate || 155.4 || narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | yacca bālyaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ darśanādeva naśyati || 155.5 || mokṣadāni na sarvatra śuklatīrthamṛte nṛpa | śuklatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā || 155.6 || samāgame munīnāṃ tu devānāṃ hi tathaiva ca | kathitaṃ devadevena śitikaṇṭhena bhārata | kailāse parvataśreṣṭhe tatte saṃkathayāmyaham || 155.7 || purā kṛtayugasyādau toṣituṃ girijāpatim | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ viṣṇurvarṣasahasrakam | vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraḥ śuklatīrthe vyavasthitaḥ || 155.8 || tataḥ pratyakṣatāmāgāddevadevo maheśvaraḥ | prādurbhūtastu sahasā tatra tīrthe narādhipa || 155.9 || krośadvayamidaṃ cakre bhuktimuktipradāyakam | tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 155.10 || gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī | grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā || 155.11 || sarvauṣadhīnāmaśanaṃ pradhānaṃ sarveṣu peyeṣu jalaṃ pradhānam | nidrā sukhānāṃ pramadā ratīnāṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu śiraḥ pradhānam || 155.12 || snātasyāpi yathā puṇyaṃ lalāṭaṃ nṛpasattama | śuklatīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 155.13 || saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā devatānāṃ janārdanaḥ | śuklatīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 155.14 || catuṣpadānāṃ surabhirvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā | pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ śuklatīrthaṃ tathā nṛpa || 155.15 || grahāṇāṃ tu yathādityo nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā śaśī | śiro vā sarvagātrāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ satyamiṣyate || 155.16 || tathaiva pārtha tīrthānāṃ śuklatīrthamanuttamam | durvijñeyo yathā loke paramātmā sanātanaḥ || 155.17 || susūkṣmatvādanirdeśyaḥ śuklatīrthaṃ tathā nṛpa | mandaprajñatvamāpanne mahāmohasamanvitaḥ || 155.18 || śuklatīrthaṃ nā jānāti narmadātaṭasaṃsthitam | bahunātra kimuktena dharmaputra punaḥ punaḥ || 155.19 || śuklatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ samprāptaṃ kalmaṣakṣayāt | yo'tra datte śucirbhūtvā ekaṃ revājalāñjalim || 155.20 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi pitarastena tarpitāḥ || 155.21 || ekaḥ putro dharāpṛṣṭhe pitḥṇāmārtināśanaḥ | cāṇakyo nāma rājābhūcchuklatīrthaṃ ca veda saḥ || 155.22 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ko'sau dvijavaraśreṣṭha cāṇakyo nāma nāmataḥ | śuklatīrthasya yo vettā nānyo vettā hi kaścana || 155.23 || kenopāyena tattīrthaṃ tena jñātaṃ dharātale | tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 155.24 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ikṣvākuprabhavo rājā naptā śuddhodanasya ca | cāṇakyo nāma rājarṣirbubhuje pṛthivīmimām || 155.25 || vikrānto matimāñchūraḥ sarvalokairavañcitaḥ | vañcitaḥ sahasā dhūrtavāyasābhyāṃ nṛpottamaḥ || 155.26 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ sa vañcito rājā vāyasābhyāṃ kuto'thavā | purā yena pratijñātaṃ dhīgarbheṇa mahātmanā || 155.27 || na jīve vañcito'nyena prāṇāṃstyakṣye na saṃśayaḥ | etanme vada viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 155.28 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ātmānaṃ vañcitaṃ jñātvā tadā saṃgṛhya vāyasau | preṣayāmāsa tīvreṇa daṇḍena yamasādanam || 155.29 || vāyasāvūcatuḥ | sundopasundayoḥ putrāvāvāṃ kākatvamāgatau | mā vadhīstvaṃ mahābhāga kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare || 155.30 || tāvāvāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpau tvayā kopena mānada | nirastāvanirastau vā yāsyāvaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 155.31 || tadādeśaya rājendra kṛtvā tava mahatpriyam | muktaśāpau bhaviṣyāvo brahmaṇo vacanaṃ tathā || 155.32 || tacchrutvā kākavacanaṃ cāṇakyo nṛpasattamaḥ | nāhaṃ jīve viditvaivaṃ vañcitaḥ kena karhicit || 155.33 || tasmāttīrthaṃ vijānītaṃ yamasya sadane dvijau | preṣayāmi yathānyāyaṃ śrutvā tatkathayiṣyathaḥ || 155.34 || tenaiva muktau tau kākau srakcandanavibhūṣitau | śīghragau preṣayāmāsa yamasya sadanaṃ prati || 155.35 || rājovāca tatra dharmapuraṃ gatvā vicarantāvitastataḥ | yadi pṛcchati dharmātmā yamaḥ saṃyamano mahān || 155.36 || kuto vāmāgataṃ brūtaṃ kena vā bhūṣitāvubhau | madīyā bhāratī tasya kathanīyā hyaśaṅkitam || 155.37 || ikṣvākusaṃbhavo rājā cāṇakyo nāma dhārmikaḥ | dvādaśāhe mṛtasyāsya tarpitāvaśanādinā || 155.38 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājño gatau tau yamasādanam | krīḍitau prāṅgaṇe tasya srakcandanavibhūṣitau | dharmarājena tau dṛṣṭau pṛṣṭau dhṛṣṭau ca vāyasau || 155.39 || yama uvāca kutaḥ sthānātsamāyātau kena vā bhūṣitāvubhau | vṛttaṃ vai kathyatāmetadvāyasāvaviśaṅkayā || 155.40 || kākāvūcatuḥ | ikṣvākusambhavo rājā cāṇakyo nāma dhārmikaḥ | dvādaśāhe mṛtasyāsya tarpitāvaśanādibhiḥ || 155.41 || tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā sadā vaivasvato yamaḥ | citraguptaṃ kaliṃ kālaṃ vīkṣyatāmidamabravīt || 155.42 || aṇḍajasvedajātīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ sacarācare | vihitaṃ lokakartḥṇāṃ sānnidhyaṃ brahmaṇā mama || 155.43 || gataḥ kutra durācāraścāṇakyo nāmatastviha | anviṣyatāṃ purāṇeṣu tvitihāseṣu yā gatiḥ || 155.44 || tatastairdharmapālaistu dharmarājapracoditaiḥ | nirīkṣitā purāṇoktā karmajā gatirāgatiḥ || 155.45 || tataḥ provāca vacanaṃ dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | śṛṇvatāṃ dharmapālānāṃ meghagambhīrayā girā || 155.46 || śuklatīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narmadāvimale jale | aṇḍajasvedajātīnāṃ na gatirmama sannidhau || 155.47 || tattīrthaṃ dhārmikaṃ loke brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ | nirmitaṃ parayā bhaktyā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 155.48 || pāpopapātakairyuktā ye narā narmadājale | śuklatīrthe mṛtāḥ śuddhā na te madviṣayāḥ kvacit || 155.49 || etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ tau kākau yamabhāṣitam | āgatau śīghragau pārtha dṛṣṭvā yamapuraṃ mahat || 155.50 || pṛṣṭau tau praṇatau rājñā yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam | kathayāmāsatuḥ pārtha dānavau kākatāṃ gatau || 155.51 || asmātsthānādgatāvāvāṃ yamasya puramuttamam | pṛthivyā dakṣiṇe bhāge hyatītya bahuyonijam || 155.52 || tatpuraṃ kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svarṇaprākāratoraṇam | anekagṛhasambādhaṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitam || 155.53 || catuṣpathaiścatvaraiśca ghaṇṭāmārgopaśobhitam | udyānavanasaṃchannaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamanditam || 155.54 || haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭaṃ kokilākulasaṃkulam | siṃhavyāghragajākīrṇamṛkṣavānarasevitam || 155.55 || naranārīsamākīrṇaṃ nityotsavavibhūṣitam | śaṃkhadundubhirnirghoṣairvīṇāveṇunināditam || 155.56 || yamamārge'pi vihitaṃ svargalokamivāparam | gatau tatra punaścānyairyamadūtairyamājñayā || 155.57 || viditau preṣitau tatra yatra devo jagatprabhuḥ | prāṇasya bhītyā dṛṣṭo'sau siṃhāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ || 155.58 || mahākāyo mahājaṅgho mahāskandho mahodaraḥ | mahāvakṣā mahābāhurmahāvaktrekṣaṇo mahān || 155.59 || mahāmahiṣamārūḍho mahāmukuṭabhūṣitaḥ | tatrānyaśca kaliḥ kālaścitragupto mahāmatiḥ || 155.60 || samāgatau tadā dṛṣṭau madhye jvalitapāvakau | puṇyapāpāni jantūnāṃ śrutismṛtyarthapāragau || 155.61 || vicārayantau satataṃ tiṣṭhāte tau divāniśam | tato hyāvāṃ praṇāmānte yamena yamamūrtinā || 155.62 || pṛṣṭāvāgamane hetuṃ tamabrūva śṛṇuṣva tat | ujjayinyāṃ mahīpālaścāṇakyo'bhūtpratāpavān || 155.63 || dvādaśāhe mṛtasyāsya bhuktvā prāptau yamālayam | tato'smākaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā kampayitvā śiro yamaḥ || 155.64 || uvāca vacanaṃ satyaṃ sabhāmadhye hasanniva | asti tatkāraṇaṃ yena cāṇakyaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ || 155.65 || nāyāto mama loke tu sarvapāpabhayaṃkare | śuklatīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narmadāyāṃ paraṃ padam || 155.66 || jāyate sarvajantūnāṃ nātra kācidvicāraṇā | avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi jantustatkṣetramaṇḍale || 155.67 || mṛtaḥ sa vai na sandeho rudrasyānucaro bhavet | taddharmavacanaṃ śrutvā nirgatya nagarādbahiḥ || 155.68 || paśyantau vividhāṃ ghorāṃ narake lokayātanām | triṃśatkoṭyo hi ghorāṇāṃ narakāṇāṃ nṛpottama || 155.69 || dṛṣṭā bhītau parāmārtigatau tatra mahāpathi | narako rauravastatra mahāraurava eva ca || 155.70 || peṣaṇaḥ śoṣaṇaścaiva kālasūtro'sthibhañjanaḥ | tāmisraścāndhatāmisraḥ kṛmipūtivahastathā || 155.71 || dṛṣṭaścānyo mahājvālastatraiva viṣabhojanaḥ | narakau daṃśamaśakau tathā yamalaparvatau || 155.72 || nadī vaitaraṇī dṛṣṭā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | śītalaṃ salilaṃ yatra pibanti hyamṛtopamam || 155.73 || tadeva nīraṃ pāpānāṃ śoṇitaṃ parivartate | asipatravanaṃ cānyaddṛṣṭānyā mahatī śilā || 155.74 || agnipuṃjanibhākārā viśālā śālmalī parā | ityādayastathaivānye śatasāhasrasaṃjñitāḥ || 155.75 || ghoraghoratarā dṛṣṭāḥ kliśyante yatra mānavāḥ | vācikairmānasaiḥ pāpaiḥ karmajaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 155.76 || ahaṃkārakṛtairdoṣairmāyāvacanapūrvakaiḥ | pitā mātā gururbhrātā anāthā vikalendriyāḥ || 155.77 || bhramanti noddhṛtā yeṣāṃ gatisteṣāṃ hi raurave | tatra te dvādaśābdāni kṣapitvā raurave'dhamāḥ || 155.78 || iha mānuṣyake loke dīnāndhāśca bhavanti te | devabrahmasvahartḥṇāṃ narāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām || 155.79 || mahārauravamāśritya dhruvaṃ vāso yamālaye | tataḥ kālena mahatā pāpāḥ pāpena veṣṭitāḥ || 155.80 || jāyante kaṇṭakairbhinnāḥ kośe vā kośakārakāḥ | mṛgapakṣivihaṅgānāṃ ghātakā māṃsabhakṣakāḥ || 155.81 || peṣaṇaṃ narakaṃ yānti śoṣaṇaṃ jīvabandhanāt | tatratyāṃ yātanāṃ ghorāṃ sahitvā śāstracoditām || 155.82 || iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya paṅgvandhabadhirā narāḥ | gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca hyanṛtaṃ vadatāmiha || 155.83 || patanaṃ jāyate puṃsāṃ narake kālasūtrake | tatratyā yātanā ghorā vihitā śāstrakartṛbhiḥ || 155.84 || bhuktvā samāgatā hyatra te yāsyantyantyajāṃ gatim | bandhayanti ca ye jīvāṃstyaktvātmakulasantatim || 155.85 || patanti nātra sandeho narake te'sthibhañjane | tatra varṣaśatasyānta iha mānuṣyatāṃ gatāḥ || 155.86 || kubjā vāmanakāḥ pāpā jāyante duḥkhabhāginaḥ | ye tyajanti svakāṃ bhāryāṃ mūḍhāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ || 155.87 || te yānti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | tatra varṣaśatasyānte iha mānuṣyatāṃ gatāḥ || 155.88 || duścarmāṇo durbhagāśca jāyante mānavā hi te | mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kūṭakaṃ tu vadanti ye || 155.89 || narake te'ndhatāmisre prapacyante narādhamāḥ | śatasāhasrikaṃ kālamuṣitvā tatra te narāḥ || 155.90 || iha śatrugṛhe tvandhā bhramante dīnamūrtayaḥ | pitṛdevadvijebhyo'nnamadattvā ye'tra bhuñjate || 155.91 || narake kṛmibhakṣye te patanti svātmapoṣakāḥ | tataḥ prasūtikāle hi kṛmibhuktaśca savraṇaḥ || 155.92 || jāyate'śucigandho'tra parabhāgyopajīvakaḥ | svakarmavicyutāḥ pāpā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ || 155.93 || narake pūyasampūrṇe kliśyante hyayutaṃ samāḥ | pūrṇe tatra tataḥ kāle prāpya mānuṣyakaṃ bhavam || 155.94 || udvejanīyā bhūtānāṃ jāyante vyādhibhirvṛtāḥ | agnido garadaścaiva lobhamohānvito naraḥ || 155.95 || narake viṣasampūrṇe nimajjati durātmavān | tatra varṣaśatātkālādunmajjanamavasthitaḥ || 155.96 || bhuvi mānuṣatāṃ prāpya kṛpaṇo jāyate punaḥ | pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ prāvaraṇāni ca || 155.97 || adattvā daṃśamaśakairbhakṣyante janyasaptatim | piturdravyāpahartārastāḍanakrośane ratāḥ || 155.98 || pīḍanaṃ kriyate teṣāṃ yatra tau yugmaparvatau | yā sā vaitaraṇī ghorā nadī raktapravāhinī || 155.99 || pibanti rudhiraṃ tatra ye'bhiyānti rajasvalām | asipatravane ghore pīḍyante pāpakāriṇaḥ || 155.100 || parapīḍākarā nityaṃ ye naro'ntyajagāminaḥ | gurudāraratānāṃ tu mahāpātakināmapi || 155.101 || śilāvagūhanaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate janmasaptatim | jvalantīmāyasīṃ ghorāṃ bahukaṇṭakasaṃvṛtām || 155.102 || śālmalīṃ te'vagūhanti paradāraratā hi ye | parasya yoṣitaṃ hṛtvā brahmasvamapahṛtya ca || 155.103 || araṇye nirjale deśe sa bhavetkrūrarākṣasaḥ | devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca lobhenaivāharecca yaḥ || 155.104 || sa pāpātmā pare loke gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati | evamādīni pāpāni bhuñjante yamaśāsanāt || 155.105 || yeṣāṃ tu darśanādeva śravaṇājjāyate bhayam | tathā dānaphalaṃ cānye bhuñjānā yamamandire || 155.106 || dṛṣṭāḥ śrutaṃ kathayatāṃ dūtānāṃ ca yamājñayā | rathairanye gajairanye kecidvājibhirāvṛtāḥ || 155.107 || dṛṣṭāstatra mahābhāga tapaḥsaṃcayasaṃsthitāḥ | godātā svarṇadātā ca bhūmiratnapradā narāḥ || 155.108 || śayyāśanagṛhādīnāṃ sa lokaḥ kāmado nṛṇām | annaṃ pānīyasahitaṃ dadate ye'tra mānavāḥ || 155.109 || tatra tṛptāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ krīḍante yamasādane | atra yaddīyate dānamapi vālāgramātrakam || 155.110 || tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ śuklatīrthe nṛpottama | etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ yacca vai śrutam || 155.111 || kuruṣva yadabhipretaṃ yadi śaknoṣi mucyatām | tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā cāṇakyo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 155.112 || visarjayāmāsa khagāvabhinandya punaḥpunaḥ | tābhyāṃ gatābhyāṃ sarvasvaṃ dattvā vipreṣu bhārata || 155.113 || kāmakrodhau parityajya jagāmāmaraparvatam | tatra baddhvoḍupaṃ gāḍhaṃ kṛṣṇarajjvāvalambitam || 155.114 || plavamāno'śu dhyāyandevaṃ janārdanam | ārogyaṃ bhāskarādiccheddhanaṃ vai jātavedasaḥ || 155.115 || prāpnoti jñānamīśānānmokṣaṃ prāpnoti keśavāt | nīlaṃ raktaṃ tadabhavanmecakaṃ yaddhi sūtrakam || 155.116 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rajjuṃ mahāmatiḥ | āplutya vimale toye gato'sau vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 155.117 || gāyanti yadvedavidaḥ purāṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śāśvatamacyutāhvayam | prāptaḥ sa taṃ rājasuto mahātmā nikṣipya dehaṃ śubhaśuklatīrthe || 155.118 || eṣā te kathitā rājansiddhiścāṇakyabhūbhṛtaḥ | tathānyattava vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 155.119 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe cāṇakyasiddhiprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.156>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca nāsti lokeṣu tattīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yannareśvara | śuklatīrthena sadṛśamupamānena gīyate || 156.1 || śuklatīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam | prāgudakpravaṇe deśe munisaṅghaniṣevitam || 156.2 || vaiśākhe ca tathā māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī | kailāsādumayā sārddhaṃ svayamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ || 156.3 || madhyāhnasamaye snātvā paśyatyātmānamātmanā | brahmaviṣṇvindrasahitaḥ śuklatīrthe samāhitaḥ || 156.4 || kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa vaiśākhyāṃ ca narottama | brahmaviṣṇumahādevān snātvā paśyati taddine || 156.5 || devarājaḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ vāyumārgavyavasthitaḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā paśyati śaṅkaram || 156.6 || gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ | taddine te'pi deveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā muñcanti kilbiṣam || 156.7 || ardhayojanavistāraṃ tadarddhenaiva cāyatam | śuklatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 156.8 || yatra sthitaiḥ pradṛśyante vṛkṣāgrāṇi narottamaiḥ | tatra sthitā mahāpāpairmucyante pūrvasaṃcitaiḥ || 156.9 || pāpopapātakairyukto naraḥ snātvā pramucyate | upārjitā vinaśyeta bhrūṇahatyāpi dustyajā || 156.10 || yasmāttatraiva deveśa umayā saha tiṣṭhati | vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kailāsādeti śaṅkaraḥ || 156.11 || tena tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | kathitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ mayā tava tathā nṛpa || 156.12 || rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam | tathā tatra vapuḥsnānaṃ puruṣasya bhavecchuci || 156.13 || pūrve vayasi pāpāni kṛtvā puṣṭāni mānavaḥ | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā śuklatīrthe vyapohati || 156.14 || śuklatīrthe mahārāja rākāṃ revājalāñjalim | kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi dattvā syuḥ pitaraḥ śivāḥ || 156.15 || na mātā na pitā bandhuḥ patanaṃ narakārṇave | uddharanti yathā puṇyaṃ śuklatīrthe nareśvara || 156.16 || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa na tāṃ gacchanti sadgatim | śuklatīrthe mṛto janturdehatyāgena yāṃ labhet || 156.17 || kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | ghṛtena snāpayeddevamupoṣya prayato naraḥ || 156.18 || snātvā prabhāte revāyāṃ dadyātsaghṛtakambalam | sahiraṇyaṃ yathāśakti devamuddiśya śaṅkaraṃ || 156.19 || devasya pūraṇaṃ kuryādghṛtena ghṛtakambalam | sa gacchati mahātejāḥ śivalokaṃ mṛto naraḥ || 156.20 || ekaviṃśakulopeto yāvadābhūtasamplavam | śuklatīrthe naraḥ snātvā hyumāṃ rudraṃ ca yo'rcayet || 156.21 || gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | māsopavāsaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe nareśvara || 156.22 || mucyate sa mahatpāpaiḥ saptajanmasusaṃcitaiḥ | uṣṭrīkṣīramavikṣīraṃ navaśrāddhe ca bhojanam || 156.23 || vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇam | avikraye'nṛte pāpaṃ māhiṣe'yājyayājake || 156.24 || vārddhuṣye paṅktigarade devabrāhmaṇadūṣake | evamādīni pāpāni tathānyānyapi bhārata || 156.25 || cāndrāyaṇena naśyanti śuklatīrthe na saṃśayaḥ | śuklatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 156.26 || tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti sutarpitāḥ | pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāmāsanameva ca || 156.27 || suvarṇaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ yuktahalaṃ tathā | annaṃ pānīyasaṃhitaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe dadanti ye || 156.28 || hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭā mṛtā yānti śivalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śivamuddiśya bhārata || 156.29 || bhikṣāmātraṃ tathānnaṃ ye te'pi svaryānti vai narāḥ | yajvināṃ vratināṃ caiva tatra tīrthanivāsinām || 156.30 || api vālāgramātraṃ hi dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam | agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryācchuklatīrthe samāhitaḥ || 156.31 || rāgadveṣavinirmukto hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam | sarvakāmasusampūrṇaḥ sa gacchedvāruṇaṃ puram || 156.32 || na rogo na jarā tatra yatra devo'ṃbhasāṃ patiḥ | anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira || 156.33 || anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam | avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi jantustatkṣetramaṇḍale || 156.34 || mṛtaḥ sa tu na sandeho rudrasyānucaro bhavet | śuklatīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ śaktyā dadyādalaṃkṛtām || 156.35 || vidhinā yo nṛpaśreṣṭha kurute vṛṣamokṣaṇam | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ purāṇe rudrabhāṣitam || 156.36 || tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa | yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ sarvāṅgeṣu pṛthakpṛthak || 156.37 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate | śuklatīrthe tu yaddattaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ || 156.38 || vardhate tadguṇaṃ tāvaddināni daśa pañca ca | śuklatīrthe śucirbhūtvā yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam || 156.39 || pṛthvī pradakṣiṇā tena kṛtā yattasya tatphalam | śobhanaṃ mithunaṃ yastu rudramuddiśya pūjayet || 156.40 || sapta janmāni tasyaiva viyogo na ca vai kvacit | etatte kathitaṃ rājan saṃkṣepeṇa phalaṃ mahat || 156.41 || śuklatīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ yathā devācchrutaṃ mayā | ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā purāṇe vihitaṃ phalam || 156.42 || sa labhennātra sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || 156.43 || mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ snānadānaphalaṃ mahat || 156.44 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śuklatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.157>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ rājañchuklatīrthasamīpataḥ | vāsudevasya tīrthaṃ tu sarvalokeṣu pūjitam || 157.1 || taddhi puṇyaṃ suvikhyātaṃ narmadāyāṃ purātanam | yatra huṅkāramātreṇa revā krośaṃ jagāma sā || 157.2 || yadā prabhṛti rājendra huṅkāreṇa gatā sarit | tadāprabhṛti sa svāmī huṅkāraḥ śabdito budhaiḥ || 157.3 || huṅkāratīrthe yaḥ snātvā paśyatyavyayamacyutam | sa mucyate naraḥ pāpaiḥ saptajanma kṛtairapi || 157.4 || saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ narāṇāṃ pāpakarmiṇām | naivoddhartā jagannāthaṃ vinā nārāyaṇaṃ paraḥ || 157.5 || sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ yattadarpitam | tāveva kevalau ślāghyau yau tatpūjākarau karau || 157.6 || sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu nāsti teṣāmamaṅgalam | yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavānmaṅgalāyatano hariḥ || 157.7 || yadanyaddevatārcāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | sāṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena tatphalaṃ labhate hareḥ || 157.8 || reṇuguṇṭhitagātrasya yāvanto'sya rajaḥkaṇāḥ | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 157.9 || sammārjanābhyukṣaṇalepanena tadālaye naśyati sarvapāpam | nārī narāṇāṃ parayā tu bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu revāṃ narasattamasya || 157.10 || yenārcito bhagavānvāsudevo janmārjitaṃ naśyati tasya pāpam | sa yāti lokaṃ garuḍadhvajasya vidhūtapāpaḥ surasaṅghapūjyatām || 157.11 || śāṭhyenāpi namaskāraṃ prayuñjaṃścakrapāṇinaḥ | saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ gacchatyāśu na saṃśayaḥ || 157.12 || pūjāyāṃ prīyate rudro japahomairdivākaraḥ | śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ praṇipātena tuṣyati || 157.13 || bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām | viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplavānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām || 157.14 || huṅkāratīrthe rājendra śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | yatkṛtaṃ puruṣavyāghra tannaśyati na karhicit || 157.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe huṅkārasvāmitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.158>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchetparaṃ tīrthaṃ saṅgameśvaramuttamam | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpabhayāpaham || 158.1 || dhanadastatra viśrānto muhūrtaṃ nṛpasattama | pitṛlokātsamāyātaḥ kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam || 158.2 || pratyayārthaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha hyadyāpi dharaṇītale | kṛṣṇavarṇā hi pāṣāṇā dṛśyante sphaṭikojjvalāḥ || 158.3 || vindhyanirjharaniṣkrāntā puṇyatoyā saridvarā | praviṣṭā narmadātoye sarvapāpapraṇāśane || 158.4 || saṅgame tatra yaḥ snātvā pūjayetsaṅgameśvaram | aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 158.5 || ghaṇṭāpatākāvitanaṃ yo dadetsaṅgameśvare | haṃsayuktavimānastho divyastrīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ || 158.6 || sa rudrapadamāpnoti rudrasyānucaro bhavet | dadhi bhakte na devasya yaḥ kuryālliṅgapūraṇam || 158.7 || sikthasaṃkhyaṃ śive loke sa vasetkālamīpsitam | śrīphalaiḥ pūrayelliṅgaṃ niḥsvo bhūtvā bhavasya tu || 158.8 || so'pi tatphalamāpnoti gataḥ svarge nareśvara | akṣayā santatistasya jāyate saptajanmasu || 158.9 || snapanaṃ devadevasya dadhnā madhughṛtena vā | yaḥ karoti vidhānena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 158.10 || dhṛtakṣīravahā nadyo yatra vṛkṣā madhusravāḥ | tatra te mānavā yānti suprasanne maheśvare || 158.11 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yastu dadyānmaheśvare | tatsarvaṃ saptajanmāni hyakṣayaṃ phalamaśnute || 158.12 || sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāṃ mahāpātraṃ maheśvaraḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyo maheśvaraḥ || 158.13 || brahmacaryasthito nityaṃ yastu pūjayate śivam | iha jīvansa deveśo mṛto gacchedanāmayam || 158.14 || śive tu pūjite pārtha yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ | yogīndre caiva tatpārtha pūjite labhate phalam || 158.15 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu bhuñjanti śivabhaktiratā narāḥ || 158.16 || saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasenmuniḥ | tatra tatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 158.17 || yatphalaṃ vedaviduṣi bhojite śatasaṃkhyayā | tatphalaṃ jāyate pārtha hyekena śivayoginā || 158.18 || yatra bhuñjati bhasmāṅgī mūrkho vā yadi paṇḍitaḥ | tatra bhuñjati deveśaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 158.19 || viprāṇāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ koṭiṃ saṃbhojya yatphalam | bhikṣāmātrapradānena tatphalaṃ śivayoginām || 158.20 || saṅgameśvaramāsādya prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ | na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ śivalokātkadācana || 158.21 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe saṅgameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.159>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam | narmadāyāṃ suduṣprāpaṃ siddhaṃ hyanarakeśvaram || 159.1 || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pāpakarmāpi bhārata | na paśyati mahāghoraṃ narakadvārasaṃjñikam || 159.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śubhāśubhaphalaistāta bhuktabhogā narāstviha | jāyante lakṣaṇairyaistu tāni me vada sattama || 159.3 || yathā nirgacchate jīvastyaktvā dehaṃ na paśyati | tathā gacchanpunardehaṃ pañcabhūtasamanvitaḥ || 159.4 || tvagasthimāṃsamedo'sṛkkeśasnāyuśataiḥ saha | viṇmūtraretaḥsaṅghāte kā saṃjñā jāyate nṛṇām || 159.5 || evamuktaḥ sa mārkaṇḍaḥ kathayāmāsa yogavit | dhyātvā sanātanaṃ sarvaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 159.6 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu pārtha mahāpraśnaṃ kathayāmi yathāśrutam | sakāśādbrahmaṇaḥ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame || 159.7 || gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām | iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ || 159.8 || acīrṇaprāyaścittānāṃ yamaloke hyanekadhā | yātanābhirviyuktānāmanekāṃ jīvasantatim || 159.9 || gatvā manuṣyabhāve tu pāpacihnā bhavanti te | tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 159.10 || sahitvā yātanāṃ sarvāṃ gatvā vaivasvatakṣayam | vistīrṇayātanā ye tu lokamāyānti cihnitāḥ || 159.11 || gadgado'nṛtavādī syānmūkaścaiva gavānṛte | brahmahā jāyate kuṣṭhī śyāvadantastu madyapaḥ || 159.12 || kunakhī svarṇaharaṇādduḥścarmā gurutalpagaḥ | saṃyogī hīnayoniḥ syāddaridro'dattadānataḥ || 159.13 || grāmaśūkaratāṃ yāti hyayājyayājako nṛpa | kharo vai bahuyājī syācchvānimantritabhojanāt || 159.14 || aparīkṣitabhojī syādvānaro vijane vane | vitarjako'tha mārjāraḥ khadyotaḥ kakṣadāhataḥ || 159.15 || avidyāṃ yaḥ prayaccheta balīvardo bhaveddhi saḥ | annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vipre dadānaḥ klībatāṃ vrajet || 159.16 || mātsaryādatha jātyandho janmāndhaḥ pustakaṃ haran | phalānyāharato'patyaṃ mriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 159.17 || mṛto vānaratāṃ yāti tanmukto'tha galāḍavān | adattvā bhakṣayaṃstāni hyanapatyo bhavennaraḥ || 159.18 || haranvastraṃ bhavedgodhā garadaḥ pavanāśanaḥ | pravrājī gamanādrājan bhavenmarupiśācakaḥ || 159.19 || vātako jalahartā ca dhānyahartā ca mūṣakaḥ | aprāptayauvanāṃ gacchan bhavetsarpa iti śrutiḥ || 159.20 || gurudārābhilāṣī ca kṛkalāso bhavecciram | jalaprasravaṇaṃ yastu bhindyānmatsyo bhavennaraḥ || 159.21 || avikreyān vikrayan vai vikaṭākṣo bhavennaraḥ | ayonigo vṛko hi syādulūkaḥ krayavañcanāt || 159.22 || mṛtasyaikādaśāhe tu bhuñjānaḥ śvopajāyate | pratiśrutya dvijāyārthamadadanmadhuko bhavet || 159.23 || rājñīgamādbhavedduṣṭataskaro viḍvarāhakaḥ | parivādī dvijātīnāṃ labhate kācchapīṃ tanum || 159.24 || vrajeddevalako rājanyoniṃ cāṇḍālasaṃjñitām | durbhagaḥ phalavikretā vṛściko vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 159.25 || mārjāro'gniṃ padā spṛṣṭvā rogavānparamāṃsabhuk | sodaryāgamanātṣaṇḍho durgandhaśca sugandhahṛt || 159.26 || grāmabhaṭṭo divākīrtirdaivajño gardabho bhavet | kupaṇḍitaḥ syānmārjāro bhaṣaṇo vyāsa eva ca || 159.27 || sa eva dṛśyate rājanprakāśātparamarmaṇām | yadvā tadvāpi pārakyaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || 159.28 || kṛtvā vai yonimāpnoti tairaścīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | evamādīni cānyāni cihnāni nṛpasattama || 159.29 || svakarmavihitānyeva dṛśyante yaistu mānavāḥ | tato janma tato mṛtyuḥ sarvajantuṣu bhārata || 159.30 || jāyate nātra sandehaḥ samībhūte śubhāśubhe | strīpuṃsoḥ samprayogeṇa viṣuddhe śukraśoṇite || 159.31 || pañcabhūtasamopetaḥ saṣaṣṭhaḥ parameśvaraḥ | indriyāṇi manaḥ prāṇā jñānamāyuḥ sukhaṃ dhṛtiḥ || 159.32 || dhāraṇaṃ preraṇaṃ duḥkhamicchāhaṅkāra eva ca | prayatna ākṛtirvarṇaḥ svaradveṣau bhavābhavau || 159.33 || tasyedamātmanaḥ sarvamanāderādimicchataḥ | prathame māsi sa kledabhūto dhātuvimūrchitaḥ || 159.34 || māsyarbudaṃ dvitīye tu tṛtīye cendriyairyutaḥ | ākāśāllāghavaṃ saukṣmyaṃ śabdaṃ śrotrabalādikam | vāyostu sparśanaṃ ceṣṭāṃ dahanaṃ raukṣyameva ca || 159.35 || pittāttu darśanaṃ paktimauṣṇyaṃ rūpaṃ prakāśanam | salilādrasanāṃ śaityaṃ snehaṃ kledaṃ samārdavam || 159.36 || bhūmergandhaṃ tathā ghrāṇaṃ gauravaṃ mūrtimeva ca | ātmā gṛhṇātyajaḥ pūrvaṃ tṛtīye spandate ca saḥ || 159.37 || daurhṛdasyāpradānena garbho doṣamavāpnuyāt | vairūpyaṃ maraṇaṃ vāpi tasmātkāryaṃ priyaṃ striyāḥ || 159.38 || sthairyaṃ caturthe tvaṅgānāṃ pañcame śoṇitodbhavaḥ | ṣaṣṭhe balaṃ ca varṇaśca nakharomṇāṃ ca sambhavaḥ || 159.39 || manasā cetanāyukto nakharomaśatāvṛtaḥ | saptame cāṣṭame caiva tvacāvān smṛtivānapi || 159.40 || punargarbhaṃ punardhātrīmenastasya pradhāvati | aṣṭame māsyato garbho jātaḥ prāṇairviyujyate || 159.41 || navame daśame vāpi prabalaiḥ sūtimārutaiḥ | nirgacchate bāṇa iva yantracchidreṇa sajvaraḥ || 159.42 || śarīrāvayavairyukto hyaṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyutaḥ | aṣṭottaraṃ marmaśataṃ tatrāsthā tu śatatrayam || 159.43 || sapta śiraḥkapālāni vihitāni svayambhuvā | tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca romṇāmaṅgeṣu bhārata || 159.44 || dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayādabhinisṛtāḥ | hitānāma hi tā nāḍyastāsāṃ madhye śaśiprabhā || 159.45 || evaṃ pravartate cakraṃ bhūtagrāme caturvidhe | utpattiśca vināśaśca bhavataḥ sarvadehinām || 159.46 || gatirūrdhvā ca dharmeṇa hyadharmeṇa tvadhogatiḥ | jāyate sarvavarṇānāṃ svadharmacalanānnṛpa || 159.47 || devatve mānavatve ca dānabhogādikāḥ kriyāḥ | dṛśyante yā mahārāja tatsarvaṃ karmajaṃ phalam || 159.48 || svakarma vihite ghore kāmaksodhārjite śubhe | nimajjennarake ghore yasyottāro na vidyate || 159.49 || uttāraṇāya jantūnāṃ narmadātaṭasaṃsthitam | evametanmahātīrthaṃ narakeśvaramuttamam || 159.50 || narakāpahaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāmuttamaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 159.51 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeta maheśvaram | mahāpātakayukto'pi narakaṃ naiva paśyati || 159.52 || tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyāddhenuṃ vaitaraṇīṃ śubhām | sa mucyate sukhenaiva vaitaraṇyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 159.53 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yamadvāre mahāghore yā sā vaitaraṇī nadī | kiṃrūpā kiṃpramāṇā sā kathaṃ sā vahati dvija || 159.54 || kathaṃ tasyāḥ pramucyante keṣāṃ vāsastu saṃtatam | keṣāṃ tu sānukūlā sā hyetadvistarato vada || 159.55 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca dharmaputra mahābāho śṛṇu sarvaṃ mayoditam | yā sā vaitaraṇī nāma yamadvāre mahāsarit || 159.56 || agādhā pārarahitā dṛṣṭamātrā bhayāvahā | pūyaśoṇitatoyā sā māṃsakardamanirmitā || 159.57 || tattoyaṃ bhramate tūrṇaṃ tāpīmadhye ghṛtaṃ yathā | kṛmibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ pūyaṃ vajratuṇḍairayomukhaiḥ || 159.58 || śiśumāraiśca makarairvajrakartarisaṃyutaiḥ | anyaiśca jalajīvaiḥ sā suhiṃsrairmarmabhedibhiḥ || 159.59 || tapanti dvādaśādityāḥ pralayānta ivolbaṇāḥ | patanti tatra vai martyāḥ krandanto bhṛśadāruṇam || 159.60 || hā bhrātaḥ putra hā mātaḥ pralapanti muhurmuhuḥ | asipattravane ghore patantaṃ yo'bhirakṣati || 159.61 || prataranti nimajjanti glāniṃ gacchanti jantavaḥ | caturvidhaiḥ prāṇigaṇairdraṣṭavyā sā mahānadī || 159.62 || taranti tasyāṃ saddānairanyathā tu patanti te | mātaraṃ ye na manyante hyācāryaṃ gurumeva ca || 159.63 || avajānanti mūḍhā ye teṣāṃ vāsastu saṃtatam | pativratāṃ sādhuśīlāmūḍhāṃ dharmeṣu niścalām || 159.64 || parityajanti ye pāpāḥ saṃtataṃ tu vasanti te | viśvāsapratipannānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām || 159.65 || strībālavṛddhadīnānāṃ chidramanveṣayanti ye | pacyante tatra madhye vai krandamānāḥ supāpinaḥ || 159.66 || śrāntaṃ bubhukṣitaṃ vipraṃ yo vighnayati durmatiḥ | kṛmibhirbhakṣyate tatra yāvatkalpaśatatrayam || 159.67 || brāhmaṇāya pratiśrutya yo dānaṃ na prayacchati | āhūya nāsti yo brūte tasya vāsastu saṃtatam || 159.68 || agnido garadaścaiva rājagāmī ca paiśunī | kathābhaṅgakaraścaiva kūṭasākṣī ca madyapaḥ || 159.69 || vajravidhvaṃsakaścaiva svayaṃdattāpahārakaḥ | sukṣetrasetubhedī ca paradārapradharṣakaḥ || 159.70 || brāhmaṇo rasavikretā vṛṣalīpatireva ca | gokulasya tṛṣārtasya pālībhedaṃ karoti yaḥ || 159.71 || kanyābhidūṣakaścaiva dānaṃ dattvā tu tāpakaḥ | śūdrastu kapilāpānī brāhmaṇo māṃsabhojanī || 159.72 || ete vasanti satataṃ mā vicāraṃ kṛthā nṛpa | sānukūlā bhavedyena tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 159.73 || ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte dinakṣaye | anyeṣu puṇyakāleṣu dīyate dānamuttamam || 159.74 || kṛṣṇāṃ vā pāṭalāṃ vāpi kuryādvaitaraṇīṃ śubhām | svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ kāṃsyapātrasya dohinīm || 159.75 || kṛṣṇavastrayugācchannāṃ saptadhānyasamanvitām | kuryātsadroṇaśikhara āsīnāṃ tāmrabhājane || 159.76 || yamaṃ haimaṃ prakurvīta lohadaṇḍasamanvitam | ikṣudaṇḍamayaṃ baddhvā hyuḍupaṃ paṭṭabandhanaiḥ || 159.77 || uḍupopari tāṃ dhenuṃ sūryadehasamudbhavām | kṛtvā prakalpayedvidvāñchattropānadyugānvitām || 159.78 || aṅgulīyakavāsāṃsi brāhmaṇāya nivedayet | imamuccārayenmantraṃ saṃgṛhyāsyāśca pucchakam || 159.79 || oṃ yamadvāre mahāghore yā sā vaitaraṇī nadī | tartukāmo dadāmyenāṃ tubhyaṃ vaitaraṇi namaḥ | ityadhivāsanamantraḥ || 159.80 || gāvo me cāgrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ | gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham || 159.81 || oṃ viṣṇurūpa dvijaśreṣṭha bhūdeva paṅktipāvana | sadakṣiṇā mayā dattā tubhyaṃ vaitaraṇi namaḥ | iti dānamantraḥ || 159.82 || brāhmaṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ ca dhenuṃ vaitaraṇīṃ śivām | sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 159.83 || pucchaṃ saṃgṛhya surabheragre kṛtvā dvijaṃ tataḥ || 159.84 || dhenuke tvaṃ pratīkṣasva yamadvāre mahābhaye | uttitīrṣurahaṃ dheno vaitaraṇyai namo'stu te | ityanuvrajamantraḥ || 159.85 || anuvrajeta gacchantaṃ sarvaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ nayet | evaṃ kṛte mahīpāla saritsyātsukhavāhinī || 159.86 || tārayate tayā dhenvā sā sarijjalavāhinī | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ || 159.87 || rogī rogādvimuktaḥ syācchāmyanti paramāpadaḥ | svasthe sahasraguṇitamāture śatasaṃmitam || 159.88 || mṛtasyaiva tu yaddānaṃ parokṣe tatsamaṃ smṛtam | svahastena tato deyaṃ mṛte kaḥ kasya dāsyati | iti matvā mahārāja svadattaṃ syānmahāphalam || 159.89 || ityevamuktaṃ tava dharmasūno dānaṃ mayā vaitaraṇīsamuttham | śṛṇoti bhaktyā paṭhatīha samyaksa yāti viṣṇoḥ padamaprameyam || 159.90 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca prāpte cāśvayuje māsi tasminkṛṣṇā caturdaśī | snātvā kṛtvā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ sampūjya ca maheśvaram || 159.91 || pitṛbhyo dīyate dānaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaiḥ | paścājjāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsatkathāśravaṇādibhiḥ || 159.92 || tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā vai narmadājale | tarpaṇaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā pitḥṇāṃ devapūrvakam || 159.93 || sauvarṇe ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dīpaṃ dadyāddvijātaye | paścātsaṃbhojayedviprān svayaṃ caiva vimatsaraḥ || 159.94 || evaṃ kṛte naraśreṣṭha na janturnarakaṃ vrajet | avaśyameva manujairdraṣṭavyā nārakī sthitiḥ || 159.95 || anena vidhinā kṛtvā na paśyennarakānnaraḥ | tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ vidhinā nṛpa || 159.96 || manvantaraṃ śive loke vāso bhavati durlabhe | vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇīśataśobhinā || 159.97 || sa gacchati mahābhāga sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ | bhunakti vividhānbhogānuktakālaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 159.98 || pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ | sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 159.99 || prāpya cāśvayuje māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram | mahāpātakayukto'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 159.100 || aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭyo vai narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | vimuktā narakairduḥkhaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te || 159.101 || tatra bhuktvā mahābhogāndivyaiśvaryasamanvitān | labhante mānuṣaṃ janma durlabhaṃ bhuvi mānavāḥ || 159.102 || || iti śrīskande mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'narakeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.160>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchetpāṇḍuputra mokṣatīrthamanuttamam | sevitaṃ devagandharvairmunibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ || 160.1 || bahavastanna jānanti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ | yatra siddhā mahābhāgā ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ || 160.2 || pulastyaḥ pulaho vidvānkratuścaiva mahāmatiḥ | prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca dakṣo nārada eva ca || 160.3 || ete cānye mahābhāgāḥ saptasāhasrasaṃjñitāḥ | mokṣaṃ gatāḥ saha sutaistattīrthaṃ tena mokṣadam || 160.4 || tatra pravāhamadhye tu patitā tamahā nadī | tatra tatsaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 160.5 || ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñānāmabhyastānāṃ tu yatphalam | samyagjaptvā tu vidhinā gāyatrīṃ tatra tallabhet || 160.6 || tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tīrthasevārjitaṃ phalam | sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti mokṣasādhanamuttamam || 160.7 || tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu saṃnyāsena dvijanmanām | anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ mokṣatīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 160.8 || eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa mayānagha | vyuṣṭistīrthasya mahatī purāṇe yābhidhīyate || 160.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mokṣatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.161>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja sarpatīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddhā mahāsarpāstapastaptvā yudhiṣṭhira || 161.1 || vāsukistakṣako ghoraḥ sārpa airāvatastathā | kāliyaśca mahābhāgaḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau || 161.2 || śaṅkhacūḍo mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro vṛkodaraḥ | kuliko vāmanaścaiva teṣāṃ ye putrapautriṇaḥ || 161.3 || tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇye tapastaptvā suduṣkaram | bhuñjanti vividhānbhogānkrīḍanti ca yathāsukham || 161.4 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | vājapeyaphalaṃ tasya purā provāca śaṅkaraḥ || 161.5 || snātānāṃ sarpatīrthe tu narāṇāṃ bhuvi bhārata | sarpavṛścikajātibhyo na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 161.6 || mṛto bhogavatīṃ gatvā pūjyamāno mahoragaiḥ | nāgakanyāparivṛto mahābhogapatirbhavet || 161.7 || mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe ca yāṣṭamī | sopavāsaḥ śucirbhūtvā liṅgaṃ sampūrayettilaiḥ | yathāvibhavasāreṇa gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 161.8 || evaṃ vidhāya vidhivatpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nareśvara || 161.9 || tilāstatra ca yatsaṃkhyāḥ patrapuṣpaphalāni ca | tāvatsvargapure rājanmodate kālamīpsitam || 161.10 || tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo jāyate vimale kule | surūpaḥ subhagaścaiva dhanakoṭipatirbhavet || 161.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sarpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.162>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gopeśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarpakṣetrādanantaram | yatra snānena caikena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ || 162.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam | sa gacchedyadi yukto'pi pāpena śivamandiram || 162.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram | mucyate sarvapāpaiśca rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 162.3 || krīḍitvā ca yathākāmaṃ rudraloke mahātapāḥ | iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 162.4 || hastyaśvarathasampanno dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ | pūjyamāno narendraiśca jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī || 162.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.163>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja nāgatīrthamanuttamam | āśvinasya site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ || 163.1 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpanivedanaiḥ | prabhāte vimale snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 163.2 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanprāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati || 163.3 || anivartikā gatistasya provāceti śivaḥ svayam || 163.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.164>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahārāja sāṃvauraṃ tīrthamuttamam | yatra saṃnihito bhānuḥ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 164.1 || tatra ye paṅgutāṃ prāptāḥ śīrṇaghrāṇanakhā narāḥ | dadrumaṇḍalabhinnāṅgā makṣikākṛmisaṃkulāḥ || 164.2 || mātāpitṛbhyāṃ rahitā bhrātṛbhāryāvivarjitāḥ | anāthā vikalā vyaṅgā magnā ye duḥkhasāgare || 164.3 || teṣāṃ nātho jagadyonirnarmadātaṭamāśritaḥ | sāṃvauranātho lokānāmārtihā duḥkhanāśanaḥ || 164.4 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā māsamekaṃ nirantaram | pūjayedbhāskaraṃ devaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 164.5 || yatphalaṃ cottare pārtha tathā vai pūrvasāgare | dakṣiṇe paścime snātvā tatra tīrthe tu tatphalam || 164.6 || kaumāre yauvane pāpaṃ vārddhake yacca saṃcitam | tatpraṇaśyati sāṃvaure snānamātrānna saṃśayaḥ || 164.7 || na vyādhirnaiva dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam | saptajanmāni rājendra sāṃvauraparisevanāt || 164.8 || saptamyāmupavāsena taddine cāpyupoṣite | sa tatphalamavāpnoti tatra snātvā na saṃśayaḥ || 164.9 || raktacandanamiśreṇa yadarghyeṇa phalaṃ smṛtam | tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt || 164.10 || narmadāsalilaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | nirīkṣitaṃ viśeṣeṇa sāṃvaureṇa mahātmanā || 164.11 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | snātvā paśyanti deveśaṃ sāṃvaureśvaramuttamam || 164.12 || sūryaloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 164.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sāṃvaureśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.165>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle siddheśvaramiti śrutam | tīrthaṃ paraṃ mahārāja siddhaiḥ kṛtamiti prabho || 165.1 || tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu pāvanam | narmadāyā mahārāja dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamāśritam || 165.2 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo dadyātpitḥnuddiśya bhārata || 165.3 || tṛpyanti pitarastasya dvādaśābdānna saṃśayaḥ | tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā snātvā pūjayate śivam || 165.4 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām | tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 165.5 || vīkṣate girijākāntaṃ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim | purā siddhā mahābhāgāḥ kapilādyā maharṣayaḥ || 165.6 || japantaśca paraṃ brahma yogasiddhā mahāvratāḥ | siddhiṃ te paramāṃ prāptā narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 165.7 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.166>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ siddheśvarī devī vaiṣṇavī pāpanāśinī | ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā sthānaṃ suśobhanam || 166.1 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ | devīṃ paśyati yo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 166.2 || mṛtavatsā tu yā nārī vandhyā strījananī tathā | putraṃ sā labhate nārī śīlavantaṃ guṇānvitam || 166.3 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā paśyeddevīṃ subhaktitaḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakāle'thavā nṛpa || 166.4 || saṅgame tu tataḥ snātā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā | putraṃ dhanaṃ tathā devī dadāti paritoṣitā || 166.5 || gotrarakṣāṃ prakurute dṛṣṭā devī supūjitā | prajāṃ ca pāti satataṃ pūjyamānā na saṃśayaḥ || 166.6 || navamyāṃ ca mahārāja snātvā devīmupoṣitaḥ | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 166.7 || sa gacchetparamaṃ lokaṃ yaḥ surairapi durlabhaḥ || 166.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.167>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tvaccihnenopalakṣitam | tīrthametanmamākhyāhi sambhavaṃ ca mahāmune || 167.1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā kṛtayugasyādau dakṣiṇe girimuttamam | vindhyaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ niyato niyatāśanaḥ || 167.2 || ṛṣisaṅghaiḥ kṛtātithyo daṇḍake nyavasaṃ ciram | uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sukhī || 167.3 || tānṛṣīn samanujñāpya śiṣyairanugatastataḥ | nivṛttaḥ sumahābhāga narmadākūlamāgataḥ || 167.4 || puṇyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca sarvapāpavināśanam | kṛtvāhamāspadaṃ tatra dvijasaṃghasamāyutaḥ || 167.5 || brahmacāribhirākīrṇaṃ gārhasthye supratiṣṭhitaiḥ | vānaprasthaiśca yatibhiryatāhārairyatātmabhiḥ || 167.6 || tapasvibhirmahābhāgaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaiḥ | tatrāhaṃ varṣamayutaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam || 167.7 || ārādhayaṃ vāsudevaṃ prabhuṃ kartāramīśvaram | japaṃstapobhirniyamairnarmadākūlamāśritaḥ || 167.8 || tatastau varadau devau samāyātau yudhiṣṭhira | pratyakṣau bhāskarau rājannumāśrībhyāṃ vibhūṣitau || 167.9 || praṇamyāhaṃ tato devau bhaktiyukto vaco'bruvam | bhavantau prārthayāmi sma varārhau varadau śivau || 167.10 || dharmasthitiṃ mahābhāgau bhaktiṃ vānuttamāṃ yuvām | ajaro vyādhirahitaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣavat | asminsthāne sadā stheyaṃ saha devairasaṃśayam || 167.11 || evamuktau mayā pārtha tau devau kṛṣṇaśaṅkarau | māmūcatuḥ prahṛṣṭau tau nivāsārthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 167.12 || devāvūcatuḥ | asminsthāne sthitau viddhi saha devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ | evamuktvā tato devau tatraivāntaradhīyatām || 167.13 || ahaṃ ca sthāpayitvā tau śaṅkaraṃ kṛṣṇamavyayam | kṛtakṛtyastato jātaḥ sampūjya susamāhitaḥ || 167.14 || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | mārkaṇḍeśvaranāmnā vai viṣṇuṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || 167.15 || sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivameva ca | ghṛtena payasā vātha dadhnā ca madhunā tathā || 167.16 || nārmadenodakenātha gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ | puṣpopahāraiśca tathā naivedyairniyatātmavān || 167.17 || evaṃ viṣṇoḥ prakurvīta jāgaraṃ bhaktitatparaḥ | snānādīni tathā rājanprayataḥ śucimānasaḥ || 167.18 || jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ kārayeddevapūjanaṃ vaiṣṇavo naraḥ || 167.19 || evaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāmekādaśyāṃ narottama | vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnoti viṣṇutulyo bhavennaraḥ || 167.20 || māheśvare ca rājendra gaṇavanmodate pure | śrāddhaṃ ca kurute tatra pitḥnuddiśya susthiraḥ || 167.21 || tasya te hyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ | narmadāyāṃ dvijaḥ snātvā maunī niyatamānasaḥ || 167.22 || upāsya sandhyāṃ tatrastho japaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam | tarpayitvā pitḥndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathāvidhi || 167.23 || kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitvā mārkaṇḍeśasya vā punaḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmamantrāṃśca japedatra prayatnataḥ || 167.24 || ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu ṛgvedasya phalaṃ labhet | yajurvedasya yajuṣā sāmnā sāmaphalaṃ labhet || 167.25 || ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā | mṛtaprajā tu yā nārī vandhyā strījananī tathā || 167.26 || rudrāṃstu vidhivajjaptvā brāhmaṇo vedatattvavit | liṅgasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayetkalaśaṃ śivam || 167.27 || rudraikādaśabhirmantraiḥ snāpayetkalaśāmbhasā | putramāpnoti rājendra dīrghāyuṣamakalmaṣam || 167.28 || mārkaṇḍeśvaravṛkṣānyo dūrasthānapi paśyati | brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate śaṅkaro'bravīt || 167.29 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā nṛpasattama | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 167.30 || idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvapāpapramocanam || 167.31 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.168>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe rodhasyaṅkūreśvaramuttamam | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 168.1 || yatra siddhaṃ mahārakṣa ārādhya tu maheśvaram | śaṅkaraṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ smṛtimātrāvahāriṇam || 168.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kiṃ tadrakṣo dvijaśreṣṭha kiṃnāma kasya vānvaye | etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha || 168.3 || ajñānatimirāndhā ye pumāṃsaḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ | yuṣmadvidhairdīpabhūtaiḥ paśyanti sacarācaram || 168.4 || dharmaputravacaḥ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ | smitaṃ kṛtvā babhāṣe tāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm || 168.5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ pulastyo nāma pārthiva | vedaśāstrapravaktā ca sākṣādvedhā ivāparaḥ || 168.6 || tṛṇabindusutā tasya bhāryāsītparameṣṭhinaḥ | tasya dharmaprasaṅgena putro jāto mahāmanāḥ || 168.7 || yasmādvedetihāsaiśca saṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ | viśrāntā brahmaṇā dattā nāma viśravaseti ca || 168.8 || kasmiṃścidatha kāle ca bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ | svasutāṃ pradadau rājanmudā viśravase nṛpa || 168.9 || sa tayā ramate sārdhaṃ paulomyā maghavā iva | mudā paramayā rājanbrāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ || 168.10 || kenacittvatha kālena putraḥ putraguṇairyutaḥ | jajñe viśravaso rājannāmnā vaiśravaṇaḥ śrutaḥ || 168.11 || so'pi maunavrataṃ kṛtvā bālabhāvādyudhiṣṭhira | sarvabhūtābhayaṃ dattvā cacāra paramaṃ vratam || 168.12 || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha | sakhitvaṃ ceśvaro dattvā dhanadatvaṃ jagāma ha || 168.13 || yamendravaruṇānāṃ ca caturthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | brahmāpyuktvā jagāmāśu lokapālatvamīpsitam || 168.14 || tatastvanantare kāle kaikasī nāma rākṣasī | pātālaṃ bhūtalaṃ tyaktvā viśravaṃ cakame patim || 168.15 || putro'tha rāvaṇo jātastasyā bharatasattama | kumbhakarṇo mahārakṣo dharmātmā ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 168.16 || kumbhaścaiva vikumbhaśca kumbhakarṇasutāvubhau | mahābalau mahāvīryau mahāntau puruṣottama || 168.17 || aṅkūro rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ kumbhasya tanayo mahān | vibhīṣaṇaṃ ca guṇavaddṛṣṭvaivaṃ rākṣasottamaḥ || 168.18 || tataḥ sa yauvanaṃ prāpya jñātvā rakṣaḥ pitāmaham | paraṃ nirvedamāpannaścacāra sumahattapaḥ || 168.19 || dakṣiṇaṃ paścimaṃ gatvā sāgaraṃ pūrvamuttaram | narmadāyāṃ prasaṅgena hyaṅkūro rākṣaseśvaraḥ || 168.20 || tapaścacāra sumahaddivyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila | tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ sākṣātparapuraṃjayaḥ || 168.21 || vareṇa chandayāmāsa rākṣasaṃ vṛṣaketanaḥ | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te tava dāsyāmi suvrata || 168.22 || provāca rākṣaso vākyaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram | varadaṃ so'grato dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || 168.23 || yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva varado'si sureśvara | durlabhaṃ sarvabhūtānāmamaratvaṃ prayaccha me || 168.24 || mama nāmnā sthito'nena vareṇa tripurāntaka | sadā saṃnihito'pyatra tīrthe bhavitumarhasi || 168.25 || īśvara uvāca yāvadvibhīṣaṇamataṃ yāvaddharmaniṣevaṇam | kariṣyasi dṛḍhātmā tvaṃ tāvadetadbhaviṣyati || 168.26 || evamuktvā yayau devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ | vimānenārkavarṇena kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam || 168.27 || gate cādarśanaṃ deve snātvācamya vidhānataḥ | sthāpayāmāsa rājendra hyaṅkūreśvaramuttamam || 168.28 || gandhapuṣpaistathā dhūpairvastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ | patākaiścāmaraiśchatrairjayaśabdādimaṃgalaiḥ || 168.29 || pūjayitvā sureśānaṃ stotrairhṛdyaiḥ supuṣkalaiḥ | jagāma bhavanaṃ rakṣo yatra rājā vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 168.30 || pūjitaḥ sa yathānyāyaṃ dānasanmānagauravaiḥ | saudarye sthāpito bhāve so'vātsītparayāmudā || 168.31 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | aṅkūreśvaranāmānaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 168.32 || māṇḍavyakhātamārabhya saṅgamaṃ vāpi yacchubham | revāyā āmalakyāśca devakṣetraṃ maheśvaram || 168.33 || māṇḍavyakhātātpaścimatastīrthaṃ tadaṅkūreśvaram | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 168.34 || sandhyāmācamya yatnena japaṃ kṛtvātha bhārata | tarpayitvā pitḥndevānmanuṣyān bharatarṣabha || 168.35 || sacailaḥ klinnavasano maunamāsthāya saṃyataḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmupoṣya vidhivannaraḥ || 168.36 || pūjāṃ yaḥ kurute rājaṃstasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | sāgraṃ tu yojanaśataṃ tīrthānyāyatanāni ca || 168.37 || bhavanti tāni dṛṣṭāni tataḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate | tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ devamuddiśya dīyate || 168.38 || snātvā tu vidhivatpātre tadakṣayamudāhṛtam | homāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ jāpye tato'dhikam || 168.39 || triguṇaṃ copavāsena snānena ca caturguṇam | saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vā || 168.40 || anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam | kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | aṅkūreśvaranāmākhye mṛtānāṃ sugatirbhavet || 168.41 || etatte kathitaṃ rājannaṅkūreśvarasambhavam | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ paramaṃ pāpanāśanam || 168.42 || ye'pi śṛṇvanti bhaktyedaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ mahāphalam | labhante nātra sandehaḥ śivasya bhuvanaṃ hi te || 168.43 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṅkūreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.169>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchetparaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | māṇḍavyo yatra saṃsiddha ṛṣirnārāyaṇastathā || 169.1 || nārāyaṇena śuśrūṣā śūlasthena kṛtā purā | tatra snātvā mahārāja mucyate pāpakañcukāt || 169.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryametallokeṣu yattvayā kathitaṃ mune | na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ tāta śūlasthena tapaḥ kṛtam || 169.3 || etatsarvaṃ kathaya me ṛṣibhiḥ sahitasya vai | asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ māṇḍavyasya kutūhalāt || 169.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttapurā tretāyuge kṣitau | lokapālopamo rājā devapanno mahāmatiḥ || 169.5 || dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca yajvā dānarataḥ sadā | prajā rarakṣa yatnena pitā putrānivaurasān || 169.6 || dātyāyanī priyā bhāryā tasya rājño vaśānugā | hāranūpuraghoṣeṇa jhaṅkāraravanāditā || 169.7 || parasparaṃ tayoḥ prītirvardhate'nudinaṃ nṛpa | vaṃśastambe sthito rājā saṃśāsti pṛthivīmimām || 169.8 || hastyaśvarathasampūrṇāṃ dhanavāhanasaṃyutām | alaṃkṛto guṇaiḥ sarvairanapatyo mahīpatiḥ || 169.9 || duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ saṃtaptaḥ santatiṃ vinā | snānahomarato nityaṃ dvādaśābdāni bhārata || 169.10 || vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ patnībhiḥ saha tasthivān | ārādhayadbhagavatīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamardinīm || 169.11 || stotrairanekairbhaktyā ca pūjāvidhisamādhinā | jaya vārāhi cāmuṇḍe jaya devi trilocane || 169.12 || brāhmi raudri ca kaumāri kātyāyani namo'stu te | pracaṇḍe bhairave raudri yoginyākāśagāmini || 169.13 || nāsti kiṃcittvayā hīnaṃ trailokye sacarācare | rājñā stutā ca saṃtuṣṭā devī vacanamabravīt || 169.14 || varayasva yathākāmaṃ yaste manasi vartate | ārādhitā tvayā bhaktyā tuṣṭā dāsyāmi te varam || 169.15 || devapanna uvāca yadi tuṣṭāsi deveśi varārho yadi vāpyaham | putrasantānarahitaṃ saṃtaptaṃ māṃ samuddhara || 169.16 || santānaṃ naya me vṛddhiṃ gotrarakṣāṃ kuruṣva me | aputriṇāṃ gṛhāṇīha śmaśānasadṛśāni hi || 169.17 || pitarastasya nāśnanti devatā ṛṣibhiḥ saha | kriyamāṇe'pyaharahaḥ śrāddhe matpitaraḥ sadā || 169.18 || darśayanti sadātmānaṃ svapne kṣutpīḍitaṃ mama | iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā devī dhyānamupāgatā || 169.19 || divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | prasannavadanā devī rājānamidamabravīt || 169.20 || santānaṃ nāsti te rājaṃstrailokye sacarācare | yajasva yajñapuruṣamapatyaṃ nāsti te'nyathā || 169.21 || mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahīpāla trailokyaṃ divyacakṣuṣā | evamuktvā gatā devī rājā svagṛhamāgamat || 169.22 || iyāja yajñapuruṣaṃ saṃjātā kanyakā tataḥ | tejasvinī rūpavatī sarvalokamanoharā || 169.23 || devagandharvaloke'pi tādṛśī nāsti kāminī | tasyā nāma kṛtaṃ pitrā harṣātkāmapramodinī || 169.24 || tataḥ kālena vavṛdhe rūpeṇāstambhayajjagat | haṃsalīlāgatiḥ subhrūḥ stanabhārāvanāmitā || 169.25 || raktamālyāmbaradharā kuṇḍalābharaṇojjvalā | divyānulepanavatī sakhībhiḥ sā surakṣitā || 169.26 || kucamadhyagato hāro vidyunmāleva rājate | bhramarāñcitakeśī sā bimboṣṭhī cāruhāsinī || 169.27 || karṇāntaprāptanetrābhyāṃ pibantīvātha kāminaḥ | candratāmbūlasaurabhyairākarṣantīva manmatham || 169.28 || kambugrīvā cārumadhyā tāmrapādāṅgulīnakhā | nimnanābhiḥ sujaghanā rambhorū sudatī śubhā || 169.29 || mātāpitṛsuhṛdvarge krīḍānandavivardhinī | ekasmindivase bālā sakhīvṛndasamanvitā || 169.30 || candanāgarutāṃbūladhūpasaumanasāñcitā | gṛhītvā puṣpadhūpādi gatā devīprapūjane || 169.31 || taḍāgataṭa utsṛjya bhūṣaṇānyaṅgaveṣṭakān | cakruḥ sarasitāḥ krīḍāṃ jalamadhyagatāstadā || 169.32 || krīḍantīṃ tāmavekṣyātha sasakhīṃ vimale jale | rākṣasaḥ śambaro nāma śyenarūpeṇa cāgamat || 169.33 || gṛhītā jalamadhyasthā tena sā kāmamodinī | khamutpapāta duṣṭātmā gṛhītvābharaṇānyapi || 169.34 || vāyumārgaṃ gataḥ so'tha kāminyā saha bhārata | apatankuṇḍalādīni yatra toye mahāmuniḥ || 169.35 || māṇḍavyo narmadātīre kāṣṭhavatsaṃjitendriyaḥ | līno māheśvare sthāne nārāyaṇapade pare || 169.36 || tasya cānucaro bhrātā bhrātuḥ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ | tapojapakṛśībhūto dadhyau devaṃ janārdanam || 169.37 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmamodinīharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyadhiśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.170>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kāmapramodinīsakhyo nīyamānāṃ ca tena tu | dṛṣṭvā tāścukruśuḥ sarvā niḥsṛtya jalamadhyataḥ || 170.1 || gatā rājagṛhe sarvāḥ kathayanti suduḥkhitāḥ | kāmapramodinī rājanhṛtā śyenena pakṣiṇā || 170.2 || krīḍantī ca jalasthāne taḍāge devasannidhau | anveṣyā ca tvayā rājaṃstasya mārgaṃ vijānatā || 170.3 || tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devapannaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | hāhetyuktvā samutthāya rudamāno varāsanāt || 170.4 || mantribhiḥ sahitastasmiṃstaḍāge jalasannidhau | na cihnaṃ na ca panthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhānmumoha ca || 170.5 || tasya rājñastu duḥkhena duḥkhito nāgaro janaḥ | kṣaṇenāśvāsito rājā mantribhiḥ sapurohitaiḥ || 170.6 || kiṃ kurma ityuvācedamasminkāle vidhīyatām | sarvaistatsaṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vāhinīṃ caturaṅgiṇīm || 170.7 || preṣayāmi diśaḥ sarvā hastyaśvarathasaṃkulā | vāditrāṇi ca vādyante vyākulībhūtasaṃkule || 170.8 || nārācaistomarairbhallaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhādibhiḥ | rājā saṃnāhabaddho'bhūdganaṃ grasate kila || 170.9 || na devo na ca gandharvo na daityo na ca rākṣasaḥ | kiṃ kariṣyati rājādya na jāne roṣaniṣkṛtim || 170.10 || nāgaro'pi janastatra dṛṣṭvā cakitamānasaḥ | caturdaśasahasrāṇi dantināṃ sṛṇidhāriṇām || 170.11 || aśvārohasahasrāṇi hyaśītiḥ śastrapāṇinām | rathānāṃ trisahasrāṇi viṃśatirbharatarṣabha || 170.12 || saṅgrāmabherīninadaiḥ khurareṇurnabhogatā | etasminnantare tāta rakṣako nagarasya hi || 170.13 || gṛhītvābharaṇaṃ tasyāstvaṅgapratyaṅgikaṃ tathā | kuṇḍalāṅgadakeyūrahāranūpurajhallarīḥ || 170.14 || nivedyākathayadrājñe mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tvavekṣaṇāt | tāpasānāmāśrame tu māṇḍavyo yatra tiṣṭhati || 170.15 || tāpasairveṣṭito yatra dadṛśe tatra sannidhau | daṇḍavāsivacaḥ śrutvā pratyakṣāṅgavibhūṣaṇam || 170.16 || sa krodharaktanayano mantriṇo vīkṣya naigamān | īdṛgbhūtasamācāro brāhmaṇo nagare mama || 170.17 || cauracaryāṃ vratacchannaḥ paradravyāpaharakaḥ | tena kanyā hṛtā me'dya tapasvipāpakarmiṇā || 170.18 || śākuntaṃ rūpamāsthāya jalastho gaganaṃ yayau | pākhaṇḍino vikarmasthān biḍālavratikāñchaṭhān || 170.19 || cāṭutaskaradurvṛttān hanyānnastyasya pātakam | na draṣṭavyo mayā pāpaḥ steyī kanyāpahārakaḥ || 170.20 || śūlamāropyatāṃ kṣipraṃ na vicārastu tasya vai | sa ca vadhyo mayā duṣṭo rakṣorūpī tapodhanaḥ || 170.21 || evaṃ bruvaṃścalankrodhādādiśya daṇḍavāsinam | kāryākāryaṃ na vijñāya śūlamāropayaddvijam || 170.22 || paurā jānapadāḥ sarve aśrupūrṇamukhāstadā | hāhetyuktvā rudantyanye vadanti ca pṛthakpṛthak || 170.23 || kutsitaṃ ca kṛtaṃ karma rājñā caṇḍālacāriṇā | brāhmaṇo naiva vadhyo hi viśeṣeṇa tapovṛtaḥ || 170.24 || yadi roṣasamācāro nirvāsyo nagarādbahiḥ | na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyātsarvapāpe'pyavasthitam || 170.25 || rāṣṭrādenaṃ bahiṣkuryātsamagradhanamakṣatam | nāśnāti ca gṛhe rājannāgnirnagaravāsinām | sarve'pyudvignamanaso gṛhavyāptivivarjitāḥ || 170.26 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe māṇḍavyaśūlāropaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.171>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ śūle kṣiptaṃ tapodhanaiḥ | nārāyaṇasamīpe tu gatāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 171.1 || nārado devalo raibhyo yamaḥ śātātapo'ṅgirāḥ | vasiṣṭho jamadagniśca yājñavalkyo bṛhaspatiḥ || 171.2 || kaśyapo'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro'ruṇirmuniḥ | vālakhilyādayo'nye ca sarve'pyṛṣigaṇānvayāḥ || 171.3 || dadṛśuḥ śūlamārūḍhaṃ māṇḍavyamṛṣipuṃgavāḥ | procurnārāyaṇaṃ vipraṃ kiṃ kurmastava cepsitam || 171.4 || sarve te tatra sāṃnidhyānmāṇḍavyasya mahātmanaḥ | saṃbhrāntā āgatā ūcuḥ kiṃ mṛtaḥ kiṃ nu jīvati || 171.5 || avasthāṃ tasya te dṛṣṭvā viṣādamagamanparam | asahitvā tu tadduḥkhaṃ sarve te manasā dvijāḥ || 171.6 || pṛcchayatāṃ yadi manyeta rājānaṃ bhasmasātkuru | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ nārāyaṇo'bravīt || 171.7 || mayi jīvati madbhrātā hyavasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ | dhigjīvitaṃ ca me kiṃtu tapaso vidyate phalam || 171.8 || dṛṣṭvā śūlasthitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ manmano nu vidīryate | paraṃ kiṃ tu kariṣyāmi yena rāṣṭraṃ sarājakam || 171.9 || bhasmasācca karomyadya bhavadbhiḥ kṣamyatāmiha | evamuktvā gṛhītvāsau karasthamabhimantrayet || 171.10 || krodhena paśyate yāvattāvaddhuṃkārako'bhavat | tena huṅkāraśabdena ṛṣayo vismitāstadā || 171.11 || māṇḍavyasya samīpe tu hyapṛcchaṃste dvijottamāḥ | nivārayasi kiṃ vipra śāpaṃ nṛpajighāṃsanam || 171.12 || apāpasya tu yeneha kṛtamasya jighāṃsanam | ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛcchrānmāṇḍavyako'bravīt || 171.13 || abhivandāmi vo mūrdhnā svāgataṃ ṛṣayaḥ sadā | arghyasanmānapūjārhāḥ sarve'tropaviśantu te || 171.14 || niviṣṭaikāgramanasā sarvānmāṇḍavyako'bravīt || 171.15 || prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ mayā ghoraṃ pūrvajanmārjitaṃ phalam | mā viṣādaṃ kurudhvaṃ bhoḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tu bhujyate || 171.16 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kena karmavipākena iha jātyantaraṃ vrajet | dānadharmaphalenaiva kena svargaṃ ca gacchati || 171.17 || māṇḍavya uvāca adattadānā jāyante parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ | na snānaṃ na japo homo nātithyaṃ na surārcanam || 171.18 || na parvaṇi pitṛśrāddhaṃ na dānaṃ dvijasattamāḥ | vrajanti narake ghore yānti te tvantyajāṃ gatim || 171.19 || punardaridrāḥ punareva pāpāḥ pāpaprabhāvānnarake vasanti | tenaiva saṃsariṇi martyaloke jīvādibhūte kṛmayaḥ pataṅgāḥ || 171.20 || ye snānaśīlā dvijadevabhaktā jitendriyā jīvadayānuśīlāḥ | te devalokeṣu vasanti hṛṣṭā ye dharmaśīlā jitamānaroṣāḥ || 171.21 || vidyāvinītā na paropatāpinaḥ svadāratuṣṭāḥ paradāravarjitāḥ | teṣāṃ na loke bhayamasti kiṃcitsvabhāvaśuddhā gatakalmaṣā hi te || 171.22 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | pūrvajanmani viprendra kiṃ tvayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | yena kaṣṭamidaṃ prāptaṃ sandhānaṃ śūlagarhitam || 171.23 || śūlasthaṃ tvāṃ samālakṣya hyāgatāḥ sarva eva hi | jīvantaṃ tvāṃ prapaśyāma tvantarannavatārayan | rujāsaṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ soḍhvāpi tvamavedanaḥ || 171.24 || māṇḍavya uvāca svayameva kṛtaṃ karma svayamevopabhujyate | sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ pūrve nānye bhuñjanti karhicit || 171.25 || yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram | tathā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kartāramupagacchati || 171.26 || na mātā na pitā bhrātā na bhāryā na sutāḥ suhṛt | na kasya karmaṇāṃ lepaḥ svayamevopabhujyate || 171.27 || śrūyatāṃ mama vākyaṃ ca bhavadbhiḥ pṛcchito hyaham | pūrve vayasi bho viprā malasnānakṛtakṣaṇaḥ || 171.28 || ajñānādbālabhāvena yūkā kaṇṭe'dhiropitā | tailābhyaktaśirogātre mayā yūkā ghṛtā na hi || 171.29 || kaṅkatīṃ ropya keśeṣu sāsā kaṇṭe'dhiropitā | teṣu pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ sadyaḥ phalametanmamābhavat || 171.30 || kiṃcitkālaṃ kṣapitvāhaṃ prāpsye mokṣaṃ nirāmayam | bhavantastviha santāpaṃ māṃ kurudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ || 171.31 || imāmavasthāṃ bhuktvāhaṃ kaṃcicchape na coccare | ahani katicicchūle kṣapayiṣyāmi kilbiṣam || 171.32 || prāktanaṃ karma bhuñjāmi yanmayā saṃcitaṃ dvijāḥ | kṣantavyamasya rājño'tha kopaścaiva visarjyatām || 171.33 || śrutvā tu tasya tadvākyaṃ māṇḍavyasya maharṣayaḥ | praharṣamatulaṃ labdhvā sādhu sādhvityapūjayan || 171.34 || nārāyaṇa uvāca idaṃ jalaṃ mantrapūtaṃ kasminsthāne kṣipāmyaham | yena rājā bhavedbhasma sarāṣṭraḥ sapurohitaḥ || 171.35 || māṇḍavya uvāca idaṃ jalaṃ ca rakṣasva kālakūṭaviṣopamam | samudre kṣipayiṣyāmi devakāryaṃ samutthitam || 171.36 || atha te munayaḥ sarve māṇḍavyaṃ praṇipatya ca | āmantrayitvā harṣācca kaśyapādyā gṛhānyayuḥ || 171.37 || gacchamānāstu te coktāḥ pañcame'hani tāpasāḥ | āgantavyaṃ bhavadbhiśca matsakāśaṃ pratijñayā || 171.38 || tatheti te pratijñāya nāradādyā adarśanam | gateṣu vipramukhyeṣu śāṇḍilī ca tapodhanā || 171.39 || dvitīye'hni samāyātā na tu buddhvātha taṃ ṛṣim | bhartāraṃ śirasā dhārya rātrau paryaṭate sma sā || 171.40 || na dṛṣṭaḥ śūlake vipro bharākrāntyā yudhiṣṭhira | skhalitā tasya jānubhyāṃ śūlasthasya pativratā || 171.41 || sarvāṅgeṣu vyathā jātā tasyāḥ praskhalanānmuneḥ | īdṛśīṃ vartamānāṃ ca hyavasthāṃ pūrvadaivikīm || 171.42 || punaḥ pāpaphalaṃ kiṃciddhā kaṣṭaṃ mama vartate | vyathito'haṃ tvayā pāpe kimarthaṃ sūnakarmaṇi || 171.43 || svairiṇīṃ tvāṃ prapaśyāmi rākṣasī taskarī nu kim | evamuktvā kṣaṇaṃ mohātkrandamāno muhurmuhuḥ || 171.44 || tapasvino'tha ṛṣayaḥ sarve saṃtrastamānasāḥ | paśyamānā muneḥ kaṣṭaṃ pṛcchante te yudhiṣṭhira || 171.45 || paryaṭase kimarthaṃ tvaṃ niśīye vahanaṃ nu kim | kṣiptaṃ tu jholikābhāraṃ kiṃvāgamanakāraṇam | vyathāmutpādya ṛṣaye duḥkhādduḥkhavilāsini || 171.46 || śāṇḍilyuvāca nāsurīṃ na ca gandharvīṃ na piśācīṃ na rākṣasīm | pativratāṃ tu māṃ sarve jānantu tapasi sthitām || 171.47 || na me kāmo na me krodho na vairaṃ na ca matsaraḥ | ajñānāddṛṣṭimāndyācca skhalanaṃ kṣantumarhatha || 171.48 || vahanaṃ bhartṛsaukhyāya divā sampīḍyate rujā | ayaṃ bhartā vijānītha jholikāsaṃsthitaḥ sadā || 171.49 || bharaṇaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ ca dadāmyetasya rogiṇaḥ | ṛṣiḥ śaunakamukhyo'sau śāṇḍilīṃ māṃ vijānata || 171.50 || svabhartṛdharmiṇīṃ kopaṃ mā kuruṣvātithiṃ kuru | satāṃ samīpaṃ samprāptāṃ sarvaṃ me kṣantumarhatha || 171.51 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | paravyathāṃ na jānīṣe vyacarantī yadṛcchayā | prabhāte'bhyudite sūrye tava bhartā mariṣyati || 171.52 || ātmaduḥkhātparaṃ duḥkhaṃ na jānāsi kulādhame | tena vākyena ghoreṇa śāṇḍilī vimanābhavat || 171.53 || paraṃ viṣādamāpannā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvābravīdvacaḥ | kopātsaṃraktanayanā nirīkṣantī munīṃstadā || 171.54 || satāṃ gehe kila prāptā bhavatāṃ cāpakāriṇī | sāmenātithipūjāyāṃ śiṣṭe ca gṛhamāgate || 171.55 || bhavadbhirīdṛgātithyaṃ kṛtaṃ caiva mamaiva tu | svargāpavargadharmaśca bhavadbhirna nirīkṣitam || 171.56 || prājāpatyāmimāṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ yathā prākṛtāḥ striyaḥ | bhavantaḥ strībalaṃ me'dya paśyantu divi devatāḥ || 171.57 || mariṣyati na me bhartā hyādityo nodayiṣyati | andhakāraṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṣīyate nādya śarvarī || 171.58 || evamukte tayā vākye stambhite'rke tamomayam | na ca prajāyate sarvaṃ nirvaṣaṭkārasatkriyam || 171.59 || svāhākāraḥ svadhākāraḥ pañcayajñavidhirnahi | snānaṃ dānaṃ japo nāsti sandhyālopavyatikramaḥ | ṣaṇmāsaṃ ca tadā pārtha luptapiṇḍodakakriyam || 171.60 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śāṇḍilīṛṣisaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.172>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāścendrapurogamāḥ | māṇḍavyasyāśrame puṇye samīyurnarmadātaṭe || 172.1 || śaṅkhadundubhinādena dīpikājvalanena ca | apsarogītanādena nṛtyantyo vārayoṣitaḥ || 172.2 || kathānakaiḥ stuvatyanye tasya śūlāgradhāriṇaḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi snātakānāṃ tapasvinām || 172.3 || samāje tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatra te ca didṛkṣayā | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāstatra harṣātsamāgatāḥ || 172.4 || mātaro mallikādyāśca kṣetrapālā vināyakāḥ | dikpālā lokapālāśca gaṅgādyāśca saridvarāḥ || 172.5 || ṛṣidevasamāje tu nityaṃ harṣapramodane | tatra rājā samāyātaḥ paurajānapadaiḥ saha || 172.6 || dṛṣṭvā kautūhalaṃ tatra vyākulīkṛtamānasam | vitrastamanaso bhūtvā bhayātsarve samāsthitāḥ || 172.7 || tasminsamāgame divye brahmaviṣṇvīśamabruvan | bho māṇḍavya mahāsattva varadāste'maraiḥ saha || 172.8 || anekakaṣṭatapasā tava siddhirbhaviṣyati | prārthayasva yathākāmaṃ yaste manasi rocate || 172.9 || anādityamayaṃ lokaṃ nirvaṣaṭkāramākulam | naṣṭadharmaṃ vijānīhi prakṛtisthaṃ kuruṣva ca | anugrahaṃ tu śāṇḍilyāḥ prārthayāma dvijottama || 172.10 || eṣa te kaṣṭado rājā samāyātastavāgrataḥ | saṃbhūṣayasva viprarṣe janaṃ devāsuraṃ gaṇam || 172.11 || māṇḍavya uvāca yadi prasannā me devāḥ samāyātāḥ suraiḥ saha | trikālamatra tīrthe ca sthātavyamṛṣibhiḥ saha || 172.12 || bhavatāṃ tu prasādena rujā me śāmyatāṃ sadā | evamastviti deveśā yāvajjalpanti pāṇḍava || 172.13 || tāvadrakṣo gṛhītvā'gre kanyāṃ kāmapramodinīm | uvāca bhagavañchāpaṃ purā dattvorvaśī mama || 172.14 || yadā kanyāṃ hare rakṣaḥśāpāntaste bhaviṣyati | tena me garhitaṃ karma śāpenākṛtabuddhinā || 172.15 || kṣantavyamiti coktvā ca gataścādarśanaṃ punaḥ | gate caiva tu sā kanyā dṛṣṭvā padmadalekṣaṇā || 172.16 || mantrayitvā suraiḥ sarvairdattā māṇḍavyadhīmate | tāṃ vajraśūlikāṃ plāvya pavitrairnarmadodakaiḥ || 172.17 || māṇḍavyamṛṣimuttārya jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ | vivāhayitvā tāṃ kanyāṃ māṇḍavyarṣipuṃgavaḥ || 172.18 || abhivādya ca tān sarvān dānasanmānagauravaiḥ | atha rājā samīpastho ratnaiśca vividhairapi || 172.19 || dhigvādairninditaḥ sarvaistairjanairbhūṣitaḥ punaḥ | rājñā ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ || 172.20 || suvarṇakoṭidānena tuṣṭānkṛtvā kṣamāpitāḥ | vṛtte vivāha āhūya śāṇḍilīṃ tāmathābravīt || 172.21 || mānayasva imān viprānmocayasva divākaram | apahṛtya tamo yena kṛpā sadyaḥ pravartate || 172.22 || ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā śāṇḍilī duḥkhitābravīt | udite'rke tu me bhartā mṛtyuṃ yāsyati bho dvijāḥ || 172.23 || taṃ kathaṃ mocayāmīha hyātmano'niṣṭasiddhaye | kriyāpravartanāccādya kiṃ kāryaṃ me maharṣayaḥ || 172.24 || niḥpuṃsī strī hyanāthāhaṃ bhavāmi bhavato matam | tiṣṭha tvamandhakāre tu necchāmi raviṇodayam || 172.25 || tena vākyena te sarve devāsuramaharṣayaḥ | śiraḥsaṃcālanāḥ sarve sādhu sādhviti cābruvan || 172.26 || pativrate mahābhāge śṛṇu vākyaṃ tapodhane | manyase yadi naḥ sarvānkuruṣva vacanaṃ ca yat || 172.27 || śāṇḍilyuvāca yena me na maredbhartā yena satyaṃ munervacaḥ | tatkurudhvaṃ vicāryāśu yena saṃvardhate sukham || 172.28 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā svapnāvasthākṛto hṛṣiḥ | antarhito muhūrtaṃ ca śāṇḍilyāśca prapaśya tām || 172.29 || punarādāya te sarve kṛtvā nirvraṇasattanuṃ snāpito narmadātoye śāṇḍilyāyai samarpitaḥ || 172.30 || tataḥ sā hṛṣṭamanasā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā tu taijasam | praṇamya tānṛṣīn devān vimalārkaṃ jagatkṛtam || 172.31 || kriyāpravartitāḥ sarve devagandharvamānuṣāḥ | hṛṣṭatuṣṭā gatāḥ sarve svamāśramapadaṃ mahat || 172.32 || pativratā svabhartrā sā māsamevāśrame sthitā | māṇḍavyenāpyanujñātā yayau natvā svamāśramam || 172.33 || gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu sthāpayāmāsa cācyutam | māṇḍavyeśvaranāmānaṃ nārāyaṇa iti smṛtam || 172.34 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pūjayāmāsa bhārata | gato'sāvṛṣisaṅghaiśca sahito'maraparvatam || 172.35 || tapastapantau tau tatra hyadyāpi kila bhārata | bhrātarau saṃyatātmānau dhyāyataḥ paramaṃ padam || 172.36 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pitarastasya tṛpyanti piṇḍadānāddaśābdikam || 172.37 || devagṛhe tu pakṣādau yaḥ karoti vilepanam | godānaśatasāhasre datte bhavati yatphalam || 172.38 || upalepanena dviguṇamarcane tu caturguṇam | dīpaprajvalane puṇyamaṣṭadhā parikīrtitam || 172.39 || divyanetradharo bhūtvā trailokye sacarācare | dadhnā madhughṛtairdevaṃ payasā narmadodakaiḥ || 172.40 || snapanaṃ ye prakurvanti puṣpamālāvilepanaiḥ | ye'rcayanti virūpākṣaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 172.41 || te'pi divyavimānena krīḍante kalpasaṃkhyayā | dīpāṣṭakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādaṣṭamīṃ ca caturdaśīm || 172.42 || ekādaśyāṃ tu kṛṣṇasya na paśyanti yamaṃ tu te | phalairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhrairyaḥ kuryālliṅgapūraṇam || 172.43 || te'pi yānti vimānena siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ | ghaṇṭā caiva patākā ca vimāne puṣpamālikā || 172.44 || vāditrāṇi yathārhāṇi prānte ca gacchate śivam | devālayaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādvaiṣṇavaṃ māṇḍaveśvaram || 172.45 || svarge vasati dharmātmā yāvadābhūtasamplavam | māṇḍavyanārāyaṇākhye viprān bhojayate'grataḥ || 172.46 || ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā | āśvine māsi samprāpte śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm || 172.47 || kṛtopavāsaniyamo rātrau jāgaraṇena ca | dīpamālāṃ caturdikṣu pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ || 172.48 || nārī vā puruṣo vāpi nṛtyagītapravādanaiḥ | prabhāte vimale sūrye snānādikavidhiṃ nṛpa || 172.49 || abhinirvartya maunena paśyate devamīdṛśam | sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate || 172.50 || athavā mārgaśīrṣe ca caitravaiśākhayorapi | śrāvaṇe vā mahārāja sarvakāle'thavāpi ca || 172.51 || śivarātrisamaṃ puṇyamityevaṃ śivabhāṣitam | vājapeyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ bhavati nānyathā || 172.52 || durbhagā duḥkhitā vandhyā daridrā ca mṛtaprajā | snāti rudraghaṭairyā strī sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 172.53 || kṛmikīṭapataṅgāśca tasmiṃstīrthe tu ye mṛtāḥ | svargaṃ prayānti te sarve divyarūpadharā nṛpa || 172.54 || anāśake jale'gnau tu ye mṛtā vyādhipīḍitāḥ | anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ rudraloke hyasaṃśayam || 172.55 || nityaṃ namati yo rāja śivanārāyaṇāvubhau | godānaphalamāpnoti tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 172.56 || devālaye tu rājendra yaśca kuryātpradakṣiṇām | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena sasāgaradharā dharā || 172.57 || sārddhaṃ śataṃ ca tīrthāni mallikābhavanādbahiḥ | tasya tīrthapramāṇaṃ tu vistaraṃ rājasattama || 172.58 || sūtreṇa veṣṭayetkṣetramathavā śivamandiram | athavā śivaliṅgaṃ ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 172.59 || jambūdvīpaśca kṛtasnaśca śālmalī kuśakrauñcakau | śākapuṣkaragomedaiḥ saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || 172.60 || bhūṣitā tena rājendra saśailavanakānanā | revāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge śivakṣetrātsamīpataḥ || 172.61 || devakhātaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ nirmitaṃ tridaśairapi | tasmin yaḥ kurute snānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 172.62 || pūrṇimāyāmamāvasyāṃ vyatīpāte'rkasaṃkrame | śrāddhaṃ ca saṃgrahe kuryātsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || 172.63 || devakhāte trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | tiṣṭhanti ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ pitṛdevagaṇaiḥ
