saha || 172.64 || tatra tīrthe'śvine māsi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | vāyumārge sthitaḥ śakrastiṣṭhate daivataiḥ saha || 172.65 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarāstathā | viṃśati tāni sarvāṇi devakhāte dinadvayam || 172.66 || gayāśire ca yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge makarakaṇṭake | prayāge somatīrthe ca tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare || 172.67 || paṭṭabandhena yatpuṇyaṃ mātrāyāṃ lakuleśvare | āśvinyāmaśvinīyoge tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare || 172.68 || ujjayinyāṃ mahākāle vārāṇasyāṃ tripuṣkare | saṃnihatyāṃ ravigraste māṇḍavyākhye sanātanam || 172.69 || iti jñātvā mahārāja sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam | pitḥndevān samabhyarcya snānadānādipūjanaiḥ || 172.70 || caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthito bhūtvā śucivrataḥ | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇe śivam || 172.71 || snānaiśca vividhairdevaṃ puṣpāgaruvilepanaiḥ | prabhāte paurṇamāsyāṃ tu snānādividhitarpaṇaiḥ || 172.72 || śrāddhena havyakavyena śivapūjārcanena ca | agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca vidhivaccāptadakṣiṇaiḥ || 172.73 || dhautapāpo viśuddhātmā phalate phalamuttamam | gosahasrapradānena dattaṃ bhavati bhārata || 172.74 || snānādyairvidhivattatra taddine śivasannidhau | hiraṇyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dhenuṃ bhūmiṃ gomithunaṃ hayam || 172.75 || śivamuddiśya vai vastrayugme dadyātsurūpiṇe | pādukopānahau chatraṃ bhājanaṃ raktavāsasī || 172.76 || homaṃ jāpyaṃ tathā dānamakṣayaṃ sarvameva tat | ṛcamekāṃ tu ṛgvede yajurvede yajustathā || 172.77 || sāmaikaṃ sāmavede tu japeddevāgrasaṃsthitaḥ | samyagvedaphalaṃ tasya bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ || 172.78 || gāyatrījāpyamātrastu vedatrayaphalaṃ labhet | kulakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate tu śivārcanāt || 172.79 || snāne dāne tathā śrāddhe jāgare gītavādite | anivartikā gatistasya śivalokātkadācana || 172.80 || kālena mahatāviṣṭo martyaloke samāviśet | rājā bhavati medhāvī sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ || 172.81 || jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautradhanānvitaḥ | tacca tīrthaṃ punaḥ smṛtvā līyamāno maheśvare || 172.82 || upāste yastu vai sandhyāṃ tasmiṃstīrthe ca parvaṇi | sāṅgopāṅgaiścaturvedairlabhate phalamuttamam || 172.83 || tatra sarvaṃ śivakṣetrāccharapātaṃ samantataḥ | na saṃcaredbhayodvignā brahmahatyā narādhipa || 172.84 || yatra tatra sthito vṛkṣān paśyate tīrthatatparaḥ | vividhaiḥ pātakairmukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 172.85 || śvabhrī tatra mahārāja jalamadhye pradṛśyate | kathānikā purāṇoktā vānarī tīrthasevanāt || 172.86 || tatra kūpo mahārāja tiṣṭhate devanirmitaḥ | śivasya paścime bhāge śivakṣetramanuttamam || 172.87 || vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa | krīḍanti pitarastasya svargaloke yadṛcchayā || 172.88 || agamyāgamane pāpamayājyayājane kṛte | steyācca brahmagohatyāgurughātācca pātakam | tatsarvaṃ naśyate pāpaṃ vṛṣotsarge kṛte tu vai || 172.89 || māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samādhinā | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 172.90 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.173>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 173.1 || siddheśvaramiti khyātaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | yatra śuddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto devadevo maheśvaraḥ | purā hatyāyutaḥ pārtha devadevastriśūladhṛk || 173.2 || purā pañcaśirā āsīdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | tenānṛtaṃ vacaścoktaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare || 173.3 || tacchrutvā sahasā tasmai cukopa parameśvaraḥ | chedayāmāsa bhagavānmūrdhānaṃ karajaistadā || 173.4 || tasya tatkarasaṃlagnaṃ cyavate na kadācana | tato hi devadeveśaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām || 173.5 || tato vārāṇasīṃ prāptastasyāṃ tadapatacchiraḥ | patite tu kapāle ca brahmahatyā na muñcati || 173.6 || tatastu sāgare gatvā pūrve ca dakṣiṇe tathā | paścime cottare pārtha devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 173.7 || paryaṭansarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sutīrthaṃ prāptavān prabhuḥ || 173.8 || kulakoṭiṃ samāsādya prārthayāmāsa cātmavān | prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā babhūva gatakalmaṣaḥ || 173.9 || tato niṣkalmaṣo jāto devadevo maheśvaraḥ | hatvā surebhyastatsthānaṃ tataścāntardadhe prabhuḥ || 173.10 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śuddharudreti kīrtitam | vikhyātaṃ triṣu loke brahmahatyāharaṃ param || 173.11 || māse māse site pakṣe'māvāsyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 173.12 || dadyātpiṇḍaṃ pitḥṇāṃ tu bhāvitenāntarātmanā | tasya te dvādaśābdāni sutṛptāḥ pitaro nṛpa || 173.13 || gandhadhūpapradīpādyairabhyarcya parameśvaram | śuddheśvarābhidhānaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate || 173.14 || etatte kathitaṃ rājañchuddharudramanuttamam | mayā śrutaṃ yathā devasakāśācchūlapāṇinaḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 173.15 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śuddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.174>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gopeśvaraṃ tato gaccheduttare narmadātaṭe | yatra snānena caikena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ || 174.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam | barhiyuktena yānena sa gacchecchivamandire || 174.2 || krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ śivaloke narādhipa | iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati vīryavān || 174.3 || hastyaśvarathasampanno dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ | pūjyamāno narendraiśca jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ || 174.4 || samprāpte kārttike māsi navamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ | sopavāsaḥ śucirbhūtvā dīpakāṃstatra dāpayet || 174.5 || gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya rātrau kurvīta jāgaram | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 174.6 || yāvatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ saṃkhyā dīpakānāṃ tathaiva ca | tāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 174.7 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra liṅgapūraṇakaṃ vidhim | tathaiva padmakaiścaiva dadhibhaktaistathaiva ca || 174.8 || yastu kuryānnaraśreṣṭha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | yāvanti tilasaṃkhyāni dadhibhaktaṃ tathaiva ca || 174.9 || padmasaṃkhyā śive loke modate kālamīpsitam | tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yatkiṃciddīyate nṛpa || 174.10 || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya saṃkhyātuṃ vā na śakyate | evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatīrthamanuttamam || 174.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.175>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca uttare narmadākūle bhṛgukṣetrasya madhyataḥ | kapileśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ viśeṣātpāpanāśanam || 175.1 || yo'sau sanātano devaḥ purāṇe paripaṭhyate | vāsudevo jagannāthaḥ kapilatvamupāgataḥ || 175.2 || pātālaṃ sutalaṃ nāma tasyaiva nitalaṃ hyadhaḥ | gabhastigaṃ ca tasyādho hyandhatāmisrameva ca || 175.3 || pātālaṃ saptamaṃ yacca hyadhastātsaṃsthitaṃ mahat | vasate tatra vai devaḥ purāṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 175.4 || sa brahmā sa mahādevaḥ sa devo garuḍadhvajaḥ | pūjyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhaistiṣṭhate brahmavādibhiḥ || 175.5 || vasatastasya rājendra kapilasya jagadguroḥ | vināśaṃ cāgrataḥ prāptāḥ kṣaṇena sagarātmajāḥ || 175.6 || bhasmībhūtāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā kapilo munisattamaḥ | jagāma paramaṃ śokaṃ cintyamāno'tha kilbiṣam || 175.7 || sarvasaṅgaparityāge citte nirviṣayīkṛte | ayuktaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ kartaṃ mama vināśanam || 175.8 || kṛtasya karaṇaṃ nāsti tasmātpāpavināśanam | gatvā tu kāpilaṃ tīrthaṃ mocayāmyaghamātmanaḥ || 175.9 || pātālaṃ tu tato muktvā kapilo munisattamaḥ | tapaścacāra sumahannarmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ || 175.10 || vratopavāsairvividhaiḥ snānadānajapādikaiḥ | paraṃ nirvāṇamāpannaḥ pūjayanrudramavyayam || 175.11 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram | gosahasraphalaṃ tasya labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 175.12 || jyeṣṭhamāse tu samprāpte śuklapakṣe caturdaśī | tatra snātvā vidhānena bhaktyā dānaṃ prayacchati || 175.13 || pātrabhūtāya viprāya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu | akṣayaṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ śivena parameṣṭhinā || 175.14 || aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ navamīṣu ca | snānaṃ karoti puruṣo bhaktyopoṣya varāṅganā || 175.15 || rūpamaiśvaryamatulaṃ saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ parām | labhate saptajanmāni nityaṃ nityaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 175.16 || paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ snātvā piṇḍaṃ prayacchati | tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptā yānti surālayam || 175.17 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā dadyāddīpaṃ suśobhanam | jāyate tasya rājendra mahādīptiḥ śārīrajā || 175.18 || tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu jantūnāṃ sarvadā kila | anivartikā bhavetteṣāṃ gatistu śivamandirāt || 175.19 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapileśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.176>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla piṅgalāvartamuttamam | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ kāmikaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 176.1 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam | piṅgaleśvaramāsādya tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet || 176.2 || tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca devakhāte kṛtaṃ nṛpa | akṣayaṃ tadbhavetsarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 176.3 || pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu samuddhṛtya śubhodakam | muktaṃ tatra suraiḥ khātvā devakhātaṃ tato'bhavat || 176.4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ tu devakhātaṃ tatsaṃjātaṃ dvijasattama | surāḥ sarve kathaṃ tatra mumucurvāri tīrthajam | sarvaṃ kathaya me vipra śravaṇe lampaṭaṃ manaḥ || 176.5 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca yadā tu śūlaśuddhyarthaṃ rudro devagaṇaiḥ saha | babhrāma pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śubhām || 176.6 || prabhāsādyeṣu tīrtheṣu snānaṃ cakruḥ surāstadā | sarvatīrthotthitaṃ toyaṃ pātre vai nihitaṃ tu taiḥ || 176.7 || śūlabhedamanuprāpya śūlaṃ śuddhaṃ tu śūlinaḥ | tatrotthamudakaṃ gṛhya āgatā bhṛgukacchake || 176.8 || tatrāpaśyaṃstato hyagniṃ ca piṅgalākṣaṃ ca rogiṇam | tapasyugre vyavasitaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ maheśvaram || 176.9 || havirbhāgaistu viprāṇāṃ rājñāṃ caivāmayāvinām | dṛṣṭvā tu bahurogārtamagniṃ devamukhaṃ surāḥ | prāhuste sahitā devaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram || 176.10 || devā ūcuḥ | prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ śambho piṅgalasyāmayāvinaḥ | yathā hi nīrujaḥ kāyo haviṣāṃ grahaṇakṣamaḥ | punarbhavati piṅgastu tathā kuru maheśvara || 176.11 || īśvara uvāca bhobhoḥ surā hi tapasā tuṣṭo'haṃ vo viśeṣataḥ | vacanācca viśeṣeṇa dadāmyabhimataṃ varam || 176.12 || piṅgala uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa dīyate deva cepsitam | candrādityau ca nayane kṛtvātra kalayā sthitaḥ || 176.13 || tathā punarnavaḥ kāyo bhavedvai mama śaṅkara | tathā kuru virūpākṣa namastubhyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 176.14 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavāñchambhurmūrtimādityarūpiṇīm | kṛtvā tu tasya tadrogamapānudata śaṅkaraḥ || 176.15 || tataḥ punarnavībhūtaḥ punaḥ provāca śaṅkaram | atraiva sthīyatāṃ śambho tathaiva bhāskaraḥ svayam || 176.16 || prāṇināmupakārāya rogāṇāmupaśāntaye | pāpānāṃ dhvaṃsanārthāya śreyasāṃ caiva vṛddhaye || 176.17 || evamuktastu bhagavānpiṅgalena mahātmanā | avatāraṃ ca kṛtavān gīrvāṇānidamabravīt || 176.18 || īśvara uvāca muñcadhvamudakaṃ devāstīrthebhyo yatsamāhṛtam | mama cottarataḥ kṛtvā khātaṃ devamayaṃ śubham || 176.19 || tatra nikṣipyatāṃ vāri sarvarogavināśanam | sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvairapi surādibhiḥ || 176.20 || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve khātaṃ kṛtvā tathottare | vayastriṃśatkoṭigaṇairmuktaṃ tattīrthajaṃ jalam || 176.21 || procuste sahitāḥ sarve virūpākṣapurogamāḥ | yaḥ kaściddevakhāte'sminmṛdālambhanapūrvakam || 176.22 || snānaṃ kṛtvā ravidine saṃsnāya narmadājale | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyo vai dānaṃ dattvā svaśaktitaḥ || 176.23 || pūjayiṣyati piṅgeśaṃ tasya vāsastriviṣṭape | bhaviṣyati surairuktaṃ śṛṇoti sakalaṃ jagat || 176.24 || āmayā bhuvi martyānāṃ kṣayarogavicarcikāḥ | vyādhayo vikṛtākārāḥ kāsaśvāsajvarodbhavāḥ || 176.25 || ekadvitricaturthāhā ye jvarā bhūtasambhavāḥ | ye cānye vikṛtā doṣā dadruśca kāmalaṃ tathā || 176.26 || dinaiste saptabhiryānti nāśaṃ snānairraverdine | śatabhedaprabhinnā ye kuṣṭhā bahuvidhāstathā || 176.27 || śatamādityavārāṇāṃ snāyādaṣṭottaraṃ tu yaḥ | sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ dadyāttilapātraṃ dvijātaye || 176.28 || naśyanti tasya kuṣṭhāni garuḍeneva pannagāḥ | evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve tridaśāstridaśālayam || 176.29 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saritsu ca | snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 176.30 || ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasreṣu ṣaṣṭitīrthaśateṣu ca | yatphalaṃ snānadāneṣu devakhāte tato'dhikam || 176.31 || devakhāteṣu yaḥ snātvā tarpayitvā pitḥnnṛpa | pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ piṅgaleśvaramuttamam || 176.32 || so'śvamedhasya yajñasya vājapeyasya bhārata | dvayoḥ puṇyamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 176.33 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe piṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.177>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhūtīśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam | darśanādeva rājendra yasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 177.1 || tatra sthāne purā pārtha devadevena śūlinā | uddhūlanaṃ kṛtaṃ gātre tena bhūtīśvaraṃ tu tat || 177.2 || puṣye vā janmanakṣatre amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | bhūtīśvare naraḥ snātvā kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet || 177.3 || tatra sthāne tu yo bhaktyā kurute hyaṅgaguṇṭhanam | tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 177.4 || yāvanto bhūtikaṇikā gātre lagnāḥ śivālaye | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 177.5 || sarveṣāmeva snānānāṃ bhasmasnānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam | purāṇairṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ sarvaśāstreṣvanuttamam || 177.6 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ cāpi yaḥ sadā | snānaṃ karoti cāgneyaṃ pāpaṃ tasya praṇaśyati || 177.7 || divyasnānādvaraṃ snānaṃ vāyavyaṃ bharatarṣabha | vāyavyāduttamaṃ brāhmyaṃ varaṃ brāhmyāttu vāruṇam || 177.8 || āgneyaṃ vāruṇācchreṣṭhaṃ yasmāduktaṃ svayambhuvā | tasmātsarvaprayatnena hyāgneyaṃ snānamācaret || 177.9 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyameva ca | kimuktaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 177.10 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānamavagāhya ca vāruṇam | āpohiṣṭheti ca brāhmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ smṛtam || 177.11 || sūrye dṛṣṭe tu yatsnānaṃ gaṅgātoyena tatsamam | tatsnānaṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ divyaṃ pāṇḍavasattama || 177.12 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snātvā bhūtīśvare tu yaḥ | pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ || 177.13 || tatra sthāne tu ye nityaṃ dhyāyanti paramaṃ padam | sūkṣmaṃ cātīndriyaṃ nityaṃ te dhanyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 177.14 || muktitīrthaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam | darśanādeva yasyaiva pāpaṃ yāti mahatkṣayam || 177.15 || jāyate pūjayā rājyaṃ tatra stutvā maheśvaram | japena pāpasaṃśuddhirdhyānenānantyamaśnute || 177.16 || oṃ jyotiḥ svarūpamanādimadhyamanutpādyamānamanucāryamāṇākṣaram | sarvabhūtasthitaṃ śivaṃ sarvayogeśvaraṃ sarvalokeśvaraṃ mohaśokahīnaṃ mahājñānagamyam || 177.17 || tatra tīrthe tu yo gatvā snānaṃ kuryānnareśvara | aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | evambhūtaṃ na jānanti mokṣāpekṣaṇikā narāḥ || 177.18 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhūtīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.178>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra gaṅgāvāhakamuttamam | narmadāyāṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhṛgutīrthasamīpataḥ || 178.1 || tatra gaṅgā mahāpuṇyā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ | purā varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ paramaṃ vratamāsthitā || 178.2 || dhyātvā devaṃ jagadyoniṃ nārāyaṇamakalmaṣam | ātmānaṃ paramaṃ dhāma saritsā jagatīpate || 178.3 || tato janārdano deva āgatyedamuvāca ha || 178.4 || viṣṇuruvāca tapasā tava tuṣṭo'haṃ matpādāmbujasambhave | mattaḥ kimicchase devi brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 178.5 || gaṅgovāca tvatpādakamalādbhraṣṭā gaṅgā sahacarā vibho | yadṛcchayā trilokeśa vandyamānā divaukasaiḥ || 178.6 || nṛpo bhagīrathastasmāttapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram | samārādhya jagannāthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram || 178.7 || avatārayāmāsa hi māṃ pṛthivyāṃ dharaṇīdhara | mayā vai yuvayorvākyādavatāraḥ kṛto bhuvi || 178.8 || vaiṣṇavīmiti māṃ matvā janaḥ sarvāpluto mayi | ye vai brahmaṇo loke ye ca vai gurutalpagāḥ || 178.9 || tyāginaḥ pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ ye ca svarṇaharā narāḥ | goghnā ye manujā loke tathā ye prāṇihiṃsakāḥ || 178.10 || agamyāgāmino ye ca hyabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣakāḥ | ye cānṛtapravaktāro ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ || 178.11 || devabrāhmaṇavittānāṃ hartāro ye narādhamāḥ | devabrahmagurustrīṇāṃ ye ca nindākarā narāḥ || 178.12 || brahmaśāpapradagdhā ye ye caivātmahano dvijāḥ | bhraṣṭānaśanasaṃnyāsaniyatavratacāriṇaḥ || 178.13 || tathaivāpeyapeyāśca ye ca svagurunindakāḥ | niṣedhakā ye dānānāṃ pātradānaparāṅmukhāḥ || 178.14 || ṛtughnā ye svapatnīnāṃ pitroḥ sehaparā na hi | bāndhaveṣu ca dīneṣu karuṇā yasya nāsti vai || 178.15 || kṣetrasetuvibhedī ca pūrvamārgapralopakaḥ | nāstikaḥ śāstrahīnastu vipraḥ sandhyāvivarjitaḥ || 178.16 || ahutāśī hyasaṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī | kadaryā nāstikāḥ krūrāḥ kṛtaghnā ye dvijāyaḥ || 178.17 || paiśunyā rasavikreyāḥ sarvakālavinākṛtāḥ | svagotrāṃ paragotrāṃ vā ye bhuñjanti dvijādhamāḥ || 178.18 || te māṃ prāpya vimucyante pāpasaṅghaiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ | tatpāpakṣārataptāyā na śarma mama vidyate || 178.19 || tathā kuru jagannātha yathāhaṃ śarma cāpnuyām | evamuktastu deveśastuṣṭaḥ provāca jāhnavīm || 178.20 || viṣṇuruvāca ahamatra vasiṣyāmi gaṅgādharasahāyavān | praviśasva sadā revāṃ tvamatraiva ca mūrtinā || 178.21 || mama pādatalaṃ prāpya vaha tripathagāmini | yadā bahūdakakāle narmadājalasaṃbhṛtā || 178.22 || prāvṛṭkālaṃ samāsādya bhaviṣyati jalākulā | plāvyobhayataṭaṃ devī prāpya māmuttarasthitam || 178.23 || plāvayiṣyati toyena yadā śaṅkhaṃ kare sthitam | tadā parvaśatodyuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ parvasaṃjñitam || 178.24 || na tena sadṛśaṃ kiṃcidvyatīpātādisaṃkramam | ayane dve ca na tathā puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ yathā || 178.25 || tasminparvaṇi deveśi śaṅkhaṃ saṃspṛśya mānavaḥ | snānamācarate toye miśre gāṅgeyanārmade || 178.26 || puṇyaṃ tvaśeṣapuṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam | viṣṇunā vidhṛto yena tasmācchāntiḥ pracakrame || 178.27 || tatrāntaṃ pāpasaṅghasya dhruvamāpnoti mānavaḥ | śaṅkhoddhāre naraḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 178.28 || tṛptāste dvādaśābdāni siddhiṃ ca sārvakāmikīm | gaṅgāvahe tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ śaṅkhoddhāre pradāsyati || 178.29 || tena piṇḍapradānena nṛtyanti pitarastathā | śaṅkhoddhāre naraḥ snātvā pūjayedbalakeśavau || 178.30 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddho bhavati jāhnavi | yattvaṃ lokakṛtaṃ karma manyase bhuvi duḥsaham || 178.31 || tasminparvaṇi tatsarvaṃ tatra snātvā vyapohaya | evamuktvā naraśreṣṭha viṣṇuścāntaradhīyata || 178.32 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhakamuttamam | brahmādyairṛṣibhistāta pāramparyakramāgataiḥ || 178.33 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktibhāvena bhārata | gaṅgātīrthe tu sa snātaḥ samasteṣu na saṃśayaḥ || 178.34 || tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ viṣṇulokātkadācana || 178.35 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gaṅgāvahakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.179>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra gautameśvaramuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 179.1 || gautamena tapastaptaṃ tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 179.2 || praṇamya śirasā tatra sthāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sthāpito gautameneśo gautameśvara ucyate || 179.3 || tatra devaiśca gandharvairṛṣibhiḥ pitṛdaivataiḥ | samprāptā hyuttamā siddhirārādhya parameśvaram || 179.4 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pūjayetparamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 179.5 || bahavastanna jānanti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ | tatra saṃnihitaṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram || 179.6 || brahmacārī tu yo bhūtvā tatra tīrthe nareśvara | snātvārcayenmahādevaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 179.7 || brahmacārī tu yo bhūtvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | pūjayetparamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 179.8 || tatra tīrthe tu yo dānaṃ bhaktyā dadyāddvijātaye | tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 179.9 || māse cāśvayuje rājan kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | snātvā tatra vidhānena dīpakānāṃ śataṃ dadet || 179.10 || pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhirnaraḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 179.11 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | upoṣya prayato bhūtvā ghṛtena snāpayecchivam || 179.12 || pañcagavyena madhunā dadhnā vā śītavāriṇā | sa ca sarvasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 179.13 || bhaktyā tu pūjayetpaścātsa labhetphalamuttamam | bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiśca puṣpairunmattakodbhavaiḥ || 179.14 || kuśāpāmārgasahitaiḥ kadambadroṇajairapi | mallikākaravīraiśca raktapītaiḥ sitāsitaiḥ || 179.15 || puṣpairanyairyathālābhaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayecchivam | nairantaryeṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ yo'rcayedgautameśvaram | sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 179.16 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gautameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.180>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla daśāśvamedhikaṃ param | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 180.1 || yatra gatvā mahārāja snātvā sampūjya ceśvaram | daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 180.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca aśvamedho mahāyajño bahusambhāradakṣiṇaḥ | aśakyaḥ prākṛtaiḥ kartuṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ labhet || 180.3 || atyāścaryamidaṃ tattvaṃ tvayoktaṃ vadatā satā | yathā me jāyate śraddhā dīrghāyustvaṃ tathā vada || 180.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca idamāścaryabhūtaṃ hi gauryā pṛṣṭastriyambakaḥ | tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi pṛcchate nipuṇāya vai || 180.5 || purā vṛṣastho deveśa hyumayā saha śaṅkaraḥ | kadācitparyaṭanpṛthivīṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 180.6 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā devo maheśvaraḥ | tīrthaṃ pratyañjaliṃ baddhvā namaścakre trilocanaḥ || 180.7 || kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā devīdamabravīt || 180.8 || devyuvāca kimetaddevadeveśa carācaranamaskṛta | prahvanamrāñjaliṃ baddhvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 180.9 || etadāścaryamatulaṃ sarvaṃ kathaya me prabho || 180.10 || īśvara uvāca pratyakṣaṃ paśya tīrthasya phalaṃ mā vismitā bhava | viyatsthā me bhuvisthasya kṣaṇaṃ devi sthirā bhava || 180.11 || evamuktvā tu deveśo gauravarṇo dvijo'bhavat | kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭho jaṭilaḥ śuṣko dhamanisaṃtataḥ || 180.12 || upaviśya bhuvaḥ pṛṣṭhe susvaraṃ mantramuccaran | kramapriyo mahādevo mādhuryeṇa pramodayan || 180.13 || śrutvā tāṃ madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ svayaṃ devena nirmitām | saṃbhrāntā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve snātuṃ ye tatra cāgatāḥ || 180.14 || nityakriyā ca sarveṣāṃ vismṛtā śrutivibhramāt | taṃ dṛṣṭvā paṭhamānaṃ tu kṣutpipāsābhipīḍitam || 180.15 || dvijo'nyamantrayatkaścidbhaktyā taṃ bhojanāya vai | prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ brahmanbhojanāya gṛhe mama || 180.16 || adya me saphalaṃ janma hyadya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ | sarvānkāmānpradāsyanti prītā me'dya pitāmahāḥ || 180.17 || tvayi bhukte dvijaśreṣṭha prasīda tvaṃ dhruvaṃ mama | evamukto mahādevo dvijarūpadharastadā || 180.18 || prahasya pratyuvācedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā | mayā varṣasahasraṃ tu nirāhāraṃ tapaḥ kṛtam || 180.19 || idānīṃ tu gṛhe tasya kariṣye dvijasattama | daśabhirvājimedhaiśca yeneṣṭaṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā || 180.20 || ityukto devadevena brāhmaṇo vismayānvitaḥ | uttamāṅgaṃ vidhunvanvai jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati || 180.21 || evaṃ te bahavo viprāḥ pratyākhyāte nimantraṇe | purāṇārthamajānanto nāstikā bahavo gatāḥ || 180.22 || atha kaściddvijo vidvānpurāṇārthasya tattvavit | devaṃ nimantrayāmāsa dvijarūpadharaṃ śivam || 180.23 || tathaiva so'pi devena proktaḥ sa prāha taṃ punaḥ | manasā cintayitvā tu purāṇoktaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 180.24 || smṛtivedapurāṇeṣu yaduktaṃ tattathā bhavet | iti niścitya taṃ vipramuvāca prahasanniva || 180.25 || bhobho vipra pratīkṣasva yāvadāgamanaṃ punaḥ | ityuktvā tu dvijo gatvā daśāśvamedhikaṃ param || 180.26 || snānaṃ mahālambhanādi kṛtaṃ tena dvijanmanā | japaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā dānaṃ kṛtvā dharmānusārataḥ || 180.27 || saṃkalpya kapilāṃ tatra purāṇoktavidhānataḥ | samāyāttvaritaṃ tatra yatrāsau tiṣṭhate dvijaḥ || 180.28 || athāgatya dvijaṃ prāha vājimedhaḥ kṛto mayā | uttiṣṭha me gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ bhojanārthaṃ hi gamyatām || 180.29 || ityuktaḥ śaṅkarastena brāhmaṇenātivismitaḥ | uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ deva idānīṃ tvamito gataḥ || 180.30 || dvijavarya kathaṃ ceṣṭā daśa yajñā mahādhanāḥ || 180.31 || dvija uvāca na vicārastvayā kāryaḥ kṛtā yajñā na saṃśayaḥ | yadi vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ taṃ bhuvi devā dvijāstathā || 180.32 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā satyaṃ dvijottama | yadi vedapurāṇoktaṃ vākyaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ bhavet || 180.33 || tadā prāptaṃ mayā sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | evamuktastu deveśa āstikyaṃ tasya cetasaḥ || 180.34 || vimṛśya bahubhiḥ kiṃciduttaraṃ na prapadyata | jagāma tadgṛhaṃ ramyaṃ paṭhanbrahma sanātanam || 180.35 || samprāptaṃ taṃ dvijaṃ bhaktyā pādyārghyeṇa tamarcayat | ṣaḍrasaṃ bhojanaṃ tena dattaṃ paścādyathāvidhi || 180.36 || tato bhukte mahādeve sarvadevamaye śive | puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātāśu gaganāttasya mūrdhani | tasyāstikyaṃ tu saṃlakṣya tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ || 180.37 || īśvara uvāca kiṃ te'dya kriyatāṃ brūhi varado'haṃ dvijottama | adeyamapi dāsyāmi ekacittasya te dhruvam || 180.38 || brāhmaṇa uvāca yadi prīto'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama | asmiṃstīrthe mahādeva sthātavyaṃ sarvadaiva hi || 180.39 || upakārāya deveśa eṣa me vara uttamaḥ | evamuktastu devena āruroha dvijottamaḥ || 180.40 || gandharvāpsaraḥsambādhaṃ vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam | pūjyamāno gatastatra yatra lokā nirāmayāḥ || 180.41 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca etadāścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī suvismitā | vismayotphullanayanā punaḥ papraccha śaṅkaram || 180.42 || pārvatyuvāca kathametadbhavetsatyaṃ yatredamasamañjasam | snānaṃ kurvanti bahavo lokā hyatra maheśvara || 180.43 || teṣāṃ tu svargagamanaṃ yathaiṣa svargatiṃ gataḥ | kathametatsamācakṣva vismayaḥ paramo mama || 180.44 || etacchrutvā tu deveśaḥ prahasanpratyuvāca tām | vedavākye purāṇārthe smṛtyarthe dvijabhāṣite || 180.45 || vismayo hi na kartavyo hyanumānaṃ hi tattathā | asaṃbhāvyaṃ hi lokānāṃ purāṇe yatpragīyate || 180.46 || yadi pakṣaṃ puraskṛtya lokāḥ kurvanti pārvati | tasmānna siddhireteṣāṃ bhavatyeko na vismayaḥ || 180.47 || nāstikā bhinnamaryādā ye niścayabahiṣkṛtāḥ | teṣāṃ siddhirna vidyeta āstikyādbhavate dhruvam || 180.48 || śrutvākhyānamidaṃ devī vavande tīrthamuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 180.49 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca daśāśvamedhaṃ rājendra sarvatīrthottamottamam | tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 180.50 || tatrāgatā mahābhāgā snātukāmā sarasvatī | puṇyānāṃ paramā puṇyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī || 180.51 || nāmamātreṇa yasyāstu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | snātāstatra divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ || 180.52 || daśāśvamedhe sā rājanniyatā brahmacāriṇī | ārādhayitvā deveśaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇamāgatīḥ || 180.53 || kāluṣyaṃ brahmasambhūtā saṃvatsarasamudbhavam | prakṣālayitumāyāti daśamyāmāśvinasya ca || 180.54 || upoṣya rajanīṃ tāṃ tu sampūjya tripurāntakam | rājanniṣkalmaṣā yānti śvobhūte śāśvataṃ padam || 180.55 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī | śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca rājannāśvayuje māsi daśamyāṃ tadviśiṣyate | pārthiveṣu ca tīrthe tu sarveṣveva na saṃśayaḥ || 180.56 || daśāśvamedhike rājannityaṃ hi daśamī śubhā | viśeṣādāśvine śuklā mahāpātakanāśinī || 180.57 || tasyāsnātvārcayeddevānupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena paścātsampūjayecchivam || 180.58 || tatrasthāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ snātukāmāṃ sarasvatīm | namo namaste deveśi brahmadehasamudbhave || 180.59 || kuru pāpakṣayaṃ devi saṃsārānmāṃ samuddhara | gandhadhūpaiśca sampūjya hyarcayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || 180.60 || daśa pradakṣiṇā dattvā sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet | kapilāṃ tu tato vipre dadyādvigatamatsaraḥ || 180.61 || sarvalakṣaṇasampannāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām | dattvā viprāya kapilāṃ na śocati kṛtākṛte || 180.62 || paścājjāgaraṇaṃ kuryādghṛtenājvālya dīpakam | purāṇapaṭhanenaiva nṛtyagītavivādanaiḥ || 180.63 || vedoktaiścaiva pūjayecchaśiśekharam | prabhāte vimale paścātsnātvā vai narmadājale || 180.64 || brāhmaṇān bhojayedbhaktyā śivabhaktāṃśca yoginaḥ | evaṃ kṛte tato rājan samyaktīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 180.65 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ naraḥ | daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthaṃ labhate puṇyamuttamam || 180.66 || pūtātmā tena puṇyena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati | ārūḍhaḥ paramaṃ yānaṃ kāmagaṃ ca suśobhanam || 180.67 || tatra divyāpsarobhistu vījyamāno'tha cāmaraiḥ | krīḍate suciraṃ kālaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ || 180.68 || tato'vatīrṇaḥ kālena iha rājā bhaveddhruvam | hastyaśvarathasampanno mahābhogī paraṃtapaḥ || 180.69 || daśāśvamedhe yaddānaṃ dīyate śivayoginām | daśāśvamedhasadṛśaṃ bhavettannātra saṃśayaḥ || 180.70 || sarveṣāmeva yajñānāmaśvamedho viśiṣyate | durlabhaḥ svalpavittānāṃ bhūriśaḥ pāpakarmaṇām || 180.71 || tatra tīrthe tu rājendra durlabho'pi surāsuraiḥ | prāpyate snānadānena ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 180.72 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā mṛtastatra nareśvara | devatvaṃ prāpnuyātso'pi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 180.73 || agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe narottama | agniloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 180.74 || jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe narādhipa | dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 180.75 || daśāśvamedhe yaḥ kaścicchūravṛttyā tanuṃ tyajet | akṣayā nu gatistasya ityevaṃ śrutinodanā || 180.76 || na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti bhṛguprapātino na daṇḍino naiva ca sāṃkhyayoginaḥ | dhvajākule dundubhiśaṅkhanādite kṣaṇena yāṃ yānti mahāhave mṛtāḥ || 180.77 || yatra tatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ | akṣayāṃllabhate lokānyadi klībaṃ na bhāṣate || 180.78 || daśāśvamedhe saṃnyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti vidhānataḥ | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokātkadācana || 180.79 || daśāśvamedhe yatpuṇyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yudhiṣṭhira | kathitaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 180.80 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe daśāśvamedhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.181>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhṛgutīrthasya vistaram | yaṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghno mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 181.1 || tatra tīrthe tu vikhyātaṃ vṛṣakhātamiti śrutam | bhṛguṇā tatra rājendra tapastaptaṃ purā kila || 181.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca bhṛgukacche sa viprendro nivasan kena hetunā | tapastaptvā suvipulaṃ parāṃ siddhimupāgataḥ || 181.3 || ko vā vṛṣa iti proktastatkhātaṃ yena khānitam | etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kathayasva mamānagha || 181.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca eṣa praśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ | tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 181.5 || ṣaṣṭhastu brahmaṇaḥ putro mānaso bhṛgusattamaḥ | tapaścacāra vipulaṃ śrīvṛte kṣetra uttame || 181.6 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu saṃśuṣko munisattamaḥ | nirāhāro nirānandaḥ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇavatsthitaḥ || 181.7 || tataḥ kadāciddeveśo vimānavaramāsthitaḥ | umayā sahitaḥ śrīmāṃstena mārgeṇa cāgataḥ || 181.8 || dṛṣṭvā tatra mahābhāgaṃ bhṛguṃ valmīkavatsthitam | uvāca devī deveśaṃ kimidaṃ dṛśyate prabho || 181.9 || īśvara uvāca bhṛgurnāma mahādevi tapastaptvā sudāruṇam | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 181.10 || jalabindu kuśāgreṇa māse māse pibecca saḥ | saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhate ca varānane || 181.11 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ gaurī krodhasaṃvartitekṣaṇā | uvāca devī deveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram || 181.12 || satyamugro'si loke tvaṃ khyāpito vṛṣabhadhvaja | niṣkāruṇyo durārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaraḥ || 181.13 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dhyāyamānasya śaṅkaram | brāhmaṇasya varaṃ kasmānna prayacchasi śaṃsa me || 181.14 || evamukto'tha deveśaḥ prahasya girinandinīm | uvāca naraśārdūla meghagambhīrayā girā || 181.15 || strī vinaśyati garveṇa tapaḥ krodhena naśyati | gāvo dūrapracāreṇa śūdrānnena dvijottamāḥ || 181.16 || krodhānvito dvijo gaurī tena siddhirna vidyate | varṣāyutaistathā lakṣairna kiṃcitkāraṇaṃ priye || 181.17 || evambhūtasya tasyāpi krodhasya caritaṃ mahat | evamuktvā tataḥ śambhurvṛṣaṃ dadhyau ca tatkṣaṇe || 181.18 || vṛṣo hi bhagavanbrahmā vṛṣarūpī maheśvaraḥ | dhyānaprāptaḥ kṣaṇādeva garjayan vai muhurmuhuḥ || 181.19 || kiṃ karomi suraśreṣṭha dhyātaḥ kenaiva hetunā | karomi kasya nidhanamakāle parameśvara || 181.20 || īśvara uvāca kopayasva dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ gatvā tvaṃ bhṛgusattamam | yena me śraddadhatyeṣā gaurī lokaikasundarī || 181.21 || etacchrutvā vṛṣo gatvā dharṣaṇārthaṃ dvijottamam | narmadāyāstaṭe ramye samīpe cāśrame bhṛguḥ || 181.22 || tataḥ śṛṅgairgṛhītvā tu prakṣipto narmadājale | tataḥ kruddho bhṛgustatra daṇḍahasto mahāmuniḥ || 181.23 || paśuvatte vadhiṣyāmi daṇḍaghātena mastake | śikhāyajñopavīte ca paridhānaṃ varāsane || 181.24 || susaṃvṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena dhāvanvai pṛṣṭhato bravīt || 181.25 || bhṛguruvāca pāpakarmandurācāra kathaṃ yāsyasi me vṛṣa | avamānaṃ samutpādya kṛtvā gartaṃ khuraistathā || 181.26 || garjayitvā mahānādaṃ tato vipramapātayat | ātmānaṃ pātitaṃ jñātvā vṛṣeṇa parameṣṭhinā || 181.27 || bhṛguḥ krodhena jajvāla hutāhutirivānalaḥ | kare gṛhya mahādaṇḍaṃ brahmadaṇḍamivāparam || 181.28 || hantukāmo vṛṣaṃ vipro'bhyadhāvata yudhiṣṭhira | dhāvamānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā sa vṛṣaḥ pūrvasāgare || 181.29 || jambūdvīpaṃ kuśāṃ krauñcaṃ śālmaliṃ śākameva ca | gomedaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāptaḥ pūrvato dakṣiṇāpatham || 181.30 || uttaraṃ paścimaṃ caiva dvīpāddvīpaṃ nareśvara | pātālaṃ sutalaṃ paścādvitalaṃ ca talātalam || 181.31 || tāmisramandhatāmisraṃ pātālaṃ saptamaṃ yayau | tato jagāma bhūrlokaṃ prāṇārthī sa vṛṣottamaḥ || 181.32 || bhuvaḥ svaścaiva ca mahastapaḥ satyaṃ janastathā | anugamyamāno vipreṇa na śarma labhate kvacit || 181.33 || pāpaṃ kṛtvaiva puruṣaḥ kāmakrodhabalārditaḥ | tato jagāma śaraṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumeva ca || 181.34 || indraṃ candraṃ tathādityairyāmyavāruṇamārutaiḥ | yadā sarvaiḥ parityakto lokālokaiḥ sureśvaraiḥ || 181.35 || tadā devaṃ namaskṛtvā rakṣa rakṣasva cābravīt | vadhyamānaṃ mahādevo bhṛguṇā parameṣṭhinā || 181.36 || sarvalokaiḥ parityaktamanāthamiva taṃ prabho | dṛṣṭvā śrāntaṃ vṛṣaṃ devaḥ patitaṃ caraṇāgrataḥ || 181.37 || tataḥ provāca bhagavān smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 181.38 || īśvara uvāca paśya devi mahābhāge śamaṃ viprasya sundari || 181.39 || pārvatyuvāca yāvadvipro na cāsmākaṃ kupyate parameśvara | tāvadvaraṃ prayacchāśu yadi cecchasi matpriyam || 181.40 || tato bhasmī jaṭī śūlī candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ | umārddhadeho bhagavānbhūtvā vipramuvāca ha || 181.41 || bhobho dvijavaraśreṣṭha krodhaste na śamaṃ gataḥ | yasmāttasmādidaṃ tāta krodhasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 181.42 || tato dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ śambhuṃ bhṛguḥ śreṣṭhaṃ trilocanam | jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā idaṃ stotramudairayat || 181.43 || bhṛguruvāca praṇipatya bhūtanāthaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ bhūtidaṃ bhayātītam | bhavabhīto bhuvanapate vijñaptuṃ kiṃcidicchāmi || 181.44 || tvadguṇanikarānvaktuṃ kā śaktirmānuṣasyāsya | vāsukirapi na tāvadvaktuṃ vadanasahasraṃ bhavedyasya || 181.45 || bhaktyā tathāpi śaṅkara śaśidhara karajāladhavalitāśeṣa | stutimukharasya maheśvara prasīda tava caraṇaniratasya || 181.46 || sattvaṃ rajastamastvaṃ sthityutpattivināśanaṃ deva | bhavabhīto bhuvanapate bhuvaneśa śaraṇaniratasya || 181.47 || yamaniyamayajñadānaṃ vedābhyāsaśca dhāraṇāyogaḥ | tvadbhakteḥ sarvamidaṃ nārhanti vai kalāsahasrāṃśam || 181.48 || utkṛṣṭarasarasāyanakhaḍgāṃ janavivarapādukāsiddhiḥ | cihnaṃ hi tava natānāṃ dṛśyata iha janmani prakaṭam || 181.49 || śāṭhyena yadi praṇamati vitarasi tasyāpi bhūtimicchayā deva | bhavati bhavacchedakarī bhaktirmokṣāya nirmitā nātha || 181.50 || paradāraparasvarataṃ paraparibhavaduḥkhaśokasaṃtaptam | paravadanavīkṣaṇaparaṃ parameśvara māṃ paritrāhi || 181.51 || adhikābhimānamuditaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguravibhavavilasantam | krūraṃ kupathābhimukhaṃ śaṅkara śaraṇāgataṃ paritrāhi || 181.52 || dīnaṃ dvijaṃ varārthe bandhujane naiva pūritā hyāśā | chinddhi maheśvara tṛṣṇāṃ kiṃ mūḍhaṃ māṃ viḍambayasi || 181.53 || tṛṣṇāṃ harasva śīghraṃ lakṣmīṃ dada hṛdayavāsinīṃ nityam | chinddhi madamohapāśaṃ māmuttāraya bhavācca deveśa || 181.54 || karuṇābhyudayaṃ nāma stotramidaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ divyam | yaḥ paṭhati bhṛguṃ smarati ca śivalokamasau prayāti dehānte || 181.55 || etacchrutvā mahādevaḥ stotraṃ ca bhṛgubhāṣitam | uvāca varado'smīti devyā saha varottamam || 181.56 || bhṛguruvāca prasanno devadeveśa yadi deyo varo mama | siddhikṣetramidaṃ sarvaṃ bhavitā mama nāmataḥ || 181.57 || bhavadbhiḥ sannidhānena sthātavyaṃ hi sahomayā | devakṣetramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yena sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 181.58 || atra sthāne mahāsthānaṃ karomi jagadīśvara | tava prasādāddeveśa pūryantāṃ me manorathāḥ || 181.59 || īśvara uvāca śriyā kṛtamidaṃ pūrvaṃ kiṃ na jñātaṃ tvayā dvija | anumānya śriyaṃ devīṃ yadīyaṃ manyate bhavān || 181.60 || kuruṣva yadabhipretaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ naḥ tadanyathā | evamuktvā gate deve snātvā gatvā bhṛguḥ śriyam || 181.61 || kṛtvā ca pāraṇaṃ tatra vasanviprastayā saha | śriyā ca sahitaḥ kāla idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 181.62 || bhṛguruvāca yadi te rocate bhadre duḥkhāsīnaṃ ca te yadi | tvayā vṛte mahākṣetre svīyaṃ sthānaṃ karomyaham || 181.63 || śrīruvāca mama nāmnā tu viprarṣe tava nāmnā tu śobhanam | sthānaṃ kuruṣvābhipretamavirodhena me matiḥ || 181.64 || bhṛguruvāca kacchapādhiṣṭhitaṃ hyetattasya pṛṣṭhigataṃ rame | saṃmantrya sahitaṃ tena śobhanaṃ bhavatī kuru || 181.65 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛgukacchotpattivarṇanaṃ nāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.182>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato bhṛguḥ śriyā caiva sametaḥ kacchapaṃ gataḥ | abhinandya yathānyāyamuvāca vacanaṃ śubham || 182.1 || tvayā dhṛtā dharā sarvā tathā lokāścarācarāḥ | tathaiva puṇyabhāvatvātsthitastatra mahāmate || 182.2 || cāturvidyasya saṃsthānaṃ karomi ramayā saha | yadi tvaṃ manyase deva tadādeśaya māṃ vibho || 182.3 || kūrma uvāca evameva dvijaśreṣṭha mama nāmāṅkitaṃ puram | bhaviṣyati mahatkālaṃ mamopari susaṃsthitam || 182.4 || acalaṃ susthiraṃ tāta na bhīḥ kāryā sulocane | etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ kacchapasya mukhāccyutam || 182.5 || hṛṣṭastuṣṭaḥ śriyā sārddhaṃ padmayonisuto bhṛguḥ | abhīci udaye prāpte kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ || 182.6 || nandane vatsare māghe pañcamyāṃ bharatarṣabha | śaste tu hyuttarāyoge kumbhasthe śaśimaṇḍale || 182.7 || revāyā uttare tīre gambhīre cābhivāruṇi | prāgudakpravaṇe deśe koṭitīrthasamanvitam || 182.8 || krośapramāṇaṃ tatkṣetraṃ prāsādaśatasaṃkulam | acireṇaiva kālena tapobalasamanvitaḥ | vicintya viśvakarmāṇaṃ cakāra bhṛgusattamaḥ || 182.9 || brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃsaḥ kṣatriyā rājyapālakāḥ | vaiśyā vṛttiratāstatra śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣakāstriṣu || 182.10 || evaṃ śriyā vṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ paramānandananditam | nirmitaṃ bhṛguṇā tāta sarvapātakanāśanam | iti bhṛgukacchotpattiḥ || 182.11 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ kālena mahatā kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare | devalokaṃ jagāmāśu lakṣmīrṛṣisamāgame || 182.12 || samarpya kuñcikāṭṭālaṃ bhṛgave brahmavādine | pālayasva yathārthaṃ vai sthānakaṃ mama suvrata || 182.13 || devakāryāṇyaśeṣāṇi kṛtvā śrīḥ punarāgatā | ājagāma ramā devī bhṛgukacchaṃ tvarānvitā || 182.14 || prārthitaṃ kuñcikāṭṭālaṃ svagṛhaṃ saparigraham | bhṛguryadā tadā pārtha mithyā nāsti tadā vadata || 182.15 || eva vivādaḥ sumahānsaṃjātaśca nareśvara | mameti mama caiveti parasparasamāgame || 182.16 || tataḥ kālena mahatā bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā | cāturvidyapramāṇārthaṃ cakāra mahatīṃ sthitim || 182.17 || asmadīyaṃ yathā sarvaṃ nagaraṃ mṛgalocane | cāturvidyā dvijāḥ sarve tathā jānanti sundari || 182.18 || śrīruvāca pramāṇaṃ mama viprendra cāturvaṇyā na saṃśayaḥ | madīyaṃ vā tvadīyaṃ vā kathayantu dvijottamāḥ || 182.19 || tataḥ samastairvibudhaiḥ sampradhārya parasparam | dvidhā tairvāksthalaṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇā nṛpasaṃhitam || 182.20 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi nocurvai kiṃciduttaram | aṣṭādaśasahasreṣu bhṛgukopabhayānnṛpa | uktaṃ ca tālakaṃ haste yasya tasyedamuttaram || 182.21 || etacchrutvā tu sā devī nigamaṃ naigamaiḥ kṛtam | krodhena mahatāviṣṭā śaśāpa dvijapuṃgavān || 182.22 || śrīdevyuvāca yasmātsatyaṃ samutsṛjya lobhopahatamānasaiḥ | madīyaṃ lopitaṃ sthānaṃ tasmācchṛṇvantu me giram || 182.23 || tripauruṣā bhavedvidyā tripuruṣaṃ na bhaveddhanam | na dvitīyastu vo vedaḥ paṭhito bhavati dvijāḥ || 182.24 || gṛhāṇi na dvibhaumāni na ca bhūtiḥ sthirā dvijāḥ | pakṣapātena vo dharmo na ca niḥśreyabhāvataḥ || 182.25 || iṣṭo gotrajanaḥ kaścillobhenāvṛtamānasaḥ | na ca dvaidhaṃ parityajya hyekaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 182.26 || adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāmahaṅkāro dvijanmanām | na pitā putravākyena na putraḥ pitṛkarmaṇi || 182.27 || ahaṅkārakṛtāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | iti śaptvā ramādevī tadaiva ca divaṃ yayau || 182.28 || tato gatāyāṃ vai lakṣmyāṃ devā brahmarṣayo'malāḥ | krodhalobhamidaṃ sthānaṃ te'pi coktvā divaṃ yayuḥ || 182.29 || gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tato devīmṛṣīṃścaiva tapodhanān | bhṛguśca parameṣṭhī sa viṣādamagamatparam | prasādayāmāsa punaḥ śaṅkaraṃ tripurāntakam || 182.30 || tapasā mahatā pārtha tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ kāle harṣayan bhṛgusattamam || 182.31 || kiṃ viṣaṇṇo'si viprendra kiṃ vā santāpakāraṇam | mayi prasanne'pi tava hyetatkathaya me'nagha || 182.32 || bhṛguruvāca śāpayitvā dvijānsarvānpurā lakṣmīrvinirgatā | apavitramidaṃ coktvā tato devā vinirgatāḥ || 182.33 || īśvara uvāca purā mayā yathā proktaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā | krodhasthānamasaṃdehaṃ tathānyadapi tacchṛṇu || 182.34 || tatra sthānasamudbhūtā mahadbhayavivarjitāḥ | brāhmaṇā matprasādena bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 182.35 || vedavidyāvratasnātāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ | ye'pi te śatasāhasrāstvaritā hyāgatāstviha || 182.36 || apaṭhasyāpi mūrkhasya sarvāvasthāṃ gatasya ca | uttarāduttaraṃ śakro dātuṃ na tu bhṛgūttama || 182.37 || koṭitīrthamidaṃ sthānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | adyaprabhṛti viprendra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 182.38 || matprasādāddevagaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | bhṛgukṣetre mṛtā ye tu kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ || 182.39 || vāsasteṣāṃ śive loke matprasādādbhaviṣyati | vṛṣakhāte naraḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram || 182.40 || sarvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam | bhṛgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 182.41 || tasya te dvādaśābdāni śāntiṃ gacchanti tarpitāḥ | dadhikṣīreṇa toyena ghṛtena madhunā saha || 182.42 || ye snapanti virūpākṣaṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape | matprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha sarvadevānusevitam || 182.43 || bhaviṣyati bhṛgukṣetraṃ kurukṣetrādibhiḥ samam | mārtaṇḍagrahaṇe prāpte yavaṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam || 182.44 || dattvā śirasi yaḥ snāti bhṛgukṣetre dvijottama | avicāreṇa taṃ viddhi saṃsnātaṃ kurujāṅgale || 182.45 || ahaṃ caiva vasiṣyāmi ambikā ca mama priyā | sarvaduḥkhāpahā devī nāmnā saubhāgyasundarī || 182.46 || vasiṣyāmi tayā devyā sahito bhṛgukacchake | evamuktvā sthito devo bhṛgukacche'mbikā tathā || 182.47 || bhṛgustu svapuraṃ prāyādbrahmaghoṣanināditam | ṛgyajuḥsāmaghoṣeṇa hyatharvaṇanināditam || 182.48 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vṛṣamutsṛjate naraḥ | sa yāti śivasāyujyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 182.49 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā caitre māsi samācaret | dadyācca lavaṇaṃ vipre pūjya saubhāgyasundarīm || 182.50 || gobhūhiraṇyaṃ viprebhyaḥ prīyetāṃ lalitāśivau | na duḥkhaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca viyogaṃ patinā saha || 182.51 || prāpnoti nārī rājendra bhṛgutīrthāplavena ca | yastu nityaṃ bhṛguṃ devaṃ paśyedvai pāṇḍunandana || 182.52 || ā brahmasadanaṃ yāvattatrasthairdaivataiḥ saha | yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama || 182.53 || suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ kapilāṃ payasvinīṃ sādhvīṃ suśīlāṃ taruṇīṃ savatsām | dattvā dvije sarvavratopapanne phalaṃ ca yatsyāttadihaiva nūnam || 182.54 || samāḥ sahasrāṇi tu sapta vai jale mriyellabheddvādaśavahnimadhye | tyajaṃstanuṃ śūravṛttyā narendra śakrātithyaṃ yāti vai martyadharmā || 182.55 || ākhyānametacca sadā yaśasyaṃ svargyaṃ dhanyaṃ putryamāyuṣyakāri | śṛṇvaṃllabhetsarvametaddhi bhaktyā parvaṇi parvaṇyājamīḍhassadaiva || 182.56 || saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu bhṛgutīrthe vidhānataḥ | sa mṛtaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ gacchedvai yacca durlabham || 182.57 || etacchrutvā bhṛguśreṣṭho devadevena bhāṣitam | prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā tatraiva saṃsthito dvijaḥ || 182.58 || tirobhāvaṃ gate deve bhṛguḥ śreṣṭho dvijottamaḥ | svamūrti tatra muktvā tu brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || 182.59 || bhṛgukacchasya cotpattiḥ kathitā tava pāṇḍava | saṃkṣepeṇa mahārāja sarvapāmapraṇāśanī || 182.60 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ kṣetraṃ devena kīrtitam | caturyugasahasreṇa pitāmahadinaṃ smṛtam || 182.61 || prāpte brahmadine viprā jāyate yugasambhavaḥ | na paśyāmi tvidaṃ kṣetramiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau || 182.62 || yaḥ śṛṇoti tvidaṃ bhaktyā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā | sa yāti paramaṃ lokamiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau || 182.63 || devakhāte naraḥ snātvā piṇḍadānādisatkriyām | yāṃ karoti nṛpaśreṣṭha tāmakṣayaphalāṃ viduḥ || 182.64 || ya imaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā bhṛgukacchasya vistaram | koṭitīrthaphalaṃ tasya bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ || 182.65 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛgukacchatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.183>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja gacchetkedārasaṃjñakam | yatra gatvā mahārāja śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pibejjalam | sampūjya devadeveśaṃ kedārotthaṃ phalaṃ labhet || 183.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathamatra suraśreṣṭha kedārākhyaḥ sthitaḥ svayam | uttare narmadākūle etadvistarato vada || 183.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā kṛtayugasyādau śaṅkarastu maheśvaraḥ | bhṛguṇārādhitaḥ śaptaḥ śriyā ca bhṛgukacchake || 183.3 || apavitramidaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam | bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha gatetyuktvā haripriyā || 183.4 || tapaścacāra vipulaṃ bhṛgurvarṣasahasrakam | vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraściraṃ dhamanisaṃtataḥ || 183.5 || tataḥ pratyakṣatāmāgālliṅgībhūto maheśvaraḥ | prādurbhūtastu sahasā bhittvā pātālasaptakam || 183.6 || dadarśātha bhṛgurdevamautpalīṃ kelikāmiva | stutiṃ cakre sa devāya sthāṇave tryambaketi ca || 183.7 || evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān provāca prahasanniva | punaḥ punarbhṛguṃ mattaḥ kiṃtu prārthayase mune || 183.8 || bhṛguruvāca pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ padmayā śāpitaṃ vibho | upavitramidaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam | bhaviṣyatīti ca procya gatā devī vidaṃ prati || 183.9 || punaḥ pavitratāṃ yāti yathedaṃ kṣetramuttamam | tathā kuru maheśāna prasanno yadi śaṅkara || 183.10 || īśvara uvāca kedārākhyamidaṃ brahmaṃlliṅgamādyaṃ bhaviṣyati | kṛtvedamādiliṅgāni bhaviṣyanti daśaiva hi || 183.11 || ekādaśamadṛśyaṃ hi kṣetramadhye bhaviṣyati | pāvayiṣyati tatkṣetramekādaśaḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ || 183.12 || tathā vai dvādaśādityā matprasādāttu mūrtitaḥ | vasiṣyanti bhṛgukṣetre rogaduḥkhanibarhaṇāḥ || 183.13 || durgāḥ hyaṣṭādaśa tathā kṣetrapālāstu ṣoḍaśa | bhṛgukṣetre bhaviṣyanti vīrabhadrāśca mātaraḥ || 183.14 || pavitrīkṛtametaddhi nityaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati | nāghamāse hyuṣaḥkāle snātvā māsaṃ jitendriyaḥ || 183.15 || yaḥ pūjayati kedāraṃ sa gacchecchivamandiram | tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata | śrāddhaṃ dadāti vidhivattasya prītāḥ pitāmahāḥ || 183.16 || iti te kathitaṃ samyakkedārākhyaṃ savistaram | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam || 183.17 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kedāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.184>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchedbhṛgutīrthasamīpataḥ | vṛṣeṇa tu bhṛgustatra bhūyobhūyo dhutastataḥ || 184.1 || dhautapāpaṃ tu tattena nāmnā lokeṣu viśrutam | tatra sthito mahādevastuṣṭyarthaṃ bhṛgusattame || 184.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śāṭhyenāpi nareśvara | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 184.3 || yastu samyagvidhānena tatra snātvārcayecchivam | devānpitḥnsamabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 184.4 || brahmahatyā gavāṃ vadhyā tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | praviśenna sadā bhītā praviṣṭāpi kṣayaṃ vrajet || 184.5 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryabhūtaṃ loke'sminkathayasva dvijottama | praviśenna brahmahatyā yathā vai dhautapāpmani || 184.6 || brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā neha kiṃcana | kathaṃ vā dhautapāpe tu praviṣṭaṃ naśyate dvija | etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ pṛcchāmi vada kautukāt || 184.7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ādisarge purā śambhurbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | vikāraṃ pañcamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiro'śvamukhasannibham || 184.8 || aṅguṣṭhāṅguliyogena tacchirastena kṛntitam | kṛttamātre tu śirasi brahmahatyābhaktadā || 184.9 || brahmahatyāyutaścāsīduttare narmadātaṭe | dhunitaṃ tu yato rājanvṛṣeṇa dharmamūrtinā || 184.10 || tatra dhauteśvarīṃ devīṃ sthāpitāṃ vṛṣabheṇa tu | dadarśa bhagavāñchambhuḥ sarvadaivatapūjitām || 184.11 || dṛṣṭvā dhauteśvarīṃ durgāṃ brahmahatyāvināśinīm | tatra viśramamāṇaśca śaṅkarastripurāntakaḥ || 184.12 || sa śaṅkaro brahmahatyāvihīnaṃ mene ātmānaṃ tasya tīrthasya bhāvāt | suvismito devadevo vareṇyo dṛṣṭvā dūre brahmahatyāṃ ca tīrthāt || 184.13 || vidhautapāpaṃ mahitaṃ dharmaśaktyā viśenna hatyā devībhayātprabhītā | raktāmbarā raktamālyopayuktā kṛṣṇā nārī raktadāmaprasaktā || 184.14 || māṃ vāñchantī skandhadeśaṃ rahasye dūre sthitā tīrthavaryaprabhāvāt | saṃcintya devo manasā smarārirvāsāya buddhiṃ tatra tīrthe cakāra || 184.15 || vimṛśya devo bahuśaḥ sthitaḥ svayaṃ vidhautapāpaḥ prathitaḥ pṛthivyām | babhūva tatraiva nivāsakārī vidhūtapāpanikaṭapradeśe || 184.16 || tadāprabhṛti rājendra brahmahatyāvināśanam | vidhautapāpaṃ tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 184.17 || āśvayukśuklanavamī tatra tīrthe viśiṣyate | dinatrayaṃ tu rājendra saptamyādiviśeṣataḥ || 184.18 || samupoṣyāṣṭamīṃ bhaktyā sāṅgaṃ vedaṃ paṭhettu yaḥ | ahorātreṇa caikena ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñakam || 184.19 || abhyasanbrahmahatyāyā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva yaśca gurvaṅganāgamaḥ || 184.20 || snātvā brahmarasotkṛṣṭe kumbhenaiva pramucyate | vandhyā strījananī yā tu kākavandhyā mṛtaprajā || 184.21 || sāpi kumbhodakaiḥ snātā jīvatputrā prajāvatī | apaṭhastu nara upoṣya ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhavām || 184.22 || ṛcamekāṃ japanviprastathā parvaṇi yo nṛpa | anṛcopoṣya gāyatrīṃ japedvai vedamātaram || 184.23 || japannavamyāṃ viprendro mucyate pāpasañcayāt | evaṃ tu kathitaṃ tāta purāṇoktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 184.24 || dhautapāpaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ mama | prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryājjale vāgnau sthale'pi vā || 184.25 || sa gacchati vimānena jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ | haṃsabarhiprayuktena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 184.26 || śivasya paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham | krīḍate svecchayā tatra yāvaccandrārkatārakam || 184.27 || dhautapāpe tu yā nārī kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam | tatkṣaṇādeva sā pārtha puruṣatvamavāpnuyāt || 184.28 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ dhautapāpe kṛtaṃ nṛpa || 184.29 || saṃnyasenniyamenānnaṃ saṃnyasedviṣayādikam | phalamūlādikaṃ caiva jalamekaṃ na saṃtyajet || 184.30 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha rudralokaṃ sa gacchati | tatra bhuktākhilānbhogāñjāyate bhuvi bhūpatiḥ || 184.31 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.185>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam | snānamātreṇa tatraiva brahmahatyā praṇaśyati || 185.1 || māsi cāśvayuje tatra śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm | upoṣya prayataḥ snātastarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 185.2 || putrarddhirūpasampanno jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam | śivalokaṃ mṛto yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 185.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.186>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ kanakhalottamam | garuḍena tapastaptaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram || 186.1 || divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvajjātamātreṇa bhārata | tapojapaiḥ kṛśībhūto dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā || 186.2 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo vainateyaṃ manojavam | uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ vinatānandavardhanam || 186.3 || prasannaste mahābhāga varaṃ varaya suvrata | durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu dadāmi tava khecara || 186.4 || garuḍa uvāca icchāmi vāhanaṃ viṣṇordvijendratvaṃ sureśvara | prasanne tvayi me sarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama || 186.5 || śrīmaheśa uvāca durlabhaḥ prāṇināṃ tāta yo varaḥ prārthito'nagha | devadevasya vāhanaṃ dvijendratvaṃ sudurlabham || 186.6 || nārāyaṇodare sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | tvayā sa kathamūhyeta devadevo jagadguruḥ || 186.7 || tenaiva sthāpitaścendrastrailokye sacarācare | kathamanyasya cendratvaṃ bhavatīti sudurlabham || 186.8 || tathāpi mama vākyena vāhanaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇervahato'pi jagattrayam || 186.9 || indrastvaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ madhye bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā antardhānaṃ gato haraḥ || 186.10 || tato gate mahādeve hyuruṇasyānujo nṛpa | ārādhayāmāsa tadā cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamaṇḍitām || 186.11 || śmaśānavāsinīṃ devīṃ bahubhūtasamanvitām | yoginīṃ yogasaṃsiddhāṃ vasāmāṃsāsavapriyām || 186.12 || dhyātamātrā tu tenaiva pratyakṣā hyabhavattadā | jālaṃdhare ca yā siddhiḥ kaulīne uḍḍiśe pare || 186.13 || samagrā sā bhṛgukṣetre siddhakṣetre tu saṃsthitā | cāmuṇḍā tatra sā devī siddhakṣetre vyavasthitā || 186.14 || saṃstutā ṛṣibhirdevairyogakṣemārthasiddhaye | vinatānandajananastatra tāṃ yoginīṃ nṛpa | bhaktyā prasādayāmāsa stotrairvaidikalaukikaiḥ || 186.15 || garuḍa uvāca oṃ yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā navarudhiramukhā pretapadmāsanasthā bhūtānāṃ vṛndavṛndaiḥ pitṛvananilayā krīḍate śūlahastā | śastradhvastapravīravrajarudhiragalanmuṇḍamālottarīyā devī śrīvīramātā vimalaśaśinibhā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā || 186.16 || yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā vikṛtabhayakarī trāsinī duṣkṛtānāṃ muñcajjvālākalāpairdaśanakasamasaiḥ khādati pretamāṃsam | yā sā dordaṇḍacaṇḍairḍamaruraṇaraṇāṭopaṭaṃkāraghaṇṭaiḥ kalpāntotpātavātāhatapaṭupaṭahairvalgate bhūtamātā | kṣutkṣāmā śuṣkakukṣiḥ khavarataranaravaraiḥ kṣodati pretamāṃsaṃ muñcantī cāṭṭahāsaṃ ghuraghuritaravā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā || 186.17 || yā sā nimnodarābhā vikṛtabhavabhayatrāsinī śūlahastā cāmuṇḍā muṇḍaghātā raṇaraṇitaraṇajhallarīnādaramyā | trailokyaṃ trāsayanti kakahakahakahairghorarāvairanekairnṛtyantī mātṛmadhye pitṛvananilayā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā || 186.18 || yā dhatte viśvamakhilaṃ nijāṃśena mahojjvalā | kanakaprasave līnā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.19 || himādrisambhavā devī dayādarśitavigrahā | śivapriyā śive saktā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.20 || anādijagadādiryā ratnagarbhā vasupriyā | rathāṅgapāṇinā padmā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.21 || sāvitrī yā ca gāyatrī mṛḍānī vāgathendirā | smartḥṇāṃ yā sukhaṃ datte pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.22 || saumyāsaumyaiḥ sadā rūpaiḥ sṛjatyavati yā jagat | parā śaktiḥ parā buddhiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.23 || brahmaṇaḥ sargasamaye sṛjyaśaktiḥ parā tu yā | jaganmāyā jagaddhātrī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.24 || viśvasya pālane viṣṇoryā śaktiḥ paripālikā | madanonmādinī mukhyā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.25 || viśvasaṃlayane mukhyā yā rudreṇa samāśritā | raudrī śaktiḥ śivānantā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.26 || kailāsasānusaṃrūḍha kanakaprasaveśayā | bhasmakābhihṛtā pūrvaṃ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.27 || patiprabhāvamicchantī trasyantī yā vinā patim | abalā tvekabhāvā ca pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.28 || viśvasaṃrakṣaṇe saktā rakṣitā kanakena yā | ā brahmastambajananī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.29 || brahmaviṣṇvīśvarāḥ śaktyā śarīragrahaṇaṃ yayā | prāpitāḥ prathamā śaktiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī || 186.30 || śrutvā tu garuḍenoktaṃ devīvṛttacatuṣṭayam | prasannā saṃmukhī bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 186.31 || śrīcāmuṇḍovāca prasannā te mahāsattva varaṃ varaya vāñchitam | dadāmi te dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi rocate || 186.32 || garuḍa uvāca ajaraścāmaraścaiva adhṛṣyaśca surāsuraiḥ | tava prasādāccaivānyairajeyaśca bhavāmyaham || 186.33 || tvayā cātra sadā devi sthātavyaṃ tīrthasannidhau | mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā devī devairabhiṣṭutā || 186.34 || jagāmākāśamāviśya bhūtasaṅghasamanvitā | yadā lakṣmyā nṛpaśreṣṭha sthāpitaṃ puramuttamam || 186.35 || anumānya tadā devīṃ kṛtaṃ tasyāṃ samarpitam | lakṣmīruvāca rakṣaṇāya mayā devi yogakṣemārthasiddhaye || 186.36 || mātṛvatpratipālyaṃ te sadā devi puraṃ mama | garuḍo'pi tataḥ snātvā sampūjya kanakeśvarīm || 186.37 || tīrthaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpya jagāmākāśamuttamam | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 186.38 || sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute | gandhapuṣpādibhiryastu pūjayetkanakeśvaram || 186.39 || tasya yogaiśvaryasiddhiryogapīṭheṣu jāyate | mṛto yogeśvaraṃ lokaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ | sa gacchennātra sandeho yoginīgaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 186.40 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kanakhaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.187>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca jāleśvaraṃ tato gacchelliṅgamādyaṃ svayambhuvaḥ | kālāgnirudraṃ vikhyātaṃ bhṛgukacche vyavasthitam || 187.1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam | kṣetrapāpavināśāya kṛpayā ca samutthitam || 187.2 || purā kalpe'suragaṇairākrānte bhuvanatraye | vedoktakarmanāśe ca dharme ca vilayaṃ gate || 187.3 || devarṣimunisiddheṣu viśvāsaparameṣu ca | kālāgnirudrādutpanno dhūmaḥ kālodbhavodbhavaḥ || 187.4 || dhūmātsamutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhittvā pātālasaptakam | avaṭaṃ dakṣiṇe kṛtvā liṅgaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhati || 187.5 || tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha kuṇḍaṃ jvālāsamudbhavam | yatra sā patitā jvālā śivasya dahataḥ puram || 187.6 || tatrāvaṭaṃ samudbhūtaṃ dhūmāvartastato'bhavat | tasminkuṇḍe tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā vai narmadājale || 187.7 || kuryācchrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyo vai pūjayecca trilocanam | kālāgnirudranāmāni sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || 187.8 || yatkiṃcitkāmikaṃ karma hyābhicārikameva vā | ripusaṃkṣayakṛdvāpi sāṃtānikamathāpi vā | atra tīrthe kṛtaṃ sarvamacirātsidhyate nṛpa || 187.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kālāgnirudratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.188>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ paraṃ mahārāja catvāriṃśatkramāntare | śālagrāmaṃ tato gacchetsarvadaivatapūjitam || 188.1 || yatrādidevo bhagavānvāsudevastrivikramaḥ | svayaṃ tiṣṭhati lokātmā sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā || 188.2 || nāradena tapastaptvā kṛtā śālā dvijanmanām | siddhikṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ jñātvā revātaṭe svayam || 188.3 || śālagrāmābhidho devo viprāṇāṃ tvadhivāsitaḥ | sādhūnāṃ copakārāya vāsudevaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 188.4 || yogināmupakārāya yogidhyeyo janārdanaḥ | śālagrāmeti tenaiva narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ || 188.5 || māsi mārgaśire śuklā bhavatyekādaśī yadā | snātvā revājale puṇye taddinaṃ samupoṣayet || 188.6 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsampūjya ca janārdanam | punaḥ prabhātasamaye dvādaśyāṃ narmadājale || 188.7 || snātvā saṃtarpya devāṃśca pitḥnmātḥstathaiva ca | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścātpitṛbhyo vidhipūrvakam || 188.8 || śaktito brāhmaṇānpūjya svarṇavastrānnadānataḥ | kṣamāpayitvā tānviprāṃstathā devaṃ khagadhvajam || 188.9 || evaṃ kṛte mahārāja yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavennḥṇām | śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā tatpuṇyaṃ nṛpasattama || 188.10 || na śokaduḥkhe pratipatsyatīha jīvanmṛto yāti murārisāmyam | mahānti pāpāni visṛjya dugdhaṃ punarna mātuḥ pibate stanodyat || 188.11 || śālagrāmaṃ paśyate yo hi nityaṃ snātvā jale nārmade'ghaughahāre | sa mucyate brahmahatyādipāpairnārāyaṇānusmaraṇena tena || 188.12 || vasanti ye saṃnyasitvā ca tatra nigṛhya duḥkhāni vimuktasaṅghāḥ | dhyāyanto vai sāṃkhyavṛttyā turīyaṃ padaṃ murāreste'pi tatraiva yānti || 188.13 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śālagrāmatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.189>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | udīrṇo yatra vārāho hyabhavaddharaṇīdharaḥ || 189.1 || dhanvadaṃṣṭrāṃ karālāgrāṃ bibhracca pṛthivīmimām | sa eva pañcamaḥ prokto vārāho muktidāyakaḥ || 189.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathamudīrṇarūpo'bhūdvārāho dharaṇīdharaḥ | vārāhatvaṃ gataḥ kena pañcamaḥ kena saṃjñitaḥ || 189.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ādikalpe purā rājankṣīrode bhagavān hariḥ | śete sa bhogiśayane yoganidrāvimohitaḥ || 189.4 || babhūva nṛpatiśreṣṭha gatvā vai devasaṃnidhau | avocadbhārakhinnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi rasātalam || 189.5 || dṛṣṭvā devāḥ samudvignā gatā yatra janārdanaḥ | tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ keśavaṃ jagatpatim || 189.6 || devā ūcuḥ | namo namaste deveśa surārtihara sarvaga | viśvamūrte namastubhyaṃ trāhi sarvānmahadbhayāt || 189.7 || ityukto daivatairdevo hyuvāca kimupasthitam | kāryaṃ vadadhvaṃ me devā yatkṛtyaṃ mā ciraṃ kṛthāḥ || 189.8 || devā ūcuḥ | dharā dharitrī bhūtānāṃ bhārodvignā nimajjati | tāmuddhara hṛṣīkeśa lokānsaṃsthāpaya sthitau || 189.9 || evamuktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ keśavaḥ parameśvaraḥ | vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya sarvayajñamayaṃ vibhuḥ || 189.10 || daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ samākuñcitamūrdhajam | kṛtvā'nantaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanbhuvam || 189.11 || saparvatavanāmurvīṃ samudraparimekhalām | uddhṛtya bhagavān viṣṇurudīrṇaḥ samajāyata || 189.12 || darśayanpañcadhātmānamuttare narmadātaṭe | tathādyaṃ koralāyāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ yodhanīpure || 189.13 || jayakṣetrābhidhāne tu jayeti parikīrtitam | asurānmohayalliṅgastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 189.14 || pāvanāya jagaddhetoḥ sthito yasmācchaśiprabhaḥ | atastu nṛpaśārdūla śveta ityābhidhīyate || 189.15 || uddhṛtya jagatāṃ devīmudīrṇo bhṛgukacchake | tataḥ pañcama udīrṇo varāha iti saṃjñitaḥ || 189.16 || iti pañcavarāhāste kathitaḥ pāṇḍunandana | yugapaddarśanaṃ caiṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 189.17 || jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | gatvā hyādivarāhaṃ tu samprāpte daśamīdine || 189.18 || haviṣyamannaṃ bhuñjīyāllaghusāyaṃ gate ravau | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvārāhe hyādisaṃjñake || 189.19 || tataḥ prabhāte hyuṣasi saṃsnātvā narmadājale | saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca tilairyavavimiśritaiḥ || 189.20 || dhenuṃ dadyāddvije yogye sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | nirmamo nirahaṅkāro dānaṃ dadyāddvijātaye || 189.21 || gatvā sampūjayeddevaṃ vārāhaṃ hyādisaṃjñitam | anena vidhinā pūjya paścādgacchejjayaṃ tvaran || 189.22 || tvaritaṃ tu jayaṃ gatvā pūrvakaṃ vidhimācaret | aśvaṃ dadyāddvijāgryāya jayapūrvābhinirgatam || 189.23 || liṅge caiva tilā deyāḥ śvete hiraṇyameva ca | udīrṇe ca bhuvaṃ dadyātpūrvakaṃ vidhimācaret || 189.24 || anastamita āditye varāhānpañca paśyataḥ | yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu || 189.25 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ | ebhistu saha saṃyogo viśvastānāṃ ca vañcanam || 189.26 || svasṛduhitṛbhaginīkuladāropabṛṃhaṇam | ā janmamaraṇādyāvatpāpaṃ bharatasattama || 189.27 || tīrthapañcakapūtasya vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ | yugapaccavinaśyeta tūlarāśirivānalāt || 189.28 || nārāyaṇānusmaraṇājjapadhyānādviśeṣataḥ | vipraṇaśyanti pāpāni girikūṭasamānyapi || 189.29 || dṛṣṭvā pañca varāhānvai pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ | āplavannarmadātoye śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 189.30 || udayāstamanādarvāgyaḥ paśyelloṭaṇeśvaram | kalevaravimuktaḥ sa ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt || 189.31 || muktiṃ prayāti sahasā duṣprāpāṃ parameśvarīm | pauruṣe kriyamāṇe'pi na siddhirjāyate yadi || 189.32 || bruvanti svargagamanamapi pāpānvitasya ca | yatra tatra gatasyaiva bhavetpañcavarāhakī || 189.33 || jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau dhruvaṃ tatra vasennaraḥ | ādiṃ jayaṃ tathā śvetaṃ liṅgamudīrṇameva ca || 189.34 || āśritya tasyā draṣṭavyā varāhāstu yatastataḥ | jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau viṣṇunā prabhuviṣṇunā || 189.35 || vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā dharaṇī vibho | puṇyātpuṇyatamā tena hyaśeṣāghaughanāśinī || 189.36 || dṛṣṭvā pañcavarāhānvai kroḍamudīrṇarūpiṇam | pūjayitvā vidhānena paścājjāgaraṇaṃ caret || 189.37 || sapañcavartikān dīpān ghṛtenojjvālya bhaktitaḥ | purāṇaśravaṇairnṛtyairgītavādyaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ || 189.38 || vedajāpyaiḥ pavitraiśca kṣapayitvā ca śarvarīm | yatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo hyājamīḍha śṛṇuṣva tat || 189.39 || revājalaṃ puṇyatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tathā ca devo jagatāṃ patirhariḥ | ekādaśī pāpaharā narendra bahvāyāsairlabhyate mānavānām || 189.40 || ekaikaśo brahmahatyādikāni śaktāni hantuṃ pāpasaṅghāni rājan | naite sarve yugapadvai sametā hantuṃ śaktāḥ kiṃ na tadbrūhi rājan || 189.41 || yathedamuktaṃ tava dharmasūno śrutaṃ ca yacchaṅkarāccandramauleḥ | śrutvedamicchanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ paṭhanpadaṃ yāti hi vṛtraśatroḥ || 189.42 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye udīrṇavarāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.190>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla somatīrthamanuttamam | candrahāseti vikhyātaṃ sarvadaivatapūjitam || 190.1 || yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somo rājā surottamaḥ || 190.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ siddhimanuprāptaḥ somo rājā jagatpatiḥ | tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha || 190.3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata | asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi || 190.4 || udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam | yā niṣṭhā jāyate teṣāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama || 190.5 || ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ | sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca hītyevaṃ śrutinodanā || 190.6 || tatkālocitadharmeṇa ye na sevanti tāṃ narāḥ | teṣāṃ brahmaghnajaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 190.7 || tena pāpena ghoreṇa veṣṭato raurave patet | tasya tadrudhiraṃ pāpāḥ pibante kālamīpsitam || 190.8 || tato'vatīrṇakālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati | tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā || 190.9 || nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo hyadhikaḥ parivartate | viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyate kāmasāyakaiḥ || 190.10 || paribhūtā hi sā bhartrā dhyāyate'nyaṃ patiṃ tataḥ | tasyāḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam || 190.11 || svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ jātā mahīpate | patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate || 190.12 || tena karmavipākena kṣayarogī śaśī hyabhūt | tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ || 190.13 || tatra tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | bhramitvā narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm || 190.14 || upavāsastu dānāni vratāni niyamāśca ye | cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ || 190.15 || sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ somalokamanuttamam || 190.16 || yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā | tāvadyugasahasrāṇi tasya lokaṃ samaśnute || 190.17 || tena devān vidhānoktān sthāpayanti narā bhuvi | akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātphalaṃ bhavati nānyathā || 190.18 || somatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram | jāyate sa naro bhūtvā somavitpriyadarśanaḥ || 190.19 || candraprabhāse yo gatvā snānaṃ vidhivadācaret | vyādhinā nābhibhūtaḥ syātkṣayarogeṇa vā yutaḥ || 190.20 || candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ tu nareśvara | caturdaśyāmupoṣyaiva kṣīrasya juhuyāccarum || 190.21 || mantraiḥ pañcabhirīśānaṃ puruṣastryambakaṃ yajet | haviḥśeṣaṃ svayaṃ prāśya candrahāsyeśamīkṣayet || 190.22 || anena vidhinā rājaṃstuṣṭo devo maheśvaraḥ | vidhinā tīrthayogena kṣayarogādvimucyate || 190.23 || saptabhiḥ somavārairyaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret | sa vai karṇakṛtādrogānmucyate pūjayañchivam || 190.24 || akṣirogastathā rājaṃścandrahāsye vinaśyati | candrahāsye tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 190.25 || tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāsye śubhaśubham | kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 190.26 || te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam | candrahāsye tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ || 190.27 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam | snānamātrāttu rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati || 190.28 || bahavastanna jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ | dehastha iva sarveṣāṃ paramātmeva saṃsthitam || 190.29 || paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam | tatsamagramavāpnoti candrahāsye na saṃśayaḥ || 190.30 || saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte viṣuve cāyane tathā | candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 190.31 || te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam | candrahāsyaṃ na jānanti narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam || 190.32 || candrahāsye tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute nṛpa | anivartikā gatistasya somalokātkadācana || 190.33 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe candrahāsyatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.191>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchettasyaiva tu samīpataḥ | amṛtasrāvi talliṅgamādyaṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tathā || 191.1 || dṛṣṭamātreṇa yeneha hyanṛṇo jāyate naraḥ | purā varṣaśataṃ sāgramārādhya parameśvaram || 191.2 || prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ siddhimādityā dvādaśaiva tu | ataḥ siddheśvaraḥ proktaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhikāṅkṣiṇām || 191.3 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ siddheśvare prāptāḥ siddhiṃ devā dvijottama | ādityā iti yaccoktaṃ tanme vismāpanaṃ kṛtam || 191.4 || tapasyugre vyavasitā ādityāḥ kena hetunā | samprāptāstu dvijaśreṣṭha siddhiṃ caivābhilāṣikīm || 191.5 || saṃkṣipya tu mayā pṛṣṭaṃ vistarāddvija śaṃsa me || 191.6 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca aditerdvādaśādityā jātāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | indro dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro'tha varuṇo'ryamā || 191.7 || vivasvānsavitā pūṣā hyaṃśumānviṣṇureva ca | ta ime dvādaśādityā icchanto bhāskaraṃ padam || 191.8 || narmadātaṭamāśritya tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ | siddheśvare mahārāja kāśyapeyairmahātmabhiḥ || 191.9 || parā siddhiranuprāptā dvādaśādityasaṃjñitaiḥ | sthāpitaśca jagaddhātā tasmiṃstīrthe divākaraḥ || 191.10 || svakīyāṃśavibhāgena dvādaśādityasaṃjñitaiḥ | tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rājankhyātiṃ gataṃ bhuvi || 191.11 || pralaye samanuprāpte hyādityā dvādaśaiva te | dvādaśādityato rājan sambhavanti yugakṣaye || 191.12 || indrastapati pūrveṇa dhātā caivāgnigocare | gabhastipatirvai yāmye tvaṣṭā nairṛtadiṅmukhaḥ || 191.13 || varuṇaḥ paścime bhāge mitrastu vāyave tathā | viṣṇuśca saumyadigbhāge vivasvānīśagocare || 191.14 || ūrdhvataścaiva savitā hyadhaḥ pūṣā viśoṣayan | aṃśumāṃstu tathā viṣṇurmukhato nirgataṃ jagat || 191.15 || pradahanvai naraśreṣṭha babhramuśca itastataḥ | yathaiva te mahārāja dahanti sakalaṃ jagat || 191.16 || tathaiva dvādaśādityā bhaktānāṃ bhāvasādhanāḥ | prātarutthāya yaḥ snātvā dvādaśādityasaṃjñitam || 191.17 || paśyate devadeveśaṃ śṛṇu tasyaiva yatphalam | vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam || 191.18 || naśyate tatkṣaṇādeva dvādaśādityadarśanāt | pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasya devasya bhārata || 191.19 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ | tatra tīrthe tu saptamyāmupavāsena yatphalam || 191.20 || anyatra saptasaptamyāṃ labhanti na labhanti ca | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāre dainakare dvādaśādityadarśanāt || 191.21 || pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasya pāpaṃ tu naśyati | arogī saptajanmāni bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ || 191.22 || yastu pradakṣiṇaśataṃ dadyādbhaktyā dine dine | dadrūpiṭakakuṣṭhāni maṇḍalāni vicarcikāḥ || 191.23 || naśyanti vyādhayaḥ sarve garuḍeneva pannagāḥ | putraprāptirbhavettasya ṣaṣṭyā vāsarasevanāt || 191.24 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dvādaśādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.192>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta devatīrthamanuttamam | dṛṣṭvā tu śrīpatiṃ pāpairmucyate mānavo bhuvi || 192.1 || maharṣestasya jāmātā bhṛgordevo janārdanaḥ || 192.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ko'yaṃ śriyaḥ patirdevo devānāmadhipo vibhuḥ | kathaṃ janmābhavattasya deveṣu triṣu vā mune || 192.3 || sambandhī ca kathaṃ jāto bhṛguṇā saha keśavaḥ | etadvistarato brahman vaktumarhasi bhārgava || 192.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca saṃkṣepātkathayiṣyāmi sādhyasya caritaṃ mahat | na hi vistarato vaktuṃ śaktāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 192.5 || nārāyaṇasya nābhyabjājjāto devaścaturmukhaḥ | tasya dakṣo'ṅgajo rājan dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhasambhavaḥ || 192.6 || dharmaḥ stanāntātsaṃjātastasya putro'bhavatkila | nārāyaṇasahāyo'sāvajo'pi bharatarṣabha || 192.7 || marutvatī vasurjñānā lambā bhānumatī satī | saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvāvatī kakup || 192.8 || dharmapatnyo daśaivaitā dākṣāyaṇyo mahāprabhāḥ | tāsāṃ sādhyā mahābhāgā putrānajanayannṛpa || 192.9 || naro nārāyaṇaścaiva hariḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca | viṣṇoraṃśāṃśakā hyete catvāro dharmasūnavaḥ || 192.10 || tathā nārāyaṇanarau gandhamādanaparvate | ātmanyātmānamādhāya tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 192.11 || dhyāyamānāvanaupamyaṃ svaṃ kāraṇamakāraṇam | vāsudevamanirdeśyamapratarkyamanantaram || 192.12 || yogayuktau mahātmānāvāsthitāvurutāpasau | tayostapaḥprabhāveṇa na tatāpa divākaraḥ || 192.13 || vavāha śaṅkito vāyuḥ sukhasparśo hyaśaṅkitaḥ | śiśiro'bhavadatyarthaṃ jvalannapi vibhāvasuḥ || 192.14 || siṃhavyāghrādayaḥ saumyāśceruḥ saha mṛgairgirau | tayorgauriva bhārārtā pṛthivī pṛthivīpate || 192.15 || ceruśca bhūdharāścaiva cukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ | devāśca sveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu niṣprabheṣu hataprabhāḥ | babhūvuravanīpāla paramaṃ kṣobhamāgatāḥ || 192.16 || devarājastathā śakraḥ saṃtaptastapasā tayoḥ | yuyojāpsarasastatra tayorvighnacikīrṣayā || 192.17 || indra uvāca rambhe tilottame kubje ghṛtāci lalite śubhe | pramloce subhru sumloce saurabheyi mahoddhate || 192.18 || alambuṣe miśrakeśi puṇḍarīke varūthini | vilokanīyaṃ bibhrāṇā vapurmanmathabodhanam || 192.19 || gandhamādanamāsādya kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama | naranārāyaṇau tatra tapodīkṣānvitau dvijau || 192.20 || tepāte dharmatanayau tapaḥ paramaduścaram | tāvasmākaṃ varārohāḥ kurvāṇau paramaṃ tapaḥ || 192.21 || karmātiśayaduḥkhārtipradāvāyatināśanau | tadgacchata na bhīḥ kāryā bhavatībhiridaṃ vacaḥ || 192.22 || smaraḥ sahāyo bhavitā vasantaśca varāṅganāḥ | rūpaṃ vayaḥ samālokya madanoddīpanaṃ param | kandarpavaśamabhyeti vivaśaḥ ko na mānavaḥ || 192.23 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityuktvā devarājena madanena samaṃ tadā | jagmurapsarasaḥ sarvā vasantaśca mahīpate || 192.24 || gandhamādanamāsādya puṃskokilakulākulam | cacāra mādhavo ramyaṃ protphullavanapādapam || 192.25 || pravavau dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ malayānugato'nilaḥ | bhṛṅgamālārutaravai ramaṇīyamabhūdvanam || 192.26 || gandhaśca surabhiḥ sadyo vanarājisamudbhavaḥ | kinnaroragayakṣāṇāṃ babhūva ghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ || 192.27 || varāṅganāśca tāḥ sarvā naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī | vilobhayitumārabdhā vāgaṅgalalitasmitaiḥ || 192.28 || jagau manoharaṃ kācinnanarta tatra cāpsarāḥ | avādayattathaivānyā manoharataraṃ nṛpa || 192.29 || hāvairbhāvaiḥ sṛtairhāsyaistathānyā valgubhāṣitaiḥ | tayoḥ kṣobhāya tanvaṅgyaścakrurudyamamaṅganāḥ || 192.30 || tathāpi na tayoḥ kaścinmanasaḥ pṛthivīpate | vikāro'bhavadadhyātmapārasamprāptacetasoḥ || 192.31 || nivātasthau yathā dīpāvakampau nṛpa tiṣṭhataḥ | vāsudevārpaṇasvasthe tathaiva manasī tayoḥ || 192.32 || pūryamāṇo'pi cāmbhobhirbhuvamanyāṃ mahodadhiḥ | yathā na yāti saṃkṣobhaṃ tathā tanmānasaṃ kvacit || 192.33 || sarvabhūtahitaṃ brahma vāsudevamayaṃ param | manyamānau na rāgasya dveṣasya ca vaśaṃgatau || 192.34 || smaro'pi na śaśākātha praveṣṭuṃ hṛdayaṃ tayoḥ | vidyāmayaṃ dīpayutamandhakāra ivālayam || 192.35 || puṣpojjvalāṃstaruvarān vasantaṃ dakṣiṇānilam | tāścaivāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ kandarpaṃ ca mahāmunī || 192.36 || yaccārabdhaṃ tapastābhyāmātmānaṃ gandhamādanam | dadarśāte'khilaṃ rūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puruṣarṣabha || 192.37 || dāhāya nāmalo vahnernāpaḥ kledāya cāmbhasaḥ | taddravyameva taddravyavikārāya na vai yataḥ || 192.38 || tato vijñāya vijñāya paraṃ brahma svarūpataḥ | madhukandarpayoṣitsu vikāro nābhavattayoḥ || 192.39 || tato gurutaraṃ yatnaṃ vasantamadanau nṛpa | cakrāte tāśca tanvaṅgyastatkṣobhāya punaḥpunaḥ || 192.40 || atha nārāyaṇo dhairyaṃ saṃdhāyodīrṇamānasaḥ | ūrorutpādayāmāsa varāṅgīmabalāṃ tadā || 192.41 || trailokyasundarīratnamaśeṣamavanīpate | guṇairlāghavamabhyeti yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādanu || 192.42 || tāṃ vilokya mahīpāla cakampe manasānilaḥ | vasanto vismayaṃ yātaḥ smaraḥ sasmāra kiṃcana || 192.43 || rambhātilottamādyāśca vailakṣyaṃ devayoṣitaḥ | na rejuravanīpāla tallakṣyahṛdayekṣaṇāḥ || 192.44 || tataḥ kāmo vasantaśca pārthivāpsarasaśca tāḥ | praṇamya bhagavantau tau tuṣṭuvurmunisattamau || 192.45 || vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ | prasīdatu jagaddhātā yasya devasya māyayā | mohitāḥ sma vijānīmo nāntaraṃ vidyate dvayoḥ || 192.46 || prasīdatu sa vāṃ devo yasya rūpamidaṃ dvidhā | dhāmabhūtasya lokānāmanāderapratiṣṭhataḥ || 192.47 || naranārāyaṇau devau śaṅkhacakrāyudhāvubhau | āstāṃ prasādasumukhāvasmākamaparādhinām || 192.48 || nidhānaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ sarvapāpavanānalaḥ | nārāyaṇo'to bhagavān sarvapāpaṃ vyapohatu || 192.49 || śārṅgacihnāyudhaḥ śrīmānātmajñānamayo'naghaḥ | naraḥ samastapāpāni hatātmā sarvadehinām || 192.50 || jaṭākalāpabaddho'yamanayornaḥ kṣamāvatoḥ | saumyāsyadṛṣṭiḥ pāpāni hantuṃ janmārjitāni vai || 192.51 || tathātmavidyādoṣeṇa yo'parādhaḥ kṛto mahān | trailokyavandyau yau nāthau vilobhayitumāgatāḥ || 192.52 || prasīda deva vijñānadhana mūḍhadṛśāmiva | bhavanti santaḥ satataṃ svadharmaparipālakāḥ || 192.53 || dṛṣṭvaitannaḥ samutpannaṃ yathā strīratnamuttamam | tvayi nārāyaṇotpannā śreṣṭhā pāravatī matiḥ || 192.54 || tena satyena satyātmanparamātmansanātana | nārāyaṇa prasīdeśa sarvalokaparāyaṇa || 192.55 || prasannabuddhe śāntātmanprasannavadanekṣaṇa | prasīda yogināmīśa nara sarvagatācyuta || 192.56 || namasyāmo naraṃ devaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ harim | namo narāya namyāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca || 192.57 || prasannānāmanāthānāṃ tathā nāthavatāṃ prabho | śaṃ karotu naro'smākaṃ śaṃ nārāyaṇa dehi naḥ || 192.58 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evamabhyarcitaḥ stutyā rāgadveṣādivarjitaḥ | prāheśaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ madhye nārāyaṇo nṛpa || 192.59 || nārāyaṇa uvāca svāgataṃ mādhave kāme bhavatvapsarasāmapi | yatkāryamāgatānāṃ ca ihāsmābhistaducyatām || 192.60 || yūyaṃ saṃsiddhaye nūnamasmākaṃ balaśatruṇā | saṃpreṣitāstato'smākaṃ nṛtyayogādidarśanam || 192.61 || na vayaṃ gītanṛtyena nāṅgaceṣṭādibhāṣitaiḥ | lubdhā vai viṣayairmanye viṣayā dāruṇātmakāḥ || 192.62 || śabdādisaṅgaduṣṭāni yadā nākṣāṇi naḥ śubhāḥ | tadā nṛtyādayo bhāvāḥ kathaṃ lobhapradāyinaḥ || 192.63 || te siddhāḥ sma na vai sādhyā bhavatīnāṃ smarasya ca | mādhavasya ca śākro'pi svāsthyaṃ yātvaviśaṅkitāḥ || 192.64 || yo'sau paraśca paramaḥ puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ | paramātmā samastasya sthāvarasya carasya ca || 192.65 || utpattiheturete ca yasminsarvaṃ pralīyate | sarvāvāsīti devatvādvāsudevetyudāhṛtaḥ || 192.66 || vayamaṃśāṃśakāstasya caturvyūhasya māninaḥ | tadādeśitavārtmānau jagadbodhāya dehinām || 192.67 || tatsarvabhūtaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvatra samadarśinam | kutaḥ paśyantau rāgādīnkariṣyāmo vibhedinaḥ || 192.68 || vasante mayi cendre ca bhavatīṣu tathā smare | yadā sa eva bhūtātmā tadā dveṣādayaḥ katham || 192.69 || tanmayānyavibhaktāni yadā sarveṣu jantuṣu | sarveśvareśvaro viṣṇuḥ kuto rāgādayastataḥ || 192.70 || brahmāṇamindramīśānamādityamaruto'khilān | viśvedevānṛṣīn sādhyānvasūnpitṛgaṇāṃstathā || 192.71 || yakṣarākṣasabhūtādīnnāgānsarpānsarīsṛpān | manuṣyapakṣigorūpagajasiṃhajalecarān || 192.72 || makṣikāmaśakāndaṃśāñchalabhāñjalajān kṛmīn | gulmavṛkṣalatāvallītvaksāratṛṇajātiṣu || 192.73 || yacca kiṃcidadṛśyaṃ vā dṛśyaṃ vā tridaśāṅganāḥ | manyadhvaṃ jātamekasya tatsarvaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 192.74 || jāyamānaḥ kathaṃ viṣṇumātmānaṃ paramaṃ ca yat | rāgadveṣau tathā lobhaṃ kaḥ kuryādamarāṅganāḥ || 192.75 || sarvabhūtamaye viṣṇau sarvage sarvadhātari | nipātya taṃ pṛthagbhūte kuto rāgādiko guṇaḥ || 192.76 || evamasmāsu yuṣmāsu sarvabhūteṣu cābalāḥ | tanmathaikatvabhūteṣu rāgādyavasaraḥ kutaḥ || 192.77 || samyagdṛṣṭiriyaṃ proktā samastaikyāvalokinī | pṛthagvijñānamātraiva lokasaṃvyavahāravat || 192.78 || bhūtendriyāntaḥ karaṇapradhānapuruṣātmakam | jagadvai hyetadakhilaṃ tadā bhedaḥ kimātmakaḥ || 192.79 || bhavanti layamāyānti samudrasalilormayaḥ | na vāribhedato bhinnāstathaivaikyādidaṃ jagat || 192.80 || yathāgnerarciṣaḥ pītāḥ piṅgalāruṇadhūsarāḥ | tathāpi nāgnito bhinnāstathaitadbrahmaṇo jagat || 192.81 || bhavatībhiśca yatkṣobhamasmākaṃ sa puraṃdaraḥ | kārayatyasadetacca vivekācāracetasām || 192.82 || bhavantyaḥ sa ca devendro lokāśca sasurāsurāḥ | samudrādrivanopetā maddehāntaragocarāḥ || 192.83 || yatheyaṃ cārusarvāṅgī bhavatīnāṃ mayāgrataḥ | darśitā darśayiṣyāmi tathā caivākhilaṃ jagat || 192.84 || prayātu śakro mā garvamindratvaṃ kasya susthiram | yūyaṃ ca mā smayaṃ yāta santi rūpānvitāḥ striyaḥ || 192.85 || kiṃ surūpaṃ kurūpaṃ vā yadā bhedo na dṛśyate | tāratamyaṃ surūpatve satataṃ bhinnadarśanāt || 192.86 || bhavatīnāṃ smayaṃ matvā rūpaudāryaguṇodbhavam | mayeyaṃ darśitā tanvī tatastu śamameṣyatha || 192.87 || yasmānmadūrorniṣpannā tviyamindīvarekṣaṇā | urvaśī nāma kalyāṇī bhaviṣyati varāpsarāḥ || 192.88 || tadiyaṃ devarājasya nīyatāṃ varavarṇinī | bhavatyastena cāsmākaṃ preṣitāḥ prītimicchatā || 192.89 || vaktavyaśca sahasrākṣo nāsmākaṃ bhogakāraṇāt | tapaścaryā na vāprāpyaphalaṃ prāptumabhīpsatā || 192.90 || sanmārgamasya jagato darśayiṣye karomyaham | tathā nareṇa sahito jagataḥ pālanodyataḥ || 192.91 || yadi kaścittavābādhāṃ karoti tridaśeśvara | tamahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi nivṛtto bhava vāsava || 192.92 || kartāsi cettvamābādhāṃ na duṣṭasyeha kasyacit | taṃ cāpi śāstā tadahaṃ pravartiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 192.93 || etajjñātvā na santāpastvayā kāryo hi māṃ prati | upakārāya jagatāmavatīrṇo'smi vāsava || 192.94 || yā ceyamurvaśī mattaḥ samudbhūtā puraṃdara tretāgnihetubhūteyaṃ evaṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati || 192.95 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye śrīpatyutpattivarṇanaṃ nāma dvinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.193>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityukte'psarasaḥ sarvāḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ | ūcurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ taddarśanasamīhayā || 193.1 || vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ | bhagavanbhavatā yo'yamupadeśo hitārthinā | proktaḥ sa sarvo vijñāto māhātmyaṃ viditaṃ ca te || 193.2 || yattvetadbhavatā proktaṃ prasannenāntarātmanā | darśiteyaṃ viśālākṣī darśayiṣyāmi vo jagat || 193.3 || tatrārthe sarvabhāvena prapannānāṃ jagatpate | darśayātmānamakhilaṃ darśiteyaṃ yathorvaśī || 193.4 || yadi devāparādhe'pi nāsmāsu kupitaṃ tava | namaste jagatāmīśa darśayātmānamātmanā || 193.5 || nārāyaṇa uvāca paśyatehākhilāṃllokānmama dehe surāṅganāḥ | madhuṃ madanamātmānaṃ yaccānyaddraṣṭumicchatha || 193.6 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityuktvā bhagavāndevastadā nārāyaṇo nṛpa | uccairjahāsa svanavattatrābhūdakhilaṃ jagat || 193.7 || brahmā prajāpatiḥ śakraḥ saha rudraiḥ pinākadhṛk | ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ || 193.8 || nāsatyadasrāvanilaḥ sarvaśaśca tathāgnayaḥ | yakṣagandharvasiddhāśca piśācoragakinnarāḥ || 193.9 || samastāpsaraso vidyāḥ sāṅgā vedāstaduktayaḥ | manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ kīṭāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ pādapāstathā || 193.10 || sarīsṛpāścātha sūkṣmā yaccānyajjīvasaṃjñitam | samudrāḥ sakalāḥ śailāḥ saritaḥ kānanāni ca ||
