193.11 || dvīpānyaśeṣāṇi tathā tathā sarvasarāṃsi ca | nagaragrāmapūrṇā ca medinī medinīpate | devāṅganābhirdevasya dehe dṛṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 193.12 || nakṣatragrahatārābhiḥ susampūrṇaṃ nabhastalam | dadṛśustāḥ sucārvaṅgyastasyāntarviśvaṃ rūpiṇaḥ || 193.13 || ūrdhvaṃ na tiryaṅnādhastādyadāntastasya dṛśyate | tamanantamanādiṃ ca tatastāstuṣṭuvuḥ prabhum || 193.14 || madanena samaṃ sarvā madhunā ca varāṅganāḥ | sasādhvasā bhaktiparāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ || 193.15 || vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ | paśyāma nādiṃ tava deva nāntaṃ na madhyamavyākṛtarūpapāram | parāyaṇaṃ tvāṃ jagatāmanantaṃ natāḥ sma nārāyaṇamātmabhūtam || 193.16 || mahīnabhovāyujalāgnayastvaṃ śabdādirūpastu parāparātman | tvatto bhavatyacyute sarvametadbhedādirūpo'si vibho tvamātman || 193.17 || draṣṭāsi rūpasya parasya vettā śrotā ca śabdasya hare tvamekaḥ | sraṣṭā bhavān sarvagato'khilasya ghrātā ca gandhasya pṛthakśarīrī || 193.18 || sureṣu sarveṣu na so'sti kaścinmanuṣyalokeṣu na so'sti kaścit | paśvādivargeṣu na so'sti kaścidyo nāṃśabhūtastava devadeva || 193.19 || brahmāmbudhīndupramukhāni saumya śakrādirūpāṇi tavottamāni | samudrarūpaṃ tava dhairyavatsu tejaḥ svarūpeṣu ravistathāgniḥ || 193.20 || kṣamādhaneṣu kṣitirūpamagryaṃ śīghro balavatsu vāyuḥ | manuṣyarūpaṃ tava rājaveṣo mūḍheṣu sarveśvara pādapo'si || 193.21 || sarvānayeṣvacyuta dānavastvaṃ sanatsajātaśca vivekavatsu | rasasvarūpeṇa jalasthito'si gandhasvarūpaṃ bhavato dharitryām || 193.22 || dṛśyasvarūpaśca hutāśanastvaṃ sparśasvarūpaṃ bhavataḥ samīre | śabdādikaṃ te nabhasi svarūpaṃ mantavyarūpo manasi prabho tvam || 193.23 || bodhasvarūpaśca matau tvamekaḥ sarvatra sarveśvara sarvabhūta | paśyāmi te nābhisarojamadhye brahmāṇamīśaṃ ca haraṃ bhṛkuṭyām || 193.24 || tavāśvinau karṇagatau samastāstavāsthitā bāhuṣu lokapālāḥ | ghrāṇo'nilo netragatau ravīndu jihvā ca te nātha sarasvatīyam || 193.25 || pādau dharitrī jaṭharaṃ samastāṃllokān hṛṣīkeśa vilokayāmaḥ | jaṅghe vayaṃ pādatalāṅgulīṣu piśācayakṣoragasiddhasaṅghāḥ || 193.26 || puṃstve prajānāṃ patiroṣṭhayugme pratiṣṭhitāste kratavaḥ samastāḥ | sarve vayaṃ te daśaneṣu deva daṃṣṭrāsu devā hyabhavaṃśca dantāḥ || 193.27 || romāṇyaśeṣāstava devasaṅghā vidyādharā nātha tavāṅghrirekhāḥ | sāṅgāḥ samastāstava deva vedāḥ samāsthitāḥ sandhiṣu bāhubhūtāḥ || 193.28 || varāhabhūtaṃ dharaṇīdharaste nṛsiṃharūpaṃ ca sadā karālam | paśyāma te vājiśirastathoccaistrivikrame yacca tadāprameyam || 193.29 || amī samudrāstava deva dehe maurvālayaḥ śailadharāstathāmī | imāśca gaṅgāpramukhāḥ sravantyo dvīpāṇyaśeṣāṇi vanādideśāḥ || 193.30 || stuvanti ceme munayastaveśa dehe sthitāstvanmahimānamagryam | tvāmīśitāraṃ jagatāmanantaṃ yajanti yajñaiḥ kila yajñino'mī || 193.31 || tvattohi saumyaṃ jagatīha kiṃcittvatto na raudraṃ ca samastamūrte | tvatto na śītaṃ ca na keśavoṣṇaṃ sarvasvarūpātiśayī tvameva || 193.32 || prasīda sarveśvara sarvabhūta sanātanātmaparameśvareśa | tvanmāyayā mohitamānasābhiryatte'parāddhaṃ tadidaṃ kṣamasva || 193.33 || kiṃ vāparāddhaṃ tava devadeva yanmāyayā no hṛdayaṃ tavāpi | māyābhiśaṅkipraṇatārtihantarmano hi no vihvalatāmupaiti || 193.34 || na te'parāddhaṃ yadi te'parāddhamasmābhirunmārgavivartinībhiḥ | tatkṣamyatāṃ sṛṣṭikṛtastavaiva devāparādhaḥ sṛjato vivekam || 193.35 || namo namaste govinda nārāyaṇa janārdana | tvannāmasmaraṇātpāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu || 193.36 || namo'nanta namastubhyaṃ viśvātmanviśvabhāvana | tvannāmasmaraṇātpāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu || 193.37 || vareṇya yajñapuruṣa prajāpālana vāmana | tvannāmasmaraṇātpāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu || 193.38 || namo'stu te'bjanābhāya prajāpatikṛte hara | tvannāmasmaraṇātpāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu || 193.39 || saṃsārārṇavapotāya namastubhyamadhokṣaja | tvannāmasmaraṇātpāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu || 193.40 || namaḥ parasmai śrīśāya vāsudevāya vedhase | svecchayā guṇayuktāya sargasthityantakāriṇe || 193.41 || upasaṃhara viśvātmanrūpametatsanātanam | vardhamānaṃ na no draṣṭuṃ samarthaṃ cakṣurīśvara || 193.42 || pralayāgnisahasrasya samā dīptistavācyuta | pramāṇena diśo bhūmirgaganaṃ ca samāvṛtam || 193.43 || na vidmaḥ kutra vartāmo bhavānnāthopalakṣyate | sarvaṃ jagadiaikasthaṃ piṇḍitaṃ lakṣayāmahe || 193.44 || kiṃ varṇayāmo rūpaṃ te kiṃ pramāṇamidaṃ hare | māhātmyaṃ kiṃ nu te deva yajjihvāyā na gocare || 193.45 || vaktāro vāyutenāpi buddhīnāmayutāyutaiḥ | guṇanirvarṇanaṃ nātha kartuṃ tava na śakyate || 193.46 || tadetaddarśitaṃ rūpaṃ prasādaḥ paramaḥ kṛtaḥ | chandato jagatāmīśa tadetadupasaṃhara || 193.47 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityevaṃ saṃstutastābhirapsarobhirjanārdanaḥ | divyajñānopapannānāṃ tāsāṃ pratyakṣamīśvaraḥ || 193.48 || viveśa sarvabhūtāni svairaṃśairbhūtabhāvanaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūteṣu līyamānamadhokṣajam || 193.49 || vismayaṃ paramaṃ cakruḥ samastā devayoṣitaḥ | sa ca sarveśvaraḥ śailānpādapānsāgarānbhuvam || 193.50 || jalamagniṃ tathā vāyumākāśaṃ ca viveśa ha | kāle dikṣvatha sarvātma hyātmanaścānyathāpi ca || 193.51 || ātmarūpasthitaṃ svena mahimnā bhāvayañjagat | devadānavarakṣāṃsi yakṣīvidyādharoragāḥ || 193.52 || manuṣyapaśukīṭādimṛgapaśvantarikṣagāḥ | ye'ntarikṣe tathā bhūmau divi ye ca jalāśrayāḥ || 193.53 || tānviveśa sa viśvātmā punastadrūpamāsthitaḥ | nareṇa sārdhaṃ yattābhirdṛṣṭapūrvamarindama || 193.54 || tāḥ paraṃ vismayaṃ jagmuḥ sarvāstridaśayoṣitaḥ | praṇemuḥ sādhvasātpāṇḍuvadanā nṛpasattama || 193.55 || nārāyaṇo'pi bhagavānāha tāstridaśāṅganāḥ || 193.56 || nārāyaṇa uvāca nīyatāmurvaśī bhadrā yatrāsau tridaśeśvaraḥ | bhavatīnāṃ hitārthāya sarvabhūteṣvasāviti || 193.57 || jñānamutpāditaṃ bhūyo layaṃ bhūteṣu kurvatā | tadgacchadhvaṃ samasto'yaṃ bhūtagrāmo madaṃśakaḥ || 193.58 || ahamadyātmabhūtasya vāsudevasya yoginaḥ | asmātparataraṃ nāsti yo'nantaḥ paripathyate || 193.59 || tamajaṃ sarvabhūteśaṃ jānīta paramaṃ padam | ahaṃ bhavatyo devāśca manuṣyāḥ paśavaśca ye | etatsarvamanantasya vāsudevasya vai kṛtam || 193.60 || evaṃ jñātvā samaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam | sapaśvādiguṇaṃ caiva draṣṭavyaṃ tridaśāṅganāḥ || 193.61 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ityuktāstena devena samastāstāḥ surastriyaḥ | praṇamya tau samadanāḥ savasantāśca pārthiva || 193.62 || ādāya corvaśīṃ bhūyo devarājamupāgatāḥ | ācakhyuśca yathāvṛttaṃ devarājāya tattathā || 193.63 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tathā tvamapi rājendra sarvabhūteṣu keśavam | cintayansamatāṃ gaccha samataiva hi muktaye || 193.64 || rājannevaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhūteṣu parameśvaram | vāsudeva kathaṃ doṣāṃllobhādīnna prahāsyasi || 193.65 || sarvabhūtāni govindādyadā nānyāni bhūpate | tadā vairādayo bhāvāḥ kriyatāṃ na tu putraka || 193.66 || iti paśya jagatsarvaṃ vāsudevātmakaṃ nṛpa | etadeva hi kṛṣṇena rūpamāviṣkṛtaṃ nṛpa || 193.67 || parameśvareti yadrūpaṃ tadetatkathitaṃ tava | janmādibhāvarahitaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 193.68 || saṃkṣepeṇātha bhūpāla śrūyatāṃ yadvadāmi te | yanmataṃ puruṣaḥ kṛtvā paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 193.69 || sarvo viṣṇusamāso hi bhāvābhāvau ca tanmayau | sadasatsarvamīśo'sau mahādevaḥ paraṃ padam || 193.70 || bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām | viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplavānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām || 193.71 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.194>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tacchrutvānāntadevena viśvarūpamudāhṛtam | devarājastathā devāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ || 194.1 || dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasaṃ puṇyāmurvaśīṃ kamalānanām | saṃtrasto vismitaścābhūdindro rājaśriyā vṛtaḥ || 194.2 || na kiṃciduttaraṃ vākyamuktavāñjoṣamāsthitaḥ | iti vṛttāntabhūtaṃ hi nārāyaṇaviceṣṭitam || 194.3 || bhṛgoḥ khātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīḥ śrutvā tu vai nṛpa | vaiśvarūpaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ vismitācintayattadā || 194.4 || kenopāyena sa syānme bhartā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | vratena tapasā vāpi dānena niyamena ca || 194.5 || vṛddhānāṃ sevanenātha devatārādhanena vā | iti cintāparāṃ kanyāṃ satī jñātvā yudhiṣṭhira || 194.6 || prāha prāpto mayā bhartā śaṅkarastapasā kila | prajāpatiśca gāyatryā hyanyābhirabhivāñchitāḥ || 194.7 || tapasaiva hi te prāpyastasmāttaccara suvrate | tapastvaṃ hi mahaccograṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakam || 194.8 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca sāgarāntaṃ samāsādya lakṣmīḥ parapuraṃjaya | cacāra vipulaṃ kālaṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 194.9 || sthāṇuvatsaṃsthitā sābhūddivyaṃ varṣasahasrakam | tata indrādayo devāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ || 194.10 || bhūtvā jagmustadarthaṃ te sā tu pṛṣṭavatī surān | viśvarūpaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yattaddarśayata māciram || 194.11 || vilakṣā vrīḍitā devā gatvā nārāyaṇaṃ tadā | abruvan vaiśvarūpaṃ no śaktā darśayituṃ vayam || 194.12 || tato yatheṣṭaṃ te jagmuḥ sa ca viṣṇuracintayat | ugrarūpā sthitā devī dehaṃ dahati bhārgavī || 194.13 || tāṃ tasmāttatra gatvāhaṃ varaṃ dattvā tu vāñchitam | punastapaḥ kariṣyāmi darśayiṣyāmi vā punaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yaddurdaśyaṃ devadānavaiḥ || 194.14 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gatvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ sāgarāntasthitāṃ śriyam | prāha tuṣṭo'smi te devi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam || 194.15 || śrīruvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva prapannāyā janārdana | tadā darśaya yaddṛṣṭamapsarobhistavānagha || 194.16 || viśvarūpamanantaṃ ca bhūtabhāvana keśava | gandhamādanamāsādya kṛtaṃ yacca tapastvayā || 194.17 || tadvadasva vibho viṣṇo na mithyā yadi keśava | śraddadhāmi na caivāhaṃ rūpasyāsya kathaṃcana || 194.18 || bahubhiryakṣarakṣobhirmāyācāripracāribhiḥ | chanditā mama jānadbhirbhāvamantargataṃ harau || 194.19 || bhūtvā viṣṇusvarūpāste cakriṇaśca caturbhujāḥ | suvrīḍitā gatāḥ sarve viśvarūpo sahāyataḥ || 194.20 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca nārāyaṇo'tha bhagavāñchaṅkhacakragadābhṛtam | tayā tathoktastadrūpaṃ muktvā vai surapūjitam || 194.21 || rūpaṃ paraṃ yathoktaṃ vai viśvarūpamadarśayat | darśayitvā vacaḥ prāha pañcarātravidhānataḥ || 194.22 || yo'rcayiṣyati māṃ nityaṃ sa pūjyaḥ sa ca pūjitaḥ | dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ sarvabhogasamanvitaḥ || 194.23 || mūlaṃ hi sarvadharmāṇāṃ brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | tenāhaṃ tatra sthāsyāmi mūlaśrīpatisaṃjñitaḥ || 194.24 || mūlaśrīḥ procyate brāhmī brahmacaryasvarūpiṇī | sarvayogamayī puṇyā sarvapāpaharī śubhā || 194.25 || patistasyāḥ prabhurahaṃ varadaḥ prāṇināṃ priye | revājale naraḥ snātvā yo'rcayenmāṃ yatavrataḥ || 194.26 || mūlaśrīpatināmānaṃ vāñchite prāpnuyātphalam | dānāni tatra yo dadyānmahādānāni ca priye || 194.27 || sahasraguṇitaṃ puṇyamanyasthānādavāpyate | dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā tatra deśe samyakcaivāvadhāritam | tadarcitvā parān kāmānāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 194.28 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva deveśi vāñchitaṃ durlabhaṃ suraiḥ | durgasaṃsārakāntārapatitaiḥ parameśvari || 194.29 || śrīruvāca nārāyaṇa jagaddhātarnārāyaṇa jagatpate | nārāyaṇa parabrahma nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa || 194.30 || prasīda pāhi māṃ bhaktyā samyaksarge niyojaya | priyo hyasi priyāhaṃ te yathā syāṃ tattathā kuru || 194.31 || gṛhaṃ dharmārthakāmānāṃ kāraṇaṃ deva saṃmatam | tadāsthāyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ māṃ śreyasi niyojaya || 194.32 || nārāyaṇa uvāca nārāyaṇagirā devi vijñapto'smi yatastvayā | nārāyaṇagirirnāma tena me'tra bhaviṣyati || 194.33 || nārāyaṇasmṛtau yāti duritaṃ janmakoṭijam | yasmādgirati tasmācca girirityeva śabditam || 194.34 || tasmātsarvāśrayo devi giriḥ parvatarāṅbhavet | surāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāhamapi cāśrayaḥ || 194.35 || ya etatpūjayiṣyanti maṇḍalasthaṃ paraṃ mama | nārāyaṇagirirnāma devarūpaṃ śubhekṣaṇe || 194.36 || te divyajñānasampannā divyadehaviceṣṭitāḥ | divyaṃ lokamavāpsyanti divyabhogasamanvitāḥ || 194.37 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tayorevaṃ saṃvadatordevā indrapurogamāḥ | samāgatā vanoddeśaṃ sāgarānte maharṣayaḥ || 194.38 || tato bhṛguṃ devarājo nārāyaṇavicintitam | vavre jñātvā tu tatkanyāṃ dharmātmā sa dadau ca tām || 194.39 || dharmo'pi vidhivadvatsa vivāhaṃ samakārayat | devadevasya rājarṣe devatārthe samāhitaḥ || 194.40 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca dharmo vivāhamakarodvidhivadyattvayoditam | ko vidhistatra kā dattā dakṣiṇā bhṛguṇāpi ca || 194.41 || vivāhayajñe samabhūtsruksruvagrahaṇe ca kaḥ | ṛtvijaḥ ke sadasyāśca tasyāsan dvijasattama || 194.42 || kiṃ tasyāvabhṛthaṃ tvāsīttatsarvaṃ vada vistarāt | tvadvākyāmṛtapānena tṛptirmama na vidyate || 194.43 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca nārāyaṇavivāhasya yajñasya ca yudhiṣṭhira | tapasastasya devasya samyagācaraṇasya ca || 194.44 || vaktuṃ samartho na guṇānbrahmāpi parameśvaraḥ | tathāpyuddeśato vacmi śṛṇu bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 194.45 || brahmā saptarṣayastatra sruksruvagrahaṇe ratāḥ | agnīñjuhuvire rājanvedirdhātrī sasāgarā || 194.46 || daduḥ samudrā ratnāni brahmarṣibhyo nṛpottama | dhanado'pi dadau vittaṃ sarvabrāhmaṇavāñchitam || 194.47 || viśvakarmā'pi devānāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ paraṃtapa | veśmāni suvicitrāṇi sarvaratnamayāni ca || 194.48 || kṛtvā pradarśayāmāsa devendrāya yaśasvine | śatakratustato viprānkāpiṣṭhalapurogamān || 194.49 || śaunakādīṃśca papraccha baṣkalāñchāgalānapi | ātreyānapi rājendra vṛṇudhvamabhivāñchitam || 194.50 || dṛṣṭvā te citraratnāni prāhuḥ sarveśvareśvaram | devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṅgamo'yaṃ supuṇyakṛt || 194.51 || asminpuṇye sureśāna vastuṃ vāñchāmahe sadā | śatakratuḥ prāha punarvāso vātra bhaviṣyati | satyadharmaratā yūyaṃ yāvatkālaṃ bhaviṣyatha || 194.52 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca pṛṣṭaṃ yadrājaśārdūla ke makhe hotriṇo'bhavan | tatprocyamānamadhunā śṛṇu bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 194.53 || sanatkumārapramukhāḥ sadasyāstasya cābhavan | audgātramatryaṅgirasau marīciśca cakāra ha || 194.54 || hautraṃ dharmavasiṣṭhau ca brahmatvaṃ sanako muniḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśadgrāmasāhasraṃ prādāttebhyaḥ śatakratuḥ || 194.55 || lakṣmīrbhartrā ca saṃyuktābhavattatkṛtavānprabhuḥ | brahmaṇo juhvato vahniṃ yāvaddeśasthitaiḥ suraiḥ || 194.56 || dṛṣṭaṃ lalāṭaṃ deśo'sau lalāṭa iti saṃjñitaḥ | sa deśaḥ śrīpateḥ kṣetrapuṇyaṃ devarṣisevitam || 194.57 || sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ divyasiddhisamanvitam | brāhmaṇānāṃ tataḥ paṅktiṃ niveśayitumudyatā || 194.58 || lakṣmīḥ śrīpatināmānamāha devaṃ vacastadā | śrīruvāca ya ete brāhmaṇāḥ śiṣyā bhṛgvādīnāṃ yatavratāḥ || 194.59 || tānniveśayitumicchāmi tvatprasādādadhokṣaja | marīcyādayaḥ surendreṇa sthāpitā garuḍadhvaja || 194.60 || naiṣṭhikavratino viprā bahavo'tra yatavratāḥ | prājāpatye vrate brāhme kecidatra vyavasthitāḥ | tānahaṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi tvatprasādādadhokṣaja || 194.61 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ kautūhaladharo bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | papraccha vratinaḥ sarvānvṛttibhede vyavasthitān || 194.62 || nārado'pi mahādevamupetya ca satīpatim | prāha kṛṣṇājinadharo naiṣṭhikā brāhmaṇā hyamī || 194.63 || amī kāryāḥ suvastreṇa channaguhyā dvijottamāḥ | prājāpatyāścaturviṃśasahasrāṇi nareśvara || 194.64 || brahmacaryavratasthānāṃ vratabrahmavicāriṇām | dvādaśaiṣāṃ sahasrāṇi santi vai vṛṣabhadhvaja || 194.65 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā devarṣayo'pi ca | sādhu sādhvityamanyanta nocuḥ kecana kiṃcana || 194.66 || samāhvayattato lakṣmīstān viprān bhaktisaṃyutā | uvāca caraṇāngṛhya prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi || 194.67 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi veśmanāmatra saṃsthitiḥ | viśvakarmakṛtānāṃ tu teṣu tiṣṭhantu vo'khilāḥ || 194.68 || te tatheti pratijñāya sthitāḥ saṃprītamānasāḥ | dhanadhānyasamṛddhāśca vāñchitaprāptilakṣaṇāḥ | sarvakāmasamṛddhāśca hyanārambheṣu karmaṇām || 194.69 || iti saṃsthāpya tān viprān sā sthitā paryapālayat | caturdhā tu sthito viṣṇuḥ śriyā devyāḥ priye rataḥ || 194.70 || evaṃ vaivāhikamakhe nivṛtte ṛṣayastu tam | ūcuścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kutra kurmo janārdana || 194.71 || iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ śrīpatiḥ pādapaṅkajāt | mumoca jāhnavītoyaṃ revāmadhyagamaṃ śuci || 194.72 || hareḥ pādodakaṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥsṛtaṃ munayastu te | vismitāḥ samapadyanta jānantastasya gauravam || 194.73 || rudreṇa sahitāḥ sarve devatā ṛṣayastathā | saṃkathā vismitāścakrurvidhunvantaḥ śirāṃsi ca || 194.74 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | brūhi śambho kimatrāyaṃ akasmādvārisambhavaḥ | viṣṇoḥ pādāmbujotthaśca sammohakaraṇaḥ paraḥ || 194.75 || īśvara uvāca pādodakamidaṃ viṣṇorahaṃ jānāmi vai surāḥ | daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthaiḥ snānamatrātiricyate || 194.76 || yuṣmābhiḥ śrīpatiḥ pūjyaḥ snānaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ kutaḥ | bhaviṣyatīti tenāśu idaṃ vo'rthe vinirmitam || 194.77 || snātvātra tridaśeśānā yatphalaṃ samprapadyate | vaktuṃ na kenacidyāti tataḥ kimuttaraṃ vacaḥ || 194.78 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca evamuktvā tu te sarve snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāgatam | jagmurdevā maheśānapurogā bharatarṣabha || 194.79 || brāhmaṇāśca tataḥ sarve svaveśmānyeva bhejire | devatīrthe mahārāja sarvapāpapraṇāśane || 194.80 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpativivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma caturnavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.195>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca devatīrthe tu kiṃ nāma māhātmyaṃ samudāhṛtam | phalaṃ kiṃ snānadānādikāriṇāṃ jāyate mune || 195.1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni devairmunigaṇairapi | sevitāni mahābāho tāni dhyātāni viṣṇunā || 195.2 || samāgatānyekatāṃ vai tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | tattīrthaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ puṇyaṃ devatīrthamiti śrutam || 195.3 || kurukṣetraṃ bhuvi paramantarikṣe tripuṣkaram | puruṣottamaṃ divi paraṃ devatīrthaṃ parātparam || 195.4 || devatīrthasamaṃ nāsti tīrthamatra paratra ca | yatprāpya manujastapyenna kadācidyudhiṣṭhira || 195.5 || devairuktāni tīrthāni yo'tra snānaṃ samācaret | devatīrthe sa sarvatra snāto bhavati mānavaḥ || 195.6 || evamastviti tairuktā devā ṛṣigaṇā api | saṃtuṣṭāḥ śrīśamabhyarcya svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ tu bhejire || 195.7 || sūryagrahe'tra vai kṣetre snātvā yatphalamaśnute | snātvā śrīśaṃ samabhyarcya samupoṣya yathāvidhi || 195.8 || yaddadāti hiraṇyāni dānāni vidhivannṛpa | tadanantaphalaṃ sarvaṃ sūryasya grahaṇe yathā || 195.9 || bhūmidānaṃ dhenudānaṃ svarṇadānamanantakam | vajradānamanantaṃ ca phalaṃ prāha śatakratuḥ || 195.10 || somo vai vastradānena mauktikānāṃ ca bhārgavaḥ | suvarṇasya ravirdānaṃ dharmarājo hyanantakam || 195.11 || devatīrthe tu yaddānaṃ śraddhāyuktena dīyate | tadanantaphalaṃ prāha bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || 195.12 || devatīrthe bhṛgukṣetre sarvatīrthādhika nṛpa | devatīrthe naraḥ snātvā śrīpatiṃ yo'nupaśyati || 195.13 || somagrahe kulaśataṃ sa samuddhṛtya nākabhāk | dānāni dvijamukhyebhyo devatīrthe narādhipa || 195.14 || yairdattāni narairbhogabhāginaḥ pretya ceha te | devatīrthe viprabhojyaṃ harimuddiśya yaścaret || 195.15 || sa sarvāhlādamāpnoti svargaloke yudhiṣṭhira | devatīrthe naro nārī snātvā niyatamānasau || 195.16 || upoṣyaikādaśīṃ bhaktyā pūjayedyaḥ śriyaḥ patim | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtenodbodhya dīpakam || 195.17 || dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya tathā vai narmadājale | vipradāmpatyamabhyarcya vidhivatkurunandana || 195.18 || vastrābharaṇatāmbūlapuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ | akṣaye viṣṇuloke'sau modate caritavrataḥ || 195.19 || yaḥ sadaikādaśītithau snātvopoṣyārcayeddharim | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvedaśāstravidhānataḥ || 195.20 || dharmarājakṛtāṃ pāpāṃ na sa paśyati yātanām | pañcarātravidhānena śrīpatiṃ yo'rcayiṣyati || 195.21 || dīkṣāmavāpya vidhivadvaiṣṇavīṃ pāpanāśinīm | svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ bhogadāṃ vittadāmatha || 195.22 || rājyadāṃ vā mahābhāga putradāṃ bhāgyadāmatha | sukalatrapradāṃ vāpi viṣṇorbhaktipradāmiti || 195.23 || tariṣyati bhavāmbhodhiṃ sa naraḥ kurunandana | yo'rcayiṣyati tatraiva devatīrthe śriyaḥ patim || 195.24 || viśvarūpamatho samyaṅmūlaśrīpatimeva vā | nārāyaṇagiriṃ vāpi gṛhe vaikādaśītithau || 195.25 || bhaktimāñchraddhayā yuktaḥ kṣīraistīrthodakairapi | susūkṣmairahatairvastrairmahākauśeyakairnṛpa || 195.26 || vicitrairnetrajairvāpi dhūpairagurucandanaiḥ | guggulairghṛtamiśraiśca naivedyairvividhairapi || 195.27 || pāyasādyairmanuṣyendra payasā vā yudhiṣṭhira | piṣṭadīpaiḥ suvimalairvardhamānairmanoharaiḥ || 195.28 || pūjayitvā naro yāti yathā tacchṛṇu bhārata | śaṅkhī cakrī gadī padmī bhūtvāsau garuḍadhvajaḥ || 195.29 || devalokānatikramya viṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate | yastu vai parayā bhaktyā śrīpateḥ pādapaṅkajam || 195.30 || caturdhādhiṣṭhitaṃ paśyecchriyaṃ trailokyamātaram | nṛtyagītavinodena mucyate pātakardhruvam || 195.31 || nīrājane tu devasya prātarmadhye dine tathā | sāyaṃ ca niyato nityaṃ yaḥ paśyetpūjayeddharim || 195.32 || sa tīrtvā hyāpadaṃ durgāṃ naivārtiṃ samavāpnuyāt | āyuḥśrīvardhanaṃ puṃsāṃ cakṣuṣāmapi pūrakam || 195.33 || upapāpaharaṃ caiva sadā nīrājanaṃ hareḥ | tadā nīrājanākāle yo hareḥ paṭhati stavam || 195.34 || sa dhanyo devadevasya prasannenāntarātmanā | harernīrājanāśeṣaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 195.35 || saṃgṛhya cakṣuṣī tena yojayenmārjayanmukham | timirādīnakṣirogānnāśayeddīptimanmukham || 195.36 || bhavatyaśeṣaduṣṭānāṃ nāśāyālaṃ narottama | dīpaprajvalanaṃ yasya nityamagre śriyaḥ pateḥ || 195.37 || snātvā revājale puṇye pradadyādadhikaṃ vratī | saptadvīpavatī tena sasāgaravanāpagā || 195.38 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā syādvai dharaṇī śaṅkaro'bravīt | idaṃ yaḥ paṭhyamānaṃ tu śṛṇuyātpaṭhate'pi vā || 195.39 || smaraṇaṃ so'tasamaye vipāpmā prāpnuyāddhareḥ | idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ pitṛguṇapriyam || 195.40 || māhātmyaṃ śrāvayedviprāñchrīpateḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi | ghṛtena madhunā tena tarpitāḥ syuḥ pitāmahāḥ || 195.41 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.196>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharādhīśa haṃsatīrthamanuttamam | yatra haṃsastapastaptvā brahmavāhanatāṃ gataḥ || 196.1 || haṃsatīrthe naraḥ snātvā dānaṃ dattvā ca kāñcanam | sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 196.2 || haṃsayuktena yānena taruṇādityavarcasā | sarvakāmasamṛddhena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ || 196.3 || tatra bhuktvā yathākāmaṃ sarvān bhogān yathepsitān | jātismaro hi jāyeta punarmānuṣyamāgataḥ || 196.4 || saṃnyāsena tyajeddehaṃ mokṣamāpnoti bhārata || 196.5 || etatte kathitaṃ pārtha haṃsatīrthasya yatphalam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 196.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.197>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ gacchetsūryatīrthamanuttamam | mūlasthānamiti khyātaṃ padmajasthāpitaṃ śubham || 197.1 || mūlaśrīpatinā devī proktā sthāpaya bhāskaram | śrutvā devoditaṃ devī sthāpayāmāsa bhāskaram || 197.2 || procyate narmadātīre mūlasthānākhyabhāskaraḥ || 197.3 || tatra tīrthe naro yastu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ | saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca piṇḍena salilena ca || 197.4 || mūlasthānaṃ tataḥ paśyetsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim | guhyādguhyatarastatra viśeṣastu śruto mayā || 197.5 || samāgame munīnāṃ tu śaṅkarācchaśiśekharāt | sadā vai śuklasaptamyāṃ mūlamādityavāsaraḥ || 197.6 || tadā revājalaṃ gatvā snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ | pitḥṃśca bharataśreṣṭha dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 197.7 || karavīraistato gatvā raktacandanavāriṇā | saṃsthāpya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi || 197.8 || tataḥ sāgurukairdhūpaiḥ kundaraiśca viśeṣataḥ | dhūpayeddevadeveśaṃ dīpān bodhya diśo daśa || 197.9 || upoṣya jāgaraṃ kuryādgītavādyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | evaṃ kṛte mahīpāla na bhavedugraduḥkhabhāk || 197.10 || sūryaloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpaśatatrayam | gandharvairapsarobhiśca sevyamāno nṛpottama || 197.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mūlasthānatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.198>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla bhadrakālītisaṅgamam | śūlatīrthamiti khyātaṃ svayaṃ devena nirmitam || 198.1 || pañcāyatanamadhye tu tiṣṭhate parameśvaraḥ | śūlapāṇirmahādevaḥ sarvadevatapūjitaḥ || 198.2 || sa saṅgamo nṛpaśreṣṭha nityaṃ devairniṣevitaḥ | darśanāttasya tīrthasya snānadānādviśeṣataḥ || 198.3 || daurbhāgyaṃ durnimittaṃ ca hyabhiśāpo nṛpagrahaḥ | yadanyadduṣkṛtaṃ karma naśyate śaṅkaro'bravīt || 198.4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ śūleśvarī devī kathaṃ śūleśvaro haraḥ | prathito narmadātīre etadvistarato vada || 198.5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca babhūva brāhmaṇaḥ kaścinmāṇḍavya iti viśrutaḥ | vṛttimānsarvadharmajñaḥ satye tapasi ca sthitaḥ || 198.6 || aśokāśramamadhyastho vṛkṣamūle mahātapāḥ | ūrdhvabāhurmahātejāstasthau maunavratānvitaḥ || 198.7 || tasya kālena mahatā tīvre tapasi vartataḥ | tamāśramamanuprāptā dasyavo loptrahāriṇaḥ || 198.8 || anusarpyamāṇā bahubhiḥ puruṣairbharatarṣabha | te tasyāvasathe loptraṃ nyadadhuḥ kurunandana || 198.9 || nidhāya ca tadā līnāstatraivāśramamaṇḍale | teṣu līneṣvatho śīghraṃ tatastadrakṣiṇāṃ balam || 198.10 || ājagāma tato'paśyaṃstamṛṣiṃ taskarānugāḥ | tamapṛcchaṃstadā vṛttaṃ rakṣiṇastaṃ tapodhanam || 198.11 || vada kena pathā yātā dasyavo dvijasattama | tena gacchāmahe brahman yathā śīghrataraṃ vayam || 198.12 || tathā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ bruvatāṃ sa tapodhanaḥ | na kiṃcidvacanaṃ rājannavadatsādhvasādhu vā || 198.13 || tataste rājapuruṣā vicinvantastamāśramam | saṃyamyainaṃ tato rājñe sarvān dasyūnnyavedayan || 198.14 || taṃ rājā sahitaiścorairanvaśādvadhyatāmiti | sambadhya taṃ ca tairrājañchūle proto mahātapāḥ || 198.15 || tataste śūlamāropya taṃ muniṃ rakṣiṇastadā | pratijagmurmahīpāla dhanānyādāya tānyatha || 198.16 || śūlasthaḥ sa tu dharmātmā kālena mahatā tadā | dhyāyandevaṃ trilokeśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tamumāpatim || 198.17 || bahukālaṃ maheśānaṃ manasādhyāya saṃsthitaḥ | nirāhāro'pi viprarṣirmaraṇaṃ nābhyapadyata || 198.18 || dhārayāmāsa viprāṇāmṛṣabhaḥ sa hṛdā harim | śūlāgre tapyamānena tapastena kṛtaṃ tadā || 198.19 || santāpaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ śrutvaitanmunayo'khilāḥ | te rātrau śakunā bhūtvā saṃnyavartanta bhārata || 198.20 || darśayanto muneḥ śaktiṃ tamapṛcchan dvijottamam | śrotumicchāma te brahman kiṃ pāpaṃ kṛtavānasi || 198.21 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ sa muniśārdūlastānuvāca tapodhanān | doṣataḥ kiṃ gamiṣyāmi na hi me'nyo parādhyati || 198.22 || evamuktvā tataḥ sarvānācacakṣe tato muniḥ | munayaśca tato rājñe dvitīye'hni nyavedayan || 198.23 || rājā tu tamṛṣiṃ śrutvā niṣkrāntaḥ saha bandhubhiḥ | prasādayāmāsa tadā śūlasthamṛṣisattamam || 198.24 || rājovāca yanmayā'pakṛtaṃ tāta tavājñānavaśādbahu | prasādaye tvāṃ tatrāhaṃ na me tvaṃ kroddhumarhasi || 198.25 || evamuktastato rājñā prasādamakaronmuniḥ | kṛtaprasādaṃ rājā taṃ tataḥ samavatārayat || 198.26 || avatīryamāṇastu muniḥ śūle māṃsatvamāgate | atisaṃpīḍito vipraḥ śaṅkaraṃ manasāgamat || 198.27 || saṃdhyātaḥ śaṅkarastena bahukālopavāsataḥ | prādurbhūto mahādevaḥ śūlaṃ tasya tathāchinat || 198.28 || śūlamūlasthitaḥ śambhustuṣṭaḥ prāha punaḥpunaḥ | brūhi kiṃ kriyatāṃ vipra sattvasthānaparāyaṇa || 198.29 || adeyamapi dāsyāmi tuṣṭo'smyadyomayā saha | kiṃ tu satyavatāṃ loke siddhirna syācca bhūyasī || 198.30 || svakarmaṇo'nurūpaṃ hi phalaṃ bhuñjanti jantavaḥ | śubhena karmaṇā bhūtirduḥkhaṃ syātpātakena tu || 198.31 || bahubhedaprabhinnaṃ tu manuṣyeṣu vipacyate | keṣāṃ daridrabhāvena keṣāṃ dhanavipattijam || 198.32 || santatyabhāvajaṃ keṣāṃ keṣāṃcittadviparyayaḥ | tathā durvṛttitasteṣāṃ phalamāvirbhavennṛṇām || 198.33 || keṣāṃcitputramaraṇe viyogātpriyamitrayoḥ | rājacaurāgnitaḥ keṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ syāddaivanirmitam || 198.34 || taccharīre tu keṣāṃcitkarmaṇā sampradṛśyate | jarāśca vividhāḥ keṣāṃ dṛśyante vyādhayastathā || 198.35 || dṛśyante cābhiśāpāśca pūrvakarmānusaṃcitāḥ | kaṣṭāḥ kaṣṭatarāvasthā gatāḥ kecidanāgasaḥ || 198.36 || pūrvakarmavipākena dharmeṇa tapasi sthitāḥ | dāntāḥ svadāraniratā bhūridāḥ paripūjakāḥ || 198.37 || hrīmanto nayasaṃyuktā anye bahuguṇairyutāḥ | durgamāmāpadaṃ prāpya nijakarmasamudbhavām || 198.38 || na saṃjvaranti ye martyā dharmanindāṃ na kurvate | idameva tapo matvā kṣipanti suvicetasaḥ || 198.39 || hā bhrātarmātaḥ putreti kaṣṭeṣu na vadanti ye | smaranti māṃ maheśānamathavā puṣkarekṣaṇam || 198.40 || duṣkṛtaṃ pūrvajaṃ bhoktuṃ dhruvaṃ tadupaśāmyati || 198.41 || dināni yāvanti vasetsa kaṣṭe yathākṛtaṃ cintayaddevamīśam | tāvanti saumyāni kṛtāni tena bhavanti vipra śrutinodanaiṣā || 198.42 || yasmāttvayā kaṣṭagatena nityaṃ smṛtaścāhaṃ manasā pūjitaśca | gaurīsahāyastena ihāgato'smi brūhyadya kṛtyaṃ kriyatāṃ kiṃ nu vipra || 198.43 || māṇḍavya uvāca tuṣṭo yadyumayā sārdhaṃ varado yadi śaṅkara | tadā me śūlasaṃsthasya saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ vada || 198.44 || na rujā mama kāpi syācchūlasaṃprotite'gake | amṛtasrāvi tacchūlaṃ prabhāvātkasya śaṃsa me || 198.45 || śrīśūlapāṇiruvāca śūlasthena tvayā vipra manasā cintito'smi yat | anayānāṃ nihantāhaṃ duḥkhānāṃ vinibarhaṇaḥ || 198.46 || dhyātamātro hyahaṃ vipra pātāle vāpi saṃsthitaḥ | śūlamūle tvahaṃ śambhuragre devī svayaṃ sthitā | jaganmātāmbikā devī tvāmṛtenānvapūrayat || 198.47 || māṇḍavya uvāca pūrvameva sthito yasmācchūlaṃ vyāpyomayā saha | prasādapravaṇo mahyamidānīṃ cānayā saha || 198.48 || yasyāḥ saṃsmaraṇādeva daurbhāgyaṃ pralayaṃ vrajet | na daurbhāgyātparaṃ loke duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ kila || 198.49 || kilaivaṃ śrūyate gāthā purāṇeṣu surottama | trailokyaṃ dahatastubhyaṃ saubhāgyamekatāṃ gatam || 198.50 || viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ prāpya tatsthitaṃ ceti naḥ śrutam | pītaṃ tadvakṣasastrastadakṣeṇa parameṣṭhinā || 198.51 || tasmātsatīti saṃjajña iyamindīvarekṣaṇā | yajatastasya deveśa tava mānāvakhaṇḍanāt || 198.52 || juhāvāgnau tu sā devī hyātmānaṃ prāṇasaṃjñikam | ātmānaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā prāleyādrestataḥ sutā || 198.53 || menakāyāṃ prabho jātā sāmprataṃ yā hyumābhidhā | anādinidhanā devī hyapratarkyā sureśvara || 198.54 || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa hyumā me varadā yadi | ubhāvapyatra vai sthāne sthitau śūlāgramūlayoḥ || 198.55 || avatāro yatra tatra saṃsthitiṃ vai tataḥ kuru || 198.56 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tenaivamukte sahasā kṛtvā bhūmaṇḍalaṃ dvidhā | niḥsṛtau śūlamūlāgrālliṅgārcāpratirūpiṇau || 198.57 || pradyotayaddiśaḥ sarvā liṅgaṃ mūle pradṛśyate | vāmataḥ pratimā devī tadā śūleśvarī sthitā || 198.58 || vilobhayantī ca jagadbhāti pūrayatī diśaḥ | dṛṣṭvā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ stutiṃ cakre dvijottamaḥ || 198.59 || māṇḍavya uvāca tvamasya jagato mātā jagatsaubhāgyadevatā | na tvayā rahitaṃ kiṃcidbrahmāṇḍe'sti varānane || 198.60 || prasādaṃ kuru dharmajñe mama tvājñaptumarhasi | īdṛśenaiva rūpeṇa keṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhasi | prasādapravaṇā bhūtvā vada tāni maheśvari || 198.61 || śrīdevyuvāca sarvagā sarvabhūteṣu draṣṭavyā sarvato bhuvi | sarvalokeṣu yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ na mayā vinā || 198.62 || tathāpi yeṣu sthāneṣu draṣṭavyā siddhimīpsubhiḥ | smartavyā bhūtikāmena tāni vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 198.63 || vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī | prayāge lalitā devī kāmukā gandhamādane || 198.64 || mānase kumudā nāma viśvakāyā tathā'pare | gomante gomatī nāma mandare kāmacāriṇī || 198.65 || madotkaṭā caitrarathe hayantī hāstine pure | kānyakubje sthitā gaurī rambhā hyamalaparvate || 198.66 || ekāmrake kīrtimatī viśvāṃ viśveśvare viduḥ | puṣkare puruhūtā ca kedāre mārgadāyinī || 198.67 || nandā himavataḥ prasthe gokarṇe bhadrakarṇikā | sthāneśvare bhavānī tu bilvake bilvapattrikā || 198.68 || śrīśaile mādhavī nāma bhadre bhadreśvarīti ca | jayā varāhaśaile tu kamalā kamalālaye || 198.69 || rudrakoṭyāṃ tu kalyāṇī kālī kālañjare tathā | mahāliṅge tu kapilā mākoṭe mukuṭeśvarī || 198.70 || śāligrāme mahādevī śivaliṅge jalapriyā | māyāpuryāṃ kumārī tu saṃtāne lalitā tathā || 198.71 || utpalākṣī sahasrākṣe hiraṇyākṣe mahotpalā | gayāyāṃ vimalā nāma maṅgalā puruṣottame || 198.72 || vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane | nārāyaṇī supārśve tu trikūṭe bhadrasundarī || 198.73 || vipule vipulā nāma kalyāṇī malayācale | koṭavī koṭitīrtheṣu sugandhā gandhamādane || 198.74 || godāśrame trisandhyā tu gaṅgādvāre ratipriyā | śivacaṇḍe sabhānandā nandinī devikātaṭe || 198.75 || rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane | devakī mathurāyāṃ tu pātāle parameśvarī || 198.76 || citrakūṭe tathā sītā vindhye vindhyanivāsinī | sahyādrāvekavīrā tu hariścandre tu caṇḍikā || 198.77 || ramaṇā rāmatīrthe tu yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī | karavīre mahālakṣmī rūpādevī vināyake || 198.78 || ārogyā vaidyanāthe tu mahākāle maheśvarī | abhayetyuṣṇatīrthe tu mṛgī vā vindhyakandare || 198.79 || māṇḍavye māṇḍukī nāma svāhā māheśvare pure | chāgaliṅge pracaṇḍā tu caṇḍikāmarakaṇṭake || 198.80 || someśvare varārohā prabhāse puṣkarāvatī | vedamātā sarasvatyāṃ pārā pārātaṭe mune || 198.81 || mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṅgaleśvarī | siṃhikā kṛtaśauce tu kartike caiva śāṃkarī || 198.82 || utpalāvartake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṅgame | matā siddhavaṭe lakṣmīstaraṃgā bhāratāśrame || 198.83 || jālandhare viśvamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate | devadāruvane puṣṭirmedhā kāśmīramaṇḍale || 198.84 || bhīmādevī himādrau tu puṣṭirvastreśvare tathā | kapālamocane śuddhirmātā kāyāvarohaṇe || 198.85 || śaṅkhoddhāre dhvanirnāma dhṛtiḥ piṇḍārake tathā | kālā tu candrabhāgāyāmacchode śaktidhāriṇī || 198.86 || veṇāyāmamṛtā nāma badaryāmurvaśī tathā | oṣadhī cottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā || 198.87 || manmathā hemakūṭe tu kumude satyavādinī | aśvatthe vandinīkā tu nidhirvaiśravaṇālaye || 198.88 || gāyatrī vedavadane pārvatī śivasannidhau | devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmāsye tu sarasvatī || 198.89 || sūryabimbe prabhā nāma mātḥṇāṃ vaiṣṇavī matā | arundhatī satīnāṃ tu rāmāsu ca tilottamā || 198.90 || citre brahmakalā nāma śaktiḥ sarvaśarīriṇām | śūleśvarī bhṛgukṣetre bhṛgau saubhāgyasundarī || 198.91 || etaduddeśataḥ proktaṃ nāmāṣṭaśatamuttamam | aṣṭottaraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ śatametadudāhṛtam || 198.92 || idameva paraṃ vipra sarveṣāṃ tu bhaviṣyati | paṭhatyaṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ yaḥ śivasannidhau || 198.93 || sa mucyate naraḥ pāpaiḥ prāpnoti striyamīpsitām | snātvā nārī tṛtīyāyāṃ māṃ samabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ || 198.94 || na sā syādduḥkhinī jātu matprabhāvānnarottama | nityaṃ maddarśane nārī niyatāyā bhaviṣyati || 198.95 || patiputrakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ na sā prāpsyati karhicit | madālaye tu yā nārī tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitam || 198.96 || sampūjya maṇḍayeddevāṃllokapālāṃśca sāgnikān | sapatnīkāndvijānpūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā || 198.97 || bhūtebhyastu baliṃ dadyādṛtvigbhiḥ saha deśikaḥ | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tulāmityabhimantrayet || 198.98 || śuciraktāmbaro vā syādgṛhītvā kusumāñjalim | namaste sarvadevānāṃ śaktistvaṃ paramā sthitā || 198.99 || sākṣibhūtā jagaddhātrī nirmitā viśvayoninā | tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇamiha kīrtitā || 198.100 || karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāmāste paśyannumāmukham | tato'pare tulābhāgenyaseyurdvijapuṃgavāḥ || 198.101 || dravyamaṣṭavidhaṃ tatra hyātmavittānusārataḥ | mandaśabhūte viprendra pṛthivyāṃ yadadhiṣṭhitam || 198.102 || suvarṇaṃ caiva niṣpāvāṃstathā rājikusumbhakam | tṛṇarājendulavaṇaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tu tathāṣṭamam || 198.103 || eṣāmekatamaṃ kuryādyathā vittānusārataḥ | sāmyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvatkāñcanādi bhaveddvija || 198.104 || tāvattiṣṭhennaro nārī paścādidamudīrayet | namo namaste lalite tulāpuruṣasaṃjñite || 198.105 || tvamume tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārakardamāt | tato'vatīrya murave pūrvamarddhaṃ nivedayet || 198.106 || ṛtvigbhyo'paramarddhaṃ ca dadyādudakapūrvakam | tebhyo labdhā tato'nujñāṃ dadyādanyeṣu cārthiṣu || 198.107 || sapatnīkaṃ guruṃ raktavāsasī paridhāpayet | anyāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ śaktyā guruṃ keyūrakaṅkaṇaiḥ || 198.108 || śuklāṃ gāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ dadyāllalitā prīyatāmiti | anena vidhinā yā tu kuryānnārī mamālaye || 198.109 || mattulyā sā bhavedrājñāṃ tejasā śrīrivāmalā | sāvitrīva ca saundarye janmāni daśa pañca ca || 198.110 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ gauryā dvijavarottamaḥ | namaskṛtya jagāmāśu dharmarāja niveśanam || 198.111 || tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ śūleśvarīti ca | tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 198.112 || brāhmaṇānannavāsobhiḥ piṇḍaiḥ pitṛpitāmahān | bhaktopahārairdeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaraṃ || 198.113 || dhūpagugguladānaiśca dīpadānaiḥ subodhitaiḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa gacchecchivasannidhim || 198.114 || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kaścidabhiyukto nareśvara | ambhiśāpi tathā snātastridinaṃ mucyate naraḥ || 198.115 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ rātrau jāgarti yo naraḥ | upavāsaparaḥ śuddhaḥ śivaṃ sampūjayennaraḥ | pramucya pāpasaṃmohaṃ rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 198.116 || trinetraśca caturbāhuḥ sākṣādrudro'paraḥ | krīḍate devakanyābhiryāvaccandrārkatārakam || 198.117 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.199>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ rājannāśvinaṃ tīrthamuttamam | kāmikaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ prāṇināṃ siddhidāyakam || 199.1 || tatra tīrthe'śvinau devau surūpau bhiṣajāṃ varau | tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ saṃjātau yajñabhāginau || 199.2 || saṃmatau sarvadevānāmādityatanayāvubhau | nāsatyau sattvaṃ pannau sarvaduḥkhaghnasattamau || 199.3 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ādityasya sutau tāta nāsatyau yena hetunā | saṃjātau śrotumicchāmi nirṇayaṃ paramaṃ dvija || 199.4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca purāṇe bhāskare tāta etadvistarato mayā | saṃśrutaṃ devadevasya mārtaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 199.5 || tatte saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ bhaktiyuktasya bhārata | kathayāmi na sandeho vṛddhabhāvena karśitaḥ || 199.6 || atitejoraverdṛṣṭvā rājñī devī narottama | cacāra merukāntāre vaḍavā tapa ulbaṇam || 199.7 || tataḥ katipayāhasya kālasya bhagavānraviḥ | dṛṣṭvā tu rūpamutsṛjya paramaṃ teja ujjvalam || 199.8 || manobhavavaśībhūto hayo bhūtvā laghukramaḥ | visphurantī yathāprāṇaṃ dhāvamānā itastataḥ || 199.9 || heṣamāṇaḥ svareṇāsau maithunāyopacakrame | sammukhī tu tato devī nivṛttā laghuvikramā || 199.10 || yathā tathā nāsikāyāṃ praviṣṭaṃ bījamuttamam | tato nāsāgate bīje saṃjāto garbha uttamaḥ || 199.11 || jātau yataḥ sutau pārtha nāsatyau viśrutau tataḥ | susamau suvibhaktāṅgau bimbādbimbamivodyatau || 199.12 || adhikau sarvadevānāṃ rūpaiścaryasamanvitau | narmadātaṭamāśritya bhṛgukacche gatāvubhau | parāṃ siddhimanuprāptau tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram || 199.13 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ | surūpaḥ subhagaḥ pārtha jāyate yatra tatra ca || 199.14 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe āśvinatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.200>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha sāvitrītīrthamuttamam | yatra siddhā mahābhāgā sāvitrī vedamātṛkā || 200.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca sāvitrī kā dvijaśreṣṭha kathaṃ vārādhyate budhaiḥ | prasannā vā varaṃ kaṃ ca dadāti kathayasva me || 200.2 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca padmā padmāsanasthenādhiṣṭhitā padmayoginī | sāvitratejaḥsadṛśī sāvitrī tena cocyate || 200.3 || padmānanā padmavarṇā padmapatranibhekṣaṇā | dhyātavyā brāhmaṇairnityaṃ kṣatravaiśyairyathāvidhi || 200.4 || brahmahatyābhayātsā hi na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana | uccāraṇāddhāraṇādvā narake patati dhruvam || 200.5 || vedoccāraṇamātreṇa kṣatriyairdharmapālakaiḥ | jihvāchedo'sya kartavyaḥ śūdrasyeti viniścayaḥ || 200.6 || bālā bālendusadṛśī raktavastrānulepanā | uṣaḥkāle tu dhyātavyā sandhyā sandhāna uttame || 200.7 || uttuṅgapīvarakucā sumukhī śubhadarśanā | sarvābharaṇasampannā śvetamālyānulepanā || 200.8 || śvetavastraparicchannā śvetayajñopavītinī | madhyāhnasandhyā dhyātavyā taruṇā bhuktimuktidā || 200.9 || pradoṣe tu punaḥ pārtha śvetā pāṇḍuramūrdhajā | sumṛtā tu durgakāntāre mātṛvatparirakṣati || 200.10 || viśeṣeṇa tu rājendra sāvitrītīrthamuttamam | snātvācamya vidhānena manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 200.11 || prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣān saptajanmārjitānbahūn | āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayedātmanastanum || 200.12 || navaṣaṭca tathā tisrastatra tīrthe nṛpottama | āpohiṣṭheti trirāvṛtya pratigrāhairna lipyate || 200.13 || aghamarṣaṇaṃ tryṛcaṃ toyaṃ yathāvedamathāpi vā | upapāpairna lipyeta padmapatramivāmbhasā || 200.14 || tryāpaṃ hi kurute vipra ullekhatrayamācaret | caturthaṃ kārayedyastu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 200.15 || drupadākhyaśca yo mantro vede vājasaneyake | antarjale sakṛjjaptaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 200.16 || udutyamiti mantreṇa pūjayitvā divākaram | gāyatrīṃ ca japeddevīṃ pavitrāṃ vedamātaram || 200.17 || gāyatrīṃ tu japeddevīṃ yaḥ sandhyānantaraṃ dvijaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 200.18 || daśabhirjanmabhirlabdhaṃ śatena tu purākṛtam | triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam || 200.19 || gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ | nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī || 200.20 || sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu | yadanyatkurute kiṃcinna tasya phalabhāgbhavet || 200.21 || sandhyāṃ nopāsate yastu brāhmaṇo mandabuddhimān | sa jīvanneva śūdraḥ syānmṛtaḥ śvā samprajāyate || 200.22 || sāvitrītīrthamāsādya sāvitrīṃ yo japeddvijaḥ | traividyaṃ tu phalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 200.23 || pitḥnuddiśya yaḥ snātvā piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ nṛpa | kurute dvādaśābdāni tṛpyanti tatpitāmahāḥ || 200.24 || sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yaḥ kuryātprāṇasaṃkṣayam | brahmalokaṃ vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 200.25 || pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ | caturvedo dvijo rājañjāyate vimale kule || 200.26 || dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ | vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 200.27 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sāvitrītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.201>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchenmahīpāla devatīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddhā mahābhāgā devāḥ sendrā yudhiṣṭhira || 201.1 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam | tatra tīrthaprabhāvena kṛtamānantyamaśnute || 201.2 || viśeṣādbhādrapade tu kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīm | pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ devairadhyāsitaṃ purā || 201.3 || snātvā trayodaśīdine śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | devaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ devaṃ sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam | sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokamavāpnuyāt || 201.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.202>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyacchikhitīrthamanuttamam | pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pañcāyatanamuttamam || 202.1 || tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā śikhārthaṃ havyavāhanaḥ | śikhāṃ prāpya śikhī bhūtvā śikhākhyaṃ sthāpayañchivam || 202.2 || pratipacchuklapakṣe yā bhavedāśvayuje nṛpa | tadā tīrthavare gatvā snātvā vai narmadājale || 202.3 || devānṛṣīn pitḥṃścānyāṃstarpayettilavāriṇā | hiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyātsaṃtarpya ca hutāśanam || 202.4 || gandhamālyaistathā dhūpaistataḥ sampūjayecchivam | anena vidhinābhyarcya śikhitīrthe maheśvaram || 202.5 || vimānenārkavarṇena hyapsarogaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ | gīyamānastu gandharvairrudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 202.6 || śatrukṣayamavāpnoti tejasvī jāyate bhuvi || 202.7 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śikhitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.203>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharādhīśa koṭitīrthamanuttamam | yatra siddhā mahābhāgāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā maharṣayaḥ || 203.1 || tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulamṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ | tathā koṭīśvarī devī cāmuṇḍā mahiṣārdinī || 203.2 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade nṛpa | tīrthakoṭīḥ samāhūya munibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ || 203.3 || tasyāṃ tithau ca hastarkṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | tatra tīrthe tadā gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ || 203.4 || narakāduddharatyāśu puruṣānekaviṃśatim | tilodakapradānena kimuta śrāddhado naraḥ || 203.5 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam | tasya tīrthasya yogena sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 203.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.204>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhṛgutīrthaṃ tato gacchettīrtharājamanuttamam | paitāmahaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 204.1 || brahmaṇā tatra tīrthe tu purā varṣaśatatrayam | ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ śambhoḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare || 204.2 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kimarthaṃ muniśārdūla brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | ārādhayaddevadevaṃ mahābhaktyā maheśvaram || 204.3 || ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagadbhartā jagadguruḥ | śrotavyaṃ śrotumicchāmi mahadāścaryamuttamam || 204.4 || dharmaputravacaḥ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ | kathayāmāsa tadvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam || 204.5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca svaputrikāmabhigantumicchanpūrvaṃ pitāmahaḥ | śaptastu devadevena kopāviṣṭena sattama || 204.6 || vedāstava vinaśyanti jñānaṃ ca kamalāsana | apūjyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 204.7 || evaṃ datte tataḥ śāpe brahmā khedāvṛtastadā | revāyā uttare kūle snātvā varṣaśatatrayam | toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ || 204.8 || pūjyastvaṃ bhavitā loke prāpte parvaṇi parvaṇi | ahamatra ca vatsyāmi devaiśca pitṛbhiḥ saha || 204.9 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātiṃ prāptaṃ pitāmahāt | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam || 204.10 || tatra bhādrapade māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ | amāvāsyāṃ tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 204.11 || piṇḍadānena caikena tilatoyena vā nṛpa | tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 204.12 || kanyāgate tu yastatra nityaṃ śrāddhaprado bhavet | avāpya tṛptiṃ tatpūrve valganti ca hasanti ca || 204.13 || sarveṣu pitṛtīrtheṣu śrāddhaṃ kṛtvāsti yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti darśe tatra na saṃśayaḥ || 204.14 || paitāmahe naraḥ snātvā pūjayanpārvatīpatim | mucyate nātra sandehaḥ pātakaiścopapātakaiḥ || 204.15 || tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | anivartikā gatī rājanrudralokādasaṃśayam || 204.16 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe paitāmahatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.205>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gacchettataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | kurkurīnāma vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 205.1 || yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ paśuputradhanādikam | taṃ taṃ dadāti deveśī kurkurī tīrthadevatā || 205.2 || kṣetrapālo vasettatra ḍhauṇḍheśo nāma nāmataḥ | tasya cārādhanaṃ kṛtvā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || 205.3 || vandanādapi rājendra daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt | aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamuttamam || 205.4 || nārī narastathāpyevaṃ labhate kāmamuttamam | sparśanāddarśanāttasya tīrthasya vidhipūrvakam || 205.5 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kurkurītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<5.3.206>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gacchettataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam | mahādevakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 206.1 || tatra tīrthe mahādevo daśakanyā guṇānvitāḥ | brahmaṇo varayāmāsa hyudvāhena yuyoja ha || 206.2 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamakṣayaṃ kīrtitaṃ phalam || 206.3 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadāti samalaṃkṛtām | prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā svalaṃkṛtām || 206.4 || tena dānotthapuṇyena pūtātmāno narādhipa | vasanti romasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi śivasannidhau || 206.5 || tataḥ kālena mahatā tviha loke nareśvara | mānuṣyaṃ prāpya duṣprāpyaṃ dhanakoṭīpatirbhavet || 206.6 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā snātvā viprāya kāñcanam | samprayacchati śāntāya so'tyantaṃ sukhamaśnute || 206.7 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti svarṇadānena bhārata || 206.8 || naro dattvā suvarṇaṃ cāpi vālāgramātrakam | tatra tīrthe divaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 206.9 || tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhairvimānavaramāsthitaḥ | pūjyamāno vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 206.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe daśakanyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.207>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyāgre pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ svarṇabindviti viśrutam | yatra snātvā divaṃ yānti mṛtāśca na punarbhavam || 207.1 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā datte viprāya kāñcanam | tena yattu phalaṃ proktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahīpate || 207.2 || sarveṣāmeva ratnānāṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnamuttamam | agnitejaḥsamudbhūtaṃ tena tatparamaṃ bhuvi || 207.3 || tenaiva dattā pṛthivī saśailavanakānanā | sapattanapurā sarvā kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 207.4 || mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam | tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ svarṇadānena bhārata || 207.5 || svarṇadānaṃ tu yo dattvā hyapi vālāgramātrakam | tatra tīrthe mṛto yāti divaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 207.6 || tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhairvimānavaramāsthitaḥ | pūjyamāno vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam || 207.7 || pūrṇe tatra tataḥ kāle prāpya mānuṣyamuttamam | suvarṇakoṭisahite gṛhe vai jāyate dvijaḥ || 207.8 || sarvavyādhivinirmuktaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ | jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ rājasaṃ satsu viśrutaḥ || 207.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇabindutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.208>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhūmipāla tato gacchettīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pitḥṇāmṛṇamocanam || 208.1 || tatra snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | manuṣyaśca nṛpaśreṣṭha dānaṃ dattvānṛṇo bhavet || 208.2 || icchanti pitaraḥ sarve svārthahetoḥ sutaṃ yataḥ | punnāmno narakātputro'smānayaṃ mocayiṣyati || 208.3 || piṇḍadānaṃ jalaṃ tāta ṛṇamuttamamucyate | pitḥṇāṃ taddhi vai proktamṛṇaṃ daivamataḥ param || 208.4 || agnihotraṃ tathā yajñāḥ paśubandhāstatheṣṭayaḥ | iti devarṇaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu mānuṣyakaṃ tataḥ || 208.5 || brāhmaṇeṣu ca tīrtheṣu devāyatanakarmasu | pratiśrutya dadettattadvyavahāraḥ kṛto yathā || 208.6 || ṛṇatrayamidaṃ proktaṃ putrāṇāṃ dharmanandana | satputrāste tu rājendra snātā ya ṛṇamocane || 208.7 || ṛṇatrayādvimucyante hyaputrāḥ putriṇastathā | tasmāttīrthavaraṃ prāpya putreṇa niyatātmanā | pitṛbhyastarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 208.8 || tatra tīrthe hutaṃ dattaṃ guravastoṣitā yadi | mṛtānāṃ sapta janmāni phalamakṣayamaśnute || 208.9 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ṛṇamocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.209>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha puṣkalītīrthamuttamam | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā hyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 209.1 || kṣamānāthaṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam | dānavagandharvairapsarobhiśca sevitam || 209.2 || tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sākṣādrudro maheśvaraḥ | bhāreṇa mahatā jāto bhārabhūtiriti smṛtaḥ || 209.3 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca bhārabhūtīti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam | śrotumicchāmi viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 209.4 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca bhārabhūtisamutpattiṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍavasattama | vistareṇa yathā proktā purā devena śambhunā || 209.5 || āsītkṛtayuge vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | viṣṇuśarmeti vikhyātaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 209.6 || kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dhṛtistathā | vidyā vijñānamāstikyaṃ sarvaṃ tasminpratiṣṭhitam || 209.7 || īdṛgguṇā hi ye viprā bhavanti nṛpasattama | patitānnarake ghore tārayanti pitḥṃstu te || 209.8 || indriyaṃ lolupā viprā ye bhavanti nṛpottama | patanti narake ghore raurave pāpamohitāḥ || 209.9 || ye kṣāntadāntāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhānnivṛttāḥ | pratigrahe saṃkucitāgrahastāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ || 209.10 || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo brāhmaṇo narmadātaṭe | vasate brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ śiloñchavṛttijīvanaḥ || 209.11 || tādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jñātvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ | dvijarūpadharo bhūtvā tasyāśramamagātsvayam || 209.12 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhamuccarantaṃ padakramam | abhivādayate vipraṃ svāgatena ca pūjitaḥ || 209.13 || provāca taṃ muhūrtena brāhmaṇo vismayānvitaḥ | kimatha tadbaṭo brūhi kiṃ karomi tavepsitam || 209.14 || baṭuruvāca vidyārthinamanuprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ dvijasattama | dadāsi yadi me vidyāṃ tataḥ sthāsyāmi te gṛhe || 209.15 || brāhmaṇa uvāca sarveṣāmeva viprāṇāṃ baṭo tvaṃ gotra uttame | dānānāṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ kathaṃ vidyā ca dīyate || 209.16 || guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā | athavā vidyayā vidyā bhavatīha phalapradā || 209.17 || baṭuruvāca yathānye bālakāḥ snātāḥ śuśrūṣanti hyaharniśam | tathāhaṃ baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ śuśrūṣāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 209.18 || tatheti coktvā viprendraḥ pāṭhayaṃstaṃ dine dine | vartate saha śiṣyaiḥ sa śiloñchānupahārayan || 209.19 || tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ prokto baṭubhirīśvaraḥ | pacanādyaṃ baṭo karma kuru kramata āgatam || 209.20 || tatheti cokto deveśo bhāragrāmamupāgataḥ | dhyātvā vanaspatīḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 209.21 || yāvadāgacchate vipro baṭubhiḥ saha mandiram | adarśanābhiḥ kartavyaṃ tāvadannaṃ susaṃskṛtam || 209.22 || evamuktvā tu tāḥ sarvā viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ | krīḍanārthaṃ gatastatra baṭuveṣadharaḥ pṛthak || 209.23 || dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ tatra baṭuveṣadharaṃ pṛthak | dhiktvāṃ ca paruṣaṃ vākyamūcuste girisannidhau || 209.24 || kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhāḥ sarve ca gatvā tu kila mandiram | tvayā siddhena cānnena tṛptiṃ yāsyāmahe vayam || 209.25 || tadvṛthā cintitaṃ sava tvayāgatya kṛtaṃ dvija | mithyāpratijñena satā duranuṣṭhitamadya te || 209.26 || baṭuruvāca santāpamanutāpaṃ vā bhojanārthaṃ dvijarṣabhāḥ | mā kurudhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ siddhe'gre gṛhameṣyathā || 209.27 || baṭuruvāca dinaśeṣeṇa cāsmākaṃ pañcatāṃ ca dine dine | niṣpattiṃ yāti vā neti tadasiddhamaśeṣataḥ || 209.28 || asiddhaṃ siddhamasmākaṃ yattvayā samudāhṛtam | dṛṣṭvānṛtaṃ gatāstatra tvāṃ baddhāmbhasi nikṣipe || 209.29 || baṭuruvāca bhobhoḥ śṛṇudhva sarve'tra sopādhyāyā dvijottamāḥ | pratijñāṃ mama durdharṣāṃ yāṃ śrutvā vismayo bhavet || 209.30 || yadi siddhamidaṃ sarvamannaṃ syādāśrame guroḥ | yūyaṃ baddhvā mayā sarve kṣeptavyā narmadāmbhasi || 209.31 || athavānnaṃ na siddhaṃ syādbhavadbhirdṛḍhabandhanaiḥ | gurostu paśyato baddhvā kṣeptavyo'haṃ narmadāhrade || 209.32 || tatheti kṛtvā te sarve samayaṃ gurusannidhau | snātvā jāpyavidhānena bhūtagrāmaṃ tato yayuḥ || 209.33 || dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ jagmurvistṛte bhakṣyabhojane | ṣaḍrasena nṛpaśreṣṭha bhuktvā hutvā pṛthakpṛthak || 209.34 || tataḥ provāca vacanaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭo dvijottamaḥ | varado'smi varaṃ vatsa vṛṇu yattava rocate || 209.35 || sāṅgopāṅgāstu te vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca | pratibhāsyanti te vipra madīyo'stu varastvayam || 209.36 || praṇamya baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sa cikrīḍa yathāsukham | dvitīye tu tataḥ prāpte divase narmadājale || 209.37 || krīḍanārthaṃ gatāḥ sarve sopādhyāyā yudhiṣṭhira | tataḥ smṛtvā paṇaṃ sarve bhāṣayitvā vidhānataḥ || 209.38 || upādhyāyamathovāca natvā devaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | jale prakṣepayāmyadya niṣpratijñān baṭūn prabho || 209.39 || taddevasya vacaḥ śrutvā naṣṭāste baṭavo nṛpa | gurostu paśyato rājandhāvamānā diśo daśa || 209.40 || vāyuvegena devena luñjitāste samantataḥ | bhāraṃ baddhvā tu sarveṣāṃ baṭūnāṃ ca nareśvara || 209.41 || śāpānugrahako devo'kṣipattoye yathā gṛhe | tato viṣādamagamaddṛṣṭvā tānnarmadājale || 209.42 || guruṇā baṭurukto'tha kimetatsāhasaṃ kṛtam | eteṣāṃ mātṛpitaro bālakānāṃ gṛhe'ṅganāḥ || 209.43 || yadi pṛcchanti te bālān kva gatān kathayāmyaham | evaṃ sthite mahābhāga yadi kaścinmariṣyati || 209.44 || tadā svakīyajīvena tvaṃ yojayitumarhasi | mṛteṣu teṣu vipreṣu na jīve niścayo mṛtaḥ || 209.45 || brahmahatyāśca te bahvyo bhaviṣyanti mṛte mayi | dvijabandhanamātreṇa narako bhavati dhruvam || 209.46 || maraṇādyāṃ gatiṃ yāsi na tāṃ vedmi dvijādhama | evamuktaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 209.47 || bhārabhūteśvare tīrtha ujjahāra jalāddvijān | muktvā bhāraṃ tu devena chādayitvā tu tāndvijān || 209.48 || liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tatra bhārabhūteti viśrutam | mṛtāṃstān vai dvijān dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyā nirākṛtā || 209.49 || gatāni pañca vai dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyāśatāni vai | tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā tānbālakān guruḥ || 209.50 || nānyasya kasyacicchaktirevaṃ syādīśvaraṃ vinā | jñātvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ praṇāmamakaroddvijaḥ || 209.51 || ajñānena mayā sava yaduktaṃ parameśvara | apriyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣantavyaṃ tanmama prabho || 209.52 || deva uvāca bhagavangururbhavāndevo bhavānmama pitāmahaḥ | vedagarbha namaste'stu nāsti kaścidvyatikramaḥ || 209.53 || janitā copanetā ca yastu vidyāṃ prayacchati | annadātā bhayatrātā pañcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 209.54 || evamuktvā jagannātho viṣṇuśarmāṇamānataḥ | tatra tīrthe jagāmāśu kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam || 209.55 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhārabhūtīti viśrutam | vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam || 209.56 || tatra tīrthe punarvṛttamitihāsaṃ bravīmi te | sarvapāpaharaṃ divyamekāgrastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat || 209.57 || purā kṛtayugasyādau vaiśyaḥ kaścinmahāmanāḥ | sukeśa iti vikhyātastasya putro'tidhārmikaḥ || 209.58 || somaśarmeti vikhyāto mṛtaḥ pṛthulalocanaḥ | sa sakhāyaṃ vaṇikputraṃ kaṃciccakre daridriṇam || 209.59 || sudevamiti khyātaṃ sarvakarmasu kovidam | ekadā tu samaṃ tena vyavahāramacintayat || 209.60 || sakhe samudrayānena gacchāvottaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | bhāṇḍaṃ bahu samādāya madīye dravyasādhane || 209.61 || paraṃ tīraṃ gamiṣyāva utkarṣastvāvayoḥ samaḥ | iti tau mantrayitvā tu mantravatsamabhīpsitam || 209.62 || sarvaṃ prayāṇakaṃ gṛhya hyārūḍhau lavaṇodadhim | tau gatvā tu paraṃ bhāṇḍaṃ vikrīya puratastadā || 209.63 || prāptau bahu suvarṇaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca | nāvaṃ tāṃ saṃgatāṃ kṛtvā paścāttāvārurohatuḥ || 209.64 || nāvamantarjale dṛṣṭvā niśīthe svarṇasaṃbhṛtām | dṛṣṭvā tu somaśarmāṇamutsaṅge kṛtamastakam || 209.65 || śayānamativiśvastaṃ sahadevo vyacintayat | eṣa nidrāvaśaṃ yāto mayi prāṇānnidhāya vai || 209.66 || asyādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ dravyaratnamaśeṣataḥ | utkarṣārddhaṃ tu me dadyāttatra gatveti vā na vā || 209.67 || iti niścitya manasā pāpastaṃ lavaṇodadhau | cikṣepa somaśarmāṇaṃ pāpadhyātena cetasā || 209.68 || uttīrya taraṇāttasmādgatvā saṃgṛhya taddhanam | tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā || 209.69 || gato yamapuraṃ ghoraṃ gṛhīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ | sa nītastena mārgeṇa yatra saṃtapate raviḥ || 209.70 || kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ samprāpte pralaye yathā | sutīkṣṇāḥ kaṇṭakā yatra yatra śvānaḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 209.71 || tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā mahāvyālā vyāghrā yatra mahāvṛkāḥ | sutaptā vālukā yatra kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tamo mahat || 209.72 || pānīyasya kathā nāsti na chāyā nāśramaḥ kvacit | annaṃ pānīyasahitaṃ yāvattaddīyate viṣam || 209.73 || chāyāṃ saṃprārthamānānāṃ bhṛśaṃ jvalati pāvakaḥ | tairdahyamānā bahuśo vilapanti muhurmuhuḥ || 209.74 || hā bhrātarmātaḥ putreti patanti pathi mūrchitāḥ | itthaṃbhūtena mārgeṇa sa gīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 209.75 || yatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ | te dvāradeśe taṃ muktvācakṣuryamakiṃkarāḥ || 209.76 || baddhvā taṃ galapāśena hyāsīnaṃ mitraghātinam | avadhāraya deveśa budhyasva yadanantaram || 209.77 || yama uvāca na tu pūrvaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā viśvāsaghātinām | ye mitradrohiṇaḥ pāpāsteṣāṃ kiṃ śāsanaṃ bhavet || 209.78 || ṛṣayo'tra vicārārthaṃ niyuktā nipuṇāḥ sthitāḥ | te yatra bruvate tatra kṣipadhvaṃ mā vicāryatām || 209.79 || ityuktāste tamādāya kiṃkarāḥ śīghragāminaḥ | munīśāṃstatra tānūcustaṃ nivedya yamājñayā || 209.80 || dvijā anena mitraṃ svaṃ prasuptaṃ niśi ghātitam | viśvastaṃ dhanalobhena ko daṇḍo'sya bhaviṣyati || 209.81 || munaya ūcuḥ | adṛṣṭapūrvamasmābhirvadanaṃ mitraghātinām | kṛtvā paṭāntare hyenaṃ śṛṇvantu gatimasya tām || 209.82 || te śāstrāṇi vicāryātha ṛṣayaśca parasparam | āhūya yamadūtāṃstānūcurbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ || 209.83 || ālokitāni śāstrāṇi vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ smṛtīrapi | purāṇāni ca mīmāṃsā dṛṣṭamasmābhiratra ca || 209.84 || brahmaghne ca surāpe ca steye gurvaṅganāgame | niṣkṛtirvihitā śāstre kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 209.85 || ye strīghnāśca gurughnāśca ye bālabrahmaghātinaḥ | vihitā niṣkṛtiḥ śāstre kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 209.86 || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ bhettāro ye ca pāpinaḥ | udyānavāṭikānāṃ ca chettāro ye ca durjanāḥ || 209.87 || dāvāgnidāhakā ye ca satataṃ ye'suhiṃsakāḥ | nyāsāpahāriṇo ye ca garadāḥ svāmivañcakāḥ || 209.88 || mātāpitṛgurūṇāṃ ca tyāgino doṣadāyinaḥ | svabhartṛvañcanaparā yā strī garbhapraghātinī || 209.89 || vivekarahitā yā strī yāsnātā bhojane ratā | dvikālabhojanaratāstathā vaiṣṇavavāsare || 209.90 || tāsāṃ strīṇāṃ gatirdṛṣṭā na tu viśvāsaghātinām | viśvāsaghātināṃ puṃsāṃ mitradrohakṛtāṃ tathā || 209.91 || teṣāṃ gatirna vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca kā kathā | iti sthiteṣu pāpeṣu gatireṣāṃ na vidyate || 209.92 || nānyā gatirmitrahanane viśvastaghne ca naḥ śrutam | ito nītvā yamadūtā enaṃ viśvastaghātinam || 209.93 || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ paryāyeṇa pṛthakpṛthak | narakeṣu ca sarveṣu triṃśatkoṭiṣu saṃkhyayā || 209.94 || kṣipyatāmeṣa mitraghno vicāro mā vidhīyatām | iti te vacanaṃ śrutvā kiṃkarāstaṃ nigṛhya ca || 209.95 || yatra te narakā ghorāstatra kṣeptuṃ gatāstataḥ | te tamādāya hi narake ghore rauravasaṃjñite || 209.96 || cikṣipustatra pāpiṣṭhaṃ kṣipte rāvo'bhavanmahān | narakasthitabhūteṣu moktavyo naiṣa pāpakṛt || 209.97 || asya saṃsparśanādeva pīḍā śataguṇā bhavet | yathā vyathāsikāṣṭhaiśca samiddhairdahanātmakaiḥ || 209.98 || bhavati sparśanāttasya kimetena kṛtāmalam | yathā durjanasaṃsargātsujano yāti lāghavam || 209.99 || sannidhānāttathāsyāśu kṣate kṣārāvasecanam | prasādaḥ kriyatāmāśu nīyatāṃ narake'nyataḥ || 209.100 || evamuktāstatastaistu gatāste tvaśuciṃ prati | tatra te nārakāḥ santi pūrvavatte'pi cukruśuḥ || 209.101 || evaṃ te kiṃkarāḥ sarve paryaṭannarakamaṇḍale | narake'pi sthitistasya nāsti pāpasya durmateḥ || 209.102 || yadā tadā tu te sarve taṃ gṛhya yamasannidhau | gatvā nivedya tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ nārakairnaraiḥ | narake na sthitiryasya tasya kiṃ kriyatāṃ vada || 209.103 || yama uvāca pāpiṣṭha eṣa vai yātu yoniṃ tiryaṅniṣevitām | kālaṃ munibhiruddiṣṭaḥ tiryagyoniṃ praveśyatām || 209.104 || evamukte tu vacane prajāsaṃyamanena ca | sa gataḥ kṛmitāṃ pāpo viṣṭhāsu ca pṛthakpṛthak || 209.105 || tato'sau daṃśamaśakān pipīlikasamudbhavān | yūkāmatkuṇakāḍhyāṃśca gatvā pakṣitvamāgataḥ || 209.106 || sthāvaratvaṃ gataḥ paścātpāṣāṇatvaṃ tataḥ param | sarīsṛpānajagaravarāhamṛgahastinaḥ || 209.107 || vṛkaśvānakharoṣṭrāṃśca sūkarīṃ grāmajātikām | yonimāśvatarīṃ prāpya tathā mahiṣasambhavām || 209.108 || etāścānyāśca bahvīrvai prāpa yonīḥ krameṇa vai | sa tā yonīranuprāpya dhuryo'bhūdbhāravāhakaḥ || 209.109 || sa gṛhe pārthiveśasya dhārmikasya yaśasvinaḥ | sa dṛṣṭvā kārttikīṃ prāptāmekadā nṛpasattamaḥ || 209.110 || purohitaṃ samāhūya brāhmaṇāṃśca tathā bahūn | na gṛhe kārttikīṃ kuryādetanme bahuśaḥ śrutam || 209.111 || sametāḥ kutra yāsyāma iti brūta dvijottamāḥ | yo gṛhe kārttikīṃ kuryātsnānadānādivarjitaḥ || 209.112 || saṃvatsarakṛtātpuṇyātsa bahirbhavati śrutiḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam || 209.113 || sahitāstatra gacchāmaḥ snātuṃ dātuṃ ca śaktitaḥ | evamukte tu vacane pārthivena dvijottamāḥ || 209.114 || ūcuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nṛpatheṣṭha revāyā uttare taṭe | bhāreśvareti vikhyātaṃ muktitīrthaṃ nṛpottama || 209.115 || tatra yāmo vayaṃ sarve sarvapāpakṣayāvaham | evamuktaḥ sa nṛpatirgṛhītvā pracuraṃ vasu || 209.116 || śakaṭaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ kṛtvā tatra yuktaḥ sa dhūrvahaḥ | yaḥ kṛtvā mitrahananaṃ goyoniṃ samupāgataḥ || 209.117 || itthaṃ sa narmadātīre samprāptastīrthamuttamam | gatvā caturdaśīdine hyupavāsakṛtakṣaṇaḥ || 209.118 || gatvā sa narmadātīre nāma rudretyanusmaran | śucipradeśācca mṛdaṃ mantreṇānena gṛhyatām || 209.119 || uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa rudreṇa śatabāhunā | ahamapyuddhariṣyāmi prajayā bandhanena ca || 209.120 || sa evaṃ tāṃ mṛdaṃ nītvā muktvā tīre tathottare | dadarśa bhāskaraṃ paścānmantreṇānena cālabhet || 209.121 || aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasuṃdhare | mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ janmakoṭiśatārjitam || 209.122 || tata evaṃ vigāhyāpo mantrametamudīrayet | tvaṃ narmade puṇyajale tavāmbhaḥ śaṅkarodbhavam || 209.123 || snānaṃ prakurvato me'dya pāpaṃ haratu cārjitam | sa snātvānena vidhinā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || 209.124 || yayau devālayaṃ paścādupahāraiḥ samanvitaḥ | bhaktyā saṃcintya sānnidhye śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram || 209.125 || purāṇoktavidhānena pūjāṃ samupacakrame | pūjācatuṣṭayaṃ devi śivarātryāṃ nigadyate || 209.126 || saṃsnāpya prathame yāme pañcagavyena śaṅkaram | ghṛtena pūraṇaṃ paścātkṛtaṃ nṛpavareṇa tu || 209.127 || dhūpadīpanaivedyādyaṃ saṃkalpya ca yathāvidhi | argheṇānena deveśaṃ mantreṇānena śaṅkaram || 209.128 || namaste devadeveśa śambho paramakāraṇa | gṛhāṇārghamimaṃ deva saṃsārāghamapākuru || 209.129 || vittānurūpato dattaṃ suvarṇaṃ mantrakalpitam | agnirhi devāḥ sarve suvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanāt || 209.130 || ataḥ suvarṇadānena prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ | tadarghaṃ sarvadā dātuḥ prīto bhavatu śaṅkaraḥ || 209.131 || anena vidhinā tena pūjitaḥ prathame śivaḥ | yāme dvitīye tu punaḥ pūrvoktavidhinā caret || 209.132 || snāpayāmāsa dugdhena gavyena tripurāntakam | taṃdulaiḥ pūraṇaṃ paścātkṛtaṃ liṅgasya śūlinaḥ || 209.133 || kṛtvā vidhānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ dattaṃ vastrayugaṃ sitam | śvetavastrayugaṃ yasmācchaṅkarasyātivallabham || 209.134 || prīto bhavati vai śambhurdattena śvetavāsasā | yāmaṃ tṛtīyaṃ samprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatisattamaḥ || 209.135 || devaṃ saṃsnāpya madhunā pūraṇaṃ cakrivāṃstilaiḥ | tiladroṇapradānaṃ ca kuryānmantramudīrayan || 209.136 || tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sarvapāpaharāstilāḥ | tiladroṇapradānenu saṃsāraśchidyatāṃ mama || 209.137 || anena vidhinā rājā yāminīyāmapūjanam | ativāhya vinodena brahmaghoṣeṇa jāgaram || 209.138 || cakāra pūjanaṃ śambhorbahupuṇyaprasādhakam | ye jāgare trinetrasya śivarātryāṃ śivasthitāḥ || 209.139 || te yāṃ gatiṃ gatāḥ pārtha na tāṃ gacchanti yajvinaḥ | pāpāni yāni kāni syuḥ koṭijanmārjitānyapi || 209.140 || harakeśavayoḥ snānti jāgare yānti saṃkṣayam | yāvanto nimiṣā nṛṇāṃ bhavanti niśi jāgratām || 209.141 || nimiṣe nimiṣe rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ dhruvam | upavāsaparāṇāṃ ca devāyatanavāsinām || 209.142 || śṛṇvatāṃ dharmamākhyānaṃ dhyāyatāṃ harakeśavau | na tāṃ bahusuvarṇena kratunā gatimāpnuyuḥ || 209.143 || śivarātristithiḥ puṇyā kārttikī ca viśeṣataḥ | revāyā uttaraṃ kūlaṃ tīraṃ bhāreśvareti ca || 209.144 || jāgṛtaścātiduḥkhena kathaṃ pāpaṃ na hāsyati | itthaṃsa jāgaraṃ kṛtvā śivarātryāṃ nareśvaraḥ || 209.145 || prabhāte vimale gatvā narmadātīramuttamam | snāpitāstena te sarve vāhanāni gajādayaḥ || 209.146 || yaistu vāhairgatastīrthaṃ snāto'haṃ snāpayāmi tān | tatra madhyasthitaḥ snātastiryaktvānnirgato vaṇik || 209.147 || dānaṃ dadau tānuddiśya kiṃcicchaktyanurūpataḥ | tena vāhakṛtāddoṣānmukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 209.148 || anyathāsau kṛto lābhaḥ kṛto vrajati tān prati | saṃsnāpya taṃ tato rājā svayaṃ snātvā vidhānataḥ || 209.149 || saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi | kṛtvā piṇḍānpitṛbhyaśca vṛṣamutsṛjya lakṣaṇam || 209.150 || gatvā devālayaṃ paścāddevaṃ tīrthodakena ca | saṃsnāpya pañcagavyena tataḥ pañcāmṛtena ca || 209.151 || sarvauṣadhijalenaiva tataḥ śuddhodakena ca | candanena sugandhena samālabhya ca śaṅkaram || 209.152 || kuṅkumaiśca sakarpūrairgandhaiśca vividhaistathā | puṣpaughaiśca sugandhāḍhyaiścaturthaṃ liṅgapūraṇam || 209.153 || kṛtaṃ nṛpavareṇātra kurvatā pūrvakaṃ vidhim | godānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ paścādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 209.154 || dhenuke rudrarūpāsi rudreṇa parinirmitā | asminnagādhe saṃsāre patantaṃ māṃ samuddhara || 209.155 || dhenuṃ svalaṃkṛtāṃ dadyādanena vidhinā tataḥ | kṣamāpya devadeveśaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayedbahūn || 209.156 || ṣaḍvidhairbhojanairbhakṣyairvāsobhistān samarcayet | dakṣiṇābhirvicitrābhiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet || 209.157 || sa svayaṃ bubhuje paścātparivārasamanvitaḥ | tāmeva rajanīṃ tatra nyavasajjagatīpatiḥ || 209.158 || tasya tatroṣitasyaivaṃ niśīthe'tha nareśvara | ākāśe so'ti śuśrāva divyavāṇīsamīritam || 209.159 || vāguvāca rājansamaṃ tato loke phalaṃ bhavati sāmpratam | saṃsārasāgare hyatra patitānāṃ durātmanām || 209.160 || yadi saṃnidhimātreṇa phalaṃ tatrocyate katham | yadi śaṃtanuvaṃśasya tatronmādakaraṃ bhavet || 209.161 || ya eṣa tvadgṛhe voḍhā hyatibhāradhuraṃdharaḥ | anena mitrahananaṃ pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātanam || 209.162 || kṛtaṃ janmasahasrāṇāmatīte parijanmani | gatena pāpmanātmānaṃ narakeṣu ca saṃsthitiḥ || 209.163 || tato yonisahasreṣu gatistiryakṣu caiva hi | goyoniṃ samanuprāptastvadgṛhe sa sudurmatiḥ || 209.164 || snāpitaśca tvayā tīrthe hyasmin parvasamāgame | dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ tvayā kḷptāṃ kṛtā jāgaraṇakriyā || 209.165 || tena niṣkalmaṣo jāto muktvā dehaṃ tavāgrataḥ | svargaṃ prati vimānasthaḥ so'dya rājangamiṣyati || 209.166 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evamukte nipatito dhuryaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata | vimānavaramārūḍhastatkṣaṇātsamadṛśyata || 209.167 || sa taṃ praṇamya rājendramuvāca prahasanniva || 209.168 || vṛṣa uvāca bhobho nṛpavaraśreṣṭha tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | yatra cāsmadvidhastīrthe mucyate pātakairnaraḥ | mayā jñātamaśeṣeṇa matsamo nāsti pātakī || 209.169 || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ tu kuryāṃ paraṃ tīrthānukīrtanam | bhavānmātā bhavanbhrātā bhavāṃścaiva pitāmahaḥ || 209.170 || kṣantavyaṃ praṇato'smyadya yasmiṃstīrthe hi mādṛśāḥ | gatimīdṛgvidhāṃ yānti na jāne tava kā gatiḥ || 209.171 || samārādhya maheśānaṃ sampūjya ca yathāvidhi | kā gatistava saṃbhāṣyā dehyanujñāṃ mama prabho || 209.172 || tvarayanti ca māṃ hyete divisthāḥ praṇayādgaṇāḥ | svastyastu te gamiṣyāmītyuktvā so'ntardadhe kṣaṇāt || 209.173 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca gate cādarśanaṃ tatra sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ | tīrthamāhātmyamatulaṃ varṇayansvapuraṃ gataḥ || 209.174 || itthaṃbhūtaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam | sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam || 209.175 || upapāpāni naśyanti snānamātreṇa bhārata | kārttikasya caturdaśyāmupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 209.176 || caturdhā pūrayelliṅgaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ || 209.177 || mahāpāpāni catvāri caturbhiryānti saṃkṣayam | so'śvamedhasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamam || 209.178 || kārttike śuklapakṣasya caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | svarṇadānācca tattīrthe yajñasya labhate phalam || 209.179 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe māsi pūrvavat | dīpaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā pitḥn sarvān vimokṣayet || 209.180 || tatra yaddīyate dānamapi vālāgramātrakam | tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamevamāha maheśvaraḥ || 209.181 || bhārabhūtyāṃ mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | anivartikā gatī rājañchivalokānnirantaram || 209.182 || athavā lokavṛttyarthaṃ martyalokaṃ jigīṣati | sāṅgavedajñaviprāṇāṃ jāyate vimale kule || 209.183 || dhanadhānyasamāyukto vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ | sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 209.184 || punastattīrthamāsādya hyakṣayaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 209.185 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ kathitaṃ te nṛpottama | bhāratedaṃ mahākhyānaṃ śṛṇu caiva tataḥ param || 209.186 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhārabhūtitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.210>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta puṅkhilaṃ tīrthamuttamam | tatra tīrthe purā puṅkhaḥ pārtha siddhimupāgataḥ || 210.1 || jāmadagnyo mahātejāḥ kṣatriyāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ | tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ narmadottaratīrabhāk || 210.2 || tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ puṅkhatīrthaṃ nareśvara | tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyārādhya parameśvaram || 210.3 || ihaloke balairyuktaḥ pare mokṣamavāpnuyāt | devānpitḥn samabhyarcya pitḥṇāmanṛṇī bhavet || 210.4 || tatra tīrthe naro yastu prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 210.5 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 210.6 || tatra tīrthe naro yastu brāhmaṇān bhojayennṛpa | ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 210.7 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitpūjayedvṛṣabhadhvajam | vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 210.8 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe puṅkhilatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.211>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca āścaryabhūtaṃ lokasya devadevena yatkṛtam | tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi narmadātaṭavāsinām || 211.1 || dvijān sukṛtpaṇān devaḥ kuṣṭhī bhūtvā yayāca ha | śrāddhakāle tu samprāpte raktagandhānulepanaḥ || 211.2 || sravadbudbudagātrastu makṣikākṛmisaṃvṛtaḥ | duścarmā durmukho gandhī praskhalaṃśca pade pade || 211.3 || brāhmaṇāvasathaṃ gatvā skhalandvāre'bravīdidam | bhobho gṛhapate tvadya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhojanam || 211.4 || tvadgṛhe kartumicchāmi hyebhiḥ saha susaṃskṛtam | tatastaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajamānasamanvitāḥ || 211.5 || sravantaṃ sarvagātreṣu dhigdhigityevamabruvan | nirgacchasvāśu durgandha gṛhācchīghraṃ dvijādhama || 211.6 || abhojyametatsarveṣāṃ darśanāttava satkṛtam | evameva tathetyuktvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 211.7 || jagāmākāśamamalaṃ dṛśyamāno dvijottamaiḥ | gate cādarśanaṃ deve snātvābhyukṣya samantataḥ || 211.8 || bhuñjate'sma dvijā rājanyāvatpātre pṛthakpṛthak | yatrayatra ca paśyanti tatratatra kṛmirbahuḥ || 211.9 || dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpannāḥ sarve kimiti cābruvan | tataḥ kaściduvācedaṃ brāhmaṇo guṇavānajaḥ || 211.10 || yogīndraḥ śaṅkayā tatra bahuviprasamāgame | yo'tra pūrvaṃ samāyātaḥ sa yogī parameśvaraḥ || 211.11 || tasyedaṃ krīḍitaṃ manye bhartsitasya vipākajam | phalaṃ bhavati nānyasya hyatitheḥ śāstraniścayāt || 211.12 || sampūjya paramātmā vai hyatithiśca viśeṣataḥ | śrāddhakāle tu samprāptamatithiṃ yo na pūjayet || 211.13 || piśācā rākṣasāstasya tadvilumpantyasaṃśayam | rūpānvitaṃ virūpaṃ vā malinaṃ malināmbaram || 211.14 || yogīndraṃ śvapacaṃ vāpi atithiṃ na vicārayet | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yajamānapurogamāḥ || 211.15 || brāhmaṇā dvijamanveṣṭuṃ dhāvitāḥ sarvatodiśam | tāvatkathaṃcitkenāpi gahanaṃ vanamāśritaḥ || 211.16 || dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭa iti proktaṃ tena te sarva āgatāḥ | tataḥ paśyanti taṃ vipraṃ sthāṇuvanniścalaṃ sthitam || 211.17 || krandate na calati spandate na ca paśyati | jalpanti karuṇaṃ kecitstuvanti ca tathāpare || 211.18 || vāgbhiḥ satatamiṣṭābhiḥ stūyamānastrilocanaḥ | kṣudhārditānāṃ deveśa brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | vinaṣṭamannaṃ sarveṣāṃ punaḥ saṃkartumarhasi || 211.19 || śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira | parayā kṛpayā devaḥ prasannastānuvāca ha || 211.20 || mayā prasannena mahānubhāvāstadeva vo'nnaṃ vihitaṃ sudheva | bhuñjantu viprāḥ saha bandhubhṛtyairarcantu nityaṃ mama maṇḍalaṃ ca || 211.21 || tataścāyatanaṃ pārtha devadevasya śūlinaḥ | muṇḍināmeti vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham | kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa gayātīrthena tatsamam || 211.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe muṇḍitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.212>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca athānyatsampravakṣyāmi devasya caritaṃ mahat | śrutamātreṇa yenāśu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 212.1 || bhikṣurūpaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ | ekaśālāṃ gato grāmaṃ bhikṣārthī kṣutpipāsitaḥ || 212.2 || akṣasūtrodyatakaro bhasmaguṇṭhitavigrahaḥ | sphurattriśūlo viśveśo jaṭākuṇḍalabhūṣitaḥ || 212.3 || kṛttivāsā mahākāyo mahāhikṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ | vādayanvai ḍamarukaṃ ḍiṇḍimapratimaṃ śubham || 212.4 || kapālapāṇirbhagavānbālakairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | kvacidgāyanhasaṃścaiva nṛtyanvadan kvacitkvacit || 212.5 || yatra yatra gṛhe devo līlayā ḍiṇḍamaṃ nyaset | bhārākrāntaṃ gṛhaṃ pārtha tatratatra vinaśyati || 212.6 || evaṃ sampracaran devo veṣṭito bahubhirjanaiḥ | dṛśyādṛśyena rūpeṇa nirjagāma bahiḥ prabhuḥ || 212.7 || itaścetaśca dhāvantaṃ na paśyanti yadā janāḥ | vismitāste sthitāḥ śambhurbhaviṣyati tato'stuvan || 212.8 || teṣāṃ tu stuvatāṃ bhaktyā śaṅkaraṃ jagatāṃ patim | ḍiṇḍirūpo hi bhagavāṃstadāsau pratyadṛśyata || 212.9 || tadāprabhṛti deveśo ḍiṇḍimeśvara ucyate | darśanātsparśanādrājan sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 212.10 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ekaśālaḍiṇḍimeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.213>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca punaranyatpravakṣyāmi devasya caritaṃ mahat | śrutamātreṇa yenaiva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 213.1 || abālo bālarūpeṇa grāmaṇyairbālakaiḥ saha | āmalaiḥ krīḍate śambhustatte vakṣyāmi bhārata || 213.2 || sarvaistairāmalāḥ kṣiptā ye te devena pāṇḍava | ānītāstatkṣaṇādeva tataḥ paścātkṣipeddharaḥ || 213.3 || yāvadgatvā diśo digbhya āgacchanti pṛthakpṛthak | tāvattamāmalaṃ bhūtaṃ paśyanti parameśvaram || 213.4 || tṛtīye caiva yatkarma devadevasya dhīmataḥ | sthānānāṃ paramaṃ sthānamāmaleśvaramuttamam || 213.5 || tena pūjitamātreṇa prāpyate paramaṃ padam || 213.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe āmaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.214>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca caturthaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devasya caritaṃ mahat | śrutamātreṇa yenaiva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 214.1 || kapālī kānthiko bhūtvā yathā sa vyacaranmahīm | piśācairrākṣasairbhūtairḍākinīyoginīvṛtaḥ || 214.2 || bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya pretāsanaparigrahaḥ | trailokyasyābhayaṃ dattvā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 214.3 || āṣāḍhī tu kṛtā tatra hyāṣāḍhīnāma viśrutam | kanthā muktā tato'nyatra devena parameṣṭhinā || 214.4 || tadāprabhṛti rājendra sa kantheśvara ucyate | tasya darśanamātreṇa hyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 214.5 || devo mārge punastatra bhramate ca yadṛcchayā | vikrīṇāti balākāro dṛṣṭvā cokto hareṇa tu || 214.6 || yadi bhadra na cetkopaṃ karoṣi mayi sāmpratam | balābhirbhara me liṅgaṃ dadāmi bahu te dhanam || 214.7 || evamukto'tha devena sa vaṇiglobhamohitaḥ | yojayāmāsa balakā liṅge cottamamadhyamān || 214.8 || tāvadyāvatkṣayaṃ sarve gatāḥ kāle susaṃcitāḥ | sthitaṃ samunnataṃ liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamupāgamat || 214.9 || kṛtvā tu khaṇḍakhaṇḍāni sa devaḥ parameśvaraḥ | uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā gatasādhvasam || 214.10 || na ca me pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yāsyāmi yadi manyase | dadāmi tatra vittaṃ te yadi liṅgaṃ prapūritam || 214.11 || vaṇiguvāca adhanyaḥ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ nigrāhyaḥ parameśvara | tava priyamakurvāṇaḥ śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 214.12 || etacchrutvā vacastasya vaṇikputrasya bhārata | asaṃkṣayaṃ dhanaṃ dattvā sthitastatra maheśvaraḥ || 214.13 || tadā prabhṛti rājendra balākairiva bhūṣitam | pratyayārthaṃ sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā || 214.14 || devena racitaṃ pārtha krīḍayā supratiṣṭhitam | devamārgamiti khyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | paśyan prapūjayan vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 214.15 || devamārge tu yo gatvā pūjayedbalākeśvaram | pañcāyatanamāsādya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 214.16 || devamārge mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | na bhavetpunarāvṛttī rudralokātkadācana || 214.17 || devamārgasya māhātmyaṃ bhaktyā śrutvā narottama | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 214.18 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīkapālatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.215>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṅgitīrthaṃ tato gacchenmokṣadaṃ sarvadehinām | mṛtānāṃ tatra rājendra mokṣaprāptirna saṃśayaḥ || 215.1 || tatraiva piṇḍadānena pitḥṇāmanṛṇo bhavet | tena puṇyena pūtātmā labhedgāṇeśvarīṃ gatim || 215.2 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śṛṅgitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.216>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca aṣāḍhītīrthamāgacchettato bhūpālanandana | kāmikaṃ rūpamāsthāya sthito yatra maheśvaraḥ || 216.1 || cāturyugamidaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam | tatra snātvā naro rājan rudrasyānucaro bhavet || 216.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitkurute prāṇamokṣaṇam | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 216.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṣāḍhītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.217>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ gacchetsurāsuranamaskṛtam | tattu tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 217.1 || upavāsaparo bhūtvā niyatendriyamānasaḥ | tatra snātvā vidhānena mucyate brahmahatyayā || 217.2 || tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā prāṇatyāgaparo bhavet | anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam || 217.3 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.218>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharādhīśa tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam | jamadagniriti khyātaṃ yatra siddho janārdanaḥ || 218.1 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kathaṃ siddho dvijaśreṣṭha vāsudevo jagadguruḥ | mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 218.2 || etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ | caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathyamānaṃ tvayānagha || 218.3 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca āsītpūrvaṃ mahārāja haihayādhipatirmahān | kārtavīrya iti khyāto rājā bāhusahasravān || 218.4 || hastyaśvarathasampannaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 218.5 || māhiṣmatyāḥ patiḥ śrīmānrājā hyakṣauhiṇīpatiḥ | sa kadācinmṛgānhantuṃ nirjagāma mahābalaḥ || 218.6 || bahubhirdivasaiḥ prāpto bhṛgukacchamanuttamam | jamadagnirmahātejā yatra tiṣṭhati tāpasaḥ || 218.7 || reṇukāsahitaḥ śrīmānsarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ | tasya putro'bhavadrāmaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 218.8 || sarvakṣatraguṇairyukto brahmavidbrāhmaṇottamaḥ | toṣayanparayā bhaktyā pitarau paramārthavat || 218.9 || taṃ tadā cārjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā jamadagniḥ pratāpavān | carantaṃ mṛgayāṃ gatvā hyātithyena nyamantrayat || 218.10 || tatheti coktvā sa nṛpaḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ | jagāma cāśramaṃ puṇyamṛṣestasya mahātmanaḥ || 218.11 || tatkṣaṇādeva sampannaṃ śriyā paramayā vṛtam | vismayaṃ paramaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā rājā jagāma ha || 218.12 || gatamātrastu siddhena paramānnena bhojitaḥ | sabhṛtyabalavānrājā brāhmaṇena yadṛcchayā | kimetaditi papraccha kāraṇaṃ śaktimeva ca || 218.13 || kāmadhenoḥ prabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā prāha tato dvijam | dakṣiṇāṃ dehi me vipra kalmaṣāṃ dhenumuttamām || 218.14 || śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāmayutaṃ niyutaṃ param | bhūṣitānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ dadāmi tava cārbudam || 218.15 || jamadagniruvāca ayutaiḥ prayutairnāhaṃ śatakoṭibhiruttamām | kāmadhenumimāṃ tāta na dadmi pratigamyatām || 218.16 || evamuktaḥ sa rājendrastena vipreṇa bhārata | krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 218.17 || yasyedṛśaḥ kāmacāro mayyapi dvijapāṃsana | ahaṃ te paśyatastasmānnayāmi surabhiṃ gṛhāt || 218.18 || dvija uvāca kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa nirbhayo hi mahāhinā | mṛtyudṛṣṭotareṇāpi mama dhenuṃ nayeta yaḥ || 218.19 || evamuktvā mahādaṇḍaṃ brahmadaṇḍamivāparam | gṛhītvā paramakruddho jamadagniruvāca ha || 218.20 || yasyāsti śaktistejo vā kṣatriyasya kulādhamaḥ | dhenuṃ nayatu me sadyaḥ kṣīṇāyuḥ saparicchadaḥ || 218.21 || etacchrutvā vacaḥ krūraṃ haihayaḥ śataśo vṛtaḥ | dhāvamānaḥ kṣititale brahmadaṇḍahato'patat || 218.22 || huṃkṛtena tato dhenvāḥ khaḍgapāśāsipāṇayaḥ | nirgacchantaḥ pradṛśyante kalmaṣāyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 218.23 || nāsāpuṭāgrādromāgrātkirātā māgadhā gudāt | randhrāntareṣu cotpannāḥ śataśo'tha
