sahasraśaḥ || 218.24 || evamanyo'nyamāhatya haihayaṣṭaṅkaṇāndahan | vināśaṃ saha vipreṇa gatā hyarjunatejasā || 218.25 || kārtavīryo jayaṃ labdhvā saṃkhye hatvā dvijottamam | jagāma svāṃ purīṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāntavaśamohitaḥ || 218.26 || tatastvarānvitaḥ prāptaḥ paścādrāmo gate ripau | ākrandamānāṃ jananīṃ dadarśa piturantike || 218.27 || rāma uvāca kenedamātmanāśāya hyajñānātsāhasaṃ kṛtam | mama tātaṃ jighāṃsuryo draṣṭuṃ mṛtyumihecchati || 218.28 || tataḥ sā rāmavākyena gatasattveva vihvalā | udaraṃ karayugmena tāḍayantī hyuvāca tam || 218.29 || arjunena nṛśaṃsena kṣatriyairaparaiḥ saha | ihāgatya pitā tena nihato bāhuśālinā || 218.30 || taṃ paśya nihataṃ tātaṃ gatāsuṃ gatacetasam | saṃskṛtya vidhivatputra tarpayasva yathātatham || 218.31 || etacchrutvā sa vacanaṃ jananīmabhivādya tām | pratijñāmakarodyāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva ca narādhipa || 218.32 || triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ niḥkṣatriyakulānvayām | snātvā ca teṣāmasṛjā tarpayiṣyāmi te patim || 218.33 || tasyāpi paraśunā bāhūn kārtavīryasya durmateḥ | chittvā pāsyāmi rudhiramiti satyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 218.34 || evaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvāsau jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān | krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ saṃskṛtya pitaraṃ tataḥ || 218.35 || māhiṣmatīṃ purīṃ rāmo jagāma krodhamūrchitaḥ | chittvā bāhuvanaṃ tasya hatvā taṃ kṣatriyādhamam || 218.36 || jagāma kṣatriyāntāya pṛthivīmavalokayan | saptadvīpārṇavayutāṃ saśailavanakānanām || 218.37 || pūrvataḥ paścimāmāśāṃ dakṣiṇottarataḥ kurūn | samantapañcake pañca cakāra rudhirahradān || 218.38 || sa teṣu rudhirāmbhastu hradeṣu krodhamūrchitaḥ | pitḥn saṃtarpayāmāsa rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam || 218.39 || atharcīkādaya upetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham | taṃ kṣamasveti jagadustataḥ sa virarāma ha || 218.40 || teṣāṃ samīpe yo deśo hradānāṃ rudhirāmbhasām | samaṃ tapaṃ cakramiti puṇyaṃ tatparikīrtitam || 218.41 || nivartya karmaṇastasmātpitḥn provāca pāṇḍava | rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā yadidaṃ rudhiraṃ mayā || 218.42 || kṣiptaṃ pañcasu tīrtheṣu tadbhūyāttīrthamuttamam | tathetyuktvā tu te sarve pitaro'dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ || 218.43 || evaṃ rāmasya saṃsargo devamārge yudhiṣṭhira | sarvapāpakṣayakaro darśanātsparśanānnṛṇām || 218.44 || reṇukāpratyayārthāya adyāpi pitṛdevatāḥ | dṛśyante devamārgasthāḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarāḥ || 218.45 || tatra tīrthe tu rājendra narmadodadhisaṅgame | sthānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ || 218.46 || kuśāgreṇāpi kaunteya na spṛṣṭavyo mahodadhiḥ | anena tatra mantreṇa snātavyaṃ nṛpasattama || 218.47 || namaste viṣṇurūpāya namastubhyamapāṃ pate | sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi | iti sparśanamantraḥ || 218.48 || agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca dehe reto'tha viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ | etadbruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām || 218.49 || pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ phalapuṣpākṣatairyutam | mantreṇānena rājendra dadyādarghaṃ mahodadheḥ || 218.50 || sarvaratnanidhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākaraḥ | sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo'stu te | ityarghamantraḥ || 218.51 || ā janmajanitātpāpānmāmuddhara mahodadhe | yāhyarcito ratnanidhe parvatān pārvaṇottama | iti visarjanamantraḥ || 218.52 || ko'paraḥ sāgarāddevātsvargadvāravipāṭana | tatra sāgaraparyantaṃ mahātīrthamanuttamam || 218.53 || jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | yatra devāḥ sagandharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || 218.54 || upāsate virūpākṣaṃ jamadagnimanuttamam | reṇukāṃ caiva ye devīṃ paśyanti bhuvi mānavāḥ || 218.55 || priyavāse śive loke vasanti kālamīpsitam | tatra snātvā naro rājaṃstarpayanpitṛdevatāḥ || 218.56 || tārayennarakādghorātkulānāṃ śatamuttaram | snātvā dattvātra sahitāḥ śrutvā vai bhaktipūrvakam || 218.57 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe jāmadagnyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.219>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param | yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 219.1 || tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayo ye tathāmalāḥ | koṭitīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptā bhuvi durlabhām || 219.2 || sthāpitaśca mahādevastatra koṭīśvaro nṛpa | taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām || 219.3 || tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | kriyate tannṛpaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 219.4 || tatra dakṣiṇamārgasthā ye kecinmunisattamāḥ | siddhā mṛtāḥ padaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ dhruvaṃ hi te || 219.5 || uttaraṃ narmadākūlaṃ ye śreṣṭhā munipuṃgavāḥ | devalokaṃ gatāḥ pūrvamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 219.6 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.220>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheddharādhīśa loṭaṇeśvaramuttamam | uttare narmadākūle sarvapātakanāśanam || 220.1 || tatkṣaṇādeva tatsarvaṃ saptajanmārjitaṃ tvagham | naśyate devadevasya darśanādeva tannṛpa || 220.2 || bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ yauvane cāpi yatkṛtam | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti devadevasya darśanāt || 220.3 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu narmadācaritaṃ mahat | tvayā vai kathitaṃ vipra sakalaṃ pāpanāśanam || 220.4 || yadekaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam | śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā vadāśu me || 220.5 || ye keciddurlabhāḥ praśnāstriṣu lokeṣu sattama | tvatprasādena te sarve śrutā me saha bāndhavaiḥ || 220.6 || etamekaṃ paraṃ praśnaṃ sarvapraśnavidāṃ vara | śrutvāhaṃ tvatprasādena yatra yāmi sabāndhavaḥ || 220.7 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhusādhu mahāprājña yasya te matirīdṛśī | durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu tasya te nāsti kiṃcana || 220.8 || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bharatarṣabha | kāle kāle ca yo vetti kartavyastena dhīmatā || 220.9 || tasmātte sampravakṣyāmi praśnasyāsyottaraṃ śubham | yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante bhuvi mānavāḥ || 220.10 || narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā | viśeṣaḥ kathitastasyā revāsāgarasaṅgame || 220.11 || āgacchantīṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha dṛṣṭvā revāṃ mahodadhiḥ | praṇamya ca punardevīṃ saṅgame revayā saha || 220.12 || saṃcintya manasā keyamiti māṃ vai saridvarā | jñātvā saṃcintya manasā revāṃ liṅgodbhavāṃ parām || 220.13 || luṭhanvai sammukhastāta gato revāṃ mahodadhiḥ | samudre narmadā yatra praviṣṭāsti mahānadī || 220.14 || tatra devādhidevasya samudre liṅgamutthitam | liṅgodbhūtā mahābhāgā narmadā saritāṃ varā || 220.15 || layaṃ gatā tatra liṅge tena puṇyatamā hi sā | narmadāyāṃ vasannityaṃ narmadāmbu pibansadā | dīkṣitaḥ sarvayajñeṣu somapānaṃ dine dine || 220.16 || saṅgame tatra yaḥ snātvā loṭaṇeśvaramarcayet | so'śvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 220.17 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ nṛpa | loṭaṇeśvaramāsādya sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet || 220.18 || kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kathitaṃ śaṅkareṇa tu | tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpāpanodanam || 220.19 || samprāptāṃ kārttikīṃ dṛṣṭvā gatvā tatra nṛpottama | caturdaśyāmupoṣyaiva snātvā vai narmadājale || 220.20 || saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsampūjya loṭaṇeśvaram || 220.21 || saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya saphalaṃ tasya ceṣṭitam | paṅgavaste na sandeho janma teṣāṃ nirarthakam || 220.22 || ekāgramanasā yaistu na dṛṣṭo loṭaṇeśvaraḥ | piśācatvaṃ viyonitvaṃ na bhavettasya vai kule || 220.23 || saṅgame tatra yo gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | puṇyaiścaiva tathā kuryādgītairnṛtyaiḥ prabodhanam || 220.24 || tataḥ prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā mahodadhim | āmantrya snānavidhinā snānaṃ tatra tu kārayet || 220.25 || oṃ namo viṣṇurūpāya tīrthanāthāya te namaḥ | sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva samudra lavaṇāmbhasi | ityāmantraṇamantraḥ || 220.26 || agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca deho reto'dhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ | evaṃ bruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām | iti snānamantraḥ || 220.27 || ājanmaśatasāhasraṃ yatpāpaṃ kṛtavānnaraḥ | sakṛtsnānādvyapoheta pāpaughaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi || 220.28 || anyathā hi kuruśreṣṭha devayonirasau vibhuḥ | kuśāgreṇāpi vibudhairna spraṣṭavyo mahārṇavaḥ || 220.29 || sarvaratnapradhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākara | sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo'stu te | iti arvamantra || 220.30 || pitṛdevamanuṣyāṃśca saṃtarpya tadanantaram | uttīrya tīre tasyaiva pañcabhirdvijapuṃgavaiḥ || 220.31 || śrāddhaṃ samācaretpaścāllokapālānurūpibhiḥ | kṛtvāgre lokapālāṃstu pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 220.32 || sampūjya ca yathānyāyaṃ tāneva brāhmaṇaiḥ saha | sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ paścāttebhyaḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet || 220.33 || bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ vārdhakayauvane | prakhyāpayitvā tebhyo'gre lokapālānnimantrayet || 220.34 || bālyātprabhṛti yatkiṃcitkṛtamā janmato'śubham | viprebhyaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tatsāṃnidhyaṃ sthiteṣu me || 220.35 || ityuktvā sa luṭhetpaścāttebhyo'greṇa ca sammukham | anumānya ca tānpañca paścātsnānaṃ samācaret || 220.36 || śrāddhaṃ ca kāryaṃ vidhivatpitṛbhyo nṛpasattama | evaṃ kṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 220.37 || jijñāsārthaṃ tu yaḥ kaścidātmānaṃ jñātumicchati | śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma tasya niṣṭhāmimāṃ śṛṇu || 220.38 || snātvā tatra mahātīrthe luṭhamāno vrajennaraḥ | pāpakarmānyato yāti dharmakarmā vrajennadīm || 220.39 || pāpakarmā tato jñātvā pāpaṃ me pūrvasaṃcitam | snātvā tīrthavare tasmindānaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi || 220.40 || loṭaṇeśvaramabhyarcya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | avakragamanaṃ gatvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 220.41 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena jñātvaivaṃ nṛpasattama | snātavyaṃ mānavaistatra yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || 220.42 || evaṃ snātvā vidhānena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān | pūjayetpṛthivīpāla sarvapāpopaśāntaye || 220.43 || evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ nṛpasattama | tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 220.44 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra pitḥṇāṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ || 220.45 || dānaṃ dadāti viprebhyo gobhūtilahiraṇyakam | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi koṭirvarṣaśatāni ca || 220.46 || vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ svargaloke mahīyate | narmadāsarvatīrthebhyaḥ snāne dāne ca yatphalam || 220.47 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikabhūṣaṇam || 220.48 || govṛṣaṃ ca mahīṃ dhānyaṃ tatra dattvākṣayaṃ phalam | śubhasyāpyaśubhasyāpi tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ || 220.49 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | karoti bhaktyā vidhivattasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 220.50 || koṭivarṣaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ krīḍitvā śivamandire | vedavedāṅgavidvipro jāyate vimale kule || 220.51 || putrapautrasamṛddho'sau dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ | sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃśatam || 220.52 || api dvādaśayātrāsu somanāthe yadarcite | kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatpuṇyaṃ loṭaṇeśvare || 220.53 || gayā gaṅgā kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare tathā | tatpuṇyaṃ labhate pārtha loṭaṇeśvaradarśanāt || 220.54 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā paṭhyamānamidaṃ śubham | sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 220.55 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe loṭaṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.221>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gacchettu rājendra revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe | krośadvayāntare tīrthaṃ matṛtīrthādanuttamam || 221.1 || nāmnā haṃseśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ vaimanasyavināśanam | kaśyapasya kule jāto haṃso dākṣāyaṇīsutaḥ || 221.2 || brahmaṇo vāhanaṃ jātaḥ purā taptvā tapo mahat | saikadā vidhinirdeśaṃ vinā vaiyagryamāsthitaḥ || 221.3 || abhibhūtaḥ śivagaṇaiḥ praṇanāśa yudhiṣṭhira | dakṣayajñapramathane kāṃdiśīko vidhiṃ vinā || 221.4 || brahmaṇā saṃsṛto'pyāśu nāyāti sa yadā khagaḥ | tadā taṃ śaptavānbrahmā pātayāmāsa vai padāt || 221.5 || tataḥ sa śaptamātmānaṃ matvā haṃsastvarānvitaḥ | pitāmahamupāgamya praṇipatyedamabravīt || 221.6 || haṃsa uvāca tiryagyonisamutpannaṃ bhavāñchaptuṃ na cārhati | svabhāva eva tiryakṣu vivekavikalaṃ manaḥ || 221.7 || tathāpi deva pāpo'smi yadahaṃ svāminaṃ tyaje | kiṃ tu dhāvadbhiratyugrairgaṇaiḥ śārvaiḥ pitāmaha | sahasāhaṃ bhayākrāntastrastastyaktvā palāyitaḥ || 221.8 || adyāpi bhayamevāhaṃ paśyannasmi vibho puraḥ | tena smṛto'pi bhavatā nāvrajaṃ bhavadantike || 221.9 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca iti bruvanneva hi dhāturagre haṃsaḥ śvasatyakṣipūjyaḥ sudīnaḥ | tiryañcaṃ māṃ pāpinaṃ mūḍhabuddhiṃ prabho puraḥ patitaṃ pāhi pāhi || 221.10 || eko devastvaṃ hi sargasya kartā nānāvidhaṃ sṛṣṭametattvayaiva | ahaṃ sṛṣṭastvīdṛśo yattvayā vai so'yaṃ doṣo dhātaraddhā tavaiva || 221.11 || śāpasya vānugrahasyāpi śaktastvatto nānyaḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmi | sevādharmādvicyutaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ capeṭairhantavyaṃ vai tāta māṃ trāhi bhaktam || 221.12 || vidyāvidye tvatta evāvirāstāṃ dharmādharmau sadasaddyurniśe ca | nānābhāvāñjagatastvaṃ vidhatsestaṃ tvāmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vai prapadye || 221.13 || eko'si bahurūpo'si nānācitraikakarmataḥ | niṣkarmākhilakarmāsi tvāmataḥ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 221.14 || namonamo vareṇyāya varadāya namonamaḥ | namo dhātre vidhātre ca śaraṇyāya namonamaḥ || 221.15 || śikṣākṣaraviyukteyaṃ vāṇī me stauti kiṃ vibho | kā śaktiḥ kiṃ parijñānamidamuktaṃ kṣamasva me || 221.16 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ vadati haṃse vai brahmā prāha prasannadhīḥ | śikṣā dattā tavaiveyaṃ mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ khaga || 221.17 || tapasā śodhayātmānaṃ yathā śāpāntamāpnuyāḥ | revāsevāṃ kuru snātvā sthāpayitvā maheśvaram | acireṇaiva kālena tataḥ saṃsthānamāpsyasi || 221.18 || yacceṣṭvā bahubhiryajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ | gosvarṇakoṭidānaiśca tatphalaṃ sthāpite śive || 221.19 || brahmaghno vā surāpo vā svarṇahṛdgurutalpagaḥ | revātīre śivaṃ sthāpya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 221.20 || tasmādbhargasarittīre sthāpayitvā triyambakam | viyuktaḥ sarvadoṣaistvaṃ yāsyase padamuttamam || 221.21 || evamuktaḥ sa vidhinā hṛṣṭatuṣṭaḥ khagottamaḥ | tathetyuktvā jagāmāśu narmadātīramuttamam || 221.22 || tapastaptvā kiyatkālaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram || 221.23 || svanāmnā bharataśreṣṭha haṃseśvaramanuttamam | pūjayitvā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptavānkhagasattamaḥ || 221.24 || tatra haṃseśvare tīrthe gatvā snātvā yudhiṣṭhira | pūjayetparameśānaṃ sa pāpaiḥ parimucyate || 221.25 || stuvannekamanā devaṃ na dainyaṃ prāpnuyātkvacit | śrāddhaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam | dattvā śaktyā nṛpaśreṣṭha svargaloke mahīyate || 221.26 || trikālamekakālaṃ vā yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam | navaprasūtāṃ dhenuṃ ca dattvā pārtha dvijottame | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 221.27 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃseśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.222>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ krośāntare gacchettilādaṃ tīrthamuttamam | tilaprāśanakṛdyatra jābāliḥ śuddhimāptavān || 222.1 || pitṛmātṛparityāgī bhrāturbhāryābhilāṣakṛt | putravikrayakṛtpāpaśchalakṛdguruṇā saha || 222.2 || evaṃ doṣasamāviṣṭo yatra yatrāpi gacchati | tatra tatrāpi dhikkāraṃ labhate satsu bhārata | na ko'pi saṃgatiṃ dhatte tena sārddhaṃ sabhāsvapi || 222.3 || iti lajjānvito vipraḥ kāle na mahatā nṛpa | cintāmavāpa mahatīmagatijño hi pāvane || 222.4 || cakāra sarvatīrthāni revāṃ cāpyavagāhayat || 222.5 || aṇivāpāntamāsādya dakṣiṇe narmadātaṭe | tasthau yatra vratī pārtha jābāliḥ prāśayaṃstilān || 222.6 || tilairekāśanaṃ kurvaṃstathaivaikāntarāśanam | tryahaṣaḍdvādaśāhāśī pakṣamāsāśanastathā || 222.7 || kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni vratāni ca tilairapi | tilādatvamanuprāpto hyabdadvāsaptatiṃ kramāt || 222.8 || kālena gacchatā tasya prasanno'bhavadīśvaraḥ | prādādihāmutrikīṃ tu śuddhiṃ sālokyamātmakam || 222.9 || tena sa sthāpito devaḥ svanāmnā bharatarṣabha | tilādeśvarasaṃjñāṃ ca prāpa lokādapi prabhuḥ || 222.10 || tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca || 222.11 || upavāsaparaḥ pārtha tathaiva harivāsare | tilahomī tilodvartī tilasnāyī tilodakī || 222.12 || tiladātā ca bhoktā ca nānāpāpaiḥ pramucyate | tilairāpūrayelliṅgaṃ tilatailena dīpadaḥ | rudralokamavāpnoti punātyā saptamaṃ kulam || 222.13 || tilapiṇḍapradānena śrāddhe nṛpatisattama | vikarmasthāśca gacchanti gatimiṣṭāṃ hi pūrvajāḥ || 222.14 || svargalokasthitāḥ śrāddhairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ | akṣayāṃ tṛptimāsādya modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 222.15 || pituḥ kulaṃ mātṛkulaṃ tathā bhāryākulaṃ nṛpa | kulatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaṃ nayati vai naraḥ || 222.16 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tilādeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.223>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ krośāntare pārtha vāsavaṃ tīrthamuttamam | vasubhiḥ sthāpitaṃ tatra sthitvā vai dvādaśābdakam || 223.1 || dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilo'nalaḥ | pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭāvime purā || 223.2 || pitṛśāpaparikliṣṭā garbhavāsāya bhārata | nārmadaṃ tīrthamāsādya tapaścakruryatendriyāḥ || 223.3 || ārādhayantaḥ paramaṃ bhavānīpatimavyam | dvādaśābdāni rājendra tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 223.4 || pratyakṣaḥ pradadau tebhyastvabhīṣṭaṃ varamuttamam | tataḥ svanāmnā saṃsthāpya vasavastaṃ maheśvaram | jagmurākāśamāviśya prasanne sati śaṅkare || 223.5 || tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvāsavāhvayam | tasmiṃstīrthe mahārāja yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam | yathālabdhopahāraiśca dīpaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ || 223.6 || śuklapakṣe tadāṣṭamyāṃ pratyahaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ | aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi sa vasecchivasaṃnidhau || 223.7 || tataḥ śivālayaṃ yāti garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati | puṣpairvā pallavairvāpi phalairdhānyaistathāpi vā || 223.8 || pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa dainyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit | sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate || 223.9 || ekāhamapi kaunteya yo vasedvāsaveśvare | pāparāśiṃ vinirdhūya bhānuvaddivi modate || 223.10 || viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā dadyādvāsāṃsi dakṣiṇām || 223.11 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vāsaveśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.224>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ krośāntare pārtha tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param | yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japahomārcanādikam | bhaktyā kṛtaṃ naraistatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 224.1 || tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ | jaladhiṃ pratigacchanti narmadāṃ vīkṣituṃ kila || 224.2 || militāḥ koṭiśo rājanrevāsāgarasaṅgame | vinodamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā revārṇavasamāgame || 224.3 || snātvā śivaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayitvā maheśvaram | koṭīśvarābhidhānaṃ tu svasvabhaktyā vidhānataḥ || 224.4 || koṭītīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptāḥ sarvatoṣaṇāt | tena tatpuṇyamatulaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam || 224.5 || tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | kriyate nṛpaśārdūla sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 224.6 || tatra tīrthe tu mārgasthā ye kecidṛṣisattamāḥ | siddhāmṛtapadaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ tathottamam || 224.7 || uttare narmadātīre dakṣiṇe cāśritāśca ye | devalokaṃ gatāstatra iti me niścitā matiḥ || 224.8 || bilvārkapuṣpairdhattūrakuśakāśaprasūnakaiḥ | ṛtūdbhavaistathānyaiśca pūjayitvā maheśvaram || 224.9 || nānopacārairvidhivanmantrapūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | dhūpadīpārdhanaivedyaistoṣayitvā ca dhūrjaṭim || 224.10 || śivalokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | pauṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamīyoge viśeṣaḥ pūjane smṛtaḥ || 224.11 || nityaṃ ca nṛpatiśreṣṭha caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca | śivamabhyarcya viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktito varān || 224.12 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.225>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ krośāntare gacchedalikātīrthamuttamam | alikā nāma gāndharvī kuśīlā kuṭilāśayā || 225.1 || citrasenasya dauhitrī vidyānandamṛṣiṃ gatā | vavre te svīkṛtā tena daśavarṣāṇi taṃ śritā || 225.2 || patiṃ jaghāna taṃ suptaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare | gatvā nivedayāmāsa pitaraṃ ratnavallabham || 225.3 || pitrā mātrā ca saṃtyaktā bahubhirbhartsitā nṛpa | garbhaghnī tvaṃ patighnī tvamiti darśaya mā mukham || 225.4 || brahmaghnī yāhi pāpiṣṭhe parityaktā gṛhādvraja || 225.5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca iti duḥkhānvitā mūḍhā tābhyāṃ nirbhartsitā satī | tanuṃ tyaktuṃ manaścakre prāpya tīrthāntaraṃ kvacit || 225.6 || saṃpṛcchyamānā tīrthāni brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira | śrutvā pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgame || 225.7 || tatra pārtha tapaścakre nirāhārā jitavratā | kṛcchrātikṛcchrapārākamahāsāṃtapanādibhiḥ || 225.8 || cāndrāyaṇairbrahmakūrcaiḥ karśayāmāsa vai tanum | evaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārddhaṃ vyatītaṃ tapasā nṛpa || 225.9 || tasyā viśuddhimicchantyāḥ śivadhyānārcanādibhiḥ | tataḥ katipayāhobhistasyā jñātvā haṭhaṃ param | parituṣṭaḥ śivaḥ prāha pārvatyā paricoditaḥ || 225.10 || īśvara uvāca putri mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ śuddhadehāsi sāmpratam | tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā te'dya varaṃ varaya vāñchitam || 225.11 || alikovāca yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa varārhā yadyahaṃ matā | nānāpāpāgnitaptāyā dehi śuddhiṃ parāṃ mama || 225.12 || tvaṃ me nātho hyanāthāyāstvameva jagatāṃ guruḥ | dīnānāthasamuddhartā śaraṇyaḥ sarvadehinām || 225.13 || īśvara uvāca tvaṃ bhadre śuddhadehāsi mā kiṃcidanuśocithāḥ | svanāmnā sthāpayitveha māṃ tataḥ svargameṣyasi || 225.14 || ityuktvā devadeveśastatraivāntaradhīyata | alikāpi tato bhaktyā snātvā saṃsthāpya śaṅkaram || 225.15 || dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo lokamāpa mahotkaṭam | pitaraṃ ca samāsādya mātaraṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira || 225.16 || taiśca saṃmānitā prītyā bandhubhiḥ sālikā tataḥ | vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālānvitā nṛpa || 225.17 || gaurīlokamanuprāptasakhitve'dyāpi modate | tataḥ prabhṛti tatpārtha vikhyātamalikeśvaram || 225.18 || tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī puruṣo vā yudhiṣṭhira | snātvā sampūjayedbhaktyā mahādevamumāyutam || 225.19 || sa pāpairvividhairmukto lokamāpnoti śāṃkaram | mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ yatpurā kṛtam || 225.20 || sarvaṃ tadvilayaṃ yāti bhojayitvā dvijānsadā | dīpaṃ dattvā ca devāgre na rogaiḥ paribhūyate || 225.21 || dhūpapātraṃ vimānaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ kalaśameva ca | dattvā devāya rājendra śākraṃ lokamavāpnuyāt || 225.22 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revāsāgarasaṅgame'likeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.226>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tataḥ krośāntare puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvimaleśvaram | yatra snānena dānena japahomārcanādibhiḥ || 226.1 || vimaleśvaramārādhya yo yadicchetsa tallabhet | svargalābhādikaṃ vāpi pārthivaṃ vā yathepsitam || 226.2 || purā triśirasaṃ hatvā tvaṣṭuḥ putraṃ śatakratuḥ | yasya tīrthasya māhātmyādvaimalyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 226.3 || yatra vedanidhirvipro mahattaptvā tapaḥ purā | nānākarmamalaiḥ kṣīṇairvimalo'bhavadarkavat || 226.4 || mahādevaprasādena somavatpriyadarśanaḥ | purā bhānumatīṃ bhānuḥ sutāṃ smaraśarārditaḥ || 226.5 || cakame tena doṣeṇa kuṣṭharogārdito'bhavat | sa cāpyatra tapastaptvā vimalatvamupāgataḥ || 226.6 || mahādevena tuṣṭena svasthānaṃ mudito'bhajat | tathaiva ca purā pārtha vibhāṇḍakasuto muniḥ || 226.7 || yogisaṅgaṃ vane prāpya pure ca nṛpatestathā | rājasaṃsargadoṣādvai mālinyaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 226.8 || vicārayannabhyupetya revāsāgarasaṅgamam | śāntayā bhāryayā sārddhaṃ taptvā dvādaśavatsarān || 226.9 || kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairdevaṃ toṣayaṃstryambakaṃ muniḥ | mahādevena tuṣṭena so'pi vaimalyamāptavān || 226.10 || śarvāṇyā preritaḥ śarvaḥ purā dāruvane nṛpa | mohanānmunipatnīnāṃ svaṃ dīkṣya vimalaṃ kila || 226.11 || vicārya paramasthānaṃ narmadodadhisaṅgamam | tatra sthitvā mahārāja tapastaptvā sahomayā || 226.12 || vimalo'sau yato jātastenāsau vimaleśvaraḥ | tena nāmnā svayaṃ tasthau lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 226.13 || tatastilottamāṃ sṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | prajānātho'pi tāṃ sṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvāgre sumanoharām || 226.14 || bhāviyogabalākrāntaḥ sa tasyāmabhiko'bhavat | tena vīkṣya sadoṣatvaṃ revātīradvayaṃ śritaḥ || 226.15 || tīrthānyanusaranmaunī trisnāyī saṃsmarañchivam | revārṇavasamāyoge snātvā sampūjya śaṅkaram | kālenālpena rājarṣe brahmāpyamalatāṃ gataḥ || 226.16 || evamanye'pi bahuśo devarṣinṛpasattamāḥ | tyaktvā doṣamalaṃ tatra vimalā bahavo'bhavan || 226.17 || tathā tvamapi rājendra tatra snātvā śivārcanāt | amalo'pi viśeṣeṇa vaimalyaṃ prāpsyase param || 226.18 || tatra snātvā naro nārī pūjayitvā maheśvaram | pāpadoṣavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate || 226.19 || tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sarvaparvasu pārthiva || 226.20 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam | śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitḥṇāmanṛṇī bhavet | brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām || 226.21 || yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccaivātmahitaṃ gṛhe | tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tatraivākṣayamicchatā | svarṇadhānyāni vāsāṃsi chatropānatkamaṇḍalum || 226.22 || gṛhaṃ devasya vai śaktyā kṛtvā syādbhuvi bhūpatiḥ | gītanṛtyakathābhiśca toṣayetparameśvaram || 226.23 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.227>
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca etāni tava saṃkṣepātprādhānyātkathitāni ca | na śakto vistarādvaktuṃ saṃkhyāṃ tīrtheṣu pāṇḍava || 227.1 || eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā | narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā || 227.2 || manasā saṃsmaredyastu narmadāṃ satataṃ nṛpa | cāndrāyaṇaśatasyāśu labhate phalamuttamam || 227.3 || aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikāścātra ye sthitāḥ | patanti narake ghore prāhaivaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 227.4 || narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ | tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī || 227.5 || iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā maheśvaratanūdbhavā | proktā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhāratasya yudhiṣṭhira || 227.6 || jāhnavī vaiṣṇavī gaṅgā brāhmī gaṅgā sarasvatī | iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā revā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 227.7 || yathā hi puruṣe devastraimūrtatvamupāśritaḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ na bhedastatra vai yathā | tathā sarittraye pārtha bhedaṃ manasi mā kṛthāḥ || 227.8 || koṭiśo hyatra tīrthāni lakṣaśaścāpi bhārata | tathā sahasraśo revātīradvayagatāni tu || 227.9 || vṛkṣāntarikṣasaṃsthāni jalasthalagatāni ca | kaḥ śaktastāni nirṇetuṃ vāgīśo vā maheśvaraḥ || 227.10 || smaraṇājjanmajanitaṃ darśanācca trijanmajam | saptajanmakṛtaṃ naśyetpāpaṃ revāvagāhanāt || 227.11 || devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tena agnayo vidhivaddhutāḥ | vedā adhītāścatvāro yena revāvagāhitā || 227.12 || prādhānyāccāpi saṃkṣepāttīrthānyuktāni te mayā | na śakyo vistaraḥ pārtha śrotuṃ vaktuṃ ca vai mayā || 227.13 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca vidhānaṃ ca yamāṃścaiva niyamāṃśca vadasva me | prāyaścittārthagamane ko vidhistaṃ vadasva me || 227.14 || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahārāja yacchreyaḥ pāralaukikam | śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yathājñānaṃ vadāmi te || 227.15 || adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ karma samācaret | avaśyameva yāsyanti prāṇāḥ prāghūrṇikā iva || 227.16 || dānaṃ vittādṛtaṃ vācaḥ kīrtidharmau tathā khyuṣaḥ | paropakaraṇaṃ kāyādasārātsāramuddharet || 227.17 || asminmahāmohamaye kaṭāhe sūryāgninā rātridivendhanena | māsartudarvīparighaṭṭanena bhūtāni kālaḥ pacatīti vārtā || 227.18 || jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi | nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ || 227.19 || mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau | yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī || 227.20 || aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat | asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha || 227.21 || yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ | na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim || 227.22 || santīha vividhopāyā nṛṇāṃ dehaviśodhanāḥ | tīrthasevāsamaṃ nāsti svaśarīrasya śodhanam || 227.23 || kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādyairvā dvitīyaṃ tīrthasevayā | yadā tīrthaṃ samuddiśya prayāti puruṣo nṛpa | tadā devāśca pitarastaṃ vrajantyanu khecarāḥ || 227.24 || paramā modapūrṇāste prayāntyasyānuyāyinaḥ | kṛtvābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ samāpṛcchaya tu devatām || 227.25 || iṣṭabandhūṃśca viṣṇuṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ sagaṇeśvaram | vrajeddvijābhyanujñāto gṛhītvā niyamānapi || 227.26 || ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ bhūśayyāṃ satyavāditām | varjanaṃ ca parānnasya pratigrahavivarjanam || 227.27 || varjayitvā tathā drohavañcanādi nṛpottama | sādhuveṣaṃ samāsthāya vinayena vibhūṣitaḥ || 227.28 || dambhāhaṅkāramukto yaḥ sa tīrthaphalamaśnute | yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam || 227.29 || vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute | akrodhanaśca rājendra satyaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ || 227.30 || ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute | muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 227.31 || varjayitvā kurukṣetraṃ viśālāṃ virajāṃ gayām | snānaṃ surārcanaṃ caiva śrāddhe vai piṇḍapātanam || 227.32 || viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ śaktyā sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ | prāyaścittanimittaṃ ca yo vrajedyatamānasaḥ || 227.33 || tasyāpi ca vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārtha samāhitaḥ | ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryamakṣāralavaṇāśanam || 227.34 || snātvā tīrthābhigamanaṃ haviṣyaikānnabhojanam | varjayetpatitālāpaṃ bahubhāṣaṇameva ca || 227.35 || parīvādaṃ parānnaṃ ca nīcasaṅgaṃ vivarjayet | vrajecca nirupānatko vasāno vāsasī śuciḥ || 227.36 || saṃkalpaṃ manasā kṛtvā brāhmaṇānujñayā vrajet | tīrthe gatvā tathā snātvā kṛtvā caiva surārcanam || 227.37 || duṣkarmato vimuktaḥ syādanutāpī bhavedyadi | vede tīrthe ca deve ca daivajñe cauṣadhe gurau || 227.38 || yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī | uktatīrthaphalānāṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi || 227.39 || arthavādabhavāṃ śaṅkāṃ vihāya bharatarṣabha | kṛtvā vicāraṃ śāstroktaṃ parikalpya yathocitam || 227.40 || kāyena kṛcchracaraṇe hyaśaktānāṃ viśuddhaye | jñātvā tīrthāviśeṣaṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 227.41 || tacchṛṇuṣva mahārāja narmadāyāṃ yathocitam | caturviṃśatisaṃkhyebhyo yojanebhyo vrajennaraḥ || 227.42 || caturviṃśatikṛcchrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śobhanam | ata ūrdhvaṃ yojaneṣu pādakṛcchramudāhṛtaḥ || 227.43 || tanmadhye ca mahārāja yo vrajecchuddhikāṅkṣayā | yojane yojane tasya prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 227.44 || praṇavākhye mahārāja tathā revorisaṃgame | bhṛgukṣetre tathā gatvā phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam || 227.45 || saṅgame devanadyāśca śūlabhede nṛpottama | dviguṇaṃ pādahīnaṃ syātkarajāsaṃgame tathā || 227.46 || eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvatkapilāyāśca saṃgame | kecittriguṇitaṃ prāhuḥ kubjārevotthasaṅgame || 227.47 || oṃkāre ca mahārāja tadapi syātsamañjasam | saṅgameṣu tathānyāsāṃ nadīnāṃ revayā saha || 227.48 || prāhuste sārdhakṛcchraṃ vai phalaṃ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira | triguṇaṃ kṛcchramāpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame || 227.49 || kṛcchraṃ caturguṇaṃ proktaṃ śuklatīrthe yudhiṣṭhira | yojane yojane gatvā caturviṃśatiyojanam | tatra tatra vasedyastu suciraṃ nṛvarottama || 227.50 || revāsevāsamācāraḥ saṃyuktaḥ śuddhabuddhimān | dambhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ sa vimucyate || 227.51 || iti te kathitaṃ pārtha prāyaścittārthalakṣaṇam | revāyātrāvidhānaṃ ca guhyametadyudhiṣṭhira || 227.52 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yojanasya pramāṇaṃ me vada tvaṃ munisattama | yajjñātvā niścitaṃ me syānmanaḥśuddhestu kāraṇam || 227.53 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu pāṇḍava vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ yojanasya yat | tathā yātrāviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaṃ kṛcchrasambhavam || 227.54 || tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭāvūrdhvā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ | pramāṇamaṅgulasyāhurvitastirdvādaśāṃgulā || 227.55 || vitastidvitayaṃ hastaścaturhastaṃ dhanuḥ smṛtam | sa eva daṇḍo gadito viśeṣajñairyudhiṣṭhira || 227.56 || dhanuḥsahasre dve krośaścatuḥkrośaṃ ca yojanam | etadyojanamānaṃ te kathitaṃ bharatarṣabha || 227.57 || yena yātrāṃ vrajan vetti phalamānaṃ nijārjitam | uktaṃ kṛcchraphalaṃ tīrthe jalarūpe nṛpottama || 227.58 || yathāviśeṣaṃ te vacmi pūrvokte tatra tatra ca | tanme śṛṇu mahīpāla śraddadhānāya kathyate || 227.59 || yasmiṃstīrthe hi yatproktaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchrādikaṃ nṛpa | tatrāpyupoṣaṇātkṛcchraphalaṃ prāpnotyathādhikam || 227.60 || dinajāpyācca labhate phalaṃ kṛcchrasya śaktitaḥ | tatra vikhyātadeveśaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvābhipūjya ca || 227.61 || praṇamya labhate pārtha phalaṃ kṛcchrabhavaṃ sudhīḥ | tīrthe mukhyaphalaṃ snānāddvitīyaṃ cāpyupoṣaṇāt || 227.62 || tṛtīyaṃ khyātadevasya darśanābhyarcanādibhiḥ | caturthaṃ jāpyayogena dehaśaktyā tvaharniśam || 227.63 || pañcamaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu kalpanīyaṃ hi dūrataḥ | tīrastho yojanādarvāgdaśāṃśaṃ labhate phalam || 227.64 || uktatīrthaphalātpārtha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 227.65 || upavāsena sahitaṃ mahānadyāṃ hi majjanam | apyarvāgyojanātpārtha dadyātkṛcchraphalaṃ nṛṇām || 227.66 || ṣaḍyojanavahā kulya nadyo'lpā dvādaśaiva ca | caturviṃśatigā nadyo mahānadyastato'dhikāḥ || 227.67 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthayātrādividhānaviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.228>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca parārthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ gacchataḥ kasya kiṃ phalam | kiyanmātraṃ muniśreṣṭha tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe || 228.1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca parārthaṃ gacchatastanme vadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva | yathā yāvatphalaṃ tasya yātrādivihitaṃ bhavet || 228.2 || uttameneha varṇena dravyalobhādinā nṛpa | nādhamasya kvacitkāryaṃ tīrthayātrādisevanam || 228.3 || dharmakarma mahārāja svayaṃ vidvānsamācaret | śarīrasyāthavā śaktyā anyadvā kāryayogataḥ || 228.4 || dharmakarma sadā prāyaḥ savarṇenaiva kārayet | putrapautrādikairvāpi jñātibhirgotrasambhavaiḥ || 228.5 || śreṣṭhaṃ hi vihitaṃ prāhurdharmakarma yudhiṣṭhira | taireva kārayettasmānnottamairnādhamairapi || 228.6 || adhamena kṛtaṃ samyaṅna bhavediti me matiḥ | uttamaścādhamārthe vai kurvandurgatimāpnuyāt || 228.7 || na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam | na cāsyopadiśeddharmaṃ na cāsya vratamādiśet || 228.8 || japastapastīrthayātrā pravrajyā mantrasādhanam | devatārādhanaṃ dīkṣā strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ || 228.9 || pativatnī patatyeva vidhavā sarvamācaret | sabhartṛkāśake patyau sarvaṃ kuryādanujñayā || 228.10 || gatvā parārthaṃ tīrthādau ṣoḍaśāṃśaphalaṃ labhet | gacchataśca prasaṅgena tīrthamarddhaphalaṃ smṛtam || 228.11 || anusaṅgena tīrthasya snāne snānaphalaṃ viduḥ | naiva yātrāphalaṃ tajjñāḥ śāstroktaṃ kalmaṣāpaham || 228.12 || pitrarthaṃ ca pitṛvyasya māturmātāmahasya ca | mātulasya tathā bhrātuḥ śvaśurasya sutasya ca || 228.13 || poṣakārthādayoścāpi mātāmahyā gurostathā | svasurmātṛṣvasuḥ paitryā ācāryādhyāpakasya ca || 228.14 || ityādyarthe naraḥ snātvā svayamaṣṭāṃśamāpnuyāt | sākṣātpitroḥ prakurvāṇaścaturthāṃśamavāpnuyāt || 228.15 || patipatnyormithaścārddhaṃ phalaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ | bhāgineyasya śiṣyasya bhrātṛvyasya sutasya ca | ṣaṭtripañcacaturbhāgānphalamāpnoti vai naraḥ || 228.16 || iti te kathitaṃ pārtha pāramparyakramāgatam | kartavyaṃ jñātivargasya parārthe dharmasādhanam || 228.17 || varṣāṛtusamāyoge sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ | muktvā sarasvatīṃ gaṅgāṃ narmadāṃ yamunānadīm || 228.18 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe parārthatīrthayātrāphalakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.229>
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpurāṇaṃ dharmasaṃhitam | śivaprītyā yathā proktaṃ vāyunā devasaṃsadi || 229.1 || ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭistathaiva ca | ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadāyāṃ pade pade || 229.2 || mayā dvādaśasāhasrī saṃhitā yā śrutā purā | devadevasya gadataḥ sāmprataṃ kathitā tava || 229.3 || pṛṣṭastvayāhaṃ bhūpāla parvate'marakaṇṭake | sthitaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ mayā tatkathitaṃ tava || 229.4 || narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu tasyāsti yatphalam | yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiḥ syātsaṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ || 229.5 || paṭhitaiśca śrutairvāpi tasmādbahutaraṃ bhavet | satrayājī phalaṃ yatra labhate dvādaśābdikam || 229.6 || carite tu śrute devyā labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam | sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ snātvā sāgaramāditaḥ || 229.7 || sakṛtsnātvā tathā śrutvā narmadāyāṃ phalaṃ hi tat | ādimadhyāvasānena narmadācaritaṃ śubham || 229.8 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | sa prāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ || 229.9 || rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate | etaddharmamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu sattamam || 229.10 || deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi vā grāme nagare'pi vā | gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya cāturvarṇyasya bhārata || 229.11 || sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ | trividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke dharmapanthānamuttamam || 229.12 || devatānāṃ guruṃ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam | śrutveśvaramukhātpārtha mayāpi tava kīrtitam || 229.13 || dakṣiṇe cottare kūle yāni tīrthāni kānicit | pradhānataḥ supuṇyāni kathitāni viśeṣataḥ || 229.14 || sparśanāddarśanātteṣāṃ kīrtanācchravaṇāttathā | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 229.15 || idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ śivabhāṣitam | brāhmaṇo vedavidyāvān kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || 229.16 || dhanabhāgī bhavedvaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet | saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ svargaṃ nārī śrutvāpnuyāddhanam || 229.17 || brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ | māhātmyaṃ narmadāyāstu śrutvā pāpabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 229.18 || pāpabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmiviśvāsaghātakaḥ | goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ || 229.19 || ete śrutvaiva pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śṛṇvanti satataṃ nṛpa || 229.20 || pūjayanta idaṃ devāḥ pūjitā guravaśca taiḥ | narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ || 229.21 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhapuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | pūjitaṃ parayā bhaktyā śāstrametatphalapradam || 229.22 || lekhāpayitvā sakalaṃ narmadācaritaṃ śubham | uttamaṃ sarvaśāstrebhyo yo dadāti dvijanmane || 229.23 || narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne ca yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 229.24 || etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam | svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrtivardhanam || 229.25 || sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 229.26 || śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ | gobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ svastyastu dharmaṃ dharmātmajāśrayaḥ || 229.27 || narakāntakarī revā satīrthā viśvapāvanī | narmadā dharmadā cāstu śarmadā pārtha te sadā || 229.28 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde revākhaṇḍapaṭhanaśravaṇadānādiphalaśrutivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.230>
sūta uvāca ityuktvopararāmatha pāṇḍoḥ putrāya vai muniḥ | mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānsaptakalpasmaraḥ puraḥ || 230.1 || mārkaṇḍamuninā proktaṃ yathā pārthāya sattamāḥ | tathā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ revāmāhātmyamuttamam || 230.2 || iyaṃ puṇyā saricchreṣṭhā revā viśvaikapāvanī | rudradehasamudbhūtā sarvabhūtābhayapradā || 230.3 || oṅkārajaladhiṃ yāvaduvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ | tīrthasaṅgamabhedānvai dharmaputrāya pṛcchate || 230.4 || samāsenaiva munayastathāhaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ | saptaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca || 230.5 || kathaṃ kenātra śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi | tathāpyatra muniśreṣṭhāḥ proktaṃ pārthāya vai yathā || 230.6 || tīrthamoṃkāramārabhya vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ śubhām | procyamānāṃ samāsena tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ || 230.7 || natvā somaṃ maheśānaṃ natvā brahmācyutāvubhau | sarasvatīṃ gaṇeśānaṃ devyāsāṅghripañkajam || 230.8 || pūrvācāryāṃstathā sarvāndṛṣṭvādṛṣṭārthavedinaḥ | praṇamya narmadāṃ devīṃ vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ tvimām || 230.9 || oṃ namo viśvarūpāya oṅkārāyākhilātmane | yamārabhye pravakṣyāmi revātīrthāvaliṃ dvijāḥ || 230.10 || asminmārkaṇḍagadite revātīrthakrame śubhe | purāṇasaṃhitādhyāyā mārkaṇḍāśramavarṇanam || 230.11 || tataḥ praśnādhikāraśca praśaṃsā narmadodbhavā | tathā pañcadaśānāṃ ca pravāhānāṃ prakīrtanam || 230.12 || nāmanirvacanaṃ tadvattathā kalpasamudbhavāḥ | ekaviṃśatikalpānāṃ tadvannāmānukīrtanam || 230.13 || mārkaṇḍeyānubhūtānāṃ saptānāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca | māhātmyaṃ caiva revāyāḥ śivaviṣṇvostathaiva ca || 230.14 || saṃhāralakṣaṇaṃ tadvadoṅkārasya ca sambhavaḥ | tathaivauṃkāramāhātmyamamarakaṇṭakīrtanam || 230.15 || amareśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā dāruvanaṃ mahat | dārukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai carukeśvaram || 230.16 || carukāsaṅgamastadvyadvatīpāteśvaraṃ tathā | pātāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca koṭiyajñāhvayaṃ tathā || 230.17 || varuṇeśvaratīrthaṃ ca liṅgānyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | siddheśvaraṃ yameśaṃ ca brahmeśvaramataḥ param || 230.18 || sārasvataṃ cāṣṭarudraṃ sāvitraṃ somasaṃjñitam | śivakhātaṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrāvartaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 230.19 || brahmāvartaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryāvartamataḥ param | pippalāvartatīrthaṃ ca pippalyāścaiva saṅgamaḥ || 230.20 || amarakaṇṭamāhātmyaṃ kapilāsaṅgamastathā | viśalyāsambhavaścāpi bhṛgutuṅgādrikīrtanam || 230.21 || viśalyāsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaḥ karamardāsamāgamaḥ | karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam || 230.22 || saṅgamo nīlagaṅgāyāḥ vidhvaṃsastripurasya ca | kīrtanaṃ tīrthadānānāṃ madhukatṛtīyāvratam || 230.23 || apsareśvaratīrthaṃ ca dehakṣepe vidhistataḥ | tīrthaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ nāma jvālāyāḥ saṅgamastathā || 230.24 || śakratīrthaṃ kuśāvartaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca | ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā || 230.25 || mātṛkeśvaratīrthaṃ ca bhṛgutuṅgānuvarṇanam | tatra bhairavamāhātmyaṃ capaleśvarakīrtanam || 230.26 || caṇḍapāṇeśca māhātmyaṃ kāverīsaṅgamastathā | kubereśvaratīrthaṃ ca vārāhīsaṅgamastathā || 230.27 || saṅgamaścaṇḍavegāyāstīrthaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ tathā | eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇya eraṇḍeśvaramuttamam || 230.28 || pitṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva oṅkārasya ca sambhavam | māhātmyaṃ pañcaliṅgānāmoṅkārasya munīśvarāḥ || 230.29 || koṭitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ tīrthaṃ kākahradaṃ tathā | jambukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca sārasvatamataḥ param || 230.30 || kapilāsaṅgamastadvattīrthaṃ ca kapileśvaram | daityasūdanatīrthaṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ ca vāmanam || 230.31 || tīrthalakṣaṃ viduḥ pūrve kapilāyāstu saṅgame | svargasya narakasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ munibhāṣitam || 230.32 || vyavasthānaṃ śarīrasya gopradānānuvarṇanam | aśokavanikātīrthaṃ mataṅgāśramavarṇanam || 230.33 || aśokeśvaratīrthaṃ ca mataṅgeśvaramuttamam | tathā mṛgavanaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ manoratham || 230.34 || saṅgamo'ṅgāragartāyā aṅgāreśvaramuttamam | tathā meghavanaṃ tīrthaṃ devyā nāmānukīrtanam || 230.35 || saṅgamaścāpi kubjāyāstīrthaṃ kubjeśvaraṃ tathā | bilvāmrakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ pūrṇadvīpamataḥ param || 230.36 || tathā hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgamaḥ puṇyakīrtanaḥ | dvīpeśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñeśvaraṃ tathā || 230.37 || māṇḍavyāśramatīrthaṃ ca viśokāsaṅgamastathā | vāgīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyo vai vāgusaṅgamaḥ || 230.38 || sahasrāvartakaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ tathā | saṅgamaśca sarasvatyā īśānaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 230.39 || devatātrayatīrthaṃ ca śūlakhātaṃ tataḥ param | brahmodaṃ śāṅkaraṃ saumyaṃ sārasvatamataḥ param || 230.40 || sahasrayajñatīrthaṃ ca kapālamocanaṃ tathā | āgneyamaditīśaṃ ca vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 230.41 || tathā devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñasahasrakam | śuklatīrthaṃ dīptikeśaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ ca yodhanam || 230.42 || narmadeśvaratīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśaṃ ca mārutam | yogeśaṃ rohiṇītīrthaṃ dārutīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ || 230.43 || brahmāvartaṃ ca pattreśaṃ vāhnaṃ sauraṃ ca kīrtyate | meghanādaṃ dārutīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ guhāśrayam || 230.44 || narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tatkapilātīrthamuttamam | karañjeśaṃ kuṇḍaleśaṃ pippalādamataḥ param || 230.45 || vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ | praśaṃsā śūlabhedasya tatraivāndhakavikramaḥ || 230.46 || devāśvāsanadānaṃ ca tathaivāndhakanigrahaḥ | śūlabhedasya cotpattistathā pātraparīkṣaṇam || 230.47 || praśaṃsā dānadharmasya ṛṣiśṛṅgānubhāvanam | svargatiṃ dīrghatapaso bhānumatyāstatheṅgitam || 230.48 || śabarasvargagamanaṃ māhātmyaṃ śūlabhedajam | kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca mokṣatīrthamataḥ param || 230.49 || saṅgamo mokṣanadyāśca tīrthaṃ ca vimaleśvaram | tathaivolūkatīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ || 230.50 || ādityeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram | saṅgamo bhīmakulyāyāstīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ śubham || 230.51 || mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā vai pippaleśvaram | karoṭīśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthamindreśvaraṃ śubham || 230.52 || agastyeśaṃ kumāreśaṃ vyāseśvaramanuttamam | vaidyanāthaṃ ca kedāramānandeśvarasaṃjñitam || 230.53 || mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muṇḍeśaṃ cauraṃ kāmeśvaraṃ tathā | saṅgamaścānuduhyā vai tīrthe bhīmārjunāhvaye | tīrthaṃ dharmeśvaraṃ nāma luṅkeśvaramataḥ param || 230.54 || tato dhanadatīrthaṃ ca jaṭeśaṃ maṅgaleśvaram | kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca gopāreśvaramuttamam || 230.55 || maṇināgeśvaraṃ nāma maṇinadyāśca saṅgamaḥ | tilakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca gautameśamataḥ param || 230.56 || tatraiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muninoktaṃ munīśvarāḥ | śaṅkhacūḍaṃ ca kedāraṃ pārāśaramataḥ param || 230.57 || bhīmeśvaraṃ ca candreśamaśvavatyāśca saṅgamaḥ | bahvīśvaraṃ nāradeśaṃ vaidyanāthaṃ kapīśvaram || 230.58 || kumbheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ rāmeśaṃ lakṣmaṇeśvaram | megheśvaraṃ matsyakeśamapsarāhradasaṃjñakam || 230.59 || dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ nandikeśaṃ ca vāruṇam | pāvakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathaiva kapileśvaram || 230.60 || nārāyaṇāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam | caṇḍādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caṇḍikātīrthamuttamam || 230.61 || yamahāsāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā gaṅgeśvaraṃ śubham | nandikeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāhvayam || 230.62 || naleśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ śuklatīrthamataḥ param | vyāseśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra siddheśvaraṃ tathā || 230.63 || koṭitīrthaṃ prabhātīrthaṃ vāsukīśvaramuttamam | saṅgamaśca karañjāyā mārkaṇḍeśvaramuttamam || 230.64 || tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nāma tathā saṃkarṣaṇāhvayam | kanakeśaṃ manmatheśaṃ tīrthaṃ caivānasūyakam || 230.65 || eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyo mātṛtīrthaṃ ca śobhanam | tīrthaṃ svarṇaśalākākhyaṃ tathā caivāmbikeśvaram || 230.66 || karañjeśaṃ bhārateśaṃ nāgeśaṃ mukuṭeśvaram | saubhāgyasundarī tīrthaṃ dhanadeśvaramuttamam || 230.67 || rohiṇyaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca uttareśvarasaṃjñitam | bhogeśvaraṃ ca kedāraṃ niṣkalaṅkamataḥ param || 230.68 || mārkaṇḍaṃ dhautapāpaṃ ca tīrthamāṅgiraseśvaram | koṭavīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatra vai || 230.69 || ayonijaṃ paraṃ tīrthamaṅgāreśvaramuttamam | skāndaṃ ca nārmadaṃ brāhmaṃ vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñitam || 230.70 || koṭitīrthaṃ kapāleśaṃ pāṇḍutīrthaṃ trilocanam | kapileśaṃ kambukeśaṃ prabhāsaṃ kohaneśvaram || 230.71 || indreśaṃ vālukeśaṃ ca deveśaṃ śakrameva ca | nāgeśvaraṃ gautameśamahalyātīrthamuttamam || 230.72 || rāmeśvaraṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ tathā kuśalaveśvarau | narmadeśaṃ kapardīśaṃ sāgareśamataḥ param || 230.73 || dhaurādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ cāparayonijam | piṅgaleśvaratīrtha ca bhṛgvīśvaramanuttamam || 230.74 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ | mārkaṇḍaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca ādivārāhamuttamam || 230.75 || āśāpūrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ mārutaṃ tathā | varuṇeśaṃ yameśaṃ ca rāmeśaṃ karkaṭeśvaram || 230.76 || śakreśaṃ somatīrthaṃ ca nandāhradamanuttamam | vaiṣṇavaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca rāmakeśavasaṃjñitam || 230.77 || tathaiva rukmiṇītīrthaṃ śivatīrthamanuttamam | jayavārāhartīrthaṃ ca tīrthamasmāhakāhvayam || 230.78 || aṅgāreśaṃ ca siddheśaṃ tapeśvaramataḥ param | punaḥ siddheśvaraṃ nāmatīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśvaram || 230.79 || parāśareśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ kusumeśamanuttamam | kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā kalakaleśvaram || 230.80 || nyaṅkuvārāhasaṃjñaṃ ca aṅkolaṃ tīrthamuttamam | śvetavārāhatīrthaṃ ca bhārgalaṃ sauramuttamam || 230.81 || huṅkārasvāmitīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ ca śobhanam | saṅgamo madhumatyāśca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram || 230.82 || narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca nadītritayasaṅgamaḥ | anekeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śarbheśaṃ mokṣasaṃjñitam || 230.83 || kāverīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyastīrthaṃ gopeśvarāhvayam | mārkaṇḍeśaṃ ca nāgeśamudambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ || 230.84 || sāmbādityāhvayaṃ tīrthamudambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ | siddheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ tathā siddheśvarīkṛtam || 230.85 || gopeśaṃ kapileśaṃ ca vaidyanāthamanuttamam | piṅgaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca saindhavāyatanaṃ mahat || 230.86 || bhūtīśvarāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhamataḥ param | gautameśvaratīrthaṃ ca daśāśvamedhikaṃ tathā || 230.87 || bhṛgutīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ khyātā saubhāgyasundarī | vṛṣakhātaṃ ca tatraiva kedāraṃ dhūtapātakam || 230.88 || tīrthaṃ dhūteśvarīsaṅgameraṇḍīsaṃjñakaṃ tathā | tīrthaṃ ca kanakeśvaryā jvāleśvaraṃ tataḥ param || 230.89 || śālagrāmāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ somanāthamanuttamam | tathaivodīrṇavārāhaṃ tīrthaṃ candraprabhāsakam || 230.90 || dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ ca tathā siddheśvarābhidham | kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā traivikramaṃ śubham || 230.91 || viśvarūpāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ tathā | mūlaśrīpatitīrthaṃ ca caulaśrīpatisaṃjñakam || 230.92 || devatīrthaṃ haṃsatīrtha prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam | mūlasthānaṃ ca kaṇṭheśamaṭṭahāsamataḥ param || 230.93 || bhūrbhuveśvaratīrthaṃ ca khyātā śūleśvarī tathā | sārasvataṃ dārukeśamaśvinostīrthamuttamam || 230.94 || sāvitrītīrthamatulaṃ vālakhilyeśvaraṃ tathā | narmadeśaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthamanuttamam || 230.95 || macchakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śikhitīrthaṃ ca śobhanam | koṭitīrthaṃ muniśreṣṭhāstatra koṭīśvarī mṛḍā || 230.96 || tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ nāma māṇḍavye śvarasaṃjñitam | tatra nārāyaṇeśaṃ ca akrūreśamataḥ param || 230.97 || devakhātaṃ siddharudraṃ vaidyanāthamanuttamam | tathaiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca uttareśamataḥ param || 230.98 || tathaiva narmadeśāṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathā punaḥ | tathā ca kurarītīrthaṃ ḍhauṇḍheśaṃ daśakanyakam || 230.99 || suvarṇabindutīrthaṃ ca ṛṇapāpapramocanam | bhārabhūteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā muṇḍīśvaraṃ viduḥ || 230.100 || ekaśālaṃ ḍiṇḍipāṇiṃ tīrthaṃ cāpsarasaṃ param | munyālayaṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ gaṇitādevatāhvayam || 230.101 || āmaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ kantheśvaraṃ tathā | āṣāḍhītīrthamityāhuḥ śṛṅgītīrthaṃ tathaiva ca || 230.102 || bakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca kapāleśaṃ tathaiva ca | mārkaṇḍaṃ kapileśaṃ ca eraṇḍīsaṅgamastathā || 230.103 || eraṇḍīdevatātīrthaṃ rāmatīrthamataḥparam | jamadagneḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ || 230.104 || loṭaneśvaratīrtha talluṅkeśanāmakaṃ tathā | vṛṣarakhātaṃ tatra kuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ṛṣisattamāḥ || 230.105 || tathā haṃseśvaraṃnāma tilādaṃ vāsaveśvaram | tathā koṭīśvaraṃ tīrthamalikātīrthamuttamam | vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca revāsāgarasaṅgame || 230.106 || evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā mayā proktā maharṣayaḥ | tīrthasuktāvaliḥ puṇyā grathitā taṭarajjunā || 230.107 || narmadānīranirṇiktā mārkaṇḍeyavinirmitā | maṇḍanāyeha sādhūnāṃ sarvalokahitāya ca || 230.108 || daritadhvāntaśamanīdhāryā dharmārthibhiḥ sadā | ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sakṛjjaptvāśu nāśayet || 230.109 || trikālaṃ japtvā māsotthaṃ śivāgre ca trimāsikam | māsaṃ japtvātha varṣotthaṃ varṣaṃ japtvā śatābdikam || 230.110 || śrāddhakāle ca viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ | paṭhaṃstīrthāvaliṃ puṇyāṃ gayāśrāddhaprado bhavet || 230.111 || pūjākāle ca devānāṃ śraddhayā purataḥ paṭhan | prīṇayetsarvadevāṃśca punāti sakalaṃ kulam || 230.112 || evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā revātīradvayāśritā | mayā proktā muniśreṣṭhāstathaivaśṛṇutānaghāḥ || 230.113 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthāvalikathanaṃ triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.231>
śrīsūta uvāca tathaiva tīrthastabakān vakṣye'hamṛṣisattamāḥ | yaistu tīrthāvalīgumphaḥ pūrvoktairekataḥ kṛtaḥ || 231.1 || vibhakto bhaktalokānāmānandaprathanaḥ śubhaḥ | mṛkaṇḍatanayaḥ pūrvaṃ prāha pārthāya pṛcchate || 231.2 || yathā tathāhaṃ vakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ stabakāniha | śivāmbupānajā puṇyā revā kalpalatā kila || 231.3 || tīradvayodbhūtatīrthaprasūnaiḥ puṣpitā śubhā | yatpuṇyagandhalakṣmyā vai trailokyaṃ surabhīkṛtam || 231.4 || tatpuṣpamakarandasya rasāsvādaviduttamaḥ | bhramaraḥ khalu mārkaṇḍo munirmatimatāṃ varaḥ || 231.5 || tatpuṣpamālāṃ hṛdaye tīrthastabakacitritām | dadhāti satataṃ puṇyāṃ munirbhṛgukulodvahaḥ | tasyāḥ stabakasaṃsthānaṃ vakṣye'hamṛṣisattamāḥ || 231.6 || oṅkāratīrthamārabhya yāvatpaścimasāgaram | saṃgamāḥ pañcatriṃśadvai nadīnāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ || 231.7 || daśaikamuttare tīre satriviṃśati dakṣiṇe | pañcatriṃśattamaḥ śreṣṭho revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ || 231.8 || saṅgamaḥ sahitānyevaṃ revātīradvaye'pi ca | catuḥśatāni tīrthāni prasiddhāni dvijottamāḥ || 231.9 || triśataṃ śivatīrthāni trayīstriṃśatsamanvitam | tatrāpi vyaktito vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ tāni sattamāḥ || 231.10 || mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthāni daśa teṣu munīśvarāḥ | daśādityabhavānyatra navaiva kapileśvarāḥ || 231.11 || somasaṃsthāpitānyaṣṭau tāvanto narmadeśvarāḥ | koṭitīrthānyathāṣṭau ca sapta siddheśvarāstathā || 231.12 || nāgeśvarāśca saptaiva revātīradvaye'pi tu | saptaiva vahnivihitānyathāpyāvartasaptakam || 231.13 || kedāreśvaratīrthāni pañca pañcendrajāni ca | varuṇeśāśca pañcaiva pañcaiva dhanadeśvarāḥ || 231.14 || devatīrthāni pañcaiva catvāro vai yameśvarāḥ | vaidyanāthāśca catvāraścatvāro vānareśvarāḥ || 231.15 || aṅgāreśvaratīrthāni tāvantyeva munīśvarāḥ | sārasvatāni catvāri catvāro dārukeśvarāḥ || 231.16 || gautameśvaratīrthāni trīṇi rāmeśvarāstrayaḥ | kapāleśvaratīrthāni trīṇi haṃsakṛtāni ca || 231.17 || trīṇyeva mokṣatīrthāni trayo vai vimaleśvarāḥ | sahasrayajñatīrthāni trīṇyeva munirabravīt || 231.18 || bhīmeśvarāstrayaḥ khyātāḥ svarṇatīrthāni trīṇi ca | dhautapāpadvayaṃ proktaṃ karañjeśadvayaṃ tathā || 231.19 || ṛṇamocanatīrthe dve tathā skandeśvaradvayam | daśāśvamedhatīrthe dve nandītīrthadvayaṃ dvijāḥ || 231.20 || manmatheśadvayaṃ caiva bhṛgutīrthadvayaṃ tathā | parāśareśvarau dvau ca ayonīsaṃbhavadvayam || 231.21 || vyāseśvaradvayaṃ proktaṃ pitṛtīrthadvayaṃ tathā | nandikeśvaratīrthe dve dvau ca gopeśvarau smṛtau || 231.22 || māruteśadvayaṃ tadvaddvau ca jvāleśvarau smṛtau | śuklatīrthadvayaṃ puṇyamapsareśadvayaṃ tathā || 231.23 || pippaleśvaratīrthe dve māṇḍavyeśvarasaṃjñite | dvīpeśvaradvayaṃ caiva prāha tadvadbhṛgūdvahaḥ | uttareśvaratīrthe dve aśokeśadvayī tathā || 231.24 || dve yodhanapure caiva rohiṇītīrthakadvayam | luṅkeśvaradvayaṃ khyātamākhyānaṃ muninā tathā || 231.25 || saikonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānyekaikaśo dvijāḥ | stabakeṣu kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ dviśataṃ sacaturdaśam || 231.26 || śaivānyetāni tīrthāni vaiṣṇavāni ca sattamāḥ | śṛṇudhvaṃ procyamānāni brāhmaśāktāni ca kramāt || 231.27 || aṣṭaviṃśatitīrthāni vaiṣṇavānyabravīnmuniḥ | teṣu vārāhatīrthāni ṣaḍeva munisattamāḥ || 231.28 || catvāri cakratīrthāni śeṣāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva hi | viṣṇunādhiṣṭhitānyeva prāha pūrvaṃ mṛkaṇḍajaḥ || 231.29 || tathaiva brahmaṇā siddhyai saptatīrthānyavīvadat | triṣu ca brahmaṇaḥ pūjā brahmeśāścaturo'pare | aṣṭāviṃśanmayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam || 231.30 || etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetatpāpaharaṃ param | narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam || 231.31 || sūta uvāca evamuddeśataḥ prokto revātīrthakramo mayā | yathā pārthāya saṃkṣepānmārkaṇḍo munirabravīt || 231.32 || avāntarāṇi tīrthāni teṣu guptānyanekaśaḥ | yatra yāvatpramāṇāni tānyākarṇayatānaghāḥ || 231.33 || oṅkāratīrthaparitaḥ parvatādamarakaṇṭāt | krośadvaye sarvadikṣu sārdhakoṭītrayī matā || 231.34 || tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyayā guptaprakaṭānāṃ dvijottamāḥ | koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ kapilāsaṅgame pṛthak || 231.35 || aśokavanikāyāśca tīrthaṃ lakṣaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | śatamaṃ gāragartāyāḥ saṅgame munisattamāḥ || 231.36 || tīrthānāmayutaṃ tadvatkubjāyāḥ saṅgame sthitam | śataṃ hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgame samavasthitam || 231.37 || tīrthānāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca viśokāsaṅgame sthitā | tathā sahasraṃ tīrthānāṃ saṃsthitaṃ vāgusaṅgame || 231.38 || śataṃ sarasvatīsaṅge śuklatīrthe śatadvayam | sahasraṃ viṣṇutīrtheṣu mahiṣmatyāmathāyutam || 231.39 || śūlabhede ca tīrthānāṃ sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ sthitaṃ dvijāḥ | devagrāme sahasraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ munirabravīt || 231.40 || luṅkeśvare ca tīrthānāṃ sāgrā saptaśatī sthitā | tīrthānyaṣṭottaraśataṃ maṇinadyāśca saṅgame | vaidyanāthe ca tīrthānāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ viduḥ || 231.41 || evaṃ tāvatpramāṇāni tīrthe kumbheśvare dvijāḥ | sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitaṃ revorasaṅgame || 231.42 || tataścāpyadhikāni syuriti mārkaṇḍabhāṣitam | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vyāsadvīpāśritāni ca || 231.43 || saṅgame ca karañjāyāḥ sthitamaṣṭottarāyutam | eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvattīrthānyaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam || 231.44 || dhūtapāpe ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā | skandatīrthe śataṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ muniruktavān || 231.45 || kohaneśa ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā | sārdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ sthitā vai korilāpure || 231.46 || rāmakeśavatīrthe ca sahasraṃ sāgramuktavān | asmāhake sahasraṃ ca tīrthāni nivasanti hi || 231.47 || lakṣāṣṭakaṃ sahasre dve śuklatīrthe dvijottamāḥ | tīrthāni kathayāmāsa purā pārthāya bhārgavaḥ || 231.48 || śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ prāha pratyekaṃ saṅgameṣu ca | nadīnāmavaśiṣṭānāṃ kāverīsaṅgamaṃ vinā || 231.49 || kāveryāḥ saṅgame viprāḥ sthitā pañcaśatī tathā | tīrthānāṃ parvasu tathā viśeṣo muninoditaḥ || 231.50 || mokṣatīrthaṃ hi satprāhuḥ purāṇapuruṣāśritam | bhṛgoḥ kṣetre ca tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā samāśritā || 231.51 || sādhikānāmṛṣiśreṣṭhā vaktuṃ śakto hi ko bhavet | sarvāmarāśrayaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ tathā || 231.52 || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ siddhisādhanam | bhārabhūtyāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 231.53 || akrūreśvaratīrthe ca sārdhaṃ tīrthaśataṃ sthitam | vimaleśvaratīrthe tu revāsāgarasaṅgame | daśāyutāni tīrthānāṃ sādhikānyabravīnmuniḥ || 231.54 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthasaṃkhyāparigaṇanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
<5.3.232>
sūta uvāca iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā revāmāhātmyamuttamam | yathopadiṣṭaṃ pārthāya mārkaṇḍeyena vai purā || 232.1 || tathā tīrthakadambāśca teṣu tīrthaviśeṣataḥ | prādhānyena mayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam || 232.2 || etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetatpāpaharaṃ param | narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam || 232.3 || saptakalpānugo vipro narmadāyāṃ munīśvarāḥ | mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānparamārthaviduttamaḥ || 232.4 || saṃsevya sarvatīrthāni nadīḥ sarvāśca vai purā | bahukalpasmarāṃ revāmālakṣya śivadehajām || 232.5 || me kaleti ca śarvoktāṃ śaraṇaṃ śarvajāṃ yayau | ajarāmamarāṃ devīṃ daityadhvaṃsakarīṃ parām || 232.6 || mahāvibhavasaṃyuktāṃ bhavaghnīṃ bhavajāhnavīm | tasyāmābadhya satprema jātaḥ so'pyajarāmaraḥ || 232.7 || ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyaśca sattamāḥ | vyavasthitāni revāyāstīrayugme pade pade || 232.8 || sāritaḥ paritaḥ santi satīrthāstu sahasraśaḥ | na tulāṃ yānti revāyāstāśca manye munīśvarāḥ || 232.9 || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭamakhilaṃ dvijāḥ | yanmaheśamukhācchrutvā vāyurāha ṛṣīnprati || 232.10 || tadvanmṛkaṇḍatanayo'pyanubhūyākhilāṃ nadīm | satīrthāṃ padaśaḥ prāha pāṇḍuputrāya pāvanīm || 232.11 || etacca kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ | narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || 232.12 || kimanyaiḥ saritāṃ toyaiḥ sevitaistu sahasraśaḥ | yadi saṃsevyate toyaṃ revāyāḥ pāpanāśanam || 232.13 || mekalājalasaṃsevī muktimāpnoti śāśvatīm || 232.14 || yathā yathā bhajenmartyo yadyadicchati tīrthagaḥ | tattadāpnoti niyataṃ śraddhayāśraddhayāpi ca || 232.15 || idaṃ brahmā hariridamidaṃ sākṣātparo haraḥ | idaṃ brahma nirākāraṃ kaivalyaṃ narmadājalam || 232.16 || tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni nadyo hṛdayaphalapradāḥ | yāvanna smaryate revā sevāhevā kalau naraiḥ || 232.17 || dhruvaṃ loke hitārthāya śivena svaśarīrataḥ | śaktiḥ kāpi saridrūpā reveyamavatāritā || 232.18 || tāvadgarjanti yajñāśca vanakṣetrādayo bhṛśam | yāvanna narmadānāmakīrtanaṃ kriyate kalau || 232.19 || garimā gāṇyate tāvattapodānavratādiṣu | narairvā prāpyate yāvadbhuvi bhargabhavā dhunī || 232.20 || ye vasantyuttare kūle rudrasyānucarā hi te | vasanti yāmyatīre ye lokaṃ te yānti vaiṣṇavam || 232.21 || dhanyāste deśavaryāste yeṣu deśeṣu narmadā | narakāntakarī śaśvatsaṃśritā śarvanirmitā || 232.22 || kṛtapuṇyāśca te lokāḥ śokāya na bhavanti te | ye pibanti jalaṃ puṇyaṃ pārvatīpatisindhujam || 232.23 || idaṃ pavitramatulaṃ revāyāścaritaṃ dvijāḥ | śṛṇoti yaḥ kīrtayate mucyate sarvapātakaḥ || 232.24 || yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiśca saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ | śrutaiśca paṭhitaistasmātphalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 232.25 || satrayājī phalaṃ yacca labhate dvādaśābdikam | śrutvā sakṛcca revāyāścaritaṃ tatphalaṃ labhet || 232.26 || sarvatīrthāvagāhācca yatphalaṃ sāgarādiṣu | sakṛcchrutvā ca māhātmyaṃ revāyāstatphalaṃ labhet || 232.27 || etaddharmyamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣvanuttamam | deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi nagare grāmamadhyataḥ || 232.28 || gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya likhitaṃ sārvavārṇikam | sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ || 232.29 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mārge'yaṃ devasevitaḥ | gurūṇāṃ ca guruḥ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam || 232.30 || yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ devabhāṣitam | brāhmaṇo vedavānbhūyātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || 232.31 || dhanāḍhyo jāyate vaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet || 232.32 || saubhāgyasantatiṃ nārī śrutvaitatsamavāpnuyāt | śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ svargavāsaṃ janma caivottame kule || 232.33 || rasabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmidhruṅmitravañcakaḥ | goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ || 232.34 || brahmaghnaśca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ | narmadācaritaṃ śṛṇvaṃstāmabdaṃ yo'bhiṣevate || 232.35 || sarvapāpavinirmukto jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | pākabhedī vṛthāpākī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ || 232.36 || parīvādī guroḥ pitroḥ sādhūnāṃ nṛpatestathā | te'pi śrutvā ca pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 232.37 || ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śastraṃ śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ | pūjayanti ca tacchāstraṃ nārmadaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 232.38 || puṣpaiḥ phalaiścandanādyairbhojanairvividhairapi | śāstre'sminpūjite devāḥ pūjitā guravastathā || 232.39 || iha loke pare caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 232.40 || pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vācakaṃ śāstrameva ca | vedapāṭhaiśca yatpuṇyamagnihotraiśca pālitaiḥ || 232.41 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti narmadācarite śubhe | kurukṣetre ca yatpuṇyaṃ prabhāse puṣkare tathā || 232.42 || rudrāvarte gayāyāṃ ca vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame || 232.43 || evamādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | narmadācaritaṃ śrutvā tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ labhet || 232.44 || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadācaritaṃ śubham | yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā śṛṇudhvaṃ tatphalaṃ mahat || 232.45 || samāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ devakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ | rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā śivena saha modate || 232.46 || dharmākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvākhyāneṣvanuttamam | gṛhe'pi paṭhyate yasya caturvarṇasya sattamāḥ || 232.47 || dhanyaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ manye gṛhasthaṃ cāpi tatkulam | pustakaṃ pūjayedyastu narmadācaritasya tu || 232.48 || narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ | vācake pūjite tadvaddevāśca ṛṣayo'rcitāḥ || 232.49 || lekhayitvā ca sakalaṃ revācaritamuttamam | bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ yo dadāti dvijanmane || 232.50 || narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snānadānena yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 232.51 || etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam | svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrttivardhanam || 232.52 || dharmyamāyuṣyamatulaṃ duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 232.53 || yatpradattamidaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ vācyate dvijaiḥ | śivaloke sthitistasya purāṇākṣaravatsarī || 232.54 || iti nigaditametannarmadāyāścaritraṃ pavanagaditamagryaṃ śarvavaktrādavāpya | tribhuvanajanavandyaṃ tvetadādau munīnāṃ kulapatipuratastatsūtamukhyena sādhu || 232.55 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍasamāptirevākhaṇḍapustakadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
